title: Multi-mode medical image fusion method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 刘星宇, 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a multi-mode medical image fusion method and system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring two-dimensional medical images of at least two modalities of a patient; respectively inputting the two-dimensional medical images of the at least two modes into corresponding pre-trained image segmentation network models to respectively obtain the output of the two-dimensional medical images of the body position areas of the modes; performing point cloud registration fusion on the two-dimensional medical images of the body position areas of each mode based on a point cloud registration algorithm to obtain multi-mode fusion two-dimensional medical images; and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction processing on the multi-modal fusion two-dimensional medical image to obtain the multi-modal fusion three-dimensional medical image. The multi-mode medical image registration method has high accuracy, is suitable for various complex image fusion conditions, and can also improve the operation accuracy of operators and the operation efficiency.
assignee_clean: 刘星宇; 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Electronic medical record named entity recognition method and system integrating deep learning and rules
assignee: 浪潮云信息技术股份公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying a named entity of an electronic medical record by fusing deep learning and rules, which belong to the field of natural language processing, and solve the technical problem of how to identify a civil-object entity of unstructured electronic medical record text, improve the accuracy of identifying the named entity of the Chinese electronic medical record, and adopt the following technical scheme: the method comprises the following steps: acquiring electronic medical record data; the electronic medical record naming entity labeling specification definition and entity labeling; constructing an entity library according to the electronic medical dictionary; model training is carried out on the labeling data based on a deep learning Bert-BiLSTM-CRF model, and rule matching is carried out based on an electronic medical record entity library; and performing rule matching according to an entity library constructed by the electronic medical dictionary, and fusing the entity library with an entity result identified by the deep learning model to finally obtain the named entity of the electronic medical record. The invention also discloses an electronic medical record named entity recognition system integrating the deep learning and the rules.
assignee_clean: 浪潮云信息技术股份公司
primary_assignee: 浪潮云信息技术股份公司

title: Cloud-based distributed healthcare system with biometric devices and associated methods
abstract: A system includes biometric devices generating biometric data on a person, with the biometric devices transmitting the biometric data via respective messaging protocols. A messaging platform receives the biometric data from the biometric devices based on the respective messaging protocols. A biometric data server receives the biometric data from the messaging platform. The biometric data server includes a biometric database, a biometric data algorithm, and a biometric data analyzer. The biometric database is to store the biometric data. The biometric data algorithm is to generate a biometric data model over time based on the biometric data to determine the person's version of normal bio-feedback at any given time in comparison to other like time periods. The biometric data analyzer is to analyze new biometric data in view of the biometric data model, and to generate at least one caregiver notification alert when an anomaly is detected outside the biometric data model.

title: Deep learning tissue deformation for medical imaging
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: The invention relates to deep learning tissue deformation for medical imaging. A depth machine learning method is used for medical image fusion (24) by a medical imaging system (48). This method can be used for different applications. The same deep learning is used for a given application, but with different specialized training data. The resulting deep-learned classifier provides a simplified feature vector in response to the input intensity of one image and the displacement vector of the patches for the one image relative to the other image. The output feature vectors are used to determine (16) a deformation for medical image fusion (24).
assignee_clean: 西门子保健有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司

title: Distributed machine learning systems, apparatus, and methods
assignee: Nantomics, Llc, Nant Holdings Ip, Llc
abstract: A distributed, online machine learning system is presented. Contemplated systems include many private data servers, each having local private data. Researchers can request that relevant private data servers train implementations of machine learning algorithms on their local private data without requiring de-identification of the private data or without exposing the private data to unauthorized computing systems. The private data servers also generate synthetic or proxy data according to the data distributions of the actual data. The servers then use the proxy data to train proxy models. When the proxy models are sufficiently similar to the trained actual models, the proxy data, proxy model parameters, or other learned knowledge can be transmitted to one or more non-private computing devices. The learned knowledge from many private data servers can then be aggregated into one or more trained global models without exposing private data.

title: Machine learning classification and training for digital microscopy images
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices for training models or algorithms for classifying or detecting particles or materials in microscopy images are disclosed. A method includes receiving a plurality of microscopy images of a specimen and a classification for the specimen. The plurality of microscopy images includes a first image captured at a first magnification and a second image captured at the first magnification with a different focus than the first image. The method includes training a machine learning model or algorithm using the plurality of images, wherein the first image and the second image are provided with one or more labels indicating the classification.

title: Deep learning-based medical text classification method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a medical text classification method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a word vector sequence of a medical text to be classified and a word vector sequence of disease category information, sequentially inputting the word vector sequence of the medical text to be classified and the word vector sequence of the disease category information into a recurrent neural network and a bidirectional attention mechanism layer for processing to obtain the medical disease information vector sequence, and processing the medical disease information vector sequence through a pooling layer and a full connection layer to obtain a classification prediction result of the medical text to be classified. The invention also discloses a medical text classification device based on deep learning and a computer storage medium. The invention effectively utilizes the category information of the diseases while representing based on the semantic of the medical text by using a recurrent neural network and a bidirectional attention mechanism, does not need to help additional characteristic engineering, and improves the classification effect.

title: Voxel-level machine learning with or without cloud-based support in medical imaging
abstract: A single level machine-learnt classifier is used in medical imaging. A gross or large structure is located using any approach, including non-ML approaches such as region growing or level-sets. Smaller portions of the structure are located using ML applied to relatively small patches (small relative to the organ or overall structure of interest). The classification of small patches allows for a simple ML approach specific to a single scale or at a voxel/pixel level. The use of small patches may allow for providing classification as a service (e.g., cloud-based classification) since partial image data is to be transmitted. The use of small patches may allow for feedback on classification and updates to the ML. The use of small patches may allow for the creation of a labeled library of classification partially based on ML. Given a near complete labeled library, a simple matching of patches or a lookup can replace ML classification for faster throughput.

title: System and method for denoising medical images through deep learning network
assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
abstract: The invention provides a system and a method for denoising medical images through a deep learning network. The present invention provides methods and systems for selectively denoising medical images. In an exemplary method, one or more deep learning networks are trained to map a corrupted image onto first and second types of artifacts present in the corresponding corrupted image. One or more trained learning networks are then used to pick the first type and the second type of artifact from the particular medical image. The first type of artifact is removed to a first extent and the second type of artifact is removed to a second extent. The first degree and the second degree may be different. For example, one type of artifact may be completely suppressed while another type of artifact may be partially removed from the medical image.
assignee_clean: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司

title: Machine learning classification and training for digital microscopy cytology images
abstract: The disclosure relates to machine learning classification of cells/particles in microscopy images. A method includes inputting an image having invisible features into an initial neural network classifier (INNC) of a convolutional neural network. The INNC is trained using images with ground truth derived from out-of-channel mechanisms. The method includes generating an intermediate classification from the original image. The intermediate classification and the original image are input into a final neural network classifier (FNNC) that comprises one or more bypass layers to feed forward an initial, final classification from a final activation layer to a final convolutional layer thereby bypassing a final pooling layer. The final convolutional layer has an increased kernel size and more filters than the initial convolutional layer. The final classification is generated based on the invisible features in the original image and outputted.

title: Method and system for fractional flow reserve based on pure geometry machine learning
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: Methods and systems for determining hemodynamic metrics, such as Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR), for a location of interest in a coronary artery of a patient are disclosed. Medical image data of a patient is received. A patient-specific coronary arterial tree geometry of the patient is extracted from the medical image data. Geometric features are extracted from the patient-specific coronary arterial tree geometry of the patient. Hemodynamic indices, such as FFR, are calculated for a location of interest in the patient-specific coronary arterial tree based on the extracted geometric features using a trained machine-learning based proxy model. A machine learning based proxy model is trained based on geometric features extracted from synthetically generated coronary arterial tree geometries.
