title: Apparatus, systems and methods for providing alarm and sensor data to emergency networks
abstract: A disclosed method includes: receiving an alarm notification; determining that there is a verification for the alarm notification such that the alarm notification is not a false alarm; and pushing the alarm notification to an emergency network entity along with an indication that the alarm has been verified in response to determining that there is a verification. Another disclosed method includes monitoring an emergency queue at an emergency network entity for incoming queue entries from an emergency data manager; determining correlations for the incoming queue entries based on data associated with each incoming queue entry; and generating a link for each correlated queue entry linking each correlated queue entry to a primary queue entry in response to determining correlations.

title: Systems, methods, and devices for developing patient-specific spinal implants, treatments, operations, and/or procedures
abstract: A surgical planning and assessment system is disclosed. The system may include a computing system having a processor, a data store, and a patient specific planning and analysis module. The system may be configured to store a patient specific target plan including a digital representation of a spinal rod having a target geometry and transform the digital representation into a curved line. The system may generate a spline data set comprising a plurality of spline segments that are sequentially linked to one another. The system may adjust, iteratively, each spline segment until the plurality of spline segments approximate the curved line. The system may generate a digital file comprising drawings for manufacturing a spinal rod based on the plurality of spline segments. In various embodiments, each spline segment may be defined by a corresponding arc or a corresponding line extending between a corresponding starting point and a corresponding ending point.

title: Federal learning method, system, device and medium for medical image segmentation
abstract: The invention discloses a federal learning method, a system, equipment and a medium for medical image segmentation, belongs to the field of computer vision in artificial intelligence, and is used for improving the generalization ability of a deep neural network model to image segmentation under the condition that a medical institution does not share private data. Firstly, obtaining an amplitude spectrum from an original medical image at the local end of a client through fast Fourier transform, and respectively interpolating the amplitude spectrum with amplitude spectrums of other clients by adopting a continuous frequency space interpolation algorithm to obtain an interpolated amplitude spectrum; selecting amplitude values capable of representing various data set information from each amplitude spectrum by adopting an active learning method of core set sampling, and then carrying out Fourier inversion by combining phase values to obtain a batch of new data sets; adopting a meta-learning paradigm, using an original medical data set for training, and using a new data set for testing; and highlighting the boundary in the image by utilizing contrast learning, and updating the parameters by adopting a contrast loss function.

title: Image attenuation correction method, image attenuation correction device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image attenuation correction method, an image attenuation correction device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an original medical image according to the acquired scanning data of the object to be detected; the original medical image is an image before attenuation correction and comprises a region of interest; inputting the original medical image into a preset neural network model, and determining an attenuation correction image corresponding to the original medical image; the neural network model is trained from a gold standard attenuation correction image, which includes the region of interest. By adopting the method, the accuracy of image attenuation correction can be improved.

title: Processing method for result of medical examination
abstract: Provided is a method of predicting a future progress of an examinee based on an artificial intelligence technology by analyzing recent medical examination data of the examinee. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method of machine-learning a model for predicting a future progress includes: obtaining an optimal time interval by increasing a time interval applied to a time axis of a two-dimensional feature matrix including the time axis and a corresponding feature until a performance evaluation result of a recurrent neural network (RNN)-based model trained by using the feature matrix is no longer improved; configuring the feature matrix with the time axis according to the optimal time interval, and obtaining an optimal look-back window size by increasing a look-back window size until a performance evaluation result of the RNN-based model when the feature matrix is input is no longer improved; and training the RNN-based model according to the optimal look-back window size by using the feature matrix having the optimal time interval.

title: Method and system of performing medical treatment outcome assessment or medical condition diagnostic
assignee: The Royal Institution For The Advancement Of Learning / Mcgill University
abstract: There is described a computer-implemented method of performing medical treatment outcome assessment or medical condition diagnostic. The method generally has receiving a three-dimensional (3D) anatomical image representing a region of a body of a patient; generating a 3D invariant image by processing the 3D anatomical image based on an isophote structure invariant entity (e.g., mean curvature of isophotes, Gaussian curvature of isophotes); using an image processing unit, processing the 3D invariant image and generating an output based on said processing, the output being either: medical treatment outcome data indicative of an outcome assessment of a treatment received by said patient; or medical condition diagnostic data indicative of a diagnostic of a medical condition of said patient.
assignee_clean: the royal institution for the advancement of learning mcgill university
primary_assignee: the royal institution for the advancement of learning mcgill university

title: Feature recognition in medical imaging
abstract: Concepts for feature recognition in medical imaging of objects are presented. One such concept utilizes a bayesian deep learning network to process a medical image to determine a first image feature of interest and associated uncertainty values, the first image feature being located in a first sub-region of the image. It also processes the medical image with a generation countermeasure network to determine a second image feature of interest and associated uncertainty value within the first sub-region of the image. The first sub-region of the image is classified based on the first and second image features and their associated uncertainty values.

title: Passive adaptation technique
abstract: An adaptation system comprising: a communication subsystem comprising an input subsystem and at least one of an output subsystem or an input/output subsystem; and a processing subsystem, wherein the processing subsystem is configured to automatically develop fitting data for the hearing prosthesis at least in part via data input by the communication subsystem.

title: Active titration of one or more nerve stimulators to treat obstructive sleep apnea
abstract: The present disclose generally relates to systems and methods for active titration of one or more cranial or peripheral nerve stimulators to treat obstructive sleep apnea. The active titration can be accomplished in an automated fashion by a closed-loop process. The closed-loop process can be executed by a computing device that includes a non-transitory memory storing instructions and a processor to execute the instructions to perform operations. The operations can include defining initial parameters for the one or more cranial or peripheral nerve stimulators for a patient; receiving sensor data from sensors associated with the patient based on a stimulation with the one or more cranial or peripheral stimulators programmed according to the initial parameters; and adjusting the initial parameters based on the sensor data.

title: System and method for image processing
assignee: Chunhua JIANG, Shurui ZHAO, Hanyu WANG, Haihua Zhou, Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A system and method for image processing are provided. A pre-processed image may be obtained. The pre-processed image may be decomposed into a low-frequency image and a high-frequency image. At least one grayscale transformation range may be determined based on the low-frequency image. At least one grayscale transformation parameter may be determined based on the at least one grayscale transformation range. The low-frequency image may be transformed based on the at least one grayscale transformation parameter to obtain a transformed low-frequency image. A transformed image may be generated by reconstructing the transformed low-frequency image and the high-frequency image.

title: Medical image automatic segmentation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image automatic segmentation method based on deep learning, which is specifically realized as follows: (1) Acquiring a manual segmentation result of an original medical image and a target area of a patient, and constructing a training data set related to a segmentation task; (2) Designing a deep U-shaped convolutional neural network model fusing a residual error module and an attention mechanism; (3) Constructing a mixed loss function by using the Dice and the binary cross entropy; (4) performing network training by using the training data set; (5) And dividing the target area in the test image by using the trained network. The invention relates to a full-automatic end-to-end medical image segmentation method which can effectively solve the problems of fuzzy segmentation boundary, low small target detection rate, unstable training process, difficult convergence and the like in the current deep learning image segmentation field.

title: Early warning method, system and readable storage medium for infectious diseases
assignee: 翼健(上海)信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an early warning method, a system and a readable storage medium for infectious diseases, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a deep learning framework for early warning of infectious diseases, and collecting multiple sources and multiple types of original data related to infectious diseases and syndrome; preprocessing multiple sources and multiple types of original data through an embedded layer of a deep learning architecture to balance dimension differences of all original data and obtain different preprocessed data; splicing different preprocessed data into a unified data vector by a fusion layer of the deep learning architecture; carrying out epidemic situation prediction in two dimensions of time and space by a prediction model of a deep learning architecture prediction layer, and obtaining a predicted patient number; and according to the predicted patient number value obtained by the deep learning framework, monitoring the change state in time and space, and sending out an early warning signal when abnormality occurs. The invention can realize accurate early warning of epidemic situation of infectious diseases and syndrome, and further prevent spread of epidemic situation.

title: Multi-feature fusion assisted pulmonary glass shadow nodule detection system and medium
assignee: 安徽医学高等专科学校
abstract: The multi-feature fusion assisted pulmonary glass shadow nodule detection system provided by the invention comprises a processor, a program instruction and a control unit, wherein the processor is configured to call the program instruction to execute the following method: acquiring a medical image to be detected; the medical image to be detected comprises an HRCT image; setting texture features as manually extracted features; extracting manually extracted features in the medical image to be detected by using a preset feature extraction method; constructing a deep learning neural network, and training the deep learning neural network; inputting the medical image to be detected into a trained deep learning neural network to obtain deep learning characteristics in the medical image to be detected; and fusing the manually extracted features of the medical image to be detected and the deep learning features to obtain a detection result of the medical image to be detected. The system solves the problems of misdiagnosis and missed diagnosis caused by the prior medical expert film reading and diagnosis method.

title: System and method for noise reduction
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system for active noise cancellation for a subject placed in a scanning bore of a medical imaging apparatus. The system may be directed to perform operations including detecting first noise signals by a first array of noise detection units disposed in the scanning bore, at least part of the first noise signals resulting from an operation of gradient coils of the medical imaging apparatus. The system may also be directed to perform operations including detecting, by a second array of noise detection units, second noise signals near a target position associated with the subject. The system may further be directed to perform operations including determining anti-noise signals based on the first noise signals, the second noise signals and excitation signals used for the operation of the medical imaging apparatus.

title: Emergency electronic medical record management system and management method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an emergency electronic medical record management system and an emergency electronic medical record management method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring physiological sign parameters of a patient, acquiring physiological data of the patient by utilizing an optical imaging technology based on the physiological sign parameters of the patient, and generating non-invasive physiological data; performing automatic medical record analysis by utilizing an NLP technology based on non-invasive physiological data to generate intelligent structured medical record data; based on the intelligent structured medical record data, utilizing an reinforcement learning technology to embed a personalized diagnosis and treatment scheme, and generating a personalized medical record data set; performing remote collaboration cross-platform interconnection management based on the personalized medical record data set to realize emergency electronic medical record management; the invention utilizes the physiological physical sign parameters of the patient to process the multi-element data so as to improve the processing efficiency of the emergency electronic medical record management data, reduce errors and improve the data sharing efficiency.

title: System and method for cardiovascular monitoring and reporting
assignee: Anna Barnacka, Charles R Bridges, Siddharth Patel
abstract: A system and method for cardiovascular monitoring and reporting are disclosed. The system (CV monitoring system) includes a data analysis system and an in-ear biosensor system that preferably includes left and right earbuds. The earbuds include infrasound/vibration sensors that detect biosignals from the individual including signals associated with cardiovascular activity (CV signals). The analysis system calculates cardiovascular function measurements (CV function measurements) based upon the CV signals. The CV monitoring system uses machine learning to predict blood pressure (BP) measurements of the individual based upon the CV signals and the calculated CV function measurements. In an embodiment, the CV monitoring system includes an EKG detection system that detects EKG signals associated with heart function. The analysis system can calculate additional CV function measurements from the EKG signals to augment the CV function measurements calculated from the CV signals, and predict BP measurements using the full complement of CV function measurements.

title: Method, system and computer readable medium for automatic segmentation of a 3D medical image
abstract: A method, a system and a computer readable medium for automatic segmentation of a 3D medical image, the 3D medical image comprising an object to be segmented, the method characterized by comprising: carrying out, by using a machine learning model, in at least two of a first, a second and a third orthogonal orientation, 2D segmentations for the object in slices of the 3D medical image to derive 2D segmentation data; determining a location of a bounding box (10) within the 3D medical image based on the 2D segmentation data, the bounding box (10) having predetermined dimensions; and carrying out a 3D segmentation for the object in the part of the 3D medical image corresponding to the bounding box (10).

title: Systems and methods for automated digital image content extraction and analysis
abstract: Systems and methods are configured to extract images from provided source data files and to preprocess such images for content-based image analysis. An image analysis system applies one or more machine-learning based models for identifying specific features within analyzed images, and for determining one or more measurements based at least in part on the identified features. Such measurements may be embodied as absolute measurements for determining an absolute distance between features, or relative measurements for determining a relative relationship between features. The determined measurements are input into one or more machine-learning based models for determining a classification for the image.

title: Image processing system, image processing method, and non-transitory storage medium
abstract: An image processing apparatus includes a first classification unit configured to classify each of a plurality of pixels included in a three-dimensional medical image using a first classifier for classifying each pixel into a plurality of classes including a class representing a first target region, a determination unit configured to determine an image region including the first target region and a second target region from the three-dimensional medical image based on a first classification result, a second classification unit configured to classify each of a plurality of pixels included in the determined image region using a second classifier for classifying each pixel into a plurality of classes including at least either one of a class representing the first target region and a class representing the second target region, and an integration unit configured to integrate the first and the second classification results to acquire a third classification result.

title: Techniques for learning effective musical features for generative and retrieval-based applications
abstract: A method includes receiving a non-linguistic input associated with an input musical content. The method also includes, using a model that embeds multiple musical features describing different musical content and relationships between the different musical content in a latent space, identifying one or more embeddings based on the input musical content. The method further includes at least one of: (i) identifying stored musical content based on the one or more identified embeddings or (ii) generating derived musical content based on the one or more identified embeddings. In addition, the method includes presenting at least one of: the stored musical content or the derived musical content. The model is generated by training a machine learning system having one or more first neural network components and one or more second neural network components such that embeddings of the musical features in the latent space have a predefined distribution.

title: Iterative image reconstruction
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for performing operations including: accessing a current structural estimate of a region of interest; generating a first simulated X-ray measurement based on the current structural estimate of the region of interest; receiving a first real X-ray measurement; and generating an update to the current structural estimate of the region of interest as a function of the first simulated X-ray measurement and the first real X-ray measurement, the update being generated invariant on the current structural estimate.

title: A kind of medical image search method converted based on deep learning and Radon
abstract: A kind of medical image search method converted based on deep learning and Radon is related to computer vision and field of image search.In " thick " retrieval phase, there is the region of significant object using the detection of BING target proposed algorithm, by the introducing portion mean value Pooling in depth convolutional network framework, the extractable significant differentiating characteristics based on region out simultaneously reduce characteristic dimension, then polymerize and to form a global characteristics expression.In feature vector quantizing process, similarity measurement calculates high complexity issue between block eigenvector is solved using product quantization algorithm." thin " retrieval phase, image can be done integral projection in multi-angle by Radon transformation, Top50 image obtained in " thick " retrieval is generated Radon bar code by Radon transformation, reaches more precise search by similarity measurement by the characteristic for obtaining image more details information.The present invention improves the accuracy rate of medical image retrieval, overcomes directly not strong using convolutional neural networks bring feature differentiation, characteristic dimension higher medical image retrieval problem.

title: Cross-modal synthesis method for medical images from cerebral infarction CT to MRI conventional sequence
assignee: 英瑞云医疗科技(烟台)有限公司
abstract: A method for cross-modal synthesis of medical images of a routine sequence of brain stem CT to MRI, the method comprising the steps of: preprocessing CT data and MRI data to process original medical image data into an image format convenient for computer processing; converting acquired CT data and MRI data in a Dicom format into a Nifit format by using MRIcron software, further converting into a two-dimensional slice in a PNG format, and manufacturing a brain stem CT-MRI paired data set in the PNG format; and establishing a deep learning model aiming at the pre-processed brain stem CT-MRI paired data set, wherein the deep learning model is improved by taking a GAN model as a basic framework, and comprises a generator G and a discriminator D.
