primary_assignee: the regents of the university of california

title: Portable non-face-to-face diagnostic device equipped with sensor
abstract: The present invention relates to a portable non-face-to-face diagnostic device equipped with a sensor. The portable non-face-to-face diagnostic device comprises: a housing; an input/output device; a communication module; a display; a camera; an environmental sensor; a biosensor; a kit insertion part; an inspection camera; and a processor. According to the present invention, a mobile remote diagnosis service can be provided.

title: Positioning method and device for intraoperative preset area, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司, 广州柏视数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for positioning an intraoperative preset area, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical three-dimensional image of a preset region, and extracting a region of interest (ROI) of the medical three-dimensional image; acquiring a plurality of two-dimensional projection plain films of the ROI at different angles in an operation; generating a region mask corresponding to the ROI and each two-dimensional projection plain film according to a plurality of two-dimensional projection plain films with different angles, the medical three-dimensional image and the depth learning network model; and carrying out three-dimensional space mapping on the region mask of the ROI in a plurality of two-dimensional projection plain films with different angles and the two-dimensional projection plain films with different angles to generate three-dimensional positioning information of the ROI in operation so as to position a preset region. The positioning method, the positioning device, the storage medium and the electronic equipment for the intraoperative preset area can realize accurate three-dimensional positioning, solve the problem of overhigh dosage of conventional operation positioning in the prior art and realize the requirements of accurate, convenient and efficient positioning in an operation.
assignee_clean: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司; 广州柏视数据科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司

title: XR device and method for controlling the same
abstract: The present invention relates to an XR device and a method for controlling the same, and more particularly, is applicable to the fields of 5G communication technology, robot technology, autonomous driving technology, and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The method for controlling an XR device comprises executing a home appliance arrangement application in the XR device by a user, displaying an indoor space on a screen of the XR device, displaying at least one home appliance on the screen of the XR device, selecting the at least one home appliance and a specific space in the indoor space by the user, and guiding at least one of a capacity of the at least one home appliance and an arrangement position of the specific space to the user based on the specific space.

title: Method and device for determining radiation parameters, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a radiation parameter determining method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium, the method comprising: dividing the image to be processed through a dividing network to obtain a first contour of a target area and a second contour of a protection area; inputting the image to be processed, the first contour, the second contour and the preset radiation dose into a dose array network to obtain a dose array; inputting the dose array, the first contour and the second contour into a radiation parameter network to obtain initial radiation parameters; and determining a target radiation parameter according to the initial radiation parameter and the preset radiation dose. According to the radiation parameter determining method, the target area and the protection area in the image are automatically segmented through the segmentation network, so that errors of manual intervention are reduced. And the initial radiation parameters of the medical instrument are determined through the dose array network and the radiation parameter network, so that the target radiation parameters are determined, the process of determining the radiation parameters can be automatically realized, and the working efficiency and the accuracy of the scheme are improved.
assignee_clean: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司

title: Sample-efficient adaptive text-to-speech
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for generating an adaptive audio-generation model. One of the methods includes generating an adaptive audio-generation model including learning a plurality of embedding vectors and parameter values of a neural network using training data comprising first text and audio data representing a plurality of different individual speakers speaking portions of the first text, wherein the plurality of embedding vectors represent respective voice characteristics of the plurality of different individual speakers. The adaptive audio-generation model is adapted for a new individual speaker using adaptation data comprising second text and audio data representing the new individual speaker speaking portions of the second text, the new individual speaker being different from each of the plurality of individual speakers, wherein adapting the audio-generation model includes learning a new embedding vector for the new individual speaker.

title: Device for recommending and selling medical supplies through user's medical information
abstract: The present invention provides a device for recommending and selling medical products through user's medical information including a computing device with one or more processors and one or more memories for storing instructions executable by the processor. The device comprises: a prescription receiving unit configured to receive user prescription information that is prescription information generated from a medical institution terminal for a user's disease from the outside when a user account is logged in; a category selection unit for selecting first disease category information matching the first disease information from among a plurality of pieces of disease category information pre-stored in a database on the basis of the first disease information included in the received user prescription information, when the user prescription information is received by the prescription receiving unit; a medical product display unit for controlling information output through an output means to output a plurality of pieces of medical product data included in the first disease category information selected by the category selection unit in a manner distinguished from other medical product data, when medical product data, which is information on a plurality of medical products that can be sold through the output means, is output; and a medical supplies sales unit for performing a purchase process for medical products corresponding to the purchase request input, when receiving a purchase request input for at least one from among a plurality of pieces of medical product data output through the output means. In addition to this, various embodiments identified through the present document are possible.

title: Synchronized placement of surgical implant hardware
abstract: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for robotic insertion of a screw, a rod, or another component of a surgical implant into a patient are disclosed. Synchronous insertion of screws is performed by multiple surgical robots or a single surgical robot having multiple arms and end effectors. The movements of each robotic arm are coordinated into position in preparation of the insertion of multiple surgical implant components at the same time or in the same surgical step. The insertion of the surgical implant components is performed while monitoring the insertion progress. The insertion is completed autonomously or in coordination with a surgeon.

title: Neuromodulation therapy development environment
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for generating specific software implementations of neuromodulation-therapy algorithms. A dataset may be received that includes operational specifications that correspond to a plurality of types of neuromodulation-therapy implant devices. A neuromodulation-therapy design interface may provide a representation of the neuromodulation-therapy implant device. A selection if a particular representation of a particular neuromodulation-therapy implant device may be received. Hardware characteristics of the particular neuromodulation-therapy implant device may be used to determine constraints of the implant device. A listing of neuromodulation-therapy parameters that is constraining according to the constraints may be presented. In response to a selection of a parameter, executable software code corresponding to a specific implementation of a neuromodulation-therapy algorithm may be generated. The executable software code may be transmitted to a computing device compatible with the specific implementation.

title: Circulating tumor cell detection method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 西人马大周(深圳)医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a circulating tumor cell detection method, a circulating tumor cell detection device, circulating tumor cell detection equipment and a circulating tumor cell detection medium. The method comprises the following steps: injecting a lymph fluid sample to be detected into the comprehensive molten iron power cell separation iFCS device to obtain a lymph fluid sample after white blood cells are filtered; generating a digital slice of the leukocyte-filtered lymph fluid sample; classifying the digital slices by adopting an image classification identification model to obtain a classification result of classifying the pixel points in the digital slices according to the cell types to which the pixel points belong; and detecting whether the digital slice contains the circulating tumor cells according to the classification result to obtain a detection result. According to the embodiment of the invention, the concentration of the circulating tumor cells can be increased through the iFCS device, and the accuracy and the success rate of the identification of the circulating tumor cells are improved.
assignee_clean: 西人马大周 深圳 医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 西人马大周 深圳 医疗科技有限公司

title: Medical data governance
abstract: A medical data governance system records, secures, and provides appropriate access to all patient data. By concentrating all available relevant medical data into a single source, and providing a subset of data to each receiving subsystem with the correct source and time reference, the medical data governance system becomes the true source of data and guarantees the data consistency through the use of block chain signatures.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image processing method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: removing the metal artifact of the medical image according to the position information of the metal artifact in the medical image to obtain a target image, wherein the position information is information representing the position of the metal artifact in the medical image; determining position gradient information by comparing the medical image with the target image, wherein the position gradient information is used for indicating the change amplitude of the position information; adjusting the position information according to the position gradient information to obtain adjusted position information; and continuously removing the artifacts of the medical image according to the adjusted position information until target images with the target number are obtained, and determining the obtained last target image as the image of the medical image after the metal artifacts are removed. And the artifact is removed for many times according to the characteristics of the metal artifact, so that the accuracy is higher, and the effect of removing the metal artifact is favorably improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Remote medical treatment and grading monitoring system based on cloud-terminal cooperation
assignee: 中国科学院自动化研究所, 青岛智能产业技术研究院
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field, and particularly relates to a cloud-terminal cooperation-based remote medical and grading monitoring system, which comprises a data acquisition module, an interactive terminal module and a cloud data integration module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring medical data of a patient; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring patient data; the interactive terminal module is used for single sign-on of the patient, data input and diagnosis information output; the cloud data integration module comprises a data receiving module, an information processing module and an information output module, and the information processing module is used for processing case information and outputting a final disease treatment scheme; the information output module is used for transmitting information; the invention can ensure that the patient can obtain better medical effect without going out of home, customize a private doctor for the patient, ensure that the treatment scheme is relatively accurate and reliable, simultaneously relieve the pressure of the doctor for the hospital and improve the working efficiency.

title: System and method for healthcare security and interoperability
abstract: Embodiments facilitate interoperability and secure determination of healthcare costs. An entity may receive a first Electronic Health Record (EHR) sub-block with patient medical coverage information and first treatments and may transmit a first Device Drug Information (DIR) sub-block comprising first treatment classes corresponding to each first treatment, first treatment class members corresponding to each first treatment class, and corresponding first treatment class member cost information. In response, the entity may receive a second EHR sub-block comprising second treatments each: associated with a corresponding first treatment, and selected from corresponding first treatment class members. Upon receipt of a transaction confirmation, the entity may augment a multi-dimensional blockchain with a multi-dimensional block formed by linking: a DIR block including second treatment information, an EHR block including information based on the second EHR sub-block and a transaction block. Payment assistance information determined from the second EHR block may be transmitted to a patient.

title: Imaging subsystem
abstract: An imaging subsystem is disclosed, wherein the imaging subsystem is coherent and it generally includes an optical phased array (OPA), frequency modulation (FM) and/or amplitude modulation (AM). The imaging subsystem is operable with a Super System on Chip (SSoC) or a photonic neural learning processor (PNLP). The Super System on Chip (SSoC) includes memristors. The imaging subsystem is further operable with a camera (e.g., a metamaterial camera, wherein the metamaterial camera includes one or more metasurfaces). Furthermore, the imaging subsystem may be included with a vehicle system, wherein the vehicle system can recommend a service or an offer to a user/driver by anticipating any need of the user/driver.

title: Medical oxygen safety three-dimensional monitoring cloud platform, system and method thereof and oxygen supply system
assignee: 山东润一智能科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure discloses a medical oxygen safety three-dimensional monitoring cloud platform, a system and a method thereof and an oxygen supply system. Wherein, a medical oxygen safety stereo monitoring system includes: the intelligent monitoring terminal acquires information of the intelligent monitoring terminal and sends the information to the cloud platform; receiving an image acquisition command sent by a cloud platform through a full-view camera, acquiring current image data of the oxygen supply equipment, and sending the current image data to the cloud platform; the cloud platform receives the information of the intelligent monitoring terminal, integrates the real-time operation data of the oxygen supply equipment and the safety factor data of the surrounding environment of the oxygen supply equipment in the information of the intelligent monitoring terminal to monitor the operation state of the oxygen supply equipment in real time, generates alarm information when data are abnormal, simultaneously sends an image acquisition command to the intelligent monitoring terminal, receives the current image data of the electrical equipment, and sends the current image data to the user terminal; and the user terminal receives the alarm information sent by the cloud platform and the current image data of the oxygen supply equipment for displaying.
assignee_clean: 山东润一智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 山东润一智能科技有限公司

title: Medical data analysis method based on privacy protection federal learning and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a medical data analysis method and a storage medium based on privacy protection federal study, belongs to the technical field of medical system data analysis, and provides a method for jointly solving privacy security problems and model poisoning attack problems in federal study in the medical field. The method ensures the privacy safety and model safety in the federal learning system, does not introduce excessive expenditure, and has practical significance and good application prospect in the medical field.

title: Computing platform for improved aesthetic outcomes and patient safety in medical and surgical cosmetic procedures
assignee: Iliana E. Sweis, Bryan C. Cressey
abstract: An electronic computing system creates a treatment plan and provides safe and accurate treatment recommendations by obtaining an input image of a face; comparing, using a pattern recognition process, one or more aspects of the input image to corresponding aspects of a plurality of reference images; obtaining, based on a result of the comparing, supplemental information associated with one or more additional characteristics of the face; and creating a treatment plan based on the input image and the additional characteristic.
assignee_clean: iliana e sweis; bryan c cressey

title: Endoscopic image segmentation method based on single-image deep learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of image segmentation, relates to a medical image analysis technology, and particularly provides an endoscopic image segmentation method based on single-image deep learning, which is used for realizing real-time accurate segmentation under the condition of single case and providing support for setting a treatment scheme based on an endoscopic image in clinical medicine. The invention firstly provides a training set generation method based on a single image, which is used for automatically generating a training set, and provides a lightweight deep learning network EUnet based on the method, which is used for carrying out characteristic fitting on the generated training set, realizing endoscopic image segmentation and obtaining a segmentation result of a focus region. The invention can greatly improve the segmentation precision and has the advantages of small volume, high real-time performance, easy operation and the like; particularly, the method has remarkable precision advantage and speed advantage when processing the endoscope images of rare cases such as gastric cancer, esophageal cancer and the like, and has clinical application value.

title: Construction method of medical data classification model based on semi-supervised multitask learning
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method of a medical data classification model based on semi-supervised multitask learning, which is used for training labeled data and unlabeled data based on a multitask least square support vector machine. The invention has the following advantages: (1) by using mixed data, the model is helped to better learn the unlabeled data; (2) by introducing a multi-task learning method, the model can improve the efficiency of all tasks by using the shared representation of related tasks; (3) because the least square support vector machine converts the problem of solving quadratic programming into the problem of solving a linear equation, the computational complexity is effectively reduced, and the training time is reduced; (4) the performance equivalent to that of single-task learning is achieved, and the multi-task learning needs fewer iteration times and data size.

title: Medical imaging full-flow quality control management method and system based on industrial Internet
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image processing, in particular to a medical imaging full-flow quality control management method and system based on industrial Internet, comprising the following steps: and performing quality detection and calibration on the medical imaging equipment by using an adaptive noise reduction algorithm and a deep learning technology, wherein the quality detection and calibration comprises imaging quality and parameter setting, and generating an equipment quality control detection result. According to the invention, the accuracy of medical imaging is improved through a self-adaptive noise reduction algorithm and a deep learning technology, the scanning parameters can be automatically adjusted through a model predictive control technology and an operation guide algorithm, the flow efficiency is improved, the high dynamic range technology and a color correction algorithm are adopted, the visibility and the readability of images are optimized, the deep neural network is used for image analysis, the diagnosis quality is improved, the quality control of each link is integrated through the statistical process control, the optimization and the quality assurance of the whole flow are realized, the standardization and the mutual recognition of data are promoted, and a plurality of mechanisms can share and utilize medical imaging data more easily.

title: Server and server-based medical image analysis method for building bid-data database based on quantification and analysis of medical images
abstract: Disclosed are a server and a server-based medical image analysis method. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the medical image analysis server comprises at least one processor. The at least one processor automatically transmits a search query to a first database in which a medical image is stored, controls a reception module to receive a first medial image meeting a search condition included in the search query at the first database, performs image processing with regard to the first medical image, extracts at least one first region of interest from the first medical image, quantifies a first characteristic extracted with regard to the first medial image and the at least one first region of interest, and stores the first characteristic in a second database in association with the first medical image and the search condition.

title: Recommendation system for constructing T2DM patient drug scheme based on deep learning and reinforcement learning
assignee: 四川省医学科学院·四川省人民医院
abstract: The application discloses a recommendation system for constructing a T2DM patient drug scheme based on deep learning and reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of digital medical treatment. The application adopts a reinforcement learning method, a drug recommendation scheme is obtained according to basic information of a patient and an inspection index set before drug administration, and then an inspection index after drug administration is obtained through an index prediction module, and the score of the inspection index after drug administration is used as the value of the drug recommendation scheme; and recommending for a plurality of times until the number of the obtained values reaches a preset threshold value, and calculating to obtain the total value according to all the values. The total value reflects the long-term value of the drug recommendation. The application not only considers the accuracy of the drug recommendation scheme, but also comprehensively considers the side effect and drug tolerance of the drug and the influence of the life style of the patient on the examination index of the patient, thereby improving the long-term value of the drug administration of the patient.
assignee_clean: 四川省医学科学院 四川省人民医院
primary_assignee: 四川省医学科学院 四川省人民医院

title: Operation simulation information generation method and program
abstract: A computer-implemented surgical simulation information generation method is provided. The method comprises the following steps: generating a virtual manikin identical to the physical state of the patient at the time of surgery; performing simulation of a specific surgical procedure on the virtual manikin to obtain virtual surgical data; the virtual operation data is divided into minimum operation units which are units representing one specific operation; and generating hint table data that is comprised of the minimum surgical action unit and that represents the particular surgical procedure.

title: Systems and methods of reducing noise and artifacts in magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: A computer-implemented method of reducing noise and artifacts in medical images is provided. The method includes receiving a series of medical images along a first dimension, wherein the signals in the medical images having a higher correlation in the first dimension than the noise and the artifacts in the medical images. The method further includes, for each of a plurality of pixels in the medical images, deriving a series of data points along the first dimension based on the series of medical images, inputting the series of data points into a neural network model, and outputting the component of signals in the series of data points. The neural network model is configured to separate a component of signals from a component of noise and artifacts in the series of data points. The method further includes generating a series of corrected medical images based on the outputted component of signals.

title: Insulin dosage form selection and dosage adjustment method and system
assignee: 复旦大学附属中山医院
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for selecting an insulin dosage form and adjusting the dosage, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on diabetes guide/expert consensus, combining a machine learning model to give an insulin regimen suitable for a patient, wherein the insulin regimen comprises the time for taking insulin and a corresponding insulin dosage form; collecting medical records of patients with type 2 diabetes, wherein each medical record comprises examination and inspection, first complaint and fifth history, medical advice and basic attribute data of the patients during hospitalization, and establishing a characteristic field according to the medical records; substituting the characteristic field into an Xgboost model to carry out machine learning training so as to train characteristic variables in the model; establishing an insulin initial total dose model, substituting the characteristic fields of the medical records of the patient into an Xgboost model for machine learning training to obtain the insulin initial total dose; insulin is divided into three types: the basic type, the premixing type and the meal type are divided into seven types according to different injection time; and establishing an insulin dose adjusting model.
assignee_clean: 复旦大学附属中山医院
primary_assignee: 复旦大学附属中山医院

title: Health anomaly prediction system using speech disorder diagnosis and Method
abstract: The present invention relates to a health anomaly prediction system using a speech disorder diagnosis and a prediction method thereof, more specifically, to a health anomaly prediction system using a speech disorder diagnosis and a prediction method thereof, which creates speech model information of a target person by analyzing a voice of the target person in real time using a smart device or a wearable device always carried by the target person, diagnoses the occurrence of the speech disorder by comparing speech model information of a non-disabled person (normal person) and speech model information of a disabled person with speech model information of the target person, and provides emergency event information to guardians and external emergency agencies immediately in the event of the speech disorder, so that sudden health anomaly can be predicted in advance. According to the present invention, when a speech disorder occurs, emergency event information is provided to guardians and external emergency agencies immediately so that sudden health anomaly can be predicted in advance and the golden time can be ensured.

title: Organs at risk auto-contouring system and methods
abstract: A system and methods for automatically delineating OARs in whole-volume medical images through a two-stage DCNN model, the DCNN model comprising an OAR detection network and an OAR segmentation network, and the method comprising the steps of: inputting the whole-volume medical images to the OAR detection network; extracting image features through a sequence of downsampling blocks; generating a final detection feature map via upsampling and concatenation; detecting at least one OAR candidate by branching the final detection feature map, wherein the at least one OAR candidate is defined by a predicted bounding box with a class label; inputting the predicted bounding box and corresponding class label to the OAR segmentation network; cropping the final detection feature map and a downsampling block in the OAR detection network according to the predicted bounding box; concatenating the cropped feature maps and generating a predicted binary mask delineating OARs according to the class label.

title: Medical system, medical apparatus, and medical method
abstract: A medical system comprising: a control part configured to receive pathological image data that is produced by imaging one observation target object and that includes first and second image data, the second image data relating to the observation target object but being different to the first image data, a display control part that causes a displaying part to display thereon the first image data and the second image data; and an annotation processing part that applies an annotation to each of the first image data and the second image data on a basis of inputting by a user.

title: Animal organ segmentation model training method, segmentation method and related products
assignee: 海杰亚（北京）医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an animal organ segmentation model training method, a segmentation method and related products. The training method comprises the following steps: training an initial animal organ segmentation model by using a transfer learning method based on a pre-trained human organ segmentation model; acquiring a second animal medical image of the unlabeled animal organ, and acquiring animal organ pre-labeling data in the second animal medical image based on the initial animal organ segmentation model; training an initial animal organ segmentation model to obtain an optimized animal organ segmentation model based on the first animal medical image, the second animal medical image and corresponding animal organ labeling data, wherein the animal organ labeling data corresponding to the second animal medical image is corrected based on the animal organ pre-labeling data. Not only realizing the animal organ segmentation model and data training based on transfer learning, but also solving the problems that the parameters of the human organ segmentation model are difficult to adapt and the segmentation is inaccurate when the parameters of the human organ segmentation model are transferred into the animal organ segmentation model under the condition of insufficient data quantity.
assignee_clean: 海杰亚 北京 医疗器械有限公司
primary_assignee: 海杰亚 北京 医疗器械有限公司

title: System and method for optimizing home visit appointments and related travel
abstract: A system and a computer-implemented method employ an appointment optimization and route planning system (AORPS) for optimizing home-visit appointments and related travel for delivering patient care. The AORPS receives registration and patient data from patients and client input including information about healthcare providers, onsite care coordinators, health plans, appointment types, and success rates from a client. The AORPS collates the patient data and generates an input matrix from the client input and the collated patient data. The AORPS generates a predictive model for appointments, capitation, and return on investment for delivering patient care based on appointment and patient history, feedback, and healthcare data. The AORPS generates an appointment schedule with travel routes dynamically based on optimization factors derived from the client input, the collated patient data, the input matrix, the healthcare data, and the predictive model, incorporating real-time changes in patient data, the client input, the optimization factors, and appointments.

title: Prognosis decision support system and method for severe heart failure patient based on machine learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence assisted medical decision making, and discloses a machine learning-based severe heart failure patient prognosis decision making support system and a machine learning-based severe heart failure patient prognosis decision making support method, wherein the machine learning-based severe heart failure patient prognosis decision making support system comprises an information processing subsystem, a cloud database and a prognosis decision making support system, the cloud database is respectively connected with the information processing subsystem and the prognosis decision making support system, and the information processing subsystem is sequentially connected with the prognosis decision making support system; the cloud database stores detailed data information of prediction variables of the existing severe heart failure patients in the hospital and survival states corresponding to the patients; the information processing subsystem is used for automatically processing and grabbing prediction variable index data of the severe heart failure patient to be predicted; the prognosis decision support system is used for training a machine learning model according to the detailed information of the severe heart failure patient in the cloud database and explaining the prediction result of the death risk by utilizing an interpretable mathematical model. The invention is beneficial to reasonably distributing medical resources and provides clinical decision support for medical staff of the ICU.

title: Management service system and method based on dynamic monitoring and analysis of cardiac function
abstract: The invention discloses a health management service system and a method based on dynamic monitoring and analysis of cardiac function. The portable intelligent wearable device is adopted to monitor mechanical vibration of the heart in vitro, obtain vibration information of the heart noninvasively in real time, and discover abnormalities of a physical structure and a beating rhythm of the heart, such as valvular lesions, abnormal movement of a heart wall, change of a heart ejection fraction, arrhythmia and the like, in early stage by combining digital processing, machine learning and artificial intelligence technology mode identification and intelligent diagnosis. The early warning and timely medical care aims of early warning of heart diseases are achieved by combining with an early warning report system. The early warning and monitoring of severe arrhythmia, angina pectoris and acute myocardial infarction, and the daily monitoring of family-based elderly people and sports people are significant compared with the postoperative rehabilitation monitoring.

title: Systems and methods for assisting individuals in a behavioral-change program
abstract: Methods and systems of enhancing an electronic interaction between a behavioral-modification program and a user in the program by providing customized content specific to the user. The systems and methods allow for coach-counselor assistance to the individual-user or for automated content delivery.

title: Method and system of natural language processing in an enterprise environment
abstract: A system, method, and/or device may receive a plurality of terms in a natural language of a user. The plurality of terms may relate to at least one domain of an enterprise of domains. The plurality of terms may be stored as text. For a (e.g., each) term of the plurality of terms, one or more domain levels may be determined in which the term is associated. The domain levels (e.g., each of the domain levels) may be associated with a specificity. From the domain levels, a most specific domain level having a highest degree of specificity may be identified. The term may be associated with a domain-specific term associated with the term at the most specific domain level. The domain-specific term associated with the term may be stored.

title: Context based surface form generation for cognitive system dictionaries
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system to implement an annotator for annotating content using context-based surface forms. The mechanism receives a dictionary data structure of surface forms comprising a plurality of regular expressions and input content. The mechanism compares a given span of text in the input content to each regular expression in the dictionary data structure. Responsive to the given span of text matching a given regular expression, an annotator annotates the span of text with a content indicator corresponding to a content category associated with the dictionary data structure. The mechanism performs a natural language processing operation on the input content based on results of the annotation.

title: Threat assessment and response facilitation system and method
abstract: A threat assessment and response facilitation system is provided for facilitating communication relating to threat assessment, responding to a traumatic event, and provision of training materials for professionals engaged in threat assessment and trauma response activities. The threat assessment and trauma response facilitation system may include modules such as a threat assessment assistance module, learning portal module, client portal module, response coordination module, training broker module, and messaging module. A method for facilitating communication relating to threat assessment and trauma response using the threat assessment and response facilitation system is also provided.

title: System and methods for reconstructing medical images using deep neural networks and recursive decimation of measurement data
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for reconstructing images from measurement data using one or more deep neural networks according to a decimation strategy. In one embodiment, a method for reconstructing an image using measurement data comprises, receiving measurement data acquired by an imaging device, selecting a decimation strategy, producing a reconstructed image from the measurement data using the decimation strategy and one or more deep neural networks, and displaying the reconstructed image via a display device. By decimating measurement data to form one or more decimated measurement data arrays, a computational complexity of mapping the measurement data to image data may be reduced from O(N4), where N is the size of the measurement data, to O(M4), where M is the size of an individual decimated measurement data array, wherein M<N.

title: Text corpus processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a text corpus processing method, device, equipment and storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial training sample set by adopting a set recall parameter, wherein the initial training sample set comprises at least one training sample; determining an importance index of the target training sample based on an influence function of the target training sample in the initial training sample set; according to the importance indexes of all training samples in the initial training sample set, training samples with importance indexes meeting the conditions are selected from the initial training sample set, a sampled training sample set of the relation extraction model is obtained, and the sampled training sample set is used for training the relation extraction model. According to the method and the device, the sampled training sample set can be rapidly and accurately obtained from the initial training sample set, the credibility of the sampled training sample set is guaranteed, and the accuracy of the trained relation extraction model is improved.

title: Computer-implemented segmented numeral character recognition and reader
abstract: Computer-implemented methods, systems and devices having segmented numeral character recognition. In an embodiment, users may take digital pictures of a seven-segment display on a sensor device. For example, a user at a remote location may use a digital camera to capture a digital image of a seven-segment display on a sensor device. Captured images of a seven-segment display may then be sent or uploaded over a network to a remote health management system. The health care management system includes a reader that processes the received images to determine sensor readings representative of the values output on the seven-segment displays of the remote sensor devices. Machine learning and OCR are used to identify numeric characters in images associated with seven-segment displays. In this way, a remote heath management system can obtain sensor readings from remote locations when users only have access to sensor devices with seven-segment displays.

title: Similarity determination apparatus, similarity determination method, and program
abstract: A similarity determination apparatus comprising a processor configured to: classify each pixel of a first medical image into at least one of a plurality of types of findings; calculate a first feature amount for each classified finding; set a weighting coefficient indicating a degree of weighting which varies depending on a size of each finding for each classified finding; derive an adjusted weighting coefficient by adjusting the weighting coefficient for each of a plurality of finding groups, into which the plurality of types of findings are classified; and derive the similarity between the first medical image and a second medical image by performing a weighting operation for the first feature amount for each finding in the first medical image and a second feature amount for each finding calculated in advance in the second medical image, for each of the finding groups on the basis of the adjusted weighting coefficient.

title: Machine learning based processing of magnetic resonance data, including an uncertainty quantification
assignee: Max-Planck-Gesellschaft Zur Foerderung Der Wissenschaften E. V.
abstract: A method of processing magnetic resonance data of a sample under investigation includes the steps of provision of the MR data being collected with an MRI scanner apparatus, and machine learning based data analysis of the MR data by supplying the MR data to an artificial neural network being trained with predetermined training data, wherein at least one image parameter of the sample and additionally at least one uncertainty quantification measure representing a prediction error of the at least one image parameter are provided by output elements of the neural network. Furthermore, a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanner apparatus being adapted for employing the method of processing MR data is described.
assignee_clean: max-planck-gesellschaft zur foerderung der wissenschaften e v
primary_assignee: max-planck-gesellschaft zur foerderung der wissenschaften e v

title: Systems and methods of device-agnostic data generation including a training dashboard and using data from wearable and non-wearable devices
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for receiving electronic healthcare records and wearable device data associated with multiple users from multiple data sources, which are configured to generate and store the data in various data model regimes, many of which are not standardized or are variants of a standard. The data is standardized, aggregated, and then analyzed to generate reports. The reports are used to provide a plurality of customized execution environments and user interfaces on computing devices of the users, based on a report of each user. The data is used to determine distress situations and provide alert notifications in response.

title: Medical image data processing device, electronic apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium
assignee: 吉林禾熙科技开发有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a medical image data processing apparatus, an electronic device, and a computer-readable storage medium, relating to the technical field of medical devices. The device takes image data for evaluating the disease of the target part and focus area and disease severity grading information corresponding to the image data as training data, trains a pre-constructed multi-task learning model comprising a feature extractor, a decoder and a classifier to obtain a disease evaluation model for determining the focus area on the target part and the disease severity corresponding to the focus area, so that the disease evaluation model is used for dividing the focus area on the target part and evaluating the disease severity of the focus area. According to the disease evaluation model obtained by training the multi-task learning model, the focus region segmentation and the disease severity evaluation can be simultaneously realized through one-time reasoning, and the processing efficiency of medical image data is improved.

title: Segmenting 3D intracellular structures in microscopy images using an iterative deep learning workflow that incorporates human contributions
abstract: A facility for identifying the boundaries of 3-dimensional structures in 3-dimensional images is described. For each of multiple 3-dimensional images, the facility receives results of a first attempt to identify boundaries of structures in the 3-dimensional image, and causes the results of the first attempt to be presented to a person. For each of a number of 3-dimensional images, the facility receives input generated by the person providing feedback on the results of the first attempt. The facility then uses the following to train a deep-learning network to identify boundaries of 3-dimensional structures in 3-dimensional images: at least a portion of the plurality of 3-dimensional images, at least a portion of the received results, and at least a portion of provided feedback.

title: Multi-center medical data generation system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-center medical data generation system, which comprises a medical data amount weight calculation module, a multi-center countermeasure generation network training module and a multi-center medical data generation module, wherein the medical data amount weight of each medical institution is calculated under the condition that each medical institution does not disclose the real data amount; constructing and training a generator in a calculation server by adopting a framework with the generator and the discriminator separated, constructing and training the discriminator in each medical institution, and transmitting only the generator loss with weight to the calculation server by each medical institution; calculating generator loss of the server aggregate belt weight, and updating the generator; and generating multi-center composite medical data by using the trained generator, and providing the multi-center composite medical data for a user. The invention also provides a multi-center medical data generation method. The invention can better protect the privacy and the data safety of patients and can obtain the synthesized medical data which more accords with the real multi-center medical data distribution.

title: Electronic information analysis method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an electronic information analysis method, an electronic information analysis device, electronic information analysis equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the field of machine learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring abnormal description content of a target account; acquiring a heterogeneous graph structure, wherein the electronic medical record comprises an association relation among a life body account, state description content and state types; and analyzing the abnormal description content according to the heterogeneous graph structure to obtain a state type analysis result corresponding to the target account. The heterogeneous graph model is built through the electronic medical record, the abnormal description content is analyzed through the heterogeneous graph structure of the heterogeneous graph model, the state type analysis result is obtained, the structure of the heterogeneous graph model has strong explanatory performance, and the heterogeneous graph model can contain various types of nodes and various types of edges and can contain more semantic information, so that the state type analysis result obtained through the heterogeneous graph model analysis is high in accuracy.

title: Air wave pressure massage instrument parameter optimization method based on deep learning algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses an air wave pressure massage instrument parameter optimization method based on a deep learning algorithm, and relates to an air wave pressure massage instrument parameter optimization method. The invention aims to solve the problems of low accuracy and high retraining cost caused by only once training of the existing deep learning. The invention comprises the following steps: firstly, the method comprises the following steps: collecting blood pressure and pulse data of a user; II, secondly: establishing a deep learning structure model on a server; thirdly, the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a trained deep learning structure model; fourthly, the method comprises the following steps: collecting blood pressure and pulse data of a user, inputting the blood pressure and pulse data into the trained deep learning structure model, and adjusting massage strength, massage frequency and massage parts of the air wave pressure massage instrument according to output air wave pressure massage instrument parameters; fifthly: training the obtained deep learning structure model after training through time T to obtain a new model; and (5) replacing the deep learning structure model trained in the step four with a new model, and repeatedly executing the step four. The invention is used in the technical field of medical treatment.

title: Apparatus and method for segmenting images using consecutive deep encoder-decoder network
abstract: The present invention relates to an image segmentation device using a consecutive deep encoder-decoder network and a method thereof. The image segmentation device using a consecutive deep encoder-decoder network and the method thereof may exactly segment an object of interest included in an image through a first learning process of consecutively configuring a multi-deep encoder-decoder network composed of a plurality of deep encoder-decoder networks and learning the boundary of the object of interest included in a multi-scale image by inputting the multi-scale image and a second learning process of learning a missing pattern for the boundary of the object of interest missing in the first learning process based on a result of the first learning process.

title: Regional medical image cloud and inspection result mutual recognition sharing platform
assignee: 中世康恺科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a mutual recognition sharing platform for regional medical image clouds and inspection results, which relates to the technical field of medical treatment, integrates medical image and inspection report data from different medical institutions, synchronizes and standardizes the data in real time through a medical data standard updating module, adopts a deep learning model to detect and identify possible infectious diseases, and simultaneously adds model feature training into individual features of patients, epidemic situation conditions and travel histories of the regions to reduce misjudgment and improve detection efficiency of the infectious diseases in order to avoid misjudgment caused by similar disease diagnosis and treatment schemes and processes in the training process of the model, and then generates risk early warning and prevention and control advice based on the prediction result of the deep learning model, thereby being beneficial to doctors and health decision makers to take measures more quickly and prevent the transmission of the infectious diseases.
assignee_clean: 中世康恺科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 中世康恺科技有限公司

title: Image and text mapping technology based on machine learning
assignee: 上海孚典智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an image-to-description text mapping technique based on a combination of semantic analysis and image feature extraction techniques, by which relevant text descriptions can be derived from an input image. The patent establishes a mapping relation between an image and text description, extracts an image characteristic vector through a convolutional neural network, and establishes association with semantic information in text information. The semantic information can extract intention information and entity information in the text by combining a time convolution network with a conditional random field technology, then the intention information and the entity information are coded and a corresponding model is established with the image feature vector, and the model realizes the prediction capability from the image feature vector to the text. I.e. the basic text description is derived from the input image. The technology is applied to data analysis in medical images and smart cities, and the workload of operation and maintenance personnel can be effectively reduced.

title: Method for enhancing the visibility of blood vessels in color images and visualization systems implementing the method
abstract: A method of enhancing the visibility of blood vessels in a colour image captured by an image capturing device of a medical device, including, for at least some of the pixels of the image, the steps of: (a) processing data obtained from a first colour channel together with data obtained from a second colour channel to determine a value of a first parameter indicative of the intensity in the red spectrum relative to the total intensity of said pixel; (b) using said value of said first parameter and a first value of a user parameter to alter said pixel, the first value of the user parameter being based on user input, and wherein the strength of the alteration is dependent on both the value of said first parameter and the first value of said user parameter.

title: Object identification method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an object identification method, an object identification device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: respectively extracting spatial features based on a plurality of medical images to obtain the spatial features of the medical images, wherein the medical images are images of the same target object at different moments; fusing the extracted plurality of spatial features to obtain a first fused spatial feature corresponding to the target object; extracting time sequence features based on the first fusion space features to obtain space-time features of the target object; and identifying the target object based on the space-time characteristics to obtain an identification result of the target object. The space-time characteristics extracted by the method can more accurately represent the space information and the time sequence information of a plurality of medical images, so that the accuracy of the recognition result is improved when the target object is recognized based on the space-time characteristics.
assignee_clean: 腾讯医疗健康 深圳 有限公司
