title: Intelligent medicine curative effect evaluation method based on machine learning and application thereof
assignee: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent medicine curative effect evaluation method based on machine learning and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a mapping relation between medicines and corresponding target treatment diseases or symptoms; extracting potential side effects corresponding to medicines, and calculating similarity indexes among medicines; labeling the data on the medicine line to mark whether the medicine is effective or not, structuring the text data of the medicine, and extracting multi-dimensional crowd information and relevant feature vectors of the medicine and treatment; dividing the structured data into a training set and a verification set, establishing an integrated prediction model by utilizing a plurality of algorithms and different characteristic variable selection mechanisms, and selecting a scheme with optimal prediction effect; finally, the effective rates of the similar medicines are ranked according to the medicine similarity indexes, and various functions of evaluating the curative effect of the medicines are realized through the application.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学

title: Chromosome image processing method based on combination of artificial intelligence and graphics
abstract: The invention relates to a chromosome processing technology, and discloses a chromosome image processing method based on the combination of artificial intelligence and graphics, which can be used for rapidly and accurately processing the segmentation and classification identification of a chromosome image, improving the working efficiency, reducing the labor cost and ensuring the processing quality. The method comprises the following steps: a. training a segmentation model according to a chromosome original image data set; b. when the chromosome image is processed, the original medical image of the chromosome to be processed is segmented by utilizing a segmentation model; c. performing secondary to multi-time segmentation on the chromosome cluster image which is not completely segmented in the step b to obtain a single chromosome; d. training a classification model according to the extended single chromosome image data set processed by the graphical algorithm; e. classifying the single chromosome after segmentation and straightening by using a classification model; f. and executing a typesetting function suitable for the medical report according to the classification result, and outputting the typesetted chromosome image.

title: Assistance diagnosis method for lumbar disease based on deep learning
abstract: The present invention relates to an ancillary diagnosis method for a lumbar disease based on deep learning which can accurately and automatically diagnose a lumbar disease. The ancillary diagnosis method comprises: (a) a step of using learning data to perform deep learning on lumbar diseases to generate a diagnosis model; (b) a step of inputting a lumbar disease image to be diagnosed; and (c) a step of diagnosing existence of a lumbar disease of the lumbar disease image to be diagnosed based on the diagnosis model. The step (a) includes: (a1) a step of inputting a plurality of lumbar images and segmentation images obtained by segmenting individual lumbar vertebrae for the lumbar images as first learning data; (a2) a step of using the segmentation images as output data to perform deep learning on the first learning data; (a3) a step of generating a segmentation model by deep learning using the first learning data as an input; (a4) a step of inputting a plurality of normal lumbar patches and a plurality of disease lumbar patches as second learning data; (a5) a step of performing deep learning on the second learning data by a preregistered classification algorithm; and (a6) a step of generating a disease classification model by deep learning using the second learning data as an input. In the step (c), the segmentation model and the disease classification model are applied as the diagnosis model.

title: Apparatus, method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for improving image quality of a medical image volume
abstract: An apparatus, method, and computer-readable medium for improving image quality of a medical volume. In an embodiment, the apparatus includes processing circuitry configured to receive a reconstructed input image volume from X-ray projection data corresponding to a three-dimensional region of an object to be examined, apply a pseudo-three-dimensional neural network (P3DNN) to the reconstructed input image volume, the application of the pseudo-three-dimensional neural network including generating, for the reconstructed input image volume, a plurality of three-dimensional image datasets representing a different anatomical plane of the reconstructed input image volume, applying at least one convolutional filter to each of a sagittal plane dataset, a transverse plane dataset, and a coronal plane dataset, and concatenating results of the applied at least one convolutional filter to generate an intermediate output image volume, and generate, based on the application of the P3DNN, an output image volume corresponding to the three-dimensional region of the object.

title: Super system on chip
abstract: A Super System on Chip (SSoC) is disclosed. The Super System on Chip (SSoC)'s input/outputs are coupled with a Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI), wherein the Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) can generally include a phase transition material or a phase change material. The Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) is coupled with a first optical waveguide in two-dimensions (2-D) or three-dimensions (3-D). The first optical waveguide is coupled with (i) a semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) or (ii) a second optical waveguide that can include a nonlinear optical material in two-dimensions (2-D) or three-dimensions (3-D). Furthermore, the semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) may be replaced by an optical resonator.

title: Learning system, method, and program
abstract: Provided are a learning system, a method, and a program that can provide medical institutions with motivation for creating learning data related to medical images in a case of using machine learning to support diagnosis using medical images. The learning system includes a reception unit that receives an input of first learning data from a user, a calculation unit that calculates, a contribution degree of the first learning data to learning of a discriminator for each user on the basis of at least one of a comparison result between the first learning data and second learning data used for creating the discriminator or a comparison result between an output obtained by inputting the first learning data to the discriminator and correct answer data corresponding to the first learning data, and a service setting unit that sets a service for the user on the basis of the contribution degree calculated for each user.

title: System and method for monitoring patient health
assignee: Aniruddha Amal BANERJEE, R. A. Ramanujan
abstract: A method, computer system, and computer program for improving communication between a patient and a provider are described. The method, computer system and computer program perform a method that includes: obtaining data related to the health state of a patient; associating a timestamp with the data, encrypting the data and writing the data to a computer readable medium, determining whether the data is in a pre-configured range, and responsive to determining that the data is not in the pre-configured range, sending an alert to a client. This method also includes obtaining a response from the client and writing the response to the computer readable medium, where the response includes a medical recommendation based on the data.
assignee_clean: aniruddha amal banerjee; r a ramanujan

title: Method and device for determining partition where mediastinal lymph node is located
assignee: 杭州依图医疗技术有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining a partition where a mediastinal lymph node is located, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the medical image into a lymph node positioning model to obtain the position of the mediastinal lymph node, inputting the medical image into a key target acquisition model to acquire the information of a key target, and determining the partition where the mediastinal lymph node is located based on the position of the mediastinal lymph node and the information of the key target. The technical scheme is used for accurately identifying the partition where the mediastinal lymph node is located.
assignee_clean: 杭州依图医疗技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州依图医疗技术有限公司

title: System and method for supplementing a question answering system with mixed-language source documents
abstract: Embodiments can provide a computer implemented method, in a data processing system comprising a processor and a memory comprising instructions which are executed by the processor to cause the processor to implement a mixed-language question answering supplement system, the method comprising receiving a question in a target language; applying natural language processing to parse the question into at least one focus; for each focus, determining if one or more target language verbs share direct syntactic dependency with the focus; for each of the one or more verbs sharing direct syntactic dependency, determining if one or more target language entities share direct syntactic dependency with the verb; determining one or more Abstract Universal Verbal Types associated with each verb; for each of the one or more Abstract Universal Verbal Types, determining whether a dependency between a source language entity and a source language verb is of the same type as the dependency between the target language verb and the target language entity; if the dependency is similar, returning the source language entity as a member of a set; and if the set is full, returning an answer in the target language to the question in the target language.

title: Table header detection using global machine learning features from orthogonal rows and columns
abstract: A method, system, and computer-usable medium for detecting headers in various documents, such as PDF and HTML files. The file is converted into a two-dimensional array or table having orthogonal rows and columns. It is determined that the row or column includes a header. For determining whether a row contains a header. For each row in the array or table, a pair-wise comparison is performed for each cell of each column orthogonal to that row. For each orthogonal column of the row, the pair comparison scores or values are summed, and the sum of all the orthogonal columns of the row provides the score or value for the row. The row scores are evaluated against each other to determine the likelihood of having a head in the row. To determine whether a column has a header, a similar calculation is performed between the column and its orthogonal rows.

title: Detecting machine text
abstract: System receives historical text block, creates historical features for historical text block's historical text lines. System trains machine-learning model to cluster historical features into historical features clusters based on their similarities. System identifies historical features cluster as historical human text cluster. System classifies each historical text line for historical human text cluster as human text, and each historical text line for other historical features clusters as machine text. System receives text block, creates features for text block's text lines. System applies trained machine-learning model to cluster features into features clusters based on their similarities. System identifies features cluster as human text cluster. System classifies each text line for human text cluster as human text, and each text line for other features clusters as machine text. System applies human text analysis to each text line classified as human text and machine text analysis to each text line classified as machine text.

title: Customized kit assembly for surgical implants
abstract: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for customized kit assembly for surgical implants are disclosed. A robotic surgical system designs and customizes a surgical implant and its surgical implant components. The surgical implant and its surgical implant components are assembled into a kit that is customized for a specific patient. The robotic surgical procedure using the kit can additionally select from available generic, off-the-shelf surgical implant components or customized surgical implant components.

title: Systems and methods for a wireless sensor network
abstract: This disclosure provides systems, method, and computer-readable media for operating a sensor network. The sensor network can include an array of sensor devices and gateways. The sensor devices can sense various conditions of an environment. The sensor devices can include temperature sensors, occupancy detectors, access sensors, motion sensors, tracking devices, etc. The sensor devices can also network and communicate with one another and the gateways in an ad hoc or mesh network. The environment can include different locations, such as warehouse, office building, a complex of buildings, cargo vehicles, containers or the like. The sensor network can be deployed for controlling power consumption, logistics, automated manufacturing, healthcare, intelligent buildings, and smart cities among many other implementations. The sensor devices can communicate sensed conditions and transmit data among each other without a predefined route. When a gateway receives the data, the data can be stored and analyzed at a different location.

title: Contrast and/or system independent motion detection for magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: For detecting motion in MR imaging, a regression model, such as a convolutional neural network, is machine trained. To generalize to MR imagers, MR contrasts, or other differences in MR image generation, the regression model is trained adversarially. The discriminator for adversarial training discriminates between classes of the variation source (e.g., type of MR imager or type of contrast) based on values of features learned in the regression model for detecting motion. By adversarial training, the regression model learns features that are less susceptible or invariant to variation in image source.

title: Medical text named entity recognition method based on multi-way recall
abstract: The invention discloses a medical text named entity identification method based on multi-way recall, which comprises the following steps: medical text data acquisition and preprocessing; carrying out multi-way recall of named entity candidate words on the preprocessed medical text data; a step of sorting candidate words of named entities by adopting the Lightgbm; and processing the sorted entity candidate words to obtain a final named entity set, and realizing the medical text data named entity identification step. Based on the thought of multi-path recall, the invention combines the recall modes of dictionary recall, rule recall, machine learning method recall, neural network method recall and the like, uses the Lightgbm to sort and post-process the results, and realizes accurate and effective medical text named entity recognition.

title: Stress reduction and sleep promotion system
abstract: The present invention provides systems, methods, and articles for stress reduction and sleep promotion. A stress reduction and sleep promotion system includes at least one remote device, at least one body sensor, and at least one remote server. In other embodiments, the stress reduction and sleep promotion system includes machine learning.

title: Cardiovascular intervention operation image guidance system based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 浙江大学医学院附属邵逸夫医院
abstract: The invention relates to an interventional operation image guidance system, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based cardiovascular interventional operation image guidance system. The data collection and preprocessing module is used for collecting and labeling cardiovascular interventional operation images of various types including X-rays, CT, MRI and ultrasound, and preprocessing for denoising, contrast enhancement and edge detection; adopting a deep learning model, adapting to different operation types and patient conditions, fusing different medical image types to provide a comprehensive view, and accurately marking blood vessels and structures in a real-time video stream by using an augmented reality technology; a real-time image analysis module is adopted for real-time segmentation and identification of vascular structures and lesion areas, and a path of an interventional tool is dynamically generated and adjusted according to the real-time image and a preset model; and a risk assessment and decision support system is adopted, and the risk and complications encountered in the operation are predicted on the basis of a prediction model.
assignee_clean: 浙江大学医学院附属邵逸夫医院
primary_assignee: 浙江大学医学院附属邵逸夫医院

title: Similar medical record matching system and method based on multi-round intelligent question answering
abstract: The invention discloses a similar medical record matching system and method based on multi-round intelligent question answering, wherein a comprehensive question flow is designed for key clinical information and property description thereof, then a multi-round intelligent question answering model is constructed, and answers of the clinical information questions are positioned in a medical record text; a method for comprehensively considering answers of a plurality of previous rounds of questions and a current round of questions is designed in the multi-round intelligent question-answering model, and a calculation method for identifying answer positions in a medical record text is designed, so that information considered by the multi-round intelligent question-answering model is more comprehensive; a knowledge enhancement method based on a knowledge graph in the medical field is designed in a multi-round intelligent question-answering model, so that the performance of the model is further ensured; the method firstly calculates the relationship between different clinical information, and then calculates the vector representation of the whole medical record text based on the relationship, so that the vector representation of the medical record text comprises the internal relationship between different clinical information, and the integrity and the accuracy of similar medical record results are ensured.

title: Systems and methods for manufacturing an orthodontic appliance
abstract: A distributed computer system for manufacturing an orthodontic appliance for a subject is provided. The system comprises: a server communicatively couplable to electronic devices associated with sets of users, the sets of users comprising: a first set of users for providing preliminary orthodontic treatment plans for subjects, a second set of users for providing input to the preliminary orthodontic treatment plans, and a third set of users for manufacturing orthodontic appliances to implement at least a portion of finalized orthodontic treatment plans, the finalized orthodontic treatment plans being based on a given preliminary orthodontic treatment plan and a given input from a user of the second set of users to the given preliminary orthodontic treatment plan.

title: Similarity determination apparatus, similarity determination method, and similarity determination program
abstract: A region division unit divides a target region of a first medical image into a plurality of regions. A finding classification unit classifies each pixel of the first medical image into at least one finding. A feature amount calculation unit calculates a first feature amount for each finding. A region similarity derivation unit derives a region similarity between the first medical image and a second medical image for each of the divided regions. A similarity derivation unit performs a weighting operation for a plurality of region similarities with a weighting coefficient corresponding to at least one of a size of each of the divided regions or a size of a specific finding included in each of the divided regions to derive a similarity between the first medical image and the second medical image.

title: System for integrating data for clinical decisions including multiple personal tracking devices
abstract: An automatic system for making clinical decisions, especially with relation to cannabis use, that incorporates data from multiple personal tracking devices such as fitness trackers, analyzes that data using machine learning techniques to determine which data points are relevant to account for changes over time, and offers predictions, insights, and/or suggestions to support clinical decision making.

title: CSM image segmentation method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The application provides a CSM image segmentation method, a CSM image segmentation device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of deep learning, and can improve CSM image segmentation accuracy to a certain extent. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image; and inputting the target image into a trained generator for processing to obtain a segmented image of the target image, wherein the generator is of an encoder-decoder structure, a pyramid pooling module is arranged between the encoder and the decoder, and a plurality of convolution layers in the encoder are connected with the pyramid pooling module.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院

title: Automated home system for senior care
abstract: An improved home automation system is provided to facilitate senior care, as well as to facilitate care for individuals suffering from Alzheimer's disease or other dementias. A home control unit is provided that is connected to, and interfaces with, a combination of health equipment, smart home appliances, a smart medicine cabinet, a smart pantry, wearable sensors, motion detectors, video cameras, microphones, video monitors, speakers, smart thermostat, lighting, floor sensors, bed sensors, smoke detectors, glass breakage detectors, door sensors, and other perimeter sensors. A distributed computational architecture is provided having a CPU associated with each video camera and an associated proximate microphone and speaker, wherein speech detection and processing, and video processing, is performed by each such CPU in conjunction with its associated video camera, microphone, and speaker. Remote backup for such distributed speech processing is selectively provided by a remote server based upon confidence scopes generated by each such CPU. The distributed computational architecture is also utilized for video processing to facilitate peer-to-peer video conferencing communication using industry standard formats and to reduce latency and response times that would otherwise be encountered using remote servers.

title: Systems and methods for positioning
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: Systems and methods for positioning in medical systems are provided. The system may obtain data associated with a scanning range of a subject. The system may also obtain an image of the subject on a couch of a medical radiation device. The image may be acquired by an imaging device when the couch is at a first position. The system may determine a position of the scanning range of the subject in the image. The system may further cause, based on the position of the scanning range in the image, the couch to move to a second position. The scanning range of the subject may be in a radiation region of the medical radiation device when the couch is located at the second position.

title: Method for determining at least one object feature of an object
abstract: A method is for determining at least one object feature of an object at least partially depicted by an object image. A respective preliminary feature for each object feature and at least one acquisition feature are determined from the object image. The preliminary feature depends on the object feature and on an imaging device used to acquire the object image and/or at least one imaging parameter used for acquiring and/or reconstructing the object image and/or an additional feature of the object. The acquisition feature depends on the imaging device and/or the imaging parameter and/or the additional feature of the object. A correction algorithm determines the object feature from the preliminary feature and the acquisition feature. The acquisition feature is determined by a respective determination algorithm that is selected and/or parametrized from a group of candidate algorithms, depending on multiple reference images.

title: Federal learning method and device aiming at non-independent co-distributed medical scene
abstract: The invention discloses a federal learning method aiming at a non-independent co-distributed medical scene, which comprises the steps of firstly dividing medical institutions with similar category label variable distribution into the same cluster, and in the training process, firstly performing federal average on local model weights obtained after local training in each cluster to obtain updated weights of corresponding cluster models, so that the influence of data unbalance on accurately predicting federal average results can be reduced, then integrating the updated weights of each cluster model capable of obtaining relatively accurate federal average results to obtain global model weights of current iteration, and obtaining global models capable of accurately predicting medical problems such as disease diagnosis, medication recommendation, treatment scheme and the like through multiple iterations. The invention also discloses a federal learning device and a storage medium aiming at the non-independent co-distributed medical scene.

title: System and methods for mammalian transfer learning
abstract: A neural network is trained using transfer learning to analyze medical image data, including 2D, 3D, and 4D images and models. Where the target medical image data is associated with a species or problem class for which there is not sufficient labeled data available for training, the system may create enhanced training datasets by selecting labeled data from other species, and/or labeled data from different problem classes. During training and analysis, image data is chunked into portions that are small enough to obfuscate the species source, while being large enough to preserve meaningful context related to the problem class (e.g., the image portion is small enough that it can't be determined whether it is from a human or canine, but abnormal liver tissues are still identifiable). A trained checkpoint may then be used to provide automated analysis and heat mapping of input images via a cloud platform or other application.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine clinical decision support system and method
assignee: 井颐医疗信息技术(杭州)有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine clinical decision support system, which comprises the following steps: selecting medical evidence and extracting medical entities and medical entity relations; constructing a data set according to the extracted medical entities and medical entity relations; constructing a medical knowledge graph through a graph constructing and updating module; adding a patient through a patient management module, and inputting personal basic information of the patient; the doctor looks over the outpatient service information and carries out the outpatient service through outpatient service management module, inputs symptom summary information according to patient's description. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the information is summarized for doctors, especially basic doctors with insufficient medical experience according to the chief complaints, the current medical history, various examination results and other symptoms of the patients; the problems of insufficient inquiry and clinical experience of doctors are solved, and the doctors are assisted to quickly and effectively diagnose diseases and draw up a proper treatment scheme; the evidence-based reasoning ability of the medical knowledge graph is continuously improved.
assignee_clean: 井颐医疗信息技术 杭州 有限公司
primary_assignee: 井颐医疗信息技术 杭州 有限公司

title: Ultrasonic endoscope system and method for operating ultrasonic endoscope system
abstract: In the ultrasonic endoscope system and the operating method of the ultrasonic endoscope system according to the present invention, the ultrasonic image recognition unit learns in advance at least one of a relationship between the learning ultrasonic image and the name of the organ displayed on the learning ultrasonic image and a relationship between the learning ultrasonic image and the position of the distal end portion of the ultrasonic endoscope at the time of capturing the learning ultrasonic image for the plurality of learning ultrasonic images. The ultrasonic image recognition unit recognizes at least one of the name of the organ and the position of the distal end portion of the ultrasonic endoscope, which are displayed on the diagnostic ultrasonic image, from the diagnostic ultrasonic image based on the learning result, and the display control unit displays at least one of the name of the organ and the position of the distal end portion of the ultrasonic endoscope on the display.

title: AI technology-based method and model for predicting prognosis of AAV (adeno-associated virus) in different treatment schemes
assignee: 肾泰网健康科技(南京)有限公司
abstract: A method for predicting the prognosis of AAV with different treatment schemes based on AI technology includes the following steps: s1, collecting kidney survival prognosis condition data of an existing ANCA-related nephritis patient after treatment by adopting different treatment schemes; s2, a Cox regression analysis method and an XGboost machine learning algorithm are adopted to construct a prognosis prediction model of each treatment scheme in a treatment scheme set, and ANCA-related nephritis patients are adopted to train the constructed prognosis prediction model of each treatment scheme by using the kidney survival prognosis data after treatment of different treatment schemes, so that a high-quality Cox regression model and a high-quality XGboost model which can judge the effective prognosis prediction of the kidney survival prognosis of each treatment scheme are obtained; and S3, respectively inputting medical characteristic data of the patient to be evaluated into a high-quality Cox regression model and a high-quality XGboost model of each treatment scheme in the treatment scheme set, and S4, selecting a proper treatment scheme by a doctor according to the kidney survival probability of each treatment scheme in the treatment scheme set and the reference value of whether the kidney of each treatment scheme in the treatment scheme set survives or not and according to the prognosis risk. Therefore, the aim of guiding doctors to adopt the ACNC-related nephritis treatment scheme with the lowest prognosis risk is achieved.
assignee_clean: 肾泰网健康科技 南京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 肾泰网健康科技 南京 有限公司

title: Wearable health monitoring device
abstract: A wearable patient device is provided that includes one or more sensors. The one or more sensors can record one or both of ECG information or phonocardiographic information. The sensor information can be used to determine the blood pressure of a monitored individual, including on a continuous basis. Blood pressure can be determined using one or both of a determined time to empty or fill one or more heart chambers or first and second blood velocities. Vital sign information can be provided to a monitoring individual, including graphical representations of trend information.

title: Blood vessel three-dimensional image segmentation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳睿心智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a blood vessel three-dimensional image segmentation method, a blood vessel three-dimensional image segmentation device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing an original sample blood vessel three-dimensional image to obtain a sample blood vessel three-dimensional image; acquiring integral artery labeling data of a sample blood vessel three-dimensional image, and separating arteriolar labeling data from the integral artery labeling data; taking the sample blood vessel three-dimensional image and the whole artery labeling data as a first sample set, and training to obtain a whole artery segmentation model; taking the sample blood vessel three-dimensional image and the arteriole labeling data as a second sample set, and performing deep learning training to obtain an arteriole segmentation model; respectively inputting a three-dimensional image of a blood vessel to be segmented into an integral artery segmentation model and a small artery segmentation model, and outputting an initial segmentation image of the integral artery and a small artery segmentation image; and fusing the initial segmentation image and the arteriole segmentation image to obtain a final segmentation image of the whole artery. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the three-dimensional image segmentation of the blood vessel can be improved.
assignee_clean: 深圳睿心智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳睿心智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Distributed ledger based document image extracting and processing within an enterprise system
abstract: A method for use in a hybrid network ecosystem comprising an enterprise network and a reconciliation network, the method comprising generating, by at least one first computing node in the enterprise network or the reconciliation network, a first digital facilitator, wherein the first digital facilitator enables a first device to use a private key to access data associated with a distributed ledger operation. The method also comprises transmitting, via the reconciliation network, the data from the first computing device to a second computing device, wherein the first computing device and the second computing device are connected via the reconciliation network.

title: Device and method for pneumonia detection based on deep learning
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method, a device, and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for detecting a medical condition of an organ. The method includes obtaining 2D image sequences of the organ in a plurality of different directions and applying a plurality of classification branches to the 2D image sequences. Each classification branch receives a 2D image sequence of one direction and provides a classification result with respect to that direction. Each classification branch includes a convolutional neural network configured to extract first image features from the corresponding 2D image sequence and a recurrent neural network configured to extract second image features from the first image features. The method further includes fusing the classification results provided by the plurality of classification branches for detecting the medical condition.

title: Multi-channel and with rhythm transfer learning
abstract: Techniques for classifying cardiac events in electrocardiogram (ECG) data. A feature set is generated by analyzing ECG data for a patient using a first phase in a machine learning architecture. A first cardiac event in the ECG data is classified based on the feature set, using the first phase in the machine learning architecture. A second cardiac event in the ECG data is classified based on the classified first cardiac event and the feature set, using a second phase in the machine learning architecture. The second cardiac event overlaps at least partially in time with the first cardiac event. Further, a plurality of feature sets, corresponding to a plurality channels of ECG data, are generated using paths in a machine learning architecture. A cardiac event in the ECG data is classified using the machine learning architecture based on the plurality of feature sets.

title: Medical information processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a medical information processing method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring medical record information in medical information of a target object and a medical image in the medical information; processing the medical record information through a text information processing network in a medical information processing model, and determining a first feature vector matched with the medical record information; processing the medical image through an image information processing network in the medical information processing model, and determining a second feature vector matched with the medical image; determining corresponding fusion feature vectors according to the first feature vector and the second feature vector through the medical information processing model; classifying the medical image based on the fusion feature vector. The invention also provides a medical information processing device, an electronic device and a storage medium. The medical image classification method and the medical image classification device can output the classification result of the medical image through fusion of medical record information and the medical image.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Medication security and healthcare privacy systems
abstract: Medication security and healthcare privacy analytics systems are described that enable users to search for and process stored healthcare environment data. The medication security and healthcare privacy analytics systems receive and correlate data from a plurality of data sources, including medication dispensing systems, healthcare employee records, and patient records, including user behavior or interaction data with the foregoing data sources. The medication security and healthcare privacy analytics systems include graphical user interfaces (GUIs) that enable users to select elements to filter the processed healthcare environment data and generate visualizations of filtered datasets. The visualizations are created using datasets generated by clustering algorithms and can indicate those users from a plurality of users whose interactions with various systems are anomalous (e.g., indicative of unexpected or non-customary user behavior).

title: New crown epidemic situation comprehensive evaluation method based on classification regression model
abstract: The invention provides a new crown epidemic situation comprehensive evaluation method based on a classification regression model, which specifically comprises the following steps: p1, acquiring characteristic information influencing epidemic factors; p2, constructing a classifier to classify the influencing factors; p3, fitting a regression model between the influencing factors and the severity of the epidemic; and P4, calculating factor values, weight coefficients and epidemic situation risk coefficients of all levels, and analyzing important factors influencing the epidemic situation. The invention comprehensively utilizes computer technology of artificial intelligence and big data analysis, dynamically establishes a classification regression model of machine learning, optimizes evaluation of influence factors at all levels on epidemic situation risks through multiple times of fitting functions and adjustment of a floating module, can analyze main and key aspects of the target area influencing the epidemic situation, effectively warns and guides prevention and control of the epidemic situation, effectively and actively influences the mass life, economy and related aspects of the target area in terms of optimizing macroscopic regulation and control and refining microscopic prevention and control, and greatly improves the effect of epidemic situation prevention and control work.

title: Intelligent online reservation diagnosis and treatment management system and method
assignee: 山东远程分子互联网医院有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of online reservation diagnosis and treatment, and discloses an intelligent online reservation diagnosis and treatment management system and method, wherein a user performs online reservation diagnosis and treatment, performs content identification on the detection purpose of the user, constructs an inspection category matching neural network model, and obtains inspection categories based on word set matching of the inspection purpose; generating an inspection report based on inspection data of a detected person, extracting text data to be marked on the medical image from the inspection report, annotating the text data corresponding to different part marks in the image, performing image-text registration, and generating the medical image report from the medical image, thereby realizing intelligent online reservation diagnosis and treatment management. The invention solves the problems that the existing online reservation mode does not carry out classification management and control on different illness states, is easy to cause diagnosis and treatment of emergency patients, and after a doctor gives a diagnosis result, the patient can know the diagnosis result but can not intuitively know each part from medical images and see the problem of illness.
assignee_clean: 山东远程分子互联网医院有限公司
primary_assignee: 山东远程分子互联网医院有限公司

title: Methods and apparatuses for a unified artificial intelligence platform to synthesize diverse sets of peptides and peptidomimetics
abstract: In one aspect, a method is disclosed wherein an artificial intelligence (AI) enabled automated flow synthesis platform is configured to generate optimized synthesizing recipes which enable a sequence to be synthesized using an automated flow process. The method includes receiving a synthesizing recipe including parameters used during the automated flow process to synthesize the sequence, receiving spectral data from detectors monitoring the automated flow process in a reaction chamber, where the spectral data corresponds to a reaction point in the automated flow process, and determining, based on indicators associated with the spectral data, characteristics of a chemical reaction at the reaction point in the automated flow process. An artificial intelligence engine determines the chemical reaction. The method includes associating, based on the spectral data, the synthesizing recipe with the chemical reaction.

title: Medical image processing method, storage medium, and computer device
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: After a medical image to be processed is obtained, similarity matching processing is carried out on the medical image and a reference image through a similarity network model, whether the medical image is a difficult and complicated disease image or not is automatically determined according to a matching processing result, so that the difficult and complicated image can be automatically screened from the medical image.

title: Methods, systems and use for detecting irregularities in medical images by means of a machine learning model
abstract: A method for training a computer-implemented machine learning model for detecting irregularities in medical images, the method including: identifying at least one predetermined type of body region (14) depicted in a medical image (10), said body region (14) having a depicted irregularity (12); defining a plurality of image segments (20) each including at least part of the depicted body region (14), wherein a resolution of the image segments (20) is maintained or not reduced by more than 20% compared to the medical image (10); and using said image segments (20) to train a machine learning model to detect similar irregularities (12) in other medical images (10). Further, the invention relates to a use and to systems for training a computer-implemented machine learning model for detecting irregularities in medical images.

title: Data analysis method for magnetic resonance detection based on consciousness recovery prediction of patient with consciousness disturbance
assignee: 复旦大学附属华山医院
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medical image processing and application, relates to a functional image analysis method for consciousness restoration prediction of consciousness disturbance people, and in particular relates to a data analysis method for magnetic resonance detection based on consciousness disturbance people. The invention relates to a data analysis method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of constructing a human brain function connection matrix by adopting a weighting group sparse algorithm based on resting state function magnetic resonance data (RS-fMRI), and selecting functional connection features with high contribution to classification from the matrix by using a sparse representation feature screening method for automatic prediction; and constructing a prediction model by adopting and adopting a linear support vector mechanism to obtain a final prediction result of whether consciousness is recovered or not. The method is useful as a reference for predicting whether a patient with long-term unconsciousness of brain injury will recover consciousness.

title: Synthetic data generation using anonymity preservation in computer-based reasoning systems
abstract: Techniques for synthetic data generation in computer-based reasoning systems are discussed and include receiving a request for generation of synthetic data based on a set of training data cases. One or more focal training data cases are determined. For undetermined features (either all of them or those that are not subject to conditions), a value for the feature is determined based on the focal cases. In some embodiments, the generated synthetic data may be checked for similarity against the original data, and if similarity conditions are met, it may be modified (e.g., resampled), removed, and/or replaced.

title: Deep learning based methods and systems for automated subject anatomy and orientation identification
abstract: Systems and methods for automated patient anatomy and orientation identification using an artificial intelligence (AI) based deep learning module are provided. The method comprises positioning a subject over a table of a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) system and wrapping at least one radiofrequency (RF) imaging coil over the subject. The method comprises obtaining a plurality of depth images, color images and infrared images of the subject using a three-dimensional (3D) depth camera and identifying the table boundary of the MRI system using the images obtained by the 3D camera. The method further comprises identifying a location of the subject over the table to determine if the subject is positioned within the table boundary of the MRI system and identifying a plurality of key anatomical points or regions corresponding to a plurality of organs of the subject body. The method further comprises identifying all DICOM orientations of the subject over the table of the MRI system and identifying the coils of the MRI system wrapped around the subject body and determining the orientation of the subject with respect to the coils of the MRI system, hospital gown, and blankets. The method further comprises identifying the anatomical key points occluded by the coils of the MRI system, hospital gown, and blankets to determine accurate positioning of the coils of the MRI system over the subject anatomy for automated landmarking of anatomies and imaging.

title: Systems and methods for managing voice environments and voice routines
abstract: Provided is a voice assistance system with proactive routines that couples a remote server and respective user voice interactive devices to deliver a complete experience to the end user of the device. The voice assistance system can also provide a platform to connect remote users to customize commands (e.g., proactive or reactive) to improve day-to-day operation across groups of devices and/or users. For example, routines can be built for an organization and made available to voice interactive devices distributed by or on behalf of the organization. Administrators can select features for the device and pre-configure voice assistance devices with groups of pre-selected routines to deliver a device that is ready to go out of the box. Updates to a device or routines can be based on such groups. Additionally, primary routine instances can be linked to groups where changes to the primary instance are propagated to any linked users.

title: Medical care scheduling method and system based on clinical big data
abstract: The invention discloses a medical care scheduling method and a system based on clinical big data, which belong to the field of big data, and the medical care scheduling system based on the clinical big data comprises a medical care personnel information module, an attendance module and a work allocation module; the medical staff information module is used for acquiring personal information of medical staff, including departments, positions and working ages where the medical staff information module is located; the medical groups set by the medical units are intelligently grouped according to the prediction of the personal information, the medical units adjust the personnel frameworks of the medical groups according to the grouping result, and the personnel framework adjustment of the medical groups is continuously optimized; the attendance module is used for modifying the scheduling requirements set by medical staff reservation medical institutions and submitting rest applications; the work allocation module is used for guaranteeing the medical resource average allocation of the medical units in the preset working time according to the actual conditions of the medical groups of each department and the hospital, so that the patients enjoy the maximum medical resources in the treatment time.

title: Medical image analyzing system and method thereof
abstract: Provided is a medical image analyzing system and a method thereof, which includes: acquiring a processed image having a segmentation label corresponding to a cancerous part of an organ (if present), generating a plurality of image patches therefrom, performing feature analysis on the image patches and model training to obtain prediction values, drawing a receiver operating characteristic curve using the prediction values, and determining a threshold with which determines whether the image patches are cancerous, so as to effectively improve the detection rate of, for example, pancreatic cancer.

title: Classification method and system for medical record data
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for classifying medical record data, which are used for preprocessing original medical record data to obtain a data set capable of being matched with a classifier; then, randomly dividing the data set with the selected characteristics into a specified number of data blocks with the same size, dividing each data block into a training set and a testing set, and inputting the training set and the testing set into corresponding classifiers respectively; then, based on a TPE algorithm, predicting all classifiers in a weighted voting mode, and selecting the number of the classifiers with the smallest verification error as the optimal number of the classifiers after the TPE algorithm is operated for specified times; and finally, inputting the number of the optimal classifiers into the deep cascading forest model, and performing successive operation on the deep cascading forest model until the preset precision is met to obtain the optimal classification result of the medical record data. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention has low requirement on data quantity, is easy to train and has the advantage of strong adaptability.

title: Optimized machine learning telemetry processing for a cloud based storage system
abstract: Data associated with a first storage media of a cloud-based storage system is provided as an input to a machine learning model executed by a processing device that identifies one or more characteristics of the first storage media from the data. A type of change associated with the second storage media is determined by the machine learning model based on a comparison of the one or more characteristics of the first storage media and one or more characteristics of a second storage media. The type of change associated with the second storage media is provided to a cloud services provider of the cloud-based storage system.

title: Artificial intelligence and machine learning hyperscale infrastructure
abstract: A hyperscale artificial intelligence and machine learning infrastructure includes a plurality of racks, where: at least one or more of the racks include one or more GPU servers; at least one or more of the racks include one or more storage systems; each of the racks include one or more switches coupled to at least one switch in another rack; and the one or more GPU servers are configured to execute one or more artificial intelligence or machine learning applications, wherein data stored within the one or more storage systems is used as input to the one or more artificial intelligence or machine learning applications.

title: Image processing of streptococcal infection in pharyngitis subjects
abstract: A method for determining a disease state prediction, relating to a potential disease or medical condition of a subject, includes accessing a set of subject images, the subject images capturing a part of a subject's body, and accessing a set of clinical factors from the subject. The clinical factors are collected by a device or a medical practitioner substantially contemporaneously with the capture of the subject images. The subject images are inputted into an image model to generate disease metrics for disease prediction for the subject. The disease metrics generated by the image model and the clinical factors are inputted into a classifier to determine the disease state prediction, and the disease state prediction is returned.

title: Similarity determination device, method, and program
abstract: The display control unit displays a tomographic image of a specific tomographic plane in the 1 st medical image on the display unit. The observation result classification unit classifies each pixel in the partial region of the 1 st medical image as at least one observation result. The feature amount calculation unit calculates a1 st feature amount for each observation result in the partial region. The weight coefficient setting unit sets weight coefficients having different weighting degrees according to the sizes of the observation results. The similarity deriving unit performs a weighted operation of the 1 st feature quantity of each observation result calculated in the partial region and the 2 nd feature quantity of each observation result calculated in the 2 nd medical image on the basis of the weight coefficient, thereby deriving the similarity between the 1 st medical image and the 2 nd medical image.

title: Device and method for determining quality of image
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and method for determining the quality of an image. In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, a method for analyzing a medical image comprises: a step of acquiring a target medical image including one or more artifacts; a step of acquiring an artifact information related to the artifacts based on the target medical image (the artifact information includes an artifact area which shows an area where the artifacts are distributed); a step of using a first neural network model, and acquiring a plurality of areas, respectively corresponding to one or more elements classified anatomically based on the target medical image (the first neural network model learns to acquire the plurality of areas based on the medical image, and the plurality of areas include a first area corresponding to a first element, a second area corresponding to a second element, and a third area corresponding to a third element); a step of acquiring the overlapped degree between the artifact area and an area of interest (the area of interest includes at least a part of the first area); a first quality determination step to determine the quality of the target medical image based on the overlapped degree; and a step of outputting the information related to the quality of the target medical image based on the first quality determination The present invention aims to provide a device and method for determining the quality of an image, which are capable of increasing the reliability of the results of analysis of medical images.

title: Hip joint image segmentation method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention provides a hip joint image segmentation method and a system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be segmented; inputting an image to be segmented into a target segmentation network to obtain a target image; the target segmentation network is obtained based on sample image dataset training, and comprises a first feature extraction module, a second feature extraction module and a feature fusion module; the acquiring of the target image comprises: extracting a target feature map of an image to be segmented based on a first feature extraction module; extracting global features of the image to be segmented based on a second feature extraction module and a depth aggregation pyramid network; and based on the feature fusion module, fusing the global features and the target feature map to obtain a target image. The method and the device can realize rapid segmentation processing of the image to be segmented, merge shallow detail features of the image to be segmented with global features of the image to be segmented extracted through the depth aggregation pyramid network, obtain enhanced content features, and improve segmentation accuracy of the image to be segmented.

title: System and method for implanting smart implants using robotic telesurgery
abstract: A system for using robotic telesurgery to implant a smart implant is disclosed. The system comprises a remote doctor module communicatively coupled with an operating room module over a cloud network. The operating room module comprises a robotic arm, a processor, and communication interface which communicates with the smart implant during the surgical procedure. The Operating Room Module testing the smart implant prior to implantation surgery; correlating data collected during the implantation surgery against past data from previous surgeries; determining whether the plurality of sensors is working properly; and transferring communication with the smart implant to a user device receive and monitor data from the plurality of sensors integrated into the smart implant to determine the smart implant is operating according as expected and to monitor the patient's condition.

title: Medical image labeling method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京至真互联网技术有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a medical image labeling method, a medical image labeling device, medical image labeling equipment and a storage medium, wherein the medical image labeling method comprises the following steps: selecting multiple types of reference images from an image database, performing similarity matching on the residual images in the image database and the selected reference images, classifying the residual images into the corresponding reference images according to a similarity matching result, constructing a multi-type reference image set, determining images to be annotated from the reference image set, determining annotation types of the images to be annotated based on annotation information of the images to be annotated, and performing image annotation on the images to be annotated according to the annotation types. The method and the device adopt color similarity and content structure similarity to normalize the image content, solve the problem of selecting the candidate images with automatic labeling, save labor time cost of cleaning the earlier-stage images, and improve quality and speed of image labeling.

title: Single point facility utility sensing for monitoring welfare of a facility occupant
abstract: The utility usage of a particular individual occupying a residence may give insight into the individual's current cognitive health and/or to enable provision of various services within the facility for the individual, particularly when monitoring patterns in utility usage over time. To enable accurate and non-invasive utility monitoring, a single-point utility sensor may be secured relative to a utility supply line, and generated signals may be utilized to monitor utility usage and to distinguish between utility fixtures. A centralized computing entity may identify frequency characteristics within the generated data, and may automatically generate one or more machine-learning algorithms to distinguish between utility usage events, without requiring substantial user input.

title: System and method for automated intubation
abstract: A system, method and apparatus to automatically perform endotracheal intubation in a patient comprising, inserting a blade inside the upper airway of the patient to retract an anatomical structure; inserting a bending portion and a tube arranged on the bending portion inside the airway of the patient; collecting airway data using at least one imaging sensor arranged on the bending portion; communicating collected airway data to a processing circuitry; predicting an intended path for insertion of the tube and generating control signals using the processing circuitry, wherein the intended path is predicted based on at least one anatomical structure recognized by the processing circuitry using the collected airway data; displaying an intended path via a user interface to display at least one intended path to an operator and also allow the operator to select an intended path; and communicating the control signals generated by the processing circuitry to at least one actuation unit to actuate the three-dimensional movement of the tube.

title: System and method providing risk relationship transaction automation in accordance with medical condition code
abstract: A system to provide a risk relationship transaction automation tool via a back-end application computer server of an enterprise. The system may include a risk relationship data store that contains electronic records representing transactions associated with requested resource allocations between the enterprise and a plurality of entities. The server may receive an indication of a selected requested resource allocation transaction and retrieve, from the risk relationship data store, the electronic record associated with the selected requested resource allocation transaction. The server may then execute a medical code decision model. According to some embodiments, the system may also support a graphical interactive user interface display via a distributed communication network, the interactive user interface display providing resource allocation transaction data.

title: Method for computing severity with respect to dementia of subject based on medical image and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for calculating a degree of severity of dementia of a subject based on a medical image, and to a device using the same. Specifically, according to the present invention, the method for calculating a degree of severity of dementia of a subject based on a medical image comprises the following steps. A computing device obtains a brain image of the subject. The computing device performs parcellation of a plurality of brain areas pre-designated as being related to the dementia from the brain image. And, the computing device generates classification information which classified the subject into a demented disease or a normal state, based on a result of the area classification and attribute information of the subject.

title: Machine learnng techniques for pectoral muscle equalization and segmentation in digital mammograms
abstract: Image analysis techniques applicable to mammograms and other types of images may include image normalization, image segmentation, forming a prediction bias image, and creating an equalized image based on the prediction bias image. Creation of the equalized image may include subtraction of the prediction bias image from the original image. Forming the prediction bias image may involve the use of trained predictors.

title: Applying machine intelligence for location-based services to dispatch first responders
abstract: Techniques are described herein for applying a selective automated response to a distress call received at an emergency services system. The techniques include receiving a distress call from a user device in response to an emergency event. The distress call may be parsed to identify a location, an urgency index, and a nature of the emergency event. The distress call may be routed to an available dispatcher at a dispatcher terminal. Based at least on the location, the urgency index, and the nature of the emergency event, a response procedure to resolve the distress call may be identified. The dispatcher may communicate with a dispatched first responder at the location via a communication channel established between the dispatcher terminal and a mobile first responder terminal. The response procedure may be transmitted to the mobile first responder terminal.

title: Systems and methods for associating symptoms with medical conditions
assignee: 查可神经科技有限公司
abstract: A system for associating symptoms with a medical condition is disclosed. The system includes a server device associated with a user device. The server device is operable to: providing a user active set to a user device; receiving information from the user device relating to a selection of a user activity from the set of user activities; receiving user input associated with the selected user activity from the user device; analyzing the user input and assigning a performance score thereto; identifying one or more symptoms based on the performance score; and assigning a severity score to the symptom for use in associating the symptom with the medical condition. A method for associating a symptom with a medical condition and a computer program product for performing the method are also disclosed.

title: Uberization and decentralization of healthcare services
abstract: Methods and systems for providing decentralized healthcare services are provided. An example method may commence with receiving a request for a healthcare service from a patient. The method may continue with providing the request to a responding healthcare provider and receiving a response from the responding healthcare provider. The method may continue with establishing a bidirectional communication between the patient and the responding healthcare provider in real-time and receiving a plan of actions to treat the patient from the responding healthcare provider. The method may further include instructing a diagnostic and laboratory service to physically contact the patient and collect real-time vital parameters of the patient. The method may continue with receiving, from the diagnostic and laboratory service, the real-time vital parameters of the patient and making the real-time vital parameters available to the patient and the responding healthcare provider in an electronic medical record database.

title: System and methods for restorative dentistry treatment planning using adversarial learning
abstract: Training a generator includes processing a dental image using the generator to obtain a synthetic pathology label, such has a pixel mask indicating portions of the dental image representing caries. The synthetic pathology label is compared to a target pathology label for the dental image and the generator is updated according to the comparison. The synthetic pathology may be evaluated by a discriminator along with a real pathology label to obtain a realism estimate. The discriminator and generator may be updated according to accuracy of the realism estimate. Inputs to the generator may further include tooth labels and/or labels of restorations. Machine learning models may be trained to label restorations and defects in restorations. A machine learning model may be trained to identify the surface of a tooth having a pathology thereon.

title: Medical image diagnostic apparatus and medical image diagnostic system
abstract: According to one embodiment, a medical image diagnostic apparatus includes an imager, a mechanism, and processing circuitry. The imager is configured to image a subject. The mechanism is comprising a movable part. The processing circuitry is configured to generate an image of the subject based on an output of the imager, and perform processing for incident data based on at least one of a result of analyzing the image of the subject, or information for motion of the mechanism, wherein the incident data comprises at least one of operating sound data or shaking data of the mechanism.

title: Smart vehicle
abstract: Smart car operations are detailed. The system uses neural network and population statistics to determine whether a vehicle operation is reasonably safe operation of the autonomous vehicle to guide the operation of cars as a group.

title: Blockchain verification using non-consecutive blocks
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving a request to store a data block on a hash-linked chain of data blocks, dynamically selecting a subset of non-consecutive data blocks which have been previously stored within the hash-linked chain of data blocks, generating a linking hash based on a hash value of the data block to be stored and an accumulation of hash values from the subset of non-consecutive data blocks, and adding the data block to the hash-linked chain of data blocks, wherein the added data block includes the linking hash stored therein.

title: Lung nodule semi-automatic segmentation method, device, equipment and medium based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a lung nodule semi-automatic segmentation method, a device, equipment and a medium based on deep learning, wherein a medical image is subjected to two-dimensional segmentation and three-dimensional segmentation by combining two-dimensional and three-dimensional semi-automatic lung nodule segmentation networks, an actual three-dimensional segmentation result is determined based on a two-dimensional segmentation result and a three-dimensional segmentation result of each layer, global information of a global image can be better learned through the two-dimensional segmentation network, three-dimensional characteristics of lung nodules can be better learned through the three-dimensional segmentation network, the problems that the three-dimensional characteristics cannot be well utilized by using the two-dimensional segmentation network alone, the global information cannot be well utilized by using the three-dimensional segmentation network alone and the prior information of a user are combined are effectively solved, the problem that a good cutting method cannot be selected under the prior condition without the target size is solved, the segmentation performance is effectively improved through a multi-branch combined training mode, and the problem of false positive existing in the full-automatic method is solved.

title: Subject data management system
abstract: A system for managing subject data relating to a body status of a subject, the system including one or more subject databases storing subject data for a plurality of subjects, the subject data being indicative of body status indicator and measured body parameter values of the subject and one or more processing devices that receives collected subject data from a client device via a communications network, the client device receiving measurement data indicative of at least one measured body parameter value of a subject from a measuring device, and the collected subject data being indicative of at least one of the measurement data and the at least one measured body parameter value and determines an identity of the subject, updates the subject data for the subject using the collected subject data and retrieves retrieved subject data for the subject, the retrieved subject data being indicative of measured body parameter values for the respective subject and being used to derive a body status indicator indicative of a body status of the subject.

title: Sum-of-products operator, sum-of-products operation method, logical operation device, and neuromorphic device
abstract: A sum-of-products operator including: a first circuit configured to generate a plurality of signals, each of which corresponds to each of a plurality of data; a second circuit including a first operation circuit configured to multiply each of the signals generated by the first circuit by a weight using a plurality of variable resistive elements having variable resistance values, and to calculate a sum of a plurality of results of multiplications; a third circuit configured to calculate a result of summing values corresponding to the data or a result of the summing value after being adjusted; and a fourth circuit including a differential circuit configured to output a difference between a calculated result in the first operation circuit of the second circuit and a calculated result in the third circuit.

title: Method and device for predicting dose volume histogram of organ at risk of radiotherapy plan
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting a dose volume histogram of a radiotherapy planning endangered organ, which are used for determining an anatomical structure diagram of an interested region for model training and a dose area histogram of the endangered organ; determining a prediction model; inputting the anatomy structure of the labeled region of interest of the new patient into the prediction model for prediction to obtain the dose volume histogram of the organs at risk of the new patient, wherein the prediction method has short time consumption and high accuracy, and is suitable for patients with target regions with various prescription doses and various different anatomy structures of organs at risk; the method is not limited to tumor types, can predict different tumor types, and has wide clinical application range; the invention can realize automatic setting of the initial objective function of the personalized inverse plan and plan quality inspection, improve the design quality of the radiotherapy plan, shorten the design time and solve the problems of time consumption and large difference of the plan quality of the precise radiotherapy plan.

title: Label labeling method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a label labeling method, a label labeling device, label labeling equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target image data from off-line storage equipment, and performing signature encryption on the target image data in a target verification mode corresponding to a target account; operating the labeling client to verify the target image data; loading a target image in response to the target account matching the target image data; receiving label marking operation to obtain label marking results; and sending the label labeling result to a server, wherein the server is used for generating training sample data of the image recognition model. And transmitting the target image data to the terminal in a down-line circulation mode, and signing and encrypting the target image data by combining a target account registered by a labeling client in the terminal, so that the target image data can be verified and read only when the account registered by the labeling client is the target account, and the transmission efficiency of the target image data is improved in the down-line circulation mode.

title: Medical equipment monitoring and analyzing system based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 西安交通大学医学院第一附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a medical equipment monitoring and analyzing system based on artificial intelligence, which particularly relates to the technical field of medical equipment monitoring, and comprises a sensor quality analyzing module, an operating environment analyzing module and an operating condition analyzing module, wherein the operating environment of medical equipment is monitored to obtain an operating environment abnormality evaluation index, so that abnormal operation of the medical equipment and abnormal output data caused by abnormal operating environment are avoided; the reliability of the sensor data is obtained through monitoring the sensor data, so that the problem of inaccurate acquired data caused by abnormal sensor in the prior art is solved; acquiring an output accuracy index of the medical equipment based on the equipment operation information; obtaining an equipment operation risk assessment coefficient based on the quality stability index of the sensor, the operation environment abnormality assessment index and the output accuracy index; and (5) taking corresponding treatment measures based on the equipment operation risk assessment coefficient to complete the real-time monitoring treatment of the medical equipment.
