primary_assignee: 北京品驰医疗设备有限公司

title: Machine learning model for predicting multidrug resistant gene targets
abstract: A method of predicting a gene target sequence for a gene-modifying therapeutic, such as a CRISPR-based therapeutic, that includes the steps of determining a genomic dataset for one or more infectious bacterial samples isolated from one or more hospitals, and inputting the genomic dataset for the one or more infectious bacterial samples into a machine learning model to determine the presence of antimicrobial resistance genes.

title: Synthetically generating medical images using deep convolutional generative adversarial networks
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: Methods, devices, and systems that are related to facilitating an automated, fast and accurate model for cardiac image segmentation, particularly for image data of children with complex congenital heart disease are disclosed. In one example aspect, a generative adversarial network is disclosed. The generative adversarial network includes a generator configured to generate synthetic imaging samples associated with a cardiovascular system, and a discriminator configured to receive the synthetic imaging samples from the generator and determine probabilities indicating likelihood of the synthetic imaging samples corresponding to real cardiovascular imaging sample. The discriminator is further configured to provide the probabilities determined by the discriminator to the generator and the discriminator to allow the parameters of the generator and the parameters of the discriminator to be adjusted iteratively until an equilibrium between the generator and the discriminator is established.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of california
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of california

title: Text data desensitization method, device, medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 医渡云（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a text data desensitization method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring text data; processing the text data through a preset dictionary tree and/or a preset regular expression to obtain a first sensitive entity word of the text data; processing the text data through a preset model to obtain a label of each character in the text data; determining a second sensitive entity word of the text data according to the label of each character in the text data; determining a sensitive entity word of the text data according to a first sensitive entity word of the text data and a second sensitive entity word of the text data; the desensitization processing is carried out on the sensitive entity words of the text data, and the sensitive entity words of the text data are determined to be more accurate by utilizing the mutual complementary proofreading of the first sensitive entity words and the second sensitive entity words, so that the result of the desensitization processing on the text data is more accurate, the desensitization processing on the non-sensitive entity words is avoided, and the user experience is improved.
assignee_clean: 医渡云 北京 技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 医渡云 北京 技术有限公司

title: Method and apparatus for implementing automatic evolution platform through automatic machine learning
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and apparatus for implementing machine learning based on an expert evaluation. The method of operating a server providing an artificial intelligence (AI) platform can comprise: a step of receiving an inference request message including input data into an AI model from a user apparatus; a step of using the AI model, conducting an inference based on the input data, and acquiring an inference result; a step of transmitting an inference result message including the inference result to the user apparatus; a step of an evaluation request message including the inference result to an expert apparatus; a step of receiving an evaluation result message including an expert evaluation on the inference result from the expert apparatus; and a step of using learning data generated based on the expert evaluation, and conducting a re-learning on the AI model. The present invention aims to provide a method and apparatus for implementing machine learning based on expert evaluation, which are capable of more effectively analyzing genetic and medical information.

title: Methods and systems for generating fitness recommendations according to user activity profiles
abstract: A system for generating fitness recommendations according to user activity profiles. The system includes a computing device configured to retrieve an element of user activity data and an element of user physiological data. A computing device generates utilizing fitness training data in combination with classification algorithms and a fitness classifier an output that includes a fitness profile. A computing device utilizes feature learning algorithms combined with a fitness profile to identify recommended exercises.

title: Privacy-compliant analysis of health by transaction data
abstract: Health-related data is accessed; as is a database of payment card transaction data. At least a portion of the health-related data is linked to at least a portion of the payment card transaction data to obtain linked data. Statistical analysis is carried out on the linked data, and the results of the statistical analysis are made available to at least one appropriate party. Privacy is protected, for example, via an opt-in approach or through data aggregation.

title: Machine learning-based hazard visualization system
abstract: A hazard visualization system that can use artificial intelligence to identify locations at which hazards have occurred and a cause therein and to predict locations at which hazards may occur in the future is described herein. As a result, the hazard visualization system may reduce the likelihood of structural damage and/or loss of life that could otherwise occur due to natural disasters or other hazards. For example, the hazard visualization system can train an artificial intelligence model to predict the date, time, type, severity, path, and/or other conditions of a hazard that may occur at a geographic location. As another example, the hazard visualization system can train an artificial intelligence model to identify equipment or other infrastructure depicted in geographic images.

title: Pediatric drug complications monitoring system
assignee: 深圳市尼罗河移动互联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical monitoring, in particular to a pediatric drug complication monitoring system, which comprises a symptom analysis module, a drug response evaluation module, a complication mode identification module, a drug interaction prediction module, a risk measurement module, a dynamic disease monitoring module, a personalized treatment scheme module and a drug side effect tracking module. According to the invention, natural language processing and pattern recognition are combined, the accuracy and efficiency of symptom analysis are improved, a decision tree and a probability statistical method predict drug reaction, misdiagnosis is reduced, a convolutional neural network and an image analysis technology accurately identify a medical image complication pattern, diagnosis accuracy is improved, an Apriori algorithm predicts drug interaction, risks are prevented, a Bayesian network and a risk assessment model quantify the complication risks, accurate risk assessment is provided, long-term and short-term memory network and a time sequence analysis technology dynamically monitor disease progress and complication risks, and a comprehensive pediatric drug complication monitoring system is constructed.
assignee_clean: 深圳市尼罗河移动互联科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市尼罗河移动互联科技有限公司

title: Determining functional age indices based upon sensor data
abstract: An approach is described with respect to functional age analysis. A method pertaining to such approach may include receiving sensor data collected on a plurality of individuals via a plurality of sensor devices. The method further may include constructing an age indices model by applying machine learning to the collected sensor data. The method further may include determining one or more functional age indices for a subject individual by applying the age indices model to profile data associated with the subject individual. In an embodiment, the method further may include transmitting the one or more functional age indices determined for the subject individual to a professional or a knowledge base, and receiving and processing one or more prescribed recommendations for the subject individual. According to such embodiment, the method further may include updating the age indices model based upon feedback received with respect to the one or more prescribed recommendations.

title: Method and system for generating a confidence score using deep learning model
abstract: In a system and method for analyzing images, an input image is provided to a computer and is processed therein with a first deep learning model so as to generate an output result for the input image; and applying a second deep learning model is applied to the input image to generate an output confidence score that is indicative of the reliability of any output result from the first deep learning model for the input image.

title: Understanding a query intention for medical artificial intelligence systems using semi-supervised deep learning
abstract: Provided are a method and an apparatus for receiving a query including a sequence of words. The sequence of words is converted into a sequence of feature vectors. A semantic meaning of the sequence of words is generated using a bi-directional long-short term memory (LSTM). The LSTM is regularized using a Gaussian mixed model (GMM) based on the generated semantic meaning of the sequence of feature vectors.

title: Medication recommendation system and method for treating migraine
abstract: Method and System for providing a medical drug recommendation. Time and location data is read from received client data. Weather data is retrieved based on the time and location data and the weather data is stored in a user data set. A medical drug recommendation is computed from a user data set that comprises migraine event data by using a statistical model. Furthermore, a server is prepared to provide medical drug recommendations, wherein a statistical model for delivering a medical drug recommendation is adjusted by providing user data as input data to a statistical model, the user data sets comprising migraine events.

title: Medical object classification method and apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
assignee: 浙江太美医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a medical target classification method and device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: jointly inputting the T1C image, the T2 image and the FLAIR image which are registered by the target to be classified into a first deep neural network model which is trained in advance to obtain a three-dimensional mask of the target to be classified; respectively determining the corresponding maximum target layer surfaces on the three-dimensional mask, the T1C image and the T2 image of the target to be classified; jointly inputting the maximum target layer surface of the target to be classified on the three-dimensional mask, the T1C image and the T2 image into a second deep neural network model which is trained in advance to obtain the primary classification of the target to be classified; and inputting the preliminary classification of the target to be classified and the target classification reference characteristics into a pre-trained classifier to obtain the final classification of the target to be classified. The medical target classification method combines multi-dimensional and multi-level information such as image characteristics and clinical information characteristics, and can improve the accuracy of medical target classification.
assignee_clean: 浙江太美医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 浙江太美医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Responding to emergency calls
abstract: According to an aspect, there is provided an apparatus (500; FIG. 5) for determining an action to be taken in response to an emergency call, the apparatus comprising: a processor (502; FIG. 5) configured to receive an indication that an emergency call has been initiated; extract, from speech transmitted as part of the emergency call, features indicative of a medical condition or event relating to a subject; obtain medical data relating to the subject; predict, based on the extracted features and the medical data, an acuity level of the subject; determine, based on the acuity level, an action to be taken in respect of the subject; and provide an indication of the determined action for presentation to a recipient.

title: Anatomy-aware adaptation of graphical user interface
abstract: A framework for anatomy-aware adaptation of a graphical user interface. Landmarks are first detected by passing one or more current images through a trained machine learning model. A body section may then be inferred based on the detected landmarks. One or more user interface elements may be determined based on the inferred body section. A graphical user interface may then be adapted with the determined one or more user interface elements.

title: Ai-based interpretation service system of medical image
abstract: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based medical image reading service system. The system comprises: a modality determining unit for determining a modality type of a medical image to be read when the medical image to be read in which a plurality of organs is included is input; an image segmentation module including a plurality of organ classification models classified by modality type of the medical image and segmenting the medical image to be read into a plurality of organ images by using the organ classification model corresponding to the modality type determined by the modality determining unit; a plurality of reading models divided by modality type and organ type of the medical image, wherein at least one reading model is provided for each modality type and organ; a model selection unit for selecting one of each of the organ images according to a preset selection criterion among reading models corresponding to the modality type determined by the modality determining unit and the organ type of organ images segmented by the image segmentation module; and an image reading unit for reading each of the organ images using the reading model selected by the model selection unit. Accordingly, the medical image to be read is analyzed and automatically divided into multiple organ images while possessing the plurality of reading models, and the most appropriate reading model is selected for the characteristics of the medical image, such as the modality type, the organ type, etc. of the organ image and is applied to reading.

title: Image detection model generation method and device, and application method and device
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for generating an image detection model, and an application method and a device. In the embodiment of the invention, the deep learning network model is arranged, the deep learning network model comprises a dimension reduction network and a density estimation network, the dimension reduction network comprises a dimension reduction sub-network and a reconstruction sub-network, the input of the reconstruction sub-network is the low-dimension characteristic output by the dimension reduction sub-network, the input of the density estimation network is data generated according to the associated parameters generated by the dimension reduction network, the initial parameter value of the deep learning network model is arranged, a plurality of sample images are obtained, the sample images are utilized to train the deep learning network model, an image detection model is obtained, and the detection accuracy of an abnormal image is improved by combining two modes of the dimension reduction network and the density estimation network which are mutually associated.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Medical risk factors evaluation
abstract: A method, apparatus and computer program product for using machine learning to evaluate medical risks are described. A graphical user interface is provided for entering a set of patient symptoms for a first patient. A query is sent to a medical system containing the set of patient symptoms. A set of causal factors related to the patient symptoms and a set of association link strengths are received in response. Each association link strength is representative of a strength of a relationship between a respective patient symptom and a respective causal factor. The graphical user interface displays the set of patient symptoms and the set of causal factors according to the respective association link strength to show which causal factors have likely caused the patient symptoms for the first patient and are relevant for selecting among different treatment regimens. The association link strengths are calculated by a set of association link formulas learned by a machine learning system using a set of symptoms and a set of causal factors.

title: Method and program for providing feedback on surgical outcome
assignee: Hutom Inc., Uif (University Industry Foundation), Yonsei Univ.
abstract: A method for providing a feedback on a surgical outcome by a computer includes dividing, by the computer, actual surgical data obtained in an actual surgical process into a plurality of detailed surgical operations to obtain actual surgical cue sheet data composed of the plurality of detailed surgical operations, obtaining, by the computer, reference cue sheet data about the actual surgery, and comparing, by the computer, the actual surgical cue sheet data with the reference cue sheet data, and providing, by the computer, the feedback based on the comparison result.
assignee_clean: hutom; uif university industry foundation; yonsei univ

title: Entity relationship identification method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an entity relationship identification method, an entity relationship identification device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and comprises the following steps: obtaining a sentence, performing word segmentation processing on the sentence to obtain a sentence element, and determining a head entity in the sentence from the sentence element; coding each statement element based on the head entity, and obtaining coding characteristics corresponding to statements according to the obtained statement element characteristics corresponding to the statement elements; performing iterative decoding according to the coding characteristics to identify the entity and obtain probability distribution pointing to the tail entity; decoding according to the coding characteristics and the current decoding state during each iterative decoding, wherein the current decoding state adopts probability distribution obtained by the previous iterative decoding; and after the iterative decoding stop condition is met, determining a tail entity which has an entity corresponding relation with the head entity in the statement based on the tail entity pointed by the probability distribution obtained by iterative decoding of the previous time. By adopting the method, the processing efficiency of entity relationship identification can be improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Weighted adaptive filtering based loss function to predict the first occurrence of multiple events in a single shot
abstract: There is a need for more effective and efficient prediction data analysis. This need can be addressed by, for example, solutions for performing first-occurrence multi-disease prediction. In one example, a method includes determining a per-event-type loss value for each event type of a group of event types; determining a cross-event-type loss value based at least in part on each per-event-type loss value; training a multi-event-type prediction model based at least in part on the cross-event type loss value; generating a first-occurrence prediction based at least in part on the multi-event-type prediction model, wherein the first occurrence-prediction comprises a first-occurrence prediction item for each event type of the group of event types; and performing one or more prediction-based actions based at least in part on the first-occurrence prediction.

title: Systems and methods for providing automated progress updates in a contact center
abstract: Providing automated progress updates in a contact center including detecting an activity by a resource of the contact center related to a customer interaction occurring via a customer communications channel between the resource and a customer. The activity comprises an interaction between the resource and one or more additional resources associated with the contact center occurring via a second communications channel. In response to detecting the activity by the resource, a notification comprising a progress update related to the customer interaction is automatically generated. The notification is transmitted, via the customer communications channel, to a customer device associated with the customer interaction.

title: Cross-domain featuring engineering
abstract: The example embodiments are directed to a continuously expanding cross-domain featuring engineering system. In one example, a method may include one or more of storing predictive features in a cross-domain data store, the predictive features previously used in machine learning modeling in a plurality of different domains, receiving data of an asset included in a target domain and information about an evaluation attribute associated with the asset in the target domain, determining a predictive feature in the received data based on a previously used predictive feature stored in the cross-domain data store which is associated with a machine learning model in a different domain and the evaluation attribute, and outputting the determined predictive feature for display via a user interface.

title: System and method for evaluating the performance of a user in capturing an image of an anatomical region
assignee: Cae Healthcare Canada Inc., Laurent Desmet, Yannick Perron
abstract: ABSTRACT A training platform, a method and a computer-readable medium for evaluating users in capturing images of an internal anatomical region for the analysis of organs. Automated machine learning models, trained on a dataset of labelled training images associated with different imaging device positions, are used. The one or more automated machine learning models are used to process an image resulting from a user positioning an imaging device at various imaging device positions relative to a training manikin, a human or an animal, to determine whether the generated image corresponds to a predefined view required for the analysis of the organ features shown therein. An output indicative of whether the generated image corresponds to the predefined view expected for organ analysis and measurements is provided. 16080-0045 / P19009 - 25 - Date Recue/Date Received 2021-02-26
assignee_clean: cae healthcare canada; laurent desmet; yannick perron

title: Injection device
abstract: Injection monitoring circuitry is provided for coupling to part of an injection device having a syringe and a plunger rod. The injection monitoring circuitry has an input to receive force measurement data from a force sensor, the force measurement data includes a plurality of timestamped force measurements of force applied by a user to the injection device when an injection is administered to an injection site. Processing circuitry is provided to determine from the force measurement data when an end of injection has been reached, the end of injection corresponding to the plunger rod having reached an end position in a distal portion of the barrel of the syringe during administration of the injection by the user. Machine readable instructions and an injection monitoring method are also provided.

title: Depth map matching-based automatic classification method and system for medical data elements
abstract: The invention discloses a medical data element automatic classification method and a medical data element automatic classification system based on depth map matching, wherein a medical data element map data model based on minimum metadata information is defined, so that the effect of the depth map matching model is also suitable for the condition of local data swamp of extremely low metadata information, the aim of completing data element automatic classification by using the minimum metadata information is fulfilled, and meanwhile, the graph structure data acquired under the standard of the map data model is ensured to be suitable for the training of the depth map matching model; calculating vector representation of the medical data elements based on a representation learning method, and rapidly and automatically screening effective data elements which are possibly mapped to a standard data model through classification of the vector representation; and calculating vector representation of the column vertex based on a graph attention machine mechanism, and constructing a depth map matching model to finish automatic classification of the medical data elements. The method and the system have good expansibility and can be applied to the treatment of the problem of converting various data swamps into data lakes.

title: System and method to provide public safety access to an enterprise
abstract: A method for providing public safety access to an enterprise is provided. The method may include receiving an indication of an incident at an enterprise location. The method may further include determining a type of biometric access control in use at the enterprise location. The method may further include retrieving biometric data for a responder assigned to the incident is compatible with the type of biometric access control in use at the enterprise location. The method may also include adapting the biometric data to be compatible with a specific biometric access control system in use at the enterprise location. The method may additionally include sending the adapted biometric data to the specific biometric access control system in use at the enterprise location, wherein the specific biometric access control system in use at the enterprise location grants access to the enterprise location to the responder.

title: Image processing method and device, neural network and training method thereof, storage medium
abstract: Disclosed are an image processing method, an image processing device, a neutral network and a training method thereof, and a storage medium. The image processing method includes: obtaining an input image; performing a segmentation process on the input image via a first encoding-decoding network, to obtain a first output feature map and the first segmented image; concatenating the first output feature map with at least one selected from the group consisting of the input image and the first segmented image, to obtain an input of the second encoding-decoding network; and performing a segmentation process on the input of the second encoding-decoding network via a second encoding-decoding network, to obtain the second segmented image. And the first encoding-decoding network and the second encoding-decoding network forms a neural network.

title: Methods and system for camera-aided ultrasound scan setup and control
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for adjusting settings of an ultrasound exam based on monitoring of the exam with an optical camera. One example method includes acquiring images of an ultrasound exam via a camera, analyzing the acquired images in real-time to build a spatial exam model, and adjusting settings of the ultrasound exam in real-time based on the spatial exam model.

title: Medical education cooperative system based on traditional Chinese medicine inspection objectivity
abstract: The invention relates to the field of medical treatment and education, in particular to a medical education cooperative system based on traditional Chinese medicine inspection objectification, which comprises a data storage module, a query module and a display module, wherein the data storage module is used for storing a face-tongue picture and inquiry information of a subject under a mode of newly inputting a patient medical record; the prediction model is a convolutional neural network which is trained in advance and is used for inputting the facial tongue picture and the inquiry information and outputting a prediction result; the prediction result comprises the recognition result of the facial region, the objective characteristics of the facial and tongue images, the constitution of the traditional Chinese medicine and the classification result of the syndrome type of the traditional Chinese medicine; the student evaluation module is used for inputting answer results and feeding back mistakes by students and evaluating the answer results by teachers; and the model upgrading module is used for carrying out expert correction on the feedback survey errors and then transmitting the feedback survey errors back to the prediction model and triggering the prediction model to carry out optimization training. The invention outputs the traditional Chinese medicine experience in a mode, combines a deep learning algorithm, is used for traditional Chinese medicine clinic and teaching, and finally serves the scientific explanation of the traditional Chinese medicine experience.

title: IoT device identification with packet flow behavior machine learning model
abstract: Identifying Internet of Things (IoT) devices with packet flow behavior including by using machine learning models is disclosed. Information associated with a network communication of an IoT device is received. A determination of whether the IoT device has previously been classified is made. In response to determining that the IoT device has not previously been classified, a determination is made that a probability match for the IoT device against a behavior signature exceeds a threshold. Based at least in part on the probability match, a classification of the IoT device is provided to a security appliance configured to apply a policy to the IoT device.

title: Safety monitoring method and system for medical network
assignee: 北京立思辰新技术有限公司, 杭州谷逸网络科技有限公司, 国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心
abstract: The invention discloses a safety monitoring method and a system based on a medical network, which comprises the steps of automatically identifying all equipment and equipment types connected on the current medical network and providing a real-time running state; tracking data exchange of each device on the medical network, and analyzing and determining a normal behavior mode of each connected device; and analyzing and judging the abnormal control instruction in real time, isolating the threat in real time according to the requirement and sending alarm information to the network management platform. The equipment required by the realization method comprises safety monitoring equipment for processing network flow and extracting useful information; the remote server analyzes data from the security monitoring device and discovers and identifies devices on the medical network by using a machine learning algorithm, classifies the devices according to the acquired information, determines a correct behavior mode of each device, detects abnormal behaviors and completes post-processing of the abnormal behaviors.
assignee_clean: 北京立思辰新技术有限公司; 杭州谷逸网络科技有限公司; 国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心
primary_assignee: 北京立思辰新技术有限公司

title: Medical document display control apparatus, medical document display control method, and medical document display control program
abstract: The medical document display control apparatus includes a reception unit that receives observation information on a subject, an acquisition unit that acquires relation information on an analysis result obtained by immediately analyzing the observation information received by the reception unit, and a display control unit that immediately displays the relation information acquired by the acquisition unit on a display unit.

title: Systems and methods for improved diagnostics for nuclear medicine imaging
abstract: Systems and methods described herein generally relate to improved medical diagnostics for nuclear medicine (NM) imaging. The systems and methods define an uncertainty model of a medical imaging system. The uncertainty model is based on natural-statistics distribution of the medical imaging system response. The systems and methods acquire image data of a patient from the medical imaging system, and calculate an uncertainty map of the patient based on the uncertainty model and the image data. The uncertainty map represents a collection of realizations that are generated based on the image data and the uncertainty model. The systems and methods apply a classification or ranking algorithm to the image data and the uncertainty map to calculate image data classification or ranking of the patient including confidence values.

title: Systems and methods for generating clinically relevant images that preserve physical attributes of humans while protecting personal identity
abstract: A computer implemented method of generating at least one anonymous image, comprises: extracting and preserving at least one real facial region from at least one real image of a real human face, and generating at least one anonymous image comprising a synthetic human face and the preserved at least one real facial region, wherein an identity of the real human face is non-determinable from the at least one anonymous image.

title: Medical image lesion detection method, system and equipment integrating clinical information
assignee: 合肥综合性国家科学中心人工智能研究院(安徽省人工智能实验室)
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of computer technology and intelligent medical treatment, and particularly relates to a medical image lesion detection method, system and equipment fusing clinical information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical image data to be diagnosed; inputting the medical image to be diagnosed into the trained image classification model to obtain a predicted value of probability that a lesion detection result is positive; and when the predicted value is positioned in the designated interval, multiplying the predicted value by the correction coefficient, and taking the multiplied result as the final probability that the lesion detection result is positive. The invention utilizes the statistic prior information of the gender and age of the object to be detected, adjusts the output probability in the prediction stage of the deep learning model of the medical image through the thought of Bayesian decision, solves the problem that the low-dimensional additional information and the high-dimensional image are submerged after the feature fusion, thereby integrating the prior knowledge except the radiological image and improving the classification effect of the deep learning model.
assignee_clean: 合肥综合性国家科学中心人工智能研究院 安徽省人工智能实验室
primary_assignee: 合肥综合性国家科学中心人工智能研究院 安徽省人工智能实验室

title: Automated and secure methods for dispensing medication
abstract: A point of care device for securely dispensing medication includes an enclosure sized to contain medication containers, a holding element accessible from outside the enclosure to receive medication containers from the enclosure, a dispenser to dispense medication from the enclosure to the holding element, and a securable panel configured to provide access to the enclosure for retrieval or replenishment of the medication containers within the enclosure, and a computing device operable to control the dispenser to dispense medication to the holding element based on various conditions. Specifically, the point of care device can be configured to dispense medication based on detecting that an authorized user is accessing the device, based on a timer in conjunction with known medication regimen, or based on patient or physician demand, or based on biometric information concerning the user.

title: Training deep learning engines for radiotherapy treatment planning
abstract: Example methods and systems for training deep learning engines for radiotherapy treatment planning are provided. One example method may comprise: obtaining a set of training data that includes unlabeled training data and labeled training data; and configuring a deep learning engine to include (a) a primary network and (b) a deep supervision network that branches off from the primary network. The method may further comprise: training the deep learning engine to perform the radiotherapy treatment planning task by processing training data instance to generate (a) primary output data and (b) deep supervision output data; and updating weight data associated with at least some of the multiple processing layers based on the primary output data and/or the deep supervision output data. The deep supervision network may be pruned prior to applying the primary network to perform the radiotherapy treatment planning task for a patient.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine rare disease traditional Chinese medicine prescription generation method and system based on transfer learning
abstract: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine rare disease traditional Chinese medicine prescription generation method and system based on transfer learning, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining a Chinese medicine knowledge learning model; step S2: generating a corresponding traditional Chinese medicine name sequence based on an LSTM model of a multi-head self-attention mechanism; and step S3: obtaining a traditional Chinese medicine dosage generation model; and step S4: and combining the traditional Chinese medicine name sequence and the characteristic data set as the input of the traditional Chinese medicine dose generation model, sequentially generating the recommended dose of each traditional Chinese medicine, and finally generating a complete traditional Chinese medicine prescription. The invention uses a two-segment type migration learning algorithm, trains a traditional Chinese medicine knowledge learning model in the field of traditional Chinese medicine based on a self-built traditional Chinese medicine corpus, and corrects the traditional Chinese medicine knowledge learning model by using rare clinical cases of traditional Chinese medicine. The method simulates the learning process of a doctor in traditional Chinese medicine, the generated traditional Chinese medicine prescription is more suitable for the illness state of a patient, and the empirical knowledge generated by the doctor in the clinical diagnosis and treatment process is fully utilized.

title: Method, system and equipment for constructing retinopathy incidence risk prediction model
assignee: 南昌大学第二附属医院
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system and equipment for constructing a retinopathy incidence risk prediction model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical index data of a plurality of premature infants and mothers thereof; cleaning the selected modeling factors by adopting a data cleaning method to clean out the relevant modeling factors which finally participate in modeling, and constructing a training sample set according to the relevant modeling factors; respectively training a plurality of initial prediction models of different types through a training sample set to obtain a plurality of post-training prediction models; and evaluating the plurality of trained prediction models by adopting a preset model evaluation index, and determining the optimal trained prediction model after evaluation as a retinopathy incidence risk prediction model. According to the invention, a prediction model capable of accurately predicting the onset risk of retinopathy of prematurity in early stage is obtained through training, so that the dilemma that ROP can be predicted only by depending on fundus pictures is eliminated, and effective and accurate ROP prediction can be carried out in regions with insufficient service and remote areas.
assignee_clean: 南昌大学第二附属医院
primary_assignee: 南昌大学第二附属医院

title: Robotic arm for patient protection
abstract: An approach for a computer in a robotic arm device attached to a patient to receive data identifying at least one protected area of the patient from a computing device of a medical professional. The approach includes the computer receiving instructions for one or more actions by the robotic arm device associated with the least one protected area of the patient from the computing device of the medical professional. Additionally, the approach includes the computer receiving sensor data associated with one or more movements of the patient from one or more sensors in the robotic arm device and determining that a hand of the patient in the robotic arm device is entering the at least one protected area. Furthermore, the approach includes the computer initiating one action of one or more actions by the robotic arm device that is associated with the least one protected area of the patient.

title: Intelligent insight system and method for facilitating participant involvement
abstract: A system and method for improving outcomes in various person-to-person goal-oriented interactions is disclosed. Specifically, the method and system enable intelligent insights and recommendations to be presented to a facilitator of the interaction via a virtual assistant user interface. When the facilitator seeks to produce a specific goal with respect to the participant, the system can be configured to automatically generate, based on a series of inputs about the participant and previous interactions, intelligent recommendations that have a high likelihood of successfully promoting the target goal in the current scenario.

title: MRI and CT multi-mode 3D automatic registration method and device
assignee: 德智鸿(上海)机器人有限责任公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image registration, and discloses an MRI and CT multi-mode 3D automatic registration method, which comprises the following steps: s1: obtaining lumbar medical images of CT and MRI modes, and automatically preprocessing and affine transforming; s2: and constructing a deep learning registration network, wherein the deep learning registration network comprises a deformation registration network, a forward space transformer and a reverse space transformer. The invention solves the problem that a targeted MRI and CT automatic registration tool is lacking in the field of orthopaedics imaging, reduces the calculation cost by utilizing a window registration technology, improves the matching precision by means of deep learning, and can quickly obtain high-precision lumbar MRI and CT fusion images.
assignee_clean: 德智鸿 上海 机器人有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 德智鸿 上海 机器人有限责任公司

title: System and method for monitoring drug delivery
abstract: A system for monitoring drug delivery is disclosed including a container having a medicine disposed inside, the medicine associated with a patient; a machine-readable code viewable from an outside of the container; a second code in an interior of the container not accessible until the container is opened; a computer configured to receive from a user device a video showing machine-readable code, the second code, and the patient take the medication, the computer having software executing on a computer readable medium for verifying an association of the medicine and the patient using the machine-readable code; verifying association of the machine-readable code and the patient using the second code; identifying patient movement in the video using a machine learning algorithm; and generating a score indicative of the likelihood the medicine was taken by the patient by weighing factors comprising the verification and the identified movements of the patient.

title: Accurate medicine application method and system for inflammatory bowel disease based on machine learning
assignee: 复旦大学附属华山医院
abstract: The invention provides a machine learning-based accurate medicine application method and system for inflammatory bowel disease, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring energy spectrum CT data of inflammatory bowel disease and preprocessing the energy spectrum CT data to manufacture a disease activity-medication label data set; step S2: performing focus region segmentation on the preprocessed energy spectrum CT data; step S3: will be the focus region ROI of inflammatory bowel disease IBD Extracting image histology characteristics; constructing a migration model; step S4: a non-invasive drug evaluation model of inflammatory bowel disease was obtained. The invention can help guide the selection of treatment regimens for IBD patients, assess prognosisFurther shortens the treatment time of IBD patients and has better clinical practicability.
assignee_clean: 复旦大学附属华山医院
primary_assignee: 复旦大学附属华山医院

title: Femoral stem placing device based on deep reinforcement learning and electronic equipment
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention discloses a femoral stem placement device based on deep reinforcement learning and electronic equipment, wherein the device comprises: the segmentation unit is used for acquiring image data of pelvis and femur of a patient and extracting a femoral medullary cavity cortex region through segmentation of a neural network model; the determining unit is used for determining the femoral medullary cavity axis of the femoral medullary cavity cortex area and enabling the axis of the femoral stem to be along the femoral medullary cavity axis so as to be used for placing the femoral stem; the output unit is used for outputting adjustment information according to the relative position of the femoral stem and the femur by adopting a double-network architecture DDQN; and the adjusting unit is used for adjusting the femoral stem according to the adjusting information so as to enable the femoral stem to be matched with the femur. The invention places the axis of the femoral stem along the axis of the femoral medullary cavity and adjusts the axis through the DDQN of the dual-network architecture, thereby improving the precision of the femoral stem placement, matching the femoral stem with the femur and solving the problems of femoral stem looseness or hip joint pain of patients.
assignee_clean: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司; 张逸凌
primary_assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司

title: Interactive information processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安医疗健康管理股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an interactive information processing method based on natural language processing, which comprises the following steps: acquiring interactive information sent by a user terminal, and extracting text information corresponding to the interactive information; performing text segmentation on the text information to obtain a plurality of text sentences; identifying and extracting texts to be standardized corresponding to the plurality of texts through a text analysis model; extracting the domain semantic features of the text to be standardized, and calculating mutual information values of the text to be standardized and a plurality of standard texts in a domain word bank; extracting standard texts of which mutual information values reach a mutual information threshold value to generate a candidate set; extracting and outputting standard texts of which the similarity between the text to be standardized and a plurality of standard texts in the candidate set reaches a similarity threshold; and matching the standard text with the knowledge graph data, acquiring matched target knowledge information and pushing the target knowledge information to the user terminal. By adopting the method, the domain keywords of the interactive information can be accurately and effectively identified so as to improve the processing efficiency of the interactive information and the accuracy of information pushing.
assignee_clean: 平安医疗健康管理股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安医疗健康管理股份有限公司

title: Modular garment for a wearable medical device
abstract: A cardiac monitoring and treatment system includes a controller, a first wearable portion, and a second wearable portion separate from the first wearable portion. The first wearable portion includes an elongated strap configured to encircle a thoracic region of a patient, a plurality of ECG sensing electrodes disposed about the elongated strap, one or more receiving ports configured to receive one or more additional components including a treatment electrode and/or an additional sensor, and a plurality of conductive wires configured to couple the plurality of ECG sensing electrodes and the one or more receiving ports with the controller. The second wearable portion is configured to be worn over at least one shoulder of the patient and includes a wearable substrate, one or more treatment electrodes disposed on the wearable substrate, and at least one conductive wire configured to releasably connect the one or more treatment electrodes to the controller.

title: Systems and methods to process electronic images to determine salient information in digital pathology
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for identifying a diagnostic feature of a digitized pathology image, including receiving one or more digitized images of a pathology specimen, and medical metadata comprising at least one of image metadata, specimen metadata, clinical information, and/or patient information, applying a machine learning model to predict a plurality of relevant diagnostic features based on medical metadata, the machine learning model having been developed using an archive of processed images and prospective patient data, and determining at least one relevant diagnostic feature of the relevant diagnostic features for output to a display.

title: Method for determining whether medication adherence has been fulfilled considering medication adherence type and server using same
abstract: The present application relates to a server for determining whether medication adherence has been fulfilled, wherein the server comprises: a server communication part for receiving a video recorded by a wearable device; a memory storing part for storing a model for determining whether medication adherence has been fulfilled, the model including a first model corresponding to a first medication adherence-related object and a second model corresponding to the second medication adherence-related object; a server control part configured to determine whether a user has adhered to medication based on the video received through the server communication part, in which the server control part classifies the video into one of a first category related to the first medication adherence-related object and a second category related to the second medication adherence-related object. If the video is classified into the first category, the server control part uses the first model and the video to determine whether the user adheres to the medication. If the video is classified into the second category, the server control part uses the second model and the video to determine whether the user adheres to the medication.

title: Systems and methods for medical imaging
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method for medical imaging may include obtaining a plurality of successive images of a region of interest (ROI) including at least a portion of an object's heart. The plurality of successive images may be based on imaging data acquired from the ROI by a scanner without electrocardiography (ECG) gating. The plurality of successive images may be related to one or more cardiac cycles of the object's heart. The method may also include automatically determining, in the plurality of successive images, target images that correspond to at least one of the one or more cardiac cycles of the object's heart.

title: Method And Apparatus for Classifying ECG wave by Using Machine Learning
abstract: Disclosed are a method and a device for classifying an electrocardiogram waveform using machine learning. The present embodiment provides a method and a device for classifying an electrocardiogram waveform using machine learning, the method comprising the steps of: applying a segmentation technique to an electrocardiogram waveform to identify a characteristic index value of each section of a P waveform, a Q waveform, an R waveform, an S waveform, a T waveform and a noise waveform included in the electrocardiogram waveform; rapidly classifying heartbeats into a normal beat (N), a supraventricular beat (S), a ventricular beat (V) and noise on the basis of the characteristic index value; and removing the noise so that medical judgment can be made quickly and accurately. Therefore, provided are a method and a device for classifying an electrocardiogram waveform using machine learning, wherein quick and accurate medical judgment is enabled.

title: System and method for automatic graphic prescription using deep neural network
abstract: The invention provides a system and a method for automatic graphic prescription using deep neural network. Methods and systems for automatic graphic prescription with a deep learning system are provided. In one embodiment, a method for a medical imaging system includes: acquiring a locator image of the subject by a medical imaging system; generating, by the trained neural network system, a graphic prescription using the locator image; and performing, by the medical imaging system, a scan of the subject according to the graphic prescription. In this way, a desired region of interest of the subject may be accurately scanned with minimal input from an operator of the medical imaging system.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for generating common disease feature knowledge base
abstract: The invention relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for generating a common disease feature knowledge base, belonging to the technical field of medical data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting patient electronic medical record text and preprocessing data; extracting an entity and an information group of the electronic medical record text to obtain a text deep structuring result, wherein the information group consists of entity pairs; carrying out term standardization on a text deep structuring result based on a deep learning model to form co-disease features; according to the text deep structuring result and the manual diagnosis result after term standardization, supplementing the diagnosis result by using an auxiliary diagnosis model, and mining a common disease mode of the diagnosis result based on an association rule algorithm; and constructing a co-disease characteristic knowledge base based on the co-disease characteristics and the co-disease mode. Compared with the prior art, the co-disease characteristic knowledge base constructed by the invention has the advantages of supporting fine granularity screening and the like.

title: Human-like emulation enterprise system and method
assignee: Kurtis John Ritchey, Kenneth Ira Ritchey
abstract: An enterprise system and method for maintaining and transitioning humans to a human-like self-reliant entity is presented. Said system including at least one a biological, biomechatronic, and mechatronic entity with a biological or artificial neural network to at least one transform or maintain. Embodiments are provided to assist in the transition of human between a biological state to a bio-mechatronic and mechatronic entity. Said entity's biological, biomechatronic, and mechatronic subsystems are configured to communicate and interact with one another in order for said enterprise system to manage, configure, maintain, and sustain said entity throughout the entity's life-cycle. Subsystem embodiments and components supported by the enterprise system are presented.
assignee_clean: kurtis john ritchey; kenneth ira ritchey

title: Diabetes and hypertension probability calculation system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning-based diabetes and hypertension probability calculation method, which comprises the following steps: (1) after acquiring user physical examination data, carrying out data cleaning and preprocessing, and then respectively carrying out coding operation on digital data and text data in the data to obtain training data; (2) establishing a multitask probability calculation model for diabetes and hypertension; (3) training the multi-task probability calculation model by using training data, and optimizing network parameters according to the superposition condition of the result of model calculation and labels of diabetes and hypertension until the model is converged; (4) and cleaning, preprocessing and coding the physical examination data needing to calculate the probability of diabetes and hypertension, and inputting the physical examination data into the trained model to calculate the probability of diabetes and hypertension. By utilizing the method and the device, the probability of diabetes and hypertension can be calculated simultaneously, and doctors are assisted to make better judgment.

title: Systems and methods for software development and deployment platforms having advanced workflow and event processing capabilities and graphical version controls
abstract: This disclosure relates to an improved software development platform that enables the dynamic generation and deployment of advanced applications such as electronic forms and/or other applications. The platform includes graphical user interfaces that enable users to drag-and-drop or otherwise insert components into a development window to define the content, functionality, workflow, background processes, and other criteria for the electronic forms. The components may correspond to pre-defined or pre-packaged software bundles that can be integrated into the electronic forms to define input fields, design layouts, application functions, preconfigured templates, and background processes. After electronic forms are completed, options can be selected to deploy the forms in a cloud-based environment or in other ways. This disclosure is also related to improved software development and deployment platforms that provide version control components that are configured to perform various functions associated with managing, controlling, accessing, and/or comparing multiple versions of electronic forms and associated form components.

title: Conversation system for detecting a dangerous mental or physical condition
abstract: The present disclosure describes a system to use conversation data of patients to detect dangerous mental or physical conditions, such as suicidal thoughts, physical abuse, recent falls, and viral infection. A machine learning system may be trained to identify a dangerous mental or physical condition from conversations based on examples of patients evaluated to have a specific mental or physical condition. Conversations of patients may be monitored, natural language understanding (NLU) processing performed, and a machine learning system used to detect dangerous mental or physical conditions.

title: Method and apparatus for supporting measurement reporting enhancement for aerial device in wireless communication system
abstract: A method and apparatus for supporting a measurement reporting enhancement for an aerial device in a wireless communication system is provided. A prohibit timer can be used in order to prohibit frequent measurement reporting, and the prohibit timer may be stopped when a leaving condition for the measurement reporting is satisfied and/or a handover procedure and/or a radio resource control (RRC) connection re-establishment procedure is performed.

title: Vision screening device and methods
abstract: A vision screening system for testing the vision of a patient is described herein. The vision screening system may include a vision screening device configured to perform a number of vision screening tests. For example, the system may be configured to determine or generate a graphical representation for display to the patient, via the vision screening device, to evaluate the health of the patient's vision and/or detect abnormal vision behavior. The system may be configured to evaluate image/video data recorded by the vision screening device to determine measurements associated with the patient during the vision screening. The system may be configured to analyze the measurements to generate a diagnosis recommendation associated with the vision of the patient. The system may also be configured to display the recommendation and/or the measurements, along with additional screening data, to a tester conducting the vision test.

title: Systems and methods for implementing a secure database for storing a patient operational longitudinal record
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for aggregating and indexing a patient operational longitudinal record and extracting statistics therefrom. In one example, a system for storing and indexing entries in a patient operational longitudinal record may include at least one memory storing instructions and at least one processor configured to execute the instructions to: receive a health update from an authenticated device; map the health update to a health record; apply at least one stored rule to the health update and the health record to determine additional operational data; index and store the health update and the additional operational data in association with the health record; and allow access to the health record based on an associated security protocol.

title: Protocol-aware tissue segmentation in medical imaging
abstract: For medical imaging such as MRI, machine training is used to train a network for segmentation using both the imaging data and protocol data (e.g., meta-data). The network is trained to segment based, in part, on the configuration and/or scanner, not just the imaging data, allowing the trained network to adapt to the way each image is acquired. In one embodiment, the network architecture includes one or more blocks that receive both types of data as input and output both types of data, preserving relevant features for adaptation through at least part of the trained network.

title: Medical resource allocation method and equipment based on lung CT image and clinical information
abstract: The application discloses a medical resource allocation method and equipment based on lung CT images and clinical information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: segmenting a pathological region from a lung CT image and generating a lung focus slice; respectively taking a lung focus slice of a patient and clinical diagnosis information of a preset type as input, taking severity labels as output, and training two different learning models to obtain two mutually independent severity prediction models; respectively taking the feature vector of the CT image and the clinical diagnosis information of a preset type as input, taking the medical resource allocation label as output, and training to obtain two medical resource pre-allocation models based on random forests; and (3) respectively performing resource pre-allocation on the new patient with pneumonia by using two medical resource pre-allocation models based on CT images and clinical information of the new patient, and finally fusing allocation results to serve as a final medical resource allocation scheme of the new patient. The application can reasonably allocate the medical resources and avoid the waste of the medical resources.

title: Medical information processing apparatus, medical information processing method, and storage medium
abstract: According to one embodiment, a medical information processing apparatus includes processing circuitry configured to derive an index value with respect to noise included in data associated with magnetic resonance signals collected by each of a plurality of reception coils, adjust a degree to which noise is removed from the data associated with the magnetic resonance signals based on the derived index value, remove noise from the data associated with the magnetic resonance signals based on the adjusted degree, and perform compositing of the data associated with the magnetic resonance signals from which noise has been removed.

title: Generation of medical records based on doctor-patient dialogue
abstract: Methods and apparatus for generating medical records from a doctor-patient dialogue are provided. A main content portion of a written doctor-patient conversation is identified. The main content portion of the conversation is extracted from the conversation. The main content of the conversation is divided into sections according to a pre-defined set of sections, and, based on the sections and their respective content, a medical record is generated according to a pre-defined template. The pre-defined template is one of a hard medical record format or a soft medical record format.

title: Active prediction, early warning and full-period intelligent management system for venous thromboembolism
assignee: 四川大学华西医院, 北京优炫软件股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an active prediction, early warning and full-period intelligent management system for venous thromboembolism, which comprises an AI VTE intelligent prediction diagnosis and treatment process, wherein the AI VTE intelligent prediction diagnosis and treatment process comprises the following steps: a. automatically acquiring data by a medical big data engine, the data comprising a medical record of a venous thromboembolic patient; b. AI disease analysis and VTE feature extraction; c. AI intelligent model evaluation; d. and outputting the evaluation result to the center of the blood vessel. The invention adopts the combination of big data and artificial intelligence, can actively predict and actively early warn the risk possibly existing in the VTE, and constructs a clinical auxiliary decision-making system, thereby helping medical staff to perform effective and reasonable intervention measures, reducing and further avoiding missed diagnosis, misdiagnosis, mismedication and the like, and finally realizing the high efficiency, accuracy, initiative and intellectualization of VTE prevention and control.
assignee_clean: 四川大学华西医院; 北京优炫软件股份有限公司

title: Automated scanning workflow
abstract: The present disclosure provides, in certain implementations, a rule-based or deep learning-based approach capable of assessing diagnostic utility of images in near real time with respect to acquisition. Correspondingly, an automated implementation of such an algorithm on the scanner would, in fact, emulate the doctor himself rating images in real time, and reduce the number of unneeded re-scans and recalls. In one aspect of the present invention it was found that diagnostic utility of an image is not an absolute measure, but instead depends upon the reading radiologist and the scan indication (i.e., the purpose of the scan). Therefore, adapting the threshold (probability of an imaging volume to be deemed good) as a function of reading radiologist and scan indication can result in decreasing the number of re-scans and recalls.

title: Image recognition module training method and device
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院第一医学中心
abstract: The application discloses an image recognition module training method and device. The method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on a specified medical image based on a convolutional neural network, and generating a first image feature; processing the appointed medical image based on the attention mechanism to obtain a second image feature and an extraction area; acquiring an extraction area image corresponding to the extraction area, namely secondarily windowing in a progressive focusing mode to generate an extraction area image with better training effect; performing feature extraction on the extraction region image based on the convolutional neural network to obtain a third image feature of the extraction region image; and fusing the first image feature, the second image feature and the third image feature to obtain a fused image feature. The application can re-window the interested region based on global image learning, adopts progressive focusing mode to input the neural network, and realizes the aim of training the image recognition module by the multi-window image processing method based on progressive focusing mechanism.

title: Model training method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 联仁健康医疗大数据科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a model training method, a model training device, model training equipment and a storage medium. The model training method comprises the following steps: model training is carried out based on the training data set, and an intermediate model is obtained; based on a preset data acquisition type, acquiring data from a data set to be marked as data to be tested, and generating a model reasoning result of the data to be tested based on a current intermediate model; respectively carrying out test evaluation on the model reasoning result based on the dynamic test set and the fixed test set; if the evaluation result of the fixed test set does not meet the standard condition, adjusting the preset data acquisition type based on the evaluation result of the dynamic test set, and performing iterative training on the intermediate model based on the data to be tested corresponding to the adjusted preset data acquisition type until the evaluation result of the fixed test set meets the standard condition, so as to obtain the target model. The dynamic model evaluation is carried out under the driving of the small sample labeling data, the model iteration is carried out rapidly, and the effect of the model conforming to the labeling is further produced rapidly.

title: Automatic generation of semantic description of visual findings in medical images
abstract: A method comprising using at least one hardware processor for applying a mapping function to a medical image, to generate a semantic description of a visual finding in the medical image. The mapping function is optionally an MRF (Markov random field)-based, SVM (Support Vector Machine) mapping function.

title: Recognizing pathological images captured by alternate image capturing devices
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for recognizing pathological images captured by alternate image capturing devices. In embodiments, a computer-implemented method includes: obtaining, by a computing device, a classifier generated based on a plurality of standardized training pathology images associated with a known classification and generated by a first type of device; receiving, by the computing device, an alternate pathology image captured by a second type of device; standardizing, by the computing device, the alternate pathology image; determining, by the computing device, a classification of the alternate pathology image based on applying the generated classifier; and outputting, by the computing device, information regarding the determined classification to aid in diagnosis of a medical condition represented by the alternate pathology image.

title: Methods and systems for analyzing accessing of medical data
abstract: Various aspects described herein relate to presenting electronic patient data accessing information. Data related to a plurality of access events, by one or more employees, of electronic patient data can be received. A set of access events of the plurality of access events can be determined as constituting, by the one or more employees, possible breach of the electronic patient data. An alert related to the set of access events can be provided based on determining that the set of access events constitute possible breach of the electronic patient data.

title: Operation complication prediction and avoidance aid decision-making system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses an operation complication prediction and avoidance aid decision-making system based on deep learning, relating to the technical field of medical aid decision-making, and the specific scheme is as follows: the system comprises a cloud database, a cloud server, a medical detection module, a medical case module and a doctor terminal; the cloud database includes historical clinical data for the medical institution. The invention closely combines artificial intelligence and medical treatment, covers more than 670 common symptoms, more than 700 symptom synonyms, more than 600 common physical examination items and more than 1200 common inspection items, and has three advantages of operation complication prediction standardization, prevention intellectualization and control individuation. The type, time, severity and the like of the complications are rapidly detected by utilizing deep learning, the medical record and the test data of a patient are read within 10 seconds, preventive measures (high-grade evidence) are recommended, the system performs preliminary test, and the accuracy of the product for predicting the deep venous thrombosis reaches 94.5%.

title: Method for processing parameters of machine learning method and reconstruction method
assignee: 西门子医疗保健有限责任公司
abstract: Method for processing parameters (P) of a machine learning method (L), for providing a corrected data set (KD) of a motion correction of a CT image dataset (CB) of an object (2) moving while recording the CT image dataset, wherein a training data set (T) with a plurality of reference image datasets (RD) is provided for introduction into the machine learning method (L), wherein an iteration (110) is performed, wherein in each iteration step thereof the corrected data set (KD) is determined for each reference image dataset (RD) by means of the machine learning method (L), and a result (E) of a Cost Function (CF) related to the corrected data set (KD) determined in the iteration step is found, and wherein the iteration (110) is ended or the parameters (P) of the machine learning method (L) are changed depending on the result (E) of the Cost Function (CF). Furthermore, a reconstruction method using the processed machine learning method (L) is described.
