primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Systems and methods for image cropping and anatomical structure segmentation in medical imaging
abstract: One or more medical images of a patient are processed by a first neural network model to determine a region-of-interest (ROI) or a cut-off plane. Information from the first neural network model is used to crop the medical images, which serves as input to a second neural network model. The second neural network model processes the cropped medical images to determine contours of anatomical structures in the medical images of the patient. Each of the first and second neural network models are deep neural network models. By use of cropped images in the training and inference phases of the second neural network model, contours are produced with sharp edges or flat surfaces.

title: Geospatial bioimpedance biosurveillance tool
assignee: Wayne C. A. Wright, John D. Kutzko
abstract: A health care management system for geospatial biosurveillance including a bioimpedance device. The health care management system provides real time data and analysis of an individual's physiological condition using bioimpedance data. The health care management system is further operable to monitor and model disease progression and remission based on physiological conditions during a pandemic event as well as modeling the treatment and remediation of long-lasting physiological symptoms and organ damage due to post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV2 infection (PASC).
assignee_clean: wayne c a wright; john d kutzko

title: 5G technology-based extra-hospital rehabilitation guidance and monitoring evaluation system
abstract: The invention relates to an extra-hospital rehabilitation guidance and monitoring and evaluating technology, in particular to an extra-hospital rehabilitation guidance and monitoring and evaluating system based on a 5G technology. Because the patient lacks professional rehabilitation guidance at home, the rehabilitation effect of the patient is greatly reduced, and the healing of the patient is affected. The invention aims to provide an extra-hospital rehabilitation guidance and monitoring evaluation system based on a 5G technology. The system finally generates a real-time rehabilitation training file of the patient by combining doctor diagnosis information and patient basic information, and accurately transmits data to a remote monitoring center in real time through a 5G network, so that a doctor can evaluate the rehabilitation effect of the patient and make a further reasonable rehabilitation training plan.

title: Reference interval generation
abstract: Described herein are systems and methods for generating health or risk parameter reference intervals for use in healthcare or any other application of risk/attribute measurement. The reference intervals generated by the systems and methods described herein are based on direct analysis and evidence-based models of human and/or other living organism data from a population of individuals including shared feature(s) and outcome data such as vital status. The direct analysis and evidence-based models of human and/or other living organisms data utilize shared common risk parameter feature(s) and outcome data and identify relationships of two or more health or risk parameters relative to one another. These methods also apply to the measurement of risk and/or other attributes of any living organism or nonliving objects.

title: Method and system for classifying medical image data sets based on imbalance
abstract: The invention discloses a classification method and a classification system based on an unbalanced medical image data set, wherein the classification method comprises the following steps: extracting green channel components of the original medical image; utilizing histogram equalization to correct the extracted gray level image; extracting texture features, wavelet features and wheel-assistant features from the corrected image respectively; sorting the extracted feature samples according to the distance between the samples; dividing the sorted samples into uniform feature subsets, and ensuring the difference between the subsets; respectively training the feature subsets by using an SVM algorithm and a BP neural network algorithm to generate sub-classifiers; and combining the sub-classifiers and voting to obtain a final classification result. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the classification accuracy of the negative samples in the multi-classification integrated learning is obviously improved, and the accuracy of the negative samples in the data set sample distribution height inclination and multi-classifier training in the medical field is obviously improved. The method is favorable for reducing misdiagnosis, thereby improving the practical value of the classifier.

title: Data segmentation
abstract: Techniques are disclosed relating to data management. A computer system may evaluate network traffic to extract and group data objects based on their content satisfying similarity criteria, and to identify baseline behavior with respect to those data objects. The computer system may generate data-defined network (DDN) data structures that include a content class and one or more behavioral classes. The content class may be indicative of one or more of the data objects that have been grouped based on them satisfying the similarity criteria. The one or more behavioral classes may indicate baseline behavior of those data objects within the content class as determined from evaluation of the network traffic. The computer system may detect, using the DDN data structures, anomalous data behavior within network traffic. In response to detecting anomalous data behavior, the computer system may prevent network traffic corresponding to the anomalous data behavior from being communicated.

title: MRI image reconstruction using machine learning
abstract: In the field of MRI, a model-based MRI image reconstruction technique is provided. The model-based reconstruction technique increases the performance of Time-of-Flight MRA. In a learning phase, a model is calculated from a sufficiently large set of data acquired at both low and high magnetic fields, using deep learning strategies. In a clinical phase, the model is applied to measured data generating high MR image quality.

title: Information providing system
assignee: 艾思益信息应用技术股份公司
abstract: Provided is an information providing system which can perform a job in a short time and can use output information with ease. The information providing system is provided with: an acquisition unit that acquires acquisition data having 1 st image data, wherein the 1 st image data is image data obtained by capturing a specific medical device and a specific identification tag for identifying the specific medical device; a1 st database constructed by machine learning using a data structure having a plurality of learning data, wherein the learning data has evaluation object information including image data of a medical device, and a meta ID associated with the evaluation object information; a metaid selection unit that selects a1 st metaid; a2 nd database storing a content ID and the reference information corresponding to the content ID; a content ID selection unit that selects a1 st content ID; a reference information selection unit that selects 1 st reference information; and an output unit that outputs output information including the 1 st reference information, the 1 st content ID, the 1 st meta ID, and the evaluation target information.

title: Method and system for selecting an optimal frame using distribution of intensity for each frame image of medical imaging
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for selecting an optimal frame using intensity distribution for each frame image of a medical image, which is performed by at least one processor of an information processing system. An optimal frame selection method using intensity distribution for each frame image of a medical image includes the steps of: receiving a medical image in which a blood vessel is photographed in a state in which a contrast medium is administered, wherein the medical image includes a plurality of frame images; calculating an intensity for each of a plurality of medical images; determining a frame section corresponding to a plurality of consecutive frame images based on the distribution of a plurality of intensities corresponding to the plurality of frame images; and selecting one frame image from among a plurality of consecutive frame images corresponding to the frame section. Error sensitivity can be reduced.

title: Pneumonia focus segmentation method and device
assignee: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司, 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司, 上海深睿博联医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for dividing a pneumonia focus, which solve the problems of low accuracy and low efficiency of the existing method for dividing the pneumonia focus. The pneumonia focus segmentation method comprises the following steps: predicting a focus area on the medical image data of the positive layer based on an image semantic segmentation model; screening out low-level false positive areas from predicted focus areas based on focus detection frames predicted by the focus detection model and lung areas predicted by a lung lobe lung segment segmentation model; and counting the focus area of each parallel layer, and calculating the focus volume by combining the focus areas of each parallel layer.

title: System and method for Alzheimer's disease risk quantification utilizing interferometric micro-doppler radar and artificial intelligence
abstract: A system and method for quantifying Alzheimer's disease (AD) risk using one or more interferometric micro-Doppler radars (IMDRs) and deep learning artificial intelligence to distinguish between cognitively unimpaired individuals and persons with AD based on gait analysis. The system utilizes IMDR to capture signals from both radial and transversal movement in three-dimensional space to further increase the accuracy for human gait estimation. New deep learning technologies are designed to complement traditional machine learning involving separate feature extraction followed-up with classification to process radar signature from different views including side, front, depth, limbs, and whole body where some motion patterns are not easily describable. The disclosed cross-talk deep model is the first to apply deep learning to learn IMDR signatures from two perpendicular directions jointly from both healthy and unhealthy individuals. Decision fusion is used to integrate classification results from feature-based classifier and deep learning AI to reach optimal decision.

title: Medical image-based nodule detection method and device and electronic equipment
assignee: 广西医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: A nodule detection method based on medical images takes an image sequence based on medical images as input, positions candidate nodules through a coarse detection network and outputs a first prediction score; carrying out classification training on an image sequence corresponding to the candidate nodule positioned by the coarse detection network through a false positive inhibition network to obtain the undetermined nodule and a second prediction score thereof; and constructing a single feature of the undetermined nodule, constructing a global feature based on the single features of the undetermined nodules, splicing the single feature and the global feature into a fusion feature, performing regression training, and outputting a third prediction score to complete a nodule detection result. The problem of among the prior art to the not good effect of grinding glass nodule and special position is solved.

title: Disease risk prediction method based on priori medical knowledge
abstract: The invention discloses a disease risk prediction method based on priori medical knowledge, which comprises the following steps: s1, inputting EHR record data of a patient p in a vector form; s2, obtaining a prediction probability by using a prediction model based on a convolutional neural network, so as to obtain an objective function; s3, integrating priori medical knowledge, integrating the priori medical knowledge into the prediction model of the step S2, introducing an expected distribution value, setting constraint features, and obtaining a loss function through a regularization method; s4, calculating a new objective function through the loss function, and obtaining optimal parameters of the risk prediction model; the disease risk of patient P is predicted by optimal parameters. The invention automatically combines discrete medical knowledge or rules into the depth prediction model by using a posterior regularization method, and the constructed prediction model realizes more accurate prediction results than the most advanced baseline.

title: Method for automatically determining a contrast agent injection protocol
abstract: A method for automatically determining a contrast agent injection protocol. In general, the invention relates to a method for automatically determining a contrast agent injection protocol for a patient under examination, comprising the steps of: a) providing a plurality of patient reference parameters, a plurality of contrast agent injection protocol parameters and a plurality of assignments of at least one given patient reference parameter and at least one given contrast agent injection protocol parameter, (b) comparing the at least one patient parameter with the plurality of patient reference parameters, the patient parameters being based on patient information, (c) selecting the at least one patient reference parameter from the plurality of patient reference parameters based on step (b), (d) determining the at least one contrast agent injection protocol parameter from the plurality of contrast agent injection protocol parameters.

title: Method and system for classifying blood clot in gradient echo images based on machine learning
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for classifying blood clots utilizing a machine learning-based gradient echo (GRE) image and a system thereof. The method comprises the following steps. An image obtaining unit obtains a GRE image. A lesion detecting unit detects a lesion region from the obtained GRE image using an artificial neural network model. A patch region setting unit sets the detected lesion region as a patch region in a constant size and resets the patch region through projection in a three-dimensional direction. A blood clot classifying unit classifies the blood clots in the patch region using the artificial neural network model.

title: Medical cross-mode multi-scale fusion class guide hash method and system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a medical cross-mode multi-scale fusion class guidance hash method and a system thereof, comprising the steps of training a class hash network to learn hash codes of each class, enabling the learned hash codes to contain semantic information of corresponding classes, then utilizing the learned class hash codes to express labels as supervision information to guide learning of images, texts and joint network hash codes, simultaneously training learning of the images and the text hash codes by the joint network, and the like, as well as an input module I, a feature processing module I, an input module II, a feature processing module II, a learning training module and an output module. A number of experiments on the medical dataset MIMIMIC-CXR indicate that this approach is superior to existing baselines in the cross-modal retrieval task.

title: Image deformation registration method based on deep learning
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image deformation registration method based on deep learning, which is suitable for a CT image and MRI image registration method. The image deformation registration method based on deep learning comprises the following steps: step S1, a multi-modality data set is acquired and the image data is pre-processed, and the multi-modality data set includes CT images and MRI images. Step S2: and (4) constructing a registration network model based on deep learning and training the model. Step S3: and acquiring test data, inputting the test data into the deep learning-based registration network model trained in the step S2 in a verification mode, and obtaining a corresponding deformation field. Step S4: and (3) applying a deformation field, carrying out deformation registration on the MRI image to the CT image, and carrying out post-processing on the MRI image after registration. Therefore, the image deformation registration method based on deep learning can effectively register two multi-mode or single-mode images by the introduced network structure according to the deformation relation between the two images to be registered in the unsupervised learning mode.

title: Medical image segmentation method and system based on semi-supervision and Transformers
abstract: The invention provides a medical image segmentation method and a system based on semi-supervision and Transformers in the technical field of medical image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s10, acquiring a large number of medical images, and preprocessing each medical image to obtain an image set; step S20, a medical image segmentation model with a U-shaped structure is created based on the FC-DenseNet and the RL-transducer; step S30, training a medical image segmentation model by utilizing the image set; and S40, inputting the medical image to be segmented into a trained medical image segmentation model to carry out image segmentation. The invention has the advantages that: the segmentation accuracy of the medical image lacking the labeling data is greatly improved.

title: Systems and methods for detection and analysis of polyps in colon images
abstract: There is provided a method, comprising: feeding 2D image(s) of an internal surface of a colon captured by an endoscopic camera, into a machine learning model, wherein the 2D image(s) excludes a depiction of an external measurement tool, wherein the machine learning model is trained on records, each including 2D images of the internal surface of the colon of a respective subject labelled with ground truth labels of respective bounding boxes enclosing respective polyps and at least one of an indication of size and a type of the respective polyp indicating likelihood of developing maligiancy, obtaining a bounding box for a polyp and at least one of an indication of size and type of the polyp, and generating instructions for presenting within the GUI, an overlay of the bounding box over the polyp and the at least one of the indication of size and type of the polyp.

title: Method and device for constructing auditing rule engine in medical field and computer equipment
assignee: 平安医疗健康管理股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and provides a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for constructing an audit rule engine in the medical field, wherein a current medical rule text and a medical policy information text are acquired; and abstracting the fact object and the characteristics of the fact object from the abstract data; and further, visually displaying the fact object and the characteristics corresponding to the fact object on a browser page; acquiring a target fact object selected from the fact objects by a medical user on the browser page, and acquiring medical knowledge details input by the medical user; finally, loading the target fact object selected by the medical user into a Drools engine in real time, and generating an auditing rule engine in real time, so that the auditing rule engine is updated in real time; meanwhile, the auditing rule engine can be flexibly configured by the medical user. The intelligent city intelligent medical system is applied to the intelligent medical field to promote the construction of intelligent cities.
assignee_clean: 平安医疗健康管理股份有限公司

title: Customization of individualized implant
abstract: A system for customizing an implant is provided. The system includes a processor configured to: i) obtain one or more medical image stacks of a joint; ii) obtain a three-dimensional image representation of the joint based on at least one of said medical image stacks; iii) determine damage to the joint by analyzing said medical image stacks; iv) select an implant template from a predefined set of implant templates having predetermined types and sizes; v) generate a 3D model, in which the marked damage is visualized together with the selected implant template in a proposed position; vi) display the 3D model; vii) receive an approval for said selected implant template in said proposed position; and viii) determine the final shape and dimensions of a customized implant based on said selected implant template and said proposed position.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device comprises: a first display for the left eye of a user; a second display for the right eye of the user, that is spaced apart from the first display in a one direction; frames that hold the first display and the second display and are supported on the user's head; and an optical variable unit capable of varying the optical alignment of the first display or second display. An electronic device according to the present invention may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, robot, augmented reality (AR) device, virtual reality (VR) device, and device related to 5G services.

title: Negotiating machine learning model input features based on cost in constrained networks
abstract: In one embodiment, a service receives a feature availability report indicative of which telemetry variables are available at a device in a network and resource costs associated with data features that the device could compute from the telemetry variables. The service selects at least a subset of the data features for input to a machine learning model, based on their associated resource costs and on their respective impacts on one or more performance metrics for the machine learning model. The service trains the machine learning model to evaluate the selected data features. The service sends the trained machine learning model to the device. The device computes the selected data features from the telemetry variables available at the device and uses the computed data features as input to the machine learning model.

title: Assessing data fidelity in a machine learning-based network assurance system
abstract: In one embodiment, a service computes a data fidelity metric for network telemetry data used by a machine learning model to monitor a computer network. The service detects unacceptable performance of the machine learning model. The service determines a correlation between the data fidelity metric and the unacceptable performance of the machine learning model. The service adjusts generation of the network telemetry data for input to the machine learning model, based on the determined correlation between the data fidelity metric and the unacceptable performance of the machine learning model.

title: Decomposed machine learning model evaluation system
abstract: In one embodiment, a machine learning model evaluation system may define standardized, extensible class hierarchies for evaluating performance of a given machine learning model. The class hierarchies may include a plurality of target classes that formalize an expected output of the given machine learning model based on a given dataset, a plurality of output classes that formalize an actual output of the given machine learning model based on the given dataset, a plurality of metric classes that formalize a comparison of the expected output of the given machine learning model with the actual output of the given machine learning model, and a plurality of datasets. When a machine learning model is received for evaluation, the system may identify a target class, an output class, and a metric class that are applicable to the machine learning model. The system may also retrieve a dataset applicable to the machine learning model.

title: Predicting the impact of network software upgrades on machine learning model performance
abstract: In one embodiment, a service receives software version data regarding versions of software executed by devices in a network. The service detects a version change in the version of software executed by one or more of the devices, based on the received software version data. The service makes a determination that a drop in data quality of input data for a machine learning model used to monitor the network is associated with the detected version change. The service reverts the one or more devices to a prior version of software, based on the determination that the drop in quality of the input data for the machine learning model used to monitor the network is associated with the detected version change.

title: Discovery platform
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a discovery platform including machine-learning techniques for using medical imaging data to study a phenotype of interest, such as complex diseases with weak or unknown genetic drivers. An exemplary method of identifying a covariant of interest with respect to a phenotype comprises: receiving covariant information of a covariate class and corresponding phenotypic image data related to the phenotype obtained from a group of clinical subjects; inputting the phenotypic image data into a trained unsupervised machine-learning model to obtain a plurality of embeddings in a latent space, each embedding corresponding to a phenotypic state reflected in the phenotypic image data; and determining, based on the covariant information for the group of clinical subjects, the plurality of embeddings, and one or more linear regression models, an association between each candidate covariant of a plurality of candidate covariants and the phenotype state to identify the covariant of interest.

title: Liver tumor segmentation method based on improved U-net network
abstract: The invention relates to a liver tumor segmentation method based on an improved U-net network, which comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring an abdomen CT data set and carrying out pretreatment operation; before liver tumors are segmented, firstly segmenting a liver region, building a neural network for liver segmentation based on a Keras deep learning framework, and selecting tensorflow at the rear end; step three, training the liver segmentation network based on the improved U-net; step four, constructing a liver tumor segmentation network based on improved U-net based on a Keras deep learning framework, and training the network; and step five, adopting a liver segmentation network based on the improved U-net to segment a liver region from the abdominal liver CT image, and segmenting tumor and normal liver tissues from the liver region. The invention can eliminate a large amount of error segmentation and reduce the complexity of the network model.

title: Diabetes knowledge graph construction method integrating Chinese and Western medicine knowledge
assignee: 中国矿业大学, 徐州市中医院, 中国矿业大学(北京)
abstract: The invention provides a diabetes knowledge graph construction method integrating Chinese and Western medical knowledge, and relates to the technical field of medical knowledge graphs. Firstly, constructing a disease layer, a symptom layer and a treatment layer to form a physical concept layer which is used for fusing the knowledge of Chinese and Western medicine and related to diabetes; then, filling the obtained data into an entity concept layer fusing the knowledge of the traditional Chinese medicine and the western medicine, marking and identifying the traditional Chinese medicine and the western medicine, thereby obtaining a traditional Chinese medicine entity and a western medicine entity; setting up a concept definition module, an entity classification module, an attribute division module, a relationship matching module and a construction module, and processing the obtained Chinese and Western medicine entities to construct a knowledge graph. The invention processes the construction of the diabetes knowledge graph which fuses the knowledge of the traditional Chinese and western medicine, better processes the medical entity and semantic relation of the traditional Chinese and western medicine, solves the problems of lack of quantity and insufficient classification of relevant entities for treatment and the like according to the setting of a treatment layer and the setting of an attribute dividing module in an entity concept layer, has simple steps and convenient realization, and can effectively solve the problem of fuzzy definition of diabetes in traditional Chinese medicine.
assignee_clean: 中国矿业大学; 徐州市中医院; 中国矿业大学 北京

title: Measuring method, device, equipment and storage medium for scoliosis angle
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for measuring scoliosis angle, which are applied to the field of intelligent medical treatment and are used for improving the measuring efficiency of the scoliosis angle. The measuring method of the scoliosis angle comprises the following steps: carrying out pixel value extraction and normalization processing on the image to be detected to obtain a preprocessed image; calling a plurality of preset deep learning models to position the preprocessed image so as to obtain a spine positioning result; calling a preset target key point detection model, and analyzing the spine positioning result to obtain a plurality of cone key point information; and (3) carrying out fitting treatment on the key point information of the multiple vertebrae by calling a preset least square method to obtain a fitted straight line segment, determining a bending center based on the fitted straight line segment, and calculating the scoliosis angle according to the bending center to obtain a scoliosis angle measurement result. In addition, the present invention relates to blockchain technology, and the scoliosis angle measurement can be stored in a blockchain node.

title: Machine learning-based client selection and testing in a network assurance system
abstract: In one embodiment, a network assurance service that monitors a network detects a network anomaly in the network using a machine learning-based anomaly detector. The network assurance service identifies a set of network conditions associated with the detected network anomaly. The network assurance service initiates a network test on one or more clients in the network that exhibit the identified network conditions. The network assurance service retrains the machine learning-based anomaly detector based on a result of the network test.

title: Supporting synergistic and retrofittable graph queries inside a relational database
abstract: A method and system of processing graph query are provided. A graph query is received by a relational database graph module. The graph query is translated into one or more relational database queries. One or more relational database queries are translated to be performed on data stored within a relational database. One or more results from the relational database are received based on the sent one or more relational database queries. A synergistic graph is generated on a display, based on the received one or more results.

title: System and method for navigation to a target anatomical object in medical imaging-based procedures
abstract: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR NAVIGATION TO A TARGET ANATOMICAL OBJECT IN MEDICAL IMAGING-BASED PROCEDURES The present invention is directed to a system and method for providing navigational directions to a user to locate a target anatomical object during a medical procedure via a medical imaging system. The method includes selecting an anatomical region surrounding the object; generating a plurality of real-time two-dimensional images of scenes from the anatomical region and providing the plurality of images to a controller; developing and training a deep learning network to automatically detect and identify the scenes from the anatomical region; automatically mapping each of the plurality of images from the anatomical region based on a relative spatial location and a relative temporal location of each of the identified scenes in the anatomical region via the deep learning network; and providing directions to the user to locate the object during the medical procedure based on the relative spatial and temporal locations of each of the identified scenes.

title: Microbiota-derived diagnostic and therapeutic methods and systems for brain-craniofacial health-related disorders
abstract: The present invention provides methods, compositions, and systems for detecting one or more brain-craniofacial health issues and/or determining, displaying, or facilitating treatment of a brain-craniofacial health issue by characterizing a microbiome of an individual, monitoring the impact of the microbiome. Methods, compositions, and systems for generating and comparing microbiome composition and/or functional diversity datasets are also provided. Methods, compositions, and systems are also provided for generating characterization and/or treatment models for insomnia issues, light sleep issues, headache issues, sinusitis issues, or low attention issues.

title: Systems and methods for automated analysis of medical images
abstract: There is provided a computed implemented method of automatically generating an adapted presentation of at least one candidate anomalous object detected from anatomical imaging data of a target individual, comprising: providing anatomical imaging data of the target individual acquired by an anatomical imaging device, analyzing the anatomical imaging data by a detection classifier for detecting at least one candidate anomalous object of the anatomical imaging data and computed associated location thereof, computing, by a presentation parameter classifier, at least one presentation parameter for adapting a presentation of a sub-set of the anatomical imaging data including the at least one candidate anomalous object according to at least the location of the candidate anomalous object, and generating according to the at least one presentation parameter, an adapted presentation of the sub-set of the anatomical imaging data including the at least one candidate anomalous object.

title: Image display method, device, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The application provides an image display method, device, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: processing the first image based on the image classification model to obtain a first characteristic image; based on the image classification model, acquiring a second characteristic image corresponding to the first characteristic image according to the first characteristic image; superposing the first characteristic image and the second characteristic image based on the image classification model, and acquiring a third characteristic image based on the superposed image; acquiring a second image according to the third characteristic image; and displaying the second image on the first image in an overlapping way. By the technical scheme, when medical staff judge the smear through the ocular lens of the microscope, the medical staff can see the first image and the second image at the same time, so that confirmation and judgment are carried out in real time without secondary confirmation, the work flow of the medical staff is saved, and the screening efficiency is improved.

title: Detecting behavioral anomaly in machine learned rule sets
abstract: Roughly described, anomalous behavior of a machine-learned computer-implemented individual can be detected while operating in a production environment. A population of individuals is represented in a computer storage medium, each individual identifying actions to assert in dependence upon input data. As part of machine learning, the individuals are tested against samples of training data and the actions they assert are recorded in a behavior repository. The behavior of an individual is characterized from the observations recorded during training. In a production environment, the individuals are operated by applying production input data, and the production behavior of the individual is observed and compared to the behavior of the individual represented in the behavior repository. A determination is made from the comparison of whether the individual's production behavior during operation is anomalous.

title: Medical information processing method based on FPGA edge calculation
abstract: The invention discloses a medical information processing method based on FPGA edge calculation, which belongs to the technical field of information processing and is mainly used for skin medical information processing. In the invention, the IR-BNnet model carried by the FPGA edge computing equipment and the double-channel model GL-CNN carried by the information processing server can comprehensively use a portable deep learning method and a complex high-precision deep learning method to accurately classify a large amount of medical information, thereby improving the information processing efficiency.

title: Environment sensing for care systems
abstract: A system, apparatus, and method to monitor at least one person in at least one environment. The environment includes at least two sensors capable of detecting the presence of a person in that environment. The person under monitoring has a care condition to be monitored, where such monitoring involves the at least two sensors providing data sets to at least one signal monitoring system. Such data sets are communicated to at least one digital twin representing the person under monitoring and their environment, such that patterns of behavior may be determined for that person. Such patterns may be represented in the at least one digital twin, as to detect behavior that indicates a change in the care condition of that person under monitoring.

title: Three-dimensional broken bone segmentation method and device based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional broken bone segmentation method and a three-dimensional broken bone segmentation device based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting vertex coordinates and vertex normal vectors based on the obtained three-dimensional broken bone mesh model to generate a broken bone point cloud model; and inputting the generated bone fragment point cloud model into a PointNet + + deep neural network trained in advance, mapping the obtained vertex bone fragment label probability to a corresponding three-dimensional bone fragment grid model, and further performing segmentation optimization on the three-dimensional bone fragment grid model by using a graph cutting method to obtain a final bone fragment segmentation result. According to the method, a PointNet + + deep neural network in geometric deep learning is adopted to predict classification marks of the crushed cortical bone and the cancellous bone, and the PointNet + + processes a point set sampled in a measurement space in a layering manner, so that a fine geometric structure captured by local features can be extracted, and the crushed cortical bone and the cancellous bone can be well segmented; and according to the smoothness degree between the triangular patches, the graph cutting method is used for improving the cutting result, so that the broken bone cutting efficiency and the automation degree are improved.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for realizing medical image auxiliary diagnosis based on AlexNet network model
assignee: 北京华医共享医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for realizing medical image auxiliary diagnosis based on an AlexNet network model. The invention provides a new method for realizing medical image auxiliary diagnosis by utilizing the latest deep learning technology in artificial intelligence, namely, in an AlexNet network model with good generalization capability, various complex features are extracted by using a convolutional neural network, and then the features are comprehensively judged by using a full-connection network, so that the model can cover various complex conditions, the end-to-end automatic diagnosis can be realized in the whole process of medical image auxiliary diagnosis, and the efficiency and the accuracy are extremely high. In addition, the method can also carry out transfer learning on the newly added part or image, so that the model upgrade becomes simple and easy to operate, and the maximum compatibility of the original knowledge can be ensured, thereby being convenient for practical application and popularization.

title: Acute kidney injury predicting system and method thereof
assignee: 臺中榮民總醫院, 東海大學
abstract: An acute kidney injury predicting system and a method thereof are proposed. A main processing unit is connected to a main memory and reads a plurality of data to be tested, a plurality of detection data, a machine learning algorithm and a risk probability comparison table stored in the main memory. The main processing unit trains the detection data according to the machine learning algorithm to generate an acute kidney injury prediction model, and inputs the data to be tested into the acute kidney injury prediction model to generate an acute kidney injury characteristic risk probability and a data sequence table. The data sequence table lists the data to be tested in sequence according to a proportion of each of the data to be tested in the acute kidney injury characteristics. The main processing unit selects one of the medical treatment data from the risk probability comparison table according to the acute kidney injury characteristic risk probability. Therefore, the probability of the acute kidney injury for the subject after 24 hours is predicted, and the medical treatment is given immediately.
assignee_clean: 臺中榮民總醫院; 東海大學

title: Methods and systems for the characterization, diagnosis and treatment of microbiome-derived conditions associated with functional features
abstract: A method for at least one of characterizing, diagnosing, and treating a microbiome-derived functional feature-related condition in at least a subject, the method comprising: receiving an aggregate set of biological samples from a population of subjects; generating at least one of a microbiome composition dataset and a microbiome functional diversity dataset for a population of subjects; generating a characterization of the condition based on features extracted from at least one of the microbiome composition dataset and the microbiome functional diversity dataset; generating a therapy model configured to correct the condition based on the characterization; and at an output device associated with the subject, administering a therapy to the subject based on the characterization and the therapy model.

title: Identifying and visualizing relationships and commonalities amongst record entities
abstract: A capability to identify and visualize relationships and commonalities amongst record entities is provided. A plurality of entities are extracted from one or more records. Each extracted entity is associated with a respective feature vector within a vector space of a feature matrix. The feature vectors are distributed within the feature matrix based on semantic relationships amongst the entities of a corpus. Multidimensional coordinates within a dimensionally-reduced vector space of the feature matrix are generated for each extracted entity. One or more cells of a cellular presentation of the feature matrix are identified such that each identified cell represents one or more respective extracted entities. Each cell represents (i) a respective range of multidimensional coordinates within the dimensionally-reduced vector space of the feature matrix and (ii) one or more feature vectors of the plurality of feature vectors within the feature matrix.

title: Image enhancement method and system
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image enhancement method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image; decomposing the original image to obtain a plurality of decomposition coefficients of the original image; performing enhancement processing on at least one of the plurality of decomposition coefficients by using a machine learning model to obtain at least one enhancement coefficient; and reconstructing a plurality of decomposition coefficients comprising at least one enhancement coefficient to obtain an enhanced image corresponding to the original image.

title: System and method for security in Internet-of-Things and cyber-physical systems based on machine learning
abstract: According to various embodiments, a method for detecting security vulnerabilities in at least one of cyber-physical systems (CPSs) and Internet of Things (IoT) devices is disclosed. The method includes constructing an attack directed acyclic graph (DAG) from a plurality of regular expressions, where each regular expression corresponds to control-data flow for a known CPS/IoT attack. The method further includes performing a linear search on the attack DAG to determine unexploited CPS/IoT attack vectors, where a path in the attack DAG that does not represent a known CPS/IoT attack vector represents an unexploited CPS/IoT attack vector. The method also includes applying a trained machine learning module to the attack DAG to predict new CPS/IoT vulnerability exploits. The method further includes constructing a defense DAG configured to protect against the known CPS/IoT attacks, the unexploited CPS/IoT attacks, and the new CPS/IoT vulnerability exploits.

title: Machine learning system and method with attribute sequences
assignee: 艾玛迪斯简易股份公司
abstract: The invention relates to a machine learning system and method with attribute sequences. Machine learning systems and methods for embedding attribute sequence data. The attributed sequence data includes an attribute data portion having a fixed number of attribute data elements and a sequence data portion having a variable number of sequence data elements. The attribute network module includes a feed-forward neural network configured to convert the attribute data portion into an encoded attribute vector having a first number of attribute features. The sequence network module includes a recurrent neural network configured to convert the sequence data portion into an encoded sequence vector having a second number of sequence features. In use, the machine learning system learns and outputs a fixed length feature representation of the input attribute sequence data that encodes dependencies between different attribute data elements, dependencies between different sequence data elements, and dependencies between attribute data elements and sequence data elements within the attribute sequence data.

title: Medicine recommendation evidence-based support method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medicine recommendation evidence-based support method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring a recommended prescription list of a target patient by using a medicine recommendation model; acquiring N-phase patients of the target patient, wherein N is a positive integer; acquiring characteristic information, prescription information and prognosis information of the N-phase patient; constructing a logistic regression model according to the characteristic information, prescription information and prognosis information of the N-phase patient; sequencing each recommended prescription in the recommended prescription list of the target patient by utilizing the logistic regression model to obtain sequencing results of each recommended prescription; the sequencing results of the recommended prescriptions are recommended to complete the medicine recommendation evidence-based, and the method, the device, the equipment and the storage medium can accurately recommend the prescriptions to the patient.

title: Lesson determination for dynamic gamification application
abstract: A method of dynamic lesson determination is performed by an application server. The application server receives telemetry data and a corresponding user identification (ID). The telemetry data indicates at least one usage of a user device by a user associated with the user ID. The application server stores the telemetry data to one or more databases and analyzes the telemetry data to determine one or more lessons, which are then sent, by the application server, to a dynamic gamification application of the user device.

title: Medical image segmentation method based on complete attention convolutional neural network
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a medical image segmentation method based on a complete attention convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: inputting the training medical image into a feature encoder module constructed by using a deep learning framework to obtain convolution activation graphs with different channel numbers and sizes; respectively inputting convolution activation graphs with different channel numbers and sizes into a plurality of channel attention modules to obtain convolution activation graphs with different channel numbers and sizes after channel weighting, inputting the convolution activation graphs into a pixel attention module, learning to obtain pixel attention coefficients, and distributing different pixel attention coefficients for the convolution activation graphs to obtain a final segmentation graph of the training medical image; training based on the cross entropy loss function to obtain an optimal medical image segmentation model; and determining a test medical image, and inputting the test medical image into the optimal medical image segmentation model to obtain a final segmentation map of the test medical image.

title: Carotid plaque ultrasonic image identification segmentation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a carotid plaque ultrasonic image identification segmentation method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an ultrasonic image of carotid plaque, and preprocessing the ultrasonic image; detecting the preprocessed ultrasonic image through a target detection network to generate a plaque area image, wherein the target detection network is an improved YOLOV model; extracting features of the plaque area image through a segmentation model to generate a plaque inner and outer wall segmentation result, wherein the segmentation model is an improved 2D-VNet model; calculating the dividing result of the inner wall and the outer wall of the inner middle membrane of the plaque by using an approximate radius compensation method and an approximate radius compensation method to generate the distance range of the inner wall and the outer wall of the inner middle membrane; judging the distance range of the inner wall and the outer wall of the inner middle membrane to generate an inner middle membrane distance range detection result; and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the segmentation result of the inner wall and the outer wall of the plaque intima through a three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm, and generating a plaque three-dimensional model.

title: Privacy enhanced machine learning
abstract: A method of selecting data for privacy preserving machine learning comprises: storing training data from a first party, storing a machine learning model, and storing criteria from the first party or from another party. The method comprises filtering the training data to select a first part of the training data to be used to train the machine learning model and select a second part of the training data. The selecting is done by computing a measure, using the criteria, of the contribution of the data to the performance of the machine learning model.

title: Image identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 数坤(北京)网络科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides an image identification method, an image identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium; the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an initial image of medical scanning corresponding to a target part, then preprocessing the initial image to obtain at least one of a post-processing image of a blood vessel in the target part and an abnormal region where a blood vessel center line parameter exists, then carrying out focus identification based on the initial image and the post-processing image of the blood vessel to obtain a focus region, and then determining and identifying a focus image in the initial image according to the focus region and the abnormal region to obtain a focus identification result. According to the method and the device, focus identification is carried out on the initial image in multiple ways, omission of manual identification is made up, and accuracy of identification results is improved.

title: Systems and methods for diagnosing and/or monitoring disease
abstract: A method for evaluating a gastrointestinal tract may include characterizing one or more disease parameters using objective measures obtained from imaging data of a gastrointestinal tract. The one or more disease parameters reflect a measure of at least one of lesions, ulcers, bleeding, stenosis, and vasculature. The method may also include using the one or more characterized disease parameters to classify a disease state.

title: Systems and methods for image processing
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method may include obtaining a breast image of an object that is acquired by an imaging device; determining a projection curve based on the breast image; determining a first valley point and a second valley point of the projection curve; determining a peak point of the projection curve based the first valley point and the second valley point of the projection curve; determining a first valley location, a second valley location, and a peak location in the breast image based on the peak point, the first valley point, and the second valley point of the projection curve; and

title: Systems and methods for managing energy and air quality
abstract: A management system makes decisions using local and national outdoor air quality data, public health data, and building and occupant information. The system addresses the balance between healthy air and energy efficiency.

title: Selection and monitoring methods for xenotransplantation
abstract: A method for predictive engineering of a sample derived from a genetically optimized non-human donor suitable for xenotransplantation into a human having improved quality or performance is provided. The method includes constructing a training data set from a series of libraries, wherein at least one library in the series of libraries comprises genomic, proteomic, and research data specific to non-humans. The method includes developing a predictive machine learning model based on the constructed training data set. The method includes utilizing the predictive machine learning model to obtain a predicted quality or performance of a plurality of sequences for a candidate sample from the non-human donor specific to a human patient or patient population. The method includes selecting a subset of sequences for evaluation from the plurality of sequences based on the predicted quality or performance. The method includes designing candidate samples derived from the non-human donor using the selected subset of sequences. The method includes measuring a respective in silico performance of each designed candidate sample. The method includes selecting a designed candidate sample for manufacture based on the respective in silico performance of each designed candidate sample.

title: Self-supervised data obfuscation in foundation models
abstract: Provided are methods and system for obtaining, by a computer system, a machine learning/machine learning model; obtaining, by the computer system, a training data set; training, with the computer system, an obfuscation transform based on the machine learning/machine learning model and the training data set; and storing, with the computer system, the obfuscation transform in memory.

title: Method and system for multi-part left atrium segmentation in C-arm computed tomography volumes using shape constraints
abstract: A method and system for multi-part left atrium (LA) segmentation in a C-arm CT volume is disclosed. Multiple LA part models, including an LA chamber body mesh, an appendage mesh, a left inferior pulmonary vein (PV) mesh, a left superior PV mesh, a right inferior PV mesh, and a right superior PV mesh, are segmented in a 3D volume. The LA chamber body mesh and the appendage mesh may be segmented as a combined object and the PV meshes may be segmented subject to a statistical shape constraint. A consolidated LA mesh is generated from the segmented LA part models.

title: Methods and systems for predicting content consumption
abstract: Methods and systems for content optimization are described. A computing device may determine a predictability score that indicates a probability that a device will access a first content item. The computing device may send a second content item associated with the first content item. The second content item may be based on the predictability score, and the predictability score may be modified. Additional content consumption and/or recommendations may be adjusted based on the predictability score.

title: Personalized chronic disease analysis system
assignee: 中科海微(北京)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a personalized chronic disease analysis system which comprises a smart bracelet, a smart phone platform and a cloud management platform, wherein the smart phone platform is provided with an AI processor, the smart bracelet is used for executing a primary data processing algorithm, collecting health indexes of a user and carrying out primary processing on original data to obtain a primary conclusion, the smart phone platform is used for executing a personalized health early warning model oriented to cardiovascular chronic disease related sign indexes, and the cloud management platform is used for comprehensively controlling desensitization data and business data of a client under the condition of strictly guaranteeing the privacy of health data of the user. The intelligent health monitoring system can work independently from the cloud, can complete personalized sign monitoring and personalized health management functions in a customer family, effectively protects health privacy of the customer, enables sign abnormality identification and health management to be completed on a mobile phone, has core functions not affected by network bandwidth and cloud resources, and provides intelligent health services for the customer locally.
assignee_clean: 中科海微 北京 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 中科海微 北京 科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for extracting specific data from documents using machine learning
abstract: A method includes generating, by one or more processors, a first graphical interface. The first graphical interface includes a card-based view with each card in the card-based view corresponding to a field of analysis from a plurality of fields of analysis. The method also includes transmitting, to a client device, the representation of the first graphical interface; receiving, from the client device, a selection of a particular card of the card-based view; and, based on the received selection, generating a representation of a second graphical interface that includes a detailed view of output data associated with a field of analysis that corresponds to the particular card. The method further includes transmitting, to the client device, the representation of the second graphical interface.

title: LSTM algorithm-based early warning method for new major infectious diseases
assignee: 郑州大学第一附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a new-onset serious infectious disease early warning method based on an LSTM algorithm, which belongs to the field of big data, and establishes a new-onset serious infectious disease early warning platform based on the LSTM algorithm, wherein the new-onset serious infectious disease early warning platform comprises a data acquisition and processing system, a characteristic analysis and early warning index screening system and a new-onset serious infectious disease early warning system, and solves the technical problems that the number of cases of an early warning mode of a single hospital is limited and the local area cannot be researched and judged. According to clinical case data, associated image data, medical examination data, remote consultation data and the like of a patient, time sequence data of a multi-time scale pyramid structure are constructed, long-period memory artificial neural network early warning models based on a new high-infectious-disease attention mechanism are respectively constructed for the time sequence data of different scales, early warning requirements of different time sensitivity degrees are met, and contradiction between accuracy and response time is balanced.
