title: Three-dimensional medical image segmentation method and system based on self-adaptive feature fusion network
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional medical image segmentation method and a system based on an adaptive feature fusion network, wherein the adaptive feature fusion network is firstly constructed and comprises an encoder, a decoder and a long jump link, a DAM module is arranged on the long jump link, a three-dimensional medical image is input into a plurality of encoding blocks in the encoder for step-by-step downsampling, and a plurality of downsampling feature images with different sizes are correspondingly output; inputting the downsampled feature map to the corresponding DAM module for processing, and outputting corresponding fused long jump link information; and a plurality of decoding blocks in the decoder respectively receive and aggregate the aggregated feature images output by the next layer of decoding blocks adjacent to each other and the corresponding fused long jump link information, and the aggregated feature images output by the uppermost layer of decoding blocks are used as target images which are segmented from the three-dimensional medical images. The method can improve the fusion degree of different layer information collected by the encoder and is suitable for a plurality of segmentation targets with different scales.

title: Method and system for improving matching precision of clinical test subjects based on large model
assignee: 北京惠每云科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a method and a system for improving the matching precision of a clinical test subject based on a large model, which are applied to the technical field of large models and comprise the steps of acquiring medical text information; constructing a large language model in the medical field; extracting medical text information through the large language model in the medical field and acquiring a disease-specific data set; and matching corresponding clinical test items with the specific disease data set through a preset item nano-ranking standard, wherein the item nano-ranking standard comprises different clinical test items and corresponding nano-ranking standards. The application has the effects of extracting medical entities and entity relations through the large language model with better effect, and remarkably improving the recall rate and the accuracy rate of entity identification compared with the traditional machine learning model.
assignee_clean: 北京惠每云科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京惠每云科技有限公司

title: Tumor category determining method, device and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
abstract: The application provides a method, a device, a system, an electronic device and a storage medium for determining tumor categories, comprising the following steps: inputting the obtained target gray level image of the patient into a selected tumor position labeling model to obtain a labeling gray level image labeling the tumor position; inputting the marked gray level image into a selected gene prediction model to obtain at least one predicted gene mutation probability of a patient; wherein the gene prediction model is selected based on predicted demand for the tumor; and determining the tumor category to which the tumor of the patient belongs according to the mutation probability of at least one predicted gene. In the method, the target gray level image of the patient is input into the tumor position labeling model and the gene prediction model, at least one comprehensive and accurate predicted gene mutation probability is obtained according to the scanning position and the prediction requirement of the tumor, and then the tumor category to which the tumor belongs is determined according to the at least one predicted gene mutation probability, so that the accuracy of tumor classification is improved.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院

title: Knowledge graph construction method in medical field
assignee: 麦博(上海)健康科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method for constructing a knowledge graph in the medical field, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: s1, acquiring related data in the medical field, wherein the related data mainly comprises structured data, semi-structured data and unstructured data; s2, extracting and storing knowledge of the acquired data; s3, fusing the existing knowledge, including ontology fusion and entity fusion; s4, knowledge processing is carried out on the knowledge graph, wherein the knowledge processing comprises ontology construction, knowledge reasoning, knowledge updating and quality assessment; the invention adopts various deep learning and machine learning algorithms to extract knowledge, fuses knowledge based on 2 dimensions of a body layer and a physical layer, adopts various algorithms and strategies to carry out knowledge reasoning and completion on the map, adopts a comprehensive quality evaluation method to carry out quality evaluation on the map, and obtains a comprehensive and high-quality knowledge map in the medical field, wherein the knowledge map can be updated and iterated continuously.

title: Method and providing unit for providing a virtual tomographic stroke follow-up examination image
abstract: A method is disclosed for providing a virtual tomographic stroke follow-up examination image. In an embodiment, the method includes: receiving a sequence of temporally successive tomographic perfusion imaging data sets of a region for examination; calculating the virtual tomographic stroke follow-up examination image of the region for examination by applying a trained machine learning algorithm to the sequence of temporally successive tomographic perfusion imaging data sets received; and providing the virtual tomographic stroke follow-up examination image calculated.

title: Acquisition workflow and status indicators in a handheld medical scanning device
abstract: In an embodiment, a handheld ultrasound scanning device is disclosed. One embodiment of the handheld ultrasound scanning device comprises a housing configured for handheld use, an ultrasound assembly at least partially disposed within the housing and configured obtain ultrasound data, a display unit at least partially disposed within the housing and comprising a display, and a processor disposed within the housing, wherein the processor is in communication with the ultrasound assembly and the display unit. The processor operable to receive a selection of an anatomical structure to be scanned with the ultrasound assembly, receive ultrasound data from the ultrasound assembly, determine whether the received ultrasound data includes data representative of the anatomical structure, and output an indication to the display unit in response to the determining.

title: Small sample medical image classification method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a small sample medical image classification method and a small sample medical image classification system, wherein the method comprises image collection, unsupervised feature training and small sample-based model generation; firstly, collecting various medical image data from a network or other channels; then, acquiring a pretraining model with generalization by using an unsupervised feature method based on a mixed difficult neighbor by using the acquired image; under a small sample scene, extracting sample features of different types by using a pre-training model, calculating a class prototype according to the features, and selecting the class of the prototype with the highest similarity as a prediction class of a new sample in a subsequent classification task. The invention does not depend on sample marking, uses an unsupervised learning method to migrate knowledge, and greatly reduces sample acquisition cost and labeling cost on the premise of ensuring accuracy.

title: Respirator alarm management method and system for intensive care unit
abstract: The invention discloses a ventilator alarm management method and a system for an intensive care unit, which are used in the field of intensive care alarm management, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting physiological data, medical record information and historical alarm data of patients in an intensive care unit; identifying a false alarm reason of the historical alarm data; predicting a health risk of the patient; setting an alarm threshold of the breathing machine according to medical record information of a patient, false alarm reasons of historical alarm data and prediction results of health risks; dividing alarm levels according to alarm thresholds, configuring respective alarm levels for different types of physiological parameters, and generating alarm prompt information aiming at different health risks; and (5) formulating an emergency scheme according to the alarm prompt information. The invention comprehensively understands the health condition of the patient, and can identify potential health problems in time by continuously monitoring and analyzing the physiological data of the patient, thereby realizing early intervention and reducing the occurrence of serious health risks.

title: Analysis method for work schedule of medical equipment
assignee: 北京绪水互联科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an analysis method for work scheduling of medical equipment. The method comprises the following steps: analyzing a working log in a working period of the medical equipment, and determining a plurality of use intervals and use times of the medical equipment in the working period; establishing a coordinate system by taking the use interval as a vertical coordinate and the use times as a horizontal coordinate, and generating a use interval distribution curve in a working period; the method comprises the steps of counting the relative proportion relation of different distribution ranges of the use intervals to serve as an efficiency index of work scheduling of the medical equipment, counting the fluctuation of the use intervals of the equipment, and determining the regular characteristics of the use intervals to serve as a supplementary index of the work scheduling efficiency. The embodiment of the invention realizes the data analysis of the work scheduling efficiency of the medical equipment, can help hospitals to track the change of the equipment efficiency in real time, and can effectively compare with the similar equipment of different hospitals.
assignee_clean: 北京绪水互联科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京绪水互联科技有限公司

title: Soft tissue sarcoma transfer risk prediction system based on machine learning
abstract: The invention discloses a soft tissue sarcoma transfer risk prediction system based on machine learning, which relates to the field of image processing of medical imaging departments, and comprises: the system comprises an image acquisition module, an image preprocessing module, a feature extraction module, a soft tissue sarcoma transfer risk prediction module and a result display module. In order to solve the problem of low prediction efficiency caused by adopting an artificial mode to predict the soft tissue sarcoma transfer risk, the invention collects a large number of soft tissue sarcoma images which can be transferred and can not be transferred through an image acquisition module to establish a training database, uses a support vector machine to train and establish a soft tissue sarcoma transfer prediction model after the images in the training database are subjected to image feature extraction through an image preprocessing module, and simultaneously inputs the features of image data to be predicted into the model to predict to obtain a prediction result, thereby realizing the rapid and accurate prediction of whether a target patient can be subjected to soft tissue sarcoma transfer.

title: Counterfactual measure for medical diagnosis
abstract: A method for providing a computer-implemented medical diagnosis includes receiving an input from a user comprising at least one symptom of the user. The method also includes providing the at least one symptom as an input to a medical model, the medical model being retrieved from memory. The medical model includes a probabilistic graphical model comprising probability distributions and relationships between symptoms and diseases. The method also includes performing inference on the probabilistic graphical model to obtain a prediction of the probability that the user has that disease. The method also includes outputting an indication that the user has a disease from the Bayesian inference, wherein the inference is performed using a counterfactual measure.

title: Elevator analytics facilitating passenger destination prediction and resource optimization
abstract: Systems, computer-implemented methods, and computer program products that can facilitate elevator analytics and/or elevator optimization components are provided. According to an embodiment, a system can comprise a memory that stores computer executable components and a processor that executes the computer executable components stored in the memory. The computer executable components can comprise a prediction component that can predict a current destination of an elevator passenger based on historical elevator usage data of the elevator passenger. The computer executable components can further comprise an assignment component that can assign the elevator passenger to an elevator based on the current destination.

title: Medical image artificial intelligence auxiliary diagnosis system
assignee: 中世康恺科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial intelligent auxiliary diagnosis system for medical images, which belongs to the technical field of data processing systems and comprises the following components: the model construction module is used for constructing a resource allocation model with the aim of minimizing the total cost of each hospital; the resource allocation module is used for calculating the duration that a central hospital doctor can provide diagnosis and treatment for the kth medical link of the ith hospital through the resource allocation model; the receiving module is used for receiving remote diagnosis and treatment requests about target patients initiated by general doctors in hospitals; the desensitization module is used for carrying out desensitization treatment on the original electronic medical record of the target patient; the encryption module is used for encrypting the desensitized electronic medical record by using the public key and uploading the electronic medical record to the cloud; the verification module is used for verifying the private key of the central hospital doctor; and the consulting module is used for consulting the electronic medical record of the target patient and diagnosing the target patient under the condition that the identity verification of the central hospital doctor is passed. A linkage mechanism for effective engagement can be formed between a general hospital and a central hospital.

title: Method and system for managing health files of electronic pregnant women
assignee: 辽宁鑫浩医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic health record management, in particular to a method and a system for managing health records of an electronic pregnant woman. According to the invention, the data processing efficiency is improved through the introduction of priority queue scheduling, emergency and important files are ensured to be processed preferentially, an optimal file organization scheme is found through continuous iteration in the file organization and sequencing process by using a genetic algorithm, the information retrieval speed and the processing efficiency are remarkably improved, the combination of a random gradient descent algorithm and a structural equation model is realized, the adaptability of the model to new data is enhanced, and the prediction accuracy of health intervention measures is improved through causal relationship analysis.

title: Systems and methods for orthosis design
assignee: Wuhan United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure is related to systems and methods for orthosis design. The method includes obtaining a three-dimensional (3D) model associated with a subject. The method includes obtaining one or more reference images associated with the subject. The method includes determining, based on the 3D model and the one or more reference images, orthosis design data for the subject. The orthosis design data may be used to determine an orthosis for the subject.

title: Infusion systems and related personalized bolusing methods
abstract: Infusion systems, infusion devices, and related operating methods are provided. A method of operating an infusion device involves obtaining an input qualitative event attribute, such as a meal size, obtaining a quantitative event attribute associated with the qualitative event attribute that is representative of a subset of historical events for a patient associated with the qualitative event attribute, such as a representative carbohydrate amount for the qualitative meal size, and thereafter determine a dosage of fluid based at least in part on the quantitative event attribute and operate the infusion device to deliver the dosage of the fluid to the patient.

title: GBDT model-based myeloma high-risk screening method and application thereof
assignee: 中国医科大学附属盛京医院
abstract: High-risk myeloma screening method based on GBDT model and application thereof. The invention belongs to the technical field of early-stage high-risk screening and artificial intelligence of tumors, and particularly relates to a method for establishing a multiple myeloma high-risk screening model based on clinical routine test results by utilizing artificial intelligence and application of the model. According to the invention, through the clinical 1741 cases of Multiple Myeloma (MM) and 2446 cases of non-myeloma (infectious diseases, rheumatic immune system diseases, liver diseases and kidney diseases) patients with routine blood tests, liver and kidney functions, ions, immunoglobulin and other routine test results, the possibility accuracy rate of predicting myeloma can reach more than 90% by using an artificial intelligence method, and the method has a wide application prospect. The early warning model for the multiple myeloma has the characteristics of easy popularization and convenient use, greatly improves the cognition of primary hospitals on the myeloma and the early screening of patients, and has profound clinical significance.

title: Method for constructing cardiovascular critical severe disease large model based on federal learning
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application relates to the field of intelligent medical treatment, in particular to a method for constructing a large cardiovascular critical severe disease model based on federal learning. The federal learning is composed of a central server side and m user sides, wherein the user sides train a local model from cardiovascular emergency critical data set stored by the user sides; the central server side is connected with the user side through different secure communication channels, and the user side derives local model parameters from the local model and uploads the parameters to the central server side; the central server receives local model parameters of m user terminals and carries out weighted aggregation to obtain a global model, and then derives global parameters of the global model to be transmitted to the user terminals; the user side receives the global parameter sent by the central server side and updates the local model to obtain a local update model; the method and the device provided by the application have the advantages that the distributed machine learning is provided, the privacy problem is solved, the disease classification is realized, and the clinical value is very good.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军总医院

title: CNN medical CT image denoising method based on multi-feature extraction
assignee: 兰州萃英医疗科技有限公司
abstract: CNN medical CT image denoising based on multi-feature extraction specifically comprises the following steps: step 1), constructing a medical CT image model; step 2) constructing a network model; step 3) training a network and updating parameters; and 4) denoising the medical CT image, inputting the medical CT image containing noise into the constructed network model, and outputting the medical CT image after noise removal through the network. The invention has the following advantages: multi-feature extraction medical CT image denoising in medical image processing is proposed; the PReLU activation function is used in the constructed neural network model to improve the denoising performance of the network; the training efficiency of the neural network can be improved by adopting a residual error learning mode to learn noise in the image; by adopting the convolution neural network method of multi-feature extraction, more feature information in the image can be captured.

title: System and method for privacy preserving predictive models for lung cancer survival analysis
abstract: A computer-implemented method for privacy-preserving data mining to determine cancer survival rates includes providing a random matrix B agreed to by a plurality of entities, wherein each entity i possesses a data matrix Ai of cancer survival data that is not publicly available, providing a class matrix Di for each of the data matrices Ai, providing a kernel K(Ai, B) by each of said plurality of entities to allow public computation of a full kernel, and computing a binary classifier that incorporates said public full kernel, wherein said classifier is adapted to classify a new data vector according to a sign of said classifier.

title: Artificial intelligence based risk prediction system and method for patient management
abstract: An artificial intelligence-based risk prediction system and method for patient management are disclosed. The present invention can calculate real-time risk prediction values based on vital data and EMR data of a patient using an artificial intelligence-based prediction model to provide rapid response information according to the occurrence of a risk condition.

title: Fundus image retinal arteriosclerosis detection method based on improved coding and decoding network
abstract: The invention provides a fundus image retinal arteriosclerosis detection method based on an improved codec network, which comprises the following steps: 1) Collecting fundus images which are diagnosed as retinal arteriosclerosis by ophthalmologists, fitting lesion blood vessels in the fundus images, and calculating and counting reflex parameters to determine a retinal arteriosclerosis detection threshold; 2) The coding and decoding network is improved by utilizing a Inception ResnetV module and a residual attention mechanism module, and the method is applied to segmentation of arterial blood vessels and arterial reflective bands; 3) Screening an effective area, sampling the effective area, fitting by using four Gaussian models to obtain a vascular gray distribution curve, calculating a reflection parameter according to a fitting result, comparing the reflection parameter with a threshold value, and judging whether the patient suffers from retinal arteriosclerosis. The invention determines the quantitative detection threshold of the retinal arteriosclerosis, solves the problem that the traditional method can not accurately divide the artery and vein blood vessel of the fundus and the reflective belt of the artery by utilizing the deep learning technology, and completes the detection of the retinal arteriosclerosis.

title: Method and device for constructing Chinese medical implication knowledge graph
assignee: 云知声智能科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a Chinese medical implication knowledge graph. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first medical entity and a second medical entity; integrating the first medical entity and the second medical entity, and performing de-duplication filtering on the first medical entity and the second medical entity and the entity in a preset medical knowledge graph to obtain a third medical entity which does not exist in the preset medical knowledge graph and needs to be aligned; fine tuning the pre-trained model to obtain a medical entity implication model; inputting the third medical entity and the entity with the highest similarity into the medical entity implication model, and determining the relationship between the entities; and updating the preset medical knowledge graph according to the relation between the third medical entity and the entity.
assignee_clean: 云知声智能科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 云知声智能科技股份有限公司

title: System for predicting treatment outcomes based upon genetic imputation
abstract: Methods, systems, and software provide machine learning and artificial intelligence including deep neural networks that enable the creation and operation of unique, AI-driven genomic test results augmentation through variable genetic imputation.

title: Root canal detection and scoring method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 四川大学, 四川欧润特软件科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a root canal detection and scoring method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of image processing and are characterized in that the method comprises the following steps: collecting a large number of image data of root canal X-ray films, marking and cleaning the image data, performing image processing on the obtained image data, performing data amplification to prepare a data set, respectively constructing a detection network model and a scoring network model, performing network training through the prepared data set, and automatically detecting and scoring the root canal X-ray films and outputting corresponding results by the obtained detection network model and the scoring network model. The invention reduces the detection and scoring of the root canal image by manpower, reduces the working intensity of medical staff, and simultaneously avoids low scoring reliability caused by more effect evaluation standard items and uneven expert experience level.
assignee_clean: 四川大学; 四川欧润特软件科技有限公司

title: Computed tomography perfusion imaging
assignee: Shenyang Neusoft Medical Systems Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method of computed tomography (CT) perfusion imaging includes: obtaining perfusion data by using a CT device to scan a present perfusion subject; performing calculations of the perfusion data by using two perfusion calculation methods to obtain perfusion parameters of each of said two perfusion calculation methods as initial perfusion parameters of each of said two perfusion calculation methods; performing calculations by using the initial perfusion parameters based on weights of said two perfusion calculation methods to obtain target perfusion parameters; and forming a target perfusion image of the present perfusion subject according to the target perfusion parameters.

title: Data screening method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a data screening method, a data screening device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the fields of artificial intelligence, deep learning, data screening, data labeling, image processing, medical imaging and the like. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: extracting image data to be processed from the marked data set; carrying out classification probability prediction according to the image data to be processed and the classification model to obtain a probability prediction result; and screening data according to the similarity of the data set between the probability prediction result and the marked data set to obtain the data to be marked. By adopting the method and the device, manpower and material resources are saved, and the accuracy of data annotation and class diversity are improved.

primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Sequential integration of adversarial networks with handcrafted features (SANwicH): identifying sites of prognostic significance for predicting cancer recurrence
abstract: Embodiments discussed herein facilitate generation of a prognosis for a medical condition based on determination of one or more histomorphometric features for tiles of a whole slide image (WSI) that have been identified as the most prognostically significant tiles of the WSI. A first set of embodiments discussed herein relates to training of a fully convolutional network (FCN) to determine the prognostic significance of pixels of a WSI. A second set of embodiments discussed herein relates to determination of a prognosis based on analysis of regions identified as the most prognostically significant by a trained FCN.

title: Non-invasive determination of likely response to combination therapies for cardiovascular disease
abstract: Provided herein are methods and systems for making patient-specific therapy recommendations of a combination of any two or more therapies selected from a lipid-lowering therapy, an anti-inflammatory therapy for patients with known or suspected cardiovascular disease, such as atherosclerosis.

title: Medical image super-resolution reconstruction method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image super-resolution reconstruction method and a medical image super-resolution reconstruction system, wherein a distillation progressive refinement module is constructed, hierarchical structure features are extracted step by step, and the most useful feature information can be screened step by step through the cooperation of a contrast perception attention module, so that not only can deep features be extracted, but also high-frequency parts such as edges, structures and the like of images can be reserved, finally, a combined up-sampling module is used for reconstructing a low-resolution medical image into a super-resolution image with clear edge and detail information, and the medical image super-resolution efficiency can be improved (the time for reconstructing a single image is about 38 milliseconds). Experiments prove that the medical image super-resolution method based on the multiple characteristic distillation can improve the quality and efficiency of the medical super-resolution image, the objective index and reconstruction time of the image are superior to those of a comparison method, and the parameter quantity of a model is reduced by about 6 times compared with that of the comparison model.

title: Medical image processing apparatus, and medical imaging apparatus
abstract: In medical examination of breast cancer, a lesion computer-aided detection is performed in real time and with high accuracy, and a burden on a medical worker is reduced. A medical image processing apparatus that processes a medical image includes: a detection unit configured to detect a lesion candidate region; a validity evaluation unit configured to evaluate validity of the lesion candidate region by using a normal tissue region corresponding to the detected lesion candidate region; and a display unit configured to determine display content to a user by using an evaluation result.

title: System and method for realizing intelligent health monitoring of solitary old people by utilizing edge calculation
abstract: The invention discloses a system for realizing intelligent health monitoring of solitary old people by utilizing edge calculation. The intelligent medical system has the advantages that all parts in the system are mutually matched, the purposes of health monitoring convenience, auxiliary diagnosis accuracy, emergency notification rapidness, comprehensive privacy protection and auxiliary function pertinence are achieved, the efficiency, accuracy and safety of intelligent medical treatment are improved to the greatest extent, and the intelligent medical system becomes an intelligent doctor who is guarded at the side of the elderly or patients living alone. The system is deployed in an actual application scene, so that the system can not only monitor the health of the elderly living alone at any time and help the elderly to carry out disease self-detection, provide support and guarantee for the health and life quality of the elderly, but also effectively reduce the injury probability of the elderly, reduce the burden of families and society and assist the construction of modern countries.

title: Medical image diagnosis apparatus and management apparatus
abstract: A medical image diagnosis apparatus according to an embodiment includes obtaining circuitry, detecting circuitry, deriving circuitry, and controlling circuitry. The obtaining circuitry is configured to obtain image data of a patient. The detecting circuitry is configured to detect each of a plurality of sites of the patient from the image data. The deriving circuitry is configured to derive information about a structuring member in the patient, on the basis of a detection result obtained by the detecting circuitry. The controlling circuitry is configured to determine an injection condition for a contrast agent to be administered to the patient for a contrast-enhanced scan, on the basis of the information about the structuring member.

title: Bandwidth dependent media stream compression
abstract: In general, this disclosure describes media stream transmission techniques for a computing device. The computing device may capture an image of a local background environment. The computing device may record a first media stream that includes at least a portion of the image of the background environment and at least one movement of at least one object through the background environment. The computing device may remove the image of the background environment from the first media stream to create a second media stream that includes the movement of the object without the image of the background environment. The computing device may determine a bandwidth of a network over which the second media stream will be transmitted and perform further alterations to the second media stream if the current bandwidth is less than a bandwidth threshold level in order to reduce the bandwidth needed to transmit the second media stream.

title: Pituitary tumor texture image grading method based on fine-grained medical image segmentation and truth value discovery data amplification
abstract: The invention discloses a pituitary tumor texture image grading method based on fine-grained medical image segmentation and true value discovery data amplification, which comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the following steps: optimizing medical image segmentation of drosophila-density peak clustering based on fine granularity; step two: amplifying pituitary tumor data based on truth finding; step three: grading based on the texture images of the pituitary tumors from step one and step two. The invention carries out accurate segmentation on the medical image by fusing a fine-grained division algorithm and an FOA-DPC algorithm; the invention also realizes the medical image data amplification based on the truth finding theory and solves the problem of too few available medical image data sets. The invention combines a KFOA-DPC segmentation algorithm with deep learning, solves the problems that dicom-format images have numerous and complicated gray levels and characteristics are difficult to extract, realizes grading of soft and tough texture of pituitary adenomas, and assists clinical diagnosis.

title: Method and apparatus for generating three-dimensional model
assignee: 百度在线网络技术（北京）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for generating a three-dimensional model. One embodiment of the method comprises: acquiring a medical image to be modeled, which is obtained by shooting an object to be modeled; inputting the medical image to be modeled into a pre-trained framework parameter generation model to obtain framework parameters of an object to be modeled, wherein the framework parameter generation model is used for generating the framework parameters of the object in the medical image; and adjusting the standard three-dimensional framework model based on the framework parameters of the object to be modeled to obtain the three-dimensional framework model of the object to be modeled. According to the embodiment, the skeleton parameters are generated based on the skeleton parameter generation model, the standard three-dimensional skeleton parameter model is adjusted based on the skeleton parameters, and the three-dimensional skeleton model can be obtained quickly. And moreover, a three-dimensional skeleton model is generated based on the medical image for three-dimensional display, so that the three-dimensional skeleton model is more visual and is convenient to understand.
assignee_clean: 百度在线网络技术 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 百度在线网络技术 北京 有限公司

title: Image deblurring method and device based on deep learning and electronic equipment
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image deblurring method and device based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a fuzzy type corresponding to an image to be processed; determining a fuzzy processing network matched with the fuzzy type based on the fuzzy type corresponding to the image to be processed, wherein the fuzzy processing network is obtained by training a plurality of sample image pairs corresponding to the fuzzy type, and the plurality of sample image pairs are composed of a plurality of fuzzy sample images with different fuzzy degrees and a clear sample image respectively; inputting the image to be processed into the fuzzy processing network so as to deblur the image to be processed based on the characteristic mapping relation between the fuzzy sample image and the clear sample image which is learned by the fuzzy processing network in training; and acquiring the deblurred image output by the blurring processing network. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the application can perform full-blind deblurring processing on the to-be-processed data.

title: Assisting researchers to identify opportunities for new sub-studies in digital health research and decentralized clinical trials
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for improving distributed monitoring using different groups of remote devices. In some implementations, a system communicates with a set of remote devices involved in a first monitoring program that involves collection of data from the remote devices over a communication network. The system identifies a pattern or similarity among monitoring data collected from a subset of the remote devices involved in the first monitoring program. The system determines that the identified pattern or similarity satisfies one or more criteria for initiating additional monitoring. In response, the system determines parameters specifying second types of data to collect in a second monitoring program. The system configures one or more devices to perform monitoring for the second monitoring program including acquiring data for the second types of data and providing the acquired data to a server over the communication network.

title: Scanning method and medical scanning system based on priori information
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a scanning method and a medical scanning system based on priori information, wherein the scanning method based on the priori information comprises the following steps: acquiring information data of a scanning object, acquiring priori information corresponding to the scanning object in a priori information database according to the information data of the scanning object, determining actual scanning parameters and actual reconstruction parameters of the scanning object according to the priori information, scanning the scanning object according to the actual scanning parameters, acquiring actual scanning data, and reconstructing an image of the actual scanning data of the scanning object according to the actual reconstruction parameters. The application solves the problem that the scanning parameters obtained by manufacturers through index or die body experiments in the related technology cannot be completely suitable for scanning objects of different body types and different clinical scenes, so that the scanning dosage cannot be reduced in a targeted manner, and the scanning parameters of the scanning objects are determined through prior information related to the scanning objects, so that the scanning dosage of each scanning object is reduced in a targeted manner.

primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Method for the fully automatic detection and assessment of damaged vertebrae
abstract: A method is disclosed for the automatic determination of the bone density and a method is disclosed for the automatic detection and characterization of spinal column fractures. Both methods enable the fully automatic detection and assessment of damaged vertebrae and reliably enable an analysis of the state of the vertebrae with a high accuracy rate. A computed tomography system to carry out either of the methods is further disclosed.

title: Method for entering mobile robot into moving walkway and mobile robot thereof
abstract: The present invention is directed to a method of causing a mobile robot to enter a moving walkway, the method including setting a movement path including a moving walkway, recognizing, by the mobile robot, to enter the moving walkway included in the movement path, adjusting at least one of a speed of the mobile robot and a speed of a step belt of the moving walkway via communication between the mobile robot and the moving walkway, and moving the mobile robot onto the step belt of the moving walkway based on the adjusted speed.

title: Method, system and storage medium for detecting medical insurance fraud
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system and a storage medium for detecting medical insurance fraud, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a diagnosis record of a patient, extracting corresponding patient characteristics according to the acquired diagnosis record, and establishing a doctor-patient relationship neural network according to the extracted patient characteristics and the corresponding relationship between the patient and a doctor; inputting the pre-marked fraud sample into the established doctor-patient relationship neural network, training a fraud prediction model, and outputting a predicted value of each patient node with fraud from the trained fraud prediction model; and judging whether the patient of the corresponding node has fraudulent activity or not according to the output predicted value. Whether the patient has fraud is predicted by a machine learning method, so that the difficulty of predicting the fraud is reduced, the medical insurance fraud can be effectively detected, and the health popularization of a medical insurance system is facilitated.

title: Medical image recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a medical image recognition method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the artificial intelligence fields of computer vision, deep learning, intelligent medical treatment and the like. The medical image recognition method comprises the following steps: inputting the medical image into a disease grading network, and acquiring a class activation diagram output by the disease grading network, a class of the disease and a disease confidence coefficient of the class activation diagram, wherein the class activation diagram can represent a relevant area indicating a corresponding disease class in the medical image, and the classification of the disease class is related to one or more focuses; inputting the medical image into a pathological sign recognition network, and acquiring one or more focus probability maps output by the pathological sign recognition network, wherein each pixel of each focus probability map indicates the probability that a corresponding sub-region in the medical image comprises a focus, and the similarity between each focus probability map in the category activation map and the related one or more focus probability maps is larger than a set threshold value under the condition that the corresponding disease confidence is larger than a preset confidence.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for cardiovascular blood flow and musculoskeletal modeling for predicting device failure or clinical events
abstract: Computer-implemented methods are disclosed for assessing the effect of musculoskeletal activities on disease and/or clinical events, the method comprising: receiving a patient-specific vascular and musculoskeletal model of a patient's anatomy, including at least one vessel of the patient; receiving at least one characteristic of the patient's musculoskeletal activity; generating or updating a computational anatomic vascular and musculoskeletal model of the patient's anatomy based on the received at least one characteristic of musculoskeletal activity; performing at least one of a computational fluid dynamics analysis or a structural mechanics simulation on the computational anatomic vascular and musculoskeletal model; and estimating at least one of the patient's risk of disease or clinical events based on the performed computational fluid dynamics analysis and/or structural mechanics simulation. Systems and computer readable media for executing these methods are also disclosed.

title: Image segmentation method and device
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides an image segmentation method and an image segmentation device, wherein the image segmentation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of training images and training segmentation images obtained by segmenting interesting regions of the training images; determining an independent pixel point classifier according to the training image and the training segmentation image; segmenting the interesting region of the training image by using the independent pixel point classifier to obtain an initial segmentation image; determining an interlayer associated pixel point classifier according to the training image, the training segmentation image and the initial segmentation image; and utilizing the independent pixel point classifier and the interlayer associated pixel point classifier to divide the image to be divided to obtain a target divided image. By the image segmentation method and the image segmentation device, the correlation of adjacent pixels can be fully considered when the image is segmented, and the robustness and the accuracy of medical image segmentation are improved.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Systems and methods for secure processing of eye tracking data
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for processing and storing eye-tracking data. A visual stimulus is provided to an experimental subject on a display. Eye-tracking data associated with the behavior of the experimental subject is acquired and stored while observing the visual stimulus on the display. The eye-tracking data is stored as primary data and secondary data, wherein the primary data is stored in an encrypted form using a secret key associated with the experimental subject. In response to a research request, the secondary data is transmitted for storage in a research database and, in response to a second research request authorized by the experimental subject, the primary data is transmitted for storage in the research database subsequent to decrypting the primary data using the secret key.

title: Liver disease activity estimation with ultrasound medical imaging
abstract: Ultrasound-based estimation of disease activity, such as for NAS or other activity index for NAFLD for liver disease, is provided. Ultrasound measures acoustic scatter and shear wave propagation parameters, such as measuring acoustic backscatter coefficient, shear wave velocity, and shear wave damping ratio. A score for the disease activity is determined from these scatter and shear wave propagation parameters. The physician may be assisted by relatively inexpensive and rapid ultrasound as compared to biopsy or MRI based scoring in scoring activity of a disease, such as NAFLD. Ultrasound imaging is more readily available and less expensive and MRI, and is non-invasive.

title: Vascular information acquisition method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The disclosure relates to a blood vessel information acquisition method and device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image of a tissue organ, wherein the medical image is a single-mode image or a multi-mode image; performing blood vessel extraction processing on the medical image to obtain blood vessel morphology information, wherein the blood vessel morphology information comprises at least two kinds of information related to blood vessel morphology; and determining the blood vessel morphology information of each partition based on the position information of each partition in the medical image. The embodiment of the disclosure can conveniently obtain the blood vessel morphology information of different partitions.

title: Image recognition and model training method, and true mortar position recognition method and device
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 长木谷医疗科技(青岛)有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention discloses a method for image recognition and model training, a method and a device for true mortar position recognition, wherein the method for true mortar position recognition comprises the following steps: acquiring medical image data; performing image segmentation on the medical image data, and determining femur and pelvis regions based on the image segmentation result; performing multi-stage scaling processing on the image segmentation result, and determining the femoral head central point and the tear drop lower edge position of the healthy side based on the image scaling result; and determining the true mortar position based on the femoral head central point and the tear drop lower edge position of the healthy side. This application can get rid of DDH development hip joint dislocation's artificial mortar interference fast, real mortar position of quick discernment makes things convenient for the art person to lay the acetabular cup prosthesis in real mortar position, improves planning efficiency before the art.

title: System for synthetic display of multi-modality data
abstract: A computer-implemented method for providing a multi-modality visualization of a patient includes receiving one or more image datasets. Each image dataset corresponds to a distinct image modality. The image datasets are segmented into a plurality of anatomical objects. A list of clinical tasks associated with displaying the one or more image datasets are received. A machine learning model is used to determine visualization parameters for each anatomical object based on the list of clinical tasks. Then, a synthetic display of the image datasets is created by presenting each anatomical object according to its corresponding visualization parameters.

title: Claim analysis with deep learning
abstract: Embodiments relate to system for automatically predicting payer response to claims. In an embodiment, the system receives claim data associated with a claim. The system identifies a set of claim features of the claim data, and generates an input vector with at least a portion of the set of claim features. The system applies the input vector to a trained model. A first portion of the neural network is configured to generate an embedding representing the input vector with a lower dimensionality than the input vector. A second portion of the neural network is configured to generate a prediction of whether the claim will be denied based on the embedding. The system provides the prediction for display on a user interface of a user device. The prediction may further include denial reason codes and a response date estimation to indicate if, when, and why a claim will be denied.

title: Cerebral artery segmentation method and device based on deep learning technology
assignee: 北京灵医灵科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a cerebral artery segmentation method and a cerebral artery segmentation device based on a deep learning technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing an MRA image of the human brain magnetic resonance angiography to obtain preprocessed data; taking the preprocessed data as the input of a deep learning model, and training the deep learning model to obtain a trained deep learning model, wherein the deep learning model comprises a hole dense network; acquiring data to be segmented, taking the data to be segmented as input of a trained deep learning model, and performing segmentation prediction on the data to be segmented by using the trained deep learning model to obtain brain artery blood vessel binary volume data; and processing the binary volume data of the cerebral artery blood vessel by a threshold segmentation method to obtain a cerebral artery segmentation result. The invention can improve the precision and speed of the existing deep learning-based method for segmenting the blood vessel.
assignee_clean: 北京灵医灵科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京灵医灵科技有限公司

title: Disease detection from weakly annotated volumetric medical images using convolutional long short-term memory and multiple instance learning
abstract: Systems and methods for developing a disease detection model. One method includes training the model using an image study and an associated disease label mined from a radiology report. The image study including a sequence of a plurality of two-dimensional slices of a three-dimensional image volume, and the model including a convolutional neural network layer and a convolutional long short-term memory layer. Training the model includes individually extracting a set of features from each of the plurality of two-dimensional slices using the convolutional neural network layer, sequentially processing the features extracted by the convolutional neural network layer for each of the plurality of two-dimensional slices using the convolutional long short-term memory layer, processing output from the convolutional long short-term memory layer for each of the plurality of two-dimensional slices to generate a probability of the disease, and updating the model based on comparing the probability to the label.

title: Data processing for making predictive determinations
abstract: In some examples, structured and unstructured data is evaluated using one or more predictive models to determine whether a dependent user is at risk for a certain condition. In other examples, structured and unstructured data is evaluated using one or more predictive models to determine a contact plan for contacting dependent users regarding follow-up appointments related to release of the dependent user.

title: Method and systems for filtered, real-time referral searches
abstract: A method for filtered, real-time referral searches includes receiving, by an analysis engine, during a patient interaction between a patient and an operator, an identification of a clinical need. The analysis engine analyzes the identification of the clinical need and data associated with the patient to determine at least one patient requirement. The analysis engine identifies a plurality of medical providers as potential referrals for the patient. The analysis engine generates a question to ask the patient and modifies a user interface displayed to the operator, during the patient interaction, to include the generated question. The analysis engine receives input responsive to the generated question. The analysis engine accesses at least one state machine to filter the plurality of medical providers. The analysis engine modifies, during the patient interaction, the user interface, resulting in a display of an identification of each medical provider in the filtered set of medical providers.

title: Image direction correction method and device and electronic equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides an image direction correction method, an image direction correction device and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be corrected, and extracting characteristics of a target object in the image to be corrected through an image processing model so as to acquire detection information corresponding to the target object; vectorizing the detection information to obtain coordinate information corresponding to the target object; and determining a rotation angle corresponding to the image to be corrected based on the coordinate information, and correcting the direction of the image to be corrected according to the rotation angle. The method and the device can correct the rotation angle of the fine granularity of the inclined image, and improve the correction accuracy of the image direction; meanwhile, the detection efficiency and the recognition accuracy of the information in the document image can be improved, and the efficiency and the accuracy of subsequent information structuring processing are greatly improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Medical image processing method and processing device
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image processing method and a medical image processing device, wherein an original medical image is obtained through an image shooting device; preprocessing the identified medical cached image to form a primary image containing a sensitive area; determining first to nth medical feature units from the primary image; and identifying a plurality of targets contained in the Nth medical feature unit through machine analysis, and outputting images of the first medical feature unit containing the sensitive area to the Nth medical feature unit. The method has the advantages that the method is automatically compared with the images stored by the existing equipment, the dulled images are discarded, unnecessary medical analysis is saved, the working efficiency is improved, manual deletion or retention can be performed, the error rate is reduced, the images containing sensitive areas are output according to the hierarchy, and the diagnosis of doctors is facilitated.

title: Digital twin updating
abstract: Disclosed is a method (100) of providing a personalized parameter model of at least part of the physiology of a person (10) carrying a set of sensors (12, 14, 16) with a computer system (20, 50) comprising a processor arrangement (22, 52) for the purpose of updating a biophysical model or digital twin of the person. The method comprises, with said processor arrangement, receiving (103) sensor data from said set of sensors with the communication interface over a defined period of time, the sensor data from each sensor representing a parameter relevant to an actual physiological state of the person; evaluating (105) the received sensor data from each sensor to define the personalized parameter model (3), said model including the evaluated dynamic behaviour of the values of each parameter observed with said sensors over the defined period of time and providing (107) the defined personalized parameter model for updating a digital model (1) of at least part of the anatomy of said person. Also disclosed is a method (200) for updating such a digital twin in which the digital twin is updated using such a personalized parameter model. In addition, a computer program product for implementing such methods and a computer system (20) implementing such methods are also disclosed.

title: Encoding textual information for text analysis
abstract: A computer-implemented method of encoding a word for use in a method of text analysis comprises receiving input text to be analysed, the input text comprising a first word which is not represented in a vocabulary set stored on a storage. The vocabulary set comprises a plurality of words and an associated word embedding vector for each word in the set. The method comprises identifying the first word as a word which is not represented in the vocabulary set and determining one or more sub-words within the first word with which to encode the first word. Each of the one or more sub-words corresponds with a word represented in the vocabulary set and having an embedding vector in the vocabulary set. The method comprises determining an encoding for the first word based on the one or more sub-words.

title: System and method for automated annotation of radiology findings
abstract: A method for the automated annotation of radiology findings includes: receiving a set of inputs, determining a set of outputs based on the set of inputs, assigning labels to the set of inputs, and annotating the set of inputs based on the labels. Additionally, the method can include any or all of: presenting annotated inputs to a user, comparing multiple sets of inputs, transmitting a set of outputs to a radiologist report, or any other suitable processes.

title: Fetal heart rate detection system based on deep learning and specificity correction on FECG
abstract: The invention discloses a fetal heart rate detection system based on deep learning and specificity correction on FECG, and belongs to the field of fetal heart rate detection on fetal electrocardiogram. The invention uses independent component analysis, deep neural network, one-dimensional target detection, specific model diagnosis and other methods, because the convolutional neural network and the cyclic neural network have superior performance in processing one-dimensional signals, the invention transfers the current hot target detection technology to the one-dimensional signals to build a complete detection frame aiming at fetal heart electrocardiogram based on deep learning, and simultaneously uses a specific correction model to eliminate individual difference so as to solve the problem of poor model generalization capability caused by individual difference of patients when machine learning is applied to medical problems, thereby realizing accurate fetal heart rate monitoring based on fetal heart electrocardiogram and being applicable to clinical diagnosis.

title: Dementia care support system and method for alleviation of dementia care
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for supporting a care comprises: a life log detecting device for measuring life log data including an indoor life log and an outdoor life log; a server for analyzing a movement pattern of a user based on machine learning of the collected life log data, and supporting a care support service including a result of the analyzed movement pattern; and an electronic device for guiding data of the user detected from the life log detecting device and the care support service provided by the server.

title: System and method for automated retrosynthesis
abstract: A system and method for automated retrosynthesis which can reliably identify valid and practical precursors and reaction pathways. The methodology involves a k-beam recursive process wherein at each stage of recursion, retrosynthesis is performed using a library of molecule disconnection rules to identify possible precursor sets, validation of the top k precursor sets is performed using a transformer-based forward reaction prediction scoring system, the best candidate of the top k precursor sets is selected, and a database is searched to determine whether the precursors are commercially available. The recursion process is repeated until a valid chain of chemical reactions is found wherein all precursors necessary to synthesize the target molecule are found to be commercially available.

title: Medical image processing device and endoscope system
abstract: The present invention provides a medical image processing apparatus and an endoscope system capable of preventing display of a recognition result obtained by a recognition process from interfering with observation of a medical image, and an operation method of the medical image processing apparatus. The processor device (16) is provided with an image signal acquisition unit (50), an image processing unit (56), and a display control unit (58). An image signal acquisition unit (50) acquires a digital image signal corresponding to an observation mode from an endoscope (12). The image processing unit (56) is provided with a region-of-interest mode image processing unit (64). A display control unit (58) performs switching control between a first display method for displaying an endoscope image in real time and a second display method for displaying a list of recognition results.

title: PDF-format-paper-oriented biomedical entity identification method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of named entity identification, and discloses a PDF-format-paper-oriented biomedical entity identification method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of (1) receiving a PDF paper as an input and confirming the format type of the PDF paper, (2) processing invalid text information of an input text, (3) normalizing the content of the input text, (4) identifying a medical entity in the processed text by using a named entity identification model, (5) highlighting the identified entity in the original text, and (6) packaging the whole process and displaying the entity in a Web application form. The method breaks through the precedent that no entity identification processing is specially carried out on the relevant paper and highlighting is carried out on the PDF format in the medical field at present, and medical researchers can quickly find the medical entity concerned in the paper and carry out further reading work by highlighting the medical entity in the text, so that the method has a significant use value.

title: Image segmentation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to an image segmentation method, an apparatus, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image to be segmented and a Gaussian noise image; performing feature coding processing on the Gaussian noise image by taking the target image as conditional information, and applying potential space representation constraint to the result of the feature coding processing to obtain a plurality of probabilistic potential feature vectors of the target image; performing feature decoding processing on the probabilistic latent feature vectors by taking the target image as conditional information to obtain a plurality of prediction noise; and denoising the Gaussian noise image through back diffusion based on the prediction noise to obtain an image segmentation result corresponding to each prediction noise. The method can effectively reconstruct a plurality of probabilistic segmentation masks, realize the reconstruction processing of the diversified segmentation masks of the target image, reduce the occurrence of the missing detection condition and effectively improve the accuracy of the image segmentation processing.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Machine learning-based nutritional health state assessment and risk prediction system for old people
abstract: The invention discloses a machine learning-based nutritional health state assessment and risk prediction system for old people. The system comprises a data acquisition and feature screening module, a nutrition health state assessment model construction module, a risk prediction module and a nutrition health state analysis and suggestion module; according to the invention, by combining big data with a machine learning algorithm, multidimensional features related to nutritional health states such as dietary information, organism functional states, biological markers and the like are included, a nutritional health state assessment model based on CatBoost is constructed, and people are divided into high, medium, low and healthy people to provide risk prediction information, so that personalized advice is provided through a machine learning interpretable technology; the invention can help the elderly to quickly master the nutrition and health status of the elderly in real time and promote the intervention of medical care personnel on the nutrition and health status of the elderly.

title: Cancer prediction system based on ensemble learning
abstract: The invention discloses a cancer prediction system based on ensemble learning, which belongs to the field of bioscience, and comprises the following components: the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting characteristics of samples in a research data set, wherein the research data set comprises life habit samples, environmental factor samples and physical examination report samples of patients; the training optimization module is used for training the classifier and optimizing the parameters of the support vector machine in the model training process so as to obtain a base classifier; and the integration module is used for integrating the plurality of base classifiers after training to obtain an abnormal classifier for predicting the cancer incidence risk. According to the invention, sample characteristics in the research data set are extracted, the extracted pathological characteristics can fully show potential connection with cancer tumorigenesis, and the basic classifier is optimized, so that the abnormal classifier for predicting the cancer pathogenesis risk is finally built, and the prediction accuracy of the classifier is greatly improved.

title: Method and device for improving transmission and reception performance of LTE MTC downlink control channel
abstract: The present specification discloses a method for receiving a Machine Type Communication (MTC) physical downlink control channel (MPDCCH) from a base station by a terminal in a wireless communication system, the method comprising: receiving configuration information on reception of a demodulation reference signal (DMRS) to which one of a plurality of candidate precoders applied to a cell-specific reference signal (CRS) is applied, from a base station; receiving DMRS and control information from a base station over an MPDCCH based on configuration information; performing channel estimation on the MPDCCH based on at least one of the DMRS or the CRS; and demodulating control information based on the channel estimation, wherein when there are subframes in the MPDCCH repetition that are not available for CRS, the channel estimation is performed using only the DMRS.

title: Method, system and medium for planning radiotherapy dose in particle implantation tumor
assignee: 珠海横乐医学科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for planning radiotherapy dose in a particle implantation tumor, which are used for a radiotherapy interventional operation robot in a radiation particle, and comprise the following steps: acquiring medical image information; a medical image multi-organ segmentation step, namely performing multi-organ segmentation on the medical image, wherein one or more organs are marked on the medical image; a puncture needle path planning step, namely limiting the feasible path of the puncture needle based on the marked organ and the virtual needle inserting panel; a radioactive particle radiation dose calculation step of calculating a radiation dose of a radioactive particle in an in-vivo environment for the radioactive particle; and a radioactive particle distribution dose optimization step, wherein the quantity and the spatial position of the implanted particles are optimized according to the radiation dose of the particles, the shape and the volume of the tumor focus, and a particle distribution result that the accumulated radiation dose meets the set dose is obtained. The invention enables the dose distribution of the radioactive particles to meet the clinical requirements.
