title: Fundus image semantic segmentation method based on domain generalization
assignee: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学
abstract: The invention discloses a field generalization-based fundus image semantic segmentation method, which adopts the technical scheme that a fundus image semantic segmentation system consisting of an input content enhancement module, a feature extraction module, a feature style randomization module, a feature decoding module and a category division module is constructed. Training an eye fundus image semantic segmentation system, and enhancing the eye fundus image by an input content enhancement module to synthesize a fundus image; the feature extraction module extracts a feature matrix of the fundus image; and the feature style randomizing module randomizes the feature style of the feature matrix. The feature decoding module performs space cavity convolution on the feature matrix with the randomized style to obtain a prediction matrix; and the category dividing module obtains a fundus image semantic segmentation result according to the prediction matrix. Verification is performed during the training process. The trained fundus image semantic segmentation system segments fundus images input by a user. The invention solves the problems of poor generalization and low Dice value of the fundus image semantic segmentation method.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学

title: System and method for generating a direction inquiry response from biological extractions using machine learning
abstract: A system generating a directional inquiry response is disclosed. The system comprises a computing device configured to receive a directional inquiry from a device operated by a user. Computing device is configured to retrieve a biological extraction from the user and generate a directional inquiry response by training a machine-learning process using directional training data correlating a plurality of biological extractions to a plurality of directions and generating the directional inquiry response as a function of the biological extraction from the user and the machine-learning process. Computing device is configured to update the directional inquiry response as a function of the preferences of the use and output the updated directional inquiry response to the device operated by the user. A method for generating a directional inquiry response is also disclosed.

title: Method, apparatus, and system for providing information on analysis of pet stool status using stool sheet stool images
abstract: Disclosed are a method, a device, and a system for providing information on analysis of the condition of companion animal stool using a stool image of a stool sheet. According to one embodiment, the method for providing information on analysis of the condition of companion animal stool using a stool image of a stool sheet acquires a stool sheet stool image of an identifier, detects a stool object and a color code from the stool sheet stool image, preprocesses the stool object based on the color code, and generates the preprocessed stool object to generate the stool condition determination result of the identifier.

title: Systems and methods for image processing
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method for assessing a condition of an organ or tissue of a target object is provided. The method may include: obtaining a target image of the target object; segmenting a target region from the target image, the target region of the target image corresponding to a sub-region of the organ or tissue; determining a morphological characteristic value of the target region in the target image; obtaining a reference standard associated with a sample organ or tissue of a plurality of sample objects, the sample organ or tissue being of a same type as the organ or tissue of the target object; and assessing the condition of the organ or tissue of the target object by comparing the morphological characteristic value of the target region in the target image with the reference standard.

title: Method and apparatus for a tissue engineering system
abstract: The present invention provides apparatus and methods for production of tissue structures and organs. In some examples, a cleanspace facility may be equipped with modelling hardware and software, nanotechnology and microelectronic apparatus, and additive manufacturing equipment to print cells and support matrix to allow cells to grow into tissue structures and organs. Various methods relating to using and producing the tissue engineering system are discussed.

title: Systems, methods, devices and storage mediums for obtaining a radiographic image
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure discloses methods and systems for obtaining a radiographic image. The method may include obtaining a control instruction for controlling an imaging device to image a subject; determining, based on information reflecting a user's behavior in using the imaging device, adjustment parameters of a radiation generating device in the imaging device; and based on the control instruction, determining target exposure parameters at least based on a parameter control curve or biological information of the subject, the parameter control curve including a preset first parameter control curve or a second parameter control curve determined based on operation data of the imaging device, and the biological information including at least a weight and an overall content of each component of the subject; and imaging, based on the target exposure parameters, the subject to obtain the radiographic image.

title: Network training method and device, image recognition method and electronic equipment
assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to a network training method and device, an image recognition method and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: training an image recognition network in an initial state according to a first image group in a training set to obtain the image recognition network in the first state, wherein the first image group at least comprises a first labeled sample image; training the image recognition network in the first state according to a second image group in the training set to obtain the image recognition network in the second state, wherein the second image group comprises labeled first and second sample images and an unlabeled third sample image; and training the image recognition network in the second state according to the first image group to obtain the image recognition network in the target state. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the image data with rough labels and without labels can be fully utilized, the data demand for fine labels is reduced, and the training effect of the recognition network is improved, so that the segmentation recognition precision of the image data by the image recognition network is improved.
assignee_clean: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司

title: Automated electronic patient care record data capture
abstract: A patient data charting system for automated data capture by an electronic patient care record (ePCR) generated during a patient encounter with emergency medical services (EMS) includes a local computing device including a processor, and a memory storing an ePCR including ePCR data fields, and a user interface device communicatively coupled to the local computing device and including a microphone and speaker, wherein the microphone may be configured to capture spoken patient encounter information, wherein the processor may be configured to receive the spoken patient encounter information as text information from a speech-to-text conversion application, determine at least one ePCR data field value based on the text information, populate at least one ePCR data field with the at least one ePCR data field value, generate caregiver prompts based on the at least one ePCR data field value, and provide the audible caregiver prompts to the caregiver via the speaker.

title: Intelligent traditional Chinese medicine syndrome identification method and device
assignee: 北京元知创智科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a method and a device for intelligently identifying traditional Chinese medicine syndromes, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to each target symptom word corresponding to the target traditional Chinese medicine medical record, matching the word vector database used for storing the corresponding relation between each symptom word and each word vector to obtain the respective target word vector of each target symptom word, wherein each symptom word is generated by performing dictionary matching and text word segmentation on the traditional Chinese medicine medical record description text in advance; each word vector is generated by pre-adopting N-gram language characteristics to cut words of each symptom word and training based on a CBOW or skip-gram model; generating a target traditional Chinese medicine medical record vector; and identifying the symptom information of the target traditional Chinese medicine medical case according to the target traditional Chinese medicine medical case vector and the intelligent traditional Chinese medicine symptom identification model. The method and the device can fully extract semantic features in the traditional Chinese medicine case, and can effectively improve the accuracy and effectiveness of traditional Chinese medicine syndrome classification and identification on the basis of ensuring the automation and intellectualization of traditional Chinese medicine syndrome classification and identification.
assignee_clean: 北京元知创智科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京元知创智科技有限公司

title: Breast cancer data classification method combining deep network features and machine learning model
assignee: 郑州大学第一附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a breast cancer data classification method combining deep network characteristics and a machine learning model, which belongs to the technical field of big data and comprises the steps of establishing an image acquisition server, a client and a data classification server, sketching and processing a tumor region picture to obtain a data set of the classified picture, extracting image characteristics of an MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) layer with a tumor, establishing a training model by using a network model provided by Tensorflow and Keras as a reference model by using a model construction module, and performing classification model training by using an SVM (support vector machine) radial basis kernel.
assignee_clean: 郑州大学第一附属医院
primary_assignee: 郑州大学第一附属医院

title: Epilepsy auxiliary medical intelligent question-answering method based on viewpoint type reading understanding
abstract: The invention discloses an epileptic disease auxiliary medical intelligent question-answering method based on view reading understanding, which comprises the following steps of: s1, crawling relevant data of epilepsy on the Internet by using a crawler technology, acquiring a public Chinese corpus and storing the public Chinese corpus in a database; s2, designing a deep learning model and training a classifier; s3, transmitting the classifier trained in the step S2 to a host computer of a question-answering system, and calculating the most suitable answer in an answer library aiming at the questions proposed by the user; s4, designing a man-machine interaction interface as a medium for communication between a user and a machine; s5, utilizing voice transcription and voice dictation services to convert the questions of the user into characters, and converting answers output by the characters into voice for reading. The invention can solve the defects that the generated question-answer answers are too short, not detailed enough and the open domain question-answer shows poor performance in the medical (epileptic) field.

title: Image analysis and annotation
abstract: An embodiment of the invention may include a method, computer program product and computer system for object detection and identification. The method, computer program product and computer system may include computing device which may receive an image from an imaging device. The image may be a medical image. The computing device may detect one or more potential indicators of disease in the image using a first algorithm and determine areas of potential disease in the image using an artificial intelligence algorithm. The computing device may determine a correlation between the determined areas of potential disease in the image and the one or more potential indicators of disease for the image. The computing device may, in response to determining a positive correlation, identify one or more of the potential indicators of disease for annotation and generate a report indicating one or more potential indicators of disease was found in the image.

title: Medical object category decision method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application discloses a medical object category decision method, a medical object category decision device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring user portrait data of a medical object and medical data in a historical time period, wherein the medical data comprises disease diagnosis data and diagnosis resource consumption data; determining first correlation information between feature data in the disease diagnosis data and second correlation information between feature data in the diagnosis resource consumption data according to the user portrait data; marking independent characteristic data in the disease diagnosis data according to the first associated information, and marking associated characteristic data in the diagnosis resource consumption data according to the second associated information to obtain marked disease diagnosis data and marked diagnosis resource consumption data; and generating the category of the medical object by adopting a preset medical object classification model based on the marked disease diagnosis data and the marked diagnosis resource consumption data. The method and the device can improve the reliability of the class decision of the medical object.

title: Method for image segmentation, method for training image segmentation model
abstract: The method for image segmentation includes: acquiring, according to an image to be segmented including a background, a mediastinum, an artery and a vein, a first segmentation result of the mediastinum, the artery, the vein and the background in a mediastinum region of the image to be segmented; acquiring, according to the image to be segmented, a second segmentation result of a blood vessel and the background in an epitaxial region of the image to be segmented; and acquiring, according to the first segmentation result and the second segmentation result, a segmentation result of the mediastinum, the artery, the vein and the background of the image to be segmented, so that the segmentation accuracy and the segmentation efficiency of the artery and the vein may be improved.

title: Interactive outpatient quantity prediction visual analysis method and system based on Catboost model
abstract: The invention discloses an interactive outpatient quantity prediction visual analysis method and system based on a Catboost model, which comprises the following steps: constructing an interactive visual interface provided for a user for analyzing data, selecting data and features; the method comprises the following steps that a user selects data and characteristics on a front-end interface, information is transmitted to a back end according to a preset time interval, the back end modifies original input characteristics, and a regression model based on the CatBOost is established; after the model is built, the information is transmitted back to the front-end interface, and the feature importance degree analysis and prediction results are updated in the visual interface to help the user understand the prediction results and interactively mine the information behind the data. By combining the machine learning model with the front-end visual content, the defects that the traditional method is single in characteristic, insufficient in interpretability, difficult to use for people in non-professional fields, incapable of interactive analysis and the like can be overcome.

title: Digital twin
abstract: A patient digital twin platform includes a clinical subsystem, a patient subsystem, and a performance capture system. The clinical subsystem generates physical therapy exercises for a patient. The patient subsystem directs the patient to perform the exercises generated by the clinical patient subsystem. The performance capture system captures measurement data, such as video, of the patient performing at least one physical therapy exercise prescribed by the clinical subsystem. The output of the performance capture system is input to a patient digital twin engine that updates a patient digital twin of the patient.

title: Deep learning-based multi-mode health management scheme generation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, and provides a method and a system for generating a multi-mode health management scheme based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of single-mode operable data; obtaining a clustering result according to the specific data of the single mode; acquiring predicted health data of each moment according to the clustering result; obtaining deviation measurement and missing moment according to the operable data and the predicted health data; acquiring an abnormal concentration index according to the deviation measure and the time interval; acquiring data confidence according to the abnormal concentrated index; acquiring complete data of the mode according to the data confidence; acquiring corresponding feature vectors according to the modal complete data; acquiring a modal splicing weight according to the weight and the bias of the feature vector; and acquiring a fusion result of the multi-mode feature vector according to the multi-mode splicing weight. The invention avoids the phenomenon of unbalanced training network caused by data deflection in a single-mode training set, and improves the credibility of early fusion effect in deep learning.

title: System and method for classifying road features
abstract: An electronic device is described. The electronic device includes a memory and a processor in communication with the memory. The memory is configured to store pre-calibration data for a camera mounted on a vehicle, the pre-calibration data including a camera height determined relative to a road plane the vehicle is configured to contact during operation. The processor is configured to receive a plurality of images. The processor is also configured to classify one or more features in the plurality of images as road features based on the pre-calibration data.

title: Continuous analyte sensor quality measures and related therapy actions for an automated therapy delivery system
abstract: Techniques disclosed herein relate to continuous analyte sensor quality measures. In some embodiments, the techniques may involve obtaining a current sensor-generated value that is indicative of a physiological characteristic of a user of a medical device, the current sensor-generated value produced in response to operation of a continuous analyte sensor device. The techniques may further involve obtaining a sensor quality metric that indicates accuracy of the current sensor-generated value. The techniques may further involve causing, in response to obtaining the sensor quality metric, configuration of a quality-specific operating mode of the medical device, the quality-specific operating mode comprising separate regulation of basal and bolus deliveries of a fluid medication based on the obtained sensor quality metric. The techniques may further involve causing regulation of fluid medication delivery from the medical device, in accordance with the current sensor-generated value and the quality-specific operating mode of the medical device.

title: Tax refund loan management platform
abstract: Technology is described for implementing and managing loans made against projected tax refunds. In one example, a payment service system receives a request for a loan against an expected tax refund for a user. The payment service system can determine a confidence score for loan repayment and can generate an offer for the loan based on the confidence score. Upon acceptance of the offer, the user can be provided with funds for the loan.

title: Adaptive authentication and notification system
abstract: Systems, methods, and machine-readable media for processing data transmissions from a plurality of client devices to create composites for transmission to destination addresses are provided. Communications via a network may be received from a set of devices. Each communication may include a digital identifier corresponding to a destination specification. The communication may be processed to identify the digital identifier and to identify the destination specification. A data portion may be selected from the communication and cached. A second format may be identified as corresponding to a second communication medium, where the second format is different from a first format of the communication. A composite may be created according to the second format. The composite may include the selected data portion and the destination specification. The composite formatted according to the second format may be transmitted toward an endpoint device in accordance with the destination specification.

title: Ischemic cerebral apoplexy onset risk prediction model based on heterogeneous feature fusion
abstract: Aiming at the ischemic cerebral apoplexy incidence risk prediction task, the invention provides a three-dimensional image feature extraction network model for predicting by using carotid artery CTA images and a machine learning model for predicting by using electronic medical records and medical history information. A fusion prediction network model which fuses the above models and uses heterogeneous data to jointly predict is designed, as shown in fig. 1, and finally, a machine learning model, a data resampling method and selection of weight proportion of two sub-models in the fusion prediction model are explored through a plurality of groups of comparison experiments, so that effectiveness of the proposed model in ischemic stroke incidence risk prediction tasks is verified.

title: 2D medical image registration method fusing residual image information
abstract: The invention discloses a 2D medical image registration method fusing residual image information, which relates to the technical field of medical images and comprises the following steps: constructing a medical image registration model; training a model; application of models in image registration. According to the method, the residual image is introduced when the MSE similarity is calculated, the local pixel information is effectively fused, and the problems of pixel dislocation, deformation and folding are solved; based on the locality of the convolutional neural network and the global of the multi-head attention mechanism in Vision Transformer, a basic registration network is designed, jump connection of fusion residual image information is innovatively used in the basic registration network, the problem that MSE only calculates pixel values and feature matching between pixels cannot be found accurately is solved, and the generalization performance of a registration model is improved effectively; the multi-resolution progressive registration strategy is provided, the accuracy of registration is improved, and the topology maintainability is enhanced in the deformation process.

title: Intelligent network slicing and policy-based routing engine
abstract: One or more aspects of the present disclosure are directed to network optimization solutions provided as software agents (applications) executed on network nodes in a heterogenous multi-vendor environment to provide cross-layer network optimization and ensure availability of network resources to meet associated Quality of Experience (QoE) and Quality of Service (QoS). In one aspect, a network slicing engine is configured to receive at least one request from at least one network endpoint for access to the heterogeneous multi-vendor network for data transmission; receive information on state of operation of a plurality of communication links between the plurality of nodes; determine a set of data transmission routes for the request; assign a network slice for serving the request; determine, from the set of data transmission routes, an end-to-end route for the network slice; and send network traffic associated with the request using the network slice and over the end-to-end route.

title: Artificial intelligence apparatus for recognizing speech of user and method for the same
abstract: An embodiment of the present invention provides an artificial intelligence (AI) apparatus for recognizing a speech of a user, the artificial intelligence apparatus includes a memory to store a speech recognition model and a processor to obtain a speech signal for a user speech, to convert the speech signal into a text using the speech recognition model, to measure a confidence level for the conversion, to perform a control operation corresponding to the converted text if the measured confidence level is greater than or equal to a reference value, and to provide feedback for the conversion if the measured confidence level is less than the reference value.

title: Method and apparatus for diagnosing cerebral hemorrhagic and brain tumor lesions based on deep learning
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for diagnosing brain hemorrhage and brain tumor lesions based on deep learning, and to an apparatus thereof. According to the present invention, the method for diagnosing brain hemorrhage and brain tumor lesions based on deep learning comprises the steps of: acquiring CT images photographing a brain of a patient by an image acquisition unit; extracting the brain hemorrhage and brain tumor lesions from the CT image using first and second filters having different sizes from a lesion extracting unit; extracting and classifying lesion information including at least one of a lesion location, a lesion size, a blood vessel type, and brain hemorrhage from the extracted brain hemorrhage and brain tumor lesions by a classification unit; and diagnosing the operation based on the lesion information by a diagnosis unit.

title: Adaptive anatomical region prediction
abstract: Disclosed herein is a framework for facilitating adaptive anatomical region prediction. In accordance with one aspect, a set of exemplar images including annotated first landmarks is received. User definitions of first anatomical regions in the exemplar images are obtained. The framework may detect second landmarks in a subject image. It may further compute anatomical similarity scores between the subject image and the exemplar images based on the first and second landmarks, and predict a second anatomical region in the subject image by adaptively combining the first anatomical regions based on the anatomical similarity scores.

title: Medical text relation extraction method based on BERT model
abstract: A method for extracting medical text relation based on a BERT model comprises the following steps: step 1: collecting medical texts and constructing a text data set; step 2: preprocessing the data set; and 3, step 3: constructing a medical text relation extraction model; and 4, step 4: and carrying out structured storage on the extraction result. The invention provides a method for extracting medical text relation based on BERT, which adopts a deep learning algorithm represented by a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network and mainly extracts high-level abstract attributes from a medical text aiming at the medical text.

title: Augmented intelligence system architecture
abstract: A system, method, and computer-readable medium are disclosed for cognitive information processing. The cognitive information processing includes receiving data from a plurality of data sources; processing the data from the plurality of data sources to provide cognitively processed insights via an augmented intelligence system, the augmented intelligence system and an information processing system providing a cognitive computing function; performing a learning operation to iteratively improve the cognitively processed insights over time; and, providing the cognitively processed insights to a destination, the destination comprising a cognitive application, the cognitive application enabling a user to interact with the cognitive insights.

title: Microscope autofocus method, microscope system, medical device, and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司, 深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司
abstract: The present invention provides a microscope system comprising: the beam splitter component is used for separating and projecting light rays in different light paths respectively; the lens assembly is used for projecting light rays generated by an observed sample during observation after the light rays enter different light paths through the objective lens, and the camera assembly is used for photographing the sample to be observed in the field of view of the microscope so as to realize that the camera assembly shoots clear focused images through the first light path; an auxiliary focusing device for determining a focal length matching the camera assembly; the focusing device is configured to adjust the focal length of the image light entering the camera assembly according to the defocusing amount of the sample image to be measured determined by the auxiliary focusing device. The invention also provides an automatic focusing method of the microscope, medical equipment and a storage medium, and the automatic focusing method can realize automatic focusing of the microscope system, form and output a clear focused image shot through the first light path, save the focusing time of the microscope system and improve the focusing accuracy.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司; 深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Continuous authentication system and method based on BioAura
assignee: The Trustees Of Princeton University, Indian Statistical Institute, Purdue Research Foundation
abstract: A user authentication system for an electronic device for use with a plurality of wireless wearable medical sensors (WMSs) and a wireless base station that receives a biomedical data stream (biostream) from each WMS. The system includes a BioAura engine located on a server, the server has a wireless transmitter/receiver with receive buffers that store the plurality of biostreams, the BioAura engine has a look up stage and a classifier, the classifier generates an authentication output based on the plurality of biostreams, the authentication output authenticates the user's access to the electronic device. The wireless base station has a transmitter/receiver having receive buffers that store the biomedical data from each WMS, the wireless base station has a communication engine that retrieves the biostream from each WMS and transmits the plurality of biostreams to the server.
assignee_clean: the trustees of princeton university; indian statistical institute; purdue research foundation

title: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract: The invention provides a semi-supervised medical image segmentation method based on a generation countermeasure network, which comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a segmentation generation network and a judgment network; (2) adding self-learning constraint based on cross entropy; (3) adding data distribution to meet constraint; (4) and segmenting the image with the original pixel size. The invention carries out semi-supervised segmentation task in a self-learning mode by establishing a generation pair learning system based on a deep learning network; the generator generates a probability characteristic map of the data without labels, and the characteristic map determines the reliability of the indicator generated by the discriminator; the cross entropy based self-learning constraint and the data distribution conformity constraint respectively promote the utilization rate of the data without labels and the data distribution consistency of the real labels and the generated labels. The method can solve the problem of the dependence of the traditional full supervision method on the marking amount to a certain extent, thereby better assisting intelligent medical analysis and diagnosis under the condition of a small amount of marks.

title: Systems and methods for user interface adaptation for per-user metrics
abstract: A method includes storing a parameter related to a user, storing descriptive data for multiple identifiers, and indexing multiple events. Each event corresponds to a physical object supplied to a user on behalf of an entity. The method includes identifying a first set of identifiers based on commonality among the descriptive data. The method includes training a machine learning model for the first set of identifiers based on event data from within a predetermined epoch. The method includes receiving an indication of a selected identifier and determining a first intake metric of the selected identifiers using the machine learning model. The method includes determining a second intake metric of the selected identifier and the parameter and transforming the user interface according to the first and second intake metrics. The first intake metric represents an amount of resources expected to be received during a second epoch subsequent to the predetermined epoch.

title: MicroRNA-disease associated prediction method based on multi-mode stacking automatic coding machine
assignee: 中国科学院新疆理化技术研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a microRNA-disease association prediction method based on a multi-mode stacking automatic coding machine, which comprises microRNA sequence characteristics and disease semantic similarity characteristics; constructing a microRNA-protein-disease network, a microRNA-mRNA-disease network and a microRNA-lncRNA-disease network, and respectively obtaining network adjacent characteristics among the microRNA, the disease, the protein, the mRNA and the lncRNA by using a LINE network embedding method; a multi-mode stacking automatic coding machine is utilized to respectively mine high-level abstract characteristics of the microRNA and four characteristics of diseases (the attribute characteristics of the microRNA and the four characteristics of the diseases, the adjacent characteristics of a protein network, the adjacent characteristics of an mRNA network and the adjacent characteristics of an lncRNA network), so that the time complexity of the model is reduced, and the prediction accuracy of the model is improved; and (4) respectively training and predicting the processed features by using a Catboost classifier, and taking the average value of the four feature prediction scores as a final prediction score. The method solves the problems of high time consumption and high cost of the traditional biological experiment method, realizes better classification effect, and predicts the association relation of the potential microRNA and the disease with higher accuracy.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院新疆理化技术研究所
primary_assignee: 中国科学院新疆理化技术研究所

title: Data sharing method and device based on block chain and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a data sharing method and device based on a block chain and electronic equipment, wherein the embodiment of the invention discloses the data sharing method based on the block chain, which is applied to a data requester, and the method comprises the following steps: generating a data query message, wherein the data query message comprises a target data attribute, and the target data attribute is a data attribute of data to be acquired by the data requester; inquiring data index records in a regional chain network through the data inquiry message, and determining a data holder sequence corresponding to the target data attribute; sending a data request message to a first data holder in the sequence of data holders, wherein the data request message is used for requesting data corresponding to the target data attribute; and receiving the target data model and the target data returned by the last data holder in the data holder sequence. The invention realizes safe and effective data sharing.

title: Medical record data segmentation method and system based on pre-training language model
assignee: 神州医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a medical record data segmentation method and a system based on a pre-training language model, which are characterized in that original medical record text data is generated through the pre-training language model, the original medical record text data is divided and combined according to 1-N gram based on an N-gram model, medical record division data are obtained, a medical record word vector set is obtained through the pre-training bert model, a standard word vector set is obtained through the bert model by using all standard words in the preset medical field, similarity scores of the medical record words and the standard words are calculated through similarity scores, and the conforming medical record words are marked as disease entities according to a preset threshold, so that rapid and accurate segmentation and identification operation of the medical record text is realized, and the problems of low efficiency and substandard accuracy in the segmentation method based on the traditional sequence labeling are solved.
assignee_clean: 神州医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 神州医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Profiling and performance monitoring of distributed computational pipelines
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to collect performance data for one or more computations tasks executed by a plurality of nodes of a computational pipeline and enable optimization of distribution of task execution among the plurality of nodes.

title: Cancer tissue positioning method and system based on chromatin region coverage depth
assignee: 深圳吉因加医学检验实验室, 北京吉因加医学检验实验室有限公司, 长沙吉因加医学检验实验室有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a cancer tissue positioning method and system based on chromatin region coverage depth, wherein the positioning method comprises the following steps: constructing different cancer tissue localization models according to cfDNA data of different cancer species, cfDNA data of healthy people and an OCHROdb database of tissue specific open chromatin regions; calculating the uniform correction coverage depth of each tissue specific open chromatin region of the cfDNA to be detected, performing machine learning prediction analysis through each cancer tissue localization model to obtain the scores of different cancer tissue localization models, and localizing the cancer tissues according to the scores. The positioning method and the positioning system do not cause radiation damage to human bodies, and meanwhile, the library construction sequencing cost is low, the operation and analysis process is simple and convenient, errors caused by human factors during sample preparation are avoided, and the accuracy of the positioning result is ensured.
assignee_clean: 深圳吉因加医学检验实验室; 北京吉因加医学检验实验室有限公司; 长沙吉因加医学检验实验室有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳吉因加医学检验实验室

title: Simulation-based optimization on a quantum computer
abstract: Techniques and a system to facilitate simulation-based optimization on a quantum computer are provided. In one example, a system includes a quantum processor. The quantum processor performs a quantum amplitude estimation process based on a probabilistic distribution associated with a decision-making problem. Furthermore, the quantum processor includes a simulator that simulates the decision-making problem based on the quantum amplitude estimation process.

title: Computer system and method for detecting anomalies in multivariate data
abstract: A data analytics platform may be configured to construct an inferential model for a multivariate observation vector using inferential modeling in combination with component analysis, which may enable the data analytics platform to evaluate only a subset of the variables in the observation vector and then output a predicted version of the multivariate observation vector that includes predicted values for the full set of variables that was originally included in the observation vector. In turn, the data analytics platform may use the predicted version of the multivariate observation vector output by the inferential model to determine whether an anomaly has occurred.

title: Real-time adjustment of haptic feedback in surgical robots
abstract: Haptic feedback from a robotic surgical tool can be adjusted based on intra-operative assessment of the accuracy of a pre-operative surgical navigational plans. Navigational reference points are identified in at least one pre-operative image. At least one haptic response is identified for interactions between at least one robotic surgical tool and at least one navigational reference point. At least one intra-operative image is compared to the pre-operative image to determine the relative position of at least two corresponding navigational reference points in the images. The reference points' relative position determines a confidence level in the accuracy of the pre-operative navigational reference point. The haptic response is adjusted in timing, location, type, or amplitude based upon the confidence level. Tolerances and surgical navigation plan may also be updated and altered based on the confidence level.

title: Medical instrument clinical test project review method, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 广州奥咨达医疗器械技术股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a medical instrument clinical test project review method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of clinical tests, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a grade of the target medical instrument; receiving review materials of sponsors, extracting keywords from the review materials, and constructing a feature set; determining an item review score based on the feature set and the ranking; and judging whether the project passes the audit according to the scoring value. According to the embodiment of the invention, the corresponding keywords are extracted from the review materials submitted by the reporting party, the feature set is constructed, the project review score is determined based on the classification of the feature set and the target medical instrument, and the multiple dimensions of the qualification, the inspection condition, the subject condition, the technical condition and the validity condition of the reporting party are considered independently and comprehensively, so that the automatic review of the clinical test project is realized, and the auditing efficiency is improved.
assignee_clean: 广州奥咨达医疗器械技术股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 广州奥咨达医疗器械技术股份有限公司

title: Interpretation of whole-slide images in digital pathology
abstract: Computer-implemented methods and systems are provided for interpreting a whole-slide image of a tissue specimen. Such a method includes detecting biological entities in a region of interest independently at each magnification level in a whole-slide image. An entity graph is generated for each magnification level, the entity graph comprising nodes, representing respective biological entities detected at that magnification level, interconnected by edges representing interactions between entities. The method also includes, for each region of interest, generating a hierarchical graph, defining a hierarchy of the entity graphs for that region, in which nodes of different entity graphs are interconnected by hierarchical edges representing hierarchical relations between nodes of the entity graphs. The method further comprises supplying the hierarchical graph for the region to an AI system to produce result data corresponding to a medical evaluation of the tissue specimen represented thereby, and outputting the result data for the tissue specimen.

title: System and method for host/tool registration and control for intuitive motion
assignee: 直观外科手术操作公司
abstract: The invention provides a method performed by a computing system. The method includes receiving image data from an imaging device and using the image data to determine a plurality of image space tools, each image space tool associated with a tool of the plurality of tools, each tool controlled by a manipulator of the plurality of manipulators. The method also includes determining a first correspondence between a first image space tool of the plurality of image space tools and a first tool of the plurality of tools based on a first disambiguation setting associated with the first tool.
assignee_clean: 直观外科手术操作公司
primary_assignee: 直观外科手术操作公司

title: Methods and systems for predicting mortality of a patient
abstract: Disclosed are embodiments of methods and systems for predicting mortality of a first patient. The method comprises categorizing a historical data into a first category and a second category. The method further comprises determining a first test parameter and a second test parameter based on at least one of a sample data of a first patient and the historical data corresponding to at least one of the first category and the second category. The method further comprises determining a probability score based on a cumulative distribution of at least one of the first test parameter and the second test parameter. The method further comprises categorizing the sample data in one of the first category and the second category based on the probability score. Further, the method comprises predicting the mortality of the first patient based on at least the categorization of the sample data of the first patient.

title: Medical image processing method, device, storage medium and equipment
assignee: 广州金域医学检验中心有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of medical image analysis technologies, and in particular, to a medical image processing method, apparatus, storage medium, and device. The medical image processing method includes: acquiring a medical image, and carrying out digital processing on the medical image to obtain a digital medical image; performing feature recognition on each region in the digital medical image to obtain an image feature corresponding to each region, wherein the image features include: at least one of color features, morphological features, texture features; the regions in the digital medical image are divided into a plurality of categories according to the image characteristics corresponding to the regions, and the regions with the same or similar image characteristics belong to the same category. The invention can automatically, quickly and accurately identify the pathological image area, thereby improving the working efficiency of doctors and the diagnosis accuracy.
assignee_clean: 广州金域医学检验中心有限公司
primary_assignee: 广州金域医学检验中心有限公司

title: Biased task assignments based on geotracking of discharge vehicles
abstract: Systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and computer-implemented methods are provided for using location data of discharge vehicles for management of distributions of task assignments. Systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and computer-implemented methods are provided for collecting task specifications and identifying appropriate task-performing resources. Systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and computer-implemented methods are provided for using location data of discharge vehicles for electronically adjusting scheduled tasks. Systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and computer-implemented methods are provided for assigning tasks based on empirical performance assessments of resource-allocation systems.

title: Systems and methods for automated document image orientation correction
abstract: Systems and methods are configured for correcting the orientation of an image data object subject to optical character recognition (OCR) by receiving an original image data object, generating initial machine readable text for the original image data object via OCR, generating an initial quality score for the initial machine readable text via machine-learning models, determining whether the initial quality score satisfies quality criteria, upon determining that the initial quality score does not satisfy the quality criteria, generating a plurality of rotated image data objects each comprising the original image data object rotated to a different rotational position, generating a rotated machine readable text data object for each of the plurality of rotated image data objects and generating a rotated quality score for each of the plurality of rotated machine readable text data objects, and determining that one of the plurality of rotated quality scores satisfies the quality criteria.

title: X-ray detector pose estimation in medical imaging
abstract: For x-ray detector pose estimation, a machine-learned model is used to estimate locations of markers, including occluded or other non-visible markers, from an image. The locations of the markers, including the non-visible markers are used to determine the pose of the X-ray detector for aligning an X-ray tube with the X-ray detector.

title: Systems and methods for data protection
abstract: A system includes a data owner interface, a database, a requester interface, an approver interface, a database interface, and a central controller. The data owner interface can provide protected data and data usage rules. The database can store the protected data. The requester interface can provide a request to access the protected data and receive sanitized results. The approver interface can provide approval or disapproval of access to the protected data and receive the data usage rules. The database interface can store the protected data in the database and provide access to the protected data.

title: Diagnosis and treatment auxiliary information generation method, model training method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a generation method of diagnosis and treatment auxiliary information, a model training method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of knowledge maps, natural language processing and big data. The specific implementation scheme for generating the diagnosis and treatment auxiliary information comprises the following steps: acquiring medical record data to be analyzed; determining a candidate medical record set based on the medical record data; inputting medical record data and a candidate medical record set into a pre-trained medical record distinguishing model to obtain a target medical record set, wherein the target medical record set is a subset of the candidate medical record set; and generating diagnosis and treatment auxiliary information according to the target medical record set. The diagnosis and treatment auxiliary information matched with the current medical record can be generated according to the previous medical record set, and the accuracy of the auxiliary information is improved.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Data processing method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a data processing method, a device, equipment and a medium, the method relates to the artificial intelligence technology, can be applied to the field of natural language processing, and comprises the following steps: acquiring a target text and a standard text, and generating a target entity subgraph corresponding to the target text and a standard entity subgraph corresponding to the standard text according to a knowledge graph; a first entity in the target entity sub-graph and a second entity in the standard entity sub-graph both belong to entities in the knowledge graph; generating a target graph structural feature corresponding to the target entity subgraph and a standard graph structural feature corresponding to the standard entity subgraph according to the first entity and the second entity; determining graph similarity between the target entity subgraph and the standard entity subgraph according to the target graph structural feature and the standard graph structural feature; the graph similarity is used to indicate the degree of association between the target text and the standard text. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the matching accuracy between the target text and the standard text can be improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Medical image segmentation method based on U-network
assignee: Nanjing University Of Posts And Telecommunications
abstract: A medical image segmentation method include: 1) acquiring a medical image data set; 2) acquiring, from the medical image data set, an original image and a real segmentation image of a target region in the original image in pair to serve as an input data set of a pre-built constant-scaling segmentation network, the input data set including a training set, a verification set, and a test set; 3) training the constant-scaling segmentation network by using the training set to obtain a trained segmentation network model, and verifying the constant-scaling segmentation network by using the verification set, the constant-scaling segmentation network including a feature extraction module and a resolution amplifying module; and 4) inputting the original image to be segmented into the segmentation network model for segmentation to obtain a real segmentation image.
assignee_clean: nanjing university of posts and telecommunications
primary_assignee: nanjing university of posts and telecommunications

title: Methods and systems for monitoring human body weight with vehicle sensors and big data AI analytics
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc.
abstract: A weight management system for managing vehicle seat occupant body weight by using vehicle cameras and weight sensors of a plurality of vehicles having onboard communication modules. Each vehicle is equipped to analyze and compare weight changes of the vehicle seat occupant over time. Based on the weight status, a weight management recommendation can be transmitted to the vehicle seat occupant. Each vehicle is operatively connected to a weight management application in a data center. The weight management application includes a registration module which registers each vehicle. Additionally, a vehicle seat occupant may register with the weight management application to have his/her weight analyzed when travelling in any of the plurality of vehicles. The weight management application requests a search of a data lake and analysis of search results by a weight data artificial intelligence analytics program to improve the weight management recommendation.

title: System, method and apparatus for assisting a determination of medical images
abstract: A Computer Aided Diagnosis, CADx, system (200) is described that comprises: at least one input (210, 212, 214) configured to provide at least one input medical image; and a CADx processing engine (220) configured to receive and process the at least one input medical image and produce at least one CADx score. A CADx score mapping circuit is operably coupled to the CADx processing engine (220) and configured to: map the at least one CADx score to a risk adjusted virtual score; and generate an output (235) of at least the risk adjusted virtual score associated with the processed at least one input medical image. The at least one CADx score and the risk adjusted virtual score correspond to an equivalent risk of condition or disease associated with a patient.

title: System and method for creating a data protection map and remediating vulnerabilities
abstract: Systems and methods for remediating vulnerabilities on a plurality of computing devices is disclosed herein. In one exemplary aspect, a method comprises classifying monitored data into a plurality of categories using a machine learning algorithm. For each respective data file of the monitored data, the method comprises retrieving one or more policies associated with a classified category of the respective data file and determining whether respective data file complies with the one or more policies. The method further comprises generating a compliance map based on compliance with policies for each respective data file of the monitored data, wherein the compliance map indicates vulnerabilities in the plurality of computing devices, determining whether the vulnerabilities are actionable, and in response to determining the vulnerabilities are actionable, requesting actions to be performed on the plurality of devices to remediate the vulnerabilities and non-compliance.

title: Method for predicting hydrocephalus shunt operation curative effect by artificial neural network image analysis
assignee: 安徽省立医院(中国科学技术大学附属第一医院)
abstract: The invention provides a method for analyzing and predicting the curative effect of hydrocephalus shunt operation by using an artificial neural network image. The method for analyzing and predicting the curative effect of the hydrocephalus shunt operation by the artificial neural network image comprises the following steps of: s1: collecting and preprocessing a hydrocephalus shunt operation front and back imaging specimen: by combining medical image algorithm research and clinical statistics research, for a medical image part, a deep convolutional neural network method is adopted for calculation to obtain corresponding parameters, a retrospective method is adopted to obtain the picture of the existing patient, and a network is designed for training and parameter adjustment. The method for analyzing and predicting the curative effect of the hydrocephalus shunt operation by the artificial neural network image has the advantages that the operational treatment of the hydrocephalus can be converted from the prior clinical experience to the combination of big data imaging analysis, the individual evaluation can be achieved through the artificial neural network, and meanwhile, a new idea can be provided for the research and treatment of the hydrocephalus.

title: Methods and systems for adaptive timing of a second contrast bolus
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for adaptive scan control. In one embodiment, a method includes, upon a first contrast injection of a first contrast bolus, processing acquired projection data of a subject to measure a contrast signal of the first contrast bolus, setting a timing for a second contrast injection of a second contrast bolus to a fallback injection timing, and responsive to identifying an adaptive injection timing for the second contrast injection based on the contrast signal before the fallback injection timing is reached, updating the timing for the second contrast injection to the adaptive injection timing and commanding initiation of the second contrast injection at the adaptive injection timing, otherwise commanding initiation of the second contrast injection at the fallback injection timing.

title: Method and device for generating medical image data for artificial neural network training
abstract: The application provides a method and a device for generating medical image data for artificial neural network training, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a corresponding relation between target characteristics of the basic medical image and image characteristics of the extended image by utilizing the self-learning capability of the artificial neural network; wherein the image features include texture features and content features; acquiring current target characteristics of a current basic medical image; determining image features of the current expansion image corresponding to the current target features through the corresponding relation; specifically, determining the image feature of the current extended image corresponding to the target feature includes: image features of the expansion image corresponding to the target features identical to the current target features in the corresponding relation are determined as the image features of the current expansion image, so that the rationality of the generated expansion image is improved; the detail reduction is more excellent, and the diversity of the characteristics is increased.

title: Intelligent round needle system skin therapy health management instrument based on skin scraping and metering
assignee: 北京明医堂互联网医疗科技有限公司
abstract: An intelligent round needle system skin-scraping therapy health management instrument based on skin-scraping metering relates to the field of medical appliances, and can manage corresponding physical function conditions of an operator, and the operator's manipulation can be simultaneously used by professional doctors, teachers and patients. In the doctor specialized treatment process, the intelligent round needle system skin therapy instrument records the track, speed, frequency, temperature and strength in the treatment process through a temperature sensor, a speed sensor and a pressure sensor, is used as a skin scraping quantitative parameter, builds an expert knowledge base by the parameter or lays a foundation for developing a full-automatic intelligent skin therapy instrument in the future, and corrects and guides the use of a common patient by utilizing the recorded specialized data and real-time monitoring of the use state in the common patient use process, thereby realizing remote guidance and reproduction of the specialized treatment process.

title: Systems and methods for parallel execution of program analytics utilizing a common data object
abstract: An analytics platform for analyzing medical claims with low latency is configured to compress medical claims records into common data input objects that may be usable by a plurality of independent and parallel program analytics. The common data input objects are then passed as input to all of those program analytics, which are then configured to retrieve at least one compressed parameter file for use in processing data elements of the common data input object in accordance with a framework of a respective program analytic. The program analytics generate respective outputs based at least in part on data elements of the common data input objects, and the analytics platform combines those outputs into a single combined common output object.

title: Processing device, processing system and medium for cardiac medical image
assignee: 上海依智医疗技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a processing apparatus, a processing system, and a medium of a cardiac medical image. The processing apparatus includes a processor configured to: identifying mitral valve base points, apex of the heart, and outer and inner edges of left ventricular myocardium by using a first learning network based on the heart image of the long-axis section; setting an upper edge by using a first connecting line of a mitral valve base point; the left ventricle cardiac muscle is uniformly divided on two sides by using the upper edge, the inner edge and the outer edge to enclose the left ventricle cardiac muscle and using the midpoint of the first connecting line and the second connecting line of the apex of the heart as the central lines, so that the segment division is realized; determining a first strain condition of each segment in a long axis tangent plane, wherein the first strain condition comprises an area change condition of the corresponding segment; and determining a second strain condition of the corresponding section in the vertical direction based on the area change condition of each section. The myocardial strain assessment method has the advantages that each myocardial segment can be automatically, accurately and rapidly identified, the global or local three-dimensional strain condition of the left ventricle can be determined, and the myocardial strain and the functional condition can be conveniently and comprehensively assessed.

title: Image segmentation data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image segmentation data processing method, an image segmentation data processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first source domain loss value based on the source domain label image, the first label image, and the second label image; determining a first target domain loss value based on the third label image and the fourth label image; and training a first image segmentation model based on the first source domain loss value and the first target domain loss value, and performing image segmentation task processing based on the trained image segmentation model. When the source domain image and the target domain image are adopted to train the first image segmentation model, the output result of the first image segmentation model is considered, the output result of the second image segmentation model is fused into the source domain loss value, the first image segmentation model can be supervised through the second image segmentation model, and the image segmentation model with higher accuracy and robustness is trained, so that the accuracy of image segmentation is improved.

title: Automatic generation system for clinical sepsis medication scheme
abstract: The invention provides an automatic generation system for a clinical drug regimen for septicemia, and relates to the technical field of medical treatment. According to the method, a training module adopts a Decision-Transformer deep learning network to obtain an offline track data set according to historical clinical data in each classification cluster, wherein the offline track data set comprises a predicted patient physiological state, a drug treatment dose combination and an award size; and the verification module returns the predicted drug treatment dose combination to a verification set for verification, compares the similarity degree of the actual drug treatment dose in the verification set and the predicted drug treatment dose combination, and returns the corresponding parameters to the precision-Transformer deep learning network for iteration if the survival rate condition of the patient meets the preset condition. And training by using a precision Transformer architecture in each subspace, and selecting a drug set with the best treatment effect based on past real drug administration data, so that the effect is better.

title: Medical imaging device
abstract: The present invention provides a prediction model for representing diagnosis prediction results with high medical validity with higher accuracy. A medical imaging device is provided with: an imaging unit that collects image signals of an inspection object; and an image processing unit that generates 1 st image data from the image signal and performs image processing of the 1 st image data. The image processing unit includes: a feature amount extraction unit (220) that extracts a 1 st feature amount from the 1 st image data; a feature quantity abstraction unit (221) abstracting the 1 st feature quantity and extracting the 2 nd feature quantity; a feature amount conversion unit (230) that converts the 2 nd feature amount into the 3 rd feature amount extracted from the 2 nd image data; and an identification unit (240) that calculates a predetermined parameter value using the transformed 3 rd feature quantity.

title: Systems and methods to process electronic images to provide image-based cell group targeting
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for grouping cells in a slide image that share a similar target, comprising receiving a digital pathology image corresponding to a tissue specimen, applying a trained machine learning system to the digital pathology image, the trained machine learning system being trained to predict at least one target difference across the tissue specimen, and determining, using the trained machine learning system, one or more predicted clusters, each of the predicted clusters corresponding to a subportion of the tissue specimen associated with a target.

title: Laser systems and methods for alteration of eye color
abstract: A method for altering an eye color of a patient with a color alteration procedure is disclosed that may include determining a laser power to deliver to stromal pigment in an iris of the eye of the patient by at least retrieving a set of laser criteria for delivery of an exposure less than 100 times a maximum permissible exposure that causes elimination of at least a portion of the stromal pigment. A laser system may be set to deliver laser light at the laser power which is less than the set of laser criteria and the laser light may be delivered with the laser system.

title: Meta-level short-depth quantum computation of k-eigenpairs
abstract: Techniques and a system to facilitate meta-level quantum computation are provided. In one example, a system includes a quantum processor and a classical processor. The quantum processor can perform an expectation computation process to compute an expected value of a deflated operator and a quantum state associated with a quantum circuit description. The classical processor can execute computer executable components stored in a memory, where the computer executable components comprise a meta-level variational optimization component. The meta-level variational optimization component can perform a meta-level optimization process associated with a k-eigenvalue decomposition process to iteratively determine an inflation parameter and a variational parameterization for an eigenpair based on samples of the expectation computation process.

title: System and method for coordinating care within the health industry
abstract: The present disclosure is directed to a computerized method, system and software application for coordinating medical care through a Pathways Community Hub (HUB). A Pathways Community Hub is a network of care coordination agencies which focuses its mission towards reaching individuals within the community having the greatest risk-factors through the deployment of service providers such as community care coordinators. The Pathways Community Hub finds at-risk individuals in need of medical, health-related or social services, treats identified risk factors and measures a patient's risk status over time. The goal of the Pathways Community Hub is to achieve a reduction of risk among patients through open communication and collaboration among service providers including medical service providers and community-based organizations and to reduce the overall cost of medical, health-related and social services over time within a region.

title: Methods and systems for business development and licensing and competitive intelligence
assignee: Thomson Reuters Global Resources, Mark Gordon, Tim Miller, Mans A. Olof-Ors, Hassan Malik, Andrej Bugrim, Colin Williams, Camelot Uk Bidco Limited
abstract: Systems and method for making intelligent business development and licensing decisions are disclosed. The present invention generally relates to an analytical tool that combines multiple data and content sets based on user selected factors and presents the data in the form of manipulatable visualizations to facilitate decision making to address a specific business problem. More specifically, this invention relates to providing a single portal for access to a decision support system that enables the visualization of data from multiple content and data sets to facilitate decision making related to opportunities analysis, asset acquisition, and intellectual property licensing.

title: Method, system and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for providing medical service
abstract: The present invention relates to a method, a system, and a non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for providing a medical service. According to an aspect of the present invention, the method comprises the steps of: determining a state of a patient in a hospital and a medical service needed for the patient by referring to information on a position of the patient visiting the hospital and information on medical treatment reservation or electronic medical records (EMR) of the patient; and dynamically matching the patient with at least one medical staff or assistant medical staff by referring to information on at least one of a state of the patient in the hospital, a medical service needed for the patient, a state of the medical staff or assistant medical staff belonging to the hospital in the hospital, and a medical service capable of being provided by the medical staff or the assistant medical staff.

title: Heart segmentation method, device and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a heart segmentation method, heart segmentation equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image sequence, wherein the medical image sequence comprises a part corresponding to a heart region; determining a reference layer image in the medical image sequence and performing cardiac segmentation on the reference layer image; determining a narrow-band region containing a heart boundary according to a heart segmentation result of the reference layer image; and performing heart segmentation on the medical image sequence layer by applying a graph cut algorithm in the narrow-band region. The heart segmentation method, the heart segmentation equipment and the heart segmentation storage medium provided by the embodiment of the invention realize accurate and rapid heart segmentation.

title: Methods and systems for sequence calling
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods, systems, and media for accurate and efficient estimation of a genome of a genus.

title: Method for reporting multiple channel state information in wireless communication system and apparatus therefor
abstract: According to an embodiment of the disclosure, a method for reporting a plurality of channel state information by a user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system comprises receiving association information related to a plurality of channel state reports and reporting a plurality of channel state information using the association information, wherein in reporting the plurality of channel state information, remaining channel state information except for specific channel state information among the plurality of channel state information is excluded from being reported or is reported in a form of a reduced payload size, according to the association information.

title: The method and system for providing cloud service including machine learning service based blockchain
abstract: Embodiments relate to a cloud service providing method including blockchain-based machine learning service and a system thereof and, more specifically, to a blockchain-based cloud service providing method and a system thereof which provide a cloud service by using computing resources of nodes configuring a blockchain and provide rewards to the nodes, which provide the computing resources.

title: Deep learning brain tumor prognosis analysis modeling method and system combining attention mechanism and multi-scale feature mining
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of brain image analysis, and particularly relates to a deep learning brain tumor prognosis analysis modeling method and system combining an attention mechanism and multi-scale feature mining, which are used for performing a series of preprocessing operations such as format conversion, registration, resampling, scalp removal, random mirror image overturning and the like on data by acquiring magnetic resonance image data of a brain tumor patient; in a brain tumor deep learning prognosis analysis model, regions critical to prognosis risk probability in images are automatically found through a concentration mechanism, the extraction capability of a network to tumor information on different scales is improved by fusing multi-scale features, the prognosis risk probability prediction capability of brain tumor patients is improved by utilizing the constructed model, and the later stage of classifying the diseased condition of the patients into high, medium and low risk groups through the prognosis risk probability is facilitated, so that a clinician is assisted in making a treatment plan of the patients and evaluating the curative effect of medicines, and further the survival time of the patients can be improved.

title: Dataset engine for use within a cognitive environment
abstract: An apparatus for use within a cognitive information processing system environment comprising: a dataset engine, the dataset engine coupled to receive data from a plurality of data sources, the dataset engine processing the data from the plurality of data sources to establish and maintain a dynamic data ingestion and enrichment pipeline.

title: Laser system with illumination control
assignee: 捷锐士阿希迈公司(以奥林巴斯美国外科技术名义)
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods for identifying a target during an endoscopic procedure are disclosed. An endoscope object recognition system includes: an endoscope having an endoscope illumination source; an optical fiber insertable through a working channel of the endoscope and coupled to a non-endoscopic illumination source other than the endoscopic illumination source; and a controller. The controller may send a control signal to the non-endoscopic illumination source to emit a diagnostic beam through the optical fiber when the at least one endoscopic illumination source changes from the first mode to the second mode. The second mode has a lower amount of illumination than the first mode. The controller may determine a composition of the target based on the diagnostic beam incident on the target and the light from the diagnostic beam reflected from the target.
