title: Knee joint disease ultrasonic diagnosis method based on deep learning multichannel and graph embedding method
abstract: The invention discloses a knee joint disease ultrasonic diagnosis method based on deep learning multichannel and graph embedding method, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing an effusion region in the knee joint ultrasonic image by utilizing a snake algorithm, and then inputting the hydrops region into a well-defined network model to realize semantic segmentation; on the basis of a Resnet network structure, training the knee joint ultrasonic image in the data set by using a graph embedding method of secondary training, and finally verifying by using a test of a segmentation network and a classification network; the invention adopts the thought of multi-channel superposition and graph embedding method to segment and train the knee joint ultrasonic image, can distinguish the disease category according to whether the effusion area in different knee joint disease ultrasonic images is accompanied with the difference of synovial membrane thickening, avoids the judgment of the knee joint ultrasonic image completely depending on the naked eye and personal judgment of a doctor, eliminates the problems of subjectivity and human error, and has simple and efficient whole segmentation and classification identification method and accurate diagnosis.

title: Verification of stochastic gradient descent
abstract: An example operation includes one or more of computing, by a data owner node, updated gradients on a loss function based on a batch of private data and previous parameters of a machine learning model associated with a blockchain, encrypting, by the data owner node, update information, recording, by the data owner, the encrypted update information as a new transaction on the blockchain, and providing the update information for an audit.

title: Method and device for constructing drug research and development knowledge base
assignee: 药渡经纬信息科技(北京)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing a drug research and development knowledge base, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a medical entity library, wherein the medical entity library comprises medical entities and entity attributes; the medical entity comprises: core entities and general entities; the core entity is a drug; the general entity is an entity related to a drug; determining entity relationships; the entity relationship comprises: relationships between entities of the same type and relationships between entities of different types; and establishing a knowledge graph corresponding to the medical entity library according to the entity relationship by taking the core entity as a key node and the general entity as a common node. The invention can improve the automation degree of establishing the drug research and development knowledge base, is convenient for users to understand the relationship between drug data and quickly interpret or describe the drug complex knowledge.

title: Constraining actions for reinforcement learning under safety requirements
abstract: A computer-implemented method, computer program product, and system are provided for deep reinforcement learning to control a subject device. The method includes training, by a processor, a neural network to receive state information of a target of the subject device as an input and provide action information for the target as an output. The method further includes inputting, by the processor, current state information of the target into the neural network to obtain current action information for the target. The method also includes correcting, by the processor, the current action information minimally to obtain corrected action information that meets a set of constraints. The method additionally includes performing an action by the subject device based on the corrected action information for the target to obtain a reward from the target.

title: Image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 浙江医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides an image processing method, an image processing device, image processing equipment and a storage medium, wherein a first target feature map is obtained by inputting an image to be processed into a global sub-model of a classification inference model; preprocessing through the first target feature map to obtain an interested region of the abnormal feature in the image to be processed; inputting the region of interest of the abnormal feature into a local sub-model of a classification inference model to obtain a second target feature map; the first initial feature map and the second target feature map are input into a fusion sub-model of the classification inference model to obtain a prediction result value of abnormal features in the image to be processed, and the embodiment is suitable for medical images of different modes, classification and identification of the medical images can be realized by using a weak supervision learning method, so that the manual labeling cost is greatly reduced, the classification and identification precision is improved, and the region of interest according to classification is predicted in the classification process.

title: Intelligent ranking of clinical trials for a patient
abstract: Method and apparatus for recommending clinical trials for patients. Embodiments include determining a plurality of clinical trials that a first patient is eligible to participate in. Embodiments further include determining a plurality of current attributes of the first patient. Embodiments further include determining a plurality of predicted attributes of the first patient for a future point in time. Embodiments further include generating a fitness measure for each of the plurality of clinical trials, with respect to the first patient, by processing data about each of the plurality of clinical trials, the plurality of current attributes, and the plurality of predicted attributes with a machine learning (ML) model. Embodiments further include ranking the plurality of clinical trials based on the generated fitness measures.

title: Visual recommendation method and system for time-series medical data
abstract: The invention discloses a visual recommendation method and a visual recommendation system for time-series medical data, wherein the visual recommendation method and the visual recommendation system for time-series medical data comprise the following steps: processing the acquired time sequence medical data into a standard format, and acquiring data category characteristics imported into a database; based on the type of the chart which is statistically analyzed, splitting the visual element into a plurality of visual coding channels, wherein different coding channels correspond to visual presentation elements, and a plurality of view drawing methods are preset for the different coding channels; according to the content of the visual coding channel, obtaining visual coding and obtaining a diversified configuration result; according to the diversified configuration result, completing visual recommendation; wherein the visual recommendation comprises: univariate view recommendation, associated feature pair view recommendation, alternate view recommendation. The method and the device can realize the recommendation of the visual code, and can enhance the pertinence and the practicability of the recommendation result.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image processing method, an image processing device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample image set; the sample image set comprises a first sample image and a second sample image; the number of the first sample images and the number of the second sample images are more than one; extracting image features of the first sample images and image features of the second sample images; determining the difficulty degree characteristic of each second sample image according to the similarity of each second sample image and each first sample image on the image characteristic; determining the diversity characteristics of the second sample images according to the similarity between the second sample images; screening the second sample image based on the difficulty degree characteristic and the diversity characteristic of the second sample image; and the screened second sample image and the first sample image are jointly used for model training. By adopting the method, the model training efficiency can be improved.

title: Rapid detection of bleeding following injury
assignee: Flashback Technologies, Inc., The Regents Of The University Of Colorado
abstract: Novel tools and techniques are provided for assessing, predicting and/or estimating a probability that a patient is bleeding, in some cases, noninvasively. In various embodiments, tools and techniques are provided for implementing rapid detection of bleeding of the patient or implementing assessment, prediction, or estimation of a probability of bleeding of the patient following injury, in some instances, in real-time before, during, and after fluid resuscitation. According to some embodiments, one or more sensors might monitor physiological data of the patient before, during, and after resuscitation following injury. A computer system might receive and analyze the physiological data, and might estimate a probability that the patient is bleeding, based at least in part on the analyzed physiological data. An indication of at least one of an assessment, prediction, or estimate of a probability that the patient is bleeding may then be displayed on a display device.
assignee_clean: flashback technologies; the regents of the university of colorado

title: Method, device and equipment for establishing medical imaging model and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for establishing a medical imaging model. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring K space undersampled data of a medical image as a training sample; inputting the training samples into the pre-constructed original neural network for training, wherein the original neural network comprises a Frequency Domain Network (FDN) and an image domain network (SDN), and the Frequency Domain Network (FDN) and the image domain network (SDN) are connected through inverse Fourier transform (IFFT); and taking the trained original neural network as a target medical imaging model. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention realizes more accurate and faster reconstruction of the K space undersampled medical image.

title: Generating annotation data of tissue images
abstract: Currently, there is interest in applying machine learning techniques to analyse digital pathology images automatically. Machine learning techniques often rely on training with a ground-truth image input. The quality and amount of training data determines the quality of the detector, as expressed in the rate of true and false positives, and robustness against variations in the appearance of the input images. The present application proposes to obtain image data of the same sample before and after at least one re-staining step (firstly with a structure-revealing stain, and secondly with a bio marker revealing stain). Sections of the first and second image data having a good registration relationship are chosen, along with the probability of detecting a desired candidate object (such as nucleus) and the probability of the bio marker revealing stain being present annotation data suitable for training a machine learning algorithm on the first and/or the second image data is provided.

title: Method, apparatus and system for providing informations of face condition based on analysis of face image
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for providing facial state information based on facial image analysis, which comprises the steps of: obtaining an image of a face of a user from a user terminal; extracting a facial image from the image of the face of the user from the user terminal or a service providing device; measuring, by the service providing device, the facial characteristics including at least a size, shape, and color of the face from the facial image; updating, by the service providing device, a measurement history of the facial characteristics by storing the measured facial characteristics and the time at which the image of the face is obtained; determining, by the service providing device, a change value of the facial characteristics from the measurement history of the facial characteristics; determining, by the service providing device, a facial state of the user on the basis of the change value of the facial characteristics; and providing, by the service providing device, information on the facial state for the user terminal. Therefore, a change in a human body or health can be quantitatively recognized.

title: Three-dimensional tooth point cloud model data classification method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional tooth point cloud model data classification method and system based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a tooth three-dimensional model, and extracting a whole set of tooth point cloud model from the tooth three-dimensional model; dividing the whole set of tooth point cloud models to obtain a plurality of single tooth point cloud models; extracting the point cloud model characteristics, the relative position characteristics and the adjacent similarity characteristics of the single tooth, and respectively inputting the characteristics, the relative position characteristics and the adjacent similarity characteristics into a classifier; the input various characteristics are classified in the classifier, and the primary classification result of the single tooth is output.

title: Personal pandemic proximity index system and method
abstract: The personal pandemic proximity index system and method include a data ingestion pipeline configured to receive location data associated with disease-positive cases, a data processing module configured to clean and process the received data, a personal pandemic proximity module configured to determine a numerical personal pandemic proximity index value associated with an individual having an interaction at an address relative to the location data, and a graphical user interface configured to present, to a patient care team, the numerical personal pandemic proximity index value, which may include a modified workflow to limit the spread of disease.

title: Medical image processing apparatus, endoscope system, and method for operating medical image processing apparatus
abstract: A processor device includes an image signal acquiring unit, an image processing unit, and a display control unit. The image signal acquiring unit acquires a digital image signal corresponding to an observation mode from an endoscope. The image processing unit includes a region-of-interest-detection-mode image processing unit. The region-of-interest-detection-mode image processing unit detects a region of interest from an endoscopic image and outputs a detection result of the region of interest and a cumulative detection time period of the region of interest.

title: Methods and systems for content-based image retrieval
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a method for retrieval of similar images from a database. For a plurality of input images, each input image is disintegrated into a plurality of image patches of one or more predefined pixel sizes. A representation of each image patch is computed using a dimensional reduction method and distances between the representations of each image patch are compared. Further, the representations of each image patch into addressable hyper-cubes are quantized, wherein an address of a hyper-cube is determined by content of corresponding image patch. Then, each image patch is stored using corresponding address as a key into the database. Later, for a target image patch, a set of similar image patches is retrieved from the database using the key.

title: Classification data manipulation using matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry
abstract: To methods, systems, apparatus, and/or computer programs. Mass spectrometer test data (e.g., a blood sample of a medical patient) can be associated with metadata information. The associated metadata information may be associated with a medical patient. The subset of sample reference libraries may be based on associated metadata information. According to an embodiment, the sample reference library may include multiple sets of mass spectrometer reference data. Embodiments match mass spectrometer test data with mass spectrometer reference data of a selected subset of a sample reference library. Embodiments determine characteristic information of a source of mass spectrometer test data (e.g., a medical patient) based on known characteristics of matching mass spectrometer reference data.

title: System for evaluating infant movement
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: A system and method for measuring movements, utilizing one or more wireless accelerometers attached to one or more limbs of a human subject for the purpose of determining certain temporal and spatial gestures of the subject.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of california
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of california

title: Knowledge base building system and method based on senior care guidelines and disability and intelligence losing
abstract: The invention relates to a knowledge base building system and method based on an elderly care guide and disability and intelligence loss, a data acquisition terminal, a data calculation center number and a cloud. The cloud generates a first change trend set of the disabling feature data set relative to the change of the disabling feature data set based on the disabling history data; and/or the cloud end generates a second change trend set of the nootropic feature data set relative to the nootropic feature data set based on the nootropic history data; the system includes a care guideline library storing at least two kinds of care measures so that, in a case where at least one of the first change trend set and the second change trend set triggers a trigger condition corresponding thereto, the data computing center can match out, from the care guideline library, care measures corresponding to the change trend sets that triggered the trigger conditions to each other.

title: Method and device for the automatic generation of synthetic projections
abstract: A method for the automatic generation of synthetic projections of an examination object from at least one three-dimensional data set acquired by way of a medical imaging system. The three-dimensional data set is used as a basis for determining position information relating to the arrangement of structures of the examination object and at least one synthetic projection based on the position information. We also describe a projection-image-ascertaining facility for the automatic generation of synthetic projections and a computer program product for executing the method.

title: Automatic judging method and system for tissue blood oxygen saturation monitoring part
assignee: 博联众科（武汉）科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic judging system for a tissue blood oxygen saturation monitoring part, which is used for judging the position of a sensor so as to be convenient for selecting a corresponding blood oxygen saturation calculation model in blood oxygen saturation calculation and obtaining a more accurate blood oxygen saturation result. According to the invention, the original light intensity data acquired by the sensor is converted to obtain more useful intermediate parameters, and then the mapping relation between the intermediate parameters and the classification of the detection part is established through the random forest classification model, so that the classification evaluation of the detection part is realized, the manual intervention is reduced, and the measurement precision is improved.
assignee_clean: 博联众科 武汉 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 博联众科 武汉 科技有限公司

title: Coronary artery image segmentation method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a coronary artery image segmentation method and a system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of medical image auxiliary diagnosis, and the method comprises the following steps: inputting the acquired coronary artery image to be segmented into a coronary artery segmentation model based on an improved U-Net network and an edge feature extraction network, wherein the improved U-Net network adopts an encoder-decoder structure, a cavity convolution module is arranged at the bottommost layer of the improved U-Net network, and each downsampling layer of the encoder comprises a convolution module and an attention module; the encoder extracts a multi-scale feature map from an input image, and finally the output feature map outputs a global feature map after passing through a cavity convolution module, a down-sampling layer of the decoder is connected with an up-sampling layer in a jumping manner, and the global feature map is sequentially up-sampled to output the feature map; after the edge detail feature image and the feature image output by the edge feature extraction network are fused, a segmentation result is output by the full-connection layer, and the accuracy of coronary artery image segmentation is greatly improved.

title: Interactive segmentation method of three-dimensional medical image
abstract: The invention provides an interactive segmentation method of a three-dimensional medical image, and relates to the technical field of digital medical treatment. Firstly, acquiring a plurality of three-dimensional medical images as original images and marking the three-dimensional medical images to obtain marked segmentation training data of the original images as standard segmentation results; training by using segmentation training data to obtain a full-automatic image segmentation network; generating an automatic segmentation result corresponding to the original image by using a full-automatic image segmentation network, and simulating and generating user interaction data for training a segmentation editing network according to the difference between the automatic segmentation result and a standard segmentation result; training a segmentation editing network by using simulated user interaction data; and the user finishes interactive segmentation of the image to be segmented by using the trained segmentation editing network and three interactive segmentation tools. The method can greatly improve the three-dimensional medical image segmentation precision by using fewer interaction times, and has higher practical value.

title: Non-invasive determination of a physiological state of interest in a subject
abstract: A method for non-invasively determining a physiological state of interest in a subject is described. The method involves, placing a body part in contact with a receptor, and directing a source of electromagnetic radiation (EMR) over a range of wavelengths onto body part so that the EMR reaches the blood and interstitial fluid within the body part. The EMR that is absorbed by, reflected by, or transmitted through, the blood and interstitial fluid of the body part is measured, and a spectrum over the range of wavelengths obtained. The spectrum is analyzed to determine an amount of two or more than two analytes within the blood and interstitial fluid of the body part and a biochemical profile is derived. The biochemical profile is used to determine the physiological state of interest in the subject. The physiological state of interest in the subject may be selected from the group of intoxication arising from cannabis, alcohol, a combination of cannabis and alcohol, opiates, fentanyl, amphetamines, phencyclidine, sedatives, anxyolytics, cocaine, caffeine, and nicotine consumption.

title: Cognitive agents for use within a cognitive environment
abstract: An apparatus for providing cognitive insights comprising: a cognitive inference and learning system, the cognitive inference and learning system comprising a plurality of agents, the plurality of agents processing streams of data from a plurality of data sources, the processing the streams of data from the plurality of data sources via the plurality of agents performing a respective plurality of cognitive operations on the streams of data, at least one of the plurality of agents generating cognitive insights based upon the performing the respective plurality of cognitive operations on the streams of data from the plurality of data sources.

title: Orthopedic patient rehabilitation process tracking method and system
assignee: 凝动万生医疗科技(武汉)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for tracking rehabilitation progress of an orthopedic patient, which belong to the technical field of patient rehabilitation tracking, and comprise the following steps: based on body measurement data of a patient, a three-dimensional body model of the patient is created by adopting voxel modeling and computer aided design technology, so that the model can accurately reflect the physiological structure of the patient, including soft tissues and bone structures around joints, and the three-dimensional body model of the patient is generated. In the invention, the three-dimensional body model created by voxel modeling and computer aided design technology is used, so that the simulation and analysis of joint functions are more detailed, the analysis precision is improved, the rehabilitation exercise is more scientific and effective, the rehabilitation path is dynamically adjusted by combining an optimization algorithm and a genetic algorithm, the scheme is ensured to be always matched with the actual condition of a patient, the rehabilitation progress is evaluated and analyzed by using advanced analysis methods such as a hidden Markov model, a Bayesian network and the like, and the overall efficiency and the pertinence of the rehabilitation plan are further improved.
assignee_clean: 凝动万生医疗科技 武汉 有限公司
primary_assignee: 凝动万生医疗科技 武汉 有限公司

title: System and method for monitoring physiological parameters
assignee: 深圳市长桑技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a device (110), method and system (100) for calculating, estimating or monitoring a blood pressure of a subject. A first signal reflecting heart activity of a subject may be received. A plurality of second signals reflecting time-varying information on at least one pulse wave of the subject may be received. A first feature in the first signal may be identified. A second characteristic of each of the plurality of second signals may be identified. A pulse transit time may be calculated based on a difference between the first feature and at least one of the second features. The blood pressure of the subject may be calculated according to a model based on the calculated pulse transit time. The model may comprise a compensation term related to the plurality of second signals or the second feature.

title: Quality control artificial intelligence system and quality control method for children radiation shooting and diagnosis
assignee: 辽宁万象联合医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a quality control artificial intelligence system for children radiation shooting and diagnosis and a quality control method thereof, wherein the quality control system is used for constructing a quality control model for inspection preparation, a radiation image quality control model and a diagnosis report quality control model based on deep learning technology, natural language processing technology, software engineering and other technologies, integrating the three models into the quality control artificial intelligence system, realizing the quality control of the children radiation shooting and diagnosis, and further effectively solving the problems of low working efficiency, non-uniform quality control standard and the like of artificial quality control.
assignee_clean: 辽宁万象联合医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 辽宁万象联合医疗科技有限公司

title: Medical instrument management traceability method and system based on data sharing
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instrument management, in particular to a medical instrument management traceability method and system based on data sharing, which comprises the following steps: building a medical instrument data sharing management platform based on a block chain technology, and acquiring related data required by medical instrument tracing through an RFID technology; splitting the medical instrument data to different data nodes to combine to generate an integrated model, and transmitting the medical instrument data contained in the model to a sharing management platform through an elliptic encryption algorithm; establishing an event triggering mechanism according to the situation of the sharing management platform, and monitoring abnormal situations in the data sharing process; establishing connection and interaction between the trigger mechanism and the shared management platform, and carrying out real-time information transmission and state monitoring; and the demand party determines a data source according to the data resource on the sharing management platform and the self demand, and achieves a sharing agreement with the sharing management platform. The sharing management platform provided by the invention can be used for carrying out information transmission and monitoring with a requiring party.

title: Methods and systems for determining coronary hemodynamic characteristic(s) that is predictive of myocardial infarction
abstract: The systems and methods can accurately and efficiently determine a myocardial risk from a lesion disposed along a coronary segment using hemodynamic characteristic(s) associated with one or more sections of the corresponding lesion site. The method may include segmenting one or more lesion sites disposed along at least one arterial segment of the one or more arterial segments of the coronary model into one or more sections. Each lesion site includes a lesion. The method may include determining one or more characteristics for at least one section using at least the one or more characteristics associated with the at least one arterial segment. The one or more characteristics for the at least one section including hemodynamic force characteristic(s) (e.g., wall shear stress (WSS)). The method may include determining one or more risk indices for each lesion site using at least the hemodynamic force characteristic(s) for the at least one section.

title: Active system and method for imaging with an intra-patient probe
abstract: Registration is provided for imaging with an intra-patient probe. The intra-patient probe is used for imaging or the imaging is, at least in part, of the intra-patient probe. Either approach for imaging with an intra-patient probe uses active transitions for registration. In one embodiment, one or more markers in the intra-patient probe are moveable relative to the intra-patient probe, allowing avoidance of occlusions and providing more reliable marker detection for registration. In another embodiment, a value of a parameter for imaging with at least one modality is changed so that acceptable or better registration with an image of another modality may be made. The imaging is repeated with differences, such as field-of-view or scale, allowing for registration for different types of modalities.

title: Hybrid data architecture for use within a travel industry optimized cognitive environment
abstract: A data architecture for use within a cognitive information processing system environment comprising: a plurality of data sources, the plurality of data sources comprising a public data source and a private data source, the public data source comprising publicly available travel information, the private data source comprising privately managed, company specific travel information; and, a cognitive data management module, the cognitive data management module accessing information from the plurality of data sources and providing the information to an inference and learning system.

title: Portable medical grade air purification system
abstract: A system, method, and air purification device. Air is taken in from an environment into the air purification system. The air is prefiltered. The air is filtered with a primary filter. The filtered air is treated with vacuum ultraviolet radiation in a primary reaction chamber to generate irradiated air. The irradiated air is treated with ultraviolet-C radiation in a secondary reaction chamber to remove ozone. Ozone and other contaminants are removed from the irradiated air utilizing a carbon filter to generate purified air. The purified air is emitted back into the environment from the air purification system.

title: Hybrid data architecture for use within a cognitive environment
abstract: A method for receiving a plurality of types of data within a cognitive information processing system environment comprising: receiving data from a plurality of data sources, the plurality of data sources comprising a public data source and a private data source; accessing information from the plurality of data sources via a cognitive data management module; and, providing the information to an inference and learning system.

title: Systems for detecting vascular and arterial disease in asymptomatic patients and related methods
abstract: Multispectral imaging systems are provided including an illumination control module configured to image a sample and provide an imaging output sequence including images and data; a multi-spectral physiologic visualization (MSPV) module, a peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO2) module and a physiologic status parameters (PSP) module configured to receive the imaging output sequence of the illumination control module simultaneously. The MSPV module is configured to provide real-time blood flow distribution visualization of a field of view (FOV) responsive to the received imaging output sequence. The SpO2 module is configured to provide real-time SpO2 information at a tissue surface level for the FOV responsive to the received imaging and output sequence. The PSP module is configured to derive status parameters in real-time from metadata associated with the received imaging and output sequence of the FOV. The system further includes a processing engine configured to integrate and analyze the real-time blood flow distribution visualization, SpO2 information and derived status parameters.

title: Cardiovascular disease risk prediction method based on multi-mode fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a cardiovascular disease risk prediction method based on multi-mode fusion. Acquiring patient sign data in the medical data set; aggregating various types of text reports generated by patients during a hospital; extracting time sequence characteristics by using the acquired patient sign data and using a graph neural network GNN-encoder as a network of a time sequence backbone; extracting text characteristics from patient text reports in the aggregated various text reports by using a pre-training-based hierarchical BioBERT model as a language backbone network; the time sequence features and the text features are spliced together, and the fused features are obtained as embedded vectors of the physical condition of the patient in a feature space through a self-attention depth fusion network; constructing a binary classifier based on a multi-layer perceptron to obtain a binary classification result of whether cardiovascular diseases exist; constructing a multi-element classifier based on a multi-layer perceptron to obtain the predicted subtype of the patient. The method is used for solving the problems that the text report is too long and the semantic features are difficult to extract effectively without losing full text information in the medical text data set.

title: Intelligent medical image analysis method
assignee: 莱凯医疗器械(北京)有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image analysis, and discloses an intelligent medical image analysis method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining an image to be diagnosed and a plurality of historical case images, constructing a case image generalization model to generalize the historical case images to obtain a variant case image set, constructing a medical image diagnosis model, extracting stable semantic features of the variant case images in the variant case image set, constructing a deep semantic feature extraction network model, extracting deep semantic features of the image to be diagnosed, carrying out similarity calculation on the deep semantic features of the image to be diagnosed and the stable semantic features of the variant case images, selecting a historical diagnosis case corresponding to the variant case images with similarity higher than a specified threshold as a reference of the case to be diagnosed, and assisting doctors in determining diagnosis and treatment schemes.
assignee_clean: 莱凯医疗器械 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 莱凯医疗器械 北京 有限公司

title: Medical text data processing method and device
assignee: 百洋智能科技集团股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a medical text data processing method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting a data set according to the collected public medical information to finely tune a Chinese medical pre-training model MC-BERT so as to obtain a relatively robust language model; dividing an input text into word element sets with the length of N by a word segmentation mode based on word granularity, constructing a token span matrix with the length of N, predicting the head and tail positions of medical entities according to the matrix, and identifying a text range corresponding to the entities; and sending the entity pairs with the medical relations into a fusion distance sensing multi-relation classifier, finally determining the medical entity relations, and outputting a structured result. The invention utilizes the natural language understanding technology based on deep learning, reads and understands medical texts through a machine, and automatically extracts a large number of professional medical entities and relations, thereby remarkably improving the efficiency and quality of medical clinical scientific research and having great significance for constructing a special hospital database.
assignee_clean: 百洋智能科技集团股份有限公司

title: Responder network
abstract: A variety of methods, medical devices, responder network servers, emergency services interfaces and call center related processes are described that can help improve responder networks designed to get a medical device such as an automated external defibrillator and/or volunteer responders to the scene of a potential medical incident.

title: Anomaly detection for medical samples under multiple settings
assignee: Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute Company Limited
abstract: Using multiple imaging modes in whole slide image screening is potentially useful to reduce false positives. To use multiple imaging modes, a method for locating anomalies on a medical sample from an image thereof uses an anomaly-detection process that comprises using plural base classifiers individually to classify an object-of-interest suspected to be an anomaly. Each base classifier respectively extracts features of the object-of-interest and generates, according to the extracted features, a score indicating a likelihood of the object-of-interest being anomalous. The anomaly-detection process further comprises using an aggregate classifier to combine the scores generated by the base classifiers to determine whether the object-of-interest is the anomaly. The aggregate classifier determines a dependability measure for each base classifier according to setting-based variables of a setting under which the sample and the image are obtained, and then selectively combines the scores of the base classifiers according to the dependability measures.
assignee_clean: hong kong applied science and technology research institute
primary_assignee: hong kong applied science and technology research institute

title: Three-dimensional medical image labeling method and device and related product
assignee: 沈阳东软智能医疗科技研究院有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a three-dimensional medical image labeling method and device and a related product. The method comprises the steps of determining a target focus area of a target layer image in a three-dimensional medical image; determining a focus area of an adjacent layer of the adjacent layer image according to the coordinates of pixels in a target focus area of the target layer image; the target focus area and the adjacent layer focus area correspond to the same focus in the three-dimensional medical image; obtaining marking data of the same focus; the annotation data includes: the coordinates and pixel values of the pixels in the target focal zone, and the coordinates and pixel values of the pixels in all neighboring focal zones. According to the technical scheme, the marking of the same focus in other layers of images can be realized only by determining the focus area of one layer of image in the three-dimensional medical image without manual layer-by-layer marking manually, and the focus marking in the whole three-dimensional medical image is mainly realized in an automatic mode. Therefore, the lesion marking efficiency is improved, the labor cost is saved, and the complexity of operation in the marking process is greatly reduced.

title: Method for performing graph query operations within a cognitive environment
abstract: A method for providing cognitive insights via a cognitive information processing system comprising: receiving data from a plurality of data sources; receiving and processing queries; and, bridging the queries into a cognitive graph.

title: Image processing apparatus, image processing method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract: An image processing apparatus includes a first extraction unit configured to extract a first target region from an image using a trained classifier, a setting unit configured to set region information to be used in a graph cut segmentation method based on a first extraction result including the first target region, a second extraction unit configured to extract a second target region using the graph cut segmentation method based on the set region information, and a generation unit configured to generate a ground truth image corresponding to the image based on a second extraction result including the second target region.

title: Multi-mode medical image fusion method based on global information fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode medical image fusion method based on global information fusion, which comprises the following steps: 1. performing color space conversion and image shearing pretreatment on the medical images of the original multiple modes; 2. establishing a modal branch network which is interacted in a plurality of scales through a fusion module, and establishing a fusion module formed by a transducer to combine multi-modal characteristic information; 3. a reconstruction module is established, and a fusion image is synthesized from multi-mode characteristics of multiple scales; 4. training and evaluating the model on a public data set; 4. and realizing medical image fusion tasks by using the trained model. According to the invention, the multi-mode semantic information can be fully fused through the transducer fusion module and the interactive mode branch network, so that a fine granularity fusion effect is realized, the structure and texture information of the original image are well reserved, and the mosaic phenomenon caused by the low-resolution medical image is also improved.

title: System and method for multi-device continuum and seamless sensing platform for context aware analytics
abstract: The Multi-Device Continuum and Seamless Sensing Platform for Context Aware Analytics provide a platform for continuous sensing across multiple devices towards a unified target. The Multi-Device Continuum and Seamless Sensing Platform provides a platform for extracting, loading, integrating, and tracking related data across multiple smart devices capable of integrating with internal and external sensors, such as wearable devices. The Multi-Device Continuum and Seamless Sensing Platform develop context aware solutions, which are targeted at automated recognition of context extracted from users' devices, as people are often always interacting with a digital device such as phone, tablet, or desktop.

title: Apparatus and method for generating a treatment plan for salutogenesis
abstract: An apparatus and method for generating a treatment plan for salutogenesis, the apparatus comprising a at least a processor and a memory communicatively connected to the processor, the memory containing instructions configuring the at least a processor to receive physiological data associated with a user and comprising a plurality of biomarkers, wherein the plurality of biomarkers comprise at least a glycocalyx degradation biomarker, determine a concentration for each at least a glycocalyx degradation biomarker of the plurality of biomarkers, classify the at least a glycocalyx degradation biomarker to a disease condition and a treatment label as a function of the concentration, and generate a treatment plan as a function of the disease condition and the treatment label.

title: Medical image generation method, model training method, device and medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a medical image generation method, a model training method, a device and a medium, wherein the image generation method is used for acquiring scanning sequence data of a detection object; the scan sequence data comprises full-sampling scan sequence data of different scan sequences and a plurality of undersampled scan sequence data of at least one undersampling magnification; based on the full-sampling scan sequence data and the trained neural network model, image generation is performed on each undersampled scan sequence data to obtain a medical image of the test object. Thereby improving imaging efficiency, reducing various imaging artifacts and improving medical imaging quality.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Quantitative evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium for medical equipment
assignee: 上海至数企业发展有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for medical equipment, which define an index system of the medical equipment, wherein the index system covers seven indexes of holographic standing account of the equipment, equipment benefit management, equipment efficiency management, equipment use quality, equipment safe operation, patient experience indexes, personnel performance indexes and the like, data acquisition and analysis are carried out according to the index system, a big data acquisition technology is adopted to acquire data of the medical equipment, the data comprises internet of things data on the existing system and the medical equipment of a hospital, the data in different formats are subjected to type conversion, and finally unified and integrated to the big data storage format for normalization and standardized storage; meanwhile, the neural network model is adopted to automatically process the data, so that the accuracy of the data is ensured, and the quantitative evaluation of the medical equipment in all aspects is realized.
assignee_clean: 上海至数企业发展有限公司

title: Trend analysis for hydration monitoring
abstract: A method, system, or device for hydration monitoring using trend analysis. The method may include measuring a physiological measurement of an individual with a sensor to obtain trend data correlating to a hydration level of the individual. The method may include removing an abnormal shift or an abnormal change from the trend data. The method may include removing abnormal shifts and changes from the raw trend data. The method may include identifying a trend parameter for the trend data, the trend parameter indicating a change in the hydration level of the body. The method may include determining a reference value for the trend parameter. The method may include identifying a change in the trend data for the trend parameter, the change in the trend data indicating a change in the hydration level of the individual.

title: Method and system for enhancing training data and improving performance for neural network models
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system for improving performance of a neural network model. The system receives the neural network model and a training data associated with the neural network model. In addition, the system examines a first plurality of neuron activations inside the neural network model for the training data. The system examines the first plurality of neurons for creating a statistical profile of the first plurality of neuron activations. Further, the system receives a new set of data samples to improve the neural network model. Furthermore, the system examines a second plurality of neuron activations of each new sample of the new set of data samples. Moreover, the system extracts one or more data samples from the new set of data samples with largest novelty measurements. Also, the system adds the extracted one or more samples to the training data for re-training of the neural network model.

title: System and method for diagnosing and treating biological rhythm disorders
abstract: A heart treatment system is disclosed capable of diagnosing one or more critical regions of interest for a biological rhythm disorder by sensing signals from biological tissue. If a critical region is not present at the current location of sensed signals, the system is capable of indicating a guidance direction in which to navigate to reach one or more critical regions. Ablation energy is delivered to treat said region of interest. Signals are again sensed and analyzed to assess the impact of treatment. This process is repeated until all critical regions of interest are treated. In some embodiments, all functionality is provided by a single sensing and treating catheter with display device and analytical software.

title: Block chain medical data sharing excitation method based on charapril value
abstract: The invention relates to a block chain medical data sharing excitation method based on a Charapril value, and belongs to the technical field of block chain network application. By establishing the block chain medical data sharing incentive method, alliance profits are distributed among cooperative alliance members by using a Shaapril value method, the incentive problem of medical data sharing in a block chain application scene is solved, and the provided block chain medical data sharing incentive method can effectively stimulate the cooperative alliance members to participate in cooperation and share real data. The method considers the contribution degree of a data owner and the weight of all members in a cooperative union, so that the revenue distribution scheme based on the xiapril value method is suitable for medical data sharing scenes with difference in contribution degree; aiming at the practical Byzantine fault-tolerant algorithm characteristic applied to the alliance chain, a fair reward mechanism is formulated for the consensus nodes in the alliance chain network.

title: Automatic detection of medical image acquisition protocol
abstract: The disclosure relates to method and device for determining at least a portion of an anatomy from a set of medical images. Thereafter, the image acquisition protocol associated with the medical images is determined automatically based on the determined anatomy. The image acquisition protocol is automatically determined by extracting one or more features associated with the medical images characterizing the acquisition protocol. Thereafter, the medical images are classified based in the features. Further, the medical images are assigned with an acquisition protocol label based on the classification of the medical images. The medical images are displayed with the respective protocol labels. Further, medical images acquired with an identified image acquisition protocol at different time instances are displayed for comparative analysis.

title: Internet-based cervical cancer perioperative traditional Chinese medicine nursing monitoring method and system
assignee: 南通市肿瘤医院（南通市第五人民医院）
abstract: The invention discloses a cervical cancer perioperative traditional Chinese medicine nursing monitoring method and system based on the Internet, and relates to the field of monitoring, wherein the cervical cancer perioperative traditional Chinese medicine nursing monitoring method based on the Internet comprises the following steps of S1, collecting physiological data of a patient by adopting Internet equipment and dividing the physiological data into stages; s2, setting a traditional Chinese medicine nursing target according to the stage division result; s3, setting a nursing monitoring strategy according to the traditional Chinese medicine nursing scheme and the traditional Chinese medicine nursing target; s4, evaluating the effective condition of the nursing monitoring strategy according to the nursing monitoring strategy; s5, verifying and updating the nursing management scheme and the traditional Chinese medicine nursing target according to the effective condition of the nursing monitoring strategy, and setting a nursing scheme database for storage. According to the invention, the physiological data of the patient is collected through the Internet equipment, and the traditional Chinese medicine nursing scheme is customized for each patient in a fit way by combining data characteristic extraction and analysis, so that the nursing effect is improved, and unnecessary general nursing measures are reduced.
assignee_clean: 南通市肿瘤医院 南通市第五人民医院
primary_assignee: 南通市肿瘤医院 南通市第五人民医院

title: X-ray positive chest radiography multi-task detection method based on incremental learning
assignee: 上海全景云医学影像诊断有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to an X-ray positive chest film multi-task detection method based on incremental learning, which comprises the steps of firstly dividing a medical data set into a basic group and an incremental group, then carrying out deep characterization learning on the basic group by adopting an improved ResNet-50 network model, then carrying out small sample training learning on the incremental group, and finally combining and optimizing the basic group and the incremental group to finish the training of a whole algorithm model; the improved ResNet-50 network model is an ImageNet pre-trained ResNet-50 network model. The X-ray positive chest film multitask detection method based on incremental learning achieves chest film multitask detection by the aid of the multi-semantic task and multi-label incremental learning method, existing knowledge is used for learning and identifying new disease types, a prediction model is prevented from being retrained completely when new diseases are met, the purpose of improving diagnosis performance of identifying new diseases is achieved, and feasibility support is provided for development and application of medical imaging equipment.

title: Systems, devices, and methods for harmonization of imaging datasets including biomarkers
assignee: Terran Biosciences Inc., The Trustees Of Columbia University In The City Of New York, The Research Foundation For Mental Hygiene, Inc.
abstract: An exemplary system, method and computer-accessible medium for harmonizing neuromelanin (NM) data using combat directly on a NM database or using combat generated coefficients to harmonize future data can include, for example, receiving imaging information of a brain of the patient(s), from one MRI scanner, receiving imaging information of a brain of the patient(s), from a second MRI scanner and using combat to harmonize the data between scanners against a reference dataset. The Neuromelanin (NM) concentration of the patient(s) can then be determined based on the harmonized data. The NM concentration can be determined using a voxel-wise analysis procedure. The voxel-wise analysis procedure can be used to determine a topographical pattern(s) within a substantia nigra (SN) of the brain of the patient(s).

title: Method for learning fracture diagnosis model and apparatus for the same
abstract: According to the present invention, a method for learning a fracture diagnosis model can be provided. The method for learning a fracture diagnosis model is to learn a learning model for diagnosing fractures by using a medical image. The method comprises the steps of: learning a general fracture learning model based on a fracture medical image obtained by photographing a fractured region in a body region, wherein a general fracture learning model is learned using the fracture medical image corresponding to various body regions; fixing the weight of an artificial neural network provided in the general fracture learning model, and constructing a part-unit fracture learning model of a structure in which a value output from the general fracture learning model is input into a characteristic learning model; and inputting a part-unit fracture medical image corresponding to a specific part of the body region into the general fracture learning model, and setting a corresponding fracture diagnosis result as a target variable of the characteristic learning model to perform learning on the part-unit fracture learning model. Therefore, high-performance learning models can be established using a small amount of labeling data.

title: System for simulation of soft bodies
abstract: A simulator for simulating soft body deformation includes a display system, a user interface, and a controller. The controller includes one or more processors coupled to memory that stores instructions that when executed cause the system to perform operations. The operations include generating a simulated soft body having a shape represented, at least in part, by a plurality of nodes. The operations further include determining, with at least a first machine learning model, a displacement of individual nodes included in the plurality of nodes in response to a simulated force applied to the simulated soft body. The operations further include rendering a deformation of the simulated soft body in substantially real time in response to the simulated force based, at least in part, on the displacement.

title: Methods and systems for nourishment refinement using psychiatric markers
abstract: A system for nourishment refinement using psychiatric markers includes a computing device designed and configured to retrieve a psychiatric marker relating to a user, identify a nutrient variation as a function of the psychiatric marker, establish nourishment possibilities as a function of the nutrient variation, and generate a nourishment program, wherein generating further includes training a machine learning process as a function of a training set relating psychiatric markers and nutrient variations to nourishment programs, and generating the nourishment program as a function of the psychiatric marker, the nourishment possibilities, and the machine-learning process.

title: Charging technologies
abstract: This disclosure enables various technologies for controlling and charging stationary and mobile devices.

title: System and method of generating quantum unitary noise using silicon based quantum dot arrays
abstract: A novel and useful system and method of generating quantum unitary noise using silicon based quantum dot arrays. Unitary noise is derived from a probability of detecting a particle within a quantum dot array structure comprising position based charge qubits with two time independent basis states |0> and |1>. A two level electron tunneling device such as an interface device, qubit or other quantum structure is used to generate quantum noise. The electron tunneling device includes a reservoir of particles, a quantum dot, and a barrier that is used to control tunneling between the reservoir and the quantum dot. A detector circuit connected to the device outputs a digital stream corresponding to the probability of a particle of being detected. Controlling the bias applied to the barrier controls the probability of detection. Thus, the probability density function (PDF) of the output unitary noise can be controlled to correspond to a desired probability. The unitary noise can be used in stochastic rounding by controlling the bias applied to the barrier in accordance with a remainder of numbers to be rounded.

title: Healthcare provider bill validation
abstract: A system for validation of healthcare provider bills includes obtaining an image of the bill on a mobile device which uses optical character recognition to resolve the patient identity, provider identity and amount due as alphanumeric characters. The system also receives adjudicated claims data from insurance companies in a non-standardized format. A claims conversion server converts the adjudicated claims data to a standardized machine-readable format. The standardized adjudicated claims data and provider bill are validated against each other in real-time so the patient can make payment in an accurate amount without having to first receive and decipher an EOB form.

title: 3D image classification method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides a 3D image classification method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a 3D image, wherein the 3D image comprises first dimension image information, second dimension image information and third dimension image information; extracting a first image characteristic corresponding to planar image information consisting of first-dimension image information and second-dimension image information from the 3D image; extracting a second image characteristic corresponding to the third-dimension image information from the 3D image; performing fusion processing on the first image characteristic and the second image characteristic to obtain a fusion image characteristic corresponding to the 3D image; and determining a classification result corresponding to the 3D image according to the fusion image characteristic corresponding to the 3D image. According to the technical scheme, the efficiency and the accuracy of classifying the 3D images can be improved.

title: System and method for analyzing electroencephalogram signals
abstract: A system, a computer readable storage medium, and a method for analyzing electroencephalogram signals can include a plurality of sensors configured to contact a skull and capture the electroencephalogram signals, one or more computer memory units for storing computer instructions and data, and one or more processors configured to perform the operations of clustering the electroencephalogram signals using at least stored objective data and added subjective data including patient profile data to provide clustered data results and predicting one or more among a medical diagnosis, assessment, plan, necessary forms, or recommendations for follow up based on the clustered data results.

title: Object classification method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The specification discloses a target object classification method, device, equipment and readable storage medium, wherein a feature extraction sub-network of a first classification model of each mode is used as a feature extraction sub-network corresponding to each mode through training the first classification model of each mode, a second classification model comprising the feature extraction sub-network of each mode and a second classifier is constructed, first target features of each mode are obtained through the feature extraction sub-network, second target features obtained by fusing the first target features of each mode are input into the second classifier to obtain a prediction classification result, the prediction classification result and the minimization of the difference between labels of the first training samples are used as optimization targets, and parameters of the second classifier are adjusted. Therefore, the problem of poor model classification effect caused by small training sample size is solved by migrating the feature extraction sub-network of the pre-training, and the prediction classification result is obtained by fusion according to the first target features of each mode, so that the model classification performance can be improved.

title: Verifiable training of model in untrusted environment
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, from a plurality of providers by a secure enclave, a plurality of training data sets and a plurality of salts paired with the plurality of training data sets, respectively, hashing, via the secure enclave, pairs of training data sets and salts to generate a plurality of salted hashes, and combining the plurality of salted hashes to generate a digest, training, via the secure enclave, a model based on the plurality of training data sets to generate a trained model, and providing the trained model and the digest to a plurality of data providers of the plurality of training data sets and the plurality of salts.

title: Flow determination method, training method, device and medium of flow detection model
assignee: 心擎医疗（苏州）股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a flow determination method, a training method of a flow detection model, equipment and a medium, belonging to the technical field of medical appliances, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring pump load data and motor operation data corresponding to a blood pump; inputting pump load data and motor operation data into a preset flow detection model to perform flow detection processing, and outputting flow data corresponding to a blood pump; the flow detection model is a machine learning model obtained after training based on a sample data set, and each group of sample data in the sample data set comprises pump load sample data, motor operation sample data and flow measurement data which correspond to each other; the flow detection can be realized without setting a flow sensor, the dependence of the flow detection on the flow sensor is greatly reduced, the problems of complex installation and operation of the flow sensor in the ventricular assist device are solved, the requirements of the medical scene on the structural complexity and the operation complexity of the blood pump are met, and the flow detection complexity is reduced as a whole.

title: Diagnosis method and device based on convolutional neural network and multi-modal medical image
abstract: The application provides a diagnosis method based on a convolutional neural network and multi-mode medical images, which relates to the technical fields of computer vision, deep learning and medical image processing, and comprises the following steps: collecting training data, wherein the training data comprises medical image samples of multiple modes and diagnosis marking information corresponding to the medical image samples of the multiple modes; optimizing network parameters of the convolutional neural network according to the training data to obtain an optimized classification network based on the convolutional neural network; medical images of multiple modes are acquired, the medical images of the multiple modes are input into a classification network based on a convolutional neural network, so that the prediction probability of diseases corresponding to the medical images of each mode is output, and the prediction probability is used for representing the probability of suffering from the diseases and the probability of not suffering from the diseases respectively. The application integrates medical images of multiple modes to diagnose, thereby improving the accuracy of disease diagnosis.

title: Circadian rhythm co-activation using phototherapy to enhance drug effectiveness
abstract: The circadian rhythm coordination platform can employ a drug circadian profile that includes an enantiomer of the drug with circadian rhythm disruptions and can convert such circadian rhythm disruptions into administration of phototherapy to accommodate such disruptions. The circadian rhythm coordination platform can specify how light therapy is used to coordinate a patient's circadian rhythm to compensate for or anticipate side effects of a drug, and to optimize a drug schedule for the patient's circadian rhythm to minimize side effects and increase drug efficacy. The circadian rhythm coordination platform also enables information to be gathered about the effect of drugs on circadian rhythms and to interact with patients, healthcare providers, and other providers associated with phototherapy.

title: Systems and methods for real-time transmission of digital data using a plurality of channels
abstract: Disclosed embodiments include systems, methods, and media for receiving and transmitting digital data over a plurality of channels. Disclosed embodiments may include receiving data from a plurality of sources through one or more networks. Disclosed embodiments may also include assigning a geographic area to the data from the plurality of sources, the geographic area corresponding to one or more locations associated with the data. Additionally, disclosed embodiments may include determining health effects for a predetermined location based on the data and its associated geographic locations. Further, disclosed embodiments may include generating, by querying a predetermined response database, instructions that address the determined health affects for the predetermined location, the instructions including an action and an associated device. And, disclosed embodiments may include transmitting, to the associated device, the action associated with the instructions.

title: Active contour model-based unsupervised medical image segmentation method and system
abstract: The invention provides an active contour model-based unsupervised medical image segmentation method and an active contour model-based unsupervised medical image segmentation system. After the segmentation network is pre-trained, a large number of new images without labels are predicted by using the segmentation network, a rough prediction result is obtained, parameters of the active contour model are automatically adjusted according to a set strategy, and more accurate target region contours are obtained by using image bottom layer information. After the generated contours are screened by the quality evaluation network, the segmentation network is further trained by using the contours with higher quality as pseudo tags. And (5) continuously cycling and iterating to realize the segmentation of the image under the condition of not depending on manual labeling. The invention realizes the medical image segmentation under the condition of no supervision, greatly avoids the dependence on the data annotation with high cost under the condition of ensuring the accuracy, and has good generalization.

title: Bone mass detection method based on convolutional neural network
assignee: 安徽大学, 合肥市滨湖医院
abstract: The invention discloses a bone mass detection method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: 1, constructing a convolutional neural network; 2, acquiring and preprocessing an X-ray film data set labeled according to a bone densitometer; 3, training the neural network by using the X-ray film data set to obtain a network model capable of identifying the X-ray films with abnormal bone mass, reduced bone mass and normal bone mass; 4, detecting the X-ray film by using a network model, and evaluating the classification precision of the model; and 5, integrating based on the trained network model, converting into an executable program exe, and inputting the data to be detected in the dicom format to obtain a corresponding detection result. The invention can realize the end-to-end detection of abnormal bone mass, osteopenia and normal bone mass by X-ray so as to conveniently, quickly and timely find the state of osteopenia or abnormal bone mass, and assist in further examination and treatment to reduce a series of risks caused by abnormal bone mass.
assignee_clean: 安徽大学; 合肥市滨湖医院

title: Fourier-transform infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy using a mobile device
abstract: This document describes techniques and devices for Fourier-transform infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy using a mobile device. A mobile device (502) includes a light source (504) that emits light toward an interferometer (508) that uses mirrors to separate and recombine the light. The interferometer directs the recombined light toward a person. Light reflected from, or transmitted through, the person is received through a reception port (506) to a photodetector (510) that outputs photodetector data that corresponds to a measured light intensity of the reflected and transmitted light as a function of a path length of the light or a mirror position of the interferometer. Based on the photodetector data, an interferogram is generated. Applying a technique such as a Fourier transform to the interferogram, a spectrum data set of the reflected and transmitted light is generated. Based on the spectrum data set, a concentration of solutes in the person's blood is calculated.

title: Liver cell cancer differentiation evaluation method based on multi-modal image contribution fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a hepatocyte cancer differentiation evaluation method based on multi-modal image contribution fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing an effective high-dimensional multi-modal image data association representation, namely selecting a proper feature extraction mode to extract features of multi-modal MRI images, simultaneously, utilizing a multi-modal MRI image contribution self-adaptive weighting mechanism to learn task contribution of nine-modal MRI images, then carrying out feature layer fusion on a parameter result obtained by learning the task contribution and features obtained by the multi-modal fusion MRI data through a feature extractor, finally adding a classifier at the top end of a network, and carrying out a grading task of HCC differentiation degree by using multi-modal MRI image features combined with the contribution so as to realize more accurate prediction. Compared with the traditional imaging diagnosis method, the method eliminates the influence of subjective factors and simultaneously considers the diagnosis capability and contribution of each multi-mode MRI sequence, so that the obtained result is more accurate and robust.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an image processing method, which comprises the following steps: inputting a medical image in medical information of a target object, processing the medical image through a multi-channel reversible residual error network in a medical image processing model, and determining a first feature vector matched with the medical image; processing the first characteristic vector through a squeezing excitation network of a medical image processing model, and determining a weight parameter and a second characteristic vector which are matched with the medical image; and based on the matched weight parameter and the second characteristic vector of the medical image, segmenting the medical image through an activation function of the medical image processing model and a corresponding convolutional neural network. The invention also provides an image processing device, an electronic device and a storage medium. The medical image segmentation method and the medical image segmentation device can output the segmentation result of the medical image, improve the accuracy of the segmentation of the medical image, and can also realize the processing of the medical image with larger volume through the medical image processing model.

title: Platform for semantic search and dynamic reclassification
abstract: A platform receives an input document from a user device and automatically determines a semantic signature for the input document based on a probabilistic distribution of rare words within the input document. The platform automatically scrapes at least one Internet database for additional documents and webpages, determining semantic signatures for each document or webpage. Based on similarity of semantic signatures, the platform automatically constructs and displays a graphical network of documents, wherein each document is represented as a node and similarity of semantic signatures is used to determine the locations of edges between nodes. The graph automatically groups nodes by communities and selects nodes in different communities to promote serendipity of results.

title: Medical image display method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: A medical image display method and device, a computer readable storage medium and an electronic device are disclosed, relating to the technical field of image processing. The display method of the medical image comprises the following steps: determining type information of a tissue to be displayed based on a medical image to be displayed; determining display parameters corresponding to the medical image to be displayed based on the type information; and displaying the medical image to be displayed based on the display parameters. The embodiment of the disclosure can effectively optimize the display effect of the medical image to be displayed, and further provides a precondition for better assisting the diagnosis work of a doctor. In addition, compared with the prior art, because this disclosed embodiment can realize waiting to show the automatic optimization of the display effect of medical image, consequently, this disclosed embodiment can effectively assist the work efficiency who promotes the doctor, and then promotes the user and experiences the good sensibility.
