title: Delivery of an electronic message using a machine learning policy
abstract: According to some embodiments, a method performed by a classification scanner comprises receiving an electronic message and determining whether the electronic message includes an express indication from the user indicating that a classification applies to the electronic message. In response to determining that the electronic message does not include the express indication that the classification applies to the electronic message, the message further comprises sending the electronic message to a machine learning scanner. The machine learning scanner is adapted to use a machine learning policy to determine whether the classification applies to the electronic message.

title: Creating a machine learning policy based on express indicators
abstract: According to some embodiments, a method performed by a classification scanner comprises receiving an electronic message and determining a classification that applies to the electronic message. The classification is determined based on an express indication from a user. The method further comprises providing a machine learning trainer with the electronic message and an identification of the classification that applies to the electronic message. The machine learning trainer is adapted to determine a machine learning policy that associates attributes of the electronic message with the classification.

title: Method and apparatus for machine learning
abstract: Samples each including a feature amount and a label indicating one of a first value and a second value are classified into three or more clusters according to their feature amounts. Some of the clusters are combined to form a combined cluster on the basis of information on the number of samples with labels of the first value. The accuracy level of each sample with respect to the first value or the second value is calculated on the basis of the result of classifying into the combined cluster and the remaining clusters. Then, machine learning is performed using samples whose accuracy levels do not meet a prescribed condition more preferentially than samples whose accuracy levels meet the prescribed condition.

title: Multi-layered machine learning system to support ensemble learning
abstract: A method includes providing input data to a plurality of base models to generate a plurality of intermediate outputs. The base models are non-linear in that different base models are specialized differently such that the different base models are complementary to one another. Each of the base models is generated using a different base classification algorithm in a multi-layered machine learning system. The method also includes processing the intermediate outputs using a fusion model to generate a final output associated with the input data. The fusion model is generated using a meta classification algorithm in the multi-layered machine learning system. The method may also include training the classification algorithms, where training data used by each of at least one of the base classification algorithms is selected based on an uncertainty associated with at least one other of the base classification algorithms.

title: System and method to generate discretized interpretable features in machine learning model
abstract: A system and method for processing values of a subset of numeric features to provide interpretability of the results of a machine learning model, by determining an extent of the contribution of the subset of features towards a predicted class by performing: (i) receiving the thermal image, (ii) obtaining a region of interest in the thermal image of the subject, (iii) extracting a plurality of numeric features associated with the region of interest of the thermal image, (iv) predicting a class, (v) estimate an extent of contribution of the subset of numeric features towards the decision of the first machine learning prediction model (M) and (vi) generate a report that includes a generated discrete values that determines the extent of contribution of the subset of numeric features towards the predicted class.

title: Image processing model training method, image processing model generation device, image processing model equipment and image processing model medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an image processing model training method, an image generation device, an image generation equipment and an image generation medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first training sample set, and configuring random noise for the first training sample set to form a corresponding second training sample set; adjusting the format of the output result of the discriminator network of the image processing model; determining a loss function of the image processing model; processing the first training sample set and the second training sample set by the image processing model to determine initial parameters of the image processing model; and training the image processing model through the first training sample set and the second training sample set, and determining parameters of a generator network and parameters of a discriminator network of the image processing model. The invention can improve the training precision and the training speed of the image processing model, so that the image processing model can adapt to different use scenes.

primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Reduced interaction CT scanning
abstract: Systems and methods for a reduced interaction CT scanning workflow. A sensor is used to capture an image of a patient on the table. Scan parameters are automatically set. A full CT scan is performed without a scout scan. During the full CT scan, the scan parameters are adjusted based on the raw CT measurements from the full CT scan. A radiology report is automatically generated from the results of the full CT scan.

title: Document direction recognition method, device and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a document direction identification method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the document direction identification method comprises the following steps: acquiring a document image, wherein the document image comprises a document to be identified; determining a binary image corresponding to the document image, and selecting a plurality of image blocks from the binary image; determining an information content value for each of the image blocks; the direction of the document to be identified in the document image is identified according to the information content value and the image block, so that the accurate identification of the direction of the document can be quickly realized, the method is simple, and the identification effect is good.

title: System and method for determining triage categories
assignee: Board Of Regents Of The University Of Texas System, Hari RADHAKRISHNAN, Michelle SCERBO, John B. Holcomb, Charles E. Wade
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein provide a system, method, and computer program product for providing a triage classification system. The triage classification system uses a computer model that is developed using historical patient data. The developed computer model is applied to collected patient attribute data from a patient in a pre-hospital setting to generate a triage category. Based on the generated triage category, health care professionals can take desired actions, such as transporting the patient to a facility matching the generated triage category.

title: Knowledge base construction method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for constructing a knowledge base, which comprises the following steps: the literature unit constructs an original literature base, and the classification of relevant literatures in the construction method at least comprises the following steps: the literature unit (1) calculates the relevance strength of the words/phrases and modifies the joint occurrence probability based on the relevance strength to obtain a relevance reduced coordinate of the literature; the literature unit (1) constructs the related reduced coordinates of the literature, and classifies the related literature according to an iterative algorithm form based on the related reduced coordinates of all the related literatures and a classification function constructed by the relevance strength to form a plurality of literature unit bodies, wherein the literature unit bodies are formed by the related literatures. The classification function enables deep learning based on the sample size of the relevant document, thereby enhancing the accuracy of the document unit (1). The invention realizes causal analysis reasoning between diseases and analyzes causal relationship between diseases.

title: Method for recognizing face using intelligent electronic device
abstract: According to an embodiment, a method for recognizing a user's face using an intelligent electronic device comprises obtaining a face area from the user's face captured and obtaining face information from the face area, comparing the obtained face information with a default cluster, selecting whether to extract a face vector from the face information according to a result of the comparison, determining an age variation state for the user's face based on the extracted face vector, and upon determining that the face vector is in the age variation state for the user's face, extracting a face feature vector from the face vector and configuring an expanded cluster by adding the face feature vector to the default cluster. According to the disclosure, the intelligent electronic device may be related to artificial intelligence (AI) modules, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), robots, augmented reality (AR) devices, virtual reality (VR) devices, and 5G service-related devices.

title: Automated driver assistance system
abstract: Driver assistance is provided. An issue corresponding to a driver of a vehicle is automatically identified based on analysis of collected data. A set of actions is selected to address the identified issue corresponding to the driver based on the analysis of the collected data and preference data of the driver. The driver is notified of the selected set of actions to address the identified issue corresponding to the driver.

title: System and methods for medical image quality assessment using deep neural networks
abstract: The current disclosure provides methods and systems for rapidly and consistently determining medical image quality metrics following acquisition of a diagnostic medical image. In one embodiment, the current disclosure teaches a method for determining an image quality metric by, acquiring a medical image of an anatomical region, mapping the medical image to a positional attribute of an anatomical feature using a trained deep neural network, determining an image quality metric based on the positional attribute of the anatomical feature, determining if the image quality metric satisfies an image quality criterion, and displaying the medical image, the image quality metric, and a status of the image quality criterion via a display device. In this way, a diagnostic scanning procedure may be expedited by providing technicians with real-time insight into quantitative image quality metrics.

title: Multi-contrast MRI image reconstruction using machine learning
abstract: A method for reconstructing a MRI image may include: receiving MRI measurement data sets f1 to fN, each data set being acquired from an examination object based on a different MRI protocol of an MRI system; receiving MRI images u10 to uN0 corresponding to the MRI measurement data sets f1 to fN; performing one or more translation and rotation transformations on the MRI images u10 to uN0; applying one or more trained functions: to the transformed MRI images u10 to uN0, using a neural network, and to the MRI images u10 to uN0, using a forward-sampling operator; performing one or more inverse translation and rotation transformations on an output of the neural network; and generating at least one output MRI image uT based on an output of the forward-sampling operator, the inversely transformed output of the neural network, and the input MRI images u10 to uN0.

title: Schema-based pruning of blockchain data
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, from a client, a pruned data structure that comprises a plurality of fields and a plurality of hash values, respectively, identifying a schema associated with the pruned data structure, determining whether the pruned data structure is a valid based on the plurality of fields in the data structure and the identified schema associated with the client, and in response to a determination that the pruned data structure is valid, committing the pruned data structure to a blockchain.

title: Method and system for providing standard ultrasound scan plane views using automatic scan acquisition rotation and view detection
abstract: A system and method for acquiring standard ultrasound scan plane views is provided. The method includes acquiring a scan plane by an ultrasound probe positioned at a scan position over a region of interest. The method includes identifying the scan plane as a first standard view. The method includes automatically adjusting a scan acquisition angle until a second standard view is determined. The adjusting the scan acquisition angle includes rotating and/or tilting the scan acquisition angle. The method includes acquiring, by the ultrasound probe positioned at the scan position, an additional scan plane at the adjusted scan acquisition angle until the second standard view is determined. The method includes automatically determining whether the additional scan plane is the second standard view. The method includes presenting the additional scan plane having the second standard view at a display system.

title: Optimizing garbage collection across heterogeneous flash devices
abstract: A storage system with garbage collection prioritizes data segments for garbage collection in the storage memory. Priority of each data segment relates to amount of processing device work for garbage collection of the data segment versus benefit relating to amount of dead data to be reclaimed by garbage collection of the data segment. Garbage collection is performed according to the priority of each data segment.

title: System and method for detecting a nodule in living tissue
abstract: The present application relates to a system and method for detecting a nodule in living tissue, the system comprising: an ultrasound map acquisition module that generates an ultrasound image of the living tissue through examination of the patient; the positioning and segmenting module is in communication connection with the ultrasonic image acquisition module, receives the ultrasonic image of the living tissue generated by the ultrasonic image acquisition module, and performs positioning and segmentation on the nodes on the ultrasonic image of the living tissue through a Unet++ network and a Medical Transformer network loaded on the ultrasonic image after preprocessing the ultrasonic image so as to form one or more to-be-examined node area images; the manual auditing module is used for manually judging each of one or more to-be-checked nodule area images; and the output module outputs the result of the manual judgment formed by the manual auditing module. The system and method for detecting a nodule in living tissue according to the present application may be used, for example, for the assisted diagnosis of thyroid cancer.

title: System and method for pain monitoring using a multidimensional analysis of physiological signals
abstract: The present invention is for a method and system for pain classification and monitoring optionally in a subject that is an awake, semi-awake or sedated.

title: Gathering user's speech samples
abstract: Disclosed is gathering a user's speech samples. According to an embodiment of the disclosure, a method of gathering learning samples may gather a speaker's speech data obtained while talking on a mobile terminal and text data generated from the speech data and gather training data for generating a speech synthesis model. According to the disclosure, the method of gathering learning samples may be related to artificial intelligence (AI) modules, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), robots, augmented reality (AR) devices, virtual reality (VR) devices, and 5G service-related devices.

title: Brain tissue segmentation method combining UNet and volume rendering priori knowledge
abstract: The invention relates to a brain tissue segmentation method combining UNet and volume rendering priori knowledge, and belongs to the technical field of medical image segmentation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a brain medical image dataset and performing necessary pretreatment; dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set; setting a volume rendering opacity transfer function, and calculating opacity priori knowledge of the brain medical image; constructing a UNet convolutional neural network model; training a model according to the cross entropy loss function using the training set data; and inputting the brain medical image and priori knowledge thereof into the model to obtain a segmentation result output by the model. The method can improve the segmentation precision and accuracy of brain tissues by means of the prior knowledge of the opacity of the volume rendering of the brain medical image, and obtain the brain tissue segmentation result which is closer to the true value.

title: Multi-mode data characteristic expression method, device and medium based on contrast learning
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and digital medical treatment, and provides a multi-mode data characteristic expression method, device and medium based on contrast learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-mode data sample, and preprocessing the multi-mode data sample to obtain a feature vector combination; replacing at least one feature vector in the feature vector combination to obtain a contrast feature vector combination; respectively inputting the feature vector combination and the contrast feature vector combination into a multi-layer coding and decoding model to obtain positive feature expression and negative feature expression of the multi-mode data sample; training parameters of the multi-layer coding and decoding model according to the positive characteristic expression and the negative characteristic expression of the multi-mode data sample to obtain a multi-mode data processing model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-modal data to be processed, inputting the multi-modal data to be processed into a multi-modal data processing model, and obtaining the characteristic expression of the multi-modal data to be processed, so that the sample utilization rate and the accuracy of the characteristic expression are improved.

title: Manual intelligent-based liver cancer whole course digital management method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a liver cancer whole course digital management method and system based on artificial intelligence, comprising the following steps: acquiring test index data of a target user, acquiring mark characteristics of the target user according to the test index data, judging and classifying the mark characteristics of the target user through big data analysis and pattern matching, acquiring liver cancer classification and classification results, survival rate prediction and recommendation of a treatment scheme of the target user, acquiring association degree between the target user and a service according to treatment rehabilitation data of the target user, constructing a service push service model for recommending rehabilitation service, and acquiring rehabilitation conditions of the target user through feedback of the treatment rehabilitation data and the rehabilitation service. The intelligent diagnosis and treatment scheme and the intelligent rehabilitation scheme of the liver cancer patient are generated, the treatment health management service with finer granularity, higher professional degree and more accurate demand matching is provided for the patient, and the rehabilitation service is fed back to help to improve the self-management consciousness and the health level of the patient.

title: Automatic musical note vector composing system and method based on context information
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic music composing system and method of note vectors based on context information, the method comprises the following steps: firstly, a MIDI music preprocessing module is used for preprocessing a MIDI music file and extracting a main melody note sequence containing two phonemes of pitch and duration; then, the main melody note sequence is sent to a note vector coding module which is used for training and generating note vectors with context information, the note vectors have the context information, so that the accuracy of predicting the notes of a subsequent composition network is improved, and meanwhile, the generated note vectors are used for representing the main melody note sequence again; then, the main melody note sequence expressed by the note vector generated by the note vector coding module is used as training data to be sent to the automatic composing network module, and the module is used for generating the note sequence to be composed; finally, the note sequence to be composed is restored to the MIDI format through the MIDI music synthesizing and playing module and is played.

title: Optically switchable memory
abstract: A method of manufacturing a storage device for storing information, apparatus for storing information, an optical memristor device and a memory cell are disclosed. A method comprises providing at least one first electrode and at least one further electrode and providing each of at least one region of a first material between, and in electrical connection with, a respective first electrode and a further electrode whereby said step of providing at least one region comprises providing in the first material, a plurality of changeable particles that have charge storage capacity and at least one electrical property that is reversibly changeable responsive to absorption of incident electromagnetic radiation.

title: Flat representation of machine learning model
abstract: The example embodiments are directed to a system and method for deploying a machine learning model using a parse-free memory allocation. In one example, the method may include one or more of receiving a request to deploy a machine learning model, in response to receiving the request, creating a memory map comprising a mapping of a data structure for storing an unpacked flat representation of the machine learning model, allocating a contiguous block of memory of the data structure that is mapped by the memory map, loading data blocks of the unpacked flat representation of the machine learning model into the allocated contiguous blocks of memory of the data structure, and storing an offset associated with the contiguous block of memory in storage.

title: Predictive anomaly handling in a service provider system
abstract: There is a need for solutions that perform predictive natural language processing with improved efficiency and/or accuracy. This need can be addressed by, for example, by detecting an anomaly condition in the service provider system based on affected user activity data items associated with the service provider system; determining affected user profiles, wherein each affected user profile is predicted to experience the anomaly condition; determining, for each group of affected user profiles, affected user intentions based user activity data items associated with the group of affected user profiles; generating a support communication for each affected user profile in the group of affected user profiles based on the affected user intentions for the group; and causing a transmission of each support communication to each affected user profile in the group of affected user profiles.

title: Image diagnosis support device, medical image acquisition device, and computer-readable recording medium
assignee: 富士胶片医疗健康株式会社
abstract: The invention provides an image diagnosis support device, a medical image acquisition device and a computer readable recording medium, which can select the most appropriate image for a diagnosis object in a plurality of images, and can present diagnosis support information with good precision regardless of the type or mode of the selected image. The image diagnosis support device is provided with: a diagnostic information generating unit that generates diagnostic information from a plurality of medical images; a reliability calculation unit that evaluates image quality for a plurality of medical images and calculates reliability of the image quality; and a contribution degree calculation unit that calculates the contribution degree of the plurality of medical images to the diagnostic information using the reliability calculated by the reliability calculation unit and an internal parameter indicating the suitability of each medical image to the diagnostic object. A detection image used by the diagnostic information generating unit is generated based on the contribution degree.

title: Determining an indicator relating to injury
abstract: Disclosed is a medical data processing method for determining an indicator relating to an injury of an anatomical structure (1) of a patient, wherein the method comprises executing, on at least one processor (5) of at least one computer (3), steps of:a) acquiring (S1) acceleration data describing an energy of a set of one or more signals in dependence on both time and frequency, the set of signals acquired by measuring the acceleration of the anatomical structure (1) over time;b) acquiring (S2) analysis data describing an analysis rule for determining at least one ofb1) an overall energy level of at least one signal of the set of signals,b2) a correlation between at least two signals of the set of signals in the frequency domain, the at least two signals respectively measured at at least two different respective regions of the anatomical structure (1), orb3) a relationship between energies given for at least two different frequency ranges of at least one signal of the set of signals;c) determining (S3) indicator data describing the indicator based on the acceleration data and the analysis data.

title: Entity extraction method, device and equipment based on medical dictionary and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an entity extraction method based on a medical dictionary, and belongs to the field of natural language processing. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a prefix dictionary and a suffix dictionary based on an original medical dictionary; performing n-gram traversal on the Chinese medical record; matching each word group obtained after traversal with an original medical dictionary, a prefix dictionary and a suffix dictionary respectively and outputting a matching result; outputting the feature vector of each word according to the matching result and the corresponding rule of the feature vectors; correspondingly splicing the output characteristic vector of each word with the initial vector of each word to obtain a vector set for representing the Chinese medical record; inputting the vector set for representing the Chinese medical record into the trained model to extract the entities in the model. The method firstly identifies the entity in the Chinese medical record and converts the entity into the characteristic vector, and then takes the vector set which is converted from the whole Chinese medical record as the input of the model, so as to improve the accuracy of the model for extracting the entity.

title: Method and system for measuring an X-ray image of an area undergoing medical examination
abstract: A method for measuring an X-ray image of an area undergoing medical examination that has at least one object. A 3D model is provided of the area undergoing examination that includes a virtual 3D object to be assigned to the object to be measured, a digitally reconstructed X-ray picture is computed based on the 3D model and under the assumption of a virtual projection direction, the X-ray image is compared with the digitally reconstructed X-ray picture, the virtual projection direction is changed relative to the virtual 3D object. The steps of comparing and changing are repeated until a virtual projection direction with maximum correlation between the X-ray image and the digitally reconstructed X-ray picture is found. An object plane is determined that is to be assigned to the virtual 3D object. A corrected projection direction is defined and the X-ray image is measured.

title: Apparatus and Method for Videofluoroscopic Swallowing Study
abstract: Disclosed is a videofluoroscopic swallowing study inspection device. According to the present invention, the videofluoroscopic swallowing study inspection device comprises: an image input unit through which a videofluoroscopic image in which the movement of an anatomical position is photographed while an examinee is ingesting food is input; an anatomical position designating unit which designates the anatomical position in the videofluoroscopic image to correspond to a preset anatomical standard position and designates a food position relative to the anatomical position; a coordinate setting unit for setting coordinates of the anatomical position and food position; a position tracking unit which tracks the extent to which the anatomical position moves and a path of food movement; and a reading unit which analyzes the extent to which the anatomical position moves and the path of food movement and reads whether swallowing disorder is present.

title: Tracking and fault determination in complex service environment
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of storing sensor data on a blockchain, the sensor data sensed of an object which is cooperatively managed by a plurality of providers, detecting an event with respect to the object, determining, via chaincode deployed on a blockchain peer, one or more providers from among the plurality of providers that are liable for the event based on the sensor data stored on the blockchain, and outputting a notification to a computer system of the blockchain identifying the determined one or more providers.

title: Medical image registration method based on prediction multi-level deformation field
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of image processing and computer vision, and relates to a medical image registration method based on a predictive multilayer deformation field. Extracting multi-level features on different dimensions of a reference image and an image to be registered to obtain feature images with different dimensions; the deformation fields under different sizes are obtained by carrying out error detection, feature fusion and deformation prediction operations among the multi-level features; the final deformation field is obtained by operating the deformation fields with different sizes; and carrying out deformation operation on the images to be registered, so that registration between the two medical images can be realized. The method is simple and easy to realize; and compared with the deformation field obtained by direct prediction, the deformation field obtained by utilizing the characteristics under different sizes is more accurate, and the characteristic information is more fully utilized.

title: Multi-mode and multi-example learning classification method, prediction method and related device
abstract: The application discloses a multi-mode and multi-example learning classification method, a prediction method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode data of a target object, and obtaining a mode feature map of each mode data through a feature extraction module in a classification network model; determining a fusion feature map based on each modal feature map and a feature fusion module in the classification network model; determining a multi-instance fusion feature based on the fusion feature and a multi-instance combination module in the classification network model; and determining the classification category corresponding to the target object based on the multi-instance fusion feature, the inspection information corresponding to the target object and a table data learning module in the classification network model. The multi-mode data and the multi-example are combined, the information of multiple modes can be effectively integrated and applied to real data, the situation that a sub-sample in the real data lacks a label is solved, and better performance is achieved by helping tasks.

title: Disease diagnosis model training method based on medical image data augmentation
abstract: The invention relates to a disease diagnosis method based on medical image data amplification, and belongs to the technical field of disease diagnosis methods. Firstly, mapping original image data into a depth feature space, and extracting features with highly-linearized semantic information; acquiring a characteristic covariance matrix for data amplification according to the distribution of data corresponding to different categories in the medical image in a characteristic space; and calculating a data amplification loss function, and obtaining a model with stronger feature extraction capability by continuously optimizing the loss. The data amplification method is only used when a model is trained, and does not introduce more calculation amount and calculation time when the model is used for predicting the medical image data. The method effectively expands the fixed medical image data, remarkably reduces the quantity requirement of the training of the deep neural network on the marked patient data, effectively relieves the problems of difficult acquisition of the medical image data and high marking cost, and improves the accuracy rate of disease diagnosis.

title: Medical supplies distribution system
abstract: A mobile medical supplies distribution system may include a transportable chassis forming part of a motorized vehicle; a service compartment configured to house a person serving as a medical supplies distribution service agent; a supply of select medical supplies; and one or more delivery drones configured to deliver medical supplies from the service compartment to a location remote from the service compartment.

title: Method and apparatus for improved analysis of CT scans of bags
assignee: Robert Edwin Douglas, Kathleen Mary Douglas, David Byron Douglas
abstract: A method, software and apparatus are disclosed to improve security by helping determine whether a bag contains a prohibited item. A CT scan of a bag is performed to generate an image. An artificial intelligence algorithm is performed to classify portions of an image as normal and portions of said image as abnormal. A first type of image processing for said normal portion(s) of said image. A second type of image processing for said abnormal portion(s) of said image wherein said second type of image processing is different from said first type of image processing. The normal portion(s) of the image are displayed with said first type of image processing and said abnormal portion(s) of the image are displayed with said second type of image processing to a TSA Agent for analysis of said image. In the preferred embodiment, the TSA Agent will perform the analysis on an extended reality head display unit.
assignee_clean: robert edwin douglas; kathleen mary douglas; david byron douglas

title: Neural stimulation device
abstract: Neurostimulation devices and methods provide a plurality of electrodes placed around a patient head such that electrode have electrical paths through the brain to other electrodes. A controller controls current between sets of opposing electrodes through the patient brain to selectively stimulate a region of interest of the patient brain. Different sets of electrodes are used to provide electrical current pulse with different polarities such that a net potential is exposed to a region of interest in the brain that it above a neuron stimulation threshold while a net potential exposed to tissue outside the region of interest is below the threshold.

title: Intelligent auxiliary system and method for anesthesia operation
assignee: 中国科学院苏州生物医学工程技术研究所
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary system and method for anesthesia operation, wherein the system comprises: the hardware monitoring terminal collects, transmits and fuses various physiological index data; the database module receives and stores anesthesia case data and basic information data of patients and physiological index data; the decision module acquires physiological index data, anesthesia case data and basic information data of patients, establishes physiological index differentiation standard, trains a decision model comprising physiological index health assessment, potential symptom prediction and diagnosis and treatment scheme recommendation; the doctor application terminal acquires physiological index health assessment, potential symptom prediction, diagnosis and treatment scheme recommendation and performs adjustment; the voice module provides voice interaction services of data linkage, inquiry and play. According to the voice interaction service provided by the invention, voice reminding can be given when the physiological index is abnormal or some suspicious symptoms exist; the doctor can also be provided with advice of the physiological index development condition or diagnosis and treatment scheme of the patient; effectively lightens the attention burden of doctors and improves the safety of the operation.

title: Rapid pH measurement
abstract: Among other things, certain embodiments of the present disclosure are related to devices and methods of performing biological and chemical assays, such as but not limited to pH measurement of bio/chemical samples.

title: Data-based scan gating
abstract: In accordance with the present disclosure, the present technique finds a diagnostic scan timing for a non-static object (e.g., a heart or other dynamic object undergoing motion) from raw scan data, as opposed to reconstructed image data. To find the scan timing, a monitoring scan of a patient's heart is performed. In the monitoring scan, the patient dose may be limited or minimized. As the projection data is acquired during such a monitoring scan, the projection data may be subjected to sinogram analysis in a concurrent or real-time manner to determine when to start (or trigger) the diagnostic scan.

title: System and method for improving cardiovascular health of humans
abstract: An estimate of a functional capacity such as VO2Max is made by applying the vital signs of a monitored human to a trained encoding neural network producing a cardio profile vector. The vector is applied to a trained functional capacity (VO2Max) neural network to estimate the functional capacity. Once estimated, an action is taken.

title: Blood vessel function evaluation method and blood vessel function evaluation device based on blood vessel image
assignee: 深圳科亚医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a blood vessel function evaluation method and a blood vessel function evaluation apparatus based on a blood vessel image. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a CTA image of a blood vessel and extracting a 3D central line of the blood vessel, obtaining a CAG image of the blood vessel and extracting a 2D central line of the blood vessel; establishing a mapping relation between a 3D central line of a blood vessel and a 2D central line of the blood vessel; acquiring second characteristic information of at least one position on the 3D central line, wherein the second characteristic information at least comprises first characteristic information corresponding to the position extracted from a CAG image of a blood vessel; and determining the blood vessel function evaluation parameters of at least one position by utilizing the trained learning network based on the acquired second characteristic information. The second feature information on the 3D center line extracted from the CTA image fuses the feature information of the blood vessel CTA image and the feature information of the CAG image, so that the blood vessel function evaluation parameter can be more accurately determined based on the second feature information.

title: System and method for monitoring engagement
abstract: Aspects include a computer-implemented method comprising tracking of one or more actions (e.g., patient actions) carried out on a web-based computing platform that enables text, audio, video and/or any other communication between providers and their clients, and aggregating indicators of at least one of these actions into a score calculated at one or more measurement intervals. Calculated scores may be compared to one or more reference scores. An action may be triggered based on a calculated score and/or based on the relative values of a calculated score and a reference score.

title: Three-dimensional damage assessment interface
abstract: A computing system can receive a claim trigger from a computing device of a claimant, the claim trigger indicating that a vehicular incident involving the claimant has occurred. The system provides a three-dimensional damage assessment interface for display on the computing device of the claimant, the damage assessment interface enabling the claimant to provide damage information for a vehicle based on the vehicular incident. The system receives input data indicating claimant inputs on the damage assessment interface. Based at least in part on the claimant inputs, the system generates a loss estimate for a policy provider of the claimant.

title: Corroborative claim view interface
abstract: A computing system can receive loss information from a computing device of a claimant, the loss information indicating damage or loss to property of the claimant from an event. The system can connect with a plurality of data sources to receive contextual information corresponding to the event. Based at least in part on the contextual information corresponding to the event, the system generates a graphical user interface for a policy provider of the claimant, the graphical user interface providing a set of fraud scores for the loss information provided by the claimant.

title: Artificial intelligence apparatus and method for extracting user's concern
abstract: The present disclosure provides an artificial intelligence apparatus including a memory configured to store data input by the user or data received by the artificial intelligence apparatus as user interest data, and a processor configured to extract a keyword from the user interest data, classify the keyword as a concern matching the keyword using an interest classification model, and increase an interest rank weight for the concern.

title: Systems and methods for time series analysis using attention models
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents On Behalf Of Arizona State University, Lawrence Livermore National Security. LLC
abstract: A system for time series analysis using attention models is disclosed. The system may capture dependencies across different variables through input embedding and may map the order of a sample appearance to a randomized lookup table via positional encoding. The system may capture capturing dependencies within a single sequence through a self-attention mechanism and determine a range of dependency to consider for each position being analyzed. The system may obtain an attention weighting to other positions in the sequence through computation of an inner product and utilize the attention weighting to acquire a vector representation for a position and mask the sequence to enable causality. The system may employ a dense interpolation technique for encoding partial temporal ordering to obtain a single vector representation and a linear layer to obtain logits from the single vector representation. The system may use a type dependent final prediction layer.

title: Recall probability based data storage and retrieval
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods, computer readable media, and a system comprising: a hierarchical data storage architecture comprising the following storage tiers: a first tier configured to store a data element associated with a first range of recall probability scores, and a second tier configured to store a data element associated with a second range of recall probability scores; a computing agent configured to perform the following: compute a recall probability score for the data element stored in the hierarchical data storage architecture, and affect a transfer of the data element between the first and second tier; and a graphical user interface (GUI) comprising at least one functional GUI element configured to: enable an end-user to input a desired balance between speed of data retrieval and cost of data storage, wherein the desired balance impacts the plurality of ranges of recall probability scores associated with the first and second tier.

title: Virtual research platform
abstract: Systems and methods for automated data curation and presentation are disclosed herein. The system can include a memory including a structured database and a plurality of storage bins. The system can include at least one server that can receive a packetized data file generated from a data file. This packetized data file can include a first packet generated from a content file of the data file, a second packet generated from metadata of the data file, and a third packet generated from a payload of the data file. The at least one server can automatically generate at least one tag for the packetized data file, which at least one tag is automatically generated based at least one key phrase identified in at least the targeted portion of the content file. The at least one server can index the packetized data file according to the at least one tag into a predetermined taxonomy, receive a data request including a plurality of parameters identifying attributes of packetized data, and deliver curated data selected according to the at least some of the plurality of parameters of the data request.

title: Subcutaneous P-wave centric insertable cardiac monitor with energy harvesting capabilities
abstract: A P-wave centric subcutaneous insertable cardiac monitor (ICM) for use in performing long term electrocardiographic (ECG) monitoring is disclosed. The length of the monitoring performed by the ICM is extended, potentially for a life time of the patient, and the functionality of the ICM is enhanced, by including an internal energy harvesting module in the ICM. The energy harvesting module harvests energy from outside the ICM, and provides the harvested energy for powering the circuitry of the ICM, either directly or by recharging a power cell within the ICM. As the circuitry of the ICM requires a low amount of electrical power, the harvested energy can be sufficient to support the functioning of the ICM even when the electrical power stored on the ICM at the time of implantation runs out.

title: Medical image processing method, medical image processing device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a medical image processing method, a medical image processing device, a computer device and a readable storage medium, wherein the medical image processing device comprises the steps of acquiring a two-dimensional image; constructing a corresponding first image with three dimensions according to the two-dimensional image; and taking the first image as the input of the neural network model to obtain a target two-dimensional image corresponding to the two-dimensional image. On one hand, the method provided by the application introduces additional third dimension information of the two-dimensional image, and utilizes the two-dimensional convolution to carry out network forward transmission, so that compared with the existing two-dimensional convolution neural network which processes one two-dimensional image each time, the image processing precision can be improved. On the other hand, compared with the existing three-dimensional convolution neural network which directly carries out multi-time three-dimensional convolution processing on the whole image sequence, the method reduces the operation amount of the whole network, improves the speed of image processing, and solves the problem that the image processing precision and the processing speed of the prior art are incompatible.

title: Extraction of a compliance profile for an organization
abstract: Embodiments for automatic extraction of a compliance profile for an organization by a processor. Text data may be extracted from one or more data sources representing one or more objects describing a compliance named entity of type organization expected to perform an obligation. A compliance profile of type organization may be determined for the compliance named entity of type organization according to the extracted text data.

title: Method and system for synchronizing procedure videos for comparative learning
abstract: Embodiments described herein provide various examples of preparing two procedure videos, in particular two surgical procedure videos for comparative learning. In some embodiments, to allow comparative learning of two recorded surgical videos, each of the two recorded surgical videos is segmented into a sequence of predefined phases/steps. Next, corresponding phases/steps of the two segmented videos are individually time-synchronized in pair-wise manner so that a given phase/step of one recorded video and a corresponding phase/step of the other segmented video can have the same or substantially the same starting time and ending timing during comparative playbacks of the two recorded videos. The disclosed comparative-learning techniques can generally be applied to any type of procedure videos which can be broken down into a sequence of predefined phases/steps, and to synchronize/slave one such procedure video to another procedure video of the same type at each segmented phase/step in the sequence of predefined phases/steps.

title: Robust segmentation through high-level image understanding
abstract: A facility identifies anatomical objects visualized by a medical imaging image. The facility applies two machine learning models to the image: a first trained to predict a view probability vector that, for each of a list of views, attributes a probability that the image was captured from the view, and a second trained to predict an object probability vector that, for each of a list of anatomical objects, attributes a probability that the object is visualized by the image. For each object, the facility: (1) accesses a list of views in which the object is permitted; (2) multiplies the predicted probability that the object is visualized by the image by the sum of the predicted probabilities that the accessed image was captured from views in which the object is permitted; and (3) where the resulting probability exceeds a threshold, determines that the object is visualized by the accessed image.

title: Chest radiography segmentation and processing method and system and electronic equipment
assignee: 鄂珑江, 梁会营, 赵柏松, 宋兴荣
abstract: The invention provides a chest radiography segmentation and processing method, a system and electronic equipment, which relate to the technical field of image processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image of a target chest picture and an annotated image thereof to obtain an image data set, wherein the annotated image comprises an image annotated with actual lung opening edges and thoracic edge of a lung; training the image data set by using a deep learning algorithm to obtain an image segmentation model based on deep learning; obtaining a chest film to be segmented of a target patient, and processing the chest film to be segmented to obtain an image to be segmented; processing an image to be segmented through an image segmentation model to obtain a segmented lung region and a segmented thoracic region; and calculating the lung-chest ratio according to the lung region and the thoracic region. The invention segments the actual pulmonary atelectasis edge of the chest film based on the deep learning algorithm, achieves good segmentation effect, segments the thoracic edge of the chest film for the first time, further calculates the pulmonary-thoracic ratio, can be used as an important indication for measuring whether the pulmonary ventilation is abnormal, and expands the application range of the pulmonary segmentation result.

title: Automated mapping of service codes in healthcare systems
abstract: Automatic mapping of semantics in healthcare is provided. Data sets have different semantics (e.g., Gender designated with M and F in one system and Sex designated with 1 or 2 in another system). For semantic interoperability, the semantic links between the semantic systems of different healthcare entities are created (e.g., Gender=Sex and/or 1=F and 2=M) by a processor from statistics of the data itself. The distribution of variables, values, or variables and values, with or without other information and/or logic, is used to create a map from one semantic system to another. Similar distributions of other variable and/or values are likely to be for variables and/or values with the same meaning.

title: Medical image semantic segmentation method based on CNN and random forest method
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image semantic segmentation method based on a CNN and a random forest method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a segmentation network, wherein the segmentation network comprises an input layer, a CNN part, a second full-connection layer, a random forest classification layer and a result output layer which are sequentially connected, the CNN part comprises five convolution layers and a first full-connection layer, images are input into the input layer, the five convolution layers and the first full-connection layer are trained, output of each scale is obtained in the first full-connection layer, all output results of the first full-connection layer are input into the second full-connection layer to obtain fused feature vectors, and the feature vectors are used as input of the random forest classification layer; the random forest classification layer performs feature learning and classification prediction according to the feature vectors; and carrying out pooling operation after the convolution operation of the first convolution layer, the second convolution layer and the fifth convolution layer, wherein all the convolution layers, the first full connection layer and the second full connection layer are activated by adopting a Relu function. The invention has the advantage of high segmentation accuracy.

title: Image segmentation method, network model training method, device and electronic equipment
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an image segmentation method and device, a network model training method and device and electronic equipment. The image segmentation method comprises the following steps: obtaining a first segmentation result of an artery and a background according to an image to be segmented comprising the background, the artery and a vein; acquiring a second segmentation result of the vein and the background according to the image to be segmented; and obtaining the segmentation results of the background, the artery and the vein according to the first segmentation result and the second segmentation result, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of the segmentation of the artery and the vein can be improved.
assignee_clean: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Systems and methods of accounting for shape change during radiotherapy
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure may be directed to a system for generating a motion target volume representative of shape changes of a target region in a patient. The system may comprise at least one computer system configured to receive a plurality of electronic medical images that include the target region, and each of the plurality of images may have been taken at a different time point. The computer system may be configured to define a three-dimensional volume containing the target region in each of the plurality of images, and the three-dimensional volume may be different in at least two of the plurality of images due to differences in shape of the target region in the at least two images. The computer system may also be configured to co-register the three-dimensional volumes and generate the motion target volume, wherein the motion target volume encompasses each of the three-dimensional volumes.

title: PET scattering correction and image reconstruction method, device and equipment
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method, apparatus and device for PET scatter correction and image reconstruction. The method comprises the following steps: CT projection data and PET projection data of CT scanning and PET scanning which are carried out on the same detected object are acquired; reconstructing a CT image using the acquired CT projection data and reconstructing an initial PET image using the acquired PET projection data; acquiring first scattering distribution data of gamma photons in a PET projection space by a simulation method based on the CT image and the initial PET image; based on the PET projection data, obtaining a scattering intensity coefficient of gamma photons in the PET projection space by a machine learning method; and correcting the first scattering distribution data according to the scattering intensity coefficient, so as to perform scattering correction on the PET projection data. The embodiment of the disclosure can obtain the scattering estimation with high accuracy when being based on high-dose or low-dose scanning, thereby accurately reconstructing the PET image.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Method of evaluating concomitant clinical dementia rating and its future outcome using predicted age difference and program thereof
abstract: A method of quantitatively evaluating a cognitive status and its future change from a medical image of an individual's brain, the method comprising scanning the individual's brain with a scanning device so as to acquire at least one medical brain image; processing the medical brain image to obtain at least one feature of the image; using a pre-established prediction model to determine a condition of the cognitive status and predict its future change based on the at least one feature obtained.

title: Method and system for incremental training of machine learning models on edge devices
abstract: A method and system for incremental training of machine learning (ML) models on edge devices, is disclosed. A base version of ML model is received by a first device of the peer to peer network of devices. The base version of the ML model is incremental trained in real-time by updating weights associated with the parameters of the ML model during a predetermined window of time. The ML model are devoid of an underlying event data used to generate the incremental version of the ML model. The updated weights associated with parameters of the incrementally trained ML model and/or the respective parameters are shared by each edge device with other edge devices. The edge devices update their respective ML models based on the received updated weights and/or parameters upon subsequent events at the edge devices and the updated version of the ML models are further incrementally trained.

title: Method, system and computer readable medium for determining characteristics of tissue voxels
abstract: A system, method and computer program product for predicting, predicting and/or evaluating tissue characteristics obtain measurement information associated with parameters of tissue voxels of a patient measured at two or more points in time before one or more characteristics of the tissue voxels in an image generated based on the parameters of the voxels measured at a single one of the two or more points in time are separable and determining the one or more characteristics of the tissue voxels based on the parameters of the voxels at the two or more points in time.

title: Data structuring method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a data structuring method, a data structuring device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be processed for describing a specified type event corresponding to a target object; acquiring at least two time nodes in data to be processed and at least one entity corresponding to each of the at least two time nodes; determining at least one entity transfer path based on at least two time nodes and at least one entity corresponding to each of the at least two time nodes; time nodes corresponding to all entities in the same entity transfer path are different; obtaining the path probability corresponding to at least one entity transfer path; and generating a structured text corresponding to the data to be processed based on the path probability corresponding to the at least one entity transfer path. By the method, the accuracy of the generated structured text can be improved in the process of structuring the data, and the interpretability of the data structuring is improved by introducing the time dimension information.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method for transmitting/receiving signal and channel in narrowband wireless communication system and apparatus therefor
abstract: The present specification provides a method for transmitting/receiving a signal and a channel in a narrowband wireless communication system and an apparatus therefor. Specifically, a method for transmitting/receiving a signal and a channel by a terminal in a narrowband wireless communication system coexisting with other wireless communication systems includes the steps of: receiving a synchronization signal from a base station based on a predetermined channel grid; receiving information about channel grid offset from a base station through a Physical Broadcast Channel (PBCH); and performing transmission and reception of signals and channels with the base station in a narrow band in which a center frequency is adjusted by applying a channel grid offset, wherein specific subcarriers among a plurality of subcarriers included in the narrow band may be punctured or rate-matched.

title: Support vector machine user data prediction method based on multi-party secure computing protocol
abstract: The invention discloses a support vector machine user data prediction method based on a multi-party safety calculation protocol, which is characterized in that homomorphic encryption is used for encrypting user data, and the homomorphic encryption can be used for consistent calculation result of a ciphertext and calculation of a plaintext, so that the problem of insufficient prediction accuracy of an interference method is solved, and the prediction accuracy of a support vector machine is improved; and meanwhile, introducing a third-party cloud server, and converting a computing process from the user and the prediction service party into the prediction service party and the third-party cloud server by using a multi-party secure computing protocol. The user only needs to encrypt the data and upload the data to the prediction service party, and the subsequent calculation process does not need the participation of the user and the whole-process networking. By utilizing the multi-party secure computing protocol, the computing process is simplified under the condition of protecting the data privacy of the user and the support vector machine, and the computing efficiency is improved.

title: Deep learning programming method and system based on digital twin DaaS platform
assignee: 深圳市爱云信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a deep learning programming method and a system based on a digital twin DaaS platform, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining equipment operation data of each sub-operation flow in the service flows of different terminal equipment, wherein the equipment operation data comprise process numbers of each sub-operation flow, carrying out data modeling on the equipment operation data of each sub-operation flow in the different terminal equipment, then carrying out comparative analysis, judging whether the terminal equipment needs to be upgraded and optimized or not based on an analysis result, carrying out deep learning programming on the equipment operation data of each sub-operation flow based on a trained time sequence programming model, automatically generating a target operation code, and upgrading the target operation code to the corresponding terminal equipment in a distributed mode, wherein the time sequence programming model is constructed based on the pre-collected equipment operation data of each sub-operation flow corresponding to the service flows in the different terminal equipment. The method and the device solve the problems of low efficiency and high labor cost of optimizing and upgrading the business process and the equipment.

title: Prostate cancer tissue image classification with deep learning
abstract: The method of the present invention classifies the nuclei in prostate tissue images with a trained deep learning network and uses said nuclear classification to classify regions, such as glandular regions, according to their malignancy grade. The method according to the present disclosure also trains a deep learning network to identify the category of each nucleus in prostate tissue image data, said category representing the malignancy grade of the tissue surrounding the nuclei. The method of the present disclosure automatically segments the glands and identifies the nuclei in a prostate tissue data set. Said segmented glands are assigned a category by at least one domain expert, and said category is then used to automatically assign a category to each nucleus corresponding to the category of said nucleus' surrounding tissue. A multitude of windows, each said window surrounding a nucleus, comprises the training data for the deep learning network.

title: Enhanced volume viewing
assignee: David Byron Douglas, Robert Edwin Douglas, Kathleen Mary Douglas
abstract: A method for improved 3D imaging of a volume is disclosed. The application discussed is improved assessment of complex 3D structures including breast microcalcifications and incorporation of geo-registered tools. The 3D imaging is displayed on a geo-registered head display unit.
assignee_clean: david byron douglas; robert edwin douglas; kathleen mary douglas

title: Pre-operative assessment system
abstract: A system of generating a pre-operative assessment of a patient includes one or more client electronic devices, and an assessment system configured to communication with the client electronic devices via a communication network. The assessment system includes one or more computing devices and a computer-readable storage medium. The computer-readable storage medium includes programming instructions that, when executed, cause the computing devices to receive patient information pertaining to a patient one or more of the client electronic devices, use at least a portion of the patient information to access one or more medical images associated with the patient, perform one or more image processing techniques on the medical images to identify, from medical images, a condition associated with the patient, generate a pre-operative assessment for the patient based on the patient information and the condition, and cause the assessment to be displayed on a display device of the client electronic devices.

title: Unsupervised electronic medical record-based medical behavior compliance assessment method
abstract: The invention discloses an unsupervised medical behavior compliance assessment method based on an electronic medical record, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting, cleaning and preprocessing case data; s2, classifying the case data of the patient; s3, clustering the order data of the patients; s4, fusing the medical advice data after patient clustering and the operation data with time series, and mining a diagnosis and treatment process model according to the patient category and the effect of the patients after diagnosis and treatment; and S5, aligning the actual diagnosis and treatment sequence with the excavated diagnosis and treatment process model based on the cost function, positioning the position of the abnormality and calculating the deviation degree of the abnormality. The invention reduces the dependence of prior knowledge, can deeply utilize data, has strong clinical interpretability of an evaluation result, and has high preset logic complexity of the state of illness, physical condition and the like of a patient.

title: Depth-constrained knowledge distillation for inference on encrypted data
abstract: This disclosure provides a method, apparatus and computer program product to create a full homomorphic encryption (FHE)-friendly machine learning model. The approach herein leverages a knowledge distillation framework wherein the FHE-friendly (student) ML model closely mimics the predictions of a more complex (teacher) model, wherein the teacher model is one that, relative to the student model, is more complex and that is pre-trained on large datasets. In the approach herein, the distillation framework uses the more complex teacher model to facilitate training of the FHE-friendly model, but using synthetically-generated training data in lieu of the original datasets used to train the teacher.

title: Method for performing channel estimation in wireless communication system and apparatus therefor
abstract: The present specification provides a method of estimating a channel by a terminal in a wireless communication system supporting Machine Type Communication (MTC). In particular, a terminal receives configuration information for receiving a cell specific reference signal (CRS) and a dedicated demodulation reference signal (DMRS) from a base station, and receives the CRS based on the configuration information. The terminal then receives the DMRS and the control information via an MTC Physical Downlink Control Channel (MPDCCH), performs channel estimation on the MPDCCH based on the DMRS and the CRS, and demodulates the control information based on the channel estimation, wherein one precoder among a plurality of candidate precoders applied to the CRS is applied to the DMRS.

title: Optimization of execution of smart contracts
abstract: An example operation includes one or more of receiving a smart contract code by an analyzer node, building, by the analyzer node, a control flow-graph comprising a plurality of basic code blocks based on the smart contract code, computing, by the analyzer node, a read and write set for each of the basic code blocks from the plurality of the basic code blocks, and determining, by the analyzer node, at least two basic code blocks from the plurality of the basic code blocks that may be executed in parallel.

title: Processing scheme generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a processing scheme generation method, a processing scheme generation device and a storage medium.A terminal obtains a prediction result of a calculus component according to a medical image and a preset calculus component model, determines the calculus component according to the prediction result and diagnosis and treatment information, wherein the diagnosis and treatment information comprises body indexes of a diagnosis and treatment object and physical characteristics of calculus, and further generates a calculus processing scheme according to the diagnosis and treatment information and the calculus component by adopting a preset artificial intelligence method. In the application, the diagnosis and treatment information comprises the physical indexes of the diagnosis and treatment object and the physical characteristics of the calculus, and the calculus component is determined according to the prediction result of the calculus component and the diagnosis and treatment information, so that the calculus processing scheme is determined according to the calculus component indexes, and the accuracy of generating the calculus processing scheme is greatly improved.

title: Devices, systems and methods for inhibiting or disrupting pediatric anxiety
abstract: Children who experience anxiety associated with novel situations react physically and emotionally in ways that make it challenging for the child, parents, educators, and providers to proceed with the intended goal of that novel situation. Anxiety in children can be reduced by introducing fun or distracting stimuli that act on specific neural pathways. The stimuli introduced can familiarize a child with the environment in which the procedure will take place and the equipment and people which the child will meet. In the healthcare setting, by using consistent stimuli, and by disrupting anxiety at one or more of a series of stages in which anxiety typically occurs, a reduction in needed anesthesia can be achieved, which is healthier for the child and reduces the costs associated with the medical or dental procedure.

title: Channel collaborative satisfaction investigation method and system based on big data
assignee: 杭州健海科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a channel collaborative satisfaction investigation method and a channel collaborative satisfaction investigation system based on big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a preference model; step two, constructing a content compression rule; step three, optimizing service deployment; step four, generating a survey task; and step five, executing a survey task. The system comprises: the preference module comprises an acquisition module, a processing module and a training module and is used for acquiring and sorting the data of the respondents and finding the preference of the respondents through machine learning; the content compression module is used for compressing the survey data to enable the survey items to be more suitable for the respondents; the investigation module generates and executes investigation tasks based on the preference module and the content compression module.
assignee_clean: 杭州健海科技有限公司

title: Method and system for aortic valve calcification evaluation
abstract: A method and system for automatic aortic valve calcification evaluation is disclosed. A patient-specific aortic valve model in a 3D medical image volume, such as a 3D computed tomography (CT) volume. Calcifications in a region of the 3D medical image volume defined based on the aortic valve model. A 2D calcification plot is generated that shows locations of the segmented calcifications relative to aortic valve leaflets of the patient-specific aortic valve model. The 2D calcification plot can be used for assessing the suitability of a patient for a Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVI) procedure, as well as risk assessment, positioning of an aortic valve implant, and selection of a type of aortic valve implant.

title: Automatic generation method of multi-mode network interconnection and fusion chest image diagnosis report
abstract: The invention provides an automatic generation method of a multi-mode network interconnection and fusion chest image diagnosis report, and relates to the field of medical information. The invention provides an automatic generation method of a multi-mode network interconnection fusion medical report based on a residual network (Resnet), a network of an attention mechanism (transducer) module and a cross-mode reinforced memory network (DCTMN), which aims at and fuses the two stress points, promotes interaction and matching of cross-mode (medical image and corresponding report text) information and automatically generates a medical image diagnosis report with effectively fused image and text information.

title: Computer-based system for educating a baby and methods of use thereof
abstract: A system includes a memory, an optical subsystem, an audio system, a plurality of sensors outputting sensor data, a communication circuitry, and a processor. The processor is configured to input to a baby-specific educational machine learning model, image data, audio signal data, sensor data, baby personal data associated with a baby, and a visual image and a sound presented to the baby based on a baby-specific educational plan; to receive an output from the baby-specific educational machine learning model where the output includes an indication that the baby understood or did not understand the visual image and the sound associated with the baby-specific educational plan, and a baby-specific educational recommendation based on the indication; and to execute based on the baby-specific educational recommendation, a modification of the baby-specific educational plan, or a continued execution of the baby-specific educational plan.

title: Analysis method, system, medium, and device based on user data modeling
assignee: 上海森亿医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an analysis method, a system, a medium and equipment based on user data modeling, wherein the analysis method based on the user data modeling comprises the following steps: carrying out characteristic analysis on the user data to generate a characteristic analysis result; performing stability inspection on the characteristic analysis result along with time change to detect abnormal data, and judging whether the characteristic analysis result is reliable according to the abnormal data detection result; screening characteristics required by the preprocessed data when modeling the user data; modeling user data by using the screened features to generate a user data model; and carrying out model analysis on the user data model to obtain a reliability analysis result of the user data model. In the modeling process, the invention provides reliable calculation and analysis links required by the machine learning model so as to realize complete automation, and provides enough analysis information for business personnel to help the business personnel to diagnose whether the model training process has problems.
