title: Method and apparatus for inspecting defects in washer based on deep learning
abstract: Disclosed is a method and apparatus for inspecting defects in a washer based on deep learning. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for inspecting defects in a washer based on deep learning gathers learning data while the washer operates and trains a first ANN model for diagnosing the condition of the washer and a second ANN model for securing the reliability of the result of inspection of the condition of the washer. Thereafter, the washer may make a diagnosis of whether the washer is defective based on the two pre-trained ANN models and are thereby able to continuously monitor whether the washer has an abnormal condition. According to an embodiment, the artificial intelligence (AI) module may be related to unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), robots, augmented reality (AR) devices, virtual reality (VR) devices, and 5G service-related devices.

title: Biomarker monitoring fitness system
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems and processes for measuring, monitoring, processing, and visualizing biological data including blood glucose levels. In various embodiments, a biomarker monitoring fitness system may facilitate one or more of the monitoring of fitness data including blood glucose levels measured by continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensor for an individual user or group of users, the prediction of carbohydrate intake needs or insulin delivery needs during physical activity of a user and the active indication thereof to the user and/or a delivery system of the user, and the collection and management of de-identified and identifiable user fitness data including blood glucose data.

title: Auxiliary disease reasoning system based on knowledge graph and self-adaptive mechanism
abstract: The invention provides a disease reasoning system based on a knowledge graph and a self-adaptive mechanism, which relates to the technical field of computer technology and auxiliary medical machinery, wherein the knowledge graph of a triplet < symptom, an occurrence part and a disease > is used as a data structure, a TransE translation model and a naive Bayesian classifier are used as bases to construct a disease reasoning model, a data set is divided, a proper number of TransE translation models and naive Bayesian classifiers are searched for each part of the data set to match, self-adaptive matching is realized, the influence of input unbalance on the models can be reduced, the interpretability can be improved by using the naive Bayesian classifier, the accuracy of the system on disease reasoning is improved, and the working efficiency of medical staff is further assisted.

title: Providing analytics on compliance profiles of type organization and compliance named entities of type organization
abstract: Embodiments providing analytics on a compliance profile of type organization and a compliance named entity of type organization by a processor. Text data may be extracted from one or more data sources representing one or more objects describing a compliance named entity of type organization expected to perform an obligation. A compliance profile of type organization may be determined for the compliance named entity of type organization according to the extracted text data. One or more compliance named entities of type organization may be matched to the one or more compliance profiles of type organization.

title: Medical image preprocessing method
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image preprocessing method, which comprises the following steps: semantic imaging of tag information: pre-reading the digital medical image and the label information thereof, and converting the text label information with the format into a multi-level classification mask image by applying a discrimination algorithm; region of interest extraction: reading a digital medical image, removing a transparency channel to obtain an image, extracting the outline of a tissue region in a current slice image, and dividing the image into the tissue region and a background region; multi-mask sample classification extraction: and extracting positive samples and negative samples from the tissue region by using the generated multi-level classification mask, and packaging sample data information to form structured data applicable to neural network model training and prediction. Through the technical scheme, more efficient and more accurate data preprocessing can be realized.

title: Medical information processing apparatus
assignee: 佳能医疗系统株式会社
abstract: Embodiments relate to a medical information processing apparatus. The technical problem solved by the invention is to assist a doctor or the like in verifying or improving the procedure that a patient needs to go through until reaching a final medical event. The medical information processing device of the embodiment is provided with a generation unit, a reception unit, and a display control unit. The generation unit generates a plurality of pieces of virtual patient information each of which is associated with the patient attribute information, one or more medical behaviors, one or more medical events, and one or more examinations. The receiving unit receives an operation for selecting one of the plurality of pieces of virtual patient information. The display control unit displays the events and the diagnosis and treatment actions included in the selected virtual patient information on the screen in time series.

title: Combined attention-seeking convolution method for automatic classification of brain medical images
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image automatic identification technology based on a graph convolution neural network. Based on brain diffusion tensor imaging and functional magnetic resonance imaging, a machine learning automatic diagnosis method capable of fusing two modal data and reasonably retaining and utilizing brain map structural information is designed. The current brain image classification lacks an effective method for fusing multi-mode images, and has poor learning effect on the image structure information in the data. The invention discloses a medical image automatic identification technology based on fusion diffusion tensor imaging of a graph convolution neural network and a functional magnetic resonance image. Specifically, we first aggregate neighbor information between brain region nodes on a brain diffusion Zhang Liangcheng image and then extract brain region joint attention. Then, a graph convolution operation is performed on the brain functional magnetic resonance image by taking the attention of the brain area as a reference. Finally, the characteristics are input into a multi-layer perceptron to be automatically identified and classified.

title: Target region labeling method based on image registration
assignee: 福州宜星大数据产业投资有限公司, 福建医科大学孟超肝胆医院(福州市传染病医院)
abstract: A target region labeling method based on image registration, screening registered CT or MRI images, using medical image processing software to open the images, importing four sequences of a horizontal scanning period, an arterial period, a portal period and a balance period, displaying the four sequences on a display interface at the same time, synchronously comparing the change of liver gray level layer by layer in the four display interfaces, judging a region of interest (ROI), adjusting to a labeling mode, synchronously linking and labeling in the four-phase images, completing labeling of all focus layers in the region of interest (ROI), storing NII format labeling images with label information, naming the NII format labeling images by hospitalization numbers, and obtaining labeled CT/MRI multi-period enhanced scanned images by accurately labeling the target region.
assignee_clean: 福州宜星大数据产业投资有限公司; 福建医科大学孟超肝胆医院 福州市传染病医院

title: Methods and systems for immersive reality in a medical environment
abstract: Embodiments are disclosed herein for providing an immersive reality experience to a patient during a medical procedure. In one example, a method includes determining a location of a stressful object in a medical environment that includes a patient undergoing a medical procedure. The method further includes, upon determining that the stressful object is in a field of view (FOV) of the patient, adjusting display content based on the location of the stressful object within the FOV and outputting the display content for display on an immersive device.

title: Joint image key point automatic detection method and device based on deep learning
assignee: 杭州键嘉医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a joint image key point automatic detection method, device and equipment based on deep learning and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample image, wherein the sample image comprises labeling information of key point positions; inputting the sample image into a preset key point detection model, wherein the key point detection model comprises a U-Net network; performing key point detection on the sample image by using the preset key point detection model to obtain a first thermodynamic diagram of predicted key points of the sample image; and training the network weight of the preset key point detection model according to the first thermodynamic diagram of the predicted key point of the sample image and the set loss function to obtain a target key point detection model. The technology of the invention can realize the automatic extraction of the key points in the joint image, improve the consistency of the key point detection and reduce the influence of human factors.
assignee_clean: 杭州键嘉医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州键嘉医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Cloud retina OCT (optical coherence tomography) identification intelligent diagnosis system based on software and hardware platform and application method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a cloud retina OCT (optical coherence tomography) identification intelligent diagnosis system based on a software and hardware platform and a use method thereof, wherein the cloud retina OCT identification intelligent diagnosis system comprises an optical coherence tomography scanner, a doctor client computer, a cloud retina OCT identification server and a switch; the optical coherence tomography scanner is connected with a doctor client computer, and the doctor client computer is connected with the cloud retina OCT identification server through a switch. The intelligent diagnosis system based on the embedded software and hardware platform for the OCT cloud server of the ophthalmic retina can rapidly and correctly identify the OCT images of choroidal neovascularization, diabetic macular edema, drusen and normal retina, and can be used for screening and preventing diseases before diagnosis, assisting diagnosis of medical images during diagnosis, analysis of test results, assisting operation, medical follow-up after diagnosis, chronic disease monitoring, rehabilitation assistance, health management and the like.

title: Method for configuring a medical imaging device, system for configuring a medical imaging device, computer program product and computer readable medium
abstract: A method is disclosed for configuring a medical imaging device. In at least one embodiment, the method includes providing an input data set specifying a clinical task, the input data set including quantified image requirements; transferring the input data set to a server; providing a configuration data set by the server depending on the input data set; transferring the configuration data set from the server to the medical imaging device within a defined time interval; and configuring the medical imaging device based on the configuration data set.

title: Model training system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention discloses a model training system based on artificial intelligence, which is characterized by comprising the following components: at least one front end subsystem, at least one interaction subsystem, and a data management subsystem; collecting medical image data, grouping the collected medical image data according to the type information of the medical image, taking the medical image data in each group as a grouping initial training sample, and generating a plurality of first sub-models based on a pre-training model; extracting at least one first medical image from the medical image data within the at least one group; according to the first medical image, a first dynamic form of a first interaction task is created and maintained; receiving at least one user voice instruction, and updating the first dynamic form according to the voice instruction; and updating a first sub-model according to the first dynamic form. By the method, the data marking of the medical image can be simplified, the sample data of model training can be enriched, and the deep learning effect can be improved.

title: Intestinal tract cleanliness scoring method and device and computer equipment
assignee: 青岛美迪康数字工程有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and provides an intestinal tract cleanliness scoring method, an intestinal tract cleanliness scoring device and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sampling the acquired intestinal medical images frame by frame to obtain a plurality of image frames of the intestinal tract; invoking a pre-trained intestinal tract cleanliness scoring network model to score intestinal tract cleanliness of the image frames in sequence, and obtaining intestinal tract cleanliness scores of the image frames; dividing the image frames into different frame sets according to the similarity among the image frames; calculating the average score of the intestinal cleanliness scores of all the image frames in each frame set to obtain a frame set score; and carrying out weighted average calculation on the scores of the frame sets to obtain the final score of the intestinal medical image. The invention can objectively realize the grading of the cleanliness of the intestinal canal, has high accuracy and reliability, accurately evaluates the preparation condition of the colonoscope intestinal canal, and has important significance for guiding clinical operation.
assignee_clean: 青岛美迪康数字工程有限公司
primary_assignee: 青岛美迪康数字工程有限公司

title: Methods and systems for thermal monitoring of tissue with an ultrasound imaging system
abstract: Various methods and systems are provided for thermal monitoring of tissue with an ultrasound imaging system. In one embodiment, a method comprises acquiring, via an ultrasound probe, an ultrasound image, selecting at least one region of interest in the ultrasound image, extracting features from the at least one region of interest, classifying a thermal state of tissue in the at least one region of interest based on the features, and outputting, via a display device, the thermal state of the tissue. In this way, ultrasound imaging may be used for real-time thermal monitoring of tissue during an ablation procedure, thereby improving the accuracy and efficacy of the ablation procedure.

title: Auxiliary analysis method and equipment for prostate cancer based on perception neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a prostate cancer auxiliary analysis method and equipment based on a perception neural network, wherein a plurality of disease indexes and medical image indexes are combined to be input points, the weight value and the bias value of the neural network are continuously adjusted under the medical big data background, and an intelligent analysis model based on the neural network is formed by adjusting the proportion of the weight value and the bias value, so that a doctor can be helped to diagnose a prostate patient more accurately. Although the auxiliary analysis method and the auxiliary analysis device can provide possible clinical stages and historical decision-making results of cancers, the auxiliary analysis method and the auxiliary analysis device can only be used as an auxiliary diagnosis decision-making system of doctors and cannot completely replace the doctors. However, by predicting the possible stage of cancer and screening the images, the most effective part of the screened images is provided for doctors to reference, so that the workload of the doctors is greatly reduced, the efficiency of the hospitals is improved, and the diagnosis accuracy of the doctors is greatly improved.

title: Preservation of privacy in large datasets
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a blockchain node, a file as a part of a blockchain transaction, splitting, by the blockchain node, the file into a plurality of chunks based on a file size, transmitting, by the blockchain node, the plurality of the chunks to at least one peer-to-peer data store node on a blockchain network, and generating a storage plan based on locations of individual chunks of the plurality of the chunks on the at least one peer-to-peer data store node.

title: Offline verification with document filter
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of obtaining a machine-readable code from a first document among a set of documents, extracting a probabilistic data structure from the machine-readable code which includes probabilistic hashes accumulated from the set of documents, determining whether a document hash of a second document is included within the probabilistic data structure, and in response to a determination that the document hash is included within the probabilistic data structure, outputting a notification indicating the second document is included in the set of documents.

title: Preservation of privacy in large datasets
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a file processing node, a document file identification (ID) from a file owner node over a blockchain, acquiring, by the file processing node, a file storage plan executable script and an encrypted symmetric key for the document, decrypting the symmetric key by the file processing node, and executing the file storage plan executable script using the decrypted symmetric key as an input.

title: Reinforcement learning approach to decode sentence ambiguity
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs language encoded on a computer storage medium for a logic sentence length reduction system whereby input text is modified to a logical and grammatical state using a reinforcement learning system with a real-time grammar engine and a real-time logic engine. The logic sentence length reduction system breaks sentences into fragments. An agent performs actions to each sentence fragment such that fragments are reconstructed into complete sentences. The real-time logic and real-time grammar engine are provided a reward for producing a grammatical and logical sentence. The reinforcement-learning agent optimizes a policy to reconstruct logical and grammatical sentences from sentence fragments maximizing future reward.

title: Lung ultrasonic visualization three-dimensional reconstruction method and system
assignee: 四川大学华西医院, 成都中创五联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a lung ultrasonic visual three-dimensional reconstruction method and a system, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing. The invention collects the complete lung ultrasonic image in real time, carries out image processing and data annotation on the collected lung ultrasonic image, detects and tracks the processed lung ultrasonic image by using an image segmentation model, creates a medical three-dimensional visual image of the lung, extracts parameters related to A-type lines, B-type lines, C-type symptoms and P-type symptoms, grades the lung lesion according to the parameters so as to better carry out real-time detection on the lung condition of a person to be detected, intuitively reflects the distribution condition of each subsection ABCP type of the lung in real time, and can carry out abnormity early warning. The three-dimensional reconstruction method and the system have high processing efficiency, a multi-level data model is adopted to judge the ultrasonic image, and the data is subjected to artificial intelligence high-efficiency judgment of three levels of primary screening, intermediate marking and fine delineation.
assignee_clean: 四川大学华西医院; 成都中创五联科技有限公司

title: Information processing method and device, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 上海商汤智能科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information processing method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The information processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring preset information of the displayed medical image; and dynamically generating a first template for medical report writing according to the preset information.
assignee_clean: 上海商汤智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海商汤智能科技有限公司

title: Multi-center collaborative prognosis prediction system under data sharing strategy
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-center collaborative prognosis prediction system under a data sharing strategy. The system can realize privacy protection data sharing under a plurality of medical institution centers, thereby providing enough data for model construction. The invention adopts an integrated learning algorithm which can obtain better prediction results relative to weak classifiers to construct a system. The system processes sensitive patient-level data in each center, simultaneously constructs sub-classifiers of the integrated learning model, and only exchanges less sensitive intermediate results to construct a complete integrated learning model, thereby ensuring that the proposed multi-center model and the centralized model have the same or even better results. The multi-center collaborative prognosis prediction system protects the individual privacy of patients, does not need to run an algorithm model on a large centralized data source, and provides a reliable solution for constructing a prediction model in a single medical institution with too few samples in practical clinical application.

title: Pre-training method and device for medical multi-modal model
assignee: 中国医学科学院医学信息研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a pre-training method and a device of a medical multi-modal model, which comprise the following steps: acquiring initial medical image-text sample data, wherein the initial medical image-text sample data comprises a plurality of groups of medical image-text pairs, and each group of medical image-text pairs comprises a medical image and text information; performing multi-stage task training based on initial medical image-text sample data to obtain an initial pre-training model; optimizing initial medical image-text sample data based on the initial pre-training model and the artificially labeled medical image-text pairs in the initial medical image-text sample data to obtain target medical image-text sample data; and adjusting the model parameters of the initial pre-training model by using the target medical image-text sample data to obtain the target medical multi-mode pre-training model. According to the method, the associated information of the medical image and the multi-granularity text is fully captured by training in stages, and the influence of noise in sample data can be reduced, so that the model learning accuracy and efficiency are improved.
assignee_clean: 中国医学科学院医学信息研究所
primary_assignee: 中国医学科学院医学信息研究所

title: Dynamic and mixed rendering mechanisms for medical images
abstract: Methods and systems for providing dynamic and mixed rendering of medical images on a client device. The client device receives user input selecting a medical image and determines whether system capabilities of the client device satisfy conditions for performing client-side rendering of the medical image. In response to determining that the system capabilities satisfy the conditions for performing client-side rendering, the client device retrieves raw image data corresponding to the medical image from an image repository and provides the data to the image viewer application for client-side rendering of the medical image within the image viewer application. In response to determining that the system capabilities do not satisfy the conditions for performing client-side rendering of the medical image, the client device provides a server-side rendered version of the raw medical image data corresponding to the medical to the image viewer.

title: Image segmentation method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses an image segmentation method and system based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: inputting an image to be segmented into an image segmentation model to obtain an image segmentation result; image segmentation model establishment process: s1, constructing a training set and a testing set; s2, constructing an image segmentation convolution network; the image segmentation convolution network comprises a down-sampling link, an up-sampling link and N connecting links, wherein the down-sampling link is provided with N down-sampling processing blocks, and the up-sampling link is provided with N up-sampling processing blocks; the Nth downsampling processing block is connected with the Nth upsampling processing block through an Nth connecting link; the nth downsampling processing block is connected with the nth upsampling processing block through an nth connecting link, and k convolution blocks are arranged on the nth connecting link, wherein n is [1, N-1]; and S3, training the image segmentation convolutional network by using a training set. K convolution blocks are arranged in the connection link, and the original image is spliced after the k convolution operations are carried out, so that the information is more comprehensively supplemented, and the segmentation accuracy and reliability are improved.

title: Laser fiber-to-target distance control
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods for determining a distance between a distal end of an endoscope and a target during an endoscopic procedure are disclosed. A surgical laser feedback control system comprises a feedback analyzer and a controller. The feedback analyzer can receive at least two reflected signals from a target in response to electromagnetic radiation directed at the target. The at least two reflected signals correspond to respective different distances between a distal end of a device of a surgical laser system and the target. The feedback analyzer can determine a distance between the distal end of the device of the surgical laser system and the target based on the at least two reflected signals. The controller can generate a control signal to the surgical laser system to perform a predetermined operation based on the determined distance.

title: Endoscopic laser energy delivery system and methods of use
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods for delivering laser energy to a target in an endoscopic procedure are disclosed. An exemplary method comprises providing a first laser pulse train and a different second laser pulse train emitting from a distal end of an endoscope and incident on a target. The first laser pulse train has a first laser energy level, and the second laser pulse train has a second laser energy level higher than the first laser energy level. In an example, the first laser pulse train is used to form cracks on a surface of a calculi structure, and the second laser pulse train causes fragmentation of the calculi structure after the cracks are formed.

title: Data source modeling to detect disruptive changes in data dynamics
abstract: In one embodiment, a network assurance service receives, from a reporting entity, data regarding a monitored network for input to a machine learning-based analyzer of the network assurance service. The service forms a reporting entity model of the reporting entity, based on at least a portion of the data received from the reporting entity. The service identifies a behavioral change of the reporting entity by comparing a sample of the data received from the reporting entity to the reporting entity model. The service correlates the behavioral change of the reporting entity to a change made to the reporting entity. The service causes performance of a mitigation action, to prevent the behavioral change from affecting operation of the machine learning-based analyzer.

title: Method for diagnosing, predicting, determining prognosis, monitoring, or staging disease based on vascularization patterns
abstract: Methods, computer programs, and systems for detecting disease in vasculature. The method includes obtaining images of the vasculature. The method includes extracting vessel measurements from the obtained images. The method includes determining features of the vasculature in the obtained images based on the extracted vessel measurements. The method includes applying artificial intelligence algorithms to determine if the disease is present in the vasculature based on these vascular features.

title: Method of controlling intelligent security device
abstract: A method of controlling an intelligent security device can include capturing a video; collecting voice information included in the video; in response to determining that the voice information includes a wake-up word corresponding to a predetermined basic wake-up word for the intelligent security device, transmitting a spoken utterance included in the voice information to a smart device; receiving a command from the smart device, the command being generated based on information related to the spoken utterance; and executing an operation of the intelligent security device based on the command.

title: Automatic validation and enrichment of semantic relations between medical entities for drug discovery
abstract: Embodiments of the present systems and methods may provide techniques that provide enrichment of semantic graphing with relations that can enable a higher resolution of the semantic relationships and enable a more accurate prediction of new relations in the graph. For example a method for drug discovery and drug repositioning may comprise generating semantic relationships, at the computer system, based on data relating to a plurality of aspects of drugs and pharmaceutical compounds, generated semantic relationships represented in the form of a semantic graph, learning, at the computer system, new relations among the semantic relationships in the semantic graph using Denoising Autoencoders to process the semantic graph, and generating, at the computer system, predictions for drug discovery and drug repositioning based on the semantic relationships, including the newly found relations.

title: Fleet and asset management and interfaces thereof associated with edge computing deployments
abstract: A process can include obtaining a plurality of data points each associated with a respective edge device of a fleet of edge devices, each respective edge device associated with an edge site location or edge device asset group. The plurality of data points are stored to a fleet map data catalog and a filtering selection for viewing a filtered subset of the fleet map data catalog is received, indicating a selected geographic view area and selected edge device types from a plurality of edge device types. Data points corresponding to the filtered subset are obtained from the fleet map data catalog using the filtering selection. A fleet map GUI view is generated using the data points corresponding to the filtered subset, the fleet map GUI view comprising a converged geographic map of the selected geographic view area, with data points are rendered at corresponding locations within the converged geographic map.

title: Cardiac output control apparatus and method of use thereof
abstract: The invention comprises an apparatus and a method for operating a cardiac assist pump, comprising the steps of: (1) providing a cardiac monitor comprising: a cardiac output sensor including an activity sensor and at least two of: a pulse oximeter; an electrocardiogram meter; and a blood pressure monitor; (2) receiving time-varying cardiovascular input data, from the cardiac output sensor, related to a transient hemodynamic state of a cardiovascular system; (3) receiving and operating on time-varying activity input data, from the activity sensor, to generate cardiovascular state information; (4) sensing activity with the activity sensor to generate a target cardiovascular state; (5) repeating both the steps of receiving and operating to update the transient cardiovascular state information and the step of sensing to update the target cardiovascular state; and (6) directing the cardiac assist pump to adjust assisted blood flow, yielding the updated transient cardiovascular state, toward the target cardiovascular state.

title: Image processing method and image processing apparatus
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide an image processing method and an image processing apparatus that make it possible to efficiently learn images having different identities. In learning and recognition using a hierarchical network, it is known that, based on experiences, a layer near the input functions as a feature extractor for extracting a feature that is necessary for recognition, and a layer near the output performs recognition by combining extracted features. Thus, performing learning by setting a higher learning rate to a layer near the input side of the hierarchical network than a learning rate in a layer near the output side in second learning processing as in an aspect of the present invention corresponds to mainly relearning (adjusting) a feature extraction portion in data sets having different identities. Accordingly, the difference between data sets can be absorbed, and learning can be performed more efficiently than in the case of simply performing transfer learning.

title: Medical image classification method based on transducer
assignee: 广州锟元方青医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image classification method based on a transducer, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing a sample image of a liquid-based cytological smear sample prepared from pleuroperitoneal cavity effusion to obtain a binary mask map corresponding to the sample image and a binary mask map mask corresponding to each cell in the binary mask map; acquiring a first coordinate frame for framing each cell in the binary mask map, and acquiring a second coordinate frame for framing each suspected cancer cell in the binary mask map; calculating the IOU overlapping degree of each first coordinate frame and each second coordinate frame; performing de-duplication on the first coordinate frame and the second coordinate frame; and finally classifying the cell area image selected by each coordinate frame after the duplication removal through a transducer cell classification model, and realizing the accurate and rapid classification of the lesion cells in the sample image by using a deep learning technology.
assignee_clean: 广州锟元方青医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 广州锟元方青医疗科技有限公司

title: Medical image registration method, system and computer readable medium
assignee: 嘉兴太美医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a medical image registration method, a system and a computer readable medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image and a second image; extracting rigid organs in the first image and the second image; performing rigid registration on the rigid body organ according to the extraction result; and performing non-rigid registration of the target object according to the rigid registration result. According to the method, rigid registration and non-rigid registration are carried out on the medical image, so that the matching accuracy of the target object is greatly improved, and the accuracy of lesion progress evaluation during film reading is improved; by using the rigid organ to perform rigid registration, the matching accuracy of the target object is further improved, and the accuracy of lesion progress evaluation during radiographing is further improved.
assignee_clean: 嘉兴太美医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 嘉兴太美医疗科技有限公司

title: Curation and provision of digital content
abstract: A method includes accessing a structured content item from a first database and event data from a second database, the event data including sets of event attributes in a multi-dimensional namespace and associated with a respective point in time; determining a relevancy profile characterizing a metric of relevancy of the structured content item over a respective time interval, the metric of relevancy including a distance in the multi-dimensional namespace between attributes associated with the structured content and the sets of event attributes; generating, using the relevancy profile, second digital content including a subset of the structured content item; and providing the second digital content for rendering on a device. Related apparatus, systems, techniques and articles are also described.

title: Early prediction method for gestational diabetes mellitus
assignee: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses an early prediction method of gestational diabetes mellitus, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining clinical index test results of the study subjects for 11-18 weeks; step S2: preprocessing the index obtained by detection in the step S1; step S3: selecting indexes related to gestational diabetes mellitus, evaluating each index by using a Fisher value, and sequencing the indexes according to the Fisher value of each index from large to small; step S4: the first 11 indexes are selected and input into a machine learning model, and the machine learning model is trained according to the selected input indexes, so that the prediction capability of the indexes on gestational diabetes is verified; step S5: obtaining a prediction model of gestational diabetes mellitus through the result of the step S4; step S6: substituting the other group of new clinical index test results into the prediction model for verification so as to evaluate the accuracy of the prediction model; step S7: whether the pregnant woman is ill or not is predicted by the prediction model.
assignee_clean: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院
primary_assignee: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院

title: Health trends identification
abstract: Methods and apparatus for identifying health trends via the identification of ambiguous food items via container identification may be provided by: receiving an image captured from a user device that includes a food item; identifying a food container present in the image; identifying a utensil present in the image; determining a cluster of food items from a food recognition database corresponding to the food container and to the utensil; selecting a candidate food item from the cluster based on a confidence score of the candidate food item matching the food item; and adding the candidate food item to a dietary log associated with the user device.

title: Interpretable medical data structuring method and system based on knowledge base
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical data processing, and particularly relates to an interpretable medical data structuring method and system based on a knowledge base. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: inputting medical texts to be structured; generating a regular expression under the guidance of a medical knowledge base; using a knowledge extraction model, and adopting the regular expression to carry out structuring processing on the medical text to be structured; and outputting the result of the structuring processing. The invention also provides a system for realizing the method. The invention realizes the structural technical scheme which can be explained, reasonable, strong in robustness and adaptable to different types of texts aiming at the medical text data, and has good application prospect.

title: Methods and systems for using sound data to analyze health condition and welfare states in collections of farm animals
abstract: Systems and methods are described for selecting a sound type of interest from a first (e.g., master/global) machine learning library comprising information derived from reference audio stream data acquired from a plurality of farm animal operation reference sound monitoring events, including from a first farm animal operation monitoring event of a first farm animal operation, wherein the sound type of interest is associated with a condition state of interest of a first collection of farm animals. Further, information associated with the selected sound type of interest can be included a second machine learning library, wherein the second machine learning library is operational on an edge computing device located in proximity to a second farm animal operation. Audio stream data can be acquired from the second farm animal operation in a second farm animal operation monitoring event, and processed using the second machine learning library information to determine whether the sound type of interest is present in the acquired audio stream data, thereby generating information associated with the presence or absence of the condition during the second farm animal operation monitoring event.

title: Auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 上海洛书医药科技有限公司, 张继亮
abstract: The invention relates to an auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system based on artificial intelligence, which at least comprises: patient client (1), database (3), server (4) and medical client (2), wherein, patient client (1) can record patient residence information, database (3) can be with the mode storage that takes medicine of specific patient and take medicine data, wherein, server (4) is configured to: counting medication data of the specific patient aiming at the same disease type, so as to obtain the frequency and/or the number of continuous repeated taking of the same or similar medicines by the specific patient in a set time period; in case the server (4) determines, based on the analysis performed by its analysis module, that the frequency and/or number of consecutive repeated administrations of the same or similar medicament by the specific patient is greater than a set threshold, a reminder is issued via the medical client (2) and/or the patient client (1).
assignee_clean: 上海洛书医药科技有限公司; 张继亮
primary_assignee: 上海洛书医药科技有限公司

title: Tumor detection system, method, equipment and medium based on image-text multi-mode fusion
assignee: 智慧眼科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a tumor detection system, method, equipment and storage medium based on image-text multi-mode fusion, relates to the field of medical artificial intelligent detection, and comprises the following steps: the device comprises an electronic medical record feature extraction module, an image feature extraction module, a feature fusion module and a tumor detection module. The electronic medical record feature extraction module obtains text feature vectors of the electronic medical record; the image feature extraction module acquires an electronic computer tomography image feature vector, a nuclear magnetic resonance image feature vector and a biopsy pathology image feature vector; the feature fusion module acquires the fused feature vector; the tumor detection module is used for detecting tumor probability. Therefore, the method and the device fully absorb and fuse the effective characteristics of the four modes by fully learning the data of the symptom complaint information, the electronic computer tomography, the nuclear magnetic resonance and the pathology biopsy image of the patient, so that the liver tumor detection reaches higher accuracy.
assignee_clean: 智慧眼科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 智慧眼科技股份有限公司

title: a real time temperature checking with smart band type thermometer and a location data management system and the body temperature data system capable of diseases using thereof
abstract: The present invention provides a body temperature information system, which includes a band-type thermometer, a mobile device unit, a KCDC server, and a beacon unit, and uses a smart band type thermometer which provides patient departure information and patient diagnosis learning information. The present invention performs a function to secure the number of beds in nearby hospitals by predicting the possibility of confirmation by continuously measuring the body temperature of patients suspected of having various viral infectious diseases, including corona patients, in self-quarantine.

title: System and method for predicting the development of dementia using smart devices
abstract: The present invention relates to a dementia occurrence prediction system. The dementia occurrence prediction system includes: a plurality of monitoring collection devices collecting condition data of a user including living data, bio-signal data and behavior data of the user; a communication part obtaining the condition data collected from the plurality of monitoring collection devices through a network; and a dementia prediction device predicting the dementia occurrence of the user by applying the condition data to an artificial intelligence-based learning model. The dementia prediction device derives a feature variable related with dementia based on the condition data, and predicts the dementia occurrence of the user based on a relation between the derived feature variable and the probability of dementia occurrence. Therefore, the dementia occurrence prediction system is capable of enabling self-monitoring for population-based health improvement.

title: Colorectal cancer detection system based on XGBoost
abstract: The application relates to a colorectal cancer detection system based on XGBoost, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a feature selection module, a model construction module and a result prediction module, wherein the data acquisition module, the data preprocessing module, the feature selection module, the model construction module and the result prediction module are respectively used for: constructing a colorectal cancer data set; preprocessing data; performing feature selection by using RFE recursive feature selection to obtain a plurality of sub-data sets; constructing an XGBoost model, training the XGBoost model by using a sub-data set, and optimizing parameters of the XGBoost model by a genetic algorithm to obtain a detection model; the detection model is used to predict the type of death of colorectal cancer. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device for detecting colorectal cancer death by using the RFE recursive feature selection have the advantages that the RFE recursive feature selection is used for carrying out feature selection on data, intelligent detection of colorectal cancer death types is achieved by combining a machine learning algorithm XGBoost, model parameters are optimized by using a genetic algorithm, death types of colorectal cancer can be rapidly and effectively analyzed and predicted, minority classes in multiple types can be more accurately identified, and the method and the device have high accuracy, precision, recall rate and F1 value.

title: Multifunctional medical intelligent bracelet
assignee: 山东第一医科大学(山东省医学科学院)
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-functional medical intelligent bracelet, include: the intelligent bracelet comprises a watch annular band, wherein a cavity is formed in the watch annular band, an intelligent bracelet main body is installed in the cavity, and a temperature difference power generation device is embedded in the watch annular band; the intelligent bracelet main body comprises a microprocessor, and the microprocessor is respectively connected to a signal adjusting module, an alarm device, a two-dimensional code display module, an emergency call module and an information uploading module; the signal adjusting module is respectively connected to the infrared temperature measuring module, the pulse detecting module, the electrocardio detecting module, the posture detecting module and the positioning module; thermoelectric generation device is connected with the battery electricity that sets up on the girdle, the battery is connected with intelligent bracelet main part electricity. Compared with other self-generating designs, the self-generating design for the body temperature of the human body has the advantages of being clean in energy, free of pollution, light, safe to use and capable of supplying energy continuously, and the problem of charging is solved.
assignee_clean: 山东第一医科大学 山东省医学科学院
primary_assignee: 山东第一医科大学 山东省医学科学院

title: Predicting and addressing severe disease in individuals with sepsis
assignee: The Henry M. Jackson Foundation For The Advancement Of Military Medicine, Inc.
abstract: The present disclosure describes methods and systems for predicting severe disease in an individual with sepsis or at risk of developing sepsis, in order to prevent severe disease in an individual with sepsis. The present disclosure also describes methods of using topological data analysis and/or clustering to stratify sepsis based on biomolecular signatures and identify distinct phenotypes in sepsis patients.
assignee_clean: the henry m jackson foundation for the advancement of military medicine
primary_assignee: the henry m jackson foundation for the advancement of military medicine

title: Deep learning method for identifying oral squamous cell carcinoma based on visual features
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning method for identifying oral squamous cell carcinoma based on visual features, which comprises the following steps: 1) establishing a development set and a test set; 2) constructing a data training sample; 3) training a target detection network model; 4) carrying out batch initial positioning on the oral cavity photos of the development set through the target detection model, and constructing a classification network data sample by using the positioned image areas; 5) expanding and classifying network data samples; 6) DenseNet is used as a backbone network of a classification network, and is improved, so that the model is more concentrated on difficult misclassified samples; 7) training the classification network on the expansion sample to obtain an oral squamous cell carcinoma classification network; 8) checking the classification network; 9) the classification network is applied to classify the mouth photographs. The method has high sensitivity and good specificity for detecting oral squamous cell carcinoma from the oral photos, and is suitable for detecting and screening various oral squamous cell carcinomas.

title: Coexistence mediator for facilitating blockchain transactions
abstract: A system and related method coordinate data and transactions between an enterprise transaction system (ETS) of an enterprise and a blockchain network (BN). A coexistence mediator intercepts an ETS transaction comprising ETS transaction information (ETS-TI) associated with an enterprise. The ETS-TI includes transaction context information (ETS-TCI) regarding the ETS transaction. The system determines an ETS transaction context from the ETS-TCI. Responsive to determining the ETS transaction context represents an in-flight ETS transaction, rerouting, the coexistence mediator reroutes the transaction from the ETS to the BN. The rerouting comprises converting the ETS-TI to BN transaction information (BN-TI), and interfacing with the BN to record a processed BN transaction as a transaction record. The coexistence mediator, upon recording the BN transaction, provides a new BN-TI associated with the BN transaction. The new BN-TI comprises a BN transaction id. The system further switches the ETS transaction context to a BN transaction context.

title: Method for transmitting a synchronization signal block (SSB) based on a fixed frame period (FFP) by a communication device in a wireless communication system and apparatus using the same
abstract: Provided is a synchronization signal block (SSB) transmission method performed by a communication device in a wireless communication system. The method is characterized in that: a time duration of a fixed frame period (FFP) is set for another communication device; and the SSB is periodically transmitted to the other communication device, wherein the SSB is periodically transmitted on each Nth FFP, said N being an integer greater than or equal to 1, and the transmission start time of the SSB is the first time resource included in each Nth FFP.

title: Conflict-free version control
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving from a user node, by a blockchain processor node, a document access request containing a document ID, acquiring, by the blockchain processor node, from a blockchain ledger an encrypted URL of the document and a source hash of the document based on the document ID, verifying, by the blockchain processor node, a document received from a document owner's node storage based on a decrypted URL of the document and, in response to the verification, transmitting the document received from the document owner's node storage to the user node.

title: Medical data quality evaluation method and system
assignee: 武汉博科国泰信息技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a medical data quality evaluation method and a system, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the treatment data of the user based on medical information uploaded on a medical service platform by a medical institution, wherein the treatment data comprises at least one of basic information and diagnosis and treatment information of the user; acquiring institution information of a medical institution uploading medical information, wherein the institution information comprises category information of diagnosis and treatment items of the medical institution; acquiring the credibility score of the medical institution by combining the institution information and the clinic data; and responding to a received grading query instruction sent by the user, and displaying the credibility grade to the user.
assignee_clean: 武汉博科国泰信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 武汉博科国泰信息技术有限公司

title: Medical image fusion method and medium based on multi-scale mechanism and residual attention
abstract: The invention claims a medical image fusion method and medium based on a multi-scale mechanism and residual attention, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, inputting the anatomical image and the functional image after registration into a convolution kernel with the size of 1 x 1, and increasing the dimension of the input feature; s2, respectively inputting the registered anatomical image and functional image into a multi-scale mechanism of two branches, extracting feature maps of the anatomical image and the functional image on different scales, and then inputting the extracted feature maps into a residual attention network to further extract features of the input image; s3, fusing the extracted feature maps of the anatomical image and the functional image; s4, reconstructing the fused feature map through three-layer convolution to obtain a final fused image. The invention effectively solves the problems of information loss, color distortion and the like when the pseudo-color image and the gray level image are fused by the medical image fusion method.

title: Systems and methods for computation of functional index parameter values for blood vessels
abstract: There is provided a method for calculation of a functional index parameter in at least one blood vessel of a patient, comprises: receiving a dataset of registered functional image data and anatomical image data, wherein the functional image data and the anatomical image data include data indicative of anatomical and functional data for at least one blood vessel of a certain patient; calculating at least one value for at least one functional index parameter for at least one of: (i) at least one blood vessel, and (ii) for the anatomical region of the at least one blood vessel, wherein the at least one value of the at least one functional index parameter is computed based on the functional image data of the dataset; and outputting the calculated at least one value for the at least one functional index parameter for the at least one blood vessel of the certain patient.

title: Newborn exercise development assessment system, method, device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a system, a method, a device and a storage medium for evaluating the newborn exercise development, wherein the system comprises: the video acquisition module is used for remotely acquiring a whole body movement video of the newborn; the video processing module is used for extracting the spatial coordinate position data of key points of all parts of the body in the whole body movement video of the neonate; the data analysis module is used for obtaining a curve of the space coordinate and the preset joint angle along with time change according to the space coordinate position data, extracting corresponding time domain characteristics and frequency domain characteristics according to the curve, and evaluating the whole body movement of the neonate according to the time domain characteristics, the frequency domain characteristics and a pre-trained whole body movement quality evaluation model of the neonate to obtain a whole body movement quality evaluation result; and the result storage and output module is used for storing and outputting the whole body movement video, the time domain characteristics, the frequency domain characteristics and the whole body movement quality evaluation result. By the technical scheme, the GMs of the neonates are automatically classified, and the accuracy of detecting abnormal behaviors of the neonates is improved.

title: Cardiac image processing method based on federal deep learning
assignee: 拓微摹心数据科技(南京)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a heart image processing method based on federal deep learning, which comprises the following steps: the central server side performs global initial model design of a multiscale information aggregation algorithm of heart image data, and issues the initial model to each participant; each participant uses the local data to train the global initial model to obtain a local updated model; the server side aggregates the local update models, and distributes the aggregated global update models to the participants for training; repeating the two steps until the global model converges to the preset condition. According to the invention, under the condition that original heart image data are held by all parties and cannot be taken out of the local area, the data characteristic information can be fully mined, the heart image segmentation effect is improved, the model performance is improved, and the data potential is released. The aggregation method can effectively test the local model of each participant, record and reject participants with poor effects, and effectively improve the aggregation efficiency and accuracy.
assignee_clean: 拓微摹心数据科技 南京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 拓微摹心数据科技 南京 有限公司

title: Image processing method, device and computer storage medium
assignee: 杭州海康慧影科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image processing method, an image processing device and a computer storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: determining whether the acquired first image has the grid lines or not by using the deep learning model, and eliminating the grid lines of the first image based on the characteristic information of the grid lines in the first image under the condition that the first image has the grid lines. According to the embodiment of the application, whether the first image has the grid lines is determined through the deep learning model, and then the grid lines of the first image are removed based on the characteristic information of the grid lines in the first image. The intelligent level of the image processing system is improved, whether the first image has the grid lines or not is not needed to be identified by people, and the speed of identifying the grid lines in the image is increased. Based on the characteristic information of the grid lines in the first image, the grid lines can be effectively and thoroughly removed. In addition, in the whole image processing process, the grid patterns of the first image can be automatically removed without manual participation.
assignee_clean: 杭州海康慧影科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州海康慧影科技有限公司

title: Upstream visibility in supply-chain
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a retailer node, an encrypted inventory of goods data from a plurality of supplier nodes over a blockchain network, computing, by the retailer node, an ordering proportion based on the encrypted inventory of goods data, generating, by the retailer node, an ordering policy based on the ordering proportion, and executing a smart contract to order goods from the plurality of the supplier nodes based on the ordering policy.

title: Upstream visibility in supply-chain
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of acquiring, by a retailer node, an inventory data from a supplier node over a blockchain network, receiving, by the retailer node, outstanding orders data of the supplier node, generating, by the retailer node, an order distribution policy based on the inventory data and the outstanding orders data, and executing a smart contract to order goods from the supplier node based on the ordering policy.

title: Integrated deep learning and clinical image viewing and reporting
abstract: Integrated deep learning and clinical image viewing and reporting are provided. In some embodiments, a clinical image is received. An annotated image is generated from the clinical image by application of a deep learning system. At least one clinical finding is generated from the clinical image by application of the deep learning system. The annotated image and the at least one clinical finding are provided to a user. A structured report is generated based on the annotated image and the at least one clinical finding.

title: Augmented reality risk vulnerability analysis
abstract: A system, method and program product for identifying a risk hazard vulnerability at a target environment and presenting a detected risk hazard. The method configures an evaluator mobile computing device to obtain, via the mobile device, a real-world view or image data of items/objects in a target real-world environment and, optionally, or in addition, obtain other context data associated with the target environment. The method invokes operations of a risk vulnerability model to detect a risk associated with the target object within the real-world view and based on any additional associated context data. The method causes the mobile device to further generate a visual, audible or haptics indication of the identified risk vulnerability and/or a calculated risk score of the target object for display on the mobile computing device and display the risk vulnerability indication on the real-world view displayed at the mobile device.

title: Identifying and utilizing the availability of enterprise resources
abstract: Entities may reference ledgers in order to better understand a historic use and/or status of an account. For example, a user may track historic spending or received payments based on referencing a ledger, or an enterprise may check a balance of an account for a user based on a ledger. However, the utility of ledgers in estimating an amount of funds available for a user's use is limited. Embodiments of a financial analyzer as described herein may provide entities with estimations of finances that include contributions from one or multiple income sources, including irregular sources. Some embodiments may provide recommendations to customers to meet needs based on a financial estimation.

title: System for providing virtual reality 3d model of fetus based on deep learning and method therefor
abstract: The present invention discloses a system for providing a virtual reality fetus image. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system for providing a fetus image based on deep learning to extract face features of a fetus based on deep learning for an ultrasonic image, generate a three-dimensional model corresponding to the ultrasonic image reflecting the face features of the fetus, and provide a virtual reality image using the three-dimensional model. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system may provide a differentiated and realistic fetus image service to a pregnant woman by setting a plurality of codewords reflecting features of each body part of a two-dimensional fetus image, performing a learning procedure according to a deep learning model based on the codewords to provide the three-dimensional model generated by the combination of physical components most similar to an actual face of the fetus, and display the fetus in three dimensions through HMD.

title: Physiological motion measurement system and method based on machine learning
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present application provides a system for physiological motion measurement. The system may acquire a reference image of the region of interest and a target image, the reference image corresponding to a reference motion phase of the region of interest, the target image corresponding to a target motion phase of the region of interest, wherein the reference motion phase may be different from the target motion phase. The system may determine one or more feature points associated with the region of interest from the reference image and determine a motion field of the feature points from the reference motion stage to the target motion stage using the motion prediction model. The input of the motion prediction model may include at least a reference image and a target image. The system may also determine a physiological condition of the region of interest based on the motion field.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Model training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a training method and device for a model, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original image data; carrying out data enhancement on the original image data to obtain preliminary training data; performing self-training treatment on a preset original coding model according to the initial training data to obtain an entity coding model; inputting the label sample into the entity coding model for supervised training to obtain a primary identification model; predicting the label-free sample through the primary recognition model to obtain network label data, and adding the network label data to the label sample to obtain a target label set; constructing a relative entropy loss function and a cross entropy loss function according to the preliminary training data and the target tag set; and updating parameters of the primary identification model according to the cross entropy loss function, the relative entropy loss function and the preset weight function to obtain a target model. According to the technical scheme, the accuracy of data annotation is improved.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Notifying entities of relevant events removing private information
abstract: The present invention extends to systems and methods for notifying entities of relevant events notifying entities of relevant events removing private information. A privacy infrastructure can apply data privacy operations to user information prior to, during, or after any of signal ingestion, event detection, or event notification. An entity defines a rule formula that is triggered when one or more detected events match the rule formula including defining one or more event types and one or more locations types. One or more events are detected. User information is detected in one of the events. The privacy infrastructure applies a data privacy operation on the user information. It is determined that the one or events satisfies the rule formula subsequent to applying the data privacy operation.

title: Artificial intelligence response system based on testing with parallel/serial dual microfluidic chip
abstract: An artificial intelligence response system comprises a centralized system having associated therewith a trained database, a tends engine, and a plurality of patient records, a plurality of interconnected entities connected over a network to the centralized system, and a voice-activated assistant device connected over the network to the centralized system and to the interconnected entities, the voice-activated assistant device including a memory operatively coupled to a processor, wherein the processor is configured to receive medical information pertaining to a patient's health from the centralized system, request a treatment regimen for the patient from the centralized system, receive a voice command from a medical professional to retrieve additional medical information, request additional medical information in response to the voice command, and request one or more actions related to treating a patient.

title: Cognitive learning workflow execution
abstract: Technical solutions are described for machine-assisted workflow execution, the workflow includes a sequence of workflow steps. An example method includes, pulling a preliminary update for the workflow from a data source and modifying the workflow dynamically. The method further includes selecting a workflow step for execution, and responsively, pulling updated information for the workflow step from the data source. The method further includes retrieving, from the data source, first reasoning information being indicative of whether to update the workflow step. If the first reasoning information is indicative of performing an update, updating the workflow step dynamically using the updated information, and executing the updated workflow step. The method further includes accumulating execution information including attributes of the execution of the workflow step, and second reasoning information for the updating of the workflow step, and pushing the execution information to the data source upon completion of the workflow step.

title: Cognitive learning workflow execution
abstract: Technical solutions are described for machine-assisted workflow execution. An example method includes selecting a workflow for interactive execution, the workflow including a sequence of workflow steps. The method further includes pulling a preliminary update for the workflow from a data source and modifying the workflow dynamically. The method further includes selecting a workflow step from the workflow for execution, and pulling updated information for the workflow step from the data source. The method further includes executing the workflow step using the pulled updated information, the execution includes changing a target system. The method further includes accumulating execution information including attributes associated with execution of the workflow step, and pushing the execution information to the data source upon completion of the workflow step.

title: Cognitive learning workflow execution
abstract: Technical solutions are described for a machine-assisted workflow execution. An example method includes selecting a workflow for interactive execution, the workflow includes a sequence of workflow steps, and responsively, identifying a preliminary update for the workflow from a data source. The method further includes authenticating the data source, and if the data source is a trusted data source, pulling the preliminary update from the data source and modifying the workflow dynamically. The method further includes selecting a workflow step for execution, and responsively, pulling an updated information for the workflow step from the data source. The method further includes executing the workflow step using the pulled updated information, the execution including changing a target system. The method further includes accumulating execution information and pushing the execution information to the data source upon completion of the workflow step.

title: Catheter location determination in paediatric patients
abstract: When inserting a catheter or other medical equipment into a child or adolescent or other paediatric patient, ECG signals may be recorded from the catheter and the location of the catheter determined by analysing the ECG signals. A signal processor and user interface may receive recorded signals in real-time from the catheter while the catheter is inserted into the paediatric patient. The signal processor may analyse the ECG signals to determine the location of the catheter in the paediatric patient. The user interface may display the location of the catheter and other pertinent information to a user while the user is inserting the catheter. One method for determining the location may include determining R-wave and P-wave peaks of the ECG signal and determining the location from an average location of the R-wave and P-wave peaks in the ECG signal.

title: Privacy-preserving document sharing
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a document processor node, a document comprising a document identifier (ID) and a document type, generating, by the document processor node, at least one hashed attribute for sharing of the document based on the document ID and the document type, acquiring, by the document processor node, a list of documents and corresponding document owners to be linked to the document based on the at least one hashed attribute, and creating a plurality of linked documents based on the list of the documents.

title: Supply-chain simulation
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of collecting, by a first node, a plurality of permissioned data inputs from a plurality of second nodes of a supply-chain, performing, by the first node, a granular simulation based on the permissioned data inputs to generate a plurality of key performance indicators (KPIs), and executing a smart contract to adjust order processes of the supply-chain based on the KPIs.

title: Tumor benign and malignant recognition method and system based on image data and deep learning
assignee: 中国科学院计算技术研究所
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for automatically judging benign and malignant tumors of a patient level based on deep learning for a medical image sequence. Firstly, collecting, arranging and marking image data of a patient, then obtaining the probability of benign and malignant tumors of the patient at different levels by using three information modules, namely a tumor area detection model, a sequence classification model and age information, and finally, comprehensively judging the benign and malignant tumors of the patient level by multi-model weighted fusion. The technology is helpful for pre-judging benign and malignant tumors based on image detection data in early stage of patients, so that corresponding treatment schemes are formulated, prognosis effects are improved, and meanwhile, the accuracy of early stage diagnosis of benign and malignant tumors by doctors through image data can be improved.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院计算技术研究所
primary_assignee: 中国科学院计算技术研究所

title: Secure data dissemination
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a lead peer, a new block from an orderer node over a blockchain network that includes a plurality of peers, acquiring, by the lead peer, a shared memory handler for a channel of the blockchain network from an anchor peer, appending, by the lead peer, the new block to a shared memory buffer based on the handler, and notifying the plurality of the peers that the new block is available on the shared memory buffer.

title: Blu-ray copy service
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a validation node, a copy request from a user node over a blockchain network, the request contains a copy token, invoking, by the validation node, a smart contract associated with the copy token to verify the copy token, in response to a verification, generating, by the validation node, media copy keys for generation of a Blu-ray copy, and recording, by the validation node, the copy token on a ledger of the blockchain network to indicate that the copy token is spent.

title: Probabilistic verification of linked data
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of storing a data block that is included within a sequential chain of data blocks and which comprises a probabilistic data structure stored therein, receiving a request to verify another data block, determining whether a probabilistic hash of the other data block is included within the probabilistic data structure of the stored data block, and in response to a determination that the hash of the other data block is included within the probabilistic data structure, storing an indicator that the other data block is included within the sequential chain of data blocks.

title: Method of determining a correspondence between frames of medical image data with and without contrast medium through probability distribution maps relating to position of a feature
abstract: A correspondence between frames of a set of medical image data is determined where the set of medical image data includes at least one frame acquired without contrast medium and at least one frame acquired with contrast medium. First data representing a first image frame acquired without contrast medium is received. Second data representing a second image frame acquired with contrast medium is received. A position of a feature of a medical device in the second image frame is determined at least partly on the basis of a position of the feature determined from the first image frame.

title: Methods and systems for biotherapeutic development
abstract: Disclosed are methods comprising determining experimental data associated with one or more monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), determining computationally-derived data associated with the one or more mAbs, wherein the computationally-derived data comprises one or more computational parameters weighted based on accessible surfaces (ASAs) of one or more residues of the one or more mAbs, determining, based on the experimental data and the computationally-derived data, a plurality of candidate predictive models, determining an optimal predictive model from the plurality of candidate predictive models, and outputting the optimal predictive model.

title: Methods for managing behavioral treatment therapy and devices thereof
abstract: A method, non-transitory computer readable medium and apparatus that manages behavioral treatment therapy includes generating a treatment plan comprising therapeutic techniques that is transmitted to at least one of a client at a client device or a practitioner at a practitioner device associated with the client.
