title: TransSR-Net structured image super-resolution reconstruction method
assignee: 太原理工大学, 山西阳煤联创信息技术有限公司
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of deep learning, and particularly relates to a super-resolution reconstruction method of a TransSR-Net structured image, which comprises the following steps: constructing a data set; constructing a neural network model TransSR-Net; training on the constructed TransSR-Net network by utilizing the belonging training set; acquiring a face image and a medical CT image to be reconstructed in super resolution, and performing super resolution reconstruction of a low resolution image through a trained TransSR-Net model; and establishing an evaluation index for evaluating the TransSR-Net model. The application is a CNN and Transformer combined model based on a self-coding dual-path structure, effectively reserves local structural features and global features of a structured image, fully enriches calculation information in the model, improves the training effect of the model, thereby reducing information loss in training, simultaneously utilizes a plurality of loss functions to jointly train, enhances the network fitting capability, and better solves the problem that a network structure constrained by priori knowledge of a single structured data set can only be applied to a specific structured image data set.
assignee_clean: 太原理工大学; 山西阳煤联创信息技术有限公司

title: Walking rehabilitation robot system
abstract: A walking rehabilitation robot system is provided, which can be worn by a user. The walking rehabilitation robot system includes two robot feet, any robot foot of the sound leg will generate a plurality of motion detection signals by first move so that another robot foot learns to move. A control device is electrically connected to each robot foot and receives the motion detection signals transmitted by the robot foot of first move. The control device calculates a first movement track by using the motion detection signals, and then calculates the required motor torque to generate a second movement track according to the first movement track. The control device controls the movement of the other robot foot based on the second movement track. The present invention is mainly designed for a user with a half body paralysis or an inconvenient mobility. The user uses a normal movement of sound half body so that the other robot foot can move the inconveniently moved part immediately.

title: Methods and systems for exploiting value in certain domains
abstract: Aspects relate to methods and systems for exploiting value within certain domains. An exemplary method includes interrogating, using a remote device, a user for scheduling data and at least a domain, wherein the at least a domain includes at least one domain and no more than a predetermined maximum number of domains, receiving, using the remote device, the at least a domain from the user, interrogating, using the remote device, the user for domain-specific data associated with the at least a domain, receiving, using the remote device, the domain-specific data from the user, generating, using a computing device, a domain target for the at least a domain as a function of the domain-specific data, generating, using the computing device, a user schedule as a function of the domain target and the scheduling data, and displaying, using the remote device, the user schedule and the domain target to the user.

title: Medical sign detection method, system, terminal and storage medium based on 3D variable convolution and time sequence feature fusion
assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司, 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司
abstract: The application provides a medical sign detection method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium based on 3D variable convolution and time sequence feature fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring 3D input data or pseudo 3D input data of medical images; constructing a variable convolutional network model, inputting standard medical symptom detection data into the variable convolutional neural network for training, and obtaining a trained variable convolutional neural network model; inputting the 3D input data or the pseudo 3D input data of the medical image into a trained variable convolutional neural network model; modeling the predicted data output by the variable convolutional neural network model by using time sequence fusion to form predicted data based on fusion time sequence characteristics of different scales; carrying out multi-scale pyramid progressive fusion on the predicted data of the fusion time sequence features with different resolutions to obtain candidate frames of medical symptoms; the application solves the problems of the calculation efficiency of the 3D network and the underutilization of the multi-layer related information loss of the pseudo 3D in the prior art.

title: Semantic enhancement hash medical image retrieval method based on mixed attention
abstract: The invention relates to a semantic enhanced hash medical image retrieval method based on mixed attention. Firstly dividing a data set into a training set and a test retrieval set, randomly selecting images from the training set to form a medical triplet, then constructing an integral network model, taking a medical triplet sample as input of the network model, finally training the integral network model, and obtaining a retrieval result by using a trained network. The invention utilizes the channel attention module and the space attention module to form a mixed attention mechanism, and can efficiently extract the information of the region of interest (ROI); the category-level semantic information is utilized to restrict the learning process of the hash codes, so that the similar hash codes of different categories can be distinguished; when the depth embedding is mapped to the discrete hash codes, quantization error between the depth embedding and the hash codes is reduced by using a quantization loss term, so that the precision of medical image retrieval can be further improved.

title: Unbalanced data-oriented disease prediction system
abstract: The invention discloses a disease prediction system for unbalanced data, which comprises a knowledge graph construction and relationship weight vector calculation module, wherein the knowledge graph construction and relationship weight vector calculation module is used for constructing a medical knowledge graph and calculating the relationship weight vector of each concept by using the medical knowledge graph; the map data representation module is used for acquiring the medical map data and learning the embedded representation of the medical map data; the image data augmentation module is used for using the GAN model to augment unbalanced data in the medical image data so as to keep the data balanced; the image neural network training module is used for training a second image neural network model by using the amplified medical image data; and the disease prediction module is used for inputting the graph data of the patient into the trained second graph neural network model to perform disease prediction. The quality of the generated edges is improved by using the rich relation information in the knowledge graph; by combining the countermeasure generation network model, a more real graph data sample can be generated, and the disease prediction effect of the system is improved.

title: Training a machine learning algorithm using digitally reconstructed radiographs
abstract: Disclosed is a computer-implemented method of training a likelihood-based computational model for determining the position of an image representation of an annotated anatomical structure in a two-dimensional x-ray image, wherein the method encompasses inputting medical DRRs together with annotation to a machine learning algorithm to train the algorithm, i.e. to generate adapted leamable parameters of the machine learning model. The annotations may be derived from metadata associated with the DRRs or may be included in atlas data which is matched with the DRRs to establish a relation between the annotations included in the atlas data and the DRRs. The thus generated machine learning algorithm may then be used to analyse clinical or synthesized DRRs so as to appropriately add annotations to those DRRs and/or identify the position of an anatomical structure in those DRRs.

title: Method and system for characterizing skin-related conditions
abstract: Embodiments of methods and systems for characterizing skin-related conditions for a user may include one or more of: a processing network operable to collect containers containing substances from a collection of users, the processing network comprising a sequencing system operable to determine a sequence of a microorganism by sequencing the substances; a microbiome characterization system operable to determine at least one of microbiome composition data and microbiome functional diversity data based on a microbiome sequence, collect supplemental data associated with skin-related conditions of the user set; and converting at least one of the supplemental data and microbiome composition data and microbiome functional diversity data into a characterization model; and a treatment system that characterizes the user for the skin-related disorder based on using the characterization model, the treatment system operable to facilitate treatment of the skin-related disorder of the user.

title: Automatic analysis of a set of systems used to implement a process
abstract: A device may receive first data associated with a set of systems used to implement a process. The device may determine a system topology for the set of systems. The device may identify a set of control points associated with the set of systems. The set of control points may include a set of points in the system topology where second data is received or provided by the set of systems. The second data may include information to be used by the set of systems during the process. The device may identify a set of values for a set of metrics related to the set of systems. The set of values may be identified based on the first data. The device may identify an error related to the set of control points or the set of metrics. The device may perform an action to facilitate fixing of the error.

title: Zero sample learning method based on data enhancement
abstract: The invention discloses a zero sample learning method based on data enhancement, which is characterized by drawing the outline of a focus, processing the focus outline by adopting a morphological operation method on the outline, and then filling the focus with color by using a continuous gradient color filling method; enriching the diversity of the color-filled focus by using a matrix linear transformation method, generating a plurality of simulated focus pictures, fusing the simulated focus pictures and the disease background pictures by using an image fusion technology, and adding Gaussian white noise to the fused pictures to obtain an expanded sample set; training a VGG classifier by using the extended sample set, and training an optimal classifier; testing the dermatological case using the optimal classifier. The invention effectively solves the problem of zero-sample learning auxiliary diagnosis of rare diseases.

title: Blood flow parameter calculation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a calculation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of blood flow parameters. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image to be detected, and dividing a blood vessel region in the original image to be detected to obtain a blood vessel image to be detected; determining at least one to-be-detected point according to the to-be-detected blood vessel image, and determining to-be-detected neighborhood images corresponding to each to-be-detected point in the to-be-detected blood vessel image; inputting the neighborhood image to be detected into a trained preset feature extraction model to obtain an output preset feature vector; and inputting the output preset feature vector into the trained neural network model to obtain the output blood flow parameters corresponding to the detection points to be detected. According to the embodiment of the invention, the blood flow parameters at the position of the to-be-detected point are obtained through the neural network model, so that the problem of complex calculation of the blood flow parameters is solved, and the accuracy of calculation of the blood flow parameters is improved.
assignee_clean: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Pill dispensing assembly
abstract: A pill dispensing assembly comprises a pill bottle that is securely locked between a base and an attachable sleeve. The pill bottle and base form an enclosure in which pills are stored above a top portion of a dosing mechanism of the base. The top portion of the dosing mechanism comprises a ramp and a rotating arm that carries a pill from a base of the ramp to a position in which the pill will drop through an aperture in a bottom portion of the dosing mechanism into a channel that connects the aperture to a dispensing slot in a housing of the base. The base includes a microcontroller that interacts with a servomotor to control rotation of the arm and thereby the dispensing of a pill. The base also includes a wireless communication interface that enables the dispensing of the pill to be controlled by a remote entity.

title: Determining the significance of an event in the context of a natural language query
abstract: A knowledge graph is built based on a corpus stored in the computer system. The corpus includes a set of searchable events and each event includes a respective set of entities. A set of entities is identified in a first set of significant events returned by natural language query (NLQ). The knowledge graph determines which ones of the set of entities are related to the entities in the NLQ to produce a filtered set of entities. The filtered set of entities is used to identify a second set of significant events in the selected corpus. Members of the first and second set of significant events are presented to a user as a search result.

title: Calibration of implantable device orientation
abstract: Systems and methods for calibrating an orientation of an implantable device in a patient is described. An exemplary system includes a calibration circuit that can receive acceleration information sensed from an implantable medical device (IMD) implanted in a patient, and receive reference acceleration information sensed from a reference device associated with the patient. The acceleration information and the reference acceleration information are acquired when the patient assumes a first posture or in a first position. The calibration circuit determines a spatial relationship between an orientation of the IMD and a reference orientation of the reference device using the received acceleration information and the received reference acceleration information, and calibrate subsequent acceleration information sensed from the IMD using the determined spatial relationship to correct for the orientation of the IMD.

title: Ear-wearable oxygen monitoring system
abstract: An apparatus for monitoring an oxygen saturation level of a wearer includes a first body portion, a second body portion, and a connection member. The first body portion contains a processor, a memory operably coupled to the processor, at least one light-emitting diode, and at least one optical sensor configured to detect, during operation, a reflected portion of light emitted from the at least one light-emitting diode. The second body portion includes a grommet, and the connection member is mechanically coupled to each of the first body portion and the second body portion. The memory stores instructions to cause the processor to cause light to be emitted from the at least one light-emitting diode when the apparatus is positioned on an ear of a wearer and during operation of the apparatus, and to calculate a blood oxygen saturation level of the wearer based on the reflected portion of light.

title: Medical education training assessment system and method based on VR technology
assignee: 南方医科大学南方医院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical education training assessment, and particularly discloses a medical education training assessment system and method based on VR technology. Acquiring scene information of a medical education training assessment site, constructing a medical education training assessment scene model, inputting personal information into a medical education training assessment system by participation assessment personnel for identity confirmation, acquiring limb action information of the participation assessment personnel and preprocessing; constructing an action recognition neural network model, recognizing an action instruction according to the action capturing point coordinates of the participating assessment personnel, giving a reference score according to the operation of the participating assessment personnel in the assessment process, and finally giving the assessment score of the participating assessment personnel by the scoring personnel according to the action parameters, the reference score and experience. The method solves the problems that the prior art cannot meet the interactive experience sense of users, cannot accurately identify action instructions and parameters of the participating assessment staff, cannot accurately evaluate the participating assessment staff on line and has poor teaching training effect.

title: Systems and methods of determining effectiveness of vehicle safety features
assignee: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company
abstract: The following relates generally to determining effectiveness of an update to a vehicle feature. In some embodiments, information indicating an update to a vehicle feature, and accident record information may be received. A first dataset from before the update was implemented in the vehicle, and a second dataset from after the update was implemented in the vehicle may then be constructed. An effectiveness score may then be calculated based upon the first and second datasets.

title: Digital stethoscope for counting coughs, and applications thereof
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein improve digital stethoscopes and their application and operation. A first method detects of a respiratory abnormality using a convolution. A second method counts coughs for a patient. A third method predicts a respiratory event based on a detected trend. A fourth method forecasts characteristics of a future respiratory event. In a fifth embodiment, a base station is provided for a digital stethoscope.

title: Efficient large-scale kernel learning using a distributed processing architecture
abstract: A method and system of creating a model for large scale data analytics is provided. Training data is received in a form of a data matrix X and partitioned into a plurality of partitions. A random matrix T is generated. A feature matrix is determined based on multiplying the partitioned training data by the random matrix T. A predicted data {tilde over (y)} is determined for each partition via a stochastic average gradient (SAG) of each partition. A number of SAG values is reduced based on a number of rows n in the data matrix X. For each iteration, a sum of the reduced SAG values is determined, as well as a full gradient based on the sum of the reduced SAG values from all rows n, by distributed parallel processing. The model parameters w are updated based on the full gradient for each partition.

title: Preserving data security in a shared computing file system
abstract: Various embodiments are provided for providing data security in a computing environment are provided. Data may be inspected during a write operation or a read operation and selected data from the data may be filtered according to one or more data security policies or rules prior to sending the plurality of data to or receiving the plurality of data from a shared computing file system.

title: Brain image detection method, computer device, and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a brain image detection method, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a brain image of an object to be detected; dividing the brain image into a plurality of image blocks, and inputting each image block into a corresponding image block hierarchical network for feature extraction to obtain a feature map of each image block; performing first weight screening processing on the feature maps of the image blocks, and determining the feature map of each candidate image block from the feature maps of the image blocks, wherein the number of the candidate image blocks is smaller than that of the image blocks; and inputting the feature map of each candidate image block into a neural network model to obtain a target area corresponding to the brain image and the category of the brain image. By adopting the method, the detection efficiency and the detection accuracy can be improved.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Natural disaster risk assessment method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 杭州鲁尔物联科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: extracting characteristics from each evaluation index based on an artificial intelligence algorithm to obtain evaluation characteristics; model training is carried out through a machine learning algorithm according to the evaluation characteristics so as to obtain an evaluation model; comprehensively considering the relativity between single disaster species and the vulnerability of disaster-bearing bodies according to the evaluation model to obtain a comprehensive risk evaluation result; and carrying out risk division according to the comprehensive risk assessment result. By implementing the method of the embodiment of the invention, the interpretability of risk assessment is enhanced, the vulnerability and the exposure of the disaster-bearing body are considered, the input information of the model comprises the relations among single disaster risk, the vulnerability and the disaster-bearing capacity of the disaster-bearing body and multiple disaster types, the input information of the model is sufficient, and the relation and the interaction among disaster-causing factors are considered more comprehensively.

title: Intelligent anesthesia depth monitoring instrument and feedback control system
assignee: 深圳市格阳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent anesthesia depth monitoring instrument and a feedback control system, which mainly comprise a data acquisition unit, a data processing unit and a feedback control unit; the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring brain wave signals from a target brain region directly related to the anesthesia depth, the consciousness level and the sensory perception and a non-target brain region or a reference electrode with low relevance to the anesthesia depth and the consciousness level; the data processing unit analyzes the brain wave signals through a Subconscious Nerve Response Index (SNRI) algorithm, and the algorithm is used for quantifying the relation between brain wave activity and anesthesia depth; the feedback control unit updates and adjusts the anesthetic dosage in real time according to the subconscious nerve response index obtained by the SNRI algorithm; with this integrated system, the anesthetic dosage can be controlled more precisely and individually, thereby improving surgical safety and patient comfort.

title: Encryption, security, and video optimization
abstract: Data encryption and Human Pose Estimation based on imaging a body segment. A key for encrypting a data file is generated based on image data that represent a unique biometric feature of a body segment of a user or motion of the user. An image engine executes artificial intelligence to identify matching image data for decrypting the data file. The image engine is further trained to predict changes in image data due to aging, stress, and the like. An avatar associated with the user, which is generated based on a movement pattern of the user, is configurable for generating an encryption key and for use in an avatar-based language.

title: Electronic device and method for providing digestibility on eaten food
abstract: A wearable device according to various embodiments may include a biometric sensor, an output device, and a processor operatively coupled with the biometric sensor and the output device, and configured to obtain food intake information of a user corresponding to the wearable device, to obtain biometric information of the user by using the biometric sensor, to identify a digestibility of the food of the user, based at least in part on a change of the biometric information corresponding to the food intake information, and to provide information of the digestibility, using the output device.

title: Brain image segmentation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a brain image segmentation method based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of medical image processing and computer vision, and comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring an original brain image dataset; s2: preprocessing the acquired original brain image dataset S3: and importing the preprocessed brain image data set into a brain image segmentation model for training, and segmenting the brain image by using the brain image segmentation model with mature training, so as to finally obtain a segmentation result. The method improves the capability of the network model for acquiring the image detail information, reduces the operation complexity of model training, solves the problem of blurring of the edge of the segmented image, and improves the segmentation precision.

title: Robot system for total hip replacement surgery
assignee: 汕头大学, 汕头大学医学院第一附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a robot system for total hip replacement surgery, which comprises: optical locator, imaging system and arm still include: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a target image map, forming a measurement report, calibrating a hand and eye, obtaining a three-dimensional hip bone model, obtaining a file grinding positioning path, moving to a positioning file grinding position, and performing file grinding operation through locking angle linear movement. The robot system for the total hip replacement operation can realize automation and precision of rasping in the hip replacement operation process, assist doctors in operation and improve the operation efficiency of the whole doctor. The invention is mainly used in the technical field of medical machinery.
assignee_clean: 汕头大学; 汕头大学医学院第一附属医院

title: Blood glucose prediction method, blood glucose prediction device, apparatus, and storage medium
assignee: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and in particular, to a method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for predicting blood glucose, where the method includes: acquiring medical record information, blood sugar data and medication data of a user; screening the medical record information to obtain medical record information corresponding to abnormal blood sugar values, and taking the medical record information corresponding to the abnormal blood sugar values as target medical record information; inputting the target medical record information, the blood glucose data and the medication data into a pre-trained blood glucose prediction model to obtain blood glucose trend data; acquiring state characteristic data of a user, and predicting diseases according to the blood sugar trend data and the state characteristic data to obtain expected diseases; and determining corresponding disease preventive measures according to the state characteristic data and the expected diseases, and pushing the disease preventive measures to a target terminal. Therefore, the user can be reminded to prevent possible diseases, and the user experience is improved.

title: Method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for adjusting image gray scale
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司, 联影智能医疗科技(北京)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for adjusting image gray scale. The method comprises the following steps: calculating an initial window width and/or an initial window level according to voxel values of at least one section of blood vessels of interest in the medical image; calculating a self-adaptive window width according to the initial window width and a preset window width, and/or calculating a self-adaptive window level according to the initial window level and a preset window level; and carrying out gray scale normalization on the medical image according to the self-adaptive window width and/or the self-adaptive window level to obtain a gray scale value corresponding to each voxel value in the medical image. The invention uses the voxel value of the blood vessel to adaptively adjust the window width and the window level of the medical image, and obtains the gray value of the image according to the self-adaptive window width and the window level, thereby achieving the best display effect.

title: Healthy dynamic prediction method and equipment based on polynary Medical Consumption data
assignee: 上海亿保健康管理有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a kind of healthy dynamic prediction method and equipment based on polynary Medical Consumption data.The data of present invention analysis user's Medical Consumption, gather the historical data informations such as classification, the amount of money, the frequency of its Medical Consumption, user health assessment models are set up as metadata according to physical examination information, the dynamic factors such as habits and customs, the dietary standards of user are considered simultaneously, pass through health-care multi-element data prediction model, the health condition of analysis prediction user, so as to realize healthy dynamic prediction.Cognition degree of the people to own health can be improved using the present invention, the probability that disease occurs is reduced, meet society's orientation that country cures the disease, improve the accuracy and reliability of Gernral Check-up result.

title: Systems and methods for AI driven generation of content attuned to a user
abstract: Systems and methods enabling rendering an avatar attuned to a user. The systems and methods include receiving audio-visual data of user communications of a user. Using the audio-visual data, the systems and methods may determine vocal characteristics of the user, facial action units representative of facial features of the user, and speech of the user based on a speech recognition model and/or natural language understanding model. Based on the vocal characteristics, an acoustic emotion metric can be determined. Based on the speech recognition data, a speech emotion metric may be determined. Based on the facial action units, a facial emotion metric may be determined. An emotional complex signature may be determined to represent an emotional state of the user for rendering the avatar attuned to the emotional state based on a combination of the acoustic emotion metric, the speech emotion metric and the facial emotion metric.

title: CT image segmentation method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 天津市中西医结合医院（天津市南开医院）
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to a CT image segmentation method and a CT image segmentation system based on deep learning, which are characterized in that a liver region is firstly input into a convolutional neural network model, and a large-size sample is adopted as a training set during training of a second deep learning model, so that the accuracy of identifying a large-size focus is improved; identifying a focus area with larger size, and then dividing the identified focus area to avoid the influence of the focus area with large size on a third deep learning model; then, identifying small-size focuses or nodules by adopting a U-Net model based on an attention mechanism, firstly selecting a CT image set with only the small-size focuses to train the model when the data set is selected during identification, improving the accuracy of the model for segmenting the small-size focuses, and simultaneously, segmenting the CT image after the first segmentation by adopting the U-Net model based on the attention mechanism, and improving the accuracy of segmentation, thereby improving the overall accuracy of CT image segmentation.

title: Clinical medicine intelligence discriminating gear based on electing algorithm
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an intelligent clinical medical information judging device based on a referral algorithm, which comprises a computer processing unit, a clinical index screening unit, a judging unit and a judging unit, wherein the clinical index screening unit selects a plurality of clinical medical indexes commonly owned by sick people and common people from historical data, acquires detection values of the two selected indexes, and screens out the clinical medical indexes meeting preset conditions according to the acquired detection values; constructing a binary model based on a preset referral algorithm by using the indexes as attributes and using corresponding detection values as attribute values through a model construction unit; and finally, acquiring a detection value of the person to be detected corresponding to the screened clinical medical index through an information identification unit, importing the detection value into a two-classification model, and intelligently identifying clinical medical related information of the patient. The implementation of the invention can realize the automation and standardization of the clinical medicine relevant information diagnosis and judgment process to a certain extent, improve the objectivity and reduce the error.

title: Slice image recognition method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a slice image identification method and device applied to an artificial intelligence scene, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and also relates to artificial intelligence medical technology, machine learning technology and other technologies. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target scanning image of a target slice, wherein the target slice is a biological tissue slice to be identified; identifying candidate cell images in the target scanning image to obtain pathology prediction parameters corresponding to the candidate cells; screening pathology prediction parameters corresponding to candidate cells meeting the feature extraction conditions from the pathology prediction parameters to obtain screened pathology prediction parameters; generating pathological characteristics of each pathological cycle based on the pathological cycle and the prediction parameters in the screened pathological prediction parameters; and obtaining the identification result of the target scanning image based on the pathological features. The invention solves the technical problem of poor efficiency of slice image identification.

title: Intelligent surgical decision making system suitable for high myopia cataract and establishing method thereof
assignee: 复旦大学附属眼耳鼻喉科医院
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent decision making system for high myopia cataract surgery and an establishment method thereof. The establishing method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a deep learning model, wherein the deep learning model consists of an evaluation network and a decision network, the evaluation network comprises a LOCOSIII hierarchical deep learning model, an Emery nuclear hardness hierarchical deep learning model and a fundus judgment model, the decision network combines cataract degree and fundus grading with information such as basic information of a patient, eyesight, intraocular pressure, A ultrasonic/IOLmaster report, corneal endothelial count, corneal astigmatism, B ultrasonic report and the like, and a linear regression model is built after kernel function mapping is carried out on the model to a high-dimensional space; constructing a training set; the model uses the training set to train, learn and adjust the parameters. The system comprises a storage device, an evaluation module, a decision module and a test evaluation adjustment module. The invention can rapidly and accurately identify the cataract degree and fundus condition of the high myopia cataract patient, provides comprehensive operation decision for doctors, and improves the homogeneity of prevention and treatment.

title: Automated timeline completion using event progression knowledge base
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a computing device configured with instructions executing on a processor of the computing device to implement a timeline generation system, for automated timeline completion. The timeline generation system executing on the processor of the computing device identifies a plurality of events in documents in a corpus of information. The timeline generation system places the plurality of events in a partial timeline data structure. The timeline generation system selects an event progression from an event progression knowledge base. The timeline generation system aligns the selected event progression to the partial timeline data structure. The timeline generation system identifies a set of events missing from the partial timeline data structure. The timeline generation system maps the set of events missing from the partial timeline data structure to the partial timeline based on the selected event progression to form a completed timeline data structure.

title: Augmented reality triggering of devices
abstract: An augmented reality trigger system (10) comprising a primary augmented reality device (30) and a trigger action controller (40) for implementing an augmented reality trigger method based on a medical tool (20) and/or a tool identifier (21) 5 associated with the medical tool (20). In operation, the primary augmented reality device (30) generates a camera image of the real world, which may or may not at any time include the medical tool (20) and/or the tool identifier (21). The trigger action controller (40) recognizes a generation by the primary augmented reality device (30) of the camera image of the real world including the medical tool (20) and/or the tool 10 identifier (21) and in response to such recognition, triggers a medical procedure action by the primary augmented reality device (30) and/or a medical device (50) in support of a medical procedure involving the medical tool (20).

title: Multi-site three-dimensional image oriented federal deep learning method and system
assignee: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-site three-dimensional image-oriented federal deep learning method and a multi-site three-dimensional image-oriented federal deep learning system. According to the method, the effective characteristics of the target area can be extracted from the three-dimensional image by using the limited private data of a single site and a safe federal deep learning method for collaboratively updating the global gradient information of the federal, so that the method is beneficial to breaking through the data ownership problem and the sharing barrier between different sites under the existing legal regulations, more sites with the same kind of three-dimensional data are encouraged to add the federal to enrich the safely-aggregated global information, and a more stable and effective federal three-dimensional depth classification model with stronger universality is obtained.

title: Deep learning-based automatic head and neck lymph node and drainage area delineation method
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a deep learning-based automatic head and neck lymph node and drainage area delineation method, which utilizes the symmetry of a human body structure to divide a head area into a left part and a right part for training and prediction, thereby indirectly increasing the data volume of model training and simultaneously reducing the scale of a deep learning model. The invention uses a delineation strategy of stepwise processing optimization, firstly adopts a deep learning model to realize a lymph drainage area which is easy to be segmented, and then adopts a multi-task deep learning model to optimize the lymph drainage area and segment lymph nodes, thereby fully utilizing the relevance between the lymph drainage area and the lymph nodes and improving the segmentation accuracy of the lymph drainage area and the lymph nodes. The invention implements an Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted contour delineation method in the radiation therapy planning work flow, can effectively improve the delineation consistency of the work efficiency of medical workers, and improves the radiation therapy accuracy of head and neck tumors.

title: Method for reporting channel state information and device therefor
abstract: Disclosed is a method for reporting channel state information by a terminal in a wireless communication system. More particularly, the method is characterized by: receiving information relating to an integrated channel state information-reference signal (CSI-RS) resource set including a plurality of CSI-RS resource groups; receiving information relating to CSI reporting setting associated with the integrated CSI-RS resource set; and reporting CSI for the integrated CSI-RS resource set based on the CSI reporting setting, wherein each of the plurality of CSI-RS resource groups can includes a plurality of CSI-RS resources.

title: Automated or partially automated anatomical surface assessment methods, devices and systems
abstract: Devices, systems and methods for assessing anatomical surface features are described herein. In some embodiments, a method of assessing a surface feature on a patient's skin surface includes (i) capturing one or more data sets from a patient's skin surface including the skin surface feature, and (ii) determining outline data of the skin surface feature based on at least one of the one or more data sets. The method can further include determining one or more confidence attributes associated with the determined outline data.

title: Medical image key point detection method and system based on improved neural network
assignee: 汕头大学, 汕头大学医学院第一附属医院, 汕头大学医学院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image processing, in particular to a medical image key point detection method and system based on an improved neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical sample image, wherein the medical sample image is marked with key points; training a key point detection model according to the medical sample image to obtain a trained key point detection model; receiving a medical image to be detected, and predicting a key point probability thermodynamic diagram of the medical image to be detected through a trained key point detection model; the key point probability thermodynamic diagram is used for representing the probability value of each pixel point in the medical image to be detected as a key point; determining key points of the medical image to be detected according to the key point probability thermodynamic diagram; the invention can improve the accuracy of key point prediction.

title: System for providing dose recommendations for basal insulin titration
assignee: 诺和诺德股份有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to an administration regimen useful for the treatment of diseases or conditions in which administration of insulin would be beneficial. In particular, the present invention relates to long-acting or ultra-long-acting insulin for the treatment of a disease or condition in which administration of insulin would be beneficial, wherein the administration of insulin comprises or consists of one or more of the following steps: (a) obtaining a first data set of a subject, (b) obtaining a second data set of the subject, (c) obtaining a first data structure of the subject, and (d) obtaining a second data structure of the subject. Upon determining that at least the first data structure, the second data structure, the first data set, and the second data set collectively comprise an assessment information set, the method further comprises providing a long-acting or super-long-acting insulin dosage guidance recommendation.

title: Multi-mode medical registration method based on point cloud registration
assignee: 山东卓业医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a multi-mode medical registration method based on point cloud registration. The method comprises the following steps: performing DICOM image preprocessing on the DICOM image to obtain DICOM image preprocessing data; performing three-dimensional reconstruction according to the DICOM image preprocessing data to obtain point cloud image data; constructing an optimized triangular patch model for the point cloud image data, and constructing the optimized triangular patch model; performing point cloud rough matching according to the optimized triangular patch model to obtain primary transformation matrix data, and performing point cloud fine registration to obtain secondary transformation matrix data; and acquiring DICOM image data to be registered, and performing coordinate calculation on the DICOM image data to be registered to obtain the DICOM image data to be registered. The invention can optimize and reconstruct the original DICOM image through the steps of image preprocessing and three-dimensional reconstruction, and improve the image quality.

title: Method, apparatus and system for tailoring at least one subsequent communication to a user
abstract: There is provided a method, apparatus and system for method for tailoring at least one subsequent communication to a user. Data acquired on the user in connection with a plurality of communications to the user is processed to determine a value for one or more characteristics indicative of a state of the user in connection with each communication. At least one communication parameter is varied in respect of each communication. The values for the one or more characteristics indicative of the state of the user that are determined in connection with each communication are compared to identify one or more communication parameters that are most suitable for the user. One or more communication parameters are set for the at least one subsequent communication to the user according to the one or more identified communication parameters. The subsequent communication to the user is enabled based on the set one or more communication parameters.

title: Method for detecting automatically same regions of interest between images taken on a subject with temporal interval and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for detecting the same interest region between images captured at a time interval with respect to the same object and a device using the same. More specifically, a method according to the present invention obtains a second image captured at the time interval from a time of capturing a first image and the second image. Also, if an interest region is set on the first image, a computing device detects the same interest region as the interest region as the same interest region in the second image.

title: Artificial intelligence-based smart pass medical device system using mask detection and body temperature correction of visitors
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart pass system and method using face recognition and body temperature measurement of an entrant. The smart pass system according to the present invention comprises: an infrared sensor which detects infrared rays emitted from an entrant's body; an infrared array sensor driving unit which converts a measured value of the infrared sensor into an electrical signal; a determination control unit which calculates a body temperature of the entrant by using the data that the measured value is converted into an electrical signal, and determines the entry or exit of the entrant or the range of the entry and exit according to a preset request of a manager based on the calculated body temperature; a face recognition camera unit which senses and photographs the face of the entrant; and an information display unit which displays a result of determining the entry or exit of the entrant or the range of the entry and exit, on an image obtained by photographing the face of the entrant.

title: Evaluation method and system for hip replacement postoperative image based on deep learning
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention provides an evaluation method and system of images after hip replacement based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of medicine and can realize accurate evaluation of postoperative conditions of patients after total hip replacement surgery, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a hip image of a patient after a hip replacement surgery; identifying key point positions and target areas in the hip joint image based on a deep learning target identification network; determining leg length difference, eccentricity and femoral prosthesis indexes of the legs of the patient according to the positions of the key points and the target area; and evaluating the accuracy of the femoral prosthesis position installation of the patient according to the leg length difference, the eccentricity and the femoral prosthesis indexes of the two legs. The system performs the method. The invention calculates the leg length difference of the two legs, the eccentricity and the femoral prosthesis index of the patient after the hip replacement surgery based on the hip image of the patient after the hip replacement surgery so as to realize the accurate evaluation of the recovery condition of the patient after the hip replacement surgery.

title: Radiographic-deformation and textural heterogeneity (r-DepTH): an integrated descriptor for brain tumor prognosis
abstract: Embodiments facilitate generation of a prediction of long-term survival (LTS) or short-term survival (STS) of Glioblastoma (GBM) patients. A first set of embodiments discussed herein relates to training of a machine learning classifier to determine a prediction for LTS or STS based on a radiographic-deformation and textural heterogeneity (r-DepTH) descriptor generated based on radiographic images of tissue demonstrating GBM. A second set of embodiments discussed herein relates to determination of a prediction of disease outcome for a GBM patient of LTS or STS based on an r-DepTH descriptor generated based on radiographic imagery of the patient.

title: Method for transmitting and receiving downlink control channel, and apparatus therefor
abstract: Disclosed is a method by which a user equipment (UE) configured to a discontinuous reception (DRX) operation receives a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) in a wireless communication system. Particularly, the method can configure an active time for monitoring the PDCCH based on at least one of a plurality of conditions and receive the PDCCH through PDCCH monitoring occasions allocated within a duration of the active time, wherein the PDCCH monitoring occasions can be differently allocated based on the at least one condition.

title: Method for transmitting and receiving reference signal for radio link monitoring in unlicensed band and device therefor
abstract: The present invention discloses a method for a base station to transmit a radio link monitoring-reference signal (RLM-RS) in an unlicensed band. In particular, the method may divide a frequency band for the RLM-RS into a plurality of sub-bands, perform a channel clearance assessment (CCA) for each of the plurality of sub-bands, and transmit the RLM-RS via each of the plurality of sub-bands on the basis of the result of performing the CCA.

title: Suspected infectious disease prediction method and device
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）, 北京嘉和海森健康科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for predicting suspected infectious diseases, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring electronic medical record information and examination report information of all patients from a medical database; training by using the electronic medical record information and the examination report information of each patient and the first multi-input densification diagnosis model to obtain a two-classification prediction model; training by using the electronic medical record information and the examination report information of each patient and the second multi-input densification diagnosis model to obtain a multi-classification prediction model; acquiring electronic medical record information and examination report information of a target patient; predicting whether the target patient is a suspected infectious disease using a two-class prediction model; when the target patient is predicted to be a suspected infection, a multi-classification predictive model is used to predict a specific type of the suspected infection.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院; 北京嘉和海森健康科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院

title: IT monitoring recommendation service
abstract: Operational metrics of a distributed collection of servers in a cloud environment are analyzed by a service to intelligently machine learn which operational metric is highly correlated to incidents or failures in the cloud environment. To do so, metric values of the operational metrics are analyzed over time by the service to check whether the operation metrics exceed a particular metric threshold. If so, the service also checks whether such spikes in the operation metric above the metric thresholds occurred during known cloud incidents. Statistics are calculated reflecting the number of times the operational metrics spiked during times of cloud incidents and spiked during times without cloud incidents. Correlation scores based on these statistics are calculated and used to select the correlated operational metrics that are most correlated to cloud failures.

title: Target recognition and neural network model processing method based on image
assignee: 阿里巴巴（中国）有限公司
abstract: According to the embodiment of the application, an encoder in the neural network model can be called, full feature data of an image to be identified is extracted, at least part of the full feature data is input into a plurality of decoders in the neural network model, target identification results of the corresponding decoders are obtained, and then target identification results of different decoders are combined to obtain a target identification result set corresponding to the image to be identified. The method can identify more target types in the image, and the identification result is comprehensive, accurate and non-missing. In addition, the processing method of the neural network model can also obtain a forget-free neural network model, namely the neural network model has no forget on the learned knowledge of the network.

title: Information processing apparatus, method and storage medium
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information processing device, a method and a storage medium, wherein the device comprises: one or more processors; a memory for storing one or more programs; when the one or more programs are executed by the one or more processors, the one or more processors are caused to perform operations comprising: acquiring current medical record information of a current object; performing word segmentation processing on the current medical record information, and determining a first word vector corresponding to each word in a word segmentation result; inputting each first word vector into a preset graph network model, and determining the attention weight corresponding to each word according to a first output result of the preset graph network model, wherein the preset graph network model is constructed according to a medical knowledge graph; and determining a classification result corresponding to the current object according to the preset classification network model, the attention weight corresponding to each word and the first word vector. By the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of the classification result can be ensured.

title: Histological image segmentation model based on semi-supervised learning
abstract: The invention discloses a histological image segmentation model based on semi-supervised learning, which comprises the following steps: a teacher model, a student model, a multi-level forced consistency module and a total loss function for supervision training; training the student model by using marked data and unmarked data, training the teacher model by using unmarked data, and performing consistency constraint on a segmentation prediction result of the teacher model and a segmentation prediction result of a variant of a multi-level potential representation of an encoder in the student model by using a multi-level consistency loss function by using a multi-level forced consistency module when the student model and the teacher model are trained by using the unmarked data; the histological image segmentation model is effective, a multi-level forced consistency module and a multi-level consistency loss function are provided, and the prediction invariance of a model segmentation prediction result is enhanced by adding disturbance to multi-level potential representation of the model.

title: Wearable hydration monitor sensors
abstract: Described herein are apparatuses and methods for measuring a hydration condition with a wearable device. The wearable device may include a housing, a flume integrated into the housing, and a sensor array. The housing may include a perimeter wall disposed around a perimeter of the housing between a top wall and a bottom wall, where the top wall, bottom wall, and perimeter wall form an inner cavity. The flume may be disposed in the inner cavity, where a first end of the flume is disposed at the bottom wall and a second end of the flume is disposed at the top wall. The sensor array may include a first vapor pressure sensor located within the flume at a first location and a second vapor pressure sensor located within the flume at a second location.

title: Electronic device for supporting machine learning-based image processing
abstract: An electronic device is provided, which includes a display; an under display camera (UDC); a processor; and a memory that stores instructions, which when executed, causes the processor to receive a first image from the UDC, generate a second image by lowering a resolution of the first image, obtain a third image representing a difference between the second image and an image corresponding to the second image in which artifacts are not present, generate a fourth image by increasing the resolution of the third image, and generate a fifth image by subtracting the fourth image from the first image.

title: CT image and MRI three-dimensional image registration method and device
assignee: 真健康（北京）医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method and a device for registering a CT image and an MRI three-dimensional image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring CT images and MRI three-dimensional images obtained by original acquisition and carrying out preprocessing operation to obtain CT processed imagesAnd MRI processing images(ii) a Processing the CT images using a pre-trained modality conversion generatorAnd MRI processing imagesPerforming modality conversion to obtain a CT modality conversion image and an MRI modality conversion image; processing the image for the CT by using a single-mode registration network obtained by pre-trainingAnd MRI processing imagesPredicting to obtain a single-mode registration confidence coefficient; processing the CT image by using a multi-mode registration network obtained by pre-trainingMRI processing imagesAnd the CT modality conversion image, the MRI modality conversion image and the single modality registration confidence coefficient are registered so as to realize the automatic registration of the CT image and the MRI three-dimensional image.

title: Sample data labeling system for fundus image of diabetes mellitus
abstract: The invention provides a sample data labeling system for fundus images of diabetes mellitus, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the fundus image acquisition part is used for acquiring fundus images of the diabetes mellitus to be distinguished and carrying out image preprocessing on each fundus image of the diabetes mellitus to obtain a fundus image to be distinguished; the quality discrimination screening part is used for discriminating the quality of the fundus images to be discriminated to obtain quality discrimination information and screening the fundus images to be discriminated which meet the quality requirement based on the quality discrimination information as qualified fundus images; a left and right eye determination section for performing left and right eye determination on the qualified fundus image to obtain left and right eye information; a classification discrimination unit that performs classification discrimination on the qualified fundus image based on a classification discrimination model and left and right eye information that are constructed in advance to obtain classification discrimination information indicating the qualified fundus image; and a labeling result storage unit for storing the diabetic fundus image, the quality discrimination information, the left and right eye information, and the classification discrimination information in association with each other.

title: Biomedical literature retrieval method based on sequencing learning algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data mining and search engines, in particular to a biomedical literature retrieval method based on a sequencing learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: (1) the method comprises the steps of (1) retrieving by using original queries and extracting results, (2) constructing a recommendation model to grade query concepts, (3) constructing a query optimization model and refining the original queries, (4) constructing a query expansion model and expanding the queries, (5) fusing a ranking model, and (6) retrieving by using new queries and extracting results. The method can expand the original query submitted by the user by using resources such as a knowledge base in the biomedical field, uses a sequencing algorithm for expanding the vocabulary importance measurement in the expansion, supplements and perfects the query submitted by the user through the query expansion process, ensures the accuracy of the query result, and further meets the information requirement of the user.

title: Method, system and computer readable medium for anatomical tree structure analysis
assignee: 北京昆仑医云科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method, system, and computer-readable medium for anatomical tree structure analysis. The method may begin with the task of receiving an anatomical tree structure analysis. A set of positions in the anatomical tree structure may then be set or received by the processor as sampling positions for the model input and the model output. The model input may be determined by the processor at the sampling location based on the task. An encoder may be selected by the processor for each position in the set of positions based on the task. The encoder may be configured to receive a model input for each location and extract features for the corresponding location. A tree structured Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) may then be constructed by the processor, with nodes corresponding to a set of positions and connected to corresponding encoders. RNN units for each node may be selected based on the task and information propagation between nodes may be set based on spatial constraints for a set of locations in the anatomical tree structure. The RNN of the generated tree structure may be provided for the task of performing an anatomical tree structure analysis.
assignee_clean: 北京昆仑医云科技有限公司

title: Intelligent voice recognizing method, apparatus, and intelligent computing device
abstract: An intelligent voice recognition method, voice recognition apparatus and intelligent computing device are disclosed. An intelligent voice recognition method of a voice recognition apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention detects a voice of a user, receives an authentication request from the user, and performs authentication for the user on the basis of a result of determination of whether authentication for the user has recently been performed and a result of recognition of the voice of the user, thereby reducing a time and the quantity of calculations necessary for user authentication. One or more of the voice recognition apparatus and the intelligent computing device can be associated with artificial intelligence (AI) modules, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) robots, augmented reality (AR) devices, virtual reality (VR) devices, 5G service related devices, etc.

title: Method for evaluating dementia and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for evaluating dementia through a brain image and a neuropsychological test result, and an apparatus using the same. According to the present invention, the method for evaluating dementia comprises the steps of: generating one or more first maps for applying a first attention for a brain image on the basis of a neuropsychological test result; generating one or more second maps for the brain image, which are in the same number as the first maps; mapping the first and second maps in one-to-one correspondence, and generating third maps for each of the mapped first and second maps to apply the first attention for the brain image; applying a second attention for the brain image on the basis of the third and second maps; and performing dementia evaluation for the brain image on the basis of the brain image applied with the second attention and a pre-learned classifier.

title: System, client terminal, control method for system, and storage medium
abstract: An estimation apparatus includes an acquisition unit configured to acquire data about a domesticated animal identified by identification information that is transmitted by a client terminal, and an estimation unit configured to perform estimation by inputting the acquired data about a domesticated animal to a trained model generated by performing machine learning based on captured image data of domesticated animals and collected data about domesticated animals and provide, to the client terminal, an estimation result indicating a result of the estimation, and the client terminal includes a presenting unit configured to transmit a request for estimation together with identification information for identifying a domesticated animal targeted for estimation, receive the estimation result, and present body weight data about the domesticated animal targeted for estimation to a user.

title: Related method and device for processing fundus images based on deep learning
assignee: 中国移动通信有限公司研究院, 中国移动通信集团公司, 沈阳何氏眼科医院有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a related method and equipment for processing fundus images based on deep learning. The fundus image processing method based on deep learning comprises the following steps: segmenting the fundus image to be processed in a preset segmentation mode to obtain at least one analysis image; analyzing at least one analysis image through a fundus image deep learning network model to obtain at least one intermediate image; fusing at least one intermediate image to obtain a fundus image to be processed containing the characteristic mark; the fundus image deep learning network model is obtained by respectively carrying out multilayer convolution calculation on at least one training image through a deep learning network so as to iteratively update the deep learning network model; in the process of updating the deep learning network model each time, combining the feature map obtained by the last layer of convolution calculation and at least one updated feature map to update the deep learning network model; the updated feature map is obtained by performing convolution calculation again on the feature map obtained by the convolution calculation of one layer.

title: Multi-objective scheduling system and method
assignee: B.G. Negev Technologies & Applications Ltd. At Ben-Gurion University
abstract: A master-slave scheduling system, comprising (a) a master DRL unit comprising: (i) a queue containing a plurality of item-representations; (ii) a master policy module configured to select a single item-representation from the queue and submit to the slave unit; (iii) a master DRL agent configured to (a) train the master policy module; and (b) receive an updated item-representation from the slave unit, and update the queue;(b) The slave DRL unit comprising: (i) a slave policy module receiving a single item-representation, selecting a single task entry and submitting to a slave environment for performance; (ii) a slave DRL agent configured to: (a) train the slave policy module; (b) receive an item-representation from the master DRL unit, and submit to the slave policy module; (c) receive an updated item-representation from the slave's environment, and submit the same to the master DRL unit; and (iii) the slave DRL agent.
