title: Systems and methods for machine learning models for performance measurement
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer-readable media for generating a statistically covaried machine learning model for performance measurement of service providers. The method receives a configuration file that includes one or more parameters associated with a plurality of individuals and parses it to generate and executing the database query on input data to generate sets of tabulated data of individuals of the plurality of individuals. The method next determines one or more measures of service providers listed in the configuration file using two or more tabulated data of individuals from the sets of tabulated data of individuals. The method finally generates a covaried machine learning model by training a machine learning model by statistically covarying measures and using them as training data.

title: Support system for specified inspection, support method for specified inspection, and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to increase accuracy of a specific test using an electronic microscope and improve work efficiency. Provided is a system that identifies test recipe information corresponding to an object to be tested on the basis of attribute information about a testing sample, and analyzes and evaluates the object to be tested contained in the testing sample by checking image data and element analysis data that are acquired by a measuring device in accordance with a control program for the test recipe information, against reference image data and reference element analysis data that are used as evaluation references for the object to be tested.

title: Device and method for the computer-assisted simulation of surgical interventions
abstract: A first interface for reading image data of an anatomical region obtained by means of a medical imaging method is provided. A modeling module serves for establishing a volumetric biomechanical structure model of the anatomical region on the basis of the image data. Moreover, provision is made of a tracking module, couplable with a camera, for video-based registration of spatial gestures of a user. Furthermore, a simulation module, based on the biomechanical structure model, serves to assign a registered gesture to a simulated mechanical effect on the anatomical region, simulate a mechanical reaction of the anatomical region to the simulated mechanical effect, and modify the biomechanical structure model in accordance with the simulated mechanical reaction. Moreover, provision is made for a visualization module for the volumetric visualization of the biomechanical structure model.

title: Determination of a concentration of an analyte in a subject
abstract: A method for determining a concentration of an analyte in a subject includes irradiating a part of the subject with electromagnetic radiation, wherein a part of the subject comprises biological molecules arranged to absorb the electromagnetic radiation and to emit fluorescence in response. The method also includes measuring fluorescence emitted to obtain data representative of a fluorescence decay. The method further includes processing the data to determine one or more feature points associated with the fluorescence decay and to generate one or more feature vectors based on the one or more feature points, and applying the one or more feature vectors to a regression model for the analyte to determine the concentration of the analyte. Also provided is a system for determining a concentration of an analyte in a subject, as well as a measurement device for facilitating determination of a concentration of an analyte in a subject.

title: Muscle CT image sketching method, system, electronic equipment and machine storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a muscle CT image sketching method, a system, electronic equipment and a machine storage medium, which relate to the technical field of image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired muscle CT image to obtain a preprocessed muscle image sequence; positioning and identifying the CT sagittal position of the muscle image sequence to obtain a sagittal position positioning image of target muscles (including muscles or muscle groups at specified positions); dividing the sagittal positioning image of the target muscle at the axial level to obtain various results of CT images of the muscle or muscle group at the designated position; the segmentation results include a variety of muscle parameters. The invention can rapidly and accurately realize the automatic measurement of the muscle segmentation parameter information of the three-dimensional medical image, thereby improving the muscle sketching and measuring efficiency of the medical image (image) and reducing the labor cost.

title: Financial loan auditing method and system based on block chain and machine learning
assignee: 中科柏诚科技（北京）股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a financial loan auditing method and system based on a block chain and machine learning, which are applied to a block chain network and comprise super nodes and common nodes, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when any node inquires a request, counting the quantity of conflict information, carrying out risk classification on the lending user based on a static prediction result and a dynamic prediction result, upgrading the common nodes which firstly generate the static prediction result and the dynamic prediction result into super nodes, and degrading the same quantity of super nodes into the common nodes according to a super node ranking list and a ranking sequence. The method overcomes the defect of information isolated islands of the traditional platforms, realizes the sharing synchronization of the blacklists of the users, and realizes the combined audit of the users to be borrowed and lended; by combining the static risk model and the dynamic risk model, the influence of subjective factors of artificial examination is avoided, and the accuracy and the growth of risk identification are ensured; by adjusting the super nodes, the rigidity and joint operation of the super nodes can be avoided.
assignee_clean: 中科柏诚科技 北京 股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 中科柏诚科技 北京 股份有限公司

title: Fundus fluorescence contrast image generation method based on deep learning
assignee: 中国科学院苏州生物医学工程技术研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a fundus fluorescence radiography image generation method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting fundus fluorescence contrast images; s2, constructing a training data set; s3, pre-processing the training data set; s4, constructing and training an image processing network model for generating fundus fluorescence contrast images; s5, inputting the fundus structure image to be processed into a trained image processing network model, and automatically generating a corresponding fundus fluorescence contrast image. Compared with the existing fundus fluorescence contrast image generation method, the method can accurately generate the fundus blood vessel structure and simultaneously has a good effect on generation of fundus fluorescence leakage points; the fundus medical image processing method has potential medical value for preventing, diagnosing and guiding inspection of fundus related diseases.

assignee: 西安启玥华辰软件咨询开发有限公司, 西安医学院第一附属医院
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of registration and review, and particularly discloses a medical institution registration and review system based on big data and a method thereof.

title: Localization of aorta and left atrium from magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: The aorta and left atrium are localized from magnetic resonance data. The locations of the aorta and left atrium are detected jointly. The aorta and the left atrium are, at least in part, treated as one object. The detection may be from data representing a two-dimensional region. The two-dimensional region may be determined by first detecting the left ventricle from data representing a volume.

title: Method, device and medium for auditing of claim data
assignee: 北京懿医云科技有限公司
abstract: In one aspect, the disclosure provides a method for auditing claim data, including: acquiring data of a plurality of insurance claim cases; utilizing a general rule to audit the data of the plurality of insurance claim cases to obtain data of a plurality of preliminarily qualified insurance claim cases; the data of the plurality of preliminarily qualified insurance claim cases are audited by using the integrated learning model, whether the data of each preliminarily qualified insurance claim case is real and accords with claim settlement rules is determined according to the auditing result, so that whether the insurance claim case needs to be paid or not is determined. The disclosure also provides an auditing device and medium for the claim data.
assignee_clean: 北京懿医云科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京懿医云科技有限公司

title: Intelligent analysis system for children intussusception diagnosis based on multi-mode fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a child intussusception diagnosis intelligent analysis system based on multi-mode fusion, which comprises a child intussusception relation extraction model, a text feature extraction model, an ultrasonic image quality control model, a structured data feature extraction model and a feature fusion model; the child intussusception relation extraction model is used for constructing a child intussusception knowledge map; the text feature extraction model is used for extracting text features in an original diagnosis medical record and an ultrasonic diagnosis report; the ultrasonic image quality control model is used for extracting image characteristics in the ultrasonic image of the intussusception of the child; the structured data feature extraction model is used for extracting the structured data features in the children intussusception laboratory data; the feature fusion model is used for fusing text features, image features and structural data features, and after high-dimensional features are output, the prediction output of the child intussusception is mapped into probability distribution by using a normalization function. The invention can realize the rapid diagnosis of the intussusception diseases of children, shorten the diagnosis time and reduce the false positive rate.

title: Context-aware medical image segmentation method based on lesion boundary information response
abstract: The invention discloses a context-aware medical image segmentation method based on lesion boundary information response. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing original image data; the method comprises the steps that preprocessed image data are input into a trained convolutional neural network to conduct feature extraction so as to conduct image segmentation, wherein an encoding network of the convolutional neural network comprises a plurality of encoding stages and a spatial pyramid convolution module, each encoding stage is sequentially connected with a pyramid edge feature extraction module, a multi-task learning module and a cross feature fusion module so as to mine features of the same level and aggregate features of different levels, and a decoding network of the convolutional neural network sequentially obtains decoding features through the output features of the aggregated spatial pyramid convolution module and the encoding features of each encoding stage. The invention can effectively utilize boundary information, fully excavate the contextual characteristics of the same layer, and realize information complementation among the characteristics of different layers, thereby obviously improving the segmentation effect of medical images.

title: Data processing apparatus and method
assignee: The University Court Of The University Of Edinburgh, Canon Medical Systems Corporation
abstract: A medical image data processing apparatus is provided and includes processing circuitry to receive medical image data in respect of at least one subject; receive non-image data; generate a filter based on the non-image data; and apply the filter to the medical image data, wherein the filter limits a region of the medical image data.
assignee_clean: the university court of the university of edinburgh; canon medical systems
primary_assignee: the university court of the university of edinburgh

title: MRI hip joint inflammation segmentation and classification automatic quantitative classification sequential method
assignee: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学, 西安电子科技大学
abstract: The invention discloses an MRI hip joint inflammation segmentation and classification automatic quantitative classification sequential method, which solves the problems of difficulty in quantitative classification of hip joint inflammation areas caused by uneven distribution of hip joint shapes, sizes and voxel values, and realizes automatic accurate quantitative and classified evaluation of hip joint inflammation areas. According to the invention, the label value of the hip joint inflammatory region is modified in an inverse exponential ratio according to the voxel value, so that the problem of poor segmentation result caused by large voxel value difference of the hip joint inflammatory region is solved; the invention designs a multi-scale convolution module GMS to improve the segmentation effect of hip joint inflammation areas with large shape and size differences; aiming at the problem that the hip joint inflammation area with small duty ratio is difficult to classify, the invention fuses the segmentation model and the classification model to improve the classification precision. The invention realizes the integrated automatic quantitative classification of hip joint inflammatory regions with multiple scales and large voxel value difference, and improves the quantitative classification efficiency. Can be used for quantitative and graded automatic treatment of MRI hip inflammation area.

title: System for providing pseudonymization processing service using metadata and deeplearning security control
abstract: Provided is a system for providing a pseudonymization processing service using metadata and deep-learning security control. The system comprises: a user terminal which progresses a preparation step of setting types and purposes for pseudonym information processing after being designated as a personal information manager; a pseudonym processing step of selecting an object to be pseudonymized corresponding to an Excel file including personal information, selecting a pseudonym processing level, and progressing pseudonym processing; an appropriateness review step of checking compliance with pseudonym processing guidelines, and a post-management step of managing use details in a pseudonym information ledger; and a pseudonymization processing service providing server which includes a providing unit that provides a pseudonym processing solution including the preparation step, the pseudonym processing step, the appropriateness review step, and the post-management step, a meta management unit that provides tools to manage metadata, which is a personal information attribute within a pseudonym processing solution, a security control unit that analyzes the log of the user terminal, analyzes threats, and outputs actions for the threats entered as queries by using a pre-built deep-learning algorithm, so that deep-learning security control is performed when the pseudonym processing solution is used on the user terminal, and a distributed authentication unit that provides a distributed pseudonym authentication platform so that real name information can be obtained through the cooperation between a pseudonym authentication server and a real name authentication server when real name information in pseudonym processing data, which is pseudonymized data, is required. Therefore, the system can automatically take measures based on threat analysis information.

title: Arrangement for knee diagnostics
abstract: An arrangement (100) for knee diagnostics comprising a measurement apparatus (110) attachable to a leg, and a processing apparatus (140). The measurement apparatus (110) comprises three frames (112, 116, 130) with various sensors: audio sensors (124, 126), thermal sensors (120, 122), and inertial sensors (114, 132). The processing apparatus (140) is caused to: analyze (202) the medial sound and the lateral sound to produce an assessment (204) of a joint friction of the knee; analyze (206) the thigh inertial data and the lower leg inertial data to produce an assessment (208) of a malalignment of the knee; analyze (210) the medial temperature and the lateral temperature to produce an assessment (212) of an inflammation of the knee; and compile (214) an assessment (216) of a condition of the knee (306) based on said assessments (204, 208, 212).

title: Attenuation correction method, apparatus, computer device and storage medium for PET image
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium for attenuation correction of PET images. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a nuclear Magnetic Resonance (MR) image and a positron emission computed tomography (PET) image, wherein the MR image and the PET image are medical images obtained by scanning the same scanning area; inputting the MR image into an image generation model to generate a pseudo-electronic computed tomography CT image; and inputting the pseudo CT image and the PET image into an attenuation correction model to obtain an attenuation corrected PET image. The method improves the efficiency of PET attenuation correction image processing and improves the accuracy of the obtained PET image.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Training method of abnormal area image generation network and related product
assignee: 武汉中科医疗科技工业技术研究院有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a training method of an abnormal region image generation network and a related product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a training sample image, wherein the training sample image has an abnormal area; inputting a training sample image into an initial abnormal area image generation network to obtain an initial abnormal area image, and fusing the initial abnormal area image and the training sample image to obtain a fused image; the fusion image comprises a preset simulation mark; inputting the fused image and the real sample image into an initial discrimination network to obtain a discrimination result of the fused image; calculating the loss between the discrimination result and the simulation mark by adopting a loss function, and training an initial discrimination network and an initial abnormal region image generation network according to the loss; and when the value of the loss function reaches convergence, finishing training of the initial abnormal region image generation network to obtain an abnormal region image generation network. The method can improve the accuracy of the abnormal area image generation network obtained by training and the training efficiency.

primary_assignee: 武汉中科医疗科技工业技术研究院有限公司

title: Processing method of medical image and computing apparatus for processing medical image
assignee: 緯創資通股份有限公司
abstract: A processing method of medical images and a computing apparatus for processing medical images are provided. In the method, one or more image samples are obtained, the tumor region and its appearance feature of the image sample are labeled, and the image identification module is trained according to the image sample, its tumor region, and the appearance feature of the first tumor. The image sample is the image obtained by capturing an animal body. The appearance feature is used to represent the appearance of the first tumor corresponding to the tumor region. The image identification module is used to identify whether the second tumor in a to-be-evaluated image is the first type. The first type is related to the tumor region and the appearance feature of the first tumor. Accordingly, the accuracy of the prediction may be improved.
assignee_clean: 緯創資通股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 緯創資通股份有限公司

title: Infrared human behavior recognition method based on cooperative heterogeneous deep learning network
abstract: The invention discloses an infrared human behavior recognition method based on a collaborative heterogeneous deep learning network, which belongs to the field of computer vision and comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing view representation of actions based on infrared images, and respectively constructing an infrared image space information view and an infrared light flow time information view of the same actions; secondly, respectively constructing a convolutional neural network and a long-short-time memory network, constructing two heterogeneous depth networks for heterogeneous network collaborative training based on view difference, and selecting unlabeled data by adopting two methods of consistency and confidence evaluation based on multiple outputs in the training process; finally, feature extraction and feature fusion are carried out through the cooperative trained heterogeneous network model, then the feature extraction and feature fusion are input into a random forest for training and classification recognition, the defects existing in the behavior recognition of deep learning and semi-supervised learning are overcome effectively, and the deep learning and the semi-supervised learning are combined for perfect recognition of human behaviors.

title: System, method, and computer program product for patient authentication and identity risk assessment
abstract: Provided are a system, method, and computer program product for patient authentication and identity risk assessment. The method includes receiving an initial patient authorization request from a medical provider computing device. The initial patient authorization request includes a patient identifier communicated by a mobile device of a user to the medical provider computing device. The method also includes generating, using an identification risk assessment model and based at least partly on the initial patient authorization request, an authenticity score. The method further includes communicating the authenticity score to an insurance provider system to cause the insurance provider system to approve or decline the initial patient authorization request. The method further includes receiving a primary insurance provider response from the insurance provider system and communicating at least a portion of the primary insurance provider response to the medical provider computing device.

title: DHCP server-based steering logic for policy enforcement on IoT devices
abstract: The technology disclosed relates to a DHCP server-based steering logic for policy enforcement on IoT devices. In particular, the technology disclosed provides a steering logic running on a DHCP server on a network segment of a network. The steering logic is configured to receive DHCP requests broadcasted to the DHCP server by a plurality of special-purpose devices on the network segment, access DHCP responses generated by the DHCP server for the DHCP requests, receive, from a device classification logic, a positive determination that special-purpose devices in the plurality of special-purpose devices are special-purpose devices and not general-purpose devices, modify the accessed DHCP responses by replacing the default gateway with an inline secure forwarder on the network segment, and send the modified DHCP responses to the special-purpose devices.

title: Stimulation response profiles
abstract: Techniques for providing therapy to a patient via electrical stimulation are described. The techniques include, for example, determining, relative to a start time of providing the electrical stimulation, one or more efficacy times that correspond to an efficacy indicator, determining, according to the efficacy times, efficacy data items for the patient, comparing the efficacy data items with the efficacy indicator, and generating, based on the comparison, a prediction of an expected response to the therapy manifesting in the patient at a prospective time.

title: Video question-answering method and system based on cross-modal prompt learning
abstract: The invention discloses a video question-answering method and system based on cross-mode prompt learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting visual features and text features aiming at the teaching video, and obtaining corresponding cross-mode output features by utilizing the context query attention; and according to the output characteristics, utilizing the video answer interval highlighting module to acquire video answer interval highlighting characteristics and serve as visual prompts of a pre-trained language model, and predicting the subtitle span based on the text questions, the subtitles and the visual prompts through the pre-trained language model. According to the invention, the video answer time period interval of question matching is efficiently and accurately found from the given non-clipped teaching video, the specified text questions are semantically answered by the video answer time period interval as a target, and the text span positioning in the pre-training language model is enhanced by utilizing the video answer interval highlighting module, so that the accuracy and efficiency of video classification and video question answering can be remarkably improved, and the method is applicable to classification and video question answering tasks of various videos.

title: System and method for estimating synthetic quantitative health values from medical images
abstract: A computer-implemented method, an apparatus, and a system for estimating synthetic values of quantitative metrics are provided. They involve calculating new, more accurate boundaries using a classifier based on local intensity and spatial estimators, for the segmentation mask provided by a non-local means patch-based segmentation in a test image, and estimating for the pixels of interest at least one synthetic value of a quantitative metric using a given value of the quantitative metric assigned to the reference images and the boundaries. The method, apparatus, and system provide the advantage of generating synthetic values directly comparable against known values for given subjects or against predetermined scales for diagnostic or prognostic purposes. In the specific case of Alzheimer's disease, the invention stretches the predictive range up to two full decades, which constitutes a significant advance in the field of medical diagnostics.

title: Medical image marking point matching method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 极限人工智能有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a medical image marking point matching method, which comprises the following steps: reading a three-dimensional medical image; identifying a plurality of marker points in a three-dimensional medical image; the marking points are images of a positioning ball in the oral cavity positioner in the three-dimensional medical image; the oral cavity positioner at least comprises three positioning balls; the distances between every two positioning balls are arranged according to the size sequence to form a positioning ball distance array; obtaining the distances between every two of the plurality of marking points, and arranging the distances according to the size sequence to form a marking point distance array; and determining the corresponding relation between the mark points and the positioning balls according to the comparison result of the distance number sequence of the mark points and the distance number sequence of the positioning balls.
assignee_clean: 极限人工智能有限公司
primary_assignee: 极限人工智能有限公司

title: Intelligent care system and care method for aged people based on internet of things (IoT)
assignee: 深圳市震有智联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent care system and a care method for the aged based on an internet of things (IoT), which relate to the field of intelligent care and comprise emotion recognition and analysis, an intelligent sensor module, a data processing and control module, an alarm module and an exchange module. The sensor module is positioned in the living area of the old and is used for acquiring emotion, physiological parameters and behavior data of the old in real time; the data processing and controlling module receives and processes the data, predicts the behaviors of the old people through the medical big data and the historical medical data, and generates early warning prediction information; the communication module plays specific sound or music to improve the emotion of the old. The invention can analyze emotion and play corresponding music or specific voice according to emotion types. The early warning prediction information can trigger the auxiliary equipment to start to carry out important care on the risky old. The invention can monitor the behavior, physiological and psychological health condition of the old in real time, provide timely feedback and advice, and effectively improve the life quality and safety of the old.
assignee_clean: 深圳市震有智联科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市震有智联科技有限公司

title: Vector representation generation method and device for medical text
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a vector representation generation method and device of medical texts, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a single granularity map of the medical text and a first adjacency matrix corresponding to each single granularity map; based on the first adjacency matrix, performing repeated iterative operation on each single granularity graph by using a preset graph neural network model to obtain a first vector representation of each node in the single granularity graph; splicing the first vector representation of each node in each single granularity graph to obtain the second vector representation of each node; determining a second adjacency matrix of the multi-granularity graph based on the inclusion relation of the nodes of the different single granularity graphs; and performing repeated iterative operation on the multi-granularity graph by using the graph neural network model based on the second adjacency matrix to obtain target vector representation of each node in the multi-granularity graph. The method and the device can enhance the information richness of the text representation so as to improve the robustness of the medical text representation.

title: Medical system and operation method of medical system for controlling a driver to move an area defined by a plurality of positions of a treatment tool to a predetermined region in next image captured
abstract: A medical system, having a treatment tool; an endoscope having an image sensor configured to capture an image; a driver configured to drive the endoscope; and a processor configured to control the driver, wherein the processor is configured to determine a locus of the treatment tool and control the driver for operating the endoscope according to the determined locus.

title: Medical rehabilitation prediction system based on laser scanning imaging
assignee: 西南医科大学附属医院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a medical rehabilitation prediction system based on laser scanning imaging, which comprises: scanning and imaging module: the method comprises the steps of acquiring medical image data in a laser scanning imaging mode; an image processing module: the medical image processing device is used for preprocessing acquired medical image data; and the feature extraction module is used for: the method comprises the steps of performing feature extraction on preprocessed medical image data; model building module: the medical rehabilitation prediction model is used for building a medical rehabilitation prediction model based on the extracted medical image data characteristics and performing training optimization; rehabilitation prediction module: and the medical rehabilitation prediction model is used for performing medical rehabilitation prediction according to the medical rehabilitation prediction model obtained through training optimization. According to the invention, the characteristic extraction is carried out on the imaging of the affected part of the patient by the laser imaging, and the medical rehabilitation prediction model optimized based on the improved whale optimization algorithm is built, so that the calculation time is greatly shortened, and the medical rehabilitation prediction efficiency is improved.
assignee_clean: 西南医科大学附属医院
primary_assignee: 西南医科大学附属医院

title: Method and system for multi-tissue full-automatic segmentation of oral cavity image
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for full-automatically segmenting a plurality of tissues of an oral cavity CBCT image, which are characterized in that the data are marked by a deep learning method according to the acquired three-dimensional CBCT data of an original oral cavity, a new image is segmented by a deep learning method again, the image processing process is simple, excessive manual marking and intervention are not needed, the difficulty of the marking of the existing medical data is overcome, and meanwhile, the artificial difference in the image marking process is reduced. In the process of training the network, the countermeasures are generated for the training data, so that the training data quantity is increased, and the universality of the network can be effectively improved. The establishment of the method greatly promotes the segmentation of medical image technology and provides effective technical support for automatic diagnosis and prognosis of oral diseases.

title: Computer-based systems for dynamic data discovery and methods thereof
abstract: In order to facilitate dynamic graphing of entity networks based on activity, systems and methods include a processor receiving entity-specific data records and a plurality of entity-related activity records for a plurality of entities, where each entity-specific activity record includes activity data regarding at least one activity associated with an entity. The processor generates graph nodes for an entity activity graph based on the plurality of entity-specific data records, where each graph node of the plurality of graph nodes represents the particular entity and then generating an activity data structure, including the graph nodes and edges between the graph nodes, where the edges represent characteristics of the activities between graph nodes based on the entity-related activity record.

title: Worsening heart failure stratification
abstract: Systems and methods for monitoring patients for risk of worsening heart failure (WHF) are discussed. A patient management system includes a sensor circuit to receive respiration measurements, and an input device to receive patient dyspnea descriptor indicating dyspnea symptom severity. The system includes a risk analyzer circuit to trend the respiration measurement over time, and to generate a WHF risk indicator using both the trended respiration measurement and the received dyspnea descriptor. A control circuit controls the receiver circuit to receive the dyspnea descriptor in response to the trended respiration measurement satisfying a specific condition. The system can present the WHF risk indicator to a user or a process, or deliver or adjust a HF therapy based on the WHF risk indicator.

title: Technique for quantifying a cardiac function from CMR images
abstract: A value indicative of an ejection fraction, EF, of a cardiac chamber of a heart is based on a temporal sequence of cardiac magnetic resonance, CMR, images of the cardiac chamber. A neural network system has an input layer configured to receive the temporal sequence of a stack of slices of the CMR images along an axis of the heart. The temporal sequence is one or multiple consecutive cardiac cycles of the heart. The neural network system has an output layer configured to output the value indicative of the EF based on the temporal sequence. The neural network system has interconnections between the input layer and the output layer and is trained with a plurality of datasets. Each of the datasets comprises an instance temporal sequence of the stack of slices of the CMR images along the axis over one or multiple consecutive cardiac cycles for the input layer and an associated instance value indicative of the EF for the output layer.

title: Ear endoscope image neural network model construction method and classification processing method
assignee: 中山大学孙逸仙纪念医院, 华南理工大学
abstract: The invention discloses an ear endoscope image neural network model construction method and an intelligent classification processing method based on deep learning, wherein the model construction method comprises the following steps: selecting an otoscope image from a hospital case database to construct an otoscope data set, and dividing the data set into a test set and a training set; and (B) step (B): loading a pre-trained neural network model, and fine-tuning the pre-trained neural network model on the obtained training set to obtain a trained neural network model; step C: and B, verifying the performance of the neural network model obtained by training in the step B on a test set, and screening out an optimal neural network model. The invention also discloses an intelligent classification processing method of the otoscope image based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: and C, intelligently classifying the newly added otoscope images through the optimal neural network model obtained in the step C, and outputting classification results.
assignee_clean: 中山大学孙逸仙纪念医院; 华南理工大学
primary_assignee: 中山大学孙逸仙纪念医院

title: Intelligent recommendation method for collagen peptide health products based on machine learning
assignee: 威海百合生物技术股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electric digital data processing, in particular to an intelligent collagen peptide health care product recommendation method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring user information corresponding to each historical user in a user to be recommended and a historical user set; forming a target user group by using target users with the same occupation in all target users; analyzing and processing the working intensity of the occupation of each target user group; determining a physical strain index corresponding to each target user; determining the usage dissimilarity of the health products between every two target users; clustering all target users according to the body strain index, the professional work intensity and the dissimilarity of health care product use; and recommending the collagen peptide health products to the user to be recommended according to the user information corresponding to the target user in the target cluster to which the user to be recommended belongs. According to the invention, through data processing on all user information, the accuracy of recommending the collagen peptide health care products to the user is improved.
assignee_clean: 威海百合生物技术股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 威海百合生物技术股份有限公司

title: Image diagnosis support apparatus, image diagnosis support method, and image diagnosis support program
abstract: An image diagnosis support apparatus includes: an acquisition unit that acquires a plurality of first image data groups and a plurality of second image data groups to be subjected to comparative interpretation; an association unit that associates each of the plurality of first image data groups and each of the plurality of second image data groups with each other based on a degree of similarity between the image data groups; an image extraction unit that extracts a corresponding image corresponding to at least one target image of the first image data group from a second image data group among the plurality of second image data groups associated with a first image data group among the plurality of first image data groups; and a display controller that displays a set of images of the target image and the corresponding image on a display unit in a contrastable layout.

title: Predicting transient ischemic events using ECG data
assignee: Mayo Foundation For Medical Education And Research
abstract: Apparatuses and methods are provided to predict or diagnose an ischemic event, such as a stroke or a transient ischemic attack (TIA). A machine-learning model such as a neural network is generated that allows for recognition of an ECG consistent with an ischemic event. A system is trained and used to process a recording of ECG data from a patient to generate a prediction indicating a likelihood that the patient will experience a stroke. In other examples, a system is trained and used to process a recording of ECG data from a patient and detect an ischemic event for the patient who did not appear to have such an ischemic event.
assignee_clean: mayo foundation for medical education and research
primary_assignee: mayo foundation for medical education and research

title: System and method for providing glucose control therapy
abstract: A system may include an implantable structure with a plurality of electrodes attached thereto, where the implantable structure is configured to be implanted proximate to a nerve that innervates and is proximate to an organ involved with glucose control. The system may further include a controller configured for use to control which of the plurality of electrodes are modulation electrodes and which of the plurality of electrodes are sense electrodes, a modulation energy generator configured to deliver modulation energy using one or more of the modulation electrodes, and a nerve traffic sensor configured to sense nerve traffic in the nerve using one or more of the sense electrodes. The controller may be configured to determine if the delivered modulation energy captures the nerves based on the sensed neural activity.

title: Method for enabling data analysis services at a service layer
assignee: 康维达无线有限责任公司
abstract: A common Data Analysis Service (DAS) at the service layer is designed to use underlying existing/future data analysis techniques or tools and provide them with a unified access method to service layer entities that require those data analysis operations. The common operational framework/interface is designed to enable the DAS and operational details within the DAS. Related procedures for interacting with the DAS including new parameters in the service layer request/response messages may be used.
assignee_clean: 康维达无线有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 康维达无线有限责任公司

title: Systems and methods for predicting B1+ maps from magnetic resonance calibration images
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for predicting B1 + field maps from magnetic resonance calibration images using deep neural networks. In an exemplary embodiment a method for magnetic resonance imaging comprises, acquiring a magnetic resonance (MR) calibration image of an anatomical region, mapping the MR calibration image to a transmit field map (B1 + field map) with a trained deep neural network, acquiring a diagnostic MR image of the anatomical region, and correcting inhomogeneities of a transmit field in the diagnostic MR image with the B1 + field map. Further, methods and systems are provided for collecting and processing training data, as well as utilizing the training data to train a deep learning network to predict B1 + field maps from MR calibration images.

title: Image segmentation method, model training method, device, medium, and electronic device
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image segmentation method, an image segmentation model training method, a training device, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment.A first model is trained through a training sample image and an interested region image corresponding to the training sample image, then an interested region boundary probability graph of the training sample image is calculated, namely the probability that each pixel point in the training sample image is an interested region boundary, a second model is trained through the training sample and the corresponding interested region probability graph, finally, the first model and the second model are weighted and fused to obtain a final image segmentation model, and the first model is trained through the training sample image and the interested region image corresponding to the training sample image; the second model is trained by utilizing the boundary probability map of the region of interest, and the second model is used for guiding the retraining of the first model, so that the influence of the fuzzy boundary on the model training can be reduced, and the accuracy and the robustness of the image segmentation model are improved.
assignee_clean: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Tumor screening model, and construction method and device thereof
assignee: 北京橡鑫生物科技有限公司, 天津橡鑫生物科技有限公司, 北京橡鑫医学科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a tumor screening model, and a construction method and a device thereof. The model construction method comprises the steps of obtaining two groups of free DNA sequencing data from a plurality of positive samples and a plurality of control samples respectively; comparing the sequencing data of the two groups of free DNA and screening out the specific characteristics of ctDNA fragments; and (5) performing machine learning model construction by using the specific characteristics of the ctDNA fragments to obtain a tumor screening model. The method can be used for greatly improving the detection of the ctDNA by means of characteristic distribution according to the ctDNA fragments which are obviously different from the cfDNA, and can be used for constructing a tumor screening model by means of machine learning by fully utilizing the specific characteristics of the ctDNA. The tumor screening model has low requirement on the sequencing depth of a sample to be detected, can be realized by adopting conventional low-depth sequencing, and provides important research direction and clinical guidance significance for (early stage) screening of cancer.
assignee_clean: 北京橡鑫生物科技有限公司; 天津橡鑫生物科技有限公司; 北京橡鑫医学科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京橡鑫生物科技有限公司

title: Synchronous prediction method and device for three-dimensional dose distribution and flux of radiotherapy plan
assignee: 中山大学肿瘤防治中心（中山大学附属肿瘤医院、中山大学肿瘤研究所）
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of radiotherapy, and discloses a synchronous prediction method and device for three-dimensional dose distribution and flux of a radiotherapy plan, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting a planned target area outline image, a organs-at-risk outline image and a CT image from a tumor medical image of a patient; obtaining a predicted three-dimensional dose distribution map and a predicted two-dimensional flux map of a radiotherapy plan of a patient according to a pre-trained synchronous prediction model, an extracted planned target area contour image, a organs-at-risk contour image and a CT image; and according to the predicted three-dimensional dose distribution map and the predicted two-dimensional flux map, performing inverse normalization to obtain an absolute dose distribution map and an absolute flux map of the radiotherapy plan of the patient. The application can achieve the effect of improving the consistency of the quality of the radiotherapy plan and the plan design efficiency.

title: Non-invasive measurement of fibrous cap thickness
abstract: A system including a hierarchical analytics framework that can utilize a first set of machine learned algorithms to identify and quantify a set of biological properties utilizing medical imaging data is provided. System can segment the medical imaging data based on the quantified biological properties to delineate existence of perivascular adipose tissue. The system can also segment the medical imaging data based on the quantified biological properties to determine a lumen boundary and/or determine a cap thickness based on a minimum distance between the lumen boundary and LRNC regions.

title: Detection method for cancer using RNA biomarkers
abstract: Provided herein are materials and methods for detecting colorectal neoplasms and colon cancer based on the expression levels of stool-derived eukaryotic RNA biomarkers in eukaryotic nucleic acid present in a stool sample from a subject, for example, a patient. The methods can be used for the detection of high-risk adenomas and colorectal neoplasm molecular subtypes.

title: Video image enhancement method
assignee: 罗雄彪, 万英, 曾志明, 忞惪医疗机器人(苏州)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a video image enhancement method, which comprises the following steps: expanding and enhancing a medical video image training set based on image gray level transformation to obtain a video image data training set required by deep learning; performing image down-sampling processing on an input test image to obtain a low-resolution image; performing illumination component prediction on the low-resolution image based on a deep learning convolution neural network to obtain a two-dimensional low-resolution image illumination component map; performing full-resolution image illumination component prediction on the low-resolution image illumination component map based on bilateral grids and guided filtering to obtain a full-resolution image illumination component; and carrying out image enhancement on the illumination component of the full-resolution image to obtain an enhanced image. The method solves the problems of insufficient illumination and nonuniformity in the prior art, the problem that the demand of a deep learning-based method for data is large, and the problem that image video data is insufficient, improves the quality of video images, and realizes the real-time enhancement processing of the video images.
assignee_clean: 罗雄彪; 万英; 曾志明; 忞惪医疗机器人 苏州 有限公司

title: Systems and methods for generating medical image data for longitudinal studies
abstract: In a method for generating synthetic medical image data, first image data of an object under examination including a first value for a property is acquired, second image data of the object under examination including a second value for the property is acquired, the second value of the property of the second image data is matched to the first value to modify the second image data to generate synthetic image data, and the synthetic image data is provided (e.g. in electronic form as a data file). The first image data can be captured with a first magnetic resonance device at a first point in time, and the second image data can be captured with a second magnetic resonance device at a second point in time.

title: Method for applying a label made after sampling to neural network training model
assignee: 義守大學, 義大醫療財團法人義大醫院
abstract: A method for applying a label made after sampling to neural network training model comprises the following steps of: a transforming step including inputting disease-related data, transforming the data, extracting the character features of the data, and coding the data to obtain data to-be-trained; a grouping step including: grouping the data to-be-trained according to the character features to obtain grouped data; a sampling step including sampling plenty of character points from the grouped data, which have a vector approaching zero with a group core of the grouped data; an amplifying step including providing label for the unlabeled character points according to the labeled character points to obtain data for training; and ;a training step including obtaining a training model from the data for training via neural network.
assignee_clean: 義守大學; 義大醫療財團法人義大醫院

title: System and method for enhancing learning relating to a sound pattern
abstract: Systems and related methods for enhancing learning of a sound pattern or relating to a sound pattern are described. A sound output corresponding to the sound pattern is delivering to the subject, and a learning enhancing neural stimulus is delivered to a cranial nerve of the subject in association with the sound output. The neural stimulus may be, for example, a transcutaneous neural stimulus. In an aspect, the subject is prompted to mentally rehearse the sound pattern. Electrical control circuitry controls timing of delivery of sound outputs and neural stimuli. In some aspects, the system is implemented in connection with a personal computing device.

title: Systems methods, and media for detecting an anatomical object in a medical device image using a multi-stage classifier
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents, A Body Corporate Of The State Of Arizona, Acting For And On Behalf Of Arizona State University
abstract: Systems, methods, and media for detecting an anatomical object in a medical device image are provided. In some embodiments, system for detecting an anatomical object in a medical device image are provided, the systems comprising: at least one hardware processor that: applies the medical device image to a classifier having a plurality of stages, wherein a first stage of the plurality of stages and a second stage of the plurality of stages each includes a strong learner formed from a plurality of weak learners, and the weak learners in the second stage include a plurality of the weak learners included in the first stage; and identifies the medical device image as being positive or negative of showing the anatomical object based on the application the medical device image to be classifier.
assignee_clean: arizona board of regents; a body corporate of the state of arizona; acting for and on behalf of arizona state university

title: Model obtaining method, keyword generation method, device, medium and computing equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a model acquisition method, a keyword generation device, a keyword generation medium and computing equipment. The model acquisition method comprises the following steps: building a keyword generation model, the model including a main module based on an encoder-attention mechanism-decoder framework; in a supervised learning stage, aiming at each training data pair, a main module constructs probability distribution based on semantic and domain information of a source keyword and a reference target keyword, and samples a first hidden variable from the probability distribution to generate a first target keyword; the parameters of the master module are updated using a gradient back propagation approach by minimizing the loss function of the master module. The technology of the invention can generate low-frequency related keywords except the hot high-frequency keywords, and the generated target keywords are more related to the field of the source keywords by introducing field constraints; in addition, the relevance and the domain consistency of the keywords can be further improved by utilizing reinforcement learning.

title: Apparatus and method for analyzing an element of a photolithography process with the aid of a transformation model
abstract: An apparatus for analyzing an element of a photolithography process, said apparatus comprising: (a) a first measuring apparatus for recording first data of the element; and (b) means for transforming the first data into second, non-measured data, which correspond to measurement data of a measurement of the element with a second measuring apparatus; (c) wherein the means comprise a transformation model, which has been trained using a multiplicity of first data used for training purposes and second data corresponding therewith, which are linked to the second measuring apparatus.

title: Generation device, generation method, and recording medium
abstract: A generation device that generates a feature amount range visualization element that defines a continuous feature amount range for each of the factors based on time series data including feature amounts of different factors existing in time series and generates an inter-feature amount visualization element that defines relevance between a first feature amount of a first factor and a second feature amount of a second factor that are continuous in time. The device also generates visualization information indicating a relationship of the feature amounts related to the plurality of different factors by associating, by the inter-feature amount visualization element, a first feature amount range visualization element of the first factor with a second feature amount range visualization element of the second factor.

title: Method for predicting dynamic soft tissue movement of HIFU treatment system
abstract: The invention discloses a method for predicting dynamic soft tissue motion of a HIFU treatment system, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing an HIFU image sequence; constructing a predictive mapping relation between the image sequence and the tag sequence; constructing a data set and carrying out online data enhancement on the training set; building a dynamic soft tissue motion prediction model of the HIFU treatment system, training, and obtaining an optimal model through an evaluation index optimization network; after the optimal model is obtained, the test set is input into a network to perform dynamic soft tissue medical image sequence motion prediction and performance evaluation. The invention adopts a combination mode of stacking convolution long-short time memory network and time wrapper to provide basic data conditions for processing medical image sequences by a network model, can fully utilize the space-time information of the HIFU image sequences, and can perform motion prediction with accurate contour on dynamic soft tissues of the HIFU treatment system.

title: Image processing method, image processing apparatus, and non-transitory computer readable medium
assignee: 科亚医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an image processing method, an image processing apparatus, and a non-transitory computer readable medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a 3D central line of a blood vessel tree; acquiring a 2D central line of the vessel tree and 2D vessel geometric information; registering a 3D centerline of the vessel tree to a 2D centerline of the vessel tree; based on the registration result, transferring the 2D vessel geometry information of each position on the 2D central line of the vessel tree to the corresponding position on the 3D central line of the vessel tree to construct a 3D model of the vessel tree. According to the method, when the Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR) is calculated, the whole space information of the 3D image of the blood vessel tree and the blood vessel geometric information of the 2D image are combined, so that a more accurate 3D model of the blood vessel tree can be obtained.
assignee_clean: 科亚医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 科亚医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Endoscope system, medical image processing device, and operation method therefor
abstract: A medical image processing device includes a processor, in which the processor acquires an examination image of a subject captured by an endoscope, and identifies an incision suitable site in the subject included in the examination image and performs control for outputting incision suitable site information regarding the incision suitable site on the basis of the examination image, and the identification of the incision suitable site information is performed by using a learning image associated with a position of a muscular layer in the subject.

title: Deep learning automatic segmentation system and method for new hair subcortical infarction focus
assignee: 北京慧脑云计算有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning-based automatic segmentation system and method for new hair subcortical infarction lesion, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the image preprocessing module is used for reading brain image data, resampling the image data and carrying out normalization operation; registering the image data to a standard brain template space by using a registration algorithm, and transmitting a processed result to a skull removing module; the skull removing module is used for removing the skull by using a skull removing algorithm and removing noise interference; and the RSSI segmentation module is used for reading the image data processed by the skull removal module, converting the image data into image information data, and transmitting the image information data to the residual Unet model for segmentation. By adopting the RSSI focus region segmentation method and device, a segmentation technology based on deep learning can be utilized to assist a doctor to automatically and effectively segment the RSSI focus region, the workload of the doctor is reduced, and the doctor can conveniently perform subsequent diagnosis and research.
assignee_clean: 北京慧脑云计算有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京慧脑云计算有限公司

title: Method and device for tracing target tissue in ultrasonic image
assignee: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a tracing method and device for target tissues in an ultrasonic image. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting ultrasonic waves to a target tissue, receiving ultrasonic echoes, and obtaining ultrasonic echo signals; obtaining a two-dimensional ultrasonic image comprising target tissue according to the ultrasonic echo signals; receiving a first track drawn on a two-dimensional ultrasonic image, and determining a tracing outline of a target tissue according to the first track; and adjusting the tracing outline to obtain the final tracing outline of the target organization. The invention solves the technical problems of inaccurate and unrepeatable segmentation result caused by full manual image segmentation in the related technology.
assignee_clean: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
