title: Clinical data automatic generation method and system based on causal relationship mining
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically generating clinical data based on causal relationship mining, which are used for counting the information of a patient retained in a hospital according to the admission and discharge processes of the patient from the collection source of the medical data in a classified manner, neglecting redundant information generated in the admission process of the patient, sorting the admission process of the patient into 4 items of illness, examination, disease and medicine, integrating the 4 items into a uniform data set, then screening the data in the data set for the first time according to the individual requirements of the user, then determining the dependency relationship and the dependency direction among all lines of data through an algorithm, drawing a complete part of the selected data into an acyclic graph, finding the causal relationship among the data, then selecting the part of interest of the user from the causal graph to perform causal relationship virtual generation, and further solving the problem of untight relationship among the generated virtual data.

title: System and method for processing personal data by application of policies
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for processing personal data by application of policies. In one aspect, an exemplary method comprises, by the network infrastructure component, analyzing communication protocols between an IoT device and the network infrastructure component, identifying at least one field that contains personal data, for each identified field, analyzing the identified field using personal data processing policies uploaded to the network infrastructure component, and applying the personal data policies for enforcement.

title: Opportunistic placement of compute in an edge network
abstract: Various systems and methods for providing opportunistic placement of compute in an edge network are described herein. A node in an edge network may be configured to access a service level agreement related to a workload, the workload to be orchestrated for a user equipment by the node; modify a machine learning model based on the service level agreement; implement the machine learning model to identify resource requirements to execute the workload in a manner to satisfy the service level agreement; initiate resource assignments from a resource provider, the resource assignments to satisfy the resource requirements; construct a resource hierarchy from the resource assignments; initiate execution of the workload using resources from the resource hierarchy; and monitor and adapt execution of the workload based on the resource hierarchy in response to the execution of the workload.

title: Medical image focus detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a medical image focus detection method, a medical image focus detection device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image to be detected; inputting a medical image to be detected into a preset cascade detection network to obtain the initial detection probability of each stage of detection network of the cascade detection network; and calculating based on the initial detection probability of each stage of detection network to obtain the target detection probability, and determining the detection result according to the target detection probability. The method can reduce false positive and improve the detection accuracy.

title: 2D/3D spine CT (computed tomography) level registration method based on deep learning network
abstract: The invention discloses a 2D/3D spine CT level registration method based on a deep learning network, which mainly comprises two steps of coarse registration and fine registration; firstly, generating deformation of a 3D CT sequence, generating a DRR image through projection of an X-ray imaging calculation model, and then randomly selecting the DRR image to train a deep learning network; then deforming the 3D image to be registered before the operation, generating a DRR through projection of an X-ray imaging model, and inputting the DRR and the 2D reference image in the operation into a depth learning network to obtain a coarse registration parameter; and finally, based on the coarse registration parameters, finishing the precise registration of a plurality of vertebrae in the preoperative 3D image to be registered through an Adam parameter optimization algorithm, and realizing the CT level registration of the spine.

title: Method for refining cognitive insights using travel-related cognitive graph vectors
abstract: A method, system and computer-usable medium are disclosed for using travel-related cognitive graph vectors.

title: Enteral nutrition diet information management system and method
abstract: The application discloses an enteral nutrition diet information management system and method, which relate to the technical field of intelligent management, and are characterized in that basic information, diet habit data and nutrition evaluation data of a patient are analyzed and processed by adopting an artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning, deep semantic features of the basic information, the diet habit data and the nutrition evaluation data of the patient are mined, nutrition risks of the patient are comprehensively represented based on multi-mode semantic fusion features of the basic information, the diet habit data and the nutrition evaluation data of the patient, and nutrition risk scores of the patient are intelligently generated. Therefore, the accurate assessment of the nutrition risk of the patient can be realized, personalized nutrition advice is provided for the patient, the workload of medical staff is reduced, the medical cost is reduced, and the efficiency and quality of medical service are improved.

title: Image registration alignment metric
assignee: 皇家飞利浦电子股份有限公司
abstract: A method includes obtaining a combined data set that includes first and second imaging data sets. The first and second imaging data sets correspond to different imaging modalities. The method further includes determining a metric indicative of an alignment between the first and second imaging data sets in the combined data set. The method further includes presenting the metric in a human readable format.
assignee_clean: 皇家飞利浦电子股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 皇家飞利浦电子股份有限公司

title: Systems, articles and methods for cardiology sensory technology
abstract: Device and methods for a wearable medical device are disclosed. The device and methods use an on-board mobile system to alert emergency services when the user is in cardiovascular distress. The device takes advantage of newly miniaturized electrocardiograph, pulse oximetry sensors, mutual reinforcement and anomaly detection algorithms. Electrocardiograph waveforms are recorded digitally for physician review with emphasis on critical events. In the occurrence of a immediate critical-need cardiac event, the system will contact emergency services (EMS) for assistance. The system is a biometric monitoring system that implements key concepts of cardiovascular monitoring through pulse oximetry and electrocardiography (ECG). The system implements key concepts of ECGs and active/capacitive electrodes to produce a wireless network of (individually isolated) ECG nodes that can produce a system ranging from 3 to 16 leads.

title: Personal monitoring apparatus and methods
abstract: An apparatus, including a personal monitoring device assigned to an individual, which includes a database, global positioning device, first processor, and RFID tag, an RFID reader located at an entrance or exit of a venue or vehicle; and a computer assigned to a venue or vehicle. The RFID reader detects the RFID tag and the computer generates and transmits a first message containing information regarding a date and time when the RFID tag was detected and location information regarding the venue or vehicle. The personal monitoring device processes information regarding the address or location of the venue or vehicle using information regarding a travel itinerary or schedule of the individual. The personal monitoring device determines that the individual is not following, or has deviated from, the travel itinerary or schedule and generates and transmits a second message to a user communication device or central processing computer.

title: CNN and Transformer fused medical image depth information extraction method
assignee: 中加健康工程研究院(合肥)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a CNN and Transformer fused medical image depth information extraction method, and belongs to the technical field of medical image processing. The invention includes: 1. acquiring medical images with high resolution and low resolution as a training set and a test set; 2. converting all images into tensors, extracting shallow features through a layer of convolution, and then respectively inputting the shallow features into a CNN module and a Transformer module; 3. projecting all tensors into a spherical surface by adopting a spherical sensitive hashing method in a CNN module, then calculating similarity, and rearranging the tensors in sequence; 4. in a transform module, tensor is put into a depth feature extraction module, long-term dependence between images is learned, and a correlation feature relation is obtained; 5. and (3) fusing the CNN module and the Transformer module to improve the performance of the model. The invention can better reconstruct the details and the texture of the medical image.
assignee_clean: 中加健康工程研究院 合肥 有限公司
primary_assignee: 中加健康工程研究院 合肥 有限公司

title: ICU electronic medical record knowledge graph construction method, system and storage medium
assignee: 东软教育科技集团有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for constructing an ICU electronic medical record knowledge graph, comprising the following steps: creating an ICU patient feature dataset; the knowledge extraction of facts and reasoning is respectively carried out through the preprocessed ICU patient characteristic data set and the association rule mining algorithm, and the knowledge is represented in a triplet form; according to the existing facts reflected by the feature data set, a knowledge graph based on the facts is constructed, and on the basis, reasoning knowledge among the many-to-many entities is mapped into a graph structure, so that ICU electronic medical record knowledge graph construction based on the facts and reasoning is completed; generating a low-dimensional dense vector of each patient feature map by using a graph embedding method based on facts and reasoning; and calculating a similarity matrix between the low-dimensional dense vectors of each patient, and returning to Top k similar electronic medical records of the given patient according to the similarity sequence. According to the invention, the ICU electronic medical record knowledge graph is constructed in a manner based on facts and reasoning, so that the completeness of the ICU electronic medical record knowledge graph is improved.
assignee_clean: 东软教育科技集团有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软教育科技集团有限公司

title: Atrial fibrillation prediction using heart rate variability
abstract: A method comprising: receiving a plurality of data segments each representing human cardiac activity; calculating, from each of said data segments, a first value representing a distribution of a heart rate variability (HRV) parameter; acquiring a signal representing cardiac activity in a patient; deriving a second value representing distribution of an HRV parameter in said signal; and indicating an atrial fibrillation (AF) event in said patient, when a difference between said first and second values is above a predetermined threshold.

title: Thoracolumbar fracture identification segmentation and detection positioning method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a thoracolumbar fracture identification segmentation and detection positioning method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1: CT images are acquired, and a U-Net neural network is utilized to conduct thoracolumbar vertebra identification segmentation, so that a thoracolumbar vertebra target area with fracture is obtained; s2: in the target area of the thoracolumbar bones with fracture, the thoracolumbar fracture is detected and positioned by using a Faster-Rcnn deep learning network. The invention needs to locate the target area of thoracolumbar bones possibly with fracture from the CT image for subsequent deep analysis of the vertebral state. Therefore, the Faster-Rcnn deep learning network is used for detecting the fracture of the thoracolumbar bones, the relative position association relation of the concerned target in the image scene space is explored, the fracture position belongs to the thoracolumbar or the lumbar and the sections of the fracture position are positioned, and the detection segmentation and positioning method for the various fracture types of the thoracolumbar is formed, so that the positioning is accurate.

title: Systems and methods for automatic detection of surgical specialty type and procedure type
abstract: Systems and methods for automatic detection of surgical specialty type and procedure type are disclosed. One or more classification networks may be applied to automatically process input surgical image data in order to recognize and determine a surgical specialty type and a surgical procedure type depicted in the input image data. Based on the determination made by the system, one or more output indications may be generated and one or more surgical devices may be automatically controlled, such as by being optimized for use during the surgical procedure type and/or surgical specialty type represented by the input image.

title: Image filtering method and device and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image filtering method, an image filtering device and a storage medium, wherein the embodiment of the application acquires tissue images of multiple modalities of a target tissue, and determines a quality control network model to be used, and the quality control network model comprises: the method comprises the steps of sequentially connecting a cross-channel convolution sub-network, a convolution sub-network and a classification sub-network, fusing tissue image features of multiple modes based on the cross-channel convolution sub-network to obtain a first fusion feature, performing feature intensive extraction on the first fusion feature based on the convolution sub-network to obtain a second fusion feature, classifying the second fusion feature based on the classification sub-network to obtain a quality identification result of the tissue image, and filtering the tissue images of the multiple modes according to the quality identification result to obtain a filtered tissue image.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Methods and devices for treating vascular-related diseases
abstract: The invention discloses a method of treatment, comprising: selecting tissue to be exposed to radiation for gradual closure of one or more blood vessels within the tissue to be exposed to radiation; selecting a plurality of radiation levels to promote progressive constriction of the one or more blood vessels; exposing the tissue to be exposed to radiation to a selected plurality of radiation levels.

title: Semi-supervised medical image organ segmentation method and system for self-adaptive data set
abstract: The invention discloses a semi-supervised medical image organ segmentation method and a system of a self-adaptive data set, comprising the following steps: acquiring a medical image dataset comprising a labeled dataset and an unlabeled dataset; carrying out statistical analysis on the medical image dataset to obtain statistical information; preprocessing the medical image dataset based on the statistical information; constructing a semi-supervised learning framework and a segmentation network according to a semi-supervised learning method and nnU-Net, wherein the semi-supervised learning framework is used for guiding nnU-Net to adaptively design a preprocessing method, a structure of the segmentation network and super parameters; training the segmentation network according to the preprocessed label data set and the preprocessed non-label data set by adopting a five-fold cross validation method to obtain a trained segmentation network; and carrying out organ segmentation on the medical image according to the trained segmentation network to obtain a segmentation result graph. The generalization performance is strong, the segmentation precision is high, and the medical image organ segmentation task can be realized.

title: Ultrasonic follow-up patient screening method based on machine learning
assignee: 万达信息股份有限公司, 上海市公共卫生临床中心
abstract: The invention provides an ultrasonic follow-up patient screening method based on machine learning. Due to the rapid development of deep learning technology, natural language processing technology and deep learning technology are used as important means for analyzing medical texts, and are effective ways for replacing manual text screening. According to the invention, the text content is segmented by a JIEBA segmentation tool, word vectors are respectively constructed by adopting a TF-IDF method and a Word2Vec algorithm, and a chi-square test method is further utilized to select feature vectors. The classification model selects XGBoost, lightgbm and CNN to perform training modeling on the characteristic data, so that automatic screening of an ultrasonic examination follow-up list is realized.

title: Medical image registration method, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image registration method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the medical image registration method comprises the following steps: acquiring an enhanced image to be processed and a corresponding target panning image; inputting the enhanced image to be processed into a medical image enhanced component network model to acquire a target enhanced component; acquiring a target de-enhanced image according to the enhanced image to be processed and the target enhanced component; inputting the target de-enhanced image and the target panning image into an image registration network model to obtain a target deformation field of the target de-enhanced image relative to the target panning image; and carrying out deformation processing on the target de-enhanced image according to the target deformation field so as to obtain a registered target registration image. The invention improves the accuracy of image registration, effectively reduces the calculated amount in the image registration process, shortens the registration time length and greatly improves the image registration efficiency.

title: Indicating electrode contact
abstract: In one embodiment, a medical system, includes a catheter to be inserted into a chamber of a heart of a living subject, and including catheter electrodes configured to contact tissue at respective locations within the chamber of the heart, a display, and processing circuitry to receive signals from the catheter, and in response to the signals assess a respective quality of contact of each of the catheter electrodes with the tissue in the heart, and render to the display respective intracardiac electrograms traces representing electrical activity in the tissue that is sensed by the catheter electrodes at the respective locations, while modifying a visual feature of at least some of the traces responsively to the respective quality of contact of the catheter electrodes with the tissue of the heart at the respective locations.

title: Methods and systems for estimation of obstructive sleep apnea severity in wake subjects by multiple speech analyses
assignee: B.G. Negev Technologies And Applications Ltd., At Ben-Gurion University, Mor Research Applications Ltd.
abstract: Provided herein is a method and system for the estimation of apnea-hypopnea index (AHI), as an indicator for Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) severity, by combining speech descriptors from three separate and distinct speech signal domains. These domains include the acoustic short-term features (STF) of continuous speech, the long-term features (LTF) of continuous speech, and features of sustained vowels (SVF). Combining these speech descriptors may provide the ability to estimate the severity of OSA using statistical learning and speech analysis approaches.
assignee_clean: b g negev technologies and applications; at ben-gurion university; mor research applications
primary_assignee: b g negev technologies and applications

title: Utilizing satisified rules as input signals
abstract: The present invention extends to systems and methods for notifying entities of relevant events. An entity defines a rule formula that is triggered when one or more detected events match the rule formula including defining one or more event types and one or more locations types. A boundary associated with a selected location type is also received along with a monitoring area. The received elements are combined into the rule formula notification preferences are associated with the defined rule. One or more events are detected and then compared to the rule formula to determine if the combination of one or more event types occurred within the boundary of the one or more location types within the area.

title: Methods, systems, and media for deep neural network interpretation via rule extraction
assignee: Huawei Cloud Computing Technologies Co., Ltd.
abstract: Methods, systems and media for deep neural network interpretation via rule extraction. The interpretation of the deep neural network is based on extracting one or more rules approximating classification behavior of the network. Rules are defined by identifying a set of hyperplanes through the data space that collectively define a convex polytope that separates a target class of input samples from input samples of different classes. Each rule corresponds to a set of decision boundaries between two different decision outcomes. Human-understandable representations of rules may be generated. One or more rules may be used to generate a classifier. The representations and interpretations exhibit faithfulness, robustness, and comprehensiveness relative to other known approaches.

title: Systems and methods for detection and staging of pulmonary fibrosis from image-acquired data
abstract: A method for ascertaining pulmonary fibrosis disease progression or treatment response includes obtaining a first set of computed tomography (CT) images of a lung and determining a first Pulmonary Surface Index (PSI) score for the lung by detecting a first actual lung boundary of the lung within the first set of CT images, determining a first approximated lung boundary within the first set of CT images, and determining the PSI score using inputs based on the first actual lung boundary and the first approximated lung boundary. The method also includes obtaining a second set of CT images of the lung and determining a second PSI score for the lung using inputs based on a second actual lung boundary and a second approximated lung boundary. The method also includes assessing pulmonary fibrosis treatment response or disease progression based on the first PSI score and the second PSI score.

title: AI-based data virtualization
abstract: Embodiments are disclosed for a method. The method includes determining a context of a data access request for a data virtualization engine. The method also includes determining data sources that are relevant to the data access request by using a governance machine learning model trained to predict the data sources based on the request and the context. Additionally, the method includes determining data governance rules-policies that are relevant to the request, by using the governance machine learning model, further trained to predict the data governance rules-policies based on the data sources and the context. Further, the method includes generating, by using a query machine learning model, a data access command executable by the data virtualization engine and configured to retrieve data from the data sources and apply the data governance rules-policies.

title: Predictive power management in a wireless sensor network using presence detection
abstract: A system comprising a plurality of self-powered devices and a plurality of proximity self-powered devices. The plurality of self-powered devices may be configured to (i) perform instructions, (ii) store scheduling data and (iii) select one of a plurality of modes of operation. The proximity self-powered devices may be configured to (i) detect a presence and (ii) select one of a plurality of modes of operation. The plurality of self-powered devices may select one of the plurality of modes of operation based on (i) the stored scheduling data and (ii) the presence detected by at least one of the plurality of proximity self-powered devices.

title: Methods and systems for diagnosing tendon injury via ultrasound imaging
assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for diagnosing tendon injury via ultrasound imaging. The present invention provides various methods and systems for diagnosing tendon injuries using an ultrasound imager. In one example, a method may include: acquiring an ultrasound image of the anatomical feature; pairing the acquired ultrasound image with a sample image of the sample anatomical feature via a trained neural network; determining a degree of damage to the anatomical feature based on the sample image; and simultaneously displaying the acquired ultrasound image and the sample image.
assignee_clean: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司

title: Background sensitive magnifier
abstract: A medical imaging system (100) includes a user interface (110) and an enlarged view engine (130). The user interface displays a view of the medical image on a display device (114) and provides a movable indicator (116) identifying a movable point located in the displayed medical image. A magnified view engine (130) generates a local magnification of a region of interest within the displayed medical image in response to a selection of an existing endpoint or an existing contour in the displayed medical image as indicated by a first input of one or more input devices and by a current position of the movable indicator.

title: Coronary artery CTA image processing method and device based on deep learning
assignee: 青岛美迪康数字工程有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a coronary artery CTA image processing method and device based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: converting the CTA image sequence into a target NIFTI file; calling a pre-trained mask image recognition model to recognize a target NIFTI file, and converting the obtained NIFTI file with mask information into a target mask image sequence; removing a sternum area in the CTA image sequence according to the target mask image sequence to obtain a target image sequence; carrying out image three-dimensional reconstruction based on volume rendering on the target image sequence; and extracting a blood vessel region from the three-dimensional model, and projecting each point on the blood vessel region onto a two-dimensional plane to obtain a reconstructed image after the blood vessel is straightened. The invention introduces a deep learning method, realizes the removal of the sternum area in the CTA image sequence by utilizing a mask image recognition model trained in advance, realizes the three-dimensional reconstruction of the image, greatly shortens the processing time of the CTA image and obtains higher recognition precision.
assignee_clean: 青岛美迪康数字工程有限公司
primary_assignee: 青岛美迪康数字工程有限公司

title: Method and device for segmenting ventricle of echocardiogram based on deep learning and deformation model
abstract: The invention relates to an echocardiography ventricular segmentation method and a device based on deep learning and a deformation model, which are provided for solving the defects that the traditional manual boundary calibration mode usually consumes a large amount of manpower and material resources, and results calibrated by different people have certain difference, so that the calculation of relevant indexes of a ventricle is greatly influenced, and comprise the following steps: training the heart chamber rough segmentation model by using artificially labeled training data to obtain a rough segmentation training result; calculating the center point of the rough segmentation training result on each section, fitting a straight line according to all the center points, and calculating the average value of the distances from all the center points to the outer edge of the rough segmentation training result in the direction perpendicular to the straight line as a radius; resampling is carried out according to the central point and the radius which are obtained through calculation, and a three-dimensional initialization model is reconstructed based on a sampling result; and performing fine segmentation on the heart chamber rough segmentation result by adopting a deformation model. The invention is suitable for ventricular image processing.

title: Method, device, and computer program product for deep learning
abstract: A method, device and computer program product for deep learning are provided. According to one example, a parameter related to a deep learning model for a training dataset allocated to a server is obtained at a client; a transmission state of the parameter is determined, the transmission state indicating whether the parameter has been transmitted to the server; and information associated with the parameter to be sent to the server is determined based on the transmission state to update the deep learning model. Therefore, the performance of deep learning may be improved, and the network load of deep leaning may be reduced.

title: Dynamic model server for multi-model machine learning inference services
abstract: Implementations include receiving, by an application programming interface (API) server of a plurality of API servers, a prediction request from a client system, each of the plurality of API servers including a stateless server, selecting, by the API server, a model server from a plurality of model servers based on the prediction request, each of the plurality of model servers including a stateful server, calling, by the API server, the model server to execute inference using a ML model loaded to memory of the model server, receiving, by the API server, an inference result from the ML model, and sending, by the API server, the inference result to the client system.

title: Image processing method and image processing system for deep learning
assignee: Pusan National University Industry-University Cooperation Foundation
abstract: Disclosed herein is an image processing method and an image processing system for deep learning. The image processing method includes converting image data including at least one figure image into a vector image by changing a data format, encrypting at least one first attribute value for a position of the figure image in the vector image according to a selected encryption scheme, constructing a de-identified image for the image data by using a second attribute value which is changed by the encryption, and transferring the de-identified image to a cloud server in which a deep learning model is managed and processing deep learning operations of the de-identified image by the cloud server.

title: Response corpus generation method based on artificial intelligence and related equipment
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and discloses an artificial intelligence-based response corpus generation method and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring inquiry corpus and response corpus to be pushed, and performing word segmentation based on a preset linear chain conditional random field to correspondingly acquire inquiry word segmentation and response word segmentation; performing professional word sense matching on the inquiry segmentation words and the response segmentation words to correspondingly obtain inquiry professional segmentation words and response professional segmentation words; cross question-answer matching is carried out on the question-answer professional participles and the response professional participles, and the question-answer professional participles and the response professional participles are combined according to the result of the cross question-answer matching to obtain a diagnosis sentence; and (3) adopting a preset priori medical knowledge base to match treatment product information corresponding to the diagnosis statement, and combining the treatment product information and the response corpus to be pushed to obtain a new response corpus to be pushed and pushing. The invention realizes the recommendation of the treatment products in the on-line inquiry process and improves the intelligent degree of the on-line inquiry.

title: Disease data set sample acquisition processing method, system, device, processor and storage medium for novel coronavirus pneumonia
assignee: 上海市疾病预防控制中心, 上海市预防医学研究院, 上海市卫生健康委员会, 万达信息股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a method for obtaining and processing a disease data set sample aiming at novel coronavirus pneumonia based on a CART decision tree, which comprises the steps of collecting data sets of different disease types according to different types of collection standards to form a single data set aiming at each target patient; carrying out characteristic engineering treatment on each collected data set; calculating and evaluating the data of each processed data set to obtain data meeting the requirements; carrying out sample classification and training on the data set obtained by calculation and evaluation to generate a decision tree model; and acquiring and expanding the acquired data set to obtain a combined data set sample. The invention also relates to a system, a device, a processor and a storage medium thereof for realizing intelligent early diagnosis of novel coronavirus pneumonia based on the CART decision tree. By adopting the corresponding method, system, device, processor and storage medium thereof, the invention can assist medical institutions to carry out more efficient and rapid implementation and save more manpower when large-scale residents carry out suspected case screening.

title: Medical data anomaly analysis method and device based on big data and computer equipment
assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
abstract: The application relates to artificial intelligence and provides a medical data abnormity analysis method and device based on big data, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: when an abnormal analysis request sent by a terminal is received, medical data to be analyzed corresponding to the same disease category are obtained; combining the data of each type in the medical data according to a preset data combination type to obtain a medical data pair corresponding to each data combination type; clustering the medical data pairs corresponding to the data combination types respectively, and determining outliers in the medical data corresponding to the data combination types according to clustering results; and determining abnormal data in the medical data according to the abnormality degree of each outlier, and feeding the abnormal data back to the terminal so as to perform visual display at the terminal. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the medical data anomaly analysis can be improved.

title: Neural network construction method applied to medical ultrasonic image
assignee: 深圳度影医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a neural network construction method applied to medical ultrasonic images, which comprises the steps of obtaining an ultrasonic image analysis task to be processed, and determining a candidate network model corresponding to the ultrasonic image analysis task according to the ultrasonic image analysis task; and replacing a module to be replaced in the candidate network model by adopting a preset network unit to obtain a search network model, and training the search network model to obtain a network model corresponding to the ultrasonic image analysis task. According to the invention, through combining transfer learning and neural network architecture searching, a neural network architecture searching algorithm is utilized to perform replacement searching on a network layer with huge partial parameter quantity on a candidate network model, so that the network architecture searching can be combined with the feature extraction capability of the existing big data training. On one hand, starting from the head is avoided, and the searching efficiency and stability are improved; on the other hand, the model parameters of the searched hybrid neural network are retrieved and the network performance is improved.

title: System and method for detection of cognitive and speech impairment based on temporal visual facial feature
abstract: A computer-implemented method of assessing whether a patent has a condition is provided, including generating a facial landmark on a received input video to define points associated with a region of interest on a face of the patient, defining a period of talking based respective positions of the defined points, during the period of talking, measuring pause frequency, repetitive pattern, and vocabulary variety, without determining or applying semantic information associated with the talking, to generate an aggregate score, and based on the aggregate score, generating a prediction of the patient having the condition associated with the aggregate score.

title: Segmentation model establishment and segmentation method and device based on dual-attention mechanism
assignee: 陕西大智慧医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medical image segmentation, and discloses a segmentation model establishment and segmentation method and device based on a dual-attention mechanism, wherein the segmentation method is used for acquiring an original medical image dataset and acquiring a medical image dataset with labels for labeling categories and target areas of each original medical image; the method comprises the steps that a Mask R-CNN segmentation network is established, the Mask R-CNN segmentation network comprises a feature pyramid network and a double attention module, the double attention module is arranged in a residual block of the feature pyramid network, the double attention module comprises a channel attention module and a space attention module which are connected in series, and the double attention module is arranged in a convolution residual block and an identity residual block in the feature pyramid network; training a Mask R-CNN segmentation network by using a medical image data set with a label, and obtaining a segmentation model based on a dual-attention mechanism after training is finished. The invention introduces a double-attention mechanism, optimizes the segmentation boundary and can reduce the phenomena of missing segmentation and error segmentation.

primary_assignee: 陕西大智慧医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Securing user-entered text in-transit
abstract: Systems and methods described herein discuss securing user-entered data in-transit between a first device and a second device. A user may enter text in a document. A first device may analyze the document to identify the user-entered text. The user-entered text may be separated from the document and transformed into an image using a machine learning algorithm. Transforming the text into an image may secure the data in-transit from the first device to a second device. The second device may receive the image and the document from the first device. The second device may reconstruct the user-entered text from the received image and re-assemble the document from the received document and the reconstructed user-entered text.

title: Management and control for IP and fixed networking
abstract: A method for managing alarms in a network includes identifying a first set of alarms based on data in a knowledge base, determining at least one attribute for each alarm in the first set of alarms, generating a model based on the at least one attribute, and applying the model to manage alarms in the network. The at least one attribute includes at least one of a persistence time for one or more alarms in the first set of alarms, an alarm group derived from the first set of alarms, and predictions for alarms in the first set of alarms. The model may be adaptively updated to track changing network conditions relating to the alarms.

title: Lightweight ground-oriented medical Internet of things big data sharing system
abstract: The application discloses a lightweight ground large data sharing system for a medical internet of things, which comprises a patient side, a trust center, a cloud server and a user side, wherein the patient side is internally provided with a safety middleware. The patient end carries out data encryption on the shared medical data and sets an authorized user identity set, the encrypted shared medical data is divided into a plurality of data blocks by using the security middleware, and a label is generated for each data block; the trust center calculates an encryption intermediate value and a decryption intermediate value of the shared medical data for the patient side and the user side based on the system parameters, and generates a data downloading license and a private key for the user; after verifying that the downloading data time in the user data downloading license is valid, the cloud server generates a data certificate and a label certificate; and after the user side determines that the data is complete according to the data certificate and the tag certificate, downloading the encrypted data from the cloud server and calculating a decryption key to obtain plaintext data. Safe and lightweight medical big data sharing is realized, and the privacy and integrity of the shared data are ensured.

title: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma prediction equipment, system and storable medium
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
abstract: The application relates to equipment, a system and a storable medium for predicting ovarian clear cell carcinoma. The apparatus for predicting risk occurrence includes: memory and a processor. The processor is configured to invoke program instructions, the program instructions comprising: obtaining image data of an epithelial ovarian cancer patient, and extracting image features of the image data to obtain radiological features; acquiring clinical information of an epithelial ovarian cancer patient, and extracting clinical information characteristics, wherein the clinical information characteristics comprise one or more of the following characteristics: CA-125 levels, endometriosis status and hypercalcemia status; inputting the radiological features and the clinical information features into a classifier to obtain a classification result, wherein the classification result is whether the epithelial ovarian cancer patient is ovarian clear cell cancer. The application provides a classification method for predicting ovarian clear cell carcinoma and effective intervention treatment measures based on clinical problems, and has important clinical application value.
assignee_clean: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
primary_assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院

title: Method, device and system for acquiring medical prescriptions based on blockchain
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device and a system for acquiring a medical prescription based on a blockchain, and relates to the field of medical management systems. The method is applied to a business system and comprises the following steps: receiving an electronic prescription and a user identification sent by a terminal of a medical institution; generating a digital abstract of the electronic prescription, and correspondingly storing the electronic prescription and the digital abstract; storing the digital digest and the user identification to a first block in a blockchain of a blockchain system configuration; and sending the first block identifier to the user terminal to instruct the user terminal to sign the first block identifier by using the first private key, and generating a prescription certificate carrying the first block identifier, the signature of the first block identifier and the user identifier, wherein the terminal of the target institution acquires the electronic prescription from the service system according to the prescription certificate. Therefore, the user terminal does not directly contact the electronic prescription, so that the manual modification of the electronic prescription is avoided, and the target organization directly acquires the electronic prescription from the service system, so that the authenticity of the electronic prescription is ensured.

title: Optical coherence tomography super-resolution imaging method based on external attention mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to an optical coherence tomography super-resolution imaging method based on an external attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: firstly, reading in optical coherence tomography cube data, constructing a data set, preprocessing the data to obtain a full-depth low-resolution part image and an arbitrary-depth low-resolution part image, taking the full-depth low-resolution part image and the arbitrary-depth low-resolution part image as input of a convolutional neural network model, and taking the arbitrary-depth part image which is not subjected to downsampling as a training label; the second step, constructing a convolutional neural network comprising an attention mechanism, wherein the convolutional neural network model mainly comprises a feature extraction module, an external space attention module, an external channel attention module and a feature up-sampling module; thirdly, training a model.

title: System and method for perfusion-based arrhythmia alarm evaluation
abstract: A method of prioritizing arrhythmia alarms based on one patient's perfusion level includes receiving arterial blood pressure, electrocardiogram heart rate, and arterial pulse rate values of the one patient during a same time window. Analyzing the set of blood pressure values to determine if an arrhythmia event is indicated, where if an arrhythmia event is indicated, the method includes calculating a systolic blood pressure (SBP) ratio, comparing the SBP ratio to a first predetermined threshold, and if the SBP ratio is less than or equal to the first predetermined threshold, then activating a non-perfusion alarm. If the SBP ratio is greater than the first predetermined threshold, then calculating a standard deviation of a rate differential between the heart rate and the pulse rate values, and if the standard deviation is greater than a second predetermined threshold, then activating the non-perfusion alarm. A system and non-transitory computer media is also presented.

title: Apparatus and method for inserting annotation on surgery video based on artificial intelligence
abstract: Disclosed are an annotation insertion device and method for a surgical video based on AI to enable search by required surgical action. According to one embodiment of the present application, the method may comprise the steps of: dividing an inputted surgical video into a plurality of clip images; analyzing a surgical action for each of the plurality of clip images based on a previously generated AI algorithm; and providing the surgical video by inserting an annotation indicating the analyzed surgical action into the plurality of clip images.

title: Media for generating fast counterfactual explanations using reinforcement learning
abstract: In an embodiment, the systems and methods discussed herein are related to generating, via a processor, a Markov Distribution Problem (MDP), the MDP including a state space, an action space, a transition function, a reward function, and a discount factor. A reinforcement learning (RL) model is applied, via the processor, to the MDP to generate a RL agent. An input data associated with a first user is received at the RL agent. At least one counterfactual explanation (CFE) is generated via the processor and by the RL agent and based on the input data. A representation of the at least one CFE and at least one recommended remedial action is caused to transmit, via the processor, to at least one of a compute device of the first user or a compute device of a second user different from and associated with the first user.

title: Method and device for labeling blood vessel segments, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 瀚依科技(杭州)有限公司, 杭州涿溪脑与智能研究所
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for labeling blood vessel segments, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the main technical scheme comprises the following steps: firstly, labeling a blood vessel mask on blood vessel information in an image to be processed based on a preset segmentation model; secondly, marking the starting point and the end point of each blood vessel according to the blood vessel information; wherein the starting point and the ending point of the blood vessel are used for distinguishing different blood vessels; and finally, generating a segmentation mask label of each blood vessel based on a preset algorithm, the blood vessel mask and the starting point and the ending point of each blood vessel. The automatic labeling of the blood vessel segmentation masks is realized by labeling the blood vessel masking and the starting point and the ending point of different segmentation of the blood vessel and determining the segmentation mask labeling of different blood vessels by combining the blood vessel masking and the segmentation of the blood vessel, the content of manual intervention in the blood vessel segmentation masking process is reduced, and the labeling speed and the labeling precision of the blood vessel segmentation masks are improved.

title: Method and device for determining sign data
assignee: 数坤(北京)网络科技股份有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a method and a device for determining sign data, and relates to the technical field of image processing. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image and a user identifier; acquiring sign configuration data associated with the user identification, the sign configuration data including at least one target sign feature associated with the user identification; determining a set of symptom results from the symptom configuration data; and causing the terminal to output the collection of symptom results.

title: Activating functional electrical stimulation of abdominal muscles to assist coughing
assignee: Yeda Research And Development Co. Ltd., Mor Research Applications Ltd.
abstract: A system for assisted coughing includes a first sensor for measuring a parameter which can indicate a closed glottis and producing a first signal, a processor for receiving the first signal, determining a state indicating the closed glottis and generating an instruction for a Functional Electric Stimulation (FES) controller based, at least in part, on the determining, and a FES controller for generating an electric stimulation signal.
assignee_clean: yeda research and development; mor research applications

title: Method for transmitting and receiving physical uplink control channel in wireless communication system and apparatus therefor
abstract: A method of transmitting a physical uplink control channel (PUCCH) in a wireless communication system and a device therefor are disclosed. Specifically, the method performed by a user equipment (UE) includes receiving, from a base station (BS), configuration information for performing transmission and reception on a per subslot basis, receiving, from the BS, multiple physical downlink shared channels (PDSCHs) based on the configuration information, and transmitting, to the BS, the PUCCH including hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ)-acknowledgement (ACK) information for the multiple PDSCHs in a specific slot. The PUCCH includes a first PUCCH transmitted in a first subslot of the specific slot and a second PUCCH transmitted in a second subslot of the specific slot. The first PUCCH and the second PUCCH each are transmitted based on a separately constructed HARQ-ACK codebook.

title: Method and device for controlling data transmission state in wireless communication system
abstract: A method for controlling a data transmission state by a terminal in a wireless communication system may comprise: transmitting capability configuration information of the terminal to a node of a network; applying a triggered communication environment configuration on the basis of the capability configuration information from the node; transmitting, to the node, first connection configuration information related to a wireless local area network (WLAN) connection configuration; and applying a first communication environment reconfiguration triggered from the node on the basis of the first connection configuration information, wherein the capability configuration information includes LWA function permission information of the terminal.

title: Performing measurements using sensors of a medical device system
abstract: This disclosure is related to devices, systems, and techniques for performing patient parameter measurements. In some examples, a medical device system includes an optical sensor configured to measure ambient light and a tissue oxygen saturation parameter and processing circuitry configured to determine that a current measurement of the tissue oxygen saturation parameter is prompted and control the optical sensor to perform an ambient light measurement associated with the current measurement of the tissue oxygen saturation parameter. The processing circuitry is further configured to determine, based on the ambient light measurement, at least one of whether to control the optical sensor to perform the current measurement of the tissue oxygen saturation parameter, when to control the optical sensor to perform the current measurement of the tissue oxygen saturation parameter, or whether to include the current measurement of the tissue oxygen saturation parameter in a trend of the tissue oxygen saturation parameter.

title: Medical material intelligent management method based on cloud bin
assignee: 安徽中技国医医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical material intelligent management method based on a cloud bin, which relates to the technical field of storage and comprises the following steps: judging whether the stock quantity of the first article meets the first replenishment condition according to the predicted replenishment threshold value of the first article; if the first replenishment condition is met, generating a first replenishment order according to the stock quantity of the first article and a preset stock threshold value; and issuing a first demand order to the material supplier according to the first replenishment order. According to the technical scheme, when the cloud bin is used as a material demand side, active pushing and replenishment of medical materials is achieved, when the stock quantity of the medical materials is insufficient, demand orders are timely sent out to ensure supply guarantee of the medical materials, and meanwhile when the cloud bin is used as a material supply side, the materials are pushed by a second pushing and booking one-way material demand side generated by an operation main body based on a second demand order, so that the phenomenon that the medical material management efficiency is low due to over-high delivery frequency is avoided, and the distribution efficiency of the medical materials is improved.
assignee_clean: 安徽中技国医医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 安徽中技国医医疗科技有限公司

title: Method and system for providing ultrasound image enhancement by automatically adjusting beamformer parameters based on ultrasound image analysis
abstract: A system and method for automatically adjusting beamformer parameters based on ultrasound image analysis to enhance ultrasound image acquisition is provided. The method includes acquiring, by an ultrasound system, an ultrasound image. The method includes segmenting, by at least one processor, the ultrasound image to identify anatomical structure(s) and/or image artifact(s) in the ultrasound image. The method includes detecting, by the at least one processor, a location of each of the identified anatomical structure(s) and/or image artifact(s). The method includes automatically adjusting, by the at least one processor, at least one beamformer parameter based on the detected location of one or more of the identified anatomical structure(s) and/or the image artifact(s). The method includes acquiring, by the ultrasound system, an enhanced ultrasound image based on the automatically adjusted at least one beamformer parameter. The method includes presenting, at a display system, the enhanced ultrasound image.

title: Corneal topography distinguishing method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 中山大学中山眼科中心
abstract: The invention discloses a corneal topography distinguishing method and system based on deep learning, which preprocesses a corneal topography obtained in the prior art to obtain corneal topography characteristic data which can be processed by a corneal topography distinguishing model, inputs the corneal topography characteristic data into the corneal topography distinguishing model, and obtains a corneal morphology result through the corneal topography distinguishing model. The corneal topography is analyzed and determined by the corneal topography distinguishing model, the morphology result is determined, a doctor can directly determine the corneal morphology according to the result output by the corneal topography distinguishing model, and the prediction accuracy is high. According to the corneal topography distinguishing method and system based on deep learning, the trained convolutional neural network model is used for distinguishing the form of the corneal topography, and the problem that the corneal form distinguishing technology for deep learning processing analysis of the corneal topography is lacked in the prior art is solved.
assignee_clean: 中山大学中山眼科中心
primary_assignee: 中山大学中山眼科中心

title: System for receiving transmissions from disparate node and triggering automatic portal action
abstract: A system for monitoring device data is provided. The system is configured to monitor, continuously, a computing device associated with the first user for an indication of a status change for a status of the first user; identify, from the computing device associated with the first user, the indication of the status change for the first user, where the indication of the status change was received from the first user via first user input to the computing device; identify a responsive action associated with the status change of the first user; and transmit a responsive action to a mobile computing device of a second user of the one or more users, wherein the responsive action alert activates the responder application to cause the mobile computing device of the second user to display a notification of the status change and the responsive action in real time.

title: Wearable terminal and system for supporting nursing care using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable terminal and a nursing support system using the same, capable of reducing medical expenses of a user. The nursing support system comprises: one or more wearable terminals worn by a person to be cared; a nurse terminal including a first biometric information processing unit; and a central management server set in association with the wearable terminal and the nurse terminal.

title: Automatic cardiac view classification of echocardiography
abstract: A method for view classification includes providing a frame of an object of interest, detecting a region of interest within the object of interest for each of a plurality of detectors (e.g., binary classifiers), wherein each binary classifier corresponds to a different view, performing a global view classification using a multiview classifier for each view, outputting a classification for each view, fusing outputs of the multiview classifiers, and determining and outputting a classification of the frame based on a fused output of the multiview classifiers.

title: Media label propagation in an ad hoc network
abstract: A method of labeling media files includes connecting to at least one device on an ad hoc network and indexing media and corresponding labels in the ad hoc network. The method also includes comparing a computed feature representation of a seed media file with feature representations of other media files in the ad hoc network to create an ordered list. The method further includes determining whether a label corresponding to a media file on the ordered list matches the label of the seed media file and increasing a label frequency when the label corresponding to the media file on the ordered list matches the label of the seed media file.

title: Multi-sequence MRI image segmentation method based on residual error network
abstract: The invention belongs to the cross field of computer vision and machine learning, and discloses a multi-sequence MRI image segmentation method based on a residual error network. The invention introduces a residual error network on the basis of a classical encoder-decoder partition network, and replaces the original encoding-decoding network with a residual error unit. And extracting more local features by utilizing the jump connection in the residual error unit. Jump connection among residual error units at the same level is increased, and extraction of global features is realized. In addition, aiming at the problem of unbalanced segmentation categories caused by large proportion difference between a target region and a background region in an MRI image, the invention linearly combines cross entropy loss and Dice loss and weights the Dice loss to solve the problem.

title: Method and system for centralized patient monitoring management
abstract: A centralized monitoring unit (CMU) receiving patient monitoring data from multiple patient monitoring devices includes at least two monitoring technician stations and an assignment management module. Each monitoring technician station is configured to present alarms for each patient in the group of patients to a CMU technician. The assignment management module is executable by a processing system to calculate a load index for each monitoring technician station based on alarms for patients in the group of patients. The load index for each monitoring technician station is calculated based on at least one of a number of alarms, an alarm type of each alarm, a severity of each alarm, and a duration of continuous alarming at the monitoring technician station. Assignment of the multiple patients amongst the at least two monitoring technician stations is then distributed based on the load indexes.

title: Methods and systems for motion detection in positron emission tomography
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for medical imaging systems. In one embodiment, a method for a medical imaging system comprises acquiring emission data during a positron emission tomography (PET) scan of a patient, reconstructing a series of live PET images while acquiring the emission data, tracking motion of the patient during the acquiring by determining a per-voxel variation for selected voxels in a current live PET image of the series of live PET images, and outputting an indication of patient motion based on the per-voxel variation for the selected voxels in each live PET image. In this way, patient motion during the scan may be identified and compensated for via scan acquisition and/or data processing adjustments, thereby producing a diagnostic PET image with reduced motion artifacts and increased diagnostic quality.

title: Lung cancer prediction
assignee: The Johns Hopkins University, Provincial Health Services Authority
abstract: A device may obtain first information relating to one or more first lung nodules identified in first imaging of a chest of a patient and second information relating to one or more second lung nodules identified in second imaging of the chest of the patient. The device may provide the first information and the second information to a machine learning model. The device may determine, using the machine learning model, a risk of lung cancer associated with the patient based on an elapsed time between performance of the first imaging and the second imaging and differences between the first information and the second information. The risk of lung cancer may have an inverse correlation to the elapsed time and a direct correlation to the differences. The device may perform one or more actions based on the risk of lung cancer that is determined
assignee_clean: the johns hopkins university; provincial health services authority

title: Partial phase vectors as network sensors
abstract: Systems and methods provide for improving the accuracy of a location system. The location system can capture partial phase vector data from one or more access points (APs). The location system can capture associated data associated with the partial phase vector data across multiple dimensions, such as identity data of the APs and client devices generating the partial phase vector data and frequency band data, location data, a time and date, and other data associated with the partial phase vector data. The location system can determine correlation data across the multiple dimensions using the first partial phase vector data and the associated data. The location system can a cause of the partial phase vector data based on the correlation data. The location system can perform one or more remediation actions based on the cause of the partial phase vector data.

title: Self-diagnosis device, program control system, and computer-readable storage medium
assignee: 景昱医疗科技（苏州）股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a self-diagnostic device, a program-controlled system, and a computer-readable storage medium. The self-diagnostic apparatus is configured to: when the patient meets preset monitoring conditions, acquiring first measurement data of health monitoring parameters of the patient by using health monitoring equipment; respectively detecting whether the first measurement data of each health monitoring parameter is in a preset range corresponding to the first measurement data; when the first measurement data of at least one health monitoring parameter is detected not to be in a preset range corresponding to the first measurement data, historical measurement data are obtained; acquiring actual configuration information based on the latest N times of historical configuration information; acquiring second measurement data of the health monitoring parameter of the patient by using the health monitoring device; based on the historical measurement data and the second measurement data, detecting whether the stimulator has faults or not to obtain fault diagnosis results. The fault result of the stimulator is acquired by the self-diagnosis device at the first time by the patient.

title: Cranial image analysis method and system based on neural network and random forest
assignee: 上海优医基医疗影像设备有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a cranial image analysis method and system based on a neural network and a random forest. After exposure and picture synthesis are carried out on the craniofacial surface of a patient by imaging equipment (generally oral and maxillofacial tomography equipment, CBCT for short), an imaging result is input into a craniofacial anatomical feature marking module, marking work on an important anatomical structure on an image is completed through a series of automatic computer identification and marking processes, and a high-precision position of a feature point is output; and then the craniofacial report generation module receives the positions of all the anatomical feature points of the craniofacial anatomical feature marking module after manual verification and adjustment, and the craniofacial medical analysis is completed, so that a final craniofacial analysis report is obtained and is used as the basis for subsequent diagnosis of a doctor. The invention solves the problem of rapid automatic analysis of the cranial image, greatly reduces the physical labor of doctors in the cranial image analysis process, and shortens the diagnosis period; meanwhile, the stability of system prediction is improved, and abnormal results are prevented from occurring.

title: CTA full-automatic collateral circulation scoring method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 复旦大学附属华山医院
abstract: The application provides a CTA full-automatic collateral circulation scoring method and system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: masking and normalizing the brain CTA image; step S2: performing brain region division on the CTA image, acquiring a related anatomical map and a functional map, and acquiring a mask map of each brain region of the weighted brain; step S3: performing blood vessel segmentation on the mask and the normalized CTA image; step S4: quantitatively calculating scoring characteristics based on the vessel segmentation result; step S5: measuring scoring characteristics of the wall thickness of the blood vessel based on the convolutional neural network; step S6: and constructing a multi-label grading classification model, and grading the calculated feature vectors in a classification way. The application can realize a collateral circulation blood vessel grading mechanism based on a blood flow compensation way, improves the segmentation precision of small blood vessels, and can lead a grading strategy to have wider application range and more objective evaluation threshold.

title: Medical environment event parsing system
abstract: A system and a method are described for identifying (e.g., parsing images) images pertaining to an event. The method also includes identifying a first subset of pixels from the plurality of potential locations as representing a bed and/or a seating platform. The method also includes identifying a second subset of pixels within the field of view of the camera as representing an object proximal to the bed and/or seating platform. The method also includes determining an orientation of the object with respect to the bed and/or seating platform, and determining changes in the orientation and/or position of the object over a period of time. In implementations, the method further includes generating state data pertaining to an event and associating the state data with corresponding image frame data.

title: Image feature fusion method, apparatus, and medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: An image feature fusion method, apparatus, and medium are disclosed. The image feature fusion method comprises the following steps: inputting at least two images with an incidence relation to a feature extraction network; respectively extracting feature information corresponding to each image of the at least two images through the feature extraction network; providing the extracted characteristic information as point characteristic information of each node in the graph convolution neural network; and determining fused feature information of each node based on point feature information of each node and edge feature information of edges connecting each node through the graph convolution neural network, updating feature information corresponding to each of the at least two images based on the fused feature information of each node to obtain fused feature information corresponding to each image, wherein the edge feature information is a weight value indicating the strength of a dependency relationship between the two connected nodes, and the strength of the dependency relationship comprises at least three different levels.

title: Solution for machine learning system
abstract: Disclosed is a computer-implemented method for estimating an uncertainty of a prediction generated by a machine learning system, the method including: receiving first data; training a first machine learning model component of a machine learning system with the received first data, the first machine learning model component is trained to generate a prediction; generating an uncertainty estimate of the prediction; training a second machine learning model component of the machine learning system with second data, the second machine learning model component is trained to generate a calibrated uncertainty estimate of the prediction. Also disclosed is a corresponding system.

title: Doppler radar system with machine learning applications for fall prediction and detection
abstract: A system for passively predicting and detecting falls using one or more dual-polarized Doppler radars and machine learning algorithms. The system is typically implemented for use in predicting or detecting falls in older adults and may be connected with various systems that can alert emergency services or hospice personnel in the event of a fallen individual. Furthermore, the system overcomes conventional radar systems by integrating vertical and horizontal micro-Doppler signatures into a combined signature which is analyzed by machine learning algorithms to correctly and expeditiously predict and detect a variety of human movements. The system also finds applications wherever micro-Doppler signals may be generated such as predicting or detecting behaviors or movements over time to detect and predict the onset of diseases and other disabilities.

title: Training method, system and device of image feature extraction model
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application discloses a training method, a system and a device of an image feature extraction model, wherein the training method of the image feature extraction model comprises the following steps: acquiring an image sample set, and randomly acquiring a plurality of single-frame images aiming at each image sample; preprocessing each single-frame image according to a preset strategy to obtain a plurality of image samples; inputting the plurality of image samples into a feature extraction network architecture, wherein the feature extraction network architecture is composed of a plurality of feature extraction models, and a feature map of each image sample is obtained through the feature extraction models; constructing a loss model, constructing a training sample based on the feature maps of the plurality of image samples, and training the loss model in an automatic supervision mode to obtain a loss function of the training sample; and updating parameters of the feature extraction model by using the loss function so as to finish the training of the feature extraction model.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军总医院

title: Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (WCD) system logging events and broadcasting state changes and system status information to external clients
abstract: Methods, apparatus, and systems relating to a Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (WCD) system capable of logging event data and/or broadcasting state changes and/or system status information to external clients are described. In an embodiment, a processor stores data corresponding to one or more event markers in memory in response to occurrence of an event. Occurrence of the event is detected based at least in part on detection of one or more parameters by one or more sensors or a signal to be generated by one or more of electrodes of the WCD system. A communication device transmits at least a portion of the stored data to a remote device. A patient condition or a WCD system condition can then be detected based at least in part on analysis of the stored data and/or the transmitted portion of the stored data.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine health evaluation system and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine health evaluation system and application thereof, wherein the system comprises: registering a login module; a user management module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the tongue picture of the user and the disease information input by the user, and storing the acquired information to the data storage module; a data storage module; the data processing module is used for confirming that the health state of the user is normal or biased according to the user disease data information by a traditional Chinese medicine health evaluation method based on personalized normal information; and the health maintenance scheme recommending module is used for recommending the health maintenance scheme according to the health state of the user. According to the system, the health state of the user is confirmed through the traditional Chinese medicine health assessment method based on personalized normal state information, the personalized health assessment in the traditional Chinese medicine field is realized, the defect that individual differences are not considered in the prior art is overcome, data can be updated in real time, the accuracy of a personalized normal state health model can be continuously improved, the assessment effect of 'according to personal conditions' can be realized, and the application prospect is good.

title: Method and apparatus for outputting information
assignee: 百度在线网络技术（北京）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for outputting information. One embodiment of the method comprises: acquiring user input information; in response to the user input information including an image of the patient, determining a first set of probabilities based on the image, wherein the first probability is a probability that the patient has a disease of a predetermined set of diseases determined based on the image; determining a disease from the disease set as a target disease based on the first set of probabilities; and outputting the disease information of the target disease. The embodiment enriches the generation mode of the information, improves the diagnosis accuracy of the electronic equipment and is beneficial to saving the diagnosis time of medical staff.
