title: Medical similar entity classification method and system based on knowledge graph and clustering algorithm
assignee: 神州医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge maps, in particular to a medical similar entity classification method and a medical similar entity classification system based on a knowledge map and a clustering algorithm, wherein the method comprises the steps of forming data of a medical database into a triple data set, taking the triple data set as a training set, training a knowledge map learning model to obtain the medical knowledge map expressed by vectorization of the medical database, obtaining representative vectors of triples by the triples through a mean pooling layer, clustering the representative vectors of entities and relations by using a unsupervised clustering algorithm Kmeans to obtain a similar term entity library in the medical knowledge map, taking the entities in the same cluster as positive samples, taking the entities in different clusters as negative samples, inputting the positive samples and the negative samples, training an entity similar classification model, and performing similar judgment on the entities based on the entity similar classification model; the invention solves the problem of complicated classification of manually labeled similar entities and realizes the non-manual accurate construction of the medical knowledge graph.

title: CT image generation method for attenuation correction of pet images
assignee: Zhejiang Lab, Minfound Medical Systems Co., Ltd
abstract: Disclosed is a CT image generation method for attenuation correction of PET images. According to the method, a CT image and a PET image at T1 and a PET image at T2 are acquired and input into a trained deep learning network to obtain a CT image at T2; the CT image can be applied to the attenuation correction of the PET image, thereby obtaining more an accurate PET AC (Attenuation Correction) image. According to the CT image generation method for attenuation correction of PET images, the dosage of X-rays received by a patient in the whole image acquisition stage can be reduced, and physiological and psychological pressure of the patient is relieved. In addition, the later image acquisition only needs a PET imaging device, without the need of PET/CT device, cost of imaging resource distribution can be reduced, and the imaging expense of the whole stage is reduced.

title: Deep learning atrial septal defect detection method and device
assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司, 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司, 上海深睿博联医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for detecting atrial septal defect for deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an ultrasonic cardiogram, preprocessing the ultrasonic cardiogram, and extracting a region of interest; extracting features of the region of interest, and identifying a subxiphoid septal frontal section, a subxiphoid septal sagittal section, a apical four-chamber heart section, a low-level parasternal four-chamber heart section and a parasternal aortic short-axis section; detecting a minimum distance point of the atrial defect; dividing a heart structure of a subxiphoid room frontal section, a subxiphoid room sagittal section, a cardiac apex four-cavity heart section, a low-level parasternal four-cavity heart section and a parasternal aortic short axis section to obtain a division result, wherein the heart structure comprises: left atrium, right atrium, left ventricle, right ventricle, aorta and pulmonary artery; and filtering the boundary box of the minimum distance point of the detected atrial defect according to the segmentation result, and taking the filtered result as the atrial septal defect detection result.

title: Medical image assisted detection method based on residual network with cbam mechanism
abstract: Disclosed is a medical image assisted detection method based on a residual network with a convolutional block attention module (CBAM) mechanism. The method includes: S1, obtaining medical images (chest X-ray (cxr) medical images of lungs), and clipping and normalizing the medical images; S2, carrying out data transformation on the normalized medical images; S3, building a network model on the basis of a convolutional auto-encoder and in combination with a feature extraction method of a spatial and channel attention mechanism and a hierarchical-split block (hs-block) module; and S4, inputting the medical images into the network model for prediction, and visualizing lesion prediction regions. According to the present invention, by introducing the cbam mechanism and an hs-block residual structure, a capability of the model to extract features of the X-ray images of lungs is enhanced, and detection accuracy is improved; and the method can improve detection efficiency.

title: Multi-card co-occurrence medical treatment fraud detection method, system, cloud end and medium
assignee: 上海理想信息产业（集团）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of data mining, and discloses a multi-card co-occurrence medical treatment fraud detection method, a system, a cloud and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-card aggregation knowledge graph according to the first-level co-occurrence frequency of all the participants in the total group to be detected in medical institutions and pharmacies and the second-level co-occurrence frequency of doctors and departments, searching the center nodes of the participants in the participants divided according to the multi-card aggregation knowledge graph and the community detection algorithm, extracting a first-order subgraph corresponding to each center node of the participants, comparing the similarity of the medical actions of the participants on doctors, medical time, medicines, medical items and examination items according to the first-order subgraph by adopting a multi-view double-clustering algorithm, outputting card groups with similar medical actions corresponding to the center nodes of all the participants respectively, verifying positions, and generating separation labels. The embodiment of the invention can improve the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the detection of the multi-card co-occurrence medical insurance fraudulent conduct.

title: Medical task information management system
assignee: 首都医科大学宣武医院
abstract: The present invention relates to a medical task information management system, comprising: a server for assigning medical task information; a plurality of response terminals for uploading tasks to the server and/or responding to tasks assigned by the server; the server receives the task uploaded by the response terminals and distributes the task to one or more of the response terminals again according to the task attribute and/or historical task information of the response terminals, wherein the response terminals at least comprise a primary terminal, a secondary terminal and a tertiary terminal which are determined according to the working attribute of an executive person of the response terminals, and the server can at least match the task attribute with the working attribute when distributing the task. The server comprehensively considers the executors with the task type adaptation according to various parameters of the task and the working attributes of the executors, so that task conflict is avoided, the labor intensity of the executors is reflected according to the fatigue value, the timing tasks are reasonably distributed, and task reminding is timely carried out on the executors through the response terminal, so that error and forgetting are avoided.

title: Brain tumor image detection method based on unsupervised learning
abstract: The invention provides a brain tumor image detection method (MS-NF) based on unsupervised learning. The model training of the method is carried out on a normal data set completely without professional labeling. And capturing object information details under different scales by fusing the multi-scale feature images extracted by the backbone network. The normalized flow is used for converting the image characteristics into potential space, and the exact likelihood of abnormal data is lower than that of normal data in the test process because the training is completely carried out on a normal data set, so that the threshold with discriminant is obtained for completing detection. The method also integrates a channel and a space convolution attention mechanism, and focuses the model on an abnormal area through a shared network, so that the detection performance is improved. The invention well models the data by means of the abnormality detection idea, calculates the exact likelihood of the sample data by the normalized flow, and proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme by series comparison and ablation experiments on the brain tumor data set, thereby improving the accuracy of intelligent detection of brain tumor.

title: Medical imaging method and system and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The present application provides a medical imaging method and system and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium. The medical imaging method comprises identifying an image quality type of a medical image based on a trained learning network, and generating, based on the identified image quality type, a corresponding control signal for controlling a medical imaging system.

title: Emergency communication system with contextual snippets
abstract: Systems and methods for processing emergency communications are provided. A system may receive an emergency communication initiated by an emergency communicator. The system may detect a data field action in response to an emergency receiver entering a data input based on the emergency communication. The system may capture a timestamp of when the data field action occurred. The system may generate a communication snippet based on the action timestamp and a snippet length. The communication snippet may be configured to provide context from the emergency communication to the data input. The system may transmit the communication snippet and the data input to an emergency responder.

title: Image labeling method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 联仁健康医疗大数据科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image labeling method, an image labeling device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: generating a pre-labeling result of the image to be labeled through the pre-labeling model trained in advance, and manually carrying out contour sketching, regional information input and the like on the image is not needed, so that the rapid generation of the pre-labeling result of the image is realized, and the generation efficiency of a labeling data set is improved; and the label classification model trained in advance is used for generating the label classification result of the pre-labeling result, so that the dimension reduction of the labeling revision problem of the pre-labeling result into the labeling classification problem is realized, and the generation efficiency of the labeling data set is further improved. And the formed labeling data set also comprises label classification results of the pre-labeling results, so that the accuracy of the labeling data set is improved. The pre-labeling result and the label classification result of the pre-labeling result in the embodiment can be used for assisting training of other subsequent models, so that the technical effect of improving the output precision of the training model is achieved.

title: Intelligent path planning device, system and storage medium based on two-dimensional contrast image
assignee: 北京唯迈医疗设备有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an intelligent path planning device, system and storage medium based on two-dimensional contrast images. The intelligent path planning apparatus includes a processor configured to: acquiring a two-dimensional contrast image acquired by imaging equipment, wherein lesions exist in a target blood vessel; determining the naming of each vessel segment in the two-dimensional angiography image based on the vessel by using a learning network; the starting point and the end point of the path are obtained by determining the starting point and/or the end point of the path; combining the names of the blood vessel sections to obtain the names of the blood vessel sections corresponding to the starting point and the ending point respectively; obtaining the names of the intermediate vessel sections to be passed according to the prior hierarchical connection condition of the vessel sections; and planning segment paths for the blood vessel segment corresponding to the starting point position, each middle blood vessel segment and the blood vessel segment corresponding to the ending point position respectively, and sequentially connecting the segment paths in series to obtain the whole path. Therefore, the intelligent path planning device can automatically and accurately plan paths, and can avoid planning paths which do not exist in reality.

title: Multi-band Wi-Fi fusion for WLAN sensing
abstract: A system for fusion of Wi-Fi measurements from multiple frequency bands to monitor indoor and outdoor space is provided. The system includes a multi-band wireless network comprising a set of radio devices to provide coverage in an environment, wherein the set of radio devices are configured to establish wireless communication or sensing links over multi-band wireless channels, wherein the multi-band wireless channels use a first radio band at a millimeter wavelength and a second radio band at a centimeter wavelength. The system further includes a computing processor communicatively coupled to the set of radio devices and a data storage, wherein the data storage has data comprising a parameterized model, modules and executable programs. The computing processor is configured to receive measurement data over the multi-band wireless channels to obtain a set of heterogeneous sensor data, network transferred data, or wireless channel attribute data, fuse at least two types of measurements from the first and the second radio bands at one or more steps in a parameterized model to generate an estimated environmental state in the environment.

title: Method for detecting tree-structure bifurcation key points in three-dimensional tomography image
abstract: The invention provides a method for detecting a tree-structure bifurcation key point in a three-dimensional tomography image, and relates to the field of medical image processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional tomography image containing an anatomical tree structure at an off-line stage, preprocessing the three-dimensional tomography image, marking the image, generating corresponding bifurcation key point detection, tree structure segmentation and prediction targets of a branch vector field according to results, and finally forming training data to train a deep learning network to obtain a trained network; and in the online stage, acquiring an image of the same type, outputting the branch key point heat map, the tree structure segmentation probability map and the prediction result of the branch vector field corresponding to the image by using the trained network, and calculating the final key point detection position by using the prediction results of the heat map and the segmentation probability map. The invention can be widely applied to the detection of bifurcation key points in various anatomical tree structures, such as trachea, artery, vein and the like, and can realize better detection effect.

title: Photon-counting X-ray detector, medical imaging device and method for generating an X-ray image data set
abstract: A photon-counting X-ray detector includes a converter element constructed to convert incident X-rays into electrical signals in dependence on a deposition of energy in the converter element, and an evaluation device. The evaluation device includes a pulse-generator to generate and output an electrical pulse based upon an electrical signal fed from the converter element; a differentiator to generate a differentiated signal of the electrical pulse output by the pulse-generator; and a first comparator to compare the generated differentiated signal with a first threshold value and, based upon the comparison, to output a binary output signal for a period for which the threshold value is exceeded.

title: Machine assisted analysis of documents
abstract: A document analysis system (100) for use by legal or business users is described. The system (100) includes a number of user devices 102 that communicate with a processing platform (104) to upload documents and receive reports concerning the documents. The illustrated platform (104) includes a processor (112), a document database (114), a preprocessing module (115), a machine learning module (116), a repository for analytics (118), and a report generator (120). A user can upload contracts or other documents to the platform (104) and receive scoring and ratings information for the contract.

title: Block chain-based medical question answering method, device and medium
assignee: 珠海健康云科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a medical question answering method, a device and a medium based on a blockchain, which comprise the following steps: correlating the digital certificate with the corresponding blockchain network identity and entity identity; invoking intelligent contract record facial features of the blockchain; comparing the face recognition result with the face characteristics; generating an encryption token after the face recognition is successful, managing the encryption token through a blockchain, and storing the encryption token through a doctor client; the doctor client responds to the request message of the patient user for responding; the intelligent contract records the answer process; the medical service platform audits the answers and checks the validity of the encrypted token, calls the trusted timestamp service to obtain the trusted timestamp, and further records the records by using the blockchain intelligent contract. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the medical service generation time and the content are proved not to be tampered and forged, so that the result of the medical service process has legal effect.

title: Method and device for defending attack of taking and riding in federal study with privacy protection
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for defending a pick-up car attack in federal study with privacy protection, wherein a key center generates a public-private key pair, and private keys are divided among a first server, a second server, a first server and clients; the first server encrypts the first initial model by using the public key and carries out partial decryption by using private key segmentation held by the first server to obtain a second initial model, and each client downloads the second initial model and carries out decryption by using the private key segmentation of the second initial model to carry out local model training to obtain respective gradients; the method comprises the steps that a first server and a second server calculate the gradient of a client side and cosine similarity of average gradient according to gradient ciphertext of each client side, corresponding rewards or penalties are carried out on each client side, aggregation is carried out according to the gradient ciphertext, the aggregated gradient ciphertext is obtained, each client side is updated according to the aggregated gradient ciphertext, and in a trap wheel, a trap gradient is constructed to induce a riding attacker to update to an error direction.

title: Systems and methods for a health-related survey using pictogram answers
abstract: In some embodiments, a non-transitory processor-readable medium includes code to cause a processor to send a signal representing a first question and a set of pictogram answers associated with the first question and a second question, different from the first question, and a set of pictogram answers associated with the second question. The first question and the second question can define a health-related survey such as a health-risk assessment. The non-transitory processor-readable medium includes code to receive a user selection of a pictogram answer associated with the first question and receive a user selection of a pictogram answer associated with the second question. The non-transitory processor-readable medium includes code to define a health-related user profile based on the user selection to the first question and the second question.

title: Urinary calculus component analysis method and system based on machine learning and energy spectrum CT
assignee: 广州市番禺区中心医院(广州市番禺区人民医院、广州市番禺区心血管疾病研究所), 深圳大学
abstract: The invention discloses a urinary calculus component analysis method and system based on machine learning and energy spectrum CT, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a spectral CT image to be analyzed; extracting a region of interest of the calculus from the acquired energy spectrum CT image; and (4) carrying out urinary calculus component analysis by adopting a machine learning method according to the region of interest of the calculus. The invention combines the energy spectrum CT image with the machine learning technology to be applied to the analysis of the components of the calculus of the human body, analyzes the components of the calculus of the urinary system by analyzing the energy spectrum CT image of the human body through the machine learning, is more efficient, objective and accurate, and combines the energy spectrum CT multi-parameter imaging technology based on the energy spectrum CT image, can more comprehensively reflect various components of the calculus of the urinary system, thereby providing more accurate and comprehensive analysis results of the chemical components of the calculus. The invention can be widely applied to the field of medical image processing.

title: Method, system, and computer program product for fraud prevention using deep learning and survival models
abstract: Provided is a method for fraud prevention using deep learning and survival models. The method may include receiving, with at least one processor, transaction data associated with a plurality of transactions of at least one payment account. At least one attempted attack may be detected based on the transaction data. A fraud risk score for each subperiod of a plurality of subperiods in a time period following the at least one attempted attack may be generated based on the transaction data using a deep learning model and a survival model. The fraud risk score for each respective subperiod may be associated with a probability that a fraudulent transaction will not occur by the respective subperiod. A system and computer program product are also disclosed.

title: Methods and apparatus for computer-aided radiological detection and imaging
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: A computer aided detection (CAD) method and system is configured to input chest radiographs and generate overlay layer for labeling and tracing tubes detected within the image. The input image is first preprocessed and then segmented according to anatomy. Seeds are generated from the segmented image and then used to grow the region. Tubes are selected from the grown region and data is overlayed on the image based on the grown seed path.

title: Data analysis apparatus, data analysis method, and data analysis program
abstract: A data analysis apparatus executes: a selection process selecting a first feature variable group that is a trivial feature variable group contributing to prediction and a second feature data group other than the first feature variable group from a set of feature variables; an operation process operating a first regularization coefficient related to a first weight parameter group corresponding to the first feature variable group in a manner that the loss function is larger, and operating a second regularization coefficient related to a second weight parameter group corresponding to the second feature variable group in a manner that the loss function is smaller, among a set of weight parameters configuring a prediction model, in a loss function related to a difference between a prediction result output in a case of inputting the set of feature variables to the prediction model and ground truth data corresponding to the feature variables.

title: System and method for generating images
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: Systems and methods of generating an enhanced segmented image set are provided. The method can comprise the following steps: acquiring a first image comprising a first anatomical structure of a first object; determining first feature data of the first anatomical structure; determining one or more first transforms related to the first anatomical structure, wherein a first transform comprises a transform type and one or more transform parameters related to the transform type; applying the one or more first transformations to the first feature data of the first anatomical structure to generate second feature data of the first anatomical structure; and generating a second image based on the second feature data of the first anatomical structure. Since the second image generated based on the first image marks the segmentation information of the image, the method solves the problem that marked segmented image data cannot be acquired in a large scale.

title: Intelligent interpretation method for prenatal fetal heart monitoring signals
assignee: 广州三瑞医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent interpretation method of prenatal fetal heart monitoring signals, which comprises the steps of preprocessing fetal heart rate signals, uterine contraction pressure signals and fetal movement signals to obtain a fusion multi-signal data set; then carrying out segmentation processing to construct a data set to be classified; sequentially inputting an embedded layer, a splicing layer, a bidirectional gating circulating unit layer and a full-connection layer of the prenatal fetal monitoring intelligent interpretation model, and performing sigmoid function compression on the output result to obtain a classification discrimination result; the intelligent interpretation method of the invention integrates the uterine contraction pressure signal and fetal movement signal into the prenatal fetal monitoring intelligent interpretation model based on the bidirectional gating circulation unit, and compared with other deep learning models, the intelligent interpretation method of the invention has the advantages of less time consumption and better classification discrimination capability.

title: Molecular biomarkers and assay methods for rapid diagnosis of kawasaki disease
assignee: 天津云检医学检验所有限公司, 天津云检医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to biomarker combinations and characterization methods for diagnosing Kawasaki Disease (KD) in a clinical setting. In particular, the invention calls for the use of RNA/DNA molecular biomarkers and combinations of their copy numbers (concentrations) to derive KD scores for aiding diagnosis, prognosis, risk assessment and treatment/monitoring. More specifically, these biomarker characterization reagents (e.g., primers and polymerase) will be packaged in a kit along with a test system (e.g., applied Biosystems QuantStudio) that measures biomarker concentrations to generate a KD score that can be used to distinguish KD from other febrile pediatric indications.

title: Method for classifying and localizing images using deep neural network and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for classifying and localizing images using a deep neural network and an apparatus using the same. More specifically, according to the method of the present invention, the computing device obtains image data for training and calculates classification loss and guidance loss, updates a weight parameter of a deep neural network toward an inclination of a direction in which a loss function value becomes smaller, repeats the obtaining, calculation, and update until a predetermined training terminal condition is satisfied, classifies an input image using a trained deep neural network when the input image is obtained, and localizes an area of the input image corresponding to the classification.

title: Method and system for generating multiparametric nosological images
abstract: The method of generating multi-parametric nosological images including the steps of obtaining a stack of images; improving such images; reducing the images to a new space of equivalent representation; classifying in an unsupervised manner the units of the images obtained according to a pre-established number of classes without biological interpretation; automatically assigning multi-parametric profiles to the obtained classes; and generating a nosological image through the obtained classes. The system includes an imaging unit; an image processing unit for processing the obtained images and generating therefrom a multi-parametric nosological image; a connection for transmitting the images obtained by the imaging unit to the image processing unit; and a display for displaying the generated multi-parametric nosological image.

title: Multi-mode image automatic sketching model migration method
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal image automatic delineation model migration method, which comprises the following steps: medical images from multiple data sources are acquired and processed to obtain a source data set. And training an automatic delineation model based on a convolutional neural network and a characteristic self-coding model based on a self-coder by using the source data set. And deploying the trained automatic delineation model and the characteristic self-coding model to each hospital. And selecting matched data by using the automatic delineation model and the characteristic self-coding model according to whether the available data of the hospital has the label of the doctor, and performing online transfer learning on the automatic delineation model by using the selected data to adapt to the data characteristics of each hospital. Therefore, the multi-mode image automatic delineation model migration method reduces the cost of large-scale deployment and application and the cost of data marking, and can obtain higher delineation precision.

title: Facial expression recognition device and management service server for dementia patient using the same
abstract: A server for providing a management service for a dementia patient according to an embodiment of the present invention may include: a communication part which receives terminal state information and the facial image of a user from a user terminal, and transmits a login result performed based on the received facial image to the user terminal; a storage part which stores a result of processing the information received from the user terminal, an image analysis program for analyzing the face image of the user, and user identification information; and a control part which performs user the log-in determination of the user and emotion determination based on the received facial image of the user, and determines at least one of an emergency situation and a necessity of function limitation based on the received terminal state information, and controls the specific function of the user terminal according to the determination result. The availability of a mobile device can be improved by providing contents which the dementia patient prefers.

title: Cognitive data discovery and mapping for data onboarding
abstract: Performing an operation comprising transforming an input dataset to a predefined format, extracting, from the transformed dataset, a plurality of features describing the transformed dataset, and generating, by a machine learning (ML) algorithm executing on a processor and based on an ML model, a plurality of rules for modifying the transformed dataset to conform with a first data model.

title: Systems and methods for a configurable radio frequency coil for MR imaging
abstract: Various systems are provided for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). In one example, a method includes selecting a contour topology for operating a configurable radio frequency (RF) coil assembly, wherein the configurable RF coil assembly includes an array of conductive segments coupled via a plurality of switches, and the contour topology defines a configuration of one or more RF coil elements formed on the configurable RF coil assembly. The method further includes, during a receive mode, at least partially activating one or more subsets of switches of the plurality of switches according to the selected contour topology to form the one or more RF coil elements.

title: Return and replacement protocol (RRP)
abstract: Systems and methods provide for managing faulting network devices. A first network device can receive an error. The first network device can generate one or more frames including data indicative of the error. The first network device can broadcast the one or more frames to one or more neighboring network devices. It may be determined that the first network device is inaccessible. The first data can be retrieved and presented from a second network device among the one or more neighboring network devices. In some embodiments, a network management system can utilize the first data to generate a machine learning model that classifies whether network devices are instances of network devices designated for a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) process. In some embodiments, the network management system can apply the first data to a machine learning classifier to determine whether to initiate the RMA process for the first network device.

title: Intelligent acquisition and analysis system and method for acute diagnosis patient sign data
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent acquisition analysis system and method of emergency patient's vital sign data relates to intelligent analysis field, it is through medical equipment and sensor real-time supervision acquisition emergency patient's vital sign data, such as rhythm of the heart, blood pressure, respiratory rate, body temperature etc. and introduce data processing and analysis algorithm at the rear end and automatic detection emergency patient's vital sign and have unusual data, the trend change and the change mode of data, and early warning and the demonstration to the anomaly, through this kind of mode, can realize the automatic acquisition and the intelligent analysis of emergency patient's vital sign data, with help medical personnel discover patient's state of an illness change and risk factor fast, thereby improve emergency medical efficiency and quality.

title: Organism reaction and hemodynamic monitoring method and system based on heart ultrasonic segment activity
assignee: 四川大学华西医院, 成都中创五联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring organism reaction and hemodynamics based on heart ultrasonic segment movement, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing. The heart ultrasonic image is automatically identified and calculated based on an artificial intelligence deep learning model, dynamic typing is carried out according to the positions of all the sections and the ejection fraction, then the organism reaction is typed according to the positions of all the sections and the ejection fraction, the typing is carried out according to the Heart Rate (HR), the typing is carried out according to the central cavity morphology of the ultrasonic image of all the sections, finally the organism reaction and the hemodynamics of the heart section activity are monitored and analyzed according to the typing result, and related suggestions are given so as to carry out health monitoring and auxiliary medical monitoring, and the blank of the organism reaction and the hemodynamics monitoring of the heart section activity at present is filled.
assignee_clean: 四川大学华西医院; 成都中创五联科技有限公司

title: Medical image identification method and system based on edge calculation
abstract: The invention provides a medical image identification method and a medical image identification system based on edge calculation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the data using end sends a first request to the inner edge calculation, wherein the first request comprises an algorithm, data request information and a private key; the edge computing searches a data owning end meeting the first request in the cloud center according to the first request, establishes a sandbox, encrypts the algorithm by using a private key, and places the encrypted algorithm and data request information into the sandbox and sends the encrypted algorithm and data request information to the cloud center; the cloud center sends the data request information to a data owning end meeting the first request; the data owner side inquires data request information, encrypts a data set corresponding to an inquiry result by using a private key and then sends the encrypted data set to the cloud center; and the cloud center decrypts the algorithm and the data set in the sandbox, executes the algorithm on the data set to obtain an image identification result set, encrypts the image identification result set and sends the encrypted image identification result set to the data owning end and the data using end. The method and the system provide a reliable algorithm operation method, and ensure that the medical image data cannot be leaked from the data source to the outside.

title: Method for intelligently transmitting and receiving signal and device l'hereof
abstract: An intelligent computing device detects a plurality of candidate beams irradiated from a base station, clusters at least one of the plurality of candidate beams into at least one candidate cluster using a clustering algorithm, selects an optimal beam based on a received signal strength of each candidate beam in the at least one candidate cluster; and receives a signal using the optimal beam, and thus can reduce a beam failure rate by learning user's movement pattern of a UE through machine learning and performing a beam tracking function based on this. At least one of the base station, the UE, the intelligent computing device, and a server can be associated with an artificial intelligence module, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), a robot, an augmented reality (AR) device, a virtual reality (VR) device, devices related to 5G services, etc.

title: Automatic grading method based on multitask deep learning ankylosing spondylitis
assignee: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学
abstract: The disclosure provides an automatic grading method based on multitask deep learning ankylosing spondylitis, which relates to the technical field of image processing, and comprises the steps of obtaining a target sample data set; constructing a hip joint gap target recognition network and a hip joint gap segmentation network based on global attention according to the target sample data set; performing target recognition detection and segmentation on the plurality of preprocessed 2D hip orthotopic X-ray film images according to a hip joint gap target recognition network and a hip joint gap segmentation network to obtain a hip joint gap segmentation result; performing edge extraction processing on the hip joint gap segmentation result to obtain a hip joint gap profile curve; performing distance measurement on the hip joint gap profile curve to obtain a measurement result; and grading the symptoms according to a preset grading system. The method realizes the automatic grading of the ankylosing spondylitis symptoms by the hip joint X-ray film based on the multi-task deep learning, and improves the automation degree and the accuracy of the hip joint gap measurement.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学

title: Systems and methods for generating semantic information for scanning image
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method for generating semantic information may include obtain a scanning image. The scanning image may include a plurality of pixels representing an anatomical structure. The method may also include obtain a trained segmentation model. The method may further include determine a location probability distribution of the anatomical structure in the scanning image based on the trained segmentation model. The method may also include generate a segmentation result related to the anatomical structure based on the location probability distribution. The method may further include save the segmentation result into a tag of a digital imaging and communications in medicine (DICOM) file.

title: Methods and systems for an adaptive contrast scan
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for adaptive scan control. In one embodiment, a method for an imaging system includes performing, with the imaging system, a first contrast scan of a subject including injection of a contrast agent to the subject; processing projection data of the subject acquired during the first contrast scan to measure a contrast signal of the subject at a monitoring area; estimating a target acquisition timing for a first acquisition of a second contrast scan of the subject based on the contrast signal; and performing, with the imaging system, the second contrast scan of the subject, with the first acquisition performed at the target acquisition timing and without performing any monitoring scans between the first contrast scan and the second contrast scan.

title: System and related method for automatically selecting hanging protocols for medical research
abstract: A system (100) for selecting a selected hanging protocol (201) for a medical study (1), comprising: -a memory (101) storing hanging protocols (200) and storing a confidence factor (3) for each of the hanging protocols (200); -a selection engine (102) adapted to: combining the calculated match scores (2) between each of the hanging protocols (200) and the medical study (1) with a confidence factor (3), thereby defining a relevance score (4) for each of the hanging protocols (200); and selecting the hanging protocol with the highest relevance score (40) as the selected hanging protocol (201).

title: Device for marking image data
abstract: A device including a display panel, a storage circuit, and a processing circuit is provided. The display panel of the device is utilized to display a first image data, and a region of interest can be circled on the first image data. The processing circuit of the device is utilized to receive at least one first mark content and a first region information of the region of interest, and connect the first region information of the region of interest to the at least one first mark content. In this manner, medical professionals can quickly make an initial diagnosis by means of the at least one first mark content of the first image data.

title: UE capability for AI/ML
abstract: This disclosure provides systems, devices, apparatus, and methods, including computer programs encoded on storage media, for a UE capability for AI/ML. A UE may receive a request from a network to report a UE capability for at least one of an AI procedure or an ML procedure. The UE may transmit to the network, based on the request to report the UE capability, an indication of one or more of an AI capability, an ML capability, a radio capability associated with the at least one of the AI procedure or the ML procedure, or a core network capability associated with the at least one of the AI procedure or the ML procedure.

title: Compliance intelligent early warning system and early warning method based on data behavior feature analysis
assignee: 西安安迈信科科技有限公司
abstract: A compliance intelligent early warning system and an early warning method based on data behavior feature analysis, the system comprises: the system comprises a data source module, a data acquisition module, a capability assembly module, a behavior monitoring module and an intelligent early warning module; the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting original data in real time through a data collecting module, carrying out cleaning conversion, analysis packaging and storage on the collected data, carrying out standardization processing on the data, carrying out data analysis on the stored data through a capability component module, identifying an abnormal behavior mode through a behavior monitoring module, namely judging compliance of the data behavior, sending alarm information to an intelligent early warning module if the abnormal behavior is monitored, receiving the alarm information through the intelligent early warning module, sending risk early warning to relevant responsible persons or departments, counting early warning information from different dimensionalities, and generating a statistical analysis report form to show early warning distribution conditions; the invention has the advantages of high-efficiency identification, high safety, low operation cost and comprehensive data processing.
assignee_clean: 西安安迈信科科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 西安安迈信科科技有限公司

title: Medical big data-oriented cloud and mist mixed path determination method
abstract: The invention discloses a cloud and mist mixed path determining method for medical big data, which mainly solves the problems of high communication load and high task processing time delay in a traditional cloud-center medical big data processing mode. The scheme is as follows: constructing a medical big data task into a directed acyclic graph consisting of a plurality of subtask nodes with definite input and output relations; by a cloud and mist mixed network architecture, a mist computing layer is formed by utilizing network equipment such as switches and routers in hospitals, and medical big data task computing is gradually completed by utilizing computing capacity of mist nodes in an end-to-end directional data transmission process; and setting a path calculation mapping rule, mapping the big data in the form of directed acyclic graph to a hospital fog network topological graph, and searching an optimal mapping path for the task data. The invention effectively reduces the task processing time delay of the medical big data, ensures the working efficiency of doctors, and can be used for medical management and early warning of diseases for the medical big data.

title: Renal dysfunction risk stratification
abstract: Systems and methods for assessing a patient's risk of renal dysfunction are described. A system may include sensor circuits to sense physiological signals and processors to generate signal metrics from the physiological signals. The system may generate a primary renal risk indication using a first signal metric, and a secondary renal risk indication using at least a second signal metric. The system may generate a composite renal risk indication and estimate a glomerular filtration rate or a chronic kidney disease stage using at least the primary and secondary risk indications. The composite renal risk indication, which indicative of a degree of renal dysfunction, may be presented to a clinician, or provided to a detector for detecting worsening heart failure.

title: Survival prediction method based on multi-mode data and deep learning model
abstract: The invention discloses a survival prediction method based on multi-modal data and a deep learning model. The traditional pathological image survival prediction method only focuses on partial pathological information, cannot completely reflect the tumor morphology of a patient, and can neglect the influence of factors such as gene mutation on the tumor, and most of the traditional pathological image survival prediction methods cannot effectively combine the image and gene expression data for analysis. The invention adopts a binary image of an Otsu threshold algorithm survival differentiation tissue area and samples slice images according to the binary image; relevant features are extracted from the ResNet-50 network pre-trained by the ImageNet dataset and the features are clustered using a K-means algorithm. And (3) obtaining gene characteristics by using a minimum angle regression characteristic selection algorithm on the gene expression profile data, and inputting the data into a deep learning survival prediction model to obtain the probability of the survival risk of the patient. The invention is a method which is relatively suitable for pathological images and gene expression data and simultaneously ensures high accuracy.

title: Patient-specific virtual percutaneous structural cardiac intervention methods and systems
abstract: A system and method for selecting a cardiac implant of optimal size for implantation into a patient from a series of cardiac implants of different sizes. The method includes acquiring data representing a patient-specific cardiac region, and predicting an optimal size of the cardiac implant that best matches a predefined criteria when deployed within the cardiac region. The prediction includes: querying a database; determining a parameter value expressed by a parameter model of the patient-specific heart region; and/or inputting data representing a patient-specific heart region into the artificial intelligence device.

title: Multi-modal emission tomography quality based on patient and application
abstract: For a multi-modal emission tomography system, an improved control system increases the likelihood of optimal image quality, satisfaction of physician goals, and/or avoids repetition in scanning and the corresponding increase in dose burden. The control system is divided into two or more arrangements. One arrangement receives goal information and outputs reconstruction settings and generic scan settings to satisfy the goal information. Another arrangement converts the generic scan settings to emission tomography system-specific scan settings, which are used to detect emissions. The separation of the arrangements allows independent operation so that different system-specific conversions may be used for different systems. Another possible arrangement performs a quality check on the detected emissions, allowing feedback for altering the system-specific scan settings to possibly avoid scan repetition and/or allowing feedforward for reconstruction to optimize the reconstruction settings based on the acquired data to be reconstructed.

title: Medical image auxiliary diagnosis device based on Web browser
abstract: The application discloses a medical image auxiliary diagnosis device based on a Web browser, which belongs to the technical field of medical auxiliary, and comprises the following components: the device comprises an image camera, a memory, an image processor, a data analysis processor and a display; the image camera is used for acquiring medical images; the memory is used for acquiring medical statistical data corresponding to the medical image; the image processor is used for acquiring the medical image sent by the image camera, dividing the medical image to obtain a divided image, and acquiring the numerical characteristics of the divided image; the data analysis processor is used for determining a medical index value of the concerned part according to the numerical characteristics of the segmented image and the medical statistical data; the display is used for displaying the segmented image and the medical index value through the Web browser. The problems of high diagnosis pressure and low diagnosis efficiency caused by incapability of rapid diagnosis in the medical diagnosis process are solved, and the universality of medical services is improved.

title: Computerized system and method for estimating levels of obesity in an insured population
abstract: A computerized system and method for estimating levels of obesity in an insured population using claims data. The model uses health risk assessment data comprising age, height, and weight information as well as information about health conditions and health behaviors for a member population. Claims data is used to train a two-stage model on the member population. The first stage comprises a support vector machine, a rule-based module, and a generalized linear model that estimates the probability of obesity. The second stage comprises a regression neural network that operates on the output of the first stage and a subset of the input feature vector. Cost and utilizations in these areas, along with overall health measures as well as demographics and social factors, are inputs to a set of pattern recognition engines that perform regression. The output is the estimated body mass index of the member.

title: Support unit for a medical imaging element
abstract: A medical imaging element support unit is for use in fixing a medical imaging element (26) releasably against a region of skin of a subject. The includes a support body (14), having a base for engaging with skin of a subject in use and having a coupling means (22) for releasably coupling the medical imaging element (26) to the support body in use. A pneumatic positioning mechanism facilitates adjustment of a position of the medical imaging element relative to the support body, this being fluidly supplied by an air pump mechanism. The same air pump mechanism facilitates releasable fixation of the support body (14) to the skin, through creation of a configurable suction force at the skin engagement surface.

title: Medical viewing system configured to generate three-dimensional information and calculate an estimated region and corresponding method
abstract: A medical viewing system (1000), a signal processing apparatus and a medical viewing method are provided to suppress the influence of a change in a target point of view over time. The medical viewing system includes: the apparatus includes a generation section (21) that generates three-dimensional information about an operation field, a setting section (31) that sets a region of interest in a special light image based on the special light image captured by a medical observation device during irradiation of the special light having a predetermined wavelength band, a calculation section (32) that estimates an estimated region corresponding to a physical position of the region of interest in a normal light image captured by the medical observation device during irradiation of the normal light having a wavelength band different from the predetermined wavelength band from the three-dimensional information, and an image processing section (41) that applies predetermined image processing to the estimated region in the normal light image.

title: Medical system supporting optical fibers
assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to an optical fiber-supporting medical system comprising an elongated medical device having an optical fiber and one or more conductive elements. The optical fiber is configured to determine the shape of the medical device as it passes through the tortuous vascular pathway. The one or more conductive elements may be configured to transmit electrical signals therealong between a distal tip and a console coupled to a proximal end of the medical device. The electrical signal may determine the location of the tip of the medical device, detect an electrophysiological signal at the distal tip, and/or provide electrical stimulation or ablation energy to the distal tip of the medical device. The one or more conductive elements may be wires that extend linearly or helically around the optical fiber, or may be tubes or tube segments that extend annularly around the optical fiber, or a combination thereof.

title: Medical device and medical device system
assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to medical devices and medical device systems that include an elongate probe configured to be inserted into a patient, wherein a multicore fiber extends along the elongate probe. The optical fiber includes a sensing core fiber extending distally along a flexible distal tip portion having a bending flexibility that exceeds the flexibility of the main probe portion. The optical fiber may also include an illumination core fiber, an imaging core fiber, and an electrical conductor. The electrodes at the distal end are used to detect the ECG signal. The distal tip portion may also be steerable. The elongate probe further includes a shape memory material defining a transition temperature.

title: Medical device system and medical device
assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to a medical device system and a medical device. The medical device system includes a medical device defining an elongate probe configured for insertion into a patient's body, the elongate probe comprising: an optical fiber extending along the elongate probe, the optical fiber comprising a plurality of illumination core fibers; and an optical member disposed at the distal end of the elongate probe, the optical member configured to receive illumination light from the plurality of illumination core fibers and project the illumination light distally away from the distal end, wherein the illumination light is configured to be selectively provided to one or more subsets of the plurality of illumination core fibers such that the illumination light is projected separately away from the optical member in any one of two or more illumination modes.

title: Medical image segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a medical image segmentation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image to be segmented comprising a target segmentation area; inputting the medical image to be segmented into a trained neural network model so that the trained neural network model performs image segmentation on the medical image to be segmented to obtain the target segmented region, wherein the neural network model comprises a contraction module and an expansion module, and the contraction module is used for downsampling the medical image to be segmented through a capsule convolution layer formed by capsule convolutions with different step sizes to extract feature images with different sizes; the expansion module is configured to gradually recover the received different sized feature maps from the contraction module by a capsule deconvolution layer to generate a target sized feature map. The method solves the problem that the image segmentation method in the prior art consumes longer time.

title: Medical information anonymizing system and anonymizing method setting device
abstract: A medical information anonymizing system includes a processing circuitry. The processing circuitry acquires medical information generated in a format based on a communication standard for a medical image and including a medical image and supplementary information. The processing circuitry adds the anonymization reference information indicating an anonymizing method for anonymizing the medical information to the supplementary information in the medical information. The processing circuitry configured to receive the medical information in which the anonymization reference information is added to the supplementary information and, based on the anonymization reference information added to the medical information, anonymize at least one of the medical image and the supplementary information included in the medical information.

title: Supervised machine learning-based modeling of sensitivities to potential disruptions
abstract: A sensitivity index model for predicting the sensitivity of an entity to a potential future disruption can be trained using a process that includes dividing a population of entities for which data attributes are available into matched pairs in a first sub-population and a second sup-population based on matching propensity scores for the entities using supervised machine learning, modeling outcomes for the two sub-populations, using the resultant models to calculate expected performances of the entities under differing conditions, and generating the sensitivity index model using supervised learning techniques based on quantification of differences between the calculated expected performances for the entities.

title: Modeling method of lupus nephritis prediction model of lupus erythematosus patient
assignee: 南通大学, 南通先进通信技术研究院有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a modeling method of a lupus nephritis prediction model of a lupus erythematosus patient, which comprises the following steps: s10, collecting data, wherein phenotype data and demographic data are extracted from electronic medical records of a patient with systemic lupus erythematosus by using a natural language processing method; s20, converting the phenotype data and the demographic data into feature vectors through a 01 matrix; and S30, training the lupus nephritis prediction model by using part of the feature vectors to obtain the lupus nephritis prediction model. According to the modeling method of the lupus nephritis prediction model of the lupus erythematosus patient, disclosed by the invention, a large amount of existing electronic medical record data are used for establishing the lupus nephritis prediction model, and the lupus nephritis prediction model is applied to the study of the lupus erythematosus patient complications, so that proper measures can be taken for high-risk people, doctors are assisted in diagnosis and treatment, and the incidence rate of the lupus nephritis is reduced.
assignee_clean: 南通大学; 南通先进通信技术研究院有限公司

title: Medical guide mapping construction search system and method for intelligent question-answering system
assignee: 成都索贝数码科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical guide mapping construction search system and method for an intelligent question-answering system, which comprises the following steps: constructing a medical guideline as a medical knowledge graph; representing the user input by using a matrix to obtain a keyword representation matrix, matching the keyword representation matrix with a knowledge graph representation matrix to calculate the matrix similarity, and outputting an inquiry result and the like according to the matrix similarity; the invention is beneficial to improving the efficiency and the accuracy of the inquiry of the intelligent question-answering system.

title: Artificial intelligence pathology auxiliary diagnosis system based on multi-scale analysis
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院, 北京透彻未来科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an artificial intelligence pathology auxiliary diagnosis system based on multi-scale analysis, which comprises: pretreatment module: the method comprises the steps of acquiring a full-scan image, determining an image slice according to the full-scan image, extracting a tissue mask of the image slice, calculating a coverage ratio of the tissue mask, and determining a preselected image cut; the multi-magnification image block extraction module: the method comprises the steps of dividing the region position of a full-scan image, determining a training region and a prediction region, extracting training data of the training region, training the prediction region through the training data, and extracting a target image cut block; a multi-magnification characteristic fusion module: the method comprises the steps of extracting characteristic values of target image cutting, fusing the target image cutting, and determining a characteristic map; simulation diagnosis model module: and cutting the target images after fusion, determining the outline of the lesion area according to the feature map, and generating a simulation diagnosis model.

title: Method and device for generating electronic medical record report and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 安徽科大讯飞医疗信息技术有限公司
abstract: The application provides a method and equipment for generating an electronic medical record report and a computer readable storage medium; the method for generating the electronic medical record report comprises the steps of acquiring voice information, and carrying out voice recognition on the voice information to acquire voice characters; and matching the voice characters with elements in the element library, and after the matching is successful, generating information corresponding to the voice characters and displaying the information on the terminal in an editable form for confirmation and modification. The method can support text editing while performing voice filling.

title: Smart sensing techniques
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for smart sensing using a security and automation system are described. One method may include monitoring a parameter of a resource associated with a structure, predicting a future change in condition associated with the parameter based on the monitoring, and performing a function using the security and automation system based on the predicting. In some examples, the resource may include a service or a product.

title: Method and system for implementing customer resource use as a service
abstract: Novel tools and techniques are provided for implementing customer resource telemetry and use as a service. In various embodiments, a computing system might receive, from a user, a request to access at least one network-accessible resource associated with a customer of a service provider, the user being unassociated and unrelated with the customer; might identify at least one of a user identification, a company, or a class of user associated with the user; might determine whether at least one resource record associated with the customer indicates that the user has permission to access the at least one network-accessible resource, based on the identification. If so, the computing system might provide the user with access to the at least one network-accessible resource associated with the customer. If not, the computing system might deny, to the user, access to the at least one network-accessible resource associated with the customer.

title: System and method for situation awareness
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present application generally provides systems and methods for situational awareness. The at least one processor, when executing the set of instructions stored in the at least one non-transitory storage medium, may be configured to cause the system to perform operations including obtaining, from at least one of the one or more sensors, environmental data related to an environment corresponding to the first point in time, generating a first static global representation of the environment corresponding to the first point in time based on at least a portion of the environmental data, generating a first dynamic global representation of the environment corresponding to the first point in time based on at least a portion of the environmental data, and estimating a target state of the environment at the target point in time using a target estimation model based on the first static global representation and the first dynamic global representation.

title: Medical image processing method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
assignee: 天津新开心生活科技有限公司, 天津开心生活科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to a medical image processing method, a medical image processing device, an electronic device and a computer readable medium. Relates to the field of medical image information processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image picture and a corresponding medical image report; extracting a structured text from the medical image report, the structured text comprising a plurality of feature classes; determining a region template through the structured text; and inputting the medical image picture, the structured text and the region template into a focus positioning model to position a focus image region in the medical image picture, wherein the focus positioning model is a weak supervised learning model. The medical image processing method, the medical image processing device, the electronic equipment and the computer readable medium can improve the accuracy of locating the focus area in the medical image.

title: Systems and methods for capturing, displaying, and manipulating medical images and videos
abstract: A surgical image capture and display system includes a handheld image capture and pointing device and a display assembly. An image is captured by an image sensor of the handheld device and displayed on the display assembly. The image sensor detects light emitted by one or more beacons of the display assembly. The system determines, based on the light emitted by the one or more beacons, a position or orientation of the handheld device relative to the display assembly. The system updates display of a graphical user interface comprising the image on the display assembly in accordance with the determined position or orientation of the handheld device.

title: Disease region extraction apparatus, disease region extraction method, and disease region extraction program
abstract: Provided are a disease region extraction apparatus, a disease region extraction method, and a disease region extraction program that can extract an infarction region even in an image in which it is difficult to prepare a large amount of data indicating a correct infarction region.A disease region extraction apparatus includes: an image acquisition unit that acquires a first image obtained by capturing an image of a subject that has developed a disease; an estimated image derivation unit that estimates a second image, whose type is different from the type of the first image, from the first image to derive an estimated image; and a disease region extraction unit that extracts a disease region from the estimated image.

title: Movement station for interactive health therapy
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices for interactive workplace health therapy are disclosed, which include a movement station having a processor, memory, a user interface communicatively coupled to the processor, a communication interface, and at least one sensor. At least one piece of health therapy equipment is provided in a receptacle of the movement station. The sensor of the movement station is arranged to detect a mobile computing device that is in proximity of the movement station, and a user associated with the mobile computing device is identified. Based on the identity of the user, user profile information is retrieved from a user profile database. At least one directive is presented to the identified user via the user interface. The directive instructs the user in the use of the at least one piece of health therapy equipment. Information regarding the user's use of the at least one piece of health therapy equipment is collected and stored in the user profile database.

title: Heater plate assembly in humidifier systems for medical use
abstract: An improved system and method of determining a low water and/or water-out condition in a humidifier chamber of a respiratory or surgical humidifier system can use a specific frequency band to detect changes in a temperature of a heater plate. The temperature changes can correlate to the specific heat capacity value of the humidifier chamber. The low water and/or water-out detection process can be performed without having to determine the gases flow rate and/or can be run continuously. A heater plate assembly of the system can include a compliant insulation sheet to improve thermal coupling between the heating element and the top heating plate of the heater plate assembly, thereby improving the low water and/or water-out detection process.

title: Factor estimation device, factor estimation system, and factor estimation method
abstract: A cause estimating apparatus according to an aspect of the present invention receives information on objects, extracts state information from the received information, specifies a predetermined state related to a 1 st object among the objects, receives an input of state information corresponding to the predetermined state as the extracted state information, classifies the predetermined state, extracts situation information from the received information, specifies a situation until the state progresses to the predetermined state, and receives an input of situation information corresponding to the specified situation as the situation information extracted by the situation information extracting unit, and classifies the specified situation. Then, the factor estimation device estimates a factor causing the state to progress to the predetermined state based on the classification result of the predetermined state and the classification result of the determined state.

title: Sequence, frequency, and time interval based journey recommendation
abstract: In some examples, sequence, frequency, and time interval based journey recommendation may include generating a plurality of clusters of entities, and generating a network that identifies a time interval to a next interaction that leads to success. An estimated time interval to a specified number of conversions may be determined. A success criterion that represents a positive outcome in the estimated time interval may be determined. A historical sequence of events may be partitioned into a plurality of sequences of events leading to success or failure. The plurality of sequence of events may be mapped based on analyzed probabilities, a determined waiting interval, and determined frequency contributions, and evaluated as to whether a mapped sequence of events duration is less than a planned duration. If so, a journey may be generated and include a determined sequence of events, a corresponding frequency, and a corresponding waiting interval.

title: Data discovery solution for data curation
abstract: Disclosed are methods and systems for a data discovery solution which harnesses the power of crowdsourcing to improve automated data curation. This is done in two complimentary ways: (a) large scale collective curation through anonymized multi-tenancy, and (b) and through internet scale matching and validation gaming platform using mobile application game. The result is the most extensive library of semantic-technical mappings of the enterprise data, which are immediately at hand to provide a fast, easy and a good understanding of the enterprise data. The data discovery solution forms a gateway for governing and unlocking value from big data.

title: Method and system for esophageal cancer preoperative management based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 武汉楚精灵医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical assistance, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based esophageal cancer preoperative management method and system, comprising a client and a server; the server side comprises a case typical picture library, a picture mode identification module, a high risk focus target identification module, a surface blood vessel typing identification module and an AVA segmentation identification module. According to the invention, a plurality of deep learning models (related to image classification, target detection and semantic segmentation) are constructed according to different tasks, and a cascading model fusion technology is adopted, so that a full-flow intelligent auxiliary diagnosis function is provided in the process of screening esophageal diseases by an endoscope doctor. By detecting the high-risk lesion of the esophagus in the NBI distant view mode and according to AB typing and AVA typing observed by endoscopy, doctors can be helped to better evaluate the illness state of patients accurately, and more scientific treatment options are provided.

title: Video composition management system
abstract: Techniques for face tracking in a telemedicine environment. A method of face tracking in a telemedicine environment may include streaming video data to a user device from an agent device via an application on the agent device, the video data captured by a camera connected to the agent device through a first connector, analyzing a frame of the video data by an extension of the application to determine a position of a provider's face in the video data, generating, by the extension, a movement instruction based at least on the position of the provider's face in the video data, sending, by the extension, the movement instruction to a base application in communication with a motorized camera base coupled to the agent device through a second connector, wherein the motorized camera base executes the movement instruction causing a change in an orientation of the camera.

title: Knowledge question answering method and device, computer readable medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a knowledge question-answering method, a knowledge question-answering device, a computer readable medium and electronic equipment, wherein the knowledge question-answering method comprises the following steps: obtaining problem templates respectively formulated for various relations in the knowledge graph; filling content into the problem template according to the filling content type and the content filling position indicated by the placeholder in the problem template to obtain a problem; taking the relation between each question and each question as training data, training according to the training data to obtain an entity relation recognition model, and recognizing a target relation corresponding to the question to be answered based on the entity relation recognition model; determining a target entity matched with the entity in the questions to be answered from the knowledge graph; and generating a question answer corresponding to the to-be-answered question based on the target entity and the target relation. The embodiment of the application solves the problem of cold start of the model and can improve the performance and generalization of knowledge question-answering. The embodiment of the application can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence, intelligent traffic, auxiliary driving and the like.

title: Simulation method and equipment for laser interstitial thermotherapy
assignee: 华科精准（北京）医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a simulation method and equipment for laser interstitial thermotherapy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing an ablation model of laser interstitial thermotherapy according to the tissue diagnosis data; correcting an ablation model based on a deep learning algorithm and actual data of the completed laser interstitial hyperthermia; obtaining medical image data of a subject to be treated, establishing a three-dimensional model, drawing a region to be ablated in the three-dimensional model, inputting tissue parameters of the region to be ablated into an ablation model, and simulating an ablation process by the ablation model to provide parameters of a laser interstitial thermotherapy scheme meeting requirements.
