title: Apparatus for measuring glycation of red blood cells and glycated hemoglobin level using physical and electrical characteristics of cells, and related methods
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for measuring glycated A1c hemoglobin. A glycated hemoglobin level measuring system includes a sample testing apparatus having a microchannel that compresses a blood sample traveling through, a first pair of electrodes coupled to the microchannel, and a second pair of electrodes coupled to the microchannel. The glycated hemoglobin level measuring system further includes an analysis apparatus having sensors coupled to the first and second pairs of electrodes and configured to calculate a travel time taken by a red blood cell to pass through the first and second pairs of electrodes. The glycated hemoglobin level measuring system can use the travel time to measure a rigidity of the red blood cells and the corresponding glycated hemoglobin level.

title: Intravascular ultrasound imaging
abstract: An image processing apparatus (10) is disclosed that comprises a processor arrangement (16) adapted to receive image data corresponding to a region of interest (1) of a patients cardiovascular system, said image data comprising a temporal sequence (15) of intravascular ultrasound images acquired (150) at different phases of at least one cardiac cycle of said patient, said intravascular ultrasound images imaging overlapping volumes of the patient's cardiovascular system; implement a spatial reordering process of said temporal sequence of intravascular ultrasound images by evaluating the image data to select at least one spatial reference (6, Vref) associated with said temporal sequence of intravascular ultrasound images; estimating a distance to the at least one spatial reference for each of the intravascular ultrasound images of said temporal sequence; and reordering said temporal sequence of intravascular ultrasound images into a spatial sequence of intravascular ultrasound images based on the estimated distances; and generate an output comprising said spatial sequence of intravascular ultrasound images. Also disclosed are a method and computer program product to configure an image processing apparatus accordingly.

title: Densley-packed analyte layers and detection methods
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods and systems for detection and discrimination of optical signals from a densely packed substrate. These have broad applications for biomolecule detection near or below the diffraction limit of optical systems, including in improving the efficiency and accuracy of polynucleotide sequencing applications.

title: Apparatus and method using deep learning (DL) to compensate for large focal spot size in x-ray projection imaging
abstract: A method and apparatus is provided that uses a deep learning (DL) network to correct projection images acquired using an X-ray source with a large focal spot size. The DL network is trained using a training dataset that includes input data and target data. The input data includes large-focal-spot-size X-ray projection data, and the output data includes small-focal-spot-size X-ray projection data (i.e., smaller than the focal spot of the input data). Thus, the DL network is trained to improve the resolution of projection data acquired using a large focal spot size, and obtain a resolution similar to what is achieved using a small focal spot size. Further, the DL network is can be trained to additional correct other aspects of the projection data (e.g., denoising the projection data).

title: Machine learning based method for MIMO detection complexity reduction
abstract: A machine learning based multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) demapper for wireless devices may include a classifier that selects which MIMO demapper to use for samples of a particular tone. For example, a wireless device may receive a plurality of signals including a plurality of tones via a plurality of antennas. The wireless device may determine a selection feature for each of the plurality of tones. The wireless device may select, for each tone, a selected demapper from at least the first MIMO demapper and the second MIMO demapper based on the selection characteristics by the classifier. The second MIMO demapper may have different performance characteristics than the first MIMO demapper. The wireless device may detect for each tone one or more streams using a selected demapper for that tone. A stream may refer to a sequence of bits.

title: Multi-mode image super-resolution method based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode image super-resolution method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing data; second, a super-resolution network is constructed that concatenates a plurality of dense residual attention modules, comprising: shallow layer feature extraction, feature depth processing and image reconstruction; third, super-resolving the input low-resolution image, including: super-resolution network training and super-resolution image testing. The invention can fully utilize complementary and redundant information in medical images of different modes to reconstruct high-resolution images with better quality, provides images with better quality for human eye observation, and simultaneously provides support for computer vision tasks such as image segmentation, classification and the like.

title: Medical laboratory monitoring image analysis method and system based on image recognition
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to a medical laboratory monitoring image analysis method and system based on image recognition, wherein when image analysis is carried out on laboratory monitoring images, an unsafe behavior sample library is firstly arranged, almost all unsafe behaviors occurring in a laboratory are covered in the unsafe behavior sample library, and the image analysis of the monitoring images is carried out according to the unsafe behavior sample library, so that the accuracy of the image analysis and the unsafe behavior recognition can be effectively improved; in addition, when the unsafe behavior is identified, the unsafe behavior is classified into a dangerous behavior library and a more dangerous behavior library according to the dangerous level of the unsafe behavior; different image analysis models are set, and the image to be analyzed is sent to which image analysis model is determined through preliminary judgment, so that the image of the dangerous behavior with high requirement on alarming timeliness can be identified as soon as possible, the alarming efficiency of the dangerous behavior can be obviously improved, and the occurrence of accidents in a medical laboratory is prevented.

title: Inventory management system
abstract: Apparatus and associated methods relate to an inventory management system having a machine learning engine trained to (a) dynamically predict a demand amount of the inventory in response to a set of near-future data and (b) generate a signal to order the amount of inventory as needed. In an illustrative example, the machine learning engine may be trained by a hotel's historical room booking data, the hotel's historical occupancy data, and corresponding inventory consumption data stored in a database. Various embodiments may enable, for example, the hotel to have better management on the status of inventories at various stages. For example, sufficient inventory may be available. In addition, providing the proper amount of inventory may also advantageously reduce the cost spent on unused products.

title: Using at home measures to predict clinical state and improving the accuracy of at home measurements/predictions data associated with circadian rhythm and meal timing
abstract: Techniques are disclosed herein for using standardized meals and digital devices can be utilized outside a clinical setting to assist in determining/predicting one or more clinical states associated with one or more individuals. Using the technologies described herein, different techniques can be utilized to for using nutritional response measurements. For example, response measurements can be obtained for two fat meals instead of a single fat meal. Data associated with a circadian rhythm (e.g., sleep times, awake times) can also be utilized to improve the accuracy of the measured biomarkers. In other examples, biome data and other data can be utilized.

title: Detecting physiological responses while accounting for touching the face
abstract: Described herein are systems and methods for detecting a physiological response based on thermal measurements while accounting for touching the face. In one embodiment, a system includes an inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAM) that takes thermal measurements of a region of interest (THROI) on a user's face, and a sensor that provides measurements (M) indicative of times at which the user touches the region of interest (ROI). The system also includes a computer that detects the physiological response based on THROI and M. Optionally, the computer generates feature values based on THROI and M, and utilizes a model to detect, based on the feature values, the physiological response. Optionally, the model was trained based on samples, each including: (i) feature values generated based on previous THROI taken while M indicated touching the ROI, and (ii) a corresponding label indicative of an extent of the physiological response.

title: Macular image classification method and device
assignee: 北京鹰瞳科技发展股份有限公司, 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a macular image classification method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: capturing a macular region image from a fundus image, wherein the macular region image comprises a macular image and a background; and classifying the macular region image and the fundus image by using a machine learning model to obtain at least one category information.

title: System and method for controlling confidential information
abstract: A method for evaluating an external machine learning program while limiting access to internal training data includes providing labeled training data from a first source, receiving, by the first source, a machine learning program from a second source different from the first source, blocking, by the first source, access by the second source to the labeled training data, and training, by the first source, the machine learning program according to a supervised machine learning process using the labeled training data. The method further includes generating a first set of metrics from the supervised machine learning process that provide feedback about training of the neural network model, analyzing the first set of metrics to identify subset data therein, and, in order to permit evaluation of the neural network model, transmitting, to the second source, those metrics from the first set of metrics that do not include the subset data.

title: Information processing method, system and device
abstract: This application involves information processing method, system and devices, and specifically provide a kind of method, and wherein knowledge manager generates the structure of knowledge including security comment token and term token.At least one of each of security comment token is stored in parallel field, and snap to term token.Knowledge manager matches the security strategy for corresponding to searching request with the one or more in security comment token, and the blurrings of one or more term tokens based on snapping in the term token of matched security comment token generates search result in turn.

title: Machine-learned validation framework
abstract: A system and a method are disclosed herein for machine-learned detection of outliers within payload requests. An entity management system uses machine learning to cluster data characterizing requests from entities to route payloads, and determines one or more data clusters that are outliers. The system receives a request to route a payload to a destination, and applies a supervised machine learning model to size and type information indicated by the payload. The supervised machine learning model applies a label to the payload data (e.g., indicating that the payload routing request is an outlier). This outlier detection may drive a validation process to address detected outliers. The system may receive an indication to perform a validation function and transmit the payload to a validation destination. The system may leverage payload data and feedback received from an entity to optimize machine learning techniques to the entity.

title: Real-time or frequent ingestion by running pipeline in order of effectiveness
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for partial ingestion of content. The mechanism receives new content to be ingested into a corpus of information. The mechanism applies a plurality of sub-pipelines of annotation engines against the new content in order of effectiveness. The plurality of sub-pipelines include all annotation engines of an ingestion pipeline. Each sub-pipeline within the plurality of sub-pipelines generates one or more intermediate output objects. The mechanism provides access to the one or more intermediate output objects.

title: Training method and device of generated countermeasure network, image enhancement method and device
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a training method and device of a generated type countermeasure network, an image enhancement method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The training method comprises the following steps: obtaining a first sample set and a second sample set, the first sample set comprising first image data and corresponding enhanced image data, the second sample set comprising second image data; inputting first image data into a generated countermeasure network, and calculating a first loss error according to the enhanced image data and an output result of the generated countermeasure network so as to adjust network parameters of the generated countermeasure network; inputting second image data into the generated countermeasure network, and calculating a second loss error according to the output result of the generated countermeasure network so as to adjust the network parameters of the generated countermeasure network. The invention trains the generation type countermeasure network based on the semi-supervised deep learning, reduces the difficulty of sample data collection, and improves the accuracy and the robustness of the generation type countermeasure network.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Method, system, device and storage medium for generating visual decision tree set model
assignee: 青岛百洋智能科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for generating a visual decision tree (set) model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sorting decision knowledge in the medical guideline into a rule set in a data structured form; splitting the rule set, and counting the number N of the decision trees under the condition of not supplementing a missing value state, wherein N is more than or equal to 1; respectively taking corresponding rule sets in the N decision trees, taking the rule sets as input, taking one decision tree as output to construct a decision tree model, and generating a data structure model of each decision tree; and carrying out visualization processing on the constructed data structure model of each decision tree to generate a visualization decision tree model, and storing the visualization decision tree model in an image form. The invention ensures that the generated decision tree (set) and the original rule set have reasoning equivalence and good visualization effect.

primary_assignee: 青岛百洋智能科技股份有限公司

title: Text index enhanced question-answering method and system based on knowledge graph
assignee: 苏州体素信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a text index enhanced question-answering method and system based on a knowledge graph, comprising the following steps: and (3) a knowledge graph construction step: according to the knowledge corpus, constructing a knowledge graph with a knowledge corpus text index; knowledge matching step: and matching the knowledge triples in the knowledge graph, taking the text fragments corresponding to the extracted knowledge triples as input, and finally generating the answers. According to the invention, different knowledge points in the article or the section of speech are decomposed and are subjected to coding retrieval in an accurate and clear mode of knowledge triples, so that knowledge integration and information denoising are easier to perform, the retrieval efficiency and recall rate are improved, and the possibility of retrieval errors is reduced; according to the method, indexes of paragraphs and sentences corresponding to the specific knowledge points of the articles are added into the knowledge triples of the knowledge graph, so that the corresponding sentences or the specific paragraphs of the article corpus can be found from the knowledge graph; the invention provides additional information for the large language model, thereby improving the answer quality of the large language model in the new field.

title: System and method to detect and track surgical instruments and/or surgical material
abstract: Certain embodiments may relate to apparatuses and methods for performing surgical procedures. For example, a method may comprise initiating detection and tracking of at least one surgical instrument (including associated surgical material) within a surgical area. The method may further comprise performing a surgical procedure with the at least one surgical instrument and material and ending detection and tracking of the at least one surgical instrument and material within the surgical area. The method may further comprise displaying at least one indication of location status of the at least one surgical instrument.

title: Acoustic sensor and ventilation monitoring system
assignee: Thomas Jefferson University, RTM Vital Signs LLC
abstract: A method of monitoring respiration with an acoustic measurement device, the acoustic measurement device having a sound transducer, the sound transducer configured to measure sound associated with airflow through a mammalian trachea, the method includes correlating the measured sound into a measurement of tidal volume and generating at least one from the group consisting of an alert and an alarm if the measured tidal volume falls outside of a predetermined range.
assignee_clean: thomas jefferson university; rtm vital signs

title: Computer vision and speech algorithm design service
abstract: A synthetic world interface may be used to model digital environments, sensors, and motions for the evaluation, development, and improvement of computer vision and speech algorithms. A synthetic data cloud service with a library of sensor primitives, motion generators, and environments with procedural and game-like capabilities, facilitates engineering design for a manufactural solution that has computer vision and speech capabilities. In some embodiments, a sensor platform simulator operates with a motion orchestrator, an environment orchestrator, an experiment generator, and an experiment runner to test various candidate hardware configurations and computer vision and speech algorithms in a virtual environment, advantageously speeding development and reducing cost. Thus, examples disclosed herein may relate to virtual reality (VR) or mixed reality (MR) implementations.

title: Unbalanced clinical data classification system driven by knowledge and data in cooperation
abstract: The application discloses an unbalanced clinical data classification system driven by knowledge and data in a synergic mode, which comprises the following steps: the patient map construction module is used for extracting a medical concept set from the electronic medical record data of the patient and constructing a patient map based on the medical concept set and the corresponding relation set; the patient representation acquisition module is used for extracting knowledge features containing graph structure information from a patient graph by using a graph convolution network, and fusing the knowledge features and the data features to obtain a patient representation; the system comprises a patient clinical classification result acquisition module, a clinical data classification model and a data classification model, wherein the patient representation is input into the clinical data classification model, the clinical data classification model consists of a gating network and a plurality of expert networks, the patient representation is simultaneously input into the gating network and each expert network, the gating network distributes different patient weights for each expert network, and each expert network respectively outputs classification results based on the patient weights; and combining the classification results output by each expert network to obtain the clinical classification result of the patient.

title: User interface for predictive model generation
abstract: A dataset is searched using inclusion set criteria to produce an inclusion set and exclusion set criteria to produce an exclusion set. A set of unique content elements is identified from the inclusion set and the exclusion set. Metrics are derived from the inclusion set, exclusion set, and set of unique content elements, such as a measure, for each unique content element, of the absolute value of the difference between the percentage of records in the inclusion set containing the unique content element and the percentage of records in the exclusion set containing the unique content element. The unique content element set may be sorted and displayed in decreasing order of the above-referenced absolute value. The content element set may be filtered. Individual content elements may be excluded from the content set. A predictive model may be generated based on the resulting version of the content element set.

title: Ultrasound imaging apparatus and control method thereof
abstract: An ultrasound imaging apparatus and a control method thereof. The ultrasound imaging apparatus may include: a display; a communication unit; and a processor configured to be operatively connected to the display and the communication unit. The processor may obtain a first ultrasound image of a subject and a result of an analysis of the first ultrasound image. The processor may also control the display to display a user interface, which allows selection of an operating mode of the ultrasound imaging apparatus, based on the result of the analysis.

title: Ward system based on mobile terminal
assignee: 湖南维鼎信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of ward systems, and provides a ward system based on a mobile terminal, which comprises a medical care host, a plurality of bedside extensions, a doctor terminal, a mobile terminal, a merchant terminal and a management platform, wherein the medical care host, the bedside extensions, the doctor terminal, the mobile terminal and the merchant terminal are respectively communicated with the management platform; every head of a bed extension all is equipped with an ID address, every the ID address associates the patient information of living on corresponding berth, mobile terminal is through scanning two-dimensional code access on the head of a bed extension display screen management platform can download client APP, looks over patient information and looks for peripheral life service, need not to register and login, the two-dimensional code contains the ID address of head of a bed extension and the URL address of downloading client APP. According to the system, a user can check patient information and search life services by scanning the two-dimensional code of the bed head and entering the system, so that convenience is provided for the patient.

title: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for ocular measurements
abstract: Systems, methods and apparatuses are provided for the measurement of intraocular pressure. These systems, methods and apparatuses can include an imaging apparatus for capturing two- or three-dimensional images or video of a patient's eye. An image reconstruction based on the captured images or video can be performed, and measurements can be taken of blood vessel features, curvature metrics, or distances between point pairs. In some embodiments, blood pressure measurements can also be taken synchronously with the captured images or video. From these measurements, a relationship between certain medical condition (e.g., elevated intraocular pressure, heart arrhythmia) and the extracted metrics can be established.

title: Holding pattern detection and management
abstract: The present disclosure provides for holding pattern detection and management by identifying from flight data for an aircraft that the aircraft has performed a first turn, followed by a leg traverse, and followed by a second turn in a direction circuitous to the first turn and indicating that the aircraft is in a holding pattern and/or identifying from flight data that the aircraft has passed within a predefined distance of a fixpoint and in response to identifying that the aircraft has performed a turn in a known direction associated with a historical holding pattern charted from the fixpoint, indicating that the aircraft is in a holding pattern.

title: Oxygen saturation monitoring using artificial intelligence
abstract: In some examples, a system includes an oxygen saturation sensing device configured to sense an oxygen saturation level of a patient and processing circuitry. The processing circuitry may be configured to receive a signal indicative of the oxygen saturation level of the patient, determine that the signal indicates the oxygen saturation level is at or below a desaturation threshold, and in response to determining the oxygen saturation level of the patient is at or below the desaturation threshold, predict, using an oxygen saturation prediction model, whether the oxygen saturation level of the patient will increase above the desaturation threshold by the end of a predefined time period. In response to predicting that the oxygen saturation level of the patient will increase above the desaturation threshold by the end of the predefined time period, the processing circuitry refrains from outputting an indication of the patient experiencing an oxygen desaturation event.

title: Convenient layered old people MODS early death risk assessment model, device and establishment method
abstract: The application discloses a convenient hierarchical old MODS early death risk assessment model, device and establishment method thereof, wherein an assessment module is based on an XGboost model fused with a SHAP method, the assessment module comprises four sub-modules, and the four sub-modules are respectively used for carrying out death risk assessment and providing risk factor contribution degree analysis on the basis of 13 or 14 input features for elderly patients or elderly patients of low age. The application provides a convenient and fast hierarchical model and device for evaluating early death risk of old MODS, so that doctors can conveniently and accurately evaluate the disease urgency and the risk degree of patients.

title: Application method of class II segmentation loss function in achieving class II segmentation of intervertebral disc tissue image
abstract: A class II segmentation loss function and a construction method and application thereof relate to the field of deep learning and medical image processing and solve the problems of unbalanced background and poor segmentation precision in the prior art. The invention obtains the second-class segmentation loss function by setting the basic loss function, setting the limiting item suitable for the basic loss function, setting the balance quantity and combining the basic loss function and the limiting item through the balance quantity. The method obviously inhibits false positive influence caused by unbalance of the segmentation target during the intervertebral disc tissue image segmentation, improves the segmentation performance of the full convolution neural network and the class II segmentation loss function, improves the segmentation effect, and has extremely high application and popularization values in the technical fields of deep learning and medical image processing.

title: Cart robot
abstract: A cart robot analyzing a hand motion of a user is disclosed. The cart robot comprises a code input interface obtaining a product identification code, a sensor detecting a hand motion of a user, a weight measuring device measuring a weight of one or more products contained in a product loading space, and a controller. When there is no change in weight of the loaded products, the cart robot updates a shopping list with respect to the products loaded in the product loading space in real time by analyzing the hand motion of the user. Therefore, the convenience of the user is enhanced.

title: User state selection based on the shape of the exhale stream
abstract: The three-dimensional (3D) shape of the exhale stream from a user's nostrils is often correlated with the user's state (e.g., an emotional state and/or a certain health condition). Thus, identifying the shape of a user's exhale stream can help determine the user's state. In one embodiment, a system that selects a state of a user includes at least one inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera that takes thermal measurements of at least three regions below the nostrils (THS). THS are indicative of shape of the exhale stream (SHAPE). The system also includes a computer that generates feature values based on THS, which are indicative of the SHAPE, and utilizes a model to select the state of the user, from among potential states of the user, based on the feature values. Optionally, the system includes a user interface that present the user's selected state.

title: Chest image processing method, chest image processing device, storage medium and medical equipment
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a chest image processing method, a chest image processing device, a storage medium and medical equipment, which are used for reducing missing of bone diseases such as micro fracture and bone fracture. The chest image processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a three-dimensional chest image obtained by scanning a subject, wherein the three-dimensional chest image comprises a plurality of tomographic images, and identifying a rib region in which a rib is positioned in the tomographic images; selecting a preset number of images from the plurality of tomographic images to form a sampling image set, and determining a chest curve corresponding to any one of the sampling images according to a rib region in the sampling image; determining the corresponding relation between the projection point and the projection angle on the thoracic curve; determining a target projection angle; and according to the corresponding relation between the projection points and the projection angles on the thoracic curve, projecting the three-dimensional thoracic image to a two-dimensional plane by adopting a cylindrical projection unfolding algorithm to obtain a two-dimensional thoracic unfolding image.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Case clustering analysis method and system based on machine learning
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of case data processing, in particular to a case clustering analysis method and a system based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the steps that a case importing module imports a plurality of case samples to acquire case data; the data processing module preprocesses the case data; the feature extraction module sequentially extracts feature words in the case data to determine keywords of cluster analysis; the central control module determines the category distribution of the keywords; the central control module calculates the duty ratio of each keyword category and determines the basis of cluster analysis according to the duty ratio of each keyword category, and the cluster analysis module performs cluster analysis according to the determined basis of cluster analysis; after the cluster analysis is completed, the detection module detects discrete values of symptom information or diagnosis information in the cluster analysis result, and the central control module corrects the determination standard of the keywords according to the detection result. The invention improves the practicability and application value of the clustering analysis result.

title: Systems and methods for machine learning model to calculate user elasticity and generate recommendations using heterogeneous data
abstract: A method may include generating a feature table, hierarchical segments, and a graph network based on raw interaction data of a set of users. The method may further include generating a set of rankings for features in the feature table. The method may further include targeting hierarchical segments of the set of users through marketing campaigns and calculate a set of elasticity scores for the set of users in response to the marketing campaigns in the hierarchical segments. The method may further include generating item recommendations for the set of users based on the graph network. The method may further include executing a machine learning model to generate an uplift score for each user from the set of users based on at least one of the raw interaction data, the set of rankings, hierarchical segments, the set of elasticity scores, or the item recommendations.

title: Methods of processing a biofluid sample
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods and compositions for processing biofluid samples. Some such methods may include obtaining a biofluid sample from a subject having a disease state such as lung cancer. The biofluid sample may be contacted with a nanoparticles to adsorb proteins. The proteins may then be ionized or contacted with a detection reagent. Also disclosed herein are compositions comprising proteins coupled to a nanoparticle upon contact of the nanoparticle with a biofluid sample from a subject having a disease.

title: Electronic device and method for wireless communications
abstract: Disclosed are an electronic device for wireless communication and a method thereof. The electronic device may include an interface module and a processor. The processor may be configured to establish a first Ethernet tethering connection with an external electronic device by using an Ethernet driver, provide an Internet service to the external electronic device using a first IP address allocated to the external electronic device, deactivate the Ethernet driver in response to identifying that the IP address of the electronic device is changed and the first Ethernet tethering connection is in the bridge mode, reactivate the deactivated Ethernet driver, establish a second Ethernet tethering connection with the external electronic device by using the reactivated Ethernet driver, and provide the Internet service to the external electronic device using a second IP address allocated to the external electronic device.

title: System and method for conducting on-device spirometry test
abstract: A method includes receiving, by an electronic device, sensor data during a spirometry test of a user, the sensor data comprising audio data of the user, image data of a face of the user, and distance data of a distance from the face of the user. The method also includes obtaining, by the electronic device, at least one measured parameter associated with the spirometry test that is determined using at least one of the audio data, the image data, or the distance data, wherein the at least one measured parameter is correlated with an amount of air volume exchange or an amount of exhalation force by the user during the spirometry test. The method further includes providing, by the electronic device, real time feedback during the spirometry test, the real time feedback based on the at least one measured parameter, the real time feedback indicating whether or not the user is performing the spirometry test correctly.

title: Medical device and medical system including an elongate probe
assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to medical devices and medical systems including an elongate probe configured for insertion into a patient's body, wherein the elongate probe includes a conductive medium extending along the probe. The conductive medium may take several forms including conductive sleeves, ionic solutions, flexible circuits, wires, or plating. The probe includes a conductive tip for exchanging electrical signals with the patient. The probe includes an optical fiber having a shape sensing core fiber, an illumination core fiber, and an imaging core fiber.

title: Multimode personalized monitoring method
assignee: 港湾之星健康生物(深圳)有限公司
abstract: Decomposing a monitoring value into a variable monitoring component and a fixed monitoring component, introducing an extended component monitoring value and background noise, calculating the variable component, the fixed component and the extended component through a correlation function and an individualized characteristic set, monitoring an agreed truth value through historical and current monitoring data, and executing an object algorithm and a differential object algorithm to obtain an object correction value of which the error with the agreed truth value of the object is smaller than an allowable error. In addition, the personalized feature set is optimized by adopting an object algorithm and a group algorithm through historical monitoring data of a single object and a plurality of objects. And further calculating to obtain a group correction value of the object by adopting the monitoring data of other objects. The system also comprises modes such as cloud network big data, a local area network and a single point, and solves the dilemma brought by the traditional method of measuring all individuals by using one standard.

title: Medical image processing method and device for brain midline detection, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司, 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司
abstract: The application discloses a medical image processing method, a medical image processing device, equipment and a storage medium for brain midline detection. Inputting a CT image, and obtaining a standardized image after image standardization; obtaining a midline segmentation network through the standardized image training; and according to the neutral line segmentation network, outputting a neutral line detection result. The method and the device solve the technical problem of poor image processing accuracy of the brain midline detection. The method and the device can obtain better centerline segmentation performance and have good generalization capability. In addition, the application can be beneficial to the clinical diagnosis and prognosis treatment of stroke and traumatic brain injury by neurosurgeons and neuroradiologists. By applying for image standardization, the performance of image processing is greatly improved.

title: Treatment and diagnosis of epigenetic disorders and conditions
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to the field of epigenetics and in particular epigenetic profiles associated with a pathological condition. The present specification teaches screening of individuals and populations for epigenetic profiles associated with a pathological condition. The epigenetic profiles can be from an intron, an intron/exon boundary or a splicing region. Epigenetic profiles are disclosed from the following sites in the FMR locus: FREE3, intron 2 of FMR1, the genomic FREE2 region as a whole or specific FREE2 fragments including FREE2 (D) or FREE2 (E). Kits and diagnostic assays are also taught herein as are computer programs to monitor changes in epigenetic patterns and profiles. Further enabled herein is a method for screening for agents which can reduce or mask the adverse effects of epigenetic modification and the use of these agents in therapy and prophylaxis.

title: Medical automatic image processing system
abstract: The invention requests to protect a medical automatic image processing system, through combining the theoretical research of image data mining with the practical application closely, have discussed the mainstream technology that the medical image data mining at present, on the basis of statistics learning theory and decision tree classification algorithm and association rule algorithm and rough set decision tree algorithm improvement, and the method of the classification of association rule, the question existing in the classification of association rule, encapsulate the form of the multisource medical equipment data, adopt the unified processing interface to form the data directory, has removed the redundant feature, has carried on the attribute reduction, has raised the classification efficiency and reduced the processing time, meanwhile, the construction of the medical knowledge map can apply the key technology to the computer-aided diagnosis, have constructed a medical automatic image processing system based on image data mining technology.

title: Capnography device with constant remote surveillance and notification capabilities
abstract: A capnography device including a suitable sensor to measure carbon dioxide concentration for a target patient/user is provided. Such a device utilizes at least one microprocessor (MCU) to govern overall activation and communication between the capnograph and ultimately a data center. Such a component is provided with at least one RFID tag in order to charge device and transfer data via inductive coupling and to use as device ID for data routing purposes. The MCU may thus provide pre-programmed information to determine alert levels for a target patient/user, with the utilization, additionally of a data recordation device to capture all sensor results for such a target patient/user as well. If an alert occurs, the MCU transfers of all subsequent information from the sensors to the data center. Thus, the inventive device and system provides a real-time, reliable, wireless surveillance and notification platform that has been lacking in the industry.

title: Method for detecting time consistency of complaints and symptoms of current medical history in medical records
assignee: 云知声（上海）智能科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method for detecting the time consistency of a main complaint and an existing medical history symptom in medical records, and relates to the technical field of medical informatization. The accuracy of the pure rule extraction time determined under the condition of longer context dependence is optimized by combining the rule with the statistical model, and the traditional statistical model has less dependence on the data quantity than the model method of deep learning under the condition of limited medical record data. The method of combining rules with statistical models is superior to the complex model method in system time response performance. The method has the advantages of high time consistency, high accuracy and high efficiency.

title: Breast ultrasound image segmentation method based on denoising diffusion probability model
abstract: The invention discloses a breast ultrasound image segmentation method based on a denoising diffusion probability model, and provides a medical image segmentation method based on the denoising diffusion probability model; the method enhances the capturing capability of global semantic information and complex information, and improves the attention of the denoising diffusion probability model to the focus area; in addition, the interaction between noise and semantic features is better realized, and the interference of high-frequency noise is effectively reduced; through the improvement, the method can more accurately divide the focus area in the breast tumor image, and provides powerful support for diagnosing diseases such as breast tumor and the like.

title: Live-monitoring of agent instances to trigger automation
abstract: A system may include one or more processors disposed within a management network. An end-user network may contain agent instances and one or more servers. The one or more processors may be configured to perform one or more tasks. These tasks may include receiving, from the end-user network, monitor data from on or more monitoring applications on one or more agent instances; determining, based on a specification, operations to be performed on the end-user network, wherein the specification is defined by the end-user network and comprises logical directives, each logical directive including conditions that, if satisfied by the received data, define the operations; and providing, to the one or more servers, the operations.

title: Medical image processing method, system, medium and equipment based on hyperspectral image
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hyperspectral images, in particular to a medical image processing method, a medical image processing system, a medical image processing medium and medical image processing equipment based on hyperspectral images. The hyperspectral image processing method comprises the following steps: adjusting the image acquisition parameters according to the relation between the abnormal external representation of blood and the image acquisition parameters to obtain a hyperspectral image of a blood sample; performing color standardization on the hyperspectral image according to the relation between the reflectivity calibration parameter and the RGB color duty ratio of the image; and distributing the infrared spectrum of the hyperspectral image to a red channel, and distributing the visible spectrum to a green channel and a blue channel, so as to enhance the near infrared spectrum band information of the hyperspectral image. The method is applied to the blood hyperspectral image processing process, the influence of external characterization is eliminated, the influence of color on a judgment result is avoided, the optical information of the marker is increased, and the accuracy is improved.

title: A method and an apparatus for analyzing personal physical ability based on motion recognition
abstract: Provided is a device for analyzing physical ability (100). The device for analyzing physical ability (100) may comprise: a communication unit (110) configured to receive an image photographed from a camera (200); a motion sensing unit (120) configured to generate motion data by sensing motion of a user from the received image; and a data processing unit (130) analyzing the generated motion data to predict calorie consumption according to the motion of the user.

title: NBI image processing method based on deep learning and image enhancement and application thereof
assignee: 武汉楚精灵医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an NBI image processing method based on deep learning and image enhancement and application thereof, wherein the characteristics of microvessels, microstructures and the like of an NBI image are extracted by utilizing a deep learning algorithm and an image enhancement technology, the characterized image is presented to an endoscopist, the bottleneck of the prior art is overcome, and the doctor can give more accurate auxiliary diagnosis opinions on early cancers under NBI by utilizing artificial intelligence. The image processed by the method of the invention has the advantages that the focus area in the stomach early cancer image is strengthened, the boundary of the focus and the normal area is processed by highlighting, the focus becomes clearer, and a doctor can refer to the processed image to judge whether the patient has early cancer in an auxiliary way during diagnosis, so that the condition that the focus is missed due to too fast gastroscopy or fatigue operation of the doctor is avoided.

title: Apparatus and method for assisting chest medical images reading
assignee: 주식회사 코어라인소프트, 인스티튜트 포 다이어그노스틱 어큐레시 리서치 비브이
abstract: Disclosed is an apparatus including a computing system and supporting chest medical image reading, which detects various factors inside the lung region and provides medical staff with the detected factors together with information on symptoms of lung diseases. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus comprises a computing system and the computing system includes at least one or more processors. The at least one processor segments the airways and the blood vessels from medical images including the lungs; segments subregions corresponding to each of a plurality of intensity sections, which are divided and set on the basis of at least one of tissue property and condition of tissue, in an image of the lung region excluding the airway and the blood vessels from the medical image; and visualizes distribution of the subregions corresponding to each of the plurality of intensity sections in the image of the lung region.

title: Weakly supervised learning for improving multimodal sensing platform
abstract: A machine learning model is trained for user activity detection and context detection on a mobile device. The machine learning model is configured to learn a statistical relationship between an always-on sensing modality of the mobile device and actual user context. Rather than user annotations, the machine learning model is enhanced and personalized for the always-on sensing modality by automated annotations obtained from non-always-on sensing modalities. The non-always-on sensing modality opportunistically provides an imperfect label of user context, where the imperfect label has a known associated probability of error.

title: Machine learned feature recommendation engine in a digital transaction management platform
abstract: An online document system provides a recommendation for one or more features within the online document system to an entity. The online document system accesses a set of feature training data to train a machine learning model. The set of feature training data may describe characteristics of entities associated with the online document system and historical activity associated with the entities' usage of the online document system's features. The machine learning model may be configured to identify a feature to recommend to an entity based on the entity's characteristics and history of using other features within the online document system. For example, data representing the entity's user accounts and use of an electronic signature feature is used by the machine learning model to identify a document authentication feature to recommend to the entity. The online document system may then provide the identified feature in a recommendation to the entity.

title: Electromotive Bed with Safety Device and Method for Controlling the Same
abstract: Disclosed are an electromotive bed for preventing a user's snoring and a control method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, an electromotive bed for preventing a user's snoring comprises: a sensor unit including a sound sensor for detecting the user's snoring sound and a motion sensor for detecting the user's movement; a snoring target determination unit for determining a snoring user among a plurality of sleeping users based on the information obtained from the sensor unit; and an operation control unit for controlling the movement of the electromotive bed in order to prevent the determined snoring user from snoring.

title: Identification and analysis of protein biomarkers
abstract: Protein biomarkers may be used to rapidly and accurately diagnose stroke. Biomarkers may be utilized in a rapid and inexpensive test that could be used at the bedside or ambulatory setting to definitively indicate the presence or absence of stroke and its severity. Such a test would quickly stratify patients in need of immediate stroke treatment from those who are not having a stroke. The test may aid emergency personnel in the decision for the most appropriate treatment plan and treatment location, thereby minimizing morbidity and mortality of stroke patients.

title: Auxiliary diagnosis system for myocardial infarction complications
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and provides an auxiliary diagnosis system for myocardial infarction complications, which comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring medical data of a patient, wherein the medical data comprises physiological index data, image data and electrocardiogram data; the image analysis module is used for judging the abnormal condition of the heart of the patient based on a pre-trained heart image abnormal detection model according to the image data; the electrocardiogram analysis module is used for judging the abnormal condition of the heart of the patient based on a pre-trained electrocardiogram abnormity detection model according to electrocardiogram data; and the complication diagnosis module is used for judging the probability of various complications based on a pre-trained myocardial infarction complication diagnosis model according to the physiological index data, the image analysis result and the electrocardiogram analysis result of the patient. The invention comprehensively considers the physiological, image and electrocardiogram cross-modal data and improves the accuracy of complication diagnosis.

title: Impedance-based far-field subtraction of waveform using non-tissue contacting electrodes
abstract: A medical system for removing far-field signals from a unipolar electrical signal is disclosed. In embodiments, the medical system comprises a catheter and a processing device communicatively coupled to the catheter. The catheter comprises a plurality of electrodes configured to sense a plurality of unipolar signals transmitted through tissue. The processing device is configured to: receive the sensed unipolar electrical signals, determine an electrode having a high level of contact with the tissue, and determine an electrode having a lower level of contact with the tissue than the electrode having the high level of contact with the tissue. Further, the processing device is configured to determine a sensed near-field electrical signal based on the unipolar electrical signal received from the electrode having the high level of contact and the unipolar electrical signal received from the electrode having the lower level of contact.

title: Systems and methods for dynamic identification of a surgical tray and the items contained thereon
abstract: The invention provides artificial intelligence-enabled image recognition methods and systems for continuously training a computer system to accurately identify a surgical item in a tray using at least 100 randomly created 2-dimensional images of a 3-dimensional synthetic item having unique identifiers assigned to the images or item. The invention also provides an artificial intelligence-enabled image recognition method and system for use to determine whether surgical instruments are present or missing on a surgical tray, and, if applicable, identifying those missing. In one aspect, a server receives an image and analyzes the image with a deep convolutional neural network to classify the type of tray and then compares a list of items that should be on the tray to that which the computer recognizes on the tray to generate an output displayed to a user identifying the items present and/or missing.

title: Information pushing method and device and server
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides an information pushing method, an information pushing device and a server, and belongs to the technical field of internet. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target query word at the current time, wherein the query heat of the target query word is greater than a preset threshold value; acquiring target news content related to the target query word; acquiring a keyword set from target news content according to preset disease words, wherein keywords included in the keyword set are matched with the preset disease words; determining the medical heat score of the keyword according to the occurrence frequency of the keyword in the keyword set; acquiring a target medical topic from the keyword set according to the medical popularity score of the keyword; medical topic information related to the target medical topic is obtained, and the medical topic information is pushed to the terminal. According to the method and the device, the target medical topic behind the hot news event represented by the target query word can be rapidly excavated, and the medical topic information related to the target medical topic is pushed to the terminal, so that the production efficiency of the medical topic information is improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Serum markers predicting clinical response to anti-TNF[alpha] antibodies in patients with psoriatic arthritis
abstract: The invention provides tools for management of patients diagnosed with psoriatic arthritis, specifically, prior to the initiation of therapy with an anti-TNF [alpha] agent. The tools are specific markers and algorithms of predicting response to therapy based on standard clinical primary and secondary endpoints using serum marker concentrations. In one embodiment the baseline levels of VEGF, prostatic acid phosphatase, and adiponectin are used to predict the response at Week 14 after the initiation of therapy. In another embodiment, the change in a serum protein biomarker after 4 weeks of therapy is used such as MDC, lipoprotein a, and [beta] 2-microglobulin.

title: Remote individual monitoring, training and recording system
abstract: The invention provides a wearable multi-modal body sensor and network for continuous health monitoring, selective recording, and transmission of various body vitals such as BPM, ECG, EEG, temperature, blood pressure, O2 saturation, body balance, etc. The selective recording can be timed and centered on the occurrence of clinically significant events detected by the monitoring system, A continuous log of all body vitals can also be stored in the system according to various scenarios. In certain embodiments, the system includes a patch wearable by the individual and including a number of sensors, A sensor module is releasably secured to the patch in connection with the sensors in order to receive the signals obtained by the sensors for ECG and EEG analysis, for example.

title: Personal hand-held detector
abstract: The present application describes a PHHM of the type described in WO2013/002165, WO2014/125431 and international patent application No. pct/EP2015/079888, with improved aspects to find health indicators and other improvements that facilitate their construction and calibration.

title: Systems and methods for contagious illness surveillance and outbreak detection
abstract: Systems and methods for population health surveillance utilizing a network of smart thermometers is provided. Based on the geolocated user data provided by the smart thermometers, contagious illness can be forecasted for various population nodes. Population nodes can be provided at various levels of granularity. Geographic or population specific early warning signals can be generated based on detected outbreaks of contagious illness.

title: Machine learning method-based severe pancreatitis prediction model construction method
assignee: 川北医学院附属医院, 川北医学院
abstract: The invention discloses a machine learning method-based severe pancreatitis prediction model construction method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring clinical and laboratory index related data of a predicted object, and preprocessing the acquired data; removing the index of missing or little change; data is divided into boxes; screening a severe pancreatitis data prediction model; pre-training the selected model; screening and determining characteristic indexes associated with 10 severe pancreatitis according to the pre-training result, and training again; and determining a threshold value applicable to a prediction algorithm according to the working characteristic curve of the subject, and further obtaining a final severe pancreatitis data prediction model. The noninvasive diagnosis of severe pancreatitis model based on a plurality of clinical indexes solves the problem of diagnosis hysteresis, has high prediction speed and high accuracy, and can provide reference for clinical diagnosis of severe pancreatitis.
assignee_clean: 川北医学院附属医院; 川北医学院

title: Automating table-based groundtruth generation
abstract: A method, system and computer-usable medium are disclosed for automating the generation of table-based groundtruth, comprising: receiving a document comprising unstructured text and a table; generating questions by applying a template the contents of the table; performing QA pair generation operations on the table to generate QA pairs, each QA pair comprising a question generated by applying the template; and, assigning a score to each QA pair, the score providing an indicator of user interest to each QA pair, the score being based on a score generation methodology using the unstructured text and the table.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment recommendation system and method based on graph neural network and electronic equipment
assignee: 海南榕树家信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and provides a traditional Chinese medicine dialectical treatment recommendation system, method and electronic equipment based on a graph neural network, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the knowledge graph acquisition module is used for acquiring a knowledge graph of the Chinese medicine dialectical treatment based on the structured Chinese medicine dialectical treatment data; the construction module is used for extracting feature vectors from the knowledge graph through a graph neural network so as to construct low latitude characterization information of the Chinese medicine dialect; the result acquisition module is used for obtaining a prediction result of the dialectical treatment of the traditional Chinese medicine according to the low latitude characterization information of the dialectical treatment of the traditional Chinese medicine by using a similarity evaluation algorithm; wherein, the historical Chinese medicine dialectical treatment data comprises symptoms, symptoms and characteristics attribute and association relation of Chinese medicines. The invention uses a spatial domain-based graphic neural network to conduct dialectical treatment. The system of the invention utilizes a deep learning algorithm of a graph to extract Chinese medicine condition vectors, chinese medicine condition vectors and characterization information of Chinese medicine vectors of large-scale graph expression relation data. The recommended recall of the Chinese medicine dialectical treatment is realized between diseases, symptoms and medicines by calculating the relation of the characterization vectors.
assignee_clean: 海南榕树家信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 海南榕树家信息科技有限公司

title: System and device for assessing psychological state based on text semantic vector model
assignee: 北京智能工场科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a system and a device for evaluating a psychological state based on a text semantic vector model, by adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the psychological state is evaluated based on the text semantic vector model, a user does not need to manually do questions or contact with the user face to face, but the psychological state of the user is evaluated by analyzing the mood text or saying words of the user, the mode does not cause pressure on the user, the latest real psychological state of the user can be obtained, and finally, an evaluation result and a corresponding countermeasure suggestion can be obtained by text analysis, so that the user can intuitively know the current psychological state and self-adjust or even seek medical advice according to the suggestion so as to achieve the state of psychological health.
assignee_clean: 北京智能工场科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京智能工场科技有限公司

title: Molecular vibrational spectroscopic markers for detection of cancer
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University
abstract: Methods of detecting diagnostic biomarkers on cancer-derived extracellular vesicles such as exosomes by mid-infrared spectroscopy are provided. In particular, methods of detecting ovarian cancer by spectral fingerprint analysis of molecular vibrational spectroscopic markers on individual or subpopulations of extracellular vesicles are disclosed.
assignee_clean: the board of trustees of the leland stanford junior university
primary_assignee: the board of trustees of the leland stanford junior university

title: Drug effect optimization method and device based on blood concentration monitoring
assignee: 上海交通大学医学院附属新华医院, 北京诺道认知医学科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a drug effect optimization method and a device based on blood concentration monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a drug effect optimization sample database based on blood concentration monitoring, wherein each sample in the drug effect optimization sample database comprises medication advice information when the blood concentration of the drug is normal and test item data with the nearest time distance before medication; carrying out deletion value processing and significance inspection on the drug effect optimization sample database to obtain a preprocessed drug effect optimization sample database; according to the preprocessed drug effect optimization sample database, performing supervised learning by using an XGboost algorithm to construct a drug effect optimization model; and inputting the data of the test items to be predicted into the medicine efficacy optimization model to obtain the medication advice information corresponding to the data of the test items to be predicted. The embodiment of the invention can predict the drug effect optimization scheme with stronger practicability according to the test result of the patient, solve the problem of drug use of the patient under complex conditions and realize individualized drug effect optimization.
assignee_clean: 上海交通大学医学院附属新华医院; 北京诺道认知医学科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海交通大学医学院附属新华医院

title: Terminal device, cloud device, method of driving terminal device, method of co-processing data, and computer-readable recording medium
abstract: The invention provides a terminal, cloud equipment, a method for analyzing user activities through the terminal and a method for analyzing user activities through the cloud equipment. The terminal for analyzing activities of an external device and a user includes: a communication interface unit configured to communicate with the external device; a controller configured to acquire data for predicting the user activity, suppress a part of the acquired data, and provide the suppressed data and remaining undemoshed data of the data to the external device through the communication unit; and a display unit configured to display notification information about the user's activity based on activity prediction data obtained by the external device using the provided data analysis.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging system and method
abstract: In a method for performing a magnetic resonance measurement of an organ structure of a patient using a magnetic resonance imaging system adapted to the imaging of the organ structure: a correct positioning of the organ structure of the patient is ascertained, a correct positioning of the magnetic resonance imaging system with regard to the positioning of the organ structure of the patient is ascertained, a magnetic resonance scanning protocol is selected, a spatial coverage of the magnetic resonance measurement with regard to the organ structure to be imaged is adjusted, and the magnetic resonance measurement is performed to acquire magnetic resonance image data of the organ structure.

title: Linear structure extraction device, method, program, and learned model
abstract: Provided are a linear structure extraction device, a method, a program, and a learned model which can detect a linear structure in an image. A linear structure extraction device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes a learning model that is learned to receive an input of the image and output, as a prediction result, one or more element points which constitute the linear structure from the image, in which the learning model includes a first processing module that receives the image and generates a feature map representing a feature amount of the image by convolution processing, and a second processing module that calculates a shift amount from a unit center point to the element point of the linear structure closest to the unit center point, for each unit obtained by dividing the feature map into a plurality of the units including regions having a predetermined size in a grid pattern.

title: Software interface tool for breast cancer screening
assignee: Xerox Corporation, Krithika Venkataramani, Lalit Keshav Mestha, Michael P. Kehoe, Geetha Manjunath, Niramai Health Analytix Pvt. Ltd.
abstract: What is disclosed is a software interface tool for breast cancer screening that is designed for medical professionals to view and analyze suspicious regions for hot spots and hence facilitate a determination of whether identified areas of breast tissue are cancerous. Isotherm maps are constructed at designated temperature resolution. Maps are displayed on the screen. Point & click on the isotherm map can extract temperature values of pixels within the region covered by the isotherm contours. Also provided are isothermic views at different viewing angles which is advantageous for visual detection. Additional functionalities for hotspot selection, cropping, zooming, viewing at different angles, etc. are also enabled by the present software interface. The present software interface further utilizes a tumor detection method which is also disclosed herein.
assignee_clean: xerox; krithika venkataramani; lalit keshav mestha; michael p kehoe; geetha manjunath; niramai health analytix pvt

title: Method, apparatus and program product for image difference detection and model training
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a method, equipment and a program product for image difference detection and model training, and relates to the fields of software testing, computer vision, deep learning and the like in computer technology. The image difference detection model provided by the disclosure can determine the difference visualization matrix of an input sample image and a reference image, and determine the prediction probability of the difference between the two images according to the difference visualization matrix, because the difference visualization matrix is an intermediate result generated in the process of determining the prediction probability of the difference between the two images, when the model is trained, the annotation data in the training sample set only needs to contain the annotation information of whether the difference exists between the sample image and the reference image, so that the model can be trained, the obtained model can accurately judge whether the difference exists between the images, and position information of the difference between the images is positioned, the region of each difference is not required to be marked, the annotation data is greatly simplified, the difficulty and the cost for obtaining the annotation data are reduced, and the usability of the model is improved.

title: Methods and apparatus for security enhanced portable data store and processor for allowing secure and selective access to genomic data
abstract: In some embodiments, a device includes a memory and a processor. The memory is operatively coupled to the processor and configured to store encrypted personal data. The processor is configured to receive query and a personal identifier from a user. Based on the query, the processor further identifies and retrieves a portion of the associated encrypted personal data from the memory. Using the personal identifier, the processor produces decrypted personal data by decrypting a portion of the retrieved encrypted personal data. The processor is further configured to analyze the decrypted personal data to identify a result of the query. The result is sent to the user without sending the decrypted personal data.

title: Apparatus and method for estimating blood pressure
assignee: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., University Of Maryland, College Park
abstract: An apparatus for estimating blood pressure includes: a ballistocardiogram (BCG) sensor configured to measure a limb BCG signal from a user; and a processor configured to obtain blood pressure-related features from the measured limb BCG signal, according to sensing characteristics of the BCG sensor, and estimate a blood pressure of the user based on the obtained blood pressure-related features.
assignee_clean: samsung electronics; university of maryland; college park

title: Systems and methods for mass testing a population for a contagious infection via pooled sample testing
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for the mass testing of a population for an infection. Pooled sampling may be used to reduce the number of tests needed for effective community surveillance. Individual members may be sorted into pools via a probability of infection to minimize the tests needed to identify positive individuals. The detection limits of testing assays may be used to help determine an appropriate pool size. Taxonomy tables characterizing the solution space of the total tests needed based on different variables may be generated and/or used to make testing decisions. Simulations of mass testing schemes may be used to facilitate testing decisions. Systems may be used to coordinate data and/or automate one or more steps of the testing process. Long-term community surveillance strategies may use prevalence testing, periodic mass testing via sample pooling, and/or periodic single sample testing to contain the spread of a contagion.

title: Method of and system for customized image denoising with model interpretations
abstract: There is provided a method and a system for customized image denoising with interpretability. A deep neural network (NN) is trained to denoise an image on a training dataset including pairs of noisy and corresponding clean images acquired from an imaging apparatus, where during the training a structured covariance score (SCS) indicative of a performance of the deep NN in recovering content of corresponding clean images relative to the denoised image is determined based on sparse conditional correlations. A test noisy image is received and denoised by the deep NN. A user feedback score indicative of user satisfaction of the denoising is obtained. A quality parameter is obtained based on the SCS and a quality metric indicative of denoised image quality is obtained from a pretrained NN, and compared with the user feedback score. If the SCS is above the user feedback score, the deep NN is provided for denoising.

title: Image positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image positioning method, an image positioning device, image positioning equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image; and inputting the medical image into an image positioning model to obtain a target area positioning result. The invention adopts the image positioning model to automatically position the target area in the medical image, can help a doctor to quickly and accurately determine the position of the target area, and provides a technical basis for further analyzing the form of the target area by using a computer.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
