title: Entity identification data enhancement method and system based on knowledge graph
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a knowledge-graph-based entity identification data enhancement method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring question and answer data of a determined field; identifying labeling information of the question-answer data, and identifying intention of the question-answer data according to the labeling information so as to establish a structure of an entity in the question-answer data in a knowledge graph; identifying a first entity related to the intent from the entities and conceptualizing the first entity as a first concept to obtain a first question-answer data template, the first question-answer data template comprising the first concept and Guan Jici; segmenting the relation words to obtain segmented words; according to the degree of correlation between each word segmentation word and the intention, respectively giving corresponding weight to each word segmentation word so as to obtain reserved word segmentation words; combining the reserved word segmentation words and the first concept to generate a second question-answer data template and adding the second question-answer data template into a question-answer database. The invention can improve the construction speed of the question-answering system in the vertical field and can effectively improve the recall rate of question entity identification.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Electronic document analysis system and method based on machine learning
assignee: 王欣, 杨煜清, 施举红
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic document analysis system and method based on machine learning, which describe the submitted electronic document structure by using a document feature description module, if more than one electronic document structure is described, a machine learning calculation module judges the description type which best accords with the current electronic document, and then structure analysis is carried out; the machine learning algorithm module carries out model training and information extraction according to the electronic document structure analysis result and the target information content characteristics, an analyst modifies the content characteristic description or the target information extracted by the machine learning algorithm, and the machine learning algorithm module retrains the model corresponding to the modified content characteristics; and the analysis result auditing module presents the model training and information extraction results of the machine learning algorithm module to an electronic document analyzer. The invention effectively solves the learning problems of limited document quantity and dynamic change of characteristics of the machine learning algorithm, can help the algorithm to truly assist document analysis, and improves the analysis efficiency.
assignee_clean: 王欣; 杨煜清; 施举红

title: Method for processing artificial intelligent model, and method and device for processing data
abstract: The application discloses a method for processing an Artificial Intelligence (AI) model, which can carry out confusion processing on a first calculation graph of the AI model with semantic information so as to obtain a second calculation graph without semantic information, thus improving the confidentiality of the AI model in terms of storage and transmission. Moreover, the scheme provided by the application is suitable for various software and hardware environments and scenes, does not need a TEE environment, and is better in universality.

title: Augmented reality pharmacy system and method
abstract: An augmented reality pharmacy system and method for assisting pharmacy personnel with health care-related tasks is presented. The augmented reality pharmacy system can reduce or eliminate common pharmacy fulfillment errors attributable to human error. The present disclosure improves pharmacy fulfilment error rates by providing image processing systems adapted to characterize prescription and drug related information to verify prescription fulfillment; incorporates augmented reality systems with pharmacy systems to provide enhanced fulfillment systems where real-world objects can be over-laid with virtual reality elements to provide additional pharmaceutical information to a user; and shortens the time spent by a user looking for a specific drug bottle in a maze of similar-looking drug bottles by incorporating wayfinding technology coupled with location based components.

title: Question and answer system emulating people and clusters of blended people
abstract: Embodiments are directed to an information processing system for generating answers in response to questions. The system includes a memory, a processor system communicatively coupled to the memory. The processor system is configured to store in the memory data of a corpus of a predetermined entity, and receive a question comprising a natural language format. The processor circuit is further configured to analyze the data of the corpus of the predetermined entity to derive an emulated answer to the question, wherein the emulated answer includes an emulation of an actual answer that would be provided by the predetermined entity.

title: Deep residual network-based classification system for thyroid cancer computed tomography (ct) images
abstract: The present disclosure provides a deep residual network-based classification system for thyroid cancer computed tomography (CT) images, including: a thyroid cancer CT image acquisition module, configured to acquire labeled CT images of plurality of thyroid cancer patients; a multi-scale segmentation module, configured to segment CT images of each of the plurality of thyroid cancer patients according to different scales, and sequentially intercept a cubic tumor area, a cubic tumor area expanded by 5 mm and a cubic tumor area expanded by 10 mm, to obtain a tumor image, a tumor image expanded by 5 mm and a tumor image expanded by 10 mm; a preprocessing module, configured to preprocess the images to obtain a training set; a deep residual network training module, configured to train and optimize the deep residual network by using the training set; and a thyroid cancer CT image classification module, configured to input thyroid cancer CT images to be classified into the optimized deep residual network for classification, to obtain a classification result of the thyroid cancer CT images. The present disclosure can accurately classify the thyroid cancer CT images.

title: Coronary artery segmentation method, system and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a coronary artery segmentation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image of a coronary artery to be segmented and carrying out scaling treatment; roughly segmenting the zoomed image by using 3D U-net to obtain a roughly segmented result; using 3D U-net to perform prior region extraction on the scaled image and perform morphological processing to obtain a voxel block; segmenting the voxel block by using 3D U-net + + to obtain a voxel block segmentation result; and voting and integrating the rough segmentation result and the voxel block segmentation result to obtain the final segmentation result. The invention also provides a coronary artery segmentation system and a storage medium, which realize better feature extraction and efficient segmentation, effectively combine global information and local information, realize accurate full-automatic segmentation of a model on a CTA image, and improve the efficiency and precision of prediction.

title: Medical image segmentation based on mixed context CNN model
assignee: 香港应用科技研究院有限公司
abstract: A volumetric image formed from a plurality of anatomical images, each having a plurality of image slices of a different imaging modality, is segmented by a 2D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A single anatomical image is pre-processed by combining selected image slices from two adjacent anatomical images without any estimated image slices to form a mixed context image. The 2D CNN utilizes side information about multimodal contexts and 3D spatial context to improve segmentation accuracy while avoiding segmentation performance degradation due to artifacts in the estimated image slices. The 2D CNN is implemented by a BASKET-NET model with multiple tiers from the highest tier to the lowest tier. The number of channels in most multi-channel feature maps of a level decreases monotonically from the highest level to the lowest level, allowing the highest level to be rich in low-level feature detail to help more finely segment a single anatomical image.
assignee_clean: 香港应用科技研究院有限公司

title: Methods and systems for quality-aware continuous learning for radiotherapy treatment planning
abstract: Example methods and systems for quality-aware continuous learning for radiotherapy treatment planning are provided. One example method may comprise: obtaining an artificial intelligence (AI) engine that is trained to perform a radiotherapy treatment planning task. The method may also comprise: based on input data associated with a patient, performing the radiotherapy treatment planning task using the AI engine to generate output data associated with the patient; and obtaining modified output data that includes one or more modifications made by a treatment planner to the output data. The method may further comprise: performing quality evaluation based on (a) first quality indicator data associated with the modified output data, and/or (b) second quality indicator data associated with the treatment planner. In response to a decision to accept, a modified AI engine may be generated by re-training the AI engine based on the modified output data.

title: Image segmentation confidence determination
abstract: Examples for determining a confidence level associated with image segmentation are disclosed. A confidence level associated with a collective image segmentation result can be determined by generating multiple individual segmentation results each from the same image data. These examples can then aggregate the individual segmentation results to form the collective image segmentation result and measure the spread of each individual segmentation result from the collective image segmentation result. The measured spread of each individual segmentation result can then be used to determine the confidence level associated with the collective image segmentation result. This can allow a confidence level associated with the collective image segmentation result to be determined. This confidence level may be determined without needing a ground truth to compare to the collective image segmentation result.

title: Sentiment aggregation
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for aggregating sentiment about an entity from a corpus of documents. The mechanism identifies a plurality of sentiment passages in the corpus of documents. Each of the plurality of sentiment passages includes a statement of sentiment about the entity. The mechanism determines a plurality of passage sentiment scores for the plurality of sentiment passages and an actual aggregate sentiment score from the plurality of passage sentiment scores based on a k-valued model. The mechanism determines a sentiment confidence score for the actual aggregate sentiment score based on the raw aggregate sentiment score and the actual aggregate sentiment score and presents the actual aggregate sentiment score and the sentiment confidence score.

title: Multi-iteration corpus labeling method, device and system
assignee: 中科鼎富（北京）科技发展有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a corpus labeling method, a device and a system for multi-round iteration, a cluster comprising a non-empty cluster and an empty cluster is initialized according to a small amount of labeled corpuses, a cluster characteristic set of each non-empty cluster is obtained, then, multi-round iteration corpus labeling is carried out on at least one unlabeled corpus by using the cluster according to a preset labeling rule, after each round of corpus labeling is completed, whether corpus labeling results meet preset termination conditions or not is analyzed, if not, the cluster characteristic set is adjusted, next round of corpus labeling is executed, if the preset termination conditions are met, multi-round iteration is terminated, and a corpus labeling result at the termination moment is output. The technical scheme of this application can realize the automatic labeling to the not mark corpus to constantly improve the precision of corpus labeling in the iterative process, obtain the positive example corpus set and the negative example corpus set that satisfy the corpus labeling precision, thereby, solved among the prior art and can't realize the problem of automatic labeling to a large amount of not mark corpuses.
assignee_clean: 中科鼎富 北京 科技发展有限公司
primary_assignee: 中科鼎富 北京 科技发展有限公司

title: Platform for management of user data
abstract: A system, method, device, and platform for managing data. Data associated with a user is automatically retrieved from one of a number of sources. The data is automatically confirmed as applicable to a user. The data is added to a data set associated with the user. A determination is made whether the data set is complete after adding the data to the data set. One or more tokens are created based on the data set of the user.

title: Learning apparatus and learning method for training neural network
abstract: There are provided a learning apparatus and a learning method that can facilitate creation of teaching data and prevent overtraining. A learning apparatus (10) includes a first database that stores a first image set in which a first image for learning and coordinate information for identifying a region larger than a region of interest included in the first image are associated with each other, and a second database that stores a second image set in which a second image for learning and second mask data for identifying a region of interest included in the second image are associated with each other. In a case of using the first image set to update a parameter of a CNN (32) (in a case of performing learning), a mask data creation unit (38) creates first mask data on the basis of the coordinate information for identifying the region larger than the region of interest. The first image and the second image are used as input images for the CNN (32), and the first mask data and the second mask data are used as teaching data to update the parameter of the CNN (32).

title: Method and apparatus for a sidelink terminal to transmit and receive signals related to channel state reporting in a wireless communication system
abstract: According to an embodiment, a method of transmitting and receiving a signal by a sidelink terminal in a wireless communication system includes: receiving a physical secondary link shared channel (PSSCH) including a channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS); channel State Information (CSI) reports are transmitted based on the CSI-RS within a predetermined window. Parameters related to the predetermined window are independently configured for at least one of a resource pool, a type of service, a priority, a quality of service (QoS) parameter, a block error rate (BLER), a speed, a CSI payload size, a subchannel size, or a frequency resource region size.

title: Methods and systems for a physiologically informed virtual support network
abstract: A system for a physiologically informed virtual support network includes a computing device a support module operating on the computing device, the support module configured to receive a biological extraction related to a user, wherein the biological extraction comprises an element of user physiological data, generate a request for the user to join a support network as a function of the biological extraction, identify a support network for the user from a plurality of support networks, as a function of the biological extraction; and display to the user on the computing device, the identified support network, and a machine-learning module operating on the computing device, the machine-learning module configured to assess a membership of the plurality of support networks, organize member participants of the plurality of support networks utilizing a first machine-learning process and assign member participants to the plurality of support networks as a function of the first machine-learning process.

title: Systems and methods for mesothelioma feature detection and enhanced prognosis or response to treatment
abstract: A method and apparatus of a device that classifies a mesothelioma image is described. In an exemplary embodiment, the device segments the mesothelioma image into a region of interest that includes information useful for classification, and a background region, by applying a first convolutional neural network. In addition, the device tiles the region of interest into a set of tiles. For each tile, the device extracts a feature vector of that tile by applying a second convolutional neural network, where the features of the feature vectors represent local descriptors of the tile. Furthermore, the device processes the extracted feature vectors of the set of tiles to classify the image.

title: Determining digital markers indicative of a neurological condition
abstract: Disclosed are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for determining a digital marker indicative of a neurological condition. An embodiment operates by detecting a region of interest in an image frame of a face of a user. The region of interest includes an eye of the user and the image frame is obtained from a video stream. The embodiment then generates a point spread function (PSF) based on acquired data and a portion of the image frame specified by the region of interest, performs deconvolution on the portion of the image frame specified by the region of interest using the PSF, determines a set of oculometric parameters of the eye of the user using the deconvolved image, and determines one or more digital markers of the user based on the set of oculometric parameters. The one or more digital markers are indicative of a neurological condition of the user.

title: Method and system for extracting slot position information
assignee: 新华智云科技有限公司, 新华融合媒体科技发展(北京)有限公司
abstract: The application provides a method and a system for extracting slot information, which are used for retraining a pre-training model which is trained by Mask by taking a business text after random segment Mask as training data, so that the generated segment Mask pre-training model has the capability of analyzing and understanding the semantics of the segments in the business text, the business text after the random segment Mask is trained is not marked, and the cost of manual marking is saved. The method has the advantages that the method is characterized in that the method comprises the steps of enabling the fine-tuned segment Mask pre-training model to use a small amount of descriptive templates marked with the slot information by further introducing the descriptive templates of the additional slot information into the segment Mask pre-training model, enabling the fine-tuned segment Mask pre-training model to have sufficient semantic understanding on the slot extraction of specific tasks, enabling the fine-tuned segment Mask pre-training model to automatically identify the slot information of a text to be extracted, enabling the required marking data to be small, and enabling the fine-tuned segment Mask pre-training model to extract the slot information of a plurality of slots at one time when extracting the slot information.
assignee_clean: 新华智云科技有限公司; 新华融合媒体科技发展 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 新华智云科技有限公司

title: Optimized data discretization
abstract: In one embodiment, an apparatus comprises a memory and a processor. The memory is to store data. The processor is to: store a first dataset on the memory; identify a plurality of bin sizes for compressing the first dataset; compute a plurality of performance costs associated with the plurality of bin sizes; identify a minimum performance cost of the plurality of performance costs; identify an optimal bin size based on the particular bin size associated with the minimum performance cost; partition the first dataset into a plurality of bins based on the optimal bin size; identify a plurality of bin counts associated with the plurality of bins; generate a second dataset based on the plurality of bin counts, wherein the second dataset is smaller than the first dataset; and store the second dataset on the memory, wherein the second dataset is stored using less memory space than the first dataset.

title: Skin lesion segmentation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medical image processing, and particularly relates to a skin lesion segmentation method based on deep learning. The first step, dividing the data set into a training sample and a verification sample, and preprocessing the pictures in the data set to obtain the processed pictures. And secondly, constructing a five-layer neural network, inputting the training samples and the verification samples obtained in the first step into the network according to batches, and performing network optimization by using a gradient descent method with momentum to obtain a classifier network after training. And thirdly, preprocessing the test sample picture to obtain a processed test sample picture. Fourth, predicting the picture. The method provided by the invention uses the whole picture to carry out classification segmentation, so that the calculated amount is smaller compared with the method, and meanwhile, the detail information is considered. Experiments show that the segmentation precision of the deep learning method based on the attention mechanism is higher than that of U-Net.

title: Systems and methods for generating cancer prediction maps from multiparametric magnetic resonance images using deep learning
abstract: Various example embodiments are described in which an anisotropic encoder-decoder convolutional neural network architecture is employed to process multiparametric magnetic resonance images for the generation of cancer predication maps. In some example embodiments, a simplified anisotropic encoder-decoder convolutional neural network architecture may include an encoder portion that is deeper than a decoder portion. In some example embodiments, simplified network architectures may be combined with test-time-augmentation in order to facilitate training and testing with a minimal number of test subjects.

title: Determining a state of a user based on thermal measurements of the forehead
abstract: Often the physiological and emotional state of a person can be associated with certain cortical activity that can cause certain thermal patterns on the person's forehead. Thus, thermal measurements of the forehead may be used to differentiate between user states. In one embodiment, a system includes at least one inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAM) that takes thermal measurements of at least first and second regions on the right side of a user's forehead (THR1 and THR2, respectively), and thermal measurements of at least third and fourth regions on the left side of the forehead (THL1 and THL2, respectively). The middles of the first and third regions are at least 1 cm above the middles of the second and fourth regions, respectively. The system also includes a computer that determines, based on THR1, THR2, THL1, and THL2, whether the user is in a normal state or an abnormal state.

title: Unsupervised image segmentation method based on Chan-Vese model
abstract: The invention provides an unsupervised image segmentation method based on a Chan-Vese model, and belongs to the technical field of computer application and the field of precise medical treatment. The method comprises the steps of firstly cutting an original image, carrying out super-pixel segmentation on the cut image, then establishing an undirected graph according to a super-pixel segmentation result, representing an energy item of a Chan-Vese model by the weight of edges, and simultaneously considering the relation between the distance and the gray level between super-pixels in the edge assignment process by using a Markov chain. Finally, the corresponding segmentation result can be obtained by repeatedly using the maximum stream segmentation and the weight of the updated edge. The invention can automatically and accurately segment the image in the medical field lacking the labeled data, thereby providing accurate information of the segmented object for the subsequent medical research. The invention can accurately segment the required target in shorter time and with less manual intervention.

title: Disease critical degree assessment method based on multiple variables
abstract: The invention discloses a disease critical degree assessment method based on multiple variables, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical medical detection data and past illness state data of a target user, and determining illness state information of the target user by combining feedback data of the target user; screening variable parameters representing the critical degree of the disease, constructing a disease critical degree model, and acquiring daily sign data of a target user to input the disease critical degree model; early warning is carried out according to the severe probability of the disease critical degree model, and corresponding department information of the current symptoms is obtained according to the early warning information; and acquiring living environment data of a target user, analyzing dominant factors of critical pre-warning, and generating notes and medical advice through the dominant factors and the real-time disease hazard degree. The invention dynamically evaluates the critical degree of the illness state of the user, so that the user can know the change trend of the illness state, perform preliminary self-evaluation and provide preliminary reference for medical diagnosis.

title: System, methods, and devices for improving sleep habits
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices that provide personalized sleep improvement programs for improving sleep habits are described. The personalized sleep improvement programs may include sleep characteristics of a user, at least one factor impacting a sleep of the user, at least one sleep goal for the user, and a sleep-related performance of the user.

title: Managing and predicting privacy preferences based on automated detection of physical reaction
abstract: Methods for preventing the transmission of sensitive information to locations outside of a secure network by a person who has legitimate access to the sensitive information are described. In some embodiments, in order for an end user of a computing device to establish a secure connection with a secure network and access data stored on the secure network, a client application running on the computing device may be required by the secure network. The client application may monitor visual cues (e.g., facial expressions and gestures) associated with the end user, detect suspicious activity performed by the end user based on the visual cues, and in response to detecting suspicious activity may perform mitigating actions to prevent the transmission of sensitive information such as alerting human resources personnel or requiring authorization prior to sending information to locations outside of the secure network.

title: Medical image three-dimensional reconstruction method and system
assignee: 真健康（北京）医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a medical image three-dimensional reconstruction method and system, and relates to the field of medical images. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image; identifying each target organ in the medical image, and respectively determining a target pixel value range of each target organ; preprocessing the medical image based on the target pixel value range to obtain a feature-enhanced medical image corresponding to the target organ; reconstructing a three-dimensional image based on the feature-enhanced medical images corresponding to the respective target organs.
assignee_clean: 真健康 北京 医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 真健康 北京 医疗科技有限公司

title: Intelligent auxiliary tool adaptation decision-making system and method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary tool adaptation decision-making system and method, and relates to the field of intelligent rehabilitation. The intelligent auxiliary tool adaptation decision method comprises a CBR reasoning step, an RBR reasoning step and a clinical correction step. The system comprises a knowledge base, a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a hybrid reasoning module and a result processing module. The data acquisition module acquires original data and uploads the original data to a case library in a knowledge base of the cloud platform for storage, and the original data is transmitted to the data preprocessing module; the data preprocessing module divides the collected original data into two types of CBR reasoning basic data and RBR reasoning basic data according to the correlation, and performs preprocessing. The hybrid reasoning module is configured to perform a CBR reasoning step and an RBR reasoning step. The result processing module displays the decision result of the auxiliary adaptation scheme through an interface and updates a case library.

title: Image retrieval method, device, medium and equipment
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to an image retrieval method, an image retrieval device, a medium and image retrieval equipment. According to the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the similarity with the image to be searched can be determined for each image in the image database to be searched based on the Euclidean distance between the feature vectors, so that a part of images similar to the image to be searched are screened out, the similarity with the image to be searched can be further determined for the screened out similar images based on the feature vector difference between the feature vectors, and then the images similar to the image to be searched can be output based on the two similarity determination results, so that the accuracy of image search is improved.
assignee_clean: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司

title: Image classification and image classification model training method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 广州医思信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an image classification method, an image classification model training method, an image classification device, image classification equipment and a medium, and belongs to the field of data identification. In the embodiment of the application, the image is firstly segmented by using the image classification model to obtain the image blocks, and then the attention weights of the image blocks are determined one by one, so that the classification is carried out, the importance and influence of different image blocks on the image classification result are considered, rather than directly carrying out overall classification on the image, so that the local characteristic and the fine characteristic difference of the image can be effectively focused, and the key characteristic and the irrelevant characteristic influenced on the classification result can be distinguished, thereby ensuring that the classification result is more accurate, naturally avoiding the manual correction after the classification error, and greatly improving the classification efficiency.
assignee_clean: 广州医思信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 广州医思信息科技有限公司

title: Noninvasive techniques for identifying choroidal neovascularization in retinal scans
abstract: Methods and systems for identifying CNV membranes and vasculature in images obtained using noninvasive imaging techniques are described. An example method includes generating, by a first model based on at least one image of a retina of a subject, a membrane mask indicating a location of a CNV membrane in the retina. The method further includes generating, by a second model based on the membrane mask and the at least one image, a vasculature mask of the retina of the subject, the vasculature mask indicating CNV vascularization in the retina.

title: System for detecting fetal craniocerebral abnormality based on machine learning
assignee: 南方医科大学, 湖南大学
abstract: The invention discloses a method for detecting fetal craniocerebral abnormality based on machine learning, and particularly detects whether the main tissue structure of the craniocerebral is abnormal or not and which related craniocerebral diseases can be caused by the abnormality in the development process of the fetal craniocerebral. The method mainly comprises the steps of obtaining data of a series of craniocerebral standard sections of different gestational weeks, preprocessing the data, and training a model to detect whether the main tissue structure of the craniocerebral is abnormal or not. Extracting features by adopting a deep convolutional network, generating a candidate region by using a region generation network RPN, collecting an input feature map and the candidate region layer by layer in an interested pooling, classifying and regressing the feature map and the candidate region by using a softmax classifier, and finally analyzing whether a main structure is abnormal or not by using a detection result. If no abnormity exists, the system is judged to be normal. The invention aims to utilize computer-aided diagnosis to assist in diagnosing whether the cranium is abnormal or not under the condition that doctors or artificial excessive diagnosis is not needed.
assignee_clean: 南方医科大学; 湖南大学

title: Method for providing result data which is suitable for use in planning the irradiation of a patient
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) measurement data of the patient is acquired using a CT device having a quantum counting X-ray detector, and the CT measurement data is processed to generate result data, considering a specific information content of the CT measurement data resulting from the use of the quantum counting X-ray detector in acquiring the CT measurement data. The result data is suitable for use in the planning of irradiation of the patient. The result data is provisioned to an interface such that the result data is usable for planning the irradiation of the patient.

title: Personalized medication non-adherence evaluation
abstract: A method, a computer program product, and a computer system predict medication adherence of a patient. The method includes identifying risk factors associated with medication adherence of the patient. The method includes determining a likely behaviour for medication adherence of the patient based on the identified risk factors and a temporal causal model. The temporal causal model is based on features of a patient cluster to which the patient belongs. The features are nodes in the temporal causal model. The likely behaviour is based on causality measures for each identified risk factor to the nodes. The method includes determining a current medication adherence value of the patient. The current medication adherence value is indicative of a ratio between an actual medication regiment and an expected medication regiment. The method includes determining a future medication adherence value of the patient based on the current medication adherence value and the causality measures.

title: Examination support device, examination support method, and examination support program
abstract: An image acquisition unit acquires an actual endoscopic image that is generated by an endoscope inserted into a tubular structure of a subject and represents an inner wall of the tubular structure, and a virtual endoscopic image that is generated from a three-dimensional image including the tubular structure of the subject and spuriously represents the inner wall of the tubular structure. A conversion unit converts an expression form of the actual endoscopic image into an expression form of the virtual endoscopic image. A similarity calculation unit calculates similarity between the converted actual endoscopic image and the virtual endoscopic image.

title: Image segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image segmentation method, an image segmentation device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be segmented; and carrying out image segmentation on the image to be segmented through a trained image segmentation model to obtain a target segmentation area, wherein a decoding unit of the image segmentation model completes decoding operation in a mode of combining a deformed non-local network and a channel attention mechanism. The method solves the problems that the model structure of the existing deep learning method is simple, and the image segmentation result is not accurate enough.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院

title: Gait-based biometric data analysis system
abstract: Systems and methods for diagnosing a user's condition based on his gait. A sensor module with multiple sensors is placed inside a user's shoe and biometric data is gathered from the sensors when the user takes a step or walks. The data is used to generate loops as the various sets of data is plotted against each other. The loops obtained from the data are then compared against stored loops previously obtained. Based on the results of the comparison, the user's condition is diagnosed using predetermined indicators of specific health issues. Using the biometric data and in conjunction with data from various databases, it can be determined whether the user has a specific condition, whether a specific condition is worsening, or whether a specific condition is improving.

title: Brain navigation lead
abstract: A brain navigation device, comprising a lead with an elongated lead body, at least one macro-electrode contact positioned on an outer surface on the lead, wherein the at least one macro-electrode contact is located at the distal part of the lead, and wherein the at least one macro-electrode contact is configured to be used during lead navigation.

title: Image processing method, computer device, and readable storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image processing method, an image processing device, a computer device and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: judging whether the test image needs to be partitioned or not according to the image size of the test image, the system available memory value and the corresponding relation between the preset different image sizes and the system memory value required for processing the images with different sizes, and determining the number of partitions of the test image when the test image needs to be partitioned; according to the number of blocks of the test image, carrying out block processing on the test image according to a preset block rule to obtain a plurality of test image blocks; and inputting the plurality of test image blocks into the deep learning network model to obtain test results of the plurality of test image blocks, and combining the test results of the plurality of test image blocks to obtain the test result of the test image. The method makes full use of GPU resources, and further improves the test performance.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Method for transmitting data in unlicensed band by terminal and apparatus using the same
abstract: A method of a terminal transmitting data in an unlicensed band and an apparatus using the same are provided. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting data to a base station through a Physical Uplink Shared Channel (PUSCH) in an unlicensed band; and receiving acknowledgement/negative acknowledgement (ACK/NACK) information on the data from the base station in the unlicensed band, wherein the terminal receives time line information informing of a time relationship between a PUSCH transmission time point and an ACK/NACK information reception time point from the base station.

title: Multi-center synergetic cancer prognosis prediction system based on multi-source migration learning
abstract: Provided is a multi-center synergetic cancer prognosis prediction system based on multi-source migration learning. The system includes a model parameter setting module, a data screening module, and a multi-source migration learning module, wherein the model parameter setting module is responsible for setting cancer prognosis prediction model parameters; the data screening module is arranged at a clinical center, and a management center transmits the set model parameter to each clinical center, such that each clinical center inquires a sample feature and prognosis index data from a local database according to the model parameter, so as to preprocess the data; and the multi-source migration learning module includes a source model training unit, a migration weight calculation unit, and a target model calculation unit.

title: Systems and methods for segmenting documents
assignee: The Florida International University Board Of Trustees
abstract: Systems and methods for automatically modeling the discourse structure of psychiatric reports and segmenting these reports into various sections are provided. The systems and methods can be based around a model that learns the section types, positions, and sequence and can automatically segment unlabeled text in a psychiatric report into the corresponding sections. Knowledge of the ordering of the sections can improve the performance of a section classifier and a text segmenter. A Hierarchical Hidden Markov Model (HHMM) can be trained and can categorize sections in psychiatric reports into a predefined section label.
assignee_clean: the florida international university board of trustees
primary_assignee: the florida international university board of trustees

title: Medical text translation method, device and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the field of medical science and technology, and particularly discloses a medical text translation method, a medical text translation device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical text to be translated; extracting semantic features of the medical text to be translated to obtain a first feature vector; acquiring a target characteristic vector corresponding to the medical text to be translated, wherein the target characteristic vector is used for representing a medical knowledge graph corresponding to the medical text to be translated; splicing the first feature vector and the target feature vector to obtain a second feature vector; and translating the medical text to be translated according to the second feature vector. The embodiment of the application is beneficial to improving the accuracy of medical text translation.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method of authenticating user and apparatus thereof
abstract: Disclosed is user authentication. A user authentication method includes receiving a plurality of images including at least one object, extracting biological information from the plurality of images, performing user authentication based on a difference between the extracted biological information and biological information of a user stored in a memory, and updating a parameter of a learning model for the user authentication when a result of the execution of the user authentication satisfies a preset condition. The mobile terminal and the AI system of the present disclosure may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, a drone (or unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)), a robot, an augmented reality (AR) device, a virtual reality (VR) device, a device related to 5G service, etc.

title: Low-field-intensity MR stomach segmentation method based on transfer learning image enhancement
assignee: 西安电子科技大学, 杭州职业技术学院
abstract: The invention discloses a low-field-intensity MR stomach segmentation method based on transfer learning image enhancement, which mainly solves the problems of large noise, more artifacts and less image data of a low-field-intensity 3DMR image. The scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring high and low field intensity 3DMR stomach image data sets and corresponding tag data sets, and preprocessing the image data; inputting the preprocessed data into a cyclic generation type countermeasure network to obtain an enhanced pseudo low field strength 3DMR stomach image set; constructing and training a 3D Res3-U-net segmentation network; and inputting the pseudo low field intensity 3DMR stomach image set into the segmentation network to finish fine adjustment of segmentation network parameters, forming a 3D Res3-U-net segmentation network after transfer learning, and inputting test data into the network to obtain a segmentation result. The invention realizes the segmentation of the low-field-intensity 3DMR stomach image and effectively improves the image segmentation precision.
assignee_clean: 西安电子科技大学; 杭州职业技术学院

title: Medical information processing method and system based on big data
assignee: 山东中医药大学附属医院
abstract: The application discloses a medical information processing method and a system based on big data, which are used for carrying out image processing and analysis on medical diagnosis images by utilizing big data technology and artificial intelligence technology, extracting image semantic features from the medical diagnosis images and identifying and image segmentation on focus areas in the medical diagnosis images. In this way, the physician is assisted in identifying focal areas in the medical diagnostic image, thereby helping the physician make more accurate diagnostic and therapeutic decisions.
assignee_clean: 山东中医药大学附属医院
primary_assignee: 山东中医药大学附属医院

title: Detection, characterization, and prediction of real-time events occurring approximately periodically
abstract: Systems and methods for detection, characterization, and prediction of real-time events having approximate periodicity include detection of events from raw data that are approximately periodic. The detection includes analyzing raw data to determine approximately periodic chains of events. The raw data can be related to network management systems, financial monitoring systems, medical monitoring, seismic activity monitoring, or any system that performs some management or monitoring of an underlying system or network having time lasting events. The detected approximately periodic events could be characterized and presented in natural language as well as used for prediction of future events via supervised machine learning.

title: Method and apparatus for transmitting signal by side link terminal in wireless communication system
abstract: One embodiment relates to a method for transmitting a sidelink signal by a terminal in a wireless communication system, the method comprising: a step of selecting one or more subchannels for physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH) or physical sidelink control channel (PSCCH) transmission; and a step of transmitting the PSSCH or the PSCCH through the one or more subchannels, wherein the terminal selects the subchannel from a sidelink synchronization signal block (S-SSB) and a frequency division multiplexing (FDM) resource, on the basis of at least one of a priority of a threshold or higher, a target reliability of a threshold or higher, a latency requirement of a threshold or lower, a QoS requirement of a threshold or higher, and an SSB measurement value of a threshold or higher.

title: Community old people cardiovascular disease prediction system and method based on big data
abstract: The invention provides a cardiovascular disease prediction system and method for old people in communities based on big data. The prediction system comprises a client and a Spark big data platform; the system comprises a client, a system and a health suggestion, wherein the client is used for interaction between the system and a user, the user registers pathological parameter information through the client, and the system presents a judging result of cardiovascular disease risk and the health suggestion to the user through the client; the Spark big data platform comprises a data preprocessing module, a prediction model prediction module and a data management module; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a data set to be trained; analyzing the pathological parameter information registered by the client based on the BP neural network, and judging the cardiovascular disease risk of the user; and the pathological parameter information received from the plurality of community hospital clients is uniformly managed and stored.

title: Interactive image editing
abstract: The present embodiment relates to a renderer and an interactive method for image editing of medical 3D anatomical data. The method includes receiving a dataset with volumetric image data, which have been acquired from an image acquisition modality, and providing a signed distance field data structure of the received dataset. Further, editing operations are received from a user interface for editing at least a part of the provided signed distance field data structure. A visualization of the editing operations is calculated and displayed on a display.

title: Method for providing an image based on a reconstructed image group and an apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention is to provide an interface allowing effective conversion between and viewing of an image corresponding to a relatively large slice thickness and an image corresponding to a small slice thickness. Disclosed is a computing device-based image provision method including: (a) a step in which the computing device obtains a first image group including at least a part of a series of images generated with respect to the continuous volumes of a first slice thickness belonging to a subject or performs support such that another device interlocked to the computing device obtains the first image group; (b) a step in which the computing devices provides as a current viewing image one image in the first image group or one image in a second image group including a series of images generated with respect to the continuous volumes of a second slice thickness belonging to the subject or performs support such that the device interlocked to the computing device provides the image; and (c) a step in which the computing device performs (c1) and (c2) processes. In the (c1) process, the computing device responds to first certain input of an input device and repeatedly updates the image provided as the current viewing image into an individual image determined to be provided for next viewing based on the directionality given to the first certain input or performs support such that the device performs the update. In the (c2) process, the computing device responds to second certain input of the input device and converts the current viewing image between the images belonging to the first and second image groups or performs support such that the device performs the conversion.

title: Text auditing method and device
assignee: 创新先进技术有限公司
abstract: The specification provides a text auditing method and a text auditing device, wherein the text auditing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a text to be checked, and determining the service dimension of the text to be checked; labeling keywords contained in the text to be checked based on the service dimension to obtain a service keyword set associated with the service dimension; calculating word optimization parameters of the service keywords in the text to be audited, wherein the word optimization parameters are contained in the service keyword set; screening the service keywords contained in the service keyword set according to the word optimization parameters to obtain an optimal keyword set; vectorizing each business keyword contained in the preferred keyword set, and obtaining vector characteristics according to the vectorization processing result; and inputting the vector characteristics into the auditing model, auditing the text to be audited, and obtaining the auditing result of the text to be audited output by the auditing model. By the text auditing method, the auditing accuracy of the text to be audited corresponding to the service dimensionality is improved, and the auditing efficiency is improved.
assignee_clean: 创新先进技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 创新先进技术有限公司

title: Methods and systems for facilitating classification of documents
abstract: Disclosed herein is a method for facilitating the classification of documents. Accordingly, the method may include receiving, using a communication device, documents from at least one user device, analyzing, using a processing device, the documents based on a filter, classifying, using the processing device, the documents into a topic based on the analyzing of the documents, transmitting, using the communication device, the documents and a topic identifier associated with the topic to a user device, receiving, using the communication device, a judgment data from the user device, analyzing, using the processing device, the judgment data, modifying, using the processing device, the filter based on the analyzing of the judgment data, generating, using the processing device, a modified filter based on the modifying, and storing, using a storage device, the modified filter.

title: Self-learning connected-device network
assignee: At&T Intellectual Property I, L.P., At&T Mobility Ii Llc
abstract: A connected-device network can continually learn from abstract sensory data (e.g., speech processing, cognitive inference, and/or computer vision image segmentation) and can generate never-seen-before data in real time. In one aspect, the network devices extract important correlations in the sensor data based on network data collected at different time slice and/or locations. Further, underlying relationships in a set of data can be detected as the sensor data transverses through different layers of the network. Moreover, the network devices can provide logic in different layers to help classify the sensor data early in the detection process (e.g., instead of waiting for it to reach its final destination).
assignee_clean: at t intellectual property i; l p; at t mobility ii

title: Training method of image processing network, computer device and readable storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a training method of an image processing network, a computer device and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of training sample images, wherein the plurality of training sample images are a plurality of groups of tomograms; inputting a plurality of training sample images into an initial image processing network for image processing to obtain image processing results of the plurality of training sample images; and calculating loss between the image processing results of the training sample images and the corresponding gold standard, calculating difference values between the image processing results of the training sample images of the adjacent layers in the same group of training sample images, and training the initial image processing network according to the loss and the difference values. According to the method, when the loss of the image processing results of the training sample images is calculated, the difference value between the image processing results of the training sample images of the adjacent layers is considered, meanwhile, the number of the training sample images is not reduced, and the network precision obtained by training is greatly improved.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Relative risk ranking of cloud assets used in multi-cloud workloads
abstract: An apparatus comprises a processing device configured to receive, at a user interface of a trust platform configured to manage cloud assets operating in clouds of two or more cloud service providers, a request to view multi-cloud relative risk information for at least a subset of the cloud assets on which workloads of a given entity run. The processing device is also configured to obtain, utilizing application programming interfaces of the trust platform, first and second sets of cloud asset risk data generated by first and second pluralities of monitoring tools operating in tenant and management environments of the clouds of the two or more cloud service providers. The processing device is further configured to generate and provide, at the user interface of the trust platform, a unified view of the multi-cloud relative risk information utilizing the first and second sets of cloud asset risk data.

title: Disease typing determination system, method, device and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a system, a method, a device and a storage medium for determining disease typing, which are applied to the technical field of medical treatment, wherein the system comprises a storage device and a terminal device, wherein the storage device is used for storing historical medical data related to at least one patient and a target disease; and the terminal equipment is used for acquiring target historical medical data of the target patient related to the target disease from the storage equipment, determining multi-modal data according to the target historical medical data, and determining the target disease type of the target patient according to the multi-modal data. Compared with single-modality data, the target disease type of the target patient is determined through the multi-modality data of the target patient, and the relevance among the data of a plurality of data sources can be considered, so that the accuracy of determining the target disease type of the target patient is improved. The present application relates to blockchain techniques, such as historical medical data of a patient may be written into a blockchain for use in scenarios such as determining a target disease classification to which a target patient belongs.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method, system, equipment and medium for controlling data transmission
assignee: 明品云(北京)数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for controlling data transmission, which comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be transmitted and a data communication session request generated at a user side; establishing communication connection between a user side and a server side, determining a target communication link, and allocating an initial flow bandwidth to the target communication link according to a data communication session request; data fragmentation is carried out on data to be transmitted to form a corresponding data packet, and the data packet is transmitted to a server side; acquiring the transmission time length of the data packet, judging whether the transmission time length is within a preset time length range, and if the transmission time length is not within the preset time length range, dynamically adjusting the initial flow bandwidth on the target communication link. According to the invention, the flow bandwidth on the target communication link corresponding to the client and the server is dynamically adjusted, so that the transmission time of the data packet on the target communication link can be kept within the preset time range after the data to be transmitted is formed into the data packet, and the data packet can be stably transmitted.

primary_assignee: 明品云 北京 数据科技有限公司

title: Prediction system and method based on federal learning
assignee: 北京智源人工智能研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a prediction system and a prediction method based on federal learning. The system comprises a federal learning deployment machine and a federal learning client, wherein the federal learning deployment machine comprises a distribution system, a model container system and a federal learning server; the distribution system maps the prediction request from the user to the model of the model container system, the model predicts the request, the model to be optimized is determined according to the prediction result, and the federal learning service terminal and the federal learning client terminal perform online federal learning optimization on the model to be optimized. The method has the advantages that the prediction effect index is more ideal, the satisfaction degree of users is improved, data do not need to be collected in the model optimization process, the model optimization process and the use process are fused and unified, and the problems that data islands are caused by high data collection difficulty at present, the prediction effect index is not ideal and the problem of violation of a law due to data collection and use isolation are solved.

title: Image retrieval method and device
abstract: The invention discloses an image retrieval method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing first feature extraction processing, regularized global attention sampling processing, second feature extraction processing and feature dimension reduction processing by using a trained feature extraction network to obtain a dimension reduction feature map to be searched and a dimension reduction feature map of a database, and performing similarity calculation on the feature extraction map to be searched and the dimension reduction feature map of the database to obtain a search result; the feature extraction network training process comprises the following steps: scaling the training image, and extracting features of the scaled training image by using a feature extraction network to obtain a feature matrix; regularized attention sampling processing is carried out on the feature matrix, and a global structure sampling graph and a local structure sampling graph are obtained; and carrying out knowledge distillation processing based on the global structure sampling graph and the local structure sampling graph to obtain a trained feature extraction network. The invention can learn the local characteristics of the scene more deeply, and improve the retrieval accuracy.

title: Guide plate design method for total hip replacement and related equipment
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention provides a guide plate design method for total hip replacement and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a corresponding three-dimensional image based on medical image data of a target part, and selecting an adaptive prosthesis model from a pre-stored total hip prosthesis database; generating a simulation guide plate matched with the prosthesis model to obtain guide plate design data; the guide plate design data is used for machining and manufacturing the total hip joint prosthesis. The invention reduces the design difficulty of the artificial total hip joint guide plate, shortens the design period of the guide plate, obviously improves the production efficiency of the guide plate used in the artificial total hip joint replacement operation, assists an operator to complete the operation more accurately and efficiently, and further improves the clinical effect.

title: Electrocardiogram lead data simulation reconstruction method based on neural network algorithm
assignee: 上海乐普云智科技股份有限公司, 乐普（北京）医疗器械股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to an electrocardiogram lead data simulation reconstruction method based on a neural network algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring electrocardio monitoring data of a monitored person; the electrocardiographic monitoring data comprises lead data of at least one limb lead and lead data of at least one chest lead; training a multi-lead electrocardiosignal reconstruction multivariate neural network regression prediction model based on a neural network machine learning algorithm; the independent variables of the multivariate neural network regression prediction model are known lead data of at least one limb lead and lead data of at least one chest lead, and the dependent variables are lead data of other unknown leads except the lead data of the at least one limb lead and the lead data of the at least one chest lead; the multivariate neural network regression prediction model comprises a weight coefficient and a bias coefficient, and is determined by the result of training of a neural network machine learning algorithm; and predicting the lead data of the other unknown leads according to the weight coefficient and the bias coefficient obtained by training.

title: Automatic and blind segmentation of diverse data
abstract: An electronic device may access one or more records associated with an individual based at least in part on an identifier of the individual. Then, based at least in part on values of features associated with a predetermined segment in a population that includes the individual and values of the features in the one or more records, the electronic device assigns the individual to the predetermined segment. Note that the features may be identified based at least in part on count statistics of the features in combinations of features for the population, and the predetermined segment may be based at least in part on distances (such as Euclidean distances) computed using values of the features. Next, the electronic device provides a recommendation for the individual, where the recommendation is based at least in part on one or more attributes associated with one or more other individuals in the predetermined segment.

title: Deformable registration of preoperative volumes and intraoperative ultrasound images from a tracked transducer
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for registration of preoperative images to ultrasound images. The preoperative images are segmented using a shape model. An ultrasound procedure is performed to acquire the ultrasound images. The path of an ultrasound transducer used in the ultrasound procedure is tracked. The path is used to deform the segmented preoperative images, providing an alignment. The ultrasound images are registered to the preoperative images using the alignment.

title: System and method for assigning dynamic operation of devices in a communication network
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system (102) for assigning dynamic operation of devices in a communication network (106). The system (102) receives one or more behavioral attributes and one or more contextual attributes associated with one or more devices (232) in a communication network (106). The system (102) further determines one or more clusters (234) associated with each device from the one or more devices (232). The system (102) further determines, dynamically, one or more network slices, from a set of network slices associated with the one or more clusters (234). The system (102) further determines, dynamically, one or more analytics models associated with the one or more clusters (234). The system (102) further assigns dynamic operation of the one or more clusters (234) based on the one or more contextual attributes, the one or more network slices and the one or more analytics models.

title: System for managing medication
abstract: A smart system for managing medication according to the present invention comprises: a user terminal configured to receive prescription information and medication information for medication; a portable medication storage device which receives the medication and receives medication completion information indicating that the person taking the medication takes the medication; and a server configured to acquire disease information and medical treatment information corresponding to the disease information from an external server as learning data, configured to input the disease information and the medical treatment information into an artificial intelligence model to output disease management information and learn the artificial intelligence model, configured to receive the prescription information and the medication information from the user terminal or receive the prescription information and the medication information from the external server, configured to generate prescription analysis information based on the prescription information of the person taking the medication, and configured to generate medication analysis information based on the medication completion information.

title: Systems and methods for providing personalized estimates of bioheat transfer
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing personalized estimates of bioheat transfer through a patient's body or a portion of a patient's body. One method includes receiving a patient-specific vascular model of a patient's anatomy, including at least one vessel of the patient; receiving a patient-specific tissue model including at least a portion of tissue of the patient's anatomy; receiving an estimate of heat content of the portion of tissue of the patient-specific tissue model or tissue surrounding the portion of tissue; determining an estimate of heat distribution of the portion of tissue of the patient-specific tissue model or tissue surrounding the portion of tissue based on the vascular model, the tissue model, or the received estimate of heat content; and output the determined estimate of heat distribution to a storage medium or user display.

title: Computing device for machine learning based risk analysis
abstract: Described herein is computing device for machine learning based risk analysis and decision automation in intelligent underwriting. In accordance with one aspect of the framework, input data of underwriting cases is preprocessed and used to train a predictive model. The predictive model may be cross-validated and tested for accuracy. The predictive model may then be applied to a current underwriting case in order to automatically identify and assess associated risks and provide a decision recommendation.

title: Method for controlling vehicle and intelligent computing device for controlling vehicle
abstract: A vehicle control method and an intelligent computing device for controlling a vehicle are disclosed. An intelligent computing device for controlling a vehicle according to an embodiment of the present disclosure acquires a direction of a line of sight of a passenger of a vehicle through at least one sensor included in the vehicle and displays driving information of the vehicle through at least one of a plurality of displays included in the vehicle on the basis of the direction of the line of sight of the passenger, to thereby provide convenience to the passenger. One or more of the autonomous vehicle, the intelligent computing device and the server of the present disclosure can be associated with artificial intelligence (AI) modules, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) robots, augmented reality (AR) devices, virtual reality (VR) devices, 5G service related devices, etc.

title: Multi-driving method of display and electronic device supporting same
abstract: An electronic device includes a display including a plurality of regions, a display driver integrated circuit configured to drive a first region of the display at a first driving frequency and drive a second region of the display at a second driving frequency according to a configuration of the display, and a processor configured to provide display data to the display driver integrated circuit. The processor identifies a driving frequency of a first screen to be output on the display in response to reception of a first input; and controls the display to output at least a portion of the first screen on a region, of the plurality of regions, driven at a driving frequency corresponding to the driving frequency of the first screen. The display optimizes driving frequency, thus reducing heating problems and resource waste in the electronic device.

title: ICD automatic merging coding system and method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses an ICD automatic merging and coding system and method based on reinforcement learning, S1: acquiring original medical records data and removing defect or error entries to obtain effective medical records data; s2: preprocessing the effective medical records data, and then carrying out Chinese word segmentation on the medical records text to construct feature vectors; s3: constructing a first data set and a second data set; s4: constructing an ICD code allocation model, and inputting a first data set into the ICD code allocation model to complete training; s5: constructing a diagnosis combination extraction model, and inputting a second data set into the diagnosis combination extraction model to complete training; s6: and performing joint training on the ICD code distribution model and the diagnosis combination, and outputting ICD codes corresponding to the diagnosis. The invention provides ICD combined codes, learns potential relations among disease diagnoses, and accurately combines the disease diagnoses needing combined codes to construct diagnosis characterization under the condition of no need of manual marking so as to be used by an ICD code distribution model and improve distribution precision.

title: Image processing method and system for pneumonia CT image
assignee: 浙江飞图影像科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the medical image processing technology, and discloses an image processing method and an image processing system for pneumonia CT images, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking CT images, preprocessing the CT images, and segmenting the processed images; carrying out lung lobe CT image segmentation on the segmented CT image; segmenting the lung lobe image through a convolutional neural network to obtain an abnormal region image; inputting the segmented abnormal region image into a random forest model for image fusion; and performing sign analysis on the abnormal area image after fusion to obtain the abnormal area image. Abnormal image region segmentation is carried out on the lung CT image by using a plurality of semantic segmentation models, and random forests are used for fusing multi-model segmentation results, so that the accuracy and the generalization of boundary region segmentation are improved; and aiming at the segmented abnormal region image, the physical sign analysis such as the form, the density, the physiological positioning and the like is judged by utilizing a machine learning algorithm and a deep learning algorithm, so that the pneumonia image is analyzed more efficiently.
assignee_clean: 浙江飞图影像科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 浙江飞图影像科技有限公司

title: Knowledge graph question-answering method based on knowledge enhancement
abstract: The invention discloses a knowledge graph question-answering method based on knowledge enhancement, which comprises the following steps: inputting the target image and the target problem into a trained medical visual language model; encoding the target image through an image encoder to obtain target image characteristics, and encoding the target problem through a text encoder to obtain target language characteristics; obtaining a target image knowledge representation by combining knowledge feature representations in the knowledge representation pool based on similarity scores between the target image features and the image feature representations in the knowledge representation pool of the pre-trained medical visual language model; fusing the target image knowledge representation, the target image features and the target language features based on a cross-modal attention fusion mechanism to output knowledge-enhanced multi-modal representation features; inputting the multimodal presentation feature into an answer classifier to output a medical answer corresponding to the target question; the knowledge graph question-answering method improves the output accuracy of the medical visual language model on the input problem.

title: Methods and compositions for treating a condition in a subject
abstract: Methods for treating a condition in a subject, e.g., by enhancing homeostatic capacity of the subject (which may manifest as an increase in a dynamic range of one or more system responses in the subject), are provided. Aspects of embodiments of the methods include: (a) enhancing at least one symptom of the condition to be treated in a manner effective to cause the subject to mount a compensatory response; and (b) diminishing at least one symptom of the condition to be treated; so as to treat the subject for the condition. Also provided are compositions, kits and systems for practicing the subject methods.

title: An intelligent in-store shopping platform for customers and retailers. With this, customers can select, scan, and pay for the products via smartphones and check-out of the store with minimal human intervention. The system uses hi-end technologies such as artificial intelligence for anti-shoplifting, automated decision making, Computer Vision, weighing techniques, electronic circuitry and RFID. The framework uses intricate IoT (Internet of Things) technology and self-learning algorithms, big data analytics, customer engagement and pattern analysis using data extraction and knowledge mining.
abstract: Abstract A process of shopping using an app on mobile devices to scan product bar codes with RFID technology and pay for the shopping cart containing scanned items using said app. The process further provides anti-theft arrangements, automated checkout based on inventory of scanned and paid-for items, consumer purchase history and shopping behaviour projections.
