title: Self-training classification
abstract: Systems, methods, and related technologies for self-training classification are described. In certain aspects, a plurality of device classification methods with associated models are accessed. Each of the classification methods have an associated reliability level. The models of classification methods with a higher reliability level than other classifications methods are used to train the models associated with lower reliability level. The trained models and associated classification methods are thus improved.

title: Electronic device and method for controlling touch function
abstract: An electronic device includes a touch sensor integrated circuit (IC) and a display driver IC. The display driver IC is configured to: obtain information for a display update, and provide, to the touch sensor IC, a first driving signal including (i) a first pulse indicating an address scan period in which the information is recorded via application of a voltage and (ii) a second pulse indicating a self-scan period in which the recorded information is maintained without application of the voltage. Furthermore, while the first driving signal is provided from the display driver IC, the touch sensor IC is configured to: perform a first operation based on detection of the first pulse, and perform a second operation based on detection of the second pulse.

title: Prediction model of atrial fibrillation and prediction system thereof
assignee: 中國醫藥大學附設醫院
abstract:
A prediction system of atrial fibrillation is provided. The prediction system of atrial fibrillation includes an electrocardiogram obtaining unit and a non-transitory machine readable medium. The non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which, when executed by a processing unit, obtains a prediction result. The program includes a reference database obtaining module, a reference feature selecting module, a training module, a target feature selecting module and a comparing module. 
Therefore, the prediction system of atrial fibrillation can be used to predict an incidence of stroke in a subject.

title: Knowledge system and knowledge map system of breast cancer risk factors and construction method
assignee: 四川大学华西医院, 四川大学
abstract: The invention discloses a breast cancer risk factor knowledge system, a breast cancer risk factor knowledge graph system based on the knowledge system and a construction method thereof, belongs to the field of big data processing, and can be applied to intelligent medical evaluation and risk prediction. The knowledge system comprises an ontology establishing module, a data acquisition module, a knowledge evaluation module and a relationship classification module. The breast cancer risk factor knowledge system and the knowledge graph system provided by the invention can be used for carrying out structuring and standardization treatment on breast cancer and related risk factor knowledge, are beneficial to subsequent expansion application and maintenance, can be used for effectively combing the etiology interaction relationship of breast cancer, can be used for carrying out networking connection on complex multidimensional risk factor entities and relationships, can be applied to intelligent medical systems based on knowledge graph data from multiple angles in the future, are beneficial to improving the health benefit of screening projects, and promote the overall health level of society, and have important research significance.
assignee_clean: 四川大学华西医院; 四川大学

title: Method, system, and computer program product for applying deep learning analysis to financial device usage
abstract: Described are a system, method, and computer program product for applying deep learning analysis to predict and automatically respond to predicted changes in financial device primacy for a financial device holder. The method includes receiving transaction data representative of a plurality of transactions between the financial device holder and a merchant. The method also includes generating time series data based on the transaction data and generating a predictive model configured to: (i) receive an input of time-interval-based transaction data; and (ii) output a probability of primary financial device primacy change, the predictive model trained based on historic transaction data. The method further includes determining a probability of primary financial device primacy change for the financial device holder by applying the predictive model to the time series data. The method further includes, generating at least one communication to at least one issuer and/or the financial device holder.

title: Protective clothing wears standardized flow monitoring system
assignee: 成都愚创科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep learning and behavior recognition, and discloses a protective clothing wearing standardized flow monitoring system, which comprises: the boundary dividing module is used for dividing the video into a plurality of video clips, and each video clip comprises a staged action in the protective clothing wearing standardized process; the skeleton detection module is used for detecting skeleton key points of the single-frame image and generating a plurality of skeleton structure images; the skeleton association module is used for connecting a plurality of skeleton key points with action association in the skeleton structure diagram according to the characteristics of the staged actions to generate a skeleton structure association diagram; the action discriminating module is used for identifying each staged action in the video segment to be detected according to the spatial information of the skeleton architecture association diagram, and matching the identification result with the corresponding staged action in the protective clothing wearing standardized process, so as to realize real-time monitoring and prompting on whether the medical staff meets the standardized wearing process in the protective clothing wearing process.

title: Pneumoconiosis detection method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 四川元匠科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a detection method of pneumoconiosis nodules, which comprises the following steps: s1, converting the CT image in the DICOM format into a lung image in a numpy array format and reading data information of the CT image; s2, performing morphological operation to obtain a parenchymal image only retaining lung parenchyma; s3, dividing the substantive image into a plurality of small block images; s4, sending the small images into a convolutional neural network for screening and diagnosing pneumoconiosis nodules to obtain a detection result; and S5, storing the detection result into the csv format. According to the invention, the CT image is converted, morphologically operated and screened, and the number of pneumoconiosis nodules and the coordinate region where the pneumoconiosis nodules are located are detected, so that the automatic diagnosis of pneumoconiosis symptoms is realized, and the problem that a large amount of medical resources are required for pneumoconiosis identification is reduced.

primary_assignee: 四川元匠科技有限公司

title: Method, apparatus and computer readable storage medium for evaluating wounds
abstract: The invention provides a method, apparatus and computer readable storage medium for assessing wounds. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of training images; labeling each training image with the edge of each tissue and the damage type of the tissue contained in the wound to generate a labeled training image; training the image segmentation model based on the plurality of training images and the annotation training images of the plurality of training images to produce a predictive segmentation training image and an assessment model; inputting an image to be evaluated containing the wound into an evaluation model to obtain a prediction segmentation image of the image to be evaluated; extracting a wound contour point of the predictive segmented image, and calculating a wound area, a wound length, and a wound width based on the wound contour point; determining an intra-wound ratio of tissue of each lesion type of the wound based on the predictive segmented image; and generating wound assessment information for the wound based on the wound area, the wound length, the wound width, and the intra-wound ratio of tissue of each wound type of the wound.

title: Method and system for acquiring half word pointing symptoms in doctor-patient conversation
assignee: 北京左医科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for acquiring half word pointing symptoms in doctor-patient conversation, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment. The method comprises the following steps: determining that the doctor-patient conversation is completed, and acquiring doctor-patient conversation information of the doctor-patient conversation; acquiring a precedent word set and a half word set according to the doctor-patient conversation information; combining the antecedent set and the half word set as training data to execute a preset reference resolution algorithm to obtain a real antecedent set of each half word; combining each half word and each antecedent in the corresponding real antecedent set into a complete symptom respectively to obtain a complete symptom set; electronic case information for the patient is obtained from the complete symptom set. According to the scheme of the invention, on the premise of ensuring the accuracy of generating the electric power case, the time for a doctor to hand-write the case is greatly saved, and the inquiry efficiency is improved.

primary_assignee: 北京左医科技有限公司

title: Method for dialog using health information database and apparatus therefor
abstract: Disclosed are a dialog method and a dialog apparatus using a health information database. The dialog method includes the following steps: receiving an articulated sentence; analyzing an intention of a question for health information included in the articulated sentence; obtaining health condition information of a user from a user health database including health information of a user; issuing a query to a health information database to obtain the health information based on the health condition information of the user; obtaining first health information from the health information database; and generating a response sentence with respect to the articulated sentence based on the first health information and outputting the response sentence. According to the present invention, the user can obtain information about health management proper for the user in an easy manner.

title: Spine graph segmentation method of 2D convolutional neural network based on mixed attention mechanism
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and discloses a spine graph segmentation method of a 2D convolutional neural network based on a mixed attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: (1) establishing a training set; (2) preprocessing an original spine CT image to be segmented; (3) Establishing a 2D convolutional neural network with a mixed attention mechanism, and training; (4) And inputting the sample to be segmented into a network, and outputting to obtain a spine CT image segmentation result. The invention improves the overall flow design of the segmentation method, the structure and the cooperation mode of the key convolutional neural network, the functional module design of the corresponding segmentation system and the like, and compared with the prior art, the invention can effectively solve the problem of automatic segmentation of the spine CT image and can efficiently extract the spine region from the spine CT image.

title: Mobile device localization in complex, three-dimensional scenes
abstract: The present embodiments relate to localizing a mobile device in a complex, three-dimensional scene. By way of introduction, the present embodiments described below include apparatuses and methods for using multiple, independent pose estimations to increase the accuracy of a single, resulting pose estimation. The present embodiments increase the amount of input data by windowing a single depth image, using multiple depth images from the same sensor, and/or using multiple depth image from different sensors. The resulting pose estimation uses the input data with a multi-window model, a multi-shot model, a multi-sensor model, or a combination thereof to accurately estimate the pose of a mobile device.

title: Patient body data remote acquisition monitoring system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a system and a method for remotely acquiring and monitoring body data of a patient, and relates to the technical field of data acquisition and monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: the acquired time series of the body data of the patient object are respectively arranged according to the time dimension, and then data enhancement is carried out to obtain an enhanced heart rate time sequence input vector, an enhanced blood pressure time sequence input vector and an enhanced blood sugar time sequence input vector; and performing multi-mode fusion analysis based on feature embedding on the amplified heart rate time sequence input vector, the amplified blood pressure time sequence input vector and the amplified blood sugar time sequence input vector by using a multi-mode embedding analysis framework to obtain comprehensive features of the physical state of a patient, and determining whether to send out health early warning. Therefore, whether health early warning is sent out or not can be intelligently judged, and accordingly the health early warning is timely fed back to medical staff or patients, corresponding measures can be timely taken, health and safety of the patients are guaranteed, and efficiency of medical service is improved.

title: Surgery support apparatus and surgical navigation system
abstract: The accuracy of an intervention site in surgery is predicted and the predicted intervention site is presented to a surgeon. A surgery support apparatus includes a prediction data generation unit that generates prediction data predicting an intervention site based on data before an intervention using an artificial intelligence algorithm. The artificial intelligence algorithm is an artificial intelligence algorithm learning an intervention site by analyzing data before the intervention and intervention site data for an object, and outputs coordinates, a region, or a shape of one point of the intervention site as prediction data. Data before the intervention used for learning of the artificial intelligence algorithm and input data input to the artificial intelligence algorithm to generate prediction data correspond to image data, a segment image, a feature point, etc. The prediction data is displayed on a display apparatus together with an image of a patient acquired in advance.

title: Decentralized data collection for clinical trials
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer-readable media encoded with computer program instructions, for customized monitoring by remote devices. In some implementations, a system provides access to an application to a user through a device. The system receives an identifier for a secured data storage area of the user. Before receiving authorization to access the data in the data storage area, the system uses the identifier to obtain metadata indicating data classifications for the data stored in the data storage area, the metadata being obtained from a server system over a communication network. Based on the metadata, the system generates a second set of types of data to collect from the user. The system customizes interaction of the application with the user based on the set of second set of types of data, which is customized for the user based on the data classifications indicated by the metadata.

title: Display screen control method and electronic device supporting same
abstract: An instruction of an electronic device is provided. The instruction of the electronic device, when executed by a processor, causes a display panel to be operated using one of a first gamma set corresponding to a first operating frequency and a second gamma set corresponding to a second operating frequency, each of the first gamma set and the second gamma set comprises gamma voltage values for each luminance and gradation, the first gamma set and the second gamma set include the same gamma voltage value in a first gradation range of a first luminance so as to have the substantially same optical characteristic when the operating frequency changes, the first gamma set and the second gamma set include the same gamma voltage value in a second gradation range of a second luminance, and the first gradation range and the second gradation range are different from each other.

title: Cervical cancer cell intelligent detection method based on deep learning
abstract: An intelligent cervical cancer cell detection method based on deep learning. The invention relates to classification of nuclei by a deep learning method. The invention aims to solve the problems of low accuracy, long time consumption and the like of the existing traditional diagnosis mode for detecting cancer cells. In order to solve the problem, the invention provides an intelligent cervical cancer cell screening method based on deep learning. The method comprises the following specific processes: firstly, preparing data; secondly, dividing cell nucleuses; thirdly, classifying cell nucleuses; and fourthly, screening cancer cells. In the cell nucleus classification part, data is expanded and classified by an active learning method; the model is based on ResNeSt, doctor diagnosis experience is introduced, and more accurate model is trained by extracting diagnosis indexes and coacting. Experiments show that the accuracy rate of the cell nucleus classification method is higher than that of the original model, and in addition, the invention also provides a more effective data preparation method for expanding data and subdividing classes. The invention is applied to the field of medical image classification.

title: Method for predicting fine dust concentration based on artificial intelligence and apparatus implementing the same method
abstract: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is a method performed by a computing device, which includes the steps of: inputting fine dust forecast data into each of a plurality of fine dust prediction models and outputting a fine dust prediction value for each model; determining a final fine dust prediction value using the output fine dust prediction value for each model and the fine dust forecast data; and generating fine dust prediction information for each region by using the final fine dust prediction value.

title: Keyword newly-adding method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安医疗科技有限公司, 平安健康互联网股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a keyword newly-adding method, a keyword newly-adding device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: inquiring search records without search results, and popping up a keyword mapping management interface; acquiring ontology words with different dimensions corresponding to the search records, and inputting the ontology words with different dimensions into attribute values with corresponding dimensions in a keyword mapping management interface; receiving input keywords through the keyword mapping management interface; and storing the attribute value and the keyword in an associated manner. By adopting the method, the recommendation success rate of departments can be improved.
assignee_clean: 平安医疗科技有限公司; 平安健康互联网股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安医疗科技有限公司

title: Methods and systems for merging outputs of candidate and job-matching artificial intelligence engines executing machine learning-based models
abstract: The instant disclosure discloses methods and systems for merging outputs of matching artificial intelligence (AI) engines that are configured to match jobs to candidates, candidates to candidates and jobs to jobs. The methods and systems illustrate how multiple artificial intelligence engines or algorithms executing machine learning-based models can be used to identify candidates or jobs that match other candidates or jobs.

title: Methods and apparatus for controlling treatment delivery using reinforcement learning
abstract: Methods and systems are provided which relate to the planning and delivery of radiation treatments by modalities which involve moving a radiation source along a trajectory relative to a subject while delivering radiation to the subject. An artificial intelligence (AI) agent trained using reinforcement learning (and/or some other suitable form of machine learning) is used to control the radiation delivery parameters in effort to achieve desired delivery of radiation therapy. In some embodiments, the AI agent selects suitable control steps (e.g. radiation delivery parameters for particular time steps), while accounting for patient motions, difference(s) in patient anatomical geometry and/or the like.

title: Systems and methods for treating coronavirus
abstract: Provided herein are methods of treatment, including methods of treating subjects having or at risk of having or having a viral infection, and specifically a SARS-CoV-2 viral infection. The methods provided include the administration of 4-methylumbelliferone (4-MU), palmitoylethanolamide (PEA), resveratrol, fisetin, H2, nebulized hyaluronidase or combinations thereof. Also provided herein are a respiratory assistance device, methods of generating a customized respiratory assistance device, methods of treating a coronavirus infection, and methods of inhibiting a coronavirus infectivity, virulence and/or spread.

title: Training method, device, equipment and storage medium of image classification network
assignee: 广州视源电子科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a training method, a training device, training equipment and a training storage medium of an image classification network, wherein the training method comprises the following steps: generating an image classification network based on the labeled sample set; selecting target data from unlabeled data based on a strategy network and an evaluation network for labeling; updating the marked sample set according to the marking result of the target data, and updating the image classification network according to the updated marked sample set; updating the strategy network and the evaluation network according to the labeling result; and circularly executing the selecting operation and the updating operation until the preset condition is met, so as to obtain the trained image classification network. According to the technical scheme, only part of unlabeled data is selected for labeling and updating the image classification network each time, so that the data cost and labeling workload in the training process are reduced, and the classification accuracy is ensured.
assignee_clean: 广州视源电子科技股份有限公司

title: Estimating diffusion metrics from diffusion- weighted magnetic resonance images using optimized k-q space sampling and deep learning
abstract: Diffusion metric maps are generated from a limited input of magnetic resonance data to a suitably trained machine learning algorithm, such as a suitably trained neural network. In general, a downsampling strategy is implemented in the joint k-q space to enable the simultaneous estimation of multiple different diffusion metrics from a more limited set of input diffusion-weighted images.

title: Virtual machine backup and restoration
abstract: Reversing deletion of a virtual machine including managing, by a storage system, a repository of virtual machine snapshots on a datastore; receiving, by the storage system, a request to recover a deleted virtual machine from the datastore; accessing, by the storage system, the repository of virtual machine snapshots on the datastore to generate a list of deleted virtual machines associated with virtual machine snapshots in the repository of virtual machine snapshots; receiving, by the storage system, a selection of one of the deleted virtual machines in the list of deleted virtual machines; and recovering, by the storage system, the selected deleted virtual machine using a virtual machine snapshot for the selected deleted virtual machine.

title: Communication robot and method for operating the same
abstract: A communication robot capable of communicating with other electronic devices and an external server in a 5G communication environment by performing artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms and/or machine learning algorithms to be loaded and performing a speech recognition, and a driving method thereof are disclosed. The method for driving a communication robot according to an exemplary embodiment of the present disclosure may include receiving an utterance speech uttered by a user who has approached within a predetermined distance from the communication robot, and selecting any one ASR module capable of processing the uttered speech among plural ASR modules as an optimized ASR module. According to the present disclosure, it is possible to improve user's satisfaction with the use of the communication robot by reducing the inconvenience that the user has to manually set a first language in the preprocessing operation in order to receive a service from the communication robot.

title: Method of obtaining medical sagittal image, method of training neural network and computing device
abstract: A method of training neural network for obtaining medical sagittal image includes: using a first neural network on a 3-D medical image to generate a prediction sagittal mask; generating a prediction result according to the 3-D medical image and the prediction sagittal mask; generating a ground truth result according to the 3-D medical image and a ground truth sagittal mask; using a second neural network on the prediction result and the ground truth result; generating a loss function data according to an output of the second neural network; and adjusting parameters of the first neural network or the second neural network according to the loss function data.

title: Method for distributing equity reward for federated learning based on equity theory
abstract: A method for distributing an equity reward for federated learning based on an equity theory includes the following steps: applying Adams' equity theory to federated learning, analyzing, by a participant, all factors invested in a federated task comprehensively, then giving an expected reward for this task, calculating, by the task publisher, the reputation of the participant; participating, by the participant, in each round of a training task using a local data to evaluate data contribution, model contribution, and a waiting-time allowance of the participant, then combining contribution results of the three factors to evaluate the contribution of the participant; after a global model converges, dynamically adjusting weights of the three factors according to an objective function of the equity reward, with a goal that an actual reward of the participant is as close as possible to the expected reward, and obtaining and distributing the actual reward of the participant.

title: Online diagnosis and treatment data processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 康键信息技术（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an online diagnosis and treatment data processing method and device based on deep learning, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: when receiving online conversation content of a patient on an Internet diagnosis and treatment platform, acquiring scene characteristics and symptom descriptions according to historical conversation content if auxiliary diagnosis and treatment conditions are met; when the sentence type of the online conversation content is identified as a question sentence, extracting the intention and the medical entity of the online conversation content; matching relevant questions from the candidate question library that satisfy the intent and the medical entity; and obtaining candidate answers of the related questions, determining matching answers related to the symptom description from the candidate answers, and outputting auxiliary diagnosis and treatment replies serving as online session contents. Because the online diagnosis and treatment reply comprehensively considers the intention of the conversation content, the medical entity and the symptom description, the output answer is not thousand pieces uniformly, but accords with the conversation content, and the matching degree of the automatic reply content and the patient requirement can be improved.
assignee_clean: 康键信息技术 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 康键信息技术 深圳 有限公司

title: Computing system for notifying persons of exposure to an infectious disease in a healthcare facility
abstract: An electronic health records application (EHR) receives an indication that a patient in a healthcare facility has been diagnosed with an infectious disease at a datetime. The EHR determines first locations in the healthcare facility in which the patient has been present. The EHR identifies portions of a heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system (HVAC) system of the healthcare facility based upon the first locations. The portions of the HVAC system connect the first locations to second locations in the healthcare facility. The EHR identifies a person that has been present in at least one of the first locations or the second locations. The EHR then causes a notification to be transmitted to a computing device operated by the person notifying the person of potential exposure to the infectious disease.

title: Fiber optic medical systems and devices with atraumatic tip
abstract: Disclosed herein are medical systems and devices that include an elongate probe configured for insertion into a patient, where the elongate probe includes an atraumatic tip and where the atraumatic tip includes one or more of a loop, a curl, coil, a flexible distal tip section, a steerable distal tip section, a distal tip section configured to transition away from a first shape toward a second shape upon insertion of the elongate probe within the patient. The optical fiber includes sensing core fibers configured to facilitate a determination of a physical state of the elongate probe. The elongate probe is also configured to project illuminating light away from a distal end and receive imaging light at the distal end.

title: Method for improving image classification accuracy of computer aided diagnosis system
abstract: The invention relates to a method for improving the image classification accuracy of a computer-aided diagnosis system, belonging to the technical field of computer vision. The method is based on the fusion of medical image characteristics and clinical characteristics of deep learning, and firstly, the system image data and the clinical data are preprocessed. Then, the clinical data C of the system is analyzed i And obtaining the high-dimensional feature vector through convolution layer and maximum pooling operation. And performing feature extraction on the image information through the residual block. And adjusting the finally obtained image feature map into a one-dimensional vector, and splicing the one-dimensional vector with the clinical feature vector to obtain a new larger feature vector. And finally obtaining the probability of each classification result by passing the feature vector through a full connection layer and a Softmax function. Compared with the image classification method of the existing computer aided diagnosis system, the method of the invention can lead the computer aided diagnosis system to obtain rapid and highly reliable image classification under various practical application scenes.

title: Intelligent auxiliary system and method for rehabilitation nursing
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary system and method for rehabilitation nursing, and relates to the field of rehabilitation nursing. In this way, the health care personnel can better monitor and manage the rehabilitation process of the patient.

title: Adjustment of analgesic stimulation parameters based on trust dynamic measurements
abstract: Systems and techniques are disclosed to establish programming of an implantable electrical neurostimulation device for treating pain of a human subject, through the use and adjustment of analgesic stimulation parameters based on trust dynamics and trust measurements. In an example, the system to establish programming of the neurostimulation device performs operations that: determine a trust measurement value that is derived from results of at least one commitment made with a human subject, via observable interactions; determine a modification of at least one neurostimulation programming parameter, based on the trust measurement value; and to cause the implantable neurostimulation device to implement the modification of the at least one neurostimulation programming parameter. Further examples are provided to produce and track the trust measurement value, as well as identify a pain susceptibility value and determine a receptiveness to analgesic effects based on these and other trust dynamics.

title: System and method for image segmentation
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses associated with image segmentation are described herein. The system, method and tool have a hierarchical structure for generating a rough segmentation of the anatomical structure, which is then refined based on a shape prior of the anatomical structure. The coarse segmentation may be generated using a multi-tasking neural network and based on both segmentation loss and regression loss. The refined segmentation may be obtained by a priori deforming the shape using one or more of a shape-based model or a learning-based model.

title: Question-answering model editing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an editing method, an editing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a question-answering model, which relate to a large language model; according to the method and the device, the basic question-answering model can be subjected to model editing processing, and an edited question-answering model is obtained; carrying out answer prediction processing on content information of each test question content in the test data under the evaluation index in at least one mode through the edited question-answering model, and determining a prediction answer corresponding to the test question content; aiming at the test data of each evaluation index, obtaining the recognition accuracy corresponding to the test data under the evaluation index based on expected answers and predicted answers corresponding to the content of each test question in the test data; and carrying out optimization processing on the edited question-answer model based on the recognition accuracy corresponding to the test data under each evaluation index to obtain the target question-answer model. The method and the device can improve model updating efficiency and accuracy of answer output.

title: Method to measure tissue texture using NMR spectroscopy to identify the chemical species of component textural elements in a targeted region of tissue
abstract: A method for identifying the chemical species of various textural elements in a targeted region of tissue wherein a volume of interest (VOI) is selectively excited and a k-encode gradient pulse is applied to induce phase wrap to create a spatial encode for a specific k-value and orientation. The specific k-value is selected based on anticipated texture within the VOI. Multiple sequential samples of the NMR RF signal encoded with the specific k-value are recorded as signal data. The Fourier Transform of the acquired signal data is then taken, wherein for each k-encode, the signal recorded is indicative of the spatial frequency power density at that point in k-space. Each peak in the NMR spectrum is then evaluated, whereby the relative contribution to the texture of tissue in the VOI at a k-value for each chemical species is determined.

title: Topographically conforming garments
assignee: Regents Of The University Of Minnesota
abstract: Advances in actuating fabrics could enable a paradigm shift in the field of smart wearables by dynamically fitting themselves to the unique topography of the human body. Active fabrics and fitting mechanisms are described herein that enable garments to conform around surface concavities without requiring high elasticity or a multiplicity of closure devices. Advanced materials and systems innovations (1) enable novel garment manufacturing and application strategies, (2) facilitate topographical fitting (spatial actuation) through garment architectural design, and (3) provide tunable NiTi-based SMA actuation temperatures to enable actuation on the surface of human skin. Such fabrics and garments are usable in a variety of fields including medical compression, technical sportswear, exosuits, space suits and components thereof, or non-garment applications.
assignee_clean: regents of the university of minnesota
primary_assignee: regents of the university of minnesota

title: Optimization method and device for policy simulation analysis and computer equipment
assignee: 平安医疗健康管理股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an optimization method, an optimization device and computer equipment for policy simulation analysis, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, basic information and policy rule information of each user are acquired; based on the basic information and the policy rule information, screening the characteristics of each user to obtain the user characteristics of each user; classifying the users by taking the user characteristics of the users as classification conditions to generate at least one classification cluster; and executing policy simulation analysis of the batch users according to the group characteristics of the classification clusters. The method is equivalent to providing a policy simulation scheme based on feature selection, and can improve the efficiency and accuracy of policy simulation analysis from algorithm and software at the same time. In addition, the application also relates to a blockchain technology, and the characteristic data and the policy simulation analysis result of the user can be stored in the blockchain so as to ensure the privacy and the safety of the data.

title: Method and apparatus for electronic device unlocking
abstract: An electronic device comprising: a sensor module for detecting a tilt of the electronic device; a touchscreen display; at least one processor configured to: control the display to display at least a part of a 3-dimensional (3D) object having a plurality of faces, each face comprising a respective plurality of elements; detect an unlocking pattern that is input using the object and a tilt value that identifies at least one value in an orientation of the electronic device that occurs while the unlocking pattern is being input; and at least partially unlock the electronic device based on the tilt value and the unlock pattern.

title: Device and method for optical retinography
abstract: Principles of the present disclosure are directed to novel methods and devices for focal or global optical stimulation of retina and detecting activity of the retina by collecting and processing the back-scattered optical signal from the retina (Optical RetinoGram). Specifically, the invention provides device and method for quantitatively determining the layer specific activity of retina from the acquired intrinsic back reflected signal by monitoring phase/intensity fluctuations and thereafter employing multifractality algorithm on optical signal for obtaining various multifractal parameters such as width of singularity spectrum, Hurst exponent, fractal dimension, locally connected fractal mapping as well as artificial intelligence based classification for the use of diagnosis of retinal degenerative/ocular disease(s) and asses the progression of diseases or recovery of function due to one or more treatment by therapeutic drugs, devices, protocols.

title: Systems and methods for signal synchronization in MRI device
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: Systems and methods for MR signal synchronization may be provided. The method may include determining a time difference in a local clock generator at a coil side assembly compared to a system clock generator at a system side assembly. The method may include maintaining a constant phase difference between clock signals generated by the local clock generator and by the system clock generator by correcting the local clock generator based on the time difference. The method may include acquiring MR echo signals by scanning at least a part of a subject in response to the clock signal generated by the corrected local clock generator. The method may further include digitizing the MR echo signal at the coil side assembly.

title: Method and system for generating limited sampling text sequence
assignee: 北京邮电大学, 北京智芯微电子科技有限公司
abstract: The method and the system for generating the limited sampling text sequence provided by the embodiment of the invention comprise the following steps: inputting the initial text sequence into a confrontation network model to obtain a first word of a pre-output text sequence; selecting a next word of the first word from a dictionary database by using a generator according to the first word to form a pre-output text sequence; according to the word list mask-based method, continuously selecting the next word of the pre-output text sequence according to the pre-output text sequence, acquiring a new pre-output text sequence until the total word number reaches a set threshold value, inputting the new pre-output text sequence into a discriminator for discrimination, and calculating an update gradient according to a classification discrimination result; updating the parameters of the generator, and inputting the initial text sequence into the updated generator again; and outputting the target text sequence until the generator and the discriminator are converged. The method and the system provided by the embodiment simplify the sampling space and improve the quality of the generated text by improving the formulated text rule.
assignee_clean: 北京邮电大学; 北京智芯微电子科技有限公司

title: Terms for query expansion using unstructured data
abstract: A processor determines a set of terms frequently occurring within unstructured data associated with criteria of a query. The processor analyzes the unstructured data to match a term of the set of terms, to criteria of the query. Matching terms are retained and unmatched terms are checked for semantic similarity to terms of the criteria to determine an inferred match of the term of the unstructured data to terms of the criteria of the query. In response to determining an inferred match, the inferred match term is added to the second set of terms, and the processor compares the second set of terms to the terms of the criteria of the query, and removes matching terms, resulting in a third set of terms added to the set of criteria terms of the query. The additional query terms will enhance the recall without diluting the precision.

title: Experience engine-method and apparatus of learning from similar patients
abstract: The present solution covers identifying a recommended treatment for a patient based on records of similar patients, wherein the similarities are non-obvious and non-linear. The solution generates a similarity map that minimizes the variance of elements records among a curated group of patients, and this similarity map is used to find the patients who are most similar to an untreated patient.

title: Dynamic modification of media content in an internet of things (IoT) computing environment
abstract: Embodiments for optimizing media content in an Internet of Things (IoT) environment. User information is collected by a first, embedded IoT computing device associated with a user. The collected user information is transmitted from the first computing device to a second, content-displaying IoT computing device. Characteristics of media content rendered by the second computing device are then rendered according to an analyzation of the user information received from the first computing device.

title: Step-by-step progressive two-stage medical image registration method
abstract: The invention provides a progressive two-stage medical image registration method, which is used for solving the problem that the traditional registration method has low precision during image registration. The method comprises the following steps: fusing a reference image to be registered and a floating image to generate a plurality of intermediate progressive images; registering the floating image and the intermediate progressive image by utilizing an SURF algorithm and affine transformation to obtain a coarse registration result; registering the reference image and the coarse registration result by utilizing a SURF algorithm and affine transformation to obtain an accurate registration result; and repeating iteration, comparing accurate registration results obtained by each intermediate progressive image, and selecting the optimal registration result as a final registration image. In the brain image combined registration, the mutual information, the normalized cross correlation coefficient, the mean square error and the normalized mutual information of the invention are superior to those of the existing registration algorithm; the invention carries out image registration based on a step-by-step progressive strategy, and can effectively improve the precision of medical image registration.

title: Device and method for natural language processing through statistical model comparison
abstract: A computer-implemented method comprising: receiving the first set of words and the second set of words, wherein each of the first and second sets of words; calculating a first likelihood-based measure representing how well a first model can be fit to the first and second sets of words, the first model comprising a shared parametric distribution representing both the first and second sets of words; calculating a second likelihood-based measure representing how well a second model can be fit to the first and second sets of words, the second model comprising a first parametric distribution representing the first set of words and a second parametric distribution representing the second set of words; calculating a similarity score based on a ratio of the first likelihood measure to the second likelihood measure, the similarity score being representative of the similarity between the first and second sets of words; and outputting the similarity score.

title: High myopia cataract intraocular lens accurate selection system
assignee: 复旦大学附属眼耳鼻喉科医院
abstract: The invention relates to a precise selection system for a high myopia cataract intraocular lens, which is characterized by comprising the following components: and a data module: constructing a successful high myopia cataract intraocular lens degree calculation model; and an evaluation module: determining a target diopter of the patient; and a matching module: determining the most suitable intraocular lens type; and a selection module: the required intraocular lens power is calculated quickly and accurately. The advantages are as follows: improving the accuracy of intraocular lens selection; improving the accuracy of intraocular lens selection; improving the selection efficiency of the artificial lens for cataract surgery; the requirements of the patient are met, the most suitable target diopter is selected according to the time distribution of different eye use distances in the daily life of the patient, and the daily life requirements of the patient are met; meets the selection requirement of the personalized artificial lens; the service objects are wide, and the social value is high.

title: Structural processing method of thyroid ultrasound report based on tree structure
assignee: 东华大学, 万达信息股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a tree-structured template established according to a part-of-speech dictionary and a dependency tree, and a method for structuring a thyroid ultrasound report by referring to the template. The overall flow mainly comprises three stages of part-of-speech dictionary establishment module, tree structure template establishment module and tree structure template calling for structuring. Part-of-speech dictionary creation module: and performing phrase segmentation on the report and performing phrase clustering. And then using a named entity recognition technology, and establishing a part-of-speech dictionary according to the organ words ORG, the position words LOC, the attribute words ATT and the attribute names. The tree template building module: semantic relationships of each short sentence are obtained through dependency syntactic analysis, and the part of speech of each word is obtained through a part of speech dictionary. And a tree template establishment flow is provided by combining the two. Tree template calling module: text structuring is performed using tree templates.
assignee_clean: 东华大学; 万达信息股份有限公司

title: Auxiliary detection method for pulmonary nodules
abstract: The invention relates to a lung nodule auxiliary detection method, which mainly comprises the steps of S100, acquiring a data set, wherein the data set comprises chest scanning CT images of N patients, and each patient has a series of chest scanning CT images; s200, establishing a multi-scale auxiliary detection model, wherein the model consists of three U-net networks with different void ratios and a VGG neural network, and training and optimizing parameters of the multi-scale auxiliary detection model by using a relevant multi-task joint loss function by adopting data of S100; s300, inputting a series of CT images of the patient to be predicted into an optimized multi-scale auxiliary detection model, and outputting a detection result, a segmentation result and a classification result of the patient to be predicted. On the basis of the multi-scale unified characterization of the pulmonary nodules, the method analyzes the strong correlation action relation among the pulmonary nodule auxiliary detection multitasks, realizes the multi-task combined training and optimization, and integrally optimizes the sensitivity and accuracy of the pulmonary nodule auxiliary detection.

title: Method and system for monitoring prescription drug data and determining claim data accuracy
abstract: A method and system for scanning claims data, the method comprising receiving, by a computing system, contract details associated with claims, receiving, by the computer system, prescription transactions data associated with the claims, parsing, by the computer system, the transactions data into column values, and executing, by the computer system, analytics on the parsed transactions. The analytics include comparing the parsed transactions against the contract details for accurate pricing, fees, and accepted treatment protocols concerning dose and quantity, comparing the parsed transactions with independent pricing data that is based on third-party pricing data and drug information, identifying material errors in the parsed transactions, determining withholdings from payment of the claims for a portion above a tolerance level based on the identified material errors. The method further comprising presenting, by the computer system, results of the execution of the analytics to a portal.

title: Intravascular system supporting optical fibers
assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to an intravascular system supporting optical fibers. Placement of an elongate medical device having a tortuous vascular path can be challenging. The disclosed systems and methods include a stylet having a shapeable portion formed from a shape memory superelastic material such as nitinol. The stylet may be placed within the catheter and include a Fiber Optic Strain Sensor (FOSS) system configured to determine the shape of the stylet. Passing a fluid at a predetermined temperature through the lumen of the catheter changes the temperature of the shapeable portion, which in turn changes the shape and/or the flexible state of the shapeable portion. Changing the shape of the shapeable portion may change the angle at which the distal tip of the stylet extends relative to the central longitudinal axis. The user may then rotate and advance the distal tip to pass through the tortuous vascular pathway. Similarly, altering the flexibility of the shapeable segment may facilitate passage through tortuous vasculature.

title: Training method and device for thermodynamic diagram generation model, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a training method, a training device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for thermodynamic diagram generation models, and particularly relates to the technical fields of deep learning, image recognition, computer vision, AI medical treatment and the like. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a fundus image and a labeling thermodynamic diagram corresponding to the fundus image, wherein a thermodynamic value corresponding to a yellow spot fovea in the labeling thermodynamic diagram is different from a thermodynamic value corresponding to other pixel points, and the yellow spot fovea is a pixel point positioned in the fundus image; processing the fundus image by using an initial model to obtain a predicted thermodynamic diagram corresponding to the fundus image; determining a loss value corresponding to the fundus image based on the difference between the predicted thermal value of any point in the predicted thermodynamic diagram and the labeling thermal value of the corresponding point in the labeling thermodynamic diagram and the distance between any point and the fovea; and reversely correcting the initial model based on the loss value corresponding to the fundus image to generate a corrected thermodynamic diagram generation model.

title: Nursing information sharing method, system and storage medium based on Internet of things
assignee: 山东新时代药业有限公司, 常州市武进人民医院(常州市第八人民医院)
abstract: The invention discloses a nursing information sharing method, a nursing information sharing system and a storage medium based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of medical information processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the invention realizes data targeted analysis of medicines according to the relevant records of the patient in the early stage of admission, solves the problem of unsmooth medicine management in the current nursing information processing process, can provide accurate data base for timely management of the medicines through data processing, ensures that the medicine management accuracy and management efficiency of a department in nursing are reliably data-supported, and further ensures the effectiveness of medicine resource coordination management.

title: New coronary pneumonia risk prompting device and system based on ultrasonic imaging
assignee: 北京核信锐视安全技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a new coronary pneumonia risk prompting device, method and system based on ultrasonic imaging. And determining the risk level of the detected person suffering from the new coronary pneumonia according to the epidemiological information and symptom information of the detected person and the identification result output by the identification model. The possibility that the detected person suffers from the new coronary pneumonia can be determined according to the risk level, the worry is eliminated or correct preventive treatment measures are taken, the detected person does not need to be checked one by one, the workload of doctors is greatly reduced, and the utilization rate of medical resources is improved. Meanwhile, the acquisition process of the ultrasonic image and the determination of the risk level of the new coronary pneumonia are short, so that the detected person with low risk of the new coronary pneumonia can eliminate the worry as soon as possible, and the influence on normal life is avoided.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image processing method, an image processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium, which relate to artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image, and inputting the original image into a target image processing model to be trained for processing to obtain a target image; acquiring a target reference model, wherein the target reference model is obtained by training according to the difference between an image input to the model and an image output by the model; inputting an original image into a target reference model to obtain corresponding reference information; obtaining a first model loss value according to the difference between target information and reference information, wherein the target information comprises at least one of a target image or coding characteristics obtained by inputting the target image into a target reference model for coding; and adjusting model parameters in the target image processing model according to the first model loss value to obtain an updated target image processing model, so as to perform image processing by using the updated target image processing model. The method can improve the image processing effect.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method for activity-based learning with optimized delivery
assignee: Avail Support Limited, Lisa Marie CLINTON, Mary Ann Cronin
abstract: According to techniques and systems disclosed herein a pre-assessment profile may be generated for a learner based on a designated activity. The pre-assessment profile may be based on evaluating learner provided inputs or responses to one or more inquiries. A designated activity may be received and a plurality of activity steps to perform the designated activity may be generated and may be based on the pre-assessment profile. A media type may be identified for each activity step of the plurality of activity steps based on the pre-assessment profile for the learner, and may be provided to the learner. A learner's ability to perform the designated activity may be determined, based on applicable feedback information. According to techniques disclosed herein, a trigger event may be learned during learning mode and may include trigger event surrounding data for a behavioral attribute. A response may be generated based on detecting the trigger event.
assignee_clean: avail support; lisa marie clinton; mary ann cronin

title: Internet of things resource conflict-free distribution method and system based on graph reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of things resource management, in particular to a method and a system for conflict-free allocation of Internet of things resources based on graph reinforcement learning, and provides a novel hypergraph network service management model aiming at an overlapping area of network resource conflict in network service management. Because the hypergraph network service management model is an NP difficult problem and is difficult to solve, an indirect solution is provided, and the hypergraph network service management problem is modeled as a decision model combining a hypergraph and a Markov decision process. However, the Deep Q Network (DQN) method inevitably has a problem of high estimation, and in order to solve the problem of network resource conflict, a network service management algorithm based on a graph rolling network double-resolution deep Q network (GCN-D3 QN) is proposed. Simulation results show that the network resource management capability of the system is effectively enhanced in the scene of the Internet of things.

title: Apparatus, method and readable storage medium for performing tasks using deep reinforcement learning
assignee: 安徽寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to an integrated circuit device, board, method and readable storage medium for performing continuous decision tasks in a random dynamic environment using a deep reinforcement learning model, wherein the computing device of the present invention is included in an integrated circuit device that includes a generic interconnect interface and other processing devices. The computing device interacts with other processing devices to collectively complete a user-specified computing operation. The integrated circuit device may further comprise a storage device coupled to the computing device and the other processing device, respectively, for data storage by the computing device and the other processing device.
assignee_clean: 安徽寒武纪信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 安徽寒武纪信息科技有限公司

title: System and method for machine learning assisted multifunction peripheral fleet management via a handheld device
abstract: A system and method for maintaining and optimizing a fleet of multifunction peripherals is operated by use of a smartphone or tablet computer. Fleet changes are provided in multiple categories such as software updates, configuration changes and feature activation. A user is provided with a dashboard having a selectable indicia for each category. Devices are monitored and machine learning provides for recommendations for each category. A badge showing a number of recommendations for each category is displayed with its selectable indicia. When an indicia is selected, an associated recommendation is displayed and implemented if accepted. Once accepted, the dashboard is regenerated with updated badge information reflecting an accepted implementation.

title: Care system for predicting bed exit and patient management system including the same
abstract: A care system for predicting bed exit and suitable for a frame supporting a patient is provided. The care system includes a boundary-crossing detection system, a location sensing system, and a control circuit. The boundary-crossing detection system is coupled with the frame. The location sensing system is coupled with the frame, and is for obtaining relative position information between the patient and the frame. The control circuit is for data communicating with the boundary-crossing detection system and the location sensing system, and is for accessing care data defining multiple bed-exit behaviors. When one of following situations occurs, the control circuit transmits a warning signal: (1) the control circuit determines that, according to the relative position information and the care data, a current behavior of the patient corresponds to one of the multiple bed-exit behaviors; and (2) the boundary-crossing detection system senses that an object is passing through.

title: Segmentation method of viscera and internal blood vessels thereof in surgical planning system
assignee: 苏州迪凯尔医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a segmentation method of medical images, and specifically relates to a segmentation method of viscera and internal blood vessels thereof in a surgical planning system. The method designs a segmentation method of images of liver parenchyma, portal veins and hepatic veins based on minimal supervised classification of the three-dimensional CT images of the viscera and internal tubular tissues thereof. The method applies methods of statistics and spatial information, introduces high credible points, and obtains segmentation results based on arrival time of fast march of grey level. The method assumes that spatially adjacent points belong to a same organ, and performs segmentation calculation on the images by using a classification algorithm based on the above assumption, wherein the segmentation calculation comprises the steps of: acquiring estimated values of parameters of a Gaussian mixture distribution model; selecting the high credible points; and calculating the mean value of the grey level of the images and calculating the arrival time by using a fast marching algorithm to obtain arrival time images of three tissue classifications. According to the invention, good robustness and good anti-noise interference capability are obtained, accumulated errors are eliminated effectively, classification accuracy is improved, and great application value in clinical treatment is achieved.
assignee_clean: 苏州迪凯尔医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 苏州迪凯尔医疗科技有限公司

title: Anonymizing data sets in risk management applications
abstract: A method for anonymizing data sets for use with risk management applications comprises receiving a data set from a source, the data set containing a plurality of correlated attributes. This embodiment further comprises analyzing the plurality of correlated attributes to create an attribute classification. Applying a differential privacy algorithm to the plurality of correlated attributes if the attribute classification requires data randomization is likewise a part of this embodiment. The randomized data set is provided to a risk management application. The randomized data set is used to create a risk management report, wherein the risk management report is an output of the risk management application.

title: Stair lift monitoring
abstract: A monitoring system that is configured to monitor a property is disclosed. The monitoring system includes a sensor that is configured to generate sensor data that reflects an attribute of the property. The monitoring system further includes a stair lift that is configured to transport a person up and down stairs at the property and that is configured to generate stair lift data that reflects a status of the stair lift. The monitoring system further includes a monitor control unit that is configured to receive the sensor data and the stair lift data. The monitor control unit is further configured to analyze the sensor data and the stair lift data. The monitor control unit is further configured to determine that an event occurred at the property. The monitor control unit is further configured to, based on determining that the event occurred at the property, perform a monitoring system action.

title: Apparatus and method for caring emotion based on vehicle sound
assignee: Hyundai Motor Company, Kia Corporation, Seoul National University R&Db Foundation
abstract: An apparatus and a method for caring emotion of a driver based on a vehicle sound, may include a detector configured to detect driving information of the vehicle and body information of a user, a non-transitory storage to store instructions, and a processor to execute the instructions. The processor determines an emotional status of the driver by use of at least one of the driving information or the body information, to generate a healing sound by designing a virtual sound based on the driving information and the emotional status of the driver, and to generate and output the healing sound.
assignee_clean: hyundai motor; kia; seoul national university r db foundation

title: Voice enabled IoT using second line service
abstract: Enablement of a voice channel being established between an IoT device and a controller through the use of a voice-line service system.

title: Method and apparatus for modeling mobility and dynamic connectivity on a stationary wireless testbed
abstract: A device, comprising a packet data interface port; a microcontroller, configured to control the packet data interface port, receive a input control signal through the packet data interface port, transmit a status report through the packet data interface port, and in dependence on the input control signal, produce an output control signal; and a radio frequency modification device, configured to modify a received radio frequency signal over a range selectively in dependence on the output control signal. A control processor, communicating through the packet data interface port with the microcontroller, may generate a plurality of the input control signals for a plurality of respective devices comprising the microcontroller and the radio frequency signal control device. The input control signals may be dynamically changed over time to emulate radio frequency conditions resulting from mobility of nodes in a mobile ad hoc radio frequency communication network.

title: Determining a course of action based on aggregated data
abstract: Described herein is a system that transmits and combines local models, that individually comprise a set of local parameters computed via stochastic gradient descent (SGD), into a global model that comprises a set of global model parameters. The local models are computed in parallel at different geographic locations along with symbolic representations. Network transmission of the local models and the symbolic representations, rather than transmission of the large training data subsets processed to compute the local models and symbolic representations, conserves resources and decreases latency. The global model can then be used as a model to determine a likelihood of a course of action being successful for an organization. For example, the course of action can be a purchase of a security or a business operation strategy. In another example, the course of action can be a type of medical treatment for a patient.

title: Systems and methods for control-data plane partitioning in virtual distributed ledger networks
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for control-data plane partitioning in virtual distributed ledger networks. In one embodiment, a processor-implemented method is disclosed, comprising receiving a request for a microservice at a virtual distributed ledger technology node associated with a virtual distributed ledger technology network; identifying operations on user data to be performed related to the request for the microservice; retrieving the user data from a data storage memory external to the virtual distributed ledger technology network; performing the identified operations on the user data; executing the microservice based on performing the identified operations on the user data, to generate user data and control information; storing the generated user data in the data storage memory external to the virtual distributed ledger technology network; and committing the generated control information to a distributed ledger associated with the virtual distributed ledger technology network.

title: Segmentation of target areas in images
abstract: An input image that includes a target area may be received. A first segment for extracting the target area from the input image may be generated using a first extracting model. A second segment for extracting the target area from the input image may be generated using a second extracting model. The first segment is compared to the second segment to determine a combined segment of at least the target area.

title: Endoscope and endoscope sheath with diagnostic and therapeutic interfaces
abstract: A removable and replaceable sheath may be coupled to a medical instrument used during a procedure, and may enable one or more functional features of the medical instrument while maintaining a sterile barrier between the instrument itself and the treatment site. The sheath may be replaced prior to a subsequent use, and sterilization of the medical instrument is not required due to the sterile barrier. Sheaths may include an embedded memory that stores procedure configurations and procedure results, longitudinal channels for delivering power or irrigation, optical elements for providing procedure specific endoscopic views, and other features. One sheath may be fitted to an endoscope for imaging and tissue ablation. Another sheath includes a balloon usable during sinuplasty procedures. Yet another sheath may be fitted to a sonic ablation instrument to provide improved transmission of sonic power to tissue.

title: Image detection method, image detection device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image detection method, an image detection device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: performing image segmentation on a medical image of an object to be detected by adopting a segmentation model, and determining a target segmentation image; judging whether a region of interest exists in the target segmentation image; if so, performing a gating operation on the medical image. The region of interest obtained by the method is more accurate.

title: Super-resolution processing method for amplifying medical image by any multiple
abstract: The invention provides a super-resolution processing method for amplifying any multiple of a medical image, which adopts a gradient operator and morphological operation to detect a tissue region, wherein the gradient operator can detect a position with larger gray value change, the opening operation in morphology can remove tiny connection and isolated points, the influence of noise and bubbles is reduced, and the expansion operation can coarsen an object. The method improves the detection speed of the tissue region, realizes quick positioning and ensures the detection precision.

title: Blood vessel CTA intelligent analysis system and application
assignee: 慧影医疗科技(北京)股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a blood vessel CTA intelligent analysis system and application, comprising: the acquisition module is used for acquiring blood vessel CTA image data to be analyzed; the automatic segmentation module is used for segmenting blood vessels in the CTA image data according to the CTA image data to obtain a segmentation result; the automatic straightening module is used for automatically straightening the blood vessel according to the segmentation result; and the automatic measurement module is used for automatically measuring the blood vessel after the straightening treatment so as to obtain a measurement result. Therefore, the intelligent analysis system provides the automatic analysis result for the user to refer to, so that the user can obtain more accurate treatment according to the automatic analysis result.

title: Detecting tumorous breast tissue in a thermal image
assignee: Xerox Corporation, Krithika Venkataramani, Niramai Health Analytix Pvt. Ltd.
abstract: What is disclosed is a system and method for detecting cancerous tissue in breast tissue using a thermal image. In one embodiment, the present tumor detection method involves selecting a region of interest in the thermal image to be processed for breast cancer screening. Thereafter, a percentage of pixels p1 in the selected region having a temperature T1 pixel, where T1 <= T1 pixel <= - T2 is determined. A percentage of pixels p2 in the selected region having a temperature T2 pixel, where T3 <= T2 pixel, is determined. A ratio p3 = P edge / P block is also determined, where P edge is a number of pixels around a border of a suspected tumor within the selected region, and P block is a number of pixels in a perimeter of the selected region. A decision fusion rule R, as more fully disclosed herein, is utilized to determine, based on these determination whether tissue within that region is cancerous, or non-cancerous, or is suspicious of being cancerous.

title: Method and device for predicting insect vector infectious disease transmission risk, electronic equipment and medium
assignee: 中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium for predicting the transmission risk of an insect-borne infectious disease. The invention relates to the technical field of infectious disease transmission risk prediction, which comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of influence variables influencing disease transmission in a target area, and determining a first prediction model corresponding to each influence variable; predicting the transmission risk of the arborescent infectious disease based on each first prediction model respectively, and determining the transmission risk prediction accuracy corresponding to each influence variable based on the transmission risk prediction result of each first prediction model; determining correlations between the plurality of influencing variables, and determining at least one target variable from the plurality of influencing variables based on the prediction accuracy and the correlations; and determining a target risk prediction model based on the target variable so as to predict the insect-borne infectious disease transmission risk of the area to be predicted. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention realizes the prediction of the transmission risk of the infectious diseases on a fine spatial scale.
