title: 3D visualization enhancement for depth perception and collision avoidance
abstract: A series of images is obtained from an endoscope. Three-dimensional reconstruction is performed on the series of images to reconstruct anatomy shown in the series of images. A graphic, such as a grid, is rendered based on the three-dimensional reconstruction, over the series of images resulting in an enhanced endoscopic video feed to be shown on a display.

title: Pulmonary nodule auxiliary diagnosis system based on countermeasure network and fast R-CNN
abstract: A pulmonary nodule auxiliary diagnosis system based on an antagonistic network and fast R-CNN belongs to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises: the method comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring CT image data of a lung of a patient, a lung parenchyma segmentation module for segmenting to obtain complete lung parenchyma, a lung nodule detection network constructed based on a deep learning model, and a lung parenchyma segmentation image input into the lung nodule detection network for nodule detection and identification; and the intelligent analysis module is used for automatically determining qualitative and quantitative data of the lung nodules, displaying the qualitative and quantitative data to a user, and finally giving a picture-text diagnosis report to assist a doctor in diagnosis. The invention can accurately detect and diagnose the tiny pulmonary nodules, can solve the reading problem more quickly, accurately and scientifically for doctors, and provides imaging support for clinical assistant decision-making of lung cancer.

title: Machine learning knowledge management based on lifelong boosting in presence of less data
abstract: A method for lifelong machine learning using boosting includes receiving a new task and a learning sample for the new task. A distribution of weights is learned over the learning sample using previously learned classifiers from old tasks. A set of task-specific classifiers are learned for the new task using a boosting algorithm and the distribution of weights over the learning sample, whereby the distribution of weights over the learning sample is updated using the task-specific classifiers for the new task.

title: Telemedicine system, telemedicine doctor resource allocation method, and storage medium
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司, 泰康健康产业投资控股有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a telemedicine system, a telemedicine doctor resource allocation method, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The telemedicine system includes: the first terminal is used for receiving the symptom description, the real-time physical sign data and the medical consultation request of the user and uploading the symptom description, the real-time physical sign data and the medical consultation request to the server; the second terminal is used for displaying the historical consultation data and the real-time physical sign data of the user, receiving a diagnosis result input by a doctor, sending the diagnosis result to a server, and receiving a reserved return visit operation of the doctor; a server, comprising: the portrait module is used for obtaining doctor portrait data and user portrait data; the prediction module is used for predicting the number of the medical consultation requests in a first preset time period; and the distribution module is used for realizing the distribution of the doctors according to the doctor portrait data, the user portrait data and the prediction data obtained by the prediction module. The present disclosure may enable reasonable assignment of doctors.
assignee_clean: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司; 泰康健康产业投资控股有限公司

title: Identifying duplicate entities
abstract: The disclosed embodiments provide a system that identifies duplicate entities. During operation, the system selects training data for a first machine learning model based on confidence scores representing likelihoods that pairs of entities in an online system are duplicates. Next, the system updates parameters of the first machine learning model based on features and labels in the training data. The system then identifies a first subset of additional pairs of the entities as duplicate entities based on scores generated by the first machine learning model from values of the features for the additional pairs and a first threshold associated with the scores. The system also determines a canonical entity in each of the duplicate entities based on additional features. Finally, the system updates content outputted in a user interface of the online system based on the identified first subset of the additional pairs.

title: Entity pyramid embeddings
abstract: The disclosed embodiments provide a system for processing data. During operation, the system performs processing related to a first set of features for a first entity using a first series of embedding layers, wherein the processing includes applying each embedding layer in the first series of embedding layers to a concatenation of all outputs of one or more layers preceding the embedding layer. Next, the system obtains a first embedding as an output of a first final layer in the first series of embedding layers. The system then outputs the first embedding for use by a machine learning model.

title: Deep learning allergen mapping
abstract: An entry on an allergen map may be generated by a computer system where a deep learning model is trained using online content data. Allergen content data which contains geographic data may be detected from the online content data. The allergen content data may be analyzed by the computer system and tagged with a quality and intensity indicator. Based on the tagging and the geographic location, an allergen map may be generated.

title: Generation of product mesh and product dimensions from user image data using deep learning networks
abstract: The present invention provides systems and methods for generating a 3D product mesh model and product dimensions from user images. The system is configured to receive one or more images of a user's body part, extract a body part mesh having a plurality of body part key points, generate a product mesh from an identified subset of the body part mesh, and generate one or more product dimensions in response to the selection of one or more key points from the product mesh. The system may output the product mesh, the product dimensions, or a manufacturing template of the product. In some embodiments, the system uses one or more machine learning modules to generate the body part mesh, identify the subset of the body part mesh, generate the product mesh, select the one or more key points, and/or generate the one or more product dimensions.

title: Server and information processing method
assignee: 日商威亞視股份有限公司
abstract:
A server has an access unit, a receiving unit and a sending unit. The access unit accesses a database storing a 3D data set for a plurality of target. The 3D data set for a plurality of target includes 3D modeling data and attachment data. The 3D modeling data include a plurality of element. The receiving unit receives an API request from information processing device. The API request includes request information for specifying an element from target used and a plurality of element used. The sending unit sends 3D model data for outputting as an API response to the API request to the information processing device. The 3D model data for outputting are extracted from 
the database and represented by 3D modeling data consisted of elements specified. The 3D model data for outputting are targets specified by the request information.

title: Presenting event intelligence and trends tailored per geographic area granularity
abstract: The present invention extends to methods, systems, and computer program products for presenting event intelligence and trends tailored per geographic area granularity. Event related data can be combined with information from other domains to enable intelligent decision making within those domains. Responsive to user commands, graphical presentation can be tailored to a geographic granularity and can vary between geographic granularities. Event related information and other information for a defined area as well as adjacent areas can be at least partially summarized based on geographic granularity. At least partially summarizing data for currently presented areas as well as adjacent areas reduces resource consumption when moving between presented areas, for example, in a map. The level of summarization can be a tailored to a selected geographic granularity. As such, overall presented graphical data (e.g., total number of icons) can be relatively stable, and possibly tuned to available computing resources.

title: Electronic device and screen refresh method thereof
abstract: An electronic device may include a display, and a processor operatively connected to the display. The processor is configured to identify a frame rate of a first application that is currently being executed. The processor is also configured to, based on the frame rate, determine a scanning rate of the display and a frame refresh rate for refreshing a frame related to the first application. The processor is further configured to control a first screen refresh of the first application, based on the scanning rate and the frame refresh rate.

title: Systems and methods for providing personalized targeted non-invasive stimulation to a brain network
abstract: Disclosed herein are devices, systems, and methods for ameliorating or treating or preventing Alzheimer's Disease and related dementias. Methods may include using individual patients' data to identify the optimal treatment target(s) as well as the stimulation intensity, frequency, or waveform, or any combination thereof, for transcranial electromagnetic induction delivered via a device as in the case of Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation. Systems and methods include a platform or infrastructure for treatment delivery and data processing. In some embodiments, methods are applied to restore cognitive function, ameliorate clinical symptoms, modify altered mechanisms of plasticity, modulate cortical excitability and reactivity, or induce changes in local brain metabolism.

title: WSN anti-interference method, device, equipment and medium based on reinforcement learning
assignee: 中国科学院上海高等研究院, 中国科学院大学
abstract: The method, the device, the equipment and the medium for resisting the WSN based on the reinforcement learning are characterized in that an initial frequency hopping sequence is preset; initializing weights and bias in a preset neural network model, and defining parameters of a reinforcement learning method; enabling all nodes in the WSN network to be tested to transmit or receive test data according to the initial frequency hopping sequence, and acquiring observation values corresponding to transmission conditions of all the nodes; and updating the weight, the parameters and the parameters by adopting a random gradient descent method and a reverse transfer algorithm according to the observed values, adjusting the initial frequency hopping sequence according to the updated weight, parameters and parameters, and repeating the previous step until a stable final frequency hopping sequence corresponding to the WSN network to be detected is obtained. The method and the device can gradually learn the optimal frequency hopping sequence for avoiding the channel with strong interference in the environment according to the interference condition of the nodes in the wireless sensor network, achieve the anti-interference effect, and simultaneously transmit the information of the source node to the target node in the shortest time, and ensure the transmission reliability.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院上海高等研究院; 中国科学院大学

title: Systems and methods for assessing a likelihood of CTEPH and identifying characteristics indicative thereof
abstract: Described are systems and methods for assessing a likelihood of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH) within a subject patient based upon an analysis of characteristics indicative of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension within an imaging study of the subject patient. The systems and methods can identify characteristics of one or more anatomical structures within a cardiac region of the subject patient indicative of CTEPH, characteristics of a pulmonary vasculature of the subject patient indicative of CTEPH, and characteristics of a chronic abnormality in a lung of the subject patient indicative of CTEPH. The systems and methods can assess these characteristics to compute the likelihood of CTEPH within the subject patient.

title: Method and system for providing feedback on label information
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for providing feedback on label information, which is performed by at least one computing device. The method may comprise the steps of: acquiring label information on objective data; training a machine learning model by using the objective data and the label information; calculating at least one numerical value among numerical values related to training and performance of the trained machine learning model; and providing the feedback on the label information on the basis of the calculated at least one numerical value.

title: System, method, and computer program product for operating dynamic shadow testing environments
abstract: Described are a system, method, and computer program product for operating dynamic shadow testing environments for machine-learning models. The method includes storing a testing policy including an identifier of a machine-learning model and an identifier of a transaction service. The method includes generating a shadow testing environment operating the transaction service using the machine-learning model. The method also includes receiving, at a transaction service provider system, a transaction authorization request including transaction data of a transaction associated with a payment device. The method further includes identifying the machine-learning model associated with the transaction based on a parameter of the transaction data. The method further includes determining, based on the identifier of the machine-learning model, the testing policy and the shadow testing environment. The method further includes replicating the transaction data in the shadow testing environment as input for testing the transaction service using the machine-learning model.

title: Location-based risk alerts
abstract:
A location-based risk alerting system is disclosed. When information regarding a 
risk assessment situation is received, the location and time attributes of the risk assessment 
situation are extracted, a risk score is calculated and a risk alert is generated to include the 
attributes and the risk score upon validating the received information for risk. The risk alert 
is transmitted to client devices of subscribers where a user-specific risk score is calculated 
at each client device based on a comparison of the distance of the client device from the 
location attribute and the time at which the risk alert is received with the time attribute. The 
risk alert is displayed at the client device based on the user-specific risk score and 
information regarding the user is shared with trusted authorities upon receiving user consent.

title: Plaque parting method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
assignee: 南京景三医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a plaque typing method, a plaque typing device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image containing carotid artery blood vessels to be classified at a position to be detected; extracting carotid artery blood vessel regions to be classified and plaque component regions in each carotid artery blood vessel region to be classified from the medical image; acquiring position characteristic information of a medical image; determining second position information of the corresponding carotid artery blood vessel to be classified relative to the human body according to the position characteristic information and the carotid artery blood vessel region to be classified; and determining the plaque classification of the carotid artery blood vessel to be classified at each position to be classified according to the plaque component area corresponding to each carotid artery blood vessel to be classified and the second position information. By implementing the method, the obtained plaque typing result is the typing result of the carotid artery blood vessel at each position, so that the indication of a specific direction can be given when the unstable plaque is confirmed, and the guiding value of medical treatment is improved.
assignee_clean: 南京景三医疗科技有限公司

title: Autonomous application of security measures to IoT devices
abstract: Methods and systems for classifying a device on a network. The systems and methods may receive network activity data associated with an unknown device. A classifier executing one or more machine learning models may then classify the device as an internet of things (IoT) device or a non-IoT device.

title: Method and system for refining label information
abstract: A method for refining label information, which is performed by at least one computing device is disclosed. The method includes acquiring a pathology slide image including a plurality of patches, inferring a plurality of label information items for the plurality of patches included in the acquired pathology slide image using a machine learning model, applying the inferred plurality of label information items to the pathology slide image, and providing the pathology slide image applied with the inferred plurality of label information items to an annotator terminal.

title: Estimating power consumption of different types of radio access technologies
abstract: Estimating power consumption of different types of radio access technologies is disclosed. A method comprising: determining a type of radio access technology supported by a device, wherein the device supports at least two types of radio access technologies; providing input to a machine learning model, wherein the machine learning model includes a corresponding machine learning model for each type of radio access technology, and for each type of radio access technology, parameters associated with that type of radio access technology are provided as input to the corresponding machine learning model; and for each type of radio access technology, obtaining a power consumption estimate provided by a corresponding machine learning model.

title: Apparatus and methods for mapping user-associated data to an identifier
abstract: An apparatus and method for mapping user-associated data to an identifier. The apparatus includes a processor configured to store a plurality of user identifiers. User identifiers may be determined by way of user or by machine-learning modules or the like. Apparatus receives user-associated data from a user to be stored in a resource data storage system. User-associated data may include a plurality of data sets to be mapped to an identifier. Mapping a data set to an identifier may be user determined or use a machine-learning module. Apparatus is configured to update the immutable sequential listing associated with the data set with the mapped identifier.

title: Method and device for establishing brain focus detection model and computer equipment
assignee: 清华大学, 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application provides a method and a device for establishing a brain focus detection model, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of simultaneously training a Natural Language Processing (NLP) model and a convolution model by using small-scale labeled data and adopting a cooperative training mode, selecting partial data from the residual unlabeled data set by using the NLP model and the convolution model in each iteration, updating the partial data to a training set, continuing training, and further taking the trained convolution model as a brain lesion detection model. Therefore, the method for realizing the automatic detection of the brain CT focus by using the matched CT image and the text information in the report to carry out the collaborative training; when the module is trained, only a small amount of data labels are needed, large-scale data can be trained, and the data labeling workload in the deep learning process is greatly saved.
assignee_clean: 清华大学; 中国人民解放军总医院

title: Medical image classification method based on partial average stochastic optimization model
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image classification method based on a partial mean random optimization model, which comprises the following steps: 1. constructing a data set by using the existing medical image processing technology; 2. defining an objective function of the problem; 3. defining a loss function of the problem; 4. initializing relevant parameters involved in the classification algorithm, including: iteration number T, polynomial attenuation average parameter rho and cost sensitivity coefficient Cp,Cn. 5. Carrying out iterative solution on the target function by utilizing a COMID framework to obtain a classification model; 6. and classifying the sample by using a classification model. The invention can improve the classification precision, obtain better classification results under specific scenes (large scale, unbalance and sparseness), and obtain the optimal convergence rate of O (1/T).

title: Method for medical diagnosis by using neural network
abstract: One embodiment of the present disclosure discloses a computer program stored in a computer readable storage medium. When the computer program is executed on one or more processors, the following operations are performed for performing medical diagnosis using a neural network, and the operations include: acquiring a medical image by inputting a medical image generation variable into a training data generation model for generating a training data set used for training a fracture diagnosis model; inputting at least one of the generated medical image or the actual medical image into a discrimination model to obtain a fracture similarity; updating the training data generation model based on the fracture similarity; and generating a training data set used for training a fracture diagnosis model by using the updated training data generation model.

title: Product recommendation method based on voice recognition and related equipment
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a product recommendation method based on voice recognition and related equipment, and relates to the field of machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a response voice of a user to a preset problem about a target product; extracting voice characteristic parameters of the response voice; determining a label of a target product of the user based on an acoustic model and the response voice; determining the gender and age range of the user by using a GMM-UBM model based on a MAP algorithm and combining the voice characteristic parameters; recommending products to the user based on the label of the target product of the user and the gender and age range of the user. The method improves the precision of recommending products.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Retina OCT image classification method based on wavelet transformation and migration learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and medical image processing, and discloses a retina OCT (optical coherence tomography) image classification method based on wavelet transformation and transfer learning, which comprises the following steps: performing wavelet transformation on the retina OCT image to obtain four sub-bands of a low-frequency detail component, a horizontal detail component, a vertical detail component and a diagonal detail component; extracting sub-band features of the images of the four sub-bands based on transfer learning; and carrying out cascading and feature fusion on the extracted features of the four sub-band images, and then inputting the features after cascading and feature fusion into a random forest as a training set to carry out training, classification and prediction results. The invention fully utilizes the original information of the retina OCT image, reduces training parameters to a certain extent, accelerates operation, and improves the accuracy of final classification prediction.

title: Automatic auditory neuroma image segmentation method and system
abstract: The invention provides an auditory neuroma image automatic segmentation method and system, which utilize a pre-trained auditory neuroma image automatic segmentation model to automatically segment an acquired nuclear magnetic resonance image of an auditory neuroma patient to obtain a segmentation result, wherein the auditory neuroma image automatic segmentation model adopts a cascade structure of a preprocessing network and a segmentation network. According to the embodiment of the invention, the segmentation performance of the model is improved by constructing the preprocessing network aiming at improving the segmentation performance of the model, the limitation of a single Unet segmentation model is broken through, the current optimal automatic segmentation model of the auditory neuroma image is obtained, the automatic segmentation of the auditory neuroma image can be realized at a higher speed, and the segmentation efficiency of the auditory neuroma image is greatly improved.

title: Intelligent auxiliary diagnosis system for fundus laser surgery
assignee: 南京博视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary diagnosis system and method for fundus laser surgery, which comprises a laser image stabilizing and treating device (1), a data control device (2), an image display device (3) and a data processing device (4), wherein a first database (41) of the system stores fundus image data; disease characteristic data in the fundus images are extracted through a characteristic extraction module (42), a data analysis matching module (45) is used for carrying out comparison operation, the disease characteristic data are matched with disease characteristic data stored in a known case characteristic template base (44), the matching operation result is stored in a second database (43), if the matching degree exceeds a set threshold value, a corresponding auxiliary diagnosis conclusion is given, and then an auxiliary diagnosis report is generated through a diagnosis report generation module (46). By adopting the invention, the misdiagnosis rate can be reduced, the diagnosis and operation process of a clinician can be further simplified, the diagnosis efficiency is improved while the operation treatment precision is ensured, and the risk of laser operation treatment is reduced.
assignee_clean: 南京博视医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 南京博视医疗科技有限公司

title: Image processing model generation method, image processing method and device, and electronic device
assignee: Beijing Boe Technology Development Co., Ltd., Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.
abstract: An image processing model generation method includes: inputting at least one training sample lesion image into an initial image processing model, the initial image processing model including a classification layer and a marking layer; calling the classification layer; calling the marking layer; obtaining a loss value of the at least one training sample lesion image in the initial image processing model; determining whether the loss value is within a preset range; if not, updating parameters of the initial image processing model, an image processing model with updated parameters being used as an initial image processing model in next training; and repeating above steps until the loss value is within the preset range.
assignee_clean: beijing boe technology development; boe technology group

title: Plaque segmentation method, plaque segmentation device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a plaque segmentation method, a plaque segmentation device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target coronary arteries comprising a plurality of reference image blocks, respectively carrying out coronary plaque detection on each reference image block in the target coronary arteries through a preset plaque detection network to obtain candidate reference image blocks, and inputting the obtained candidate reference image blocks into a preset plaque segmentation network to obtain coronary plaque segmentation results of the candidate reference image blocks. The method can improve the recognition rate of coronary plaque detection, can divide the edge details of the coronary plaque more accurately, and can realize rapid and accurate division of the coronary plaque in each candidate reference image block.
assignee_clean: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Fracture detection method based on complete fusion integrated network candidate frame
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image detection, and particularly relates to a fracture detection method based on a complete fusion integrated network candidate frame. Aiming at the problems that during fracture detection, a network model generates a large amount of false positive predictions due to gray level similarity among bones, the detection effect is poor and the like, the invention provides an integrated target detection network (ED-Net) to improve the fracture detection result, designs a brand new weighted fusion candidate frame algorithm (CBF) to eliminate a large amount of redundant frames, obtains a fracture candidate frame with more accurate positioning and more accurate confidence coefficient, and meanwhile, combines with Unet to divide the candidate frame, thereby further improving the fracture detection effect. The invention has the characteristics of simple and accurate implementation, and the cascade ED-Net, CBF and Unet modules effectively solve the problems, thereby well improving the detection effect of the fracture.

title: Identifying optimum times at which to retrain a logistic regression model
abstract: An approach is provided in which a knowledge manager trains a machine-learning model and generates a hyperplane based upon a first set of labeled feature vectors. The knowledge manager computes, relative to the hyperplane, a first distribution of a first set of feature vectors corresponding to a first set of source documents. Subsequently, the knowledge manager computes, relative to the hyperplane, a second distribution of a second set of feature vectors corresponding to a second group of source documents. The knowledge manager, in turn, generates an indicator to retrain the machine-learning model in response to determining that a distribution difference between the second distribution and the first distribution reaches a distribution difference threshold.

title: Storage device and operating method of storage controller
abstract: A storage device and an operating method thereof are provided. The storage device includes a non-volatile memory and a storage controller. The storage controller includes a command and address generator, an error detection module, and an interface circuit. The command and address generator generates a first command, an address, and a second command, the second command including an error detection signal for detecting a communication error in the first command and the address. The error detection module generates the error detection signal from the first command and the address. The interface circuit sequentially transmits the first command, the address, and the second command to the non-volatile memory. The first command indicates a type of a memory operation to be performed in the non-volatile memory, and the second command corresponds to a confirm command.

title: System, method, and computer program product for implementing a generative adversarial network to determine activations
abstract: Provided is a computer-implemented method for generating a machine learning model to classify an account based on merchant activation, including providing an input to a generator network of a generative adversarial network (GAN) to generate an output; providing the output as input to a discriminator network; providing a training dataset as input to the discriminator network; and updating the generator network based on a first output of the discriminator network having a label that indicates whether a set of values of each of the plurality of features is a real set of values or a fake set of values. The method may include updating the discriminator network based on a second output of the discriminator network having a label that indicates whether a selected account of the plurality of accounts is going to conduct a first payment transaction. A system and computer program product are also provided.

title: Data analytics system to automatically recommend risk mitigation strategies for an enterprise
abstract: A data analytics system may include a first risk relationship data store containing electronic records that represent a plurality of risk relationships between the enterprise and a first risk relationship provider. Similarly, a second risk relationship data store containing electronic records that represent a plurality of risk relationships between the enterprise and a second risk relationship provider. A back-end application computer server may include a data mining engine that analyzes a set of electronic records in the first and second risk relationship data stores to identify flags corresponding to risk drivers. A predictive analytics engine may then calculate a risk score associated with the set of electronic records based on the associated entity attribute values and the identified flags corresponding to risk drivers. An insight platform may automatically generate a recommended action for the enterprise to lower the calculated risk score.

title: Iterative deepening knowledge discovery using closure-based question answering
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for question answering using context features in closure form. The mechanism receives a function call comprising an input question and a set of non-local context evidence in closure form. The mechanism decomposes the input question into one or more queries and applies the one or more queries to a corpus of information to obtain a set of local hypothesis evidence. The mechanism generates hypotheses for answering the input question based on the local hypothesis evidence and the set of non-local context evidence.

title: Security surveillance and entry management system
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) entry management (EM) security system includes a camera, a microphone, a motion detector, a speaker, and a software platform. Geofences are utilized to create boundaries around physical areas, such as locations for package delivery or property boundaries. The EM device and other devices connected to the software platform are configured to monitor the geofences and detect a presence of an activity, an event, an object, or a device. At least one license plate reader is utilized to read license plate characters. Voice recognition and voice identification are used to grant or deny permissions for individuals on a property.

title: Intelligent diagnosis recommendation method and system based on multi-objective optimization
assignee: 北京南师信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent diagnosis recommendation method and system based on multi-objective optimization, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting historical consultation problems and historical consultation recommendation information from the consultation file information, classifying the characteristics of the historical consultation problems based on the consultation knowledge graph, training the classified consultation characteristic information and the classified historical consultation recommendation information through a deep learning network structure, and generating a consultation recommendation network model; determining an optimization recommendation sedimentation logic according to the target optimization dimension; optimizing and updating the diagnosis recommendation network model based on the optimizing and recommending sedimentation logic to generate a diagnosis optimizing and recommending network model; and carrying out diagnosis recommendation on the diagnosis consultation information of the target user based on the diagnosis optimization recommendation network model. The intelligent diagnosis recommendation is realized by generating the diagnosis optimization recommendation network model through multi-objective optimization, the accuracy of the diagnosis recommendation result is improved, and the technical effect of the patient diagnosis effect is further ensured.
assignee_clean: 北京南师信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京南师信息技术有限公司

title: Indirect bio-feedback health and fitness management system
abstract: A health and fitness management system that employs an algorithm to determine suggested recommended actions for a user to improve their health and fitness. The system obtains a user's health indicating measurement from a respective acquisition device. The user is never informed of the acquired data. The health indicating measurement can include a heart/pulse rate, blood pressure measurement, weight, etc. Base line data (age, ideal age, initial weight, current weight, ideal weight, etc.) can be considered in the algorithm. Examples include the user's environment, sleep habits, exercise routines, medical records, and the like. The health index number is used to determine recommended actions, which can include changes to environments, routines, activities, etc. Data collection, the algorithm, and other features of the system can be provided by an Application operating on a portable computing device. Features of the portable computing device can be employed to automatically acquire data for the algorithm.

Features of the portable computing device can be employed to automatically acquire data for the algorithm.

title: Automatic exposure control method for X-ray imaging, storage medium and medical device
abstract: In an automatic exposure control method for X-ray imaging, a visible light image of a subject under test is acquired, an initial region of interest (ROI) is defined on the visible light image, the subject under test is pre-exposed with a set pre-exposure dose to obtain a first image, an ROI on the first image is defined based on the initial ROI, a reference pixel value is defined based on the ROI, and a main exposure dose for an actual exposure is calculated according to the reference pixel value. With the imaging quality guaranteed, a physical automatic exposure control (AEC) chamber may be omitted, and the number, positions and sizes of ROIs can be adjusted according to the actual requirements.

title: 3D ventricular nuclear magnetic resonance video segmentation optimization system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a 3D ventricular nuclear magnetic resonance video segmentation optimization system based on depth learning, which acquires high-dimensional image features in an MRI video segment through a depth space-time deformable convolution fusion module TDAM; the feature images with different scales are fused by utilizing space-time information in the high-dimensional image features obtained by the enhanced deformable convolution attention network TDAM, and then feature images with multi-scale information are output; obtaining the distribution of the high-dimensional image features through a probability noise correction module PNCM, and outputting an embedded vector containing distribution mean and variance information; and performing splicing convolution on the feature map output by EDAN and the embedded vector output by PNCM after expanding to obtain a prediction result. The training network model is utilized to directly segment the newly input 3D ventricular MRI video, and the accuracy and efficiency of ventricular segmentation can be effectively improved by introducing multi-frame image compensation, deformable convolution and a multi-scale attention mechanism, and the method has higher robustness.

title: Surveillance camera upgrade via removable media having deep learning accelerator and random access memory
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods related to a deep learning accelerator and memory are described. For example, a removable media (e.g., a memory card, or a USB drive) may be configured to execute instructions with matrix operands and configured with: an interface to receive a video stream; and random access memory to buffer a portion of the video stream as an input to an artificial neural network and to store instructions executable by the deep learning accelerator and matrices of the artificial neural network. Such a removable media can be used to replace an existing removable media used in a surveillance camera to record video or images. The deep learning accelerator can execute the instructions to generate analytics of the buffer portion using the artificial neural network, enabling the surveillance camera that is upgraded via the use of the removable media to provide intelligent services based on the analytics.

title: Hospital building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on digital twins
abstract: The utility model provides a hospital building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on digital twin, relates to earthquake damage prediction technical field, lacks the problem that is used for the method of judging the building earthquake damage condition after the earthquake among the prior art, and this application can the quick prediction earthquake response result: a hospital finite element model is established based on Openses software, seismic motion is input to obtain seismic response data, 90% of the data is used as a training set and 10% of the data is used as a verification set in combination with a deep neural network, the intelligent prediction seismic response model is trained and verified, and when new seismic motion is input into the intelligent prediction seismic response model, a response result of a hospital building under the earthquake can be quickly given.

title: Combination device for tonometric measurement and drug administration to the eye
assignee: 卡尔蔡司医疗技术公司, 卡尔蔡司医疗技术股份公司
abstract: The proposed combination device combines any tonometric measurements with drug administration to administer glaucoma drug to the eye. Several technical concepts are presented and exemplary embodiments of rebound tonometry and insufflation tonometry are shown. However, other methods, such as Optical Coherence Elastography (OCE), may also be used. These solutions provide home care tonometers capable of administering glaucoma medications.

title: Pneumonia classification method, pneumonia classification device, pneumonia classification medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a pneumonia classification method, a classification device, a computer readable storage medium and an electronic device, wherein acquired pneumonia signs and clinical information of a detected person are input into a first neural network model, the type of pneumonia is automatically identified by the first neural network model, and the pathological characteristics such as the pneumonia signs and the like are considered and meanwhile the clinical information of the detected person is combined, so that the type of the pneumonia is more accurately identified, the pneumonia types can be automatically distinguished, the accuracy can be ensured, more accurate and refined type information is provided for subsequent treatment, and the subsequent treatment is more targeted and has more effects.
assignee_clean: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司

title: System and method for determining radiation parameters
abstract: A method includes positioning a patient at a first orientation relative to a radiation source. The method further includes using a 3D imaging technique to measure one or more positions of the patient's chest. The method further includes, while using the 3D imaging technique to measure the one or more positions of the patient's chest: generating a model of the patient's chest using the one or more positions of the patient's chest; updating the model of the patient's chest as the patient breathes; and exposing the patient to a dose of radiation using the radiation source, wherein the dose is based on the model of the patient's chest.

title: Gathering data in a communication system
abstract: A computer-implemented method comprising: outputting questions to a user via one or more user devices, and receiving back responses to some of the questions from the user via one or more user devices; over time, controlling the outputting of the questions so as to output the questions under circumstances of different values for each of one or more items of metadata, wherein the one or more items of metadata comprise at least a time and/or a location at which a question was output to the user via the one or more user devices; monitoring whether or not the user responds when the question is output with the different metadata values; training the machine learning algorithm to learn a value of each of the items of metadata which optimizes a reward function, and based thereon selecting a time and/or location at which to output subsequent questions.

title: Methods and systems useful in mapping heart rhythm abnormalities
abstract: A computer implemented method and system for identifying one or more areas of the heart muscle responsible for supporting or initiating abnormal heart rhythms using electrogram data recorded from a plurality of electrodes obtained from a corresponding series of sensing locations on the heart over a recording time period; the method including the steps of: setting a pre-defined geodesic distance, dividing the recording time period into several analysis time periods, and pairing each sensing location with a plurality of other sensing locations from within the defined geodesic distance, thus forming a plurality of location pairings; for each of the analysis time periods, defining the relative timing of each activation signal for each location within each pairing, determining whether the relative timing of activation signals falls within plausible biological parameters, defining the leading signal of the pair for each electrogram activation within the respective analysis time period; and assigning a series of lead signal scores to each electrogram pairing acquired within each analysis time period based on the proportion of time within the respective analysis time period that each activation signal is leading within each pairing; repeating the analysis at the same location at least once whilst varying the analysis time period; combining each analysis time period for each signal location to provide a statistical measure of the proportion that each signal location tends to lead relative to other locations within the defined geodesic area; and relating lead signal scores from overlapping geodesic areas to provide relative combined lead signal scores; to provide an indication of the relative likelihood that each sensing location is generally preceding other areas and is therefore at or adjacent to a driver area of the abnormal heart rhythm.

title: Vehicle risk aversion and reward system
assignee: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for identifying vehicle care that may reduce risk in fields not directly associated with a vehicle itself. One or more electronic sources may provide an indication of care (e.g., service, maintenance, or part configuration) of a vehicle by a user, and the vehicle care may be determined to be associated with a lowered risk for an entity (e.g., a home or business) operated by the same user in another field not associated with operation of the vehicle itself. In response, a user-specific reward may be generated and transmitted to the user, to further incentivize vehicle care and other risk averse behavior in the other field.

title: Sepsis patient condition assessment method and system based on multi-mode data fusion
assignee: 东莞市东南部中心医院(东莞市东南部中医医疗服务中心)
abstract: The invention provides a sepsis patient condition assessment method and system based on multi-mode data fusion, and relates to the technical field of condition assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode data, determining corresponding mode type nodes based on modes, determining corresponding mode association edges based on association relation of the multi-mode data, and constructing a heterogeneous multi-mode diagram; inputting the heterogeneous multi-modal graph into a multi-modal fusion network, aggregating the characteristics of the modal type nodes through a type perception attention mechanism and a cross-modal attention mechanism, constructing interaction among the modal type nodes, extracting and fusing the characteristic representation of multi-modal data, and obtaining a patient fusion modal representation; inputting the patient fusion mode representation into a multi-task illness state evaluation model, obtaining patient task perception representation through constructing an evaluation subtask, constructing an independent task tower, and generating a patient illness state evaluation result based on the patient task perception representation.
assignee_clean: 东莞市东南部中心医院 东莞市东南部中医医疗服务中心

title: Efficient factor analysis on large datasets using categorical variables
abstract: Methods and apparatus are disclosed for efficient factor analysis of a large population of data records, using factors that are categorical variables. Computation is balanced between extracting key factors by training a machine learning classifier on a reduced sample of data records, for computational efficiency, and scoring the categorical values of the key factors on the entire population, for accuracy of results. A joint factor is constructed by combining all proposed root factors, and the sample is generated by stratified sampling on the joint factor. The key factors are selected from candidate factors which can be combinations of the root factors. Original variables of a dataset, whether categorical or not, can be binned to obtain new categorical factors. Variations and user interfaces are also disclosed.

title: MRI tumor voxel detection method based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an MRI tumor voxel detection method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises five steps; firstly, building a double-path double-convolution kernel 3D CNN model frame based on an AlexNet model, wherein the upper path adopts a large convolution kernel to extract characteristics such as correlation between a focus area and peripheral tissues, and the lower path adopts a small convolution kernel to extract characteristics such as texture, size and the like of the focus area; the second step adds 1X 1 convolution kernel before the convolution layer of the frame to perform characteristic dimension reduction; training based on the constructed model, and expanding a sample of the original data set; fourthly, changing the CNN model into an FCN model; and fifthly, optimizing the pre-trained 3D FCN model on the expanded data to obtain a final MRI tumor voxel classification model. The method can effectively avoid information redundancy, greatly reduce the number of parameters, reduce the calculation cost and improve the classification precision on the basis of ensuring the comprehensiveness of feature extraction.

title: Systems and methods for image fusion
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system and method for image generation. The method may include obtaining a first image of a first modality representing a first region of a subject. The method may further include determining a second image of a second modality representing a second region of the subject based on the first image. The second region may include at least part of the first region of the subject. A slice direction of the first image may be the same as a slice direction of the second image. The method may further include generating a fused image by fusing the first image and the second image.

title: Event detection removing private information
abstract: The present invention extends to methods, systems, and computer program products for event detection removing private information. In one aspect, an event detection infrastructure determines that characteristics of multiple signals, when considered collectively, indicate an event of interest to one or more parties. In another aspect, an evaluation module determines that characteristics of one or more signals indicate a possible event of interest to one or more parties. A validator then determines that characteristics of one or more other signals validate the possible event as an actual event of interest to the one or more parties. Signal features can be used to compute probabilities of events occurring. A privacy infrastructure spans signal ingestion, event detection, and event notification and protects the integrity of private information.

title: 5G intelligent hospital basic data processing method and database platform
assignee: 湖南尚医康医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, in particular to a 5G intelligent hospital basic data processing method and a database platform. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring hospital basic data, analyzing the hospital basic data by utilizing JSON based on the hospital basic data, and generating API direct connection interface data; performing cross index verification by using a scene optimization processing formula based on the API direct connection interface data to generate task type distribution index data; performing distribution calculation by using a 5G network slice based on task type distribution index data to generate a management index data set; according to the invention, the hospital basic data is subjected to data processing, and the 5G network slicing technology is used for combining the artificial intelligent model to perform data processing on the hospital basic data, so that the network delay in the data processing is reduced, the processing efficiency of the hospital basic data is improved, and the bandwidth required by the data processing is reduced.
assignee_clean: 湖南尚医康医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 湖南尚医康医疗科技有限公司

title: Computer-implemented method, computer program, systems and x-ray facility for correction of x-ray image data with regard to noise effects
abstract: A computer-implemented method and system for providing a trained artificial intelligence determination algorithm for correcting x-ray image data with regard to noise effects, for example for scattered radiation correction of the x-ray image data. The determination algorithm, from input data comprising a recorded image dataset, determines a noise effect dataset describing the noise effects to be used for correction of the x-ray image dataset. A statistical physics model parameterized by model parameters is used to describe the noise effects. The model parameters are able to be determined at least in part using the determination algorithm including receiving of training datasets that include x-ray image sub datasets with assigned, known noise effect sub datasets and/or with at least one assigned, noise-free reference image sub dataset, training the determination algorithm using the training datasets, and providing the trained determination algorithm.

title: Disease probability decision method and system thereof
abstract: The invention provides a disease probability decision method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a test physiological index set, training the test physiological index set to obtain potential information of the test physiological index, acquiring a current physiological index set, and training the test physiological index set to obtain potential information of the current physiological index; modeling based on the potential information of the test physiological index and the potential information of the current physiological index by using a softmax classifier to obtain a disease probability model; and inputting the current physiological index into a disease probability model to obtain the disease probability. The invention can obtain the probability of chronic diseases in real time through the physiological index data acquired in real time, and provides an auxiliary basis for the decision of doctors.

title: Training and management of technicians in the service or repair of machines, devices, or systems
abstract: Examples related to facilitating the training, assessment, and dispatching of technicians to a customer location for at least the purpose of servicing or repairing machines, devices, or systems present at the customer location are presented. The technician can be selected for dispatch to the customer location by review of database information, including training information for the technician, among other things. While at the customer location, the technician can be provided with training information delivered via a training module, where such training material content can comprise written materials, photos, video, virtual assistance, remote assistance, games, or the like. The technician can generate videos or other collateral while at the customer location, which can be included for use in a library of training materials for subsequent use, or for other purposes. Various systems and processes for facilitating the selection, management and deployment of training materials for technicians are also provided herein.

title: Method and system for detecting cervical vertebra and spinal cord height signals
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting cervical vertebra and spinal cord height signals, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a cervical vertebra spinal cord image, and performing segmentation, validity verification and segmentation processing on the cervical vertebra spinal cord image to generate a plurality of candidate regions and numbers corresponding to the candidate regions; extracting the features of the candidate regions by a preset method to obtain a feature vector of each candidate region; classifying the feature vectors of each candidate region through an LDA algorithm, judging whether a cervical vertebra and spinal cord image has a spinal cord height signal according to a classification result, and if so, positioning the spinal cord height signal according to numbers corresponding to a plurality of candidate regions. The method effectively reduces misdiagnosis caused by mismatching of medical resources, avoids delaying the illness state of the patient, assists doctors in diagnosis and improves diagnosis and treatment efficiency.

title: Automated anatomic and regional location of disease features in colonoscopy videos
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of Michigan
abstract: A system for automatically analyzing a video recording of a colonoscopy includes a processor and memory storing instructions, which when executed by the processor, cause the processor to receive the video recording of the colonoscopy performed on the colon and detect informative frames in the video recording. A frame is informative if the clarity of the frame is above a threshold or if the frame includes clinically relevant information about the colon. The instructions cause the processor to generate scores indicating severity levels of a disease for a plurality of the informative frames, estimate locations of the plurality of the informative frames in the colon, and generate an output indicating a distribution of the scores over one or more segments of the colon by combining the scores generated for the plurality of the informative frames and the estimated locations of the plurality of the informative frames in the colon.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of michigan
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of michigan

title: Method, apparatus, system and computer readable storage medium for intracranial aneurysm identification detection
assignee: 杭州脉流科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a method, a device, a system and a computer readable storage medium for identifying and detecting intracranial aneurysms, wherein the method for identifying and detecting intracranial aneurysms comprises the following steps: sequentially receiving and labeling the original intracranial CTA images to obtain labeled image data; extracting boundary pixel points of the aneurysm in a three-dimensional space by using the marked image data, and distinguishing positive sample image blocks and negative sample image blocks of the image data according to the boundary pixel points, wherein the positive sample image blocks are areas where the aneurysm is located, and the negative sample image blocks are areas where the aneurysm is not located; and detecting intracranial aneurysms in the positive and negative sample image blocks by using the deep learning model, and outputting a detection result. The application utilizes the algorithm of the encoder and the decoder in the deep learning model to process the positive and negative sample image blocks simultaneously, thereby improving the detection rate of the small aneurysms; the method mainly uses a long-range jump connection algorithm introduced by a deep learning model, and is assisted by short-range jump connection introduced by the long-range jump connection algorithm, so that the problem of poor continuity between different layers is solved.
assignee_clean: 杭州脉流科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州脉流科技有限公司

title: Medical image iterative reconstruction method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a medical image iterative reconstruction method, a medical image iterative reconstruction device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial image; calculating Z-direction information of the initial image according to the initial image; obtaining regularization item parameters according to the Z-direction information of the initial image, and determining an objective function according to the regularization item parameter number; and carrying out iterative reconstruction according to the initial image and the objective function. According to the method, the regularization term can be dynamically adjusted according to the Z-direction information in the image volume, and the regularization term is dynamically adjusted to adapt to Z-direction values of different pixels, so that the aim of accelerating iterative reconstruction is fulfilled, image edge information can be effectively reserved, and artifacts at the image edge can be eliminated.

title: Alzheimer disease pre-judgment method based on 3D convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a pre-diagnosis method of Alzheimer's disease based on a 3D convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1: selecting a data set: selecting MRI and DTI image data by adopting an ADNI database; s2: data preprocessing: pre-processing the selected MRI and DTI image data; s3: the CNN-based DL method specifically comprises the following steps: 3D convolution; adopting a batch regularization technology and adopting a linear rectification function as an activation function; 3D pooling, S4: establishing a network architecture; s5: the method has the advantages that the performance evaluation is realized, the accuracy of diagnosis can be improved by adding DTI data, the DTI image data is acquired as MRI images, and the same parameters from the same system are obtained by scanning, so that the method has the characteristics of low cost, no wound and easiness in acquisition, and is easy to popularize in clinical application.

title: Radiation image diagnostic apparatus and medical image processing apparatus
abstract: According to one embodiment, a radiation image diagnostic apparatus includes a gantry and image reconstruction circuitry. The gantry images a subject with radiation over a plurality of phases and acquires a plurality of imaging data sets for the plurality of phases. The image reconstruction circuitry executes an iterative reconstruction for the plurality of imaging data set to generate a plurality of reconstruction images for the plurality of phases. The image reconstruction circuitry executes the iterative reconstruction using, as the initial image, the first reconstruction image obtained by executing the iterative reconstruction based on the imaging data set of the first phase, generating a second reconstruction image for the second phase different from the first phase.

title: XGBoost-based eye refraction correction multisource data automatic classification method
abstract: The invention relates to an XGBoost-based eye refraction correction multisource data automatic classification method, which utilizes a scheme of combining clinical experience of an ophthalmologist with a statistical strategy to select attribute features related to eye refraction data classification as the most original features used for training; based on the screened data, further performing feature screening according to the feature importance by using an XGBoost algorithm, and selecting relevant attribute features most relevant to the target; based on the selected training samples, each sample is given different weights in consideration of the problem of sample imbalance, corresponding early stop functions are set by avoiding training over-fitting, and the XGBoost model is trained to classify the samples. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of classification based on multi-source data, does not need manual intervention in the training process, shortens the training time and improves the training efficiency.

title: Protecting IOT devices by behavioural analysis of their file system
abstract: Techniques are provided to automatically generate and apply policy rules for IoT devices. Historical data associated with IoT behaviors is obtained, where the historical data describes the file systems and behavior trends for multiple different IoT devices. Groups of the IoT devices are generated by grouping together devices identified as being common with one another based on similarities between their identified behaviors. Policies are then automatically generated for each group, corresponding to the detected behavior trends. Each policy determines how to subsequently monitor any device categorized as belonging to that policy's group and also how to respond when a device is operating abnormally. After a device is characterized as belonging to a group, that device is monitored to determine whether it conforms with the group's policy. Optionally, mitigation operations may be performed when the device is non-conforming.

title: Computer implemented method and system for aiding mapping heart rhythm abnormalities
abstract: A computer implemented method and system are described that identify one or more regions of the heart responsible for supporting or initiating abnormal heart rhythms. Electrogram data is used that has been recorded from a plurality of electrodes on multipolar cardiac catheters obtained from a corresponding series of sensing locations on the heart over a recording time period. The method includes the steps of:

title: System and method for camera-based stress determination
abstract: A system and method for camera-based stress determination. The method includes: determining a plurality of regions-of-interest (ROIs) of a body part; determining a set of bitplanes in a captured image sequence for each ROI that represent HC changes using a trained machine learning model, the machine learning model trained with a hemoglobin concentration (HC) changes training set, the HC changes training set trained using bitplanes from previously captured image sequences of other human individuals as input and received cardiovascular data as targets; determining an HC change signal for each of the ROIs based on changes in the set of determined bitplanes; for each ROI, determining intervals between heartbeats based on peaks in the HC change signal; determining heart rate variability using the intervals between heartbeats; determining a stress level using at least one determination of a standard deviation of the heart rate variability; and outputting the stress level.

title: Noise and artifact eliminating method for medical energy spectrum CT image
abstract: The invention relates to the field of computed tomography, and aims to reduce the influence caused by beam hardening and random noise, output more accurate medical images and reduce the harm to human bodies. Therefore, the invention provides a method for eliminating noise and artifacts of a medical energy spectrum CT image, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a virtual phantom; step 2: simulating spectral CT imaging with a plurality of X-ray photons through a phantom; step 3: simulating spectral CT imaging with lower dose X-ray photons through the phantom; step 4: matching the reconstructed images; step5, training the convolutional neural network to finish training; step6 test network training effect. The invention is mainly applied to the design and manufacture occasions of medical CT equipment.

title: Depth model for arrhythmia classification, method and device using same
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application provides a depth model for arrhythmia classification, a method and a device for utilizing the model, wherein the depth model comprises the following steps: a characterization learning section and a sequence learning section; the characterization learning part is used for receiving the equal-length sequence analyzed by the original electrocardiosignal; the characterization learning part is constructed based on an MSCNN structure and is composed of two convolution block branches stacked in different scales; the convolution kernel of the branch is large in scale and is used for capturing low-frequency information of electrocardiosignals and outputting the low-frequency information in a multi-scale characteristic; the second convolution kernel of the branch is small in scale and is used for capturing high-frequency information of electrocardiosignals and outputting the high-frequency information in a multi-scale characteristic; splicing the multi-scale features output by the first branch and the multi-scale features output by the second branch to form multi-scale depth features which are used for being input into a sequence learning part; the sequence learning part is constructed based on a Seq-Seq network taking LSTM as a basic unit, and the Seq-Seq network is provided with an attention mechanism layer between an encoder and a decoder; its output is a time-series depth feature.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军总医院
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院

title: Data desensitization method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 百度在线网络技术（北京）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a data desensitizing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical fields of artificial intelligence, computer vision, deep learning and AI medical treatment. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: identifying text information of data to be processed and position information of the text information; performing sensitive named entity recognition on the text information through a named entity recognition model to obtain a model recognition result, and processing the model recognition result according to a preset rule to obtain a target sensitive named entity; and desensitizing the data to be processed according to the position information of the text information and the target sensitive named entity. The data desensitization can be accurately and efficiently carried out, sensitive data is prevented from being leaked, and a new idea is provided for the data desensitization.
