title: Chinese word segmentation and named entity recognition system for large-scale medical text mining
abstract: The invention provides a Chinese word segmentation and named entity recognition system for large-scale medical text mining, and relates to the technical field of data processing. Firstly, constructing a dictionary; performing an improved bidirectional maximum dictionary matching algorithm on the text based on a dictionary to obtain an ambiguity set in a text rough separation result; segmenting words again for the ambiguous set based on a CRF model; obtaining word vectors based on word2vec and the text after word segmentation, inputting the word vectors into a laminated BilSTM-CRF model, carrying out entity labeling on the word vectors through a first layer of the laminated BilSTM-CRF model, adding part-of-speech characteristics into the word vectors after the entity labeling to form an input feature set, and carrying out complex named entity recognition on the input feature set through a second layer of the laminated BilSTM-CRF model. The method effectively solves the problems that a CRF word segmentation based on a dictionary is provided, the automatic disambiguation is realized by using the CRF, the word segmentation effect of ambiguous words is improved, and the accuracy of the input word vector of the laminated BilSTM-CRF model is improved, so that the introduction of word segmentation errors is reduced, and the accuracy of named entity recognition is improved.

title: Prediction-based flow estimation for ultrasound diagnostic imaging
abstract: Flow estimation is provided. The flow is predicted. A mathematical, logic, machine learning or other model is used to predict flow. For example, the boundary conditions associated with a previous flow, the previous flow, and current boundary conditions are used to predict the current flow. The current flow is corrected using the predicted flow. Velocities may be unaliased based on the predicted flow. The predicted flow may replace the current flow. Prediction may additionally or alternatively be used in determination of lateral or elevational flow.

title: Photoelectric conversion apparatus, photoelectric conversion system, moving body
abstract: A photoelectric conversion apparatus includes a first substrate including a pixel array including a plurality of pixels, a second substrate layered on the first substrate and including an AD conversion portion including a plurality of AD conversion circuits configured to convert a signal output from the first substrate into a digital signal, wherein the second substrate further includes a plurality of signal processing units including a first signal processing unit and a second signal processing unit both configured to perform machine learning processing, wherein each of a plurality of sets includes a plurality of AD conversion circuits that differ between the plurality of sets, wherein the first signal processing unit is arranged to correspond to one of the plurality of sets, and wherein the second signal processing unit is arranged to correspond to another one of the plurality of sets.

title: Total knee joint replacement postoperative revision preoperative planning system based on deep learning
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention provides a deep learning-based preoperative planning method for revision after total knee joint replacement, which comprises the steps of inputting preoperative knee joint images into a deep learning model to obtain preoperative knee joint prosthesis images and preoperative joint line images; the preoperative joint line image is a preoperative knee joint image marked with a knee joint line; determining a specification model and a position of a first knee joint prosthesis based on the preoperative knee joint prosthesis image and the preoperative joint line image. The pre-operation planning method for the total knee joint replacement surgery based on the deep learning can accurately and quickly identify the position and the specification model of the first knee joint prosthesis, is short in measurement time and high in accuracy, so that the operation time is shortened, and more accurate pre-operation data support is provided for the knee joint revision surgery.
assignee_clean: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司; 张逸凌
primary_assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司

title: Method, medium, and system for generating synthetic data
abstract: Systems and methods for generating synthetic data are disclosed. A system may include one or more memory devices storing instructions and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions. The instructions may instruct the system to categorize consumer data based on a set of characteristics. The instructions may also instruct the system to receive a first request to generate a first synthetic dataset. The first request may specify a first requirement for at least one of the characteristics. The instructions may further instruct the system to retrieve, from the consumer data, a first subset of the consumer data satisfying the first requirement. The instructions may also instruct the system to provide the first subset of consumer data as input to a data model to generate the first synthetic dataset, and to provide the first synthetic dataset as training data to a machine-learning system.

title: Training a machine-learned model to detect low variance regions
abstract: Low variance detection training is described herein. In an example, annotated data can be determined based on sensor data received from a sensor associated with a vehicle. The annotated data can comprise an annotated low variance region and/or an annotated high variance region. The sensor data can be input into a model, and the model can determine an output comprising a high variance output and a low variance output. In an example, a difference between the annotated data and the output can be determined and one or more parameters associated with the model can be altered based at least in part on the difference. The model can be transmitted to a vehicle configured to be controlled by another output of the model.

title: Automatic segmentation method for organs at risk based on convolutional neural network
assignee: 众安信息技术服务有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic organ-at-risk segmentation method based on a convolutional neural network, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring patient CT image data and corresponding labeling data; s2: preprocessing the CT graphic data and the corresponding labeling data; s3: establishing a 3D convolutional neural network model, inputting a data block, and acquiring a prediction result image output by the model; s4: and optimizing the prediction result image output by the 3D convolutional neural network model. The method is only based on CT image data, the original data acquisition difficulty is small, the application range is wide, the automatic segmentation of organs at risk in the CT image can be realized, manual interference is not needed in the segmentation process, the segmentation efficiency and the segmentation result precision are effectively improved, the post-processing operation is increased, and the segmentation result is further optimized.
assignee_clean: 众安信息技术服务有限公司
primary_assignee: 众安信息技术服务有限公司

title: Epidemic situation investigation method and device based on artificial intelligence, electronic equipment and medium
assignee: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides an epidemic situation investigation method, device, electronic equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out stream analysis processing on video stream data containing a target user to obtain face characteristic data corresponding to the target user; performing face recognition according to the face feature data, and determining a user behavior track corresponding to the target user; determining a plurality of target track points based on the user behavior track; searching the plurality of target track points, and determining a target value corresponding to each target track point; determining a track risk value corresponding to the target user based on the target value corresponding to each target track point; determining a user disorder corresponding to the target user, and determining a disease risk value corresponding to the target user based on the disorder risk tree and the user disorder; and inputting the track risk value and the disease risk value into a semi-supervised learning model to obtain a risk label corresponding to the target user. The application improves the efficiency of epidemic situation investigation.
assignee_clean: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司

title: Cerebral apoplexy END risk prediction model building method and device, END risk prediction system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of data information processing, and aims to solve the technical problem of how to predict and evaluate early nerve function deterioration risks of patients suffering from ischemic cerebral apoplexy. Therefore, the invention provides a method and a device for establishing an early neural function deterioration risk prediction model of a cerebral apoplexy thrombolysis patient, a risk prediction system, electronic equipment and a medium. By collecting personal data of a stroke patient, the stroke patient comprising a patient suffering from early deterioration of neurological function and a patient not suffering from early deterioration of neurological function, wherein the personal data comprises trapezin 1, and/or brain hemoglobin; creating a dataset using the collected personal data; and establishing the early-stage nerve function deterioration risk prediction model by using the data set, and predicting the final recovery effect of the patient by inputting personal data information of the cerebral apoplexy patient into the risk prediction model to generate the output of clinical prediction. The invention can timely, accurately and effectively predict and evaluate the final recovery effect of the ischemic cerebral apoplexy patient, and provide targeted treatment and nursing intervention for the patient, thereby improving the prognosis of the patient.

title: Respiratory tract examination result interpretation system and method based on image recognition
assignee: 上海徒数科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a respiratory tract examination result interpretation system and a respiratory tract examination result interpretation method based on image recognition, wherein the respiratory tract examination result interpretation system comprises a computer, a microscope and an industrial camera, wherein software for performing respiratory tract examination result interpretation is installed in the computer, the microscope is used for acquiring samples for nine respiratory tract examinations, and the samples are amplified through the microscope to acquire cell images; the industrial camera is used for collecting the image amplified by the microscope so as to obtain a cell electronic image; the computer identifies and processes the electronic image through software, and finally judges and outputs the respiratory tract examination result. The invention is based on the software fully trained by adopting a large amount of original data, and can improve the accuracy and the processing efficiency of the interpretation of nine detection items of the respiratory tract. But also can greatly reduce the labor intensity of medical staff and improve the working efficiency.
assignee_clean: 上海徒数科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海徒数科技有限公司

title: Method and device for standardizing multi-source heterogeneous medical data
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for standardizing multi-source heterogeneous medical data, belonging to the technical field of data management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-source heterogeneous medical data mapping text based on original medical data, and generating a standardized model based on a standard term set and a text set to be mapped; according to the mapping result, manual marking is carried out, and an iterative upgrade standardized model is continuously optimized; and (3) successfully constructing an automatic standardization model and a term system of the multi-source medical data, wherein the term system comprises a basic term module and a disease term library. The invention can realize information communication and fusion of different medical institutions, different business processes and different storage modes, can greatly improve the defects of low manual standardization efficiency, poor accuracy and the like, can greatly reduce the difficulty of data management by standardizing data of terms, is favorable for realizing integration of multi-source medical data by an artificial intelligence method, and is favorable for the problem of medical information sharing.

title: Image identification method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image identification method, an image identification device, image identification equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring object category relation information, and acquiring an object category convolution matrix corresponding to the object category relation information through an image recognition model; acquiring an image sample, and extracting image characteristics of the image sample through an image recognition model; fusing the object class convolution matrix and the image characteristics to obtain fusion characteristics, and outputting at least two prediction probabilities corresponding to the fusion characteristics through an image recognition model; and respectively adjusting the object class convolution matrix and the image identification model according to at least two prediction probabilities, determining the adjusted image identification model as a target image identification model when the adjusted image identification model meets a model convergence condition, and determining the adjusted object class convolution matrix as a target object class convolution matrix. By the method and the device, the accuracy of identifying the object type of the image can be improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Preeclampsia biomarkers and related systems and methods
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods, kits, tests, and systems for detecting, predicting, monitoring, or ruling out preeclampsia in pregnant women. Also provided herein are novel diagnostic markers, methods of data analysis, assay formats, and kits employing such markers to improve one or more characteristics of a test for identifying or ruling out preeclampsia based on biomarkers from patient samples.

title: Data typing method and model for major infectious disease queue and electronic equipment
assignee: 重庆市公共卫生医疗救治中心
abstract: The application provides a data typing method, a typing model and electronic equipment for a great infectious disease queue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring multidimensional data of a major infectious disease, wherein the multidimensional data comprises numerical data, symbolic data and text data; performing data preparation processing on a data set corresponding to the multidimensional data to determine a plurality of importance characteristics; performing cluster analysis on the data set of the importance features by using a plurality of preset cluster models, and performing cluster effect evaluation on the plurality of obtained cluster results to determine a target cluster result from the plurality of cluster results; based on the target clustering result, performing T test, chi-square test and F test on all feature data of the data set, and typing the significance difference of the test result; and evaluating the parting result, if the parting result accords with expert consensus, determining that the current parting is effective, and if the parting result does not accord with expert consensus, determining that the current parting is ineffective, and re-parting.
assignee_clean: 重庆市公共卫生医疗救治中心
primary_assignee: 重庆市公共卫生医疗救治中心

title: Assessment-based opportunity exploration
abstract: The disclosed embodiments provide a system for processing data. During operation, the system obtains a first assessment result related to a first qualification of a candidate. Next, the system filters a set of opportunities based on a first comparison of the first assessment result with qualifications for the opportunities to produce a first subset of opportunities. The system then selects a second qualification associated with some or all of the first subset of opportunities to assess for the candidate. The system also filters the first subset of opportunities based on a second comparison of a second assessment result related to the second qualification of the candidate with additional qualifications for the first subset of opportunities to produce a second subset of opportunities. Finally, the system outputs recommendations related to applying to the second subset of opportunities by the candidate.

title: De-identification of electronic records
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: A system is provided for de-identifying electronic records. The system may be configured to tokenize an electronic record to produce a plurality of tokens including a first token. The system may determine whether the first token is part of one of a plurality of expressions known to include protected health information. In response to determining that the first token is not part of any one of the plurality of expressions, the system may determine, based on a blacklist of tokens known to include protected health information, whether the first token includes protected health information. In response to determining that the first token includes protected health information, the system may generate a de-identified electronic record by replacing the first token with a second token obfuscating the protected health information. Related methods and computer program products are also provided.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of california
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of california

title: Intelligent accompanying robot system
abstract: The application provides an intelligence robot system of accompanying and attending to includes: the wearable device acquires physiological state data through a built-in sensor and uploads the physiological state data to the intelligent management system; the entity robot is deployed in an application site and used for carrying out emotional communication with a guided object through a configured human-computer interaction system, acquiring emotional state information of the guided object, uploading the emotional state information to the intelligent management system, receiving emotional guidance recommendation information sent by the intelligent management system, and displaying the emotional state information to the guided object so as to guide the emotional state of the guided object; the intelligent management system is used for receiving the emotional state information and the physiological state data of the guided object, carrying out artificial intelligent analysis on the emotional state information and the physiological state data based on a pre-deployed emotional algorithm model trained by big data, identifying the emotional state of the user, generating corresponding emotional guidance recommendation information and issuing the information to the entity robot; the scheme improves the accuracy and the use effect of the emotional state guidance.

title: Generating structured meeting reports through semantic correlation of unstructured voice and text data
abstract: Generating reports. The method may include receiving, by a computer, data associated with a meeting. The method may include converting the received data to audio text data, digital text data, and graphical object data. The method may include identifying tokens associated with the converted audio text data, the converted digital text data, and the converted graphical object data. The method may include integrating each token corresponding to timeline data, positional data, and structural data. The method may include creating semantic correlations by connecting tokens associated with the converted audio text data and tokens associated with the converted digital text data. The method may include associating each of the integrated tokens with a semantic correlation based on the timeline data. The method may include creating a report outline based on the received data. The method may include creating an integrated report using the created report outline and the associated tokens.

title: Construction method and construction system of risk assessment model for Kawasaki disease
assignee: 道之精准医学科技(上海)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method and a construction system of a Kawasaki disease risk assessment model. The construction method comprises the following steps: extracting effective samples which can be used for modeling evaluation from the sample data set; screening 10 features which accord with the field medical auxiliary diagnosis application from the feature set of the effective sample; randomly dividing the incomplete data set of the effective sample into a training set and a verification set; fitting the training set by using a random forest method to construct a model, and recording optimal model parameters according to the error outside the bag; meanwhile, calculating a model classification threshold t by using a verification set according to an ROC curve, and thus constructing and obtaining a Kawasaki disease risk assessment model. The evaluation model disclosed by the invention can be used for quickly and effectively performing auxiliary evaluation on a suspected Kawasaki disease patient, is beneficial to reducing the misdiagnosis rate and the missed diagnosis rate, enables the patient to obtain effective prevention, intervention and treatment in the early stage of disease attack, and provides a basis for achieving the optimal treatment effect.
assignee_clean: 道之精准医学科技 上海 有限公司
primary_assignee: 道之精准医学科技 上海 有限公司

title: Systems and methods for secure high speed data generation and access
abstract: Systems and methods for generating a data map for retrieval of a data object. An example method includes: receiving an indication to generate a data entry for the data map, the data entry corresponding to a field identifier and a field value related to the field identifier; obfuscating the field identifier to generate a record locator associated with the data entry based, at least in part, on one or more variable storage parameters; and encrypting the field identifier and field value and storing the data entry in the data map as an encrypted field identifier and field value in association with the record locator.

title: Dynamic limiting of vehicle operation based on interior configurations
assignee: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for controlling operation of a vehicle. An example system for controlling operation of a vehicle includes one or more data collection components and one or more processors. The one or more data collection components are configured to collect data representative of a physical configuration of an interior vehicle component. The one or more processors are configured to access the collected data, determine, by processing the collected data, the physical configuration of the interior vehicle component, select a manner of operation based upon the determined physical configuration of the interior vehicle component, and cause the vehicle to operate according to the manner of operation.

title: Identifying entities using search results
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for identifying entities using search results. One of the methods includes the actions of determining that a first search query includes a respective text reference to each of one or more predetermined attributes, wherein each attribute is associated with a first entity type; for each of a plurality of entities of the first entity type, generating a combined search query that includes the first search query and a name of the entity; obtaining search results for each of the plurality of entities using the combined search query for each respective entity; and using the obtained search results to generate combined search results to include in a response to the first search query.

title: Method and device for determining a flow situation in a vessel
abstract: A method and device for determining a flow situation in a vessel are disclosed. According to an embodiment of the method, a first image data set containing image information relating to the vessel is used and a vascular tree of the vessel is segmented based upon the first image data set. An organ is also segmented based upon the first image data set or of a second image data set and the organ is assigned at least one area of a parenchyma of the organ. Via texture analysis, a texture of the area of the organ is determined and, depending on the texture, the area of the organ is assigned a flow characteristic. Depending on the vascular tree and the flow characteristic assigned to the area of the organ, a value of a measured variable characteristic of the flow situation within the vessel is then determined via a numerical method.

title: Systems and methods for augmented or mixed reality writing
abstract: An augmented reality system that includes processors and storage devices storing instructions. The instructions configure the processors to perform operations. The operations include identifying a writing object in a video feed being displayed in an augmented reality viewer, identify a tip of the writing object based on a contour of the writing object, and tracking movements of the tip in the augmented reality viewer. The operations may also include generating a virtual file, the virtual file storing the tracked movements and generating a text file by performing an image recognition operation associating the tracked movements stored in the virtual file with one or more characters.

title: 3D/2D medical image registration method based on LoG operator
abstract: The invention discloses a 3D/2D medical image registration method based on a LoG operator, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining 2D and 3D medical images and carrying out denoising pretreatment, and then establishing a projection coordinate system according to an X-ray imaging calculation model and a rigid body transformation model; and then, completing a rapid generation process of the DRR image by utilizing the parallel computation of the GPU, establishing a similarity measure function based on a LoG operator, and finally, performing iterative optimization on the similarity measure function by utilizing a hybrid optimization algorithm to find out rigid body transformation parameters meeting the precision registration, and stopping iteration so as to complete the registration process.

title: Automatic acetabular radius measurement method and system based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 哈尔滨医科大学附属第一医院, 黑龙江拓盟科技有限公司
abstract: An automatic acetabular radius measuring method and system based on artificial intelligence relates to the technical field of acetabular radius measurement and aims to solve the problem that the prior art cannot accurately and automatically measure the acetabular radius of a human body. The technical key points of the invention include: medical image data of a patient are obtained through CT and marked, the marked CT images are preprocessed, a hip joint structure is segmented by a segmentation model based on a training 2D (three-dimensional) Unet neural network, feature points on an acetabulum are identified by a pre-trained identification model based on the 3D Unet neural network, so that the radius of the acetabular fossa is calculated, and the measurement of the acetabular radius is completed. The invention can be used for the operation planning before orthopaedics operation, can lead the subsequent operation process to be more accurate, more personalized and lower in complications. The invention has strong clinical application prospect and value.
assignee_clean: 哈尔滨医科大学附属第一医院; 黑龙江拓盟科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 哈尔滨医科大学附属第一医院

title: Risk identification and response
abstract: A method, system, and computer-readable medium to stratify a health risk acquires structured information and unstructured information from a plurality of sources, converts at least some of the unstructured information to structured information, and geocodes the acquired structured information and converted structured information to produce geocoded data. Health information of a plurality of subjects are similarly geocoded to produce geocoded subject health data and merged with the geocoded data and mapped to a dashboard. First geographical correlations between at least some of the health information and the structured and unstructured information derived from the merged geocoded data and geocoded subject health data are output for display, and a risk stratification base score is developed in accordance with second geographical correlations between at least some of the health information and the acquired structured and unstructured information derived from the merged geocoded data and geocoded subject health data. The risk stratification base score is adjusted in accordance with positive and/or negative variables, and a total risk score is determined from the adjusted risk stratification base score and output for integration into an electronic health records system.

title: Speech emotion recognition method based on mixed wavelet packet feature deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a speech emotion recognition method based on mixed wavelet packet feature deep learning, and S1, carrying out endpoint detection on speech data through an autocorrelation function algorithm; s2, intercepting the voice sequence data into the same length, unifying the voice sequence samples into 1024, and generating new 8 reconstruction signals by using a 3-layer wavelet packet reconstruction algorithm aiming at the sequence to form a feature set 1; s3, extracting 140 feature values which are fused with LLDs and generalization functions thereof from the voice signal directly through Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to form a feature set 2; s4, further extracting the features of the feature set 2 by using a deep learning structure of DNN, and further extracting the features of the feature set 1; and S5, fusing two feature sets extracted by using different structures together, and finally classifying by using a Softmax loss function. The invention can fully extract the time domain information and frequency domain information characteristics of the voice signal under the condition of mixing noise, and further realize the extraction by utilizing a deep learning algorithm.

title: Osteoporosis artificial intelligent diagnosis device for recognizing hip joint X-ray
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial intelligent diagnosis device for identifying the osteoporosis of hip joint X rays, which comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a model construction module, a model training module and an image detection module; the model training module is used for training the two neural network models, and the image detection module is used for obtaining the bone condition information value through the processing of the trained image segmentation neural network model and the image classification neural network model of the hip joint X-ray film to be detected. The device can realize the purpose that only the hip joint X-ray film is identified to assist in primary screening of osteoporosis, and simply and effectively improve the diagnosis rate of the osteoporosis.

title: Cloud-edge-end-architecture-based pathological detection system and method
assignee: 山东省计算中心（国家超级计算济南中心）
abstract: The invention relates to a pathology detection system and method based on a cloud edge-side architecture, which comprises a cloud platform layer, a communication network layer and an edge layer; the cloud platform layer comprises a cloud computing server center, a database, a cloud file storage system and an MQTT server; the network communication layer comprises a plurality of network communication modes; the edge layer is each equipment component integrated in the medical institution and comprises edge equipment, a local file storage system and a pathological section scanner; the invention provides a pathology detection method of a cloud edge-side architecture based on a Kubeedge management platform, which realizes the creation of an edge device object model, the training of a pathology image model, the issuing of a mirror image, the detection and inference of a pathology image, the uploading of edge data and the like, can effectively save the labor and time cost of a hospital pathology department, and improves the quality and efficiency of pathology diagnosis.
assignee_clean: 山东省计算中心 国家超级计算济南中心
primary_assignee: 山东省计算中心 国家超级计算济南中心

title: Systems and methods of optimizing resource allocation using machine learning and predictive control
abstract: A computer system includes a transceiver that receives over a data communications network different types of input data from multiple source nodes and a processing system that defines for each of multiple data categories, a set of groups of data objects for the data category based on the different types of input data. Predictive machine learning model(s) predict a selection score for each group of data objects in the set of groups of data objects for the data category for a predetermined time period. Control machine learning model(s) determine how many data objects are permitted for each group of data objects based on the selection score. Decision-making machine learning model(s) prioritize the permitted data objects based on one or more predetermined priority criteria. Subsequent activities of the computer system are monitored to calculate performance metrics for each group of data objects and for data objects actually selected during the predetermined time period. Predictive machine learning model(s) and decision-making machine learning model(s) are adjusted based on the performance metrics to improve respective performance(s).

title: Continuous blood pressure estimation method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a continuous blood pressure estimation method, a continuous blood pressure estimation device and continuous blood pressure estimation equipment. The method comprises the following steps: 1) and (3) a calibration link: sampling the pulse wave of the tested object to obtain a sample pulse characteristic parameter and acquiring a reference blood pressure value of the tested object, wherein the first pulse characteristic parameter comprises: the slope of the ascending branch of the second order pulse leading wave, the amplitude difference of the ascending branch of the second order pulse leading wave, the coverage area of the ascending branch of the second order pulse leading wave, the slope of the descending branch of the second order pulse leading wave, the amplitude difference of the descending branch of the second order pulse leading wave and the coverage area of the descending branch of the second order pulse leading wave; calculating to obtain a coefficient parameter of the blood pressure estimation model according to the reference blood pressure value and the sample pulse characteristic parameter; measuring the pulse wave of the measured object in real time to obtain a real-time pulse characteristic parameter; and inputting the coefficient parameters and the real-time pulse characteristic parameters into a blood pressure estimation model so as to estimate the real-time pulse continuous blood pressure value of the measured object.

title: Processing a file to generate a recommendation using a database system
abstract: Disclosed are examples of systems, apparatus, methods and computer program products for processing a file to generate a recommendation using a database system. A database can be maintained. The database can store data objects identifying historical keywords for a user and weights associated with the historical keywords. Information identifying a file can be received. The file can be processed to extract file keywords. A query attribute can be generated based on the historical keywords, the file keywords, and the weights. It can be determined that the query attribute conforms to a designated characteristic associated with the user. Data indicating a recommendation of the file can be generated in response to determining that the query attribute conforms to the designated characteristic. The data indicating the recommendation can be provided as at least a portion of a feed item of a feed of a social networking system. The feed can be displayed in a user interface on a display device associated with a user of the social networking system.

title: Multi-needle combined cryoablation path planning equipment
assignee: 海杰亚（北京）医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-needle combined cryoablation path planning device, which comprises a memory and a processor, wherein the memory stores a computer program, and the processor realizes the following steps when executing the computer program: acquiring a target area corresponding to a target tissue to be cryoablated in a medical scanning image of a target object; selecting a single needle ablation zone from the target zone; aiming at a single-needle ablation area, obtaining a puncture path of single-needle cryoablation and a corresponding ice ball covering area; and if the ice ball coverage area does not completely cover the target area, taking the residual area of the target area except the ice ball coverage area as a new target area, and returning to the step of selecting the single-needle ablation area from the target area. By adopting the multi-needle combined cryoablation method and the multi-needle combined cryoablation device, the multi-needle puncture path for carrying out multi-needle combined cryoablation on the target tissue to be cryoablated can be accurately obtained, and the puncture path planning of each needle of the multi-needle combined cryoablation is realized.
assignee_clean: 海杰亚 北京 医疗器械有限公司
primary_assignee: 海杰亚 北京 医疗器械有限公司

title: Method for providing speech and intelligent computing device controlling speech providing apparatus
abstract: A method for providing a speech and an intelligent computing device controlling a speech providing apparatus are disclosed. A method for providing a speech according to an embodiment of the present invention includes obtaining a message, converting the message into a speech, and determining output pattern based on a generation situation of the message, so that it is possible to more realistically convey a situation at a time of message generation to a receiver of TTS. One or more of the voice providing method, devices, intelligent computing devices controlling the voice providing device, and servers of the present invention may include artificial intelligence modules, drones (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, UAVs), robots, Augmented Reality (AR) devices, and virtual reality (VR) devices, devices related to 5G services, and the like.

title: Global longitudinal strain from cine magnetic resonance images
abstract: A method for computing global longitudinal strain from cine magnetic resonance (MR) images includes automatically detecting landmark points in each MR long axis image frame included in a cine MR image sequence. A deformation field is determined between every pair of frames based on the landmark points. Myocardial pixels in the frames are labeled using a deep learning framework to yield myocardium masks. These myocardium masks are propagated to each frame using the deformation fields. A polar transformation is performed on each of the masked frames. The contours of the myocardium in each transformed frame are computed using a shortest path algorithm. Next, longitudinal strain is calculated at every pixel in the myocardium for the polar frames using the contours of the myocardium. Then, global longitudinal strain is computed by averaging the longitudinal strain at every pixel in the myocardium of the transformed frames.

title: Method for the artifact correction of three-dimensional volume image data
abstract: A method for the artifact correction of three-dimensional volume image data of an object is disclosed. In an embodiment, the method includes receiving first volume image data via a first interface, the first volume image data being based on projection measurement data acquired via a computed tomography device, the computed tomography device including a system axis, and the first volume image data including an artifact including high-frequency first portions in a direction of a system axis and including second portions, being low-frequency relative to the high-frequency first portions, in a plane perpendicular to the system axis; ascertaining, via a computing unit, artifact-corrected second volume image data by applying a trained function to the first volume image data received; and outputting the artifact-corrected second volume image data via a second interface.

title: Utilizing temporal indicators to weight semantic values
abstract: A mechanism is provided, in a data processing system comprising a processor and a memory configured to implement a question and answer system (QA), for utilizing temporal indicators to weight semantic values. A set of temporal characteristics is identified of a set of initial candidate answers. For each initial candidate answer in the set of initial candidate answers: a distance value is generated for each of the set of temporal characteristics of the set of initial candidate answers, a multiplier value is determined with which to weight an initial confidence score associated with the initial candidate answer using the distance value; a sentiment value is determined of the initial candidate answer, and a final weight value is determined using the multiplier value, the sentiment value, and the initial confidence score associated with the initial candidate answer. A set of temporally refined candidate answers is then provided using the determined final weight values.

title: Method, system, and apparatus for remote patient monitoring or tracking of sepsis-related indicators
abstract: A method, system, and apparatus for remote patient monitoring or tracking sepsis-related indicators or markers in ambulatory patients or outpatients. The method, system, and apparatus is devised or configured to provide remote patient monitoring of patient vitals signs for determining the risk for sepsis.

title: VCG vector loop bifurcation
abstract: A system for determining T wave bifurcation that includes three or more ECG leads configured to receive an ECG signal and a first computing device including a processor coupled to a memory, the processor and the memory configured to perform operations including: generating at least two orthogonal ECG vectors based on the ECG signal of a patient, processing the at least two orthogonal ECG vectors to determine a loop trajectory of at least a portion of the ECG signal, identifying a trajectory bifurcation by comparing the loop trajectory to a control loop trajectory for a plurality of cardiac cycles, and determining an indicator of a cardiac event based on the trajectory bifurcation.

title: Mapping assessment results to levels of experience
abstract: The disclosed embodiments provide a system for processing data. During operation, the system obtains an assessment result containing a rating of a candidate with respect to a qualification for an opportunity. Next, the system determines, based on the assessment result, a position of the rating in a distribution of assessment results associated with the qualification and one or more attributes of the opportunity. The system then compares the position to a threshold to determine a recommendation related to the candidate and the opportunity. Finally, the system outputs the recommendation in association with the candidate.

title: Nodule detection apparatus and method
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a nodule detection apparatus and a CT imaging system. A nodule detecting apparatus includes: a computer-readable storage medium for storing instructions executable by a processor; a processor for executing the instructions to perform the steps of: acquiring a first medical image marked with nodule information; generating a training data block containing nodules from the first medical image; generating a label matrix according to the nodule information and the training data block; training a convolutional neural network by using the training data block and the label matrix to obtain a network model suitable for detecting the nodule; and performing nodule detection on the second medical image using the network model to determine a nodule region in the second medical image. The nodule detection device and the CT imaging system can efficiently and accurately detect the nodule, and have strong universality.
assignee_clean: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Beam codebook generating method of 5G terminal
abstract: The present disclosure relates to providing a communication method and system for fusing a fifth generation (5G) communication system supporting higher data rates than a fourth generation (4G) system with internet of things (IoT) technology. The present disclosure may be applied to smart services based on 5G communication technology and IoT-related technology, such as smart home, smart building, smart city, smart car, networking car, healthcare, digital education, smart retail, security and security services. A method of a User Equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system is provided. The method comprises the following steps: identifying electric field data of each antenna of the UE to be used for transmitting and receiving data; generating a set of codewords comprising a first upper limit and a second upper limit based on the electric field data, the set of codewords corresponding to candidate beams for each antenna; selecting at least one codeword from a set of codewords based on a performance criterion; configuring a codebook to be used for each antenna by adding at least one codeword to the codebook; determining whether a codebook including at least one codeword satisfies a condition to stop adding another codeword to the codebook; and applying the configured codebook to transmit or receive data on each antenna based on whether the condition is satisfied.

title: System and method of managing personal security
abstract: A method of managing personal security allows a portable computing device to provide a user with a variety of automated security detection and responses. The portable computing device uses integrated hardware to assess an emergency situation from spoken distress cues, audible danger cues, medical distress cues, physical trauma cues, and manually-inputted cues. The portable computing device also provides the user with a variety of responses to the emergency situation, which include a contacting-help response, a supplemental-help response, a communal-help response, an immediate alarm response, a delayed alarm response, an informing response, an increasing-visibility response, and a decreasing-visibility response.

title: Electric pulse stimulation system, control method and control method of electric pulse stimulation signal
assignee: 清华大学, 北京品驰医疗设备有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of medical instruments, in particular to an electric pulse stimulation system and a control method thereof, and a control method of electric pulse stimulation signals. An electrical pulse stimulation system comprising: the stimulation electrode comprises a pulse generator, a first type of stimulation electrode and a second type of stimulation electrode. The pulse generator can synthetically tune the first left sacral nerve pulse signal and the first right sacral nerve pulse signal to the first type of stimulation electrode and the second type of stimulation electrode. Or outputting a first left sacral nerve pulse signal and a first right sacral nerve pulse signal to the sacral nerves of different branches on the same side. The pulse generator can determine and regulate a stimulation volume ratio of the first left sacral nerve pulse signal and the first right sacral nerve pulse signal. The electrical pulse stimulation system may tune the input of electrical pulse signals synthetically according to patient neural anatomical or functional distribution variations. Therefore, the electric pulse stimulation system achieves the effect of improving the proportion of beneficial people and the benefit degree of a single patient.
assignee_clean: 清华大学; 北京品驰医疗设备有限公司

title: Diagnostic tool for eye disease detection using smartphone
abstract: Diagnostic tool for eye disease detection using a smartphone. At least some of the example embodiments are methods including capturing, by way of a camera lens on a device, an image of an eye to create a raw specimen; processing the raw specimen to create a processes specimen; performing edge detection on the processed specimen to detect a boundary of a cornea; extracting a region of interest of the cornea; identifying a boundary of the region of interest using a boundary tracing technique to identify a second boundary; analyzing the second boundary of the region of interest, by measuring a slope of the second boundary; and classifying the region of interest as including an eye disease, based on the analyzing the second boundary.

title: Atrial flutter detection utilizing nonlinear dimension reduction
abstract: A computer implemented method and system for declaring arrhythmias in cardiac activity are provided. The method and system are under control of one or more processors that are configured with specific executable instructions. The method and system obtain far field cardiac activity (CA) signals for a series of beats and builds an N-dimensional data set from data values for features of interest from the CA signals. The method and system utilize a manifold structure to map the N-dimensional data set, through nonlinear dimensional reduction, onto an M-dimensional data set and declares an atrial fibrillation (AFL) episode based on a relation between the M-dimensional data set and one or more AFL classification criteria.

title: LARS diabetes prediction method based on characteristic weight
abstract: The invention relates to a LARS diabetes mellitus prediction system based on characteristic weight, which comprises a storage device; a feature weight based LARS diabetes prediction module coupled to the storage device and configured to: calculating an independent variable characteristic weight vector and an original correlation vector; and outputting regression coefficient omega of the LARS diabetes model based on the characteristic weight based on the independent variable characteristic weight vector and the original relevance vector. Starting from the characteristics of the diabetes data set, key characteristic variables of diabetes are screened out, and a diabetes prediction model is simplified; the accuracy of the diabetes prediction model is improved, so that accurate diabetes prevention and treatment measures are provided.

title: Cross-modal generation method for generating ECG (electro-magnetic resonance) based on PPG (PPG) of diffusion model
abstract: The invention discloses a PPG generation ECG cross-mode generation method based on a diffusion model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an ECG (ECG), PPG (PPG) paired data set; converting the ECG and PPG data into image data using a method of converting time series data into image data; constructing a deep learning model; training the depth model in a first stage, training VQGAN models and CLIP models, and training the diffusion model in a second stage; defining a total loss function; and training by adopting different super-parameter combinations on a training set by using super-parameter search, verifying the performance of the super-parameter combinations on a verification set, selecting the optimal super-parameter combination, and testing a deep learning model adopting the optimal super-parameter training on a test set. The cross-modal generation method for generating the ECG based on the PPG of the diffusion model can effectively generate a high-quality ECG signal from the PPG signal, and improves the accuracy and reliability of signal generation.

title: Image processing apparatus, image processing method, and image processing system
abstract: An image processing apparatus extracts a first region and a second region from a medical image, identifies a third region that is included in the second region and that is at a distance greater than or equal to a threshold from the first region, and acquires a feature value that is a value indicating a feature of the second region on the basis of the third region.

title: Real-time, context based detection and classification of data
abstract: Various embodiments are provided for providing real-time context-based detection and classification of data in a computing environment are provided. Data may be received from a user. Contextual information may be learned from the data received from a user using a machine learning operation. The data may be classified according to the contextual classification criteria applied to contextual information derived in real time from the data.

title: Cup optic disk segmentation method based on fundus image data set migration learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a medical fundus image data set, in particular to a cup optic disc segmentation method for fundus image data set migration learning. The method extracts general characteristics among fundus map data sets through the countermeasure training of a backbone segmentation network and discriminators in two fields, utilizes an attention module to weight the characteristics, solves the problem of blurred vision cup and optic disc boundaries, and eliminates the interference of other various eyebases on segmentation tasks. On the premise of not using labeling information of a target data set, the algorithm keeps higher optic cup optic disc segmentation precision in the fundus image data set migration process, and the problem of performance limitation of a traditional automatic glaucoma screening method due to insufficient labeled fundus data is effectively solved.

title: Signal processing for making predictive determinations
abstract: In some examples, unstructured data is evaluated using a natural language processing model to output a set of subjective indicators. These subjective indicators are scored using a predictive model to determine whether a dependent user has or is likely to develop a particular condition such as a cellular abnormality.

title: Ultrasonic imaging method, device and readable storage medium
assignee: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides an ultrasonic imaging method, an ultrasonic imaging device and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting ultrasonic waves to a detection area and receiving ultrasonic echoes to obtain a first ultrasonic echo signal; obtaining an ultrasonic image of a detection area according to the first ultrasonic echo signal; identifying the anatomical structure of interest in the ultrasound image of the detection region based on the class of anatomical structure of interest and the image features of the ultrasound image of the detection region; and determining a target region of interest based on the identified anatomical structure of interest, the target region of interest at least partially surrounding the anatomical structure of interest; transmitting ultrasonic waves to a detection area in the target region of interest, receiving ultrasonic echoes, and obtaining a second ultrasonic echo signal; and obtaining a three-dimensional ultrasonic image of the detection area in the region of interest according to the second ultrasonic echo signal. The method improves the efficiency of acquiring the target ROI, and further greatly improves the acquisition efficiency of the three-dimensional ultrasonic image.
assignee_clean: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司

title: System and method for providing a response to a user query using a visual assistant
abstract: Embodiments relate to providing at least one response to a user of a user device using a visual assistant, wherein the response is based on at least one user query. In an embodiment, the virtual assistant system receives the user query through a virtual multimedia contact, wherein the virtual multimedia contact is invoked by receiving a user command from the user through an interface. Thereafter, the virtual assistant system determines the response based on the user query. Further, the virtual assistant system selects a visual assistant (e.g., virtual character) for representing the response and subsequently provides the response to the user device using the visual assistant by transmitting the response to the user device using the visual assistant.

title: Webpage hidden link detection method and device and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 深信服科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for detecting a webpage hidden link, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a training set of a preset webpage classification model; acquiring a text characteristic vector of a webpage to be detected and a text characteristic vector of a webpage in a training set; selecting a plurality of text characteristic vectors of the web pages which accord with preset similar conditions with the text characteristic vector of the web page to be detected from the training set based on a proximity algorithm, taking the text characteristic vectors as proximity vectors of the text characteristic vectors of the web page to be detected, and determining a web page type corresponding to the proximity vectors according to a web page classification model, and taking the web page type as a candidate web page type of the web page to be detected; respectively calculating the probability that the webpage to be detected belongs to each candidate webpage type; and judging whether the candidate webpage type corresponding to the probability maximum value belongs to a positive sample or a negative sample, and if the candidate webpage type belongs to the negative sample, judging that the webpage to be detected contains a dark chain. The invention also discloses a device for detecting the webpage hidden link and a computer readable storage medium. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of detecting the webpage dark chain.

title: Image processing method, image processing apparatus, device storage medium, and growth evaluation system
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image processing method, an image processing device, an equipment storage medium and a growth and development evaluation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image; inputting the medical image into a preset image processing model based on a neural network for calculation to obtain an image processing result corresponding to the medical image; the image processing result comprises a bone age prediction result and/or a ossification center positioning result. The invention can simultaneously carry out the learning of the bone age prediction task and the ossification center positioning task and obtain the image processing result, thereby realizing the rapid and accurate bone age prediction.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Control of content broadcasting
abstract: A method modifies how content is broadcast based on the tone and format of the content. One or more processors retrieve a set of rules that describe a tone and format for proposed content that is to be broadcast to an intended target, and determine whether the proposed content conforms to the set of rules. In response to determining that the proposed content does not conform to the set of rules, the processor(s) modify how the proposed content is broadcast to the intended target. The processor(s) generate an enriched content of the modified content by applying, to the modified content, content metatags that describe a content of the modified content, and then analyze the enriched content to calculate a trustworthiness index (TI) for the enriched content. The processors further modify how content is broadcast to the intended target based on the TI of the enriched content.

title: System, method, and computer program product for determining fraud
abstract: A method of determining fraud includes: receiving a transaction request associated with a first payment transaction between a merchant and a user from a merchant system; generating a first risk score based on the transaction request and a first set pot of transaction data received prior to the transaction request; processing a transaction request approval based on the first risk score not satisfying a first threshold; receiving a risk score request associated with the first payment transaction, where the risk score request is received after the transaction request has been approved; generating a second risk score based on a second set of transaction data received after the first risk score is determined; and automatically classifying the first payment transaction as potentially fraudulent in response to determining that the second risk score satisfies a second threshold.

title: Independent security threat detection and remediation by storage systems in a synchronous replication arrangement
abstract: A system may include a plurality of storage systems each configured to operate in accordance with a synchronous replication configuration in which a dataset is synchronously replicated to each of the plurality of storage systems such that each of the plurality of storage systems stores and continually updates a different copy of the dataset. Each of the storage systems may be configured to independently monitor, while operating in accordance with the synchronous replication configuration, for security threats against one of the copies of the dataset; and perform, when the monitoring indicates that the one of the copies of the dataset is possibly being targeted by a security threat, a remedial action with respect to the security threat.

title: Image processing method and device, model training method and device, and electronic equipment
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an image processing method and device, a model training method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: performing target detection on at least one current vertebral segment adjacent to a current second intervertebral disc on the vertebral mask image of the image to be segmented according to a key point corresponding to the current first intervertebral disc of the image to be segmented and an example segmentation model so as to determine the position of the at least one current vertebral segment; and performing example segmentation on the at least one current vertebra segment according to the position of the at least one current vertebra segment to obtain the background of the image to be segmented and an example segmentation result of the at least one current vertebra segment, so that under-segmentation, over-segmentation and other phenomena can be avoided when the vertebra segment is segmented.
assignee_clean: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Diabetic retinopathy image identification method based on fundus images
abstract: A diabetic retinopathy image identification method based on a fundus image, wherein a pathological change area and a surrounding normal area of a fundus image often present different visually obvious characteristics, and the areas are interested areas; considering the region of interest of the diabetic retina, fusing an attention mechanism algorithm in the traditional classification network; the idea of Arcface loss is used and improved, and progressive relations among categories are modeled, so that the model is sensitive to data distribution. The method considers the characteristics of the medical image, integrates the attention characteristics in the deep learning network, enables the model to focus on the region of interest in the image, and can obtain better effect under the condition of limited data scale; in addition, the distance progressive relation among different types of diabetic retina images is also considered, the W-Arcface loss is provided according to the modeling of the distance among the types, the penalty item in the Arcface loss is dynamically adjusted according to the distance between the sample type and the real label, and the classification accuracy is further improved.

title: Wheat ear detection and counting method based on deep learning point supervision thought
abstract: The invention discloses a wheat ear detection and counting method based on a deep learning point supervision thought, which comprises the steps of pre-collecting a field wheat ear image in a specific area so as to obtain an input image; the method comprises the steps of inputting an input image into a network structure and obtaining output parameters, and the steps of obtaining each ear patch and predicting the number of ears. The network structure firstly extracts features through a down-sampling network, then up-samples the extracted features through an up-sampling path, so that the output is consistent with the size of an input image, the probability of each pixel in the output image is obtained, and the plaque of the ear of wheat is obtained based on the probability. The method can effectively overcome the noise in the field environment and realize the rapid detection and accurate counting of the wheat ears. The reliability of the method is verified by various pictures in different field environments, different illumination intensities, different growth conditions and different shooting lens distances of two markets.

title: Three-dimensional data medical classification system based on deep learning
assignee: 中国科学院自动化研究所, 东莞中国科学院云计算产业技术创新与育成中心
abstract: The application belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and medical treatment, in particular relates to a three-dimensional data medical classification system and method based on deep learning, and aims to solve the problem that pathological feature classification accuracy of a lesion part is low in an existing computer method. According to the application, three-dimensional data feature vectors are obtained through three-dimensional space affine transformation on the three-dimensional data of the lesion part of the patient, and pathological feature classification is obtained by judging pathological feature types of the three-dimensional data feature vectors based on a medical classification model constructed by a neural network. The application enriches the information content contained in the input data based on the three-dimensional data, reduces the influence of natural factors such as illumination and the like, distributes pathological feature classification based on the trained medical classification model, and improves the pathological feature classification accuracy of the pathological part.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院自动化研究所; 东莞中国科学院云计算产业技术创新与育成中心
primary_assignee: 中国科学院自动化研究所

title: Proactively deploying analytics to a computerized edge device
abstract: Techniques proactively deploy analytics to a computerized edge device. The techniques involve receiving data from the edge device. The data is conveyed through the edge device from a set of sensors disposed at a particular location. The techniques further involve performing analytics on the data to identify a set of edge device rules that defines a set of actions for the edge device to carry out under a set of predefined conditions potentially sensed by the set of sensors. The techniques further involve providing a command to the edge device. The command (i) includes the set of edge device rules and (ii) directs the edge device to, at a future time, start operating according to the set of edge device rules to protect against unsuccessful deployment of the command to the edge device due to subsequent delayed communication between the processing circuitry and the edge device.

title: Cnn model based approach towards breast cancer features detection from ultra sound images
assignee: A, Tamilselvi MS, Chandrasekaran, Rajeswari MS, J, Krithiga MS, N, Archana MS, R, Dhanagopal DR, R, Menaka DR, R, Suresh Kumar DR, T, Sampath MR
abstract:
CNN MODEL BASED APPROACH TOWARDS BREAST CANCER

ABSTRACT 
Breast cancer is the serious cause of death for women globally. The Breast cancer cells divides 
faster to the lymph nodes and even leads damage to other parts of the body. Detection of breast 
cancer as early as possible is very important. Ultra sound is one of the methods to detect breast 
cancer in earlier stage and its advantage is that, it doesn't have any radiation. Machine Learning 
plays a very important role in medical imaging research. Here, the deep learning technique is used 
to classify the breast cancer. The Deep learning methods have great capability in medical research.  
The approach of using image enhancement techniques is to improve the diagnostic accuracy of 
medical image technologies like ultrasound imaging. Computer machine learning advanced 
technologies, for example, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have risen as a viable tool in 
medical image analysis for the detection and classification of disease in various way progressively.  
Image processing and machine learning techniques helps to diagnose the various disorder in prior 
itself by using the breast ultrasound image. The breast ultrasound image is used to recognize the 
cancer in early stages. Microwave sensor plays a major role in microwave imaging system. The 
main aim of this title is to detect the disease present in the breast images using machine learning 
techniques. Results show that the neural network is superior to the other techniques for 
classification.
