title: Method and system for digital based musculoskeletal rehabilitation treatment
abstract: A digital-based method for providing musculoskeletal rehabilitation treatment, provided by an application, may comprise the steps of: selecting an exercise plan to be provided to a patient based on the assignment of prescription information including an exercise plan for the patient from a doctor terminal; executing the application on a user terminal where the patient's account is logged in; providing an exercise list according to the exercise plan to the user terminal on which the application is executed; playing, on the user terminal, exercise videos corresponding to a plurality of exercise items, according to the plurality of exercise items constituting the exercise list; providing an evaluation page for performing an evaluation related to the exercise items, based on the playback frequency of the exercise videos satisfying a preset standard; and updating the exercise plan based on evaluation information received through the evaluation page. Accessibility to the exercise treatment can be enhanced.

title: Timely quality improvement of an inventory of elements
abstract: Timely quality improvement of an inventory of elements is provided. An event submission that includes at least one element of the inventory of elements is received at about the same time as the event is encountered. The event submission is prioritized based on factors related to the submitter, the event, historical information, or combinations thereof. A risk level or rating is assigned to the event submission and others are invited to comment on the event submission. Based on the comments, real-time information is presented so that the event submission may be tracked during the process. The submitter of the event submission is assigned a credibility rating and is given an incentive for providing the event submission.

title: System and method for augmented knowledge discovery
abstract: A system and method to present global and local context sensitive augmented content in accordance with multiple criteria, including one or more user's preferences, and present the augmented content via a transparent layer on top of the original content for less obtrusive and more efficient browsing, knowledge discovery and exploration experience. The original content remains visible to the user while the augmented content is being viewed or interacted with. The global context sensitive augmented content is generated using metrics based on the overall document or content being viewed, while the local context sensitive augmented content is generated using metrics based on the currently viewed or selected object within the document or content being viewed. Real-time and theme based augmentation are used to further enhance the user's experience. The local and global augmentation represent an in-situ user customized augmented network of concepts and relationships that are of interest to knowledge discovery of the topic at hand.

title: Write-only limited-read filesystem
abstract: A secure filesystem provides write-only access with limited read. The filesystem stores data as an encrypted block on a user machine using a symmetric (active) key, along with metadata including a read condition. While the read condition is valid, local applications can read the data using the active key. When the read condition becomes invalid, the active key is deleted so local applications no longer have access. However, the filesystem encrypts the active key to yield an inactive key, using an RSA public key. The corresponding private key is sent to an authorized party machine, but deleted from the user machine. Thus the user machine is unable to decrypt the inactive key, but the authorized party machine can still read the data by first decrypting the inactive key using the private key to regenerate the active key, and then decrypting the encrypted block using the regenerated active key.

title: Converting data formats in a storage system
abstract: Converting data formats in a storage system: converting first data in a first format to second data in a second format, wherein second data in the second format includes a reference to the first data, wherein the first data and the second data are associated with a dataset, including updating the second data to include: a reference to first data associated with a portion of the dataset that precedes a data-converted portion of the dataset; second data associated with the data-converted portion of the dataset, wherein the second data associated with the data-converted portion of the dataset is in the second data format; and a reference to first data associated with a portion of the dataset that follows the data-converted portion of the dataset; and replacing first data associated with the data-converted portion of the dataset with a reference to the second data associated with the data-converted portion of the dataset.

title: Fungal microscopic image segmentation detection method and system based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a fungal microscopic image segmentation detection method and a fungal microscopic image segmentation detection system based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the fungal microscopic image segmentation detection method comprises the following steps: dividing a plurality of fungus microscopic images into a positive sample and a negative sample, and marking hyphae in the positive sample to obtain a marked positive sample; carrying out slicing and sample enhancement operations on the unmarked negative sample and the marked positive sample to generate a training data set for deep learning; constructing a deep convolutional neural network model, reading a training data set to generate a segmentation model for segmentation detection, identifying pathogenic phases and non-pathogenic phases in a microscopic image of the fungus to be detected by using the segmentation model, representing a global microscopic image of the fungus by using a heat value map, and describing the outline of a pathogenic phase structure in the microscopic image of the fungus to be detected. The method not only classifies the fungus microscopic images, but also can segment and accurately position the hypha structure of the pathogenic phase from the images.

title: X-ray chest radiography classification device based on improved dense connection network
abstract: The invention relates to an X-ray chest radiography classification device based on an improved dense connection network, which comprises a memory, a processor and a computer program stored on the memory and capable of running on the processor, wherein the processor executes the program to realize the following method steps: firstly, preprocessing a chest radiography; and secondly, constructing and training a deep convolutional neural network: modifying a classification network DenseNet121, adding an extrusion-excitation module in the network in a dense connection mode to form an improved dense connection network, constructing a loss function according with the task, and training the network by using a preprocessed chest radiography; thirdly, testing the network and selecting the optimal network model: and testing the network model obtained by each round of training on the test set, and selecting the network model with the highest average AUC value as a final model.

title: Method and system for generating synthetically anonymized data for a given task
assignee: Imagia Cybernetics Inc., Florent Chandelier, Andrew JESSON, Lisa DIJORIO, Cecile LOW-KAM, Florian SOUDAN, Mohammad HAVAEI, Nicolas Chapados
abstract: A method and a system are disclosed for generating synthetically anonymized data, the method comprising providing first data to be anonymized; providing a data embedding comprising data features, wherein data features enable a representation of corresponding data, and wherein the data is representative of the first data; providing an identifier embedding comprising identifiable features, wherein the identifiable features enable an identification of the data and the first data; providing a task-specific embedding comprising task-specific features, wherein said task-specific features enables a disentanglement of different classes relevant to the given task; generating synthetically anonymized data, the generating comprising a generative process using samples comprising a first sampling from the data embedding which ensures that a corresponding first sample originates away from a projection of the data and the first data in the identifier embedding and a second sampling from the task-specific embedding which ensures that a corresponding second sample originates close to the task-specific features and wherein the generating further mixes the first sample and the second sample in a generative process.

title: Training method of segmentation model of multi-modal image, image processing method and device
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a training method, an image processing method, an apparatus, and a medium for a segmentation model of a multi-modal image. The training method comprises the following steps: training a first segmentation model by using a training image set of a first mode; for each training image in a training image set of a second modality, processing by using a trained first segmentation model and a trained second segmentation model respectively to obtain a first semantic feature and a second semantic feature, wherein the training image set of the first modality and the training image set of the second modality are sets of images obtained by acquiring a plurality of reference objects under the first modality and the second modality respectively, each training image of the first modality and each training image of the second modality have a first number and a second number of labeled categories respectively, and the second number is smaller than the first number; and training the second segmentation model by inputting the first semantic features to the second segmentation model and inputting the second semantic features to the trained first segmentation model.

title: Super resolution method and device for image, storage medium and electronic device
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a super-resolution method and device of an image, a storage medium and an electronic device. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image to be subjected to super-resolution processing, wherein the first image carries first interference information; and performing interference filtering processing and super-resolution processing on the first image through a first model to obtain a second image, wherein the first model is a neural network model trained by the image carrying the second interference information in advance, and the resolution of the second image is higher than that of the first image and the first interference information in the first image is not carried. The invention solves the technical problem of lower definition of the image obtained by super resolution in the related technology.

title: Multi-channel advertisement putting method, device, equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and intelligent medical treatment, and discloses a multi-channel advertisement putting method, device, equipment and storage medium, which are used for improving advertisement putting efficiency. The multi-channel advertisement delivery method comprises the following steps: acquiring the delivery effect data and the original delivery strategy of the advertising platforms of the multiple channels; establishing an initial delivery effect funnel model of each channel advertisement delivery platform; comparing the initial delivery effect funnel models of the advertising platforms of the channels to obtain an optimal delivery effect funnel model and an event to be optimized; adjusting the throwing crowd strategy, the bidding strategy and the material selection strategy in the original throwing strategy to obtain a target throwing strategy; and carrying out data format compatible processing on the target delivery strategy to obtain a delivery strategy package of each channel advertisement delivery platform, and distributing the delivery strategy package to the corresponding channel advertisement delivery platform. In addition, the invention also relates to a blockchain technology, and the release strategy package can be stored in a blockchain node.

title: Intestinal polyp detection system and method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses an intestinal polyp detection system and method based on deep learning, which are characterized in that a true boundary box marking area is used as priori information, and a contrast learning method is combined, so that the distinguishing capability of a model on a polyp area and a non-polyp area is enhanced, the polyp detection accuracy is improved, and the omission factor of polyp detection is reduced; the method is based on the improvement of the traditional target detection framework CenterNet, and adds a cascading structure designed for the small polyp target, so that the detection accuracy of the model on the small polyp is improved, the model is simple, the training and detection process is simple and efficient, and the detection speed is high; the self-adaptive difficult sample mining technology can find out potential difficult samples in training data and make a model give stronger attention to the potential difficult samples, can effectively improve the detection capability of the model to the difficult samples in actual conditions, has simple and effective self-adaptive difficult sample mining functions, and does not consume extra calculation amount.

title: Multi-mode route selection
abstract: A method managing a generated route for multiple modes of transportation includes displaying guidance for a generated route based on a travel itinerary between an origin location and a destination location, wherein the generated route includes at least one mode of transportation alteration. The method receives user data associated with a user traveling at a specific point along the generated route. The method generates a confidence score for the user traveling along generated route based on the received user data. Responsive to determining the confidence score is below a confidence level threshold, the method modifies the generated route based on an analysis of the generated route at the specific point, wherein the modified route causes the confidence score to increase above the confidence level threshold. The method displays guidance for the modified route.

title: Cancer accurate chemotherapy typing marker screening method, chemotherapy sensitivity molecular typing method and application
assignee: 北京谷海天目生物医学科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a cancer accurate chemotherapy parting marker screening method, a chemotherapy sensitive molecular parting method and application, wherein the method is characterized in that parting markers are obtained from a multi-center large sample queue, molecular parting is found, and then a classifier is constructed by using the parting markers or using differential proteins obtained based on parting labels as selection characteristics; when the classifier is used for classifying, the expression spectrum data of the acquired samples are input, the expression spectrum data is preprocessed, the classifier features are matched, logarithm conversion is carried out, and the classifier constructed by a machine learning classification algorithm or an artificial intelligent model predicts, so that output labels of a chemotherapy sensitive group or a chemotherapy insensitive group are finally obtained, and the molecular typing of the accurate chemotherapy is carried out, so that the pain point problem in the tumor medical field is solved, and the method comprises the steps of accurately judging whether the chemotherapy benefits the crowd, providing optimal combination recommendation of a first-line medication scheme and providing optimal period recommendation of the chemotherapy scheme.

title: Cerebral hemorrhage auxiliary diagnosis system based on neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a cerebral hemorrhage auxiliary diagnosis system based on a neural network, which belongs to the technical field of medical image processing and segmentation, and comprises the following components: the acquisition module is used for acquiring a plurality of original CT images and marking a focus area; the processing module is used for carrying out image enhancement on the plurality of original CT images to obtain a training set; the training module is used for training the neural network by utilizing the training set; the first diagnosis module is used for acquiring a CT image shot for the second time, preprocessing the CT image, inputting the processed image into a trained neural network, and obtaining a gray level image which is consistent with the size of the input image and represents the confidence coefficient of each pixel; the second diagnosis module is used for sequentially carrying out threshold segmentation, morphological closing operation and hole elimination treatment on the gray level image; and according to the processed gray level image, cerebral hemorrhage focus detection and hemorrhage amount calculation are realized. Therefore, the invention can improve the efficiency and accuracy of cerebral hemorrhage diagnosis and treatment.

title: Training method and device for constructing network model based on functional magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: Training methods and apparatus, computer devices, and storage media for constructing network models based on fMRI are disclosed. The training method for constructing the network model based on the fMRI comprises the following steps: sampling and pre-processing raw functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) image data; establishing a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model; creating a first training data set, wherein the first training data set comprises pre-processed fMRI image segments; training a CNN model by using a first training data set in a first stage and outputting a classification result; creating a second training data set, wherein the second training data set is the fMRI image segment with the smallest loss value in the first training data set; and in the second stage, the second test data set is used for training the CNN model and outputting a classification result.

title: Reconstruction method of organ vessel centerline
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of producing a 3D centerline of an organ vessel from a plurality of 2D x-ray images. The method comprises the steps of producing a point-cloud of 3D points which represent intersecting and non-intersecting points between projection lines from the 2D images to their respective x-ray sources; fitting a compound curve to the points in the point-cloud of 3D points; removing outliers from the point-cloud; fitting a new compound curve to the remaining points in the point-cloud of 3D points; and repeating certain steps, wherein the resultant compound curve represents the 3D centerline of the organ vessel. The method minimizes reconstruction errors and produces an optimally-reconstructed 3D vessel skeleton.

title: Context driven data profiling
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods and systems for processing data via a data profiling process. Data profiling can include modifying attributes included in source data and identifying aspects of the source data. The data profiling process can include processing an attribute according to a set of validation rules to validate information included in the attribute. The process can also include processing the attribute according to a set of standardization rules to modify the attribute into a standardized format. The process can also include processing the attribute according to a set of rules engines. The modified attributes can be outputted for further processing. The data profiling process can also include deriving a value score and usage rank of an attribute, which can be used in deriving insights into the source data.

title: Method and apparatus for performing dynamic respiratory classification and tracking of wheeze and crackle
abstract: A method for detecting wheeze from an audio respiratory signal comprises capturing the audio respiratory signal from a subject using a microphone. Further, the method comprises recognizing a plurality of breath cycles and a plurality of breath phases from the audio respiratory signal and detecting wheezing from the plurality of breath cycles and the plurality of breath phases. The detecting comprises analyzing a block of interest in the audio respiratory signal, wherein the block of interest comprises a plurality of frames. The detecting further comprises calculating an auto-correlation function (ACF) for each frame in the block and determining a maximum value of the ACF calculated for each frame in the block. Finally, the detecting comprises analyzing the maximum value to detect if wheezing is present in the block.

title: Predicting clinical parameters from fluid volumes determined from OCT imaging
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for evaluating an eye using retinal fluid volumes to provide a clinical parameter. An optical coherence tomography (OCT) image of an eye of a patient is obtained. The OCT image is segmented to produce a total retinal volume and one or both of a subretinal fluid volume and an intraretinal fluid volume for a region of interest within the eye. A metric is generated as a function of the total retinal volume and one or both of the subretinal fluid volume and the intraretinal fluid volume. A clinical parameter for the patient is determined from the metric. The determined clinical parameter is provided to a user at a display.

title: Medical image registration system and method for surgical navigation
assignee: 苏州寻是科技有限公司, 青岛大学附属医院
abstract: A medical image registration system and method for surgical navigation, the registration system includes a structured light camera module, an infrared camera and a computing center; the structured light camera module comprises a structured light camera and an infrared reflecting tool which are fixedly connected; the infrared light reflecting tool comprises at least three non-collinear light reflecting points; the infrared camera is arranged corresponding to the structured light camera module, and each reflecting point of the infrared reflecting tool is positioned in the shooting range of the infrared camera; the computing center is in communication with the structured light camera and the infrared camera. The registration method comprises the following steps: 1. extracting three-dimensional image feature points of the head of a patient through the preoperative medical image; 2. acquiring point cloud data comprising a head outline of a patient through a structured light camera; 3. extracting three-dimensional characteristic points of the point cloud based on the obtained point cloud data; 4. and matching the three-dimensional image characteristic points with the three-dimensional point cloud characteristic points to realize the registration of the image space of the patient before operation and the real space position of the patient in operation. The invention has fast and accurate registration, and saves the cost of the mechanical arm and the occupied space.

primary_assignee: 苏州寻是科技有限公司

title: Preserving temporal relevance in a response to a query
abstract: A method, system and computer-usable medium are disclosed for preserving temporal relevance in a response to a query. A query is processed to extract first temporal features, which is then used to identify first documents within a corpus. The first documents are processed to generate first metadata and mined content, which is processed with the first temporal features to generate second documents having second temporal features corresponding to the first temporal features. The corpus is updated with new documents and revisions to the first documents to generate second documents. In turn, the second documents are processed to generate second metadata and mined content, which is then used to generate a ranked list of temporally-relevant documents.

title: System for extracting header labels for header cells in tables having complex header structures
abstract: A method, system and computer-usable medium are disclosed for associating data cells with headers and header labels. In certain embodiments, a table having rows and columns is received, wherein the table includes a plurality of cells, wherein each cell is populated with at least one of a header name, data value, or no information. A determination is made as to whether a cell is a header cell or data cell. If the cell is a header cell, current list of column and current list of row headers are dynamically updated. The current list of column and row headers are assigned to the cell regardless of whether the cell is a header cell or data cell. Headers associated with header cells are used to identify label candidates for the header name of the header cell. The labels may be used to provide additional context for headers within a data cell.

title: Single-disease clinical path construction method and system based on bidirectional GRUs
assignee: 南昌大学第二附属医院
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for constructing a single clinical path based on bidirectional GRUs, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source heterogeneous medical data of a single disease species to be constructed, and preprocessing the medical data by utilizing machine learning; structuring the medical data according to the data structure of the IP protocol message to obtain a first type path node set; classifying, extracting features and clustering the first class path nodes through a topic LDA algorithm to obtain a second class path node set; and taking the second class path node set as the input of a bidirectional GRUs and a capsule network, and training the bidirectional GRUs and the capsule network to obtain a third class path node. The invention utilizes IP protocol message to structure medical data, then utilizes topic LDA to extract characteristics, and finally utilizes two-way GRUs and capsule network to generate clinical path, so that the clinical path has consistency, time sequence and variability and strong interpretation.
assignee_clean: 南昌大学第二附属医院
primary_assignee: 南昌大学第二附属医院

title: Method and device for determining customer service call cluster
assignee: 支付宝(杭州)信息技术有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the present description provide a method and apparatus for determining a customer service technology cluster. In the method, a candidate customer service technology set is determined from an artificial customer service data set, a plurality of business technology sets respectively aiming at different business types are screened from the candidate customer service technology set by using a business technology screening model, and at least one customer service technology cluster is determined from the business technology set by using a semantic model, so that reference can be provided for the same or similar user problems encountered in the process of carrying out business service by customer service.
assignee_clean: 支付宝 杭州 信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 支付宝 杭州 信息技术有限公司

title: Methods and systems for registering images for electronic designs
assignee: Center for Deep Learning in Electronics Mfg., Inc.
abstract: Methods for training a convolutional neural network to register images for electronic designs include inputting a first pair of images aligned in a first modality and a second pair of images aligned in a second modality. An affine transformation is generated with a convolutional neural network, using one image from the first pair of images and one image from the second pair of images. The one image from the first pair of images is in the first modality and the one image from the second pair of images is in the second modality. Methods for registering images for electronic designs include inputting a pair of images, wherein the pair of images comprises a computer aided design (CAD) image and a scanning electron microscope (SEM) image. The CAD image is registered to the SEM image, using a trained convolutional neural network. The trained convolutional neural network further comprises an affine transformation.

title: Electronic device and method for controlling same
abstract: An electronic device and a method for controlling the same are disclosed. The method for controlling an electronic device according to the present disclosure comprises the steps of: detecting at least one user and acquiring user information of the detected at least one user; determining a user mode on the basis of the acquired user information; determining a service to be provided to the detected at least one user, by inputting the user information and the determined user mode as input data to a model learned by an artificial intelligence algorithm; and providing the determined service corresponding to the user mode. A method for providing the service by the electronic device may at least partially use an artificial intelligence model learned according to at least one of machine learning, neural network, and deep learning algorithms.

title: Three-dimensional electrical impedance imaging system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional electrical impedance imaging system based on deep learning, which comprises: the sensor module, the data acquisition control module and the upper computer module are connected in sequence; the sensor module is used for forming a sensitive field of a measured area space; the data acquisition control module is used for measuring the surface impedance of the measured area, and performing primary processing and transmission of data; and the upper computer module is used for reconstructing an image according to the processed impedance data. The invention provides a three-dimensional electrical impedance imaging system based on deep learning, which can be used for human breast imaging, can obtain three-dimensional surface impedance information of a hemispherical measurement region through a certain excitation acquisition mode, and is used for conductivity distribution reconstruction of a three-dimensional hemispherical region by utilizing the electrical characteristic difference of breast tissues and cancer tissues.

title: Context-aware respiration rate determination using an electronic device
abstract: A method for contextually aware determination of respiration includes obtaining, by an electronic device, context information and selecting, by the electronic device, a set of sensor data associated with respiratory activity of a subject, based on the context information. The method further includes selecting, based on the selected set of sensor data, an algorithm from a plurality of algorithms for determining a respiration rate of the subject, and determining, by applying the selected algorithm to the selected set of sensor data associated with respiratory activity of the subject, the respiration rate for the subject.

title: Method and system for providing result of prospect of cancer treatment
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and system for providing a result of prospect of cancer treatment using an artificial intelligent network for a user to understand the most appropriate cancer treatment, by providing prospect of cancer treatment that meets the conditions required by the user among various types of cancer and methods of treatment by data mining technique. The method and the system for providing a result of prospect of cancer treatment using an artificial intelligent network comprises the steps of: constructing a semantic database dictionary by collecting and data mining cancer treatment literature information; when at least one of a treatment area, a treatment method, a side effect type, and patient condition information is input as input information, building a treatment prediction model based on the input information and the constructed semantic database dictionary; and providing result information corresponding to the input information based on the treatment prediction model.

title: Embryo tissue segmentation method based on generation of confrontation network
abstract: The invention relates to an embryonic tissue segmentation method based on a generation countermeasure network, and belongs to the technical field of medical image processing. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, performing tissue segmentation mask mapping on an embryo tissue slice image through a U-net network; step 2, making a segmentation network training set; step 3, configuring parameters required by network training to obtain a set network; step 4, using the tissue quality recognition network after the training setting of the manufactured segmentation network training set; step 5, fixing the parameters of the tissue quality recognition network, and using the manufactured segmentation network training set combined with the U-net network set by the tissue quality recognition network training; and 6, taking the embryonic tissue slice image without the marked segmentation result as input to generate a corresponding mask image. The segmentation method depends on that a classification model is used for compensating loss during training and segmentation of the network, so that the information of the cell growth state is fully utilized, and the accuracy of the segmentation network in the field of embryo tissue segmentation is improved.

title: Surgical instrument image intelligent segmentation method and system based on multi-scale feature fusion
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent surgical instrument image segmentation method and system based on multi-scale feature fusion, and relates to the field of surgical instrument image segmentation. The invention firstly builds a lightweight network architecture for multi-scale feature fusion, comprising a pre-trained encoder and decoder. The preprocessing is carried out to obtain a first convolution neural sub-network of a high-resolution image input encoder, and a second convolution neural sub-network of a low-resolution image input encoder, so as to obtain large-scale image characteristic information and small-scale image characteristic information respectively; fusing large-scale image characteristic information and small-scale image characteristic information with the same dimension by adopting a cascading mode; and inputting the final image characteristic information into a decoder, and connecting each fusion characteristic information layer to each decoding unit to perform up-sampling operation to obtain the intelligent segmentation result of the surgical instrument image. Compared with the traditional deep learning method, the obtained surgical instrument image segmentation result has higher accuracy, and the reasoning time of the model is reduced.

title: Evaluation optimization method and system of neural network model
assignee: 清华大学深圳研究生院
abstract: The invention provides an evaluation optimization method and system of a neural network model. The method comprises the following steps: selecting data with training value based on uncertainty indexes through active learning, wherein the uncertainty indexes are used for reflecting the classification capability of a trained neural network model on the data; constructing a test set based on the selected data and obtaining an effectiveness evaluation result of the neural network model by using the test set; and optimizing a training sample set of the neural network model and updating the neural network model according to the effectiveness evaluation result until a desired neural network model is obtained. The method and the system can adapt to the individual requirements of the neural network model and are easier to supervise.
assignee_clean: 清华大学深圳研究生院
primary_assignee: 清华大学深圳研究生院

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing optimized network resources
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing optimization of network resources. The system is operable to monitor the electromagnetic environment, analyze the electromagnetic environment, and extract environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment. The system extracts the environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment by including customer goals. The system is operable to use the environmental awareness with the customer goals and/or user defined policies and rules to extract actionable information to help the customer optimize the network resources.

title: Method for design of insoles
abstract: The invention provides an algorithm-driven method that uses a set of mathematical techniques and numerical procedures to carry out an automatic design for therapeutic insoles. Objectives of the invention include relieving soft tissue overpressure, aligning bone segments and redistributing loads located in specific zones of the foot.

title: Leopard-shaped eye fundus image recognition method, model training method and device
assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a leopard streak fundus image identification method, a model training method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fundus image, classifying the fundus image by using a machine learning model to obtain a classification result, and the classification result is used for representing the significance degree of leopard streak features of the fundus image.
assignee_clean: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司

title: Artificial intelligence and digital twinning system and method for intelligent clothes
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence and digital twinning system and method for intelligent clothes, wherein the system comprises an intelligent clothes module and a digital twinning module; the intelligent clothing module comprises clothing, a sensor module and a wireless communication module and is used for acquiring user data and performing data interaction with the digital twin module; the digital twin module comprises a deep learning algorithm module, a digital twin body module and a cloud server module, the cloud server module judges and stores the current state of the user by using the deep learning algorithm, the user entity is mapped to the digital twin body by using a digital twin technology to be displayed and interacted in real time, and when the user is detected to be in danger, the cloud server module automatically warns. The invention innovatively combines an intelligent wearing technology, an artificial intelligence technology and a digital twin technology, obtains more comprehensive user data, accurately judges the user state, can record and analyze the current state of the user in real time and take corresponding measures when the user encounters danger, and effectively ensures the life safety of the user.

title: System for monitoring a medical procedure and system for monitoring a medical device
assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to a system for monitoring a medical procedure and a system for monitoring a medical device. A system for monitoring a medical procedure comprising: a medical device configured for insertion into the vasculature of a patient; a plurality of electrodes coupled with a medical device; and a monitoring module electrically coupled with the plurality of electrodes. The monitoring module is configured to: transmitting an electrical signal between the first electrode and the second electrode; determining an electrical impedance between the first electrode and the second electrode; and providing a notification to an operator when the determined electrical impedance is outside the predefined impedance range.
assignee_clean: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司

title: Target surface reconstruction method, device, equipment and medium based on three-dimensional image
assignee: 武汉联影智融医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a target surface reconstruction method, device, equipment and medium based on three-dimensional images. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial three-dimensional image data, and dividing a target in the initial three-dimensional image data to obtain a division mask; processing the segmentation mask to obtain a target contour; and carrying out surface reconstruction on the initial three-dimensional image data based on the target contour to obtain surface reconstruction data of the target. The application also relates to a target surface reconstruction method based on the three-dimensional image, which comprises the following steps: obtaining surface reconstruction data of the target based on the foregoing method; carrying out surface reconstruction on the segmentation mask to obtain initial reconstruction data; and obtaining final surface reconstruction data of the target according to the initial reconstruction data and the surface reconstruction data of the target. The reconstruction accuracy can be improved by adopting the method.

title: Systems and methods for capturing deep learning training data from imaging systems
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for capturing deep learning training data from imaging systems. In one embodiment, a method for an imaging system comprises performing a scan of a subject to acquire imaging data, inputting the imaging data to a deep neural network, displaying an output of the deep neural network and an image reconstructed from the imaging data, and transmitting an intermediate representation of the imaging data generated by the deep neural network to a server for training a central deep neural network. In this way, imaging data may be leveraged for training and developing global deep learning models without transmitting the imaging data itself, thereby preserving patient privacy.

title: Fusion reasoning and learning decision classification method for liquid-based cytology examination
abstract: The invention discloses a liquid-based cytology examination-oriented fusion reasoning and learning decision classification method, which comprises the following steps: 1) Data and ontology preparation: constructing a data set for a decision target and an ontology related to the data, extracting a plurality of associated data features between the data set and the ontology, and taking the data set and the ontology as sub-features of target features; 2) Neural network and rule construction: training a neural network set comprising a target feature cluster and a plurality of sub-feature classifiers to construct a decision target related reasoning rule; 3) Knowledge reasoning and neural network fusion: and integrating knowledge reasoning and machine learning, realizing a knowledge rule reasoning and reasoning result supporting machine learning results, combining an evolution method of the machine learning results, and analyzing and processing the results. The invention combines two approaches of knowledge reasoning and machine learning, improves the classification accuracy, simultaneously ensures that the result has interpretability through an evolution method, and gradually improves the reliability of the result.

title: Department diagnosis guiding method, device and equipment
assignee: 清华大学, 科大讯飞股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a department diagnosis guiding method, a device and equipment. The design basis is 1) that the patient can conduct department diagnosis inquiry autonomously and self-help without configuring a great deal of medical manpower. 2) When the self-help query is carried out autonomously, the problem of two dimensions is overcome, and the trouble of professional medical information is removed from the aspect of patients; from the self-service system perspective, the recognition and analysis capability of fuzzy query information input by non-professional patients needs to be improved. Therefore, the main scheme provided by the invention is that the primary department identification and text validity judgment are firstly carried out on the input consultation text, the department recommendation or illegal consultation input advance treatment can be directly carried out, and further, the effective condition description which cannot be directly recommended to the department is deeply analyzed by adopting a double-strategy combination mode of text classification and key information retrieval, so that an accurate and reliable recommended consultation department is provided, a patient is guided to smoothly visit a doctor, and the pressure of hospital consultation guiding consultation is relieved.
assignee_clean: 清华大学; 科大讯飞股份有限公司

title: Method for delivering a digital therapy responsive to a user's physiological state at a sensory immersion vessel
abstract: One variation of a method for delivering a digital medicine experience to a user includes: loading the digital medicine experience at a sensory immersion vessel; calculating a target value of a bioindicator of the physiological state of the user, the target value of the bioindicator corresponding to a target physiological state of the user; at an initial time, rendering sensory representations of a set of elements in a multi-sensory virtual environment within the sensory immersion vessel at an initial progression rate; at a time during the digital medicine experience, succeeding the initial time, measuring a value of the bioindicator; calculating a progression rate through the digital medicine experience based on a difference between the value of the bioindicator and the target value of the bioindicator; and at a second time succeeding the time, rendering sensory representations of the set of elements in the multi-sensory virtual environment at the progression rate.

title: Color analysis and control using a transparent display screen on a mobile device with non-transparent, bendable display screen or multiple display screen with 3D sensor for telemedicine diagnosis and treatment
abstract: The present disclosure relates to mobile electronic devices including at least one transparent display screen for color analysis and control relating to medical conditions using an electronic mobile device have a transparent display screen and a non-transparent display screen, bendable display screen and multiple screen device with 3D sensor used as telemedicine device. Color data for a perceived color stores in a memory and displays images as perceived through the transparent display screen. Image difference values are determined between a first set of optical processing data and a second set of optical processing data. The transparent display screen indicates image difference values from including differences in color, texture, transparency, lighting, etc., especially for augmented reality applications.

title: System and method to improve video conferencing using presence metrics
abstract: A system and method of image analytics, computer vision focused on monitoring specific virtual presence metrics will provide each individual user with consistent progress reports and live feedback during video meetings. Machine learning and AI are leveraged to provide professionals with feedback and coaching according to virtual presence metrics in order to develop a new skill set through and elevate the user's virtual presence. Pre-trained machine learning models combined with the founders own thought leadership in nonverbal communication, presence and body language assists in assessing posture, gesture, eye contact, filler words and speech metrics, sentiment analysis and other presence and communication features.

title: Method and image processor for evaluating a contrast agent-enhanced magnetic resonance slice image of a heart
abstract: In a method and processor for evaluating a contrast agent-enhanced two-dimensional magnetic resonance slice image of a heart of a patient in order to determine picture elements revealing contrast agent deposits in the myocardium, an endocardium contour in the magnetic resonance slice image, taking into consideration deposition information describing picture elements potentially revealing contrast agent deposits and determined by image analysis on the basis of a shape assumption for the heart structure that is to be examined, in particular the left ventricle, such that picture elements potentially revealing contrast agent deposits are avoided as much as possible as a contour component. An epicardium contour enclosing the endocardium contour is then determined. Picture elements are marked that indicate contrast agent enhancement in the myocardium lying between the epicardium contour and the endocardium contour as contrast agent deposit.

title: Learning-based aorta segmentation using an adaptive detach and merge algorithm
abstract: Systems and methods for segmenting a structure of interest in medical imaging data include generating a binary mask highlighting structures in medical imaging data, the highlighted structures comprising a connected component including a structure of interest. A probability map is computed by classifying voxels in the highlighted structures using a trained classifier. A plurality of detaching operations is performed on the highlighted structures to split the connected component into a plurality of detached connected components. An optimal detaching parameter is determined representing a number of the detaching operations. A detached connected component resulting from performing the number of detaching operations corresponding to the optimal detaching parameter is classified as the structure of interest based on the probability map and the trained classifier.

title: Epileptic zone positioning device and method based on electroencephalogram, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
abstract: The disclosure relates to an electroencephalogram-based epileptic zone positioning device and method, an electronic device and a storage medium. The epileptogenic area positioning device based on the electroencephalogram comprises: the device comprises an electrode contact positioning module, a high-frequency oscillation distribution area positioning module, an epilepsy initiation area positioning module, an evoked potential abnormal area positioning module and an epilepsy causing area positioning module. The device firstly obtains the accurate position of the deep electrode according to the MRI image and the CT image, and on the basis, the final location of the epileptogenic area is determined through the combination of a high-frequency oscillation release area obtained during the epileptic seizure interval, an epileptic initiation area obtained during the seizure period and an evoked potential abnormal area obtained from the cortex-cortex evoked potential during the epileptic seizure interval. In the process, the accuracy and the stability of epileptogenic area positioning are improved by the accurate positioning of the deep electrode and the common positioning of a plurality of epileptic related areas, and meanwhile, the clinical work efficiency is improved because a large amount of electroencephalogram original data in an electroencephalogram do not need to be manually interpreted.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院

title: Semi-supervised heart semantic segmentation algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a semi-supervised heart semantic segmentation algorithm, which overcomes the defect of scarcity of existing marked heart data and realizes accurate semi-supervised heart semantic segmentation. The method uses coarse-granularity feature extraction branches and fine-granularity feature extraction branches respectively, and combines network structures of Unet and Swin-Unet to realize semi-supervised cardiac semantic segmentation. In the structure, the coarse-granularity feature extraction branch adopts a Swin-Unet framework to extract global feature information. And the fine-granularity feature extraction branch adopts local convolution operation of the Unet to realize feature information extraction of the local area. Thereby by evaluating on the acquired cardiac nmr dataset. Experimental data and visual results prove that the proposed semi-supervised framework can realize rapid and accurate segmentation of tumor areas, and is high in accuracy and automation degree. Therefore, the method is suitable for popularization and application.

title: GPT-based hip joint lesion intelligent diagnosis method, device and equipment
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The application provides a GPT-based intelligent diagnosis method, device and equipment for hip joint pathology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting a hip joint image to be diagnosed into a pre-trained first coding network model to obtain image coding information output by the first coding network model, wherein the first coding network model is constructed by a Swin transform model; inputting the image coding information into a trimmed language model GPT to obtain intelligent diagnosis information output by the language model GPT; the first coding network model is trained based on a target sample image and target sample information, and the language model GPT is finely tuned based on the target sample image and the target sample information. In the method, the hip joint image is encoded into the image encoding information which can be identified by the GPT through the encoding network model constructed based on the Swin transform model, so that the problem that the GPT is difficult to process the hip joint image information is solved.
assignee_clean: 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司; 张逸凌

title: System and method for providing a social media shopping experience
abstract: Disclosed are a system and process of providing social networking purchasing processes. A method includes receiving, from a posting entity and at the social networking entity, a posting or a submission of a text, an image or a video. When the submission is associated with a product within a product catalog of the posting entity, the social networking entity presents in a newsfeed of users or otherwise on the social networking entity, the text, image or video with an associated option to buy. The option to buy might be presented through a messenger application or as the user browses the posting. When there is a correlation between the posting and the product catalog, and when the user makes a purchase of the product, the user is not transitioned away from the social networking entity. Initiating a payment process occurs within the social networking entity.

title: Automatic identification method and system for updated content of clinical guideline
assignee: 中国医学科学院医学信息研究所
abstract: The invention provides an automatic identification method and system for updating content of clinical guideline, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to a module hierarchical structure tree established by utilizing each level of title of the clinical guideline in advance, respectively analyzing and structurally extracting a first clinical guideline and a second clinical guideline to at least obtain a first guideline module corresponding to the first clinical guideline and a second guideline module corresponding to the second clinical guideline; and determining difference information between the first guide module and the second guide module, marking corresponding labels at positions corresponding to the difference information in the first clinical guide and the second clinical guide respectively, and manually consulting the two clinical guides to be compared to find differences and changes among different clinical guides, so that the efficiency and accuracy of determining the differences and changes among different clinical guides are improved.
assignee_clean: 中国医学科学院医学信息研究所
primary_assignee: 中国医学科学院医学信息研究所

title: System and methods for updating patient registration during surface trace acquisition
abstract: A surgical navigation system and method for identifying positions on a patient, including a processor, and a tracking system for tracking a pointer tool. The processor is programmed to initialize a surface trace acquisition, continuously record the positions of the pointer tool during the surface, conduct trace acquisition, combine the positions recorded during the surface trace acquisition into a surface trace, receive a patient image of the patient, extract a surface from the patient image, compute a registration transform between the surface traces and the surface for patient registration, segment the patient image into a regions where each region contains an anatomical landmark, determine a spatial distribution of surface traces among the regions; determine whether the spatial distribution in relation to each region minimizes deviance below a threshold, and if the determination is exceeding the threshold, provide information relating to such region.

title: System and method for providing a social media shopping experience
abstract: Disclosed are a system and process of providing social networking purchasing processes. A method includes receiving, from a posting entity and at the social networking entity, a posting or a submission of a text, an image or a video. When the submission is associated with a product within a product catalog of the posting entity, the social networking entity presents in a newsfeed of users or otherwise on the social networking entity, the text, image or video with an associated option to buy. The option to buy might be presented through a messenger application or as the user browses the posting. When there is a correlation between the posting and the product catalog, and when the user makes a purchase of the product, the user is not transitioned away from the social networking entity. Initiating a payment process occurs within the social networking entity.

title: Deep learning for targeted password generation with cognitive user information understanding
abstract: An approach is provided that receives a set of user information pertaining to a user. The received set of information is encoded into a neural network and the neural network is trained using the encoded user information. As an output of the trained neural network, passwords corresponding to the user are generated.

title: Methods for robotic assistance and navigation in spinal surgery and related systems
abstract: A surgical navigation system is provided to create a plan to correct a deformed spinal alignment. A processor is configured to obtain a first set of image data associated with a deformed alignment in a spine of a patient from at least one imaging device. The processor is also configured to process the first set of image data to identify a set of deformed alignment parameters associated with the deformed alignment. The processor is further configured to identify a set of corrected alignment parameters. The processor is also configured to process the first set of image data, the set of deformed alignment parameters, and the set of corrected alignment parameters to generate a correction plan to surgically manipulate the deformed alignment to the preferred alignment. The processor is additionally configured to provide navigation through the correction plan to facilitate surgical manipulation of a patient spine to the preferred alignment. The processor is also configured to receive information relating to forces on a rod-link reducer or surgical implants from strain gauges to aid the correction plan.

title: Improved random forest model for coronary heart disease pre-diagnosis and pre-diagnosis system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an improved random forest model for coronary heart disease pre-diagnosis and a pre-diagnosis system thereof, which are used for screening hundreds of indexes used in clinical examination of coronary heart disease patients based on feature selection and a statistical machine learning algorithm, establishing a model with high prediction accuracy, being capable of being used as a basis for whether coronary angiography is carried out or not, calculating the current risk of coronary heart disease of the patient by combining clinical examination indexes, image detection results and patient electronic medical record information, and providing an evaluation basis for follow-up diagnosis.

title: Body-worn thermometry solutions
abstract: An example system includes a patch defining a first surface and a second surface opposite the first surface. The first surface is removably attachable to skin of a subject. The patch includes a conductor associated with the first surface, a first sensor configured to determine a temperature of the conductor, and a second sensor configured to determine an additional temperature. The first sensor is separated from the second sensor by material having a known thermal resistance. The patch also includes a transmitter operably connected to the first and second sensors.

title: Systems and methods for correction of position of focal point
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: Systems and methods for determining an offset of a position of a focal point of an X-ray tube is provided. The methods may include obtaining at least one parameter associated with an X-ray tube during a scan of a subject. The methods may further include determining a target offset of a position of a focal point based on the at least one parameter and a target relationship between a plurality of reference parameters associated with the X-ray tube and a plurality of reference offsets of reference positions of the focal point. The methods may further include causing, based on the target offset, a correction on the position of the focal point of the X-ray tube.

title: Application program updating method and system
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司, 泰康养老保险股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for updating an application program, wherein a specific implementation mode of the method comprises the steps that a cloud center acquires a service request event, identifies a service type, acquires front-end processor information corresponding to the service type according to a preset front-end processor mapping table, and encrypts a configuration file in the service request event by utilizing a front-end processor public key so as to send the encrypted configuration file to a corresponding front-end processor through a configuration chain; wherein, each front-end processor in cloud center and block chain node is associated through corresponding configuration chain; the front-end processor decrypts the encrypted configuration file based on the private key, and then sets the decrypted configuration file into the application program to update the application program. Therefore, the method and the device can solve the problems of high cost and low efficiency of the localization deployment of the existing project.
