primary_assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司

title: Medical information labeling method, system, intelligent terminal and storage medium
assignee: 深圳度影医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical information labeling method, a medical information labeling system, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the medical information labeling method comprises the following steps: setting a configuration file according to the labeling scene; the medical information of various types and various formats can be read; performing personalized labeling processing on the medical information according to the configuration file, and outputting a labeling file; encrypting the labeling file and outputting an encrypted file; storing the encrypted file to the selected folder. The method and the device are compatible with different types of labels among different data types by optimizing the labeling flow, realize coexistence of the data types and the label types in the maximum range, and can simultaneously process a plurality of label types, thereby realizing functional diversification of labels, increasing flexibility of labels and improving convenience of labeling of users.
assignee_clean: 深圳度影医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳度影医疗科技有限公司

title: Automatic feature engineering during online scoring phase
abstract: Embodiments for intelligent automated feature engineering for relational data in a computing environment by a processor. Indices may be automatically selected and built from one or more columns of one or more tables in a relational database using one or more automated feature engineering models that include a set of queries. One or more features may be determined using a set of queries of an automated feature engineering models to execute for a scoring operation.

title: Multimodal safety systems and methods
abstract: Multimodal systems are provided for managing safety in an industrial environment. The system comprises: (a) a computer vision component for generating a first output data; (b) a real-time locating component for generating a second output data about an object within the industrial environment and a mobile tag device deployed to the object; (c) a LIDAR component for generating a third output data; and (d) an edge computing device connected to the computer vision component, the real-time locating component and the LIDAR component via a local network, and is configured to: (i) receive a data stream including the first output data, the second output data and the third output data, (ii) process the data stream using a machine learning algorithm trained model to generate a safety related result and feedback data, and (iii) deliver the feedback data to the object via the mobile tag device.

title: Collecting application crashes on resource-constrained devices
abstract: The subject matter of this specification can be implemented in, among other things, a method for crash reporting for resource-constrained devices. The method includes a step for accessing one or more rules for crash data management upon an application crash on a resource-constrained device. The one or more accessed rules take into account at least one resource constraint of the resource-constrained device. The method also includes a step for collecting crash data and communicating the crash data to a crash report management system. Either or both the collecting or the communicating of the crash data is based on the one or more accessed rules.

title: Statistics collection for lesion segmentation
abstract: A method of collecting information regarding an anatomical object of interest includes displaying an image characterized by a first region and a second region, wherein the first and second regions are mutually exclusive and the object is displayed within the second region, selecting first and second points spanning the object in the displayed image, at least one of the points being within the first region, and extracting a plurality of statistical values from image voxels, lying on a line segment between the first and second points, that correspond to the object.

title: Fundus image segmentation model training method and device
assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a fundus image segmentation model training method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first segmentation model and a second segmentation model which are pre-trained; segmenting the fundus image in the training data using the first segmentation model and a second segmentation model, respectively, wherein the first segmentation model outputs first confidence information about the first object of interest and the second segmentation model outputs second confidence information about the first object of interest and the second object of interest; obtaining integrated confidence information according to the first confidence information and the second confidence information; and optimizing parameters of the second segmentation model according to a loss function constructed by the integrated confidence information, the second confidence, the labeling data and a segmentation result determined by the second confidence.
assignee_clean: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司

title: Generating saliency masks for inputs of models using saliency metric
abstract: An example system includes a processor to receive an input and a model trained to classify inputs. The processor is to iteratively generate a perturbed input that optimizes a saliency metric including a classification term, a sparsity term, and a smoothness term, while keeping parameters of the model constant. The processor is to also detect that a predefined number of iterations is exceeded or a convergence of values of the perturbed input. The processor is to further generate a saliency mask based on a perturbation of the perturbed input in response to detecting the predefined number of iterations is exceeded or the convergence.

title: Incident response system
abstract: Systems and methods for responding to incidents in a building are provided. One method includes performing operations including retrieving data relating to one or more on-premises building devices of the building, determining the incident relating to the one or more on-premises building devices, and determining a plurality of potential responses to the incident. The operations further include analyzing the plurality of potential responses and determining relative risks of the potential responses to the incident and transmitting, to a first on-premises building device of the on-premises building devices, data indicating the incident and at least one of the plurality of potential responses based on the relative risks of the potential responses.

title: Training method, segmentation device, and medium for segmentation learning network of 3D image
assignee: 深圳科亚医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a training method, a segmentation apparatus, and a medium for a segmentation learning network of a 3D image. The 3D image contains an object of interest and the proportion of the object of interest occupied therein is below a predetermined threshold, the training method comprising: constructing a segmentation learning network based on sequential union of a plurality of dense blocks, wherein dense connections are arranged among basic units in the dense blocks, and the basic units consist of a batch normalization layer, a RELU layer and a convolution layer; training, by a processor, a segmentation learning network with a loss function based on a training dataset of the 3D image, the loss function paying more attention to difficult samples and penalizing negative voxels far away from the object of interest. The irregular and small object of interest can be quickly and accurately segmented by the learning network which is more compact in structure and less in parameters, the unbalance problem of the sample and the foreground background can be solved in the training process of the learning network, and the overfitting problem caused by lack of the training sample is avoided as much as possible.
assignee_clean: 深圳科亚医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳科亚医疗科技有限公司

title: It is a kind of based on bracing wire driving and mirror image synchronization simulation can autonomous rehabilitation training hand ectoskeleton
assignee: 南京拓步智能科技有限公司
abstract: The utility model discloses a kind of based on bracing wire driving and mirror image synchronization simulation can autonomous rehabilitation training hand ectoskeleton, hemiplegic patient and the impaired patient for needing hand rehabilitation training of kinesitherapy nerve can be helped to carry out the rehabilitation training of hand.This hand ectoskeleton is different from traditional rigid body manipulator, also different from pneumatic type software manipulator.It is made of active hand ectoskeleton and mirror hand ectoskeleton, and overall structure is made of cartilage formula elastic material and small electrical unit, control circuit, measuring circuit, Bending Deformation sensor and wireless module.Hemiplegic patient can proper motion hand wearing active hand ectoskeleton when taking exercises, mirror hand ectoskeleton is driven by motor and bracing wire, cooperates elastic material, and mirror image simulates the movement of normal hand, to carry out rehabilitation training to disabled hand.This hand ectoskeleton not only promotes crippled hand to do mirror image rehabilitation exercise, but also can be driven by patient's sense of independence, its kinesitherapy nerve of training has more obvious advantage compared to Traditional Rehabilitation manipulator.
assignee_clean: 南京拓步智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 南京拓步智能科技有限公司

title: Enhanced residual error cascade network model for magnetic resonance undersampling imaging
abstract: An enhanced residual error cascade network model for magnetic resonance undersampling imaging. The invention provides a reinforced residual error cascade network model, wherein a network takes a densely connected recursion unit as a memory module for learning bottom layer characteristic information, and then uses the dense connection between the memory modules as a long memory connection for learning high layer characteristic information. Compared with the simple network cascade, the cascade method of the local dense connection and the global dense connection can better learn multilevel characteristic information and build a deeper network structure. The cascade deep neural network is constructed by combining the residual error network and the dense connection mode, so that better stability is provided for the training of the deeper neural network, and the network performance is improved. In addition, the network of the invention is added with a data consistency module and a high-frequency characteristic guide module for strengthening, thereby further improving the confidence of the reconstruction result and the reconstruction effect of the texture detail characteristic.

title: Tracking a digital diet for targeted advertisement delivery
abstract: The present invention comprises of receiving a text input comprising message content from an electronic computing device associated with a user; parsing the message content comprised in the text input for emotionally-charged language; assigning a sentiment value, based on the emotionally-charged language, from a dynamic sentiment value spectrum to the text input; and, based on the sentiment value, imposing a sentiment vector, corresponding to the assigned sentiment value, to the text input, the imposed sentiment vector rendering a sensory effect on the message content designed to convey a corresponding sentiment.

title: Wireless laparoscopic device with gimballed camera
abstract: A laparoscopic imaging apparatus has a shaft having a proximal end opposite a distal end, wherein the proximal end is configured for attachment to an actuator, wherein a longitudinal axis extends through the shaft, between the proximal and distal ends, wherein the distal end is configured for insertion into patient anatomy and for attachment of one or more laparoscopic tools, wherein at least a first laparoscopic tool at the distal end pivots on a first gimbal apparatus that is actuable, from the actuator at the proximal end of the shaft, to rotate the at least the first laparoscopic tool about the longitudinal axis of the shaft and, further, to rotate the at least the first laparoscopic tool about at least a second axis, orthogonal to the longitudinal axis.

title: Image processing apparatus, image processing method, and storage medium
abstract: An image processing apparatus includes: an obtaining unit configured to obtain a first image of an object and a second image of the object; a difference unit configured to obtain a difference image after the first image and the second image are registered; and a change unit configured to perform processing of changing a pixel value in the difference image based on a likelihood calculated using a pixel value in the first image and a pixel value in the second image.

title: Deterrence devices and techniques
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, devices, and computer program products for deterrence techniques are described. A method may include processing data from an outdoor camera. A method may include detecting a person based at least in part on processed data from an outdoor camera. A method may include emitting a sound from an outdoor camera to deter a person in response to detecting the person.

title: Named entity recognition method of Chinese medical record based on word structure
abstract: The invention discloses a named entity recognition method for Chinese medical records based on an iterative expansion convolutional neural network-conditional random field of a character structure, wherein the named entity recognition method comprises the following steps of: 1) extracting feature vectors from bitmaps corresponding to the Chinese characters through a convolutional neural network aiming at a training data set of a group of inquiry sequences and entity tagging sequences; 2) combining the word embedding result with the feature vector output by the convolutional neural network; 3) acquiring a score sequence for each label in the label set through an iterative expansion convolutional neural network and an attention mechanism; 4) and obtaining the result of named entity recognition through a linear chain element random field algorithm. By the method, the Chinese character structure information in the Chinese medical record can be utilized, and the expression of the named entity identification method can be further improved by combining the iterative expansion convolution neural network with the conditional random field algorithm.

title: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for evaluating consultation dialogue quality
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method, an apparatus, a device, and a storage medium for evaluating the quality of a consultation dialogue, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and in particular to the technical field of natural language processing and deep learning. The concrete implementation scheme of the method for evaluating the consultation dialogue quality is as follows: obtaining characteristic information of a consultation dialogue to be processed; based on the characteristic information, a predetermined level classification model is used to determine the quality level of the pending consultation session.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Tissue grasping devices and related methods
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to systems, devices, and methods for supporting, stabilizing, and/or positioning a medical device, such as a transcatheter medical device. The stabilizer allows for control of degrees of freedom from no movement to free movement to selective movements, to substantially translation only movement and/or to substantially rotational only movement of the medical device. The patent describes pure mechanical embodiment as well as smart embodiments that can synergistically sense, actuate and/or transmit data between the stabilizer, medical device and control or display system to operate and/or deploy the device/therapy.

title: Intelligent operation decision system for puncture operation robot and application method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent operation decision system facing a puncture operation robot and an application method thereof, wherein the system comprises: the target human body tissue extraction module is used for carrying out three-dimensional modeling on tissues and organs in a puncture target region according to ultrasonic detection of the puncture target region on a target human body and extracting the target human body organ based on the established model; the puncture needle pose module is used for acquiring the position information and the posture information of a puncture needle of the puncture surgical robot under the current pose based on the motor code value of the puncture surgical robot and the mechanical parameters of the operating platform; and the prediction and decision module is used for predicting the probability of successful puncture next time at the current position and posture of the puncture needle and the puncture position and posture with the maximum probability of successful puncture once based on the position information and posture information of the target human body organ and the puncture needle and the puncture success database. The puncture operation process can be decided and monitored in real time, planning suggestions and decision early warning are carried out, and operation safety is improved.

title: Decentralized computing force perception-based decentralised federal learning framework and modeling method
assignee: 中国科学技术大学苏州高等研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a decentralized federal learning framework based on heterogeneous computing power perception, which comprises a cloud coordinator and a plurality of equipment ends; the cloud coordinator is used for managing, training and generating a parameter updating scheme and backing up a periodic model during operation; the equipment end is used for transmitting equipment information to the cloud coordinator, and the model is operated locally to update parameters of the equipment end; the cloud coordinator obtains that the least common multiple of the one-time training time of the equipment end is an overcycle, the equipment end calculates different step sizes in the overcycle, and the model is aggregated when the minimum common multiple is an integer multiple of the overcycle. Running different local steps according to different computing capacities of the equipment, and reducing negative influence of slow nodes in the model aggregation process; by adopting the distributed point-to-point communication mode, the communication pressure of the central server in the distributed training process can be eliminated under the condition of not increasing the whole communication quantity.
assignee_clean: 中国科学技术大学苏州高等研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学技术大学苏州高等研究院

title: Method for computer-implemented determination of a data-driven prediction model
abstract: Provided is a method for computer-implemented determination of a data-driven prediction model. The method processes digital input data having input and output variables and being semantically annotated based on a digital semantic representation having a hierarchical tree structure where each tree in the structure represents an input variable of the data, the leaf nodes of the respective tree being the discrete values of the input variable. The method of the embodiment provides a recoding of those discrete values by cutting off hierarchical levels of the respective trees. Based on this recoding, a plurality of data modifications is determined for the input data. Those data modifications are trained by a machine learning method where the trained machine learning method with the highest prediction quality is derived from the trained machine learning methods.

title: Noise suppression for wave-CAIPI
assignee: Siemens Healthcare Gmbh, The General Hospital Corporation
abstract: Techniques are disclosed to leverage the use of neural networks or similar machine learning algorithms to de-noise highly accelerated Wave-CAIPIRINHA scans. The described techniques facilitate the generation of 3D sequences using a greatly reduced scan time, with the resulting images having a high spatial resolution and an improved SNR compared to conventional approaches.

title: Wearable non-invasive carbon monoxide inhalation tracking
abstract: Systems and devices of the present disclosure provide automated detection and tracking of carbon monoxide inhalation through non-invasive optical spectroscopy. A wearable device includes a light source coupled to the base and directing light towards a subject and a photodetector coupled to the base to receive light emitted by the light source through or reflected the subject. The light source emits light at a wavelength spectrum corresponding to a carboxyhemoglobin absorption spectrum and an oxyhemoglobin absorption spectrum. Biometric circuitry is coupled to the photodetector to receive a signal from the photodetector and process the signal to determine an intensity of the wavelengths present in the light received at the photodetector. The intensity of the wavelengths is indicative of a level of carbon monoxide inhalation associated with the subject.

title: Electrocardiosignal analysis method and imaging method
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an electrocardiosignal analysis method and an imaging method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting an original electrocardiosignal; carrying out low-pass filtering on the original electrocardiosignal to obtain a filtered electrocardiosignal; judging whether to start search gating or not based on the filtered electrocardiosignals; and searching R waves on the original electrocardiosignal when search gating is started, and determining the positions of the R waves. By adopting the method of controlling by search gating and detecting R wave on the original electrocardiosignal, the interference of high-frequency noise can be weakened, and the problem that the R wave cannot be accurately identified due to signal distortion and output signal delay caused by filtering can be effectively avoided.
assignee_clean: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Blood pressure measuring device
assignee: 精准医电科技股份有限公司
abstract: A wearable device (100) for measuring blood pressure, comprising a housing (195) formed with a through hole, a processing unit (120) disposed within the housing (195), a display (160) connected to the processing unit (120), a plurality of sensors (110) connected to the processing unit (120), the sensors (110) being configured to transmit at least one physiological signal to the processing unit (120) through the through hole, a delay structure connected between one of the plurality of through holes and one of the plurality of sensors (110), and configured to lengthen a path distance between a skin surface and the sensor (110). Wherein the processing unit (120) is configured to determine a systolic arterial pressure and a diastolic arterial pressure from the at least one physiological signal and a Moens-Kortewig (MK) function, and to control a display (160) to display the systolic arterial pressure and the diastolic arterial pressure for reading by a user.

title: Neurophysiological signatures for fibromyalgia
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of Colorado, A Body Corporate
abstract: Described herein are novel fMRI-based neurologic signatures that predict fibromyalgia (FM), clinical severity, and treatment outcomes. Further described are methods for diagnosing FM and for predicting or evaluating efficacy of a treatment of FM based on the neurologic signature.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of colorado; a body corporate
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of colorado

title: Lung cancer leading edge trend prediction method based on multi-label classification
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-label classification-based lung cancer leading edge trend prediction method, which comprises the following steps of: collecting the serial number, title, abstract and publication date of a paper in the lung cancer research field to form a data set; formulating a classification set corresponding to the subject of a paper in the lung cancer research field; marking the collected abstract text according to the category set; preprocessing the text in the data set; dividing a data set into a training set and a verification set according to publication dates of the papers; inputting training samples into a multi-label classification network based on Bert, setting loss functions (loss), reversely transmitting loss values, updating weight parameters, and continuously iterating the training network until the loss values are not reduced any more; and classifying the data of the verification set by using the trained classification network to obtain a classification result. The invention improves the problem that the traditional multi-label algorithm ignores the label correlation; meanwhile, the artificial intelligence technology is combined with medical treatment, and a new idea for predicting the trend in the medical field is provided.

title: Female body intelligent evaluation detection device and method and storage medium
assignee: 中山市人民医院, 广州辉博信息技术有限公司, 华中科技大学
abstract: The invention discloses a female body intelligent evaluation detection device and method, and a storage medium, wherein the female body intelligent evaluation detection method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring the front side and the back side of a human body to be detected and a depth image to be detected in the walking process through a depth camera; acquiring a large number of depth images of the front side, the back side and the walking process of a human body, obtaining sample data of the depth images, establishing a female body shape evaluation model, obtaining a label image of the human body to be detected according to the female body shape evaluation model, and reconstructing morphological analysis calculation of the spine and the pelvis according to the label image of the human body to be detected to obtain a body shape evaluation report of the human body to be detected. The invention can perform non-invasive automatic evaluation on a plurality of key parts of the human body by using the depth camera and matching with the depth learning technology, thereby greatly shortening the inspection time and providing objective and quantized detection results for clinic.
assignee_clean: 中山市人民医院; 广州辉博信息技术有限公司; 华中科技大学

title: Computer aided diagnosis and monitoring of heart failure patients
abstract: A system and computer program are provided for computer aided diagnosis or monitoring of heart failure patients. The system and computer program obtain patient data representing measurements of a select and limited set of health indicators of a patient. A trained classifier is applied to the patient data to obtain a classification of the occurrence or degree of heart failure for the patient. The limited set of health indicators is specifically selected from a large set of health indicators which are known to be predictive of heart failure on the basis of a clinical study which demonstrated the accuracy of the classification using this select set.

title: Method and device for training bill identification model and bill identification
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a method and a device for training a bill recognition model and bill recognition, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning, and can be applied to an image recognition scene. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a training sample set and an initial model; inputting the sample bill image of the selected training sample into a first feature extraction layer to obtain a first feature image; inputting the first feature map into a first head layer to obtain the position of a text frame; inputting the first feature map into a second feature extraction layer to obtain a second feature map; inputting the second feature map into a second head layer to obtain key value pairs; determining a field area corresponding to the key value pair in the selected sample bill image according to the position of the text frame; determining a loss value based on the labeling information and the field region; in response to the loss value being less than a predetermined threshold, the initial model is determined to be a ticket identification model. The method and the device can quickly and accurately extract the field of interest from the bill image.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Auxiliary analysis method and system for neural diagnosis
assignee: 北京智精灵科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an auxiliary analysis method and an auxiliary analysis system for nerve diagnosis. The auxiliary analysis method comprises the following steps: collecting a tissue oxygenation quantifiable value of a brain of a patient by using an fNIRS device; constructing a time domain analysis result by taking time as a reference and constructing a frequency domain analysis result by taking frequency as a reference aiming at the tissue oxygenation quantifiable value; analyzing the time domain data by executing a first instruction to obtain a first analysis result; analyzing the frequency domain data by executing the second instruction to obtain a second analysis result; integrating the first analysis result and the second analysis result and inputting the integrated first analysis result and the integrated second analysis result into a priori damage model so as to predict the symptom type of a patient; the prior damage model is a brain damage detection standard model constructed according to prior experience. The auxiliary analysis method is obtained on the basis of comprehensive analysis of time domains and frequency domains, and forms an analysis diagnosis model of multi-mode data fusion through supervised machine learning to effectively predict neurodegenerative diseases.
assignee_clean: 北京智精灵科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京智精灵科技有限公司

title: System for detecting roaming
assignee: Korea Institute Of Science & Technology Information
abstract: A method for detecting whether a user's roaming has occurred is provided. The method may be performed by a roaming detection server and comprises receiving location data of the user from a terminal of the user, determining whether the user may be located indoors by using the location data of the user, and determining a use of a building in which the user may be located using use information of the building based on the user being located indoors, and detecting whether the user's roaming has occurred based on a predetermined condition, wherein it may be detected that the roaming has occurred based on the building in which the user may be located not being a building of a predetermined use.
assignee_clean: korea institute of science technology information
primary_assignee: korea institute of science technology information

title: Electroencephalogram self-adaptive model based on discriminant confrontation network and application of electroencephalogram self-adaptive model in rehabilitation
abstract: An electroencephalogram adaptive model based on a discriminant confrontation network and application in rehabilitation, comprising the following steps: constructing a source domain and a target domain of electroencephalogram signal data as input samples; constructing a main network of the electroencephalogram self-adaptive model, which is composed of a feature extractor and a classifier; constructing a domain discriminator of the electroencephalogram adaptive model as a branch network; constructing a loss function of the electroencephalogram adaptive model; and (3) training the electroencephalogram adaptive model by utilizing the electroencephalogram signal data of the source domain and the target domain. The electroencephalogram signal data of a testee, which are acquired by an electroencephalogram acquisition device in the rehabilitation medical equipment, are adopted to predict the electroencephalogram signal category, monitor the movement intention of the testee in real time, convert the movement intention into the corresponding action of the rehabilitation medical equipment, and assist the limb of the testee to complete the corresponding action by an external skeleton rehabilitation instrument in the rehabilitation medical equipment. The invention can be applied to a rehabilitation medical system to realize the identification of the human motion intention.

title: Motion artifacts simulation
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: Motion contaminated magnetic resonance (MR) images for training an artificial neural network to remove motion artifacts from the MR images are difficult to obtain. Described herein are systems, methods, and instrumentalities for injecting motion artifacts into clean MR images and using the artificially contaminated images for machine learning and neural network training. The motion contaminated MR images may be created based on clean source MR images that are associated with multiple physiological cycles of a scanned object, and by deriving MR data segments for the multiple physiological cycles based on the source MR images. The MR data segments thus derived may be combined to obtain a simulated MR data set, from which one or more target MR images may be generated to exhibit a motion artifact. The motion artifact may be created by manipulating the source MR images and/or controlling the manner in which the MR data set or the target MR images are generated.

title: Method and system for generating a visualization plane from 3D ultrasound data
abstract: A system (e.g., an ultrasound imaging system) is provided. The system includes an ultrasound probe configured to acquire three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound data of a volumetric region of interest (ROI). The system further includes a display, a memory configured to store programmed instructions, and a controller circuit. The controller circuit includes one or more processors. The controller circuit is configured to execute the programmed instructions stored in the memory. When executing the programmed instructions, the controller circuit performs a plurality of operations. The operations includes collecting the 3D ultrasound data from an ultrasound probe and identifying a select set of the 3D ultrasound data corresponding to an object of interest within the volumetric ROI. The operations further include segmenting the object of interest from the select set of the 3D ultrasound data, generating a visualization plane of the object of interest, and displaying the visualization plane on the display.

title: Method and system for generating mediastinum lymph node segmentation model
assignee: 上海市肺科医院（上海市职业病防治院）
abstract: The invention provides a generation method and a generation system of a mediastinal lymph node segmentation model, which relate to the technical field of medical image processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring lung CT images of a plurality of thoracic surgery patients, and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on each lung CT image to obtain a three-dimensional image; respectively carrying out three-dimensional segmentation on each three-dimensional image to obtain a three-dimensional labeling image marked with a true mediastinal lymph node focus area; grouping the three-dimensional labeling images to obtain a training set, a testing set and a correction set; training the training set to obtain a mediastinal lymph node segmentation model; inputting the test set into the mediastinal lymph node segmentation model to obtain a corresponding segmentation image, and calculating the segmentation accuracy of the mediastinal lymph node segmentation model; the segmentation accuracy is smaller than the accuracy threshold, and the correction set corrects the mediastinal lymph node segmentation model; and if the segmentation accuracy is not less than the accuracy threshold, storing the mediastinal lymph node segmentation model. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of mediastinal lymph node segmentation, does not need manual intervention, and has strong practicability.

title: Method and device for processing facial area in medical image and related product
assignee: 东软集团股份有限公司, 东软集团(广州)有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device and a related product for processing a facial area in a medical image, wherein a three-dimensional data body of the medical image containing the head of a human body is subjected to three-dimensional reconstruction in a facial observation direction to obtain a reconstructed image, and the reconstructed image can show the facial morphology of a patient. In order to protect privacy of a patient corresponding to the medical image, on the basis of obtaining a reconstructed image, five sense organs in the reconstructed image are further identified, and then a two-dimensional region to be replaced is formed according to a region corresponding to the five sense organs. And determining the facial area data corresponding to the area to be replaced in the three-dimensional data volume. And finally, replacing the facial area data with a preset constant. By replacing the facial region data with a preset constant, the facial features of the patient are effectively masked. In the subsequent application, the replaced three-dimensional data body cannot obtain the special facial form of the patient through three-dimensional reconstruction, so that the privacy of the patient can not be affected by utilizing the three-dimensional data body, and the privacy of the patient can be effectively protected.

title: Systems and methods for follow-up functional imaging
abstract: A method is provided for follow-up functional imaging after obtaining a first functional image data set of a patient. The method includes obtaining a second functional image data set of the patient at a follow-up time subsequent to the obtaining of the first functional image data set. The method also includes generating a local change map using the first functional image data set and the second functional image data set. Further, the method includes generating a mutual structural similarity map using the first functional image data set and the second functional image data set. Also, the method includes generating a significant-response map using the local change map and the mutual structural similarity map. The method also includes displaying the significant-response map.

title: Key generation from an imaging sensor
abstract: There is disclosed a method of handling a sensor, comprising the steps of: challenging a subset of sensor components under uniform conditions; receiving output signal values from said subset; for each component, determining the statistical moment of order i of the temporal distribution of the output signal value of said each sensor component; and determining one or more pathological sensor components whose sum of the distances of values to other components of the subset is greater than a threshold, the distance between two sensor components being determined by the difference of the ith statistical moment values of the two temporal distributions associated to the components obtained when challenging said subset under uniform conditions. Described developments comprise the use of imaging sensors, key or identifier generation, authentication mechanisms, determination of thresholds, use of helper data files, adjustments of light sources and/or beam shaping, handling of lossy compression and of videos.

title: Method for generating antagonistic low-dose CT (computed tomography) denoising based on dual-domain U-net discriminator
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image analysis, and particularly relates to a generation confrontation low-dose CT denoising method based on a dual-domain U-net discriminator. The invention uses a U-Net discriminator to learn the global and local differences between the image domain and the generation domain of a normal dosage image and a generated image; the discriminator provides pixel-by-pixel feedback to the denoising network through global output, and enables the denoising network to pay attention to a global structure at a semantic level through an intermediate layer; the discriminator is applied in an image gradient domain to reduce artifacts in low-dose CT and enhance the edge of a denoised CT image; the CutMix technology is used for enabling the discriminator to output pixel by pixel, a confidence map is provided for a radiologist, uncertainty of a visualized denoising result is avoided, and screening and diagnosis of low-dose CT are promoted; the invention can effectively improve the quality of the denoising low-dose CT, enables the generated image to have higher definition, has richer edges, reduces the influence of artifacts, and improves the accuracy in the medical image analysis process.

title: System, method, and computer program product for generating synthetic data
abstract: Provided are a system, method, and computer program product for generating synthetic data. The method includes receiving a plurality of data types associated with an environment to be evaluated and receiving a plurality of correlations of one data type to another data type. The method also includes generating a correlation graph of the plurality of data types based on the plurality of correlations and generating a directed acyclic graph of the plurality of data types based on the correlation graph. The method further includes generating a hierarchical graph of the plurality of data types by applying a path traversal technique to the directed acyclic graph and generating a synthetic dataset by repeatedly traversing the hierarchical graph to generate a plurality of records of data.

title: Multi-path imaging method, device, equipment and storage medium for endoscope multi-spectrum
assignee: 深圳市中安视达科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and discloses an endoscopic multispectral multipath imaging method, device and equipment and a storage medium, which are used for improving the quality of endoscopic multispectral multipath imaging. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first spectral image data for each channel by a plurality of image sensors in the endoscope; constructing a light source model of each channel and performing spectrum correction to obtain a plurality of second spectrum image data; multidimensional data fusion is carried out on the plurality of second spectrum image data, multidimensional data three-dimensional is generated, and weighting treatment is carried out, so that a fused multidimensional pixel matrix is obtained; performing data dimension reduction and feature extraction to obtain target dimension reduction pixel data, and performing data reconstruction and model construction to obtain a spectrum three-dimensional data model; performing image feature analysis to obtain an image feature analysis result; and carrying out three-dimensional imaging on the image characteristic analysis result and the spectrum three-dimensional data model to obtain three-dimensional imaging data of the endoscope.
assignee_clean: 深圳市中安视达科技有限公司

title: Automatic computerized joint segmentation and inflammation quantification in MRI
assignee: The Chinese University Of Hong Kong
abstract: Segmentation of bony regions in MRI images of joints is automated using a two-stage process. In a first stage, a machine-learning image-slice categorizer is used to categorize image slices of the MRI image data as belonging to one of a set of image-slice categories, depending on presence or absence of bone and/or tendon in the image slice. In a second stage, a first instance of a machine-learning segmentation classifier is used to segment image slices that contain both bone and tendon into bone and non-bone regions, and a second instance of a machine-learning segmentation classifier is used to segment image slices that contain bone but not tendon into bone regions and non-bone regions. Results from the two segmentation classifiers can be combined across image slices to provide a final segmentation of the bony structures, including inflammatory regions, in the image data.

title: Virtual staining of cells in digital holographic microscopy images using general adversarial networks
abstract: A cell visualization system includes a digital holographic microscopy (DHM) device, a training device, and a virtual staining device. The DHM device produces DHM images of cells and the virtual staining device colorizes the DHM images based on an algorithm generated by the training device using generative adversarial networks and unpaired training data. A computer-implemented method for producing a virtually stained DHM image includes acquiring an image conversion algorithm which was trained using the generative adversarial networks, receiving a DHM image with depictions of one or more cells and virtually staining the DHM image by processing the DHM image using the image conversion algorithm. The virtually stained DHM image includes digital colorization of the one or more cells to imitate the appearance of a corresponding actually stained cell.

title: Image registration method based on automatic delineation
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image registration method based on automatic delineation, which comprises the following steps: inputting medical images of two arbitrary modalities; training a neural network by adopting a domain self-adaptive transfer learning strategy, and enabling the neural network to have the capability of identifying OAR for other modes except CT when training data only contains the OAR drawing golden standard of CT; inputting the two input images into the neural network respectively to obtain respective whole body OAR segmentation results; obtaining a transformation matrix and a displacement vector of rigid registration by adopting an iterative optimization method based on the OAR contour points, thereby obtaining a medical image subjected to rigid registration; on the basis of rigid registration, for each OAR, matching the contour point of the OAR in the fixed image with the contour point of the OAR in the corresponding moving image to further obtain a displacement value of the contour point; and obtaining a complete displacement field three-dimensional matrix by an interpolation method based on control points, thereby obtaining the non-rigid registered medical image forward image. Therefore, the problem of OAR gold standard shortage can be effectively solved.

title: CBCT image reconstruction method, CBCT image reconstruction system, CBCT image reconstruction computer device and CBCT image storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a CBCT image reconstruction method, a CBCT image reconstruction system, a CBCT image reconstruction computer device and a CBCT image storage medium. The method mainly comprises four steps of acquisition of multi-mode image data of a patient for training, registration of the multi-mode image data of the patient, training of a denoising diffusion probability model based on conditions and use of the denoising diffusion probability model based on the conditions. According to the invention, the CBCT image shot by the patient in the follow-up stage process can be utilized, the CT image for positioning shot before treatment is combined, the image quality is optimized through the denoising diffusion probability model based on the condition, and the synthetic CT image corresponding to the time point is finally generated. The quality of the synthesized CT image generated by the method completely meets the requirement of clinical diagnosis, has higher clinical value, can be directly used for auxiliary diagnosis, helps a clinician to recalculate the radiation dose of radiotherapy, improves the accuracy of dose calculation, further helps to improve the efficiency of self-adaptive treatment, and simultaneously eliminates subjectivity.

title: Spatial localization design service
abstract: A synthetic world interface may be used to model digital environments, sensors, and motions for the evaluation, development, and improvement of localization algorithms. A synthetic data cloud service with a library of sensor primitives, motion generators, and environments with procedural and game-like capabilities, facilitates engineering design for a manufactural solution that has localization capabilities. In some embodiments, a sensor platform simulator operates with a motion orchestrator, an environment orchestrator, an experiment generator, and an experiment runner to test various candidate hardware configurations and localization algorithms in a virtual environment, advantageously speeding development and reducing cost. Thus, examples disclosed herein may relate to virtual reality (VR) or mixed reality (MR) implementations.

title: Health management method and system suitable for surgical patients
assignee: 北京和兴创联健康科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a health management method and system suitable for a surgical patient. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring a hospital historical user data set, dividing the historical user data set into a training number set and a test data set for model training, and training to obtain a blood transfusion amount prediction model; inputting a blood transfusion quantity prediction model according to the related information of the current patient blood transfusion, mutually fusing the collected health strategy set and the hospital historical user data set to obtain a basic strategy map, inputting the individual blood transfusion quantity of the patient to the sequencing strategy model for sequencing learning, and generating a Top-N recommendation strategy list. The invention additionally incorporates the target value of the postoperative related index on the basis of incorporating the preoperative related index of the patient by the obtained recommended value of the blood transfusion volume, determines the target value of the postoperative related index with the aim of optimal prognosis of the patient, and substitutes the parameter value of the set postoperative related index into the blood transfusion volume prediction model according to the set parameter value of the postoperative related index to predict and recommend the intraoperative blood transfusion volume of the patient for reference of a clinician.

title: Method for identifying lesion type and gene mutation in thyroid tumor pathological image
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
abstract: The invention discloses a method for identifying pathological areas in pathological images of thyroid follicular tumor tissues, and predicting gene mutation. The method is an automatic auxiliary diagnosis technology based on a deep learning method, utilizes big data and a deep convolutional neural network algorithm to automatically locate a pathological region in a pathological tissue section image of the thyroid follicular tumor, automatically identifies the pathological histology type and the gene mutation type of the pathological region, identifies cases carrying RAS and other driving gene mutations according to the pathological tissue image, and realizes the histological classification of the thyroid follicular tumor and the prediction of related gene mutations. The method provides information for clinicians, assists in pathological diagnosis and assists in making clinical decisions, and promotes development of digital pathology and accurate medical treatment.

title: Deep learning-based ultrasonic brachial plexus image recognition method
assignee: 复旦大学附属华山医院
abstract: The invention provides an ultrasonic brachial plexus image recognition method based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of intelligent ultrasonic image recognition, and comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of ultrasonic nerve image data, preprocessing, and constructing an ultrasonic image data set with a label required by training a nerve network model; dividing an ultrasonic image data set into a training set and a testing set according to the proportion of 8:2, and expanding and characteristic enhancing ultrasonic images in the training set; the building extrusion-attention mechanism module SA is added to the traditional convolution; introducing an extrusion excitation module and an attention mechanism module into the V-net network so as to construct an SA V-net network model and train; and loading the trained SA V-net network model, inputting a test set for prediction to obtain an identification result, and calculating a Dice coefficient according to the label. The invention can help a clinician to quickly and accurately locate the region needing nerve block, helps a patient to be more stable in operation, and has quicker postoperative recovery and better clinical practicability.

title: Synthetic physically unclonable function derived from an imaging sensor
abstract: There is disclosed a method of handling a sensor, comprising the steps of: defining a subset of sensor components of the sensor; challenging said subset under uniform conditions; receiving output signal values from said subset; for each component of the subset, determining the statistical moment of order i of the temporal distribution of the output signal value of said each sensor component; determining one or more outliers sensor components, said outliers sensor components being components whose ith order statistical moment has a difference with the mean value of the spatial distribution of the chosen moment over the subset superior in absolute value to a threshold, the ith order statistical moment of one sensor component being estimated on the temporal distribution associated to this sensor component. Developments describe in particular the use of imaging sensors, key generation, authentication, helper data files and the handling of videos.

title: Diagnostic process for disease detection using gene expression based multi layer PCA classifier
assignee: Latha Chakravarthy, Prathik Abhay Chakravarthy, Sudarshan Venkat Chakravarthy, Vasu Devan Chakravarthy
abstract: A diagnostic process for disease detection using gene expression based PCA (Principal Component Analysis) classifier is provided. The present invention includes a method of diagnosing disease in a patient by performing a multilayer PCA classification that analyzes gene expression profiles of patients' biological samples to predict their class as disease or healthy, uses patients' biological samples to extract a set of fingerprint genes for specific disease and cell type which can be used as identification features, and classifies patient biological samples as disease or healthy based on differential gene expression profiles of the fingerprint genes. The present invention also implements the multilayer PCA classifier on patients' biological samples to extract a set of fingerprint genes for specific disease and cell type, and tabulates the fingerprint gene information in a database that will be referenced for disease diagnosis, prescreening in early stages of disease, and for confirming the stage of the disease, executed through the many embodiments of the invention.

title: Speech processing method and apparatus therefor
abstract: Disclosed are a speech processing method and speech processing apparatus which execute an installed artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or machine learning algorithm to perform speech processing to enable the speech processing apparatus, a user terminal, and a server to communicate with each other in a 5G communication environment. The speech processing method according to an exemplary embodiment of the present disclosure includes converting a user's spoken utterance into a user utterance text, discovering a domain, an intent, and at least one named entity of the user utterance text, determining whether the user's spoken utterance is a complete spoken utterance or an incomplete spoken utterance, generating a spoken query utterance and feeding the generated spoken query utterance back to the user when the user's spoken utterance is an incomplete spoken utterance, and constructing a complete spoken utterance by receiving a user's spoken response utterance which responds to the spoken query utterance.

title: System and method for anomaly detection in dynamically evolving data using low rank matrix decomposition
abstract: Detection of abnormalities in HDBD is performed by processing it to obtain a dictionary from a training data. This is done by computing a low rank randomized LU decomposition which enables constant online updating of the training data and thus gets constant updating of the normal profile in the background.

title: Deformable photonic materials and related methods
abstract: The present disclosure describes photonic materials that reversibly change color in response to the material being stretched or otherwise mechanically deformed.

title: Multi-party collaborative prototype system oriented to intelligent anesthesia decision and method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multiparty collaborative prototype system for intelligent decision-making of anesthesia and a method thereof, wherein the multiparty collaborative prototype system comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-mode data of the anesthesia operation of the patient, and the multi-mode data specifically comprises: basic information, operation characteristic information, vital sign data, environment sensing data and real-time state data, and processing and storing multi-mode data of the whole operation flow; and the model training module is used for carrying out joint training of the anesthesia data mining model by each participant by utilizing the local related data and the initial model. The invention provides a multiparty collaborative prototype system and a multiparty collaborative prototype method for intelligent anesthesia decision-making, wherein multiparty participants respectively collect multimodal data aiming at each link of anesthesia operation, and local data are used for carrying out anesthesia related statistical analysis and combined training of an excavation model; and then, all the parties cooperatively participate in the collection of decision knowledge of the anesthesia clinical specialist, and a local database is combined to construct a full-flow combined knowledge base for anesthesia operation.

title: AI-based campaign and creative target segment recommendation on shared and personal devices
abstract: A method includes obtaining (i) device data associated with multiple electronic devices and (ii) advertisement data associated with one or more advertisement campaigns. The method also includes identifying first features and second features, where the first features correspond to the device data and the second features correspond to the advertisement data. The method further includes generating a graph relating usage history of the multiple electronic devices and one or more advertisement genres. The method also includes identifying a specified electronic device from among the multiple electronic devices and an advertisement segment from among the one or more advertisement campaigns using the first features, the second features, and the graph. In addition, the method includes providing the advertisement segment to the specified electronic device.

title: Detecting threat events
abstract: One or more computing devices, systems, and/or methods are provided. One or more first signals received from one or more first devices may be monitored. One or more first threat indicators within a first signal of the one or more first signals may be detected. One or more second signals may be analyzed to determine a probability of a threat event. One or more second devices of a plurality of devices may be selected, based upon the probability, for transmission of one or more messages associated with the threat event.

title: Result driven case management
assignee: 埃森哲环球解决方案有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the present application relate to result-driven case management. A system for orchestration operations is disclosed. The system includes a case orchestration engine to identify differences in operations and to generate multiple hypotheses for resolving the differences. The case orchestration engine also collects evidence about the differences in the operations, evaluates each of the multiple hypotheses based on dialog-driven feedback received from the user, and selects one of the multiple hypotheses for resolving the differences based on the evidence and an expected result of the operations. The case orchestration engine provides a cause for the discrepancy and a remedial action for resolving the discrepancy based on the selected assumptions, and then generates a plan for performing the operation to achieve the desired result based on the remedial action.

title: Ridge regression training method, computing device and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a ridge regression training method, which comprises the following steps: initializing parameters, generating system public parameters, generating public and private key pairs of all participants, and calculating a re-encryption key; when a training request is received, calculating a joint public key, encrypting private data by using the joint public key, and generating a ciphertext I; a two-stage decryption mechanism is utilized, and a ciphertext re-encryption technology is combined to perform partial decryption and re-encryption on the ciphertext I to generate a ciphertext II; and decrypting the ciphertext II through the DR to obtain a final training result of the model. The invention uses the ElGamal addition variant scheme and combines the ciphertext re-encryption technology, thereby simplifying the calculation while ensuring the confidentiality of the data resources in the cooperation process, improving the calculation speed and reducing the calculation cost.

title: Providing information
abstract: An apparatus, method and computer program product for: interfacing with at least a first radio access network function and a second radio access network function, sending a first message to the first radio access network function and a second message to the second radio access network function, the first message and the second message comprising a request to report information based on at least one criterion, receiving the reported information from the first radio access network function and the second radio access network function, grouping the reported information and providing the grouped information to at least one radio access network optimization algorithm.

title: Hybrid spectral imaging devices, systems and methods
abstract: A hybrid spectral imager apparatus has an imaging head arrangement (IHA), a control and processing unit (CPU), and a display. The IHA includes an optical imager, multiband filtering optics (MBFO), and a sensor arrangement. The optical imager collects and focuses an image of a target scene or object along an imaging path. The multiband optics includes a beam divider for generating at least two replica images of the target image, and a multiband filter (MF) interposed into the imaging path and effecting multi-bandpass filtering in the image replicas. The sensor arrangement has at least one Mosaic filter array (MFA) focal plane array (FPA) sensor onto which the multiband filtered image replicas are focused, and a focal plane array masked, in a pixelized manner, with at least three wide-band primary color-type filters, with each primary color-type response separating and capturing one single-band. The CPU is coupled to the IHA and is configured to execute program instructions for calibrating image acquisition processes, controlling and synchronizing the acquisition/capturing of the image replicas by the MFA sensor arrangement, and spectrally purifying the MFA sensor arrangement responses to compensate band cross-talking between the MFA and the MF. The display is configured to display on a user interface at least the acquired single-band images. The CPU is further configured to reconstruct and display, on the display, a set of at least three different single-band images per MFA-FPA sensor employed. The IHA is configured to capture sets of different single-band images for video snapshot spectral imaging at desired spectral bands within the FPA sensor arrangement spectral sensitivity range.

title: Network anti-fraud active inspection and early warning system
assignee: 中国科学院自动化研究所
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of public security, and particularly relates to an anti-fraud active inspection and early warning system for a network, aiming at solving the problem of poor robustness of fraud prevention technology of the network and the telephone. The system of the invention comprises: an automatic inspection module configured to construct a swindle-cue clustering space; the online screening module is configured to obtain the total probability association distribution of the first information of the subject leader and the affiliated members in the suspicious fraud clues through topological sorting and conditional distribution sampling; the credibility evaluation module is configured to evaluate suspicious fraud clues through a layered non-standard network comprehensive evaluation method; and the active early warning module is configured to actively push suspicious fraud clues with the weight larger than the set early warning threshold value to mobile phones of anti-fraud department personnel or case investigation systems, and start electronic supervision and limit for investigating the suspicious fraud clues. The invention locks fraud clues by actively capturing the network and telephone fraud interaction structure, thereby improving the robustness of network and telephone fraud prevention.

title: Systems and methods for capturing deep learning training data from imaging systems
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for generating deep learning training data with an imaging system. In one embodiment, a method for an imaging system comprises performing a scan of a subject to acquire imaging data, training a deep neural network on the imaging data to obtain updates to the deep neural network, and transmitting the updates to a server for training a central deep neural network. In this way, imaging data may be leveraged for training and developing global deep learning models without transmitting the imaging data itself, thereby preserving patient privacy.

title: Method and system for screening early-stage screening sub-markers of pan-cancer based on whole genome bisulfite sequencing data
assignee: 江苏先声医学诊断有限公司, 南京先声医学检验实验室有限公司, 北京先声医学检验实验室有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of bioinformatics, and particularly provides a method and a system for screening a cancer early screening sub-marker based on whole genome bisulfite sequencing data. The method is based on whole genome bisulfite sequencing data, and the methylation level of a tumor sample is corrected according to the methylation level of a paracancerous sample and the tumor duty ratio of the tumor sample, so that methylation intervals with real differences are screened out. The contribution degree sequencing is carried out on the primary screening sub-markers through a self-coding model, the difference between the primary screening sub-markers in a tumor sample, a cancer side sample and white blood cells is evaluated from the molecular level, the primary screening sub-markers are simplified, and the accuracy and the economy of the developed products are improved.

title: Method and apparatus to derive and utilize virtual volumetric structures for predicting potential collisions when administering therapeutic radiation
abstract: A control circuit accesses topograms of a patient that include patient content that is beyond the portion of the patient that appears in the three-dimensional computed tomography (CT) images for that patient. The control circuit uses those topograms to derive a virtual volumetric structure representing at least some of the patient content that is beyond the aforementioned portion of the patient that appears in the 3D CT images. That virtual volumetric structure can then be used to predict potential collisions when assessing a radiation treatment plan for the patient that utilizes the aforementioned radiation treatment platform. By one approach the topograms include at least two substantially orthographic views of the aforementioned patient content.

title: Methods and systems for a medical image annotation tool
abstract: Various methods and systems are provided for suggesting annotation shapes to be applied to a medical image. In one example, a method includes outputting, for display on a display device, a set of annotation icons from an icon library based on a current image displayed on the display device and displaying an annotation on the current image in response to selection of an annotation icon from the set. The method further includes automatically adjusting the annotation to a corresponding anatomical feature in the current image and saving the current image with the annotation.

title: Multi-mode brain tumor image segmentation system based on attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode brain tumor image segmentation system based on an attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: an acquisition module configured to: acquiring a brain tumor image to be processed; an image segmentation module configured to: adopting a trained multi-mode brain tumor image segmentation model based on attention, and processing a brain tumor image to be processed to obtain a brain tumor image segmentation result; the attention-based multi-mode brain tumor image segmentation model is obtained by adding an attention mechanism layer to a 3D U-Net convolutional neural network. The invention improves the accuracy of network segmentation of MRI brain tumor.

title: Expert system updating method, service processing method and device
assignee: 支付宝(杭州)信息技术有限公司
abstract: The present specification provides an expert system updating method, a service processing method and a device, wherein the expert system updating method includes: acquiring a probability graph network corresponding to at least one reference expert system, wherein the reference expert system and a target expert system are used for outputting a service decision result corresponding to a target service based on service characteristic data of the same target service; acquiring sample service characteristic data and optimized target data of a target service; and based on the data, combining the probability graph networks of the reference expert system and the target expert system to learn the graph structure, and outputting graph structure updating information of the probability graph network of the target expert system. The embodiment of the specification enables the expert system to have the capability of learning the graph structure, and is beneficial to the more accurate decision result of the expert system.

primary_assignee: 支付宝 杭州 信息技术有限公司

title: Motion recognition-based interaction method and recording medium
abstract: A motion recognition-based interaction method includes the steps of: providing a first motion image as a reference to a user terminal, obtaining a second motion image of the motion of a user from the user terminal, extracting a reference motion from the first motion image, extracting the user motion from the second motion image, and evaluating the motion state of the user by comparing the reference motion with the user motion, and providing feedback to the user based on the evaluation of the motion state. The feedback includes visual feedback.

title: Monolithic computer application refactoring
abstract: Refactoring a monolithic computer application can include transforming textual input into context-aware tokens represented by machine-processable data structures, the textual input acquired from text associated with a computer application having a monolithic architecture for implementing one or more application processes. Based on co-occurrence frequencies among the context aware tokens, one or more groupings of context-aware tokens can be determined. An association between each grouping and a code construct can be determined. Invocation sequences based on time series analyses of computer-generated usage data generated in response to execution of the one or more application processes can be generated, each invocation sequence linking two or more code constructs based on a time series analysis linking groupings that correspond to the linked code constructs. A recommendation for refactoring the computer application into a plurality of microservices can be generated, each microservice corresponding to one or more invocation sequences.

title: Approximate algebraic operations for homomorphic encryption
abstract: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for performing a set of operations on one or more encrypted numbers to be an approximation of performing an algebraic operation on the one or more encrypted number. A server can receive from a client, a public key of a fully homomorphic encryption scheme and one or more encrypted numbers, and perform a set of operations comprising a square root function, a rectified linear activation function (ReLU), or a multiplicative inverse function on the one or more encrypted numbers to generate an encrypted operational result. The encrypted operational result generated by the set of operations can be an approximation of performing an algebraic operation on the one or more encrypted number. The server can further transmit to the client the encrypted operational result.

title: Matching method and device for registration department
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a matching method and a device for a registration department, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a training sample set according to a plurality of court departments and a plurality of standard departments, wherein the training sample set comprises a positive sample set and a negative sample set; acquiring a plurality of word vector features according to the inquiry corpus and the patient corpus; inputting the training sample set and a plurality of word vector features into a pre-trained matching model to obtain candidate standard departments and similarity which are correspondingly matched with each institution department; and generating a mapping relation between each institution department and the standard department according to the candidate standard departments and the similarity which are correspondingly matched with each institution department and the preset confidence interval. Therefore, automatic matching of the standard department and the department of the courtyard is realized, accuracy and coverage rate of the standard department to the department of the courtyard are guaranteed, and registration service is conveniently carried out for positioning the user to the department of the courtyard.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
