title: System and method for explaining and compressing deep learning natural language understanding (NLU) models
abstract: A method includes obtaining, using at least one processor of an electronic device, a base natural language understanding (NLU) model that includes a word embedding layer, where the word embedding layer is associated with at least one training utterance. The method also includes calculating, using the at least one processor, a regularization loss value for use in a determination of an intent detection loss, where the regularization loss value reveals an effect of word embeddings on intent determination of the training utterance. The method further includes retraining, using the at least one processor, the word embedding layer of the base NLU model using the intent detection loss to obtain a retrained NLU model.

title: Dynamic 5G network slicing to maximize spectrum utilization
abstract: In a 5G network, a slice controller operating in a radio access network (RAN) is arranged to make predictions of channel state information (CSI) for user equipment (UE) on the network using a predictive propagation model. The slice controller uses the predicted CSI to schedule subcarriers and time slots associated with physical radio resources for data transmission on slices of the 5G network between a 5G radio unit (RU) and the UE to maximize network throughput on a slice for the radio spectrum that is utilized for a given time period. In view of the CSI predictions, the slice controller controls operations of the MAC (Medium Access Control) layer functions based on PHY (physical) layer radio resource subsets to schedule the subcarrier and time slots for data transmissions on a slice over the 5G air interface from RU to UE.

title: Segmentation model training method, image labeling method and related devices
assignee: 华为云计算技术有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a segmentation model training method in the field of artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a first sample set S and a second sample set R, wherein the first sample set S comprises a plurality of first images and target labels of each first image in the plurality of first images, and the second sample set R comprises a plurality of second images; ATSO training is carried out on the initial segmentation model according to a plurality of first images in the first sample set S, target labels of the first images and a plurality of second images in the second sample set R so as to obtain a target segmentation model, and the initial segmentation model is obtained by training an original model according to the first sample set S. The segmentation model trained by the embodiment of the invention can solve the problems of less available labeling quantity for images and high labeling cost.
assignee_clean: 华为云计算技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 华为云计算技术有限公司

title: Method for intelligently acquiring fetal cardiac cycle images based on ultrasonic four-cavity cardiac section
abstract: The invention discloses a method for intelligently acquiring a fetal cardiac cycle image based on an ultrasonic four-cavity cardiac section, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring an ultrasonic cardiac motion video of a four-cavity heart section of a fetus containing a plurality of periods in real time; identifying four-chamber cardiac section in an ultrasonic video frame by using a trained YOLO v3 model based on single-frame image target detection to assist an ultrasonic doctor to determine a standard section, and distinguishing a final systole frame by using an SVM; inputting the preliminarily positioned frames before and after the last systolic period into a GRU module for further optimization and selection, and then obtaining a more accurate and reasonable frame corresponding to the last systolic period of the four-cavity cardiac slice; thus, all frames in two adjacent end systoles and in the middle are a cardiac cycle, and four to five frames are uniformly extracted to be the final output. The invention aims to automatically intercept the fetal echocardiographic cycle by utilizing a computer so as to facilitate the subsequent automatic auxiliary diagnosis.

title: Automated surveillance system and method therefor
abstract: A system including a server arrangement and a programming interface in communication with external applications are provided. The server arrangement (i) acquires data from sensors, (ii) analyzes the data to determine at least one object of interest in a surveillance area, (iii) determines type of the at least one object of interest, one or more attributes associated with the at least one object of interest and a geospatial location of the at least one object of interest, (iv) estimates a state of the at least one object of interest based on the type of the at least one object, one or more attributes and the geospatial location; (v) compares the estimated state with a defined set of trigger conditions associated with surveillance area, and (vi) determines at least one action to be taken in the surveillance area based on the estimated state of the at least one object of interest matching with at least one of the trigger conditions. The programming interface triggers an external application to perform a determined action to be taken when the estimated state matches with trigger conditions.

title: Processing method for denoising and enhancing medical image
assignee: 深圳市蓝韵实业有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a real-time medical video image denoising method, which is applied to a medical video image sequence which is acquired in real time or stored, and performs recursive filtering processing of a time-space domain on each frame of video image by utilizing the high correlation of two adjacent frames of images, wherein the size of a filtering window can be adaptively adjusted according to the noise level. The method combines a motion compensation method of a time domain and a noise reduction enhancement algorithm of a space domain, and detects a motion region, a noise region and a background region by applying a motion compensation method and a morphological operator aiming at the current pixel point of the image, and estimates the integral noise level of the image in the noise region.
assignee_clean: 深圳市蓝韵实业有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市蓝韵实业有限公司

title: Method for providing data associated with original data and electronic device and storage medium for the same
abstract: According to an embodiment, an electronic device comprises at least one processor, and a memory that stores instructions configured to cause the at least one processor to obtain first data associated with original data based on random number using a first program, obtain first similarity information between the original data and the first data, obtain second data associated with the original data based on the random number using a second program, obtain second similarity information between the original data and the second data, in response to receiving a request, and provide the first program or the second program based on information included in a request that corresponds to a range that includes at least one of the first similarity information or the second similarity information.

title: Digital imaging system and method
abstract: Automated systems and methods for evaluating specimens affixed to substrates, such as slides, an exemplary system including a slide imager configured for acquiring a plurality of micro images of a specimen affixed to an substrate, the specimen including a plurality of objects distributed within a three-dimensional volume, and for generating a whole specimen image of the specimen using the micro images, wherein objects contained in the specimen are depicted substantially in focus in the whole specimen image regardless of a z-depth of the respective objects within the specimen. The whole specimen image is stored on a storage medium for subsequent review by a cytotechnologist using a computer-controlled review station including a display and a user interface, wherein the review station user interface is configured such that the cytotechnologist can review and classify the stored whole specimen images.

title: Devices, systems, and media for guiding stent implantation in a vessel
assignee: 科亚医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a device, system, and medium for guiding stent implantation in a blood vessel. The device comprises: an interface configured to receive a sequence of 2D images of a blood vessel; a processor configured to: reconstructing a first 3D model of a vessel based on the 2D image sequence; acquiring structural parameters and a position to be implanted of a stent to be implanted; modifying the first 3D model to obtain a second 3D model based on the acquired structural parameters of the stent to be implanted and the position to be implanted; and predicting a second blood flow reserve fraction of the blood vessel by using the trained learning model based on the structure-related parameters and the blood flow-related parameters of the second 3D model. The device can be used for FFR prediction before stent implantation, can also accurately and conveniently predict the FFR of various stents after being implanted into blood vessels at various positions, has quick and accurate prediction, and provides sufficient and accurate guide for a user on selection and positioning of the stent to be implanted and the prognosis effect of stent implantation.
assignee_clean: 科亚医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 科亚医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Rapid magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction algorithm based on high-dimensional correlation prior information
abstract: The invention provides a rapid magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction method based on high-dimensional correlation prior information, which comprises the following steps: preparing an open source brain data set SIAT and dividing the open source brain data set SIAT into a training data set and a testing data set; optimizing a plurality of network models under the condition of different noise levels by combining a derived law of large numbers and a multi-channel high-dimensional thought, and forming high-dimensional correlation prior information; designing an iterative solution algorithm for rapidly extracting prior information of the network model; and applying an iterative solution algorithm to the trained network model, testing the image test data set, and outputting to obtain a final reconstruction result. The method combines fully sampled data and undersampled data to serve as high-dimensional prior information based on correlation, trains a plurality of models by using different noise levels, trains an unsupervised network through undersampled images containing artifacts, and enables the trained network parameters to be very close to the supervised network trained by using fully sampled images.

title: Electrocardiogram analysis method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
assignee: 合肥心之声健康科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides an electrocardiogram analysis method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium, one embodiment of which performs analysis by inputting a first electrocardiogram analysis model to at least one electrocardiogram data segment to be analyzed of a target user to generate heart disease diagnosis result information of the target user. Optionally, in a case where the heart disease diagnosis result information indicates that the probability that the target user suffers from a specific heart disease is low, that is, in a case where the electrocardiographic data segment to be analyzed is an electrocardiograph that appears to be relatively normal, it is further determined whether the target user suffers from such heart disease in a paroxysmal manner. That is, although the target user does not have symptoms corresponding to the heart disease during the process of detecting and obtaining the electrocardiographic data segment to be analyzed, whether the target user has the heart disease discontinuously needs to be further determined, that is, the possibility of the target user to have the symptoms corresponding to the heart disease in the future is predicted, and early warning information is provided for the future physical health condition of the target user.
assignee_clean: 合肥心之声健康科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 合肥心之声健康科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for enriching for cancer-derived fragments using fragment size
abstract: Systems and methods for determining a cancer class of a subject are provided in which a plurality of sequence reads, in electronic form, are obtained from a biological sample of the subject. The sample comprises a plurality of cell-free DNA molecules including respective DNA molecules longer than a threshold length of less than 160 nucleotides. The plurality of sequence reads excludes sequence reads of cell-free DNA molecules in the plurality of cell-free DNA molecules longer than the threshold length. The plurality of sequence reads is used to identify a relative copy number at each respective genomic location in a plurality of genomic locations in the genome of the subject. The genetic information about the subject obtained from the sample and the genetic information consisting of the identification of the relative copy number at each respective genomic location, is applied to a classifier that determines the cancer class of the subject.

title: Method to mitigate allergen symptoms in a personalized and hyperlocal manner
abstract: A system and method of determining an allergy impact profile of an individual are disclosed. The system and method may be employed to predict allergy impact environmental conditions may have on allergy symptoms of an individual and to recommend treatment of the individual in response to the predicted allergy impact.

title: Resilience measurement system
abstract: Certain example embodiments provide systems, methods, apparatuses, and computer program products for a resilience measurement system. For example, the resilience measurement system may receive data from multiple sources, and may measure resiliency based on this data, such as the ability of a population or geographic area (e.g., a country) to withstand emerging threats, including but not limited to, posed by climate and environment, health, globalization, and human development. The resilience measurement system may calculate one or more scores indicating risk, need for program adjustment, or need for policy change and investment, depending on the client the project. To perform such operations, the resilience measurement system may process index scores for different categories of threats to average the index scores for different categories of threats with different weights. The final scores may be used by the resilience measurement system for additional analysis, to perform actions, and/or the like.

title: Time sequence data abnormality detection method, storage medium and electronic device
assignee: 阿里巴巴（中国）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a time sequence data anomaly detection method, a storage medium and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring time sequence data, wherein the time sequence data is used for recording data of the target application attribute changing along with time in a historical time range; performing segmentation operation on the time sequence data to obtain a plurality of time blocks; performing contrast characterization analysis on the plurality of time blocks to obtain characterization analysis results, wherein the characterization analysis results are used for characterizing data correlation inside the plurality of time blocks and data correlation among the plurality of time blocks; and performing time sequence data anomaly detection based on the characterization analysis result to obtain a detection result. The method solves the technical problems that the time sequence abnormality detection accuracy is low and the robustness is poor due to the fact that the time sequence abnormality detection method in the related technology is difficult to analyze time sequence data with high noise and multiple abnormality types.
assignee_clean: 阿里巴巴 中国 有限公司
primary_assignee: 阿里巴巴 中国 有限公司

title: Method, device and terminal for recommending inspection workflow
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a recommendation method, a recommendation device and a recommendation terminal for inspection workflow, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving patient information, wherein the patient information comprises basic information of a patient and focus information of the patient; selecting one or more pieces of workflow information matched with the basic information of the patient and the information of the patient focus from a database through machine learning according to the basic information of the patient and the information of the patient focus; and recommending the selected one or more pieces of workflow information to the user. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the workflow adaptive to the focus information of the patient can be screened out and recommended to a doctor, the condition that the generated workflow is wrong due to the influence of subjective understanding of the doctor or insufficient experience in the generated workflow can be reduced, the accuracy of the workflow can be improved, the waste of medical resources is reduced, and the time cost is reduced.

title: Method and analysis devices for classifying tissue samples
abstract: A method and analysis devices for classifying tissue samples are provided. In the method, annotated training data is generated from a known positive tissue sample and a known negative tissue sample from a patient, and the annotated training data is then used to train an automatic classifier patient-specifically. To delimit an affected tissue region of the patient, then, unknown tissue samples from the same patient are classified by the automatic classifier trained for the patient.

title: Hospital elevator safety three-dimensional monitoring cloud platform, system and method thereof, and elevator system
assignee: 山东润一智能科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure discloses an elevator safety three-dimensional monitoring cloud platform, an elevator safety three-dimensional monitoring cloud system method and an elevator system. Wherein, a hospital elevator safety stereoscopic monitoring system includes: the intelligent monitoring terminal acquires information of the intelligent monitoring terminal and sends the information to the cloud platform; acquiring current image data of the elevator equipment through the full-view camera, and sending the current image data to the cloud platform; the cloud platform receives the information of the intelligent monitoring terminal, integrates the real-time running data of the elevator equipment in the information of the intelligent monitoring terminal and the safety factor data of the surrounding environment of the elevator equipment to monitor the running state of the elevator equipment in real time, generates alarm information when data are abnormal, simultaneously sends an image acquisition command to the intelligent monitoring terminal, receives the current image data of the elevator equipment, and sends the current image data to the user terminal; and the user terminal receives the alarm information sent by the cloud platform and the current image data of the elevator equipment for displaying.
assignee_clean: 山东润一智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 山东润一智能科技有限公司

title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease prediction system, equipment and medium based on transfer learning
abstract: The invention discloses a chronic obstructive pulmonary disease prediction system, equipment and a medium based on transfer learning, which comprises the following components: the acquisition module is used for acquiring chronic obstructive pulmonary disease data and disease data to be predicted and preprocessing the chronic obstructive pulmonary disease data and the disease data to be predicted; the extraction module is used for extracting a plurality of characteristics of the disease to be predicted from the preprocessed disease data to be predicted; extracting a plurality of characteristics of the chronic obstructive pulmonary disease data from the preprocessed chronic obstructive pulmonary disease data; the similarity calculation module is used for calculating the similarity between all the characteristics of the disease to be predicted and all the characteristics of the chronic obstructive pulmonary disease data and giving weight to the characteristics of the disease to be predicted; the prediction module performs weighted fusion on the weighted characteristics of the diseases to be predicted; and inputting the fused characteristics of the disease to be predicted into a pre-trained elastic network based on transfer learning, and outputting whether the disease to be predicted can develop into the chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

title: System and method for ultrasonic spinal shadow feature detection and imaging thereof
assignee: 瑞文那医疗有限责任公司
abstract: Systems and methods for anatomical recognition using ultrasound imaging and sonography methods are provided. At least some embodiments of the present disclosure include the steps of: acquiring an ultrasonic image; detecting a shadow area; extracting a shadow contour; filtering the shadow contour with a matched filter; identifying anatomical landmarks within the shadow; extracting the characteristics of the anatomical landmarks; classifying the anatomical structure; and determining with high confidence that the target anatomy is depicted in the image. A confidence is determined that the target anatomy is depicted in the image. Conditionally, a graphic is displayed indicating the presence and location of the target anatomy, including its placement, location and orientation.
assignee_clean: 瑞文那医疗有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 瑞文那医疗有限责任公司

title: Cardiac chamber image segmentation method and device based on semi-supervision method
abstract: The invention discloses a heart chamber image segmentation method and device based on a semi-supervision method, comprising the following steps: constructing a training set of a two-dimensional heart CT image; carrying out standardization processing on the training set; constructing a neural network architecture, which consists of three branch networks of UNet, transUnet and attribute 3D UNet; training UNet by using a two-stage strategy, namely generating pseudo labels for unlabeled two-dimensional heart CT images by using a data disturbance strategy and a neural network cross-monitoring strategy respectively; using a two-dimensional heart CT image with a label and a two-dimensional heart CT image with a pseudo label as a training neural network to obtain a heart chamber segmentation model; and outputting a segmentation result of the original two-dimensional CT image by using the heart chamber segmentation model.

title: A Portable Device for Curing Rhinitis and A System for Caring Rhinitis Having the Same
abstract: The present invention relates to a portable rhinitis treatment device and a rhinitis care system including the same. More specifically, effective treatment is possible through simple configuration, convenient use, and stable fixation of the device by being fixed to the nose by an elastic member only with opening an optical probe, inserting the optical probe into the nose, and placing the optical probe on the nose. Convenient use and storage of the rhinitis treatment device are possible by allowing the rhinitis treatment device itself to control power, operating time, intensity, etc. without a separate device for controlling the portable rhinitis treatment device. The portable rhinitis treatment device comprises a pair of optical probes, a rotation coupling part, an operation control part, a support body, and a camera part.

title: Ultrasound elastography generation and processing system and method
abstract: The present application relates to ultrasound elastography generation and processing systems and methods, the systems comprising: the ultrasonic image acquisition module acquires an ultrasonic image of the living tissue at the preset position through ultrasonic; the ultrasonic elastic image generation module is in communication connection with the ultrasonic image acquisition module and generates an ultrasonic elastic image for the ultrasonic image based on the USE-GAN image generation model; the display module displays the ultrasonic elastic image and the ultrasonic image; the manual auditing module performs elastic scoring pre-evaluation on the ultrasonic elastic image according to the algorithm program, and determines the elastic score of the ultrasonic elastic image generated by the ultrasonic elastic image generating module under the condition of manual checking; and the output module is used for outputting the elasticity score of the ultrasonic elastic image determined by the manual auditing module and the conclusion report related to the elasticity score determined manually. The system and the method can be used for auxiliary diagnosis of thyroid, liver, breast, prostate and other tissues and organs when ultrasound elastography evaluation is needed.

title: Protein biomarker indicators of neurological injury and/or disease and methods of use thereof
abstract: Methods, compositions and kits useful in the detection, assessment, diagnosis, prognosis and/or treatment of neurological injury or disease or brain injury, such as traumatic brain injury (TBI), are provided in which certain newly discovered protein biomarkers are detected in a biological sample of a subject undergoing testing or evaluation. The methods allow for detection of changes in levels, amounts, or concentrations of the protein biomarkers in a subject compared with those of controls. Detection of the protein biomarkers, and/or levels thereof, provides an indication of biological and biochemical events, e.g., at a cellular level, that are occurring in the subject who is undergoing testing or analysis for the neurological injury or brain injury.

title: System and method for generating bullseye chart generation of a subject's heart
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: A system for generating a bullseye chart of a subject's heart is provided. The system may obtain a plurality of slice images in a plurality of groups, wherein each group corresponds to one of the plurality of slices of the heart and includes at least one slice image of the corresponding slice, and each slice image includes a portion of the right ventricle, a portion of the left ventricle, and a portion of the myocardium. The system may also identify at least one landmark associated with the left ventricle in each slice image by applying a landmark detection network. The system may also generate a bullseye chart of the heart based on the at least one landmark identified in each of the plurality of slice images, wherein the bullseye chart includes a plurality of sectors, each of the plurality of sectors representing an anatomical region of myocardium in one of the plurality of slices.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Third party access controls for a decentralized network
abstract: A decentralized node may generate a network of decentralized nodes individually configured to store, receive, and transmit data based on rules associated with the decentralized nodes. A decentralized node may associate a decentralized identity of an entity with a select decentralized node of the decentralized nodes. A decentralized node may present a user interface including one or more access controls at a edge device, the access controls configuring rules to be applied to third-party access and modification of decentralized identity data associated within the decentralized identity of the entity and stored at the selected decentralized node. A decentralized node may identify the decentralized identity data accessible to the select decentralized node based on the rules. A decentralized node may store the decentralized identity data within the decentralized identity associated with the entity at the select decentralized node.

title: System and method for out-of-vocabulary phrase support in automatic speech recognition
abstract: An electronic device includes an audio sensor, a memory, and at least one processor coupled to the audio sensor and the memory. The at least one processor is configured to receive, via the audio sensor an audio input. The at least one processor is further configured to perform, using an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model and an entity prediction model, out-of-vocabulary prediction of an entity. The at least one processor is further configured to receive an ASR hypothesis including the predicted entity. The at least one processor is further configured to output text including the predicted entity.

title: Accurate quantification method and device for cell basic index in cornea confocal image
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）, 中国科学院自动化研究所
abstract: The invention provides a precise quantification method of cell basic indexes in cornea confocal images, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a cornea confocal image to be identified, inputting the cornea confocal image to a cell boundary segmentation model, and outputting a cell boundary probability map according to the cell boundary segmentation model; the cell boundary segmentation model is obtained by taking a cornea confocal image sample as input, taking a labeling result of whether each pixel point in the cornea confocal image sample is a cell boundary as an output label, and performing machine learning training; performing preset post-treatment on the cell boundary probability map to obtain a cell boundary segmentation map; based on the cell boundary segmentation map, obtaining a cell area of the cornea confocal image, and calculating a basic index of the cornea cell according to the cell area of the cornea confocal image. The accurate quantification method and the accurate quantification device for the cell basic index in the cornea confocal image can realize automatic and efficient segmentation of the cell boundary in the cornea confocal image and accurate quantification of the cornea cell basic index.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院; 中国科学院自动化研究所
primary_assignee: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院

title: Method and system for identifying objects in a blood sample
abstract: A system and method for analyzing bodily fluid include a sample holder holding a bodily fluid sample, an image capture device generating an image of the bodily fluid sample comprising a plurality of fields of view. An image processor is programmed to determine a biofilm in the bodily fluid sample from the image, determine a biofilm area or volume within each of the plurality of fields of view to form a plurality of biofilm areas, determine a total biofilm area or total biofilm volume by adding the plurality of biofilm areas, determine a first value corresponding to a comparison of the total biofilm area or the total biofilm volume and a total volume of the bodily fluid sample, and classify the first value into a classification. An analyzer, using the classification, displays an indicator on a display for indicating the classification of the biofilm within the bodily fluid sample.

title: CT image kidney tumor segmentation method based on cascade gating 3DUnet model
abstract: The invention discloses a CT image kidney tumor segmentation method based on a cascade gating 3DUnet model, which comprises the following steps: collecting image sequences containing kidneys in abdominal CT scanning, labeling the kidneys and tumors in each image sequence, generating corresponding labeling masks, and constructing a Dataset Dataset; performing P1 pretreatment operation on the Dataset, and constructing a U-shaped deep network model M1 for kidney (including tumor) segmentation; cutting the image sequence in the Dataset and the corresponding labeling mask, taking out the voxel part with only kidney (or tumor), performing P2 preprocessing operation, and constructing a depth network segmentation model M2 for tumor segmentation based on the gating convolution layer; training the models M1 and M2 respectively; kidney tumor areas were segmented by a cascade of models M1 and M2. According to the invention, a two-stage segmentation model of network cascade is combined with a gating convolution layer to construct a depth network model for tumor segmentation, so that robustness can be maintained to the shape change of cancerous kidneys, and tumors with different sizes can be effectively segmented.

title: Data risk prediction method, device and equipment
assignee: 创新先进技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification discloses a data risk prediction method, a device and equipment. The scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring a first text feature vector set, wherein elements in the first text feature vector set are respectively used for representing the identity information features of each user account marked by multiple persons; classifying the first text feature vector set according to a first classification label to obtain a first classification result, wherein the first classification result is weak note data; performing iterative training on the first classification result to obtain a final risk prediction model, wherein the prediction accuracy of the final risk prediction model meets a preset condition; and carrying out risk prediction on the first text feature vector set by adopting the final risk prediction model to obtain a prediction result, wherein the prediction result is used for representing a risk degree value corresponding to each text feature vector in the first text feature vector set.
assignee_clean: 创新先进技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 创新先进技术有限公司

title: Medical system and operation method therefor
abstract: A medical system includes: an endoscope and at least one treatment tool; a treatment-tool coordinate calculating unit that extracts the treatment tool by processing two or more images acquired at different times by the endoscope, that determines directions of longitudinal axes of the extracted treatment tool, and that calculates a coordinate of an intersection of the determined two or more longitudinal axes; and a judgment unit that judges whether the treatment tool serves as a follow target, on the basis of the coordinate of the intersection calculated by the treatment-tool coordinate calculating unit.

title: Enabling communication with uniquely identifiable objects
abstract: An approach is disclosed that provides personalized two-way communication with a uniquely identified object and an AI agent. Information about the object in a context associated with a requestor is received to access to an object knowledge base. The information is analyzed to determine a unique reference for the object. A selected set of the received information and the object categorization may be sent to an object knowledge base populated with AI configuration parameters tied to uniquely identified objects. The object knowledge base is searched for the unique reference to determine a registration assessment. The registration assessment is one of registered and not registered. When the registration assessment is determined to be not registered, the object is added to the object knowledge base. After receiving an AI connection from the object knowledge base, the context associated with the requestor is sent to the AI connection.

title: Defending multimodal fusion models against single-source adversaries
abstract: A multimodal perception system for an autonomous vehicle includes a first sensor that is one of a video, RADAR, LIDAR, or ultrasound sensor, and a controller. The controller may be configured to, receive a first signal from a first sensor, a second signal from a second sensor, and a third signal from a third sensor, extract a first feature vector from the first signal, extract a second feature vector from the second signal, extract a third feature vector from the third signal, determine an odd-one-out vector from the first, second, and third feature vectors via an odd-one-out network of a machine learning network, based on inconsistent modality prediction, fuse the first, second, and third feature vectors and odd-one-out vector into a fused feature vector, output the fused feature vector, and control the autonomous vehicle based on the fused feature vector.

title: Stable coronary heart disease onset risk assessment marker and application thereof
assignee: 中国医学科学院阜外医院
abstract: The invention discloses a stable coronary heart disease onset risk assessment marker and application thereof, wherein the marker comprises bacteroides marseis, unclassified eagle bacteria, klebsiella pneumoniae, unclassified clostridium, unclassified paraLewy bacteria, maspiriaceae_5_1_63FAA, anaerobic corynebacteria faecalis, unclassified bile bacteria, human Luo Sibai Rayleigh bacteria, eubacterium abdominalis, human Pu's bacteria, enterobacter, wood fennel bacteria, eubacterium, megamonas unclassified, pleurum bacteria, parabacterium and escherichia coli. The invention predicts the risk of onset of stable coronary heart disease and can improve the prediction accuracy.

title: Image processing method and system
assignee: 北京推想科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for processing an image, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining marking data and an image to be processed corresponding to the marking data; the marking data is data marked by an operator on the image to be processed; then inputting the labeled data and the image to be processed corresponding to the labeled data into a deep learning model pool to obtain an evaluation result corresponding to the labeled data; finally, outputting the evaluation result; because the evaluation result is obtained based on a plurality of image training models which are trained in advance according to the images and the labeled data corresponding to the images in the deep learning model, a relatively accurate evaluation result can be obtained, so that an operator can know whether the analysis of the images is accurate enough or not, and the user experience is improved.

title: Patient-level tumor intelligent diagnosis method based on full-field digital section
abstract: The invention relates to a patient-level tumor intelligent diagnosis method based on a full-field digital slice, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of case databases of a certain disease, wherein each case database is named as a folder by the ID of each patient, and a plurality of full-field digital slices of the case biopsy tissue slices waiting for diagnosis and corresponding diagnosis results are stored in each case database; extracting the digital slice with the minimum size at the bottom of the picture file stack of each full-view digital slice as a color image of the full-view digital slice, and zooming the color image to obtain a color thumbnail; combining all color thumbnails of a certain case into a full-view digital slice multi-channel thumbnail according to channels; constructing a deep learning algorithm model; and loading all full-field digital slices of a certain case of the current disease type, and outputting an intelligent diagnosis result. The invention realizes the effective utilization of the full-view digital slice which needs large storage capacity.

title: Meta-structure antenna array
abstract: Examples disclosed herein relate to methods and apparatuses for an antenna structure having reactance control of an array of radiating elements to achieve radiation beam tilting.

title: Trace/trajectory reconstruction via wearable and/or mobile sensors for indoor/outdoor location
abstract: At a mobile electronic device, first sensor data is obtained from at least one wearable muscle sensor, suggesting that location tracking will imminently be desirable. A first indication that an external locator signal is not usable is also obtained. Responsive to the first sensor data and the indication, second sensor data, from at least one wearable muscle sensor, indicative of motion of a subject wearing the at least one muscle sensor, is recorded. A second indication that the external locator signal is now usable is obtained. Responsive to the second indication, the external locator signal is used to determine a current location of the mobile electronic device; and the second sensor data is sued to backtrack from the current location of the mobile electronic device to indicate a location of the mobile electronic device at a time when the recording of the second sensor data was initiated.

title: Surgical support system, data processing apparatus, and method
abstract: A surgical support system, comprising: a surgical data generation device operable to generate surgical data associated with a surgical procedure; and a data processing apparatus operable to: determining Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistance information using the generated surgical data; and provides the determined AI-assistance information to the user.

title: Health monitoring and coaching system
abstract: A system is disclosed that monitors participants in health-related programs, such as weight loss or exercise programs, and that provides automated, personalized health coaching to the program participants. The system includes breath analysis devices that are used by the program participants to generate ketone measurements, and includes a mobile application that runs on mobile devices of the participants and communicates with corresponding breath analysis devices. The system operates generally by monitoring ketone levels (such as acetone levels) and other attributes of the participants and by making personalized, machine-generated changes or updates to such programs to maintain program effectiveness and engagement. In some embodiments the system uses primary and secondary process flows to collect from the participants information that is used to select or recommend health program modifications.

title: Automatic delineation method for organs at risk in whole body multi-part radiotherapy
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a whole body multi-part radiotherapy organ-at-risk automatic delineation method, which adopts a point cloud registration method to carry out rigid registration on different patients, carries out registration on the organ-at-risk delineation results of a large number of patients to obtain a prior knowledge graph of the distribution probability of organs-at-risk of each part, realizes the mapping of the organ-at-risk probability distribution on a medical image to be processed by the point cloud registration method to obtain the prior probability distribution, and guides the training of a convolutional neural network model. The convolutional neural network model can improve the automatic delineation precision by using the anatomical structure associated information which is difficult to learn by the model, and avoid common sense error delineation. Compared with the traditional registration technology based on image gray scale, the point cloud registration technology has the advantages of higher speed and smaller influence of noise.
assignee_clean: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司

title: Method for providing screen in artificial intelligence virtual assistant service, and user terminal device and server for supporting same
abstract: A user terminal device includes a display; at least one sensor; a communication module; and a processor operatively connected to the display, the at least one sensor, and the communication module, wherein the processor is configured to, based on receiving a user utterance voice, determine whether or not a response screen corresponding to the user utterance voice is able to be provided through the display on the basis of at least one of a sensed value obtained from the at least one sensor or an inactive period of the display, based on determining that the response screen is unable to be provided through the display, receive current status information of at least one external device connected to the user terminal device through the communication module, determine one external device among the at least one external device to display the response screen on the basis of the current status information of the at least one external device, obtain the response screen to the user utterance voice, and transmit the response screen to the one external device through the communication module.

title: Method and system for making personalized nutritional and pharmaceutical formulations using additive manufacturing
abstract: The presently disclosed subject matter is directed to a system and method of preparing personalized nutritional and/or pharmaceutical formulations using additive manufacturing technology. Active pharmaceutical or dietary supplement ingredients are suspended in thixotropic stable carrier medias. The thixotropic suspensions are deposited onto a surface of a solid substrate, which can be a snack bar or small wafer used as a mechanical carrier. The disclosed system enables each additive active ingredient to be variably dosed based on a formula that is determined for each specific individual and manufactured on demand. Once the active ingredients are deposited on substrate, the entire assembly can be enrobed with one or more edible solid coatings to seal the active ingredients and provide taste-masking agent characteristics to the assembly.

title: Real-time matching and smart recommendations for tasks and experts
abstract: User information for a particular user is accessed. Expert information for experts and training that is available in an organization of the particular user is accessed. One or more pattern matches between the user information and the expert information are determined. One or more expert recommendations are generated based on the one or more pattern matches and provided.

title: Traffic steering between radio access network nodes
abstract: There are provided mechanisms for traffic steering between a first radio access network node and a second radio access network node. A method is performed by a system. The method includes obtaining, for each of the first radio access network node and the second radio access network node, a respective predicted traffic throughput for a wireless device. The wireless device is in dual connectivity with the first radio access network node and the second radio access network node. The method includes determining splitting of transmission of a flow of data destined for the wireless device between the first radio access network node and the second radio access network node according to the obtained predicted traffic throughputs. The method includes initiating traffic steering of the flow of data between the first radio access network node and the second radio access network node according to the splitting.

title: Contact center system and method for advanced outbound communications to a contact group
abstract: A method of anticipating user action by a contact center system based on machine learning includes receiving, by a processor of the contact center system, a first signal from an end user device in communication with the contact center system, the first signal being indicative of an event associated with a user journey, the user journey including a plurality of events, identifying, by the processor, a subset of the plurality of events of the user journey as a plurality of input events, predicting, by the processor, a next event associated with the user journey based on the plurality of input events; and generating, by the processor, a second signal for transmission to the end user device, the second signal including data corresponding to the next event.

title: Dynamic network slicing management in a mesh network
abstract: The present disclosure describes solutions for dynamic network slicing including provisions to create, modify, and/or delete network slices in a de-centralized communication network including a plurality of central/regional/edge/far-edge locations across hybrid and multi-cloud environment referred to as edge server or edge location for providing service to the users. Network slicing enables multiple isolated and independent virtual (logical) networks to exist together. A plurality of virtual networks, i.e., slices, may be created using resources of the same physical network infrastructure.

title: Providing monitoring services and access to information to caregivers, patients with implanted pressure sensors, and distributors
abstract: Methods based on providing monitoring services and access to information to caregivers, patients with implanted pressure sensors and distributors.

title: Image detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides an image detection method, an image detection device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: reconstructing the first image based on the encoder and the generator in the impurity detection model to obtain a second image; determining first reconstruction information based on the first image and the second image; encoding the first image and the second image based on an encoder in the impurity detection model to obtain a first encoding feature and a second encoding feature; determining second reconstruction information based on the first encoding feature and the second encoding feature; based on a discriminator in the impurity detection model, discriminating the first image and the second image respectively to obtain a first discrimination feature and a second discrimination feature; determining third reconstruction information based on the first discrimination feature and the second discrimination feature; based on the first reconstruction information, the second reconstruction information, and the third reconstruction information, it is determined whether the first image belongs to an impurity image. The scheme can detect the impurity image.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: System and method for reducing stress
abstract: Provided are methods of regulating stress comprising providing an individual with bilaterally-position-able stimulation devices and a mobile device controller comprising memory including initial stimulation settings applied in response to event-associated sensor data and population data associated with bilateral stimulation stress reduction; placing sensor(s) near/on the individual; analyzing sensor data to assess if may indicate a new stress-increasing event/condition, causing the mobile device processor to determine if any such new event/condition is learnable, causing the controller to generate a proposed new stimulation model regarding any learnable event/condition, evaluating the proposed new stimulation model by comparing the new event/condition to the population data, the event or condition of the initial model, or both, and adopting and applying the proposed new stimulation model if the new stimulation model does not vary from the population data, the event/condition of the initial model, or both, by more than a pre-programmed percentage.

title: Context-aware systems and methods for selecting smartphone applications/services and awarding reward points
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing context-aware selection and recommendation of applications and services on a mobile device. The selection of the preferred applications is based on the context of the user and the context of the applications. A comparison engine related to a recommendation module performs a similarity computation between context attribute vectors of the user and the applications. Based on the similarity computation, a rank-order is produced that determines in what order the application icons should be presented to the user. A digital wallet is also disclosed that maintains the reward points awarded to the user based on the instant principles. Unlike prevailing techniques, the reward points are awarded in a context-aware manner after reconciling the conflicting or contradictory usage habits of the user.

title: Electronic device for communicating in augmented reality and method thereof
abstract: An augmented reality (AR) device supporting an AR is provided. The AR device includes a display, a communication circuit, at least one processor operatively connected to the display and the communication circuit, and a memory operatively connected to the at least one processor. The memory stores instructions that, when executed, cause the at least one processor to establish a connection with a user device storing a contact application and a message application, through the communication circuit, detect that the message application is executed, and display a first graphic user interface (GUI) and at least one avatar, which is disposed at a location adjacent to the first GUI and corresponds to at least one contact associated with the contact application or the message application, through the display in the AR.

title: Managing a fleet of devices
abstract: Methods of managing a fleet of devices are provided, as are methods for configuring a standby device for a job in a workflow environment, and methods for performing a job in a workflow environment. Device information is analyzed, such as information pertaining to verification systems. Device instructions are sent to various locations on a device network in response to a deviation from a parameter value having been detected. The deviation from the parameter value may correspond to printed media and/or indicia produced by one or more devices. A workflow device and a standby device are provided, and the workflow device sends configuration data to the standby device. The standby device installs configuration data and is introduced into the workflow environment.

title: User or patient monitoring systems with one or more analysis tools
abstract: A system is provided for using telemetry data based on user habit information or user monitoring. A monitoring device has one or more sensors that detect or measure user information selected from of at least one of, a user's activities, behaviors and habit information, and a user's health. The monitoring device includes ID circuitry with an ID storage that contains a unique user ID, a communication system which reads and transmits the unique user ID from the ID storage, a power source and a pathway system. A telemetry system with a database receives the user information from the telemetry device. One or more analysis tools are at the telemetry system that analyze the user information and produce analysis information that is sent to the monitoring device.

title: Managing a fleet of devices
abstract: Methods of managing a fleet of devices are provided, as are methods for configuring a standby device for a job in a workflow environment, and methods for performing a job in a workflow environment. Device information is analyzed, such as information pertaining to verification systems. Device instructions are sent to various locations on a device network in response to a deviation from a parameter value having been detected. The deviation from the parameter value may correspond to printed media and/or indicia produced by one or more devices. A workflow device and a standby device are provided, and the workflow device sends configuration data to the standby device. The standby device installs configuration data and is introduced into the workflow environment.

title: Xia Puli value-based multi-party contribution degree evaluation method for data security sharing platform
assignee: 山东省计算中心（国家超级计算济南中心）, 齐鲁工业大学(山东省科学院)
abstract: A Xia Puli value-based multiparty contribution degree evaluation method for a data security sharing platform belongs to the technical field of data management computer models. In the data sharing platform, a server performs data matching with a data owner according to own data requirements, after safe data transmission and authentication, the matched data is trained and evaluated through the service analysis model, and finally contribution of a root to a plurality of participants is evaluated. The invention can evaluate the contribution of the data owners and the service side more fairly and reasonably, improves the enthusiasm of data sharing of all sides, and encourages the data owners to provide real and reliable data.

title: System for identifying sleep disorders comprising a sensing unit and a data processing device
abstract: The present invention relates to devices, systems and methods for detecting disturbances that may occur during sleep of a subject.

title: Representation of user position, movement, and gaze in mixed reality space
abstract: Controlling a mixed reality (MR), virtual reality (VR), or augmented reality (AR) (collectively, MR) environment visualization may involve obtaining a plurality of sensor data from a plurality of data sources; processing the obtained plurality of sensor data using a plurality of data analyzers to identify at least one feature; generating a plurality of annotated data sets, wherein the annotated data sets contain an annotation of the at least one feature; aggregating the plurality of annotated data sets to correlate the at least one feature as a common feature across different annotated data sets of the plurality of annotated data sets; and based at least on the common feature, providing a visualization output representing the MR (VR, AR, or specifically mixed-reality) environment. Disclosed examples enable utilizing of disparate data types from different data sources, localizing the different data a common space, and aggregating results for visualization and/or further analysis.

title: Ranking data analytics results using composite validation
abstract: A method for performing assisted knowledge discovery includes receiving a dataset. Each of a plurality of analytical techniques is applied to the received data set to generate a plurality of corresponding analytical results. A composite validation metric is applied to each of the plurality of analytical results. The composite validation metric is a single scoring/ranking function that is created from a plurality of different scoring/ranking functions. The plurality of analytical results is presented to a user arranged in accordance with the results of the applying the composite validation metric to each of the plurality of analytical results. A selection from the user from among the plurality of analytical results is recorded. The user's selection is used to modify the composite validation metric such that the analytical techniques responsible for generating the selected analytical result is scored/ranked more highly.

title: Visual interpretation method based on medical image
assignee: 中国人民解放军空军军医大学
abstract: The invention discloses a visual interpretation method based on medical images, which relates to the technical field of image recognition and comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image; inputting the medical image into a fusion prediction model based on the subareas, and outputting visual interpretation; visual interpretation of the medical image is performed according to the visual interpretation; inputting the medical image into a fusion prediction model based on the subareas, and outputting a visual interpretation, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: extracting multi-scale features based on subareas by using a backbone network-based attention mechanism, and extracting multi-scale features based on high resolution by using a backbone network-based progressive convolution structure; fusing the extracted multiple multi-scale features based on a fusion neck; visual interpretation is output based on the prediction head. The visual interpretation method based on the medical image is superior to most of strong baseline models in classification, and the visual result relieves the problems of low resolution and attention drift, so that the main stream visual method is greatly improved.

title: Electroencephalogram epileptic seizure detection method based on depth channel attention perception
abstract: The invention discloses an electroencephalogram epileptic seizure detection method based on depth channel attention perception, and belongs to the field of biomedical engineering and machine learning. The invention introduces an attention mechanism in multichannel electroencephalogram epileptic seizure detection and trains an end-to-end depth channel attention perception model. The model can extract the depth characteristics of brain wave signals, can learn the contribution scores of all channels to epilepsy detection at the same time, and can dynamically select the most relevant electroencephalogram channel. Compared with the prior art, the method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the most relevant electroencephalogram channel is dynamically selected by combining the depth feature extraction and the attention mechanism, and the epileptic feature is cooperatively expressed, so that the fusion feature of the electroencephalogram channel has channel perception capability, and the epileptic detection rate is improved while the interpretability is realized.

title: Method and Apparatus for Diagnosing Disease by Pre-Processing Bio Extracted Data
abstract: Disclosed are a method for determining a disease by preprocessing extracted biometric data and a device therefor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for determining a disease, which is performed by a computing device including at least one processor and a memory for storing at least one program executed by the processor. The computing device can perform: a data acquisition step of acquiring extracted biometric data extracted in the blood of a subject to be diagnosed; a data pre-processing step of transforming initial data generated based on a plurality of parameters included in the extracted biometric data into a coordinate value for each of a plurality of channels, and reconstructing the transformed data into training data; a data training step of extracting a feature value from the reconstructed data and classifying the feature value to perform training; and a disease determination step of determining a specific disease by using the trained feature value.

title: Medical queue follow-up dialogue assisting method and system based on questionnaire and large model
assignee: 北京六元空间信息科技有限责任公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical queue follow-up dialogue assisting method and a system based on questionnaires and large models, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the system comprises a medical knowledge graph module, a large language model module and a logic control module; constructing a medical knowledge graph, and realizing intelligent question and answer on the medical knowledge graph; designing a system-guided three-stage workflow algorithm of 'triage-pre-consultation-chat'; building a fine-tuning corpus and fine-tuning a large language model; the system is designed, and a knowledge graph, a large model and a questionnaire template are combined to realize complete lightweight medical dialogue assistance. By utilizing the technical scheme provided by the invention, the requirements of facilitating the preliminary self-screening of patients and assisting doctors in clinical diagnosis can be met, and the problem of effective combination of knowledge maps, large language models and scale questionnaires can be solved; the quality of inquiry service is improved, and the economic cost and time cost of both doctors and patients are saved, so that the utilization rate of medical resources is improved.
assignee_clean: 北京六元空间信息科技有限责任公司

title: Methods and apparatus for risk evaluation of compromised credentials
abstract: Techniques are provided for evaluating compromised credential information. A method for evaluating compromised credentials comprises the steps of: collecting data regarding previously compromised credentials that were used to commit an unauthorized activity; applying one or more statistical learning methods to the collected data to identify one or more patterns; and evaluating a risk of credentials that have been compromised by one or more attackers using the identified patterns. According to a further aspect of the invention, a risk score is generated for one or more users and devices. The risk scores are optionally ordered based on an order of risk. The data can be collected, for example, from one or more of anti-fraud servers and information sources.

title: Method for monitoring abnormality of production process of D-dimer and FDP composite quality control product
assignee: 北京众驰伟业科技发展有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the abnormality of a production process of a D-dimer and FDP composite quality control product, which relates to the technical field of production condition monitoring and solves the monitoring capability of abnormal problems in the production process, and the abnormality monitoring method comprises the following steps: d-dimer and FDP raw material preparation station monitoring; monitoring a uniform stirring station; adding buffer solution into the mixed liquid for station monitoring; comparing the D-dimer and FDP values detected in real time with the quality control range; performing data analysis on the triggering abnormal alarm event and establishing a baseline model; the production data is visually displayed, and abnormal conditions are found in time; the data information in the production process of the raw material preparation station is collected through the 360-degree rotary camera, the normal range of the D-dimer and FDP composite quality control product is distinguished through the clustering mixing algorithm, the abnormality is detected through the selection mixing algorithm, the alarm and the treatment are carried out, the production efficiency and the qualified efficiency are greatly improved, and the basic guarantee is provided for medical detection.
assignee_clean: 北京众驰伟业科技发展有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京众驰伟业科技发展有限公司

title: Registered encrypted electronic message and redacted reply system
abstract: A method and system for processing an email having redacted content, and/or where the message content has been encrypted and recorded as encrypted, is provided.

title: Distribution and inventory system and methods of using the same
abstract: Systems, computer-readable instructions, and methods for dispensing and tracking medical products in various medical locations are disclosed. For example, the system may include a server which receives one or more requests for types of medical products from one or more client devices, determines whether the requested types and quantities are available in a dispenser and issues an instruction to the dispenser to automatically dispense the requested medical products and quantities. The server may receive confirmation after the types of medical products are dispensed from the dispenser and update a database. The server may receive unused and used medical product information from a client device and reconcile with restocked medical product information from the dispenser. Available types of medical products and quantities, usage reports and recommendations may be viewed via a Platform by one or more client devices. The dispenser may receive requests directly from a client device for medical products.

title: Chinese electronic medical record information extraction preprocessing method based on big data platform
assignee: 郑州大学第一附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese electronic medical record information extraction preprocessing method based on a big data platform, which belongs to the technical field of big data, and comprises the steps of preprocessing an unstructured electronic medical record, judging the type of the unstructured electronic medical record by text segmentation, decomposing the unstructured electronic medical record into parts according to different types, and finally forming a partition table which is decomposed into HIVE table fields according to business logic; according to different labeling designs, the pre-labeled corpora are respectively output, so that the technical problem of quickly and conveniently labeling the corpora is solved.
assignee_clean: 郑州大学第一附属医院
primary_assignee: 郑州大学第一附属医院

title: Medical data storage and transmission method and application system
assignee: 贵州精准健康数据有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a medical data storage and transmission method and an application system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the intranet server erected in the subordinate hospital or the central hospital acquires medical data and sends the medical data to the bastion cloud server, the intranet server comprises a medical technology server and a clinical cloud server, the bastion cloud server erected in the central hospital receives and stores the medical data sent by the medical technology server and/or the clinical cloud server, after a public number query request sent by a user terminal is detected, push data generated according to the medical data and the public number query request are sent to the user terminal in a public number mode, and the push data and the intranet server are separated through a one-way NAT and an ACL technology which are physically isolated.
assignee_clean: 贵州精准健康数据有限公司
primary_assignee: 贵州精准健康数据有限公司

title: Stimulus transmission device
abstract: A stimulus transmission device suppresses power consumption, and effectively transmits a physical stimulus to a user. The stimulus transmission device has a pressure receiving portion which receives pressure from part of a human body, an actuator which drives the pressure receiving portion, and a supporting portion which supports the actuator. The actuator does not move in conjunction with the supporting portion.

title: Training method of neural network, object detection method, device and equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a training method, an object detection device and equipment of a neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly extracting the category characteristics of the objects in the first support sample and the category characteristics of the objects in the second support sample through a first characteristic extraction sub-network, and calculating the difference between the category characteristics of the objects in the two support samples through a first loss function; then detecting the object in the query sample based on the category characteristics of the object in the second support sample and through the object detection sub-network so as to obtain a detection result; acquiring a second loss function based on the detection result and the label of the object in the query sample; finally updating parameters of the target neural network based on the first loss function and the second loss function; because the difference of the characteristics between the support samples before and after the transformation is restrained through the first loss function, the overlarge characteristic difference between the support samples before and after the transformation can be avoided, and the object detection precision of the target neural network is improved.

title: Apparatus for displaying information about an item of equipment in a direction of interest
abstract: Methods and apparatus for determining information about an item of equipment in a direction of interest based upon coordinates derived from wireless communication between wireless transceivers. A smart device assembly is operative to communicate via multiple antennas with a reference point transceiver. A set of coordinates is generated indicating a relative position and/or angle of the wireless transceiver in relation to the reference position transceiver. A query may be made based upon the relative position and angle of the wireless transceiver in relation to the reference position transceiver. A response to the query may include a human readable interface indicating one or more of: direction of travel, a virtual image based upon location and location and direction, and annotative and pictorial information.

title: Methods and apparatus for secure persistent location based digital content associated with a two-dimensional reference
abstract: Augmented reality apparatus and methods of use are provided with secure persistent digital content linked to a location coordinates. More specifically, the present method links a physical location with digital content to enable a user interface with augmented reality that combines aspects of the physical area with location specific digital content. According to the present method, digital content remains persistent with a location even if visual aspects of the location change.

title: Methods for user adaptive radiation therapy planning and systems using the same
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods for user adaptive radiation therapy planning and a system for using the same. In some aspect, method for generating a radiation therapy plan is provided. The method includes receiving imaging information acquired from a patient and producing a preliminary radiation therapy plan, using a treatment planning system, based on the imaging information. The method also includes generating an indication for modifying the preliminary radiation therapy plan in accordance with a predetermined clinician profile, wherein the predetermined clinician profile is based on a trained learning machine. The method further includes producing, using the indication, an updated radiation therapy plan that is adapted to the predetermined clinician profile.

title: Electrocardiosignal identification and classification method based on multi-cascade deep neural network
abstract: An electrocardiosignal identification and classification method based on multiple cascade deep learning comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired one-dimensional electrocardio data and dividing the preprocessed one-dimensional electrocardio data into a training set, a verification set and a test set; constructing and training a deep learning model based on a convolutional neural network, a cyclic neural network and a transducer module to obtain a model with the best classification effect on a verification set; and inputting the electrocardiographic data to be classified into a model with the best classification effect on the verification set, and obtaining the classification of the electrocardiographic signals of the electrocardiographic data. The invention extracts the low-level waveform structural features through one-dimensional convolution, gathers shallower and deeper layers to obtain the spatial features of electrocardiosignals, extracts the time sequence features of the whole lead by utilizing RNNs and convertors, can be applied to classification of single-lead electrocardiosignals or multi-lead electrocardiosignals with different lengths, and has good compatibility for different electrocardiosignal acquisition devices.

title: Methods and systems for sequencing long nucleic acids
abstract: The present invention provides methods and systems for sequencing long nucleic acid fragment. The present invention also provides a method of sequencing a target polynucleotide with fewer probes. Further, the present invention provides a method of sequencing a target polynucleotide with longer reads. Locus-specific, ligation-assisted sequencing/genotyping method and ligation-captured sequencing method are also provided in the present invention. The methods of the present invention allow low-cost, high-throughput and accurate sequencing of nucleic acids.

title: Blood vessel segmentation method, device and system based on fundus examination image
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京同仁医院
abstract: The invention relates to a blood vessel segmentation method, device and system based on fundus examination images, which aim to realize automatic segmentation of retinal small blood vessels and capillary vessels based on fundus photographs or OCT by combining computer vision, image processing technology, neural network algorithm and medical image analysis, improve the efficiency and accuracy of blood vessel segmentation, reduce the workload of doctors and reduce the risk of human errors. The method, the device and the system provided by the application take the retina blood vessel segmentation scheme of the U-Net improved network model as a core model, combine conventional fundus examination image data, and simultaneously utilize the advantages of computer data to rapidly divide small retina blood vessels and capillary blood vessels, so that the workload of doctors can be reduced, and the risk of human errors can be reduced.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京同仁医院
