title: Creating software packages for performing secure computations
abstract: This disclosure is related to devices, systems, and techniques for automatically generating software packages to provide Secure Computation as a Service (SCaaS). For example, a computing device includes processing circuitry configured to receive a set of information comprising an indication of a first party and an indication of a second party. Additionally, the processing circuitry is configured to generate, based on the set of information, a first software package corresponding to the first party, the first software package configured to implement a secure computation, and generate, based on the set of information, a second software package corresponding to the second party, the second software package configured to implement the secure computation. Additionally, the processing circuitry is configured to export the first software package and export the second software package, enabling the first party device and the second party device to perform the secure computation.

title: Methods and arrangements to detect a payment instrument malfunction
abstract: Logic may detect a malfunctioning payment interface on a customer's payment instrument. Logic may receive transaction data about at least one transaction performed via a payment instrument associated with a customer. The transaction data may indicate a payment interface of the payment instrument through which the customer conducted the at least one transaction and the payment instrument may comprise one or more payment interfaces. Logic may determine, by a model, based on the transaction data, a probability of a malfunction by at least one interface of the one or more payment interfaces. The model may be trained based on a pattern of transactions associated with malfunctioning payment instruments. Logic may compare the probability of the transaction against a threshold. And logic may determine whether to contact a customer associated with the payment instrument, based comparison of the probability of the transaction against the threshold.

title: System and method for computation of ransomware susceptibility
abstract: A method of cyber-risk assessment includes populating a database with ransomware attack information non-intrusively gathered from a plurality of data sources. A request for a ransomware susceptibility assessment of an entity associated with a domain name is received. A digital footprint of an entity is discovered in response to the associated domain name using non-intrusive information gathering. Commercial information associated with the entity is collected in response to the domain name. The database is scanned in response to the discovered digital footprint and at least one ransomware factor associated with the entity is generated in response to the scan. An impact parameter and a ransomware factor coefficient is computed based on the collected commercial information. Then an entity susceptibility index is computed based on the impact parameter, the ransomware factor coefficient, and the at least one ransomware factor. A ransomware attack is then identified and the database is re-populating in response to the identified ransomware attack. At least one of impact parameter or a ransomware factor coefficient is re-computed based at least one of an impact parameter or a ransomware factor coefficient based on the identified new ransomware attack to provide a cyber-risk assessment.

title: Heart sound automatic diagnosis system based on deep learning
assignee: 华中科技大学, 武汉中科医疗科技工业技术研究院有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a heart sound automatic diagnosis system based on deep learning, which belongs to the field of medical signal processing and comprises a heart sound signal processing module, a heart sound signal processing module and a heart sound signal processing module, wherein the heart sound signal processing module is used for preprocessing a heart sound signal and dividing the preprocessed heart sound signal into a plurality of heart sound signal segments with equal length; the heart sound detection module is used for respectively inputting the obtained heart sound signal segments into a pre-trained heart sound detection model to obtain the heart sound category of each heart sound signal segment; synthesizing the heart sound category of each heart sound signal segment to obtain the heart sound category of the heart sound signal to be detected; the invention provides a heart sound detection model for automatically detecting heart sound signals end to end, which combines multi-level time sequence characteristics extracted by LSTM and local characteristics extracted by CNN, fully utilizes the advantages of CNN local characteristic extraction capability and LSTM long-term dependence capture capability, and greatly improves classification accuracy.

title: Automatic delineation system of CT image breast cancer clinical target area based on deep learning
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic delineation system of a CT image breast cancer clinical target area based on deep learning, which comprises: data acquisition: firstly, acquiring CT images of breast cancer patients before radiotherapy and contour data of a clinical target area manually outlined by a doctor from a hospital; data preprocessing: preprocessing the collected contour data of the clinical target area, and dividing the contour data into a training set and a testing set according to the ratio of 8: 2; model training: sending the preprocessed training set into a built convolutional neural network for model training, and stopping training when a loss function of the test set reaches the minimum; and fusing the prediction results: the model is used for predicting to obtain a mask of a neck drainage area, a mask of a breast target area and a mask of an inner breast drainage area, and the three masks are subjected to post-treatment and fused into an integral breast cancer clinical target area. The automatic delineation system can reduce the time for a doctor to delineate the target area of the breast cancer during radiotherapy and improve the consistency of delineation results of the doctor.

title: Malignant tumor combined venous thromboembolism risk prediction method
abstract: The invention discloses a malignant tumor combined venous thromboembolism risk prediction method, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing acquired patient information to obtain a basic data set, then carrying out bidirectional combined resampling to obtain a training set, and then carrying out feature screening on each training sample in the training set to remove redundant features; constructing and training a StackingXgbMlp model, wherein the model comprises two layers, the first layer comprises an XGBoost model and an MLP model which are connected in parallel, and the second layer comprises an XGBoost model; and after training, preprocessing unknown patient information whether the patient is ill or not by adopting a method of S100, performing feature screening by adopting a method of S300 to obtain a sample to be predicted, inputting the sample to be predicted into a trained StackingXgbMlp model, and outputting the prediction probability of the sample to be predicted. Experiments show that the method provided by the invention has better prediction accuracy than the traditional method.

title: Detecting special events and strategically important areas in an IoT tracking system
abstract: A wireless sensing system uses heartbeat signals to monitor locations and usage information for assets. Heartbeat signals are signals transmitted periodically. However, in fast-paced environments, assets may move too quickly for heartbeat signals to provide useful information. In these and other scenarios, the wireless sensing system receives a first set of data describing signal strength between a tape node associated with an asset and a first node associated with a first portion of an area and a second set of data describing signal strength between the tape node associated with the asset and a second node associated with a second portion of the area. Based on relative signal strengths described by the received data, the wireless sensing system determines a path of the tape node associated with the asset.

title: Self-adaptive image augmentation system based on cervical fluid-based cells
assignee: 广州锟元方青医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive image augmentation system based on cervical fluid-based cells, and particularly relates to the technical field of medical treatment, wherein the system comprises a target image set creation module, a target image and source image automatic matching module and an image transformation module; the target image creating module is used for collecting slice images influenced by various uncontrollable factors as target images so as to simulate color influence caused by the uncontrollable factors; and the automatic matching module of the target image and the source image is used for finding the target image corresponding to the source image. According to the invention, the target image and the source image are used for modeling by using the staining density map, and on the basis of saving the biological structure information, the color of the section image is transferred, namely the color characteristics of the target image are transferred to the source image, so that the influence of the uncontrollable factors on the image color can be simulated, and the generalization capability of the AI auxiliary system is improved.

title: Method and device for constructing electronic medical record
assignee: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for constructing an electronic medical record, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: analyzing the electronic medical record for constructing the electronic medical record sample based on the configured grammar rule to determine the structural information of the electronic medical record; and constructing an electronic medical record sample for training a structural model of the electronic medical record based on the structural information of the electronic medical record. According to the embodiment of the application, the electronic medical record sample can be constructed in a large quantity, so that the situation that the electronic medical record sample for training the electronic medical record structural model is obtained by marking the electronic medical record in a large quantity is avoided, and the training cost of the electronic medical record structural model is greatly reduced.

title: Image and video analysis with a low power, low bandwidth camera
abstract: A remote detection method, node, and system is described. The detector includes a wireless communications module that wirelessly transmits the detection message to a remote sensing device. The remote sensing device includes a camera having a field of view and wirelessly communicates with the detector. The remote illumination and detection method performs preliminary filtering of captured image data to determine images/frames of interest with a computer vision module on board a processor in the node. The images of interest are then transmitted to a cloud computing component via a wireless or cellular network for detailed analysis to determine the presence or absence of motion or an object in each image of interest. The cloud computing component may employ machine learning computations that time and energy intensive, such as convolutional neural networks.

title: Server apparatus, odor sensor data analysis method, and computer-readable recording medium
abstract: A terminal apparatus 20 includes a sensor data collection unit 21 that collects sensor data from an odor sensor 40 that outputs the sensor data in reaction to a plurality of types of odors, an analyzer acquisition unit 22 that, in the case where an analyzer capable of analyzing a designated odor analysis target is transmitted thereto from a server apparatus 10 that holds a plurality of analyzers for analyzing odor analysis targets by analyzing the sensor data, acquires the analyzer transmitted thereto, an analysis execution unit 23 that executes analysis processing of the designated odor analysis target, by applying the acquired analyzer to the collected sensor data, and an analysis result holding unit 24 that holds information indicating a result of the analysis processing.

title: Bit-level data generation and artificial intelligence techniques and architectures for data protection
abstract: Techniques and architectures for representing data with one or more n-dimensional representations and/or using one or more models to identify threats associated with the one or more n-dimensional representations are described herein. For example, the techniques and architectures may determine one or more coordinates for one or more points based on one or more sets of bits in the data and generate an n-dimensional representation for the data based on the one or more points. The techniques and architectures may evaluate the n-dimensional representation with one or more machine-trained models to detect a threat associated with the data, such as malware or another threat.

title: Man-machine conversation method, client, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification discloses a man-machine conversation method, a client, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: providing a man-machine conversation interface; under the condition that the first input is received, displaying input information of a user; displaying a response result to the input information; displaying at least one function identifier according to a second input under the condition that the second input is received; wherein, the business function represented by the function identifier is used for responding to the input information; under the condition that a third input is received, determining a target function identifier according to the third input; wherein the business function represented by the target function identifier is used for responding to the input information. According to the technical scheme disclosed by the specification, a man-machine conversation interface can be provided, when the intention of a machine recognition user is wrong, the user can select the function identifier to respond to the input information, so that more accurate feedback information is obtained, and the use experience of the user is improved.

title: Method of solving problem of network and apparatus for performing the same
abstract: A method of solving a problem of a network and an electronic device for performing the method are provided. The electronic device includes at least one processor. The processor may determine a representative cause representing a cause of each of anomaly samples of a quality indicator indicating a quality of the network. The processor may perform a time-series analysis on an indicator associated with the representative cause. The processor may propose a solution corresponding to the representative cause and a result of the time-series analysis.

title: Medical first-aid kit based on network
assignee: 甘肃德弘生物科技有限公司
abstract: The utility model discloses a medical first-aid kit based on network, when the patient receives common accidental injury, the patient can click the medicine supply module on the display screen, the user can quickly select the appropriate first-aid medical supplies according to the self condition, and compared with clinics, drugstores and community hospitals, the time for searching is reduced; compared with hospitals, the hospital queuing and registration saves registration cost and shortens time, and patients can treat wounds to a certain extent according to instructions; if the patient is injured when heavier, usable the emergency response module calls for help to emergency center, and emergency center calls for help accurate positioning and calls for help person position, mobilizes nearest first aid strength to arrive at on-the-spot rescue to this zero hour response of accomplishing, simultaneously family planning supplies for use the module can provide family planning articles for use to the user is free, can help the implementation of the family planning policy of country, medical first-aid kit's based on network function is more comprehensive, and user experience feels better.

title: Methods and magnetic imaging devices to inventory human brain cortical function
abstract: Techniques are described for determining cognitive impairment, an example of which includes accessing a set of epochs of magnetoencephalography (MEG) data of responses of a brain of a test patient to a plurality of auditory stimulus events; processing the set of epochs to identify parameter values one or more of which is based on information from the individual epochs without averaging or otherwise collapsing the epoch data. The parameter values are input into a model that is trained based on the parameters to determine whether the test patient is cognitively impaired.

title: Information pushing method, mobile terminal and storage medium
assignee: Oppo广东移动通信有限公司
abstract: The application and the terminal field disclose a method, a terminal and a storage medium for information push. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring professional information of a user; determining a news category matching the professional information; determining a first pushing time point according to the reading habit model of the user; and when the pushing time point is reached, pushing the information belonging to the news category. Through the technical scheme, the information matched with the user professional information can be pushed, and the information matched with the professional information can be the information which is concerned or interested by the user or is willing to spend time to browse to a great extent, so that the time spent by the user for searching the interested information is reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title: Noninvasive blood pressure estimation method based on self-supervision transfer learning
abstract: The invention provides a noninvasive blood pressure estimation method based on self-supervision transfer learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting photoelectric volume pulse wave signals and invasive continuous blood pressure waveform signals of a human body, constructing a noninvasive blood pressure estimation model based on self-supervision transfer learning, training the noninvasive blood pressure estimation model according to the photoelectric volume pulse wave signals and the invasive continuous blood pressure waveform signals of the monitored human body, collecting photoelectric volume pulse wave signals of a user, inputting the photoelectric volume pulse wave signals into the noninvasive blood pressure estimation model, and performing noninvasive blood pressure estimation. According to the noninvasive blood pressure estimation method based on self-supervision transfer learning, noninvasive blood pressure estimation can be achieved through only the photoelectric volume pulse wave, a large amount of supervision data is not needed, and the prediction error meets the medical standard.

title: Fundus image blood vessel segmentation method and system based on self-supervision learning
abstract: The invention discloses a fundus image blood vessel segmentation method and a fundus image blood vessel segmentation system based on self-supervision learning, wherein a U-net structure is improved by using a network model, different layers of characteristic images are mutually transmitted to meet the requirement of fundus image detail characteristic extraction, and the speed of fundus image blood vessel segmentation in the segmentation process can be improved by network pruning. And then, designing and adopting an aggregation task strategy, and combining four methods of intensity transformation, random pixel filling, inward filling and outward filling so as to acquire global features and detail features of more fundus images in a pre-training learning process. Finally, a vector classification task module is designed to generate different vector routes, and an encoder is trained by network prediction vector routes to obtain spatial correlation features of fundus images. The invention can learn the effective fundus image characteristics from the unmarked data, and can achieve the blood vessel segmentation accuracy equivalent to that of the supervised deep learning method by requiring fewer training iteration times and manual annotation data.

title: Method and apparatus for enhanced automated wireless orienteering
abstract: Methods and apparatus for Orienteering using a wireless communication between transceivers. A smart device is operative to generate a vector based upon the wireless communications. A query may be made based upon the vector. A response to the query may include a direction of travel, a virtual image based upon location and location and direction, and annotative and pictorial information.

title: Integrated learning-based intelligent self-labeling method and device for hip joint lesions
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The application provides an integrated learning-based intelligent self-labeling method and device for hip joint lesions, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting an image to be annotated into a position detection model to obtain a hip joint image in the image to be annotated; inputting the hip joint image into an ensemble learning model to obtain a plurality of disease categories of the hip joint image; determining the true category of the hip joint image from a plurality of disease categories based on a preset comprehensive strategy and marking; the ensemble learning model includes a feature extraction unit and a plurality of classification units connected to the feature extraction unit. According to the method, the automatic labeling of the disease types of the images to be labeled is realized by using the position detection model integrated learning model combined with each other, the speed and the number of the disease type labeling are greatly improved through batched labeling, and the labeling rules are unified, so that the condition that the same image is labeled differently through different manpower is avoided.

title: Magnetic resonance (MR)-scanner control
abstract: Techniques are described for controlling a fleet of MR-scanner systems by means of a user interface. Each MR scanner system in the fleet of MR scanner systems comprises a hardware layer having a plurality of electronically controllable components and mechanical components to perform an MR measurement and capture MR-scanner raw data, a Measurement And Reconstruction System (MARS) computing unit configured to implement a measurement framework using a sequence to calculate real-time instructions and transmit these instructions to the components of the hardware layer for controlling the MR-scanner system, and a communication interface for communicating with an external device. Each MR scanner system has system attributes, which are transmitted to the external device via the communication interface.

title: Bone age assessment method based on non-subsampled contourlet transform and convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an X-ray image bone age assessment method based on non-subsampled contourlet transform and a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out non-downsampling contourlet transformation on an X-ray image with normalized size to obtain high-frequency direction sub-bands and a low-frequency coefficient graph under multiple scales, then inputting the high-frequency direction sub-bands and the low-frequency coefficient graph into a multi-channel convolution neural network to obtain feature graphs under different scales, and finally, overlapping the feature graphs and inputting the feature graphs into a regression network formed by a plurality of fully-connected layers to obtain a bone age prediction value; the above process is implemented in an end-to-end network structure, and the network training is implemented by using an error back propagation mechanism. The method utilizes non-subsampled contourlet transformation to pre-extract and separate the features of the original spatial domain image, can overcome the difficulty of network training on a small-scale data set by the conventional deep learning method, and improves the generalization performance of the network, thereby providing a more accurate and reliable evaluation method for clinical application.

title: Bone marrow cell image artificial intelligence auxiliary grading diagnosis system and method
assignee: 中国人民解放军陆军军医大学第二附属医院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary diagnosis, and discloses a marrow cell image artificial intelligence auxiliary grading diagnosis system and a marrow cell image artificial intelligence auxiliary grading diagnosis method. The invention can not only automatically identify, label, count and analyze and diagnose the marrow cell image, but also manually label the marrow cell image, and store the manually labeled result into the storage module, and the system memorizes the manually labeled information, thereby gradually improving the discrimination capability of the system to the marrow cell image.

title: Block chain-based identity recognition method, device and system and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an information identification method, device and system based on a block chain and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of networks. The method comprises the following steps: the wearable device unlocks the wearable device according to the characteristics of the object to be recognized, obtains signature information of the object to be recognized according to the private key signature of the object to be recognized, and sends the identification information of the object to be recognized to the first block chain node, wherein the identification information comprises the identification of the object to be recognized and the signature information of the object to be recognized, the first block chain node inquires the public key of the object to be recognized on the block chain platform according to the identification of the object to be recognized, and the signature verification is carried out on the signature information according to the public key of the object to be recognized so as to carry out information recognition on the object to be recognized. The method and the device for identifying the information help to improve the efficiency of information identification, and enrich the information identification mode.

title: Intelligent diagnosis guiding method and system
assignee: 无码科技（杭州）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an intelligent diagnosis guiding method and system, which relate to the technical field of medical information and comprise the following steps: intention classification is carried out on the current input information of the user to obtain the current intention category of the user; when the current intention category is symptom description, carrying out symptom term matching on the current input information to obtain the chief complaint symptom of the user; determining a first candidate department set based on the chief complaint symptoms, and constructing a weighted directed graph with the chief complaint symptoms and each first candidate department as nodes; and calculating the score of each first candidate department according to the side weight to generate a first kinni index of department score distribution in the first candidate department set, judging whether to inquire according to the kini index, if so, determining inquiry symptoms, and otherwise, recommending the final visiting department to the user. The method and the system have the advantages that the diagnosis guide interaction decision degree generated in an automatic form is high, the labor cost is saved, the generalization performance is good, meanwhile, a large amount of labeled data is not needed when the department is predicted, and the interpretability is high.

title: Pose-based beam update techniques for wireless communications
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described in which a user equipment (UE) may be configured to monitor a set of beams, and may request an update to a monitoring configuration based on a position of the UE, an orientation of the UE, a rate of change of the position or orientation, or any combinations thereof. In some cases, the position or orientation information of the UE may include information for a current time period, predictive information for one or more future time periods, other information, or any combinations thereof. The UE may transmit a beam monitoring request to a base station for an updated monitoring configuration, such as a subset of a set of configured beams or an identified scan angle to be monitored by the UE.

title: Secondary profiles with confidence scores
abstract: A system, apparatus, and method are provided for implementing secondary profiles for members of an online application or service. Each member has a corresponding primary profile populated by the member, and a secondary profile populated with information from data sources other than the member. Each fact or entry in the secondary (or inferred) profile is accompanied by a confidence score reflecting confidence in the source of the fact, confidence that the fact is correctly associated with this member, and/or other factors. A given fact may be obtained or extracted from multiple sources, with each copy or version assigned a separate confidence score. In response to a request to identify members having a particular attribute, in addition to identifying members that have the attribute in their primary profiles, members having the attribute in their secondary profiles may be identified if the corresponding confidence scores are greater than a threshold.

title: Fundus image processing method and fundus image processing system
assignee: 江苏富翰医疗产业发展有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to the field of medical image processing technology; the application provides a fundus image processing method and a fundus image processing system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring bright part information and dark part information of a color fundus image to obtain a bright part image and a dark part image; subtracting the dark part image from the bright part image, and adding the dark part image with pixels of the color fundus image to obtain a first processed image; performing blurring processing on the first processed image; acquiring high-frequency information in a first processed image; then performing high-frequency information enhancement on the first processed image after the blurring processing by using the high-frequency information to obtain a second processed image; and finally denoising the second processed image by using a target detection and image segmentation network model to obtain a clear fundus image, wherein the target detection and image segmentation network model is a deep learning model obtained by training fundus sample images so as to solve the problems that low texture and high noise exist and real-time denoising cannot be realized when the fundus image is clarified by using other image processing methods.
assignee_clean: 江苏富翰医疗产业发展有限公司
primary_assignee: 江苏富翰医疗产业发展有限公司

title: Computer-executable and traceable metric queues system
abstract: A computer-controlled system for digitally evaluating one or more computer-executable and traceable metrics associated with a machine at a node. The system includes a computerized data collection wireless device for collecting digital data stored in the form of a plurality of computer-executable files from the machine. The computerized data collection wireless device includes a metric logistics device that generates a metric queue containing a plurality of computer-executable metric components storing information indicative of at least one of a date, time, geo-coordinates, machine identification details, and computer readable and executable performance data associated with the machine. The system includes a data aggregator and a computer-controlled metric appliance communicatively coupled to the data aggregator and receives the metric queue from the data aggregator. The computer-controlled metric appliance analyzes and processes the metric queue to generate an output that is indicative of whether the metric is achieved or not by the machine.

title: System and method for accelerating FEP methods using a 3D-restricted variational autoencoder
abstract: A system and method for accelerating the calculations of free energy differences by automating FEP-path-decision-making and replacing the standard series of alchemical interpolations typically created by molecular dynamic (MD) simulations with voxelated interpolated states. A novel machine learning approach comprising a restricted variational autoencoder (ResVAE) is used which can reduce the computational-cost associated with interpolations by restricting the dimensions of a molecular latent space. The ResVAE generates a model based on flow-based transformations of a 3D-VAE latent point that is trained to maximize the log-likelihood of MD samples which enables the model to compute transformations more efficiently between molecules and also handle deletions of atoms more efficiently during iterative FEP calculation steps.

title: Digestive tract endoscope lesion detection and identification method based on sliding window
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image intelligent processing, and particularly relates to a digestive tract endoscope lesion detection and identification method based on a sliding window. Early screening by endoscopy is an effective means to reduce the incidence and mortality of digestive cancer. In the traditional diagnosis method, the diagnosis of the doctor is a subjective judgment process completely, and is limited and influenced by the experience and knowledge level of the diagnostician. Therefore, the deep learning is applied to the lesion detection of the gastrointestinal endoscope, a sample is made based on the frame of a lesion area marked by a doctor, and a classifier is trained; and (4) extracting a candidate region from the gastrointestinal endoscope image to be detected, inputting the candidate region into a classifier, and performing post-processing on a classification result to achieve the purpose of lesion detection. The experimental result shows that the invention can accurately detect the lesion position of the endoscope image of the alimentary canal, provides reference for doctors and explains that the artificial intelligence assisted diagnosis and treatment of the early cancer of the alimentary canal has irreplaceable superiority.

title: Ultra-low dose PET image reconstruction system and method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses an ultra-low dose PET image reconstruction system and method based on deep learning, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the PET and MRI registration and standardization module is used for registering and standardizing PET and MRI images; the shift prediction network module is used for fully exploring the structural information among stacked two-dimensional image slices which are formed by disassembling the three-dimensional brain image data of the tested person and predicting a shift value; the space variable aggregation module captures the metabolic residual value of each slice relative to the adjacent slices through variable convolution and displacement values, so that the aim of pre-strengthening low-dose images is fulfilled, and the execution efficiency and the performance of the subsequent modules are accelerated; the pre-reinforced ultra-low dose PET and MRI slices are fused based on a CNN and a bimodal fusion coding module of the self-adaptive weight adjustment loss; based on the generation countermeasure network, the accuracy and the high efficiency of the process of synthesizing the full-dose PET image are ensured, and the semantic understanding capability of the image is further improved.

title: Image generation system for generating pseudo CT from multi-sequence MR based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses an image generation system for generating pseudo CT from multi-sequence MR based on deep learning, which comprises: the data collection module is used for collecting a data set comprising CT images and multi-sequence MR image data and dividing the data set into a training set and a test set; an image generation model training module for respectively training the generator G based on CNN by using the small batches of data of corresponding modes in the training setCTAnd GMRAnd a discriminator DCTAnd DMRPerforming iterative training to obtain an optimal image generation model; and the image generation module is used for generating a pseudo CT image from the multi-sequence MR images of the test set. The method is based on the counter network generated circularly, and complementary features among different sequences of the MR image are fully utilized through a multi-sequence feature fusion strategy, so that the synthesis quality of the pseudo CT image is remarkably improved; a multi-sequence identity loss term is introduced, so that the stability and reliability of the network training process are improved; and a contour loss term is constructed between the original image and the synthesized image, so that the distortion of the anatomical structure of the synthesized image is reduced, and the quality of the synthesized CT image is improved.

title: Method for transmitting measurement report by wireless node in wireless communication system and apparatus therefor
abstract: A method for transmitting a measurement report by a wireless node in a wireless communication system is disclosed. The method comprises measuring a channel for obtaining channel congestion information; and transmitting the measurement report including the channel congestion information to the network, wherein the channel congestion information is determined based on a number of times a busy period appears and a number of busy samples, within a reporting interval.

title: Cerebral apoplexy focus segmentation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a stroke focus segmentation method and system. According to the stroke focus segmentation method and system provided by the invention, in the model creation process, partial convolution units in the traditional U-Net network model are replaced by convolution long-time and short-time memory units, and the correlation among the slices is established, so that the segmentation performance is improved by utilizing the correlation among the slices; in the data preprocessing stage, orderly rotating and slicing operation is carried out on 3D image data of the cerebral apoplexy to generate a first orderly rotating and slicing sequence and a second orderly rotating and slicing sequence of a 2D positive sequence and a 2D negative sequence, and a first orderly rotating and slicing sequence training and segmenting model is used for respectively generating a positive reverse sequence long-time memory U-Net segmentation network model; and in the segmentation implementation stage, a positive and negative sequence long-time memory U-Net segmentation network model is adopted to perform data fusion on positive and negative sequence lesion segmentation result sequences obtained by segmentation according to the second ordered rotary slicing sequence, so that the accuracy of lesion segmentation can be further improved.

title: Single-camera real-time three-dimensional human body posture detection method based on self-adaptive mapping relation
assignee: 深圳龙岗智能视听研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a single-camera real-time three-dimensional human body posture detection method based on a self-adaptive mapping relation, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a self-adaptive human body posture mapping relation library; performing two-dimensional human body joint point detection on each frame of image obtained by the camera by using a deep learning model to obtain joint point data; using a quick search algorithm to find out a plurality of three-dimensional human body posture mappings corresponding to two-dimensional human body joint points in a self-adaptive human body posture mapping relation library; and obtaining the final three-dimensional human body posture corresponding to the two-dimensional human body joint points by using a dynamic matching algorithm. The method is based on deep learning and a dynamic matching framework, and the detection speed is improved to a real-time detection level; the self-adaptive database and the dynamic matching algorithm are provided for the condition that a plurality of three-dimensional human body postures correspond to the same two-dimensional human body posture, the accuracy and the stability of detection results are greatly improved, and the leading detection level is obtained on the currently published test data set.

title: Disparate data aggregation for user interface customization
abstract: In some examples, there may be provided systems, devices, and methods for using data from disparate databases to determine characteristics of a set of users within an organizational unit and generate customized user interface elements for display within a user interface.

title: Female pelvic floor dysfunction disease risk early warning model and construction method and system thereof
assignee: 四川大学华西第二医院
abstract: The invention discloses a female pelvic floor dysfunction disease risk early warning model and a construction method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring risk factors of regional risk groups; s2, screening related variables in risk factors and constructing a risk early warning model; s3, training the risk early warning model to obtain model optimization. According to the invention, by constructing an early warning system of PDF, primary screening of basin bottom dysfunction disease risks is carried out on healthy people (non-basin bottom dysfunction disease), risk people, patient human portraits and the like, risk degree layering of the people is realized, the people are divided into high risk and low risk, and auxiliary diagnosis, whole-course management and grading diagnosis and treatment are carried out on key people through different follow-up strategies.

title: Integrated plant management system using artificial intelligence
abstract: In the present specification, provided is a method for a plant management system to manage a plant using an artificial intelligence module. The method comprises the steps of: receiving a reference value for initial setting from a user; setting a set value based on the reference value, and performing irrigation based on the set value; periodically monitoring and storing soil temperature and humidity, RGB values, normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) values, and bio-impedance values through the artificial intelligence module; and controlling an operation unit based on a result value of the monitoring, wherein the operation unit may include an irrigation pump, a water discharge pump, a growth lamp, and a circulation fan. Accordingly, it is possible to implement a system which can efficiently manage plants.

title: Experience orchestration
abstract: Examples of a digital orchestration system are provided. The system may obtain orchestration data on a real-time basis. The system may identify a plurality of events for offering a plurality of user services across a plurality of user interaction stages. The system may identify a plurality of actions associated with each of the plurality of events. The system may create a recipe associated with each of the plurality of actions. The system may identify and implement the associated recipe. The system may create an event sequence for each of the plurality of user interaction stages. The system may create a user service sequence comprising the plurality of user services associated with the event sequence. The system may generate a user experience result based on the event sequence and the user service sequence.

title: Reduced false alarms for outdoor IP security cameras
abstract: An apparatus comprising a camera sensor and a processor. The camera sensor may be configured to generate video data of an area of interest. The processor may be configured to (A) analyze the video data, (B) generate control signals and (C) adjust a status of a plurality of security responses. The control signals may be generated in response to (a) the analysis of the video data and (b) the status of the security responses. The control signals may adjust an activation of the security responses. A first of the security responses may be activated in response to an event detected by the analysis of the video data. A first communication to a first contact may be initiated based on the analysis of the video data of the event. A second communication to a second contact may be initiated based on a response to the first communication.

title: Fundus image generation method, fundus image generation device, fundus image generation apparatus, and fundus image storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a fundus image generation method, a fundus image generation device, fundus image generation equipment and a fundus image storage medium, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence such as computer vision, deep learning and intelligent medical treatment. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first real fundus image, a second real fundus image and a third real fundus image; extracting a fundus blood vessel mask from the first real fundus image; extracting a fundus focus mask from the second real fundus image; and inputting the third real fundus image, the fundus blood vessel mask and the fundus focus mask into a generation network to generate a simulated fundus image. The embodiment provides a fundus image generation technology combining three information of model distribution information, fundus blood vessel structure information and focus information of fundus images, and solves the problem of fundus image data shortage.

title: Ultrasonic scanning system, method and medium
assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an ultrasonic scanning system, a method and a medium, comprising the following steps: and identifying a current scanning part according to the ultrasonic image, identifying a current scanning section according to the ultrasonic image, and outputting navigation information for assisting the operation of the ultrasonic transducer to a preset position according to the current scanning part and/or the current scanning section and the position information. The invention can accurately identify the scanned part and the section, thereby leading an operator to operate the ultrasonic transducer to quickly and accurately position the target part and the section and obtain the corresponding ultrasonic image.

title: Computer system and presentation method of information
abstract: A computer system is accessible to a database storing learning data to generate a prediction model, the learning data includes input data and teacher data, the computer system: performs first learning to set an extraction criterion for extracting the learning data including the input data similar to prediction target data in a case of being input the prediction target data; extract the learning data from the first database based on the extraction criterion and generate a dataset; perform second learning to generate a prediction model using the dataset; generate a decision logic showing a prediction logic of the prediction model; and output information to present the decision logic.

title: Processing data records in a multi-tenant environment to ensure data quality
abstract: A computer system processes data records in a multi-tenant environment to ensure data quality. A plurality of records from a plurality of data sources are processed to provide a data quality metric for each field of the plurality of records based on record values in the field. A threshold range satisfying a specificity level of a data source is selected for each data quality metric. The data quality metric is compared to the threshold range to determine whether the data quality metric violates the threshold. A data quality report is provided for the plurality of records, wherein the data quality report indicates whether the data quality metric of each field violates the selected threshold range. Embodiments of the present invention further include a method and program product for processing data records in a multi-tenant environment to ensure data quality in substantially the same manner described above.

title: Systems and methods for determining an objective pressure injury score and altering a treatment plan based on the same
abstract: Systems include a plurality of sensors coupled to a person support apparatus, at least one moisture sensor configured to sense a moisture level between the person and the support surface, and at least one computing device coupled to the plurality of sensors coupled to the person support apparatus and the at least one moisture sensor. The at least one computing device receives data from the plurality of sensors coupled to the person support apparatus and the at least one moisture sensor, obtains data from an electronic medical record associated with the person supported by the person support apparatus, calculates a pressure injury score indicative of a likelihood that the person will develop a pressure injury based on the data from the plurality of sensors, the at least one moisture sensor, and the electronic medical record, and alters a treatment plan for the person based on the calculated pressure injury score.

title: Apparatus, system and method for assisting assessment of a motor function of an object
assignee: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a device, a method and a system for assisting the assessment of the motor function of a subject. The system includes a collection device and an evaluation aid independent of the collection device. The acquisition device is configured to acquire video of subject motion. The evaluation device is configured to process the captured video to obtain quantitative data for assisting in evaluating the motion function of the subject.

title: Method and apparatus for generating a 3D reconstruction of an object
assignee: 卡尔蔡司光学国际有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to generating a 3D reconstruction (62) of an object. This includes: illuminating the object, capturing image data about the object; and calculating a 3D reconstruction (62) of the object from the image data. According to the invention, the image data comprise first image data and second image data, wherein the first image data are captured when the object (12) is illuminated with illumination light, at least a part of which is reflected light illuminating the object with respect to an object imaging beam path, wherein the second image data are captured with illumination light from different recording directions, at least a part of which is directed along the object imaging beam path, and wherein a 3D reconstruction (62) of the object is calculated from the first image data and the second image data.

title: Bayesian modeling of pre-transplant variables accurately predicts kidney graft survival
assignee: The United States Of America As Represented By The Secretary Of The Navy
abstract: An embodiment of the invention provides a method for determining a patient-specific probability of renal transplant survival. The method collects clinical parameters from a plurality of renal transplant donor and patient to create a training database. A fully unsupervised Bayesian Belief Network model is created using data from the training database; and, the fully unsupervised Bayesian Belief Network is validated. Clinical parameters are collected from an individual patient/donor; and, such clinical parameters are input into the fully unsupervised Bayesian Belief Network model via a graphical user interface. The patient-specific probability of disease is output from the fully unsupervised Bayesian Belief Network model and sent to the graphical user interface for use by a clinician in pre-operative organ matching. The fully unsupervised Bayesian Belief Network model is updated using the clinical parameters from the individual patient and the patient-specific probability of transplant survival.

title: Real-time image generation method for super-resolution B-mode ultrasound image
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time image generation method for super-resolution B-mode ultrasound images, which aims at the problem that the definition needs to be improved in the generation process of the B-mode ultrasound real-time images. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a loss function based on MSE; two types of loss were prepared for the different phases: carrying out secondary classification on the gray scale of the black-and-white image by using the cross entropy loss, initializing the internal characteristics and attention parameters of the network, and using MSE as a loss function of a post-stage refinement result; constructing the neural network according to the core block of the deep convolutional neural network; stacking by using a block structure to obtain a deep convolution network, and generating a static graph; b, initializing the cross entropy loss in the step b by using an Adam optimizer, stopping training when the loss reduction rate is reduced to be close to flat, changing the loss to be MSE loss, and refining to generate enough reasoning results to improve the PSNR; weights are derived, integrated and run in the medical device using static maps. The invention can input single frame and output single frame, to obtain the result better than manual design image enhancement algorithm.

title: In-situ additive implants
abstract: Methods for growing spinal implants in situ using a surgical additive-manufacturing system. In one aspect, the method includes positioning a dispenser at least partially within an interbody space, between a first patient vertebra and a second patient vertebra. The method includes maneuvering the dispensing component within the space to deposit printing material forming an interbody implant part, positioning the dispensing component adjacent the vertebrae, and maneuvering the dispenser adjacent the vertebrae to deposit printing material on an exterior surface of each vertebrae and in contact with the interbody implant part forming an extrabody implant part connected to the interbody implant part and vertebrae, yielding the spinal implant grown in situ connecting the first vertebra to the second vertebra. The extrabody part can be printed around anchors affixed to the vertebrae, and the anchors may be printed in the process.

title: Wearable glove with hybrid resistive-pressure sensors
abstract: A wearable article comprising a knitted fabric formed in the shape of a glove. A force sensing element coupled to the fabric, the force sensing element comprising a resistive sensing system and a fluidic sensing system comprising one or more soft tubes coupled to a surface of the wearable glove wherein the resistive and fluid sensing systems correspond to first and second different sensor modalities which are physically decoupled. Control circuitry is coupled to receive signals from both the resistive sensing system and the fluidic sensing system and to combine resistive and fluidic sensing system signals provided thereto to perform at least one of: pose estimation, environment sensing, human state sensing, and static and dynamic task identification.

title: Method for diagnosis of articular phthology and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention discloses a joint disease diagnosis method which comprises the steps of: generating an image of a joint of a companion animal; preprocessing the image; and diagnosing a joint disease in the companion animal by using the image and based on a means for diagnosing the joint disease in the companion animal prepared in advance through analysis of the joint disease in the companion animal. According to the present invention, a joint disease of a companion dog can be diagnosed through an artificial intelligence algorithm which utilizes rules for diagnosing the joint disease of the companion dog derived based on accumulated clinical experience.

title: Task execution engine and system
abstract: Methods are disclosed for optimizing execution of tasks for users. A processing system including a processor detects a triggering condition for a transport task for transporting a subject from a first location to a second location via usage of an autonomous vehicle, establishes a negotiated task coordination plan between a user and a third party provider for performing the transport task, and executes the negotiated task coordination plan, wherein the executing causes the autonomous vehicle to travel between the first location and the second location for transporting the subject.

title: Method and system for analyzing nail black line skin mirror image
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing an A-black line dermatoscope image. The method comprises the following steps: establishing an original training sample set of an A-black line dermoscope image with a binary mask image label, and performing edge extraction on the image label to generate an edge detection label; performing data enhancement on the original training sample set to construct a data enhancement training sample set; building a full convolution partition network of an encoding-decoding structure; and outputting outlines of the nail area and the color-changing area by a full convolution segmentation network, and acquiring image analysis related indexes by using the image knowledge to complete nail black line dermoscopy image analysis. Compared with the traditional algorithm, the deep supervised learning method leads the model to learn the common characteristics of the images in the data set, better eliminates the interference of background noise, has a higher-precision segmentation effect and has better robustness.

title: Systems and methods for generating account permissions based on application programming interface interactions
abstract: Systems and methods for generating account permissions for an account on a computing system are provided. In some embodiments, application programming interface (API) interactions involving an external application and the computing system are used to generate a corresponding set of account permissions for the account. API permissions for the external application may also or instead be used to generate the set of account permissions for the account. The set of account permissions may enable the account to access the same resources on the computing system as the external application, which may avoid granting the account overly broad access to the computing system.

title: Identifying anomalous activity from thermal images
abstract: A computing system may train an autoencoder to generate a first set of codes from a first set of thermal video images of activities of a user in an environment. The activities may represent routine behaviors of the user in the environment. The computing system may use an unsupervised machine-learning algorithm to categorize the first set of codes into a set of clusters. The computing system may use the autoencoder to determine a code representative of a second set of thermal video images of an activity in the environment. Based on the code not being associated with any cluster in the set of clusters, the computing system may determine that the code is an anomalous code. The computing system may perform an alert action based on the anomalous code.

title: X-ray film spine automatic segmentation and identification method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image segmentation, and relates to an X-ray film spine automatic segmentation and identification method, which adopts a segmentation strategy of firstly coarse and then fine, can quickly position a spine region by utilizing a constructed deep neural network, and then realizes subsequent fine segmentation of a vertebral body; the segmentation precision is high, the constructed neural network takes the spine semantics and the edge characteristics into consideration, and the image morphological operation optimization processing is used on the basis, so that the segmented vertebral bodies are independent and can keep complete edges, and a foundation is laid for the intelligent measurement of the medical parameters of the subsequent spine X-ray film.

title: Method, device, server and medium for determining coronary artery branches where calcified regions are located
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, a server and a storage medium for determining coronary branches where calcified regions are located, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be processed, and registering a heart model obtained in advance on the image to be processed to obtain a first preprocessed image, wherein the image to be processed comprises a calcified region; obtaining a heart chamber model corresponding to the image to be processed based on the first preprocessing image; and determining the target coronary branch where the calcified region is located according to the target cavity where the calcified region is located in the heart cavity model and the probability value that the calcified region is located on at least one candidate coronary branch in the target cavity. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention solves the technical problem that in the prior art, a worker is required to determine which coronary artery the calcification point is positioned on according to experience, and has a certain error, and realizes the technical effect of rapidly and accurately determining the target coronary artery to which the calcification point belongs.

title: Classification method based on longitudinal three-dimensional image deep learning features
abstract: The invention discloses a classification method based on longitudinal three-dimensional image deep learning characteristics, and belongs to the field of image analysis. The invention comprises two stages: a training stage: the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a three-dimensional image of a research object, obtaining a slice image feature extractor, calculating a scanning image feature vector according to a bag-of-words model, and designing and training a recurrent neural network classifier; and (3) a testing stage: the method comprises the steps of making a classification request for a research object P to be classified, preprocessing a three-dimensional image of the P, extracting slice image characteristics, calculating scanning image characteristics and outputting a classification result. The invention utilizes the deep convolutional neural network to directly carry out automatic extraction of the characteristics from the slice image without any complex preprocessing steps of manually designed image characteristics, 3D registration of the image, characteristic region detection and the like, and the invention researches the longitudinal three-dimensional image, utilizes the cyclic neural network to learn the change characteristics of the image from the longitudinal three-dimensional image characteristic vector, and has more accurate classification.

title: Method to detect white blood cells and/or white blood cell subtypes from non-invasive capillary videos
abstract: In one aspect, a method to detect white blood cells and/or white blood cell subtypes from non-invasive capillary videos is featured. The method includes acquiring a first plurality of images of a region of interest including one or more capillaries of a predetermined area of a human subject from non-invasive capillary videos captured with an optical device, processing the first plurality of images to determine one or more optical absorption gaps located in said capillary, and annotating the first plurality of images with an indication of any optical absorption gap detected in the first plurality of images. The method also includes acquiring a second plurality of images of the same region of interest of the same capillary with an advanced optical device capable of resolving cellular structure of white blood cells and white blood cell subtypes and spatiotemporally annotating the second plurality of images with an indication of any white blood cell detected and/or a subtype of any white blood cell detected in the second plurality of images. The method also includes inputting the first plurality of images and annotated information from the first plurality of images and annotated information from the spatiotemporally annotated second plurality of images into a machine learning subsystem configured to determine a presence of white blood cells and/or the subtype of any white blood cells present in the one or more optical absorption gaps in the first plurality of images.

title: Medical image segmentation method based on multi-resolution overlapping attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image segmentation method based on a multi-resolution overlapping attention mechanism, which constructs a symmetrical encoder-decoder system structure with jump connection based on the multi-resolution overlapping attention mechanism, wherein the encoder realizes the attention mechanism from local to global, and the decoder gradually upsamples global features to corresponding input resolutions; and a cross-scale expansion layer module is provided to realize up-sampling and feature dimension increase, and finally, pixel-level semantic segmentation is realized through a segmentation head module. The invention utilizes a transducer attention mechanism and jump connection, fully utilizes global context characteristics and fine semantic information of each level, and greatly improves the segmentation precision of medical images in global and local levels.

title: Computer system for alerting emergency services
assignee: Agency for Science, Technology end Research
abstract: Disclosed is a computer system for alerting emergency services. The system comprises a monitoring device, a at least one physical symptom device, a transmitter, a processor, and memory. The memory stores a predetermined baseline for one or more vital signs of a patient, a physical symptom baseline, each physical symptom baseline corresponding to a device of the physical symptom device. The memory stores instructions that cause the monitoring device to measure vital signs of the patient, compare the vital sign(s) to the respective predetermined baseline for the one or more vital signs, and if the measured vital sign(s) exceed the predetermined baseline, detect one or more physical symptoms corresponding to the physical symptom baseline The instructions cause the processor to compare the one or more physical symptoms to the respective physical symptom baseline, and initiate contact of emergency services using the transmitter, if at least one of physical symptoms deviates from the respective physical symptom, detect one or more physical symptoms corresponding to the physical symptom baseline. The instructions cause the processor to compare the one or more physical symptoms to the respective physical symptom baseline, and initiate contact of emergency services using the transmitter, if at least one of physical symptoms deviates from the respective physical symptom.

title: Methods for assessing risk of developing breast cancer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods and systems for assessing the risk of a human female subject for developing breast cancer. In particular, the present disclosure relates to combining clinical risk assessment with genetic risk assessment to improve risk analysis, wherein the genetic risk assessment comprises screening for at least (72) Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs) disclosed herein or SNPs in linkage disequilibrium with one or more thereof.

title: Retinal diabetes mellitus depth network detection method based on genetic fuzzy tree
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent processing of medical information, in particular to a retinal diabetes depth network detection method based on a genetic fuzzy tree. Firstly, enhancing the retina image, widening the lesion area, and compressing the normal area; then building a network model U-net, and accurately dividing retinal blood vessels and blood vessel peripheral images; training the blood vessel image segmented by the model and a real diagnosis result to construct an interpretable fuzzy decision tree; secondly, coding the weight of the decision tree, constructing an adaptability function, and carrying out combination optimization on a plurality of decision trees based on a genetic algorithm; and finally, introducing an accuracy index to dynamically adjust a weight graph in the loss function. The invention has the beneficial effects that the vascular terminal of the retinal diabetes mellitus can be accurately identified, the accuracy of detection and classification is improved, doctors are more effectively helped to diagnose the retinal diabetes mellitus, and patients can obtain the optimal treatment period.

title: Data processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 联仁健康医疗大数据科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: upon receiving the text to be processed, determining at least one piece of data to be used having standardized coding associated with the text to be processed; for each data to be used, determining the feature similarity attribute between at least one word segmentation vocabulary in the text to be processed and the forward feature character string and/or the reverse feature character string in the current data to be used; determining target similarity of each data to be used based on the sentence similarity corresponding to each data to be used and the corresponding characteristic similarity attribute; and determining target standardized codes corresponding to the text to be processed based on the similarity of the targets. According to the technical scheme, the character coincidence rate, the forward characteristic character string and the reverse characteristic character conversion are combined, the text to be processed is identified, the corresponding standardized coding effect is determined, and the identification accuracy and the data management efficiency are improved.

abstract: The application provides an image processing method, an image processing device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein a chest image of a target user is firstly acquired; then, inputting the chest radiography image into a trained segmentation model, and determining an original rib image according to the output of the trained segmentation model; and finally, carrying out segmentation processing on the original rib image to obtain a target rib image, wherein the segmentation processing is used for obtaining a non-adhesion rib image. The deep learning neural network model can be combined with subsequent processing, the target rib image with each rib being independent can be automatically segmented, the accuracy and the efficiency of image processing are improved, and convenience is provided for doctors.

title: Blockchain content reconstitution facilitation systems and methods

User content is obtained via a client computing device and rendered onto the first and second node such that secondary content thereof is stored onto other media. This facilitates regeneration and other orderly migration of a particular node transplanted to another environment.

title: Method and device for identifying information in non-structured text
abstract: The invention provides a method and device for identifying information in a non-structured text, which can process the non-structured text containing/not containing the name or synonym form. The device for identifying information comprises a basic term extraction unit, a term extraction rule generation unit, a term extraction unit and a term mapping unit, wherein the basic term extraction unit is used for extracting the name included in the first non-structured text from the first non-structured text according to the dictionary as a basic term; the term extraction rule generation unit is used for generating a term extraction rule according to the extracted basic term and the first non-structured text; the term extraction unit is used for extracting a new term from the second non-structured text according to the extracted basic term and the generated term extraction rule; and the term mapping unit is used for mapping each extracted term to the most appropriate name in the dictionary as the identified information.
