title: Method for predicting treatment efficacy of anti-angiogenesis drug combined with immune checkpoint inhibitor
assignee: 复旦大学附属中山医院
abstract: The invention relates to a prediction method of curative effect of anti-angiogenesis medicine combined with immune checkpoint inhibitor, which is to prepare curative effect evaluation data of patients receiving anti-angiogenesis medicine combined with immune checkpoint inhibitor; reading enhanced magnetic resonance imaging data of a patient before treatment by using 3D medical image processing software, then carrying out focus range or focus area delineation on the same imaging data by a plurality of related doctors, and forming a plurality of characteristic delineation files by an enhanced magnetic resonance imaging sequence and delineation information of each doctor; respectively extracting the image omics characteristic parameters of the focus by utilizing a pyradiomics package to a number of sketching files; screening by using the obtained several image omics characteristic parameter files to obtain effective characteristics, establishing a prediction model according to the screened characteristics, and training and verifying the prediction model to predict the curative effect of the patient before treatment, so as to assist clinical decision, screen effective people, improve the overall curative effect, reduce the economic burden of the patient and avoid adverse reactions.
assignee_clean: 复旦大学附属中山医院
primary_assignee: 复旦大学附属中山医院

title: Multi-faceted security framework for unstructured storage objects
abstract: At an object storage service, one or more security rules to be implemented for a request directed to an unstructured object are identified, including a content query-based rule. The query-based rule indicates a query predicate and a security enforcement action. A value of an attribute is extracted from the unstructured object using a rule obtained via a programmatic interface, and used to verify that the predicate is satisfied. The security enforcement action is then implemented.

title: Personalization of artificial intelligence models for analysis of cardiac rhythms
abstract: Techniques are disclosed for monitoring a patient for the occurrence of cardiac arrhythmias. A computing system obtains a cardiac electrogram (EGM) strip for a current patient. Additionally, the computing system may apply a first cardiac rhythm classifier (CRC) with a segment of the cardiac EGM strip as input. The first CRC is trained on training cardiac EGM strips from a first population. The first CRC generates first data regarding an aspect of a cardiac rhythm of the current patient. The computing system may also apply a second CRC with the segment of the cardiac EGM strip as input. The second CRC is trained on training cardiac EGM strips from a smaller, second population. The second CRC generates second data regarding the aspect of the cardiac rhythm of the current patient. The computing system may generate output data based on the first and/or second data.

title: Intelligent anesthesia machine people
abstract: The utility model is a kind of intelligent anesthesia machine people, including anaesthesia machines human body and control system, infusion device is provided with anaesthesia machines human body, injection device, infusion solution heating device, touch display screen, processor, memory, information collecting device, control system includes transfusion control module, inject control module, transfusion heating control module, information acquisition module and deep learning neural network module, deep learning neural network module and transfusion control module, inject control module, transfusion heating control module, information acquisition module is connected, deep learning neural network module can be controlled to the work of other modules.The utility model can be controlled according to the actual anaesthetic effect of patient in infusion process and operation situation of change to module, so as to exactly, automatic management anesthesia.

title: Image semantic alignment system for small samples
abstract: The application discloses an image semantic alignment system for small samples based on an encoding-decoding model, which is an auxiliary diagnosis and treatment model for automatically generating medical image reports in the artificial intelligence field. The system is mainly divided into three hierarchical structures: a preprocessing layer, an encoding layer and a decoding layer. The preprocessing layer comprises image enhancement, image segmentation, image matrix conversion and label alignment; the coding layer mainly utilizes convolutional neural network (Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) encoders to extract image features; the decoding layer mainly uses a long short-term memory (LSTM) loop network to decode text matching. The alignment system of the application adapts to the generation of small sample image descriptions by adjusting the structure of the convolutional network in the image coding layer.

title: Training method, device, system, storage medium and equipment for federal learning model
assignee: 医渡云（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a training method, device, system, storage medium and equipment of a federal learning model, wherein the method is applied to a user side and comprises the following steps: model training is carried out through local data, and a local model are obtained; determining local weight parameters corresponding to the local model according to the difference degrees of the local model and the local model; transmitting local model parameters and local weight parameters corresponding to the local model to a server, so that the server updates global model parameters according to the local model parameters and the local weight parameters; receiving updated global model parameters from the server; updating the local model parameters and the local weight parameters according to the updated global model parameters to obtain updated local model parameters and updated local weight parameters; by the method, the global model with better model performance can be obtained.
assignee_clean: 医渡云 北京 技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 医渡云 北京 技术有限公司

title: Image area segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 脑玺(苏州)智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an image region segmentation method, an image region segmentation device, image region segmentation equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a cerebral blood flow image and an apparent diffusion coefficient image of a brain of a target object; calculating a first Z-fraction map corresponding to the cerebral blood flow image and a second Z-fraction map corresponding to the apparent diffusion coefficient image based on a predetermined brain image dataset of a healthy population; and processing the cerebral blood flow image, the first Z-fraction image, the apparent diffusion coefficient image and the second Z-fraction image by using a pre-trained classification model to obtain a regional segmentation image of the target object brain. According to the image area segmentation method, the ischemic penumbra segmentation is carried out through the combination of the cerebral blood flow image, the apparent diffusion coefficient image and the corresponding statistical characteristics, the information of an individual and the information compared with a healthy population are comprehensively considered, and the accuracy and the robustness of the ischemic penumbra segmentation can be improved.
assignee_clean: 脑玺 苏州 智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 脑玺 苏州 智能科技有限公司

title: Accurate prediction method for tacrolimus dosage of organ transplantation patient
assignee: 华中科技大学同济医学院附属协和医院
abstract: The invention discloses a method for accurately predicting the dosage of tacrolimus for an organ transplant patient, which comprises the following steps: collecting model building data including personal data of a patient, tacrolimus clinical medication data based on an organ transplant patient and gene detection data; managing and statistically analyzing the collected model building data; and establishing a tacrolimus dosage model for organ transplantation based on the model establishment data, wherein the model establishment comprises data arrangement, a basic structure model, covariate inclusion and model verification. The Tacrolimus accurate dose prediction mathematical model helps to accurately predict the initial dosage and dosage adjustment scheme of an individual patient clinically, reduces the risk of rejection caused by toxic and side effects or too low dosage of Tacrolimus, reduces the incidence rate of acute rejection, reduces adverse drug events, has important significance for the accurate application of immunosuppressive drugs for organ transplantation patients, and has good economic and social benefits.
assignee_clean: 华中科技大学同济医学院附属协和医院

title: Intelligent question and answer method and device based on pharmacy knowledge graph
assignee: 北京诺道认知医学科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an intelligent question and answer method and device based on a pharmacy knowledge graph. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an answer to a current question; if the answer to the current question is judged to be matched with the information represented by the current node to be answered, outputting the question according to the next node to be answered; wherein, the current question is output according to the current node to be answered; the node to be answered is an intermediate node of which the represented information can not be obtained according to the initial input information; the intermediate node is an intermediate node on the regular path; the regular path is obtained by searching the pharmaco-knowledgeable map based on the initial input information, and the information represented by the start node on the regular path matches the patient's disease information in the initial input information. According to the intelligent question-answering method and device based on the pharmacy knowledge graph, the intelligent question-answering is carried out through the pharmacy knowledge graph, the question-answering process accords with professional medication rules, and the accuracy and the practicability of the intelligent question-answering can be improved.

primary_assignee: 北京诺道认知医学科技有限公司

title: Surgical robot based on ultrasonic image and electronic skin and positioning method thereof
assignee: 山东卓业医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical clinic, in particular to an operation robot based on ultrasonic images and electronic skin and a positioning method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out coordinate extraction on the skin acquisition layout to generate standard positioning coordinate data; performing puncture area skin marking and coordinate optimization on the standard positioning coordinate data by utilizing an electronic skin technology, and generating accurate space coordinate data; ultrasonic image data acquisition is carried out on the skin acquisition layout by utilizing ultrasonic image acquisition equipment, so that ultrasonic image data are generated; carrying out three-dimensional image construction on the ultrasonic image data by utilizing a three-dimensional modeling technology to generate a three-dimensional image model; performing three-dimensional image target positioning mapping on the three-dimensional image model according to the accurate space coordinate data to generate target position data; and carrying out navigation path planning and instruction coding according to the target position data to generate robot navigation instruction data. By precisely locating the skin target position, the surgical robot plans the optimal navigation path.

title: Method, apparatus, and computer program product for using machine learning to encode a healthcare claim as a predefined sized vector
abstract: A method, apparatus and computer program product are provided for generating a predefined sized vector representative of a healthcare claim including a variable number of service lines. A neural network is trained to identify hierarchical relationships between claim lines and services lines and to represent the relationships in the predefined sized vector. The predefined sized vector may be used to make predictions regarding adjudication, such as probability of denial (claim-level or service-level), days to pay, probability of being paid as a diagnosis related group (DRG), allowed amount, and/or denial reason. Predictions may also be made from the predefined sized vector relating to the likelihood and/or identification of missing procedure codes.

title: Malware detection from operating system event tracing
abstract: There is disclosed in one example a computing apparatus, including: a hardware platform including a processor and a memory; and instructions encoded within the memory to instruct the processor to: receive a client event report, the client event report including an operating system event trace for an attempt to exploit a patched vulnerability, and first feature data for a malware object that made the attempt; receive second feature data for an unknown object; compare the first feature data to the second feature data; and if the second feature data match the first feature data above a threshold, convict the unknown object as malware.

title: Attribution of response to multiple channels
abstract: Various implementations for multitouch attribution are described. One example method includes receiving a plurality of channel data associated with a first channel and second channel, determining conversion data for the first channel and the second channel using the plurality of channel data, receiving a first touch event and a second touch event associated with a first channel and a second channel, determining a first attribution for the first channel using a first touch event and the first channel data, determining a second attribution for the second channel using a second touch event and the second channel data, and determine an item conversion strategy using the first attribution and the second attribution.

title: Systems and methods for impedance tomography of a body part of a patient
abstract: There is provided a system for mixed imaging modalities including impedance based analysis of a body portion of a patient, comprising: multi conductor busbar(s), each connected to a controller and at least two of multiple sensing components, a controller arranged to: iteratively perform: sequentially activate as a current source, a first sensing component previously un-used as the current source in earlier iterations, sequentially activating as a current sink, a second sensing component previously un-used as the current sink in earlier iterations, obtain surface voltages, by sequentially activating each of the other sensing components as a respective voltage sensor, and obtaining a respective voltage reading while alternating current is transmitted between the first and second sensing components, wherein the voltages and current obtained for each pair of first and second sensing component of each iteration are provided for computation of a 3D dataset of 3D impedance values of the body portion.

title: Configurable entity matching system
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for receiving an input comprising one or more attributes, selecting a subset of query options from a list of query options relevant to the attributes of the input, and based on query optimization results from an audit of previous queries, determining a priority order to execute each query in the set of queries based on the query optimization results, and executing each query in the priority order to generate a candidate list. For each candidate in the list of candidates, systems and methods are provided for selecting a subset of available workflows based on relevance to the candidate and based on workflow optimization results, determining an order in which the selected subset of workflows is to be executed, and executing the selected subset of workflows in the determined order to generate a match score indicating the probability that the candidate matches the input.

title: Health monitoring with ear-wearable devices and accessory devices
abstract: Each accessory device in a set of accessory devices may establish a respective communication link between the accessory device and an ear-wearable device. A particular accessory device in the set of accessory devices may receive data via the communication link between the particular accessory device and the ear-wearable device. The data comprise information generated based on sensor signals from sensors that monitor a user of the ear-wearable device. The accessory devices perform a health monitoring activity based on the data.

title: Blood vessel center line tracking method combining convolutional neural network and cyclic neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing and machine learning, and discloses a blood vessel center line tracking method combining a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network, wherein in an original image, a center line is sampled at equal intervals, image blocks are extracted and form a sequence, and the direction category of the sequence is given; selecting non-central line points, extracting image blocks and generating an expansion sequence, and giving direction categories of the expansion sequence; training a convolution-circulation neural network by taking the sequence and the direction category as inputs; segmenting the center line of the blood vessel in the test image and fitting to obtain an initial sequence for tracking; starting from the start sequence, tracking is achieved by predicting the direction through a convolutional-recurrent neural network. According to the method, the starting point and the end point of tracking are automatically determined, so that the problem that manual intervention is needed in the traditional method is solved, and the global and local information of the blood vessel is effectively utilized; the automatic tracking of the central line is realized, and the method has the characteristics of no need of pre-segmenting the blood vessel and high accuracy.

title: Wearable device coupled by magnets positioned in a frame in an interior of the wearable device with at least one electronic circuit
abstract: A wearable device is provided with a wearable device structure. A frame is positioned in an interior of the wearable device structure. A plurality of magnets are provided. At least a portion of the plurality of the magnets are coupled to the frame. Electronic circuitry is positioned in an interior of the wearable device structure adjacent to the frame.

title: Meibomian gland texture region segmentation method and system, storage medium and intelligent terminal
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for segmenting meibomian gland texture regions, a storage medium and an intelligent terminal, wherein the segmenting method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an intelligent terminal obtains clinically collected meibomian gland image data to be processed and inputs the meibomian gland image data into a meibomian gland segmentation network model which is established in advance through offline training; the meibomian gland segmentation network model processes the meibomian gland image data, automatically segments a meibomian gland texture area in the meibomian gland image data and an eyelid inner surface area where the meibomian gland texture area is located, and outputs a segmentation result. The meibomian gland texture area is segmented by establishing the meibomian gland segmentation network model, so that the meibomian gland texture area and the eyelid inner surface area where the meibomian gland texture area is located can be accurately positioned, the influence of poor segmentation effect caused by individual difference and different image quality in the traditional image processing is reduced or eliminated, and the accuracy of judgment and segmentation of the meibomian gland texture area is improved.

title: Coarse marking fundus oculi illumination bleeding lesion detection method and system based on bounding box correction network
abstract: The invention discloses a coarse labeling eyeground irradiation hemorragic disease detection method based on a bounding box correction network, which comprises the following steps: the fundus image preprocessing is used for enhancing the contrast ratio of the fundus image and correcting the illumination degree of the fundus image to ensure that the whole image is uniform in brightness and darkness; marking and correcting the boundary frame, namely adopting a boundary frame correction network capable of automatically correcting the rough boundary frame into a more accurate boundary frame; and (3) detecting a bleeding area by adopting a fast-rcnn network with an anchor box guiding mechanism (Guided adsorbing) and a Label Smoothing mechanism (Label smoothening) in the target detection network. The boundary frame correction network designed by the invention can effectively correct the boundary frame of the rough range of manual labeling, can remarkably decouple the target detection network from the image labeling, and greatly reduces the requirement of the model on the labeling quality (accuracy), so that the deep network can learn to obtain a good target detection model on the basis of the rough labeling, thereby reducing the time and the energy spent by a doctor on data labeling.

title: System for monitoring individuals with a monitoring device, telemetry system, activity manager and a feedback system
abstract: A monitoring device, with one or more sensors detects or measures individual information selected from of at least one of, an individual's activities, behaviors and habit information, and an individual's health. The monitoring device includes ID circuitry with an ID storage that contains a unique individual ID, a communication system which reads and transmits the unique individual ID from the ID storage, a power source and a pathway system. A telemetry system is in communication with the monitoring device. An activity manager is in communication with the monitoring device. The activity manager provides information analysis of the individual information received from the monitoring device, the individual information selected from at least one of, individual physiological information, information that is indicative of the individual's activities, data indicative of one or more contextual parameters of the individual and monitoring a degree to which an individual has followed a routine.

title: Wearable device with magnets magnetized through their widths or thickness
abstract: A wearable device is provided with a wearable device structure. The wearable device has a first end and a second end. A plurality of magnets is positioned at the first and second ends that provide for coupling of the first end to the second end of the wearable device. At least a portion of the magnets are magnetized through their widths or thickness, e.g., depth. ID circuitry is provided at a surface or an interior of the wearable device.

title: Optical camera for patient position monitoring
abstract: A method includes capturing a first set of optical images of the subject while a subject is lying on a table of a Magnetic Resonance (MR) scanner. This first set of optical images is acquired without any MR phased-array coils placed on the subject. While the subject continues to lie on the table of the MR scanner, a second set of optical images of the subject is acquired with the MR phased-array coils placed on the subject. Aside from the optical images, a set of MR images of the subject is acquired using the MR scanner. The first and second set of optical images are registered to the MR images. Following registration, the first and second set of optical images are used to determine element positioning of the MR phased-array coils in the set of MR images.

title: Enteroscopy image analysis method and device and medical image processing equipment
abstract: The application provides an enteroscope image analysis method, an enteroscope image analysis device and medical image processing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an enteroscope medical image; inputting the enteroscopy medical image into a trained enteroscopy analysis model, and outputting the intestinal abnormal severity and the target abnormal intestinal section of the enteroscopy medical image; generating an intestinal segment pathological change icon according to the intestinal abnormal severity and the target abnormal intestinal segment; and synthesizing the intestinal segment lesion icon and the enteroscope medical image to obtain a synthesized enteroscope medical image for displaying. By adopting the method, the analysis precision of the enteroscope image can be improved, the reliability of the UC detection result is further improved, and the display stability of the UC detection result is finally improved.

title: Animal harness security systems and methods
abstract: A system and associated methods use an animal harness attached to an animal to improve security at a location (e.g., a home, office, warehouse, etc.). The animal harness collects health status data of the animal, and the health status data is processed using one or more algorithms that detect changes in one or more of excitement, agitation, stress, and/or anxiety in the animal. These changes are interpreted, using a behavioral model of the animal, to determine whether the animal is witnessing a security event at the location, and when the health status data indicates the security event, the system may generate an alert. The behavioral model may be updated over time to improve performance of the algorithms to detect security events.

title: Automated quality assurance testing of structured clinical data
abstract: A method for checking the quality of data content in a structured clinical record is disclosed. The method may include the steps of providing a data quality test that checks the content of at least a portion of the data content in the structured clinical record, applying the data quality test to the portion of the data content, and returning the results of the data quality test.

title: System, method and computer-accessible medium for predicting response to electroconvulsive therapy based on brain functional connectivity patterns
assignee: The Trustees Of Columbia University In The City Of New York
abstract: An exemplary system, method and computer-accessible medium for determining an effect(s) of a convulsive stimulation therapy(ies) on a patient(s) can be provided, which can include, for example, receiving first information related to a visual network or a default mode network of a brain of the patient(s), receiving second information related to a subgenual ACC or a default mode (DMN network of the brain of the patient(s), and determining the effect(s) of the convulsive stimulation therapy(ies) based on a relationship between the first information and the second information. The convulsive stimulation therapy(ies) can be an electroconvulsive therapy or a magnetic seizure therapy.
assignee_clean: the trustees of columbia university in the city of new york
primary_assignee: the trustees of columbia university in the city of new york

title: Non-invasive assessment of glymphatic flow and neurodegeneration from a wearable device
abstract: A computer-implemented method and system includes accessing neurophysiological and neurovascular data recorded during sleep. A function mapping is executed from said neurophysiological and neurovascular data to a target that is one of a glymphatic flow marker, a molecular analysis marker of neurodegeneration, or a neuroimaging marker of neurodegeneration. A target prediction model is output based on the function mapping. The target prediction model can receive new neurophysiological and neurovascular data and output a predicted marker of neurodegeneration.

title: X-ray photon counting detector consistency calibration method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a consistency calibration method of an X-ray photon counting detector based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: 1. bad pixel positioning: analyzing the projection image by using a clustering algorithm to obtain bad pixel coordinates; 2. bad pixel classification and compensation: and classifying the bad pixels by using correlation analysis to obtain the bad points of the detector and calibrating the bad points. 3. Projection image noise cancellation: and training the convolutional neural network by using the label data to eliminate noise in the projection image, and completing consistency calibration of the X-ray photon counting detector. According to the invention, the bad pixel coordinates of the detector are obtained and calibrated by analyzing the rear-end projection image, the bad pixel position of the detector can be more accurately determined, and quantum noise in the projection image is completely eliminated, so that the method is more convenient and faster than the conventional front-end calibration.

title: Cell image recognition method, system, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a cell image identification method, a system, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method is applied to the field of artificial intelligence deep learning, and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving a cell image sent by an image acquisition device, wherein the cell image is a real-time image of an in-vitro cell smear in a microscope visual field, the image acquisition device is arranged on the microscope, and the image acquisition device is used for acquiring images in the microscope visual field; calling a cell recognition model to recognize a cell image to obtain a recognition result, wherein the cell recognition model is a convolutional neural network model for recognizing target cells in the cell image, and the recognition result comprises labeling information of the target cells in the cell image; generating a target image according to the identification result and the cell image, wherein the target image is an image with the identification result marked on the cell image; the method can assist a user in cytological examination and improve the accuracy of cell screening.

primary_assignee: 腾讯医疗健康 深圳 有限公司

title: Motion detection system, motion detection method, and computer-readable recording medium thereof
assignee: 宏达国际电子股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a motion detection system, a motion detection method and a computer-readable recording medium thereof. The motion detection system includes one or more haptic feedback devices and a motion sensor. The haptic feedback device is equipped with one or more haptic feedback elements. The haptic feedback element is configured to perform haptic feedback. The haptic feedback element is triggered to perform haptic feedback according to the haptic feedback command. Triggering a haptic feedback element in response to a haptic feedback command modifies a detection value from the motion sensor. Therefore, the accuracy of positioning the haptic feedback device can be improved.
assignee_clean: 宏达国际电子股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 宏达国际电子股份有限公司

title: Brain disease detection method and device based on graph neural network and multi-task learning
assignee: 清华大学, 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The invention provides a brain disease detection method and device based on a graph neural network and multitask learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial modal image of a brain, aligning the initial modal image according to a preset modal image template to acquire a target modal image, and determining different brain partition image areas of the target modal image; inputting the target modal image into a pre-trained image feature extractor, and identifying the target low-dimensional image feature of the target modal image in a preset space; carrying out graph neural network coding on brain region node characteristics of all brain region image areas to determine structural characteristics of the human brain; and inputting the structural characteristics and the target modal image into a preset task processing model, extracting basic image characteristics through a parent branch of the task processing model, and processing the basic image characteristics through a child branch of the task processing model to obtain a disease detection result. Therefore, the detection accuracy of the brain diseases is improved.
assignee_clean: 清华大学; 中国人民解放军总医院

title: Outlier system for grouping of characteristics
abstract: A device and method is disclosed for automatically grouping data based on characteristics. The device and method include a communication interface for receiving data for component information, a storage medium for storing the received data, and a processor for performing an analysis on the received data to determine parameters included within the data and processing the data using correlations within the data to group or isolate data points. The correlations enable the processor to identify attributes associated with particular groups of the data.

title: Automated distractor generation by performing disambiguation operations
abstract: A method, system and computer-usable medium are disclosed for automating the generation of an incorrect answer to a question suitable for a multiple choice exam. An input corpus of human-readable text associated with a subject domain is provided to a question generation system, where it is processed to generate a set of question-answer (QA) pairs. The set of QA pairs is then processed with the corpus of input text to extract a set of input keywords and concepts. A concept dependency graph is then used to perform disambiguation operations on the set of input keywords and concepts, and the reference keywords and concepts it contains, to generate a set of distractor words. The resulting set of distractor words is then processed with the set of QA pairs to generate a set of multiple choice question-answers that include various distractor answers.

title: Session management method
abstract: One disclosure of the present specification provides a method by which a network control node performs communication. The method comprises the steps of: determining whether to request, from a network function (NF), control for a network slice on the basis of a session, which is managed by a network control node, being related to an interworking procedure and on the basis of the network slice being controlled by a provider policy set in the network control node, the network slice being related to the session; transmitting a control request message for the network slice to the NF, on the basis of the determination that the network control node requests control for the network slice; and receiving a response message from the NF, wherein the response message includes information about whether the session is available in the network slice.

title: Activation and deactivation for pool of resources
abstract: A method and apparatus for activation and/or deactivation for a pool of resources is provided. A first device operating in a wireless communication system receives, from a network, a configuration of one or more resource pools for autonomous resource selection, selects a resource pool for a logical channel from among the one or more resource pools based on data being available in the logical channel, and transmits, to a second device, information on the selected resource pool.

title: Dictionary expansion using neural language models
abstract: Embodiments relate to a system, program product, and method for iterative expansion and application of a domain-specific dictionary. One or more dictionary instances are applied against a text corpus. The dictionary is iteratively expanded and selectively populated with one or more additional dictionary instances, including semantically similar instances to the applied dictionary instances and extension instances contextually related to the applied dictionary instances. The iteratively expanded dictionary is applied to an unexplored corpus to identify matching corpus data to populated instances of the dictionary.

title: Method and apparatus for registration of multimodal imaging data using constraints
abstract: First and second images obtained from first and second imaging modalities, respectively, are set as a target image and an object image, respectively. The object image is segmented into one or more anatomic segments. Each segment is associated with a respective anatomic class. At least one attribute is assigned to at least one of the anatomic segments based on the anatomic class corresponding to said at least one anatomic segment. A registration is performed with the object image and the target image, wherein the registration is constrained by the assigned attribute(s).

title: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based guidance for an ultrasound device to improve capture of echo image views
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based guidance for an ultrasound device to improve capture of echo image views comprises receiving a plurality of the echo images captured by a probe of the ultrasound device, the ultrasound device including a display and a user interface (UI) that displays the echo images to a user. One or more neural networks process the echo images to continuously attempt to automatically classify the echo images by view type and generates corresponding classification confidence scores. The view type of the echo images are simultaneously displayed in the UI along with the echo images. Feedback indications are displayed in the UI of the ultrasound device to the user, where the feedback indications include which directions to move the probe of the ultrasound device so the probe can be placed in a correct position to capture and successfully classify the echo images.

title: Suggesting queries based upon keywords
abstract: One or more computing devices, systems, and/or methods for generating a list of suggested queries associated with one or more keywords are provided. For example, one or more keywords may be received via a search interface. A plurality of queries associated with the one or more keywords may be determined based upon the one or more keywords and a historical query database. A plurality of relationship scores associated with the plurality of queries may be generated based upon a plurality of search sessions associated with the historical query database. The historical query database may be analyzed to determine a plurality of click rates associated with the plurality of queries. A list of suggested queries may be generated based upon the plurality of relationship scores and the plurality of click rates.

title: Method and apparatus for controlling and manipulation of multi-phase flow in microfluidics using artificial intelligence
abstract:
The present invention relates to a system for controlling microfluidic droplets or bubbles. The system 
includes a microfluidic generator for generating the micro-droplets or bubbles. A feedback sensor is 
provided for sensing one or more feedback parameters of the generated micro-droplets or bubbles. A 
controller is provided for controlling the microfluidic generator using the sensed feedback parameters.

title: Blood pressure waveform monitoring method and device
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The application is suitable for the technical field of medical measurement, and provides a blood pressure waveform monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a physiological signal waveform, and performing signal segmentation processing on the physiological signal waveform to obtain a segmented signal waveform corresponding to the physiological signal waveform; the physiological signal waveform is acquired by signal acquisition equipment; inputting the segmented signal waveform corresponding to the physiological signal waveform into a trained function parameter generation model for processing to obtain a function parameter corresponding to the physiological signal waveform; and performing waveform reconstruction according to the function parameters to obtain a continuous blood pressure waveform corresponding to the physiological signal waveform, acquiring the acquired physiological signal waveform, generating a model based on the trained function parameters to obtain the function parameters corresponding to the physiological signal waveform, and reconstructing the corresponding continuous blood pressure waveform according to the function parameters to realize continuous monitoring of the blood pressure waveform.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院

title: Method and system for ventricular assistive device adjustment using a wearable device
abstract: There is provided herein, a method for adjusting a VAD device parameters using a wearable device placed on the patient's hand, the method includes the steps of acquiring a set of signals from sensors in the wearable device, computing at least one quality metric, and adjusting at least one VAD operational parameter so as to optimize at least the one quality metric.

title: System for providing consulting using artificial intelligence
abstract: The present invention relates to a consulting providing system using artificial intelligence (AI), which comprises: a user terminal used by each user and communicating with a consulting providing server through a wired or wireless communication network; and a consulting providing server communicating with the user terminal, providing consulting-related information according to a request of the user terminal, collecting commercial district data in a specific region requested by the user terminal and personal data of a user using the user terminal, storing the collected commercial district data and personal data in a database, analyzing the commercial district data and personal data converted into big data using AI, and visualizing and sharing the analysis results to provide consulting-related information. According to the present invention, optimal consulting information is quickly provided to each user by providing a consulting service using AI technology.

title: Controller-based management of noncompliant power over ethernet devices
abstract: Systems and methods provide for managing a power consumption policy for a powered device. A network controller may be configured to receive power consumption information for a powered device (PD) connected to power sourcing equipment (e.g., a PSE device), calculate a predicted threshold for the PD based on the power consumption information for the PD, and transmit the predicted threshold for the PD to the PSE device. Power sourcing equipment is configured to calculate power consumption information for the PD, transmit the power consumption information for the PD to the network controller, receive a predicted threshold for the PD, and implement a power consumption policy for the PD based on the predicted threshold.

title: Asynchronous evaluation strategy for evolution of deep neural networks
abstract: The technology disclosed proposes a novel asynchronous evaluation strategy (AES) that increases throughput of evolutionary algorithms by continuously maintaining a queue of K individuals ready to be sent to the worker nodes for evaluation and evolving the next generation once a fraction Mi of the K individuals have been evaluated by the worker nodes, where Mi<<K. A suitable value for Mi is determined experimentally, balancing diversity and efficiency. The technology disclosed is extended to coevolution of deep neural network supermodules and blueprints in the form of AES for cooperative evolution of deep neural networks (CoDeepNEAT-AES). Applied to image captioning domain, a threefold speedup is observed on 200 graphics processing unit (GPU) worker nodes, demonstrating that the disclosed AES and CoDeepNEAT-AES are promising techniques for evolving complex systems with long and variable evaluation times.

title: Anesthesia and consciousness depth monitoring system
assignee: 中科搏锐（北京）科技有限公司, 中科搏康(北京)医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The utility model discloses an anesthesia and consciousness degree of depth monitor system, including wearing the anesthesia depth sensor at the head, cerebral blood oxygen saturation sensor reaches the main control unit who passes through the cable connection with two sensors, main control unit includes EEG signal acquisition module, infrared light transceiver module, central processing unit, show output module and user input module, central processing unit is used for sending synchronous instruction acquisition signal to EEG signal acquisition module and infrared light transceiver module, receive through the EEG acquisition data that EEG signal acquisition module handled and through the cerebral blood oxygen acquisition data that infrared light transceiver module handled, central processing unit carries out synchronous data processing to EEG acquisition data and cerebral blood oxygen acquisition data, obtain EEG and cerebral blood oxygen saturation synchronous data, and show numerical value or trend curve on showing output module. The utility model discloses synchronous brain electricity and brain blood oxygen gather, really realize synchronous collection, analysis and relevant index's real-time extraction.
assignee_clean: 中科搏锐 北京 科技有限公司; 中科搏康 北京 医疗器械有限公司
primary_assignee: 中科搏锐 北京 科技有限公司

title: Deep learning-based dispute focus generation method
abstract: The invention relates to a deep learning-based dispute focus generation method, which comprises the following steps of: step 1) crawling a large number of judge documents from a network; step 2) carrying out preliminary cleaning and arrangement on the judge document by using a regular expression method, extracting original complaints and told names in the judge document, manually marking each pair of original complaints and told names, and manually marking the original told names, told names and manually marked data sets, wherein 1:1:1 to construct a training set; step 3) training the training data set obtained in the step 2) by using a seq2seq text generation model and an attribute model in deep learning, and then deriving a generator model corresponding to the training data set; and 4) generating the dispute focus of the two parties from the unlabeled original complaint name and the told dialect by using the trained text generator obtained in the step 3).

title: Urine sediment tube type identification method based on morphological segmentation and deep learning
assignee: 深圳市美侨医疗科技有限公司
abstract: A urine sediment tube type identification method based on morphological segmentation and deep learning relates to the field of medical image processing, and is used for solving the problems of high false positive rate and missed detection rate of the existing urine sediment tube type automatic identification, and the method comprises the following steps: the original color urinary sediment image is subjected to linear transformation by adopting a color migration method, so that the background color difference of the original image among different samples is reduced, the integral span of the colors contained in the similar type tube is reduced to the maximum extent, and the similar type tube data distribution is more concentrated; performing tubular segmentation on the color-migrated image by adopting a morphological combination algorithm, and primarily screening to obtain tubular candidate areas; rotating the candidate sub-images, performing poisson fusion and the like to synthesize a standard input image; inputting normalized image data into a residual neural networkThe model performs network training and automatic classification. The invention has the advantages of better robustness and higher recognition rate, and greatly reduces the omission rate and false positive rate of the tube type in clinical detection of urinary sediment.
assignee_clean: 深圳市美侨医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市美侨医疗科技有限公司

title: Conversation based dynamic functional settings
abstract: Methods, computer program products, and systems are presented. The method computer program products, and systems can include, for instance: receiving conversation data of a user from a data source, the data source being provided be a voice enabled personal assistant (VEPA); processing the conversation data to return a sentiment parameter value and a topic parameter value for the conversation data; updating one or more functional setting of a computing environment in dependence on the sentiment parameter value and the topic parameter value; receiving subsequent conversation data from the data source; and processing the subsequent conversation data in accordance with the updated one or more functional setting.

title: Electronic device with wakeup word determined multi-mode operation
abstract: An artificial intelligence device is provided. The artificial intelligence device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes: an input unit configured to receive a speech input; and a processor configured to operate in an interaction mode if a second wakeup word for setting an operation mode is recognized after a first wakeup word for calling the artificial intelligence device is recognized, and process one or more commands received after the second wakeup word according to the operation mode indicated by the second wakeup word.

title: Design data analysis platform using machine learning
assignee: 埃森哲环球解决方案有限公司
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for designing data analysis platforms using machine learning are disclosed. In one aspect, a method includes acts of receiving data indicative of characteristics of the data for analysis, analysis techniques to be applied to the data, and requirements of a user accessing the analyzed data. These actions also include: provider information is accessed, the provider information indicating computing capabilities of a respective data analysis provider, analysis techniques provided by the respective data analysis provider, and a real-time data analysis load of the respective data analysis provider. The actions also include applying characteristics of the data, analysis techniques, requirements of the user, and provider information, analysis techniques, and real-time data analysis loads to the model. These actions also include: one or more specific data analysis providers are configured to perform analysis techniques on the data.
assignee_clean: 埃森哲环球解决方案有限公司
primary_assignee: 埃森哲环球解决方案有限公司

title: Method, System and Computer-Readable Medium for Prescreening Brain Disorders of a User
abstract: The present invention relates to a method, a system and a computer-readable medium for diagnosing brain diseases of a user, and more particularly, to a method, a system and a computer-readable medium for diagnosing brain diseases of a user that receives brainwave information from a plurality of brainwave sensor parts that sense in a plurality of positions of the head of a user, analyzes an image map generated based on an asymmetry value for each piece of the received brainwave information, and determines and provides whether the user has brain diseases and the degree of the brain disease.

title: Machine learning optimization framework
abstract: Techniques that facilitate machine learning optimization are provided. In one example, a system includes a computational resource component, a batch interval component, and a machine learning component. The computational resource component collects computational resource data associated with a group of computing devices that performs a machine learning process. The batch interval component determines, based on the computational resource data, batch interval data indicative of a time interval to collect data for the machine learning process. The machine learning component provides the batch interval data to the group of computing devices to facilitate execution of the machine learning process based on the batch interval data.

title: Spatial and temporal encoding of transmission for full synthetic transmit aperture imaging
abstract: Techniques, systems, and devices are disclosed for spatial and temporal encoding of transmission in full synthetic transmit aperture imaging to achieve optimal spatial and contrast resolution and large signal-to-noise ratio for medical imaging applications with fewer signal transmissions, which can be equal to or less than the number of array elements within the aperture. In some aspects, a method of signal transmission is disclosed that includes a sequence of one or more sets of transmissions on a plurality of elements with unique, random, and/or optimized combinations of waveforms using amplitude and phase, and/or delay encoding. Sets of echoes corresponding to the sequence are beamformed such that fewer transmissions are needed than the number of array elements within the aperture, while maintaining complete spatial sampling of the aperture as if sampled according to a full set of synthetic transmit aperture transmissions on the same aperture.

title: Determination device for radiotherapy curative effect, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 福建自贸试验区厦门片区Manteia数据科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a radiotherapy curative effect determining device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein the device includes: the first acquisition unit is used for acquiring image features corresponding to N daily images of the target object, wherein N is an integer greater than 1, and the N daily images are medical images shot by the target object during radiotherapy; the determining unit is used for determining image characteristic change information corresponding to the target object in the radiotherapy period according to the image characteristics corresponding to the N daily images; and the processing unit is used for processing the image characteristic change information corresponding to the target object in the radiotherapy period through a target model to obtain the curative effect information corresponding to the target object in the radiotherapy period, wherein the target model is a model trained based on a plurality of historical daily images of the reference object and the historical curative effect information corresponding to the reference object. The technical problem that the radiotherapy curative effect cannot be evaluated in the radiotherapy process in the prior art is solved.

title: Image processing method and device
assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司, 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司
abstract: The application discloses an image processing method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of view angle images of an original image based on different view angles; extracting the characteristics of each visual angle image based on a depth convolution neural network model to obtain the visual angle image characteristics corresponding to each visual angle image; fusing the image characteristics of the plurality of visual angles to obtain image characteristics corresponding to the original image; and extracting a target region in the original image based on the image characteristics and classifying the target region. The method and the device solve the problem of how to improve the efficiency and the accuracy of CT image classification processing.

title: Electronic device and method for translating language
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes one or more sensors, a display device, and a processor, wherein the processor may be configured to control receiving an input, control translating the input based on at least one of a surroundings factor or a translation factor, and control providing a translation result based on at least one of the surroundings factor or the translation factor.

title: User equipment signaling and capabilities to enable federated learning and switching between machine learning and non-machine learning related tasks
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may transmit, to a base station, capability information that indicates whether the UE has a capability to support machine learning algorithms. The UE may receive, from the base station, configuration information that indicates one or more tasks to be performed in a machine learning mode or a non-machine learning mode based at least in part on the capability information. The UE may perform the one or more tasks in the machine learning mode or the non-machine learning mode. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Method and device for realizing interpretation of prediction result of machine learning model
assignee: 第四范式（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: A method and apparatus for implementing interpretation of prediction results of a machine learning model are disclosed. Acquiring a machine learning model and sample data to be interpreted; determining an interpretation method for interpreting a prediction result obtained by predicting sample data by a machine learning model; processing the prediction result by using the determined interpretation method to obtain interpretation data; and outputting the interpretation data. Therefore, corresponding interpretation methods can be adapted for different machine learning models, so that the universality of the scheme can be improved.
assignee_clean: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司

title: Machine learning system for predicting optimal interruptions based on biometric data collected using wearable devices
abstract: Method and apparatus for using machine learning to monitor biometric data to provide intelligent alerts are provided. At a first moment in time, first biometric data for a plurality of users are received from a plurality of sensor devices. A group metric is generated by processing the first biometric data using at least one trained machine learning model, and it is determined that the group metric does not satisfy one or more predefined criteria. At a second moment in time, second biometric data for the plurality of users is received from the plurality of sensor devices, and an updated group metric is generated by processing the second biometric data using the at least one trained machine learning model. Upon determining that the updated group metric satisfies the one or more predefined criteria, an indication is provided that the one or more predefined criteria have been satisfied.

title: Systems and methods for computational risk scoring based upon machine learning
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein disclose a back-end computer to generate a risk score and a front-end visualization engine to hierarchically display the generated risk core. The back-end computer users a machine learning model for a stepwise perturbation from a digital reference profile until a user profile to be score is reached. The computer may calculate intermediate risk score for each perturbation and calculate the final risk score after all the perturbations are completed. The front-end visualization engine generates an interactive hierarchical display showing information associated with the risk score calculation. More specifically, the visualization engine may show a filtered list of users sharing one or more attributes with the user profile, a visual rendering of the top factors contributing to the risk score, and individual input values within a factor; and juxtapose the scores and attributes of the user profile in the graphical information display of the associated population.

title: Machine learning-based selection of metrics for anomaly detection
abstract: A plurality of metrics records, including some records indicating metrics for which anomaly analysis has been performed, is obtained. Using a training data set which includes the metrics records, a machine learning model is trained to predict an anomaly analysis relevance score for an input record which indicates a metric name. Collection of a particular metric of an application is initiated based at least in part on an anomaly analysis relevance score obtained for the particular metric using a trained version of the model.

title: Using machine learning to evaluate patients and control a clinical trial
abstract: A method, computing platform, and computer program product are provided for monitoring a clinical trial. A computer platform receives, for the clinical trial, study design information including a set of parameters and corresponding parameter values related to travel constraints of a subject for the clinical trial. The computer platform applies the study design information and the corresponding parameter values to a trained machine learning model to calculate a predicted travel score indicative of a travel burden for the subject. When the travel score fails to satisfy a travel score threshold, the computer platform determines at least one suggestion for adjusting the travel score and the at least one suggestion is output. The computer platform outputs the predicted travel score.
