title: A kind of health status evaluation system based on multidimensional physiology big data deep learning
abstract: The present invention discloses a kind of health status evaluation system based on multidimensional physiology big data deep learning, and the feature of physiology time series data is extracted using non-supervisory convolutional neural networks, and multivariate Gaussian distribution is then recycled to do the abnormality detection of feature.The results show that being a kind of abnormality detection system of physiological signal that can be efficiently detected from the high-level feature and multivariate Gaussian abnormal distribution of original physiological signal learning signal.User can identify certain early stage illnesss, and corresponding precautionary measures is taken to reduce risk in advance.

title: Digital foveation for machine vision
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of Michigan
abstract: A machine vision method includes obtaining a first representation of an image captured by an image sensor array, analyzing the first representation for an assessment of whether the first representation is sufficient to support execution of a machine vision task by the processor, if the first representation is not sufficient, determining, based on the first representation, a region of the image of interest for the execution of the machine vision task, reusing the image captured by the image sensor array to obtain a further representation of the image by directing the image sensor array to sample the image captured by the image sensor array in a manner guided by the determined region of the image of interest and by the assessment, and analyzing the further representation to assess whether the further representation is sufficient to support the execution of the machine vision task by implementing a procedure for the execution of the machine vision task in accordance with the further representation.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of michigan
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of michigan

title: Semantic matching distillation method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a semantic matching distillation method and a semantic matching distillation device, and belongs to the technical field of semantic matching. The input sentence vectors are respectively input into a Teacher model and a Student model, the similarity of the user question and the standard question is respectively calculated by the Teacher model and the Student model, loss calculation is carried out on the output vector of the Teacher model and the output vector of the Student model, a final objective function is obtained by adding the loss, the objective function is optimized by adopting an optimization algorithm, the final Student model is obtained after optimization is completed, and finally the Student model judges the user question and the standard question, so that the semantic matching speed is improved, and the effects of few model parameters, high model reasoning speed, obvious delay reduction and work efficiency improvement are achieved.

title: Composite material defect nondestructive inspection method based on deep learning algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a composite material defect nondestructive inspection method based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing an original image, wherein each preprocessed image corresponds to one label picture; taking the preprocessed image as the input of the U-net network, taking the tag image as a tag, and carrying out iterative training on the U-net network by a gradient descent method, wherein the trained U-net network forms a processing network; the output of the processing network is a feature map of the input image; inputting an image to be processed into a processing network, outputting a feature image, processing the feature image through a threshold segmentation algorithm to obtain a binary image of a marked defect, and positioning the defect position in the binary image through a rectangular frame positioning algorithm; and finally, fusing the binary image and the image to be processed, and positioning the defect in the image to be processed. The method solves the limitations of the traditional algorithm through the rapidness and high accuracy of the neural network learning characteristics, and provides a new thought for defect detection of the composite material.

title: Alzheimer disease classification method based on fusion network
abstract: The invention discloses an Alzheimer's disease classification method based on a fusion network, which comprises the following steps: 1. given a tested magnetic resonance image data set, preprocessing; 2. dividing the sample into a training set and a testing set, and performing image amplification and normalization operations; 3. inputting a training set into a training network; 4. carrying out feature extraction and feature fusion on the sample; 5. fusing the classification decision of each base network and the classification decision of the feature fusion; 6. error calculation is carried out on the output label, and parameters are updated through back propagation; 7. evaluating the classification model and obtaining an optimal model, and repeating the steps 3-7 until the iteration is finished; 8. and (4) training the finished optimal model, and inputting the preprocessed tested magnetic resonance image data to obtain a tested label. The invention uses the line convolution neural network, realizes the method for effectively using the tested magnetic resonance image data to classify the Alzheimer's disease, and has better robustness.

title: Functional connectivity matrix processing system and device based on feature selection using filtering method
abstract: The present application discloses a system and a device for functional connectivity matrix processing based on feature selection using a filtering method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a preprocessed resting state brain functional magnetic resonance image of a subject; extracting time series; calculating a Pearson correlation coefficient to obtain a Pearson correlation coefficient matrix; vectorizing the Pearson correlation coefficient matrix; calculating quantitative correlation indices using a filtering method, and selecting a quantitative correlation index based on a preset threshold; performing weighting processing a selected functional connectivity feature by using the corresponding quantitative correlation index with high correlation with a disease diagnosis result to obtain a functional connectivity matrix; and obtaining a prediction result from the functional connectivity matrix.

title: Secure data analysis
abstract: Methods and systems for secure data analysis include determining that analysis provider access rules and data provider access rules are compatible. Analysis software is received from an analysis provider and a dataset is received from a data provider. The analysis software is executed on the dataset to generate an analysis output, with access to data in the dataset being constrained by the analysis provider access rules and the data provider access rules. An output of the analysis is sent to the analysis provider.

title: MRI system and method for detection and correction of patient motion
abstract: A system and method for detecting, timing, and adapting to patient motion during an MR scan includes using the inconsistencies between calculated images from different coil-array elements to detect the presence of patient motion and, together with the k-space scan-order information, determine the timing of the motion during the scan. Once the timing is known, various actions may be taken, including restarting the scan, reacquiring those portions of k-space acquired before the movement, or correcting for the motion using the existing data and reconstructing a motion-corrected image from the data.

title: Portable multi-modal electro-physiological signals monitor system for domestic sleeping monitoring
abstract: The utility model belongs to sleep monitor technical field, specially a kind of portable multi-modal electro-physiological signals monitor system for domestic sleeping monitoring.The system includes electrode signal acquisition component, pretreatment circuit module, multi-modal electro-physiological signals processing module, signal acquisition control module, wireless transport module and power supply power consumption management module.The utility model has used programmable a large amount of height, high integration and low-power consumption component, the multi-parameter sleep monitor of the multi-modal physiological parameters such as brain electric (EEG), eye electric (EOG), electrocardio (ECG), myoelectricity (EMG) is made to become portability, summary, low production cost in conjunction with advanced modern signal processing technology, to provide new way for domestic sleeping monitoring.

title: Liver focus image processing system and image processing method
abstract: The invention discloses a liver focus image processing system and an image processing method, which comprise an information and image acquisition module for acquiring basic information of an examiner who performs abdominal CT and a CT image, an image information processing module for transmitting the image to an algorithm server for analysis and calculation, a database storage module for writing the information and calculation results into a MySQL and MongoDB database to establish a RESTful interface and expose data, and an information display module for displaying liver and possible focus information on a front-end webpage. The system algorithm of the invention can identify and segment flat scanning and enhance micro-focus, fuzzy focus, diffuse focus, marginal focus, heterogeneous focus and the like in liver CT on the basis of the existing classical neural network u-net architecture and on the support of continuously feeding back an enlarged liver focus data set through the comprehensive improvement of the model, and improves the accuracy of liver identification to 98 percent and the accuracy of liver focus (cancer, tumor, cyst and the like) identification to 97 percent.

title: Pre-training model acquisition and disease entity labeling method, device and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the field of disease entity labeling in natural language processing, and discloses a pre-training model acquisition method, a disease entity labeling method, a device and a storage medium, which can effectively improve pre-training efficiency. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first Chinese corpus, and performing word segmentation on the first Chinese corpus to obtain a preliminary word segmentation result; word segmentation is carried out on the very used words of the preliminary word segmentation result so as to obtain a target word segmentation result; creating a Chinese vocabulary of the pre-training model according to the target word segmentation result; and pre-training the pre-training model by utilizing the Chinese vocabulary to obtain a target pre-training model.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: System and method for remote monitoring
abstract: A method for remote monitoring includes (1) generating first sensor data from a first sensor at a first network node of a communications network and (2) sending the first sensor data from the first sensor to a second network node that is remote from the first network node, via the communications network. The first network node is powered from an electrical power grid that is separate from the communications network. The first sensor data may be raw sensor data and/or lossless sensor data.

title: Hydration assessment system
abstract: The present invention provides methods and systems that provide for reliable, convenient, and noninvasive assessment of hydration status. The methods and apparatuses can use the temporal sequence of the aortic value opening and closing along with the user's body position to derive parameters that determine the hydration status of the user. The user can use this information to make near-term lifestyle changes that can improve physical performance, health, and general wellbeing.

title: Intelligent prompting method, device and equipment based on semantic analysis
assignee: 京东方科技集团股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent prompting method, device and equipment based on semantic analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first information input by a user, and identifying user intention according to the first information; determining all prompt fields for realizing the intention of the user, and judging whether the first information comprises all prompt elements corresponding to all the prompt fields; and responding to that the first information comprises all prompt elements corresponding to all prompt fields, and setting prompt information according to all prompt elements.
assignee_clean: 京东方科技集团股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 京东方科技集团股份有限公司

title: Identity-feature-fused fall identification method and system for solitary old people
abstract: The invention discloses a method for identifying falling of solitary old people by integrating identity features, which comprises the following steps: acquiring human body reflection signals and monitoring videos in a home environment, and performing time synchronization; based on the human body reflection signals, when the number of people in the home environment is 1, extracting the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the human body; performing face recognition based on the monitoring video, and monitoring the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the elderly in the solitary when the person is identified as the monitored elderly in the solitary; performing fall action recognition based on images in the monitoring video to obtain fall recognition results and fall confidence of the solitary old people; carrying out weighted fusion on the extracted and monitored heart rate and respiratory rate, and carrying out abnormal/normal classification to obtain a classification result and abnormal confidence coefficient; and carrying out maximum fusion on the falling confidence coefficient and the abnormal confidence coefficient to obtain a fused falling confidence coefficient so as to identify the falling condition of the solitary old man. The invention can solve the problem that the existing fall identification system lacks identity information of the solitary old man, and can monitor and identify in a targeted manner.

title: Flux sensing system
abstract: A flux sensing system includes a memory and a processor in communication with the memory and a sensing device, the memory storing a plurality of capabilities and a plurality of semantic fluxes associated with the plurality of capabilities. The computing system is configured to infer a semantic based on received inputs and route the inputs to the semantic fluxes based on semantic drift inference between their associated capabilities and inferred semantic. Further, it positions the sensing device for receiving the input from a user in an optimal manner.

title: Robotic post system
abstract: A robotic post system includes one or more composable robotic posts each having a processor and a memory. At least one composable post includes a set of modules including one or more pairable latches which is configured to couple and lock with another pairable latch from among another set of modules included on another of the composable posts, such that the composable robotic posts form a composable carrier structure defined by the composable robotic posts.

title: Method and system for dynamically selecting VPNC gateway and on-demand VRF-ID configuration based on user behavior patterns
assignee: 慧与发展有限责任合伙企业
abstract: Systems and methods for dynamic Virtual Private Network Concentrator (VPNC) gateway selection and on-demand VRF-ID configuration are provided. The dynamic VPNC gateway selection component may dynamically route to a particular VPNC gateway based on a number of user-specific factors, including: a) Behavior of users on the network; b) Performance of the destination service/device. The dynamic VPNC gateway selection component may rank the users based on one or more factors related to their behavior. In addition, the dynamic VPNC gateway selection component can determine whether the VPNC gateway at the data center is healthy and whether the destination service at the data center is healthy. If VPNC gateways or services are unhealthy, a dynamic VPNC gateway selection component may dynamically select VPNC a gateway from a plurality of VPNC gateways at a data center for delivering forwarding traffic from a user based on the ranking of the user.
assignee_clean: 慧与发展有限责任合伙企业
primary_assignee: 慧与发展有限责任合伙企业

title: Flux sensing system
abstract: A sensing flux system includes a memory and a processor in communication with the memory and a sensing device, the memory storing a plurality of capabilities and a plurality of semantic fluxes associated with the plurality of capabilities. The computing system is configured to infer a semantic associated with an indicated user interest based on received inputs and route the inputs to the semantic fluxes based on semantic drift inference between their associated capabilities and inferred semantic in association with a time preference indicated by the user interest.

title: System for physical-virtual environment fusion
abstract: A sensing system includes a sensor with a computing system and a memory in communication with the computing system, the memory storing a plurality of endpoints. The computing system is configured to receive activity preferences from a device at an endpoint and further determines the likeability of the activities at the endpoint. Further, it receives semantic identification preferences from the device in communication with the computing system and the system blurs the corresponding semantic identities based on the received preferences.

title: Robotic post system
abstract: A robotic post system includes one or more robotic posts having a processor and a memory. The robotic posts may include a manipulation arm and/or a swiveling and/or otherwise moveable trunk and/or base. Sensors provided on the robotic post enable the robotic post to rotate, tilt or move toward another robotic post to orient and secure a lockable band on one post with a lock on another post. A manipulation arm may grasp a lockable band and attach it to a lock, and either post may move away from the other to extend the length of a guide path.

title: Human body posture estimation method based on improved HRNet network in operating room scene
abstract: The invention discloses a human body posture estimation method based on an improved HRNet network in an operating room scene, which comprises the following steps: 1) Data preparation, which includes sample data in an operating room scene and a data set related to human body posture; 2) The HRNet network is improved, and a designed mixed attention mechanism module is added; 3) Training an improved HRNet network, training on the prepared data set related to the human body posture in a transfer learning mode, and simultaneously adding an MMD Loss in the middle layer of the network to calculate the Loss of the middle feature map so as to pull up the data distribution distances of different data sets in a parallel training mode of two data sets; 4) And transmitting the test set into a trained improved HRNet network to obtain the final predicted human body key points. The invention can solve the problems of small sample size, shielding and difficult recognition of human limbs of the original data set, and the improved HRNet network improves the accuracy of human body posture estimation and detection, thereby being beneficial to 3D human body posture estimation, behavior recognition and other visual tasks.

title: Method and apparatus for inspecting pattern collapse defects
abstract: A method for detecting defects on a sample based on a defect inspection apparatus is provided. In the method, an image data set that includes defect data and non-defect data is organized. A convolutional neural network (CNN) model is defined. The CNN model is trained based on the image data set. The defects on the sample are detected based on inspection data of the defect inspection apparatus and the CNN model. The sample includes uniformly repeating structures, and the inspection data of the defect inspection apparatus is generated by filtering out signals of the uniformly repeating structures of the sample.

title: Hemodialysis complication long-term risk prediction system based on convolution survival network
abstract: The invention discloses a long-term risk prediction system for hemodialysis complications based on a convolutional survival network, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a learning prediction module and a result display module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring a data set; the invention utilizes a convolution neural network to process multidimensional hemodialysis time sequence characteristics; the convolutional neural network combines with Cox proportion risk hypothesis to provide a convolutional survival network; and on the basis of utilizing the convolution survival network, adopting Breslow to estimate a reference risk function and calculating the long-term risk change condition of the patient. The invention can make full use of the common truncation data in medical research; the main framework of the convolutional neural network is applied, so that visual analysis is facilitated, and interpretable and heuristic results are made; long-term risk variation of the patient can be predicted.

title: Hemodialysis data acquisition and analysis system and method
abstract: The application discloses a hemodialysis data acquisition and analysis system and a hemodialysis data acquisition and analysis method, which relate to the technical field of intelligent monitoring. Therefore, real-time abnormality detection in the dialysis process can be realized, so that doctors and patients can timely detect abnormal conditions, and potential risks and hazards are avoided.

title: Hearing accommodation
abstract: A method may include obtaining a first audio signal including first speech originating at a remote device during a communication session between the remote device and a communication device and obtaining a second audio signal including second speech originating at the communication device during the communication session between the remote device and the communication device. The method may also include obtaining a characteristic of the communication session from one or more of: the first audio signal, the second audio signal, and settings of the communication device and determining a hearing level of a user of the communication device using the characteristic of the communication session.

title: Heartbeat based selection of images for cardiovascular model
abstract: To create a 3D model of part of a cardiovascular system, two 2D images taken of different orientations of the cardiovascular system may be combined. The 2D images originate from video streams taken at different points in time, which comprise frames showing a beating heart, and thus a moving cardiovascular system. Because of this movement, not just any random set of two 2D images may result in useable 3D model. To select a proper set of two 2D images, a method is provided wherein said selection is based on cardiac cycle data. The cardiac cycle data may comprise heart activity data as a function of time and timing data on cycle events. These cycle events may be repetitive, as the same events occur with every heartbeat. The selected frames are preferably selected at, or approximately at, similar events.

title: Cardiac magnetic resonance image registration method based on mask self-encoder CNN-transducer
abstract: The invention provides a cardiac magnetic resonance image registration method based on a mask self-encoder CNN-transducer, and belongs to the technical field of medical image processing. The method aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, the image redundancy characteristics and attention weight are not differentiated enough, so that the calculated amount is huge, and the higher registration accuracy cannot be achieved. The method comprises the steps that pre-training weights are obtained through a transducer pre-training network based on a mask self-encoder and used for initializing the weights based on a CNN-transducer registration network, and the registration network generates feature graphs with different dimension attention distribution weights through space & channel parallel extrusion and excitation modules; extracting features by a transducer encoder; generating a deformation field between the fixed image and the floating image by a CNN-based decoder; inputting the floating image and the deformation field into a space transformation network to obtain a registration image; and calculating the loss between the registration image and the fixed image, and generating an optimal weight registration network. The method can reduce the calculated amount and achieve more accurate registration results.

title: Median based estimation of database query responses
abstract: A computer system may include a processor and a memory coupled thereto. The memory may include a database. The processor may be configured to randomly split the database into sub-databases and applying a database query to the sub-databases. The processor may also be configured to generate respective estimated query response values for each sub-database based upon applying the database query, calculate a median of the estimated query response values, and generate a probability distribution based upon the estimated query response values and the calculated median. The processor may further be configured to select a final estimated query response value based upon the probability distribution.

title: Automatic triage method and device
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an automatic triage method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image uploaded by a diagnosis requester, and determining triage information for triage according to the medical image; matching triage elements in the triage information with expert information in a preset expert database, taking an expert identification corresponding to the matched expert information as a target identification, and distributing the medical image to a diagnosis expert corresponding to the target identification for diagnosis. Therefore, according to the method and the device, the triage information does not need to be filled in by the patient, the manual triage of the triage personnel aiming at the triage information uploaded by the diagnosis requester is not needed, the triage information can be directly extracted from the medical image, and the automatic triage is carried out based on the triage information, so that the accuracy of the triage result is improved, and the triage efficiency is also improved.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Abnormity prediction method, and abnormity prediction model training method, device and equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides an anomaly prediction method, an anomaly prediction model training method, an anomaly prediction device and anomaly prediction equipment, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: sampling the pathological images based on semantic information in the pathological images to obtain a plurality of first image blocks; based on a multi-head self-attention mechanism with a fixed window and a multi-head self-attention mechanism with a shifting window, coding the plurality of first image blocks to obtain coding features of the plurality of first image blocks, and decoding the coding features of the plurality of first image blocks to obtain a segmented image of the plurality of first image blocks; classifying the divided images based on the plurality of first image blocks to obtain the prognosis level of each first image block; and predicting the prognosis level of the pathological image based on the prognosis level of each first image block to obtain abnormal information of the pathological image. The technical scheme has the advantages that the predicted exception information is more accurate, and more accurate basis is provided for exception handling.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Access management system
abstract: An access management system includes a mobile device with a processor and a memory and a software platform including at least a processor and a memory. The software platform is configured to analyze data obtained from the mobile device and other devices connected to the software platform. Specifically, the software platform is operable to determine if an access key received, read, or captured by a mobile device matches an access key for an authorized account, object, device, or space for the mobile device, and to provide access to the mobile device if the access key received, read, or captured by the mobile device matches the authorized access key.

title: Infant feeding reinforcement system
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for providing feeding reinforcement in real-time or near real-time based on physiological sensor data acquired during feeding. In some examples, music reinforcement is rendered when one or more feeding features indicative of one or more feeding behaviors are detected using the physiological sensor data. When at least one feature is not detected, the music reinforcement is stopped. In this way, contingent reinforcement is provided in real-time or near real-time based on detection of the one or more feeding behaviors to encourage and improve independent feeding behavior.

title: System for providing artificial intelligence based baby monitoring service
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for providing an infant monitoring service based on artificial intelligence, which comprises: a monitoring terminal photographing an opposite direction of an infant to observe the infant to transmit a photographed image in real time, detecting illuminance to drive a flash, and receiving the setting of an area in a screen photographed to output a risk event or escape event; a user terminal outputting a video streamed in real time from the monitoring terminal, outputting at least one monitoring event as a guidance message when at least one pre-stored monitoring event is detected, and receiving the risk event or escape event when the risk event or escape event is detected in the monitoring terminal; and a monitoring service providing server including a storage unit mapping and storing the monitoring terminal and the user terminal, a transmission unit for transmitting the video streamed in real time from the monitoring terminal to the user terminal, an alarm unit for transmitting the risk event or escape event occurring within the set area to the user terminal when an area is set in the screen photographed by the monitoring terminal, and a transmission unit for transmitting at least one monitoring event to the user terminal as a guidance message when at least one monitoring event pre-stored in the video photographed by the monitoring terminal is detected. Accordingly, a life-threatening situation of the infant can be immediately recognized.

title: Multimode interaction method and system based on holographic equipment
assignee: 深圳优立全息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of holographic images, and discloses a multi-mode interaction method and system based on holographic equipment, which are used for improving display timeliness and display accuracy when multi-mode interaction is performed based on the holographic equipment. Comprising the following steps: collecting infrared reflection signals to obtain infrared reflection signals; collecting a target visual line and a brain wave data set; performing time sequence alignment processing to obtain target fusion data; extracting multi-type feature data to obtain position feature data, concerned position feature data and emotion feature data; space division is carried out on the three-dimensional display space to obtain a target space region; generating an interaction instruction for the voice control instruction to generate a target interaction instruction; constructing holographic display space coordinates, generating a holographic display space coordinate set, and carrying out holographic equipment matching to determine a target holographic equipment set; and constructing a three-dimensional virtual reality space, and transmitting the three-dimensional virtual reality space to the virtual reality glasses for holographic image display.
assignee_clean: 深圳优立全息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳优立全息科技有限公司

title: Human body daily behavior activity recognition optimization method based on stacked noise reduction self-encoder
abstract: The invention relates to a human body daily behavior activity recognition optimization method based on a stacked noise reduction self-encoder, which comprises the following steps of: 1) Based on a deep learning method and an SDAE model, a classification model for human behavior recognition is constructed by adopting human behavior data acquired by a wearable sensor; 2) Initializing a classification model of data collected and collected by a wearable sensor, and dividing the initialized data into a training set, a testing set and a verification set; 3) Performing pre-training and fine tuning treatment on the constructed classification model; 4) And adopting a cross verification mode, verifying the generalization capability of the trained classification model by using a verification set, and inputting the test set into the classification model to obtain the corresponding prediction category. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of obtaining a more accurate model identification result, being beneficial to providing more directions for behavior identification application and the like.

title: Object re-identification using multiple cameras
assignee: Nanyang Technological University, Ncs Pte. Ltd.
abstract: In some aspects, a method for object re-identification may include obtaining a first set of images from a first camera, and a second set of images from at least one second camera; determining a first set of features based on the first set of images, the first set of features lying in a first feature space; and determining a second set of features based on the second set of images, the second set of features lying in a second feature space. The method may additionally include determining a first feature projection matrix and a second feature projection matrix that respectively map the first set of features and the second set of features to a shared feature space; and determining a common dictionary based on the shared feature space.

title: Method and system for generating a three-dimensional ultrasound image of a tissue volume from two-dimensional ultrasound images
abstract: A method may include generating a series of two-dimensional (2D) ultrasound images of the tissue volume associated with a plurality of positions along a scanning direction of the tissue volume; estimating, for each pair of consecutive 2D ultrasound images of the series of 2D ultrasound images, a distance between the positions associated with the pair of consecutive 2D ultrasound images based on a classification of a difference image generated from the pair of consecutive 2D ultrasound images using a deep neural network to produce a plurality of estimated distances associated with the plurality of pairs of consecutive 2D ultrasound images, respectively; modifying the number of 2D ultrasound images in the series of 2D ultrasound images based on the plurality of estimated distances to produce a modified series of 2D ultrasound images; and rendering the 3D ultrasound image of the tissue volume based on the modified series of 2D ultrasound images.

title: System for application aware rate-limiting using plug-in
abstract: A method, system and computer-usable medium for web application aware rate-limiting. One embodiment of the system involves a computer-implemented method in which requests for a web application are receive from a plurality of client entities. When the received requests are to be rate-limited, a rate-limiting identifier is requested from a plug-in respectively associated with the web application. The plug-in generates the rate-limiting identifier, wherein the rate-limiting identifier is unique to the web application. The plug and sends the rate-limiting identifier to the rate-limiting engine, which uses the rate-limiting identifier to rate-limit passing of the received requests to the web application. In some embodiments, the rate-limiting identifier is generated as a hash value that is independent of IP address and header information data of the client making the request.

title: User body-customized motion analysis system
abstract: The present invention relates to a body-customized exercise analysis system implemented to analyze a posture of a user by using an image of the user photographed by using a smartphone. The body-customized exercise analysis system comprises: a user terminal installing an exercise analysis service application and transmitting at least one body information among the gender, age, height and weight of the user received from the user and image information generated by photographing the body of the user through a camera; and an exercise analysis server that digitizes joint points of the user through the body information and the image information received from the user terminal, analyzes a posture of the user by using the digitized joint points, finds out a correct posture according to a current situation of the user, creates posture correction information, and transmits the posture correction information to the user terminal.

title: Abdominal lymph node detection method and device based on semi-supervised learning
abstract: The invention discloses an abdominal lymph node detection method and device based on semi-supervised learning, relates to abdominal lymph node detection based on semi-supervised learning, and aims to solve the problems that a large amount of accurately labeled abdominal lymph node image data is difficult to obtain, and deep neural network training cannot be well completed due to too little labeled data. Firstly, inputting the limited labeled data into supervised learning to form a lymph node detection model with a certain maturity; then copying the lymph node detection model into a teacher network and a student network, inputting weakly-enhanced non-labeled data into the teacher network to generate a pseudo label, inputting strongly-enhanced non-labeled data into the student model by using the pseudo label to train, and updating parameters of the teacher model and the student model; the training is repeated until the model converges. By utilizing the label-free data to generate the pseudo label for training, the label work of the original sample data can be obviously reduced, and thus, better performance can be achieved on a small data set.

title: New coronary pneumonia multi-modal feature extraction fusion method and system based on depth map
abstract: The invention discloses a new coronary pneumonia multi-modal feature extraction fusion method and system based on a depth map, wherein the fusion process consists of two stages of data representation and data fusion, in the data representation stage, CT image data and clinical physiological index data are comprehensively utilized, a semantic segmentation model based on a graph neural network is adopted to extract high-level ROI features of pneumonia infected parts, then the extracted ROI features and other clinical data are converted into a graph structure, and a unified multi-modal data representation space is constructed by utilizing a graph embedding technology; in the feature fusion stage, multi-mode feature fusion and logical reasoning are carried out among a medical image map, a physiological index map and a medical report text based on a self-attention mechanism, and data support is provided for diagnosis of new coronary pneumonia.

title: Method for finding anomalies in medical image data and medical imaging device
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and a medical imaging device for finding anomalies in medical image data. Method for finding anomalies in medical image data of an area of a patient arranged outside the area to be examined of the patient, comprising the following method steps: providing medical image data mapping an area of the patient arranged outside the area to be examined of the patient, wherein the area to be examined of the patient has been selected from the pre-examination data; automatically analyzing medical image data of an area arranged outside an area to be examined of a patient by means of a control unit; generating, by means of a control unit, abnormality information of medical image data of an area arranged outside an area to be examined of a patient; and displaying the abnormality information by means of the output unit.

title: Credit fraud group identification method and system based on improved isolated forest algorithm
assignee: 数尊信息科技(上海)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a credit fraud group identification method and a system based on an improved isolated forest algorithm, wherein the identification method comprises the following steps: carrying out data processing of integrating cleaning, data analysis and variable screening on the original user data; predicting the processed data by using a random forest algorithm model to obtain fraud probability of each user; identifying the processed data by utilizing an improved isolated forest algorithm to obtain a fraudulent party in the user; and (3) using an improved isolated forest algorithm as an unsupervised model, and using the fraud probability of each user as a weight to infect the fraudulent group partner so as to output the fraudulent group partner members. By the technical scheme, the fraudulent party members can be identified by utilizing the characteristics of the user data, and the method and the device have the advantages of high prediction efficiency, high execution efficiency, simplicity and easiness in implementation.

title: System and method for machine-learning based extraction of information from documents
abstract: A method and system are provided for training a machine-learning (ML) system/module and to provide an ML model. In one embodiment, a method includes using a labeled entities set to train a machine learning (ML) system, to obtain an ML model, and using the trained ML model to predict labels for entities in an unlabeled entities set, yielding a machine-labeled entities set. One or more individual ML models may be trained and used in this way, where each individual ML model corresponds to a respective document source. The document sources can be identified via classification of a corpus of documents. The prediction of labels provides a respective confidence score for each machine-labeled entity. The method also includes selecting from the machine-labeled entities set, a subset of machine-labeled entities having a respective confidence score at least equal to a threshold confidence score; and updating the labeled entities set by adding thereto the selected subset of machine-labeled entities. The method further includes removing from the machine-labeled entities set the selected subset of machine-labeled entities and deleting labels assigned to the entities in the updated machine-labeled entities set to provide the unlabeled entities set for a next iteration. The method also includes, if a termination condition is not reached, repeating the steps above and, otherwise, storing the ML model.

title: Continuous blood pressure measuring method, device and equipment
abstract: A method, apparatus and device for continuous blood pressure measurement, the method comprising: the acquisition equipment acquires an electrocardiosignal and a photoplethysmography pulse signal, determines an actual measurement blood pressure according to the electrocardiosignal and the photoplethysmography pulse signal, corrects a coefficient of a prediction equation according to the actual measurement blood pressure and the prediction equation for determining the predicted blood pressure, and calculates a blood pressure value according to the corrected prediction equation. The continuous blood pressure measuring method, the device and the equipment can improve the accuracy of continuous blood pressure measurement.

title: Network training method and device based on artificial intelligence and electronic equipment
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a network training method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting a first audio feature and a second audio feature of an audio sample, and a first text feature and a second text feature of a text sample; fusing the first audio feature and the first text feature to obtain a first fused feature, and fusing the second audio feature and the second text feature to obtain a second fused feature; extracting a third audio feature and a fourth audio feature corresponding to the first fusion feature, and extracting a third text feature and a fourth text feature corresponding to the second fusion feature; fusing the third audio feature and the third text feature, and fusing the fourth audio feature and the fourth text feature; and adjusting parameters of the second audio feature extraction network based on the sum of the first loss value and the second loss value, so that the second audio feature extraction network has the capability of extracting features similar to the text sample in the audio sample.

title: Method and device for extracting features of fundus leopard spots and determining feature indexes
assignee: 依未科技(北京)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for extracting fundus leopard spot characteristics and determining characteristic indexes, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a fundus image, inputting the fundus image into a pre-trained leopard patch feature extraction model, and obtaining the confidence probability that each pixel on the fundus image belongs to the leopard patch feature; dividing the confidence probability by using a threshold dividing method according to a preset confidence probability threshold to obtain a fundus leopard spot characteristic region image; determining a first area of the fundus image and a second area of the fundus leopard spot feature area image; and determining the density of the fundus leopard spot according to the first area of the fundus image and the second area of the fundus leopard spot characteristic area image. The embodiment of the invention can finely extract the characteristics of the fundus leopard spots and represent the significance degree of the leopard fundus by calculating the characteristic index.

title: Coordinated de-identification of a dataset across a network
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer program products are provided. A network device receives, from a client device, a description of a dataset to be de-identified, and a list of one or more data de-identification techniques selected from groups consisting of a group of data masking techniques and a group of data pseudonymization techniques, and their configuration options supported by the client device. A first technique, from the at least one group of techniques and its configuration options supported by the client device and the network device are determined. The network device receives a dataset produced at the client device by applying the first technique and selected configuration options to corresponding attributes from the client device. The network device applies a de-identification technique to the dataset to produce a resulting set of de-identified data, wherein the de-identification technique is coordinated with the first technique and its configuration options to de-identify the dataset.

title: Method of screening high rate electrochemical cells
abstract: A method of screening a battery for failure mechanisms is provided. The method may include activating an electrochemical cell. Within 5 minutes to two hours of activating the cell, the open circuit voltage of the cell is measured over a period of time to determine a voltage versus time function. The cell is then screened for the presence of a failure mechanism by checking the voltage versus time function for a failure criteria.

title: Enhanced detection and quantitation of biomolecules
abstract: Described herein are methods for screening for a disease state. The method may include obtaining multiple data sets, and identifying the disease state based on a combination of the data sets. The data sets may include biomolecule measurements obtained by multiple methods, such as through the use of particles and reference biomolecules.

title: Construction method and system of mental disease knowledge map
assignee: 济南大学, 山东思正信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a construction method and a system of a mental disease knowledge base, which are used for acquiring the existing information related to mental diseases and establishing a mental disease corpus; determining an entity, a relation and an attribute indication word list according to the mental disease corpus; fine-tuning data in the mental disease corpus set by using a language model, constructing a mental disease named entity recognition data set, extracting characteristic values of the mental disease named entity recognition data set, fusing the fine-tuned data and the extracted characteristics, and training a pre-constructed deep learning model by using the fused data; and predicting the psychological disease corpus to be processed by utilizing the trained deep learning model, converting the entity category index sequence obtained by prediction into an entity type sequence, storing each entity word into an entity word list, and respectively extracting entity relationship and attribute data according to the relationship type and the attribute type for respectively storing. The invention can effectively improve the accuracy of entity identification and improve the accuracy of extracting complex entities.
assignee_clean: 济南大学; 山东思正信息科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for airway tree segmentation
abstract: Novel systems and methods for airway segmentation are disclosed using confident airway volume, multi-scale topological and geometric leakage detection, exact leakage localization and correction, forbidden volume insertion and freezing, iterative shift in growing techniques starting with a conservative parameter/strategy and progressing toward generous ones, and a final pruning using machine learning, neural network, deep learning or artificial intelligence methods. The systems and methods are fully automated requiring no manual inputs or post-editing steps. The systems and methods use region growing-based segmentation to iteratively grow an airway tree starting with an initial seed, possibly inside the trachea, and a conservative segmentation parameter, e.g., a conservative threshold value for intensity-based region growing. The method then gradually progresses toward more generous values of the segmentation parameters until there is convergence.

title: Automatic spinal canal segmentation using cascaded random walks
abstract: A method and apparatus for automatic spinal canal segmentation in medical image data, such as computed tomography (CT) image data, is disclosed. An initial set of spinal canal voxels is detected in the 3D medical image using a trained classifier. A spinal canal topology defined by a current set of spinal canal voxels is refined based on an estimated medial line of the spinal canal. Seed points are sampled based on the refined spinal canal topology. An updated set of spinal canal voxels is detected in the 3D medical image using random walks segmentation based on the sampled seed points. The spinal canal topology refinement, seed points sampling, and random walks segmentation are repeated in order to provide cascaded random walks segmentation to generate a final spinal canal segmentation result.

title: Efficiently debugging a program in homomorphically encrypted space
abstract: A device, system and method for debugging a homomorphically encrypted (HE) program. The HE program comprising real ciphertext data and encrypted operations in the HE space (production mode) may be mapped to an equivalent plaintext program comprising equivalent pseudo-ciphertext data and pseudo-encrypted operations in the unencrypted space (simulation mode). The plaintext program may be executed in a first full pass in simulation model and a sampling of the HE program may be executed in a second partial pass in production mode, the results of which are compared. The HE program and/or mapping may be validated if the results of simulation and production mode match and debugged if the results do not match. An integrated development environment (IDE) may switch among the HE space (production mode), the unencrypted space (simulation mode), and a combination of both HE and unencrypted spaces simultaneously (simultaneous production-simulation mode).

title: Method and system for establishing cerebral hemorrhage patient neural function prognosis prediction model
assignee: 南通市康复医院(南通市第二人民医院)
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for establishing a cerebral hemorrhage patient neural function prognosis prediction model, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical prognosis data of patients of different categories; establishing and generating an countermeasure network model; preprocessing the enhanced historical prognosis data, and constructing a historical prognosis data set according to the preprocessed historical data; dividing a historical data set into a training set and a testing set according to a preset proportion; constructing a random forest prediction model, and training the prediction model by using a training set; evaluating the prediction accuracy of the trained random forest prediction model by using a test set, using the tested random forest prediction model for prognosis prediction of a patient, and counting the average value of the prediction accuracy at intervals of preset time length; and under the condition that the accuracy average value is lower than the accuracy average threshold value, adjusting the hyper-parameters of the random forest prediction model by combining a Bayesian optimization algorithm, and training the random forest prediction model again. And the model prediction accuracy is improved.
assignee_clean: 南通市康复医院 南通市第二人民医院

title: Quantitation of signal in stain aggregates
abstract: The present application provides for systems and methods for detecting and estimating signals corresponding to one or more biomarkers in biological samples stained for the presence of protein and/or nucleic acid biomarkers. On particular aspect is directed to a method of estimating an amount of signal corresponding to at least one biomarker in an image of a biological sample. The method includes detecting isolated spots in a first image, deriving an optical density value of a representative isolated spot based on signal features from the detected isolated spots, estimating a number of predictive spots in signal aggregates in each of a plurality of sub-regions based on the derived optical density value of the representative isolated spot, and storing the estimated number of predictive spots and detected isolated spots in each of the plurality of generated sub-regions in a database.

title: Three-dimensional pulmonary nodule detection model training method and device without anchor point frame
assignee: 北京小白世纪网络科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional pulmonary nodule detection model training method and a device without an anchor point frame, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image data, labeling categories and labeling coordinate points of a three-dimensional lung nodule sample in a data set, and constructing a three-dimensional lung nodule database; inputting the image data subjected to data enhancement into a convolutional neural network for processing to obtain a plurality of characteristic graphs; inputting the characteristic diagram into a preset shared head network with two convolution branches, outputting a prediction type, a prediction centrality and a prediction coordinate point, calculating a prediction confidence coefficient and a marking centrality, inputting the marking coordinate point, the prediction confidence coefficient, the marking type, the prediction centrality and the marking centrality into a loss function, performing back propagation and training a model. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the problems caused by the anchor frame are solved, a lot of calculated amount is reduced, the characteristics of different tasks are not interfered with each other by adopting a double-branch network structure, and the model result is more accurate.

title: Image recognition system applied to renal cell carcinoma full-chain diagnosis
abstract: An image recognition system applied to full-chain diagnosis of renal cell carcinoma comprises an image segmentation module, wherein the image segmentation module segments an original pathological image comprising a cancer genome image TCGA and an LH data set provided by a local hospital after marking cancer areas, cancer subtypes and cancer grades, then inputs the image into an image cancer area detection module to train and predict the image, the accuracy of the image processed by the image cancer area detection module is improved by an accuracy improvement module to obtain a more accurate cancer area prediction thermodynamic diagram, the area predicted to be cancer is marked and sent to a cancer area classification module for further classification to obtain the cancer subdivision subtypes, and a report of an image recognition result is output by a report output module after classification; the invention can quickly and accurately carry out typing and grading identification on the pathological images of the renal cell carcinoma by using a deep learning method, lightens the dependence on personal experience of doctors, reduces diagnosis errors, and is practical and efficient.

title: Virus focus segmentation method based on migration learning and cascade self-adaptive cavity convolution
abstract: The invention discloses a virus focus segmentation method based on transfer learning and cascade self-adaptive cavity convolution, which designs a new module and a new frame to segment CT images. First, a cascade structure based on three-dimensional convolution is applied. The first-stage structure performs rough segmentation on the image to keep the integrity, and the second-stage structure combines the rough segmentation to obtain a precise segmentation result. In the second level internal structure, parallel multi-scale feature extraction blocks are introduced to promote the adaptability of the system to different size lesions. Finally, transfer learning is used to solve the system over-fitting problem. The invention mainly designs a multi-scale parallel cavity convolution block, which reduces the calculated amount and ensures that the model has self-adaptability. Through tests on two data and the data, the virus focus extraction model designed by the invention has better performance.

title: Method for the automatic regulation of radiation doses of medical X-ray devices
abstract: A method is for the automatic regulation of radiation doses of a person for an examination with a medical X-ray device, which has a first dose regulation. In an embodiment, the method includes a specification of X-ray parameters of an X-ray examination based upon patient information and a specification of a dose regulation as a function of X-ray parameters as well as a limit value for deterministic radiation damage and/or a guide value for stochastic effective doses.

title: Multi-model complementary enhanced machine learning method based on perioperative risk early warning
assignee: 广州知汇云科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-model complementary enhanced machine learning method based on perioperative risk early warning, which comprises the following specific steps of: s1: processing variables adopted by the model, particularly related information of an intraoperative life monitor; s2: selecting 9 common classification algorithms as sub-algorithms of the model to improve the stability and accuracy of the whole model; s3: and (3) each layer in the array obtained in the S2 is used as an input signal of the ANN algorithm, the ANN algorithm is used for classifying the signals of each layer, whether corresponding symptoms appear on the patient or not is judged, and an early warning model is established. The method is characterized in that the ANN algorithm is creatively adopted to fuse other algorithms, the input of the ANN model for fusion is not the traditional original variable any more, but the output value of the original variable after primary classification and prediction is carried out through a series of sub-algorithms, and the purpose of obtaining a global stable prediction and evaluation model is achieved, so that the defects of the traditional method are overcome.

title: Document rectification via homography recovery using machine learning
abstract: Techniques for document rectification via homography recovery using machine learning are described. An image rectification system can intelligently make use of multiple pipelines for rectifying document images based on the detected type of device that generated the images. The image rectification system can provide high-quality rectifications without requiring human cooperation, multiple views of the document in multiple images, and/or without being constrained to only be able to process images from one source context.

title: Federal learning system and method based on segmentation learning and differential privacy fusion
assignee: 广州中平智能科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a federated learning system and a federated learning method based on segmentation learning and differential privacy fusion, wherein the system comprises: a master participant (master) for constructing an overall model structure; the parameter server (server) is used for distributing the global model structure to other participants (clients) and aggregating the global model parameters uploaded by the other participants to construct a new global model; and the other participants are used for constructing a private model structure, form an integral model by adding the global model structure, independently finish the pre-training of the integral model by utilizing local data, and upload the trained global model parameters to the parameter server. According to the method, through the thought of segmentation learning, the model constructed by the participants is divided into the global model and the private model, the participants only share the gradient of the local model, and a differential privacy mechanism is introduced, so that the risk of data leakage of the gradient is greatly reduced.

title: Text detection method, text detection device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司, 泰康在线财产保险股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a text detection method, a text detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein a picture to be detected is firstly obtained; then detecting a target text area in the picture to be detected, wherein the target text area comprises at least one of a header text area, a seal text area and a layout text area; determining a target text detection model corresponding to the target text region according to a preset corresponding relation between the text region and the text detection model; and detecting the text in the target text region by using the target text detection model to obtain a target text detection box. According to the technical scheme, the target text region in the picture to be detected is detected, the text in the region is detected by adopting the text detection model matched with the target text region in a targeted manner by combining the advantages of different text detection models, the integrity of text detection is improved, and powerful support is provided for subsequent text recognition.

title: Abnormality determination device, electronic apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium
assignee: 八乐梦医用床有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an abnormality determination device, an electronic apparatus, and a computer-readable storage medium, the abnormality determination device including: a biological information value acquisition section for acquiring a biological information value of the subject person; an activity amount acquisition unit configured to acquire an activity amount of the subject person; a subject state estimating unit that determines whether or not the subject is in an abnormal state based on the biological information value and the activity amount. The abnormality determination device according to the embodiment of the present invention can accurately determine the state of the subject person, and in particular, can accurately determine the state in which the abnormality of the subject person is continuing.

title: Method and system for archiving data based on data de-identification
abstract: Disclosed are a data archiving method and system based on data de-identification. According to one embodiment, the data archiving method includes the steps of: replacing a personal information value included in a table of a database of a data archiving target system with a unique value; encrypting the personal information value and storing the value in an encryption table; and compressing the encrypted personal information value stored in the encryption table and re-storing the value in the encryption table.

title: Image support for cognitive intelligence queries
abstract: A computer-implemented method, a cognitive intelligence system and computer program product adapt a relational database containing image data types. At least one image token in the relational database is converted to a textual form. Text is produced based on relations of tokens in the relational database. A set of word vectors is produced based on the text. A cognitive intelligence query expressed as a structured query language (SQL) query may be applied to the relational database using the set of word vectors. An image token may be converted to textual form by converting the image to a tag, by using a neural network classification model and replacing the image token with a corresponding cluster identifier, by binary comparison or by a user-specified similarity function. An image token may be converted to a plurality of textual forms using more than one conversion method.

title: Method, apparatus, and system for data-driven evaluation of heuristics for trajectory cropping
abstract: An approach is disclosed for a data-driven evaluation of heuristics for trajectory cropping. The approach involves, e.g., determining a cropping heuristic, wherein the cropping heuristic comprises an algorithm for cropping a probe trajectory collected from one or more sensors of a mobile device to anonymize the probe trajectory data. The approach also involves processing the probe trajectory using the cropping heuristic to generate a cropped probe trajectory. The approach further involves extracting one or more heuristic-based features of the cropped probe trajectory data. The approach also involves extracting one or more privacy-based features from a privacy preference, wherein the one or more privacy-based features represent a target level of cropping to meet the privacy preference. The approach further involves computing a score based on a distance between the one or more heuristic-based features and the one or more privacy-based features. The approach further involves providing the score as an output.

title: Knowledge graph fusion method for doctor experience knowledge and ultrasonic image information
abstract: The application provides a knowledge graph fusion method of doctor experience knowledge and ultrasonic image information. Firstly, the doctor experience labeling information is described as triple regularization knowledge one by one, and each regularization knowledge is constructed as a doctor experience knowledge graph; then, carrying out semantic ontology query on entities in the doctor experience knowledge graph and the ultrasonic image knowledge graph, and carrying out alignment treatment and knowledge graph embedding representation; and finally, solving the constructed fusion objective function to obtain joint space embedded vectors of different maps, and combining distance judgment to realize fusion of the doctor experience knowledge map and the ultrasonic image knowledge map. According to the application, the doctor experience is fused into the ultrasonic image in a knowledge graph mode, so that the limitation that the computer-aided diagnosis method only adopts medical image data for driving can be broken through, and the aided diagnosis process is more consistent with the doctor experience.

title: System and method for detecting acute brain function impairment
abstract: A system and method is provided for acquiring data from a brain of a subject and analyzing the data to generate an indication of a level of acute impairment of the subject.

title: Predicting lung cancer risk
abstract: A system and method for predicting a lung cancer risk based on a chest X-ray in which a nodule is detected in a chest of a patient based on an analysis of the chest X-ray using an image processing technique. A region of interest associated with the nodule is identified using the image processing technique. The region of interest is further analyzed using deep learning to determine a plurality of characteristics associated with the nodule. The plurality of characteristics comprises a size of the nodule, a calcification in the nodule, a homogeneity of the nodule and a spiculation of the nodule. Further, the plurality of characteristics is compared with a trained data model using deep learning. Based on the comparison, a risk score associated with the nodule is generated. Further, the lung cancer risk is predicted when the risk score exceeds a predefined threshold value.

title: System and method for power generation control
abstract: A method for controlling operation of an electric power generation system includes receiving power generator data corresponding to the electric power generation system. The method further includes receiving, using a digital prime mover unit, a set-point parameter corresponding to a prime mover unit and generating one or more prime mover parameter estimates corresponding to the plurality of prime mover parameters. Further, the method includes receiving, using a digital generator unit, one or more prime mover parameter estimates and generating one or more generator parameter estimates corresponding to the plurality of generator parameters. The digital prime mover unit and the digital generator unit are real-time operational models of the prime mover unit and the generator unit. The method also includes controlling the operation of the electric power generation system based on at least one or more of the power generator data, the prime mover parameter estimates, and the generator parameter estimates.

title: System and method for transformer control
abstract: A method for controlling operation of transformer system includes receiving, by a controller unit, transformer data corresponding to a transformer. The transformer data includes a plurality of transformer input parameters and a plurality of transformer output parameters. The method further includes receiving, by a digital transformer unit, the plurality of transformer input parameters from the controller unit. The digital transformer unit is a real-time operational model of the transformer. The method also includes generating, by the digital transformer unit, a plurality of transformer output parameter estimates corresponding to the plurality of transformer output parameters. The method further includes controlling operation of the transformer, by the controller unit, based on at least one of the transformer data and the plurality of transformer output parameter estimates.

title: Context-based personalized activity schedule
abstract: A schedule for performing physical activities is generated by a physical activity model. The model draws from activity data, environmental data, and physical data collected during performance of identified physical activities. Weather forecasts for a particular region and time range drive the model to produce the performance schedule during the time range.

title: Feature point detection method, feature point detection device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a feature point detection method, a feature point detection device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a neural network model; inputting an interested image into the neural network model to obtain a characteristic point probability map; and calculating to obtain the position of the feature point based on the feature point probability graph. According to the feature point detection method, the device, the computer equipment and the storage medium, the full convolution neural network model is obtained through training, the interested image is input into the full convolution neural network model, and the feature point position is obtained through calculation, so that when the feature point is detected, the whole interested image can be directly detected without taking image blocks as units, and the speed and the accuracy of feature point detection are greatly improved.

primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技有限公司

title: Electronic device for supporting task management service and operating method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is an electronic device including an intelligence function that reminds a user of a task to be performed, even though the user does not manually set a reminder and notifies the user whether the task has been completed. This intelligence function may be implemented in various applications, such as a reminder, a calendar, or an artificial intelligence assistant. Aspects of the disclosure may also increase business utilization of a care service. For example, the electronic device may be used to check the progress of housework of a sitter who cares for a person such as a child, an elderly parent, or a patient.

title: Similar case retrieval method, similar case retrieval device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 天河超级计算淮海分中心
abstract: The application provides a similar case retrieval method, a similar case retrieval device, computer equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of data processing, and is used for improving the similar case retrieval accuracy. The method mainly comprises the following steps: inputting a target case into a case type identification model to obtain a case label of the target case, wherein the case type identification model is obtained by training according to a sample case and a case label corresponding to the sample case; acquiring a case database corresponding to a case label of the target case, wherein a plurality of cases corresponding to the case label are stored in the case database; calculating the similarity between the target case and each case in the case database; and determining the case with the similarity greater than a preset value with the target case in the case database as the similar case of the target case.
assignee_clean: 天河超级计算淮海分中心
primary_assignee: 天河超级计算淮海分中心

title: Virtual stent placement apparatus, virtual stent placement method, and virtual stent placement program
abstract: Provided are a virtual stent placement apparatus, a virtual stent placement method, and a virtual stent placement program that simplify an operation of virtually placing a stent in a blood vessel extracted from a medical image. An extraction unit (22) extracts a blood vessel region (30) from a three-dimensional image (V0). A display control unit (26) displays a three-dimensional image (V1) including the blood vessel region (30). The information acquisition unit (23) acquires information of the diameter of a virtual stent placed in the blood vessel region (30), a maximum contour length of the virtual stent, and a start position (S1) in a case in which the virtual stent is placed. A placement unit (24) places the virtual stent having a maximum contour length (L0) from the start position (S1) along a maximum contour line of the blood vessel region (30) in the blood vessel region (30).

title: Image processing method, image processing apparatus, image processing device, and storage medium
assignee: 重庆金山医疗技术研究院有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image processing method, an image processing device, image processing equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial image, and acquiring an initial light reflecting region included in the initial image, wherein the initial light reflecting region is determined according to the pixel value of each pixel point in the initial image; filtering the initial image to obtain a reference image; acquiring a reference area matched with the initial light reflecting area in the reference image, and determining a highlight subarea included by the initial light reflecting area based on the initial light reflecting area and the reference area; and performing brightness reduction processing on the highlight subarea to obtain a target image. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the light reflecting region in the initial image can be effectively removed.
assignee_clean: 重庆金山医疗技术研究院有限公司
