primary_assignee: the regents of the university of california

title: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing content according to geolocation
abstract: Methods, apparatus, systems, and computer-readable media are set forth for providing digital and non-digital content to a segment of a population that is identified using geolocation data and other activity data. In some implementations, non-digital content is delivered via postal mail to a segment of a population according to whether the segment of the population viewed certain content before, during, or after visiting a particular geographic location. In other implementations, digital content, such as phone calls or voice messages, can be delivered to a segment of a population according whether the segment of the population is present or has recently been present at a particular location and previously viewed certain content associated with the location. Segmenting populations in this way can conserve computational resources and materials that might otherwise be wasted on serving a larger population that may have less of an interest in the content.

title: Hole area positioning method and device and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 博志生物科技有限公司
abstract: A method, a device and a computer readable storage medium for locating a hole area are provided, wherein the method for locating the hole area comprises the following steps: acquiring and normalizing the image of the region of interest of the patient; within a preset gray threshold range, performing threshold segmentation on the normalized image obtained by normalization processing under different gray thresholds to obtain threshold segmentation images under different gray thresholds; for each threshold segmentation image, determining a characteristic value of each target voxel in each threshold segmentation image; generating a fitting function of each target voxel based on the characteristic values of each target voxel under different gray threshold values; quantizing the fitting function of each target voxel to obtain a function quantized value of each target voxel; and determining a region formed by the target voxels with the function quantization value smaller than a preset quantization threshold value as a cavity region. The technical scheme provided by the application can realize the automatic positioning of the cavity area.
assignee_clean: 博志生物科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 博志生物科技有限公司

title: Body area sensor network bio-feedback system
assignee: Lasarrus Clinic and Research Center, LLC
abstract: This system is a network of sensor nodes with multiple sensors at each node. The nodes are used in combination with a wearable garment to enable multiple types of data to be combined together to produce a fuller picture of a body's physiological state; such as during physical therapy. In addition, the system utilizes acoustic imaging to measure muscle activation. The system transmit this data to a host computer to visualize various data comparisons.

title: Endoscope control model training method and device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 珠海视新医用科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of endoscope control, and discloses an endoscope control model training method, device, equipment and storage medium.
assignee_clean: 珠海视新医用科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 珠海视新医用科技有限公司

title: On-demand wireless device centric security for a 5G wireless network
abstract: The disclosed embodiments include a method performed by a wireless network to mitigate a security risk arising from an application-layer transaction and contextual scenario of a wireless device (WD). A security resource can be maintained inactive by default and configured for on-demand activation in response to a security risk associated with the WD. The method can include monitoring the WD for application-layer transactions and contextual scenarios, and detecting a security risk relative to a particular type of a application-layer transaction and a contextual scenario of the WD. In response to detecting the security risk, the security resource is activated to support the application-layer transaction while safeguarding the entire wireless network. In response to detecting a change to the application-layer transaction or the particular contextual scenario, the security resource for the WD can be deactivated.

title: System and method for passive subject specific monitoring
abstract: A method includes obtaining, by an electronic device, an audio segment comprising one or more audio events of a target subject. The method also includes extracting, by the electronic device, audio embeddings from the one or more audio events using an embedding model, the embedding model comprising a trained machine learning model. The method further includes comparing, by the electronic device, the extracted audio embeddings with a match profile of the target subject, the match profile generated during an enrollment stage. The method also includes generating, by the electronic device, a label for the audio segment based on whether or not the extracted audio embeddings match the match profile, wherein the label enables correlation of the audio segment with the target subject for monitoring a health condition of the target subject.

title: Image data generation method and device
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating image data, relates to the technical field of image processing, and aims to solve the problem that a data generation method in the prior art cannot provide an effective training data sample for an artificial intelligent medical image analysis process. The method mainly comprises the following steps: acquiring a focus-free image; generating a predicted focus mask according to a preset focus outline; and inputting the non-focus image and the predicted focus mask into an image generation model to generate a predicted focus image, wherein the image generation model is generated through marking focus training pictures. The method and the device are mainly applied to the process of expanding the image data.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Apparatus and method for wide-range optical tracking during medical imaging
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University
abstract: Methods to quantify motion of a human or animal subject during a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) exam are provided. In particular, these algorithms make it possible to track head motion over an extended range by processing data obtained from multiple cameras. These methods make current motion tracking methods more applicable to a wider patient population.
assignee_clean: the board of trustees of the leland stanford junior university
primary_assignee: the board of trustees of the leland stanford junior university

title: User generated tag collection system and method
abstract: In some embodiments, an input document is received at a tagging platform, via a communication device, and associates it with a tag request. The tagging platform automatically selects at least one electronic record associated with a first user from a user data store containing electronic records associated with users (each record including at least a user identifier and a user communication address). The input document and tag request are transmitted to the communication address associated with the first user, and a document tag is received from the first user. The tagging platform may then store the document tag in a document mining result database by adding an entry to the database identifying the received document tag and transmit an indication associated with the document mining result database to a plurality of risk applications.

title: Systems and methods for determining and distributing an update to an inference model for wearable apparatuses
abstract: A system and a method determine a global update to an inference model and distribute the global update to a plurality of wearable apparatuses. In one implementation, the system includes a data interface and at least one processing device. The at least one processing device is programmed to receive, via the data interface and from a first one of the plurality of wearable apparatuses, first update information associated with the inference model. The at least one processing device is further programmed to receive, via the data interface and from a second one of the plurality of wearable apparatuses, second update information associated with the inference model. The at least one processing device is further programmed to analyze the first update information and the second update information to determine the global update to the inference model, and transmit, via the data interface, the global update to the plurality of wearable apparatuses.

title: Methods and systems for identifying target genes
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods and systems for identification of genomic regions for therapeutic targeting. A method for identifying one or more genomic regions for therapeutic targeting, which may facilitate re-programming of a cell from one phenotypic state to another, may comprise: providing single-cell RNA-seq data for a plurality of diseased cells and a plurality of normal cells of a cell type; mapping the single-cell RNA-seq data for the plurality of diseased cells and the plurality of normal cells into a latent space corresponding to a plurality of phenotypic states of the cell type; identifying, based at least in part on a topology of the latent space, the one or more genomic regions for therapeutic targeting; and electronically outputting the one or more genomic regions for therapeutic targeting.

title: Detecting data center large scale interruptions through near real time/offline data using machine learning models
abstract: The present embodiments relate to data center interrupt detection and alert generation. The interrupt detection service as described herein is capable of processing near real-time data from various sources in a data center and processing the data using a model to determine one or more expected sources of detected interrupts. The model as described herein can include one or more machine learning models that incorporate a series of rules to process near real-time data and offline data and determine one or more expected sources of interruption. Alert messages can be generated to provide an intended source of the interrupt as well as other data related to the interrupt.

title: Privacy protection method for collaborative deep learning model training
assignee: 西安电子科技大学, 公安部第三研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a privacy protection method for collaborative deep learning model training, which comprises the following steps: providing a collaborative distributed deep learning model training method, wherein participants locally utilize the existing training data to perform model parameter gradient calculation, and send the calculated gradient data to a parameter server to perform model parameter updating; a privacy protection mechanism based on a double-trapdoor public key cryptographic algorithm is provided, so that the participants can realize the safety training of a deep learning model on the premise of ensuring the privacy of respective training data; a fine-grained deep learning model issuing method is designed, so that only data owners participating in training can obtain the model, and the model training fairness is guaranteed. The result of the simulation test shows that the method can provide accurate model training service on the premise of ensuring the data privacy of the participants. The method can provide privacy protection for new-generation computer technologies such as artificial intelligence and the like.
assignee_clean: 西安电子科技大学; 公安部第三研究所

title: Methods and systems for somewhat homomorphic encryption and key updates based on geometric algebra for distributed ledger/blockchain technology
abstract: Disclosed are methods and systems to encrypt data with SomeWhat Homomorphic Encryption (SWHE) properties for submission to a distributed ledger/blockchain that allows further open operations retained in the distributed ledger/blockchain on the encrypted data that will be properly reflected when the encrypted result is decrypted by the data owner. The somewhat homomorphic properties include addition and scalar division. Also disclosed is an ability to update a secret key applied for a ciphertext such that a single piece of data may be provided on the distributed ledger/blockchain by a data owner to a new data owner without also exposing other data encrypted with the original secret key of the original data owner.

title: Organ contour line quality assessment method, device and system
assignee: 福建自贸试验区厦门片区Manteia数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for evaluating the quality of an organ contour line. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image, wherein the target image comprises a plurality of voxels, and the target image at least comprises a medical image of a target organ and a contour line of the delineated target organ; determining a first area and a second area in the target image according to the contour line, wherein the first area is positioned outside an area surrounded by the contour line, and the second area is positioned inside the area surrounded by the contour line; determining a first evaluation index of the target attribute of the first region and a second evaluation index of the target attribute of the second region; and determining a quality evaluation result of the contour line according to the first evaluation index and the second evaluation index, and outputting the quality evaluation result. The invention solves the technical problems that the accuracy of the evaluation result of the contour line is lower because the existing method for evaluating the quality of the contour line of the organ is insufficient in utilizing the image attribute of the area near the contour line, so that the local detail of the contour line is evaluated insufficiently.
assignee_clean: 福建自贸试验区厦门片区manteia数据科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 福建自贸试验区厦门片区manteia数据科技有限公司

title: Manufacturing machine remote management system using optical image sensing and smart technology
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for remotely controlling a manufacturing machine using optical image sensing and a smart technology. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system for remotely controlling a manufacturing machine using optical image sensing and a smart technology which synchronizes optical image information and wireless sensor information, and applies a remote transmission technology, thereby applying the system to a small manufacturing machine or various types of facility risk managements, and realizing a real-time monitoring system with high quality at low costs.

title: Method, device, and storage medium for weakly-supervised universal lesion segmentation with regional level set loss
abstract: The present disclosure provides a computer-implemented method, a device, and a storage medium. The method includes inputting an image into an attention-enhanced high-resolution network (AHRNet) to extract feature maps for generating a first feature map; generating a first probability map which is concatenated with the first feature map to form a concatenated first feature map, and updating the AHRNet using the first segmentation loss; generating a second feature map, and scaling the second feature map to form a third feature map; generating a second probability map which is concatenated with the third feature map to form a concatenated third feature map, and updating the AHRNet using the second segmentation loss; generating a fourth feature map, and scaling the fourth feature map to form a fifth feature map; updating the AHRNet using the third segmentation loss and the regional level set loss; and outputting the third probability map.

title: Image segmentation model based on improved U-Net network and training method
abstract: The invention provides an image segmentation model based on an improved U-Net network, which adopts an encoding and decoding structure and comprises the following steps: the device comprises an encoding module, a decoding module, an encoding and decoding connection layer and a multi-feature fusion module; the coding module comprises a plurality of coding units which are connected in series, the decoding module comprises a plurality of decoding units which correspond to the coding units one by one, and the coding and decoding connecting layer is used for connecting the coding module and the decoding module; the multi-feature fusion module comprises an upper sampling layer and an additive fusion layer; and the up-sampling layer performs corresponding up-sampling on the output of each decoding unit and then inputs the output to the additive fusion layer for superposition to obtain an image segmentation result. The model of the application can improve the capability of feature extraction and the accuracy of extraction. In addition, the loss function provided by the application can perform better segmentation under the conditions that the segmentation target size is not fixed and the difference between the target and the background is too large.

title: Modeling objects from monocular camera outputs
abstract: Systems and techniques are provided for modeling three-dimensional (3D) meshes using images. An example method can include receiving, via a neural network system, an image of a target and metadata associated with the image and/or a device that captured the image; determining, based on the image and metadata, first 3D mesh parameters of a first 3D mesh of the target, the first 3D mesh parameters and first 3D mesh corresponding to a first reference frame associated with the image and/or the device; and determining, based on the first 3D mesh parameters, second 3D mesh parameters for a second 3D mesh of the target, the second 3D mesh parameters and second 3D mesh corresponding to a second reference frame, the second reference frame including a 3D coordinate system of a real-world scene where the target is located.

title: Flux system
abstract: A flux system includes a memory and a processor in communication with the memory and a sensing device, the memory storing a plurality of capabilities and a plurality of semantic fluxes associated with the plurality of capabilities. The computing system is configured to infer a semantic based on received inputs and to infer an activity interest semantic based on an input, and to assign a servicing agent to service an activity interest based on semantic matching.

title: System, method, and computer program product for detecting potential money laundering activities
abstract: Provided is a computer-implemented method for detecting potential money laundering activities. The method may include determining an overall transaction product category risk score for each transaction product category of a plurality of transaction product categories, where the overall transaction product category risk score is based on transaction data, a transaction product category risk score associated with the at least one issuer institution for each transaction product category, an issuer institution risk score associated with the at least one issuer institution, and a geographic risk score associated with the at least one issuer institution, determining an overall issuer institution risk score associated with the at least one issuer institution, determining whether the overall issuer institution risk score satisfies a threshold value, generating a notification, and communicating the notification to a client device based on generating the notification. A system and computer program product are also disclosed.

title: Method for classifying and identifying vascular lesions on fundus images based on migration convolution network
assignee: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院, 北京好医生云医院管理技术有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for classifying and identifying vascular lesions on fundus images based on a migration convolution network, which comprises the following steps: performing random data augmentation on the fundus image dataset; labeling the fundus image dataset as if it has vascular lesions; dividing the fundus image dataset into levels of different arterial and venous stenosis severity; dividing a fundus image dataset into a training set and a testing set; cropping the bottom-of-eye image dataset; modifying the deep layer of the network architecture; extracting features of the pre-training model, and retraining by using the training set to obtain new weights so as to obtain a vascular lesion recognition model; generating a result identifying a vascular lesion using the test set by the vascular lesion identification model; based on the vascular lesion recognition model, the classifier is adjusted to a multi-classifier algorithm to carry out grading judgment on the severity of the local stenosis of the mobile vein, and a grading result is generated. The invention can solve the problem of multi-classification of the severity of the local stenosis of the artery and vein of the fundus and can improve the accuracy of recognition.
assignee_clean: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院; 北京好医生云医院管理技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院

title: Identifying anatomical structures
abstract: Aspects described herein disclose devices, systems, and methods for use in contexts such as minimally invasive surgery (MIS). A device is provided herein having a proximal portion and a distal portion, and an ultrasound transducer may be disposed within the distal portion and configured to scan tissue and identify certain portions of a patent's anatomy during the scanning process. The results of the detection may be presented to an operator of the device aurally and/or visually, such as in a 3-D volumetric image. By scanning the tissue, identifying the anatomy, and presenting the results to an operator, unnecessary damage to elements of the patients anatomy may be avoided or lessened. In some aspects, multiple transducers may be positioned on the device to increase the scanning range and/or scanning accuracy of the device. The device may provide an inner channel for the passage of surgical tools while scanning tissue.

title: Medical resource processing method and device and readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a medical resource processing method, a medical resource processing device and a readable storage medium; generating a priority distribution weight of the medical object through the object type and the reservation time of the medical object in the medical object data set, determining the priority of the medical objects of different object types in resource distribution from multiple dimensions, adjusting the resource distribution time of the medical object according to the priority distribution weight, training a distribution model based on the allocable resource amount, the priority distribution weight and the adjusted resource distribution time to obtain a distribution model of target medical resources, and determining the resource distribution time of the object to be distributed so as to distribute the target medical resources based on the resource distribution time; according to the scheme, the resource allocation time of the medical object is determined by measuring the reservation time and the object type of the medical object, the balance between the resource demand of the medical object to be allocated and the allocable amount of the target medical resource is achieved, and the control force on the target medical resource is improved.

title: Ventilator system with multiple airflow control lumens
abstract: Ventilator system with multiple inspiratory lumens is provided. The inspiratory lumens are configured so that separate inspiratory lumens provide inspiratory gas mixtures to separate portions of a patient's airways, for instance to separate lungs and/or bronchi. The ventilator system can include one or more expiratory lumens to evacuate expiratory gases from airways. The use of separate inspiratory lumen(s), with expiratory lumen(s), allows for functional separation of structural portions of the lungs, and maintenance of continuous or almost continuous flow through at least part of respiratory cycle via inspiratory and expiratory lumens. This can further reduce dead space and clear suspended therein diseases causative agents with improvement in outcomes, reduce risk of cross-contamination or cross-infection between different parts of airways, for example such as cross-infection from one lung lobe to another lobe or. The ventilator system allows for independent titration of PEEP, pCO2 and pO2 with no need for permissive hypercapnia.

title: Image annotation method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 合肥综合性国家科学中心人工智能研究院(安徽省人工智能实验室)
abstract: The invention provides an image labeling method, an image labeling device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original data set; inputting an original data set into a clause model to obtain a high-frequency clause and a low-frequency clause, marking the high-frequency clause through a knowledge graph node to generate a first graph label, marking image report information corresponding to the low-frequency clause through a knowledge graph node to generate a second graph label; labeling the target image data according to the first map label and the second map label to obtain a labeling result, so that a structural label of the target image data is generated through the labeling result; according to the method and the device, the high-frequency clauses and the low-frequency clauses are marked respectively to generate different map labels, so that the automatic marking of the next sentence with the same or similar meaning can be realized by one-time marking, the marking efficiency is improved, the marking cost is reduced, and the method and the device are suitable for general structured marking of different forms of image data.
assignee_clean: 合肥综合性国家科学中心人工智能研究院 安徽省人工智能实验室
primary_assignee: 合肥综合性国家科学中心人工智能研究院 安徽省人工智能实验室

title: Computing system for electronic message tamper-proofing
abstract: A computing system for generating tamper-proof electronic messages is disclosed herein. A service provider application receives an electronic message from a client application. The electronic message comprises an authorization provider (AuP) token that includes a public key of a local signing authority (LSA) and a signed payload that has been signed by the LSA using a private key of the LSA that forms a cryptographic key pair with the public key, the signed payload comprising an indication of a programmatic task to be executed by the service provider application. Responsive to validating the AuP token in the electronic message, the service provider application extracts the public key from the electronic message. Responsive to validating the signed payload based upon the extracted public key of the LSA, the service provider application executes the programmatic task.

title: Direct informative communication through an ear-wearable device
abstract: A method and system are described for providing high-priority notification messages to a user of an ear-wearable device system. The ear-wearable device system includes a physiological sensor present on, within, or carried with the user and an ear-wearable device comprising a speaker, a microphone, a processor, a memory storage, and a wireless communication device. The system is capable of receiving a plurality of sensor messages from the physiological sensor, identifying high-priority sensor information from among the plurality of received sensor messages, identifying content for an audio voice message to provide to the user, and providing the audio voice message at the speaker of the ear-wearable device. The content includes user notification information containing or based on the high-priority sensor information identified from among the received sensor messages.

title: Ultrasonic image processing method, device and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 深圳瀚维智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an ultrasonic image processing method and device and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. Firstly, enhancing the contrast of an ultrasonic image to be processed by adopting a contrast-limiting adaptive histogram equalization algorithm; and then, the improved brightness adaptive guided filtering algorithm is used for denoising the enhanced ultrasonic image, so that the functions of denoising, contrast enhancement and brightness adjustment are effectively realized. And finally, the multidirectional Sobel operator is adopted to enhance the focus edge information in the filtered ultrasonic image, so that the deep learning model can be promoted to learn more feature information of the focus in the mammary ultrasonic image after pretreatment, the influence of wrong information on the deep learning is reduced, the quality of the ultrasonic image to be processed is further improved, and the precision of the deep learning model on the extraction of the focus features and the pathological detection is improved.
assignee_clean: 深圳瀚维智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳瀚维智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Complex disease state evaluation method based on high-throughput sequencing data and clinical phenotype construction and application
assignee: 上海朴岱生物科技合伙企业（有限合伙）
abstract: The invention relates to the field of gene detection and bioinformatics, and discloses a method for mining complex disease markers based on transcriptome data, exome/genome data and clinical phenotypes, which designs a set of calculation method for integrating high-throughput sequencing data and clinical phenotypes to construct a complex disease state evaluation model, and applies the calculation method to colorectal cancer, pancreatic duct cancer and pan-tumor targeted drug, so that the disease-related biomarkers are respectively screened, and a corresponding disease state evaluation model is formed. The marker with both accuracy and mechanism interpretation is constructed by the method, and can be used for complex disease prognosis evaluation, treatment effect prediction, treatment scheme auxiliary decision making and the like.
assignee_clean: 上海朴岱生物科技合伙企业 有限合伙
primary_assignee: 上海朴岱生物科技合伙企业 有限合伙

title: Medicine IC50 deep learning model prediction method based on molecular structure and gene expression
assignee: 普瑞基准科技（北京）有限公司, 普瑞基准生物医药(苏州)有限公司, 北京普康瑞仁医学检验所有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medicine IC50 deep learning model prediction method based on molecular structure and gene expression, which comprises the following steps: establishing a deep learning model for predicting the IC50 of the medicine in different cell lines; prediction of IC50 of drugs in different cell lines was performed based on a deep learning model. A prediction system, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium are also disclosed, the chemical molecular formula of the drug is coded by using a syntax variation automatic encoder and the expression data of a cell line is coded by using the variation automatic encoder, the IC50 of the drug in different cell lines is predicted by a neural network method, the value of IC50 of the drug in different cancer cell lines can be directly predicted by the molecular information of the drug, and the capital and time investment of preclinical development can be reduced to a certain extent. The model is applied to patients, so that applicable groups of the medicine can be screened out, unnecessary clinical experiments are reduced, and the success rate of the clinical experiments is improved.

primary_assignee: 普瑞基准科技 北京 有限公司

title: Intelligent prospect assessment
abstract: Examples for a prospect assessment system are provided. The system may receive a query from a user and obtain prospect data from a plurality of data sources. The system may create a plurality of prospect clusters. The system may determine a cluster significance value. The system may determine a prospect churn value. The system may determine a set of significant prospect clusters from among the plurality of prospect clusters having the cluster significance value and the prospect churn value above a threshold value. The system may determine a prospect pattern matrix including a plurality of patterns from the set of significant prospect clusters. The system may identify a set of products for each of the plurality of patterns. The system may determine a prospect profile for each of the plurality of patterns. The system may generate a prospect assessment result based on the prospect profile for the resolution of the query.

title: Systems and methods for tremor detection and quantification
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for detecting tremors in a subject. One method comprises receiving data from a digital device, the data comprising a plurality of digital device positions and a plurality of timestamps, each timestamp in the plurality of timestamps being associated with a digital device position in the plurality of digital device positions. The method further comprises determining a plurality of frequencies of hand movements of the subject based on the plurality of digital device positions and plurality of timestamps. The method further comprises determining a subportion of the data corresponding to frequencies of hand movements above a low tremor threshold, and determining a magnitude of tremors of the subject's hand based, at least in part, on the subportion of the data.

title: Systems and methods for health monitoring
abstract: Behavioral intervention improves the efficacy of treatments designed to encourage healthy behaviors such as smoking cessation, adherence to food regimen after surgeries, and avoiding overeating. Aspects of the present disclosure relate to a health monitoring system that leverages wearable sensors, mobile devices (e.g. smartphones), and computer-based servers to monitor the health of a user and provide intervention at opportune moments to encourage healthy behavior. This system provides a scalable and cost-efficient way for health care providers to monitor the behavior of many users and encourage healthy behavior as appropriate.

title: Processing of brain image data to assign voxels to parcellations
abstract: A method (400) including: determining (702) a registration function [705, Niirf(T1)] for the particular brain in a coordinate space, determining (706) a registered atlas [708, Ard(T1)] from the registration function and an HCP-MMP1 Atlas (102) containing a standard parcellation scheme, performing (310, 619) diffusion tractography to determine a set [621, DTIp(DTI)] of brain tractography images of the particular brain, for a voxel in a particular parcellation in the registered atlas, determining (1105, 1120) voxel level tractography vectors [1123, Vje, Vjn] showing connectivity of the voxel with voxels in other parcellations, classifying (1124) the voxel based on the probability of the voxel being part of the particular parcellation, and repeating (413) the determining of the voxel level tractography vectors and the classifying of the voxels for parcellations of the HCP-MMP1 Atlas to form a personalised brain atlas [1131, PBs Atlas] containing an adjusted parcellation scheme reflecting the particular brain (Bbp).

title: CT super-resolution reconstruction method, system and device based on generation network
abstract: The invention discloses a CT super-resolution reconstruction method, a system and a device based on a generation network, comprising the following modules: an acquisition module: used for collecting low-resolution original CT image data; a pretreatment module: the method comprises the steps of performing full-variation-based super-resolution reconstruction on an original CT image to obtain an initial value; a super-resolution reconstruction module: for high resolution reconstruction of the initial values. The invention adopts a parameter fine-tuning method, and adjusts the CT reconstruction network which is not suitable for a certain patient into the network which is suitable for the condition of the patient on the premise of not using a large number of data sets for training, and only uses the low-resolution CT data of the patient per se in the process without using the corresponding high-resolution CT data as a label, so that the problem of complicated conditions of the medical data according to different conditions can be flexibly solved, and the method has excellent generalization. The inventive technique aims at reconstructing images with a higher spatial resolution than the images actually obtained, while ensuring a high signal-to-noise ratio.

title: Type I interferon signatures and methods of use
abstract: Type I interferon (IFN-I) signatures are useful in methods of diagnosing whether a subject (or patient) with IFN-I mediated disease will be responsive to treatment with an IFN-I inhibitor and treating or refraining from treating the subjects.

title: Disease subtype prediction system based on gene network analysis
abstract: A disease subtype prediction system based on gene network analysis is divided into the following three modules: the system comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a patient classification and disease subtype prediction module and a result display module, wherein the patient classification and disease subtype prediction module comprises a gene node vectorization submodule in a gene network, a disease patient vectorization submodule and a disease subtype prediction submodule.

title: Sonification of biometric data, state-songs generation, biological simulation modelling, and artificial intelligence
abstract: Embodiments are generally directed to methods, systems and devices for generating and playing back a personalized state song representing a target state of a user. In one scenario, a computer system accesses biometric data corresponding to various bodily systems of a user. The computer system encodes the biometric data into data structures that are configured for modeling using an algorithm that is specific to the user. The computer system models the encoded biometric data to identify specified patterns in the encoded biometric data, and these identified patterns are used to generate a personalized algorithm that corresponds with the identified patterns unique to the user. The computer system then synthesizes a state song using the personalized algorithm, which represents a specific biometric state for one of the bodily systems, and plays back the state song to the user to induce the user to the specific biometric state.

title: Automatic detection system for electroencephalogram high-frequency oscillation signals for assisting epileptic focus positioning
abstract: The invention relates to an electroencephalogram high-frequency oscillation signal automatic detection system for assisting in positioning an epileptic focus, which comprises an electroencephalogram signal acquisition part and an SEEG high-frequency oscillation signal automatic detection platform for positioning the epileptic focus; the electroencephalogram signal acquisition part is used for acquiring electroencephalogram signals and importing data into the SEEG high-frequency oscillation signal automatic detection platform; the SEEG high-frequency oscillation signal automatic detection platform can judge whether the fragments contain HFOs through a deep learning algorithm, record the positions of the fragments before the deep learning algorithm is input, record the positions of the fragments judged as HFOs after the deep learning algorithm is output, and highlight the positions. Can help medical staff to quickly find out the position of the occurrence of the high-frequency oscillation signal in the SEEG of the epileptic, and the tedious, time-consuming and subjective work is handed over to a computer to be completed, so as to prepare for the positioning of the epileptic focus in the next stage.

title: Intelligent inspection devices
abstract: An intelligent inspection device is disclosed. The intelligent inspection device includes a camera configured to photograph a refrigerator that is installed and a processor configured to position a first refrigerator image photographed by the camera in a preset area of an inspection frame, compare the first refrigerator image with the inspection frame, inspect whether a step is present in the refrigerator based on a result of the comparison, and learn a solution corresponding to a result of the inspection to provide the solution to a user. The intelligent inspection device may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), a robot, an augmented reality (AR) device, a virtual reality (VR) device, devices related to 5G services, and the like.

title: Shielding facility and method of making thereof
abstract: The present disclosure, in an embodiment, is a facility that includes a device configured to generate a beam having an energy range of 5 MeV to 500 MeV, a first radiation shielding wall surrounding the device, a second radiation shielding wall surrounding the first radiation shielding wall, radiation shielding fill material positioned between the first radiation shielding wall and the second radiation shielding wall forming a first barrier. In embodiments, the radiation shielding fill material includes at least fifty percent by weight of an element having an atomic number from 12 to 83, and a thickness of the first barrier is 0.5 meter to 6 meters.

title: Vehicle collision management responsive to adverse circumstances in an avoidance path
abstract: Described embodiments include a system and a method. A system includes an evaluation circuit configured to determine a characteristic of an adverse circumstance present in a possible collision avoidance path of a vehicle. The system includes a rating circuit configured to assign a risk value to the possible collision avoidance path responsive to the determined characteristic of the adverse circumstance. The system includes an uncertainty assessment circuit configured to assign an uncertainty to the risk value. The system includes a threshold circuit configured to determine if the risk value of the possible collision avoidance path and the uncertainty in a combination meet a threshold criteria. The system includes a communication circuit configured to output the possible collision avoidance path as a selected collision avoidance path if the threshold criteria is met.

title: AI-based health condition monitoring system for old people
abstract: The invention discloses an AI-based old people health condition monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent health monitoring and comprises the following components: the system comprises an activity monitoring module, a frequency updating module, a health condition analyzing module and an abnormal dynamic early warning module. According to the invention, by acquiring user behavior data and vital sign data, monitoring frequency is adjusted in real time, a dynamic health report is generated, and health condition assessment results and personalized health suggestions are given; adjusting the overall sign monitoring frequency according to the activity category of the user, avoiding unnecessary frequent monitoring and enhancing the calculation efficiency; the activity category monitoring frequency library is updated regularly, so that the sign monitoring frequency is closely matched with the behavior and physiological needs of the user, and the comprehensive performance of health condition monitoring is improved; the personalized health advice is obtained through AI analysis, so that the user is guided to change the health management behavior, the user is led to pay attention to health management, and the health quality of the user is ensured.

title: Privacy protection linear regression method based on secret sharing and random disturbance
abstract: The invention discloses a privacy protection linear regression method based on secret sharing and random disturbance, which comprises the following steps: s1: multiplication of secret shared values, S2: training data preprocessing, S3: initializing parameters, and S4: updating model parameters, and S5: reconstructing model parameters, and S6: predictive data preprocessing, S7: calculating a predicted shared value, S8: reconstructing a prediction result. The data provider can obtain the model parameters by only adding the parameter values of the two sides, and the privacy of the model parameters and the privacy of the original data can be protected. The technology can lead an enterprise or an organization to divide data to two cloud servers in a secret sharing mode, the cloud servers are utilized to store the data, and the two cloud servers can be utilized to calculate a linear regression model, so that the original data cannot be revealed when the cloud servers are utilized to calculate efficiently in the process.

title: Methods and apparatus for a tablet computer system incorporating a battery charging station
abstract: A tablet computer includes a housing, a display, a processing system, a camera system comprising a camera sensor, and a battery system, the battery system positioned within the housing. The battery system is configured to charge an external device. A charging cable retainer is configured to retain one or more cables against or within the housing. One or more integral cables are provide. The one or more integral cables include a cable comprising a first end fixedly coupled to the battery system, a first connector of a first type configured to mate with a first type of external device connector, a second connector of a second type configured to mate with a second type of external device connector, and a lens configured to form images on the camera sensor. The charging cable retainer includes a cable channel or magnet.

title: Auxiliary detection system for EGFR gene mutation in non-small cell lung cancer histological image
assignee: 安徽省立医院(中国科学技术大学附属第一医院)
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of medical artificial intelligence, in particular to an auxiliary detection system for EGFR gene mutation of a histological image of non-small cell lung cancer, which comprises the steps of scanning, sequencing and fusing pathological section images of a plurality of patients with non-small cell lung cancer to generate a training set and a testing set, training the training set to obtain an EGFR gene mutation judgment model of the non-small cell lung cancer, inputting the testing set into the EGFR gene mutation judgment model of the non-small cell lung cancer to test mutation conditions, obtaining detection accuracy according to gene mutation data of the EGFR gene mutation judgment model, and storing the EGFR gene mutation judgment model when the detection accuracy is larger than a set accuracy threshold. The method and the device for detecting the EGFR gene mutation by using the image-level annotation detect whether the EGFR gene is mutated and mutation sites, develop an artificial intelligent auxiliary detection model for the lung cancer EGFR gene mutation, and improve the accuracy of EGFR mutation analysis and specific mutation sites.

title: Methods for diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune diseases
abstract: Provided herein are methods, assays and devices for the detection and diagnosis of autoimmune diseases, including systemic lupus erythematosus. The methods, assays and devices provided herein analyzes binding patterns of peripheral-blood antibodies on peptide array that correlates well with current systemic lupus erythematosus clinical assessment standards.

title: Artificial intelligence service system and method based on intelligent contract and general evidence
assignee: 苏州纳维时空信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence service method and system based on intelligent contracts and passes. The artificial intelligence service method comprises the following steps: uploading expert agreed rules or data driven models to an evaluation system and verifying; binding the authenticated expert agreed rules or the evaluation systems corresponding to the data driving models to intelligent contracts, and writing block chains to issue to an artificial intelligent service system; when input data call artificial intelligent service to predict, expert negotiation rules or data driving models applicable to an artificial intelligent service system call mode library obtain a prediction result; and paying the pass to the artificial intelligence service system according to the intelligent contract after the user selects the prediction result. The method applies the blockchain technology to the professional field, realizes the sharing of professional data and expert experience, and effectively ensures the legal rights and interests of industry experts, industry data contributors, algorithm personnel and system maintainers by a certification mechanism.

title: An electronic device for providing multiple windows using an expandable display
abstract: In accordance with various embodiments of the present invention, a portable electronic device comprises: a slidable housing including a first housing and a second housing coupled to the first housing to be able to slide with respect to the first housing; a roller part; a flexible display including a first display region disposed adjacent to the first housing and a second display region disposed in an internal space of the portable electronic device while surrounding the roller part; a processor connected to the display; and a memory connected to the processor. The memory can, when executed, store instructions to cause the processor to: divide an active area into a first window and a second window based on the fact that the active area in which visual information is to be displayed is expanded from the first display area to at least a part of the second display area; provide an execution screen of a first application through the first window; provide, through the second window, a recommendation screen for recommending candidate applications that are likely to be second applications to be executed through the second window; and provide an execution screen of a candidate application selected by a user from among the candidate applications through the second window. In addition, various embodiments are possible. In accordance with the present invention, an electronic device can recommend a user with a candidate application as having potential to become a second application.

title: Alzheimer disease image analysis method and device
abstract: The invention discloses an Alzheimer's disease image analysis method and device. The Alzheimer disease image analysis method comprises a pretreatment stage, a primary dimensionality reduction stage and a secondary dimensionality reduction stage, and the process comprises the following steps: firstly, converting the format of an original image into a data input format conforming to an image processing method, and processing the image; performing primary dimensionality reduction, selecting seed points to obtain a functional connection diagram, performing statistical analysis on the functional connection diagram to obtain significance difference areas of the functional connection diagram among different groups, extracting corresponding functional connection values tested in the significance difference areas, and splicing the functional connection values into feature vectors; and finally, performing secondary dimensionality reduction on the feature vectors by using a machine learning method, putting the dimensionality-reduced data into an SVM classifier, performing cross validation, and outputting a classification result. Experiments prove that the analysis method provided by the invention can efficiently extract features and has positive significance for automatic image analysis of Alzheimer's disease.

title: Automatic detection method and system for aneurysms in brain medical images
assignee: 中国科学院苏州生物医学工程技术研究所
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic detection method and system for aneurysms in brain medical images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) Collecting a training set brain MRA image, extracting a blood vessel region, and labeling an aneurysm region on the image after the blood vessel region is extracted; 2) Constructing a three-dimensional full convolution neural network and carrying out network model training; 3) Extracting a blood vessel region from a brain MRA image to be detected; 4) And carrying out aneurysm detection on the image after the blood vessel region extraction is completed by adopting a three-dimensional full convolution neural network. The blood vessel extraction method adopted by the invention is not only suitable for blood vessels with normal anatomical structures, but also can realize better segmentation effect on anatomical structure variation such as aneurysms and cysts or normal physiological structure variation; the improved 3DUnet network model can reduce the number of parameters required to be optimized during 3DUnet training, can accelerate training and detection speed and improves detection sensitivity.

title: Self-adaptive learning method and system based on cervical cell slice image
assignee: 赛维森(广州)医疗科技服务有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure describes a self-adaptive learning method and a learning system based on cervical cell slice images, the learning method comprising: preparing a first preset number of labeled cervical cell slice images from a first target source to obtain a trunk training set, obtaining a first training set and a second training set through the trunk training set, training a feature combination model by using the first training set, and training a feature classification model by using the second training set; setting the source of the cervical cell slice images to be classified as a second target source, preparing a second preset number of labeled cervical cell slice images from the second target source to obtain a third training set, adjusting the trained feature classification model by using the third training set to obtain an adaptive feature classification model, and obtaining the adaptive model by using the trained feature combination model and the adaptive feature classification model. Therefore, the method can adapt to pathological slide digital images from different sources.
assignee_clean: 赛维森 广州 医疗科技服务有限公司
primary_assignee: 赛维森 广州 医疗科技服务有限公司

title: Noise label correction method based on federal learning
assignee: 中国科学院计算技术研究所
abstract: The invention provides a noise label correction method based on federal learning, which comprises the following steps: sending the local model parameters updated by the client according to the local training data and the corresponding sample data size to the server; acquiring global model parameters calculated by a server according to local model parameters updated by a client and other clients and corresponding sample data size; calculating a plurality of local class references indicating average prediction probabilities of different classes according to the global model parameters and the local training data by the client and sending the local class references to the server; and acquiring a plurality of global class references calculated by the server according to the plurality of local class references, and performing noise label correction on the local training data of the client based on the global model parameters and the global class references. The correction method is applied to the Federal learning system, information enhancement is achieved, data loss and dependence on an additional reference set are reduced, and accuracy of a Federal learning training structure test is effectively improved.

title: System and method for improved anonymized data repositories
abstract: A computing system includes an anonymizer server. The anonymizer server is communicatively coupled to a data repository configured to store a personal identification information (PII) data. The anonymizer server is configured to perform operations including receiving an anonymized data request, and creating an anonymized data repository based on the anonymized data request. The anonymizer server is also configured to perform operations including anonymizing the PII data to create an anonymized data by applying a cluster-based process, and storing the anonymized data in the anonymized data repository.

title: Device and system for providing Parkinson's disease information by using neuromelanin image
assignee: 和人人工知能科技有限公司
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus for providing parkinson's disease information using neuromelanin imaging according to the present invention may include: an image receiving part for obtaining a magnetic resonance imaging image for photographing the brain of a patient; an image preprocessing unit that preprocesses the magnetic resonance imaging image obtained so as to enable observation of a neural melanin region serving as an image biomarker for parkinson's disease; an image processing unit that classifies a first image including the neuromelanin area by analyzing the preprocessed magnetic resonance imaging image, and detects the neuromelanin area from the classified first image; and an image analysis unit for diagnosing whether the patient has Parkinson's disease by analyzing whether the detected neural melanin region is normal.

title: Catheter position discrimination system and method in heart coronary wave silhouette
assignee: 江苏省人民医院（南京医科大学第一附属医院）
abstract: The application discloses a catheter position judging system and method in heart coronary wave silhouette, which can effectively restore the corresponding three-dimensional model through a single DSA image, project imperfect catheter position information in two-dimensional DSA silhouette on the three-dimensional model through a three-dimensional reconstruction method, acquire accurate catheter position information, accurately image focus parts, avoid image deviation caused by movement of patient breathing and the like during multi-angle imaging without causing inconvenience to patients, and greatly reduce the time required for detection in the traditional positioning method.

title: Method and system for analyzing one or more multi-resolution medical images
abstract: A method and system analyzes multi-resolution medical images. The method includes receiving one or more multi-resolution medical images of one or more tissues. Each multi-resolution medical image is divided into a plurality of segments. Thereafter, each segment of the plurality of segments of each multi-resolution medical image is processed in parallel, utilizing one or more computation nodes, wherein each computation node includes one or more Graphical Processing Units (GPUs). The results corresponding to each segment of a multi-resolution medical image are collated, and a collated report is displayed.

title: Tumor and organ position ultrasonic image real-time monitoring system for radiotherapy
abstract: The invention provides a tumor and organ position ultrasonic image real-time monitoring system for radiotherapy, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the radiotherapy equipment comprises a treatment bed and a radiotherapy irradiation device, wherein the radiotherapy irradiation device is used for irradiating a patient according to a preset irradiation range; a fixed body membrane which is matched with the treatment bed to fix the patient; a fixing part arranged on the body film and positioned outside the irradiation range; the ultrasonic probe is arranged on the fixed part and is attached to the body surface of the patient; and a processing device, wherein the fixed body membrane is provided with an opening part matched with the fixed position of the ultrasonic probe, the processing device is provided with an ultrasonic image recognition part and a radiotherapy control part, the ultrasonic image recognition part recognizes the ultrasonic image according to a marker calibrated in advance by a radiotherapy doctor so as to recognize the real-time position of a tumor, an organ or an implant of a patient, and the radiotherapy control part controls the radiotherapy irradiation device to irradiate according to the irradiation range when the real-time position of the marker is within a preset threshold range.

title: Disease screening rate improving method and system by combining knowledge graph with blood routine test data
assignee: 健数(长春)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a disease screening rate improving method and a disease screening rate improving system for combining a knowledge graph with blood routine test data, belonging to the technical field of medical treatment, wherein the disease screening rate improving method for combining the knowledge graph with the blood routine test data comprises the following steps: constructing a knowledge graph corresponding to the disease screening rate improving purpose, and training a disease screening model by using the knowledge graph to obtain a trained disease screening model; extracting characteristic information of blood routine test data, inputting the characteristic information into the trained disease screening model, acquiring a disease identification result through the trained disease screening model, constructing a knowledge graph corresponding to a disease screening purpose, and training the disease screening model by utilizing the knowledge graph, so that a large amount of related disease subject information and target data information can be integrated.

primary_assignee: 健数 长春 科技有限公司

title: Face recognition systems with external stimulus
abstract: An apparatus includes a camera and a processor. The camera may be configured to capture video data of an area of interest. The processor may be configured to (A) process the video data, (B) generate control signals used to initiate an external stimulus and (C) execute computer readable instructions. The computer readable instructions may be executed by the processor to (a) stream the video data to an external server, receive facial recognition results from the external server and (c) if the facial recognition results cannot detect a face of a detected person, determine which of the control signals to generate. The external stimuli may be implemented to encourage a detected person to look in a direction of the camera sensor.

title: Body joystick for interacting with virtual reality or mixed reality machines or software applications
abstract: A system and method for using a body joystick to interact with a virtual or mixed-reality machines or software applications that uses a support arm to hold a device for attaching the body joystick to a user's body, a sensor for detecting movement, and a tether and actuator for providing feedback to the user about interactions with the virtual or mixed-reality machines or software applications.

title: Method and system for image-based ulcer detection
abstract: Ulcer detection may include calculating ulcer head scores for image pixels, and calculating ulcer red region scores for pixels, each score correlated to the probability that the pixel color is typical to ulcer heads, ulcer red regions, or a other regions. Ulcer head scores may be compared to an ulcer head threshold level and, based on the results, ulcer head candidates may be obtained. Ulcer red region scores may be compared to a threshold and ulcer red region candidates may be obtained. Ulcer candidates may be formed by creating pairs including an ulcer head candidate and a potential ulcer red region candidate. A grade for ulcer candidates indicating the probability that the ulcer candidate is an ulcer may be used to generate a score for the image, the score indicating the probability that the image includes an ulcer.

title: Monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multiple dimensions
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the field of intelligent medical treatment, and discloses a multi-dimensional-based monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: determining dimension factors corresponding to an object to be monitored from a knowledge graph, wherein the dimension factors are names of designated nodes with associated edges corresponding to the object to be monitored in the knowledge graph, and the designated nodes at least comprise two; in a designated data set corresponding to an object to be monitored, counting sample data corresponding to each dimension factor respectively; respectively calculating early warning signal sets corresponding to the dimension factors according to sample data corresponding to the dimension factors; judging whether specified early warning signals exceeding a threshold value exist in early warning signal sets corresponding to the dimension factors respectively; if yes, acquiring a specified dimension factor to which a specified early warning signal belongs; and taking the appointed dimension factor as an early warning feedback result corresponding to the appointed data set. And constructing a plurality of early warning information by using a plurality of dimensions to form an early warning signal set consisting of a plurality of early warning signals, so that the sensitivity and accuracy of monitoring and early warning are improved.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Dynamic data dissemination under declarative data subject constraints
abstract: Dynamic data dissemination is provided. A resolved data subject identifier corresponding to a data subject is selected from a set of resolved data subject identifiers existing in rows of a data asset. In response to determining that the resolved data subject identifier does not correspond to a right to forget list, it is determined that the resolved data subject identifier corresponds to a data subject request list. The rows are transformed to anonymize existing pseudo and personal identifiers in cells of the rows that are tied to columns associated with data classes for which specific consent dimensions have been indicated as revoked by the data subject.

title: System and method for predicting hematoma expansion risk of cerebral hemorrhage patient
abstract: The invention provides a system and a method for predicting hematoma expansion risk of a cerebral hemorrhage patient, belonging to the technical field of image processing and receiving an input cerebral hematoma CT image and clinical information of the cerebral hemorrhage patient; analyzing the input cerebral hematoma CT image and clinical information, and outputting a risk prediction result of expansion of the hematoma of the cerebral hemorrhage patient within a certain period; analyzing a cerebral hematoma CT image by using a trained image prediction model to obtain key iconography characteristics of hematoma expansion; and analyzing the clinical information by using the trained clinical prediction model to obtain the key clinical characteristics of hematoma expansion. According to the invention, by analyzing the image and clinical big data of the patient in the acute stage of cerebral hemorrhage, a multi-input composite prediction model based on a neural network is designed and constructed, and comprehensive intelligent prediction of cerebral hematoma expansion is realized; can assist neurologists to make a prediction on the expansion of cerebral hematoma and provide reasonable decision support for diagnosis and treatment of patients.

title: Intelligent diagnosis and treatment instrument for macular degeneration of old people
assignee: 中山大学中山眼科中心
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of ophthalmologic diagnosis and treatment equipment, and particularly relates to an intelligent diagnosis and treatment system for senile macular degeneration. The invention discloses an intelligent diagnosis and treatment system for age-related macular degeneration, which comprises a detection module, a wireless transmission module, a feature extraction module and a diagnosis and treatment module, wherein the detection module comprises an eye fundus OCT (optical coherence tomography), an eye fundus fluorescein angiography FFA, a choroid angiography, a central vision detection, a blood sugar detection and a blood pressure detection, the feature extraction module automatically extracts features from an eye fundus image, the data obtained by the detection module is transmitted to the diagnosis and treatment module through the wireless transmission module, the diagnosis and treatment module comprises a database, a GA-BP (genetic algorithm-BP) neural network diagnosis model and an interface display module, a personal data file of a patient is further established, the disease data can be dynamically tracked, a targeted treatment scheme can be given, and the delay of the disease condition is avoided. The system has the effects of low misdiagnosis rate, no dependence on manual work, near detection and capability of realizing dynamic tracking of patient data.

primary_assignee: 中山大学中山眼科中心

title: Neural network model training method, device and system based on privacy protection
assignee: 支付宝(杭州)信息技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a neural network model training method, device and system based on privacy protection. The first member device and the second member device are respectively provided with first characteristic data and second characteristic data, the first characteristic data and the second characteristic data form characteristic data of a training data sample of the neural network model according to a vertical segmentation mode, and the first member device or the second member device is provided with label data. The first member device receives data possessed by the second member device and initializes the neural network model together with the second member device. When performing model training, the first member device randomly extracts training data samples from the first training data sample set; and carrying out share decomposition processing on the second feature data of the training data sample to obtain third and fourth feature data shares, and sending the fourth feature data shares and corresponding label data to second member equipment. The first and second member devices perform joint model training using the first feature data, the third feature data share, the fourth feature data share, and the corresponding label data.

title: System and methods for differentiating mental disorders and predicting medication-class response in patients using resting state functional MRI scans
abstract: The present invention is directed to a system and methods of predicting undiagnosed mental disorders in a patient and determining the best medication-class treatment for the mental disorder through the analysis of functional magnetic resonance imaging of functional connectivity of the brain representative of a certain mental disorder.

title: Method and device for determining brain midline shift
assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for determining brain midline shift. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image of a brain; determining a physical brain centerline in the medical image; determining a physiological centerline of the brain in the medical image; whether the brain central line in the medical image shifts or not is determined based on the brain physical central line and the brain physiological central line.
