title: Syndrome differentiation method based on traditional Chinese medicine knowledge graph library
abstract: The invention provides a syndrome differentiation method based on a traditional Chinese medicine knowledge graphic library, which is used for improving the utilization of the traditional Chinese medicine knowledge graphic library and the informatization and intellectualization of the traditional Chinese medicine theory. The syndrome differentiation method is based on the established Chinese medicine knowledge graph base according to the basic theory of Chinese medicine, utilizes reinforcement learning to discover and calculate the primary path from the symptoms to the syndromes and the primary path from the symptoms to the etiology, scores the input symptoms from the syndromes and the etiology corresponding to the two types of primary paths respectively, and obtains the most possible syndromes from the fused highest score. The invention opens up a new thought and method for the research of the intelligent diagnosis of the traditional Chinese medicine, simultaneously excavates and enriches the connotation of the traditional Chinese medicine theory, promotes the modernization and informatization development of the traditional Chinese medicine theory, improves the guiding ability and level of the historical experience in the clinical practice, further promotes the development of the traditional Chinese medicine subject, and has great practical significance for the innovation and the deepening of the traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment service.

title: Electronic device including heat dissipation member
abstract: An electronic device is provided, which may include a first housing; a second housing configured to accommodate at least a portion of the first housing and guide a sliding movement of the first housing; a display including a first display area disposed on the first housing and a second display area extending from the first display area; a PCB configured to accommodate at least one electronic component; a support member configured to support the PCB; a side wall member connected to the support member and facing at least a portion of the first housing; a heat dissipation sheet configured to receive heat from the at least one electronic component, the heat dissipation sheet being disposed on the support member and the side wall member; and a heat dissipation member disposed on the side wall member and facing the heat dissipation sheet.

title: Preamble detection in wireless network
abstract: This document discloses a solution for preamble detection. According to an aspect, a method comprises: transmitting a message to a first terminal device connected to an access node, the message instructing the terminal device to carry out a random access procedure towards the access node; receiving a signal from the first terminal device during the random access procedure, the signal comprising a random access preamble; using the received signal as a training input in a random access preamble detection process; and using the random access preamble detection process trained with the training input in detection of a random access preamble from a second terminal device not connected to the access node.

title: Passthought for multifactor authentication in augmented reality
abstract: A system and method for multifactor authentication. The method includes receiving a passthought brainprint and a training 3D pattern. The method also includes calculating a variance between the training 3D pattern and a passthought 3D pattern, and generating an error tolerance for the passthought 3D pattern based on the calculated variance between the training 3D pattern and the passthought 3D pattern. Further, the method includes storing the passthought 3D pattern and the passthought brainprint in a neural profile as a passthought for a secure area.

title: Photoelectric conversion device and photoelectric conversion system
abstract: A photoelectric conversion device according to one embodiment includes: a first substrate including a pixel that includes a photoelectric conversion element; and a second substrate including a first control unit that includes a first signal processing unit configured to process a signal from the pixel, the second substrate being stacked together with the first substrate. The signal from the pixel is output to a second signal processing unit disposed at a position different from a position of the first signal processing unit, a path through which the signal from the pixel is output to the first signal processing unit is different from a path through which the signal from the pixel is output to the second signal processing unit, and the first control unit is configured to control the pixel on the basis of the signal processed by the first signal processing unit.

title: Switchable bioactive lighting
abstract: The present disclosure provides lighting systems, which may be semiconductor light emitting devices, with two or more of blue, red and/or LRNE, short-blue-pumped cyan, long-blue-pumped cyan, yellow, and violet channels. The lighting systems can have a plurality of operational modes that provide different biological effects while having good color rendering capability. The yellow and violet channels can include violet LEDs and be used in operational modes that provide white light with lower EML values relative to operational modes using three or more of the blue, red, short-blue-pumped cyan, and long-blue-pumped cyan color channels.

title: Medical image segmentation method, system and device based on user interaction
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The specification discloses a medical image segmentation method, system and device based on user interaction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image, wherein the first image is obtained based on a medical image to be segmented; taking the first image as an image to be modified, and executing a plurality of iterative processes until a target medical image is acquired, wherein the iterative processes comprise: acquiring at least one modification of an image to be modified; modifying at least one of the medical image to be segmented, the image to be modified and the image to be modified into a medical image segmentation model, and outputting a second image; judging whether the second image meets a first preset condition or not; if yes, taking the second image as a target medical image; otherwise, the second image is used as a new image to be modified.
assignee_clean: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Acetabulum cup position adjusting method and device based on reinforcement learning and storage medium
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention provides an acetabular cup position adjusting device and method based on reinforcement learning and a storage medium, wherein the acetabular cup position adjusting device comprises: the data acquisition module is used for determining the initial placement position and the central position of the acetabular cup and the model of the acetabular cup according to the obtained central point position and the radius of the acetabulum, and taking the volume of the pelvis, the central position of the acetabular cup and the model of the acetabular cup as 3D (three-dimensional) original data; a view conversion module for converting the 3D raw data into view data of different sections, the view data including a coronal view, a sagittal view and a transversal view; and the acetabular cup adjusting module is used for inputting the converted view data of different sections into the trained deep double-network DDQN network model and adjusting the position of the acetabular cup according to an adjusting signal output by the trained deep double-network DDQN network model. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the position of the acetabular cup prosthesis can be automatically positioned and accurately adjusted based on deep reinforcement learning and 3D original data, and the coverage rate and the speed are improved compared with manual placement.

title: Method and system for screening metaphase chromosome image quality based on deep learning
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）, 中国科学院计算技术研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for screening metaphase chromosome image quality based on deep learning. After the training of the model is completed, the quality of each chromosome image of an input case can be evaluated, the quality evaluation result of each chromosome image is output, all the chromosome images are sorted in a descending order according to the quality evaluation result, namely the quality of the chromosome image which is sorted in the front is considered to be higher by the model, and then the chromosome image which is enough to be diagnosed is selected in the front of the sorted chromosome images, so that the chromosome image quality screening process can be completed. The method and the system have simple data sources, can accurately evaluate the quality of the chromosome image, has an AUC value of 0.927, and has high model detection speed which is greatly higher than the manual speed.

title: Histological differentiation grade prediction of hepatocellular carcinoma in computed tomography images
abstract: A method of determining the histological grade of Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) including: acquiring a Computed Tomography (CT) image of a person including an HCC tumor; delineating the HCC tumor; and assigning a histological grade to the HCC tumor, wherein assigning the histological grade to the HCC tumor includes: applying a plurality of filters to the HCC tumor, wherein each of the filters produces a corresponding response image and, for each of the filters, a convolution operation is performed on the filter and the CT image to produce the response image corresponding to that filter; computing an average response of the HCC tumor in each of the response images and recording each of the average responses as an Independent Subspace Analysis (ISA) feature; and determining the histological grade of the HCC tumor based on the ISA features by using a classifier.

title: Method, apparatus and computer program product for determining a semantic privacy index
abstract: A method, apparatus and computer program product are provided to determine a semantic privacy index that quantifies the risk associated with re-identification of a trajectory following anonymization of the trajectory. In the context of a method, information regarding a trajectory is received. After the trajectory has been map matched to a portion of a road network, the method associates contextual information comprising one or more map features with the trajectory. The method also provides the information regarding the trajectory and the contextual information comprising the one or more map features to a risk estimation model in order to generate the semantic privacy index.

title: CBCT jaw bone region segmentation method and system based on context fusion mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a CBCT jaw bone region segmentation method and a system based on a context fusion mechanism, relates to the technical field of computer vision, designs a new neural network structure CA-Swin-Unet, improves the network structure based on an encoder part and a decoder part of the existing Swin-Unet, and enables the decoder to consider context semantics when analyzing shallow semantics by adding a context attention module TBCAM in the decoder, thereby improving the quality of CBCT image segmentation.

title: Dose guided real-time adaptive radiotherapy
abstract: Techniques for adjusting radiotherapy treatment for a patient in real-time are provided. The techniques include determining a patient anatomy at a first time within a given radiotherapy treatment fraction after a radiotherapy treatment dose has been delivered by a radiotherapy device; retrieving a reference patient anatomy for the given radiotherapy treatment fraction that indicates a prescribed dose parameter to be delivered within the given radiotherapy treatment fraction; comparing the patient anatomy at the first time with the reference patient anatomy during the given radiotherapy treatment fraction; and based on the comparison of the patient anatomy at the first time with the reference patient anatomy, adjusting a parameter of the radiotherapy device to change an amount of radiotherapy treatment dose delivered at a second time, following the first time, within the given radiotherapy treatment fraction in accordance with the prescribed dose parameter to be delivered within the given radiotherapy treatment fraction.

title: Causal analysis
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods, systems and computer program products for causal analysis. In some embodiments, there is provided a computer-implemented method. The method comprises determining, from observation samples of a plurality of factors, a first causal structure indicating a first causal relationship among the plurality of factors, each observation sample including a set of observation values of the plurality of factors; presenting the first causal structure to a user; in response to receiving at least one user input about the first causal structure from the user, executing actions associated with the at least one user input based on the first causal structure; and presenting a result of the execution of the actions to the user. In other embodiments, another method, systems and computer program products are provided.

title: Bifocal timeline graphs for network analytics
abstract: Systems and methods provide for a bifocal timescales graph for viewing a network health history at a single glance.

title: Foreign matter detection method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 无锡时代天使医疗器械科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a foreign matter detection method, a foreign matter detection device, a foreign matter detection equipment and a computer readable storage medium. According to the embodiment of the invention, the image to be detected comprising the tray provided with the appliance is obtained, the target detection model obtained through pre-training is utilized to carry out target detection on the image to be detected, the region image comprising the detected target is cut out from the image to be detected in response to the detection of the target in the image to be detected, the classification model obtained through pre-training is utilized to classify the region image, the classification result of whether the region image comprises foreign matters is obtained, and further, whether the foreign matters are mixed in the tray is determined based on the classification result, so that the foreign matters possibly mixed in the packaging bag in the appliance in the sorting and packaging stage can be effectively detected.

title: Intelligent auxiliary analysis method for child movement epilepsy based on synchronous video and electroencephalogram
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary analysis method for child motion epilepsy based on synchronous video and electroencephalogram. The invention combines the characteristics of the brain electrical signals and the characteristics of the synchronous video data, and aims to realize accurate and reliable seizure detection and identification of the epileptic patients of children. According to the invention, the electroencephalogram and video data features are fused together to train the classification model, so that the recognition rate of seizure detection is improved, meanwhile, the fused features are processed by data equalization, and the problem that the data in the seizure period is far less than the seizure period is solved; meanwhile, the method for detecting the YOLO target is adopted, the position of the epileptic patient in the video is detected, and then the position of the epileptic patient in the video is processed in the next step, so that the problem that video data acquired by a camera of a hospital are not ideal enough in actual work is solved; according to the invention, after the space-time interest points are extracted, a space-time interest point screening module is introduced, so that feature extraction of redundant information in video is reduced, video features are simplified, and the epileptic seizure detection rate of children is improved.

title: Kit for detecting bladder cancer
assignee: 杭州可帮基因科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a kit for detecting bladder cancer, and belongs to the field of cancer diagnosis reagents. The kit comprises a reagent for detecting the expression levels of 8 genes such as CA9, CCL18, ERBB2, IGF2, LINC00565, MMP12, PPP1R14D and SGK2 in urine exfoliative cells. The invention also discloses a bladder cancer detection system, which can obtain a two-classification model for distinguishing bladder cancer from non-bladder cancer based on the expression quantity of the 8 genes through a machine learning algorithm, and can realize high-accuracy diagnosis on the bladder cancer. Under the condition of the same accuracy rate as the prior art, the system greatly reduces the number of genes for diagnosing the bladder cancer, obviously reduces the detection cost, shortens the time required by detection, and is more convenient for medical institutions to develop, thereby better meeting the urgent requirements of clinic on noninvasive bladder cancer examination.
assignee_clean: 杭州可帮基因科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for identifying a user interface
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for identifying a user interface. Flow data associated with air flowing in a respiratory therapy system is received. Acoustic data associated with the respiratory therapy system is received. The received flow data and the received acoustic data are analyzed. Based at least in part on the analysis, a mask type for the user interface is determined.

title: Application performance management integration with network assurance
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer-readable for determining performance metrics of a network include obtaining, from a network assurance system, one or more network performance metrics, the network performance metrics corresponding to execution of one or more applications in a network domain. An Application Performance Management (APM) system provides one or more applications performance metrics, the applications performance metrics corresponding to execution of the one or more applications in an applications domain. The one or more network performance metrics are integrated with the one or more applications performance metrics to determine integrated performance metrics for the one or more applications across the network domain and the applications domain.

title: Detecting tampering in assets and authenticating authorized users
abstract: In some implementations, a wireless sensing system may receive sensor data associated with an asset. The sensor data may be associated with a tampering event and the tampering event may include an action performed on the asset. The wireless sensing system may further determine whether the tampering event is performed by an authorized user of the wireless sensing system. The wireless sensing system may further determine whether the tampering event is performed within an authorized location of the wireless sensing system. The wireless sensing system may transmit a notification to a user of the wireless sensing system. The notification may alert the user of the wireless sensing system that the tampering event has occurred.

title: Artificial intelligence mobile integration
abstract: Systems, methods, devices and non-transitory, computer-readable storage mediums are disclosed for AI enhanced mobile integration (AMI). In an embodiment, a method comprises: receiving, by one or more processors, a user-driven integration request and a binary executable for a mobile application; analyzing, by the one or more processors, the binary executable to determine an integration plan; obtaining or creating fusion components based on the integration plan; and creating a second binary executable for the application using the obtained or created fusion components.

title: Muscle ultrasonic image noise reduction method, device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, a storage medium and a computer product for noise reduction of a muscle ultrasonic image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting a mammary gland ultrasonic image, extracting a noise block image from the mammary gland ultrasonic image, and amplifying the extracted noise block image to construct a training set; training the training set to generate a deep learning network for noise reduction, and training the deep learning network by using a muscle ultrasonic image after freezing part of parameters in the deep learning network; and acquiring the generated noise reduction model, and carrying out noise reduction treatment on noise in the muscle ultrasonic image by using the noise reduction model. The invention can realize the rapid noise reduction treatment of the ultrasonic image and has better noise reduction effect.

title: Use of web-based symptom checker data to predict incidence of a disease or disorder
abstract: Symptoms and methods for predicting the incidence of a disease or disorder are disclosed. A system for predicting the incidence of a disease or disorder includes a web-based symptom checker for producing a structured dataset, a data analysis component for producing a multivariate dataset from the structured dataset, and a feature construction component for producing a linear combination of orthogonal symbols representative of a disease or disorder. A method for predicting the incidence of a disease or disorder includes producing a multivariate dataset representing patient symptom counts, performing feature construction analysis on the multivariate dataset, creating a time series model using weekly illness incidence data, and applying the time series model to new illness incidence data to predict the incidence of a disease or disorder in the future.

title: Assays, sensing platforms, and methods for diagnosis of coronavirus infection and re-infection
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods for diagnosing or prognosticating SARS-CoV-2 infection and/or COVID-19 in a subject. The methods set forth improved immunoassays, sensing platforms, and methods for detecting SARS-CoV-2 infection and re-infection.

title: Method for determining efficacy of chemotherapy treatment for a subject
abstract: Various embodiments are described herein related to an assay, method and apparatus for performing an RNA Disruption Assay (RDA) for cellular RNA optionally in response to a cytotoxic treatment such as chemotherapy and/or radiation treatment. The method comprises obtaining at least one electropherogram dataset corresponding to a unique biological sample comprising the cellular RNA at a time point, optionally during or after the treatment; determining values for features from at least two shifted regions of the at least one electropherogram dataset, the shifting being due to the treatment; and optionally determining an RDA score based on a combination of the values of the features.

title: Coronary calcified plaque segmentation method, segmentation model training method and related device
assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for segmenting coronary calcified plaque and a method and a device for training a segmentation model of coronary calcified plaque, wherein the segmentation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image, wherein the target image is a non-contrast enhanced electrocardiographic gating calcification point electronic computed tomography (CSCT) image comprising a heart region; the cardiac region includes a plurality of coronary branches; inputting a target image into a target model to obtain candidate areas of calcified plaques of each coronary artery branch output by the target model; the candidate region of calcified plaque for each coronary branch comprises a plurality of first target voxels; screening a second target voxel from the plurality of first target voxels based on a preset screening rule; and dividing calcified plaque areas of each coronary artery branch from the target image based on the second target voxels. Accurate segmentation of calcified plaque areas of each coronary branch in the CSCT image is achieved.

title: Matching methods, apparatuses, and devices based on trusted asset data
abstract: Embodiments of the present specification disclose matching methods, apparatuses, and devices based on trusted asset data. One method comprises: analyzing trusted asset data of a first entity to obtain asset description information of the first entity, wherein the trusted asset data is stored on a trusted device; obtaining service information of a plurality of second entities; determining target service information that matches the first entity based on the asset description information and the service information; and sending the target service information to the first entity.

title: Graphical user interface for macro generation, modification, and verification
abstract: A graphical user interface (GUI) for an automation application is described herein. The automation applications present the GUI on a display. The GUI displays a directed graph representing a macro for a target application. The directed graph comprises nodes and directed edges connecting the nodes. Each node in the node in the nodes is assigned to an input received by the target application during recording of the macro. Each directed edge is assigned criteria that are to be satisfied in order to traverse each directed edge. Responsive to receiving a modification to the directed graph, the automation application displays a modified directed graph based upon the modification. The automation application generates a modified macro based upon the modified directed graph.

title: Computing system for macro generation, modification, verification, and execution
abstract: An automation application is described herein. The automation application executes on a computing device and accesses a macro for a target application. The macro has been generated based upon a sequence of inputs from a user received by the target application that causes the target application to perform an action, screen states of the target application as the target application receives the sequence of inputs from the user, operating system processes that are performed by an operating system as the target application receive the sequence of inputs from the user, and evidence events representing information obtained from the operating system processes. The automation application executes the macro, wherein executing the macro causes the automation application to mimic the sequence of inputs to the target application, thereby causing the target application to perform the action.

title: Method and system for training a neural network for time series data classification
abstract: Neural networks can be used for time series data classification. However, in a K-shot scenario in which sufficient training data is unavailable to train the neural network, the neural network may not produce desired results. Disclosed herein are a method and system for training a neural network for time series data classification. In this method, by processing a plurality of task specific data, a system generates a set of updated parameters, which is further used to train a neural network (network) till a triplet loss is below a threshold. The network is trained on a diverse set of few-shot tasks sampled from various domains (e.g. healthcare, activity recognition, and so on) such that it can solve a target task from another domain using only a small number of training samples from the target task.

title: Anesthesia state monitoring system based on portable electroencephalogram acquisition equipment and deep learning
assignee: 天津大学, 天津富瑞隆金属制品有限公司
abstract: An anesthesia state monitoring system based on portable electroencephalogram acquisition equipment and deep learning is characterized by comprising the portable electroencephalogram acquisition equipment, a data processing and analyzing module and a display module; the portable electroencephalogram acquisition equipment is used for acquiring electroencephalogram signals in the anesthesia process of a patient, carrying out filtering amplification processing operation and transmitting the electroencephalogram signals to the data processing and analyzing module; the data processing and analyzing module processes and analyzes the received electroencephalogram signals; the display module is a display and is used for displaying the anesthesia state of the patient in real time. The portable electroencephalogram acquisition equipment used by the invention has the advantages of low manufacturing cost, open interface and small volume, and can acquire electroencephalogram signals conveniently and efficiently; the invention can accurately realize the monitoring of the anesthesia state; the method is suitable for analyzing the electroencephalogram signals of different patients; the monitoring of the anesthesia state of the patient based on the electroencephalogram signals is more intuitive and convenient, and the method has important guiding significance for surgical medical treatment.
assignee_clean: 天津大学; 天津富瑞隆金属制品有限公司

title: Current-mode mixed-signal SRAM based compute-in-memory for low power machine learning
abstract: Multipliers and Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) circuits are fundamental building blocks in signal processing, including in emerging applications such as machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) that predominantly utilize digital-mode multipliers, and MACs. Typically, digital multipliers and MACs can operate at high speed with high resolution, and synchronously. As the resolution and speed of digital multipliers, and MACs increase, usually the dynamic power consumption and chip size of digital implementations increases substantially that makes them impractical for some ML and AI segments, including in portable, mobile, near edge, or near sensor applications. The multipliers and MACs utilizing the disclosed current mode data-converters are manufacturable in main-stream digital CMOS process, and they can have medium to high resolutions, capable of low power consumptions, having low sensitivity to power supply and temperature variations, as well as operating asynchronously, which makes them suitable for high-volume, low cost, and low power ML and AI applications. Moreover, the multipliers and MACs disclosed in this invention can be placed near conventional CMOS memory cells, such as Static-Random-Access-Memory (SRAM) or Electrically Programmable Read-Only Memory (EPROM) or Electrically Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (E2PROM), which facilitates In-Memory-Compute (IMC) and or near-memory-compute (NMC), that can further reduce dynamic power consumption.

title: Doctor evaluation method and device of Internet medical platform
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a doctor evaluation method, a doctor evaluation device, electronic equipment and a computer-readable storage medium of an internet medical platform; the method comprises the following steps: according to the hospital ranking list data, acquiring hospital authority features of a hospital to which doctors residing on the Internet medical platform belong; acquiring doctor title characteristics of the doctor; determining doctor specialty characteristics of the doctor according to the department where the doctor is good; and fusing the hospital authority feature, the doctor title feature and the doctor specialty feature to obtain the doctor authority of the doctor. By the invention, accurate evaluation information can be provided for doctors who reside in the Internet medical platform.

title: Multi-channel head magnetic resonance imaging tissue segmentation method
assignee: 清华大学深圳研究生院
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and particularly relates to a multi-channel head magnetic resonance imaging tissue segmentation method. But existing deep learning methods do not take advantage of the relatively fixed anatomical information of the brain. The application provides a multi-channel head magnetic resonance imaging tissue segmentation method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, matching each image with a pre-segmentation label closest to the image to form 4 channels; and 2, inputting the obtained 4 channel data into a convolutional neural network, training the network through a real label of the input data to obtain a training model, and obtaining a segmentation result through the trained model by using the test data. The prior texture information of the brain tissue is fully utilized, a new channel is added, the accurate segmentation of the network is promoted, and the network segmentation accuracy is improved. The method is simple, has strong robustness, and can be added into any segmentation network for segmentation without changing the original network structure.

title: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for 3-D phenotyping and physiological characterization of brain lesions and surrounding tissue
assignee: The Board Of Regents Of The University Of Texas System
abstract: The present disclosure includes methods, apparatuses, and systems for three-dimensional phenotyping and physiologic characterization of brain lesions and tissue encompassing one or more enlarged boundaries surrounding the brain lesion to study the metabolic and physiologic profiles from tissue within and around lesions and their impacts on lesion shape and surface texture. The non-invasive biomarker blood-oxygen their impacts on lesion shape and surface texture. The non-invasive biomarker blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) slope was used to metabolically characterize lesions. Metabolically active lesions with more intact tissue and myelin architecture have more symmetrical shapes and more complex surface textures compared to metabolically inactive lesions with less intact tissue and myelin architecture. The association of lesions' shapes and surface features with their metabolic signatures aid in the translation of MRI data to clinical management by providing information related to metabolic activity, lesion age, and risk for disease reactivation and self-repair.

title: Cloud authentication service system based on block chain and big data mining method
assignee: 北京信洋睿连科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a cloud authentication service system based on a block chain and a big data mining method, which solve the technical problem that personal information data protection is not compliant; the private block chain data network unit comprises a data acquisition processor and a final node; the data acquisition processor comprises a personal data mining and sensitivity evaluation unit for mining sensitive data and finishing sensitivity judgment; if the authentication data are judged to be sensitive data, the data acquisition processor encrypts the sensitive information by using a symmetric encryption algorithm, a final node forms an encrypted information abstract by using a Hash algorithm, and the signature is carried out by using an asymmetric encryption algorithm; if the authentication data is judged to be non-sensitive data, the terminal node directly carries out signature through an asymmetric encryption algorithm, so that the problem is well solved, and the method can be used in cloud authentication.

title: Segmentation model generation method and device based on convolution Lstm and multi-model fusion
assignee: 北京小白世纪网络科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a segmentation model of pleural lesions based on convolution Lstm and multi-model fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining CT images of pleura, and preprocessing the CT images; the preprocessed CT images are respectively sent into a Unet network model embedded with convolution Lstm and a 3D segmentation model for segmentation; calculating the Unet network model embedded in the convolution Lstm and the segmentation result output by the 3D segmentation model by using a method of combining a plurality of loss functions, and carrying out weighted summation on the loss value obtained after calculation by using a gradient descent algorithm to obtain a gradient; the gradient is counter-propagated, and weight parameters of the Unet network model and the 3D segmentation model embedded in the convolution Lstm are updated; repeating the steps for iteration to finally obtain the segmentation model. The embodiment of the invention can well combine time sequence space characteristics, accurately segment out related focuses and better meet the standard of human judgment.

title: Preset free imaging for ultrasound device
assignee: Shenzhen Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics Co., Ltd.
abstract: Aspects of the disclosed technology provide ways to detect the object of ultrasound scanning and to automatically, load system settings and image preferences necessary to generate high quality output images. In some aspects, an ultrasound system can be configured to perform steps including receiving a selection of a first transducer, identifying a body structure or organ based on a signal received in response to an activation of the first transducer, retrieving a first set of image parameters corresponding with the body structure, and configuring the first transducer based on the first set of image parameters. Methods and machine-readable media are also provided.

title: Accessible remote deposit capture
abstract: Apparatuses, methods, program products, and systems are disclosed for accessible remote deposit capture. An apparatus includes a position module that determines a position of a hardware device relative to a document based on input captured from a camera of the hardware device. An apparatus includes a direction module that determines one or more directions for moving a hardware device relative to a document to position the document within a predefined area of a field of view of a camera. An apparatus includes an accessibility module that provides accessibility feedback via a hardware device based on determined one or more directions. Accessibility feedback includes feedback for assisting a user that has a visual impairment with positioning a hardware device such that a document is within a predefined area of a field of view of a camera.

title: Systems and methods for analyzing walking behavior
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for analyzing a walking behavior. In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, the system for analyzing the walking behavior comprises: an identity checking unit for checking the identity of a walker; a walking information acquisition unit which photographs the walking motions of the walker in one or more directions among from a left side, right side, and front side based on an identity checking signal from the identity checking unit, and extracts and provides kinematic information of the photographed walking videos (three-dimensional and/or two-dimensional skeleton information); a video merging unit which merges the kinematic information of the photographed walking videos (three-dimensional and/or two-dimensional skeleton information); a walking parameter extraction and classification unit which extracts one or more walking parameters based on the merged kinematic information (three-dimensional and/or two-dimensional skeleton information), and classifies walking types; and a walking result notification unit which determines whether the one or more walking parameters exceed a recommended reference value or included in a walking parameter range of abnormal walking or classified as a pathological walking, and provides the result of determination to the walker or an expert. Therefore, it is possible to provide the classified walking motions of a walker as data for helping an expert present a medical opinion.

title: Medical image association calling method and system based on multi-feature fusion
assignee: 青岛瑞思德生物科技有限公司, 宜昌市中心人民医院(三峡大学第一临床医学院、三峡大学附属中心人民医院)
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image association calling method and a system based on multi-feature fusion, which relate to the technical field of medical image processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring a medical category; analyzing the association degree to obtain a plurality of image feature association degrees; selecting a plurality of target medical image features, and analyzing standard degree and richness; acquiring accuracy as a plurality of accurate labeling values; performing correction calculation to obtain a plurality of correction accurate labeling values; and carrying out image fusion processing to obtain a fusion processing image, marking by adopting a plurality of correction accurate marking values, and sending to a client for displaying. The invention solves the technical problems of uneven displayed image quality and further affecting the guiding effect caused by low medical image processing efficiency in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the medical image processing efficiency, ensuring the image display accuracy and further improving the medical guiding effect and quality through intelligent screening, fusion processing and labeling processes.

title: Beam failure declaration and reporting
abstract: This disclosure provides systems, methods and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for signaling mechanisms associated with reporting information associated with multiple beam failure indicator (BFI) types via a beam failure detection (BFD) report. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may measure a periodic reference signal as part of a BFD procedure and may report a BFI if the UE measures that the reference signal fails to satisfy a threshold signal strength or quality. The UE may further detect or classify each reported BFI as one of multiple BFI types and may store information associated with respective numbers of the multiple BFI types in accordance with the detection or classification. In scenarios in which the UE declares beam failure, the UE may transmit a BFD report including the information associated with the respective numbers of the multipole BFI types.

title: Endoscope processor, information processing device, endoscope system, program, and information processing method
abstract: The invention provides a processor (2) for an endoscope, which can output the statistical result of lesion parts of each examination part. One aspect relates to an endoscope processor (2) provided with: an image acquisition unit for acquiring a captured image from an endoscope (1) for large intestine; a region identification unit for identifying a region in the large intestine from the captured image acquired by the image acquisition unit; a polyp extraction unit for extracting a polyp from the captured image; a statistics unit configured to count the number of polyps for each of the sites identified by the site identification unit; and an output unit configured to output a statistical result counted by the counting unit and an endoscopic image based on the captured image.

title: Computer generated user interfaces, computerized systems and methods and articles of manufacture for personalizing standardized deduction or itemized deduction flow determinations
abstract: Computing systems, computer-implemented methods, articles of manufacture for making personalized assessments regarding whether a taxpayer should be presented with a standardized flow of interview screens, questions or topics, or with an itemized deduction flow of interview screens, questions or topics. This assessment is made utilizing a generated user interface and analytic data elements that generate outputs that reflect the taxpayer's data, e.g., in the form of ranges of numerical data that are based on the taxpayer's data. User interface elements representing response options in the form of range data may be selected by the user without entering specific electronic tax return data for the purpose of making standardized v. itemized determinations and to determine which questions or topics can be bypassed.

title: System and method for joint clinical decision for pharmaceuticals
abstract: A clinical therapy system (10) includes a drug delivery device (14) configured to delivery medication to a patient. One or more therapy devices (12, 16, 11, 13, 15, 17) are configured to provide therapy or to monitor the patient. A computer (70) is programmed to perform a CDS method (100) including: receiving clinical context data for the patient from a health information system (HIS) (18); receiving high fidelity data (20, 22, 24, 60, 62, 64, 66) comprising real time measurements for the patient from one or more of the drug delivery device, one or more vital sign sensors, and at least one device of the one or more therapy devices; applying one or more physiologic models (30, 32, 34 36, 38) to the combination of the clinical context data and the high fidelity data to generate a clinical prediction for the patient; outputting a therapy recommendation for the patient based on the clinical prediction for the patient; and controlling operation of the drug delivery device or one of the therapy devices based on the therapy recommendation.

title: Systems and methods of entomology classification based on extracted anatomies
abstract: A method of identifying a living creature includes training a convolutional neural network model using pretrained convolutional neural networks to generate proposals about the regions where there might be an anatomical object within a digital image. Introducing a residual connection to get the input from the previous layer to the next layer helps in solving gradient vanishing problem. The next step is to design an object detector network that does three tasks: classifying the boxes with respective anatomies, tightening the boxes, and generating a mask (i.e., pixel-wise segmentation) of each anatomical component. In constructing the architecture of the object detector network, the network uses per-pixel sigmoid, and binary cross-entropy loss function (to identify the k anatomical components) and rigorously train them.

title: Portable multi-information fusion analysis and intervention evaluation system and method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-mode processing, and particularly discloses a portable multi-information fusion analysis and intervention evaluation system and method, wherein a portable multi-mode non-invasive data acquisition device is utilized for data acquisition to obtain a multi-mode physiological signal data set; preprocessing multi-mode physiological signal data and carrying out multi-dimensional dynamic fusion analysis to obtain a dynamic fusion feature set; establishing a brain disease auxiliary identification model by combining an ensemble learning method, and constructing a brain symptom standard mapping table corresponding to the dynamic fusion feature set; and further performing early intervention stimulation, and obtaining brain symptom types corresponding to different degrees according to the brain symptom standard mapping table so as to quantify early intervention treatment evaluation results and assist early diagnosis and intervention treatment of the brain neurological diseases, thereby achieving the purpose of delaying the development of chronic symptoms.

title: Method and device for processing mammary gland image and mammary gland imaging equipment
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for processing a mammary gland image and mammary gland imaging equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original scanning image, and acquiring a low-frequency image and a high-frequency image according to the original scanning image; determining a model according to the width of the mammary gland, the compression thickness of the mammary gland and the gray scale transformation distance, and determining a gray scale transformation region of the low-frequency image; and carrying out gray level transformation on the gray level transformation area to obtain a target low-frequency image with balanced thickness, and reconstructing the target low-frequency image and the high-frequency image to generate a target image. Through the technical scheme, the gray level transformation area needing thickness equalization in the mammary gland image can be accurately and automatically acquired, so that the mammary gland image with more uniform gray level distribution can be acquired, and a better mammary gland image thickness equalization effect can be achieved.

title: Method of health management for a self-cleaning cat litter box and related device
abstract: A method of health management for a self-cleaning cat litter box is disclosed. The method comprises measuring a first weight of the self-cleaning cat litter box, measuring a second weight of the self-cleaning cat litter box in responsive to a cat entering the self-cleaning cat litter box, identifying the cat entering the self-cleaning cat litter box, measuring a third weight of the self-cleaning cat litter box after the cat leaves the self-cleaning cat litter box, measuring a fourth weight of the self-cleaning cat litter box after the self-cleaning cat litter box performs waste cleaning, and uploading the identified cat with a body weight, a waste weight, and a waste type according to weight differences among the first, second, third and fourth weights.

title: Security surveillance and entry management system
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) entry management (EM) security system includes a camera, a microphone, a motion detector, a speaker, and a software platform. Geofences are utilized to create boundaries around physical areas, such as locations for package delivery or property boundaries. The EM device and other devices connected to the software platform are configured to monitor the geofences and detect a presence of an activity, an event, an object, or a device. At least one license plate reader is utilized to read license plate characters. Voice recognition and voice identification are used to grant or deny permissions for individuals on a property.

title: System and method for provisioning a gift with a uniform resource locator
abstract: Provided herein are systems and methods for provisioning a gift. The method includes receiving, with at least one processor, a request to provision a gift, the request comprising a uniform resource locator (URL) corresponding to a network location associated with a merchant and/or item, generating, with at least one processor, a modified URL configured to direct a user device to the network location associated with the merchant and/or item, the modified URL based on the original URL, an account identifier, and one or more account limits, and transmitting, with at least one processor, the modified URL to the user device, such that the user device is facilitated to engage in a transaction through the network location associated with the merchant and/or item using a payment account associated with the account identifier.

title: Parallel training method and system for federal learning
assignee: 深圳致星科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a parallel training method for federal learning. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an intersection with the same mark between the private data of the first party and the private data of the second party; obtaining a related data set according to a mapping mode determined based on the mark; grouping the hardware resources of the first participant and the hardware resources of the second participant through a preset grouping rule to obtain a hardware group of the first participant and a hardware group of the second participant respectively; respectively obtaining a first matching relation between the associated data set and the hardware group of the first party and a second matching relation between the associated data set and the hardware group of the second party; and cooperatively moving the hardware resources of the first participant and the hardware resources of the second participant according to the first matching relationship and the second matching relationship, and performing parallel training by using the associated data set.
assignee_clean: 深圳致星科技有限公司

title: Computer-program products tangibly embodied in a non-transitory machine-readable storage medium, computer-implemented methods, and computing devices
assignee: 美商薩思學會有限公司
abstract:
A computing device (2002) accesses a machine learning model (2050) trained on training data (2032) of first bonding operations (1308, 2040A) (e.g., a ball and/or stitch bond). The first bonding operations comprise operations to bond a first set of wires (1504) to a first set of surfaces (1506, 1508). The machine learning model is trained by supervised learning. The device receives input data (2070) indicating 
process data (2074) generated from measurements of second bonding operations (2040B). The second bonding operations comprise operations to bond a second set of wires to a second set of surfaces. The device weights the input data according to the machine learning model. The device generates an anomaly predictor (2052) indicating a risk for an anomaly occurrence in the second bonding operations based on weighting the input data according to the machine learning model. The device outputs the anomaly predictor to control the second bonding operations.

title: Data processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides a data processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein a large language model in the embodiment of the application is a large model, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be identified, wherein the data to be identified comprises image data and text data, acquiring a label of the image data, wherein the label of the image data is used for describing elements existing in the image data, acquiring text description of the image data, determining a target template corresponding to the data to be identified from at least one preset template, setting the target template according to a service scene of a multi-mode identification task, generating a piece of text information according to the label of the image data, the text description of the image data and the text data, inputting the text information into a pre-trained large language model, and outputting an identification result of the data to be identified. Therefore, the execution efficiency of the multi-mode identification task can be improved, and the computational cost and the time cost of multi-mode identification can be reduced.

title: Antibiotic susceptibility of microorganisms and related compositions, methods and systems
abstract: Provided herein is an antibiotic susceptibility test and related compositions, methods and systems based on detection of a nucleic acid from a target microorganism in a sample in the presence or absence of a lysis treatment of the sample.

title: Patient postoperative infection risk assessment system and method
abstract: The application discloses a system and a method for evaluating postoperative infection risk of a patient, which relate to the technical field of medical information processing. Therefore, the risk of postoperative infection of the patient can be effectively identified and managed, so that the wound infection of the patient can be prevented and treated in time, and the success rate of the operation and the satisfaction degree of the patient are improved.

title: MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) segmentation method aiming at brain lesion integration attention mechanism
abstract: The invention provides an MRI segmentation method aiming at a brain lesion integration attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps of; step S1, collecting brain MRI images with segmentation map results, and establishing a training set; s2, preprocessing an original brain MRI image to be segmented in a training set; s3, building a convolutional neural network with an attention mechanism, and training a model of the convolutional neural network with the attention mechanism by using a training set; s4, after model training is completed, predicting the verification set image by using trained model parameters, and generating a brain MRI tissue and lesion segmentation map; s5, establishing an evaluation file, and evaluating the segmentation result; the invention can extract more key and important information, and can improve the training effect of training on a small data set by means of transfer learning.

title: Cognitive assimilation and situational recognition training system and method
abstract: A tool for cognitive assimilation and situational recognition training includes one or more modules for visualization and visual association, auditory association, textual association, subliminal imprinting, constructive repetition, summarization, and testing of content provided to learners. The tool enables material provided as training content to be visualized by a user, and applies subliminal imprinting techniques to reinforce the visualized training content. The visualized and subliminally imprinted training content is further reinforced with visual, auditory and textual associations to the training content, and by constructive repetition of training content for the user, together with the subliminal messaging and associations. The tool also provides material in a building block approach so that previously-learned material is additionally reinforced in subsequent introductions of additional content. Cognitive assimilation and situational recognition training is also presented to the user in a hosting platform that enables online access and mobile learning in a flexible e-learning environment.

title: Electronic device
abstract: Provided is an electronic device. The electronic device according to the present disclosure can adjust the length of a band surrounding a user's head, by sensing pressure of a part of the electronic device coming into contact with the user. Furthermore, the electronic device according to the invention can identify a direction in which the user's eyeball looks, and deduce the user's facial expression, by sensing the movement of muscle around the user's eyeball. The electronic device of the invention can be associated with artificial intelligence modules, robots, augmented reality (AR) devices, virtual reality (VR) devices, devices related to 5G service, etc.

title: Wearable electronic device on head
abstract: Disclosed is an electronic device according to the present invention. The electronic device according to the present invention may move a display unit so that the position of the display unit corresponds to the pupil position of a user, and nanopatterns of an in-coupling portion, where a beam enters the display unit, and an out-coupling portion, where a beam is emitted, may be the same pattern. The electronic device according to the present invention may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, a robot, an augmented reality (AR) device, a virtual reality (VR) device, a device related to a 5G service, and the like.

title: Deep learning-based chart image data identification method and system
assignee: 深圳格隆汇信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to a chart image data identification method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: based on the input chart image, adopting a histogram equalization algorithm to adjust brightness, and adopting an edge enhancement algorithm to perform edge sharpening processing, so as to enhance image characteristics and generate a characteristic enhanced image. In the invention, the image characteristics are enhanced through a histogram equalization algorithm and an edge enhancement algorithm, a foundation is laid for characteristic extraction and graph analysis, and a convolutional neural network and a depth semantic segmentation algorithm are adopted, so that the method can accurately capture fine differences in images and realize fine classification of graph components, the analysis of deep logic and semantic relations of graphs is optimized through the application of the graph neural network and a natural language processing technology, graph content interpretation is provided, and the generation of a comprehensive analysis data set and a reconstruction graph data set is realized, so that the analysis and application of graph information are more flexible and efficient.
assignee_clean: 深圳格隆汇信息科技有限公司

title: Emotion recognition method and system based on multi-mode physiological information and deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a emotion recognition method and system based on multi-mode physiological information and deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: collecting brain electrical signals and electrocardiosignals of a tested person, and setting emotion labels to construct a training set; constructing a deep neural network model based on priori knowledge obtained from the pre-acquired functional magnetic resonance image; training the deep neural network model through the training set to obtain an emotion recognition model; and carrying out emotion recognition through the emotion recognition model. According to the invention, the electroencephalogram and the electrocardiosignal are synchronously acquired, and the pre-acquired functional magnetic resonance image data are used for establishing a high-dimensional model of the relation between the physiological information characteristics and the current emotion through a deep learning method, so that emotion recognition can be carried out on a person to be detected only by acquiring the electroencephalogram and the electrocardiosignal.

title: Data processing systems and methods for automatically redacting unstructured data from a data subject access request
abstract: System and methods are disclosed for redacting analyzing unstructured data in a request for data associated with a data subject to determine whether the unstructured data is relevant to the request. The relevancy of pieces of the unstructured data may be determined by determining a categorization for each such piece of unstructured data and comparing them to known personal data associated with the data subject having the same categorization. Pieces of the unstructured data that do not match known personal data having the same categorization are redacted from the request before the request is processed.

title: Diagnostic image generation apparatus and diagnostic image generation method
abstract: A three-dimensional region of interest (ROI) is established with a high degree of accuracy, by a simple method without increasing a burden on the operator, in generating a three-dimensional projected image from medical volume data according to rendering, achieving more efficient interpretation of three-dimensional image and streamlining of diagnostic flow, with the use of the diagnostic image generation apparatus. An energy map is generated on a predetermined tomographic plane, assuming a preset start point as a reference and searching for a path that minimizes the energy, and then the path is set as a boundary of the three-dimensional ROI. The start point may be decided on the basis of the boundary inputted by a user, or the user may set the start point. The user may be allowed to adjust the boundary having been set. The boundary may also be determined on another plane orthogonal to the predetermined tomographic plane.

title: Image classification method, training method and device for image classification model
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an image classification method, an image classification model training method and an image classification model training device, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: inputting an image to be classified into a coding layer of a pre-trained image classification model, and extracting vectors to obtain feature vectors, wherein the feature vectors comprise a plurality of local vectors, and each local vector corresponds to one sub-image in the image to be classified; screening the local vectors by using an attention mechanism layer in the coding layer to obtain residual local vectors; and obtaining a classification result of the image to be classified based on the residual local vector. The embodiment of the application firstly does not need an auxiliary network or introduces more parameters in the process of reducing the local vector, and can reduce the calculated amount, is also suitable for images with different resolutions and enhances the adaptability of the scheme because a lightweight image classification model can be trained from the beginning.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: File integrity monitoring
abstract: A file integrity monitoring system supports monitoring of system-critical, enterprise-critical and user-critical data by reporting events to a threat management facility in response to changes in certain files, folders, registry keys and registry values of the computing environment in which the system is operating and/or monitoring. The file integrity monitoring system may dynamically create, adapt and apply context-based rules to improve the sensitivity and relevance of reported events to undesirable changes in the data footprint of a monitored device.

title: Feature extraction network training method, image processing method and device
assignee: 北京达佳互联信息技术有限公司, 北京中科研究院
abstract: The disclosure relates to a feature extraction network training method, an image processing method and an image processing device, and relates to the field of image processing. The embodiment of the disclosure adds a second feature extraction network for extracting a second feature, wherein the second feature is used for representing the content feature distribution condition of the target class image, namely the neighborhood structure of the sample image, and combines with the first feature extraction network for extracting the self feature of the sample image to process the image feature of the sample image from two angles, considering the condition that the neighborhood structures of different sample images are possibly uneven, in the training process, not only the characteristics of the sample image are learned, but also the neighborhood structure of the sample image can be adaptively learned, the accuracy of the feature extraction network obtained by training in the aspect of feature extraction is better, so that the extracted features can more accurately reflect the categories to which the images belong, and more accurate retrieval results can also be obtained by performing image retrieval based on the trained feature extraction network.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device according to an aspect of the present invention comprises a case formed of an ultra-light fabric material; a frame coupled to the case and supporting the case; and a face pad coupled to the frame, wherein ultra-light fabric material comprises an ultra-light material comprising a thermoplastic resin and a core material dispersed in thermoplastic resin; and a fabric thermo-compressed on at least one side of the ultra-light material by thermoplastic resin.

title: Electronic device
abstract: Disclosed is an electronic device implementing a pin mirror-type display to address a double image problem, the electronic device including: a plate-shaped optical element forming an inner side surface directed toward a user's eyes and an outer side surface opposite to the inner side surface; an optical driving assembly allowing image light to be incident on one side in a lengthwise direction of the optical element; a reflection member provided on the other side in the lengthwise direction of the optical element so that the incident image light travels along an inside of the optical element; and a pin mirror member reflecting the reflected image light toward the reflection member to make a depth of field (DOF) deep, and disposed between a point at which the image light is incident from the optical element and a point at which the image light is reflected in the reflection member.

title: Electronic device
abstract: In an electronic device connected to an external device and a cable, an electronic device comprising a driving unit including an image source panel configured to form image light, a display unit configured to make the image light formed by the driving unit visible to a user, and a frame provided with the driving unit and the display unit, wherein the frame includes a front frame configured to locate the display unit to be seen by the user, a pair of side frames connected to left and right sides of the front frame, respectively, and a port formed at an outer side of at least one point on which the side frame and the front frame are connected so that a cable for transferring data or power from an external device may be attached or detached, and the side frame includes a support unit configured to support a head, and a connection unit configured to connect the support unit and the front frame and having a step recessed inward from the support unit to secure a space for a connector of a cable is provided to minimize the interference problem of the cable and to implement a light and simple design.

title: Deep learning-based heart disease heart sound intelligent classification method, device and medium
assignee: 浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院, 浙江大学滨江研究院
abstract: The invention provides a heart disease heart sound intelligent classification method, device and medium based on deep learning, belongs to the technical field of medical treatment, solves the problems of manual auscultation, non-objective judgment and the like based on the traditional stethoscope, and is based on the deep learning, and comprises the following steps: step S01: acquiring a heart sound audio signal, preprocessing the heart sound audio signal, and acquiring heart sound period information according to the preprocessed heart sound audio signal; step S02: extracting a feature map according to the preprocessed heart sound audio signal and heart sound period information to obtain a Mel spectrogram; step S03: training a deep neural network model; step S04: and step S01 and step S02 are executed to obtain a plurality of Mel spectrograms of the target heart sounds, and the Mel spectrograms are respectively input into the trained deep neural network model to obtain the final classification result of the target heart sounds.

title: System for recommending personalized nutritional supplements using artificial intelligence based on blt therapy
abstract: The present invention relates to a personalized nutritional supplement recommending system using artificial intelligence based on a BLT therapy, which comprises: a database unit for constructing big data by accumulating evaluation information which is information obtained by evaluating medical examination information in accordance with characteristics for each user and nutritional supplement information, and storing an artificial intelligence model; and a control unit for evaluating the medical examination information to generate evaluation information, repeatedly learning the artificial intelligence model to separately derive the nutritional supplement information matching the evaluation information through the big data, and deriving a nutritional recommendation result using the learned artificial intelligence model when the medical examination information is input. According to the present invention, a user can be recommended with nutritional supplements, which are most suitable for characteristics such as constitution, health condition, etc. of the user.

title: System and method for motion estimation using artificial intelligence in helical computed tomography
assignee: University Of Central Florida Research Foundation, Inc., iTomography Corporation, Canon Medical Systems Corporation
abstract: An improved system and method for estimating and compensating for motion by reducing motion artifacts produced during image reconstruction from helical computed tomography (CT) scan data. In a particular embodiment, the reconstruction may be based on helical partial angle reconstruction (PAR) and the registration may be performed utilizing one or more artificial intelligence (AI) based methods.
assignee_clean: university of central florida research foundation; itomography; canon medical systems
primary_assignee: university of central florida research foundation

title: Deleting user data using keys
abstract: Described are techniques for tracking associations between known keys and internal keys related to user data received at a natural language processing system and shared with target systems. The system can receive a request to delete data associated with a user or device, and determine one or more known keys related to the request. The system can retrieve previously stored associations between known keys and internal keys, and use the associations to generate a delete command containing relevant internal keys to be sent to the target systems, which in turn can delete data associated with the internal keys.

title: Data processing method and device for data processing
assignee: 北京搜狗科技发展有限公司, 搜狗（杭州）智能科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a data processing method and device and a device for data processing, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: receiving a text; the text relates to at least two languages; determining a target voice sequence corresponding to the text; determining a target image sequence corresponding to the target voice sequence according to the mapping relation between the voice characteristic sequence and the image characteristic sequence; the voice characteristic sequence and the image characteristic sequence in the mapping relation are aligned on a time axis; the mapping relation is obtained according to the voice sample and the image sample which are aligned by a time shaft; the voice sample relates to one language, or the voice sample relates to multiple languages; and fusing the target voice sequence and the target image sequence to obtain a corresponding target video. The embodiment of the invention can shorten the generation time of the target video, save the labor cost and be suitable for the texts corresponding to at least two languages.

title: Systems and methods for establishing trust online
abstract: Trust systems and methods include receiving a request from a first user, wherein the request is to a second user and relates to the second user sharing verified facts, attributes, and other pertinent information used by the first user in determining a level of trust to be afforded to the second user; providing the request to the second user for consent and for data acquisition related to the request; performing data acquisition responsive to the consent to obtain data; determining a response to the request based on the data; and providing the response to the first user, wherein the response is a minimum subset or derivative of the data required to answer the request so that the data is only shared with the first user on a limited basis.

title: Method and device for detecting length of long diameter and short diameter of nodule
assignee: 杭州依图医疗技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for detecting the length of a long diameter and a short diameter of a nodule, which relate to the technical field of machine learning, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining three-dimensional coordinates of a nodule in a nodule image, determining a region of interest (ROI) containing the nodule from the nodule image according to the three-dimensional coordinates of the nodule, segmenting the nodule region from the nodule image according to the ROI and a nodule segmentation model, and finally measuring the nodule region to determine the length of the long diameter and the short diameter of the nodule. The method has the advantages that the node image of the marked node region is trained by adopting the convolutional neural network to obtain the node segmentation model, the ROI containing the node is determined from the node image according to the three-dimensional coordinates of the node, so that the node region in the node image can be automatically determined from the RIO by adopting the node segmentation model, the length of the long diameter and the short diameter of the node is further determined, and compared with a method for determining the length of the long diameter and the short diameter of the node by manual visual observation, the detection efficiency and the detection accuracy of the length of the long diameter and the short diameter of the node are improved.
assignee_clean: 杭州依图医疗技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州依图医疗技术有限公司

title: Image registration method and related model training methods, equipment and computer readable storage medium thereof
assignee: 中國商上海商湯智能科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide an image registration method and related model training methods, an equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method includes: acquiring a real two-dimensional image and a reference two-dimensional image, using the virtual image feature extraction network of the image registration model to perform feature extraction on the reference two-dimensional image to obtain a first virtual feature image; wherein, the image registration model has been pre-trained with virtual images, and the virtual image feature extraction network has participated in the pre-training, and the virtual images are generated based on the virtual target. the real image feature extraction network of the image registration model is used to perform feature extraction on the real two-dimensional image to obtain the first real feature image; Among them, the real image feature extraction network is not involved in pre-training; use the difference between the first real feature image and the first virtual feature image to adjust the network parameters of the real image feature extraction network.
