title: Mental load detection method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a mental load detection method and a mental load detection device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a physiological signal of a to-be-detected object; inputting the physiological signal into a preset time convolution network model, and acquiring the mental load type of the object to be detected according to the output result of the time convolution network model; the physiological signals comprise electroencephalogram signals, and the time convolution network model is obtained after training according to physiological signal samples with mental load type labels. The physiological signal is input into the preset time convolution network model, and the preset time convolution network model is obtained after being trained according to the physiological signal sample with the mental load type, so that the recognition result of the mental load type can be output, the detection process is quick and accurate, the calculation consumption is less, and the redundant information can be automatically eliminated by using the time convolution network model.

title: Method and system for high speed detection of diamonds
abstract: THIS INVENTION relates to a method of or system for detecting presence of diamond in an object. The method comprises receiving classification data associated with photons emitted from object as a result of positron annihilation due to irradiation of the object with photons of a predetermined energy at which giant dipole resonance (GDR) occurs due to a nuclear reaction between the photons and carbon. The method then comprises the step of determining whether or not the object is potentially a diamond or diamondiferous by processing the received classification data with a trained machine-based learning classifier. The system typically implements the method described herein.

title: Computer, neural network construction method, and computer system
abstract: A computer constructs a neural network for executing image processing, the neural network being constituted of layers, each of which includes at least one node. The neural network includes a detection layer that realizes a process for detecting an object in an image. The computer is configured to execute: a first process of obtaining setting information for constructing the neural network including setting values relating to characteristics of a boundary of the object and a shape of the object, the setting values being values for calculating hyperparameters of the detection layer; a second process of constructing the neural network on the basis of the setting information. The second process includes a process of calculating the hyperparameters of the detection layer on the basis of the setting values.

title: Parameter monitoring device and system for proton treatment
assignee: 杭州珞珈质子科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a parameter monitoring device and a system for proton treatment, wherein the device comprises: the recurrent neural network module is used for providing a trained recurrent neural network model, and the trained recurrent neural network model provides a nonlinear relation between the activity distribution and the dose distribution of the positron nuclide of the proton beam; the PET acquisition module is used for acquiring a PET image of positive electron nuclide activity distribution generated by reaction of protons and tissues from a positron annihilation tomography system; the prediction module is used for inputting the PET image into the trained recurrent neural network model and predicting the dose distribution and the Bragg peak position of the proton beam through the nonlinear relation between the positron nuclide activity distribution and the dose distribution; the judging module is used for judging the position relation between the predicted dose distribution of the proton beam and the Bragg peak position and the target area; and the adjusting module is used for determining whether the beam outlet parameters of the proton beam need to be adjusted according to the judgment result of the judging module. The device and the system provided by the invention realize parameter monitoring and adjustment of proton treatment.

title: Three-dimensional biomedical image registration method based on iterative self-supervision
abstract: The invention relates to a three-dimensional biomedical image registration method based on iterative self-supervision, which overcomes the defect that the application precision of a model trained by an one-shot training strategy of an unsupervised deep learning registration algorithm is limited compared with the prior art. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring and preprocessing a three-dimensional biomedical image data set; constructing a registration depth model; training a registration depth model; acquiring an image to be registered; preprocessing an image to be registered; and obtaining a three-dimensional biomedical image registration result. The invention dynamically generates iterative self-monitoring information through network training and carries out multiple iterative monitoring training on each pair of selected images by utilizing the iterative self-monitoring information, so as to obtain a more accurate deformation field by utilizing the difference information of the images in different iterative stages for multiple times, and simply and efficiently improve the registration precision of the existing unsupervised biomedical image registration network.

title: visible light-based blood oxygen saturation detection method and system
assignee: 中国科学院软件研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a visible light-based oxyhemoglobin saturation detection method and system, which can be used for providing a brand-new and effective oxyhemoglobin saturation detection model by analyzing the problems existing after a traditional optical model is applied to mobile equipment, and providing a corresponding correction algorithm for the imaging baseline drift problem of a visible light sensor, so that the oxyhemoglobin saturation in a human body can be quickly detected and analyzed by using the visible light sensors (such as cameras in mobile phones) in intelligent mobile equipment and wearable equipment. The method and system of the present invention may also support many applications related to oximetry.

title: Determining user-interested information based on wearable device
assignee: Anhui Huami Information Technology Co., Ltd.
abstract: This disclosure provides wearable-device based user-interested information determination methods, apparatuses and wearable devices. The method includes: receiving, by an electrocardiography (ECG) sensor associated with the wearable device, an ECG signal of a user, determining a feature set for the ECG signal, in which the feature set includes time-domain feature data of the ECG signal and frequency-domain feature data of the ECG signal, and determining the user-interested information based on similarity between the feature set and reference feature sets indicative of the user-interested information, in which the user-interested information includes health information associated with a disease. The wearable device includes an ECG sensor configured to receive an ECG signal and an FPGA system. The FPGA system includes modules for determine user-interested information based on the ECG signal. The apparatus includes a processor and a memory coupled to the processor. The memory is configured to store instructions to implement the method.

title: Dimensional reduction of complex vectors in artificially intelligent solutions to compare similarity of natural language text
abstract: A web-based tool performs records matching in response to a freeform text input, to find highly contextually-related sentences in a corpus of records. Each sentence in the corpus is converted into a full-size vector representation, and each vector's angle within space is measured. Each full-size vector is compressed to a smaller vector and a loss function is used to preserve for each vector the angle within the lower-dimensional space that existed for the higher-dimensional vector. Full-size and reduced vector representations are generated from the freeform text input. The reduced-size vector of the input is compared to those of the corpus of text to identify, in real-time, a set of vector nearest neighbors that includes, with high accuracy, representations of all records in the corpus similar to the input. Full-size vectors for the nearest neighbors are in turn retrieved and compared to the input, and ranked results are generated.

title: Stress and hearing device performance
abstract: The disclosed technology generally relates to a hearing device configured to adjust its settings when it detects the hearing device user is experiencing stress related to the hearing device applying a processing scheme. The hearing device can use vital signs of the hearing device user to determine whether a user is stressed. The hearing device can also determine whether the user has become stressed as a result of applied setting or an applied processing scheme of the hearing device based on a change in the vital sign of the hearing device user. The disclosed technology also includes a method for reducing stressing when using a hearing device.

title: Lung function detection method, system, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳市华屹医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a lung function detection method, a system, an apparatus, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring chest and abdomen surface point cloud data of a detected object in a preset time period through a biological detection sensor; analyzing the chest and abdomen surface point cloud data and determining lung ventilation variation information of a tested object; and determining the lung function detection result of the tested object according to the lung ventilation change information. The biological detection sensor is arranged in a preset range around the detected object and is in no contact with the detected object. The method has no requirement on the breathing mode of the tested object, and avoids detection errors caused by the fact that the breathing rhythm of the tested object is not in line with the requirement, so that the accuracy of the detection result is improved. In addition, the organism detection sensor is arranged in a non-contact manner with the detected objects, is not in direct contact with the detected objects in the detection process, reduces the risk of cross infection in the sequential detection process of a plurality of detected objects, and is higher in safety.
assignee_clean: 深圳市华屹医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市华屹医疗科技有限公司

title: Method and system for positioning under cell liquid-based smear mirror
assignee: 深思考人工智能机器人科技（北京）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention introduces an image registration concept aiming at a cell liquid-based smear, applies deep learning to image registration, and matches an image under the microscope acquired by an electron microscope in real time with an image acquired by a film reading system, thereby realizing accurate positioning of target cells under the microscope and enabling the target cells to be positioned at the middle position of a visual field under the microscope. Furthermore, a focusing adjustment method of the electron microscope is further provided, aiming at the focusing difference of different areas of the under-lens image, after the under-lens visual field is positioned to the target cell, the under-lens area image is interpreted according to the fuzzy degree and the accurate focusing, so that the manual focusing process is reduced.
assignee_clean: 深思考人工智能机器人科技 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 深思考人工智能机器人科技 北京 有限公司

title: Ultrasonic image-based surgical instrument displacement monitoring device
assignee: 北京智愈医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a surgical instrument displacement monitoring device based on ultrasonic image, includes: the ultrasonic imaging system comprises a surgical instrument, an ultrasonic subsystem comprising an ultrasonic probe and a control subsystem comprising a processor, wherein the control subsystem is respectively connected with the surgical instrument and the ultrasonic subsystem, the ultrasonic subsystem continuously acquires ultrasonic images of a target tissue region and transmits acquired series of ultrasonic image frames to the processor of the control subsystem, the surgical instrument moves in the target tissue region according to a surgical planning path set by the processor, the tail end of the surgical instrument is provided with an arc-shaped top part, an image processing program contained by the processor carries out operation based on the series of ultrasonic image frames so as to determine the position deviation of a tracking subarea in a current frame image and the position deviation of the tracking subarea in a previous frame image, and the tracking subarea is the region containing the arc-shaped top part in the ultrasonic image. The displacement of the surgical instrument can be accurately, timely and effectively monitored based on the ultrasonic image, and the safety of the operation is guaranteed.
assignee_clean: 北京智愈医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京智愈医疗科技有限公司

title: Deep learning-based method and device for detecting station tampering
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a method and a device for detecting station tampering based on deep learning, and belongs to the field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: and crawling page content in a site to be detected, inputting the picture into a sensitive image detection model when the page content is the picture, wherein the sensitive image detection model is used for detecting whether the picture comprises a sensitive image or not, acquiring a detection result output by the sensitive image detection model, and determining that the site to be detected is tampered when the detection result is that the picture comprises the sensitive image. When the page content is text information, inputting the text information into a text detection model, wherein the text detection model is used for detecting whether the text information comprises sensitive information or not, acquiring a detection result output by the text detection model, and determining that the station to be detected is tampered when the detection result is that the text information comprises the sensitive information. The application can improve the accuracy of whether the station is tampered.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Multi-view data missing completion method for multi-manifold regularization non-negative matrix factorization
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-view data missing completion method based on multi-manifold regularization nonnegative matrix factorization, which is used for obtaining manifolds and global clusters of unmarked multi-view data which tend to be consistent by adopting a multi-manifold regularization nonnegative matrix factorization algorithm through the assumption of consistency among multiple views; and constructing a multi-view collaborative discrimination model by adopting a view collaborative improved Gaussian mixture method. The cluster correlation degree level of the sample with missing data under a non-missing visual angle is calculated, so that the pre-calibration of the cluster to which the sample belongs is realized; the consistency of multiple visual angles in a low-dimensional space is utilized, a multiple linear regression analysis method is adopted, a missing data prediction model under a specific visual angle is established, and accurate data completion under the condition of multi-attribute missing is achieved. The invention does not need large-scale labeling sample training, avoids predefining class relation and relevant characteristics, and improves the understanding and discovering ability of the existing multi-view mining technology on the unmarked multi-source data.

title: Systems and methods for determining whether an individual is sick based on machine learning algorithms and individualized data
abstract: In some instances, a user device for determining whether an individual is sick is provided. The user device is configured to obtain a facial image of an individual; obtain an audio file comprising a voice recording of the individual; determine a facial recognition confidence value associated with whether the individual is sick based on inputting the facial image into a facial recognition machine learning dataset that is individualized for the individual; determine a voice recognition confidence value associated with whether the individual is sick based on inputting the audio file into a voice recognition machine learning dataset that is individualized for the individual; determine whether the individual is sick based on the facial recognition confidence value and the voice recognition confidence value; and causing display of a prompt indicating whether the individual is sick.

title: Method for real time analyzing stress using deep neural network algorithm
assignee: Korea Institute Of Science And Technology
abstract: The present invention relates to a stress analysis method including: acquiring bio-signals from a test subject; calculating a probability of each of a plurality of stress level values by processing the bio-signals using a deep neural network algorithm; estimating a stress level value with the maximum probability of the plurality of stress level values as a stress level value of the test subject; determining usefulness of the estimated stress level value; and outputting the estimated stress level value determined to be useful through the determination of usefulness, as the final stress level.
assignee_clean: korea institute of science and technology
primary_assignee: korea institute of science and technology

title: Brain perfusion image feature point selection method, medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a brain perfusion image feature point selecting method, a medium and electronic equipment, and belongs to the field of medical image processing. The brain perfusion image feature point selection method comprises the following steps: acquiring a brain perfusion image to be processed; acquiring a corresponding target area in the cerebral perfusion image according to the received area selection instruction; generating a corresponding amplified image according to the target area; the magnified image is used for assisting a user to input a corresponding point selection instruction; and selecting the characteristic points in the cerebral perfusion image according to the received point selection instruction. The method for selecting the feature points of the cerebral perfusion images can improve the accuracy of feature point selection.
assignee_clean: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司

title: Body composition measuring apparatus and server providing a personalized information
abstract: In order to achieve the mentioned objective, according to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed is a body component measuring part. The device includes: a measuring part comprising at least two electrodes measuring impedance by applying a current to at least one part of the body of a user; a bio information generating part generating first body component information based on user information and impedance, measured by the measuring part at a first timing, and generating second body component information based on the user information and impedance measured at a second timing after the first timing; and a transceiving part transmitting the user information, the first body component information, and the second body component information to at least one among the user terminal and the server, and receiving correlation information indicating a correlation between first body component variation information and first user record information from at least one from the user terminal and the server. The first user record information includes record information about at least one factor, formed between the first and second timings and influencing the body component of the user, and the first body component variation information includes information about a body component variation between the first body component information and the second body component information.

title: Electrocardiosignal classification method and device
abstract: The application relates to a method and a device for classifying electrocardiosignals. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first electrocardiosignal, and calculating a first derivative sequence corresponding to the first electrocardiosignal; extracting an R wave peak value point sequence from the first derivative sequence according to a preset R wave peak value detection threshold value and a preset length window, and generating a binary image corresponding to the R wave peak value point sequence; inputting the binary image into a preset abnormal heart rate detection model to obtain an initial abnormal heart rate detection result; and determining the heart rate abnormity type of the first electrocardiosignal according to the initial heart rate abnormity detection result and a preset heart rate abnormity type judgment strategy. On the premise of ensuring low energy consumption, the method can realize higher detection precision and speed. Arrhythmia is detected in time and the type is confirmed, so that the diagnosis efficiency is improved, and medical resources are saved.

title: Flattened view for intra-lumenal navigation
abstract: Methods for creation and use (e.g., for navigation) of displays of flattened (e.g., curvature-straightened) 3-D reconstructions of tissue surfaces, optionally including reconstructions of the interior surfaces of hollow organs. In some embodiments, data comprising a 3-D representation of a tissue surface (for example an interior heart chamber surface) are subject to a geometrical transformation allowing the tissue surface to be presented substantially within a single view of a flattened reconstruction. In some embodiments, a catheter probe in use near the tissue surface is shown in positions that correspond to positions in 3-D space sufficiently to permit navigation; e.g., the probe is shown in flattened reconstruction views nearby view regions corresponding to regions it actually approaches. In some embodiments, automatic and/or easily triggered manual view switching between flattened reconstruction and source reconstruction views is implemented.

title: Hierarchical objects linkage data visualization
abstract: A computer-implemented method, computerized apparatus and computer program product for hierarchical objects linkage data visualization. A visualization of linkage data comprising a plurality of connections between a set of source objects and a set of target objects is obtained with respect to a predetermined level of hierarchy defined over attributes of at least one of the sets, wherein attributes of the objects and connections therebetween are represented in the visualization as nodes and links of a bipartite graph respectively. A spatial layout of links of a node is modified based on a relative position of each neighbor node thereof in an adjacent level, wherein neighboring nodes represent attributes of one or more objects which share in common an attribute represented by the node, wherein the relative position is determined based on a visualization restricted to the neighboring nodes so as to obtain a position preserving layout.

title: Method and device for determining medullary cavity anatomical axis based on deep learning
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for determining an anatomical axis of a medullary cavity based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of segmenting a two-dimensional cross-sectional image according to a preset segmentation neural network to segment a bone region corresponding to the medullary cavity; carrying out level classification on the bone regions according to a preset classification neural network, and separating out a pulp cavity level; determining the central points of all pulp cavity layers according to a central point calculation formula; and performing straight line fitting on the central point to determine the medullary cavity anatomical axis. The application aims to provide a high-precision marrow cavity anatomical axis determining mode.
assignee_clean: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司

title: Lung sound diagnostic device based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a lung sound diagnosis device based on deep learning, which comprises acquisition equipment, an image labeling tool, a data preprocessing module, a secondary data enhancement module and a deep learning classification model which are connected in sequence; the acquisition equipment is used for respectively acquiring lung auscultation data of normal and abnormal lung health conditions; the image marking tool is used for dividing and marking each section of collected audio; the data preprocessing module and the secondary data enhancement module are used for preprocessing the acquired audio signal samples and enhancing the data to obtain audio primary characteristics of different pulmonary auscultation signal samples, classifying and marking the audio primary characteristics as a normal sample and an abnormal sample, and extracting further deep learning characteristics; and training the deep learning classification model according to the primary feature vector to obtain a series of high-level features, classifying by adopting an RF classifier, and obtaining a multi-classification RF model through the input high-level features.

title: Iterative segmentation of images for computer-aided detection
abstract: A method and system for facilitating computer-aided detection (CAD) in which, in one implementation, image data is received (302) and iterations of an iterative segmentation process is performed on the image data. Each iterative segmentation process may include ascertaining whether a segment is normal (304), removing the segment from the image if ascertained to be normal (308) and transforming the shape of the segment (310). The iterative segmentation process may be stopped if a stop condition is met (312).

title: Natural language document summarization using hyperbolic embeddings
abstract: A mechanism is provided to implement a summarization mechanism for summarizing an identified natural language document using hyperbolic embeddings. Responsive to receiving a query from a user for a summarization of the identified natural language document, the summarization mechanism produces a hyperbolic embedding model of embeddings of the query. The summarization mechanism compares the embeddings of the query to each of a set of embeddings associated with a set of sentences of the identified natural language document. Responsive to identifying a subset of embeddings associated with the set of sentences of the identified natural language document having a semantic specificity to a subset of embeddings associated with the query, the summarization mechanism adds the sentence to a summary of the identified natural language document. The summarization mechanism then outputs the summary to the user.

title: Interactive decision support based on preferences derived from user-generated content sources
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system comprising at least one processor and at least one memory, the at least one memory comprising instructions executed by the at least one processor to cause the at least one processor to implement a personalized interactive decision support system. A customer profile generator executing within the personalized interactive decision support system determines a set of traits for at least one customer based on at least one user-generated content source. A personalized product recommendation module executing within the personalized interactive decision support system matches the at least one customer to at least one product within a set of products based on a consumption preferences-to-product attribute mapping data structure to form at least one product recommendation. Each product in the set of products has an associated set of attributes and wherein the consumption preferences-to-product attribute mapping data structure correlates customer traits and consumption preferences and correlates consumption preferences and product attributes. A visual and interactive decision support module executing within the personalized interactive decision support system presents the at least one product recommendation.

title: Method for reliable classification of samples in clinical diagnostics using an improved method of classification
abstract: A system for classification of a test object using a training set comprising a plurality of objects, each of which is assigned as a member of a class. Collectively, the objects in the training set are members of at least two classes. A computer system is configured as a probabilistic classifier. The classifier estimates the probability of the test object being a member of each of the classes in the training set. The probabilistic classifier estimates the probability with reference to the class assignments of the objects in the training set which are neighbors to the test object within a defined region within the training set. The probabilistic classifier takes into account the situation in which there is an imbalance in the number of objects in the different classes in the training set. Additionally, the probabilistic classifier does not require any knowledge of the probability distribution function of the classes in the training set.

title: Computationally customizing instructional content
abstract: A computing system causes instructional media to be played on a device to a user. An instructor in the instructional media provides guidance as to how to perform an activity when the instructional media is played on the device. The computing system obtains user data pertaining to performance of the activity by the user. The computing system generates a user-customized portion of the instructional media based upon the user data and a computer-implemented model. The computing system causes the user-customized portion to be played on the device to the user, where the device emits audible words reproduced in a voice of the instructor, where the audible words are based upon the user data, and further where the device displays generated images of the instructor depicting the instructor speaking the audible words as the device emits the audible words.

title: Utilizing financial data of a user to identify a life event affecting the user
abstract: The invention relates to a method for identifying a life event affecting a user. The method includes obtaining a classification model. The classification model models how financial data of a user relates to life events. Also, the method includes gathering the financial data of the user. The financial data of the user matches at least a subset of the classification model. In addition, the method includes identifying a life event affecting the user by applying the classification model to the financial data of the user. Still yet, the method includes customizing a user interface of an application that is utilized by the user. The customization is based on the identified life event.

title: Chromosome polarity identification method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）, 中国科学院计算技术研究所
abstract: The invention provides a chromosome polarity identification method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of (1) collecting a data set, (2) constructing a training set and a testing set, (3) carrying out learning training on a chromosome polarity identification model based on the training set, and (4) inputting the testing set into the chromosome polarity identification model for testing and outputting a polarity result of a chromosome to be predicted. The invention also provides a chromosome polarity identification system based on deep learning. The method and the system provided by the invention can accurately judge the polarity type of the current chromosome based on a deep learning classification algorithm, and complete the polarity adjustment of the chromosome according to the polarity type of the current chromosome, so that the chromosomes are all kept in a state that the short arms are upward. The method and the system have the advantages that the chromosome polarity identification accuracy rate reaches 96.36%, the data source is simple, the automation degree of chromosome analysis is high, the process is simpler, and the method and the system have wide industrial practicability.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院; 中国科学院计算技术研究所
primary_assignee: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院

title: Non-uniform quantized feedback in federated learning
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a client device may determine a feedback associated with a machine learning component based at least in part on applying the machine learning component. Accordingly, the client device may transmit a quantized value based at least in part on the feedback. The quantized value is determined based at least in part on distances between the feedback and a non-uniform set of quantized digits. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title: Tumor treatment auxiliary decision-making method based on reinforcement learning
assignee: 复旦大学附属肿瘤医院
abstract: The invention provides a tumor treatment auxiliary decision-making method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of constructing and training a patient state transition model and a treatment decision-making model, wherein the patient state transition model models the state change of a tumor patient through a cyclic neural network, and the diagnosis and treatment scheme and the examination index obtained in actual diagnosis and treatment are used as data sources to simulate the state change of the tumor patient under a certain diagnosis and treatment scheme; the treatment decision model models the process of treating a tumor patient through reinforcement learning, a patient state transfer model is used as a data source, a Deep Q Network (DQN) is constructed as a strategy network, and an excitation function is constructed on the basis of RECIST solid tumor curative effect evaluation criteria and TNM tumor imaging stage criteria to carry out iterative training. The invention can reduce the workload of the tumor specialist to a certain extent, and the treatment means predicted by the model can be used as decision reference to reduce the decision errors of doctors and assist the doctors to assign a feasible treatment scheme.
assignee_clean: 复旦大学附属肿瘤医院
primary_assignee: 复旦大学附属肿瘤医院

title: Method and system for competence monitoring and contiguous learning for control
abstract: According to some embodiments a competence module is provided to: receive an objective; select a machine learning model associated with the objective; receive data from the at least one data source; determine at least one next input based on the received data; determine whether the at least one next input is in a competent region or is in an incompetent region of the machine learning model; when the at least one next input is inside the competent region, generate an output; determine an estimate of uncertainty for the generated output; when the uncertainty is below an uncertainty threshold, the machine learning model is competent and when the uncertainty is above the uncertainty threshold, the machine learning model is incompetent; and operate the physical asset based on one of the competent and incompetent state of the machine learning model. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title: Question pre-processing in a question and answer system
abstract: Mechanisms are provided for assembling natural language user inputs into questions for a question-and-answer (QA) system. The mechanisms initialize a timer to a threshold amount of time, receive a first input of content-bearing natural language from a user computing device, and initiate running of the timer in response. The mechanisms determine whether a second input of content-bearing natural language is received from the user computing device prior to the threshold amount of time being reached by the timer. If so, the second input is grouped with the first input to generate a question comprising content of both the first input and the second input, and the timer is reset. In response to the timer reaching the threshold without further input from the user computing device, the question is provided to the QA system as an input question for processing by the QA system.

title: Multi-person cooperative focus positioning and enhanced display method based on space gesture capturing
abstract: The invention provides a multi-person collaborative focus positioning and displaying method based on space gesture capturing, which is characterized in that the space gesture of a patient is calculated, a virtual human body model is bound and a case demonstration model library is displayed by wearing AR display equipment by the patient and doctor, the space gesture of the patient positioned by depth perception equipment is shared, the doctor and the patient in the enhanced environment can observe the virtual focus model and pathological mechanism and other contents superimposed on the patient at the same time, the knowledge of the patient on the disease is enhanced, and the communication and understanding of the doctor and the patient in the diagnosis and treatment process are promoted.

title: Endobronchial ultrasound imaging
abstract:
An endobronchial ultrasound (EBUS) bronchoscope is configured as a single-use (e.g., 
disposable) device. The bronchoscope includes an insertion tube having a proximal section 
adjacent the handle and a distal tip. An ultrasound transducer assembly is located at the distal tip.  
The ultrasound transducer assembly includes an ultrasound transducer array, transmit-and
receive circuitry for the ultrasound transducer array, and a flexible interconnection between the 
ultrasound transducer array and the transmit-and-receive circuitry. The insertion tube further 
includes an imaging lumen including one or more power cables and one or more communication 
wires that extend from the ultrasound transducer assembly through the proximal section and a 
working channel that is separate from the imaging lumen.

title: Multi-channel orthogonal convolutional neural networks
abstract: Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure include apparatus and methods to classify the plaque tissue present in the coronary artery using intravascular optical coherence tomography (IVOCT) images.

title: Apparatus and method for generating and using a subject-specific statistical motion model
abstract: A method and an apparatus are provided for building a subject-specific statistical model of shape variation for an anatomical structure using a set of geometric representations of shape for the anatomical structure. Each representation is associated with one of multiple subjects, each subject having a respective subset of associated representations, and each subset comprising multiple representations including a reference representation. The multiple representations correspond to different shapes of the anatomical structure arising from physical motion and/or deformation thereof. The method comprises specifying a set of shape parameters whose values, for any given representation, characterize the shape of the representation, and for each subject, representing a probability distribution of the values of the shape parameters across the subset of representations associated with that subject by a set of subject-specific distribution parameters. The method further comprises determining a regression between the subject-specific distribution parameters and the respective reference representation for each subject, and applying said determined regression to a reference representation for a new subject to determine subject-specific distribution parameters for the new subject. The subject-specific distribution parameters are then used to build a subject-specific statistical motion model for the new subject.

title: Semi-supervised training method, system, equipment and storage medium for segmentation network
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of image processing, and relates to a semi-supervised training method, a semi-supervised training system, semi-supervised training equipment and a semi-supervised training storage medium for a segmentation network. Aiming at the problem that the supervised training method relies on a large amount of marking data and priori knowledge to be underutilized in semi-supervised training, a U-Net segmentation network is utilized as an encoder and a pre-training condition generation network is utilized as a decoder to form an encoded-decoded neural network, and the pre-training condition generation network is used for enabling the network to learn in the correct direction in a manner of generating countermeasure; the matching degree of the heart image and the prior information is improved by carrying out affine transformation registration, and meanwhile, a penalty loss term and an interest region reconstruction error loss term are provided to effectively inhibit interference of a complex background of the heart image. The rest part does not need the marking data except a small amount of marking data in the pre-training condition generating network, so that an accurate heart image segmentation network can be trained by only needing a small amount of marking data so as to quantitatively evaluate important clinical indexes such as ventricular volume and the like.

title: Geophysical sensor positioning system
abstract: An augmented reality (AR) object positioning system receives a target coordinate for a location of interest within a physical environment. The AR object positioning system then determines an AR device coordinate of an AR device within the physical environment and orientation information of the AR device at the AR device coordinate. The AR object positioning system calculates a plurality of image frame coordinates of an image frame based on the AR device coordinate and the orientation information when the image frame was captured. The AR object positioning system, in response to an image frame coordinate of the plurality of image frame coordinates corresponding with the target coordinate, renders on a display of the AR device, first annotation content relative to the image frame coordinate according to rendering instructions for the first annotation content.

title: Retina blood vessel segmentation method combining U-Net and self-adaptive PCNN
assignee: 重庆贝奥新视野医疗设备有限公司
abstract: A retinal vessel segmentation method combining U-Net and self-adaptive PCNN (pulse coupled neural network) performs data augmentation on a fundus image database selected in an experiment; carrying out graying treatment on the data set picture; performing CLAHE processing on the data set picture, and increasing contrast between retinal blood vessels and the background; image blocking; building, training and picture enhancement of a U-Net neural network model; building a self-adaptive PCNN neural network model; vessel segmentation was performed using adaptive PCNN. According to the improved U-Net secondary iteration fundus blood vessel image enhancement method, the background can be remarkably restrained, the blood vessel area is highlighted, noise interference is weakened, the image contrast is increased, and therefore the image quality of a data set is improved. The invention further provides a fundus blood vessel image segmentation method based on the self-adaptive PCNN. The accurate parameters estimated by using the Otsu algorithm are used, then the output result is enhanced by the U-Net secondary iteration and is sent into the self-adaptive PCNN, and the effective segmentation of the complete fundus blood vessel is realized.
assignee_clean: 重庆贝奥新视野医疗设备有限公司
primary_assignee: 重庆贝奥新视野医疗设备有限公司

title: Method of detecting nucleic acid targets using a statistical classifier
abstract: A method of detecting a target nucleic acid in a test sample utilizes a learning statistical classifier system to build a general linear classifier based on an amplification-dependent parameter for the target and the control nucleic acids, in order to classify the test sample as containing or not containing the target nucleic acid.

title: Tissue lesion area image auxiliary restoration system and method
assignee: 武汉千屏影像技术有限责任公司
abstract: The invention discloses a tissue lesion area image auxiliary restoration system and method. The invention relates to a general original image acquisition module, a slice image acquisition module, a tool mark extraction and numbering module, a projection repositioning module, a slice image transfer module, a result correction and confirmation module, a lesion tissue discrimination module and a result display module; the general image acquisition module is in communication connection with the tool mark extraction module and is responsible for acquiring images; the slice image transfer module is in communication connection with the slice image acquisition module, the slice image transfer module is in communication connection with the result correction and confirmation module, and the projection repositioning module is connected with the tool mark extraction and numbering module and the slice image transfer module; the invention has good universality, introduces the machine learning and deep learning algorithm in the restoration process of the lesion area, reduces the workload of a pathology technician and a pathologist as much as possible, and greatly improves the automation degree of the restoration of the general lesion area.
assignee_clean: 武汉千屏影像技术有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 武汉千屏影像技术有限责任公司

title: Method and system for determining the preparedness of a uterus for delivery
abstract: A method of determining the preparation of a uterus for delivery, the method comprising obtaining tissue displacement information using images of at least part of the uterine wall before and after contraction and using parameters obtained from the tissue displacement information to determine the preparation of the uterus for delivery. In one example, the method further comprises obtaining a stress causing the tissue displacement from the tissue displacement information, in which case the parameter obtained from the tissue displacement information comprises a parameter obtained from the stress. Systems for practicing the methods and articles are also disclosed herein.

title: Systems and methods for supporting secure transfer of data between workspaces
abstract: Systems and methods support secure transfer of data between workspaces operating on an IHS (Information Handling System). Upon a request for access to a first managed resource, such as protected data, a first workspace is deployed according to a first workspace definition. Upon a request for access to a second managed resource, a second workspace is deployed according to a second workspace definition. In response to an indication of a portion of the protected data from the first workspace being copied to a buffer supported by the IHS and of a request to paste the copied portion of the protected data to the second workspace, the protections provided by the second workspace are evaluated. If the protections of the second workspace are inadequate, an updated second workspace definition is selected that specifies additional protections. The second workspace is updated according to the updated second workspace definition and the transfer is permitted.

title: Apparatus and method for detection of dysfunctional breathing
abstract: A monitoring method is performed by a digital processor while a subject is asleep or with little movement. The method includes receiving transducer signals for a subject and training a model for characteristics of a subject or subject group. The model is used in generating sleep data according to real-time correspondence and values of transducer signals including subject rib displacement, subject abdomen displacement, subject torso movement, and subject orientation. Combinations of the transducer inputs are used to determine features from which outputs such as an AHI score are determined. A feature matrix is normalized based on dynamically-generated positional epochs bordered by subject movements to new positions and used to provide a normalization matrix.

title: Method for the detection of an albumin isoform
assignee: The Board Of Regents Of The University Of Texas Systems
abstract: The present invention provides methods for detecting, analyzing, and identifying biomolecules used to identifying patient with dengue-like symptom who are at risk of DHF. The inventive method comprises detecting in a sample from a subject dengue infected patient one or more biomarkers selected from the group consisting of IL-10, fibrinogen, C4A, immunoglobulin, tropomyosin, and three isoforms of albumin, and which are used in a predictive MARS model to detect patients with risk of developing DHF.

title: Systems, devices, and methods for monitoring loads and forces on a seat
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods are disclosed herein for monitoring physiological data of subjects seated on a toilet, including systems, devices, and methods for monitoring loads and forces on a toilet seat. In some embodiments, systems, devices, and methods disclosed herein include a set of sensors that can measure loads and forces present at coupling points between a toilet seat and a base or other components of a toilet.

title: Lung trachea segmentation method and device
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a lung trachea segmentation method and device, relates to the technical field of medical images, can realize full automation, and adopts different segmentation principles aiming at characteristics of tracheas of different levels, so that the omission problem of the lung trachea segmentation process is solved, and further, a richer and more complete trachea tree is obtained. In one aspect, the method comprises: firstly, a primary trachea is obtained; then, expanding the primary air pipe based on a hierarchical region growing algorithm and obtaining a secondary air pipe connected with the primary air pipe; secondly, acquiring local characteristics of the secondary trachea; thirdly, acquiring a tertiary trachea based on the local features and an energy minimization constraint growth algorithm; therefore, the first-stage trachea, the second-stage trachea and the third-stage trachea are fused, and the obtained trachea segmentation result is output. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention is suitable for the process of segmenting or extracting the pulmonary airway tree.

title: Prediction method of active state and determination method of activity threshold
assignee: 北京达佳互联信息技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for predicting an activity state and a method for determining an activity threshold, the method comprising: acquiring access characteristic data generated by an object accessing a service in a historical time period; determining the activity probability of the object in each prediction time period in the prediction period according to the incidence relation between the access characteristic data and the time interval of the object access service; determining the expected number of the active prediction time periods of the object in the prediction period based on the active probabilities of the object in the prediction time periods; the number expectation value of the active prediction time periods is compared with the first threshold corresponding to the object, and the active state of the object in the prediction period is determined according to the comparison result.

title: Electronic device
abstract: Disclosed is an electronic device. An electronic device according to the present invention includes: a main frame having a first opening; a display unit connected to the main frame and having a display area which may be exposed through the first opening; and a virtual reality frame movably coupled to the main frame and having a second opening to which a first lens is coupled, in which when the virtual reality frame moves to a first location where the first opening and the second opening are arranged side by side in a sight direction of a user, the user is capable of recognizing an image of the display unit as a virtual reality image through the first lens, and when the virtual reality frame moves to a second location deviated from the first location, the user is capable of recognizing the image of the display unit as an augmented reality image. An electronic device according to the present invention may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, robot, augmented reality (AR) device, virtual reality (VR) device, and device related to 5G services.

title: AR device and method for controlling the same
abstract: Disclosed is an AR device and method for controlling the same. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, the method for controlling the AR device computes a distance between the AR device and a capturing device connected with the AR device via wired/wireless communication and receives an angle of the capturing device and computes an angle of the AR device. The method determines information related to a distance to a real object captured by the capturing device, computes an augmented position of a virtual object corresponding to the real object, and displays the virtual object in the augmented position on a display. The AR device of the present disclosure may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, a robot, a virtual reality (VR) device, a device related to a 5G service, and the like.

title: Thyroid nodule automatic segmentation and grading intelligent system
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent system for automatically segmenting and grading thyroid nodules, which is characterized by comprising the following components: a thyroid ultrasound image database; a thyroid ultrasound image preprocessing module; thyroid nodule feature extraction module: the method comprises the steps that feature extraction is carried out on a preprocessed thyroid ultrasound image based on a U-Net segmentation model taking ResNet34 as a main body, and the U-Net segmentation model taking ResNet34 as the main body comprises a down-sampling module, a feature fusion module and an up-sampling module; thyroid nodule segmentation module: and the method is used for performing semantic segmentation on the image subjected to the feature extraction to form a thyroid nodule segmentation result graph.

title: Hybrid transmission scheme determination
assignee: 上海诺基亚贝尔股份有限公司, 诺基亚通信公司
abstract: There is provided a method in a network element of a wireless communication network, the method comprising: receiving a service request from a service provider; initiating a determination of a transmission scheme for the service request; obtaining multicast capability information about a plurality of terminal devices and network nodes; obtaining distribution information about a plurality of terminal devices; obtaining traffic load information about a network node; determining a transmission scheme for the service request based on the multicast capability information, the distribution information, and the traffic load information, the transmission scheme including at least one unicast transmission and at least one multicast transmission; and indicating at least one unicast transmission to the one or more unicast sending entities and at least one multicast transmission to the one or more multicast sending entities.

title: Control system and method for interventional ventricular catheter pump
assignee: 安徽通灵仿生科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a control system and a control method of an interventional ventricular catheter pump, and relates to the technical field of medical equipment; the data monitoring module is used for acquiring a plurality of physiological parameter information of the patient acquired by the flexible sensor; the model construction module is used for taking the physiological parameter information as input information of the coupling three-dimensional model to obtain hemodynamic parameter information of a patient output by the coupling three-dimensional model; and the pump rotating speed feedback control module is used for realizing pump rotating speed feedback control based on the hemodynamic parameter information. By applying the control system of the embodiment, the rotation speed control of the interventional ventricular catheter pump can be realized.

title: Integration of knob sensors in monitoring systems
abstract: Techniques are described for using information from a knob sensor of an appliance in a property monitoring system. In some implementations, a monitoring system may be configured to receive sensor information from a knob, receive monitoring device information from a monitoring device and, based on the sensor information from the knob, identify a knob event. The monitoring system may integrate the knob event with the monitoring device information and analyze the integrated knob event and monitoring device information against one or more rules related to usage of the appliance in view of the state of the property. Based on analyzing the integrated knob event and monitoring device information, the monitoring system may determine whether to perform an action, such as notifying a user or activating an appliance.

title: System and method for segmenting normal organ and/or tumor structure based on artificial intelligence for radiation treatment planning
assignee: Samsung Life Public Welfare Foundation, Seoul National University R&Db Foundation
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system and method for segmenting a normal organ and/or tumor structure based on artificial intelligence for radiation treatment planning. The system may include a data collection unit configured to collect a radiotherapy structure (RT-structure) file including a computerized tomography (CT) image of a patient and contour information of an area of interest for radiation treatment, a pre-processing unit configured to extract the contour information from the RT-structure file and generate a binary image based on the extracted contour information, and a model training unit configured to learn parameters for generating a segmentation map indicative of the area of interest using a deep learning algorithm, based on the binary image, and generate a trained model based on the learnt parameter.

title: System and method for scoliosis probability assessment
assignee: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a system for scoliosis probability assessment, comprising: a capture device configured to obtain a back picture; and a processing device configured to communicatively connect with the capture device and receive the back picture, the processing device comprising: a detection module configured to detect a back region in a back picture; a symmetry calculation module configured to calculate back symmetry of the back region; a balance calculation module configured to detect joint points in the back region and calculate a back balance based on the detected joint points; and an evaluation module configured to evaluate a probability of scoliosis based on the back symmetry and the back balance. The present application also discloses a method for scoliosis probability assessment and a machine-readable storage medium.

title: Speech recognition error correction method, system, device and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a voice recognition error correction method, a system, a device and a storage medium, which relate to an artificial intelligence technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing voice recognition on voice to be detected to obtain a text to be detected and a corresponding pronunciation sequence to be detected; constructing an FST to be detected according to the pronunciation sequence to be detected; according to the FST to be detected and the keyword FST, determining a plurality of words to be corrected in the text to be detected, and determining sentences to be corrected containing the words to be corrected; if the Chinese character confusion set contains the words to be corrected, determining the replacement words corresponding to each word to be corrected, and replacing the words to be corrected in the sentence to be corrected with the replacement words to generate a replacement sentence; and when the first logic score of the sentence to be corrected is smaller than the second logic score of the alternative sentence, replacing the sentence to be corrected in the text to be detected with the alternative sentence, and finishing the correction. The technical scheme of the invention can determine the words possibly with errors according to pronunciation, and realize effective error correction of the voice recognition text.

title: Segmentation-based damage detection
abstract: A computer-implemented method includes: obtaining a sample picture and corresponding mark data, in which the mark data includes a first damage mark outline, and in which the first damage mark outline frames a damaged object in the sample picture; determining a segmentation type for a plurality of pixels in the sample picture based on the first damage mark outline, to generate segmentation mark data; inputting the sample picture to a weak segmentation damage detection model, in which the weak segmentation damage detection model includes an outline prediction branch and a segmentation prediction branch, in which the outline prediction branch outputs outline prediction data including a damage prediction outline, the damage prediction outline framing a predicted damaged object in the sample picture, and in which the segmentation prediction branch includes segmentation prediction data including a predicted segmentation type of each pixel of the plurality of pixels.

title: Records search and management in compliance platforms
abstract: A method in one embodiment comprises defining a plurality of fields in a plurality of electronic documents, wherein the plurality of fields respectively correspond to governance, risk and compliance system data structures, identifying a plurality of relationships between the electronic documents based on one or more cross-references between fields of two or more different electronic documents of the plurality of electronic documents, and assigning respective ranks to the plurality of electronic documents based on the relationships. In the method, a query is received from a user device, and a listing of candidate documents of the plurality of electronic documents is retrieved in response to the query. Scores for respective ones of the candidate documents are computed based on at least the assigned ranks, and a response to the query is transmitted to the user device, wherein the response comprises the listing of candidate documents sorted according to the computed scores.

title: Root cause analysis of computerized system anomalies based on causal graphs
abstract: An embodiment for root cause analysis of computerized system anomalies is provided. The embodiment may include monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) for a computerized system, wherein KPI values of the monitored KPIs form respective timeseries. The embodiment may include detecting an anomaly in the computerized system based on the monitored KPIs. The embodiment may include determining a troubleshooting time window extending over a given time period. The embodiment may include identifying a strict subset of the monitored KPIs based on portions of the respective timeseries spanning the given time period. The strict subset comprises abnormal KPIs (aKPIs) and potential explanatory KPIs (xKPIs). The embodiment may include obtaining a causal graph of vertices mapping KPIs of the strict subset by running a causality algorithm to evaluate weights of directed edges connecting the vertices and accordingly obtain one or more directed paths. The embodiment may include returning the obtained causal graph.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for constructing test cases
assignee: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for constructing test cases. The method comprises the following steps: according to the type of the product to be tested, a plurality of test standard labels are obtained from a test standard database, and classified to obtain a plurality of industry keywords; generating at least one business keyword according to the original data of the product to be tested; acquiring a plurality of initial test cases from a test standard database according to the industry keywords and the business keywords, and carrying out test standard detection on each initial test case to obtain a plurality of candidate test cases; normalizing the original test case and the candidate test case to construct a target training data set; and calling a preset language model, and predicting the target test case based on the test standard label. The method combines the standard test cases of the machine learning predictive product, thereby improving the coverage rate of the test scene and further improving the accuracy of the test.

title: Cell antinuclear antibody fluorescence recognition method and system based on dynamic label distribution
abstract: The invention discloses a cell antinuclear antibody fluorescence identification method and system based on dynamic label distribution, belongs to the technical field of computer vision and medical image analysis, and solves the problems that the prior art cannot effectively extract the characteristics of a significant region, is poor in classification effect, has many false negatives and the like. The invention comprises preparing and cleaning antinuclear antibody fluorescence image of human body cell; according to the multi-example learning package and the concept of the example, abstracting an original drawing into a package, disassembling a corresponding example, and initializing a label of the example as a package label; building an identification network, namely a neural network model, which takes a residual neural network as a framework and a graph neural network classifier as a gathering head; determining a loss function of the neural network model and related hyper-parameters, training the neural network model, and iteratively updating the example label by using a dynamic label allocation technology; performance verification of the neural network model is performed on the additional image data. The invention is used for the label recognition of the human cell antinuclear antibody.

title: Remote network management infrastructure for cloud-based deployments
abstract: A software architecture within a public cloud network may include units of: (i) a plurality of computational instances respectively related to managed networks, (ii) a plurality of servers configurable as load simulators, (iii) administrative components configured to deploy and update the software architecture, and (iv) shared infrastructure services, wherein the units of the software architecture are implemented on virtual machines of the public cloud network and are connected to but logically isolated from one another by way of different access controls or policies. A provider network, coupled to the software architecture by way of network gateways within the shared infrastructure services, may be configured to deliver the configuration, software packages, and database schema to the infrastructure-as-code platform.

title: Display lighting systems with bioactive lighting
abstract: Bioactive display systems for displaying digital content. The display systems have one or more LED-based lighting channels adapted to generate one or more of a long red near infrared (LRNE) red light, a circadian-inducing blue light output in first operational mode and a less-circadian-inducing blue light output in a second operational mode. The bioactive lighting can have a first circadian-stimulating energy characteristic related to the associated first spectral power distributions of light generated in the first operational mode, and the non-circadian-inducing blue light can have a second circadian-stimulating energy characteristic related to the associated second spectral power distribution of light generated in the second operational mode. Disclosure methods of generating digital display content with the display systems described herein. The methods can generate a circadian-inducing blue light output in first operational mode and one of a LRNE output and a less-circadian-inducing blue light output in a second operational mode.

title: X-ray multi-leaf dynamic collimation for multiple source-in-motion tomosynthesis imaging system
abstract: A dynamic multi-leaf collimator system for X-ray exposure on region of interest in conjunction with multiple source-in-motion tomosynthesis imaging system is disclosed. The system comprises two opposite banks of thin heavy metal leaves arranged in parallel and stagger formation. The leaves are individually driven by electrical motors, can move in straight line in at least one direction and create multiple X-ray exposure holes with desired shapes. The leaves are made of thin heavy metal capable of blocking kV level X-rays. After a preliminary X-ray imaging scan, artificial intelligence or system operator can determine location of region of interest and then determine location of collimation holes. Therefore, subsequent X-ray imaging scan will be performed with automatic collimation dynamically, X-ray dose on an object or patient is then greatly reduced.

title: Three-dimensional craniofacial image feature point marking analysis system and method
assignee: 上海优医基医疗影像设备有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional craniofacial image feature point marking analysis system and a method, wherein the system comprises a feature point marking module, a quantization index calculation module, an abnormality identification diagnosis module and a database; the feature point marking module is used for obtaining craniofacial CBCT voxel image data, marking feature points of craniofacial anatomical structures according to the craniofacial CBCT voxel image data and generating feature point coordinates; the quantization index calculation module is used for obtaining the characteristic point coordinates and calculating quantization index data according to the characteristic point coordinates; the abnormality identification diagnosis module is used for acquiring feature point coordinates and quantitative index data, and comparing the quantitative index data with sample data in a database to generate an analysis data report; marking craniofacial CBCT voxel image data to obtain feature point coordinates; calculating the coordinates of the characteristic points to obtain quantitative index data; and comparing the characteristic point coordinates and the quantization index data with sample data in a database to generate an analysis data report.
assignee_clean: 上海优医基医疗影像设备有限公司

title: Method, device and system for processing image
assignee: 华为云计算技术有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and provides a method, a device and a system for processing images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of image blocks, wherein the image blocks are obtained by dividing a pathological image to be analyzed; inputting the plurality of image blocks into a first analysis model to obtain a first analysis result, wherein the first analysis model classifies each image block of the plurality of image blocks according to the number or the area of suspicious lesion components; inputting at least one second-type image block in the first analysis result into a second analysis model, and analyzing the position of a suspicious lesion component of each input second-type image block by the second analysis model to obtain a second analysis result; and finally, integrating the first analysis result and the second analysis result to obtain a final analysis result of the pathological image. According to the method, the pathological image is analyzed through the two analysis models, so that the problem of wrong judgment of the pathological image analysis result caused by artificial subjective factors can be solved.

title: Electronic apparatus and assistant service providing method thereof
abstract: An electronic apparatus is provided. The electronic apparatus includes a communicator, a memory, and a processor connected to the communicator and the memory and configured to control the electronic apparatus. The processor is configured to, by executing at least one command stored in the memory, based on a user input for executing an assistant service being received, transmit information on a user voice acquired by the electronic apparatus to a plurality of servers providing different assistant services through the communicator, and based on a plurality of response information being received from the plurality of servers, provide a response on the user voice based on at least one of the plurality of response information. The plurality of servers provide the assistant service using an artificial intelligence agent.

title: Remote control system and method for emergency stopping of equipment
abstract: Disclosed is a remote control system. In a remote control system for emergency braking of an equipment, the present invention comprises: a sensing part that detects a control command; a control part that receives the control command from the sensing part and generates a braking command for controlling emergency braking of the equipment; and a communication device that transmits the braking command to the switch part, wherein the sensing part may comprise a microphone that detects a voice command.

title: Low delay communication between cyber physical systems of iot applications using fog nodes
assignee: D. J, Joel Devadass Daniel MR, K N, Madhusudhan MR, M.B., Jayalekshmi DR, P Hegde, Nagaratna DR, T, Senthil DR, Y, Jeyasheela DR
abstract:
LOW DELAY COMMUNICATION BETWEEN CYBER PHYSICAL 
SYSTEMS OF IOT APPLICATIONS USING FOG NODES 
Abstract 
The cyber-physical system (CPS) in Cloud platforms have developed as a 
progressive and secure approach to promoting the collaboration of Internet of Things 
(IoT) systems. The CPS assimilates, investigates, and expresses analyzed relevant 
data between Internet of Things networks. With vastly increased communication 
challenges, centralized and cost-effective networking facilities and the optimal usage 
of optical facilities are intended to build advanced technologies. Fog computing is 
the fundamental framework for the deployment of a cyber-physical system (CPS) 
applications that entail ultra-low latency. This proposal promotes efficient 
communication among cyber-physical systems of IoT applications using Fog 
computing to reduce the latency. The Fog-RAN (F-RAN) with persistence and edge 
computing facilities assures compatibility and interoperability with minimal cost. F
RAN used along with SDN and NFV, which is deployed to accommodate 
empirically centralized supervision strategy and efficient distribution and allocation 
of resources. Emerging solutions currently encounter a wide variety of obstacles, 
such as low - latency, maximum bandwidth, and reduced energy usage to endorse 
applications.

title: System, method and application for transcoding data into media files
abstract: A data transcoding device includes a memory device for storing clear data containing private information and a processor configured as a data transcoder. The processor is configured to create packets of the clear data, prepare the packets for transcoding the clear data into an indecipherable multimedia data file appearing as noise, by determining properties of the indecipherable multimedia file based on parameters of the clear data. The processor is configured to generate the indecipherable multimedia file by transcoding the clear data based on the determined properties.

title: Microscopic imaging system and method based on deep learning and light field imaging
abstract: The invention discloses a microscopic imaging system and a microscopic imaging method based on deep learning and light field imaging, and belongs to the technical field of light field microscopic imaging. The microscopic imaging system includes: the system comprises a microscopic imaging system, a deep learning network module and an image output module. According to the invention, a two-dimensional image array is obtained through a light field microscope system formed by a micro lens array and a camera sensor, multi-view image information is obtained from the two-dimensional image array after the two-dimensional image array passes through a deep learning network, super-resolution reconstruction is further carried out on the image, and finally a high-resolution three-dimensional reconstructed image with uniform intensity distribution is obtained. Compared with the existing super-resolution reconstruction method based on the convolutional neural network, the image generated by the method has higher spatial resolution, smaller reconstruction artifacts and larger reconstruction throughput, thereby effectively improving the imaging definition; and under the lens array system, the invention also has the advantages of low cost, low system complexity and no need of scanning super-resolution imaging.

title: Neoepitope detection of disease using protein arrays
assignee: Michael Tainsky, Sorin Draghici, Madhumita Chatterjee
abstract: A biosensor for use in detecting the presence of diseases, the biosensor comprising a detector for detecting a presence of at least one marker indicative of a specific disease. A method of determining efficacy of a pharmaceutical for treating a disease or staging disease by administering a pharmaceutical to a sample containing markers for a disease, detecting the amount of at least one marker of the disease in the sample, and analyzing the amount of the marker in the sample, whereby the amount of marker correlates to pharmaceutical efficacy or disease stage. Markers for gynecological disease. An immuno-imaging agent comprising labeled antibodies, whereby the labeled antibodies are isolated and reactive to proteins overexpressed in vivo. Informatics software for analyzing the arrays, the software including analyzing means for analyzing the arrays.
