title: Temporal calibration of an angiographic imaging system
abstract: Angiographic data is obtained by injecting a chemical contrast agent intravascularly, and imaging passage of the contrast as a function of time, thereby generating a sequence of images. To correct error from uncalibrated timestamps embedded in the image metadata, radio-opaque markers are used to generate a watermark embedding timestamp data in obtained images. The radio-opaque markers cause opacification on the x-ray images in the form of dynamic watermarks that encode timestamps. The positions of the markers in the watermark (cast from the radio-opaque markers) are then processed and analyzed to generate an accurate timestamp for the image. By generating an accurate timestamp, synchronized calculations of the images with other data sources are provided.

title: Image classification method, device, computer equipment and medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image classification method, an image classification device, computer equipment and a medium, and belongs to the field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: calling a first classification sub-model in the classification model, and classifying the target image to obtain a first prediction result of the target image; calling a second classification sub-model in the classification model, and classifying the target image to obtain a second prediction result of the target image; calling a third classification sub-model in the classification model, and classifying the target image to obtain a third prediction result of the target image, wherein training sample data of the third classification sub-model comprises a sample image and a result obtained by statistics according to a plurality of labeling results; and outputting a third prediction result and the classification difficulty of the target image, wherein the classification difficulty is determined according to the first prediction result and the second prediction result, and the accuracy of the output result of the model can be indicated through the classification difficulty, so that misleading of the model to a user is avoided.

title: Auxiliary diagnosis system for restoration image of lesion area
assignee: 透彻影像(北京)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an auxiliary diagnosis system and a method for restoration of an original image of a lesion area, wherein the auxiliary diagnosis system comprises: the system comprises a technician material taking end, a doctor end, an analysis system and a server, wherein the technician material taking end and the doctor end are in communication connection with the server, and the server is connected with the analysis system; wherein: the technician material taking end photographs the gross image of the pathological tissue, identifies and codes the knife mark on the gross image, and uploads the section of the pathological tissue to the analysis system through the server; the analysis system automatically and intelligently analyzes the section of the pathological tissue, draws a pathological change area and gives a labeling result of the pathological change area; and the doctor end examines, modifies and confirms the labeling result, uploads the labeling result to the analysis system through the server, and the analysis system automatically generates a restoration image according to the labeling result of the confirmed lesion area. The technician material-taking end, the doctor end, the analysis system and the server form a whole set of automatic processing system, which can automatically complete the general image restoration and improve the working efficiency.

title: Method for enhancing the configuration of a hearing aid device of a user
abstract: The invention relates to a method for enhancing the configuration of a hearing aid device (2) of a user, said method using an external configuration unit (3) accessing a database of previously known user records, wherein the hearing aid device (2) is arranged to be configured according to an individual set of configuration parameters.

title: Methods for using a multiresolution touch interface
abstract: A method for touch detection and fingerprint unlocking includes detecting a finger of a user being in contact with a multiresolution touch interface having a low-resolution mode and a high-resolution mode. The method also includes in response to the detecting the finger of the user being in contact with the multiresolution touch interface, determining a touch interaction associated with the detected finger under the low-resolution mode. The method also includes in response to the multiresolution touch interface being locked, switching a finger contact area of the multiresolution touch interface into the high-resolution mode, wherein the finger contact area is determined based at least in part on the determined touch interaction associated with the detected finger. The method also includes detecting a fingerprint in the finger contact area, and unlocking the multiresolution touch interface based at least in part on the detected fingerprint.

title: DNA methylation detection kit for evaluating tissue immune response and diagnosing prognosis
assignee: 中山大学附属第六医院, 中山大学
abstract: The invention discloses a DNA methylation detection kit for evaluating tissue immune response and diagnosing prognosis. The inventors have found that using at least 1 of CpG sites cg02430840, cg06113913 and cg12673499 may reliably assess tissue immune response and diagnose prognosis, in particular CD8+ TILs levels in CRC and prognosis thereof. Is expected to become a research tool of CD8+ TILs and a potential marker for guiding the immunotherapy of colorectal cancer and other cancers.

title: Intelligent medical record management method based on artificial intelligence and electronic record cloud platform

abstract: The disclosed embodiment provides an intelligent medical record management method based on artificial intelligence and an electronic medical record cloud platform, which can perform artificial intelligence depth analysis on each electronic medical record uploading node associated with electronic medical record information, and can be convenient for determining electronic medical record matching data of each electronic medical record unit and matched with each electronic medical record uploading node associated with the electronic medical record information in an electronic medical record database of a widely associated patient user by combining the electronic medical record data of each corresponding electronic medical record unit, so as to match with medical record associated label features in the medical record associated label database, and associate target medical record associated label features of each matched electronic medical record unit into medical record feature areas of the corresponding electronic medical record units in the electronic medical record information respectively. So, can be convenient for carry out follow-up flow efficiency optimization construction, reduce hospital's operation cost, alleviate medical personnel's working strength.

title: Automated remotely instructed driving of an assay
abstract: The invention relates to conducting assays with an apparatus including a substantially transparent assay cartridge loaded with magnetic beads, and a magnet carrier base positioned below a scanning platform holding the assay cartridge. A microcomputer controls a stepping motor which controls movement of the magnet carrier base, and causes the magnetic beads to travel from one well to another, where the wells contain different assay reagents. An electromagnetic coil-spring assembly induces mixing of well contents with the magnetic beads on actuation. The assay cartridge is authenticated by sending its encoded identifier to a server or website, and assay instructions are provided remotely to the microcomputer. Following assay completion, the cartridge can have color change or other assay indication detected, and the results sent to the server or website or another recipient. Concurrently assaying a control allows modification of assay results based on measured field conditions.

title: Methods and systems of a patient insurance solution as a service for gig employees
assignee: Vineet Gulati, Pritim Prasad, Divyesh Motiwalla
abstract: In one aspect, a method for managing a patient-provider relationship, includes the step of providing a tiered structure for patient specific financial support. The method includes the step of providing a tailored patient financial workflows for pre-care financial commitment, approvals and post-care claims adjudication. The method includes the step of providing a multiple financial support options ranging from one off patient payment commitments, revolving options for multiple commitments or a fixed monthly amount determined by the patient. The method includes the step of providing a unified master servicing agreement that coordinates and manages the patient support experience and integrates the often-disparate servicing aims for payers, providers, credit underwriters.

title: Lung bulla focus detection method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a lung bulla focus detection method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, reading chest CT sequence images of a plurality of lung large bubble patients, and preprocessing to obtain a first CT image after intervention treatment; s2, extracting a plurality of first CT images, marking lung and lung large bubble focus areas, and generating a training set and a verification set; s3, pre-training a first depth convolutional neural network model and a second depth convolutional neural network model, wherein the first depth convolutional neural network model is used for identifying lung areas from input CT images, and the second depth convolutional neural network model is used for identifying lung bulla focus areas from CT images with the identified lung areas; s4, inputting the CT image sequence of the patient to be detected into a trained first depth convolutional neural network model and a trained second depth convolutional neural network model, identifying a lung region and a lung large bubble focus region contained in the CT image of the patient, and calculating to obtain the proportion of the lung large bubble focus of the patient in the lung. The invention also provides a lung bulla focus detection system based on deep learning.

title: Self-supervised learning for anomaly detection and localization
abstract: A method for training a machine learning model includes obtaining a set of training samples. For each training sample in the set of training samples, during each of one or more training iterations, the method includes cropping the training sample to generate a first cropped image, cropping the training sample to generate a second cropped image that is different than the first cropped image, and duplicating a first portion of the second cropped image. The method also includes overlaying the duplicated first portion of the second cropped image on a second portion of the second cropped image to form an augmented second cropped image. The first portion is different than the second portion. The method also includes training the machine learning model with the first cropped image and the augmented second cropped image.

title: Electronic device and method of executing function of electronic device
abstract: According to various embodiments of the disclosure, an electronic device and a method of executing a function of the electronic device comprise at least one communication circuit, a speaker, a microphone, at least one processor operatively connected with the communication circuit, the speaker, and the microphone, and a memory operatively connected with the at least one processor, wherein the memory stores instructions which, when executed by the at least one processor cause the electronic device to: perform a call with a first external electronic device through the communication circuit, activate a voice-based intelligent service while the call is performed, identify a voice input through the microphone while the call is performed, and transmit data associated with the voice input to an external server through the communication circuit at least in part for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and/or natural language understanding (NLU).

title: Semantic segmentation method, model training method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a semantic segmentation method, a model training method and a semantic segmentation device, which are applied to the field of artificial intelligence and used for improving the stability of a segmentation result of a video frame. The semantic segmentation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first video frame and a second video frame in a first video frame sequence, and inputting the first video frame and the second video frame into an image segmentation model respectively, wherein the image segmentation model is used for performing semantic segmentation on the input image, and a middle network layer of the image segmentation model is a network layer with the minimum resolution of an output feature map in a plurality of network layers; acquiring a first feature map of a first video frame output by a first image segmentation network layer; acquiring a second feature map of a second video frame output by a second image segmentation network layer; and inputting the first feature map and the second feature map into the first inter-frame fusion model to generate a semantic segmentation image of the second video frame.

title: Continuous zooming target identification system and method with adjustable view field
abstract: The invention discloses a continuous zooming target identification system with an adjustable view field and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of target identification. The invention discloses a continuous zooming target identification system with an adjustable view field, which comprises a continuous zooming primary subsystem with an adjustable view field, an image acquisition primary subsystem and a target identification primary subsystem. The field-of-view adjustable continuous zoom primary subsystem is used for accurate focus capture of moving targets within a variable field of view. The image acquisition primary subsystem is used for acquiring infrared light and visible light of a focusing target and generating a target image database. The target recognition primary subsystem trains a deep neural network by adopting a target image database to realize accurate recognition of the collected target image. The invention also discloses a continuous zooming target identification method with adjustable view field. Under the condition that the target moves, the method can realize clear acquisition of the moving target and accurately identify the acquired target.

title: Portable device having user interface for visualizing data from medical monitoring and laboratory equipment
abstract: A wireless device for facilitating visualization of a state of a patient being monitored by monitoring equipment. The device includes a wireless network interface, a camera, and a touch-sensitive display. A processor is in communication with the wireless network interface, the camera, a memory and the touch-sensitive display over a system bus. The device wirelessly receives data representative of a state of a first physiological parameter of a patient over a time interval. The visualization data includes a plurality of visualization data values, each of the visualization data values being generated by a data visualization module of the data visualization server from multiple values of machine data produced by the monitoring equipment in connection with monitoring the first physiological parameter. A first portion of a monitoring screen displayed by the device includes a graphical representation of the visualization data over the time interval along with or more range indicators.

title: Damage detection method and device based on weak segmentation
assignee: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for detecting damage based on weak segmentation. In the embodiment, frame marking data for manually marking the sample picture is obtained, the marking frame is used as the outline of the damage object, and the segmentation weak marking data is automatically generated. Based on the frame labeling data and the segmentation weak labeling data, a two-branch weak segmentation damage detection model is trained. When the method is used, the picture to be detected is input into the weak segmentation damage detection model, and a damage prediction frame and a damage object region are obtained through the two branches respectively. The damage prediction frame and the damage object area can be mutually verified and supplemented, so that the accuracy of damage detection is improved.

title: Intelligent medical information pushing method based on artificial intelligence and electronic medical record cloud platform
assignee: 和宇健康科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an intelligent medical information pushing method based on artificial intelligence and an electronic medical record cloud platform, wherein first electronic medical record information of a first electronic medical record user in a target visit semantic interval is obtained, and after a medical record pushing reference unit of the first electronic medical record information is determined, second electronic medical record information which is in an association relation with the medical record pushing reference unit in the target visit semantic interval is determined, so that a pushed knowledge point thermodynamic diagram is generated according to the first electronic medical record information and the second electronic medical record information, and then when the fact that the electronic medical record information of the first electronic medical record user is updated is detected, the pushed knowledge point thermodynamic diagram is updated correspondingly, and therefore knowledge point pushing is carried out. So, can carry out the relevant knowledge point propelling movement of wisdom medical treatment with electronic medical record information matching to each patient of being convenient for carries out effectual knowledge point study and promotes the consciousness of seeing a doctor and the daily consciousness of paying close attention to of self.

title: Multimode melanoma immunotherapy prediction method based on deep learning network
assignee: 杭州安鸿科技股份有限公司, 复旦大学
abstract: The invention discloses a multimode melanoma immunotherapy prediction method based on a deep learning network, which relates to the field of multimode melanoma immunotherapy prediction, and comprises the steps of firstly carrying out data acquisition, preliminary screening and image standardization processing, then carrying out image semantic segmentation through an image segmentation module, wherein the image segmentation module comprises a convolutional neural network and a deep self-attention network, then carrying out computer generation on image information which is missing in a pathological section graph through a diffusion model and natural language coding prompt, and carrying out screening and dimension reduction on the image again, then extracting image characteristics and non-image information, and evaluating the PD-1 prognosis of a patient through a graph neural network; the invention discloses a multi-mode melanoma immunotherapy prediction method based on a deep learning network, and aims to solve the problem of how to obtain a prognosis evaluation model with high accuracy in prognosis evaluation of melanoma PD-1 immunotherapy based on a limited number of training samples.

title: Method and apparatus for dynamic network evaluation and network selection
abstract: A method, apparatus, system, and article of manufacture for evaluating and selecting a network for transmitting messages from an aircraft are disclosed. An example apparatus includes a message analyzer that determines an allowable delay associated with a first message to be transmitted during a flight based on a message type. The apparatus comprises: a mapping data analyzer to generate a prediction of network availability associated with transmission of the first message based on network map data collected during a previous flight; and a target network determiner that determines a target network for transmitting the first message based on the prediction of network availability, wherein the target network has a predicted availability within an allowable delay during the current flight. The apparatus includes a message outputter responsive to an available target network for outputting a first message via the target network before an allowable delay.

title: Automatic implantation system of deep brain electrode based on image and electrophysiological real-time positioning
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
abstract: The application discloses system is implanted automatically to deep electrode of brain based on image and real-time location of electrophysiology includes: the device comprises a brain scanning unit, an image unit, an electrophysiological signal unit, a skull puncture unit and a transmission unit; the brain scanning unit, the electrophysiological signal unit and the transmission unit are all connected with the image unit; the electrophysiological signal unit and the skull puncture unit are both connected with the transmission unit; the brain scanning unit is used for acquiring a magnetic resonance scanning image of the brain of the patient; the image unit is used for generating preset implantation data of the deep brain electrode; the electrophysiological signal unit is used for acquiring an electrophysiological signal of the deep part of the brain of the patient under the transmission action of the transmission unit; the skull puncture unit is used for performing puncture operation on a patient; the transmission unit is also used for driving the deep brain electrode to complete the implantation operation. The application integrates the image processing function, the electrophysiological recording function and the electrode implantation function, and realizes accurate implantation of the electrode.

title: Systems and methods for mediating permissions
abstract: Systems and methods mediate permissions for applications on user devices using predictive models. Data communications are monitored on a user device for permission requests and responses. A predictive model is trained with these permission requests and responses until a threshold is met. Then, a default permission response is provided on behalf of the user device in response to a permission request.

title: Radiofrequency probe, system, and method for adaptive multivariate control of an ablation procedure
abstract: The present invention is directed to a system and method for adaptive multivariate control for performing a radiofrequency (RF) ablation procedure with an energy delivery device. The system includes an energy source for delivering energy to a patient's body; one or more energy delivery devices; two or more sensors for measuring at least two factors related to an ablation procedure, respectively; and at least one processor. The method includes steps of: measuring at least two factors related to an ablation procedure; determining a first operating threshold based, at least in part, on a first factor; controlling an energy delivery device based on the first operating threshold to create a lesion at the target site within the patient; determining a second operating threshold based, at least in part, on a second factor; switching control of the energy delivery device from the first factor to the second factor; and controlling the energy delivery device based on the second operating threshold to create a lesion at the target site within the patient. The present invention is also directed to a RF probe configured to be used with the adaptive multivariate control system and method to perform RF ablation procedures.

title: DCNN-based survival analysis method for cancer full-field digital pathological section
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image intelligent processing, and particularly relates to a DCNN-based survival analysis method for a cancer full-visual-field digital pathological section. The method comprises the steps of respectively taking a plurality of image blocks from a lymph dense area, a necrosis area and a tumor area in a pathological section, and sending the image blocks and the overall segmentation of the section into a convolutional neural network to obtain the survival time distribution of the section through forward propagation. The probability of death of the patient at several time intervals can be obtained from the predicted time-to-live distribution, and the probability of survival of the patient before several time nodes can be obtained by accumulation. The invention takes the local images of the slices and the global tissue distribution as input, outputs the survival time distribution of the patient, and helps doctors to estimate the prognosis condition of the patient, thereby assisting the early clinical diagnosis of the cancer.

title: Medical image segmentation method and device based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The application discloses a medical image segmentation data enhancement method and device based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing edge enhancement processing on the obtained original image to obtain an edge enhanced original image; combining the original image and the edge-enhanced original image to generate multi-channel image data; inputting the acquired multi-channel image data as input data into a convolutional neural network model, taking the labeling data of an original image as a fitting target of the convolutional neural network model, training the convolutional neural network model, and obtaining parameters of the convolutional neural network model so as to realize the segmentation of the image to be detected according to the type of the labeling data. The method is used for solving the problems of larger network model test error and even distortion caused by the reduction of network generalization performance due to insufficient training sample number in the related art.

title: Systems and methods utilizing artificial intelligence for placental assessment and examination
assignee: The Penn State Research Foundation, Northwestern University, Sinai Health System
abstract: Systems and methods for completing a morphological characterization of an image of a placenta and providing suggested pathological diagnoses are disclosed. A system includes programming instructions that, when executed, cause processing devices to execute commands according to the following logic modules: an Encoder module that receives the digital image of the placenta and outputs a pyramid of feature maps, a SegDecoder module that segments the pyramid of feature maps on a fetal side image and on a maternal side image, a Classification Subnet module that classifies the fetal side image and the maternal side image, and a convolutional IPDecoder module that localizes an umbilical cord insertion point of the placenta from the classified fetal side image and the classified maternal side image. The localized umbilical cord insertion point, segmentation maps for the classified fetal side and maternal side images are provided to an external device for determining the morphological characterization.
assignee_clean: the penn state research foundation; northwestern university; sinai health system

title: Quantification and of electrocardiogramag drive function system and method
abstract: In the present invention, a right leg drive RLD monitoring system is employed on a medical computing system/computer, such as an ECG, HEMO and/or EP monitoring, mapping and/or recording system, that includes a number of RLD circuits to be utilized for different procedures or monitoring states to be performed using the system. The RLD monitoring system operates to actively monitor and/or record the feedback voltage to the RLD isolated from the patient. Using the measured feedback voltage data, the RLD monitoring system can identify and determine if the RLD circuit in use is approaching saturation, has reached saturation and the duration the RLD circuit was in saturation. The RLD monitoring system can concurrently and/or subsequently select and/or provide selection information regarding an optimal RLD circuit to be utilized to most effectively perform the desired function of the RLD in the procedure being performed using the monitoring, mapping and/or recording system.

title: Increasing capabilities of wearable devices using big data and video feed analysis
abstract: According to one embodiment, a method, computer system, and computer program product for wearable device activity analysis is provided. A computer receives a video of an activity. The computer identifies the activity based on analyzing the video. The computer identifies body movements from the video. The computer correlates the activity and the body movements to a wearable device. The computer identifies additional inputs for the activity and updates the wearable device based on the identified additional inputs.

title: Intelligent monitoring camera using computer vision and intelligent personal audio assistant capabilities to maintain privacy
abstract: An apparatus includes a video capture device, an audio capture device and a processor. The video capture device may be configured to generate a plurality of video frames. The audio capture device may be configured to capture audio. The processor may be configured to perform video operations to detect objects in the video frames, extract data about the objects based on characteristics of the objects determined using the video operations, detect whether an event has occurred based on the characteristics of the objects, determine a permission status based on the captured audio and generate a video stream based on the video frames. The video stream may be generated only if the permission status allows the video stream. The captured audio may be monitored after the event has been detected to determine whether the permission status allows the video stream.

title: Multi-output gradient lifting tree modeling method for survival risk analysis
abstract: The invention provides a multi-output gradient lifting tree modeling method for survival risk analysis, which comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an expression of survival data for establishing a survival prediction model of a financial, insurance, medical, traffic or industrial target industry under a model algorithm framework of an optimal gradient spanning tree (XGboost); then defining and calculating a loss function corresponding to the survival data; then defining and calculating a first-order gradient and a second-order gradient corresponding to the loss function; and finally, simultaneously inputting the calculated loss function value and the first-order gradient and the second-order gradient of the loss function into an XGBoos model algorithm framework, and automatically training to generate a survival prediction model of the target industry. The modeling method can better represent the relationship between the model covariates and the risk prediction values; the prediction performance and the generalization capability of the model are improved; better prediction performance and risk discrimination are achieved; and the application scene is wide.

title: Color image caries identification method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a color image caries identification method based on deep learning, which divides caries identification into two stages, wherein the first stage is target detection, a dark neural network of dark dactnet of a yolov3 target detection framework is utilized to train a marked real color image, and an obtained model can identify caries focuses. In the second stage, the focus identified in the previous stage is stored as a new image in a cutout mode, the image is used as new deep learning training data, a residual convolution neural network se _ resnet101 with an attention mechanism is used for learning and training the cutout rectangular focus area image, and the type of the caries can be identified by the obtained model. The two stages can independently detect and classify, and the classification accuracy is improved.

title: Key evidence extraction method for text prediction result
abstract: The invention discloses a key evidence extraction method of a text prediction result, and relates to a key evidence extraction method of a text prediction result. The invention aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, when the key evidence capable of explaining the prediction result is extracted from the text, the evidence is searched by means of manual labeling. The process is as follows: firstly, obtaining sentence level vectors; secondly, taking the average value of the sentence-level vectors as an initial value of an external storage unit; thirdly, obtaining an updated external storage unit corresponding to the first sentence-level vector; until a final external storage unit corresponding to the nth sentence level vector is obtained, and a document level vector is obtained; fourthly, outputting the probability of each category of the document; fifthly, obtaining a trained hard extraction network model; and inputting the documents to be classified into the trained hard extraction network model to obtain the probability of the documents to be classified into each category and the sentence set of the documents classified into the category. The method is used for the field of evidence extraction of text prediction results.

title: Data privacy protection deep learning method based on NTRU homomorphic encryption
assignee: 浙江工商大学, 浙江鹏信信息科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a data privacy protection deep learning method based on NTRU homomorphic encryption. The invention adopts an NTRU homomorphic encryption method to encrypt training data, test data, label values and weight vectors in the sensor learning process in deep learning, and trains a prediction model under the condition of encrypting the data, thereby ensuring the privacy and the safety of user data. Compared with the common homomorphic encryption technology, the homomorphic encryption technology has better practicability because of lower times of the used polynomial, and the perceptron learning based on the privacy protection can be popularized to a multilayer neural network to realize the data privacy protection in the deep learning process.
assignee_clean: 浙江工商大学; 浙江鹏信信息科技股份有限公司

title: Artificial intelligence system for estimating excess non-sapient payload capacity on mixed-payload aeronautic excursions
abstract: A system for selection of physical asset transfer paths using mixed-payload aeronautic excursions includes a client-interface module operating on at least a server, the client-interface module, configured to receive an initial location, a terminal location, and a description of at least an element of non-sapient payload, a path-selection module operating on the at least a server configured to identify at least an aeronautic path from the initial location to the terminal location and a plurality of aeronautic excursions traversing the at least an aeronautic path and select an aeronautic excursion of the plurality of aeronautic excursions based on a plurality of excess non-sapient payload storage estimations corresponding the plurality of aeronautic excursions, and a capacity estimation artificial intelligence module operating on the at least a server, the capacity estimation artificial intelligence module designed and configured to generate the plurality of excess non-sapient payload storage estimations.

title: System and method for model-based calculation of blast exposure
assignee: Cfd Research Corporation, The Government Of The United States, As Represented By The Secretary Of The Army
abstract: A method of calculating blast injury metrics in a weapon training/IED blast scene can include: reconstructing topological layout of the scene having at least one real subject and a blast source; obtaining anthropometric and posture data for each real subject; obtaining anatomical soldier model for each real subject; identifying real position of at least one real pressure sensor on each soldier during a blast; positioning a virtual sensor on each anatomical soldier model to correspond with real pressure sensor on the real subject; calculating weapon signature of the blast source, the weapon signature including pressure versus time for a blast from the blast source; generating simulated pressure traces on each anatomical soldier model at east virtual pressure sensor; calculating blast injury metrics for the at least one real subject; and generating a report that includes the blast injury metrics for the at least one real subject.

title: Wearable device having wireless stethoscope
abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable device including a wireless stethoscope. An objective of the present invention is to resolve problems of conventional analog stethoscopes or wired/wireless digital stethoscopes where good stethoscopic sound is difficult to obtain if a person is not pressing. According to the present invention, the wearable device including a wireless stethoscope comprises: a wearable device (300) including a flat support (301) of a donut shape having a circular hole (304) formed on a center thereof, a stethoscope fixing unit (302) vertically protruding in a prescribed length along a circumference on one side and the other side of the circular hole (304) on the support (301) and having a sawtooth gear (303) formed therein, and a medical adhesive pad (305) attached to a lower portion of the support (301); and a wireless stethoscope (100) which is inserted into the stethoscope fixing unit (302) of the wearable device (300) to be installed, has a sawtooth gear (102) formed in a prescribed length around the circumferential surface thereof and pressed and fixed on a human body while being fixed by engagement with the sawtooth gear (303) of the stethoscope fixing unit (302), and receives heart sound, lung sound, or intestine sound produced in the human body through a sensor (161) to amplify the sound and then transmit the sound via Bluetooth communication. According to the present invention, the wireless stethoscope is pushed on the wearable device attached to a human body and pressed on the human body to be fixed. Therefore, the stethoscope is pushed and pressed by a hand of a person without a touch by the hand.

title: Phishing early warning method and device and computer equipment
assignee: 上海淇玥信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a phishing warning method, a phishing warning device and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: establishing and training a plurality of base models of the spoofing tendency scores, each base model being used to predict the spoofing tendency of an associated user of the user device; monitoring associated user equipment of a spoofed user in a latest specific time period, and determining candidate variables; screening candidate variables according to the influence degree of each candidate variable on the cheated result to obtain a target base model and target user equipment characteristics; acquiring characteristics of the new access equipment, and calculating scores of similarity and deception tendency; and carrying out early warning of telecommunication or phishing according to the similarity and the deception tendency score of the new access equipment. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can accurately judge whether the early warning of telecommunication or phishing is carried out on the new access equipment, and can remind the user in advance to avoid the telecommunication or the phishing.

title: Image calibration patient identification
abstract: A digital image is captured. The captured digital image includes a calibration pattern. The calibration pattern includes displayed information about the calibration pattern. The displayed information is read to obtain calibration information about the captured digital image.

title: Controlling and commanding an unmanned robot using natural interfaces
abstract: The example embodiments are directed to a system and method for controlling and commanding an unmanned robot using natural interfaces. In one example, the method includes receiving a plurality of sensory inputs from a user via one or more natural interfaces, wherein each sensory input is associated with an intention of the user for an unmanned robot to perform a task, processing each of the plurality of sensory inputs using a plurality of channels of processing to produce a first recognition result and a second recognition result, combining the first recognition result and the second recognition result to determine a recognized command, and generating a task plan assignable to the unmanned robot based on the recognized command and predefined control primitives.

title: Using synthetic events to identify complex relation lookups
abstract: An approach is provided in which a knowledge manager analyzes a corpus of documents based upon relations corresponding to entities in a structured resource and constructs a natural language context associated with a set of the relations. The knowledge manager maps the natural language context to a database query and, in turn, invokes the database query when the knowledge manager matches a question to the natural language context.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for reconstructing PET (positron emission tomography) image based on transformer feature sharing
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for reconstructing a PET image based on transformer feature sharing. The PET image reconstruction network model is composed of two groups of coding-decoders, wherein one group of the coding-decoders establishes mapping from PET back projection images to PET reconstruction images, the other group of the coding-decoders establishes mapping from PET back projection images to prior information images, and meanwhile, the two groups of the coding-decoders are optimized to realize that noise in target PET images is reduced by using prior knowledge in the prior information images and image detail information is reserved. And a transformer unit is used between the two groups of encoders to replace a convolution-based attention mechanism to realize the parameter sharing of the self-learning encoder in the reconstruction network training process, so that the reconstruction error is further reduced, and the quality of the reconstructed PET image is improved.

title: System for positioning endoscope
assignee: 宁波思康鑫电子科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a system for endoscope positioning, the system includes: an endoscope insertable within a target object to acquire endoscopic image data of a target region; an endoscope position acquisition module for determining position data of the endoscope within the target object; and the image processing module is used for determining the relative position of the endoscope and the target area based on the position data and the medical image data of the target area.

title: Intelligent adjusting method and system of LED photodynamic therapeutic instrument
assignee: 深圳市科医仁科技发展有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent adjusting method and system of an LED photodynamic therapeutic apparatus, which are used for improving the accuracy and efficiency of intelligent adjustment of the LED photodynamic therapeutic apparatus. Comprising the following steps: generating a plurality of therapeutic instrument parameter dimensions, collecting physiological state information and facial information, constructing a mapping table, and generating a target mapping table; performing data expansion on the face information to generate expanded face information, performing data mapping to generate expanded physiological state information, performing standardization processing to generate a training data set; model training and parameter adjustment are carried out on the initial therapeutic instrument intelligent adjustment model, and a target therapeutic instrument intelligent adjustment model is obtained; collecting current facial information to predict the wavelength of the therapeutic instrument and generating a target wavelength; and performing power matching on the LED photodynamic therapeutic instrument to generate target power, and adjusting the LED photodynamic therapeutic instrument based on the target wavelength and the target power.

title: Event-detection confirmation by voice user interface
abstract: Systems and methods for event-detection confirmation are disclosed. For example, a sensing device may generate sensor data, such as from radar, and the sensor data may be utilized to determine if a predefined event as occurred. Event-confirmation operations may then be performed, such as by utilizing acoustic-event detection techniques and/or natural language understanding techniques. When occurrence of an event is confirmed, such as to a certain confidence level, one or more actions may be taken, such as sending a notification to another device and/or establishing a communication channel with another device, such as a device associated with emergency services, family members, friends, and/or neighbors.

title: Pancreas tissue segmentation method and device and terminal equipment
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a pancreatic tissue segmentation method, device and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an initial segmentation area of pancreatic tissue in a CT image to be segmented; representing the outline curve of the pancreatic tissue as a level set of two-dimensional curved surface data, and constructing an energy function according to the gray information of the initial segmentation area; minimizing the energy function by a gradient descent method, and determining a level set curve corresponding to the energy function as a target contour curve of the pancreatic tissue when the energy function takes a minimum value. By the aid of the method, pancreatic tissues are automatically segmented in CT images, and an energy function of a level set model is constructed according to gray information of an initial segmentation area, so that evolution of a level set curve in the pancreatic tissues is achieved, and finally a target contour curve of the pancreatic tissues is obtained accurately.
