primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Meta-learning system
abstract: A meta-learning system includes an inner function computation module, adapted to compute output data from applied input data according to an inner model function, depending on model parameters; an error computation module, adapted to compute errors indicating mismatches between the computed output data and target values; a state update module, adapted to update the model parameters of the inner model function according to an updated state, updated based on a current state of the state update module, in response to an error received from the error computation module. The state update module is learned to adjust the model parameters of the inner model function, such that a following training of the inner model function with training data is improved.

title: Method and apparatus for gait analysis
abstract: A computerized method performed by a processor, and computer program product the method comprising: receiving sensory data of motion by a human subject, the sensory data obtained during motion in an uncontrolled environment; extracting features from the sensory data; identifying a plurality of strides from the features extracted from the sensory data; calculating kinematic parameters of each stride from the plurality of strides from the sensory data; classifying each stride from the plurality of strides in accordance with the kinematic parameters to obtain a stride type; and outputting the stride type for the plurality of strides.

title: Training method of classification model and method for classifying target object
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司, 北京康夫子健康技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a training method of a classification model, and a method, an apparatus, a device and a storage medium for classifying a target object, which are applied to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the field of deep learning and the field of intelligent medical care. The specific implementation scheme of the training method of the classification model is as follows: obtaining a prediction probability that the target object belongs to a predetermined category and prediction position information of a first object included in the target object by adopting a classification model based on a training sample aiming at the target object; and training a classification model based on the prediction probability, the predicted position information and the predetermined loss function. Wherein the predetermined loss function includes a correlation loss function characterizing a correlation between the prediction probability and the predicted location information.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司; 北京康夫子健康技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Assessment of documents related to drug discovery
abstract: Disclosed is a system and method for determining an assessment value of a document related to a current research work of researcher(s) in drug discovery. Information pertaining to the document is processed to identify entities and semantic inter-relationships specific to the current research work. Information indicative of entities and semantic inter-relationships specific to a previous research work of the researcher(s) is accessed, and is compared with the entities and the semantic inter-relationships specific to the current research work to determine an association factor indicative of an extent of an association between the current research work and the previous research work of the researcher(s). Information indicative of entities and semantic inter-relationships related to the technical field of the current research work is accessed, and is compared with the entities and the semantic inter-relationships specific to the current research work to determine a status factor indicative of a novelty of the document with respect to the knowledge available publicly. The assessment value of the document is then determined based at least upon the association factor and the status factor. The assessment value may, for example, be determined in a crypto-currency for enabling future transactions of the document using a blockchain.

title: Techniques for transforming questions of a question set to facilitate answer aggregation and display
abstract: A technique for transforming questions for a question answering (QA) system includes clustering received questions by contextual accordance into a question set. A base lexical answer type (LAT) for the question set is determined. LATs of discordant questions in the question set are transformed to the base LAT. Answers for the questions in the question set are aggregated. The aggregated answers are then displayed.

title: PiRNA-disease association relation prediction method based on convolution denoising self-encoder
abstract: The invention discloses a piRNA-disease association relation prediction method based on a convolution denoising self-encoder, which comprises the following steps: selecting and establishing a data set; generating Piwi protein interaction RNA sequence similarity characteristics; generating semantic similarity characteristics of diseases; generation of Piwi protein-interacting RNA and disease gaussian-interacting spectrum nuclear similar features; deep hidden feature mining; constructing a training set and a testing set; and (6) constructing a classifier model. The invention obtains excellent performance under the five-fold cross validation experiment, and proves the effectiveness of the convolution denoising self-coding neural network in Piwi protein interaction RNA and disease association prediction. The practical application capability of the invention in finding the association relationship between potential Piwi protein interaction RNA and diseases is more demonstrated by case study.

title: Local interpretable method based on gradient lifting tree
abstract: The invention discloses a local interpretable method based on gradient lifting trees, which comprises the steps of distilling a complex model by using knowledge to obtain a gradient lifting tree model, improving the traditional method for calculating the importance of average degree of uncertainty reduction (MDI) to be the weighted average of the contribution of each gradient lifting tree to node information gain, and sequencing the weighted average to obtain the importance sequencing of input features so as to obtain local interpretable, thereby realizing interpretation of the complex model. The invention is a general interpretable method, which can extract and interpret data sets in various fields, such as natural language processing data sets, image data sets and table data sets. Meanwhile, the method can be popularized and applied to global interpretation of the acquired model by using a sub-module selection method through local interpretation.

title: Method of monitoring patients with mental and/or behavioral disorders using their personal mobile devices
assignee: Ben Beiski, Eytan Ofry, Andy Wolff
abstract: A monitoring system embodying a monitoring system embodying a method of this invention for monitoring predetermined patients with mental and/or behavioral disorders by accessing, analyzing and monitoring their measured input through a plurality of sensors inherent in most personal mobile devices is provided. The measured input may represents values attributed to at least one physical behavior of the patient that is representative of a symptom of at least one mental/behavior health condition. The measured input can be used to establish a baseline and thresholds thereof that separates the at least one physical behavior into normative from ab-normative behavior for each predetermined patient.
assignee_clean: ben beiski; eytan ofry; andy wolff

title: Eyewear systems, apparatuses, and methods for providing assistance to a user
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, and methods are taught that provide assistance to a user through an eyewear device. Data is received from a first sensor. The first sensor is incorporated into an eyewear device. The first sensor measures a parameter related to the user. A state of the user is analyzed using the data. Assistance is provided to the user. The assistance is in a form of feedback, and the feedback is related to the state of the user. The assistance can also be related to a context of the user and a state of the user. The context of the user is determined from the data.

title: Sample manipulation and assay with rapid temperature change
abstract: Among other things, the present invention is related to devices and methods of performing biological and chemical assays, particularly an easy sample manipulation and/or a rapid change or a rapid thermal cycling of a sample temperature is needed (e.g. Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) for amplifying nucleic acids).

title: Online consultation method and system based on gynecological nursing knowledge base
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of gynecological nursing online consultation, in particular to an online consultation method and system based on a gynecological nursing knowledge base. The method comprises the following steps: performing part-of-speech decomposition on the online consultation input data set of the user to obtain online consultation part-of-speech data; carrying out nursing consultation content association identification and content association relation extraction on the online consultation input data set of the user and carrying out content structure layering processing to obtain content structure layering data; performing inter-layer heat content analysis and heat content treatment bubbling sequencing on the consultation content relation data to obtain heat content treatment sequencing data; performing self-adaptive cache loading design on the heat content sorting data to obtain heat content cache loading data; and carrying out nursing request response on the heat content cache loading data to obtain nursing request response data. According to the invention, the on-line consultation feedback is faster through the cache loading of the consultation data.

title: Small sample image classification method based on improved CNN
abstract: The invention provides a small sample image classification method based on improved CNN, and relates to the technical field of image classification. According to the invention, a model aiming at a small sample image classification task is constructed by analyzing the shallow convolutional neural network. In the data preprocessing process, under the condition of reserving the original information of the image to a large extent, the change of the image is increased, the over fitting of a network is effectively reduced, the effect of a classification model is remarkably improved, and the method is quite suitable for classifying small sample data. Compared with the original classification model, the classification effect of the invention is obviously improved.

title: Multi-branch image segmentation method, device, medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-branch image segmentation method, a segmentation device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, which are characterized in that an image to be segmented is downsampled to reduce the size of the image and input into a first model to obtain a global feature image and a first output image with coarse granularity of the image to be segmented, the image to be segmented is divided into a plurality of area images, the area images and the global feature image are input into a second model, the second model is combined with the global feature and the area images to perform fine-granularity segmentation to obtain a second output image, the first output image and the second output image are fused to obtain a final segmentation result, the coarse-granularity segmentation result is obtained by using the first model, the fine-granularity segmentation result is obtained by using the second model, different branch requirements can be met, and the global feature of the coarse-granularity segmentation result and the local feature of the fine-granularity segmentation result are combined, more accurate segmentation results can be obtained.
assignee_clean: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Method and system for predicting performance based on data reliability evaluation result of small sample
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting performance based on a data reliability evaluation result of a small sample; the method comprises the following steps: obtaining original data, scoring the reliability of each data point according to a plurality of experts in the category selection field to which the original data belongs, and combining the original data to form a database of expert knowledge in the fusion field; performing reliability estimation on data in the data set based on the data reliability estimation model to form a data set with reliability scores; taking the data set with the reliability score as a training data set of the performance prediction model, and establishing a mapping relation between the original data and the performance to obtain the performance prediction model; according to the performance prediction model, the performance of the material is predicted, knowledge in the fragmentation field is fused, data reliability assessment under the condition of small samples is assisted, and under the condition that experimental data and expert knowledge are unreliable, the problem of data discrimination under the conditions of no data label and low reliability is solved.

title: Systems and methods for rapidly determining one or more metabolite measurements from MR spectroscopy data
abstract: Systems and methods provide a parallelized deep learning approach to spectral fitting for magnetic resonance spectroscopy data enabling accurate and rapid spectral fitting and determination of metabolite measurements using a conventional computer. The method may include processing multi-spectra magnetic resonance (MR) spectroscopy data of a region of interest through a series of neural networks. The method may include determining baseline components of each spectrum using a first neural network of the series, generating baseline-corrected components for each spectrum using the baseline components; and determining one or more peak components of each spectrum using a second neural network of the series and the baseline-corrected components. The method may further include determining one or more metabolite measurements of the one or more metabolites in the region of interest using the one or more peak components.

title: Diabetic retinopathy detection using machine learning
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for computer aided diagnosis of a medical image. One of the methods includes processing the medical image through a machine learning (ML) model to provide a first feature representation of the medical image, wherein the ML model includes an input layer and a pooling layer, wherein the first feature representation is an output from the pooling layer, generating, by the ML model, a sequence of second feature representations of the medical image from the first feature representation of the medical image, wherein each second feature representation in the sequence of the second feature representations having a lower dimension than the first feature representation, and generating, by the ML model, an output as a last second feature representation in the sequence of the second feature representations.

title: Scene and state augmented signal shaping and separation
abstract: Scene and/or state information may be used to facilitate processing an input to separate one or more signals within the input, to shape the signal within the input, and/or for other processing of the input or signal(s) within the input. A scene determination may be made based upon location data, time data, data describing the received input, or other basis. A state determination may be made based upon the scene determination, properties of a signal itself, or other information such as location, time, etc. By determining an appropriate scene and/or state, processing of an input and/or a signal within an input may proceed in a fashion determined to provide the most valuable information for output. Systems and methods in accordance with the invention may be implemented in a wide variety of baseband processing systems, such as hearing aids and energy consumption monitoring systems.

title: Methods and systems for event based notifications
abstract: Methods and systems are disclosed for analyzing equipment data, determining an occurrence of an event, and transmitting a message based on the event.

title: Methods and systems for determining a plurality of nutritional needs to generate a nutrient supplementation plan using artificial intelligence
abstract: A system for determining a plurality of nutritional needs of a user and generating a nutrient supplementation plan using artificial intelligence includes at least a computing device designed and configured to receive, from a user, at least a biological extraction, generate, using the at least a biological extraction and a first machine-learning process, a plurality of nutritional needs of the user, determine a nutritional input to the user, detect at least a nutrition deficiency as a function of the plurality of nutritional needs and the nutritional input, and calculate at least a supplement dose from the plurality of nutritional needs and at the least a nutrition deficiency.

title: Method and apparatus for on-line and off-line retail of various types of clothing, shoes and accessories
assignee: 弗拉基米尔·罗森布利特
abstract: Methods and apparatus for online and offline retail of various types of clothing, shoes, and accessories are disclosed. A method for three-dimensional (3D) based shopping may include receiving or generating a 3D representation of at least a portion of a consumer's body; receiving a query to find a first wearable item that fits the portion of the body; searching for a first wearable item; displaying a 3D model of the first wearable item when worn on a portion of the body on a display accessible to a consumer; and interact with a consumer until the 3D-based shopping is completed.
assignee_clean: 弗拉基米尔 罗森布利特
primary_assignee: 弗拉基米尔 罗森布利特

title: Leveraging genomic, phenotypic and pharmacological data to cure disease
abstract: The present invention provides a process and method for repurposing existing compounds by leveraging genomic, phenotypic and pharmacological data to cure disease. Applying advanced mathematical analytics using massively interconnected computing capabilities to identify target rich sets of existing compounds available for animal testing at the earliest stage in the process collapses cycle time of development, dramatically reducing costs. Target rich sets obtained through this invention produce compounds or compositions which each have a demonstrated ability to modulate disease or an associated phenotypic expression. By rendering the mechanism of action irrelevant, this invention collapses the time and cost to discovery of an efficacious drug from decades to days and from $Billions to $Millions.

title: Facial pain expression data acquisition method
assignee: 嘉兴深拓科技有限公司
abstract: A facial pain expression data acquisition method is characterized by comprising the following steps: it comprises the following steps: (1) at each sampling moment, at least three facial pain expression pictures of the patient at different angles are simultaneously acquired through at least three image acquisition devices arranged on the front side, the left side and the right side of the patient and uploaded to a processing module; (2) finding respective face areas from the facial pain expression pictures of the patients from different angles; (3) marking feature points from the face regions of different angles to generate respective face feature vectors; (4) judging which one is a facial pain expression picture on the front side by an artificial neural network; (5) the processing module selects the picture of the face pain expression judged as the front face pain expression data. The facial pain expression data acquisition method is automatic, efficient, high in quality and high in intelligent level.
assignee_clean: 嘉兴深拓科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 嘉兴深拓科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for implementing density variation (DENSVAR) clustering algorithms
abstract: The present disclosure provides a clustering device configured to detect varying density. The clustering device may receive a set of parameters (e.g., a density parameter specifying a plurality of density values, a size parameter, and a node parameter that includes information associated with a plurality of nodes) for identifying clusters. The clustering device may determine a distance between different pairs of nodes of the plurality of nodes and identify candidate nodes of the plurality of nodes based on the distance determined for the different pairs of nodes and the size parameter. Candidate nodes may be assigned to a candidate cluster that may be evaluated against the density parameter to determine whether a density of the candidate cluster satisfies at least one of the plurality of density values. A cluster may be identified based on whether the candidate cluster satisfies at least one of the plurality of density values.

title: 3D MR and TRUS image segmentation method for prostate system puncture
assignee: 大连理工大学人工智能大连研究院, 大连医工机器人科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a 3D MR and TRUS image segmentation method for prostate system puncture, which comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring a 3D MR image dataset and a TRUS image dataset of the prostate; preprocessing the data sets respectively, and obtaining a training data set after data enhancement; constructing a segmentation generator network model, wherein the segmentation generator network comprises an encoder, a decoder, a jump connection and Bottleneck modules; constructing a discriminator network model, wherein the discriminator network is used for distinguishing an output result of the segmentation generator network and Ground truth, and using the discrimination result for training of the segmentation generator network; the training data set is randomly divided into a training set and a verification set, and the training data set is adopted to train the segmentation generator network; and establishing an evaluation index of the segmentation effect, and evaluating the model effect through an ablation experiment and a comparison experiment. The invention provides a 3D MR and TRUS image segmentation method for prostate system puncture based on a deep learning method, which realizes real-time accurate segmentation of 3D MR and TRUS images.
assignee_clean: 大连理工大学人工智能大连研究院; 大连医工机器人科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 大连理工大学人工智能大连研究院

title: Augmented reality system and method for spectroscopic analysis
abstract: Wearable spectroscopy systems and methods for identifying one or more characteristics of a target object are described. Spectroscopy systems may include a light source configured to emit light in an irradiated field of view and an electromagnetic radiation detector configured to receive reflected light from a target object irradiated by the light source. One or more processors of the systems may identify a characteristic of the target object based on a determined level of light absorption by the target object. Some systems and methods may include one or more corrections for scattered and/or ambient light such as applying an ambient light correction, passing the reflected light through an anti-scatter grid, or using a time-dependent variation in the emitted light.

title: Method, recording medium, and system for authenticating user
assignee: 柯尼卡美能达美国研究所有限公司
abstract: A method, system, and recording medium having computer readable program code stored thereon for authenticating a user having a mobile device with a plurality of sensors are disclosed. Including identifying the mobile device or user; determining whether the situation of the mobile device or the user is a predetermined situation; when the situation is a predetermined situation: determining the first action as an authentication action; determining a single sensor or a first combination of sensors of the plurality of sensors; and performing a first authentication for the user by using the single sensor or the first combination of sensors; and when the condition is not a predetermined condition: determining the second action as an authentication action; determining a second combination of sensors of the plurality of sensors; and performing a second authentication for the user by using the second combination of sensors.
assignee_clean: 柯尼卡美能达美国研究所有限公司
primary_assignee: 柯尼卡美能达美国研究所有限公司

title: Apparatus and methods for computing cardiac output of a living subject via applanation tonometry
abstract: Apparatus and methods for calculating cardiac output (CO) of a living subject using applanation tonometry measurements. In one embodiment, the apparatus and methods build a nonlinear mathematical model to correlate physiologic source data vectors to target CO values. The source data vectors include one or more measurable or derivable parameters such as: systolic and diastolic pressure, pulse pressure, beat-to-beat interval, mean arterial pressure, maximal slope of the pressure rise during systole, the area under systolic part of the pulse pressure wave, gender (male or female), age, height and weight. The target CO values are acquired using various methods, across a plurality of individuals. Multidimensional nonlinear optimization is then used to find a mathematical model which transforms the source data to the target CO data. The model is then applied to an individual by acquiring physiologic data for the individual and applying the model to the collected data.

title: Tinnitus and deafness detection test matching and treatment system based on shared cloud computing platform
assignee: 江苏贝泰福医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a tinnitus and deafness detection testing and treatment system based on a shared cloud computing platform, which comprises: the system comprises an online cloud computing platform and a plurality of offline intelligent terminals, wherein the cloud computing platform comprises a cloud server and a hearing aid fitting programmer module connected with the cloud server, and an expert or intelligent robot remote technology support, operation and supervision module, a big data module, a hearing test module, a fitting programming software module, a tinnitus physiological acoustic detection and personalized acoustic treatment scheme manufacturing module and a tinnitus acoustic treatment and cognitive behavior psychotherapy scheme library module are arranged in the cloud server. According to the tinnitus and deafness detection, matching and treatment system based on the shared cloud computing platform, an expert or an intelligent robot can remotely serve multiple different-ground-line patients at the same time, so that the multiple different-place patients can conveniently network with the cloud computing platform through multiple intelligent terminals and conduct bidirectional diagnosis and treatment respectively under the assistance of technicians, and cloud detection, matching and programming and treatment of tinnitus and deafness are achieved.
assignee_clean: 江苏贝泰福医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 江苏贝泰福医疗科技有限公司

title: System and method for providing nutrition information using artificial intelligence
abstract: Disclosed are a system and a method for providing nutritional information based on image analysis using artificial intelligence. The system includes: at least one imaging device acquiring at least one image including at least one dish or at least one food contained in each dish; a service providing apparatus for detecting at least one food included in the at least one image when the at least one image is received, confirming the name of each detected food on the basis of a learning model, mapping food information included in pre-stored food information on the basis of the confirmed name, and generating nutritional information using the mapped food information; and a user terminal for visualizing and displaying the nutritional information when the nutritional information is received.

title: Industry data analysis mining method and system based on data brain
assignee: 南京云创大数据科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an industry data analysis mining method and system based on a data brain, and relates to the field of data processing; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be processed, wherein the data to be processed is data related to a certain known industry; acquiring a processing target of data to be processed, and screening a corresponding data relevance analysis model; carrying out relevance analysis on the data to be processed according to the data relevance analysis model to obtain a relevance analysis result; and generating a visual result graph of the data relevance analysis according to the relevance analysis result. According to the invention, the analysis model is selected according to the processing target of the data to be processed, humanized service can be provided for the user, and meanwhile, the visual analysis result is obtained by mining and analyzing the irregular and unknown industrial data, so that the application value of the data is greatly improved.
assignee_clean: 南京云创大数据科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 南京云创大数据科技股份有限公司

title: Enhancing three-dimensional models using multi-view refinement
abstract: Systems and techniques are provided for modeling three-dimensional (3D) meshes using multi-view image data. An example method can include determining, based on a first image of a target, first 3D mesh parameters for the target corresponding to a first coordinate frame; determining, based on a second image of the target, second 3D mesh parameters for the target corresponding to a second coordinate frame; determining third 3D mesh parameters for the target in a third coordinate frame, the third 3D mesh parameters being based on the first and second 3D mesh parameters and relative rotation and translation parameters of image sensors that captured the first and second images; determining a loss associated with the third 3D mesh parameters, the loss being based on the first and second 3D mesh parameters and the relative rotation and translation parameters; determining 3D mesh parameters based on the loss and third 3D mesh parameters.

title: Split screen layout controlling method and device
abstract: According to an example embodiment, a method and device for controlling a screen displayed on a display is provided. The method includes: based on a layout of a split screen displayed on the display, verifying a trigger region in the split screen; based on a first input controlling a handle region of a pop-up window displayed on an upper layer of the split screen, detecting that at least a portion of the trigger region is overlaid with the pop-up window; changing the layout of the split screen based on at least one of a position of the portion of the trigger region overlaid with the pop-up window, a relative position of the handle region and a divider of the layout; and displaying a region in the split screen in which the pop-up window is to be arranged.

title: Deep learning-based pulmonary fibrosis detection and severity assessment method and system
abstract: The invention provides a pulmonary fibrosis detection and severity assessment method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing chest CT sequence images of a plurality of pulmonary fibrosis patients to obtain a plurality of first CT images; s2, extracting and labeling a plurality of first CT images to generate a training set and a verification set; s3, pre-training a first and second deep convolutional neural network model through a training set and a verification set; s4, inputting a CT image sequence of a patient to be detected into a trained first depth convolutional neural network model and a trained second depth convolutional neural network model, and identifying a lung region and a lung fibrosis focus region contained in each CT image in the CT image sequence of the patient; calculating to obtain the proportion of the pulmonary fibrosis focus of the patient in the lung; s5, marking pulmonary fibrosis stage based on the duty ratio; and S6, grading the pulmonary fibrosis severity of the patient based on the detection result of the physiological parameter. The invention further comprises a pulmonary fibrosis detection and severity assessment system based on deep learning.

title: CT image vertebral arch root nail implantation channel planning method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 上海嘉奥信息科技发展有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a deep learning-based CT image vertebral arch root nail implantation channel planning method and system, which are used for collecting CT image data of vertebration, marking key point positions of the vertebral arch root nail implantation channel in the CT image data, and splitting the CT image data into a training data set, a verification data set and a test data set; revising the three-dimensional interlayer spacing in the CT image data, normalizing the revised data, and establishing principal component analysis for the key point position; constructing a key point position identification network model, connecting a regression task and a classification task after identifying the network model, and respectively calculating the distance and the direction from an initialization point to a target point through multi-task learning; and building an identification network model by adopting Tensorflow, performing training and parameter adjustment by using a training data set and a testing data set, performing testing by using a verification data set, and deploying the identification network model passing the testing on a micro-service cloud end taking a Docker as a container. The key points of the pedicle screw implantation channel are automatically positioned on the CT image by constructing the deep neural network, so that the automatic planning of the pedicle screw implantation channel is realized.
assignee_clean: 上海嘉奥信息科技发展有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海嘉奥信息科技发展有限公司

title: Decision tree-based inference on homomorphically-encrypted data without bootstrapping
abstract: A method, apparatus and computer program product for homomorphic inference on a decision tree (DT) model. In lieu of HE-based inferencing on the decision tree, the inferencing instead is performed on a neural network (NN), which acts as a surrogate. To this end, the neural network is trained to learn DT decision boundaries, preferably without using the original DT model data training points. During training, a random data set is applied to the DT, and expected outputs are recorded. This random data set and the expected outputs are then used to train the neural network such that the outputs of the neural network match the outputs expected from applying the original data set to the DT. Preferably, the neural network has low depth, just a few layers. HE-based inferencing on the decision tree is done using HE inferencing on the shallow neural network. The latter is computationally-efficient and is carried without the need for bootstrapping.

title: Method and system for identifying potential fraud activity in a tax return preparation system to trigger an identity verification challenge through the tax return preparation system
assignee: Intuit Inc., Kyle MCEACHERN, Brent RAMBO
abstract: Special data sources and algorithms are used to analyze tax return data in order to identify potential fraudulent activity before the tax return data is submitted in a tax return preparation system. Then, once the potential fraudulent activity is identified, an identity verification challenge is generated through the tax return preparation system requiring a response from the user of the account associated with the potential fraudulent activity before the tax return data is submitted. Consequently, analysis of tax related data is performed to identify potential fraudulent activity in a tax return preparation system before the tax return related data is submitted. Then, if potential fraud is detected, a user of the tax return preparation system is required to further prove their identity before the tax return data is submitted.

title: Intestinal polyp segmentation method, system and medium integrating mixed attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an intestinal polyp segmentation method, system and medium fusing a mixed attention mechanism, which comprises the following contents: preprocessing an intestinal polyp image based on an endoscope, wherein the preprocessing comprises data enhancement and extraction of a region of a segmentation target by a self-adaptive threshold value, and is used for enhancing the robustness of a segmentation model and mining more accurate boundary information of the target; the feature token pyramid module is constructed to improve the semantic information extraction capability of the intestinal polyp image, and fewer modules are adopted to construct the feature token pyramid so as to acquire semantic information with multi-scale perception; the global feature extraction module is constructed, the local-global training strategy is utilized to reduce the requirement of the segmentation model on the data sample size and further improve the segmentation performance; the construction feature fusion module relieves semantic differences among tokens fusing features of different scales; and a multi-scale fusion module is constructed to fuse all scale feature tokens from the element angle, so that the loss of space information is reduced and the robustness of the network is enhanced.

title: Optimized detection of network defect exposure in network environment
abstract: Present technology is directed to preferred processing and the verification of diagnostic signatures for a plurality of network defect. The disclosed optimization process is based on expressing each Diagnostic Signature as a minimal sum of product Boolean function of associated network commands, followed by ranking of each command reference in the product terms of the Boolean expression as well as each Boolean product terms of the SOP Boolean expressions, and constructing a decision tree based on the provided rankings to thereby determine a minimum set of commands along with an preferred command dispatch sequence for evaluating a Diagnostic Signature. Further aspects include the translation of both the optimization computation (interpretation of network conditions associated with a network defect) and the computed workflow (dispatch of the command) into a series of declarative rules that can be processed by a machine reasoning engine to thereby automate the optimization process.

title: CNN medical CT image denoising method based on noise priori
abstract: CNN medical CT image denoising based on noise priori comprises the following specific steps: step 1) creating a medical CT image model; step 2) constructing a noise priori information extraction network; step 3) constructing a denoising network; step 4) training the noise prior information to extract the network and updating the parameters; step 5) training a denoising network and updating parameters; step 6) denoising the medical CT image; the invention has the following advantages and innovations: denoising by using noise prior information of a medical CT image is proposed; denoising by using two networks; the method comprises the following steps: extracting a network and denoising the network by using the prior noise information; the noise priori information extraction network extracts noise information of the CT medical image so as to acquire more image information; the noise prior information extraction network predicts a noise level diagram and the noise diagram are spliced in series and input into a denoising network; the BN layer is added in the network, so that the generalization capability of the network is improved, the network convergence speed is increased, and the network denoising performance is improved.

title: Generalized retinal image screening system (GRIS)
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention provide a system and method to automatically screen images from a plurality of fundus cameras for a plurality of retinal diseases. The system comprises stacked autoencoders, amplitude modulation-frequency modulation filters, and artificial neural networks. An embodiment of the present invention uses a multi-class classifier, such as a support vector machine (multi-class SVM) classifier, to determine a plurality of retinal pathologies. An exemplary embodiment of the present invention is validated on a proprietary database of thousands of images (for example over 250,000 retinal images) from multiple cameras, ranging from the table-top fundus cameras to portable hand-held cameras.

title: Methods and systems for predicting a price of any subtractively manufactured part utilizing artificial intelligence at a computing device
abstract: A method for predicting a price of any subtractively manufactured part utilizing artificial intelligence at a computing device. The method comprises receiving a manufacturing request datum, wherein the manufacturing request datum further comprises at least an element of user mechanical part data, selecting a correlated dataset containing a plurality of data entries. The method further comprises generating, at a clustering unsupervised machine-learning model, at least a first correlated compatible part element, receiving, at a supervised machine-learning model, a first training set, generating, at a supervised machine-learning model as a function of the first training set, an external price output, and determining a price ratio output, wherein determining the price ratio output further comprises generating a loss function of a part specific variable and minimizing the loss function.

title: Empathic artificial intelligence systems
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide systems and methods for training a machine-learning model for predicting emotions from received media data. Methods according to the present disclosure include displaying a user interface. The user interface includes a predefined media content, a plurality of predefined emotion tags, and a user interface control for controlling a recording of the user imitating the predefined media content. Methods can further include receiving, from a user, a selection of one or more emotion tags from the plurality of predefined emotion tags, receiving the recording of the user imitating the predefined media content, storing the recording in association with the selected one or more emotion tags, and training, based on the recording, the machine-learning model configured to receive input media data and predict an emotion based on the input media data.

title: Quantitative diet tracking and analysis systems and devices
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system that quantitatively tracks an individual's diet and exercise using smart devices (phones, watches, and other wearables). Unlike existing programs, which work in energy units (calories), the present system works in mass units (grams) and satisfies the fundamental physics law of conservation of mass. Food ingested is tracked as well as exercise in order to place the user on a quantitative, custom diet that safely and effectively results in weight loss. In addition to rigorously treating the problem of weight loss by addressing the physics that underlies diet and exercise, the system empirically learns about the user over time such that performance may be optimized.

title: Message processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 武汉联影医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a message processing method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium, when target service data is required to be sent to a third party platform, the target service data is acquired, a preset template engine is called to generate a target message body from the target service data, and then the target message body is sent to the third party platform. In the method, when the target service data is sent to the third party platform, the target service data is sent through the preset template engine, so that when the third party platform is in butt joint, only the message body template is required to be modified, the target service data is filled into the message body template, and the message can be sent to the third party platform without the need of reproducing the message body, thereby improving the message interaction efficiency between the service platforms.
assignee_clean: 武汉联影医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 武汉联影医疗科技有限公司

title: Data processing device, method and related product for executing neural network model
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a data processing apparatus, method, and related products for executing neural network models. The data processing means may be comprised as computing means in a combined processing means, which combined processing means may also comprise interface means and other processing means. The computing device interacts with other processing devices to collectively perform a user-specified computing operation. The combined processing means may further comprise storage means connected to the computing means and the other processing means, respectively, for storing data of the computing means and the other processing means. The scheme optimizes the convolution operation of the multidimensional array and improves the operation processing efficiency.
assignee_clean: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司

title: Single stripe projection measurement method based on graphics and deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a projection measurement method of single stripe based on graphics and deep learning, which converts the stripe depth calculation process into the matching problem of a distorted stripe image and an original stripe image, realizes classification matching by utilizing the characteristic extraction capability of a deep learning network, thereby realizing the prediction of the single stripe depth image, and proposes to use a computer graphics method to simulate and generate the stripe image so as to obtain a large number of samples with low cost, high quality and high degree of freedom in order to solve the problems of high cost of actually acquired data sets and different standards of the acquired stripe images under different problems, and uses a semantic segmentation network Unet to map the original stripe image to a high-dimensional characteristic space by extracting the characteristics of the distorted stripe image for a plurality of times so as to realize the matching. Has the advantages that: a stripe image acquisition method based on computer graphics simulation is provided, a depth learning method is used for realizing high-precision and high-speed depth prediction, and a solution scheme that a complete single stripe image is directly connected to a depth image is realized.

title: Center-biased machine learning techniques to determine saliency in digital images
abstract: A location-sensitive saliency prediction neural network generates location-sensitive saliency data for an image. The location-sensitive saliency prediction neural network includes, at least, a filter module, an inception module, and a location-bias module. The filter module extracts visual features at multiple contextual levels, and generates a feature map of the image. The inception module generates a multi-scale semantic structure, based on multiple scales of semantic content depicted in the image. In some cases, the inception block performs parallel analysis of the feature map, such as by parallel multiple layers, to determine the multiple scales of semantic content. The location-bias module generates a location-sensitive saliency map of location-dependent context of the image based on the multi-scale semantic structure and on a bias map. In some cases, the bias map indicates location-specific weights for one or more regions of the image.

title: Fundus image identification and classification method based on deep learning
assignee: 中国科学院长春光学精密机械与物理研究所
abstract: An eyeground image recognition and classification method based on deep learning relates to the field of deep learning and image processing and solves the problems that the accuracy and speed of eyeground image recognition in the existing deep learning method are limited by contradiction, the efficiency is low, original data are few, and great influence is brought to training precision. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, dividing a fundus image data set into an initial training set a and a verification set c after data enhancement, and performing data expansion on the training set a to obtain a training set b1 with small relative change property and a training set b2 with large relative change property; step 2, inputting three training sets a, b1 and b2 with mapping relations into different neural networks respectively, wherein training convolution bases of a training set b1 are multiplexed into a training set b2, and then a dense connection classifier is used for generating classification labels; and 3, verifying and assigning different weights through a verification set c according to the size of the image change property, and fusing and using an optimization algorithm to achieve a final result.

title: Saturated load spatial distribution accurate prediction method based on deep learning and multi-source information fusion
assignee: 国网山东省电力公司经济技术研究院, 国网山东省电力公司, 浙江大学
abstract: The invention discloses a saturated load spatial distribution accurate prediction method based on deep learning and multi-source information fusion, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring the cell characteristics and the saturation load density of a known saturation load density to obtain a load cell sample library; analyzing the attribute of multi-source information of the space load cells, and preprocessing data of the cells to be detected; respectively substituting the land use property into the load cell sample library data and the data of the cell to be detected; selecting a proper activation function by adopting a self-encoder based on stack noise reduction in a deep learning algorithm, and carrying out network training and multi-attribute feature extraction on data; inputting the load into a regressor to perform characteristic extraction and load prediction of the load. The saturated load spatial distribution accurate prediction method based on deep learning and multi-source information fusion has certain feasibility and effectiveness, and has better extraction performance than the traditional algorithm when spatial load prediction is carried out.

title: Turbine diagnostic feature selection system
abstract: The turbine diagnostic machine learning system uses one or more parameters or parameter features to construct one or more turbine engine performance models. The model of turbine engine performance includes ranking parameters or parameter features, the ranking of which is calculated by a model builder based on a function of AIC, AUC, and p-values, resulting in a corresponding importance ranking. These raw parameters and raw parameter features are then ordered according to their importance ranking and selected by a selection component to form one or more completed models. One or more models may be operatively coupled to one or more other models to facilitate further machine learning functions of the system.

title: Ambient cooperative intelligence system and method
abstract: A method, computer program product, and computing system for initiating a session within an ACI platform; receiving an authentication request from a requester; and authenticating that the requester has the authority to access the ACI platform.

title: System providing self-service access to locked merchandise
abstract: A system providing self-service access to locked merchandise comprising: (a) providing a fixture that restricts access to the locked merchandise, wherein the fixture can automatically lock or unlock, allowing or restricting access to the locked merchandise; (b) providing a means of uniquely identifying an individual attempting to access the merchandise; (c) measuring a set of behaviors of the individual during any time the fixture is an open mode; (d) assessing whether the set of behaviors of the individual are suspicious or not relative to a set of suspicious event thresholds; (e) storing the individual and their set of behaviors as accessible records in at least one database; and (f) providing an algorithm which determines future access privileges of the individual to the enclosure based on a set of variables. Additionally, a system for maximizing sales of and minimizing theft of merchandise in a retail environment, the system comprising: (a) providing a merchandise fixture, wherein the merchandise fixture can allow or restrict access to the merchandise; (b) presenting a questionnaire to an individual; (c) providing a means of uniquely identifying the individual attempting to access the merchandise; and (d) allowing or restricting access to the merchandise based on the individual's responses to the questionnaire.

title: Differential brain network analysis
assignee: 全知神经科技有限公司
abstract: A system and method of generating a graphical representation of a network of a subject's brain. The method includes receiving, via a user interface, a selection of a network of a subject's brain; determining one or more partitions of the subject's brain based on the MRI image of the subject's brain and one or more identifiers associated with the selection (405); determining a corresponding brain bundle in a diffusion tensor image of the brain using three-dimensional coordinates associated with each partition (425); and generating a graphical representation (430) of the selected network, the graphical representation comprising at least one of: (i) One or more surfaces representing one or more partitions, each surface generated using coordinates; and (ii) the determined brain bundle.
assignee_clean: 全知神经科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 全知神经科技有限公司

title: Predictive model of transient and persistent AKI of severe sepsis patient and construction method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a predictive model of transient and persistent AKI of a severe sepsis patient and a construction method thereof, wherein the predictive model comprises a continuity variable and a classification variable; the predictive model also includes a predictive probability expression

title: Method, apparatus, and system for adjusting routing of network traffic or utilization of network nodes
abstract: Novel tools and techniques are provided for implementing routing of network traffic across one or more network nodes or utilization of the one or more network nodes based on one or more demand classifications and/or based on detection of a trigger event associated with the one or more demand classifications. In some embodiment, a computing system might monitor network traffic across one or more network nodes or utilization of the one or more network nodes, the network traffic being routed based on a first demand classification. The computing system might determine whether at least one trigger event associated with a second demand classification has occurred. If so, the computing system might adjust the routing of the network traffic across the one or more network nodes or adjust the utilization of the one or more network nodes, based at least in part on the second demand classification.

title: Transcriptome image generation device, method and application
abstract: The invention relates to a device, a method and application for generating a transcriptome image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring gene coordinate data of a first target organism and gene expression data of the first target organism; the coordinates of each gene in the gene expression data of the first target organism are determined from the gene coordinate data of the first target organism, the expression amount of each gene in the gene expression data of the first target organism is converted into the pixel intensity of each gene, and a transcriptome image of the first target organism is generated from the coordinates and pixel intensity of each gene in the gene expression data of the first target organism. The transcriptome image generation device is used for generating the transcriptome images and the image library which have obvious structural characteristics and deep learning capability, so that the synthesis of a simulation transcriptome with high confidence level and the application of real and simulation transcriptome images and the image library in accurate medical scenes such as disease and patient classification, disease target and biological marker discovery, personalized early screening and prognosis and the like are developed.

title: Real-time video super-resolution reconstruction method based on deep learning
assignee: 深圳市优森美科技开发有限公司
abstract: The invention aims to provide a real-time video super-resolution reconstruction method based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of image processing and comprises the following steps of: step 1: loop executionReconstructing a second low resolution image; step 2: acquiring a target low-resolution video image in real time; calculating the ambiguity of each image frame of the target low resolution video image, and calculating the normalized ambiguity of all image frames of the target low resolution video image; step 3: a blur degree for each image frame of the target low resolution video image; step 4: traversing normalized ambiguity for all image frames of a target low resolution video imageA plurality of low resolution video images; step 5: calculating the total distortion degree of all image frames of the first high-resolution video image and the second high-resolution video image respectively; the invention realizes high-quality image and video reconstruction by circularly executing low-resolution image reconstruction and template matching.
assignee_clean: 深圳市优森美科技开发有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市优森美科技开发有限公司

title: Processing method and device of medical terms, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 杭州太美星程医药科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium for processing medical terms. The method comprises the following steps: recalling a plurality of standard medical terms from a preset standard medical term knowledge atlas database aiming at the medical original word, and taking the plurality of standard medical terms as target candidate standard medical terms; respectively constructing multi-dimensional feature vectors for the target candidate standard medical terms; performing similarity operation on a word vector generated by the medical original word and the multi-dimensional feature vector to obtain the similarity between a target candidate standard medical term corresponding to the multi-dimensional feature vector and the medical original word; determining the target standard medical term among the target candidate standard medical terms based on the similarity. The accuracy of recalling candidate standard medical terms is improved by adopting various recalling strategies, and the target standard medical terms are determined according to the result of similarity calculation, so that the working efficiency of medical term encoding personnel is improved.
assignee_clean: 杭州太美星程医药科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州太美星程医药科技有限公司

title: Disease classification method and disease classification device
assignee: Acer Incorporated, Acer Medical Inc., Taipei Veterans General Hospital
abstract: The disclosure provides a disease classification method and a disease classification device. The disease classification method includes: inputting samples into a first stage model and obtaining a first stage determination result; inputting first samples determined positive by the first stage model into a second stage high specificity model to obtain second samples determined to be positive and third samples determined to be negative and rule in the second samples; inputting fourth samples determined negative by the first stage model into a second stage high sensitivity model to obtain fifth samples determined to be positive and sixth samples determined to be negative and rule out the sixth samples; obtaining a second stage determination result of the second and sixth samples; and inputting the third and fifth samples not ruled in or ruled out into a third stage model and obtaining a third stage determination result of the third and fifth samples.
assignee_clean: acer incorporated; acer medical; taipei veterans general hospital

title: Verified templates
abstract: A computing system that facilitates approval and validation of executable code between parties. A template including executable code and specifying certain operations and functions to be performed on protected data, as well as constraints thereto, may be verified and agreed upon by parties. The verified template and/or a hash of the verified template may be stored on a blockchain. Prior to execution of the code certain parameters within the template may be filled and validated by a system that will execute the code. A contract, which too may be agreed upon and stored on the blockchain, may also include other terms governing the parties. The filled template may also be validated, and compared against a blockchain version of the template, by the parties prior to execution of the code and prior to access being granted to protected data. Such verifications and validations ensure that data is only operated on, using a secure system, within the parameters as agreed upon by the parties.

title: Network model training method and device, network model identification method and device, and electronic equipment
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a network model training method and device, a network model identification method and device and electronic equipment. The training method of the network model comprises the following steps: obtaining a sample image of a hematoma region comprising a brain; training a preset network model according to the sample image of the hematoma area containing the brain to generate the network model, wherein the network model is used for identifying the symptom category of the imaging characteristics of the hematoma area. By utilizing the network model generated by training of the network model training method provided by the embodiment of the application, the time spent on identifying the symptom category of the imaging characteristic of the cerebral hematoma can be reduced, and the accuracy and efficiency of identifying the symptom category of the imaging characteristic of the cerebral hematoma are improved.
assignee_clean: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Deep learning-based blood cell segmentation method
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning-based blood cell segmentation method, which relates to the field of biomedical image processing and deep learning and comprises the following steps: constructing a data set; constructing a blood cell microscopic image data set, labeling three types of cells (red blood cells, white blood cells and blood platelets) in the blood cell microscopic image data set, and training a neural network: and training a semantic segmentation model of the blood cell microscopic image based on the deep neural network. The invention has the beneficial effects that the deep learning method is applied to the segmentation of the blood cell microscopic image, and the accuracy of the segmentation of the blood cells is improved.

title: System and method of identifying self-healing actions for computing systems using reinforcement learning
abstract: Example implementations relate to method and system for implementation of a software agent in a computing system, to identify the most effective self-healing action to build a Q-table by applying a reinforcement learning technique. In particular, the method includes determining an induced state of the computing system based on an error in one or more components of the computing system and selecting a corrective action corresponding to the induced state based on a plurality of Q-values stored in the Q-table. The method further includes executing the corrective action in the computing system and evaluating one or more parameters of the computing system to determine a current state of the computing system. Further, the method includes updating a Q-value of the plurality of Q-values corresponding to the corrective action, in response to evaluation of the current state of the computing system, to build the Q-table.

title: Crowd portrayal algorithm based on mass public transport data
abstract: The invention provides a crowd portrayal algorithm based on mass public transportation data, which comprises the following steps: step S1, data description and preprocessing: acquiring bus card swiping data and POI data, and preprocessing the data; step S2, screening the crowd in the key areas: passenger track data which are high in travel times and frequent in times of heat removal point areas are extracted through a PageRank algorithm; step S3, track textualization: acquiring the belonged functionality of the coordinates where the passengers are located according to the POI data, and acquiring the text track data of each passenger according to the passenger track data and the belonged functionality of the coordinates where the passengers are located; step S4, text clustering: and clustering the text track data by adopting a clustering algorithm to obtain a crowd portrait. The invention provides data support for a plurality of application fields such as city planning, social behavior analysis and the like, facilitates reasonable scheduling and construction of city resources, and better helps management departments and city builders make optimal decisions on city construction and development.

title: Seven-class skin tumor detection method applied to web
abstract: The invention discloses a seven-class skin tumor detection method applied to Web, which combines the weight of a model with a Web end based on a model migration technology taking Tensorflow as an intermediary, so that the model can normally and rapidly run in a browser environment familiar to a user, and simultaneously, a model result is visualized. The model adopts an optimized inclusion-ResNetV 2 classification network, and provides a skin tumor classification method aiming at skin tumor images. The Web end development method for seven-class skin tumor detection simplifies the process of detecting skin tumors, responds the obtained probability result to the client browser, and renders the probability result for visualization, so that a doctor patient can obtain the detection result in real time only by simply operating the Web end.

title: Method for providing map based earthquake analysis information service using thematic map
abstract: Provided is a method for providing a map-based earthquake analysis information service using a mapping thematic map, which comprises the steps of: storing damage situation data, which includes address information among an earthquake damage situation list collected from a public institution server and is selected by a predetermined selection criterion, as damage situation information; collecting and storing life safety information, which is basic information required to recognize an earthquake site situation collected from a public data portal site and a life safety service providing server; collecting at least one disaster safety facility location information (POI), and building a database divided into damage situation information, life safety information, and at least one facility location information; and generating a mapping thematic map to output the damage situation information, the life safety information, and the facility location information to be output based on the collected damage situation information, the living safety information and the disaster safety facility location information.

title: Drug potential adverse reaction discovery method based on neural network language model
abstract: A method for discovering potential adverse reaction of medicine based on neural network language model relates to the field of discovery method for potential adverse reaction of medicine, comprising the following steps of data acquisition and cleaning; model optimization, modifying an original Skip-gram algorithm, and performing feature extraction from an AERS report and a drug Bank DDI data set of the FDA; expanding an interaction library, and selecting 5 kinds of adverse reaction major categories: kidney injury, heart toxicity, liver toxicity, abnormal blood pressure and neurotoxicity, taking the 5 adverse reaction major categories as Logistic regression verification drugs, expanding drug Bank drug interaction libraries within the 5 major categories; logistic regression verifies vector effects, and CM-TF-IDF model construction and distributed vector generation are completed by using Scikit-learn. The method for discovering the potential adverse reaction of the drug based on the neural network language model solves the problems that the existing method is low in data processing speed, not suitable for processing large-scale data sets and incapable of quickly performing feature learning.

title: Limiting question-answering system based on question intention understanding
assignee: 北京致远互联软件股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a limited question-answering system based on question intention understanding. Firstly, acquiring a user input question and extracting keywords to obtain a plurality of question keywords, then screening a question equivalent example related to the user input question semanteme from a question equivalent example constructed by a service expert, then, semantically encoding the question equivalent example to obtain a user question semanteme encoding feature vector, then, extracting first to N-th alternative answers from a background database and respectively semantically encoding the first to N-th alternative answer semantically encoding feature vector, then, performing semantically interactive association matching on the user question semanteme encoding feature vector and the first to N-th alternative answer semantically encoding feature vector to obtain first to N-th alternative answer-user question semanteme interaction features, finally, determining a plurality of probability values based on the semantically interaction features, and returning an alternative answer set. In this way, the user can be helped to reduce the hurdle of knowledge exploration.
assignee_clean: 北京致远互联软件股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京致远互联软件股份有限公司

title: Creation and use of an efficiency set to estimate an amount of data stored in a data set of a storage system having one or more characteristics
abstract: Systems and methods for sampling a set of block IDs to facilitate estimating an amount of data stored in a data set of a storage system having one or more characteristics are provided. According to an example, metadata (e.g., block headers and block IDs) may be maintained regarding multiple data blocks of the data set. When one or more metrics relating to the data set are desired, an efficiency set, representing a subset of the block IDs of the data set, may be created to facilitate efficient calculation of the metrics by sampling the block IDs of the data set. Finally, the metrics may be estimated based on the efficiency set by analyzing one or more of the metadata (e.g., block headers) and the data contained in the data blocks corresponding to the subset of the block IDs and extrapolating the metrics for the entirety of the data set.

title: Security flashlights with threat detection
abstract: A rechargeable flashlight configured to communicate via a wireless network, and associated systems and methods are disclosed herein. In some embodiments, the rechargeable flashlight includes a light emitter configured to generate light outputted by the flashlight and an imaging device configured to capture environmental data from an area exposed to the output light. The flashlight can also include a cylindrical handheld main body that includes one or more functionally distinct modules configured to be detachably coupled together to provide coordinated operation. The flashlight can also include at least one user-controlled switch operable to control operation of one or more of the interchangeable cylindrical modules.

title: Self Fitness Management System and Method Based on Wearable Device
abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable-based self fitness management system and a method thereof. The wearable-based self fitness management system comprises: a fitness management server performing calculation on fitness information; a smart band measuring fitness motion; and a smart terminal interworking with the fitness management server and the smart band through a communication network. Therefore, the wearable-based self fitness management system and the method thereof allow a user to perform and manage professional fitness services through the smart band, the smart terminal, and the fitness management server connected through the communication network.

title: Electrocardiosignal processing method and system for atrial fibrillation recognition
abstract: The invention provides an electrocardiosignal processing method and system for atrial fibrillation recognition, and relates to the technical field of atrial fibrillation recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the sampled electrocardiosignals, and converting the one-dimensional electrocardiosignals into a two-dimensional electrocardiosignal matrix; based on the shallow secondary features extracted from the two-dimensional electrocardiograph matrix, deep channel features and spatial features are extracted and fused by using a self-supplementing attention network, and a fused feature map is obtained; the fused feature map obtained by the invention can more accurately identify atrial fibrillation, has good generalization, is suitable for analysis of various physiological signals (such as brain electrical signals, heart sound signals, pulse signals and the like), and has certain guiding significance in the fields of image identification, semantic segmentation and the like.

title: Rapid magnetic resonance imaging method and system based on deep learning and edge assistance
abstract: The invention relates to a fast magnetic resonance imaging method and a system based on deep learning and edge assistance, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting, organizing and processing a data set; step 2, constructing a trunk image reconstruction branch based on a cascade coding and decoding convolutional neural network architecture; step 3, constructing an auxiliary edge reconstruction branch based on a progressive refinement convolutional neural network architecture; step 4, training a depth convolution reconstruction network interacted by the main image branches and the auxiliary edge branches by using the data set collected, organized and processed in the step 1; and 5, generating a reconstructed image. The invention can improve the reconstruction performance of the undersampled magnetic resonance image.

title: Data transmission configuration utilizing a state indication
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for configuring data transmission. Aspects relate to determining a data transmission configuration utilizing a machine-learning based algorithm, such as a data transmission configuration for ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) applications. A method that may be performed by a base station (BS) includes receiving a feedback report from a user equipment (UE) including an indication of a first state corresponding to a plurality of channel condition parameters and determining one or more actions based, at least in part, on the first state. The BS may determining the one or more actions utilizing a machine learning algorithm that uses a second state, where the second state is based, at least in part, on the first state.

title: Two-stage tongue picture identification method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a two-stage tongue picture identification method based on deep learning, which comprises two stages: tongue segmentation based on a transducer model and a cross-attention mechanism network model and tongue feature detection based on a Swin transducer tongue recognition network model. Tongue segmentation based on a transducer model and a cross-attention mechanism network model comprises depth residual network extraction features, transducer module global information modeling and skip connection module feature fusion; the second stage is tongue feature detection of a tongue recognition network model based on a Swin Transformer, and comprises feature extraction by a backbone network module, global information modeling by a Transformer module and feature category and boundary box obtaining by a prediction module. The invention can realize the identification of tongue picture features, and the network model designed by the invention provides an effective technical means for the identification of tongue picture features of traditional Chinese medicine.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for acquiring virtual prop
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for acquiring a virtual prop, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: displaying a virtual item box in a virtual environment, wherein the virtual environment is used for providing a running environment of virtual game alignment, and virtual objects participate in the virtual game alignment in the virtual environment; responding to the fact that the virtual object meets a prop obtaining condition, displaying a virtual prop list based on a virtual prop box, wherein the virtual prop list comprises a virtual prop group, the virtual prop group is a combination of virtual props set based on the virtual object before the start of virtual match, and the virtual prop group comprises a target virtual prop; receiving a selection operation of a target virtual item based on the virtual item list; and acquiring the target virtual prop through the virtual object based on the selection operation. The virtual item combination set before the start of the virtual match is obtained through the virtual item box in the virtual environment, so that the diversity of obtaining the virtual item is increased.
