title: Three-dimensional magnetic resonance pancreas image segmentation method based on self-learning
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional nuclear magnetic resonance pancreas image segmentation method based on self-learning, and mainly solves the problems that pancreas segmentation boundaries are not accurate and are sticky in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: 1. inputting a three-dimensional nuclear magnetic resonance image sequence and carrying out normalization processing; 2. dividing the processed data into a training set and a testing set; 3. extracting two-dimensional gray level co-occurrence matrix characteristics, two-dimensional gray level gradient co-occurrence matrix characteristics and three-dimensional gray level gradient co-occurrence matrix characteristics from the test concentrated image; 4. according to the characteristics and the labels of the training set, a classifier is obtained by utilizing self-learning and training of a support vector machine; 5. obtaining a rough segmentation sequence of the test set by using a distance regularized level set method; 6. extracting characteristics of the roughly-segmented sequence, and obtaining a finely-segmented binary sequence by using a classifier; 7. and carrying out post-processing on the subdivided and segmented binary sequence to obtain a segmentation result of the test set. The invention can obtain the accurate contour of the pancreas and can be used for providing basis and guidance for radiotherapy.

title: Constructing flexible space-filling designs for computer experiments
abstract: A computing device generates representative points, each representing a potential design point for a design space. The computing device determines for the design space primary clusters, a categorical factor, and at least two levels for the categorical factor. The computing device, for each of the primary clusters, selects a design point from each sub-cluster of the respective primary cluster. The computing device, for each of the primary clusters, allocates the at least two levels of the categorical factor, such that a level of the at least two levels is allocated to each selected design point in the respective primary cluster. The computing device modifies an initial sub-design that represents the selected design points allocated a given level of the categorical factor by increasing separation between design points allocated a same level of the categorical factor. The computing device outputs to an output device a modified design for the design space.

title: Multi-view, multi-source registration of mobile anatomy and device
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: A multi-source, multi-type image registration is provided. Receiving images from a plurality of image devices, and receiving images from a medical imaging device. A pre-existing illustration of a probe of a medical imaging device is received. A four-dimensional model is determined based on the image received from the image device. The pose of the probe of the medical imaging device is determined based on the pre-existing illustration of the probe and the image received from the image device. The plurality of images from the medical imaging device are registered with the four-dimensional model based on a common coordinate system and the determined probe pose.

title: Exploiting answer key modification history for training a question and answering system
abstract: A system and a computer program product are provided for evaluating question-answer pairs in an answer key by generating a predicted answer to a test question based on the answer key modification history for comparison matching against a generated answer that is generated in response to the test question, and then comparing the predicted answer and generated answer to determine an accuracy score match indication therebetween so as to present an indication that the answer key may have a problem if there is a match between the predicted answer and generated answer.

title: Method for analyzing consciousness level of patient based on deep learning and resting state electroencephalogram data
abstract: A method for analyzing the consciousness level of a patient based on deep learning and resting state electroencephalogram data. The method comprises preprocessing brain wave signals; constructing a phase-locked value, a full-band multichannel power spectrum density periodic component and an aperiodic component matrix; dividing a training set and a testing set; constructing a convolutional neural network model, and training and verifying; reconstructing a training set and a testing set; training and verifying the convolutional neural network model again; and obtaining the final classification result of the patient, the reliability of the classification result and the like. The CNN model used by the invention can still exert the excellent performance of pattern recognition without a large amount of feature extraction work. And a gradient weighting type activation mapping technology is introduced to achieve the aim of visualizing learning results, and the advantages are increased. The information with higher correlation with the consciousness level in the resting brain wave signals can be found, so that a convolutional neural network model with better classification performance can be established, and the preliminary analysis and evaluation of the consciousness level of the patient can be assisted by medical staff.

title: Natural language processing of formatted documents
abstract: Detecting and incorporating formatting characteristics within natural language processing analytics. Source documents are ingested and the markup formatting language is identified by the program. Once identified, the markup language is parsed and examined for formatting characteristics, embedded notes, comments and other metadata. The formatting characteristics of the plain text are extracted, along with the plain text, and converted into a common analysis structure (CAS), or CAS-equivalent structure, which annotates the natural language text together with its respective formatting characteristics. The CAS or CAS-equivalent structures are stored and sent to a natural language processing pipeline for further analysis via complex algorithms and rules. The natural language processing results data are curated to reflect meaningful analysis of the extracted CAS or CAS-equivalent structure.

title: Dental caries identification method based on oral panoramic film and dual attention module
abstract: The invention provides a decayed tooth identification method based on an oral panoramic picture and a dual attention module, which is a method for simultaneously carrying out edge segmentation and corresponding lesion degree identification on decayed tooth areas in the oral panoramic picture by using a deep learning technology. The deep learning technology comprises a dual attention module based on an image space domain and a channel domain, and a segmentation and classification network established based on the dual attention module. The caries identification system consists of three modules: the system comprises a data preprocessing module, a dual attention segmentation network module and a dual attention classification network module. The method carries out layered sampling and calculation on the attention of the image area in the deep learning process, and connects the segmentation network and the classification network in series, thereby realizing the end-to-end one-stop type positioning of the decayed tooth area and the identification of the lesion degree. The method has important clinical and social significance for the maintenance of oral health by realizing the automatic segmentation of the decayed tooth area in the panoramic picture of the oral cavity and the derivation of the result corresponding to the decayed tooth lesion.

title: Quantifying motor function using eeg signals
abstract: A motor control score is automatically generated for a subject based on electroencephalography (EEG) data represented as a plurality of EEG waveforms obtained from a plurality of EEG electrodes. Each waveform is separated into at least one window, containing a portion of the EEG waveform representative of neural activity corresponding to a movement performed by the subject. At least one or more frequency components and/or signal components are determined from the EEG data in the window, and a motor control score is determined based on these components. The frequency components may correspond to event-related desynchronization (ERD) response frequency band and event-related synchronization (ERS) response frequency band. In other embodiments, the frequency components correspond to a phase response and the signal components correspond to a signal power spectrum density of the window, which are provided to a primary neural network model to determine the motor control score.

title: Delivery of contextual interest from interaction information
abstract: Systems and techniques for delivery of contextual interest from interaction information are described that process user interactions with digital content to generate user interest scores for various topics. A contextual user interest system uses user interaction data to identify and contextualize content, and assigns propensity scores to the contextualized content. By dynamically contextualizing pages of content, the contextual user interest system may adapt to changes in the content and provide more accurate and robust information over time, which is not possible using conventional techniques. The contextualized pages of content are used to assign user interest scores across a number of topics to users who have visited the pages of content, and the user interest scores are normalized in a manner that allows a user's degree of interest in a topic to be compared to that of another user.

title: Long-acting VEGF inhibitors for intraocular neovascularization
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: Compositions and methods for treating a VEGF-related ophthalmic disorder in a subject in need comprising, administering intravitreally to the subject a therapeutically effective amount of an anti-VEGF agent, comprising a VEGF binding portion operatively linked to a Fc-IgG, wherein the VEGF binding portion comprises at least one VEGF binding domain that is an IgG-like domain 2 of VEGFR-1.

title: Image registration method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image registration method, an image registration device, image registration equipment and an image registration medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing first-stage registration on non-reference images in the image group to be registered to obtain a preliminary registration image group; performing target anatomy segmentation on images in the image group to be registered to obtain a segmentation result of a target anatomy structure in a calibration space where a reference image is positioned; overlapping and displaying the segmentation result and each image of the preliminary registration image group, and obtaining an interested region; and carrying out region registration on the region of interest of the non-reference image in the preliminary registration image group and the region of interest of the reference image, and carrying out second-stage registration on the non-reference image in the preliminary registration image group according to the registration relation in the region registration process. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention realizes the improvement of the registration effect of the local area of the image, thereby improving the accuracy of the analysis of the region of interest.

title: Gene mutation prediction method under cooperative driving of residual network and channel attention
abstract: The invention provides a gene mutation prediction method under cooperative driving of a residual network and channel attention, belonging to the technical field of deep learning; the method solves the problem that the model precision is low because the large-scale image data cannot be acquired and the type of the gene mutation is difficult to judge in the existing deep learning in the gene mutation prediction; the method comprises the following steps: inputting a CT image of the lung, preprocessing, inputting the preprocessed CT image of the lung, and performing convolution processing to extract the primary characteristics of the lung nodule; connecting the residual block with a channel of an SE mechanism by using a convolution layer of 1 multiplied by 1, realizing cross-channel interaction and integrating the extracted lung nodule information; extracting fine features of lung nodules by repeating twice with a module consisting of a residual block and an SE mechanism; classifying the extracted fine features of the lung nodules through the connection of the self-adaptive average pooling layer and the full-connection layer, and carrying out multi-task prediction on the gene mutation according to classification results; the invention is applied to gene mutation prediction.

title: Image identification method and device based on multiple focal lengths and storage medium
assignee: 深圳市瑞图生物技术有限公司
abstract: An image identification method and device based on multiple focal lengths and a storage medium, wherein the image identification method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of sample images with different focal lengths; respectively carrying out target identification on each sample image to obtain identification information of each detection target in each sample image; and performing duplication elimination according to the identification information of each detection target in each sample image, and storing the detection target after duplication elimination into a preset multi-focus image target set. According to the technical scheme, all detection targets can be effectively identified without multi-focus reconstruction of the sample image, so that the accuracy of image identification can be improved, the image processing speed can be increased, and the time required by identification can be shortened, thereby being beneficial to improving the practicability of the medical detection device.

title: Automated identification of hardware and software components relevant to incident reports
abstract: Visualizations are automatically generated based at least on a received identifier that identifies a report. One or more data sets and one or more style configurations are retrieved from a shared visualization library via a backend API based on the received identifier and passed to a router component. The router component includes a switch that renders a score component, which generates a score visualization, if the retrieved data sets include score data. If the data sets include time series data, or the score visualization also includes a time series graph, the router component renders a time series component that passes the data sets and the style configurations to a parser that parses the data sets and the style configurations and outputs one or more highcharts options objects. A highcharts component generates the time series visualizations and/or adds the time series graph to the score visualization based on the highcharts options objects.

title: Hybrid fiber coaxial fed 5G small cell surveillance with hybrid fiber coaxial hosted mobile edge computing
abstract: An architecture for surveillance of hybrid fiber coaxial (HFC) 5th generation (5G) Long Term Evolution (LTE) small cell devices using mobile edge computing techniques hosted by a HFC device is disclosed. A method can comprise receiving first data representing a quality of service value associated with a small cell device of a first group of 5G small cell devices; retrieving second data representing a historical quality of service value associated with a second group of 5G small cell devices; as a function of the first data and the second data, generating a change value for the small cell device; and based on the change value, facilitating an adjustment in an operation of the small cell device.

title: Skin image analysis
abstract: Method of processing an image of the skin is disclosed. The method comprises the receipt of skin image data, the generation of simulated images with artificial transformation and the analysis of the simulated images to form a vector from extracted features.

title: System and method for generating neck lymph node ultrasonic partition image
abstract: The application relates to a generation system and a method of neck lymph node ultrasonic partition images, wherein the system comprises the following steps: an ultrasound map acquisition module that generates cervical lymph node ultrasound images by examination of a patient; the ultrasonic image preprocessing module is in communication connection with the ultrasonic image acquisition module, receives the ultrasonic image of the cervical lymph node from the ultrasonic image acquisition module, and preprocesses the ultrasonic image of the cervical lymph node through openCV software loaded on the ultrasonic image of the cervical lymph node; the ultrasonic image partitioning module is used for partitioning the neck lymph node ultrasonic image preprocessed by the ultrasonic image preprocessing module through a trained transducer model loaded on the ultrasonic image partitioning module; the thermodynamic diagram loading module is used for loading thermodynamic diagrams on the neck lymph node ultrasonic images partitioned on the ultrasonic diagram partitioning module by selecting Grad-cam, grad-cam++ and X-Grad thermodynamic diagram programs loaded on the thermodynamic diagram loading module so as to form visual neck lymph node ultrasonic partitioned images; and the output module is used for outputting the visualized neck lymph node ultrasonic partition image. Can be used for accurate partition of cervical lymph node ultrasound.

title: Missed-bolus dose detection and related systems, methods and devices
abstract: Disclosed embodiments relate, generally, to retrospective missed-bolus detection. Some embodiments relate to systems, methods, and devices for performing retrospective missed-bolus detection by processing insulin therapy data. Some embodiments relate, generally, to systems, methods and devices for training missed-bolus classifiers using machine learning techniques to perform retrospective missed-bolus detection. Some embodiments relate, generally, to systems, methods, and devices for obtaining training data and test data that may be used to train missed-bolus classifiers to perform retrospective missed-bolus detection.

title: Automated logging of patching operations via mixed reality based labeling
abstract: A machine vision device is provided including a camera, a processor, and a device memory including computer program code stored thereon. The computer program code is configured, when executed by the processor, to receive an image, from the camera, including at least one readable digital label associated with communication equipment, determine if an anchor label is present in the image, receive equipment information based on the anchor label and generate a search matrix based on the equipment information and the anchor label The search matrix includes one or more search matrix locations of assets associated with the communication equipment.

title: Abdominal multi-organ segmentation modeling and segmentation method and system based on edge perception
assignee: 陕西大智慧医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image segmentation, and discloses an abdomen multi-organ segmentation modeling and segmentation method and system based on edge perception. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an original abdomen CT image set, marking liver, stomach, pancreas and intestinal organs in each original abdomen CT image, and preprocessing the marked original abdomen CT image set to acquire an abdomen CT image set; step 2: establishing an abdomen multi-organ segmentation network, wherein the abdomen multi-organ segmentation network comprises a voxel segmentation module, an edge perception module and a fusion module; step 3: taking the abdomen CT image set as a training set, taking the original abdomen CT images of the marked liver, stomach, pancreas and intestinal organs as labels, training an abdomen multi-organ segmentation network, and taking the trained segmentation network as an abdomen multi-organ segmentation model.

title: Automatic personal health assessment and management method and system
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic personal health assessment and management method and system, comprising the following steps: health monitoring and data acquisition; based on the collected results, performing health assessment; performing service plan adaptation based on the result of the evaluation; based on the adaptive result, implementing a service plan according to service start-stop time, and collecting feedback information; based on the result of the feedback information, performing parameter adjustment; based on the result of the adjustment, the relevant data is updated, and the data is executed according to the adjusted parameters when the data is executed next time. Aiming at personal health conditions, the invention automatically collects data by means of intelligent machine, automatically tracks, analyzes and judges, automatically tailors the body to a custom, generates a dynamic scale evaluation problem domain and automatically adapts to a custom care path; the cost is reduced, the efficiency is improved, the individual health assessment requirement is met, the standardization and standardization of the service are realized, and the individual health assessment and service plan adaptation self-organization are realized.

title: System and method for identifying a disease affected area
assignee: Disease Advisor Pty Ltd, Anton Lord, Maggy Lord
abstract: A method for identifying a disease affected area. The method includes activating a geolocation device of an electronic communication device, determining a current geolocation from the geolocation device, querying a disease database from the electronic communication device, to identify one or more diseases associated with the current geolocation, and generating a graphical display on a display of the electronic communication device displaying a risk rating associated with each of the one or more identified diseases associated with the current geolocation.

title: Reservation code display method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京声智科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for displaying an appointment code, and belongs to the field of medical treatment. The embodiment of the application provides a mode for inquiring the reservation code generated during reservation of the health service, in the mode, a reservation control is directly provided in a health service interface, so that a user can touch the reservation code through one key of the reservation control, the reservation code is quickly found and displayed, the user does not need to operate a control interface for multiple times to jump for inquiring the reservation code, the user operation can be simplified, the time consumption caused by the operation is reduced, and the searching and displaying efficiency of the reservation code is improved.

title: Automatic access point arrangement system and method
abstract: The wireless access point location may be determined by processing a combination of wired telemetry and wireless telemetry. Wireless telemetry may be combined with backend network management information to isolate a set of access points within a radio frequency neighborhood cluster. Wired telemetry, including time domain reflectometry operations performed by the local exchange, may be used to refine the position estimate for an isolated set of access points. Trilateration may be used to pinpoint access point locations, and the pinpoint locations may be overlaid on the floor plan.

title: Gastric seal ring cell cancer image intelligent classification system based on Unet transfer learning
assignee: 中国科学院自动化研究所
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of medical image processing, in particular relates to an intelligent gastric print ring cell cancer image classification system based on Unet transfer learning, and aims to solve the problem that the gastric print ring cell cancer image classification result is inaccurate due to irregular gastric cancer focus shape and low feature extraction quality in the prior art. The invention comprises the following steps: the region of interest extraction module is used for extracting stomach cancer focus region of interest from the acquired stomach CT to be classified; the preprocessing module is used for carrying out image enhancement on the extracted Rec_ROI; the intelligent classification module is used for completing intelligent classification of the preprocessed images to be classified through the trained intelligent classification model; and the screening fusion module is used for fusing the intelligent classification result with the screened obvious clinical factors to generate a final classification result of the stomach CT image to be classified. The method has the advantages of high speed, high precision and strong robustness, and has great practical value in clinic.

title: Bistable clinical trial data processing method and system using historical control data
assignee: 北京大学, 中国中医科学院西苑医院
abstract: The invention relates to a bistable clinical test data processing method and system using historical control data, belongs to the technical field of medical data processing, and solves the problems that an existing clinical test data processing method depends on model setting and crowd homogeneity assumption, is low in efficiency, is poor in accuracy and the like. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a clinical test data sample and a historical control data sample; respectively processing to obtain a treatment group condition mean model for representing the clinical treatment group result variable, a control group condition mean model for representing the control group result variable, a treatment distribution trend score model, a crowd distribution trend score model and a conditional variance ratio model; and obtaining an average causal effect estimated value and a progressive variance estimated value of the clinical test by using a bistable estimation method, thereby judging whether the average causal effect exists. According to the method, the historical comparison data is introduced, so that the accuracy and precision of the drug effect inference result can be improved, and the method has good robustness, flexibility and expansibility.
assignee_clean: 北京大学; 中国中医科学院西苑医院

title: Method and device for automatically identifying primary tumor of nasopharyngeal carcinoma
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of image processing, and provides a method and a device for automatically identifying nasopharyngeal carcinoma primary tumors, wherein the method comprises the steps of adopting a ResNeXt152 network as a backbone network in a Mask RCNN deep semantic segmentation network, and defining prediction categories of semantic segmentation branches as three categories; training the deep semantic segmentation network by utilizing a plurality of preprocessed magnetic resonance three-dimensional images, wherein the output of the deep semantic segmentation network comprises: the method comprises the following steps of (1) containing pixel position information of four end points of a rectangular frame of a tumor region, the probability that the rectangular frame is the tumor region, and the probability that each pixel in the rectangular frame belongs to a primary tumor region; inputting the magnetic resonance three-dimensional image to be identified into the depth semantic segmentation network to obtain the probability that each pixel belongs to the primary tumor region; according to the method, the accuracy of prediction and the generalization capability of a model can be effectively improved by utilizing and improving the network architecture of Mask RCNN through a deep learning method.
assignee_clean: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司

title: Early skin condition diagnostics using sonic sensors
abstract: Computing systems and methods are provided for detecting skin conditions of humans. A computing device can authenticate a user via a fingerprint scan of a first skin region of the user using a three-dimensional (3D) sonic sensor. The device can generate a three-dimensional (3D) volumetric sonic measurement of a second skin region of the user based at least in part on one or more sonic pulses of the three-dimensional sonic sensor. The device can input data indicative of the 3D volumetric sonic measurement into one or more machine-learning models, generate one or more skin cancer condition identifications associated with the second skin region of the user based on one or more outputs of the one or more machine-learned models, and provide one or more outputs including the one or more skin cancer condition identifications associated with the second skin region of the user.

title: Mammary gland image registration method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a breast image registration method based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing a first position mammary gland image and a second position mammary gland image, and constructing a training data set by taking the first position mammary gland image as a fixed image and the second position mammary gland image as a moving image; inputting the training data set into a registration network, outputting a deformation field, wherein the deformation field represents the moving direction and the moving distance of a voxel on a moving image, and acting the obtained deformation field on the moving image to obtain a transformed moving image; and training the registration network, and calculating a loss function value between the deformation field and the fixed image as well as the transformed moving image until a set optimization convergence condition is met to obtain the trained registration network for subsequent breast image registration. The invention can realize more accurate registration effect and has high registration speed.

title: Cervical carcinoma TCT slice vagina arranging method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 杭州医策科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a cervical carcinoma TCT slice vagina-discharging method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: carrying out segmentation pretreatment on the TCT image of the cervical cancer, and segmenting the target image into a plurality of image blocks with partial overlapping areas; detecting each image block by using a target detection model and outputting a cervical cancer positive target detection frame and a corresponding detection frame confidence coefficient under the image block; setting a detection frame confidence threshold, and screening and reserving the detection frames with the detection frame confidence degrees larger than the detection frame confidence degree threshold based on the detection frame confidence degree threshold; detecting the detected target images in the reserved detection frames by using a shadow elimination classification model, outputting the positive probabilities of all the detected target images, and calculating the overall average positive probability; and setting a shade elimination probability threshold, if the overall average positive probability is less than or equal to a preset shade elimination probability threshold, judging that the overall target image is negative, otherwise, judging that the image to be manually checked is an image to be manually checked, and manually checking by a doctor.
assignee_clean: 杭州医策科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州医策科技有限公司

title: Tear film rupture time detecting system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a tear film rupture time detection system based on deep learning, which comprises a computer memory, a computer processor and a computer program which is stored in the computer memory and can be executed on the computer processor, wherein a trained classification model and a dry spot segmentation model are stored in the computer memory, and the computer processor realizes the following steps when executing the computer program: extracting all frames of the shot tear film rupture time inspection video, inputting the frames into a classification model, and outputting a classification label of each frame of image to form an 0/1 sequence; extracting 3-5 eye opening sections in the sequence as detection sections; and respectively inputting each detection segment into a dry spot segmentation model for segmentation prediction, recording the position of a frame with a dry spot appearing for the first time in each detection segment, calculating the tear film rupture time of each detection segment, and finally taking the average value as the integral tear film rupture time of the person to be detected. The invention can improve the adaptability and accuracy of the computer-aided diagnosis of xerophthalmia.

title: Hyperspectral scanning to determine skin health
abstract: A system, method, and computer readable media are provided for obtaining a first set of skin data from an image capture system including at least one ultraviolet (UV) image of a user's skin. Performing a correction on the skin data using a second set of skin data associated with the user. Quantifying a plurality of skin parameters of the user's skin based on the first skin data, including quantifying a bacterial load. Quantifying the bacterial load by applying a brightness filter to isolate portions of the at least one UV image containing fluorescence, applying a dust filter, identifying portions of the at least one UV image that contain fluorescence due to bacteria, and determining a quantity of bacterial load in the users skin. Determining, using a machine learning model, an output associated with a normal skin state of the user and a current skin state of the user.

title: Ground truth collection via browser for passage-question pairings
abstract: A method, system and a computer program product are provided for collecting ground truth data by activating a ground truth collection browser plugin with a designated toolbar button to receive answer data from a webpage which includes user-selected data passage and source data from the webpage for automatic loading into a ground truth submission window along with user input question data corresponding to the answer data so that the user input question data, source data, and answer data from the ground truth submission window may be stored as ground truth data.

title: Computer implemented method for the automatic classification of instrumental citations
abstract: The learning method taught in this patent document is significantly different from previous methods for automatic classification of citations that are labor intensive and subject to human bias and error. The present invention automatically generates and avoids these limitations. A set of operational definitions and features uniquely suited to the scientific literature is disclosed along with their use with a learning method that is capable of analyzing the textual content of articles along with bibliometric data to accurately classify instrumental citations.
assignee_clean: lawrence fu; konstantinos constantin f aliferis

title: Composition with blood sugar reducing synergistic effect and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a composition with a blood sugar reducing synergistic effect and application thereof, and belongs to the technical fields of food nutrition and health care and biological medicine. The composition comprises oyster peptide and anthocyanin extract. The mass ratio of the oyster peptide to the anthocyanin extract is 1:10-3:1. Experiments prove that the synergistic effect of the internal and external blood sugar reduction of the composition is remarkable, and the digestion stability is remarkably improved; animal experiments prove that the composition has synergistic hypoglycemic effect on type II diabetes mice, has more remarkable hypoglycemic effect than single oyster peptide or anthocyanin, and has no toxic effect on animals after long-term use; the in vivo experiment shows that the combined oyster peptide and anthocyanin has partial synergistic hypoglycemic mechanism. The invention provides a new direction for reducing blood sugar and treating and preventing II diabetes.

title: Method for labeling rib areas in medical image, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 青岛海信医疗设备股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium for rib region labeling in a medical scanning image. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a rib scanning image sequence, wherein the rib scanning image sequence comprises a plurality of rib scanning images which are orderly arranged; detecting rib areas in a rib scan image; acquiring a plurality of rib connected domains in a rib scanning image sequence, wherein one rib connected domain corresponds to at least one rib region; determining rib communicating domains with the number of rib areas larger than the first preset number as effective rib communicating domains; and marking rib areas in the effective rib communication domain. The method provides a computer-aided diagnosis means, can give doctors more accurate rib numbering information reference for reading, and improves the working efficiency of the doctors for reading.

title: Method for predicting tumor risk value based on plasma multi-omic multi-dimensional features and artificial intelligence
assignee: 深圳思勤医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of biological information, and in particular, to methods, systems, electronic devices, and computer readable media for predicting the source of a sample to be tested based on plasma multi-dimensional features and artificial intelligence. The method adopts cfDNA low-depth whole genome sequencing and plasma tumor marker detection, and utilizes a machine learning method to construct a multivariable source model for predicting a sample to be detected so as to distinguish whether the sample to be detected is from a tumor sample or a normal sample. The method/model for predicting the source of the sample to be tested provided by the invention utilizes five dimensions: the concentration of cfDNA in plasma, the variation of gene copy number, the fragmentation mode, the tumor marker and the mitochondrial insert are in the proportion of less than 150bp, all quantized numerical indexes are subjected to standardized transformation, and finally the cancer contribution degree of each standardized index is weighted to obtain the probability that a sample to be detected comes from a tumor patient, so that the source of the sample to be detected can be predicted more sensitively and specifically on the premise that the detection cost is more controllable.
assignee_clean: 深圳思勤医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳思勤医疗科技有限公司

title: Deep learning-based nondestructive testing method for total sugar content in blueberry fruits
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning-based nondestructive testing method for total sugar content in blueberry fruits, which classifies the blueberry fruits by deep learning, improves the accuracy and efficiency of blueberry fruit detection, and comprises the following steps: firstly, blueberry fruits at different ripening periods are collected, anthocyanin content and total sugar content of the blueberries are measured, then a peel pigment content prediction network SPCPN based on correlation between anthocyanin and blueberry images is established, a fruit internal quality prediction network FIQPN based on correlation between anthocyanin and total sugar is established, finally, the peel pigment content prediction network and the fruit internal quality prediction network are combined into a blueberry quality parameter prediction network BQPPN, and after external verification, the prediction of the network on the total sugar content of the blueberry fruits is more than 94%, so that the blueberry fruit quality parameter prediction network has the advantages of no damage, high efficiency, high accuracy, convenience and stable results.

title: Fundus image classification model training method and device
assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a fundus image classification model training method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring training data, including fundus images and labels for expressing disease types thereof; classifying the fundus image by using a trained first machine learning model to obtain first confidence information for expressing that the fundus image belongs to various disease types; and training a second machine learning model by using the training data and the first confidence coefficient information, classifying the fundus image by the second machine learning model in the training process to obtain second confidence coefficient information for expressing that the fundus image belongs to various disease types, and optimizing parameters of the second machine learning model according to the difference between the second confidence coefficient information and the label and the difference between the second confidence coefficient information and the first confidence coefficient information.

title: Focus marking method and device for CT image and storage medium
assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司, 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司
abstract: The application discloses a focus labeling method of a CT image. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a focus detection model; inputting the marked key CT image and the adjacent CT image into the focus detection model for prediction; screening pseudo tags in the prediction result according to a preset screening rule to obtain a target tag set; and adding the target label set and the corresponding CT image into a training set. The application solves the technical problem that the performance of the deep learning algorithm is limited because the missed labels cannot be determined in marked CT images and the labels cannot be determined on a large number of unmarked CT images by a semi-supervision method.
