primary_assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for transforming an interactive graphical user interface according to machine learning models
abstract: A computerized method for transforming an interactive graphical user interface according to machine learning includes selecting a persona, loading a data structure associated with the selected persona, and generating the interactive graphical user interface. The method includes, in response to a user selecting a first selectable element, inputting a first set of explanatory variables to a first trained machine learning model to generate a first metric, and transforming the user interface according to the selected persona and the first metric. The method includes, in response to the user selecting a second selectable element, inputting a second set of explanatory variables to a second trained machine learning model to generate a second metric, and transforming the user interface according to the selected persona and the second metric. In various implementations, first metric is a first probability of the persona being approved for a first prior authorization prescription.

title: Robot-machine cooperative interaction control method and system for nasopharynx swab sampling robot
abstract: A nasopharyngeal swab sampling robot-human-computer collaborative interaction control method comprises four steps of (1) motion information acquisition, (2) motion state identification, (3) robot remote operation control, and (4) visual feedback and force feedback. The invention has the following technical effects: 1) the operator and the person to be sampled are isolated, and the phenomenon of infection caused by contact in the sampling process is avoided. 2) The method has more intuitive operation feedback, is simple to operate, and reduces the burden of an operator. 3) The comfort of the person to be sampled is improved in the sampling process.

title: Method for providing product control protocol service for complying with laws and regulations
abstract: Provided is a method for providing a product handling protocol service for complying with legal regulations, which comprises the steps of: collecting and establishing a database of legal data including at least one type of legal regulation required for handlers, including import, manufacture, distribution, and sale of products; providing legal data and product categories which are pre-mapped to product keywords and stored, when product keywords are input from a handler terminal; providing the legal regulations and obligations included in the legal data to the handler terminal; and transmitting caution data, which is a matter to be taken care of when handling the product, to the handler terminal.

title: Pre-processing for identifying nonsense passages in documents being ingested into a corpus of a natural language processing system
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for identifying nonsense passages in documents being ingested into a corpus. A natural language processing pipeline configured to execute in the data processing system receives an input document to be ingested into a corpus. The natural language processing pipeline divides the input document into a plurality of input passages. A filter component of the natural language processing pipeline identifies whether each input passage is a nonsense passage based on a value of a metric determined according to a set of feature counts. The natural language processing pipeline filters each input passage in the plurality of input passages based on whether the input passage is identified as a nonsense passage or not identified as a nonsense passage to form a filtered plurality of input passages. The natural language processing pipeline adds the filtered plurality of input passages into the corpus.

title: Monitor of oral respiration
abstract: An improved device for monitoring respiration or other vital signs of a user using one or more sensors. The invention may be worn within the mouth of the user to allow more accurate, direct, and fast measurements. The invention may also include a distribution mechanism that may be used to administer a substance such as medication. The substance may be administered in response to data collected by one or more of the sensors in the device and/or in response to data received from another device.

title: Cornea nerve fiber segmentation method based on multiscale and local feature guide network
abstract: The invention discloses a cornea nerve fiber segmentation method, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on a multiscale and local feature guide network, which comprises the following steps: extracting the characteristics of the medical sample image by using an encoder and a decoder of the U-shaped network; sampling the output of each decoder by utilizing a multi-scale depth supervision network, splicing the output of each decoder with the output of a preset decoder, and outputting a medical segmentation image corresponding to each decoder; calculating a loss function value of a medical segmentation image corresponding to each decoder and a medical image training set labeling area; the invention optimizes the output of each decoder by utilizing a plurality of loss function values based on the supervision training of the network, thereby better accelerating the convergence speed of the network, improving the segmentation performance and improving the accuracy of medical image segmentation.

title: Predicting response to immunotherapy using computer extracted features of cancer nuclei from hematoxylin and eosin (HandE) stained images of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
assignee: Case Western Reserve University, The Cleveland Clinic Foundation
abstract: Embodiments access a digitized image of tissue demonstrating non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), the tissue including a plurality of cellular nuclei; segment the plurality of cellular nuclei represented in the digitized image; extract a set of nuclear radiomic features from the plurality of segmented cellular nuclei; generate at least one nuclear cell graph (CG) based on the plurality of segmented nuclei; compute a set of CG features based on the nuclear CG; provide the set of nuclear radiomic features and the set of CG features to a machine learning classifier; receive, from the machine learning classifier, a probability that the tissue will respond to immunotherapy, based, at least in part, on the set of nuclear radiomic features and the set of CG features; generate a classification of the tissue as a responder or non-responder based on the probability; and display the classification.
assignee_clean: case western reserve university; the cleveland clinic foundation

title: Video feature tagging
abstract: An activity recording system is provided. The activity recording system includes a three-dimensional camera, a sensor arrangement that is fitted to a subject being recorded, and an activity recording device. The activity recording device receives image information from the three-dimensional camera and sensor arrangement information from the sensor arrangement. Both the image information and the sensor arrangement information include location measurements. The sensor arrangement information is generated by location sensors that are positioned at target features of the subject to be tracked. The sensor arrangement information is a key to the image information that specifies where, in any given image, the target features of the subject lie. Activity data having these characteristics may be applied to solve a variety of system development problems. Such activity data can be used to training machine learning components or test computer vision components for a fraction of the cost of using conventional techniques.

title: DR robot system and operation steps using same
assignee: 广东中科天机医疗装备有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a DR robot system and an operation step applying the same, comprising a robot chassis, a mechanical arm, a DR machine and electronic equipment, wherein the robot chassis transports the DR machine, the DR machine comprises a shooting controller, the mechanical arm is arranged on the DR machine and drives the shooting controller to move, and the electronic equipment controls the robot chassis to move and controls the DR machine to carry out medical images. The system reduces the working strength of DR shooting, and improves the convenient operation degree. Medical personnel remote control machine accomplishes obtaining of medical image, has completely received the risk that the patient infects, through intelligent image processing center, can realize the diagnosis of common disease, can also carry out remote diagnosis through network sharing data help experienced doctor, has improved diagnostic efficiency and effect.
assignee_clean: 广东中科天机医疗装备有限公司
primary_assignee: 广东中科天机医疗装备有限公司

title: Predictive build quality assessment
abstract: Predictive build quality assessment is disclosed, e.g., to predict performance of a candidate software build prior to deploying the candidate software build in a production environment. An example method can include comparing performance of a candidate software build with performance data associated with clusters of previous builds. A cluster having similar performance to the candidate software build can be selected. A source code graph for the candidate software build can be compared to source code graphs of builds included in the selected cluster. A previous build in the cluster, which is associated with a source code graph that is similar to the candidate software build's source code graph, can be selected. Individual performance data associated with the selected previous build can be inferred to be the predicted performance of the candidate software build, thereby informing decision making regarding further testing, modification, and/or deployment of the candidate software build into production.

title: Effecting multi-step operations in an application in response to direct manipulation of a selected object
abstract: An electronic document having a current layout can be presented in an application user interface. Based on a detected interaction with an object in the electronic document, an intent can be determined. The determined intent can be used to identify different sets of commands that result in corresponding visual representations that are likely to satisfy the determined intent. Different activation regions can be defined within the electronic document. A different command set, each identified from the determined intent, is associated with each different activation region. Movement and release of the selected object to a position within an activation region is detected, and the command set associated with the activation region is executed to perform a multi-step operation that modifies at least the current layout of the electronic document to result in the corresponding visual representation.

title: Digital twinning-based intelligent analysis method and device for patient disease categories
assignee: 深圳市平行维度科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a digital twinning technology, and discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent analysis method for a disease category of a patient, which comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time sign data of a target patient, and constructing a twin organ model of the target patient according to the real-time sign data; acquiring disease condition data and disease classification coding data, and performing vector conversion on the disease condition data to obtain a disease condition vector; calculating the disease similarity of the disease classification coding data, and generating a disease class similarity matrix according to the disease similarity; inputting the disease condition vectors and the disease category similarity matrix into a multi-view network fusion clustering model for training to obtain a condition category classification model; and extracting real-time disorder data in the twin organ model, and analyzing the disorder type of the real-time disorder data by using a disorder type classification model. The invention further provides an intelligent analysis device for the disease category of the patient based on digital twinning. The invention can improve the accuracy of disease identification.
assignee_clean: 深圳市平行维度科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市平行维度科技有限公司

title: Target detection method, model training method and related device
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a target detection method, a model training method and a related device, wherein the target detection method comprises the following steps: determining image characteristics corresponding to an image to be detected; determining decoding query features corresponding to each query feature in the query feature sets according to the query feature sets and the image features by a target decoder in the target detection model; the plurality of query feature sets are obtained by grouping each query feature to be processed corresponding to the target decoder; the query characteristics to be processed are determined according to the initial query characteristics or are obtained by screening from each decoding query characteristic output by a decoder of the upper layer of the target decoder based on the high-quality characteristic conditions; and determining a target detection result corresponding to the image to be detected according to each decoding query characteristic output by a last layer of decoder in the target detection model. The method can improve the calculation efficiency and the processing accuracy of the target decoder, and further improve the overall efficiency and accuracy of the target detection task.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Classifying behavior through system-generated timelines and deep learning
abstract: Computer vision and deep learning techniques are leveraged to detect behavior patterns in transaction histories. A transaction timeline is built for a series of transactions, e.g., financial, and a graphic image is constructed representing the transaction timeline. The graphic image is then matched to a known behavior pattern using a cognitive system. The cognitive system is trained with historical timeline images having associated labels. In one example the graphic image is a bar chart and each financial transaction is represented as a bar in the bar chart having a height proportional to a transaction amount, the bar being located along a time axis of the bar chart according to the transaction date and being color coded according to the transaction type.

title: CBCT tooth segmentation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to a CBCT tooth segmentation method based on deep learning, and belongs to the field of computer graphics. The method comprises the following steps: s1: preprocessing the cone beam CBCT image by using the priori knowledge of the tooth image, and extracting a tooth part to obtain an interested region; s2: performing feature extraction on the image through a ResNet-FPN network to obtain a feature map; s3: compressing the space and channel dimensions of the feature map by using a CBAM model, thereby performing importance coding on the feature map; s4: extracting candidate regions of the feature map by using an RPN (resilient packet network); s5: pooling the corresponding region in the feature map to a fixed size feature map according to the position coordinates of the preselected box using the ROI Align; s6: and classifying, segmenting, surrounding frame regression and segmenting and scoring the candidate regions. The invention simplifies the segmentation steps and improves the tooth segmentation accuracy in the CBCT image.

title: Federal learning system and method and equipment for realizing multi-party combined processing task
assignee: 第四范式（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to a federated learning system and a method and equipment for realizing a multi-party joint processing task. The federal learning system includes at least two participants, any one of which includes at least one first node and at least one second node. At least one federated learning framework is deployed on the first node. At least one federal learning operator is deployed on the second node, and the federal learning operator is obtained by carrying out de-differentiation processing on at least part of federal learning algorithms. Responding to a task request for calling a federated learning operator, converting input parameters in the task request into a format required by a federated learning algorithm corresponding to the federated learning operator by the second node, forwarding the converted input parameters to a first node where a federated learning framework supporting the federated learning algorithm is located, and executing the federated learning algorithm by the first node based on the converted input parameters. Therefore, support is provided for facilitating the use of the heterogeneous federated learning framework by users.
assignee_clean: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司

title: Method and system for analyzing skin texture and skin lesion using artificial intelligence cloud based platform
abstract: A method and a system for analyzing skin texture and skin lesion using artificial intelligence cloud based platform are provided. The system includes an electronic device and a server. The server includes a storage device and a processor. The processor is coupled to the storage device, accesses and executes a plurality of modules stored in the storage device, the plurality of modules comprising: an information receiving module, receiving a captured image and a plurality of user parameters; a feature vector obtaining module, obtaining the first feature vector from the captured image, and the second feature vector from the plurality of user parameters; a skin parameter acquisition module, obtaining the output result of skin parameters from the first feature vector and the second feature vector; and a skin identification module, determining a skin identification result based on the output result of skin parameters.

title: Skill shortlister for natural language processing
abstract: Devices and techniques are generally described for application determination in speech processing. Input data corresponding to a spoken utterance may be received. Speech recognition processing may be performed on the input data to generate text data. A machine learning encoder may generate a vector representation of the input data. A first binary classifier may determine a first probability that the input data corresponds to a first speech-processing application. A second binary classifier may determine a second probability that the input data corresponds to a second speech-processing application. A selection between the first speech-processing application and the second speech-processing application may be made based at least in part on the first probability and the second probability.

title: Compiling processing method and device and compiling processing device
assignee: 华控清交信息科技(北京)有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a compiling processing method and device and a compiling processing device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a ciphertext processing source code based on a first programming language, wherein the ciphertext processing source code comprises a privacy operation based on a second programming language, and the privacy operation is contained in the ciphertext processing source code in a dynamic library form; and converting the ciphertext processing source code into an intermediate language code corresponding to the custom language supporting the privacy operation according to the grammar rule of the first programming language and the custom language, wherein the custom language comprises a custom operation code which is used for converting the privacy operation in the ciphertext processing source code. The embodiment of the application can compile the ciphertext processing source codes realized by different programming languages, so that the ciphertext processing system can support any programming language, the expandability of the system is enhanced, and the redevelopment cost can be reduced.
assignee_clean: 华控清交信息科技 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 华控清交信息科技 北京 有限公司

title: Deep learning framework and method for generating CT image from PET image
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning framework and a method for generating CT images from PET images. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an attenuation correction coefficient map by using the first PET image which is not subjected to attenuation correction and the corresponding second PET image which is subjected to attenuation correction through the inverse calculation of an attenuation correction mechanism; and generating fitting learning of an countermeasure network through graph-to-graph generation by utilizing the obtained attenuation correction coefficient graph, and obtaining a mapping relation between the attenuation correction coefficient graph and the CT modal image, thereby realizing the generation process from the PET image to the CT modal image. In the graph-to-graph antagonism network, the generator takes the attenuation correction coefficient graph as input, takes a CT mode image as output, and takes the input image of the generator as a judging condition of a judging device to distinguish the authenticity of the generated CT mode image. The invention can simultaneously realize PET attenuation correction and CT image reconstruction, effectively reduce CT image reconstruction difficulty by means of the attenuation correction coefficient map, and simultaneously improve CT image quality.

title: Data catalog system for generating synthetic datasets
abstract: A data catalog system that is configured to automatically generate synthetic datasets based upon original datasets cataloged by the data catalog system, wherein each synthetic dataset comprises synthetic data that is generated using one or more data generation techniques. The data catalog system may access an original dataset and harvest associated metadata information and generate catalog information for the original dataset. The data catalog system may then generate a synthetic dataset based upon the original dataset and its harvested metadata information. The data catalog system may also generate catalog information for the generated synthetic dataset. The catalog information generated for the original dataset may be updated to refer to the newly generated synthetic dataset and its catalog information. The catalog information generated for the synthetic dataset may include references to the original dataset and its catalog information to inform a user of the original dataset about the synthetic dataset.

title: Managing computing capacity in radio-based networks
abstract: Disclosed are various embodiments for managing computing capacity in radio-based networks and associated core networks. In one embodiment, it is determined that a set of computing hardware implementing a radio-based network for a customer has an excess capacity. At least one action is implemented to reallocate the excess capacity of the computing hardware.

title: Liver CT image benign and malignant classification method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a liver cancer CT image benign and malignant classification method based on deep learning, which is designed and improved on the basis of the existing Resnet34 network model, provides a model algorithm which is suitable for the liver cancer CT image benign and malignant diagnosis classification with an input image of 9 channels, and simultaneously provides a solution method for selecting slices according to different numbers of slices of different patients. The method comprises the steps of obtaining patient slices, selecting the slice with the largest liver information, preprocessing data, enhancing the processed data, inputting the data into a model for training, and realizing classification of benign and malignant liver cancer CT images. The invention not only obtains better experimental results of benign and malignant classification of the liver cancer CT image, but also realizes a whole set of process for automatically classifying the liver cancer into malignant or benign, constructs a Computer Aided Diagnosis (CAD) system which can be applied to the liver cancer aided diagnosis of a clinician, and relieves the diagnosis pressure of the clinician.

title: Pairing processes for preparing reactive cytotoxic T cells
abstract: Provided in certain embodiments are methods for pairing patient cells and donor cells to prepare cytotoxic T cells, either in vitro or, when their formation is induced in a subject, in vivo. Such cytotoxic T cells could be administered to the patient for treating certain disorders, such as a cancer (for example, brain cancer).

title: Processing method and device of electrocardiogram and remote processing method and system of electrocardiogram
assignee: 深圳市理邦精密仪器股份有限公司
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of medical detection, and provides a processing method and a device of an electrocardiogram, and a remote processing method and a system of the electrocardiogram.
assignee_clean: 深圳市理邦精密仪器股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市理邦精密仪器股份有限公司

title: Data exchange services
abstract: Technology is described for providing data exchange services. A set of definitions for a data exchange service that is accessible via a data exchange domain may be received. The data exchange service may be configured to facilitate an exchange of device reporting information transformed using the set of definitions. The exchange may be between a first device and a second device. The device reporting information may be received from the first device. The first device may be registered with the data exchange service. The device reporting information may be in accordance with the set of definitions. The device reporting information may be forwarded to a second device via the data exchange service. The device reporting information may be converted to a data format that is readable by the second device, and the device reporting information may be forwarded to a second device via the data exchange service.

title: Insertable cardiac monitor
abstract: Long-term electrocardiographic and physiological monitoring over a period lasting up to several years in duration can be provided through a continuously-recording insertable cardiac monitor. The sensing circuitry and the physical layout of the electrodes are specifically optimized to capture electrical signals from the propagation of low amplitude, relatively low frequency content cardiac action potentials, particularly the P-waves that are generated during atrial activation and storing samples of captured signals. In general, the ICM is intended to be implanted centrally and positioned axially and either over the sternum or slightly to either the left or right of the sternal midline in the parasternal region of the chest.

title: Sleep arousal analysis method based on deep learning
assignee: 郑州大学, 赛尔网络有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a sleep arousal analysis method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1, a multi-mode physiological signal in the whole sleep process of a subject is collected through a multi-lead sleep instrument, respiratory signals of the abdomen and the chest, respiratory airflow and electrooculogram are selected, meanwhile, multi-modal data obtained by filtering the EEG of the 1 st and 2 nd leads are selected and sent to model training, the acquired signals are converted into signal frequency of 200Hz, the data are subjected to sample segmentation with a sliding window of 30 seconds and a 50% overlapping rate, all samples for each dimension were then averaged and standard-deviation and the data were pre-processed by Z-Score normalization, by introducing a multi-head attention mechanism to replace a long-short term memory model and aiming at sleep signal characteristics, a large convolution kernel is designed to extract the characteristics, the method greatly improves the model training speed, reduces the model parameters and effectively improves the model analysis accuracy.
assignee_clean: 郑州大学; 赛尔网络有限公司

title: Dynamic modeler
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for dynamically modeling a page using dynamic data. One of the methods includes obtaining, from a user device associated with a first resource, a dynamic final event comprising data representing a transaction; generating, using the data representing the transaction, a task chain for a plurality of tasks, wherein generating the task chain comprises: executing a geolocation task to determine a respective geolocation of one or more resources; and determining, using the respective geolocation of the one or more resources, one or more parameters for executing each task, comprising assigning a particular resource of the dynamic modeling to a particular task according to the geolocation of the particular resource; and for each task of the plurality of tasks, executing the task according to the determined parameters of the task.

title: Systems and methods for evaluating player performance
abstract: Systems and methods relating to evaluating the performance of a person playing basketball are described. The systems and methods can be used to provide an evaluation sequence that can determine and evaluate the performance level of a person at one or more basketball skills. The evaluation sequence for the person can include a first sequence of actions that are the same each person being evaluated for a particular skill and a second sequence of actions that is based on the results of the first sequence and may be different for each person. Once the first and second sequences have been completed by the person, the system can determine a performance level for the person for the skills being evaluated.

title: Multi-modal input capture and output presentation system for enhancing communications using face coverings
abstract: Communications involving one or more people wearing face coverings are enhanced over one or more modalities using sensor integrations. In one particular example, a face covering device according to the implementations of this disclosure may include one or more microphones and one or more cameras which capture input directly from the wearer of the face covering device. The input is processed to produce output representing the input in the same modality or in a different modality, and in particular is scaled to, for example, increase a volume of audio and introduce a visual representation of an expression of the wearer's face which is at least partially obscured by the face covering device.

title: Brain disease prediction system based on resting state magnetic resonance transfer learning
abstract: The invention discloses a brain disease prediction system based on resting state magnetic resonance transfer learning, which respectively obtains a resting state magnetic resonance big data set of healthy adults and resting state magnetic resonance data of patients corresponding to brain diseases, and registers the data to a standard brain space after preprocessing; extracting time signals of each brain area through a brain map matched to a standard brain space; constructing a deep learning model by using a graph convolution network and a gating cycle network and pre-training the deep learning model based on a healthy adult big data set; and performing model fine adjustment and disease prediction based on the pre-training model and the resting state functional magnetic resonance data of the patient. The method extracts the space-time characteristics in the resting-state magnetic resonance signals, pre-trains the deep learning model by using the resting-state magnetic resonance big data set of healthy adults, fully excavates the inherent space-time characteristic mode in the resting-state magnetic resonance of the healthy adults, migrates the priori space-time characteristic mode learned from the data of the healthy adults into the brain disease prediction, and effectively improves the prediction performance of the model.

title: Deep learning regression fusion positioning method based on signal intensity
abstract: The invention provides a deep learning regression fusion positioning method based on signal intensity, and relates to the field of positioning methods based on signal intensity. The invention comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a fingerprint database in an environment to be positioned; step 2, preprocessing the data in the fingerprint database; step 3, inputting the preprocessed data into an automatic coding model for pre-training; step 4, constructing a DNN model on the basis of the automatic coding model, and then training the DNN model; step 5, constructing a CNN model and inputting the preprocessed data into the CNN model for training; step 6, fusing output probability values of the DNN model and the CNN model according to a DS evidence fusion theory, and calculating a prediction result; step 7, adjusting the DNN model and the CNN model according to an error value between the model estimation result and the real result; and 8, carrying out real-time positioning according to the adjusted classification model. The invention utilizes the complementary advantages and potentials of DNN and CNN to comprehensively extract the characteristics, and improves the positioning accuracy.

title: System and method for monitoring player performance and events in sports
abstract: Systems and methods related to assessing the performance of a person participating in an athletic event (e.g., basketball) are described. The system and method may be used to provide an assessment sequence that may determine and assess a person's performance level in one or more athletic techniques. The systems and methods described herein may also be used to monitor and control one or more clocks during a sporting event (e.g., a basketball game).

title: Automated agent behavior recommendations for call quality improvement
abstract: Disclosed herein is a method for automated agent behavior recommendations for call quality improvement. The method performed at a server includes receiving a first data record and a second data record of a plurality of data records, each comprising communication between a first party and a second party and determining a first communication originated from the first party. The method includes determining a category for each section of the plurality of sections of the first communication, and a plurality of behavior distances between different categories associated with the plurality of sections. The method includes augmenting first metadata of the first data record and second metadata of the second data record to include associated behavior distances and determining an average performance ranking of the first party to generate a recommendation to increase the average performance ranking of the first party above a preconfigured threshold.

title: System, method, and computer program product for false decline mitigation
abstract: A method, system, and computer program product for false decline mitigation. The method includes obtaining an objective function associated with an issuer system; training a neural network, based on prior transaction data associated with one or more prior transactions, to optimize the objective function; providing the trained neural network; receiving transaction data generated, based on one or more case creation (CC) rules, during processing of a transaction associated with an account identifier; processing, using the trained neural network, the transaction data to generate an exclude account list including the account identifier; receiving subsequent transaction data associated with a subsequent transaction associated with the account identifier; and authorizing, based on the exclude account list and the account identifier, the subsequent transaction associated with the account identifier without applying one or more real-time decisioning (RTD) rules to the subsequent transaction.

title: Data processing method and data processing system
abstract: The present disclosure provides a data processing method, including: acquiring at least one labeling result, wherein each labeling result is formed by labeling data of an object in an image by a corresponding user; and evaluating the annotation level of the corresponding user based on the at least one annotation result and the image. According to the data processing method, the annotation level of the user is evaluated by utilizing at least one obtained annotation result formed by labeling data of the object in the image by the at least one user, the deep learning method based on artificial intelligence is adopted under the background of big data, the technical problem that the evaluation of the annotation level in the related technology needs to consume higher cost is at least partially solved, the automatic evaluation of the annotation level is realized, and the technical effect of outputting the evaluation score of the annotation level in real time is achieved. In addition, the present disclosure also provides a data processing system.
assignee_clean: 联想 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 联想 北京 有限公司

title: Multi-task fusion neural network architecture
abstract: A method includes identifying, by at least one processor, multiple features of input data using a common feature extractor. The method also includes processing, by the at least one processor, at least some identified features using each of multiple pre-processing branches. Each pre-processing branch includes a first set of neural network layers and generates initial outputs associated with a different one of multiple data processing tasks. The method further includes combining, by the at least one processor, at least two initial outputs from at least two pre-processing branches to produce combined initial outputs. In addition, the method includes processing, by the at least one processor, at least some initial outputs or at least some combined initial outputs using each of multiple post-processing branches. Each post-processing branch includes a second set of neural network layers and generates final outputs associated with a different one of the multiple data processing tasks.

title: Detecting hypocrisy in text
abstract: Techniques are disclosed for identifying hypocrisy in text. A computer system creates, from fragments of text, a syntactic tree that represents syntactic relationships between words in the fragments. The system identifies, in the syntactic tree, a first entity and a second entity. The system further determines that the first entity is opposite to the second entity. The system further determines a first sentiment score for a first fragment comprising the first entity and a second sentiment score for a second fragment comprising the second entity. The system, responsive to determining that the first sentiment score and the second sentiment score indicate opposite emotions, identifies the text as comprising hypocrisy and providing the text to an external device.

title: Multi-channel hybrid models for efficient routing
abstract: Systems and methods are used to generate contact type predictions that route user customer service requests within a support platform. The contact type predictions are generated using a hybrid model that includes a deep learning component and a business logic component. The deep learning component may generate a multi-channel output based on text features and context features. The multi-channel output is modified based on one or more business rules to generate the contact type predictions.

title: Method and device for performing target labeling on image and computer recording medium
assignee: 京东方科技集团股份有限公司, 北京京东方技术开发有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method, an apparatus, and a computer recording medium for performing target labeling on an image, the method including: acquiring a trained first neural network for classifying the image related to the target, wherein the first neural network comprises a plurality of layers of convolutional neural networks and full-connection layers, and each layer of convolutional neural network sequentially comprises a convolutional layer, an activation function layer and a down-sampling layer; processing, by a processor, the image with the acquired multilayer convolutional neural network of the first neural network; sampling, by a processor, a large-valued spatial location of an output of an activation function layer of at least one layer of a first neural network; mapping, by a processor, outputs of down-sampled layers of respective layers to a coordinate space of an image based on a result of the large-valued spatial position sampling to obtain a mapping matrix; obtaining, by a processor, a target location mask based on a mapping matrix; labeling, by the processor, the target based on the target location mask. The training sample of the method is easier to obtain and easier to train.

title: Multi-mode multi-granularity entity identification system and entity identification method
assignee: 人民网股份有限公司, 哈尔滨工业大学
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-mode multi-granularity entity identification system and an entity identification method. The invention aims to solve the problems of partial entity identification errors and low entity identification accuracy caused by lack of modeling of fine-granularity image-text matching in the current multi-mode entity extraction model. The system comprises: the training set acquisition module is used for acquiring a training set; the entity recognition model construction module is used for constructing an entity recognition model; the entity recognition model comprises a multi-mode multi-granularity entity recognition model, a VGTR model and a CLIP model; the entity recognition model training module is used for obtaining a trained entity recognition model; the prediction module is used for inputting the matched pictures and the texts to be detected into the multi-mode multi-granularity entity recognition model in the trained entity recognition model, outputting the labeling sequence and obtaining the entities in the matched pictures and the texts to be detected. The invention is used in the fields of news, medical treatment, military and agricultural entity identification.

title: Active targeted data plane traffic monitoring for wired networks
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media for monitoring traffic in a network include receiving, at an analytics platform connected to the network, one or more encapsulated packet headers from one or more network nodes of the network. From the one or more encapsulated packet headers, at least one or more source addresses of the one or more network nodes which transmitted the encapsulated packet headers, and one or more timestamps at which the one or more encapsulated packet headers were transmitted from the one or more network nodes may be determined. From at least the one or more source addresses and timestamps, network traffic information such as one or more of latency or jitter of data packets transiting through the one or more network nodes may be determined, wherein the one or more encapsulated packet headers may correspond to the data packets transiting through the one or more network nodes.

title: Apparatus for the detection of opacities in X-ray images
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for the detection of opacities in X-ray images. It is described to provide (210) an analysis X-ray image of a region of interest of an analyzed body part. A model of a normal region of interest is provided (220), wherein the model is based on a plurality of X-ray images of the region of interest. At least one abnormality is detected (230) in the region of interest of the analyzed body part, the detection comprising comparing the analysis X-ray image of the region of interest and the model of the normal region of interest. Information is output (240) on the at least one abnormality.

title: Method, device and system for constructing indwelling needle image segmentation model and positioning needle tip
assignee: 深圳市中科微光医疗器械技术有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for constructing an indwelling needle image segmentation model, wherein the method, the device and the system can train an image segmentation model special for an indwelling needle image containing a reflecting layer area, can identify different types of indwelling needles produced by various manufacturers, adopt a target contour recognition task, improve the contour recognition precision, enable a network to extract the contour information of a target, and improve the accuracy of an indwelling needle image segmentation result, thereby improving the accuracy of the positioning of the needle tip of a later indwelling needle; and secondly, a sample image is obtained by using a matching method, the position of the needle point of the detained needle in the image can be simply and rapidly determined according to the position of the reflecting layer region by using the proportion parameters of the sample image, so that the real-time performance of needle point positioning is improved, and the needle point depth of the detained needle to be positioned is calculated by using the coordinate transformation parameters of the sample image, so that the running time of a program can be effectively saved, and the real-time performance of needle point depth positioning is improved.

title: Scanning control system and method for magnetic resonance imaging system
abstract: An embodiment of the present invention provides a scanning control system for a magnetic resonance imaging system, comprising: a first 3D camera, configured to capture a three-dimensional image of a scan subject located on a scanning table of the magnetic resonance imaging system; a processing device, configured to identify body position information of the scan subject based on the three-dimensional image; and a control device, configured to set scanning parameters related to a body position based on the body position information.

title: Data processing method of spine X-ray image
abstract: The invention relates to a data processing method of spine X-ray images, which comprises the following steps: a) The spine X-ray image is imported into a data processing center; b) Performing image recognition on the imported image; c) Measuring a preset parameter value of the identified image to obtain a group of data values; d) And c) processing the data value obtained in the step c) and outputting the processed data value. The method can help the bone doctor to accurately and rapidly process the spine X-ray image, and output and display the result, thereby greatly improving the working efficiency and quality of the surgeon.

title: Single-layer microfluidic device and methods of manufacture and use thereof
abstract: The disclosure relates to methods of manufacturing and using a single layer microfluidic for detecting target analytes, including obtaining a single layer sheet of paper; depositing wax boundaries onto the paper in a plurality of patterns including a main channel, fluid transfer channels, and an independent diagnostic area corresponding to each fluid transfer channel; melting the wax through the paper; depositing diagnostic components onto the diagnostic areas; depositing a continuous wax backing; and cutting devices from the paper. The disclosure also relates to a method of capturing an image of the micro fluidic device to generate diagnostic results corresponding to the diagnostic components by: identifying at least two panels from the image; and determining a color for each panel of the at least two panels; and generating for display, using the computing device, a graphical user-interface including at least one component visualizing the diagnostic results.

title: System and method for acoustic activity recognition
abstract: Embodiments are provided to recognize features and activities from an audio signal. In one embodiment, a model is generated from sound effect data, which is augmented and projected into an audio domain to form a training dataset efficiently. Sound effect data is data that has been artificially created or from enhanced sounds or sound processes to provide a more accurate baseline of sound data than traditional training data. The sound effect data is augmented to create multiple variants to broaden the sound effect data. The augmented sound effects are projected into various audio domains, such as indoor, outdoor, urban, based on mixing background sounds consistent with these audio domains. The model is installed on any computing device, such as a laptop, smartphone, or other device. Features and activities from an audio signal are then recognized by the computing device based on the model without the need for in-situ training.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for correcting random coincidence events
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for correcting random coincidence events. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a PET detector collects coincidence events in a coincidence time window and delay events in a delay time window, packet loss operation is conducted on the delay events to obtain partial delay events and packet loss rates, the coincidence events, the partial delay events and the packet loss rates are sent to an image reconstruction processor, the image reconstruction processor rearranges the partial delay events into chord graphs, chord graphs of all delay events collected by the PET detector are obtained through a deep learning network according to the chord graphs and the packet loss rates of the partial delay events, and random coincidence events in the coincidence events are corrected according to the chord graphs of all the delay events. By adopting the method, the occupancy rate of the PET detector to the communication bandwidth of the acquired coincidence events and the delay events when the delay events are output can be reduced, the problem that the coincidence events are lost due to the fact that the delay events occupy too much communication bandwidth is avoided, and the effect of correcting the random coincidence events is improved.

title: Prediction model system and storage medium for severe spinal cord injury prognosis
assignee: 中山大学附属第三医院（中山大学肝脏病医院）, 清华珠三角研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a prediction model system for severe spinal cord injury prognosis, which comprises the following components: establishing a clinical characteristic database of patient cases of spinal cord injury; constructing a prediction model of severe spinal cord injury prognosis; predicting a probability value of the discharge end point of the patient as death, continuing professional rehabilitation and nursing treatment and returning home according to the final prediction model, inputting the probability value into a formula 1, and giving a final prediction probability value, wherein the formula 1:the invention also discloses a recording medium readable by a computer. The invention calculates the probability of discharge end point based on clinical history and ascertains important clinical characteristics affecting the clinical result of patients with severe spinal cord injury.

title: Systems and methods for establishing sender-level trust in communications using sender-recipient pair data
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for utilizing sender-recipient pair data to establish sender-level trust in future communication. One method comprises receiving raw communication data over a network and testing the received raw communication data against trained machine learning data to predict whether the raw communication data is associated with expected communication data. The raw communication data is sorted for expected communication data, which is further analyzed for sender-recipient pair data and assigned an expected communication pair data score. Senders associated with an expected communication pair data score that meets or exceeds a threshold are labeled and stored in a database as trusted. As a result of the sender-recipient pair analysis, recipients at-risk for being scammed can be identified, senders misidentified as spammers can be properly classified, and machine learning techniques utilized for analyzing raw communication data can be fine-tuned.

title: 2D/3D spine CT non-rigid registration method based on generation of countermeasure network
abstract: The invention discloses a 2D/3D spine CT (computed tomography) non-rigid registration method based on a generation countermeasure network, which is characterized in that a 2D/3D image is downloaded firstly for training the generation countermeasure network which is constructed, then in the training process, a relative deformation parameter which can ensure to accord with human body joint constraint is trained through the generation countermeasure network, the optimal registration deformation parameter is solved through iterative optimization, and finally, a 3D image which is obtained after the 3D image to be registered before the operation passes through the optimal registration deformation parameter is taken as a final registration result, so that the registration process is realized.

title: Structural data plane monitoring
abstract: Systems and methods allow for monitoring the status of a network structure using user traffic. A fabric node (e.g., a switch, router, or other network device) may receive user traffic from a node (e.g., a network device, network appliance, or endpoint). The fabric node may match the user traffic to a tuple stored in a hardware counter matrix of the fabric node, the tuple corresponding to a count in the hardware counter matrix. The fabric node may increment a count. The fabric node may send an active probe to the node in response to the count not incrementing within a first time. The fabric node may send data to the network management system indicating a disconnection between the fabric node and the node in response to the fabric node not receiving a response to the active probe within a second time.

title: Semantic coding method of long-short term memory network based on attention dispersion
assignee: 北京理工大学, 中国人民解放军总医院第二医学中心, 海南软件职业技术学院
abstract: The invention discloses a semantic coding method of a long-term and short-term memory network based on attention dispersion, belonging to the field of natural language processing and generation. Aiming at the problems of semantic deviation, gradient disappearance, gradient explosion, incomplete fusion context information and the like in the prior art, the neural network used by the method is added with a parameter sharing unit on the basis of the BilSTM, so that the capability of acquiring and fusing bidirectional feature information by a model is enhanced; the probability of gradient problems is reduced by adopting an improved activation function in the deep learning model; for the input and hidden layers, the model is constructed by adopting an interactive space and an LSTM (local Scale TM) expansion mode, so that the capability of the model for fusing context information is enhanced; an attention dispersion mechanism of statement structure information variables is introduced, and generation of semantics is limited, so that high semantic accuracy is improved. The invention is suitable for the application of natural language generation such as automatic news writing or headline writing, robot customer service, conference or diagnosis report generation and the like.

title: Digital intelligent diagnosis method for orthodontic treatment
assignee: 杭州口腔医院集团有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an orthodontic digital intelligent diagnosis method, which comprises the steps of carrying out tooth segmentation through three-dimensional scanning and CBCT image data, constructing a three-dimensional gum model according to the position characteristics of main teeth, establishing a case database by taking three dimensional characteristics such as soft tissue characteristics, CBCT cephalogram measurement hard tissue characteristics, three-dimensional gum model characteristics and the like as case classification characteristics, realizing automatic diagnosis of diseases based on a deep learning method, and establishing a three-dimensional visual dynamic treatment process simulation method based on a collision detection mechanism of a tooth treatment process. The digital intelligent diagnosis method for orthodontic treatment, disclosed by the invention, has the advantages of reasonable structure, convenience in use, high diagnosis accuracy and the like, and effectively solves the problem of inaccurate diagnosis of the traditional orthodontic treatment.

title: Information classification method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an information classification method, an information classification device, information classification equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring information to be identified; carrying out feature extraction processing on the information to be identified to obtain feature vectors of the information to be identified; classifying the information to be identified based on the feature vector to obtain a first classification result of the information to be identified; classifying the information to be identified based on the semantic vector obtained by the feature vector conversion to obtain a second classification result of the information to be identified; and determining the category of the information to be identified from the first classification result and the second classification result. In the application, on one hand, the increment learning effectively increases the number of identifiable categories, and on the other hand, the data categories which are not identifiable aiming at increment classification can be classified in a zero sample classification mode, so that the identification capability aiming at various categories is improved.

title: Fall detection method applied to wearable terminal
assignee: 台州颐健科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a fall detection method applied to a wearable terminal, which comprises the following steps: the wearable terminal is internally provided with an NB-IOT communication module and a GPS positioning module, and performs data and instruction transmission with a communication base station through the NB-IOT communication module, and performs space positioning through the GPS positioning module; according to the acquired human body activity parameters and a plurality of physiological parameters of the user, human body activity recognition is carried out to judge whether the user falls down; if the user falls down, the communication base station receives judgment result information, the communication base station is connected with a cloud platform through a network, the cloud platform is connected to the Internet, and the Internet terminal is utilized to inform a specific relational person or a hospital of the judgment result information and the GPS position information of the user. According to the invention, the NB-IOT communication module is utilized to carry out data transmission with the communication base station, so that long-distance communication can be realized, the power consumption of the wearable terminal is reduced, and the data acquisition and analysis of blood oxygen, heart rate and body temperature are combined, so that the falling severity can be judged.

title: Outlier detection for spectroscopic classification
abstract: In some implementations, a device may determine that an unknown sample is an outlier sample by using an aggregated classification model. The device may determine that one or more spectroscopic measurements are not performed accurately based on determining that the unknown sample is the outlier sample. The device may cause one or more actions based on determining the one or more spectroscopic measurements are not performed accurately.

title: Smart timelapse video to conserve bandwidth by reducing bit rate of video on a camera device with the assistance of neural network input
abstract: An apparatus including an interface and a processor. The interface may be configured to receive pixel data generated by a capture device. The processor may be configured perform computer vision operations on the video frames to detect objects, perform a classification of the objects detected based on characteristics of the objects, determine whether the classification of the objects corresponds to an event, generate a full video stream in response to all of the video frames and generate encoded video frames. The full video stream may be recorded to a storage medium local to the apparatus. The encoded video frames may be communicated to a cloud service. The encoded video frames may comprise a first sample of the video frames selected at a first rate when the event is not detected and a second sample of the video frames selected at a second rate while the event is detected.

title: Emergency assistance response
abstract: Methods, systems, and non-transitory machine-readable media associated with an emergency assistance response are described. A system for an emergency assistance response can include a non-transitory machine-readable medium comprising a processing resource in communication with a memory resource having instructions executable to receive signaling associated with monitored health data. The instructions can be executable to track the received signaling, identify, output data representative of abnormal health data based on the tracked received signaling, and transmit the output data to a wearable device. The wearable device can receive the output data representative of the abnormal health data, provide a prompt via a user interface to a wearer of the wearable device associated with the abnormal health data, determine a response to the abnormal health data based on a reply or non-reply from the wearer via the user interface, and transmit the response to the processing resource.

title: Automated communication design construction system
abstract: A method for automatically analyzing and constructing communications to a plurality of recipients includes automatically separating communication content files into page groups in a system comprising one or more intelligent communication design servers, wherein each of the page groups is associated a recipient of the communications, inputting the communication content files into an intra-page machine prediction model to produce intra-page parameters, inputting the communication content files and the intra-page parameters into an intra-page machine prediction model to produce intra-group parameters and inter-group parameters, automatically constructing standard communication design files by an intelligent communication content learning and constructing engine based on the communication content files and the intra-page parameters, intra-group parameters, and inter-group parameters, and printing and finishing physical mailing pieces to be mailed to the recipients based on the standard communication design files.

title: Data augmentation for detour path configuring
abstract: This application is directed to augmenting training images used for generating vehicle driving models. A computer system obtains a first image of a road, identifies within the first image a drivable area of the road, obtains an image of a traffic safety object, and determines a detour path on the drivable area. The computer system determines positions of a plurality of traffic safety objects to be placed adjacent to the detour path, and generates a second image from the first image by adaptively overlaying a respective copy of the image of the traffic safety object at each of the positions of the plurality of traffic safety objects on the drivable area within the first image. The second image is added to a corpus of training images to be used by a machine learning system to generate a model for facilitating driving a vehicle (e.g., at least partial autonomously).

title: Dynamic modeler
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for dynamically modeling a page using dynamic data. One of the methods includes obtaining, from a user device associated with a first resource of a dynamic modeling system, a dynamic final event comprising data representing a transaction of the dynamic modeling system; generating, by a rule monitor of the dynamic modeling system and using the data representing the transaction, a task chain for the plurality of tasks, comprising: generating a plurality of tasks in the task chain, and determining, for each task in the task chain, one or more criteria for executing the task; and for each task of the plurality of tasks: determining, by the rule monitor, that the one or more criteria for executing the task are satisfied; and in response to determining that the one or more criteria are satisfied, executing the task.

title: Learning temporal patterns from electronic health records
abstract: In one embodiment, a computer-implemented method includes transforming a plurality of electronic health records into a plurality of temporal graphs indicating an order in which events observed in the plurality of electronic health records occur and learning a temporal pattern from the plurality of temporal graphs, wherein the temporal pattern indicates an order of events that is observed to occur repeatedly across the plurality of temporal graphs.

title: Local area rehabilitation Internet of things system for rehabilitation station
abstract: The invention discloses a local area rehabilitation Internet of things system for a rehabilitation station, which comprises a front-end equipment system consisting of a sensing system module, a rehabilitation instrument module, a data transmission module and a training display module, a service end system consisting of a local area data center, a cloud platform server, an edge computing module and a rehabilitation intelligent system, and a background management system consisting of a rehabilitation management module, a rehabilitation user module, a rehabilitation doctor module, a government monitoring module and a WEB server. According to the invention, through mutual cooperation of all system modules, a private rehabilitation exercise scheme can be customized for rehabilitation users, lifelong tracking research of patients is provided for rehabilitation doctors, massive rehabilitation data mining is provided for big data analysts, decision support of disabled patients is provided for government departments, an Internet of things + big rehabilitation exercise ecosystem is created through big data analysis means, and fine careless care at the level of professional doctors is provided for rehabilitation users with different symptoms.

title: Essential oil manufacturing
abstract: Botanical materials are dehydrated, ruptured and comminuted into particles by blades or whips in a fluidized bed. Particles separated from a drying gas are transferred to reduced pressure insulated vessels. Solvents dissolve components of the particles under precise temperature control. Solvents are recirculated and distilled to recover distillates. Distillates are refined by thermal and pressure changes to remove fats, waxes and contaminants and are fractionated to specific essential oils. The essential oils are tested, winterized, filtered, decarboxilated, polished, diluted and discharged into collection vessels. The collected essential oils are pumped through needles into sealed cartridges. The cartridges are tamper-proofed, printed and labeled with batch, botanical source, process, tracking and tracing information and codes.

title: Cervical biopsy region identification method and device based on channel information multi-mode network
abstract: The invention discloses a cervical biopsy area identification method and a device based on a channel information multi-mode network, wherein the device comprises the following steps: the image acquisition unit is used for acquiring a physiological saline image, an acetic acid image and an iodine image of the cervix; the data processing unit comprises a trained cervical biopsy region identification model, analyzes and processes the physiological saline image, the acetic acid image and the iodine image, and outputs a probability label of the cervical biopsy region; the cervical biopsy region identification model comprises: the detection network layer is used for extracting characteristic graphs and position information of cervical surface areas in the physiological saline image, the acetic acid image and the iodine image; combining the characteristics with a prediction network layer, splicing the 3 characteristic graphs and the position information on the channel dimension, and outputting a probability label of a biopsy area of the cervix through characteristic fusion and identification; and the display unit acquires and displays the probability label. The cervical biopsy region identification device can assist a doctor in accurately judging whether the cervix of a patient needs to be subjected to further biopsy.

title: Application client performance indicator management
abstract: The present disclosure describes methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications. The method includes transmitting, via the wireless network, an indication of an adjustment to one or more performance indicators of an application client operating on the UE to receive services from the edge data network, based on a UE modified performance profile of the application client, and transmitting, via the wireless network, application data traffic with the edge data network in accordance with the adjusted performance indicators. The method includes receiving, from a UE via a wireless network, an indication of an adjustment of one or more performance indicators of an application client operating on the UE, and transmitting, with the UE, application data traffic via the wireless network in accordance with the adjusted performance indicators.

title: Laser methods and systems for addressing conditions of the lens
abstract:

title: Compensated enhanced capacitance touch screen display and methods for use therewith
abstract: A capacitive touch screen display operates by: receiving a plurality of sensed signals indicating variations in mutual capacitance associated with a plurality of cross points formed by a plurality of electrodes; generating capacitance image data associated with the plurality of cross points that includes positive capacitance variation data corresponding to positive variations of the capacitance image data from a nominal value and negative capacitance variation data corresponding to negative variations of the capacitance image data from the nominal value; determining, based on the positive capacitance variation data and the negative capacitance variation data, an upper threshold and a lower threshold; generating compensated capacitance image data, based on the upper threshold and the lower threshold; and processing the compensated capacitance image data to determine a proximal condition of the touch screen display.

title: Enhanced mutual capacitance touch screen display with water compensation and methods for use therewith
abstract: A capacitive touch screen display operates by: receiving a plurality of sensed signals indicating variations in mutual capacitance associated with a plurality of cross points formed by a plurality of electrodes; generating capacitance image data associated with the plurality of cross points that includes positive capacitance variation data corresponding to positive variations of the capacitance image data from a nominal value and negative capacitance variation data corresponding to negative variations of the capacitance image data from the nominal value; identifying a presence of water on the touch screen display based on the positive capacitance variation data, and the negative capacitance variation data; generating compensated capacitance image data to compensate for effects of the water on the touch screen display in the capacitance image data; and processing the compensated capacitance image data to determine a proximal condition of the touch screen display.

title: Diagnosis knowledge sharing for self-healing
abstract: According to an aspect, there is provided a local diagnosis system comprising means for performing the following. The local diagnosis system detects one or more anomaly events associated with a communications network. Each anomaly event defines an anomaly pattern describing a data point in a performance indicator space. Then, the local diagnosis system updates one or more local cluster models to incorporate the one or more anomaly patterns within complexity constraints. Each of the one or more local cluster models corresponds to a different diagnosis label defining a diagnosis. In response to failing according to one or more per-defined criteria to incorporate, in the updating, the one or more anomaly patterns to the one or more local cluster models, the local diagnosis system forwards at least the one or more local cluster models and one or more associated diagnosis labels to a central diagnosis system for further diagnosis.

title: Fair anomaly detection and localization
abstract: Described are techniques for fair anomaly detection. The techniques include generating an anomaly detection model based on a Gaussian distribution of historical data, a mean vector of the Gaussian distribution, and a precision matrix of the Gaussian distribution. The mean vector and the precision matrix can be generated by reducing a function below a threshold, where the function can include the Gaussian distribution, a first regularization term configured to generate similar anomaly scores for inputs with similar fair features and independent of unfair features, and a second regularization term configured to generate similar anomaly localization scores for the inputs with the similar fair features and independent of the unfair features. The techniques further include inputting a new data to the anomaly detection model and generating an anomaly score and an anomaly localization score associated with the new data based on the Gaussian distribution, the mean vector, and the precision matrix.

title: Image analysis-based patient motion monitoring system and method for providing the same
abstract: A patient motion monitoring system based on image analysis according to one technical aspect of the present invention includes: at least one edge terminal provided in a hospital room where a patient lives to continuously generate a plurality of photographed images, and configured to extract a human object with respect to each of the plurality of photographed images to estimate a pose, thereby generating a plurality of pose information; and a motion recognition server configured to group the plurality of pose information at different time intervals and recognize a motion by applying a deep learning model to skeleton data with respect to the pose information grouped at different time intervals. The motion recognition server may compare the estimated motion with a preset notification event requirement, and provide a corresponding notification event to a guardian terminal when the estimated motion corresponds to the notification event requirement. According to one embodiment of the present invention, it is possible to accurately monitor a condition of the patient.

title: Multiplier, data processing method, chip and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a multiplier, a data processing method, a chip and electronic equipment, wherein the multiplier comprises: multiplication circuit, register control circuit, register circuit, state control circuit and selection circuit; the multiplication circuit comprises a regular signed number coding sub-circuit and an accumulation sub-circuit, the output end of the regular signed number coding sub-circuit is connected with the input end of the accumulation sub-circuit, the output end of the accumulation sub-circuit is connected with the first input end of the register control circuit, the output end of the register control circuit is connected with the input end of the register circuit, the output end of the register circuit is connected with the first input end of the selection circuit, the first output end of the state control circuit is connected with the second input end of the register control circuit, the second output end of the state control circuit is connected with the second input end of the selection circuit, the multiplier can perform regular signed number coding on received data, the number of obtained effective partial products is small, and the complexity of the multiplier for realizing multiplication operation is reduced.

title: Method and device for setting playing parameters
assignee: 北京京东尚科信息技术有限公司, 北京京东世纪贸易有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for setting playing parameters, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises: generating playing information containing state data and local playing parameters of the player; sending the playing information to a server; receiving a remote playing parameter generated by the server according to the playing information; and replacing the local playing parameter by the remote playing parameter. The implementation method can set the playing parameters of the player in a targeted manner, and improves the transmission quality of the multimedia information, thereby improving the user experience.

assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a multiplier, a data processing method, a chip and electronic equipment, wherein the multiplier comprises: the output end of the judging circuit is connected with the first input end of the regular signed number coding circuit, the output end of the data expanding circuit is connected with the second input end of the regular signed number coding circuit, the output end of the regular signed number coding circuit is connected with the input end of the compression circuit, and the multiplier can perform regular signed number coding on received data through the regular signed number coding circuit, so that the number of obtained effective partial products is small, and the complexity of multiplication operation realized by the multiplier is reduced.
