title: Ultrasonic imaging method and ultrasonic imaging equipment
assignee: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an ultrasonic imaging method which is applied to ultrasonic imaging equipment and comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional volume data of a first tissue to be tested; identifying three-dimensional data of a fetal spinal column and three-dimensional data of fetal ribs from the three-dimensional data of the first tissue to be tested; rendering the three-dimensional data of the fetal spinal column and the three-dimensional data of the fetal rib to obtain a three-dimensional ultrasonic image of the fetal rib structure; marking the fetal ribs in the three-dimensional ultrasonic image of the fetal rib structure; outputting the marked three-dimensional ultrasonic image of the fetal rib structure. The embodiment of the application discloses ultrasonic imaging equipment.

title: Image processing apparatus and magnetic resonance imaging apparatus
abstract: An image processing apparatus according to an embodiment includes a processor and a memory. The memory stores processor-executable instructions that, when executed by the processor, cause the processor to: receive an input of information designating an observation target; extract, from each of magnetic resonance (MR) images included in an MR image group collected by applying a tagging pulse to a region where a fluid flows, a group of regions of the fluid; analyze, by an analyzing method associated with the observation target, the group of regions of the fluid extracted from each of the MR images, thereby deriving an index indicating a dynamic state of the fluid; and cause the index to be displayed on a display.

title: System and method for vehicle system control based on physiological traits
assignee: 通用汽车环球科技运作有限责任公司
abstract: The invention relates to a system and a method for vehicle system control based on physiological traits. Systems and methods for controlling a vehicle based on a physiological trait are provided. The method comprises the following steps: receiving physiological data from one or more physiological sensors; processing, by a processor, the received physiological data to determine one or more physiological conditions; and outputting one or more control signals to the vehicle system to control operation of the vehicle system based on the determined physiological condition.

title: Slice image display apparatus, method and recording-medium having stored therein program
abstract: A shadow area in a lung-field area of a subject is detected from tomographic images constituting a three-dimensional image representing the subject. A hilum-of-lung area in the lung-field area of the subject is detected from the tomographic images. Further, a slice image that passes through a first point that is a predetermined point in the detected shadow area, a second point that is a predetermined point in the detected hilum-of-lung area, and an arbitrary point that has been set in advance is generated. The generated slice image is displayed.

title: Methods for subtyping of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
assignee: Genecentric Therapeutics, Inc., The University Of North Carolina At Chapel Hill
abstract: Methods and compositions are provided for determining a subtype of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) of an individual by detecting the expression level of at least one classifier biomarker selected from a group of gene signatures for HNSCC. Also provided herein are methods and compositions for determining the response of an individual with a HNSCC subtype to a therapy such as immunotherapy.

title: Model-based therapy parameters for heart failure
abstract: A method includes determining that a patient has heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF); configuring a cardiovascular (CV) model using patient characterization data; determining one or more therapy parameters using output data of the CV model; and administering HFpEF therapy based on the one or more therapy parameters.

title: Image segmentation method of liver CT image based on clustering
assignee: 山东奥洛瑞医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image segmentation method of liver CT images based on clustering, which relates to the technical field of medical image processing and comprises the steps of obtaining an abdomen CT original image; acquiring a gray level histogram and a gray level gradient histogram of a CT original image; dividing the gray value of a pixel point in a CT original image into a plurality of gray value intervals; acquiring edge feature pixel points in a CT original image; obtaining the clustering matching degree of each gray value interval; acquiring the pixel point aggregation degree of each gray value interval; acquiring a clustering initial pixel point of each target gray value interval; clustering the pixel points in the CT original image according to the clustering initial pixel points in each target gray value interval in the CT original image to finish the segmentation of the CT original image; the invention solves the technical problems of poor segmentation effect and high calculation redundancy when the K-means clustering method is used for segmenting the liver CT image in the related technology.

title: Eye imaging apparatus with sequential illumination and a syntactic image analyzing method
abstract: Various embodiments of the disclosure comprise an eye imaging system including an eye imaging apparatus and an eye imaging computing apparatus. The eye imaging apparatus can be configured to receive a plurality of images of the eye with a same field of view while each portion of the eye is illuminated time-sequentially. The image computing apparatus can comprise an image processing unit configured to combine the plurality of images into a composite image. Various embodiments of the disclosure comprise a syntactic image analyzing method. The syntactic image analyzing method can comprise aligning a plurality of images of an eye with a same field of view and combining the plurality of images into a composite image. The image analyzing method can further comprise analyzing each image by identifying a boundary line of a clear portion and gradually removing an unclear portion in each image.

title: Distal end assembly guidance
abstract: In one embodiment, a catheter alignment system includes a catheter to be inserted into a body part, and including catheter electrodes to contact tissue at respective locations within the body part, a display, and processing circuitry to receive signals provided by the catheter, assess respective levels of contact of ones of the catheter electrodes with the tissue of the body part responsively to the received signals, find a direction in which the catheter should be moved to improve at least one of the respective levels of contact of at least one of the catheter electrodes responsively to the respective levels of contact of the ones of the catheter electrodes, and render to the display a representation of the catheter responsively to the received signals, and a direction indicator indicating the direction in which the catheter should be moved responsively to the found direction.

title: Gene-expression profiling with reduced numbers of transcript measurements
assignee: Massachusetts Institute Of Technology, The Broad Institute, Inc., Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Inc.
abstract: The present invention provides compositions and methods for making and using a transcriptome-wide gene-expression profiling platform that measures the expression levels of only a select subset of the total number of transcripts. Because gene expression is believed to be highly correlated, direct measurement of a small number (for example, 1,000) of appropriately-selected transcripts allows the expression levels of the remainder to be inferred. The present invention, therefore, has the potential to reduce the cost and increase the throughput of full-transcriptome gene-expression profiling relative to the well-known conventional approaches that require all transcripts to be measured.
assignee_clean: massachusetts institute of technology; the broad institute; dana-farber cancer institute

title: Segment-based flash suppression in ultrasound color flow
abstract: Flash suppression is provided in motion imaging. Separate regions of motion in a same frame or image are tested for flash independently. The size, shape, spatial variance, and/or location of a given region are used to categorize a level or likelihood of flash artifact for that region. Based on the level or likelihood, the motion information is altered to reduce flash.

title: Autonomous ambulance
abstract: The present invention pertains to the development of a ground autonomous ambulance that is designed to follow routes that is comprised of an autonomous vehicle that includes a drive by wire kit, a database storing the collection routes, a database of rules of the road and/or other legal allowable behavior, sensors for detecting the pedestrians, cars, and other road obstacles, and a control system that controls the vehicle to follow routes and which is capable of carrying and securing a stretcher or wheelchair. The autonomous ambulance also has a robotic stretcher which is used for transporting patients from their residences or other emergency locations to the ambulance.

title: Movement-based comfort adjustment
assignee: Volkswagen Ag, Porsche Ag, Bentley Motors Limited
abstract: Devices, systems, and methodologies for providing a comfort system of a transportation vehicle include capturing and assessing movement data of a user. The movement data can include movement data captured upon the user's approach to the transportation vehicle.

title: ICD code conversion method, ICD code conversion device, computing equipment and storage medium
assignee: 杭州火树科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an ICD code conversion method, an ICD code conversion device, a computing device and a storage medium, wherein the ICD code conversion method comprises the following steps: extracting and preprocessing ICD doublet { name class, coding class }; performing a fine transformation for each preprocessed ICD doublet, comprising: performing association matching on the ICD binary sets relative to the standard ICD binary sets { standard name class and standard ICD coding class }, and screening to obtain associated ICD binary sets as a fine transformation result; performing a coarse transformation for each unassociated ICD tuple, comprising: and calculating the similarity score of the name class and each standard name class, and the distance score of the code class and each standard ICD code class, and screening and determining a group { standard name class and standard ICD code class } with the highest score by combining the similarity score and the distance score as a rough conversion result of the ICD binary group. The coding efficiency and the coding accuracy are improved, and the workload of a coder is reduced.

title: Processes and systems for onboarding data for a digital duplicate
abstract: Disclosed herein is a process that involves retrieving a data model for a data source, establishing at least one filter operation or at least one clean operation that modifies an aspect of the retrieved data model, onboarding underlying data from the data source while applying the established at least one filter operation or at least one clean operation, defining at least one transformation operation to apply to a portion of the underlying data that has been onboarded, and applying the at least one transformation operation to the portion of the underlying data to thereby assign the data to a semantic network, the semantic network comprising conceptual data components and associative data components.

title: Data security using semantic services
abstract: Disclosed herein is a process that involves receiving an indication of an instance of a semantic network, the semantic network comprising conceptual data components and associative data components, receiving a selection of one or more of the conceptual data components and associative data components of the instance of the semantic network, the selection comprising an indication to block the selected one or more conceptual data components and associative data components or selectively filter the selected one or more conceptual data components and associative data components, and presenting a visualization of the semantic network, the visualization being configured to exclude data related to the selected one or more conceptual data components and associative data components or include data related to the selected one or more conceptual data components and associative data components and exclude data not related to the selected one or more conceptual data components and associative data components.

title: Digital duplicate
abstract: Disclosed herein is new approach for structuring an organization's data, involving at a high level establishing a digital context and populating the digital context with digital content to thereby form what is referred to herein as a digital duplicate. In one aspect, the disclosed approach may be embodied in a computer-implemented method that involves: establishing a data structure comprising (i) a structural context that has at least one data component, where each component of the structural context has associated therewith one or more respective data properties (ii) a semantic context that has at least two data types that further describe individual data properties and; and populating underlying data into an instance of the data structure such that underlying data populated into each respective property of the at least one data component has each of the at least two data types of the semantic context.

title: Electrogram annotation system
abstract: In an embodiment, an electrogram (EGM) processing system provides, for display by a head-mounted display (HMD) worn by a user, a holographic rendering of intracardiac geometry. The HMD also displays an electrogram waveform. The EGM processing system determines a gaze direction of the user by processing sensor data from the HMD. The HMD displays a marker overlaid on the electrogram waveform at a location based on an intersection point between the gaze direction and the electrogram waveform. The EGM processing system determines a measurement of the electrogram waveform using the location of the marker. The HMD displays the measurement of the electrogram waveform.

title: Prediction method and prediction model for predicting tissue trace element content based on intestinal flora
assignee: 广东省科学院微生物研究所(广东省微生物分析检测中心)
abstract: The invention discloses a prediction method and a prediction model for predicting tissue trace element content based on intestinal flora. Based on the relative abundance data of fecal flora grade, a decision tree is constructed by combining a random forest model with a cross validation method to establish a prediction model, and the importance of each strain in the prediction model is judged according to an MDA value, so that the most key strain for determining grouping is screened out; based on the relative abundance data of fecal flora grade or the screened most key strains, the iron content of each tissue of the sample is predicted by using LAS SO regression, a regression model is established, and the prediction model with the highest accuracy and based on the intestinal flora prediction tissue microelement content is screened out. The invention does not need puncture or blood drawing, and does not cause additional damage to the testee, thereby causing inevitable medical accidents.

title: Apparatus and method of monitoring VR sickness prediction model for virtual reality content
abstract: Disclosed is an apparatus and method of monitoring a VR (Virtual Reality) sickness prediction model for virtual reality content. A method of monitoring a VR sickness prediction model according to the present disclosure includes: displaying the virtual reality content on a display unit; acquiring an user input; analyzing the virtual reality content on a basis of the acquired user input; and displaying an analysis result for the virtual reality content on the display unit.

title: Data processor, method, chip and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a data processor, a method, a chip and electronic equipment, wherein the data processor comprises a first multiplication operation circuit, a second multiplication operation circuit and a partial product exchange circuit, the first multiplication operation circuit comprises a first correction coding sub-circuit and a first correction compression sub-circuit, the second multiplication operation circuit comprises a second correction coding sub-circuit and a second correction compression sub-circuit, and the data processor can carry out regular signed number coding processing on received data, so that the number of the obtained effective partial products is small, and the complexity of the data processor for realizing multiplication or multiply-accumulate operation is reduced.

title: Drug information storage method based on distributed edge calculation and multi-mode data
assignee: 天津民祥生物医药股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, in particular to a medicine information storage method based on distributed edge calculation and multi-mode data, which comprises the following steps: step S1: selecting an embedded system suitable for edge computing as edge equipment, and customizing an operating system and a software stack of the equipment to meet the requirements of drug information acquisition, storage and processing; step S2: collecting multi-modal data of a drug, wherein the multi-modal data comprises text data, image data and video data; step S3: and establishing a multi-mode data fusion and processing module on the edge equipment, and processing and analyzing the acquired multi-mode data in real time by utilizing a lightweight deep learning model. According to the invention, through a collaboration and optimization mechanism between the edge devices and intelligent distribution and scheduling of the edge computing tasks based on deep reinforcement learning, interconnection and intercommunication of data and resource sharing are promoted, and efficient integration and unified management of drug information are realized.

title: System and method for automated sequencing database generation
abstract: Systems and methods for automated sequencing database generation are disclosed herein. The system can include memory that can include a content library database; a graph database; and a model database. The system can include a user device and at least one server. The at least one server can: receive a content aggregation from the content library database; identify content components of the content aggregation based on a natural language processing analysis of at least a portion of the content aggregation; identify explicit sequencing of the content components; generate an intermediate content graph based on the explicit sequencing of the content components; generate a final content graph from the intermediate content graph based on implicit sequencing of the content components; and store the final content graph within the graph database.

title: Blood vessel simulation analysis method, device, apparatus, computer device and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a blood vessel simulation analysis method, a blood vessel simulation analysis device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the computer equipment constructs a three-dimensional model of the target blood vessel section according to at least two-dimensional image sequences of the target blood vessel section, obtains the position of a cutting surface of the three-dimensional model, and calculates the average blood flow rate of the target blood vessel section according to the gray value gradient of the position of the cutting surface of the three-dimensional model and the image frames corresponding to the positions of the cutting surfaces, so that simulation calculation is carried out according to the three-dimensional model of the target blood vessel section, preset boundary conditions and a preset simulation model, and the simulation result of the target blood vessel section is obtained. In the method, the computer equipment can identify the gray value gradient of the inlet position and the gray value gradient of the outlet position of the target blood vessel section and calculate the average blood flow velocity, so that the simulation result of the target blood vessel section obtained based on the average blood flow velocity is more accurate.

title: Method for transmitting sidelink signal in wireless communication system
abstract: Disclosed in various embodiments of the present disclosure are a method for transmitting and receiving a signal in a wireless communication system, and a device for supporting same. As a more specific embodiment, disclosed in various embodiments of the present disclosure are a method by which a user equipment transmits a sidelink signal in a wireless communication system, and a device for supporting same, the method comprising: transmitting a first sidelink signal in a sidelink channel allocated to the user equipment during a first time interval, wherein the sidelink channel is linked with a specific service; and transmitting a second sidelink signal in the sidelink channel during a second time interval positioned after the first time interval in a time domain, wherein the first sidelink signal and the second sidelink signal are transmitted on the basis of a first parameter and a second parameter linked with the specific service, respectively, and the first parameter and the second parameter have different values on the basis of interference between the sidelink channel and a sidelink channel that is adjacent to the sidelink channel in a frequency domain.

title: Operation method of UE related to sidelink DRX timer in wireless communication system
abstract: One embodiment relates to a method for sidelink related operation of a receiving (RX) user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system, the method comprising the steps in which: the RX UE receives first SCI from a transmitting UE (TX UE) through a physical sidelink control channel (PSCCH); and the RX UE receives a physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH) and second SCI from the TX UE on the basis of the first SCI, wherein the second SCI includes information about activating physical sidelink feedback channel (PSFCH) transmission related to the PSSCH, and whether to start a retransmission timer on the basis of the PSFCH transmission being dropped is determined on the basis of whether the dropped PSFCH transmission is related to either NACK or ACK.

title: Method of operating UE in relation to as configuration in wireless communication system
abstract: A method of operating a first user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system is disclosed. The method includes performing an access stratum (AS) configuration procedure with a second UE by the first UE, and transmitting a radio resource control (RRC) message to a base station (BS) based on failure of the AS configuration procedure by the first UE. The RRC message includes information about a destination identifier (ID) of a unicast link related to the failure of the AS configuration procedure.

title: Method and device for allocating resource for sidelink signal in wireless communication system
abstract: One embodiment relates to a method for transmitting and receiving a signal by means of a base station in a wireless communication system, comprising the steps of: transmitting, to a first terminal, a signal for allocating a resource for a sidelink signal; receiving, from the first terminal, information on the number of one or more Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request (HARQ) Non-ACKnowledgement (NACK) feedbacks for the sidelink signal; and transmitting, to the first terminal, information for allocating a resource for the next sidelink signal, wherein the number of resources for the next sidelink signal is determined on the basis of information on the number of one or more HARQ NACK feedbacks for the sidelink signal.

title: Method by which rsus transmit and receive signals in wireless communication system
abstract: Disclosed in one embodiment is a method for performing an operation for a first road side unit (RSU) in a wireless communication system, comprising the steps of: transmitting a first message to a second RSU; and receiving a second message from the second RSU, wherein the first message includes position information and a first position list of the first RSU, the second message includes position information and a second position list of the second RSU, and the first position list is updated with the position information and the second position list of the second RSU.

title: UE operation method related to sidelink PTRS in wireless communication system
abstract: An embodiment is a method for a user equipment (UE) to transmit a phase-tracking reference signal (PTRS) related to sidelink in a wireless communication system, the method comprising the steps of: generating demodulation reference signals (DMRSs) related to a physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH); generating a PTRS related to the PSSCH; and transmitting the PTRS and at least a portion of the DMRSs, wherein a DMRS sequence mapped to a prescribed position in a first PSSCH symbol in which the DMRSs are transmitted is used for generating the PTRS, and the prescribed position corresponds to a frequency location at which the PTRS is transmitted and includes a frequency location at which the generated DMRSs are not transmitted.

title: Sidelink discovery-related operation method in wireless communication system
abstract: One embodiment is a sidelink discovery-related UE operation method in a wireless communication system, the operation method comprising the steps in which: the UE generates a discovery message; and the UE transmits the discovery message, wherein the discovery message is delivered to a Medium Access Control (MAC) layer through a logical channel (LCH), and the LCH has a fixed Logical Channel Identity (LCID) and a fixed priority for the discovery.

title: Method for transmitting sidelink signal in wireless communication system
abstract: The method for transmitting, by a user equipment, a sidelink signal in a wireless communication system is a sidelink signal transmission method comprising: transmitting sidelink control information (SCI); mapping, to a plurality of sub-carriers, at least one complex-valued modulation symbol, which is related to a sidelink data signal, and a preset value; generating the sidelink data signal by modulating the at least one complex-valued modulation symbol and the preset value by orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM); and transmitting the sidelink data signal on the basis of the SCI, wherein the SCI comprises information regarding a sub-carrier set including at least one sub-carrier, to which the preset value is mapped, from among the plurality of sub-carriers, and at least one of the location and number in a frequency domain of the at least one sub-carrier, to which the preset value is mapped, is different for each sub-carrier set.

title: Operation method of UE related to sidelink CSI report in wireless communication system
abstract: Provided in some implementations is a sidelink-related operation method of a first user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system, including the steps in which: a first UE receives, from a second UE, a physical sidelink control channel (PSCCH) including modulation coding scheme (MCS) information; a channel status information reference signal (CSI-RS) and a physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH) related to the PSCCH are received; CSI is derived on the basis of the CSI-RS; and the first UE transmits, to the second UE, a CSI report including the CSI, wherein the CSI is derived on the basis of the determination of an MCS table.

title: Operating method of UE related to sidelink communication and feedback transmission resource in wireless communication system
abstract: Disclosed in one embodiment is an operating method of a sidelink receiving terminal in a wireless communication system, comprising the steps of: receiving a physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH); and transmitting a physical sidelink feedback channel (PSFCH) after receiving the PSSCH, wherein the receiving terminal performs Tx/Rx switching in one part of a first symbol, which is the symbol after the last symbol in which the PSSCH is received, transmits a signal related to automatic gain control (AGC) in the remaining part of the first symbol, and transmits the PSFCH in the symbol after the first symbol.

title: Speech recognition method and device
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure discloses a voice recognition method and a voice recognition device, and relates to the technical field of voice and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring first N candidate recognition results of a voice recognition model aiming at the recognition scores output by the voice to be recognized, wherein N is a positive integer greater than 1; respectively scoring the N candidate recognition results based on the pronunciation similarity of the candidate recognition results and pre-collected popular entities to obtain the similarity score of each candidate recognition result; and synthesizing the recognition scores and the similarity scores of the candidate recognition results, and determining the recognition result corresponding to the voice to be recognized from the N candidate recognition results. The present disclosure can improve recognition accuracy.

title: Interactive image segmentation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an interactive image segmentation method, an interactive image segmentation device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method can be applied to the technical fields of image segmentation, artificial intelligence, maps and the like, and comprises the following steps: acquiring an interaction characteristic diagram generated after interaction operation is executed on an image to be segmented; extracting features of the interaction feature map and the image to be segmented to obtain a depth feature map; fusing the depth feature map and the image to be segmented, and carrying out Gaussian posterior inference based on the fusion result to obtain a weight space prior term and a function space update term corresponding to each pixel in the image to be segmented; determining the classification probability of each pixel belonging to a target object in the image to be segmented according to the weight space prior term and the function space update term; and dividing the target object from the image to be divided based on the classification probability. By adopting the method, the accuracy of image segmentation can be effectively improved.

title: Data processing device, method and related product
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a data processing apparatus, method and related products. The data processing means may be comprised as computing means in a combined processing means, which combined processing means may also comprise interface means and other processing means. The computing device interacts with other processing devices to collectively perform a user-specified computing operation. The combined processing means may further comprise storage means connected to the computing means and the other processing means, respectively, for storing data of the computing means and the other processing means. According to the scheme, parallelism among different storage units is fully utilized, and the utilization rate of each functional component is improved.

title: Implementing a domain adaptive semantic role labeler
abstract: A computer-implemented method according to one embodiment includes identifying features of a plurality of data instances within a target domain; assigning weights to the plurality of data instances within the target domain, based on similarities among the features; selecting a subset of the plurality of data instances within the target domain, based on the weights; associating expert annotations with respective ones of data instances within the subset; and training a machine learning algorithm, utilizing the subset of the plurality of data instances and associated expert annotations.

title: Vascular image segmentation method, device, equipment and medium based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a blood vessel image segmentation method, a device, equipment and a medium based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a blood vessel segmentation data set; performing data expansion processing on the blood vessel segmentation data set to obtain a blood vessel image to be processed; preprocessing the blood vessel image to be processed to obtain a training data set; constructing a blood vessel segmentation model through an UNET network according to the training data set; and determining an evaluation result of the blood vessel segmentation result according to the blood vessel segmentation model, wherein the evaluation result is used for determining a correctly predicted object and a incorrectly predicted object in the blood vessel segmentation result. The invention can improve the definition of the blood vessel edge segmentation and reduce the capillary vessel omission ratio, and can be widely applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence.

title: Gene sequence representation learning method based on virus propagation network
assignee: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学
abstract: The invention discloses a gene sequence representation learning method based on a virus propagation network, which comprises the following steps: coding a virus gene sequence, and inputting the sequence code into a hidden layer with a specific length to obtain dimension reduction embedding; extracting a neighbor node set with high association degree with each node in the virus transmission network, and acquiring topology information of the nodes from the virus transmission network; adopting a forward LSTM and a backward LSTM to respectively aggregate the graph context node information of the nodes; aggregating the sequence information of the neighbor nodes by using an attention mechanism to obtain a new expression of the target node gene sequence; and (3) performing model training and target optimization on the gene sequence representation model by adopting graph context loss as a loss function. The effectiveness and the high efficiency of the invention are verified by experiments carried out on a simulated virus transmission network, a real new coronavirus transmission network occurring in a certain country and a real AIDS virus transmission network.

title: Systems and methods for application traffic simulation using captured flows
abstract: Application performance can be simulated based on captured application-specific traffic flows through a managed network. Traffic flows may be captured across the managed network and associated with a particular application. The captured flows can be used to generate trend lines and models. The generated trend lines and models may be used to simulate application performance responsive to changes in network characteristics and provided to a user through a graphical user interface as a graph. The user may then adjust simulated network characteristics through the graphical user interface to perform various hypothetical network simulations.

title: Automatic provisioning of network components
abstract: The present disclosure is directed to systems and methods that enable automatic provisioning of access points within an enterprise network by a controller of the enterprise network. In one aspect, a method includes detecting, at a network controller, attachment of a first access point to a network; identifying, by the network controller, a profile of a second access point, the second access point having being replaced with the first access point, the profile including at least one of identification parameters and configuration parameters of the second access point; and provisioning, by the network controller, the first access point with the profile of the second access point.

title: Voice-enabled communication configurations
abstract: Systems and methods for voice-enabled configurations for audio-output devices are disclosed. User accounts may be associated with one or more voice-enabled devices. Those voice-enabled devices may include audio-output functionality, while other voice-enabled devices do not include audio-output functionality. For devices without audio-output functionality, sending and/or receiving calls and/or messages may depend on whether the device is connected to an auxiliary device with audio-output functionality, via wired and/or wireless connection. Notifications of whether calling and/or messaging is enabled may be sent to the sending and/or receiving devices.

title: Medical system for remote multi-sensor monitoring
assignee: 河南省中医院（河南中医药大学第二附属医院）
abstract: A medical system of remote multi-sensor monitoring, characterized by: the system comprises a hospital system, a home system and a remote monitoring center, wherein the hospital system comprises a medical examination device, a patient state grading module, an intelligent diagnosis module and a data integration server, and the home system comprises a portable multi-sensor monitoring device.

title: Method and system for jointly updating business model
assignee: 支付宝(杭州)信息技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a system and a method for updating a business model, and federal learning is divided into two stages. In the first stage, the data parties jointly determine global model parameters. And in the second stage, after the global model parameters are issued to each data party, each data party updates the local business model by using the global model parameters and further updates the local business model parameters by using the local business data, thereby obtaining the business model more suitable for the local business data. In the process that all data parties determine the global model parameters together in the first stage, all data parties can update the model parameters by using the disturbed gradient and feed the updated model parameters back to the server, so that the local data privacy is protected more favorably. In summary, the scheme for jointly updating the business model provided by the embodiments of the present specification can improve the effectiveness of federal learning.

title: Antenna selection and device orientation
abstract: Systems may provide feedback that may include antenna selection or mobile device configuration. Antennas may be automatically configured throughout the device or the orientation or location of the mobile device may be altered to increase performance. Historical performance information of the mobile device may be maintained in order to determine proactive manipulations of the mobile device. In addition, multiple mobile devices may cooperatively determine the orientation or location that may increase performance.

title: Image recognition method, image recognition device and computer-readable storage medium
assignee: 平安国际智慧城市科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image identification method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a working area video acquired by monitoring equipment; extracting an image containing a user from the working area video, wherein the image contains a human body target area of the user; determining a human head region in the human target region according to the head-shoulder feature matching template; extracting the directional gradient histogram characteristics and the color characteristics of the human head region; inputting the directional gradient histogram features into a first support vector machine model for human body classification, and determining whether the identified human head region contains a head target; if yes, inputting the color features into a second support vector machine model for color classification, and determining the color of the head target; and if the color of the head target is not the preset hat color, determining that the user does not wear the hat. The invention also provides an image recognition device and a computer readable storage medium. The invention can identify the violation that the user does not wear the hat, and is beneficial to improving the supervision efficiency.

title: Method for assisting implant replacement based on deep learning and auxiliary intelligent system
assignee: 杭州柳叶刀机器人有限公司
abstract: A method for assisting implant replacement based on deep learning, an assisting intelligent system and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the system is used for acquiring tooth information through segmentation of 2-dimensional images of teeth to assist in selection of implants and for assisting design of a preoperative implant plan through prediction of cavity data at alveolar bones of a dental implant area, and comprises the following steps: the panoramic image generation unit is used for converting 3-dimensional oral cavity data CBCT of the image file to be processed of the tooth into image data in a 2-dimensional panoramic format; the tooth segmentation unit is used for inputting the image data into a preset image classification model for segmentation so as to obtain the segmented image data of the teeth; and the alveolar bone information prediction unit is used for performing feature extraction on the segmentation image data by using a preset feature extraction model so as to determine alveolar bone related cavity data. Therefore, doctors can be assisted in judging the tooth condition of patients to select proper implants, and the design of the preoperative implantation scheme is assisted by predicting alveolar bone cavity data.

title: Personal safety monitoring
abstract: A baseline historical record for a person is formed by monitoring information about the person derived from at least one information source over a baseline period of time. A baseline pattern of behavior of the person is established by applying analytic analysis to the baseline historical record. A current pattern of behavior of the person is determined by monitoring current information about the person derived from the at least one information source. A behavior change assessment is determined by comparing the current pattern of behavior to the baseline pattern of behavior. Whether the behavior change assessment for the person meets at least one safety concern criterion is determined by comparing the behavior change assessment to safety concern criteria comprising the at least one safety concern criterion. Responsive to determining the behavior change assessment for the person meets the at least one safety concern criterion, an action is automatically performed.

title: Dyskinesia assessment video analysis method and equipment with privacy protection function
abstract: The application provides a movement disorder assessment video analysis method and equipment with a privacy protection function, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a dyskinesia assessment video; carrying out face changing treatment on the characters in the video; identifying key points in the video after face changing processing; and determining the movement characteristics for assisting in diagnosing the diseases according to the change of the key points along with the video recording time. According to the movement disorder assessment video analysis method and the movement disorder assessment video analysis device, the movement disorder assessment video is processed to obtain the video after face change, and the video can keep the expression and the light shadow of the user and has the appearance of the public character, so that the purpose of protecting the privacy of the user is achieved. The key points of the human body are extracted from the dyskinesia assessment video, and the change of the key points along with the video progress is monitored to determine the movement characteristics related to the diseases, so that the quantifiable disease key diagnosis index is obtained, and a doctor can be effectively assisted in diagnosing related diseases.

title: Interactive image segmentation method based on Transformer
assignee: 厦门瑞为信息技术有限公司, 厦门理工学院
abstract: The invention discloses a method for segmenting an interactive image based on a transducer, which comprises the steps of selecting an image to be annotated, and loading the image to be annotated into interactive image segmentation annotation software; selecting a segmentation target, generating a click record according to the click action of a user, and generating a click mark at a corresponding position; after the interaction is confirmed, converting the interaction into a circular graph according to the click record, splicing the circular graph serving as a corresponding positive and negative click guide with an original mask, and adding the circular graph to the original graph to serve as a segmentation model to input; dividing a designated target in the image by using a pre-training dividing model, and returning to an initial dividing mask; selecting to add proper positive and negative clicks to mark the error region again according to the initial segmentation mask result; the new marker is fed into the segmentation model again and the corrected result is returned. And in this way, the segmentation result is refined to obtain a satisfactory result. The invention can improve the segmentation labeling performance of the interactive image and obtain better segmentation results with fewer interaction times.

title: System and method for automated angiography utilizing a neural network
abstract: A method for analyzing computed tomography angiography (CTA) data is provided. The method includes receiving, at a processor, three-dimensional (3D) CTA data. The method also includes automatically, via the processor, detecting objects of interest within the 3D CTA data. The method further includes generating, via the processor, a CTA image volume that only includes the objects of interest.

title: Method and apparatus for emergency alert in client devices
abstract: Emergency notification systems, such as Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS) and AMBER alerts, as well as emergency help request systems, such as E911, are generally centralized systems. Often the first responders for emergencies may not be near the people who need assistance which may sometimes cause unacceptable delays in responding to emergencies. A method and apparatus are disclosed that offer a distributed and decentralized emergency notification and response system that informs and engages the people in the immediate vicinity of the person requiring assistance and enables dissemination of more detailed information beyond what may be provided by conventional emergency services systems.

title: Enterprise risk, security and compliance automation systems and methods
abstract: A method useful for implementing an enterprise risk and compliance automation engine comprises the step of obtaining an information technology (IT) security policy standard. The method comprises normalizing the IT security policy standard into a machine-readable format. The method comprises templatizing the machine-readable format version of the IT security policy standard. Each template comprises a collection of controls. Each control comprises a statement that describes a condition that a transaction or activity an IT system is required to perform by IT security policy standard; discovering a set of configurations of the IT system. The method comprises comparing the set of configurations of the IT system with the collection of controls of each template. The method comprises generating a validation report that comprises a report of whether the set of configurations of the IT system satisfies the collection of controls of each template.

title: Monitors for movements of workers
abstract: This disclosure relates to a sensor-based monitor for movements of workers. Multiple inertial sensors are attached to different body parts of the workers. A mobile device application receives the inertial movement data from the sensors and identify movement patterns by applying a trained machine learning model to the inertial movement data. The application then determine for each movement pattern an amount of time that movement pattern occurred and accessing a database to retrieve stored data on an association between the identified movement patterns and injuries. The application calculates a risk value indicative of a risk of injury of the worker as a result of performing the identified movement pattern for the determined amount of time and produces a report detailing the risk value for each of multiple risk categories.

title: Fundus fluorescence radiography image leakage point detection method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a fundus fluorescence angiography image leakage point detection method based on deep learning. Acquiring a fundus fluorescence radiography image, constructing a data set, preprocessing, labeling a disc area and a leakage point contour line, and performing binary conversion by using a water diffusion filling method; traversing the binary segmentation image, segmenting the binary segmentation image into subgraphs and forming a feature set; constructing two U-shaped neural networks; inputting the feature set and the contour line of the leakage point into a first U-shaped neural network for training; inputting an original image, an optic disc area and a yellow spot area into a second U-shaped neural network for training; processing and predicting the fundus fluorography image to be detected, taking pixel points with classification probability larger than a preset leakage threshold value as leakage points, and outputting an optic disc region and a yellow spot region; and (5) registering the time sequence front and back contrast images, and judging the elimination of the false leakage points. The invention uses the deep convolution neural network to carry out semantic segmentation on the leakage points, eliminates wrong leakage points and has higher accuracy and reliability.

title: Segmentation method and system for prostate magnetic resonance image
abstract: The invention discloses a segmentation method and a segmentation system for a prostate magnetic resonance image, and relates to the field of medical image processing. The method comprises the following steps: in the training stage, inputting the image into a full convolution network to obtain corresponding output probability, and calculating the cross entropy between the output probability and the label; calculating a weight map according to the image and the label, multiplying the cross entropy and the weight map in a pixel-to-pixel mode to obtain final loss, and adjusting parameters of the full convolution network to enable the loss to reach the minimum value; in the segmentation stage, the prostate magnetic resonance image to be segmented is input into the trained full convolution network, and an initial segmentation result is obtained. The invention enables automatic segmentation of the central and peripheral regions within the prostate from the magnetic resonance image.

title: Electrocardiogram data quality evaluation method and device
assignee: 深圳竹信科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an electrocardiogram data quality evaluation method and device, relates to the technical field of data processing, and mainly aims to solve the problems that the quality of the existing acquired electrocardiogram data is uneven, the determination efficiency of electrocardiogram monitoring results is reduced, and a large amount of human resources are wasted for troubleshooting. The main technical scheme is as follows: acquiring electrocardiogram data to be evaluated, and sampling the electrocardiogram data through a pre-trained variate self-encoder to obtain hidden variate parameters of the electrocardiogram data; performing dimensionality reduction processing by taking the hidden variable parameter as a group electrocardio sample characteristic; clustering the population electrocardiogram sample characteristics subjected to dimensionality reduction through an unsupervised clustering algorithm, calculating the distance from the sample characteristics obtained after clustering to a clustering central point, and calculating by using the distance as a calculation parameter of a preset quality scoring formula to obtain a quality evaluation result of the electrocardiogram data.

title: Facial pain expression recognition method and system based on depth information
assignee: 广东省科学院智能制造研究所
abstract: A facial pain expression recognition method and system based on depth information, the method comprising: establishing a pain expression data set containing depth information; preprocessing the collected pain expression data set; inputting the preprocessed pain expression data set into a frame attention network to train to obtain a pain grading model, wherein the frame attention network comprises a feature embedding module and a frame attention module; and sending the expression data which are collected in real time and subjected to pretreatment to the pain grading model for recognition, and judging whether alarm processing is performed or not according to a recognition result. The invention can stably detect the abnormal state of the identification target, and timely gives an early warning to the staff, thereby having great practical value for the fields of public medical treatment, intelligent care and the like.

title: Devices and methods for sampling and profiling microbiota of skin
abstract: Devices and methods for profiling microbiota of skin are described which include a hand-held microbe profiling device including a housing defining an opening, the housing including at least one rotatable component at least partially disposed in the opening defined by the housing, an elongated flexible strip disposed on an outer surface of the at least one rotatable component, the outer surface of the elongated flexible strip positioned to contact one or more regions of a skin surface of an individual through the opening defined by the housing, a location-capture component to detect a location of one or more regions of the skin surface as the elongated flexible strip contacts said one or more regions, at least one sensor component to detect one or more signals emitted or reflected from the elongated flexible strip, and a computing component to associate the location of said one or more regions of the skin surface and the detected one or more signals.

title: Systems and methods for responsive insertion and retraction of robotic endoscope
abstract: A method is provided for controlling a tip velocity of an articulating flexible endoscope. The method comprises: generating a command to move a tip of an elongated member of the articulating flexible endoscope at an expected velocity; receiving sensor data acquired by a sensor disposed at a distal tip portion of the elongated member to calculate a tip velocity; calculate a disparity between the expected velocity and the tip velocity; and controlling the tip velocity based on the disparity.

title: Methods for assessing risk of developing colorectal cancer
abstract: Methods and systems for assessing the risk of a human subject for developing colorectal cancer are provided. These methods may be combined with the subject's clinical risk to improve risk analysis. Such methods may be used to assist decision making about appropriate colorectal cancer screening regimens.

title: Multi-layered data security in mobile personal computing devices
abstract: Methods that can provide multi-layered data security in mobile personal computing devices are provided. One method includes assigning, by a processor, one of a plurality of security levels to applications of a mobile personal computing device, assigning one of the plurality of security levels to storage partitions of a storage device of the mobile personal computing device, and providing the applications access to data stored on the storage partitions based on a nexus of a first assigned security level for each application and a second assigned security level for each storage partition. Systems and apparatus that can include, perform, and/or implement the methods are also provided.

title: Systems and methods for virtual artificial intelligence development and testing
abstract: Systems and methods are provided to create training data, validate, deploy and test artificial intelligence (AI) systems in a virtual development environment, incorporating virtual spaces, objects, machinery, devices, subsystems, and actual human action and behavior.

title: Urban block vitality prediction method, storage medium and terminal
assignee: 东南大学, 南京东南大学城市规划设计研究院有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a city block vitality prediction method, a storage medium and a terminal, and belongs to the technical field of city planning. A city block vitality prediction method, the method comprising the steps of: obtaining vector boundaries of blocks in a region to be detected from road network data, and taking the region in the boundaries as a basic unit; acquiring built environment data of a block in a region to be measured from a basic unit as an independent variable; acquiring crowd activity intensity data of a neighborhood in a region to be detected, and quantifying the crowd activity intensity data to acquire an urban activity value; building a training database by matching basic unit, block building environment data and crowd activity intensity data; training a training database by adopting GBDT algorithm to obtain a city block vitality prediction model; and predicting the block vitality of the region to be detected based on the city block vitality prediction model. The urban activity after future construction is accurately predicted through the construction environment index of the block, so that a basis is provided for planning and designing strategies.

title: Natural conversation storytelling system
abstract: The present application discloses a multi-media interactive story-telling system that provides natural conversational interactions between a human user and a contributor who appears in multi-media recordings. The multi-media interactive story-telling system includes an intake device for recording interview sessions in which a contributor tells a life story about her life experience. The contributor may rely on a script when creating the life story. The multi-media interactive story-telling system further comprises storage devices for storing the recorded interview sessions and processors for organizing the recorded interview sessions. The multi-media interactive story-telling system further comprises an interactive device for retrieving and playing a recorded interview session in response to a query from a user.

title: Full-automatic segmentation method and device for cerebral image artery
abstract: The invention provides a full-automatic segmentation method and a full-automatic segmentation device for cerebral image artery, which can automatically segment cerebral vessels of two-dimensional or three-dimensional brain images to be detected, and is characterized by comprising the following steps: step S1, performing image enhancement on the brain image to be detected; step S2, adopting a pre-trained machine learning classifier and a constructed subclass-parameter comparison table to carry out parameter self-adaptive selection; step S3, performing threshold segmentation according to the parameters; step S4, adaptive skull seed point extraction; step S5, removing skull according to the parameters; step S6, analyzing the volumes of all connected domains and screening the connected domains according to the parameters; step S7, obtaining upper and lower limit threshold values by self-adaptive threshold value statistics; step S8, increasing according to the upper and lower limit threshold value regions; and step S9, uniformly expanding to obtain the final image segmentation result.

title: Deep learning-based neurology disease analysis method and device
assignee: 东莞市东南部中心医院(东莞市东南部中医医疗服务中心)
abstract: The invention provides a deep learning-based neurological condition analysis method and device, which are used for acquiring the record requirements of a patient end on corresponding part modules in a condition record model according to a condition record request of the patient end, wherein the record requirements comprise external record requirements and internal record requirements; receiving illness state marking information of the part module based on the recording requirement by the patient side, wherein the illness state marking information comprises external marking information and internal marking information, and acquiring illness state recording information according to symptom information input by the patient side to the illness state marking information; acquiring illness state record information meeting record conditions to generate corresponding record nodes, and generating an illness state record structure corresponding to the patient end according to the record nodes; and combing and summarizing the illness state record information of the patient end based on the illness state check request of the doctor end to the illness state record structure, so as to obtain illness state summarizing information and sending the information to the doctor end.

title: Diabetes early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium based on self-supervision DNN
abstract: The invention discloses a diabetes early warning method based on self-supervision DNN. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out data preprocessing on original body index data, including label processing, numeralization processing, standardization processing, missing value processing and characteristic value selection processing; secondly, designing three deep neural networks, and performing model batch iterative training by taking the processed data as input; and then, the original body index data of the user to be predicted is subjected to the data processing steps, and the trained model is input to perform the visual early warning of the diabetes risk. The invention also discloses a diabetes early warning system based on the self-supervision DNN, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method for self-supervision learning can mine deep correlation of user health indexes by a small amount of label data, and the designed model can be adapted to other prediction tasks, so that the method has the advantages of reliability, universality and the like.

title: Evacuation using digital twins
abstract: A system, program product, and method are provided for leveraging cognitive systems and a digital twin computing system for facility evacuation, and, more specifically, to leveraging a trained cognitive system to automatically facilitate executing an effective evacuation during an emergency through a digital twin of the affected facility structure and digital twins of the evacuees. Digital twins for a structure and each occupant thereof are created through machine learning techniques. Environmental measurements representative of environmental conditions within a structure are collected. The structural digital twin predicts potential environmental conditions adverse to occupants within the structure. Evacuation routes for the occupants are determined and atmosphere pressures within the evacuation routes are modulated, thereby reducing the severity of the adverse environmental conditions within the evacuation routes to facilitate the evacuation of the occupants from the structure.

title: Pain assessment method, system, device and storage medium
assignee: 重庆医科大学附属儿童医院
abstract: The invention provides a pain assessment method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting corresponding physical sign parameters, facial expression videos and limb action videos of a user in different pain states; training by using a facial expression video and a limb action video based on a deep neural network to obtain a first pain recognition model and a second pain recognition model; calculating physiological pain scores by using the physical sign parameters of the user to be detected, and correspondingly inputting the facial expression video and the limb actions of the user to be detected into the first pain recognition model and the second pain recognition model to obtain the facial pain scores and the limb pain scores; and calculating the weighted sum of various pain scores according to a preset weight coefficient to obtain the pain evaluation value of the user to be tested. The method is suitable for newborn babies or people losing language expression, can avoid errors caused by artificial subjective judgment of pain degree, improves the efficiency and accuracy of pain evaluation, and has the advantages of wide application range, high sensitivity and simplicity in evaluation.

title: Rotational speed control method and device of ventricular catheter pump
assignee: 安徽通灵仿生科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for controlling the rotating speed of a ventricular catheter pump, which relate to the technical field of medical appliances, and comprise the following steps: under the condition of controlling the ventricular catheter pump according to the input rotating speed, obtaining the actual output flow of the ventricular catheter pump; calculating deviation flow of the actual output flow based on the actual output flow and the preset output flow; judging whether the deviation flow is larger than a preset deviation flow threshold value or not; if so, calculating the change rate of the deviation flow, respectively carrying out blurring processing on the deviation flow and the change rate of the deviation flow to obtain a first target value and a second target value, and controlling the input rotating speed based on the first target value and the second target value; if not, based on the deviation flow and the preset deviation coefficient, calculating a second adjustment amount of the input rotating speed, and controlling the input rotating speed according to the second adjustment amount. By applying the scheme provided by the embodiment, the rotation speed control of the ventricular catheter pump can be realized.

title: Method for automatically scoring intestinal tract preparation after enteroscopy
assignee: 河南萱闱堂医疗信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for automatically scoring intestinal tract preparation after enteroscopy, which can acquire learning data sets in a video in batches, train the data sets through a deep neural network model, identify intestinal tract foreign bodies, record the intestinal tract preparation condition, score the intestinal tract preparation condition through an ASTP scoring method and an EAREI scoring rule, and define the quantitative scoring standard of the intestinal tract preparation.

title: Genetic test for determining susceptibility for eosinophilic esophagitis
abstract: Methods and compositions disclosed herein generally relate to determination of susceptibility to eosinophilic esophagitis, asthma, and/or allergic diseases, disorders, and/or pulmonary and/or upper gastrointestinal conditions arising therefrom and/or related thereto and the diagnosis, treatment, and/or management of eosinophilic esophagitis, asthma, and/or allergic diseases, disorders, and/or pulmonary and/or upper gastrointestinal conditions arising therefrom and/or related thereto. Embodiments of the invention relate to the association between genes and specific polymorphisms of genes with eosinophilic esophagitis. Embodiments of the invention can be used to determine and manage patient risk factors for development of eosinophilic esophagitis; this determination can then be used to diagnose eosinophilic esophagitis and to treat a patient diagnosed with eosinophilic esophagitis.

title: Standardized coronary artery disease metric
abstract: A computing system (118) includes a computer readable storage medium (122) with computer executable instructions (124), including a biophysical simulator (126), and a reference location (128), and a processor (120) configured to the biophysical simulator and simulate a reference FFR value at a predetermined location along a segmented coronary vessel indicated by the reference location. A computer readable storage medium encoded with computer readable instructions, which, when executed by a processor of a computing system, causes the processor to simulate a reference FFR value at a predetermined location along a segmented coronary vessel indicated by a predetermined reference location. A method including simulating a reference FFR value at a predetermined location along a segmented coronary vessel indicated by a predetermined reference location.

title: Improved particle swarm parameter optimization method for colloid rumen multitasking integrated network
assignee: 复旦大学, 粤港澳大湾区精准医学研究院(广州)
abstract: The invention provides an improved particle swarm parameter optimization method for a colloid rumen multitask integrated network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a glioma patient data set: step 2: carrying out data preprocessing; step 3: constructing a multi-task learning frame; step 4: constructing a multi-task loss function; step 5: optimizing training is carried out on the multi-task learning frame through an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, so that the optimal weights of two tasks in the loss function are obtained; step 6: loading a training set in a network, determining parameters of the network model, obtaining and storing the trained network model, loading the trained network model, inputting a testing set for prediction, obtaining a result and calculating each evaluation index value according to the label. The invention uses the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to adjust the inertia weight according to the particle fitness, thereby realizing the self-adaptive adjustment of the inertia weight.
assignee_clean: 复旦大学; 粤港澳大湾区精准医学研究院 广州

title: Systems and methods for utilizing models to identify a vehicle accident based on vehicle sensor data and video data captured by a vehicle device
abstract: A device may receive sensor data and video data associated with a vehicle, and may process the sensor data, with a rule-based detector model, to determine whether a probability of a vehicle accident satisfies a first threshold. The device may preprocess acceleration data of the sensor data to generate calibrated acceleration data, and may process the calibrated acceleration data, with an anomaly detector model, to determine whether the calibrated acceleration data includes anomalies. The device may filter the sensor data to generate filtered sensor data, and may process the filtered sensor data and anomaly data, with a decision model, to determine whether the probability of the vehicle accident satisfies a second threshold. The device may process the filtered sensor data, the anomaly data, and the video data, with a machine learning model, to determine whether the vehicle accident has occurred, and may perform one or more actions.

title: Method for quickly measuring dropping speed of liquid drops of mobile equipment based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to a method for quickly measuring the dropping speed of liquid drops of mobile equipment based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of collecting an image construction image data set in a liquid drop dropping process, and constructing a liquid drop image training set and a liquid drop image testing set through image preprocessing and a manual marking method; selecting a two-classification neural network model, and training the two-classification neural network model through a liquid drop image training set to obtain a trained two-classification neural network model; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing an image collected by an intelligent terminal to obtain an image of a liquid drop to be detected, predicting through a trained binary neural network model, if the second dripping state is predicted to be the dripping state, spacing multiple frames of images, continuing predicting through the trained binary neural network model until the next dripping state is predicted to be the dripping state, calculating the time length used for the interval between two adjacent dripping states, and further calculating the current dripping speed. The invention can measure the drop speed of the liquid drop quickly and accurately, and greatly improves the measurement efficiency of the drop speed of the liquid drop.

title: Eyelid topological morphology feature extraction method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses an eyelid topological morphology feature extraction method based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: collecting an electronic digital photo of a normal person, processing the electronic digital photo, constructing an ROI image training set, and inputting the ROI image training set into a convolutional neural network to be trained to obtain a trained convolutional neural network; and positioning the position (ROI) of an eye region of interest (ROI) of the electronic digital photo to be detected by using a face recognition method, obtaining an ROI region image to be detected, inputting the ROI region image to be detected into a trained convolutional neural network to output an image with eyelid contour lines and cornea contour lines, determining a circular scale and pupil center of the electronic digital photo to be detected, and extracting eyelid topological morphology features of a single eye. The invention uses convolution neural network to segment eyelid and cornea structure, and uses MeanShift cluster to determine pupil center, and then carries out eyelid related structure parameter automatic calculation to obtain accuracy equivalent to manual measurement.

title: Left ventricle segment identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a left ventricle segment identification method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium, the method including: acquiring a target image, wherein the target image comprises a cardiac magnetic resonance film short-axis image; segmenting the target image to obtain a plurality of masks of a plurality of target areas in the target image; obtaining a plurality of target contours according to the plurality of masks; determining a left ventricular segment in a target image comprising the plurality of target contours after four-dimensional reconstruction of the target image. The embodiment of the disclosure can quickly, automatically and accurately identify the left ventricle segment, so that a clinician can accurately judge the function and motion condition of each myocardial segment of the left ventricle conveniently, the efficiency of the clinician is greatly improved, and the method has high value for clinical application of cardiac magnetic resonance images.
assignee_clean: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司

title: Method for identifying glioma recurrence and necrosis through multi-feature fusion calculation
assignee: 中科(厦门)数据智能研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a method for identifying glioma recurrence and necrosis by multi-feature fusion calculation, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing data; step two: dividing glioma lesions; step three: obtaining the image histology characteristics of the glioma focus; step four: classifying the multi-feature fusion; according to the method for identifying glioma recurrence and necrosis by multi-feature fusion calculation, the convolution layer features and the image histology features of the neural network are fused, so that a model can learn focus feature information for distinguishing recurrence and necrosis from a conventional MRI structural image through two feature dimension spaces, the problems that domestic professional medical staff are unevenly distributed, high-quality image equipment is limited and the like are solved, and a doctor can be assisted to better pre-judge a postoperative GBM patient.
assignee_clean: 中科 厦门 数据智能研究院
