title: Multi-excitation plane echo magnetic resonance imaging method based on neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of magnetic resonance imaging, and particularly relates to a multi-excitation plane echo magnetic resonance imaging method based on a deep learning neural network. The invention provides a brand-new method for performing accurate phase correction and fast image reconstruction aiming at multi-time excitation planar echo magnetic resonance imaging. Compared with the traditional model-based undersampled image reconstruction algorithm, the method utilizes the deep learning neural network, and uses a single shot planar echo (SSH-EPI) image without aliasing as a target in a training stage by applying the deep learning to aliasing correction of a multi-shot planar echo (MSH-EPI) image. And sending the aliasing SSH-EPI image with the same undersampling factor and track as the plane echo excited for multiple times into the network so as to improve the accuracy of phase estimation.

title: Method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium for predicting user attribute
abstract: The embodiment of the present disclosure provides a method, an apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium for predicting user attribute. The method comprises acquiring an input of demographic-related information; determining features corresponding to the input of the demographic-related information and a weight corresponding to each feature, where the features comprise a single feature corresponding to each input of the demographic-related information, and/or a cross feature between the at least two single features; predicting user attribute according to each feature and its corresponding weight. Based on the solution provided by the embodiment of the present disclosure, the accuracy on the prediction of the user attribute can be effectively improved.

title: Eyeball motion segmentation positioning method based on cyclic residual convolution neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an eyeball motion segmentation positioning method based on a cyclic residual convolution neural network. Acquiring and obtaining an eye position of a tested person, inputting the eye position into a first-stage circular residual error convolution neural network model for processing to obtain a rotated eye position; inputting the first-stage cyclic residual convolution neural network model again to obtain a binary mask, cutting to obtain left and right eye detection area pictures, and inputting the second-stage cyclic residual convolution neural network model to detect to obtain eyelid and cornea masks of both eyes; obtaining a scale according to the round mark on the forehead; and then, eye movement is measured by processing the eye position image through the eyelid cornea mask, the pixel distance of the functions of the six extraocular muscles is obtained, and the actual size value is obtained through conversion. The invention has stable technical performance and high segmentation accuracy, can quickly and automatically detect the eyeball movement, and avoids the error of manual measurement in a computer-aided image processing mode, thereby improving the accuracy and the objectivity of eye muscle disease diagnosis. The invention also provides possibility for physical examination screening, remote medical treatment and the like.

title: Insurance data processing method, device and equipment based on block chain and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an insurance data processing method, device and equipment based on a block chain and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of block chains. According to the method, the purchase intention contract is generated on the blockchain system based on the purchase request of the user for the target insurance product, the first data of the purchase user are obtained from the blockchain according to the authorized target data type in the contract, the fact that the data stored in the blockchain cannot be tampered can effectively guarantee the truth and the validity of the obtained first data, the first data are compared with the forbidden condition information corresponding to the target insurance product, and the contract is processed based on the comparison result.

title: Multi-dimensional traditional Chinese medicine prescription recommendation method and recommendation system
assignee: 南京大经中医药信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a multi-dimensional Chinese medicine prescription recommendation method and a multi-dimensional Chinese medicine prescription recommendation system, which comprise the following steps: establishing a traditional Chinese medicine prescription database, collecting the existing disease and symptom information of a patient, and abdominal diagnosis symptoms and constitution information selected by a doctor aiming at the patient, and respectively screening recommended symptoms, prescriptions, diseases, prescriptions, bodies, prescriptions and medical symptoms results based on the corresponding relations between traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions and symptom combinations, traditional Chinese medicine combination, diseases, constitutions and abdominal diagnosis symptoms and between traditional Chinese medicine and symptom combinations. According to the method, based on 6 dimensions such as the relationship between the traditional Chinese medicine formulas and symptoms, the medicine combination, the disease, the constitution and the abdominal diagnosis, the relationship between the traditional Chinese medicine and the symptoms and the like, the applicable traditional Chinese medicine formulas or traditional Chinese medicines are recommended from the 6 dimensions by combining different algorithms, the intelligent recommendation of the traditional Chinese medicine formulas is realized, and the recommended result has multiple dimensions, high accuracy and wide optional range.

title: Model training method, device, equipment and storage medium for plaque segmentation
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of medical treatment, and provides a model training method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for plaque segmentation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining non-segmented plaque images and segmented plaque images corresponding to the non-segmented plaque images of a first preset number of blood vessel walls, inputting the non-segmented plaque images into a deep learning network model for segmentation training to obtain a first segmentation result of the non-segmented plaque images, conducting fine-tuning iterative training on the deep learning network model after the segmentation training through the first segmentation result and the segmented plaque images, and outputting the deep learning network model for plaque segmentation after the fine-tuning iterative training, so that automation of plaque segmentation on the blood vessel walls is achieved, the precision of the plaque segmentation is improved, and further the plaque segmentation efficiency is improved.

title: Model induction method for explainable A.I
abstract: A model induction method for explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) may be shown and described. A model of a black-box AI may be an input to the model induction method, along with a set of sample input data. A linear or non-linear predictor function may be used to predict the output of the black-box model, producing a set of data points. The data points may be partitioned by a partitioning function, and each partition may represent one or more rules. The data may also be transformed using a number of transformation functions, such as a polynomial expansion. A local model may be fitted to the transformed function or functions. A set of rules may be interpreted from the local models and may form a white-box AI model. Linear or non-linear data may be modeled by the white-box model. Further, the white-box model may be implemented on a low-power device.

title: Electric power audit text entity identification method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 国网天津市电力公司培训中心, 国网天津市电力公司, 国家电网有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of text recognition, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for recognizing a text entity of electric audit. The invention utilizes a method for constructing a data index to manufacture a vocabulary, and maps the vocabulary semantic to a real number vector through word2 vec. Based on the BERT model, an ASSPA model structure special for an electric power audit system is provided, and a preprocessing working mode is changed, and character vectors, word vectors and position vectors are adapted to convolution kernel feature extraction, so that the extraction of local features of text blocks is more comprehensive. Experimental results show that the ASSPA model improves entity identification of the text to a certain extent, and the accuracy rate reaches 92.58%.

title: System and methods for aggregating features in video frames to improve accuracy of AI detection algorithms
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for aggregating features in multiple video frames to enhance tissue abnormality detection algorithms, wherein a first detection algorithm identifies an abnormality and aggregates adjacent video frames to create a more complete image for analysis by an artificial intelligence detection algorithm, the aggregation occurring in real time as the medical procedure is being performed.

title: Man-machine collaborative health case matching method and system based on chronic disease big data
abstract: The invention provides a man-machine collaborative health case matching method and system based on chronic disease big data, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of firstly fusing dynamic time-series medical health data from multiple channels and multiple modes of a user, extracting characteristics of the dynamic time-series medical health data, selecting the characteristics by combining with expert knowledge of doctors, then fusing data characteristics from different modes, distributing weights to characteristic indexes, carrying out linear weighting by combining with characteristics normalized by a preprocessing module to obtain a health evaluation index, obtaining the characteristic value sequence similarity of a characteristic value sequence of a typical case in a current case and a health case knowledge base by utilizing a characteristic similarity calculation algorithm, and finally generating a health recommendation scheme for the user in an individualized way according to the health evaluation index and the characteristic value sequence similarity. The technical scheme solves the problem that the matching result is not accurate in the matching of the health cases in the prior art.

title: Log processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a log processing method, a log processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring logs of the service system to obtain logs; transmitting the log into a service log file; judging whether a log checking request input by a user through a front-end page is received or not; if yes, carrying out authority verification on the user based on the user information; if the authority verification is passed, acquiring a target log corresponding to the service type index from a service log file based on a preset shell script and the service type index; establishing webSocket connection channels between the log server and the front-end page; and displaying the target log on the front page through webSocket connection channels. The method and the device can realize the real-time pushing of the log to the front-end page, and improve the flexibility and the intelligence of the real-time log check. The application can also be applied to the field of blockchains, and the data such as the target log can be stored on the blockchain.

title: Breast tumor block diagram generation method with boundary marking information based on depth countermeasure network
abstract: The invention provides a method for generating a breast lump graph with boundary marking information based on a depth countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of firstly extracting a lump picture and a lump segmentation picture from a breast molybdenum target picture containing lump lesions and a corresponding lump marking picture, and scaling the extracted picture to a uniform size; then, using the extracted pictures, designing a tumor picture generator according to the shape, the size, the edges and the density of the tumor; and finally, generating a tumor with various shapes, sizes, edges and positions and a tumor marking picture corresponding to the tumor on the healthy breast molybdenum target picture according to the designed tumor picture generator. The invention overcomes the defects of the existing lump generation method, fully utilizes the pathological information of the lump to generate the lump, solves the problems of limited medical image data and difficult labeling in the automatic diagnosis process based on artificial intelligence, greatly promotes the research of the existing artificial intelligence mammary gland auxiliary diagnosis, and has great clinical significance and practical application value.

title: System and method for ethical collection of data
abstract: A computerized system automatically ensures that data from a data partner has been ethnically sourced. The system reviews websites associated with URLs provided by the data provider, and privacy policy data is extracted and captured. A keyword set is used to analyze the privacy terms of websites associated with the URLs. URLs associated with websites that ethically collect data are stored in a URL database, or the URLs are given a flag or score, such that these URLs need not be checked each time a new data partner identifies these URLs as the source of its data. The system may periodically re-check the URLs to ensure that no changes have been made to the corresponding website's data collection practices.

title: VR technology-based mental disorder auxiliary treatment method
assignee: 南京元域绿洲科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment, and discloses a VR technology-based mental disorder auxiliary treatment method, which comprises the steps of collecting names, sexes, ages, facial images, heart rates, respiratory rates and skin reactance values of mental disorder patients; training a deep learning model according to the facial image of the mental disorder patient, and judging the facial image type of the mental disorder patient; determining a specific mental disorder type according to the heart rate, the breathing rate and the skin reactance value of the mental disorder patient and the facial image type; creating a virtual environment by utilizing VR technology according to specific mental disorder types, and simulating various real-world situations and trigger factors to provide personalized auxiliary treatment; after the treatment is completed, heart rate, respiratory rate and skin reactance values of the mental disorder patients are collected again to evaluate the treatment effect. The whole method has no side effect, can automatically judge specific mental disorder types, and can carry out personalized treatment on mental disorder patients.
assignee_clean: 南京元域绿洲科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 南京元域绿洲科技有限公司

title: Programmatic approvals of corporate spend and employee expense
abstract: A method of approving expenditures in real-time, comprising receiving an expenditure request initiated by a user associated with an organization for transferring funds of the organization in exchange for one or more products and/or services, identifying request attribute(s) relating to the user, the value, the funds, the product, the service, a time of reception of the expenditure request and/or a geographical location of the user, analyzing scheduling data obtained from one or more online data sources which is indicative of one or more activity attributes of activity(s) scheduled for the user, automatically determining compliance between the request attribute(s) and one or more expenditure rules predefined for the product(s) and/or service(s) with respect to the activity attribute(s) and transmitting a response to the expenditure request according to the determination which includes approval of the expenditure request in case of compliance and rejection in case of incompliance.

title: Image processing apparatus, image processing method, and computer-readable recording device
abstract: An image processing apparatus includes: a color feature data calculation unit configured to calculate color feature data of each pixel in an intraluminal image or color feature data of each small region obtained by dividing the intraluminal image into a plurality of small regions; a residue candidate distribution determination unit configured to determine, from among the color feature data, color feature data distributed on a side comparatively strong in redness to be a mucosa distribution and determine color feature data distributed on a side comparatively weak in redness to be a residue candidate distribution; and a residue distribution determination unit configured to determine, from among distributions of the color feature data determined to be the residue candidate distribution, a residue candidate distribution distributed on a side strong in yellowness with reference to the mucosa distribution to be a residue distribution.

title: Methods and systems for modulating radiation dose
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method and system for determining a dose of modulation (DOM) profile are provided. The method may include obtaining a 3D image and a topogram image of the object. The method may further include obtaining a dose of modulation (DOM) profile generation model. The DOM profile generation model may be generated by training a preliminary model based on a plurality of sample CT images, a plurality of sample 3D images corresponding to the plurality of sample CT images, respectively, and a plurality of sample topogram images corresponding to the plurality of sample CT images, respectively. The method may further include executing the DOM profile generation model to generate a DOM profile related to a computed tomography (CT) scan of the object based on the 3D image and the topogram image of the object.

title: Ultrasonic image segmentation method and device and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 深圳瀚维智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an ultrasonic image segmentation method, an ultrasonic image segmentation device and a computer-readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an ultrasonic image to be segmented, and determining a high-level semantic feature map and a low-level semantic feature map corresponding to the ultrasonic image to be segmented; determining semantic information and position information of the focus according to the high-level semantic feature map; acquiring fuzzy discrimination processing results of the extended convolutions of different sizes on the low-level semantic feature map, and determining edge information of the focus according to the processing results; aggregating semantic information, position information and edge information of the lesion; the technical scheme for determining the segmentation prediction result according to the aggregation result solves the problem of low precision of lesion segmentation by adopting an ultrasonic image, and the ultrasonic image is processed by the technical scheme of the application, so that the lesion segmentation precision is improved.

title: Method and device for measuring bone mineral density
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司, 中南大学
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for measuring bone mineral density, wherein the method is executed by a bone mineral density measuring model, the bone mineral density measuring model is obtained after being trained in advance based on a deep learning method, and the bone mineral density measuring model comprises a feature extraction module, an image segmentation module and a bone mineral density estimation module, and comprises the following steps: acquiring a feature map of an input image by using the feature extraction module, wherein the input image comprises a vertebral body of a vertebral column to be measured; performing cone segmentation on the input image based on the feature map by using the image segmentation module to obtain an image segmentation result of a vertebral body of a spine to be measured in the input image, wherein the image segmentation result is used for determining a target area in the vertebral body of the spine to be measured; and using the bone mineral density estimation module to perform bone mineral density value estimation according to the image segmentation result to obtain the bone mineral density value of the target region. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention can improve the bone mineral density measurement efficiency.

title: Weak supervision magnetic resonance rapid imaging method and device
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The invention provides a weak supervision magnetic resonance rapid imaging method based on a deep neural network model. Specifically, different imaging methods are utilized to reconstruct undersampled data with different multiplying powers to obtain reconstructed images with different multiplying powers, the reconstructed images and the undersampled data are used as sample labels to train a deep neural network model to obtain a reconstructed model which can be used for all undersampled multiplying powers, and therefore the reconstructed model can be used for directly reconstructing the magnetic resonance undersampled data to obtain a reconstructed image.

title: Image resolution improving method and device and electronic equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides an image resolution improving method, an image resolution improving device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the method comprises the following steps: carrying out first-level feature extraction processing on an original image to obtain a feature map; performing dimension reduction processing on the feature map to obtain a first feature map; performing second-level feature extraction processing on the original image to obtain a second feature map; respectively performing upsampling processing on the first characteristic diagram and the second characteristic diagram to obtain a new first characteristic diagram and a new second characteristic diagram; and carrying out fusion processing on the new first characteristic diagram and the new second characteristic diagram to obtain a hyper-resolution image with the resolution ratio being greater than that of the original image. By the method and the device, artifact removing capability can be enhanced, and quality of the obtained hyper-resolution image is improved.

title: Sparse modeling for optimizing sensor placement
abstract: A computer-implemented method is presented for arranging a plurality of sensors in a three-dimensional space. The method includes obtaining actual measured values from the plurality of sensors placed in the three-dimensional space, applying group regularization to create one or more models providing consistency between the actual measured values and corresponding predicted values, selecting a model from the one or more models having a given number of groups, wherein each group has significant coefficients, and, according to the selected model, arranging a subset of the plurality of sensors at locations corresponding to the significant coefficients to predict one or more parameters in the three-dimensional space.

title: Diabetes digital health management system based on big data
assignee: 中食安泓(广东)健康产业有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a digital health management system for diabetes based on big data, which comprises a sensor module, a blood sugar data preprocessing module, a blood sugar control module, a continuous blood sugar monitoring module and an alarm module, wherein the blood sugar data of a patient is obtained through the sensor module, the blood sugar data preprocessing module realizes cleaning and screening of abnormal data, the blood sugar control module calculates insulin to be infused by the patient through an algorithm and controls an insulin pump to infuse the insulin into the body of the patient, the continuous blood sugar monitoring module realizes real-time monitoring of the blood sugar data of the patient, and when the insulin pump begins to infuse or the amount of the insulin is insufficient, the alarm module can give an alarm to start working or work abnormally of the system, and the digital health management system has the advantages that: the system can monitor a patient non-invasively and continuously, help the patient to calculate and adjust the amount of the insulin injection accurately, and has the characteristics of wide coverage, low cost, high retention and high activity.
assignee_clean: 中食安泓 广东 健康产业有限公司
primary_assignee: 中食安泓 广东 健康产业有限公司

title: PDF document cross-page table merging method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a PDF document cross-page table merging method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The PDF document page-crossing form merging method comprises the following steps: acquiring at least two PDF documents, and acquiring at least one form in each PDF document to obtain a form data set; generating a cross-page table training data set according to the table data set; the method comprises the steps of training a deep learning model by using a cross-page form training data set to obtain a form merging model, obtaining a PDF test document, removing page headers and page footers, constructing cross-page form test data, predicting two classification predicted values of the cross-page form test data to be merged by using the form merging model, judging whether the cross-page form test data need to be merged according to the two classification predicted values, merging and outputting a cross-page form to be merged. The invention can effectively process the task of cross-page extraction of the complex forms in the PDF document and has higher accuracy for judging whether the cross-page forms need to be combined.

title: Bootstrapped predicative routing in CRM
abstract: In a crowd sourcing approach, responses to customer service inquiries are provided by routing a subset of the inquiries to an independent group of experts. The customer service inquiries are optionally routed to specific experts based on matches between identified subject matter of the inquiries and expertise of the experts. Embodiments include methods of classifying customer service inquiries, training a machine learning system, and/or processing customer service inquiries. Customer service inquiries and answers from a first enterprise and/or industry are optionally used to train an inquiry classifier for a second enterprise and/or industry. The classifier being configured to predict if a new customer service inquiry will require access to confidential information for a human to generate an answer that resolves the inquiry.

title: Physiological parameter acquisition method and device
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a physiological parameter acquisition method and a physiological parameter acquisition device, which comprise the following steps: extracting a heart tissue region and a plurality of specific adipose tissue regions from a computed tomography CT coronary non-contrast image based on a pre-trained machine learning model; based on the cardiac tissue region and the plurality of specific adipose tissue regions, a physiological parameter related to the heart is calculated. According to the technical scheme, the coronary artery calcium score, the pericardial fat related parameters and other physiological parameters related to the heart of the detected body can be directly obtained, the accuracy is high, and the robustness is good.

primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Beam failure detection in a second band based on measurements in a first band
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for beam failure detection in a second band based on measurements in a first band. A method that may be performed by a user equipment (UE) includes receiving one or more reference signals (RSs) on a first radio frequency band and initiating a beam failure recovery on a second radio frequency band based, at least in part, on the one or more RSs on the first radio frequency band. The UE may measure the one or more RSs on the first radio frequency band and perform beam failure detection (BFD) for the second radio frequency band based, at least in part, on one or more measurements of the one or more RSs on the first radio frequency band.

title: System, method, and apparatus for recurrent neural networks
abstract: A method for computation with recurrent neural networks includes receiving an input drive and a recurrent drive, producing at least one modulatory response; computing at least one output response, each output response including a sum of: (1) the input drive multiplied by a function of at least one of the at least one modulatory response, each input drive including a function of at least one input, and (2) the recurrent drive multiplied by a function of at least one of the at least one modulatory response, each recurrent drive including a function of the at least one output response, each modulatory response including a function of at least one of (i) the at least one input, (ii) the at least one output response, or (iii) at least one first offset, and computing a readout of the at least one output response.

title: Endoscopic high-definition video processing system and method based on sense-in-store calculation
assignee: 安徽医科大学, 合肥德铭电子有限公司
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of medical instruments, and provides an endoscopic high-definition video processing system and method based on sensing and memory calculation, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises a sensing and storing integrated module, an image signal processing module and a wireless communication module; the sensing and storing integrated module is used for sensing, calculating and storing detection information of a field of view to be detected and outputting image signals; the image signal processing module is used for repairing and optimizing the image signal by using one or more image processing correction algorithms and outputting the image signal as visual image information; the wireless communication module is used for constructing communication between the image signal processing module and the display so as to display the visual image information on the display; the integrated design of image processing and image storage and the high integration of the image transmission chip reduce the power consumption.
assignee_clean: 安徽医科大学; 合肥德铭电子有限公司

title: Master robot for controlling slave robot and driving method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a master robot for controlling at least one slave robot. The master robot includes a communicator that communicates with the slave robot or a mobile terminal, at least one sensor, an inputter that inputs an image signal or an audio signal, and a controller that creates a space map corresponding to a predetermined space in which the master robot and the slave robot are located on the basis of information sensed by the sensor or information inputted through the inputter. Accordingly, a master robot equipped with artificial intelligence and a 5G communication module can be provided.

title: Method and system to predict and interpret conceptual knowledge in the brain
abstract: Described is a system for explaining how the human brain represents conceptual knowledge. A semantic model is developed, and a behavioral exam is performed to assess a calibration subject into a cohort and reveal semantic relationships to modify a personalized semantic space developed by the semantic model. Semantic features are extracted from the personalized semantic space. Neural features are extracted from neuroimaging of the human subject. A neuroceptual lattice is created having nodes representing attributes by aligning the semantic features and the neural features. Structures in the neuroceptual lattice are identified to quantify an extent to which the set of neural features represents a target concept. The identified structures are used to interpret conceptual knowledge in the brain of a test subject.

title: Spline image registration method
abstract: A spine image registration method includes: obtaining a CT image and an MRI image corresponding to a spine; inputting the CT image into a first model to identify at least one first vertebral body of the spine in the CT image; inputting the MRI image to a second model to identify at least one second vertebral body of the spine in the MRI image; marking the first vertebral body with at least one first landmark and marking the second vertebral body with at least one second landmark; matching the first landmark with the second landmark to obtain a first corresponding relationship between the first landmark and the second first landmark; performing a registration to the CT image and the MRI image according to the corresponding relationship such that the content of the CT image and the content of the MRI image are located in a same coordinate space, and generating a registered image according to the content of the CT image and the content of the MRI image which are located in the same coordinate space; and outputting the registered image.

title: Systems and methods for data stream using synthetic data
abstract: Systems and methods for synthetic data generation. A system includes at least one processor and a storage medium storing instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the at least one processor to perform operations including receiving a continuous data stream from an outside source, processing the continuous data stream in real-time, and using machine learning techniques to generating synthetic data to populate the dataset. The operations also include creating a plurality of bins, wherein the plurality of bins occupy a data range between the determined minimum and maximum values without overlapping; and determining a number of samples within each of the created bin, based on a bin edges, wherein the bin edges are bounds within the data range.

title: System, method, and computer program product for incorporating knowledge from more complex models in simpler models
abstract: A system, method, and computer program product for incorporating knowledge from more complex models in simpler models. A method may include obtaining first training data associated with a first set of features and second training data associated with a second set of features different than the first set of features; training a first model based on the first training data and the second training data; and training a second model, using a loss function that depends on an output of an intermediate layer of the first model and an output of the second model, based on the second training data.

title: Validity judging device for throat swab machine sampling
assignee: 北京清智图灵科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a validity judging device for throat swab machine sampling, which comprises: the visual identification camera is used for realizing the identification of detected personnel based on the multi-task neural network and comparing the visual identification camera with the identification card information identified by the radio frequency device, so as to ensure that a sampler is positioned in front of the machine and is the person; the head support is internally provided with a sensor for detecting whether the head is always fixed in the sampling process in real time; the clencher is designed by a parabolic hyperboloid and is used for exposing the pharyngeal rear wall of a sampler, and a tongue depressor is also arranged to avoid tongue movement in the sampling process; the sampling mechanism is provided with a force sensor and is used for detecting force data at the rear end of the swab in real time and preventing the insufficient quantity of sampled cells; and the industrial personal computer is used for taking charge of flow control and judging the effectiveness of sampling. The invention identifies the detected personnel based on the multi-task neural network and compares the detected personnel with the identification card information identified by the radio frequency device, thereby effectively preventing the risk of impersonation sampling.
assignee_clean: 北京清智图灵科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京清智图灵科技有限公司

title: Automated communication design construction system
abstract: An automated communication design analysis and construction system that includes one or more intelligent communication design servers, comprising: a normalization module that converts communication content files for different recipients to normalized intermediate format files; an objects identification and quantification module that identifies text objects and image objects in the normalized intermediate format files; a cross-recipient group analysis module configured to identify static global objects that are invariant between recipients, data variables, and variable global objects that vary between recipients in the normalized intermediate format files; and an intelligent communication content learning and constructing engine that can construct standard communication design files based on the static global objects, the data variables, and the variable global objects. A data storage stores the communication content files and the standard communication design files. A communication resource allocation server sends the standard communication design files to one or more product fulfillment centers.

title: Method and apparatus for computing an estimated time of arrival via a route based on a degraded state of a vehicle after an accident and/or malfunction
abstract: An approach is provided for computing an estimated time of arrival via a route based on a degraded state of a vehicle after an accident and/or malfunction. The approach involves receiving, by one or more processors, data indicating an operational status of a vehicle. The approach also involves processing, by the one or more processors, the data to determine a degraded operational state of the vehicle. The approach further involves computing, by the one or more processors, an estimated time of arrival, a route, or a combination thereof of the vehicle based on the degraded operational state.

title: Real-time anesthesia depth monitoring system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time anesthesia depth monitoring system based on deep learning, which belongs to the technical field of medical anesthesia and comprises an initialization module, an electroencephalogram acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a feature extraction module and a multi-task neural network module; the initialization module is used for generating a blank table required by recording information and recording the anesthetic used and physiological characteristic information of a patient under the action of the anesthetic; the electroencephalogram acquisition module is used for acquiring electroencephalogram data in clinical operation of a patient; the data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the acquired brain electricity data; the state marking module is used for marking the anesthesia state of the electroencephalogram data by a clinician; the characteristic extraction module is used for calculating the characteristics of the brain electricity; the multi-task neural network module is used for storing a multi-task deep neural network model for clinically predicting anesthesia depth and anesthesia status. The invention can simultaneously estimate the anesthesia depth index and the anesthesia state, and can be applied to people of different ages and different medicines.

title: Triage data processing method, triage data processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a triage data processing method, a triage data processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the triage data processing method comprises the following steps: by acquiring patient symptom information of a patient; performing human body system identification on the symptom information of the patient through an upper learning model in the hierarchical reinforcement learning model, and identifying a first human body category; obtaining a lower reinforcement learning model associated with the first human category from the hierarchical reinforcement learning model; predicting the symptom information of the patient through the acquired lower reinforcement learning model and acquiring an action result; when the action result is the recommended department action, the symptom characteristic recognition is carried out on the symptom information of the patient through the department diagnosis and separation model, and the diagnosis and separation result corresponding to the patient is recognized. The invention inquires the relevant symptoms of the patient through the hierarchical reinforcement learning model, and can rapidly and accurately determine the department of patient visit. The invention is suitable for the fields of intelligent medical treatment and the like, and can further promote the construction of intelligent cities.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method and device for judging cornea immune state based on Langerhans cells
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）, 中国科学院自动化研究所
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for judging cornea immune state based on Langerhans cells, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting and selecting confocal images of patients with different degrees of immune corneal diseases, acquiring a target confocal image, constructing an expert database, and determining a machine learning model based on the expert database; designing and training a Langerhans cell example segmentation model; inputting the image to be identified into a Langerhans cell example segmentation model for reasoning, and determining the cell density and the cell number ratio of different types of Langerhans cells; and inputting the cell density and the cell number ratio of different Langerhans cells into a machine learning model to predict the level of the cornea immune state. The Langerhans cell example segmentation model can automatically identify the position and the type of the cell, and can help a doctor to judge the cornea immune state of a patient more quickly and accurately by combining with an expert database modeling result.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院; 中国科学院自动化研究所
primary_assignee: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院

title: Programmatic quality assessment of images
assignee: University Of Florida Research Foundation, Incorporated
abstract: Example embodiments provide real time quality monitoring of a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan. Data associated with an MRI scan of a particular patient is received. The data is sequential MRI data associated with various times. A rate of change of the sequential data is determined with reference to the various times. It is determined whether the rate of change of the sequential data meets a first configurable threshold. It is determined whether the rate of change of the sequential data meets a second configurable threshold. The sequential data is classified based on whether the rate of change of the sequential data meets the first and second configurable thresholds.
assignee_clean: university of florida research foundation; incorporated

title: Noninvasive scoliosis screening method and system based on back color images
assignee: 深圳零动医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a noninvasive scoliosis screening method and system based on back color pictures, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a back human RGB-D image, and storing the back human RGB-D image as a depth image and a color image; s2, performing Mask-RCNN network training to obtain a human body segmentation model; s3, segmenting the human body to obtain a human body color image without a background; s4, training a YOLOv5 network to obtain a back recognition model; s5, intercepting a back area of the human body to obtain a back color image; s6, obtaining a depth map of the back of the human body, and calculating a maximum ATR angle value; and S7, formulating a classification standard, labeling a class label, and inputting the back color image and the class label into an EfficientNet network for training to obtain a spine classification model. According to the invention, by combining an artificial intelligence technology, an image processing technology and a biomechanical technology, whether one input image has risk of suffering from scoliosis can be automatically, efficiently and stably evaluated through four-stage scoliosis screening.
assignee_clean: 深圳零动医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳零动医疗科技有限公司

title: Fundus image cup and optic disc segmentation method under unified frame
abstract: The invention discloses a method for segmenting a fundus image cup and a video disc under a unified frame, which comprises the steps of acquiring a fundus image and performing image preprocessing operations such as shearing, rotation and the like before segmentation; generating a corresponding mask image according to a visual cup and a visual disk area marked on fundus illumination by an ophthalmologist; constructing a depth network for dividing the vision cup and the vision disk; performing iterative training on the depth segmentation network by using the mask image and the fundus image, and optimizing network parameters; and (5) segmenting the video cup and the video disc, and obtaining segmentation results of the video cup and the video disc by using the trained segmentation network model. The invention provides a deep neural network for optic cup and optic disc segmentation, which comprises the following components: a multi-scale feature extractor, multi-scale feature transition and attention pyramid structure. The invention can effectively divide the cup optic disk, has higher dividing precision, and simultaneously provides a new thought for dividing fundus images and other medical images.

title: Operation navigation method and system
assignee: 忞惪医疗机器人(苏州)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a surgical navigation method and a surgical navigation system. By adopting the method and the system, the accurate visual three-dimensional navigation of the operation can be realized.
assignee_clean: 忞惪医疗机器人 苏州 有限公司
primary_assignee: 忞惪医疗机器人 苏州 有限公司

title: Information collection and classification method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安国际智慧城市科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an information collection and classification method, an information collection and classification device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting a list of target persons, wherein the list of target persons comprises identity information and contact information of the target persons; pushing a list of target personnel to a telephone strategy platform through the scene codes, initiating voice communication through the telephone strategy platform according to a preset calling strategy, and calling a voice conversation under the corresponding scene codes for conversation; collecting answer content in the conversation process, and then performing structured storage on the collected question and answer results to obtain return visit information; and establishing a decision tree model based on symptoms and epidemiological history, grading return visit information according to the decision tree model to obtain a grading result, and storing the grading result. The invention simultaneously collects information of mass crowds, automatically evaluates and grades the collected information, and provides visual and effective reference for data users.
assignee_clean: 平安国际智慧城市科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安国际智慧城市科技股份有限公司

title: Method and apparatus for removing self-interference signal in full-duplex communication system
assignee: Samsung Electronic Co., Ltd., Research & Business Foundation Sungkyunkwan University
abstract: A method of a first communication device for removing a self-interference signal in a wireless communication system is provided. The method includes receiving a signal having a size less than a first threshold value from a second communication device in a first interval within a first frame, transmitting a first signal to a third communication device in the first interval, and estimating a self-interference channel through which the self-interference signal is transmitted based on the signal received in the first interval and the first signal transmitted in the first interval. The self-interference signal is a signal transmitted by the first communication device and is received by the first communication device through the self-interference channel.
assignee_clean: samsung electronic; research business foundation sungkyunkwan university

title: Multi-turn dialogue online training method and system based on user interaction
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-turn dialogue online training method and a multi-turn dialogue online training system based on user interaction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current conversation turn, and judging whether the conversation turn is greater than a preset threshold value or not; if the conversation turns are larger than a preset threshold value, acquiring the current action; if the current action is a receiving operation action, intention and entity recognition are carried out on the current action through a natural language understanding module; if any one of the recognition results of the intention and the entity has errors, receiving the intention and the entity defined by the user to be correct; and performing real-time online training on the natural language understanding module according to the correct intentions and entities defined by the user. The method can be used for training the modules in real time through online interaction with users, solves the problems of lack of Chinese conversation data sets and low quality of a task-type multi-turn conversation system, and is suitable for different conversation scenes.

title: Sensor having graphene transistors
abstract: A sensor for performing measurements is disclosed. It comprises: a substrate; a plurality of graphene field-effect transistors (GFET) deposited on a central area of the substrate; at least one source electrode connected to the GFETs through at least one first metal track, wherein the at least one source electrode is disposed at the periphery of the substrate; at least one drain electrode connected to the GFETs through at least one second metal track, wherein the at least one drain electrode is disposed at the periphery of the substrate; and at least one gate electrode, disposed at least in part at the center of the substrate, wherein, in use of the sensor, when a sample is deposited in contact with the gate electrode and the GFETs, the sample allows gating between the gate electrode and the GFETs.

title: Neural network model training method, device and system based on privacy protection
assignee: 支付宝(杭州)信息技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a neural network model training method, device and system based on privacy protection. Each first member device has local data and deploys at least one client model, the second member device deploys at least one server model, and the at least one client model and the at least one server model form a neural network model according to a model interval mode. At each cycle, the respective first and second member devices perform model prediction calculations using the local data of the first member device. For each client model, the respective first member device performs a multi-party security computation using the local data or the model computation results of the previous server model. For each server model, the second member device performs local calculations using the model calculations of the previous client model. Prediction difference values are determined based on the model prediction values, and model updating is performed at each member device by a back propagation method using a noisy gradient descent method.
assignee_clean: 支付宝 杭州 信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 支付宝 杭州 信息技术有限公司

title: Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor postoperative recurrence risk prediction method
abstract: The application discloses a method for predicting postoperative recurrence risk of pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, which comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of tumor slice images in images to be predicted; determining a characteristic diagram corresponding to each tumor slice image in the plurality of tumor slice images based on a preset segmentation model; filtering the plurality of feature maps to obtain a plurality of target feature maps corresponding to the image to be predicted, and determining the feature vector of the image to be predicted based on the plurality of target feature maps; and determining a prediction result corresponding to the image to be predicted based on the feature vector and a preset prediction model. According to the method and the device, the feature vector is determined by adopting the segmentation model as an input item of the prediction model, and the prediction result corresponding to the image to be predicted is determined based on the feature map, so that the prediction result corresponding to the image to be predicted is determined in a deep migration learning mode, and the accuracy of the prediction result can be improved.

title: Configurable analog-to-digital conversion parameters
abstract: Aspects relate to analog-to-digital conversion of an analog signal. The resolution (number of bits) and/or the quantization levels of the analog-to-digital conversion may be configurable. A device may configure its analog-to-digital conversion parameters. For example, a first device may reduce the number of bits for its analog-to-digital converter to reduce power consumption. In this case, the first device may transmit an indication of selected analog-to-digital conversion parameters to a second device that will transmit to the first device. In this way, the second device may take appropriate action, if needed. A device may request another device to use certain analog-to-digital conversion parameters. For example, a first device may determine that a second device should use a larger number of bits for its analog-to-digital conversion process to improve the quality of the communication between the first and second devices.

title: Adaptive respiratory condition assessment
abstract: Adaptive respiratory condition assessment can include capturing signals generated by sensors of a portable device positioned to sense a user's body. The sensors can generate the signals in response to sensor-detected movements of the user's body measured along multiple axes and corresponding to lung activity in the user's body during respiratory cycles. A preferred axis of measurement can be selected using signal processing performed by a signal processor embedded in the portable device. Waveforms generated from signals corresponding to signals generated in response to movements of the user's body measured along the preferred axis can be filtered for extracting biomarkers from the waveforms using the signal processor. The one or more biomarkers extracted correspond to the lung activity. Based on the biomarkers, a respiratory condition of the user can be determined. A notification based on the respiratory condition as determined can be generated and conveyed with the portable device.

title: Robot, method of controlling same, and server for controlling same
abstract: The embodiments relate to a robot and a server communicating with the robot, the robot being driven by using at least one among a driving wheel, a propeller, and a manipulator moving at least one joint.

title: Method and system for neural fingerprint enhancement for fingerprint recognition
abstract: Biometrics fingerprint matching has been done with a heavily hand-tuned and designed process of classical computer vision techniques for several decades. This approach has led to accurate solutions for solving crimes today and, as such, little effort has been devoted to using deep learning in this domain. Exemplary embodiments disclosed herein leverage synthetic data generators to train a neural fingerprint enhancer to improve matching accuracy on real fingerprint images.

title: Method and apparatus for interactive television guides and program rules
abstract: Developments in interactive programming guides that utilize a confluence of users/viewers from data that may be blockchain and/or data collection from IoT and other devices, proximity sensing of viewership, and both machine and guided learning over a large dataset to produce rules for AI selection of content, format, and features presented to currently active or a nearby set of television users/viewers. Blockchain may be implemented separately for accounting, verification, billing, and/or fees/royalty payments owed to content owners/copyright holders. Playback may be initiated by a remote device and played on a same or yet another or a plurality of remote devices.

title: Color range space of human body digital tongue image color and extraction method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a color range space of a human body digital tongue image color characteristic and an extraction method thereof. The color range space is defined in an xyY standard color model plane defined by the CIE (Commission International Eclairage); a complete color range space and 98 percent of color range space of a tongue image are extracted; and a clustering color central point set of the color range space is extracted, so that a boundary curve of coated tongue natures is obtained. The invention provides an extraction method of the color range space of the human body digital tongue image color characteristic. The extraction method comprises the following steps of: extracting an image of a tongue body part by using edge segmentation; partitioning the image into small blocksaccording to the color consistence of the image by adopting a JSEG (J-value Segmentation) edge segmentation method; extracting edge pixels in a CIE xy space; and combining all pixels to obtain the color range space range of the image. When taken as a basic research of computer traditional Chinese medical science tongue diagnosis, the color range space of the human body tongue image can play a guidance role in extracting tongue color characteristics, separating coated tongue natures, extracting a color correction color block and the like.

title: Text classification method lacking negative cases
assignee: 南京稷图数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a negative-case-lacking text classification method, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning and text classification. The method comprises the steps of firstly, determining a data text to be classified, and customizing a text classification category; then training a TF-IDF model and an LSI model based on the obtained corpus; then respectively constructing feature vectors of the text based on the trained TF-IDF model and the LSI model, and constructing combined text feature vectors based on an ensemble method; then, training a Basic classifier by adopting an ROC-SVM combined algorithm, and training the Basic classifier by combining a k-means clustering method and simultaneously training a label classifier; and finally, initially classifying the text to be classified by adopting a Basic classifier, screening by using an elastic search to determine candidate classification, and accurately classifying the document to be classified into one or more types in the user-defined classes by adopting a label classifier. The method can effectively classify the text data lacking negative cases, and has high accuracy, good effect and high efficiency.
assignee_clean: 南京稷图数据科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 南京稷图数据科技有限公司

title: Dynamic hyper context-driven microsegmentation
abstract: Systems and methods for dynamic, hyper context-based microsegmentation are described. In one aspect, span traffic associated with a computing device on a network is processed. Meta data associated with the span traffic is transmitted to a hyper context cloud server. It is determined whether the span traffic meta data matches a policy condition. Responsive to the span traffic meta data matching a policy condition, a policy is triggered. It is determined whether an action associated with the triggered policy is segment. Responsive to determining that the action is segment, a MAC address of the computing device is added to a segment name provided in the policy. The segment name is pushed to one or more enforcement points associated with the network.

title: System and method for determining an immune activation state
abstract: A system or method for detecting an immune system activation state in a patient can include a sample preparation system configured to isolate white blood cells from a sample of the patient, a cytometry module configured to determine biophysical properties of the white blood cells of the sample, and an analysis module configured to analyze the biophysical properties.

title: Virtual safe enabled with countermeasures to mitigate access of controlled devices or substances
abstract: A system and means of implementing and providing a virtual perimeter enabled with interactive countermeasures to mitigate accessibility of an area or object and includes at least one sensor that establishes an electronic virtual border from at least one point to define a space, digital detection electronics for detecting the presence of an individual, animal or object encroaching the virtual border and at least one countermeasure that impedes or thwarts the movement or actions of the detected individual, animal or object. The system provides for the data collection, authorization, and deploying of countermeasures and the reporting and storage of state for an electronic virtual or electronic safe that is created as a protected space within the digital domain and can be represented within any physical or virtual location wherein the virtual safe is digitally enabled to detect the presence of a human through impedance, optical, mechanical, chemical, electronical or acoustic measurements, enables a deterrent when the presence of a person is detected, disables the deterrent if it determines the person is white listed based on facial recognition, gate analysis or voice recognition technology, escalates the deterrent if the person is not authorized as they encroach the space to impede or thwart the threat and enables a shock wave or pulse when a protected item is approached or touched. The system is a contextually aware system that based on environment or location can change its performance, countermeasures and, or intensity of countermeasures and has multiple modalities in which countermeasures are activated.

title: Lung CT multi-symptom automatic detection method, system, terminal and storage medium
assignee: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司, 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a lung CT multi-symptom automatic detection method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring a lung CT image; determining a typical layer of the lung CT image, and labeling each abnormal symptom of the typical layer by using a sparse labeling mode; inputting the labeled typical layer image data into a preset deep learning network model for training to obtain a trained 2D frame detection model; inputting image data of a layer to be detected in the lung CT image into a trained 2D frame detection model, and predicting a 2D detection frame with abnormal signs; respectively setting corresponding thresholds of the 2D detection frames according to the types of the 2D detection frames, and outputting the 2D detection frames with the scores exceeding the corresponding thresholds to obtain 2D candidate frames; merging the 2D candidate frames into a 3D candidate frame according to the position continuity on the continuous layer of the 2D candidate frames; setting a corresponding threshold of the 3D candidate frame according to the category of the 3D candidate frame, and outputting the 3D candidate frame with the score exceeding a second threshold to obtain a model detection result; the simultaneous detection and analysis of multiple signs in pulmonary CT are realized.
assignee_clean: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司; 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司

title: Dual-mode endoscopic capsule with image processing capabilities
abstract: An endoscopic capsule comprising first and second imaging systems, wherein the first imaging system is arranged for obtaining images at a broader spectral range than the second imaging system, the capsule comprising a processor, the capsule arranged for operating in any one of a first mode wherein a frame rate of the first imaging system exceeds a frame rate of the second imaging system, and a second mode wherein the frame rate of the second imaging system exceeds the frame rate of the second imaging system in the first mode, wherein the processor in the first mode is arranged for accessing one or more images from the first imaging system, detecting if there is a polyp in said one or more images, and switching from the first mode to the second mode if a polyp is detected in the one or more images from the first imaging system.

title: Systems and methods for formatting data using a recurrent neural network
abstract: Systems and methods for formatting data are disclosed. For example, a system may include at least one memory storing instructions and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions to perform operations. The operations may include receiving data comprising a plurality of sequences of data values and training a recurrent neural network model to output conditional probabilities of subsequent data values based on preceding data values in the data value sequences. The operations may include generating conditional probabilities using the trained recurrent neural network model and the received data. The operations may include determining a data format of a subset of the data value sequences, based on the generated conditional probabilities, and reformatting at least one of the data value sequences according to the determined data format.

title: Non-visual field object detection method, device and storage medium
assignee: 锋睿领创(珠海)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a non-vision field target detection method and a non-vision field target detection device, which are used for reducing detection cost and improving target detection precision, are applicable to machine vision application scenes of high-precision industrial detection in the semiconductor manufacturing industry, the electronic manufacturing industry and the like, and are also used for detection in the fields of automatic driving, security monitoring and the like. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting coherent light pulses to an intermediate surface corresponding to the non-visual field target; receiving a diffuse reflection mixed light pulse returned by the non-visual field target, wherein the diffuse reflection mixed light pulse contains shape information of the non-visual field target; preprocessing the diffuse reflection mixed light pulse according to an application scene to obtain a standard diffuse reflection mixed light pulse which accords with a required scale; converting each light pulse of the standard diffusely-reflecting mixed light pulse into a discrete digital sequence; combining the discrete digital sequences corresponding to each optical pulse conversion to obtain a digital matrix; and inputting the digital matrix into a deep learning network for feature extraction to obtain feature information of the non-visual field target.
assignee_clean: 锋睿领创 珠海 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 锋睿领创 珠海 科技有限公司

title: Ranking system for immunogenic cancer specific epitope
assignee: 行动基因(智财)有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to systems and methods for determining, predicting and ranking immunogenic T cell epitopes, and more particularly to determining epitopes produced by disease-related mutations, wherein the epitopes are predicted to elicit a T cell immune response. Specifically, the present invention contemplates both peptide chain-level information (including the effect of peptide chains on the presentation of major histocompatibility complex types one and two and on the immune response of helper and cytotoxic T cells) and sample-level information (including mutant community and major histocompatibility complex allele expression levels). In some embodiments, the above-described systems and methods are used in cancer personalized medicine.
assignee_clean: 行动基因 智财 有限公司
primary_assignee: 行动基因 智财 有限公司

title: Generalized reduced error logistic regression method
abstract: A machine classification learning method titled Generalized Reduced Error Logistic Regression (RELR) is presented. The method overcomes significant limitations in prior art logistic regression and other machine classification learning methods. The method is applicable to all current applications of logistic regression, but has significantly greater accuracy using smaller sample sizes and larger numbers of input variables than other machine classification learning methods including prior art logistic regression.

title: Artificial intelligence server
abstract: Disclosed is an artificial intelligence (AI) server. The AI server includes a communication unit configured to communicate with an AI device; and an AI unit configured to receive feature data from the AI device, wherein the received feature data is generated by the AI device by obtaining sensing data and compressing the sensing data while preserving a feature of the sensing data; and input the received feature data to a deep learning model to obtain second sensing data for use in a recognition model related to an AI function of the AI device.

title: Device for recognizing voice content, server connected thereto, and method for recognizing voice content
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) device, such as a robot, comprises: an output interface to output content in response to a request of a user; a camera to acquire an image of the user; a microphone to acquire a voice signal including a voice content uttered by the user; a processor to determine a characteristic of the user based on the content, the image, and/or the voice signal, and recognize the voice content through a voice recognition mode corresponding to the determined characteristic. The AI device may include a communication interface to forward the voice signal to a remote computer that identifies the characteristic and recognizes the voice content based on the characteristic. According to an embodiment, when an irregular voice is recognized from the acquired voice signal, the processor may recognize a regular voice corresponding to the irregular voice using an artificial intelligence-based learning model.

title: Ultrasonic imaging method and equipment
assignee: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
abstract: An ultrasound imaging method and apparatus (10), a computer readable storage medium, the ultrasound imaging method comprising: transmitting ultrasonic waves to a uterine region of the object to be detected (S201); receiving an ultrasonic echo based on ultrasonic waves returned from a uterine region of an object to be detected, and acquiring an ultrasonic echo signal based on the ultrasonic echo (S202); processing the ultrasonic echo signals to obtain three-dimensional volume data of the uterine region of the object to be detected (S203); identifying endometrium from the three-dimensional volume data of the uterine region according to the image features of endometrium of the uterine region, and obtaining position information of the endometrium (S204); performing endometrial tangential plane imaging based on three-dimensional volume data according to the endometrial position information to obtain an endometrial tangential plane image; and displaying the endometrial slice images.
assignee_clean: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司

title: Ultrasonic scanning method, ultrasonic device, system and storage medium
assignee: 无锡祥生医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of ultrasonic scanning, in particular to an ultrasonic scanning method, ultrasonic equipment and an ultrasonic scanning system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time image of a target object and a part to be scanned; determining a three-dimensional model of the part to be scanned based on the real-time image of the target object; and determining coordinate points of the target track line and the space orientation of each coordinate point according to the position relation between each coordinate point in the preset track line and the three-dimensional model so as to scan the part to be scanned. The method comprises the steps of determining a three-dimensional model of a part to be scanned through a real-time image of a target object, and determining coordinate points of a target track line and space orientations of all coordinate points so as to scan the part to be scanned; the method has stronger intuitiveness, has low professional requirements on operators, ensures comprehensive scanning of the part to be scanned in the scanning process, and lays a more accurate foundation for subsequent medical diagnosis.
assignee_clean: 无锡祥生医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 无锡祥生医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Multi-sensor, multi-view, multi-frame, multi-task synthetic image fusion engine for mobile imaging system
abstract: A method includes obtaining, using at least one processor of an electronic device, multiple calibration parameters associated with multiple sensors of a selected mobile device. The method also includes obtaining, using the at least one processor, an identification of multiple imaging tasks. The method further includes obtaining, using the at least one processor, multiple synthetically-generated scene images. In addition, the method includes generating, using the at least one processor, multiple training images and corresponding meta information based on the calibration parameters, the identification of the imaging tasks, and the scene images. The training images and corresponding meta information are generated concurrently, different ones of the training images correspond to different ones of the sensors, and different pieces of the meta information correspond to different ones of the imaging tasks.

title: Meibomian gland segmentation network training method and device based on multiple supervision modes
abstract: The application relates to a meibomian gland segmentation network training method and device based on a plurality of supervision modes, belonging to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing full supervision training on the UNet by using the first data set to obtain a pre-trained UNet; inputting the first meibomian gland sample image, the second meibomian gland sample image and the noise-added second meibomian gland sample image into the pre-trained UNet to obtain a prediction result of the first meibomian gland sample image, a pseudo image label of the second meibomian gland sample image and a prediction result of the noise-added second meibomian gland sample image; calculating self-supervision learning loss, full-supervision learning loss and semi-supervision learning loss based on the prediction result and the pseudo image label so as to perform multi-supervision training on the pre-trained UNet to obtain a meibomian gland segmentation network; compared with the full supervision learning, the method has the advantages that the semi-supervision learning and the self-supervision learning are introduced, so that more useful information can be extracted from the non-labeling meibomian gland images.

title: Electrocardiosignal acquisition device and quality grade evaluation and QRS wave detection method
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable electrocardiosignal acquisition device and a method for automatically evaluating signal quality grade and detecting QRS wave, wherein the device comprises a plurality of viscous electrodes, an electrocardiosignal acquisition device, a wireless transmission network, intelligent mobile equipment and a cloud storage and analysis platform; firstly, collecting 12-lead electrocardiosignals by utilizing a developed device; then, the electrocardiosignals are transmitted to intelligent mobile equipment by means of a wireless network to carry out automatic evaluation on signal quality grade and QRS wave detection; and finally, uploading the acceptable quality grade signal to a cloud storage and analysis platform. The doctor accesses the platform through a Web browser and analyzes and processes the electrocardiogram signal, and the user views the electrocardiogram in the same way. The device developed by the invention is combined with intelligent mobile equipment to realize signal acquisition, transmission and quality grade evaluation in a remote state. The QRS wave detection algorithm provided by the invention has better effect on low-quality signals, and provides an effective technical means for assisting the diagnosis of heart diseases.

title: Cross-contrast magnetic resonance super-resolution method and system based on variational self-encoder
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-contrast magnetic resonance super-resolution method and system based on a variation self-encoder. Firstly, acquiring high-resolution and low-resolution magnetic resonance imaging of different contrasts of the same subject; then designing a mapping from low resolution to high resolution image for super resolution network learning with single contrast; and then, designing an encoding and decoding module to learn the contrast information, and accessing a super-resolution network with single contrast to finish cross-contrast reconstruction.
