The invention adopts the pulse space-time analysis model to quantitatively describe the change of the pulse signal period and the waveform, can judge the age and the heart rhythm, and can realize intelligent identification and burst early warning of malignant arrhythmia.

title: Method and apparatus for generating signal of user equipment and base station in wireless communication system
assignee: Lg Electronics Inc., Korea Advanced Institute Of Science And Technology
abstract: Disclosed herein is a method of transmitting a signal of a user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system. The method includes generating an optical signal related to data transmission, combining an electrical signal for the data with the optical signal, and transmitting a combined signal.
assignee_clean: lg electronics; korea advanced institute of science and technology

title: Riding system of robot and method thereof
abstract: A riding system of a robot which supports a PUI through user authentication to provide convenience to users, and including a server for exchanging authentication information with the robot; a mobile terminal including an application interlocking with the server and for arranging use information of the user through the application and for calling the robot through the application; and a robot storing the authentication information, to authenticate the user through the authentication information when there is a call from the mobile terminal, and deforming according to a body size of the user included in the use information and to allow the user to ride thereon and to move the user to the destination, and a control method thereof.

title: CT image reconstruction method based on MRI
abstract: The invention discloses a CT image reconstruction method based on MRI, which comprises the following steps: 1) reconstructing MRI by using a deep learning network, training the deep learning network, acquiring undersampled k-space data of an object to be detected, and inputting the undersampled k-space data of the object to be detected into the trained deep learning network to acquire on-line MRI of the object to be detected; 2) CT images are reconstructed from MRI using a two-way generating countermeasure network. The invention has the following advantages: (1) MRI imaging speed is high; (2) the application range is wide, and the imaging device can be used for lung imaging and imaging of other parts of a human body; (3) CT images are obtained through MRI reconstruction, and ionizing radiation of CT examination is avoided; (4) the reconstructed CT images can also be used for radiation therapy planning, and PET attenuation correction.

title: Switch terminal system with an activity assistant
abstract: A system is provided for controlling a first switch terminal of a building occupied by one or more building occupant. The system includes a plurality of switch terminals at the building. A first computer system is coupled to the first switch terminal or equivalent of the building at a first location of the building. The first computer system runs on at least one platform. A first plurality of sensors is coupled to the first switch terminal and the first computer system. At least a portion of the sensors provide signal data to the first computer system. The first computer system produces a command or data output that relates to at least one of: a command output for a local control system, a command output for a different system, a data output for a different system, a command output for a non-local device or a data output that is a non-local device. A second switch terminal includes a second plurality of sensors coupled to a second computer system. An activity assistant is coupled to the system for controlling a first switch terminal.

title: System and method for validating data
abstract: A system and method are provided for validating data. The method is executed by a device having a data interface coupled to a processor and includes obtaining a validation set comprising at least one validation case, each validation case comprising at least one test condition. The method also includes obtaining, via the data interface, at least one data set to be validated using the validation set. The method also includes applying the validation set to the at least one data set to validate the data in the data set by, for each record in the at least one data set, validating a value in the record according to the at least one test condition. The method also includes outputting a validation result for each record.

title: Inventory adjustment method and system based on supply chain management
assignee: 深圳市天人供应链管理有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an inventory adjustment method and system based on supply chain management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first inventory information of a first enterprise in a first supply chain, wherein the first supply chain further comprises an upstream enterprise and a downstream enterprise of the first enterprise; acquiring logistics supply information and product demand information of an upstream enterprise and a downstream enterprise to a first enterprise in a period of time of a first supply chain; based on the historical logistics supply information and the historical product demand information of the first supply chain, the logistics supply information and the product demand information are adjusted, and first logistics supply information and first product demand information are obtained; adopting NSGA-II genetic algorithm to carry out multi-objective optimization on the stock to obtain a plurality of optimization results; acquiring inventory adjustment requirements of a first enterprise; and selecting and obtaining a first inventory adjustment scheme from a plurality of optimization results according to inventory adjustment requirements, and performing inventory adjustment of a first enterprise.
assignee_clean: 深圳市天人供应链管理有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市天人供应链管理有限公司

title: Dynamic cloudlet fog node deployment architecture
abstract: An architecture for providing an on-demand dynamic cloudlet instantiation by leveraging a grouping of software defined network devices and their respective associated analytics modules. A method can comprise receiving quality of service data representing a 5G small cell device of a group of 5G small cell devices; generating a policy rule representing a predictive policy to facilitate an instantiation of a dynamic on-demand cloudlet node into a fog of dynamic on-demand cloudlet node instantiations; and facilitating the instantiation of the dynamic on-demand cloudlet node into the fog, by a hybrid fiber coaxial device, based on the policy rule and an indication received from the hybrid fiber coaxial that a traffic surge in communications with the 5G small cell device has occurred.
assignee_clean: at t intellectual property i; l p

title: Dental images processed with deep learning for national security
abstract: Deep learning of dental images for national security is described. A computer may receive dental images of a patient from a dental provider. The computer is configured to match dental images to law enforcement databases such as a terrorist database. The process begins with matching a dental image to an anatomy probability dataset and a pathology probability dataset, then correlating it with a patient database to identify a person of interest. With different resolutions each neural network deep learns to probability map and detect different dental object probabilities to authenticate an individual. Further, the dental images will be associated with GPS coordinates to track movements of an individual. The datasets will be provided to e-commerce providers, e-commerce consumers, e-commerce administrators, machine learning entities, government entities and law enforcement entities which may exchange or transfer the data over a communication network such as the internet to locate a person of interest.

title: ICU mortality prediction method and system based on punishment integration model
assignee: 杭州妞诺科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an ICU mortality prediction method and system based on a punishment integration model, wherein the ICU mortality prediction method based on the punishment integration model comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of raw data features of an ICU patient from a plurality of dimensions; preprocessing a plurality of acquired original data features; mining and extracting new data features on the basis of the original data features; selecting the original data features and the new data features based on an algorithm in the integrated model to form an input feature set; the formed input feature set is input into a trained and tested integrated model to obtain ICU mortality prediction results, wherein the integrated model integrates a logistic regression algorithm based on a weight penalty strategy and a LightGBM algorithm based on the weight penalty strategy.
assignee_clean: 杭州妞诺科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州妞诺科技有限公司

title: Query expansion in information retrieval systems
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for query expansion. The method comprises: a) receiving a current query having at least one search term; b) inputting the at least one search term of the current query to a set of one or more query expansion modules, wherein the query expansion modules are configured to predict expansion terms of input terms; c) receiving from the set of expansion modules candidate expansion terms of the search term; d) modifying the current query using at least part of the candidate expansion terms, resulting in a modified query having at least one modified search term, The method further comprises repeating steps b) to d) using the modified query as the current query, the repeating being performed until a predefined stopping criterion is fulfilled.

title: Proactive building maintenance for smart buildings
abstract: A processor may receive an input dataset. The input dataset may include a plurality of construction components and one or more performance factors of the building/structure. A processor may generate a digital twin of the building/structure using the input dataset. A processor may simulate, using the digital twin, one or more features of the building/structure. The simulating may include a forecast having one or more predicted conditions associated with the building/structure.

title: Method and apparatus for indoor disinfection
abstract: FIELD: medical equipment.SUBSTANCE: group of inventions relates to medicine, namely to robotic apparatuses for indoor disinfection. The apparatus comprises a logistics platform, a body rigidly attached to the logistics platform, a disinfection module, a human and machine interaction module, an optoelectronic apparatus, and a control module. The logistics platform is configured to move the robotic apparatus. The disinfection module comprises at least one UV lamp providing disinfection treatment. The human and machine interaction module is configured to identify the user and to set the operating mode of the robotic apparatus. The control module is configured to construct a room map, collect and process the information from the optoelectronic device, construct a set of disinfection points in the room based on the obtained room map, calculate the irradiation time at each constructed point, and to form data for transmission to the disinfection module based on the constructed set of disinfection points and the calculated irradiation time. The disinfection points and the irradiation time at each constructed point are determined based on: the characteristics of the room obtained using the room map; the volume of air in the room determined based on the characteristics of the room; the current location of objects in said room; the preset degree of irradiation of the room.EFFECT: increase in the efficiency of disinfection of the room is achieved due to intelligent determination of the disinfection points and irradiation time.29 cl, 8 dwg

title: Fundus image multi-label classification model generation method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a fundus image multi-label classification model generation method and system based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing association analysis on the fundus image set according to the knowledge graph label information, and generating an initial graph database according to the association analysis result; sample balancing is carried out on the initial graph database, and a target graph database is obtained; extracting features of fundus images in a target graph database to obtain image feature vectors; word embedding vector representation is carried out on the knowledge graph in the target graph database, and the graph convolution network is utilized to transfer and learn the embedded label vector so as to obtain a label classification matrix; performing multi-label classification according to the image feature vector and the label classification matrix to determine a prediction classification label; optimizing the multi-label classification model according to the prediction classification labels and the real labels. The invention can improve the correlation among disease labels and the accuracy of the identification result when the multi-label classification model carries out multi-label identification of fundus images.

title: Regulatory compliance for applications applicable to providing a service for regulatory compliance on a cloud
abstract: A computer system accesses and processes regulatory requirements for data item(s) in a private manner. Both the data item(s) and the regulatory requirements are accessed and processed privately. The computer system creates an orchestration strategy satisfying the regulatory requirements. The orchestration strategy includes recommendation(s) associating the data item(s) with process(es). The computer system outputs indications of the orchestration strategy to be used to implement regulatory compliance for processing of the data item(s) by associated ones of the process(es). The computer system may be implemented as a portion of a cloud environment, and compliance may be offered as a service for cases where data usage by an application (implementing the process(es)) does not address compliance with the regulatory requirements, but following the orchestration strategy ensures use of the application on the data item(s) will comply with the regulatory requirements.

title: Image-text mutual inspection method, system, equipment and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 苏州浪潮智能科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a computer readable storage medium for image-text mutual inspection, which are used for acquiring a group of target texts and a group of target images to be retrieved, wherein the target texts comprise various sub-information representing target information; determining target text input information corresponding to a target text; processing target text input information based on a text processing model in the image-text mutual detection neural network model to obtain a target text processing result; the text processing model is built based on self-supervision learning, and the self-supervision learning is used for carrying out supervision learning on the target text based on the associated information among all kinds of sub information; processing the target image based on an image processing model in the image-text mutual detection neural network model to obtain a target image processing result; determining an image retrieval result of the target text in the target image and/or determining a text retrieval result of the target image in the target text based on the target text processing result and the target image processing result; the accuracy of mutual detection of the pictures and the texts can be ensured.
assignee_clean: 苏州浪潮智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 苏州浪潮智能科技有限公司

title: Image recognition method and device and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image identification method, an image identification device and a storage medium, wherein an echocardiogram of a heart and reference dimension information of a cardiac cycle region are obtained, cardiac cycle detection is carried out on the echocardiogram according to a cardiac cycle detection network model and the reference dimension information of the cardiac cycle region to obtain region information of a plurality of cardiac cycle regions, target region position information is determined from the region position information of the plurality of cardiac cycle regions, a cardiac cycle region image to be detected is extracted from the echocardiogram according to the target region position information, and the position information of positioning points of inner and outer layers of a heart chamber wall is obtained by detecting the positioning points of the heart chamber wall on the heart cycle region image by adopting a positioning point detection network model. The scheme can improve the efficiency and accuracy of image recognition.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Joint image processing method and device and computing equipment
assignee: 张逸凌, 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 长木谷医疗科技(青岛)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a joint image processing method, which is suitable for being executed in computing equipment, wherein a prosthesis model library corresponding to each joint is stored in the computing equipment, each prosthesis model library comprises a plurality of types of prostheses required by the joint, and each type of prosthesis comprises a plurality of prosthesis models, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image of a joint region, wherein the original image comprises a slicing region and a boundary region; image interception and rectangular conversion are carried out on the flaky area to obtain a joint image after inclination correction; generating the maximum indicating line of various types of prostheses required by the joint in the joint image; respectively calculating prosthesis images of a plurality of models of each type of prosthesis in the joint images according to the scaling of the joint images; and selecting the prosthesis image which is most matched with the maximum indicating line of each prosthesis to obtain the joint image containing the most matched prosthesis image. The invention also discloses a corresponding joint image processing device and a computing device.
assignee_clean: 张逸凌; 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司; 长木谷医疗科技 青岛 有限公司

title: Cervical OCT image classification method and device based on self-supervision texture contrast learning
abstract: The invention provides a cervical OCT image classification method and device based on self-supervision texture contrast learning. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a plurality of cervical OCT images into a pre-training data set and a classification data set according to a first proportion, and dividing the cervical OCT images in the classification data set into a training data set and a test data set according to a second proportion; setting a contrast loss function, and training a pre-training model through a pre-training data set to obtain a first model, wherein the pre-training model comprises a local binary pattern, a data enhancement layer, a backbone network and a multi-layer perceptron; a layer of full-connection layer is used as a classifier to replace a multi-layer perceptron in the first model, a second model is obtained, a new contrast loss function is set, and the second model is trained through a training data set, so that a classification model is obtained; and predicting the cervical OCT image in the test data set through a classification model to obtain a classification result. By the invention, the performance of the model is greatly improved on a small-scale data set.

title: Livestock product distribution system and method based on neural network and livestock product distribution metaverse platform
abstract: Embodiments provide a livestock product distribution system and method based on neural network and a livestock product distribution metaverse platform. The livestock product distribution system based on neural network according to an embodiment comprises: an order analysis module receiving a plurality of pieces of order information from a first client and analyzing the plurality of pieces of order information, wherein the plurality of pieces of order information include first order information and second order information, and the plurality of pieces of order information respectively include information corresponding to order time, order product, order quantity, and order price; a processor; a notification module generating a notification signal under the control of the processor and transmitting the notification signal to the first client; and a database for storing the first order information and the second order information. The order analysis module receives the first order information from the first client at a first time point, receives the second order information from the first client at a second time point subsequent to the first time point, generates first order prediction information including an analysis result on order possibility and order expected time of the first client based on the first order information and the second order information, stores the first order prediction information in the database, wherein the first order prediction information includes a first order expected interval having a third time point subsequent to the second time point as a start time point and a fourth time point subsequent to the third time point as an end time point, and determines whether to generate the notification signal based on whether third order information is received from the first client in the first order expected interval. The livestock product distribution system provides a financing function for product transactions and transaction payment, and a logistics tracking function.

title: Anomaly detection
abstract: Disclosed is a computing platform including a memory assembly having encoded thereon executable control-logic instructions configured to be executable by the computing platform, and also configured to urge the computing platform to carry out a method comprising receiving data; and detecting at least one anomaly contained in the data that was received.

title: Method for establishing PD (potential of Hydrogen) diagnosis model based on multi-modal magnetic resonance imaging omics
abstract: The invention discloses a method for establishing a PD diagnosis model based on multi-modal magnetic resonance imaging group, which is expected to improve the current situation that PD diagnosis excessively depends on subjective evaluation by converting multi-modal brain magnetic resonance images into high-order and massive brain features with potential values and establishing a diagnosis model by means of machine learning. According to the method, a group of brain image omics characteristics mainly based on black iron distribution are obtained through image processing, data segmentation, characteristic extraction, characteristic screening, model construction and external independent verification, and the method also has good diagnosis accuracy during external independent verification. Secondly, the random forest classifier constructed based on the brain imaging omics characteristics has good performance in diagnosing different clinical states of PD (early stage patients, middle and late stage patients, PD patients without drug treatment and drug treatment, PD patients with tremor as a main type and PD patients without tremor as a main type).

title: Device and method for rapidly detecting blood viscosity based on ultrasonic guided waves of fine metal tubes
abstract: The invention discloses a device and a method for rapidly detecting blood viscosity based on ultrasonic guided waves of a micro metal tube. The device comprises a device shell, a blood sampling unit and a blood sampling circuit, wherein the blood sampling unit is electrically connected with the blood sampling circuit; the sampling pipe and the sample discharge pipe are respectively arranged at two sides of the device shell, the inlet of the sampling pipe is communicated with the device shell and is externally used for connecting an external blood sampling module, the outlet of the sampling pipe is communicated with the inlet of the blood micro-flow pump through the micro-fine metal pipe, the outlet of the blood micro-flow pump is communicated with the inlet of the sample discharge pipe, and the outlet of the sample discharge pipe is communicated with the outside of the device shell; the magnetic striction assembly comprising permanent magnet, coil and magnetic striction powder coating is set outside the superfine metal pipe. The invention overcomes the problems of poor real-time performance, overlarge collection amount, incapability of being used in operation and emergency situations, large error caused by environmental factors in the measurement process and the like of the traditional blood viscosity measurement, can realize the real-time accurate measurement of the blood viscosity, and has the advantages of small blood sampling amount and convenient sampling.

title: Three-dimensional MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) semi-automatic focus image segmentation method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and discloses a three-dimensional MRI semi-automatic focus image segmentation method and a system, wherein the range of a focus slice and the position of an initial slice are determined by observing an MRI three-dimensional image, and an initial focus area and an initial normal area are divided on the initial slice; dividing the focus of the initial slice, classifying voxels in the expansion region by using a classifier, and obtaining a final focus region and a final normal region of the initial slice after multiple iterations; projecting the final focus area and the final normal area on the initial slice to adjacent slices to obtain the initial focus area and the initial normal area of the adjacent slices; dividing other section focuses, namely repeating the processes of section focus division and region projection, dividing all focuses in the focus section range, and combining the focuses to obtain the whole focus region; through the operation, the invention can obtain the focus image of the three-dimensional MRI.

title: Lightweight image segmentation method, system, medium, terminal and application
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing, and discloses a lightweight image segmentation method, a lightweight image segmentation system, a lightweight image segmentation medium, a lightweight image segmentation terminal and lightweight image segmentation application, wherein a training data set is obtained, and images and real label images in the training data set are subjected to cutting processing; constructing an improved U-Net coding and decoding network, and training the constructed improved U-Net coding and decoding network by utilizing the images in the cut training data set and the real label graph; and performing light-weight image segmentation by using a trained improved U-Net coding and decoding network. The invention improves the feature extraction capability, is lighter, enhances the network training performance and improves the reasoning efficiency; the image segmentation performance is improved, and meanwhile, the segmentation efficiency is considered.

title: Intelligent wearable assembly of self-powered flexible electrode and intelligent wearable system
abstract: The application discloses wearable subassembly of intelligence and wearable system of intelligence of self-power flexible electrode, wherein, the subassembly includes: a wearable ornament; a self-powered flexible electrode disposed on an inner side of the wearable charm; the bioelectricity detection host is arranged outside the wearable object and used for detecting micro-current and weak magnetic field of a human body; and the microcontroller is arranged on the outer side of the wearable object and is respectively and electrically connected with the flexible electrode and the bioelectricity detection host. Monitoring electromagnetic fields of cell quantum level in each organ of the body based on big data and algorithm of skin resistance; the flexible electrode is used, so that a user is more comfortable and convenient to carry and can track the early warning and real-time treatment effect at any time; the self-powered flexible electrode is used, self-power supply and self-storage can be realized, energy can be stored through illumination, extra charging is not needed, and the standby time is long.

title: Recognizing damage through image analysis
abstract: Implementations of this specification provide for recognizing damage through image analysis. An example method includes obtaining a marked picture, the marked picture including one or more damage mark boxes, each damage mark box framing a respective portion of the marked picture depicting a damaged object; using a damage detection model to predict at least one damage prediction region in the marked picture, the at least one damage prediction region including a first damage prediction region; determining a location loss term related to a location deviation in a loss function for a current prediction, including determining whether any of the one or more damage mark boxes fully encompasses the first damage prediction region; and updating the damage detection model based on the loss function, such that the damage detection model is adjusted to reduce deviations between damage mark boxes and damage prediction regions.

title: Shopping system and method based on user characteristic information and product component information
assignee: 弗雷森斯(苏州)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic commerce, and particularly relates to a shopping system and method based on user characteristic information and product component information, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the information acquisition subsystem is used for acquiring product information and user information; the user portrait construction subsystem is used for constructing a user portrait according to the collected user information; the product portrait construction subsystem is used for constructing a product portrait according to the acquired product information; the data association subsystem is used for carrying out data association according to the constructed user portrait and the product portrait; the push system can provide article recommendation aiming at different user individuations and is established based on the user portrait and the product portrait, so that the accuracy of the push result is high.
assignee_clean: 弗雷森斯 苏州 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 弗雷森斯 苏州 科技有限公司

title: Brain glioma segmentation method based on cascade deep neural network model
abstract: The invention relates to a brain glioma segmentation method based on a cascade deep neural network model, and belongs to the field of medical image processing. The model comprises a WT-Net, a TC-Net and an ET-Net coding and decoding submodule, wherein the WT-Net coding and decoding submodule is cascaded with the TC-Net coding and decoding submodule, and the TC-Net coding and decoding submodule is cascaded with the ET-Net coding and decoding submodule; the coding and decoding submodules comprise a coding part, a decoding part and a layer jump connection. According to the invention, the complex multi-classification problem is decomposed into three two classification problems, the cascade model solves the problems of low sample utilization degree, unbalanced training samples and global information loss in the feature extraction process, realizes automatic segmentation of MRI image brain glioma, and has an auxiliary effect on doctor diagnosis of illness state.

title: Urinary sediment microscopic image visible component identification method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a urinary sediment microscopic image visible component identification method based on deep learning, which comprises four parts of improving an AlexNet model into a De-AlexNet model, transferring model parameters, utilizing a visual convolution neural network model to formulate a reasonable strategy for fine tuning learning rate and cascade characteristics, integrating the De-AlexNet model, a GoogLeNet model and a ResNet model to extract the characteristics of a urinary sediment microscopic image, and designing a fully-connected neural network model as a classifier to classify the integrated characteristics. Compared with the existing method for identifying the visible components in the urinary sediment microscopic image, the method has the advantages of higher identification accuracy, simpler operation and better efficiency.

title: Multi-shot diffusion-weighted MRI reconstruction using unrolled network with U-net as priors
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University
abstract: A method of magnetic resonance imaging performs a scan by a magnetic resonance imaging system to acquire k-space data; applies the k-space data as input to an unrolled convolutional neural network comprising multiple iterations, and generates reconstructed images from the output of the unrolled convolutional neural network by combining images from different shots. Each iteration of the unrolled network performs a first gradient update, applies the result to a first U-net in k-space, performs a second gradient update, and applies a second U-net in image space. The first gradient update and the second gradient update are based on a theoretical gradient from a physical measurement model.
assignee_clean: the board of trustees of the leland stanford junior university
primary_assignee: the board of trustees of the leland stanford junior university

title: Systems and methods for performing inclusive indoor navigation
abstract: This disclosure relates to systems and methods for performing inclusive indoor navigation. State of the art systems and methods require extra hardware and fail to provide accurate localization and navigation with less precision. The method of the present disclosure obtains a nested environment data of a facility and estimate current spatial location of a user in the nested environment using surrounding recognition machine learning model. An optimal path categorized as convenient path, shortest path and multi-destination path from the current spatial location to a destination is determined. The current spatial location of the user is tracked on the optimal path using an augmented reality technique when navigation starts. The optimal path is dynamically updated based on feedback obtained from one or more user interaction modalities. The present disclosure provides user navigation with last meter precision, and no hardware and internet dependency.

title: Method and apparatus for determining supportable service in wireless communication system
abstract: One aspect of the present disclosure provides a method for a first user equipment (UE) to identify a supportable service in a wireless communication system, the method including transmitting, to a second UE, a request that is related to a first service and includes identification information related to the first UE, receiving, from the second UE, a response to the request related to the first service, and transmitting first service data to the second UE based on the response, and thus a V2X UE can stably provide ultra-low latency, enhanced mobile broadband, and massive connectivity required in the 5G communication system.

title: Devices and methods for testing ablation systems
abstract: A system for testing an ablation system comprising an optical box and a catheter connector is disclosed. The system comprises a qualitative beam assessment device, a quantitative beam assessment device, and a processor. The qualitative beam assessment device has a camera configured to record signals related to a beam profile of a beam emitted by the optical box. The quantitative beam assessment device has an energy sensor configured to measure a beam energy of the beam. The processor is configured to receive the signals from the beam assessment devices, determine a qualitative condition of the beam based on the beam profile signals, and determine a quantitative condition of the beam based on the beam energy signals.

title: System and method for a scene builder
abstract: A system and method for creating organized intent clusters or scenes using machine learning algorithms is provided. A method of creating organized intent clusters or scenes comprises extracting intent features related to the plurality of request inputs. The method also includes creating a plurality of groups comprising the extracted intent features. The method includes identifying a cluster based on co-occurring extracted intent features, the co-occurring extracted intent features belonging to a plurality of domains. The method further includes generating a proto-scene based in part by ranking the extracted intent features within the cluster.

title: System and method for planning electric field cancer treatment based on absorbed energy
assignee: Fieldcure Co., Ltd., Korea University Research And Business Foundation
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system for planning electric field cancer treatment based on absorbed energy including: an image classification unit to classify a patient's medical image into an organ and a tumor; a property information setting unit to set property information for each region classified by the image classification unit; a prescription information determination unit to set a prescription method; a dose calculation unit to initially set the number and location of electrodes used for electric field cancer treatment and the electric field intensity for each electrode; and a dose optimization unit to optimize the dose by changing at least one electrode.
assignee_clean: fieldcure; korea university research and business foundation

title: Implant intervention simulation method, selection method, medium and device
assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an implant intervention simulation method, a selection method, a medium and equipment, wherein the implant intervention simulation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a three-dimensional model of the implant; acquiring image data of a target blood vessel; obtaining a blood vessel three-dimensional model according to the image data of the target blood vessel; implanting the implant three-dimensional model into the blood vessel three-dimensional model to obtain an implanted blood vessel three-dimensional model; and performing hemodynamic simulation on the implanted blood vessel three-dimensional model to obtain an implant intervention simulation result. The implant intervention simulation method comprises the steps of blood vessel segmentation, three-dimensional model reconstruction, virtual implantation, hemodynamics simulation and the like, the mutual influence between the implant and the blood vessel is fully considered, the direct effect after the implant is placed can be effectively predicted according to the simulation result, and therefore a basis is provided for selection of the brand and the model of the implant.
assignee_clean: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司

title: Phase transform for object and shape detection in digital images
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: Object and shape detection in digital images utilizing edge detection is described. In a first edge detection approach, phase transformation is utilized in the frequency domain, such as in response to Fourier transform, followed by use of a frequency-domain phase kernel and inverse-Fourier transform. Edge detection is also provided using a phase transform in the spatial domain utilizing a convolution approach. In a second edge detection approach, phase stretching is utilized, such as in combination with phase histogramming along with thresholding and morphological operations. Numerous example images are provided illustrating benefits of the disclosed technology with different applications and under different conditions.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of california
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of california

title: Enhanced determination of cadence for control in mobile
abstract: Methods for controlling in real time an aspect of a process in a mobile or wearable device with a cadence of the device user are described, where the cadence of the device user is determined with an update frequency greater than the user's step frequency, and the controlling is also performed with an update frequency greater than the user's step frequency. For example, the determination of the user's cadence may leverage a combination of frequency and time techniques, with the analysis of, for instance, substantial orientation changes experienced by the device, or the detection of abrupt changes in the user's cadence.

title: MRI whole brain tissue segmentation method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses an MRI whole brain tissue segmentation system based on deep learning, which comprises: the image data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the MR brain image; the image blocking module is used for blocking the preprocessed image; the multi-prior feature network model building module is used for building a multi-prior feature network model based on symmetric prior, edge prior and neighborhood prior feature information; the training module is used for training the multi-prior characteristic network model by utilizing a training set; the label fusion module is used for determining the final segmentation result of each pixel in the MR brain image; and the inverse affine transformation module is used for finishing the transformation operation of the MR brain image from the MNI space to the original image space after determining the final segmentation result of each pixel in the MR brain image. According to the invention, by introducing various prior characteristics, the segmentation result is more accurate, the edges between brain tissues are clearer and the details are richer.

title: Cerebral apoplexy risk prediction intervention method and system
assignee: 国家康复辅具研究中心
abstract: The application relates to a method and a system for predicting and intervening cerebral apoplexy risks. The system comprises: the information collection module is used for collecting blood biochemical data, carotid artery color Doppler ultrasound data and daily continuous monitoring data of high-risk people suffering from cerebral apoplexy; the signal preprocessing and analyzing module is used for preprocessing the data collected by the information collecting module and extracting and analyzing the characteristics; the characteristic fusion module is used for carrying out characteristic fusion on the characteristics obtained through processing and analysis; the stroke risk prediction module is used for predicting the stroke risk according to the characteristics obtained by the characteristic fusion module; the intervention module is used for recommending an intervention scheme according to the risk level obtained by the stroke risk prediction module; and the human-computer interaction module is used for performing human-computer interaction according to the intervention scheme generated by the intervention module, wherein the feature fusion module performs feature fusion on the features obtained by the signal preprocessing analysis module by using a multi-source feature deep neural network fusion algorithm, and finally obtains fusion features DCNN-LSTM.
assignee_clean: 国家康复辅具研究中心
primary_assignee: 国家康复辅具研究中心

title: Methods and systems for improving human hair and scalp using vehicle cameras and big data AI analytics
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc.
abstract: Hair loss/gain and scalp changes are monitored using vehicle cameras and sensors of connected vehicles. Each vehicle is equipped with at least one camera which images the hair and scalp of a person riding in the vehicle. Each vehicle is operatively connected to a hair and scalp improvement application in a computing cloud which includes a registration module which registers each vehicle. Additionally, the person may register with the hair and scalp improvement application to have his/her hair and scalp analyzed when travelling in any of the registered vehicles. The hair and scalp improvement application is operatively connected to a hair and scalp data artificial intelligence (AI) analytics module and a data lake to search and analyze information related to the changes in the hair and scalp images. A hair and scalp treatment recommendation is transmitted to the person.
assignee_clean: toyota motor engineering manufacturing north america
primary_assignee: toyota motor engineering manufacturing north america

title: User-specific session timeouts
abstract: Techniques for described for generating session-related timeout parameters that are user-specific in value. A user-specific timeout parameter offers several advantages over a static timeout parameter, including minimized the risk of session hijacking, fewer stale sessions to manage, and timeout parameters that more closely match the user's actual behavior. A value for a timeout parameter can therefore depend on information stored for a specific user. The stored information can indicate user behavior observed over a period of time encompassing multiple sessions and/or multiple accesses to the same or different resources. In certain embodiments, a value for a timeout parameter is determined by a prediction engine implemented using a machine learning (ML) model. The ML model may determine the timeout parameter based on information obtained records associated with the user for whom the timeout parameter value is being determined, as well as information from records associated with other users.

title: Method and device for speech processing
abstract: Disclosed are a speech processing method and a speech processing device, for performing speech processing by executing artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms and/or machine learning algorithms installed thereon, thus enabling the communication between a user terminal and a server in a 5G communication environment. The speech processing method according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes receiving a user spoken utterance, outputting a voice actor spoken utterance in a voice actor's voice having the highest degree of similarity with a user's voice by using a user-voice actor mapping learning model, the voice actor spoken utterance corresponding to the user spoken utterance, and performing speech recognition for the voice actor spoken utterance.

title: Spine image segmentation method, medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention provides a spine image segmentation method, a medium and an electronic device. The spine image segmentation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a spine sequence image; acquiring a three-dimensional image block according to the spine sequence image; processing the three-dimensional image block by utilizing a vertebra central point positioning network to obtain a vertebra inscribed sphere detection frame, wherein the vertebra central point positioning network is a trained first machine learning model; processing the vertebral inscribed sphere detection frame and the spine sequence image by utilizing a vertebral central point refinement network to obtain a refined vertebral central point coordinate, wherein the vertebral central point refinement network is a trained second machine learning model; and processing the fine vertebra central point coordinates and the three-dimensional image block by utilizing a vertebra segmentation network to obtain a spine mask, wherein the vertebra segmentation network is a trained third machine learning model. The spine segmentation method enables accurate spine positioning and segmentation.

title: Balance diet evaluation prompting method, system, user side and background
abstract: The invention provides a balanced diet prompting method, a balanced diet prompting system, a user side, a background and a front end, and the balanced diet prompting method comprises the following steps: s1, identity registration of a user is carried out; s2, inputting order information of a user; s3, generating diet evaluation of the user according to the order information and by combining at least one of identity information of the user, eating history data and health evaluation standards of nutrition; and S4, presenting the diet evaluation to the user and carrying out targeted prompt. Basic information and health records of a user are combined with health evaluation standards of nutriology, diet evaluation and personalized diet suggestions for various types of people are obtained, diet structure evaluation can be visually presented to the user, and a direction is effectively provided for improving the diet structure of the user; meanwhile, healthy dishes are released by the restaurant, and the dietary balance of the user is ensured in multiple dimensions.

title: Method and device for physical broadcast channel (PBCH) in wireless communication system
abstract: The present specification provides a method for transmitting a PBCH by a base station in a wireless communication system, the method comprising: mapping a PBCH to a plurality of resource elements (REs); and transmitting the PBCH to a terminal on the plurality of REs, wherein the PBCH mapping comprises copying PBCH orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) symbols included in PBCH repetition into an LTE control region, in consideration of a frame structure type.

title: Dose verification method and system based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）
abstract: The invention provides a dose verification method and a system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the field area, the field modulation complexity, the blade movement and the dose characteristic parameters of the intensity modulated radiation treatment plan; establishing a regression model based on a machine learning model, taking the characteristic parameters as input samples of the machine learning model, and setting a standard gamma passing rate as output of the machine learning model; establishing a classification model based on a machine learning model, taking the characteristic parameters as input samples of the machine learning model, and taking the standard gamma passing rate as output of the machine learning model; and carrying out sample training to obtain a regression model and a classification model of optimal prediction, and carrying out prediction gamma passing rate on the characteristic parameters to be verified according to the optimal prediction model so as to predict and classify a clinical intensity modulated radiotherapy plan. The invention can solve the problems of long time and high labor cost of the existing radiotherapy dose verification work, and can improve the efficiency and the quality.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院
primary_assignee: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院

title: Multi-parallel processing of n-dimensional orthogonal splits in transactions and data for a distributed transaction system
abstract: A method of processing data stored in a distributive system may include receiving a data to be stored on a distributed ledger system; fractalizing the transaction data and/or storage data into a plurality of orthogonal components; determining a unique address on the distributed ledger system for each of the plurality of orthogonal components; partitioning the ledger into multiple portions or divisible shares; bifurcating the consensus mechanism between the partitioned ledgers; storing each of the plurality of orthogonal components at the corresponding address in a first ledger; and adding a new block to a second ledger, where the second ledger comprises the unique address on the distributed system for each of the plurality of orthogonal components.

title: For the system being trained for relating to having the medical inspection of body part of concealment anatomical structure, method and computer program
abstract: The present invention is a kind of medical training analog, is used for the training to training of medical expert in the medical inspection including relating to having the body part of the geometry of concealment.This device can include the physical model of body part, and this physical model has the structural texture of the geometry of the concealment at opening and simulated body position, and this device can receive the medical tool of insertion.Video display units can be disposed in the inside configuration of device, to show the physical handicap corresponding to body part or at least one image of health.This at least one image can be changeable, so that the appearance model of this image relates to the defect in the concealment geometry of the mankind or the animal tested patients being suitable for or the outward appearance of health when using medical tools to observe.This training devices is operable as one or more simulations, with according to training method the medical inspection of body part or during train trainee.

title: Adaptive interactive medical training program with virtual patients
abstract: Methods, systems and computer program products are provided for simulating medical management of a virtual patient. In aspects, a computer model is configured to simulate a medical state of a virtual patient, wherein the model comprises a plurality of decision-based pathways, and wherein the virtual patient is associated with a medical condition of a medical subject category. Input is received from a user of a client device, wherein the input is applied to the model to cause progression along nodes of a decision-based pathway, wherein progression along the decision-based pathway corresponds to a change in a medical state of the virtual patient. When the received input causes progression along a decision-based pathway that is not in accordance with accepted medical standards, progression of a catastrophic sequence of the model for the virtual patient is initiated. The decision-based pathway may be traversed based on input from the user, wherein components of the decision-based pathway correspond to changes in a medical state of the virtual patient.

title: Digital trust broker and end to end trust assurance in multi-domain, multi-operator and cloud networks for high security environments
abstract: System and methods of brokering trust across multiple Authentication and Authorization methods in a multi-domain, multi-operator, private and public cloud networks are identified. A Digital Trust Broker (DTB) is disclosed that brokers trust between infrastructure authentication methods that use digital certificates (PKI) and operator/enterprise Authentication/Authorization methods through interaction with multiple operator/service provider control and management platforms. The Digital Trust Broker interacts with vendor management and security platforms for associating device manufacturing, assembly, supply-chain, and logistics attributes for assuring trust of compute, network, storage and other system components that a high security enterprise or service provider acquires and installs in their networks. Additionally, methods of generating enhanced certificates for secure network slices and other Cloud and SDN hosted virtual network functions as trust assured services are also disclosed.

title: Optimizing k-mer databases by k-mer subtraction
abstract: Methods are disclosed for reducing the size of a k-mer reference database used for queries and/or taxonomic classifications when available computer storage and/or memory are inadequate. The k-mers of the reference database have been previously classified to a taxonomy, preferably based on genetic distances. In one method, the k-mers are separated into one or more groups followed by removing k-mers common to the groups. In another method, k-mers are removed based on a selected taxonomic threshold level. A third method combines the features of the previous two methods. The methods are adaptable to machine learning.

title: Methods and systems for protecting user-generated data in computer network traffic
abstract: A method for synchronizing, in a browser state of a web browser application, both automatically-generated content and user-generated content includes retrieving, by a controller application executing on a first computing device, from a profile database, profile content. The method includes receiving, by a first browser application, from the controller application, a first request including automatically-generated content based on the retrieved profile content. The method includes transmitting, by the first browser application, a first network request, the network request including the automatically-generated content. The method includes synchronizing, by a second browser application, a browser state of the second browser application with a browser state of the first browser application. The method includes receiving, by the second browser application, a second request including user-generated content. The method includes transmitting, by the second browser application, a second network request including the user-generated content and data from the synchronized browser state.

title: Target region segmentation recognition method and system for CT image
abstract: The invention discloses a target region segmentation recognition method and a target region segmentation recognition system for CT images, which belong to the field of biomedical image segmentation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a CT image, performing feature extraction on the CT image by using a transducer encoder to obtain a first feature map, and performing feature extraction on the CT image by using a multi-scale encoder to obtain a second feature map; performing feature fusion on the first feature map and the second feature map by using a feature self-adaptive attention module to obtain a fusion feature map; and (3) performing layer-by-layer feature decoding on the fusion feature map by using a decoder so as to realize end-to-end target region segmentation of the CT image. The system can automatically carry out the sketching operation on the CT image, greatly shortens the time and energy consumed in the manual sketching process, improves the sketching efficiency and precision, and can intuitively display and store the automatic sketching result to the local so as to facilitate the follow-up checking and proofreading.

title: System for determining prognosis condition of liver cancer patient based on artificial neural network model
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京地坛医院
abstract: The invention provides a device for judging prognosis condition of a liver cancer patient based on an artificial neural network model, which comprises the following components: (1) An input module configured to input tumor characteristic information of a patient to be diagnosed with liver cancer; (2) The prognosis judging module is arranged to comprise an artificial neural network model, and the artificial neural network model is used for calculating the prognosis condition of the liver cancer patient to be judged based on the input information; (3) An output module configured to output the resulting prognosis. The invention also provides a method for grouping prognosis conditions of liver cancer patients by using the device.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京地坛医院
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京地坛医院

title: Exhaled air purification unit and system for indoor multi-person venues or environments
abstract: An air management system for a common indoor room or space that comprises a plurality of air outflow apertures or vents, a plurality of air curtains having at least a portion of the air curtains separated from one another, a plurality of separated air suction intakes, and an air sterilization and/or air cleaning mechanism.

title: Cloud-based multi-tenancy computing systems and methods for providing response control and analytics
abstract: Cloud-based multi-tenancy computing systems and methods for providing response control and analytics are disclosed. An exemplary method includes capturing a first set of data based on activities that occur in the activated response center related to the client's actions taken in response to the event; generating a first set of analytics based on the captured first set of data; capturing a second set of data based on activities that occur in a plurality of response centers of client tenants related to the clients' actions taken in response to the events that occurred to them;generating a second set of analytics based on the captured second set of data; and based on the first and second set of analytics produced by the response system, generating and transmitting an updated menu of suggested actions for responding to a future event, to one or more of the clients.

title: System for providing product life-cycle management service
abstract: Provided is a system for providing a care service for each life cycle of a product. The system comprises: a user terminal which requests for a care service corresponding to one of a product purchase, product installation, product transfer, product maintenance, and used product trade, and receives the schedule of the requested care service; one or more technician terminals receiving the work allocated for the product installation, product transfer, and product maintenance; and a care service provision server which includes a personnel management unit building a personnel pool by registering the one or more technician terminals, a total care unit which manages the transmission of quotations, the management of schedule, and the trade of used products corresponding to the care service requested by the user terminal, a work distribution unit which allocates the work for the installation, transfer, and maintenance of product to one or more technician terminals, and a transmission unit which transmits the schedule of the one or more technician terminals to the user terminal. The present invention aims to provide a system for providing a care service for each life cycle of a product, which is able to provide a total care service for home appliances.

title: Apparatus, system, and method for displaying a timeline of semantic classifications
abstract: A system and method performs the steps of: retrieving a report for an imaging exam; parsing text from the report; mapping the parsed text to an ontology; automatically deriving a classification scheme from ontology concepts extracted from the report for the imaging exam; assigning semantic categories to the imaging exams using the ontology concepts and the classification schemes; and grouping the imaging exam with other imaging exams based on the assigned semantic category.

title: Biomarker for detecting novel coronavirus infection by saliva and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a biomarker for detecting novel coronavirus infection by using saliva and application thereof, and discloses an ALB, LCP1, HP, CFB, LRG and IL1B which are highly expressed in saliva of a patient infected by the novel coronavirus and can be used as an important biomarker for detecting a patient with severe new coronavirus by using saliva; SAA1, SERPING1, SERPINA3, C9, C6, LUM, TNF, CRP, SAA, LBP and CLEC3B can also be detected in saliva and can be used as reference biomarkers for detecting patients with new crown severity by using saliva. The invention discloses the effect of the substances as biomarkers in preparing the novel coronavirus saliva detection kit for the first time, can rapidly detect novel coronavirus infection, has the advantages of easily obtained samples, high detection efficiency and high speed, reduces the infection risk of operators, and has high sensitivity and specificity.

title: Tumor tissue specimen identification method and system based on nuclear magnetic resonance signals
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying tumor tissue specimens based on nuclear magnetic resonance signals, which are used for identifying benign and malignant tumor tissue specimens under surgery and improving the identification speed and accuracy. The invention relates to a method and a system for identifying tumor tissue specimens based on nuclear magnetic resonance signals, which are used for collecting multi-dimensional nuclear magnetic resonance signals of tumor tissue specimens cut off in operation by adopting a multi-dimensional pulse sequence, and identifying benign and malignant tumor tissue specimens by analyzing and processing the nuclear magnetic resonance signals. Compared with the prior art, the embodiment of the invention does not need to perform pathological section examination, only needs to collect and process nuclear magnetic resonance signals of the cut tumor tissue, and effectively improves the recognition speed. According to the embodiment of the invention, the nuclear magnetic resonance signal is used as the processing object for processing and analysis, so that the identification result is obtained, the dependence on human experience is avoided, and the identification accuracy is effectively improved.

title: Systems and methods for unsupervised neologism normalization of electronic content using embedding space mapping
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for utilizing a comment moderation bot for detecting and normalizing neologisms in social media. One method comprises transmitting, by a neologism normalization system, a comment moderation bot for detecting neologisms on an online platform maintained by one or more publisher systems. The comment moderation bot may aggregate data related to user comments and transmit the aggregated data to the neologism normalization system for further processing. The neologism normalization system implements unsupervised machine learning models for detecting neologisms in the aggregated data through tokenization and filtering; and normalizing the neologisms through similarity analysis and lattice decoding.

title: Data lifecycle discovery and management
abstract: Techniques for data lifecycle discovery and management are presented. Data lifecycle discovery platform (DLDP) can identify data of users, data type, and language of data stored in data stores (DSs) of entities based on scanning of data from databases. DLDP determines compliance of DLDP and DSs with obligations relating to data protection arising out of jurisdictional laws or agreements. DLDP generates rules to facilitate complying with and enforcing laws and agreements. DLDP can determine, and present to authorized users, risk scores relating to levels of compliance of the DLDP, associated platforms, or entities, risk indicator metrics, or a privacy health index of the organization associated with DLDP. DLDP can manage user rights regarding data, and access to data in DSs and information relating thereto stored in secure data store of DLDP. DLDP can remediate issues involving anomalies indicating non-compliance. DLDP can utilize machine learning to enhance various functions of DLDP.

title: Method for transmitting and receiving plurality of physical downlink shared channels in wireless communication system, and device for same
abstract: The present specification provides a method for transmitting and receiving downlink data in a wireless communication system and a device for same. In particular, the method carried out by a terminal may comprise the steps of: receiving downlink control information for scheduling the downlink data in a first time unit and a second time unit; receiving information on mappings between layer groups and transmission configuration indication (TCI) states; receiving downlink data, which is related to a first layer group, in the first time unit on the basis of a first TCI state; receiving downlink data, which is related to a second layer group, in the first time unit on the basis of a second TCI state; and receiving downlink data, which is related to a third layer group, in the second time unit on the basis of a third TCI state.

title: Reconstruction method of three-dimensional model, training method and device of texture reconstruction model
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a three-dimensional model reconstruction method, a texture reconstruction model training method and a texture reconstruction model training device, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. Sampling at least one vertex from a point cloud corresponding to a three-dimensional model to obtain a vertex set; mapping each vertex in the vertex set into three mutually perpendicular planes through an encoding module of the texture reconstruction model, and determining three-plane characteristic information corresponding to the vertex set; carrying out vertex reconstruction according to the three-plane characteristic information by a decoding module of the texture reconstruction model, and determining at least one reconstructed vertex and prediction information corresponding to the at least one reconstructed vertex respectively, wherein the prediction information comprises position prediction information and color prediction information of the reconstructed vertex; and generating a reconstructed three-dimensional model according to the prediction information corresponding to at least one reconstructed vertex. The method improves the accuracy of the reconstructed three-dimensional model.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Systems and methods for classifying electrical signals
abstract: An analog implementation is proposed of an adaptive signal processing model of a kind requiring a plurality of randomly-set variables. In particular, following a digital to analog conversion of a digital input signal, analog processing is used to transform the data input to the model into data which is subsequently processed by an adaptively-created layer of the model. In the analog processing, multiplication operations involving the randomly-set variables are performed by analog circuitry in which the randomly-set variables are the consequence of inherent tolerances in electrical components. This eliminates the need for the randomly-set variables to be implemented in some other way, for example as random variables stored in memory.

title: Systems and methods of monitoring medical implants
abstract: Methods of processing images, such as ultrasound images, to determine integrity of an implant are described. The method may include receiving an ultrasound image of an implant in a body of a subject; determining one or more characteristics of a surface of the implant based on an intensity of pixels of the ultrasound image; generating a predicted status of the implant based on the one or more characteristics by comparison of the one or more characteristics with a database of image data; and displaying the predicted status of the implant. The implant may be a breast implant, for example, wherein the method is useful for analyzing the presence or probability of extracapsular ruptures, contractures, and combinations thereof.

title: Mental health early warning method, server, family member terminal and system
assignee: 广东邮电职业技术学院
abstract: The invention provides a mental health early warning method, which comprises the following steps: receiving the content of the user terminal; performing sentiment analysis on the content; judging the mental health level according to the emotion analysis result; and sending early warning information to the family terminal according to the mental health level. The invention also provides a mental health early warning server, a terminal and a system, which solve the problem that the mental health state cannot be tracked in time in the prior art, and can realize timely tracking and warning through emotion analysis.
assignee_clean: 广东邮电职业技术学院
primary_assignee: 广东邮电职业技术学院

title: Breast cancer image information bottleneck multi-task classification and segmentation method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and provides a breast cancer image information bottleneck multi-task classification and segmentation method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of mammary gland images of contrast enhanced X-ray photography and corresponding benign and malignant categories and lump position pixel level labels; preprocessing each acquired mammary gland image of the contrast enhanced X-ray photography; extracting multitask shared representation for each preprocessed mammary gland image by adopting a multitask network; inputting the shared representation to a classification encoder to obtain a code tensor of the middle layer, and sending the middle code tensor to an information bottleneck attribution module for feature compression and benign and malignant classification to obtain a classification task tensor; fitting the shared representation to a segmentation network to obtain a segmentation task tensor; and performing feature fusion on the classification task tensor and the segmentation task tensor for segmenting the focus.

title: Nuclear magnetic resonance image reconstruction method based on joint optimization sampling matrix
assignee: 北京大学深圳研究生院
abstract: A method for designing a nuclear magnetic resonance image reconstruction based on a joint optimization sampling matrix, comprising: constructing a training data set; the training data set consists of a plurality of full-sampling magnetic resonance images, and each image is obtained by carrying out inverse Fourier transform on K-space full-sampling data acquired by nuclear magnetic resonance equipment; constructing a neural network of a joint optimization sampling matrix and a reconstruction algorithm; training a neural network by combining an optimized sampling matrix and a reconstruction algorithm: based on the training data set, giving a loss function, and updating parameters in the neural network of the joint optimization sampling matrix and the reconstruction algorithm by using a gradient descent algorithm until the loss function value is stable; and (3) performing a magnetic resonance image reconstruction process by applying the learned sampling matrix and a reconstruction algorithm. The method can adaptively learn the optimal sampling matrix and realize the rapid reconstruction of high-quality nuclear magnetic resonance images from K space sub-sampling data acquired by nuclear magnetic resonance equipment.
assignee_clean: 北京大学深圳研究生院
primary_assignee: 北京大学深圳研究生院

title: Registration and superposition method, system, storage medium and equipment
assignee: 沈阳蓝软智能医疗科技有限公司, 无锡蓝软智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a method for registering coincidence, which is used for assisting the planning and implementation of clinical operation. The method comprises the steps of acquiring a point cloud of a preoperative CT image or a nuclear magnetic image as a target point cloud; acquiring a point cloud of a focus area of a patient in an operation, wherein the point cloud is an integral point cloud; acquiring a characteristic region overlapped with the target point cloud from the whole point cloud; registering the target point cloud and the whole point cloud with the overlapped region by adopting a super-4PCS algorithm to obtain a point cloud coordinate of a focus region of a patient in an operation; the point cloud coordinate is a space coordinate when the point cloud of the focus region of the patient in the operation is registered and superposed with the point cloud of the CT image or the nuclear magnetic image before the operation. The invention mainly solves the problem of the registration precision of the three-dimensional model of the non-rigid organ and tissue of the patient and the focus area of the patient in the real operation environment, is convenient for a doctor to quickly and accurately find the organ corresponding to the three-dimensional model of the patient during the operation, and accurately matches the three-dimensional model with the organ.
assignee_clean: 沈阳蓝软智能医疗科技有限公司; 无锡蓝软智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Cancer biomarkers
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of screening for a cancer selected from the group consisting of prostate cancer, thyroid cancer, colon cancer, rectum cancer, lung cancer, uterine cancer, breast cancer, pancreatic cancer, bladder cancer, liver cancer, bile duct cancer, stomach cancer, oesophageal cancer, head and neck cancer, brain cancer, blood cancer, ovarian cancer, skin cancer, melanoma and a neuroendocrine tumour in a subject, said method comprising determining the level and/or chemical composition of one or more of the glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) chondroitin sulfate (CS), heparan sulfate (HS), and hyaluronic acid (HA) in a body fluid sample, wherein said sample has been obtained from said subject.

title: Query modification in a database management system
abstract: Disclosed aspects relate to automated query modification in a database management system (DBMS). A triggering event related to an execution of a query may be detected by an automated query modification engine. A query modification operation may be determined by the automated query modification engine based on a nature of the triggering event. The query modification operation may be determined to debug the triggering event related to the execution of the query. The query modification operation may be carried-out by the automated query modification engine. The query modification operation may be carried-out to modify the query to debug the triggering event related to the execution of the query.

title: Cross-subject model-generated training data for relation extraction modeling
abstract: A first vector representation of a first word within a first narrative text and a machine-generated label corresponding to the first word are constructed. Using the first vector representation, an annotator model is trained. The annotator model is configured to produce a set of probabilities, each probability in the set of probabilities representing a probable output annotation corresponding to a word within a narrative text. The training includes minimizing a difference between a first human-generated label corresponding to the first word and a first probable output annotation corresponding to the first word. Using the trained annotator model and a second narrative text, second training data is generated. The trained annotator model is configured to produce an output annotation corresponding to a word within a narrative text. The second training data is usable to train a relation extraction model.

title: System and method for optical tracking
