First, preprocessing data received from a sensor; processing the graph data by using a graph neural network model, and determining an optimal response strategy by using a reinforcement learning model; secondly, distributing a priority label for each piece of received information; thirdly, comprehensively utilizing methods of quantum computation and heuristic algorithm to provide an optimized path for the topological structure of the wireless communication network; and finally, monitoring and managing fire conditions through a fire alarm and resource scheduling module, and ensuring timely response and coordination of rescue work. The method solves the problems that the prior art often adopts an information transmission mode based on static priority, the priority cannot be changed along with the change of the situation, and the traditional priority optimization method usually depends on specific problem domain knowledge and rules and cannot cope with the situations of insufficient data quantity, concept drift and the like.

title: Graphical user interface displaying relatedness based on shared DNA
abstract: A user may select one or more potential common ancestors with a DNA match to view the target individual's relationship with them. The process may include identifying, from a first genealogical profile of the target individual. A first individual has a first linkage that connects the target individual towards the selected potential common ancestor. The process may also include identifying, from a second genealogical profile of the DNA match, a second individual who has a second linkage that connects the DNA match towards the selected potential common ancestor. The process may further include connecting the first linkage and the second linkage with the selected potential common ancestor by adding one or more individuals whose profiles are retrieved from other searchable genealogical profiles stored in the online system. With the nodes and connections available, the process may generate a map of visual connections between the target individual and the DNA match.

title: ALS patient human-computer interaction system and method based on brain-computer interface and artificial intelligence algorithm
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院, 北京姬械机科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to an ALS patient human-computer interaction system and method based on a brain-computer interface and an artificial intelligence algorithm, wherein the system comprises brain-computer interface BCI signal acquisition equipment for acquiring nerve brain electrical signals of an ALS patient; the effective channel signal selection module is used for digging out an effective contact channel of the brain-computer interface BCI signal acquisition equipment to an ALS patient; the self-adaptive scale adjustment coding module is used for adapting continuous and effective SSVEP coding frequency bands through a self-adaptive algorithm to realize intelligent generation and configuration of different coding schemes for different users; and the AI recognition algorithm module is used for performing model training to form an SSVEP signal recognition artificial intelligent algorithm model by constructing a large-scale pre-training brain-computer BCI brain-computer (BCI) brain-computer data set. The invention is based on portable BCI equipment, combines a signal data analysis algorithm and an artificial intelligence algorithm to automatically extract and identify the brain signal characteristics of the user, efficiently carries out interactive signal coding, improves the interactive efficiency, and widens the interactive application scene of the brain-computer interface.

title: Image processing system and method for generating face data
assignee: 成都睿瞳科技有限责任公司
abstract: The application discloses an image processing system and method for generating face data. Firstly, carrying out image preprocessing on an obtained face image of a target object to remove a background part in the face image of the target object so as to obtain a preprocessed face image, then carrying out image blocking processing on the preprocessed face image so as to obtain a sequence of face local image blocks, then passing the sequence of the face local image blocks through a ViT model containing an embedding layer so as to obtain a face global semantic feature vector, then carrying out distribution gain based on a probability density feature imitation paradigm on the face global semantic feature vector so as to obtain an optimized face global semantic feature vector, and finally, passing the optimized face global semantic feature vector through a first classifier so as to obtain a first classification result for representing whether the recommended level of nose bridge optimization exceeds a preset threshold value. Thus, the accuracy and the efficiency of face analysis can be improved.

title: Ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus and ultrasonic image processing method
abstract: A tomographic image includes a mammary gland image, a greater pectoral muscle image, and a boundary image. A plurality of search paths are set for the tomographic image. In each search path, a boundary search is executed from a deep spot toward a shallow spot. A region of interest is set so as to include the mammary gland image on the basis of a plurality of boundary points. An image portion in the region of interest is an image analysis target.

title: Methods and devices for predicting test scores
abstract: The present specification relates to a method for predicting a test score of a user by a terminal using an artificial intelligence model. The present invention may transmit learning data of the user to a first class for embedding, embed the learning data through the first class, transmit an embedding vector from the first class to a second class including a compressive transformer, transmit an output value to a third class for predicting the test score from the second class, and output a predicted value for predicting the test score from the third class.

title: Wireless body area network data transmission method based on reinforcement learning algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to a wireless body area network data transmission method based on an enhanced learning algorithm, which adopts a mixed data transmission method aiming at the characteristics of a wireless body area network, and specifically comprises the following steps: dividing the nodes into different grades according to the heterogeneous characteristics of different node energy levels, different data services and different workloads; calculating the channel states of the nodes and the sink nodes according to the Markov channel model so as to judge whether the relay nodes are needed during data transmission; if the channel state is good, the data of the node is directly sent to the sink node, otherwise, on the basis of node level division, the optimal path from the node to the sink node is found by using an enhanced learning algorithm, and the path selection is continuously optimized in the data transmission process. The method and the system can ensure that the physiological data related to the wireless body area network are efficiently and reliably transmitted to the sink node, can be applied to a plurality of fields, and ensure the accuracy of the data received by the monitoring center.

title: Confined field of view illumination
abstract: One or more techniques and/or systems are disclosed for effectively illuminating a target. The target may be in a confined field of view area. Such systems may mitigate shadows and lack of light homogeneity at surgical procedure settings, research sites, or other localized areas where humans may operate in a confined field of view area. One or more lighting modules can be disposed in a target area, for illumination of one or more illumination target locations in the confined field of view. An object detection component can detect an object or desired target in the target field of view location, and provide data indicative of the detected object/target to an illumination module adjustment component. Based on the data indicative of the detected object/target, the illumination module adjustment component can provide data indicative of an illumination adjustment to the first illumination module to provide desired illumination.

title: Emergency help-seeking message response method and device
assignee: 天津利信科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an emergency help-seeking message response method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when an emergency help-seeking message is received, the emergency help-seeking message is sent out by pressing an emergency button configured on a terminal, and emergency contact information corresponding to the emergency help-seeking message is determined; notifying an emergency contact according to the emergency contact message so that the emergency contact can confirm and rescue in time according to the emergency help-seeking message; when the emergency contact person cannot be contacted or cannot be rescued in time, the emergency help-seeking message mutual help circle is determined, and emergency help-seeking information is sent to friends of the emergency help-seeking message mutual help circle, so that the obtained friends of the mutual help circle can confirm and rescue according to the emergency help-seeking information. The related contact persons can arrive at the scene in time to check, whether the false triggering alarm is performed or not is confirmed, and when the disease is confirmed, the treatment is performed in time, so that the treatment efficiency can be effectively improved.

title: Generation of matched corpus for language model training
abstract: A computer-implemented method for generating a text is disclosed. The method includes obtaining a first text collection matched with a target domain and a second text collection including a plurality of samples, each of which describes rewriting between a first text and a second text that has a style different from the first text. The method also includes training a text generation model with the first text collection and the second text collection, in which the text generation model has, in a vocabulary, one or more operation tokens indicating rewriting. The method further includes outputting a plurality of texts obtained from the text generation model.

title: Human body falling dynamic monitoring method and system based on multidimensional characteristic parameters
assignee: 四川康谷康业科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a human body falling dynamic monitoring method and system based on multidimensional characteristic parameters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a human body falling monitoring mechanism by using an inertial sensor and a biological sensor, extracting characteristic parameters of data acquired by the inertial sensor and the biological sensor which are composed of acceleration and a gyroscope, and forming a characteristic parameter set; constructing a human body falling decision feature threshold parameter set convolutional neural network learning model, and deciding a human body falling decision feature threshold initial parameter set; correcting the initial parameter set of the characteristic threshold value of the human body falling decision according to the characteristics of different users to obtain the real-time characteristic threshold value parameter set of the user falling decision; and according to the user falling decision real-time characteristic threshold parameter set, carrying out real-time judgment and decision on the user activity behavior state, and outputting a falling state result. The invention introduces multidimensional fall decision feature parameters, and effectively improves the accuracy of fall monitoring.

title: Diabetes early warning model for improving k-means clustering
abstract: The present invention relates toA diabetes mellitus early warning system for improving k-means clustering, the system comprises a storage device; a diabetes pre-warning module based on improved k-means clustering coupled to the storage device and configured to: based on the first cluster center point, stable cluster centers are obtained, and are substituted into a diabetes segmentation function to obtain a diabetes early warning model, wherein a data set is selected, the cluster number k and the field radius epsilon are defined, and a sample point X is selected i The point with the largest sum of the distances from the samples is used as the first clustering center point, so that the first clustering center point falls at the center part of each cluster. The diabetes early warning system establishes a diabetes piecewise function early warning model by using an improved clustering center method, improves the diabetes early warning capability and provides basis for diagnosis and treatment of different stages of diabetes.

title: Image abnormal region detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a method for detecting an abnormal image region, which comprises the following steps: acquiring diagnosis and treatment images and diagnosis and treatment results from a local database, carrying out abnormal region positioning and 3D image construction on the diagnosis and treatment images, and generating 3D abnormal region images; extracting features of the 3D abnormal image to obtain pathological features, vectorizing the pathological features and diagnosis and treatment results, and then selecting a shared sample from the pathological features and the diagnosis and treatment results; training an abnormal region detection model by using the shared sample to obtain an initial model gradient; uploading the initial model gradient to a server and receiving the updated model gradient returned by the server; and detecting the abnormal region of the image to be inspected by using an abnormal region detection model updated according to the updated model gradient. Furthermore, the present invention also relates to blockchain techniques, where the shared samples may be stored in a blockchain. The invention also discloses an image abnormal region detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention can improve the accuracy of detecting the abnormal region of the image.

title: Optical laryngoscope image lesion area marking method based on attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an attention mechanism-based optical laryngoscope image lesion area labeling method, which mainly solves the problems that no lesion area labeling is performed on an optical laryngoscope image and overfitting is easy to occur on a small data set in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a laryngoscope image dataset and an image dataset tag; zooming and centralizing the image data set, and recording the image data set subjected to centralization and the image data set label as a training data set; constructing an 18-layer network, taking a training data set as training data of the network, and optimizing the network by using a self-adaptive learning rate optimization algorithm to obtain a trained network; and inputting a laryngoscope image to the trained network, and obtaining and marking the corresponding lesion area in the label data set according to the generated report. The invention avoids overfitting a small data set, can obtain and mark the lesion area of the optical laryngoscope image and is convenient for doctors to diagnose the optical laryngoscope image.

title: Multi-mode image segmentation method, system, terminal and readable storage medium
abstract: The multi-mode image segmentation method comprises the steps of reading data under each mode of a multi-mode image, obtaining a corresponding three-dimensional matrix, and extracting two-dimensional matrix data slices according to a sagittal plane; then carrying out normalization processing and removing slices which do not contain targets to obtain a training data set; constructing a full convolution neural network model based on the fusion of the coding-decoding structure and the characteristics; performing supervised learning on the full convolution neural network model to obtain a segmentation model with generalization capability; normalizing the actually collected multi-mode image, and inputting the normalized multi-mode image into a segmentation model with generalization capability to obtain a segmentation rough image; and obtaining a fine image segmentation result by using a method for calculating a connected region in morphology for the segmentation rough sketch. The invention avoids the problem of difficult network optimization caused by different modes, and effectively improves the segmentation precision.

title: Vertebral body sub-region segmentation method and device and storage medium
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and discloses a vertebral body subregion segmentation method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the segmentation method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired spine vertebral body image data; inputting the preprocessed image data into a pre-trained neural network model to obtain a sub-region segmentation mask regression result corresponding to the vertebral body of the spine; and performing post-processing on the mask regression result through morphological operation and connectivity test to obtain the upper and lower bony endplates of the vertebral body with uniform thickness and self-defined thickness, and the three-dimensional segmentation mask of the cortical bone side plate and the cancellous bone region, thereby completing the segmentation of the sub-region of the vertebral body. The invention solves the problem that the vertebral body sub-region segmentation method in the prior art can not realize the endplate and the individualized sub-region segmentation of the bone under the endplate which are matched with the complex anatomical shape of the vertebral body bony endplate; poor segmentation performance on the vertebral body side plate and the vertebral body cancellous bone area and low generalization capability.

title: Image processing method and device based on neural network and storage medium
assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an image processing method, apparatus and storage medium based on a neural network, wherein the method comprises: obtaining encryption noise according to the first image, a preset secret key and a noise generator; obtaining a second image according to the first image and the encrypted noise; and obtaining a relevant prediction result of image encryption through the second image and the encrypted neural network. In the embodiment of the disclosure, the encrypted neural network is only effective for the image encrypted by the preset key, and cannot be directly applied to the original image under the condition that the structure and parameters of the neural network are stolen, so that the safety of image processing is improved; meanwhile, the encrypted image still keeps the visual effect of the original image, and after the original image is encrypted and distributed to equipment carrying the encrypted neural network, the encrypted neural network can be used for prediction, and the correctness of a prediction result can be further verified according to the encrypted image.

title: Spine nuclear magnetic resonance image segmentation method based on scene perception fusion network
assignee: 邦世科技(南京)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a spine nuclear magnetic resonance image segmentation method based on a scene perception fusion network, which relates to the field of medical image recognition and comprises the following steps of: inputting a nuclear magnetic resonance image of the spine, and extracting low-layer characteristics, middle-layer characteristics and high-layer characteristics of the image; processing the high-level features using ASPP; the scene perception capacities of the low-layer features and the middle-layer features are increased through a multi-scale feature fusion method; the high-level features are further processed by using global self-adaptive pooling and Sigmoid functions, so that new high-level features are obtained; sequentially multiplying the processed high-level features with the medium-low-level feature points to obtain new high-level features; and sampling the new high-level features, the new low-level features and the new middle-level features to the same size, and performing channel dimension splicing to output a final result. The invention improves the identification effect of the spine segmentation and reduces the calculated amount.

title: System and method for virtual character animation using motion capture
abstract: A system and method for motion capture to efficiently render in-game objects, including characters, and controlling animation of characters and non-player characters. In some embodiments, the motion capture includes a machine learning model that can take as inputs information about the hand pose of a person from multiple sensors over a period of time and generates a highly probable hand pose prediction from that information, based on what it learns from a previously captured dataset of high quality sample motion captures. The systems and methods described herein overcome the imprecision conventional optical marker pipelines for the case of finger movement, where the slightest imprecision yields results that are not good enough for production.

title: Multi-dimension-based post matching degree calculation method and system
assignee: 国能大渡河大数据服务有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a post matching degree calculation method and a system based on multiple dimensions, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of employee information, and establishing a multi-dimensional index system based on the plurality of employee information; acquiring the information of the post to be matched, and acquiring a plurality of employee information related to the post to be matched based on the information of the post to be matched; establishing a multi-level post portrait based on a plurality of employee information and index systems related to the posts to be matched; acquiring information of at least one job seeker, and establishing at least one job seeker portrait based on the information of the at least one job seeker and an index system; and screening at least one matched job seeker from the at least one job seeker based on the multi-level post portrait.

title: Method and apparatus for automated spanning-tree loop detection in networks
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media for identifying a spanning tree loop in a network environment. Spanning tree loop indicators occurring in a network environment that utilizes a spanning tree protocol are identified. The spanning tree loop indicators are correlated to identify correlated spanning tree loop indicators within the network environment. A potential spanning tree loop is recognized from a plurality of the correlated spanning tree loop indicators based on indicator types of the correlated spanning tree loop indicators. The potential spanning tree loop is remedied in the network environment in response to recognizing the potential spanning tree loop in the network environment.

title: Systems and methods for detecting access point impersonators
abstract: The present disclosure is related to systems and methods for detecting and disabling operations of access point impersonators in a network. In one aspect, a method includes receiving, at a network controller of a network, beacon reports from a plurality of access points; determining, by the network controller, one or more target areas with at least one potential access point impersonator operating therein; sending, by the network controller, on-demand beacon requests to one or more of the plurality of access points with corresponding coverage areas overlapping with the one or more target areas; receiving, at the network controller, responses to the on-demand beacon requests from the one or more of the plurality of access points; and determining, by the network controller, at least one access point impersonator based on the responses.

title: Sample image labeling method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a sample image labeling method, a sample image labeling device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: inputting a sample image to be marked into a segmentation marking model to obtain an image marking result; judging whether the sample image to be marked executes the training process of the over-marked model or not based on the training identification of the sample image to be marked; if yes, storing the sample image to be marked and the image marking result into an image marking library according to the image marking result and a preset image marking standard; the image annotation standard is used for representing the quality of an image annotation result, and image data in the image annotation library is used for training an image segmentation model. The method can greatly improve the quality of the labeling data, and further improve the performance of the image segmentation model obtained through training.

title: Hip joint femur near-end segmentation method based on improved U-Net neural network
assignee: 江苏金马扬名信息技术股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image segmentation, in particular to a hip joint femur near-end segmentation method based on an improved U-Net neural network. Firstly, collecting a CT image of the femur of a patient, and preprocessing; 2. constructing a sample library, and marking the femur area to obtain a training set and a testing set; 3. data enhancement is carried out on the training set; 4. constructing an improved U-Net neural network model; 5. training an improved U-Net neural network model; 6. and testing the trained improved U-Net neural network model, outputting a segmentation result, and evaluating the model to obtain the model performance. The invention improves the accuracy of segmenting the proximal end of the femur of the hip joint, and the segmentation result can be used as an important reference basis for femur prosthesis reconstruction, improves the accuracy, objectivity and reliability of diagnosis, and has important significance for the development of target bone segmentation in medical images.

title: Three-dimensional reconstruction method and device of blood vessel image
assignee: 西人马大周(深圳)医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a three-dimensional reconstruction method and a three-dimensional reconstruction device of a blood vessel image. The method comprises the following steps: segmenting the three-dimensional chest image by adopting a level set method to obtain a two-dimensional lung image; obtaining a mask image of the pulmonary blood vessel according to the two-dimensional lung image; carrying out interpolation calculation on the mask image to obtain a complete lung blood vessel image; and performing volume rendering on the pulmonary blood vessel image to obtain a three-dimensional pulmonary blood vessel image. The embodiment of the invention can establish a pulmonary vessel tree, assist doctors in avoiding vessels as much as possible when determining a surgical plan, and reduce the damage to the vessels.

title: Neurofibromatosis segmentation method combined with spatial guidance
abstract: According to the neurofibromatosis segmentation method combining with space guidance, nnU-Net is taken as a main network, space guidance branches are added, and user interaction information is integrated into the network, so that the network can be better segmented through user interaction on the basis of automatic segmentation. Firstly, data preprocessing is carried out on an original image, and then the original image is guided into a network with a certain probability according to a label calculation space during training. When reasoning, firstly, automatic segmentation is carried out, then, a user clicks the false positive and false negative areas to generate a guide label, space guide is generated according to the label, the guide label and a test sample are transmitted into a network to conduct prediction, and the reasoning is circulated until the user is satisfied. The invention combines the deep neural network and the space guidance, not only can complete automatic segmentation, but also can receive user guidance correction segmentation, and can obtain better segmentation results on neurofibromas.

title: Fine tuning method and device for large model, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 摩尔线程智能科技(北京)有限责任公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium for fine-tuning a large model. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a training sample set into at least two training sample subsets, and determining at least two decomposition parameter values corresponding to the at least two training sample subsets one by one, wherein the at least two decomposition parameter values are different from each other; dividing a network layer of a target data processing model into a first network layer group and a second network layer group; initializing a first parameter matrix and a second parameter matrix corresponding to the training sample subsets according to the number of rows and the number of columns of an original parameter matrix corresponding to the first network layer group and decomposition parameter values corresponding to the training sample subsets for any training sample subset in the at least two training sample subsets; and training the target data processing model based on the training sample subset, and updating parameters of the target data processing model.

title: Ultrasound-guided medical tool insertion simulators
assignee: University Of Florida Research Foundation, Incorporated
abstract: A medical tool insertion simulation apparatus. The medical tool insertion simulation apparatus may comprise a syringe having an injection end, and an elongated member protruding from the injection end of the syringe. The elongated member may be configured to decrease a length of protrusion of the elongated member from the injection end of the syringe. The elongated member may be configured to receive at least one first sensor configured to indicate position information relating to the elongated member. At least one computer-readable storage medium encoded with executable instructions that, when executed by at least one processor, cause the at least one processor to perform a method for simulating medical tool insertion. A medical tool insertion simulation system.

title: Real-time managing evacuation of a building
abstract: The present disclosure relates an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 00, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building, triggered by alarm notification (S202). Based on determined (S214) precise real-time positions of personal ultra-wide band, UWB, devices, as determined by UWB real-time localization system, RTLS, a controller determines (S210) evacuation plans being personal UWB device specific in real-time. Based on individual evacuation plans and input from building facilities, real-time guidance information is defined (S208) and sent to each personal UWB device, providing guidance to person carrying said personal UWB device, in what direction to move (S212), to reach a safe area. Based on localization signals the UWB RTLSA then calculates updated positions of the personal UWB devices and sends to the evacuation management system. It is an advantage that trapped or injured people can be found, even in low visibility areas.

title: Neural network operation optimization method and device and related products
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to a neural network operation optimization method, a neural network operation optimization device and related products. The product includes a control module, the control module including: the system comprises an instruction cache unit, an instruction processing unit and a storage queue unit; the instruction cache unit is used for storing calculation instructions related to the artificial neural network operation; the instruction processing unit is used for analyzing the calculation instructions to obtain a plurality of operation instructions; the store queue unit is configured to store an instruction queue, where the instruction queue includes: a plurality of arithmetic instructions or calculation instructions to be executed in the order of the queue. By the method, the operation efficiency of the related products in the operation of the neural network model can be improved.

title: Multi-scale Dtw-BiLstm-Gan electrocardiosignal generation method based on similarity threshold migration
abstract: The invention discloses a multiscale Dtw-BiLstm-Gan electrocardiosignal generation method based on similarity threshold migration, which belongs to the field of data enhancement and comprises the following steps of: acquiring electrocardiosignal data; preprocessing electrocardiosignal data, and dividing an S data set and a V data set into training set data, verification set data and test set data according to a proportion respectively; the multi-scale Dtw-BiLstm-Gan model is formed by a generator, a discriminator and a similarity discriminator; pre-training a V-class heart beat sample data set in a multi-scale Dtw-BiLstm-Gan model to obtain weights of a generator and a discriminator; the weight of the generator and the discriminator is migrated to an S-type heart beat sample training set to be used as an initial weight for training the multiscale Dtw-BiLstm-Gan, the S-type heart beat sample training set is adopted to complete training of the multiscale Dtw-BiLstm-Ga model, and the generator model in the multiscale Dtw-BiLstm-Gan model of the S-type heart beat sample after training is used for generating a batch of pseudo S-type heart beat sample electrocardiosignals, so that the average DTW of the generated network generated signal and the original signal is reduced to about 11.1.

title: Discovery of shifting patterns in sequence classification
assignee: Regents Of The University Of Minnesota
abstract: A method includes receiving data for an entity for each of a plurality of time points. For each of a plurality of time windows that each comprises a respective plurality of time points, a confidence value is determined. The confidence value provides an indication of the degree to which the time window contains data that is useful in discriminating between classes. The confidence values are used to determine a probability of a class and the probability of the class is used to set a predicted class for the entity.
assignee_clean: regents of the university of minnesota
primary_assignee: regents of the university of minnesota

title: Systems and methods for adaptive model processing
abstract: A method performed by an apparatus is described. The method includes receiving remote data. The method also includes adapting model processing based on the remote data. The method further includes determining a driving decision based on the adapted model processing. In some examples, adapting model processing may include selecting a model, adjusting model scheduling, and/or adjusting a frame computation frequency.

title: Systems and methods for automated healthcare services
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: Healthcare services can be automated utilizing a system that recognizes at least one characteristic of a patient based on images of the patient acquired by an image capturing device. Relying on information extracted from these images, the system may automate multiple aspects of a medical procedure such as patient identification and verification, positioning, diagnosis and/or treatment planning using artificial intelligence or machine learning techniques. By automating these operations, healthcare services can be provided remotely and/or with minimum physical contact between the patient and a medical professional.

title: Blockchain based privacy compliance platform
abstract: Disclosed herein is a storage platform for managing privacy compliance in an organization. The storage platform comprises a plurality of storage servers and at least one storage controller. The at least one storage controller receives user data from a user associated with the organization and splits the user data into a plurality of data chunks. Further, each data chunk of the plurality of data chunks are stored on a separate storage server selected from the plurality of storage servers. Also, each of the plurality of data chunks are encrypted using encryption keys stored on a distributed ledger. Thereafter, an authentication token corresponding to the stored user data is generated and provided to the user to enable the user to securely share the stored user data with the organization.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院, 北京理工大学
abstract: The application provides an image processing method, an image processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring at least one group of scanning images, wherein each group of scanning images comprises a plurality of images to be marked and a plurality of standard images; aiming at each group of scanning images, respectively carrying out image registration on each image to be marked in each group of scanning images and each standard image to obtain a plurality of reference images corresponding to each image to be marked; determining the abnormal score of each pixel point in each image to be marked according to each image to be marked and each reference image corresponding to each image to be marked; and according to the abnormal score of each pixel point in each image to be marked and the determined image segmentation threshold value corresponding to each image to be marked, marking the abnormal pixel points of each image to be marked to obtain a target image corresponding to each image to be marked. The method does not need to depend on manual marking data, can greatly improve the identification efficiency of abnormal pixel points in the image, and further improves the image segmentation efficiency.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院; 北京理工大学
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院

title: Methods for nucleic acid size detection of repeat sequences
abstract: Disclosed herein are data processing and calculating annotation systems and devices, and corresponding methods, for nucleic acid analysis. In particular, disclosed herein are methods for sizing a repeat region of a nucleic acid sample. For example, the methods disclosed herein use a ladder of amplification products to determine nucleic acid size.

title: Systems and methods for selectively attenuating a voice
abstract: Systems and methods for amplifying and/or attenuating audio signals are disclosed. In one implementation, a system for selectively amplifying audio signals may include at least one microphone for capturing sounds from an environment of the user and a processor. The processor may be programmed to receive an audio signal representative of sounds captured by the at least one microphone; determine whether the audio signal comprises speech by a user of the system; subject to the audio signal comprising speech by the user, modify the audio signal by attenuating a first part of the audio signal comprising the speech by the user; subject to the audio signal comprising audio other than speech by the user, modify the audio signal by amplifying a second part of the audio signal comprising audio other than the speech by the user; and transmit the modified audio signal to a hearing interface device.

title: Biometric sensor device for digital quantitative phenotyping
abstract: A biometric sensor device system including a biometric sensor device, and a prediction computer. The biometric sensor device includes at least one camera, and a biometric sensor device processor configured to record a time synchronized communicative interaction between participants, by controlling at least one camera to record the participants over a time period, and transfer the recorded communicative interaction to the prediction computer. The prediction computer including a prediction computer processor configured to extract, from the recorded communicative interaction, a physical characteristic of each of the participants over the time period, compare the physical characteristic of at least one of the participants with the physical characteristic of at least another one of the participants over the time period, and classify or score at least one of the participants according to a predetermined classification or dimensional scoring scheme based on the comparison.
assignee_clean: the children s hospital of philadelphia
primary_assignee: the children s hospital of philadelphia

title: Methods for high-resolution genome-wide functional dissection of transcriptional regulatory regions
assignee: Massachusetts Institute Of Technology, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein provide a general, scalable, high-throughput, and high-resolution approach for experimental dissection of regulatory regions and driver nucleotides in the context of human biology and disease. Applicants present HiDRA, a novel high-resolution global screen for transcriptional regulatory activity in accessible chromatin regions, enabling high-efficiency, high-throughput, and high-resolution inference of regulatory activity.
assignee_clean: massachusetts institute of technology; beth israel deaconess medical center

title: Natural language processor for providing natural language signals in a natural language output
abstract: Embodiments are directed to a natural language processing (NLP) system configured to receive a natural language (NL) input and perform an analysis operation to generate a NL output. The NLP system is configured to generate at least one confidence level based at least in part on at least one portion of the analysis operation. The NLP system is further configured to integrate at least one disfluency into the NL output based at least in part on the at least one confidence level.

title: Platform for autonomous risk assessment and quantification for cyber insurance policies
abstract: A system for autonomous risk assessment and quantification for insurance policies for computer and information technology related risks, including but not limited to losses due to system availability, cloud computing failures, current and past data breaches, and data integrity issues. The system will use a variety of current risk information to assess the likelihood of operational interruption or loss due to both accidental issues and malicious activity. Based on these assessments, the system will be able to autonomously issue policies, adjust premium pricing, process claims, and seek re-insurance opportunities with a minimum of human input.

title: Blood pressure measurement
abstract: A method includes obtaining a baseline blood pressure at an initial time window; estimating a plurality of intermediate blood pressure change estimates, the intermediate blood pressure change estimates correspond to respective time windows that are subsequent to the initial time window; estimating a final blood pressure change estimate between the initial and final time windows; and obtaining the blood pressure by adding the baseline blood pressure to the final blood pressure change estimate. Estimating the final blood pressure includes estimating a first blood pressure change between the initial time window and the final time window; estimating a plurality of second blood pressure changes, each second blood pressure change is between a respective time window of the respective time windows and the final time window; and estimating the final blood pressure change estimate as a combination of the first blood pressure change and the plurality of second blood pressure changes.

title: Message grouping and correlation
assignee: 微软技术许可有限责任公司
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media for providing grouped data of interest. In some configurations, a computing device may include a user interface having one or more groups configured to receive messages. These groups may be computer-defined groups, such as those defined by a computing device or other system, or user-defined groups. The techniques and technologies described herein receive a message in the one or more groups and determine message relevance (e.g., utility) based on content and/or context of the message (e.g., time of day, sender, geographic location of the recipient, urgency of the message, etc.). In some configurations, message relevance may be based at least in part on the particular group or group cluster with which the message is associated.
assignee_clean: 微软技术许可有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 微软技术许可有限责任公司

title: Generating skin care recommendations for a user based on skin product attributes and user location and demographic data
abstract: Systems and methods for generating user-specific recommendations of products or services by collaborative filtering executed and/or performed by one or more trained or untrained predictive models configured to ingest product attribute(s), product purpose(s), user location data, and/or user demographics. The predictive model(s) are leveraged to detect and determine user-specific preferences for, and preferences against, particular attributes, features, ingredients, aesthetic styles, and so on.

title: Methods and compositions for enriching non-host sequences in host samples
abstract: Disclosed are compositions and methods for enriching a non-host sequence from a host sample. Also disclosed are compositions and methods for detecting a non-host sequence in a host sample. For example, a pathogen can be enriched and detected in a sample taken from a human without knowing what the pathogen is.

title: System and method for motion estimation
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: Neural network-based systems, methods, and devices associated with estimating motion of an anatomical structure are described herein. Motion estimation may be performed using feature pyramids and/or motion pyramids corresponding to multiple image scales. Motion estimation may be performed using a neural network and parameters that are learned via a training process involving a student network and a teacher network, the teacher network being pre-trained with the ability to apply progressive motion compensation.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Biomarker panels for predicting prostate cancer outcomes
assignee: Mayo Foundation For Medical Education And Research
abstract: This document provides methods and materials related to assessing male mammals (e.g., humans) with prostate cancer. For example, methods and materials for predicting (1) which patients, at the time of PSA reoccurrence, will later develop systemic disease, (2) which patients, at the time of retropubic radial prostatectomy, will later develop systemic disease, and (3) which patients, at the time of systemic disease, will later die from prostate cancer are provided.
assignee_clean: mayo foundation for medical education and research
primary_assignee: mayo foundation for medical education and research

title: Coordinate conversion relation obtaining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京柏惠维康科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a coordinate transformation relation obtaining method and device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the position of a preset mark point under an image coordinate system as a first position; acquiring the position of the mark point under the robot coordinate system as a second position; constructing an error function based on the first position and the second position by taking a translation transformation matrix and a rotation transformation matrix between an image coordinate system and a robot coordinate system as independent variables; minimizing the error function to obtain the optimal transformation relation between the translation transformation matrix and the rotation transformation matrix; converting the error function into a target function taking the rotation transformation matrix as an independent variable according to the optimal transformation relation; minimizing the target function to obtain an optimal rotation transformation matrix; and obtaining an optimal translation transformation matrix based on the first position, the second position and the optimal rotation transformation matrix. The embodiment of the application can obtain the coordinate conversion relation with higher accuracy.
assignee_clean: 北京柏惠维康科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京柏惠维康科技有限公司

title: Spinal surgery system and methods of use
abstract: A method for surgically treating a spine comprising the steps of: pre-operatively imaging vertebral tissue; displaying a first image of a surgical treatment configuration for the vertebral tissue from a mixed reality display and/or a second image of a surgical strategy for implementing the surgical treatment configuration with the vertebral tissue from the mixed reality display; determining a surgical plan for implementing the surgical strategy; and intra-operatively displaying a third image of the surgical plan with the vertebral tissue from the mixed reality display. Systems, spinal constructs, implants and surgical instruments are disclosed.

title: Systems, methods, and devices for intracranial measurement, stimulation, and generation of brain state models
abstract: Provided are systems, methods, and devices for intracranial measurement, stimulation, and generation of brain state models. Systems include a plurality of intracranial electrodes configured to be coupled to a brain of a user. Systems further include an interface configured to obtain measurements from the plurality of intracranial electrodes. Systems include a first processing device including one or more processors configured to generate a plurality of brain state parameters characterizing one or more features of at least one brain state of the user, and a second processing device including one or more processors configured to generate at least one model of the brain of the user based, at least in part, on the plurality of brain state parameters and the measurements. Systems include a controller including one or more processors configured to generate a control signal based on the plurality of brain state parameters and the at least one model.

title: Neural network data computation using mixed-precision
abstract: Techniques for mixed-precision data manipulation for neural network data computation are disclosed. A first left group comprising eight bytes of data and a first right group of eight bytes of data are obtained for computation using a processor. A second left group comprising eight bytes of data and a second right group of eight bytes of data are obtained. A sum of products is performed between the first left and right groups and the second left and right groups. The sum of products is performed on bytes of 8-bit integer data. A first result is based on a summation of eight values that are products of the first group's left eight bytes and the second group's left eight bytes. A second result is based on the summation of eight values that are products of the first group's left eight bytes and the second group's right eight bytes. Results are output.

title: Creating and handling workspace indicators of compromise (ioc) based upon configuration drift
assignee: 美商戴爾產品有限公司
abstract: Systems and methods for creating and handling workspace indicators of compromise (IOC) based upon configuration drift are described. In some embodiments, a memory storage device may have program instructions stored thereon that, upon execution by one or more processors of an Information Handling System (IHS) of a workspace orchestration service, cause the IHS to: receive configuration information from a client IHS at a workspace orchestration service, where the configuration information represents a change in a configuration of a workspace executed by the client IHS, and where the workspace is instantiated based upon a workspace definition provided by the workspace orchestration service; determine, by the workspace orchestration service, that the configuration information matches an IOC; and transmit, from the workspace orchestration service to the client IHS, an instruction to perform an action responsive to the IOC.
assignee_clean: 美商戴爾產品有限公司
primary_assignee: 美商戴爾產品有限公司

title: Training method and device for image classification model, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a training method, a training device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for an image classification model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: confirming a first sample image and a first mask image corresponding to the first sample image; training a first encoder included in an image classification model based on the first mask image, and confirming that the trained first encoder is a second encoder; inputting a second sample image into a classification branch, inputting a second mask image corresponding to the second sample image into a comparison branch, and performing feature fusion on a first feature image output by the classification branch and a second feature image output by the comparison branch to obtain a first fusion feature; inputting the first fusion characteristic into a full-connection layer classifier included in the classification branch, and confirming that the output of the full-connection layer classifier is a lung prediction classification result corresponding to the second sample image; and adjusting parameters of the classification branch based on the lung labeling classification result of the second sample image and the lung prediction classification result of the second sample image.
assignee_clean: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司

title: Generating schema change alerts in a data intake and query system
abstract: A schema consistency mechanism monitors data ingested by a data intake and query system for changes to the structure, or data schema, associated with the data. A schema consistency monitor obtains data from a data source (or, more generally, from any number of separate data sources) at a plurality of points in time. The data is analyzed to determine whether a first portion of the data received at a first point in time conforms to a first data schema and that a second portion of the data received at a second point in time conforms to a second data schema that is different from the first data schema (thereby indicating a change to the associated data schema). A graphical user interface (GUI) can be generated that includes indications of identified changes to one or more data schemas associated with data.

title: Abnormal electrocardiogram screening method based on fusion of global and local depth features of electrocardiogram
abstract: An abnormal electrocardiogram screening method based on fusion of global and local depth features of an electrocardiogram comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a detection network model, and detecting complete heart beat in an electrocardiogram; step two, constructing a local feature extraction network, and extracting the local features of the complete heart beat region detected in the step one; constructing a global feature extraction network, and extracting global features of the electrocardio image; step four, constructing a depth feature fusion network; step five, integrally training the depth feature fusion network in the step four; and carrying out normal and abnormal secondary classification on the electrocardio-image by using the depth feature fusion network obtained by training. The method can accurately screen the abnormal electrocardiogram by using the global characteristics and the local characteristics of the electrocardiogram.

title: Machine learning on mixed data documents
abstract: A first natural language document is received. The document includes unstructured data and a first table structure that includes a plurality of first table entries. The first table structure is identified based on the document. The first table structure is extracted from the document in response to the identifying. A first machine learning output is generated based on a first machine learning model and from the document. A second machine learning output is generated based on a second machine learning model and from the first table structure. The first output of the document and the second output of the first table structure are combined.

title: Median sagittal plane construction method based on artificial neural network model
abstract: The invention relates to a median sagittal plane construction method based on an artificial neural network model, which comprises the following steps: (1) establishing an artificial neural network model suitable for constructing a median sagittal plane by a three-dimensional face data PA correlation method; (2) and establishing an intelligent weight regulation and control mechanism of an artificial network model aiming at the PA anatomical landmark points, and realizing a training mode and a feedback mechanism of an expert logic strategy. The invention can apply the artificial neural network algorithm model to the symmetry analysis of the three-dimensional facial data of the oral medicine, innovatively provides an algorithm idea of establishing a median sagittal plane by an artificial neural network PA correlation method, realizes the intelligent weight regulation of PA mark points and achieves the effect of simulating clinical expert-level diagnosis strategies.

title: Method for generating objects using an hourglass predictor
abstract: A computer-implemented method for generating a 2D or 3D object, including training an autoencoder on a first set of training data to identify a first set of latent variables and generate a first set of output data; training an hourglass predictor on a second set of training data, where the hourglass predictor encoder converts a set of related but different training input data to a second set of latent variables, which decode into a second set of output data of the same type as the first set of output data; and using the hourglass predictor to predict a 2D or 3D object of the same type as the first set of output data based on a 2D or 3D object of the same type as the second set of input data.

title: Model training method and named entity recognition method
assignee: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a model training method and a named entity recognition method. The model training method comprises the following steps: training to obtain a first deep learning model component by utilizing the corresponding relation between a plurality of first historical product description information and class information corresponding to the first historical product description information, wherein the class information is set to be predicted by utilizing a machine learning model component; training to obtain a second deep learning model component by using manually marked sample data based on the first deep learning model component; and generating a plurality of training data by using the first deep learning model component and the second deep learning model component respectively, and generating a third deep learning model component by training the plurality of training data, wherein the third deep learning model component is used for identifying category information in the product description information. By using the technical scheme, the model component capable of accurately identifying the class information in the product description information can be obtained by training on the basis of low cost.
assignee_clean: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司
primary_assignee: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司

title: Method for ultrasound training with a pressure sensing array
abstract: A method for training an ultrasound user with a hand-held device having one or more first sensors to detect angular orientation of the device in one or more dimensions, and at least one two-dimensional surface device having one or more second sensors to detect translational position of the hand-held device in one or more directions, which communicates the angular orientation data from the hand-held device and the translational position data from the at least one surface device to a computer to display a virtual environment with a virtual hand-held device that moves in correlation with the hand-held device based on the angular orientation data from the hand-held device and the translational position data from the at least one surface device.

title: Parasite egg identification method based on transfer learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the fields of image processing, image recognition and transfer learning, and particularly relates to a parasite egg recognition method based on transfer learning. According to the invention, the relevant model and the shared characteristic parameters based on transfer learning are introduced, so that the basic characteristics of the whole parasite egg model are enhanced, and the huge resource and time consumed by deep model training are reduced; introducing a Sobel operator, and rapidly processing the picture through edge information, so that the dimension of the picture is reduced, and the training speed is increased; the joint distribution of the edge distribution and the condition distribution is introduced, so that the distance between the source domain and the target domain is shortest, and the identification precision is improved; and a softmax classifier is introduced, so that the problem of multiple classification is effectively solved.

title: Disaster risk comprehensive evaluation method for knowledge system combined weight self-adaptive optimization
assignee: 北京师范大学珠海校区, 北京帝测科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a disaster risk comprehensive evaluation method for knowledge system combination weight self-adaptive optimization, which relates to the technical field of data processing and comprises the following steps: extracting disaster risk factors of a target area; constructing a historical disaster condition database, and distributing initial weights for disaster risk factors to obtain a plurality of initial weights; acquiring a risk contribution degree through disaster risk factor analysis; according to the risk contribution degree, a plurality of initial weights are adaptively adjusted to obtain a plurality of final weights; and constructing a disaster risk assessment model according to the plurality of final weights, carrying out disaster risk assessment, and carrying out target area risk classification and risk management according to a disaster risk assessment result. The invention solves the technical problems of low accuracy and reliability of disaster risk assessment caused by dynamic change of risk factors in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of improving the accuracy and reliability of disaster risk assessment through the self-adaptive optimization of the risk factor weights.
assignee_clean: 北京师范大学珠海校区; 北京帝测科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京师范大学珠海校区

title: Method, apparatus and readable storage medium for predicting regional population health status
assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a regional population health state prediction method, a device and a readable storage medium, wherein the regional population health state prediction method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining user data of an area to be predicted, carrying out overall health state recognition on the area to be predicted based on the user data to obtain overall health state data, further carrying out overall state transition probability prediction on the area to be predicted based on the overall health state data to obtain a health state transition decision model, and further generating a regional population health state prediction result based on population change data of the area to be predicted, the health state transition decision model and the overall health state data. In addition, the application also relates to a block chain technology, and user data of the area to be predicted can be stored in the block chain, so that the effect of predicting the population health state of the area can be improved.
assignee_clean: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司

title: Device and system for monitoring wound closure and delivering topical therapeutic agents
abstract: Systems and methods for monitoring wound closure are described herein. The system includes a dressing for application to the wound. The dressing includes an elasticized film having a first side and a second side and a reference object disposed on the first side. The elasticized film is movable between a relaxed state in which the reference object has a first configuration and an extended state in which the reference object has a second configuration corresponding to an amount of swelling of an area of skin surrounding the wound. The system further includes a camera for capturing images of the reference object in the second configuration; and a processor for comparing the image with a stored image of a reference object in the first configuration and for determining the degree of swelling of the area of skin surrounding the wound based on the comparison.

title: Electronic device for performing image processing and operation method thereof to reduce artifacts in an image captured by a camera through a display
abstract: According to an embodiment, an electronic device, comprises a display; a camera module disposed under the display and configured to generate an image by sensing light passing through the display; and a processor configured to determine an intensity of a light source in the image, determine whether the light source is present in a preset area in the image when the intensity of the light source is greater than a preset threshold value, and reduce one or more artifacts from or in the image when the one or more artifacts are detected in the image based on results of the determining.

title: Question-answering model and answer sentence generation method and device, medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a question-answering model, a method and a device for generating an answer sentence, a medium and electronic equipment. The method for generating the question-answer model comprises the following steps: acquiring problem data and response data corresponding to the problem data; determining keywords contained in the problem data and the field to which the problem data belongs; acquiring relevant data of the problem data according to the keywords and the field; and generating a training sample based on the problem data, the related material data and the response data, and training a model file based on the training sample to generate a question-answer model. According to the technical scheme, the relevant data of the question data can be considered when the model file is trained, so that the question-answering model obtained through training can be enabled to be fused with a large amount of relevant data to generate the answer sentence, the answer sentence can be guaranteed to be obtained more comprehensively and accurately, and the quality of the answer sentence generated by the question-answering model is effectively improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Apparatuses, systems, and methods for reducing return of prescriptions to stock
abstract: Apparatuses, systems and methods are provided to reduce return of prescriptions to stock. The apparatuses, systems, and methods may reduce return of prescriptions to stock based on a predictive model. The apparatuses, systems, and methods may reduce return of prescriptions to stock based on a response of a patient to a notification that a prescription has been received for the patient.

title: Neural network model training method suitable for small samples
assignee: 苏州脉康医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a neural network model training method suitable for small samples, which obtains physical quantities related to medical diagnosis tasks by selecting a proper mathematical equation, provides additional guidance and regularization in a multi-task learning mode to assist in training the neural network model, and greatly reduces the requirement on the sample quantity. In addition, the hidden space features related in the invention are closely related with the physiological process, so that the reliability of the diagnosis result is greatly improved. The method realizes the training of the high-precision model under the small sample.
assignee_clean: 苏州脉康医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 苏州脉康医疗科技有限公司

title: NAS-FPN-based lung nodule detection method
abstract: The invention relates to a lung nodule detection method based on NAS-FPN, in particular to a combination of a neural network architecture automatic search technology (Neural Architecture Search, NAS) and a feature extraction pyramid network (Feature Pyramid Network, FPN) in deep learning, which is different from the detection mode of manually designing a lung nodule detection network at present.

title: Multi-mode image analysis method and system for cancer diagnosis
abstract: The invention provides a multi-mode image analysis method and a system for cancer diagnosis, which relate to the technical field of image data analysis, and the invention extracts suspected focus areas through a characteristic pyramid network, classifies the suspected focus areas by adopting a false positive attenuation network based on context characteristics, and extracts true positive ROIs; the classified neural network based on the residual network is adopted to stably and accurately predict the pathological types, so that the screening efficiency is improved by assisting doctors, missed diagnosis and misdiagnosis are effectively reduced, and the diagnosis and reasonable treatment of cancers based on medical images in primary hospitals are facilitated.

title: Continuous background check monitoring
abstract: A candidate is enrolled for continuous background check monitoring where a computing system continually electronically monitors data sources that include background check data for data of the candidate for any changes or updates for the candidate, until the candidate is no longer enrolled. If a record is received, an identity matching process is performed to determine the probability the record belongs to the candidate. If the probability is below a threshold or manual review is desired, the system automatically triggers a manual review of the record to determine if it belongs to the candidate. If the system determines the record belongs to the candidate, a verification of the data may be triggered including triggering a county records search using the record as a pointer. The county records search may have more complete information. The system receives the results and automatically generates a report and transmits a notification of the report.

title: Techniques for onboarding and verification of users to a services platform
abstract: Techniques and apparatus for an interactive element presentation process are described. In one embodiment, for example, an apparatus may include a storage device and logic, at least a portion of the logic implemented in circuitry coupled to the storage device. The logic may operate to maintain a platform database of services selection information based on user selections of a plurality of services, receive an onboarding request from a user device to register a user with a service platform requiring background verification, determine an onboarding request result, and transmit an eligible set of the plurality of service options for presentation on a user device based on a user level of approval and services selection information. Other embodiments are described.

title: Systems and methods for artificial intelligence-based prediction of amino acid sequences at a binding interface
abstract: Presented herein are systems and methods for prediction of protein interfaces for binding to target molecules. In certain embodiments, technologies described herein utilize graph-based neural networks to predict portions of protein/peptide structures that are located at an interface of custom biologic (e.g., a protein and/or peptide) that is being designed for binding to a target molecule, such as another protein or peptide. In certain embodiments, graph-based neural network models described herein may receive, as input, a representation (e.g., a graph representation) of a complex comprising a target and a partially-defined custom biologic. Portions of the partially-defined custom biologic may be known, while other portions, such an amino acid sequence and/or particular amino acid types at certain locations of an interface, are unknown and/or to be customized for binding to a particular target. A graph-based neural network model as described herein may then, based on the received input, generate predictions of likely acid sequences and/or types of particular amino acids at the unknown portions. These predictions can then be used to determine (e.g., fill in) amino acid sequences and/or structures to complete the custom biologic.

title: Fall remote monitoring system based on LabVIEW and MATLAB
abstract: A fall remote monitoring system based on LabVIEW and MATLAB uses a Kinect V2 depth vision sensor as a data acquisition source, adopts a LabVIEW and MATLAB joint programming mode to complete the design of a fall detection system, firstly carries out smooth reconstruction on acquired skeleton node data, calculates reconstruction data through an improved K-means clustering algorithm to obtain two clustering center points, and uses a clustering center point speed threshold and a height threshold as preliminary judgment conditions for fall detection. And constructing 7*7 detection sample data by taking acceleration of the clustering center and an included angle between the clustering center and the vertical direction as data sources, inputting a trained CNN fall detection model to finally identify a fall event, and sharing the identification result with a remote mobile phone end and a PC end. Experimental results show that the fall detection system has higher recognition accuracy, lower false alarm rate and better robustness, and the mobile phone end and the PC end can realize stable and reliable real-time remote monitoring.

title: Method for facilitating labeling of medical image and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for supporting labeling of a medical image and an apparatus using the same. The method according to the present invention comprises: allowing a computing device to acquire a plurality of individual medical images; generating a group index for an area overlapped by individual areas and generating a second classifying index which merges a first classifying index belonging to the same group index when the first classifying index for the individual area of at least a part of the individual medical image and a probability value for the first classifying index are input; and training a classifier by using the plurality of individual medical images, the first classifying index for the plurality of individual medical images and the second classifying index.

title: Complex sets of miRNAs as non-invasive biomarkers for dilated cardiomyopathy
abstract: The present invention relates to non-invasive methods, kits and means for diagnosing and/or prognosing of dilated cardiomyopathy in a body fluid sample from a subject. Further, the present invention relates to set of polynucleotides or sets of primer pairs for detecting sets of miRNAs for diagnosing and/or prognosing of dilated cardiomyopathy in a body fluid sample from a subject. In addition, the present invention relates to sets of miRNAs for diagnosing and/or prognosing of dilated cardiomyopathy in a body fluid sample from a subject.

title: Generative system
abstract: A generative sensing system includes a plurality of fairings attached to a carrier via a plurality of mechanical links and further associated with a plurality of actuators in communication with a computing system and a memory in communication with the computing system storing a plurality of fairing groups. The computer system is configured to receive and input from a sensor and adjust the fairing groups to capture an agent flow which is transduced to a voltage and transferred to an electrical energy storage and/or distribution system.

title: Training method, training device, recognition method and recognition system for glaucoma recognition
assignee: 深圳硅基智能科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure describes a training device for glaucoma recognition, comprising: an acquisition module; the image segmentation network is an artificial neural network based on deep learning, trains through the preprocessed fundus image, the annotated image and the spatial weighted graph to output the probability that each pixel point in the preprocessed fundus image belongs to the optic disc and the probability that each pixel point in the preprocessed fundus image belongs to the optic cup, and generates an optic disc region image and an optic cup region image based on the probability that each pixel point in the preprocessed fundus image belongs to the optic disc and the probability that each pixel point in the preprocessed fundus image belongs to the optic cup; the characteristic extraction module is used for acquiring glaucoma characteristics based on the optic disc area image and the optic cup area image; and a classifier trained by feature information including glaucoma features and glaucoma classification labels based on machine learning to output a probability of belonging to glaucoma. According to the scheme, the accuracy of glaucoma identification can be improved.
assignee_clean: 深圳硅基智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳硅基智能科技有限公司

title: Identifying vessel occlusions using spatial patterns
abstract: Images of individuals obtained using perfusion-based imaging techniques or diffusion-based imaging techniques can be analyzed to determine regions of the brains of the individuals where the supply of blood has been disrupted. The images can be used to generate alerts indicating the disruption of blood flow to one or more regions of the brains of the individuals.
