The images can be used to identify vessel segments (eg M1, M2, M3, M4, . . . ) and branches (MCA, ACA, PCA) of the brains of individuals in which abnormalities may be present.

title: Personalized breast imaging system
abstract: Examples of the present disclosure describe systems and methods for personalized breast imaging. In aspects, a first set of patient attributes may be collected. The first set of patient attributes may relate to, or be used to determine, for example, breast size, breast thickness, and/or three-dimensional (3D) breast shape. The first set of patient attributes may be used to customize image acquisition parameters for the patient. A second set of patient attributes may also be collected. The second set of patient attributes may relate to, or be used to determine, for example, breast elasticity and breast density. The second set of patient attributes may be used to customize breast compression parameters for the patient. The customized image acquisition parameters and breast compression parameters may then be used to perform one or more procedures (e.g., an imaging procedure, a biopsy procedure, etc.) on the patient's breast.

title: System and method for efficiently training understandable models
assignee: 支付宝(杭州)信息技术有限公司
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for training interpretable machine learning models are described. An exemplary method comprises: obtaining a plurality of training data sets from a plurality of historical data records by a plurality of non-replacement sampling, the plurality of training data sets including a first training data set and a second training data set having one or more overlapping historical data records; generating a plurality of histograms corresponding respectively to the plurality of training data sets, wherein the histogram of the second training data set reuses one or more data points in the histogram of the first training data set corresponding to the one or more overlapping historical data records; training one or more machine learning models corresponding to the one or more user features based on the plurality of histograms; and providing personalization based on the one or more machine learning models.
assignee_clean: 支付宝 杭州 信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 支付宝 杭州 信息技术有限公司

title: System and method for reducing 4D DSA reconstruction artifacts using CFD simulations
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: A computer-implemented method of reducing 4D Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) reconstruction artifacts using Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations includes: the computer receives first DSA time series data comprising a representation of a plurality of vessels and segments a vessel of interest from the first DSA time series data. The computer uses the CFD simulation to simulate fluid dynamics across the vessel of interest to generate a flow field and determines a plurality of simulated time activity curve parameters for each voxel inside the vessel of interest using the flow field. The computer then applies a reconstruction process to the second DSA time series data to generate a DSA volume. The reconstruction process is constrained by the plurality of simulated time activity curve parameters for each voxel inside the vessel of interest.
assignee_clean: 西门子保健有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司

title: Methods and systems for generating graphical content through easing and paths
abstract: Digital image editors provide tools to modify or manipulate a digital image. For animation, video, etc. this manipulation and/or modification must be undertaken over a portion of the digital content's duration. This can represent tens, hundreds, thousands of equivalent images (i.e. each frame) to be modified and/or manipulated. The invention provides digital tools allowing effects, e.g. a manipulation and/or modification, from relatively simple transitions through to highly complex transitions, to be defined and then added to digital content. Further, these digital tools can be independent of considerations of the underlying content such that an effect designed with these digital tools may be applied over a still image, video content, animation etc. without requiring the user to define frames within the digital content etc. Further, the path and/or other characteristics of the modification and/or manipulation may be linked to other characteristics of the digital element, the digital content, external factors etc.

title: Simulated reality technologies for enhanced medical protocol training
abstract: Introduced here are teaching system for realistically simulating medical situations in such a manner to test individuals as to the adequacy of their learning. A teaching system may include a manikin representative of a patient, an image projection mechanism, a simulation mechanism, a headpiece, a pair of hand coverings, a controller, a performance review mechanism, a recording device, a scenario generation mechanism, or any combination thereof. The teaching system can improve upon conventional simulation in several respects. First, the script corresponding to a simulation session may be dynamically traversed to mimic the unpredictability of an actual medical situation. Second, the action(s) of an individual may be actively monitored to discover whether her behavior complied with the relevant protocol(s).

title: Exploring medical visualization parameters in virtual space
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: Medical visualization parameters are explored in a virtual space. A computer-implemented method for exploring medical visualization parameters in a virtual space, comprising: the method further includes detecting a user position and a user orientation in the physical space, and generating a display of the immersive layout centered on the user position and the user orientation. A plurality of holograms is generated within the immersive layout. Each hologram depicts a rendering of the medical image with a different combination of rendering parameter values. The display is updated based on changes to one or more of the user position and the user orientation in the physical space.
assignee_clean: 西门子保健有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司

title: Method and equipment for emergency treatment in vehicle driving
assignee: 南京领行科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and equipment for emergency treatment in vehicle driving, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving physiological monitoring index data collected by a physiological monitoring device; judging whether a target monitored by the physiological monitoring device is in an abnormal physiological state or not according to the received physiological monitoring index data and physiological monitoring index data corresponding to different abnormal physiological states; and when the target is determined to be in the abnormal physiological state, controlling the vehicle machine to run or outputting reminding information. The method and the equipment for emergency treatment in vehicle driving provided by the invention solve the problem that the existing method for emergency treatment in vehicle driving cannot monitor, early warn and perform emergency treatment on abnormal driving caused by the driver encountering an emergency.
assignee_clean: 南京领行科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 南京领行科技股份有限公司

title: Resiliency for a storage system
abstract: A storage system has a resiliency scheme to enhance storage system performance. The storage system composes a RAID stripe. The storage system mixes an ordering of portions of the RAID stripe, based on reliability differences across zones of the solid-state memory. Each zone of the solid state memory corresponds to a type of solid state memory. The storage system writes the mixed ordering RAID stripe across the solid-state memory.

title: Guided lens design exploration system for a progressive lens simulator
abstract: A Progressive Lens Simulator comprises an Eye Tracker, for tracking an eye axis direction to determine a gaze distance, an Off-Axis Progressive Lens Simulator, for generating an Off-Axis progressive lens simulation; and an Axial Power-Distance Simulator, for simulating a progressive lens power in the eye axis direction. The Progressive Lens Simulator can alternatively include an Integrated Progressive Lens Simulator, for creating a Comprehensive Progressive Lens Simulation. The Progressive Lens Simulator can be Head-mounted. A Guided Lens Design Exploration System for the Progressive Lens Simulator can include a Progressive Lens Simulator, a Feedback-Control Interface, and a Progressive Lens Design processor, to generate a modified progressive lens simulation for the patient after a guided modification of the progressive lens design. A Deep Learning Method for an Artificial Intelligence Engine can be used for a Progressive Lens Design Processor.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for realizing interpretation of artificial intelligence
assignee: 第四范式（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for implementing an artificial intelligence interpretable method, the method comprising: firstly, receiving data to be explained corresponding to a target artificial intelligence AI model; the data to be interpreted comprises characteristic data and/or model data and estimated data. And secondly, determining an interpretation operator matched with the data to be interpreted, and finally, operating the interpretation operator to interpret the data to be interpreted to obtain an interpretation result. The embodiment of the disclosure can provide an interpretation result for the data to be interpreted corresponding to the target AI model, and realizes the interpretation of artificial intelligence. In addition, the user can also design the artificial intelligence interpretable method by himself based on the requirements of the artificial intelligence interpretable method, so as to interpret the data to be interpreted of the target AI model, thereby improving the flexibility of the artificial intelligence interpretable method.
assignee_clean: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司

title: Orthopedics knowledge graph construction system taking joint movement function as core
assignee: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a construction system of an orthopaedics knowledge graph taking joint movement function as a core, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a metadata definition module, a knowledge acquisition module, a data set construction module and a knowledge storage module; the metadata definition module is used for acquiring metadata of orthopedics knowledge, defining the metadata and constructing a specification according to the definition; the metadata includes: the concept type of the orthopedics knowledge, the relationship type and the relationship attribute type of the orthopedics knowledge; the knowledge acquisition module is used for acquiring the original data of the orthopedics knowledge through the corpus; the data set construction module is used for constructing a data set by utilizing the original data according to the specification; the knowledge storage module is used for storing the metadata, the specifications and the data set in a database. The construction system can clearly express a knowledge system of disease- > joint function- > joint anatomy, and remarkably improve the intelligent degree of the HIS system in the joint field.
assignee_clean: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司

title: System and method for disease risk assessment and treatment
abstract: A biosensor assembly that measures multiple physical parameters is disclosed. The biosensor assembly includes a first implantable probe and a first skin contacting electrode. Wherein a first physiological parameter is measured between the first implantable probe and the first skin contactable electrode.

title: Data integration and prediction for fraud, waste and abuse
abstract: Data threat evaluation systems and methods are described. A data model structure includes a data subset from the plurality of data types that predate a known threat; this third data subset includes data types from both a first data subset and a second data subset. A model schema extracts, from the data subset, data types of the first subset that predicate and indicate the threat, the model schema to produce at least an individualized data threat regression model, a script originator regression model, and a script filler data threat regression model using the extracted data types. The system may use the models back on the data set to identify potential threats. The system can operate to integrate data to predict fraud, waste or abuse.

title: Methods and systems for processing electronic communications for a folder
abstract: A system for processing electronic communications, including a computing device. The computing device receives a first communication datum, locates a folder relating to the first communication datum, generates a communication learner, outputs a response as a function of generating the communication learner, identifies a second communication datum as a function of the response, and updates the folder to include the second communication datum.

title: Method for generating mathematical models of a patient using artificial intelligence techniques
abstract: FIELD: artificial intelligence.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to a method of forming mathematical models of patients. A method comprising: obtaining a training sample containing an electronic medical history of the patients; pre-processing data contained in the patient's clinical records; converting processed data into a sequence of medical facts for each patient; performing automatic marking of the obtained sequence of medical facts on each patient; performing on server training of primary representations independently for each of modalities; training of joint representations; final model and aggregation parameters training; patient's medical history not included into the training sample is obtained; performing the patient's obtained medical history data preliminary processing; converting pre-processed data into a sequence of medical facts using medical ontologies; patient's vector presentation is formed; formed vector representation is used to diagnose, analyze and predict the development of diseases.EFFECT: technical result consists in improvement of accuracy of diagnosing, analysis and prediction of developing diseases.1 cl, 10 dwg

title: Device for releasing dynamic link library and related product
assignee: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a device for releasing a dynamic link library and a related product, wherein the device is applied to a processor unit; the processor unit is used for configuring a first process, and the first process comprises a first thread and a second thread; loading a Caffe dynamic link library by calling a first thread, using the Caffe dynamic link library and carrying out an analysis operation on a first object; after the first thread executes the deconstruction operation on the first object, the second thread is called to release the Caffe dynamic link library from the memory, so that the loading and the release of the Caffe dynamic link library can be realized, the memory can be prevented from being occupied, and the operation speed is increased.
assignee_clean: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司

title: Performance characteristics of cartridge artifacts over text pattern constructs
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention are directed to evaluating the performance characteristics of annotator configurations against text pattern constructs in unstructured text. In a non-limiting embodiment of the invention, unstructured text is received by a processor. A text pattern construct is identified in the unstructured text and a first performance characteristic of an annotator is determined based on the text pattern construct. The text pattern construct is converted to a natural language text and a second performance characteristic of the annotator is determined based on the natural language text. A delta is determined between the first performance characteristic and the second performance characteristic. An alternative annotator configuration is identified for a portion of the unstructured text comprising the text pattern construct.

title: Tooth image caries identification method and system based on convolutional neural network
assignee: 北京大学口腔医院, 北京众绘虚拟现实技术研究院有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a tooth image caries identification method and system based on a convolutional neural network. The invention can accurately judge the probability of dental caries in the target photo by deep learning a large number of digital photos of clinically diagnosed teeth, and can help people to carry out self-supervision on caries, and if necessary, the people can go to hospital for examination in time. Has the characteristics of good real-time performance and capability of finding early caries.
assignee_clean: 北京大学口腔医院; 北京众绘虚拟现实技术研究院有限公司

title: Prescription circulation processing method and device
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司, 泰康养老保险股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a prescription circulation processing method and a device, and one specific implementation mode of the method comprises the steps of receiving current prescription data sent by a hospital end, and carrying out signature authentication on the current prescription data based on a public key corresponding to the hospital end; acquiring prescription detail data in current prescription data, calling a preset conversion model to process the prescription detail data to obtain a corresponding first code, and mapping the first code through a preset compression dictionary code to obtain a second code; acquiring basic information of a patient in current prescription data to calculate a corresponding blockchain address, and further acquiring a past prescription record of the patient according to the blockchain address; and splicing the second code and the past prescription record to obtain a prescription record to be processed, and signing the prescription record to be processed based on a preset platform private key so as to update the signed prescription record to the blockchain address. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can solve the problems of low efficiency and high cost of the conventional prescription data transfer.
assignee_clean: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司; 泰康养老保险股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司

title: Breast cancer prediction system based on bagging algorithm
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of breast cancer prediction, and particularly relates to a breast cancer prediction method based on a bagging algorithm, wherein case-control data collection comprises the following steps: designing a questionnaire based on the breast cancer prevention and treatment related knowledge, the questionnaire containing characteristic variables considered to have an effect on breast cancer, collecting data on epidemiological studies of breast diseases of 25-70 years 122058 women from the city of the third province, i.e., the third province, china, recording case-control data backup, data processing: and (4) performing data cleaning on the data collected by the questionnaire, and deleting repeated information, invalid samples with excessive missing values or abnormal values and characteristic variables. According to the breast cancer prediction method based on the bagging algorithm, an effective model for predicting the breast cancer risk is established through integrated learning, so that medical staff can be helped to predict patients suffering from breast cancer, and timely and accurately take targeted measures for high risk groups, so that the breast cancer prediction method is helped to assist diagnosis and prevention of breast cancer, and contributes to intelligent diagnosis.

title: Head CT metal artifact correction method based on homomorphic adaptation learning
abstract: The invention discloses a head CT metal artifact correction method based on homomorphic adaptive learning. Constructing a deep learning generation framework by using a 17-layer convolutional neural network; performing feature extraction on the CT image by combining with the VGG19 model; expanding the data set by using prior information of CT continuous slices and similarity of CT structures; in order to solve the problem of medical data misalignment, the improved anti-noise loss is used for a network, and the purposes of removing metal artifacts and retaining original disease information are achieved in the gradual iteration process by balancing the specific gravity of style loss and content loss; and (3) evaluating results, namely training and testing on a clinical data set and a simulation data set, and evaluating the model by a comprehensive evaluation method. The invention realizes the correction of head CT artifact, has no new artifact generation and no blurring while maintaining the image detail information, improves the accuracy of clinical diagnosis and has good practical value.

title: Intelligent inspection diagnosis system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent inspection diagnosis system based on deep learning, which is provided with mobile terminal equipment and a cloud server loaded with an intelligent diagnosis platform; the mobile terminal equipment is used for acquiring image data information of a user, and the image data information is transmitted to the cloud server through the cloud server interface; the cloud server receives the image data information of the user uploaded by the mobile terminal equipment, analyzes and processes the image data information of the user, and performs fuzzy matching on a clinical information table and a disease information table by utilizing a fuzzy matching algorithm and a data indexer to obtain a primary disease diagnosis result; and performing relevance estimation on the preliminary disease diagnosis result through an intelligent sequencing processor to obtain a scoring result, performing optimization judgment on the disease diagnosis result through an optimal rule set, and finally returning the result to a user. The user can check at any time and any place, and can find the disease early, diagnose and treat the disease early.

title: Method of detecting and treating endometriosis in a female subject
abstract: Described herein are improved methods for the detection of endometriosis. Generally, the methods include, but are not limited to, applying machine learning algorithm to miRNA levels in order to detect, predict, diagnose, or monitor the presence or absence of endometriosis.

title: Intelligently organizing displays of medical imaging content for rapid browsing and report creation
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system comprising a processor and a memory, the memory comprising instructions that are executed by the processor to specifically configure the processor to implement an intelligent medical image viewing engine. The intelligent medical image viewing engine receives a medical imaging study data structure comprising a plurality of electronic medical images from a medical image database. An image processing component executing within the intelligent medical image viewing engine analyzes the medical imaging study data structure to identify, for each electronic medical image in the plurality of electronic medical images, a corresponding set of image attributes. The intelligent medical image viewing engine receives a user input specifying at least one filter attribute for generating a medical image output and correlates the at least one filter attribute with at least one medical attribute of medical images to be used for selection of electronic medical images from the medical imaging study data structure. An image selection component executing within the intelligent medical image viewing engine selects a subset of the electronic medical images in the plurality of electronic medical images based on the correlation of the at least one filter attribute with the at least one medical attribute. A user interface generation component executing within the intelligent medical image viewing engine generates and outputs a medical image output comprising the subset of electronic medical images based on the selection.

title: Systems and methods for scheduling alimentary combinations
abstract: A system for scheduling alimentary combinations includes a computing device configured to provide an alimentary instruction set including a plurality of target nutrient quantities corresponding to a plurality of scheduled meals, determine a per-meal alimentary instruction set as a function of the plurality of target nutrient quantities, receive, from each alimentary provider device of a plurality of alimentary provider devices, a plurality of provider ingredient combinations, generate a ranked list of ingredient combinations as a function of the plurality of provider ingredient combinations, receive a user selection of a provider ingredient combination corresponding to a meal of the plurality of scheduled meals, and generate a modified ranked list of ingredient combinations as a function of the user selection and the alimentary instruction set.

title: Knowledge base construction method for traditional Chinese medicine ancient languages
abstract: The invention provides a knowledge base construction method for traditional Chinese medicine ancient texts, which can quickly construct the knowledge base for the traditional Chinese medicine ancient texts, and is time-saving and labor-saving. The method comprises the following steps: extracting keywords from the traditional Chinese medicine ancient linguistic data to obtain entities with word frequency larger than a preset word frequency threshold value, and forming a seed entity word list; screening out sentences with two or more entities in the Chinese traditional ancient corpus according to the seed entity word list, and obtaining verb relations among the entities by utilizing dependency syntax analysis to form a seed verb word list; expanding a seed entity word list according to the seed verb word list; iteratively executing the steps of forming a seed verb word table and expanding a seed entity word table until new entities and verbs cannot be obtained to form entity relationship triples; and performing hierarchical clustering according to the obtained seed entity word list to obtain a classified entity word list, and constructing a Chinese traditional ancient language oriented knowledge base by combining the obtained entity relationship triple. The invention relates to the field of knowledge engineering.

title: Method for facilitating medical image view and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for supporting opening a medical image and an apparatus using the same. According to the present invention, the method enables a computing apparatus to open a medical image based on a time axis for a series set in response to a specific input of an input apparatus, and respective images included in the series set are aligned with respect to a predetermined lesion of interest, so the lesions of interest in the respective images provided for opening are positioned at the same visual position.

title: Arteriovenous fistula stenosis detection system and method thereof and sensing device
assignee: 美商腎通生醫科技公司
abstract: An arteriovenous fistula (AVF) stenosis detection system and method thereof and sensing device are provided. The AVF stenosis detection system includes: a sensing device including a microphone and a server coupled to the sensing device. The sensing device contacts a first location of a patient body, wherein a first distance is between the first location and a second location of an AVF of the patient body, and the first location is located on an extended path of an artery or a vein corresponding to the AVF. The sensing device receives a frequency spectrum signal through the microphone and transmits the frequency spectrum signal to the server. The server calculates a stenosis percentage corresponding to the frequency spectrum signal through a machine learning module and transmits the stenosis percentage to the sensing device.
assignee_clean: 美商腎通生醫科技公司
primary_assignee: 美商腎通生醫科技公司

title: Methods and systems for event based tagging of metadata
abstract: Systems and methods for management of event metadata. The methods may include maintaining a plurality of data storage systems in communication with an external metadata management system. The methods may also include operating the metadata management system to store tagged event metadata corresponding to the plurality of data storage systems. Event metadata corresponding to a data storage system includes information associated with at least one data operation event executed on data residing in that data storage system.

title: Electronic health records connectivity
abstract: A system and method for obtaining prior authorization and fulfilling a prescription is described. The method includes receiving, by a computing device, prescription information for a patient from a prescriber; identifying, by the computing device, an electronic health record associated with the patient; collecting, by the computing device, medical information for the patient related to the prescription from the electronic health record; submitting, by the computing device, a claim for the prescription with a payor associated with the patient; and completing, by the computing device, a prior authorization request for the prescription.

title: Method and system for detecting lesion and diagnosing lesion status based on fluid attenuation inverted recovery
abstract: Disclosed are a method for detecting a lesion and checking a status based on FLAIR and a system thereof. The method comprises the steps of: dividing a FLAIR image of a patient into a first FLAIR image signal corresponding to a left hemisphere of the brain of the patient and a second FLAIR image signal corresponding to a right hemisphere of the brain of the patient to use the FLAIR image in diagnosing a disease of the patient; estimating the lesion through artificial intelligence in each of the first and second FLAIR image signals; and calculating a ratio with a corresponding region of the other one of the first and second FLAIR image signals as compared to a lesion region estimated as the lesion in any one of the first and second FLAIR image signals, wherein the calculation results are used to diagnose the progress status of the lesion.

title: GUI(Graphical User Interface)-based AI(Artificial Intelligence) recommendation system and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a graphical user interface (GUI)-based artificial intelligence (AI) recommendation system to evaluate accuracy of AI and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the GUI-based AI recommendation system comprises: a data management unit generating and managing a project according to a domain desired by a user, analyzing input data to extract features according to the domain, and performing preprocessing of the data; an AI model generation unit selecting a learning algorithm according to the domain set by the data management unit and performing learning on the preprocessed data through the selected learning algorithm to generate a recommendation model; a personalization engine management unit managing the recommendation model generated by the AI model generation unit, performing a test on an inference function of the recommendation model, and distributing an API (Application Programming Interface) engine for personalized recommendation; and a chatbot interlocking unit receiving the API engine distributed from the personalization engine management unit to perform various recommendations according to the type of data on the basis of the API engine, providing a recommendation result to a user terminal, receiving chatbot user history to analyze utterance and extract keywords, and searching for the extracted keywords to collect, store, and refine data by field.

title: Cancer process evaluation
abstract: Methods of selecting a therapeutic agent to treat a cancer in a subject comprising receiving a plurality of protein data element values representing levels of the proteins in a biological sample from the subject, classifying each protein as a member of a process class, for each process class calculating a process score that represents the prominence of the process class to cancer treatment resistance and selecting at least one therapeutic agent that targets a selected process based on the process score. Systems for selecting a therapeutic agent are also provided.

title: Web-based system for enhancing user well-being
abstract: The invention relates to a method of improving a user's well-being in an interactive system, by: querying the user to determine a user identifier profile and the user's relative levels of a number of state-related traits, and identifying traits for which said relative levels deviate significantly from optimal; wherein the improvement includes: selecting, by a server, from a group of tested motivational messages which have been effective for other users to reduce the deviation in the levels of said traits, one or more selected motivational messages; where the amount of said deviation reduction is the average of all users reduction in deviation following receipt of said selected motivational messages; and sending the selected motivational messages to the device controlled by the user; and querying the user, by sending a questionnaire from the server to said device, to determine if said deviation is reduced.

title: Smart dispensing system
abstract: Embodiments relate to a system comprising a drug dispenser; a user interface to receive a user information; a bio-feedback monitoring device to monitor at least one vital of a user as an input to the bio-feedback monitoring device; a communication module; a processor; a database; a memory; wherein the processor is communicatively coupled with the memory; and wherein the processor is configured to: receive a prescription; dispense a drug through the drug dispenser on authenticating the user information with at least one vital of the user and the prescription; update an inventory of the drug through the communication module; log record of dispensing of the drug; maintain a ledger of the record of dispensing of the drug, use blockchain technology. The output of the bio-feedback monitoring device controls a quantity of drug dispensed from the drug dispenser.

title: Medical three-dimensional model generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The application provides a method and a device for generating a medical three-dimensional model, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method for generating the medical three-dimensional model comprises the following steps: responding to input operation in the interactive interface, and acquiring medical text; invoking a first generation network, and under the guidance of a medical text, learning a first tensor input into the first generation network to obtain a medical two-dimensional image conforming to the description of the medical text; the first generation network is a trained deep learning model with the capability of generating two-dimensional images from medical text to medical science; inputting the medical two-dimensional image into a second generation network to generate a medical three-dimensional model; the second generation network is a trained deep learning model with generation capabilities from a medical two-dimensional image to a medical three-dimensional model; and displaying the medical three-dimensional model generated by the second generation network in the interactive interface. The method and the device solve the problem of poor reality of the medical three-dimensional model in the related technology.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院

title: New coronaries pneumonia CT image segmentation method based on weak supervised learning
abstract: The invention provides a new coronaries pneumonia CT image segmentation method based on weak supervised learning, which comprises the following steps: firstly, a segmentation network model is established, the model is an encoder-decoder structure on the whole, a classification module is introduced on the basis of the segmentation network model, and the classification module and the segmentation module share a part of hidden layers, so that the whole network learns more useful characteristics, and meanwhile, the problem of false positive of a segmentation result is solved; based on the thought of weak supervised learning, the optimized class activation graph is obtained from the additional image level label through the classification network on the basis of the pixel level image label and used as supervision information, so that the segmentation performance of the model is enhanced. The invention provides a class activation diagram accumulation module by utilizing the characteristic of the attention transfer of the classification network, so that a more complete class activation diagram can be obtained through the classification network, and a pixel-level labeling result can be obtained.

title: MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) segmentation method based on reinforcement learning multi-scale neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an MRI segmentation method based on reinforcement learning multi-scale neural network, which solves the problems of error-prone segmentation and missed segmentation of multi-scale, fuzzy and dispersive MRI inflammatory regions in the existing method. According to the invention, a voxel constraint strategy of modifying the label value of the inflammatory region according to the voxel value is adopted, so that the segmentation effect of a segmentation model on the inflammatory region with large voxel value difference is improved; according to the invention, a multi-scale convolution module GMS is designed for the inflammation area with large shape and size difference, so that the segmentation effect of the segmentation model on the multi-scale inflammation area is improved; aiming at the problem that the segmentation model is difficult to identify the diffuse and fuzzy inflammation area, the invention utilizes the reinforcement learning network to carry out data enhancement, thereby improving the distinguishing performance of the segmentation model on the diffuse and fuzzy inflammation area. The invention reduces the wrong segmentation and missed segmentation of the multi-scale and fuzzy-dispersion inflammatory region and improves the segmentation effect of the MRI inflammatory region. Can be used for MRI inflammatory region segmentation and quantitative analysis automation treatment.

title: Eye imaging system and fundus camera positioning device
abstract: An eye imaging system can include a head-wearable fundus camera positioning helmet with an outer shell and a conformable liner that can include head location fiducials defining a specified plane. An attached articulating fundus camera fixture can include a fundus camera positioning indication system to indicate a position of the fundus camera with respect to an eye of the patient for acquiring one or more fundus camera images at the indicated position such that fundus camera images recorded over a chronic period of time are assessable using the position information from the fundus camera positioning indication system. The articulating fundus camera fixture can include an articulating arm and a fundus camera mount. The system can assist the patient with helmet positioning, and can automatically position the fundus camera for accurate image capture and analysis, such as using a trained machine learning model for patient evaluation, monitoring, or diagnosis.
assignee_clean: agnya perceptive solutions; l l c

title: Root cause identification and analysis
abstract: Embodiments relate to monitoring an information technology (IT) environment having a plurality of domains through key performance indicator (KPI) data. In response to detection of a technical health problem, a first KPI related to the problem is identified. A root cause analysis is performed on the identified KPI generating a knowledge graph. A second KPI related to the first KPI is identified through the discovery of a correlation between the two identified KPIs. A diagnosis is generated for the technical health problem within the IT environment based on the discovered hidden correlation between the first KPI and second KPI. The generated diagnosis includes the root cause of the technical health issue.

title: Fraud detection using augmented analytics
abstract: Systems and methods ingest extensive data regarding real-time transactions to determine correlation between a variety of parameters and possible fraud events. Possible fraud can be predicted, and notifications delivered to a fraud team. Correlations can be discovered using unsupervised machine learning, and particular systems and methods can utilize natural language processing to both receive and provide information concerning fraud risk and countermeasures.

title: Intelligent park safety emergency management system and method based on GPT
assignee: 成都四为电子信息股份有限公司, 四川发展新兴产业园区投资建设管理有限责任公司
abstract: The invention discloses a GPT-based intelligent park safety emergency management system and a GPT-based intelligent park safety emergency management method, which are used for identifying, evaluating, controlling and responding to emergency safety risks in a park and solving the problems of inefficiency, inaccuracy, timeliness and the like existing in the traditional park safety management mode; the system comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition and management module, a database construction module, a data preprocessing module, a GPT model fine adjustment module and a GPT model publishing and calling module, wherein the GPT model is utilized to analyze and mine various data in a park, so that risk quantification and visualization are realized, a park safety risk identification evaluation standard and a safety risk evaluation implementation method are generated, a safety risk classification management and control mechanism and an emergency plan are formulated, and a double prevention mechanism is formed; the intelligent monitoring and early warning are carried out on important dangerous sources, special operations, closed management and the like in the park, so that real-time sensing and dynamic adjustment are realized.
assignee_clean: 成都四为电子信息股份有限公司; 四川发展新兴产业园区投资建设管理有限责任公司

title: Medical image segmentation method based on frequency band decomposition and deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image segmentation method based on frequency band decomposition and deep learning, which belongs to the technical field of image processing and comprises the following steps: step 1, respectively acquiring a source domain data set and a target domain data set; the source domain data set and the target domain data set are composed of medical images of different patient groups acquired by different medical imaging devices; step 2, constructing an image segmentation deep learning model comprising an image decomposition module, a channel adaptation module and a backbone network; step 3, training the image segmentation deep learning model by taking the source domain data set as a training set to obtain a trained image segmentation deep learning model; and 4, taking the target domain data set as a test set, and inputting the test set into the trained image segmentation deep learning model to obtain a final medical image segmentation result. The invention realizes the effective segmentation of the currently acquired medical image by deeply learning the domain invariant features in the medical image.

title: Integrated method-based auxiliary analysis method and device for prostate cancer and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated method-based prostate cancer auxiliary analysis method, an integrated method-based prostate cancer auxiliary analysis device and electronic equipment, wherein the integrated method-based prostate cancer auxiliary analysis method comprises the following steps of: acquiring at least one characteristic data set of a user; generating at least one feature vector from the at least one feature data set; the feature vector is used as an input vector of a first support vector machine model trained in advance, and the benign or malignant prostate cancer of a user is judged according to the output value; if the prostate cancer of the user is judged to be malignant, respectively taking the characteristic vectors as input vectors of the models trained in advance to respectively obtain output vectors of the models; integrating each output vector into a vector, taking the vector as an input vector of a multi-linear regression model trained in advance, and judging the stage of the prostate cancer of the user according to the output value of the multi-linear regression model. The auxiliary analysis method for the prostate cancer adopts a classical machine learning method and uses an integrated learning method to reduce the risk of single model errors.

title: Multi-stage segmentation using synthetic images
abstract: The example embodiments are directed to refinement process for generating an accurate image segmentation map. A refinement network may enhance an initially generated segmentation map using a model that is trained using synthetic images. In one example, the method may include storing an image of content which includes a plurality of categories of data, receiving an initial segmentation map of the image, the initial segmentation map comprising pixel probability values with respect to the plurality of categories, executing a refinement predictive model on the initial segmentation map and the image to generate a refined segmentation map, wherein the predictive model is trained using synthetic images of the plurality of categories of data, and generating a segmented image based on the refined segmentation map.

title: Method and device for recognizing impacted tooth of panoramic picture based on deep learning
assignee: 北京羽医甘蓝信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a panoramic picture impacted tooth identification method and device based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: inputting the original panoramic picture into a deep learning-based alveolar bone line segmentation model to obtain an alveolar bone line segmentation result; generating a fitting rectangular frame according to the alveolar bone segmentation result, generating an extended rectangular frame according to the fitting rectangular frame, and cutting out image blocks of the peripheral area from the original panoramic picture according to the extended rectangular frame; and inputting the image blocks of the periodontal area into an impacted tooth segmentation model based on deep learning to obtain impacted tooth segmentation results.
assignee_clean: 北京羽医甘蓝信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京羽医甘蓝信息技术有限公司

title: Understanding and addressing complex information needs
abstract: Techniques described herein assist users in satisfying complex information needs represented as long, detailed questions. A generalized search assistance framework for complex information needs is disclosed. Given a detailed question, the techniques enrich the original question with a set of related concepts. The types of questions handled are detailed, complex questions similar to the ones posted in Q&A portals. A generalized search assistance framework enriches complex detailed questions with topically related concepts. A basic pipeline represents an instantiation of such the search assistance framework. Given a detailed question, the pipeline relies on semantic and syntactic relationships in the detailed question in order to construct a set of related queries. The queries are issued to a commercial search engine and the retrieved results are processed by state-of-the-art document understanding techniques in order to retrieve important concepts. A final concept set for enriching the original question is then assembled.

title: Methods, systems, and frameworks for data analytics using machine learning
abstract: Some embodiments relate to methods, systems, and frameworks for data analytics using machine learning, such as methods and systems for preprocessing of biomedical data, using machine learning, for input to a predictive model. The method may include receiving data from a data source, using at least one machine learning (ML) algorithm from a plurality of ML algorithms to obtain at least one combination of preprocessing steps, and computing an accuracy score for each of the at least one combination based on accuracy of prediction of the predictive model. The method may further include using at least one ML algorithm to optimize the feature selection of the predictive model, combining a plurality of datasets into a single dataset, and using a parallel computing network to provide a framework for executing such predictive model.

title: Variants in complement regulatory genes predict age-related macular degeneration
assignee: National Institutes Of Health, The Trustees Of Columbia University In The City Of New York, University Of Iowa Research Foundation
abstract: Methods for identifying a subject at risk for developing AMD are disclosed, as are kits which can be used to practice the methods. The methods include identifying specific protective or risk polymorphisms or genotypes from the subject's genetic material, including polymorphisms in the BF, C2 and/or CFH genes. Microarrays and kits for use in these methods are also provided.
assignee_clean: national institutes of health; the trustees of columbia university in the city of new york; university of iowa research foundation

title: Medical information processing apparatus and medical information processing method
abstract: According to one embodiment, a medical information processing apparatus has processing circuitry. The processing circuitry acquires medical data on a subject, acquires numerical data obtained by digitizing an acquisition condition of the medical data, and applies a machine learning model to input data including the numerical data and the medical data, thereby generating output data based on the medical data.

title: Digital therapeutic platform
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for monitoring health. An exemplary method includes: collecting a first data regarding a patient during an in-office visit; providing a remote monitoring service for remotely monitoring the patient's health; remotely collecting, using the remote monitoring service, a second data of the patient; providing a probabilistic network for assigning metric-based information to the plurality of data using a plurality of conditional probabilities; processing, using the probabilistic network, the first data and the second data using the probabilistic network; generating, using the processed plurality of data, one or more machine learning models for producing a knowledge base trained to recognize pattern types in the data; generating, using the knowledge base, one or more artificial intelligent features for recommending treatment options based on the data regarding the patient; and providing, using the one or more artificial intelligent features, one or more treatment recommendations for improving the patient's health.

title: Progress evaluation of a diagnosis process
abstract: Computer-implemented methods, computer program products, and system facilitating evaluation of a progress of a diagnosis process are provided. The computer-implemented method comprises: obtaining, by a device operatively coupled to one or more processing units, a list of symptom(s); retrieving, by the device, a sub-graph associated with the list of symptom(s) from a knowledge graph; extracting, by the device, a list of feature(s) from the retrieved sub-graph; estimating, by the device, an average number of inquiries based on the extracted list of feature(s); and calculating, by the device, the progress of the diagnosis process based on the estimated average number of inquiries.

title: Method and apparatus for determining map improvements based on detected accidents
abstract: An approach is provided for determining map improvements based on detected accidents. The approach involves determining that a vehicle was involved in an accident. The approach also involves receiving a report indicating map data configured in the vehicle at a time of the accident. The approach further involves determining an association between the configured map data and the accident. The approach further involves performing one or more of the following operations: (1) transmitting the association and/or at least a portion of the configured map data to a database and/or a computing device; or (2) determining at least one map change to the configured map data based on the determined association, and transmitting the at least one map change to the vehicle, at least one other vehicle, the database, and/or the computing device.

title: Method and device for respiratory drive assessment by using ultrasound
assignee: 四川大学华西医院, 成都华慕创联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for respiratory drive assessment by utilizing ultrasound, and relates to the technical field of medical treatment. The method utilizes bedside ultrasound to measure diaphragmatic muscle displacement, the diaphragm thickening rate and the inferior vena cava expansion rate, and utilizes the diaphragm displacement, the diaphragm thickening rate and the inferior vena cava expansion rate to evaluate the occurrence of respiratory hyperdrive of a person to be measured. The ultrasonic image of the inferior vena cava can assist in judging whether the driving pressure increase is the spontaneous respiration driving increase or the parameter setting of the breathing machine is overhigh; the combination of the two can realize the identification and classification of the high drive of the early respiration of people with severe symptoms. Meanwhile, the method and the device of the invention are not only suitable for mechanical ventilators, but also suitable for the identification and classification of the early breath high drive of the ventilators without mechanical ventilators, and can effectively solve the problem that the breath high drive of the ventilators which are incapable of identifying and retaining spontaneous breath in early stage.

title: Wearable human body characteristic acquisition device, detection device and detection underwear
assignee: 无锡闻心电子科技有限责任公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a wearable human body feature collection system, detection device, detection underwear and monitoring system, wearable human body feature collection system includes: a plurality of flexible conductive electrodes for contacting a human body, respectively; a plurality of temperature sensors for detecting the temperature of the human body, respectively; a bio-impedance sensor for detecting bio-impedance of a human body using the flexible conductive electrode; and a link wire connecting the plurality of temperature sensors and the plurality of flexible conductive electrodes in series, respectively, in a daisy chain manner. The method and the device can realize real-time synchronous and accurate acquisition and detection of various human body characteristic data including temperature, bioimpedance and the like.

title: Diagnosis support system, endoscope system, processor, and diagnosis support method
abstract: A diagnosis support system having a processor configured to acquire medical images; detect a medicine and/or equipment used when the medical images are captured, from the medical images by image recognition; detect a region of interest from the medical images by image recognition; assign, to the medical image from which the medicine and/or equipment is detected, first detection information indicating the detected medicine and/or equipment; and assign, to the medical image from which the region of interest is detected, second detection information indicating the detected region of interest, display, on a display device, the medical images in a list in a display form according to the first detection information and the second detection information.

title: Laryngoscope image recognition method based on double-gating recursion unit decoding
abstract: The invention discloses a laryngoscope image recognition method based on double-gating recursion unit decoding, which mainly solves the problems that the existing method cannot be used for optical laryngoscope images, and the generated medical text report is poor in accuracy and insufficient in readability. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring an optical laryngoscope image data set and a corresponding medical text report, and performing word segmentation and coding operation on the medical text report to obtain a label data set; scaling and centralizing the image data set, and recording the image data set and the label data set as a training data set; constructing a comprehensive network comprising 13 convolution layers, 4 pooling layers and 2 gating recursion units, and training the comprehensive network by using a training data set and utilizing an adaptive learning rate optimization algorithm; and (3) inputting an unlabeled optical laryngoscope image serving as test data into a trained comprehensive network to obtain a corresponding medical report after the test image is identified. The method improves the accuracy and the readability of the generated text, and can be used for identifying laryngoscope images.

title: Medical instrument quality safety risk supervision-based method and system
assignee: 江苏科佳软件开发有限公司, 江苏省食品药品监督信息中心
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of quality supervision, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring quality safety risks of medical instruments. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of performing periodic supervision data acquisition on medical equipment by using a blockchain technology to generate multi-source supervision data; carrying out dynamic feature mapping processing and multisource risk point prediction on multisource supervision data to generate predicted risk point data; carrying out market emotion mining and risk tracing analysis according to the predicted risk point data to obtain risk tracing data; performing evaluation weight optimization processing on the risk tracing data to generate dynamic adjustment weight data; and carrying out full-link exception analysis on the risk traceability data through dynamic adjustment of the weight data, and carrying out risk treatment scheme formulation to generate intelligent risk treatment scheme data. The quality risk supervision is realized through the full-link anomaly analysis of the medical instrument.

title: Systems and methods for providing medical guidance using a patient depth image
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: Methods and systems for using a patient representation model including a feature extraction model and a parameter determining model. For example, a computer-implemented method includes receiving, by a first feature extraction model, a depth image; generating, by the first feature extraction model, a first feature vector corresponding to the depth image; determining, by a parameter determining model, a plurality of three-dimensional model parameters based at least in part on the first feature vector; receiving a ground truth; determining a deviation between the ground truth and information associated with the plurality of three-dimensional model parameters; changing, based at least in part on the deviation, one or more parameters of the patient representation model; receiving a first patient image; determining a plurality of three-dimensional patient parameters based at least in part on the first patient image; and providing the plurality of three-dimensional patient parameters as medical guidance.

title: Constraining neural networks for robustness through alternative encoding
abstract: A neural network is augmented to enhance robustness against adversarial attack. In this approach, a fully-connected additional layer is associated with a last layer of the neural network. The additional layer has a lower dimensionality than at least one or more intermediate layers. After sizing the additional layer appropriately, a vector bit encoding is applied. The encoding comprises an encoding vector for each output class. Preferably, the encoding is an n-hot encoding, wherein n represents a hyperparameter. The resulting neural network is then trained to encourage the network to associated features with each of the hot positions. In this manner, the network learns a reduced feature set representing those features that contain a high amount of information with respect to each output class, and/or to learn constraints between those features and the output classes. The trained neural network is used to perform a classification that is robust against adversarial examples.

title: Apparatus and method for deep learning to mitigate artifacts arising in simultaneous multi slice (SMS) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
abstract: A deep learning (DL) network is proposed to mitigate artifacts in simultaneous multi-slice (SMS) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data. For example, unaliased images generated from SMS aliased images can exhibit leakage artifacts due to inaccuracies in the receive-coil sensitives used during sensitivity encoding (SENSE) processing. To mitigate leakage artifacts, the DL network learns to correct the receive-coil sensitives before SENSE processing, and/or learns to detect and subtract the artifacts from the unaliased images after SENSE processing. The DL network can also be trained to denoise the unaliased images.

title: Breast mass segmentation method based on cross attention mechanism
assignee: 浙江德尚韵兴医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to an X-ray auxiliary diagnosis technology, and aims to provide a breast mass segmentation method based on a cross attention mechanism. The method comprises the following steps: making a data set; preprocessing a cross attention mechanism; constructing a deep convolutional neural network; adjusting the pre-training weight distribution of the image network data set; adjusting the pre-training weight distribution and training a deep convolutional neural network by using the data pre-processing result; and (4) reasoning the X-ray image to be detected by utilizing the deep convolutional neural network. The method utilizes a cross attention mechanism to train the model quickly, enables the network to select the tumor characteristics from an MLO position and a CC position through the cross attention mechanism, and learns and adjusts the cross attention weight value. Compared with the traditional method for judging the tumor only from the CC position or the MLO position, the method can automatically segment the tumor on the mammary X-ray image quickly and efficiently, improves the detection rate and accuracy of the tumor in the mammary X-ray image, and has higher practical application and popularization values.
assignee_clean: 浙江德尚韵兴医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 浙江德尚韵兴医疗科技有限公司

title: Hand therapy kit with presence sensors
abstract: A hand therapy kit includes hand therapy modules and a housing having defined receptacles in which the hand therapy modules are removably disposed. A module presence sensor is disposed in each receptacle to detect the presence or absence of the corresponding hand therapy module. A microprocessor disposed in the hand therapy kit sends the module presence sensor data to a remote computer that analyzes the module presence sensor data to determine whether the patient is complying with a prescribed treatment regimen. The remote computer can generate warnings, alerts, and/or notifications when noncompliance is detected.

title: Intracranial hemorrhage detection method applied to CT image based on CNN and NLSTM neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an intracranial hemorrhage detection method applied to CT images based on CNN and NLSTM neural networks, and belongs to the field of intelligent medical image processing. The invention uses the CNN neural network to extract the picture characteristics of the CT image, the CNN neural network is trained before the CNN characteristics are extracted, and the pre-trained CNN network used here is ResNeXt. Combining the extracted embedding of the image with the sequence information of the patient as the input of the NLSTM neural network, calculating a loss back propagation network through a cross entropy loss function, and finally testing the obtained network structure. The mode of combining the CNN and the RNN neural network is very suitable for processing CT sequence images, and the CNN and the NLSM are a novel intracranial hemorrhage detection and classification method. The invention discloses an intracranial hemorrhage detection method based on the combination of CNN and NLSTM, which is an accurate and efficient automatic hemorrhage detection and classification method, has extremely important value for clinic and wide application scenes.

title: Method, device, electronic equipment and medium for analyzing components of region of interest
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium for analyzing components of a region of interest. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-contrast medical images of a target object, and registering each medical image; determining the region of interest of each medical image and the reference region corresponding to each region of interest; when the selection operation of the current pixel point in any region of interest is detected, determining the pixel point corresponding to the current pixel point in other regions of interest; and determining a comparison result of the signal value of the region of interest of each medical image and the signal value of the corresponding reference region, and determining the component corresponding to each pixel point in the region of interest based on the comparison result. So as to realize the comparison result of the signal values of the regions of interest with different contrasts and the signal values of the reference regions and the effect of each component of the regions of interest.
assignee_clean: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Methods and systems for informing self-treatment remedy selection
abstract: A system for informing self-treatment remedy selection. The system includes a computing device configured to identify a self-treatment remedy associated with a user. The computing device classifies using a remedy classify an identified self-treatment remedy as an input and outputs a self-treatment model. The computing device retrieves a biological extraction associated with a user and calculates a self-treatment model using a machine-learning model. The computing device generates a remedy label and determines using the remedy label if an identified self-treatment remedy is safe for user consumption.

title: Artificial intelligence-based gastroscopic image diagnosis assisting system and method
abstract: A system and method assist gastroscopic image diagnosis based on artificial intelligence. The processor in the system analyzes each video frame of a gastroscopic image using at least one medical image analysis algorithm and detects whether a finding suspected of being a lesion is present in the video frame. When the finding suspected of being a lesion is present in the video frame, the processor calculates the coordinates of the location of the finding suspected of being a lesion. The processor generates display information, including whether the finding suspected of being a lesion is present and the coordinates of the location of the finding suspected of being a lesion.

title: Additive-manufactured non-woven fibrous implants, systems, and related methods
abstract: Additive-manufacturing systems for forming non-woven fibrous implants are disclosed. Additive-manufacturing systems may include a robotic subsystem having scanning and imaging equipment configured to scan a patient's anatomy, and an armature including at least one dispensing nozzle configured to selectively dispense at least one material. The system may further include a controller apparatus configured to send a control signal to control the scanning and imaging equipment to determine a target alignment of a patient's spine, and develop an additive-manufactured printing plan including an additive-manufactured material selection plan based on the target alignment of the patient's spine. The controller may execute the additive-manufactured printing plan to: dispense the at least one material to form a non-woven fibrous component. The non-woven fibrous component may define a plurality of randomly oriented fibers further defining a plurality of open pore spaces between adjacent fibers configured to facilitate boney ingrowth between adjacent fibers.

title: Pressure measurable sacculus pipe and intelligent self-evolution auxiliary equipment thereof
assignee: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a pressure measurable sacculus catheter and intelligent self-evolution auxiliary equipment thereof. The intelligent self-evolution auxiliary equipment of the balloon catheter consists of a plurality of modules, has the functions of receiving and processing signals of a pressure sensor, recommending an optimal operation scheme, realizing near-mid-range operation and equipment control, intra-operative operation decision and the like, and simultaneously has the intelligent self-evolution characteristic; the auxiliary equipment processes the data and then recommends an optimal operation scheme and assists the operator in completing the operation; in addition, the auxiliary equipment realizes self evolution of the balloon catheter interventional therapy strategy through continuously added patient diagnosis and treatment follow-up data and updated prior knowledge.
assignee_clean: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院
primary_assignee: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院

title: Secure crypto processor
abstract: According to an example aspect of the invention, there is provided a cryptographic processor comprising a physically unclonable function circuit and at least one processing core, the physically unclonable function circuit comprising at least one physically unclonable function, the at least one processing core being configured to process a challenge by at least providing a challenge received from outside the cryptographic processor as input to the physically unclonable function circuit to obtain a response to the challenge, encrypting a second encryption key using the response as an encryption key, and causing the encrypted second encryption key to be provided to a party issuing the challenge.

title: Method and system for clinical decision support with local and remote analytics
abstract: A method and system for non-invasive medical image based assessment of coronary artery disease (CAD) for clinical decision support using on-site and off-site processing is disclosed. Medical image data of a patient is received. A processing strategy for assessing CAD of the patient using one of on-site processing, off-site processing, or joint on-site and off-site processing is automatically selected based on clinical requirements for a current clinical scenario. Non-invasive assessment of CAD of the patient is performed based on the medical image data of the patient using one of on-site processing, off-site-processing, or joint on-site and off-site processing according to the selected processing strategy. A final assessment of CAD of the patient is output based on the non-invasive assessment of CAD.

title: Ischemia area segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 脑玺(苏州)智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for segmenting an ischemic area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an apparent diffusion coefficient image of a target object brain; acquiring a cerebral blood flow image, a cerebral blood volume image and an artery transit time image of the brain of the target object; and processing the apparent diffusion coefficient image, the cerebral blood flow image, the cerebral blood volume image and the artery transit time image by using a pre-trained classification model to obtain an ischemic region segmentation image of the target brain. According to the ischemia area segmentation method, the ischemia area is segmented by combining diffusion weighted image information and a plurality of arterial spin labeling perfusion image information delayed after labeling, mutual information among various images is fully utilized, and the accuracy and robustness of the ischemia area segmentation are improved.
assignee_clean: 脑玺 苏州 智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 脑玺 苏州 智能科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for temperature determination
abstract: A method of determining a temperature of a patient includes measuring a first temperature of the patient with a temperature device, and measuring a second temperature of an environment with the temperature device. The method includes determining if a change in the ambient temperature exceeds a threshold. If the change does exceed the threshold, the method also includes applying a correction factor to the first temperature of the patient to account for the change in ambient temperature.

title: Intuitionistic fuzzy based deep learning model for visual interpretation of low dose x-ray image
assignee: @ Sankaran, K.Sakthidasan Dr, Vasudevan, N. Dr
