primary_assignee: 苏州景昱医疗器械有限公司

title: Method and system for segmenting medical image by fusion of transducer and convolution
abstract: The application discloses a method and a system for segmenting a medical image by fusion of a transducer and convolution, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, medical image data are acquired, the medical image data are preprocessed to form a dataset, the dataset is input into a multi-scale medical image segmentation model combined by a constructed transducer and a convolutional neural network for training, and an optimization model is obtained according to the mixed loss function through a mixed loss function formed by integrating a Dice loss function, a two-class cross entropy loss function and a proper constraint loss function based on Tversky, and a medical image test set to be tested is predicted by using the optimization model to obtain a prediction result. The method can solve the problems that the method based on the convolutional neural network and the method based on the transducer cannot pay attention to the global features and the local detail features of the image at the same time and the over-fitting problem in the image segmentation is caused by the fact that a masking part exists in a medical image data set.

title: Image processing method, apparatus, device, readable storage medium and program product
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司, 中南大学湘雅医院
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an image processing method, an image processing device, readable storage medium and program product, which can be applied to the fields or scenes of artificial intelligence, intelligent medical treatment, augmented reality, virtual reality and the like, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a to-be-processed image set of a target object, wherein the to-be-processed image set comprises at least two of a conventional color image, a multispectral image and a texture image; calling an image processing model to respectively perform region identification processing on each image in an image set to be processed to obtain a segmented image to be synthesized corresponding to each image; fusing a plurality of segmented images to be synthesized into a prediction segmented image marked with a plurality of areas; and performing edge extraction processing on the prediction segmentation image according to the plurality of regions marked by the prediction segmentation image to obtain a prediction edge image of the target object, and outputting the prediction edge image which is used for assisting the operation on the target object. By the method and the device, the generation efficiency and the generation precision of the edge image can be improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司; 中南大学湘雅医院

title: Techniques for model artifact validation
abstract: A model validation system is described that is configured to automatically validate model artifacts corresponding to models. For a model artifact being validated, the model validation system is configured to dynamically determine the validation checks to be performed for the model artifact, where the validation checks include various validation checks to be performed at the model artifact level and also for individual components included in the model artifact. The checks to be performed are dynamically determined based upon the attributes of the model artifact and of the components within the model artifact. The system is configured to generate a validation report that comprises information regarding the checks performed and the results generated from performing the various validation checks. The validation report may also include information suggesting actions for passing checks that result in a failed check, or for improving the scores of certain validation checks.

title: Electronic device comprising hall sensor for identifying folding state
abstract: An electronic device is disclosed, including: a first housing, a second housing, a folding housing that pivotably connects the first housing and second housing, a flexible display spanning the first, second and folding housings, a printed circuit board (PCB), a first camera module at least partly visible through a surface of the second housing, a first magnet disposed in the first housing, a second magnet disposed in the second housing, and a hall sensor disposed on the PCB, the hall sensor configured to detect magnetic flux caused by motion of the first and/or second magnet in folding and unfolding of the electronic device so as facilitate determination of a configuration state of the electronic device.

title: Method, device and equipment for predicting complications after transcatheter aortic valve replacement operation
abstract: The invention relates to a method, a device and equipment for predicting postoperative complications of a catheter aortic valve replacement (TAVI), which belong to the technical field of postoperative prediction, and the method is characterized in that characteristic data of a target patient are acquired and correspondingly input into a preset TAVI postoperative complications prediction model, so that a TAVI postoperative complications prediction result of the target patient is obtained; and predicting results of the postoperative complications of the TAVI, including the implantation predicting results of the pacemaker after the TAVI and the peripheral valve leakage predicting results after the TAVI. The characteristic data is obtained by anatomical indexes under CT data, is easy to obtain, and is easier to popularize and software compared with a scheme using finite elements; the invention focuses on the problem of initial implantation depth of the artificial aortic valve in the release process, and focuses on the implantation depth of the artificial aortic valve after the valve is completely released, so that the invention has more clinical application value and more accurate prediction of clinical outcome.

title: Systems, devices, and methods for developing a model for use when performing oximetry and/or pulse oximetry and systems, devices, and methods for using a fetal oximetry model to determine a fetal oximetry value
abstract: A plurality of sets of simulated optical inputs that is simulated to travel through an animal model of tissue, thereby generating simulated light transmission data, and corresponding oximetry vales may be used to train a simulated fetal oximetry model to predict, or calculate, oximetry values for subsequently received sets of simulated light transmission data. The simulated fetal oximetry model may be adapted to train an in vivo fetal oximetry model that may be configured to predict, or calculate, fetal oximetry values for subsequently received sets of light transmission data received from an in vivo study of a pregnant mammal and her fetus.

title: Pre-computing data metrics using neural networks
abstract: Methods, system, and apparatus for pre-computing data metrics. A method can include receiving, by one or more computers, (i) data from a user including a plurality of data metrics, and (ii) historical data associated with the user; generating, by the one or more computers and based at least on the historical data associated with the user, a forecast for the user using an artificial neural network, the forecast indicating a prediction of future user behaviors; determining, by the one or more computers and based at least on the forecast for the user, a subset of data metrics, from among the plurality of data metrics, that are likely to be used by the user; performing, by the one or more computers, one or more automatic data operations on the subset of data metrics; and providing, by the one or more computers, the processed subset of data metrics for output.

title: Incisional edge path generation method and system for tumor surgery and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computer-aided preoperative analysis, and discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for generating a cutting edge path for tumor surgery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring clinical pictures and skin mirror pictures of tumors and medical history information of patients; segmenting and extracting the tumor boundary in the dermatoscope picture by adopting a preset deep learning network model to obtain the skin tumor boundary under a dermatoscope; registering the skin tumor boundary with the clinical picture to obtain a target tumor boundary; generating an initial incisal edge path according to the medical history information, the target tumor boundary and a preset path generation model; under the condition that the tumor type is benign, smoothing the initial incisal edge path to generate an incisal edge path of a fusiform incision; and under the condition that the tumor type is malignant tumor, performing equidistant expansion processing on the initial incisal edge path to generate a final incisal edge path, and automatically generating a more accurate generated incisal edge path.

title: Resolving and steering decision foci in machine learning-based vascular imaging
abstract: A system (SY) for determining a relative importance of each of a plurality of image features (Fn) of a vascular medical image impacting an overall diagnostic metric computed for the image from an automatically-generated diagnostic rule. A medical kin image database (MIDB) includes a plurality of vascular medical images (M1 . . . k). A rule generating unit (RGU) analyzes the plurality of C vascular medical images and automatically generates at least one diagnostic rule corresponding to a common diagnosis of a subset of the plurality of vascular medical images based on a plurality of image features common to the subset of vascular medical images. An image providing unit (IPU) provides a current vascular medical image (CVMI) including the plurality of image features. A diagnostic metric computation unit (DMCU) computes an overall diagnostic metric for the current vascular medical image by applying the at least one automatically-generated diagnostic rule to the current vascular medical image. A decision propagation unit (DPU) identifies, in the current vascular medical image, the relative importance of each of the plurality of image features on the computed overall diagnostic metric.

title: Method and apparatus for calculating score matching advertisement information and providing it to user
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of calculating a score matching advertisement information and providing the same to a user and device thereof. The device includes: an external server which outputs advertisement information and collects records of the advertisement information to generate big data information; a user terminal of a user exposed to the advertisement information; and a management server for receiving the big data information from the external server and generating marketing analysis report information based on the record of the advertisement information.

title: Wireless power transmitting device for wirelessly transmitting power, wireless power receiving device for wirelessly receiving power, and operation method thereof
abstract: According to an embodiment, a wireless power transmitting device may include a transmission coil, a DC/DC converter configured to output a driving voltage, an inverter configured to output AC power to the transmission coil, and a controller. The controller may be configured to output a first control signal for generating the AC power having a first frequency to the inverter, measure a demodulated voltage generated by demodulating a signal applied to the transmission coil, and output, to the inverter, a second control signal for generating the AC power having a second frequency different from the first frequency, based on a first peak-to-peak value identified in the demodulated voltage being a preset first value or more. The inverter may output the AC power having the second frequency to the transmission coil based on the second control signal. Other various embodiments are possible as well.

title: Device, system and method for electronically requesting and storing missing digital evidentiary items
abstract: A device, system and method for electronically requesting and storing missing digital evidentiary items is provided. A dashboard computing device: receives, from distinct jurisdictional agency computing devices, indications of jurisdictional digital evidentiary items associated with an incident; determines, based on an incident type of the incident, one or more offenses associated with the incident type; determines required digital evidentiary items to prosecute the offenses via a digital offenses-to-evidentiary-items mapping; identifies a missing digital evidentiary item for prosecuting the offenses by: comparing the indications of the jurisdictional digital evidentiary items with the required digital evidentiary items; identifies a jurisdictional agency, associated with one or more of the distinct jurisdictional agency computing devices, that is most likely to have access to the missing digital evidentiary item; and renders, at a display screen, an actuatable option for electronically requesting the missing digital evidentiary item from the jurisdictional agency.

title: Dictionary training and image super-resolution reconstruction method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides a dictionary training and image super-resolution reconstruction method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after obtaining the low-resolution to-be-processed image, carrying out image super-resolution reconstruction on the low-resolution to-be-processed image by using the obtained high-resolution dictionary and low-resolution dictionary to obtain a high-resolution imaging image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: defining and machine learning the mapping relation between the corresponding high-resolution sample characteristic data and the corresponding low-resolution sample characteristic data; performing machine learning classification screening on the obtained multiple mapping relations to obtain a final mapping relation; and performing machine learning according to the final mapping relation to obtain corresponding high-resolution and low-resolution dictionaries. Therefore, the low-resolution imaging image obtained by imaging with low radiation dose and short CT time can be used for reconstructing to obtain a high-resolution image, and the occurrence of artifact caused by the movement of a patient can be reduced, so that the quality of the CT image is ensured, meanwhile, the rapid scanning is realized, and the radiation dose is reduced.

title: Parsing and reflowing infographics using structured lists and groups
abstract: This disclosure describes methods, systems, and non-transitory computer readable media for automatically parsing infographics into segments corresponding to structured groups or lists and displaying the identified segments or reflowing the segments into various computing tasks. For example, the disclosed systems may utilize a novel infographic grouping taxonomy and annotation system to group elements within infographics. The disclosed systems can train and apply a machine-learning-detection model to generate infographic segments according to the infographic grouping taxonomy. By generating infographic segments, the disclosed systems can facilitate computing tasks, such as converting infographics into digital presentation graphics (e.g., slide carousels), reflow the infographic into query-and-response models, perform search functions, or other computational tasks.

title: Method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for detecting traditional Chinese medicine property
assignee: 复旦大学附属妇产科医院, 苏州贝康医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for detecting the property of traditional Chinese medicine. The method comprises the steps of collecting a sample to be detected of the traditional Chinese medicine to be detected based on a metabonomics method, carrying out Raman spectrum detection on the sample to be detected of the traditional Chinese medicine to be detected to obtain Raman spectrum data of the traditional Chinese medicine to be detected, and identifying the Raman spectrum data by adopting a traditional Chinese medicine property classification detection model to obtain a property class of the traditional Chinese medicine to be detected so as to accurately identify the property of the traditional Chinese medicine by adopting a unified standard.
assignee_clean: 复旦大学附属妇产科医院; 苏州贝康医疗器械有限公司
primary_assignee: 复旦大学附属妇产科医院

title: Network intelligent system
assignee: 中国信息通信科技集团有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a network intelligent system which can be used as a future network paradigm. According to an example embodiment, a network intelligence system may include: the network data sensing device is arranged in one or more basic networks and used for sensing network data in the one or more basic networks; and the network intelligent processing device is used for carrying out artificial intelligent processing on the network data obtained from the network data perception device so as to obtain the information of the objects related to the one or more basic networks.
assignee_clean: 中国信息通信科技集团有限公司
primary_assignee: 中国信息通信科技集团有限公司

title: Method for constructing ADR prediction model of elderly patient, prediction system and storage medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of ADR prediction of Adverse Drug Reaction (ADR), and particularly relates to a method for constructing an ADR prediction model of an elderly patient, a prediction system and a storage medium. The method for constructing the ADR prediction model of the elderly patient comprises the following steps: constructing an elderly patient ADR trigger entry; constructing an ADR risk factor data set of the trigger-related elderly patients based on the ADR trigger items of the elderly patients and in combination with evidence-based evaluation results; completing risk factor labeling and ADR discrimination of the trigger-related ADR data set of the elderly patient; and training a machine learning model by using the marked data set information to obtain an ADR risk prediction model of the elderly patient. The invention further builds a prediction system by using the ADR prediction model of the elderly patient. The model and the system have good prediction performance, can predict the safety risk of a medication scheme, assist clinical medication decision and have good application prospect.

title: Systems and methods for mitigating artifacts in medical imaging
abstract: An exemplary method of imaging tissue of a subject using a rolling shutter imager to provide a video stream comprises: sequentially resetting a plurality of rows of pixels of the rolling shutter imager from a first row to a last row; transitioning a liquid crystal shutter from a closed state to an open state; after the liquid crystal shutter is transitioned into the open state and after resetting the last row, illuminating the tissue of the subject with an illumination light for an illumination period to accumulate charge at the plurality of rows of pixels, and after the illumination period ends, sequentially reading the accumulated charge at the rows of pixels from the first row to the last row; generating an image frame from the sequentially read accumulated charge at the plurality of rows of pixels; and adding the image frame to the video stream.

title: Information prediction method based on deep learning and related equipment
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: An information prediction method based on deep learning, comprising: obtaining LBS information; inputting LBS information into a clustering model to obtain a first basic feature; converting the first basic feature to obtain a second basic feature; determining a plurality of target grids from the POI grids; acquiring TF-IDF characteristics of a plurality of POI categories of a target grid and POI category distinguishing characteristics; mapping a plurality of dotting positions into each target grid, and obtaining dotting characteristics; clustering the plurality of dotting positions to obtain a plurality of resident points, mapping the plurality of resident points into a plurality of target grids, and obtaining the POI characteristics of the resident points; fusing TF-IDF characteristics, POI category distinguishing characteristics, dotting characteristics and resident POI characteristics, and obtaining position interest point characteristics; and inputting the second basic features and the position interest point features into a pre-trained model to obtain an information prediction result. The invention also provides related equipment. The invention can improve the accuracy of prediction based on the LBS information of the user.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Blood vessel tracking method, coronary image segmentation method, medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a blood vessel tracking method, a coronary image segmentation method, a medium and an electronic device. The blood vessel tracking method comprises the following steps: acquiring a seed point from the three-dimensional medical image as a current seed point; processing the three-dimensional medical image by using a convolution neural network to obtain the direction and the radius of the target blood vessel at the current seed point; if the direction of the target blood vessel at the current seed point meets a termination condition, acquiring the target blood vessel according to the direction and the radius of the target blood vessel at various seed points; otherwise, acquiring a new seed point from the three-dimensional medical image as a current seed point, and skipping to the step of processing the three-dimensional medical image by using a convolution neural network. The blood vessel tracking algorithm basically does not need manual participation, and avoids the problems of complexity, time consumption and the like caused by the manual implementation of the existing blood vessel tracking method.
assignee_clean: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司

title: Medicine market scale prediction system based on machine learning
assignee: 深圳市全药网科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical big data, in particular to a medicine market scale prediction system based on machine learning, which can predict the change trend of the medicine market purchase quantity, assist in making a purchase plan of a medicine market, help a user to know market positioning and assist in monitoring and evaluating reasonable medicine; the method comprises the following steps: s1, data requirement; s2, purchasing quantity related data; s3, data cleaning; s4, if the data are not included; s5, carrying out multi-dimensional statistics; s6, an index library; s7, randomly grouping; s8, evaluating the importance of the variable; s9, building a prediction model; s10, whether all variables are traversed or not; s11, model evaluation; s12, expert evaluation; s13, judging practicability; s14, testing a real environment; s15, whether to reevaluate.
assignee_clean: 深圳市全药网科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市全药网科技有限公司

title: Drug discovery method, device and equipment based on relation extraction and knowledge reasoning
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to artificial intelligence and discloses a medicine discovery method, a device and computer equipment based on relation extraction and knowledge reasoning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining the relationship types of the substance-gene entity pair and the gene-disease entity pair by using the relationship extraction model, and calculating a first probability score of the substance targeting gene according to the relationship types of the substance-gene entity pair; calculating a second likelihood score for the gene as a targeted gene for the disease based on the relationship type of the gene-disease entity pair; a third likelihood score for the substance as a therapeutic substance for the disease is calculated. The relationship extraction model may be stored in a blockchain. According to the method, the relation types of substances, genes and diseases are automatically extracted from massive medical documents, and the knowledge is utilized to infer substances with therapeutic effects or potential therapeutic effects of the drugs, so that the high cost and low recall of a scheme based on the similarity of structural properties of the compounds are avoided, and more substances with potential curative effects can be obtained.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Wall motion abnormity ultrasonic processing method, system and equipment based on deep learning
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application discloses a method, a system and equipment for ultrasonic processing of wall motion abnormity based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: identifying a two-dimensional section video in the echocardiogram; automatically drawing the endocardium contour of each frame of image in the two-dimensional section video, and determining the position of each segment; tracking the motion of the myocardial part spots of each frame of image in the two-dimensional section image, and calculating to obtain the strain curve of each segment of myocardium; constructing a strain model of each segment in a normal state according to the strain curve of the myocardium of each segment; inputting the ultrasonic sample to be tested into the strain model of each section, and comparing the fitting degree of the ultrasonic sample to be tested and the strain model. The method, the system and the equipment eliminate the interference of artificial subjective factors, reduce the inter-individual difference and intra-individual difference of the heart ultrasonic interpretation and improve the accuracy and consistency of the identification result.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军总医院
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院

title: Optimized score transformation for fair classification
assignee: International Business Machines Corporation, President And Fellows Of Harvard College
abstract: Obtain, from an existing machine learning classifier, original probabilistic scores classifying samples taken from two or more groups into two or more classes via supervised machine learning. Associate the original probabilistic scores with a plurality of original Lagrange multipliers. Adjust values of the plurality of original Lagrange multipliers via low-dimensional convex optimization to obtain updated Lagrange multipliers that satisfy fairness constraints as compared to the original Lagrange multipliers. Based on the updated Lagrange multipliers, closed-form transform the original probabilistic scores into transformed probabilistic scores that satisfy the fairness constraints while minimizing loss in utility. The fairness constraints are with respect to the two or more groups.
assignee_clean: international business machines; president and fellows of harvard college

title: Ergonomic assessment garment
abstract: Systems and methods of determining an ergonomic assessment of a user are provided. For example, sensor data may be received for one or more sensors implemented with an ergonomic evaluation garment worn by a user. Body data associated with at least one body part of the user may be determined based at least in part on the sensor data. The body data is associated with a bend angle associated with the at least one body part. An ergonomic assessment associated with the user may be determined based at least in part on the physical data. The ergonomic evaluation may include an indication of one or more ergonomic regions associated with the user, the one or more ergonomic regions determined based at least in part on the bend angle associated with the at least one body part.

title: Monitoring system for intelligent medical community service
abstract: The utility model provides a monitoring system towards wisdom medical community service relates to thing networking big data medical care technical field. The system comprises wearable medical equipment, an accompanying robot, a remote monitoring terminal, a cloud server control end and a community monitoring and management platform; the wearable medical equipment is worn by a person under guardianship and comprises a microprocessor, a power supply, and an attitude sensor, a vital sign detector and a Bluetooth communication module which are connected with the microprocessor and the power supply; the accompanying robot comprises a movable robot main body, an environment detection module, an image acquisition module, a main controller, a voice prompt module and a transmission module; the cloud server control end analyzes and stores the received information; and the remote monitoring terminal and the community monitoring management platform are connected with the cloud server control terminal. The system can realize the online real-time monitoring of the physical health of the aged-care community service, and a physical health state monitoring and early warning technology based on the accompanying robot is formed.

title: Shock wave incident point simulation planning method and system based on medical image
assignee: 武汉烽火凯卓科技有限公司, 华中科技大学
abstract: The invention relates to a shock wave incident point simulation planning method and a system based on medical images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical images of a plurality of human body parts related to shock wave incident point simulation planning, and constructing a human body model related to shock wave simulation according to the medical images; establishing a mathematical model with constraint conditions and target conditions according to the human body model; solving the risk value of each target condition; searching a pareto solution set until all points in the pareto solution set are divided into pareto dominant points or a set of dominant points based on each target conditional risk value and a greedy algorithm. The method utilizes self-adaptive parameters to construct a human body model with constraint conditions and target conditions, screens preliminary solutions through preliminary screening of the constraint conditions and risk values of the target conditions, and finally determines final solutions by using a greedy strategy and a pareto method, so that automation of the shock wave incident point planning and adaptability under multi-scene conditions are realized.
assignee_clean: 武汉烽火凯卓科技有限公司; 华中科技大学
primary_assignee: 武汉烽火凯卓科技有限公司

title: Transcutaneous and transcranial nerve stimulation
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: In an example, physiological signal(s) are received from physiological sensor(s) configured to measure at least one physiological property of a user. An arousal of at least one characteristic of at least one treatment resistant mood disorder is detected through employment of an estimation method based at least in part on at least one of the physiological signal(s). A value for at least one of a plurality of stimulation parameters is selected based at least in part on at least one of the physiological signal(s). An electric field based at least in part on the arousal is produced. The electric field is configured to stimulate at least a portion of a median nerve of the user transcutaneously. The electric field is based at least in part on at least some of the plurality of stimulation parameters.
assignee_clean: the regents of the university of california
primary_assignee: the regents of the university of california

title: Heterogeneous data-based device clustering method, apparatus, device, system and medium
assignee: 浪潮电子信息产业股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a device clustering method, a device, a system and a medium based on heterogeneous data, which relate to the technical field of computers, and can divide a plurality of edge devices into a plurality of device clusters so that each edge device carries out hierarchical federal training on a machine learning model; meanwhile, in the clustering process, the invention can determine the reasoning result of the machine learning model local to each edge device on the same test data set, and can determine the similarity of training data among the edge devices based on the reasoning result; furthermore, each edge device can be divided into a plurality of device clusters by utilizing the similarity of each training data, namely, the characteristics and the distribution condition of data isomerism can be considered in the clustering process, and the devices with similar data are placed in the same cluster, so that the similarity of the data in the clusters can be improved. Therefore, when each edge device performs hierarchical federation training, the similar machine learning model parameters can be ensured to be aggregated first, the global model can be ensured to converge more quickly, and federation learning efficiency can be improved.
assignee_clean: 浪潮电子信息产业股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 浪潮电子信息产业股份有限公司

title: Systems and methods for intelligent paperless document management
assignee: Capsilon Corporation, Sanjeev Malaney, Parag Kulkarni, Krishnwami Viswanathan, Vikram Malaney, Jeffrey Evans, Ice Mortgage Technology, Inc.
abstract: Provided are systems and methods for Web-based intelligent paperless document management where users can collect, store, and share all document from various locations. Also provided are systems and methods requiring minimal data reentry because of data extraction capabilities. Systems and methods described herein can deliver documents via internet to multiple persons without using barcodes or separator sheets for faxing or sending documents.
assignee_clean: capsilon; sanjeev malaney; parag kulkarni; krishnwami viswanathan; vikram malaney; jeffrey evans; ice mortgage technology

title: Medical information processing apparatus and medical information processing method
abstract: A medical information processing apparatus according to an embodiment includes a processing circuitry. The processing circuitry sets, as a finding, an item related to diagnosis of a subject; disposes, in an identical screen in accordance with the finding, each display region for displaying a piece of medical data related to diagnosis of the subject; and displays the medical data extracted from a first facility in the display region for displaying the medical data and displays the lacked medical data extracted from a second facility, together with information that identifies the second facility from which the extraction is made, in the display region for displaying the lacked medical data.

title: System and method for correcting patient index
abstract: A system and/or method for determining an immune activation state of a subject can include: deforming leukocytes within a microfluidic channel, acquiring a plurality of images of the leukocytes, determining biophysical parameters of the leukocyte, adjusting the biophysical parameters, and determining the immune activation state of the subject based on the biophysical parameters.

title: Multi-sensor interactive patient-care pod
abstract: ABSTRACT A multi-sensor interactive patient-care pod is disclosed herein. In one embodiment the system may comprise a telemedicine pod having a plurality of physiological sensors and an integrated computing device allowing medical practitioners to remotely gather increased patient information and provide advanced levels of healthcare and service. The system may have sensors for measuring body weight, pulse oximetry, body temperature, blood pressure, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, and any other appropriate parameters. The multi-sensor interactive patient care-pod may comprise an enclosed pod in a first orientation, and may open by the combined sliding of its front cowling and lifting of its top cowling to allow patient ingress and egress. The system may further comprise a mobile device that can be placed in any appropriate location, and may further integrate smart technologies such as machine learning, voice and face recognition, self-cleaning, self-driving, and self-locking technologies. 22 Date Recue/Date Received 2020-04-23

title: Method and apparatus for performing communication using multiple transmission layer configurations per bandwidth part in wireless communication system
abstract: A method for transmitting signals by a user equipment (UE) in a multi input multi output (MIMO) communication system is disclosed. The method comprises steps of receiving two or more MIMO layer configurations per bandwidth part (BWP); receiving a medium access control (MAC) control element (CE) indicating a first MIMO layer configuration for a downlink reception via a first BWP and a second MIMO layer configuration for an uplink transmission via a second BWP among the two or more MIMO layer configurations; and transmitting and receiving signals based on the first and second MIMO layer configurations.

title: System and method for staged ensemble classification
abstract: A method for training thresholds controlling data flow in a plurality of cascaded classifiers for classifying malicious software, comprising: in each of a plurality of iterations: computing a set of scores, each for one of a set of threshold sequences, each threshold sequence is a sequence of sets of classifier output thresholds, each set of classifier output thresholds used to control a flow of data from a first cascaded classifier of the plurality of cascaded classifiers to a second cascaded classifier of the plurality of cascaded classifiers, each score computed when classifying, using the respective threshold sequence, each of a plurality of software objects as one of a set of maliciousness classes; computing a set of new threshold sequences by applying a genetic algorithm to the set of threshold sequences and the set of scores; and using the set of new threshold sequences in a consecutive iteration.

title: Technology platform for care planning and coordination
abstract: Platform for care coordination and planning. Integration of care planning tool, frontend applications, and customer support platform to assist in trust administration for beneficiaries who may have disabilities. The platform may be used to provide planning, concierge, and fiduciary services.

title: X-ray image quality control system
abstract: An X-ray image quality control system includes an image acquisition unit configured to acquire an X-ray image and determine the type of imaged body part and the type of projection mode. A quality detection unit is configured to detect an image defect in X-ray image with regard to the type of the imaged body part and/or the type of the projection mode. The quality control system effectively identifies image defects including inaccurate positioning, patient movement, external object artifacts, and poor exposure. The system provides feedback to the technician at the image acquisition point to adjust the image acquisition solution in a timely manner.

title: CT rib segmentation method and device
assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司, 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司
abstract: The invention provides a CT rib segmentation method and a CT rib segmentation device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, training data are acquired, and two types of labels are generated according to the training data; s2, training a full convolution image semantic segmentation model of two tasks according to the two types of labels to obtain a rib segmentation model; s3, acquiring CT data to be segmented, wherein the CT data to be segmented comprise all layers in the CT; s4, reasoning out a two-dimensional segmentation result and an adjacent layer relation on each layer in CT data to be segmented by using a trained rib segmentation model, and obtaining a rib contour of each layer by using a connected domain detection algorithm based on two-dimensional segmentation; s5, merging rib contours of all layers according to the adjacent layer relation to obtain a three-dimensional segmentation result; s6, obtaining a CT rib segmentation result of the CT data to be segmented by utilizing a post-processing algorithm. Compared with the traditional algorithm designed by manual heuristics, the method is based on mass data and deep machine learning, so that the method has the advantages of robustness, expandability and the like.
assignee_clean: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司; 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司

title: Method and apparatus for diagnosing brain diseases using 3d magnetic resonance imaging and 2d magnetic resonance angiography
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for diagnosing a brain disease utilizing 3D magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and magnetic resonance angiography (MRA). The method for diagnosing a brain disease comprises the following steps. An image obtaining unit obtains the 3D MRI and MRA photographing a brain of a patient. A brain disease lesion extraction unit extracts a lesion region and lesion information of a brain disease from the MRA. An image mapping unit maps the lesion region to the 3D MRI based on the extracted lesion information. A classification unit localizes the mapped region and classifies a disease.

title: Systems and methods for user control of electronic chairs
abstract: Systems and methods for operating a vending machine and/or kiosk. The methods comprise: detecting a presence of a person in a seat of the vending machine; obtaining a full or partial body heat map for the person that was created based on sensor data generated by at least one sensor of the vending machine or at least one sensor located in proximity to the vending machine (the full or partial heat map showing relative temperatures of different parts of a body of the person); selecting at least one vending service parameter for the vending machine using information obtained based on the full or partial body heat map; and causing the vending machine to provide the person with a vending service in accordance with the at least one vending service parameter that was selected.

title: Method and system for improving CT image quality
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure may disclose a method for improving CT image quality. The method for improving the CT image quality may include obtaining SFS data. The SFS data may include SFS scan data or an SFS image. The SFS scan data may be acquired by a CT device in an SFS state. The SFS image may be generated by reconstructing scan data acquired by the CT device via scanning in the SFS state. The method may include generating a corresponding optimized image by processing the SFS data based on an image quality optimization model. The image quality optimization model may be a machine learning model. The present disclosure may simulate the SFS image as an FFS image using a deep neural network model, thereby improving a resolution of the SFS image and reduce artifacts in the SFS image.

title: Security scanning device
abstract: A method for scanning an individual with a security device includes providing a scanner, engaging the scanner in a first scanning mode to produce an initial scan of the individual with a controller, producing an initial representation based on the initial scan, determining a property of a second scanning mode based on information from the initial representation, and engaging the scanner in the second scanning mode to produce a second scan of the individual.

title: Prostate ultrasonic image segmentation classification method
assignee: 广东技术师范大学, 暨南大学
abstract: The invention discloses a prostate ultrasonic image segmentation classification method, which comprises the following steps: establishing an image segmentation model; establishing an image classification model; combining the image segmentation model with the image classification model to form an image segmentation classification model; and inputting the acquired prostate ultrasonic image into an image segmentation classification model for classification. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can improve the classification precision of the images and improve the later diagnosis efficiency and accuracy.
assignee_clean: 广东技术师范大学; 暨南大学

title: Image-based circular plot recognition and interpretation
abstract: A device includes software instructions for a circular plot analysis agent and at least one circular plot definition. The circular plot analysis agent obtains a digital image of a circular plot, detects a perimeter of the circular plot within the digital image, detects a plurality of edges within the perimeter, identifies a set of endpoints on the perimeter as a function of the plurality of edges, generates a plot descriptor from the set of endpoints, and initiates a transaction with a second device as a function of the plot descriptor.

title: Information and passive biometric systems and methods
abstract: Information and passive biometric capture systems and methods. The information system includes a housing having a cavity configured to receive tangible items therein. A transparent, touch-sensitive display device is positioned over the cavity and configured such that in response to pixels of the display being black, the tangible items behind the black pixels are visible through the transparent display. A controller is programmed to receive from a remote server an alarm signal, and in response thereto, cause the display to change its state to indicate an alarm condition on the display. In response to receiving an input from the touch-sensitive display, a keypad is displayed, and inputs thereon are communicated to the remote server. The display can also display personal photographs stored in the memory device. A passive biometric capture system includes a chair with pressure-sensitive sensors embedded within areas contacted by a person sitting in the chair to form a unique passive biometric signature for each person and thereby differentiate among different people who sit in the same chair.

title: Methods and systems for automatic segmentation
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for reconstructing and automatically segmenting an image. In one embodiment, a method comprises acquiring projection data, the projection data comprising higher energy projection data and lower energy projection data, generating a first image from the projection data, generating a second image from the projection data, segmenting the second image to generate segments, and segmenting the first image based on the segments of the second image. In this way, an image which may otherwise prove challenging for an automatic segmentation process may be accurately segmented without sacrificing textural details of the image.

title: Ultrasonic simulation method and system based on medical tomography
abstract: The invention provides an ultrasonic simulation method and system based on medical tomography, which belong to the technical field of ultrasonic imaging and calculate the acoustic impedance coefficient of each voxel of the tomography; carrying out reflection modeling on the tomographic image by combining the acoustic impedance coefficient to obtain an initial reflectivity map; processing the initial reflectivity map by utilizing a reflectivity generating network to obtain a complete reflectivity map; and simultaneously inputting the complete reflectivity map and the real ultrasonic image into an ultrasonic deep learning network to carry out realism learning, so as to obtain an ultrasonic virtual image. The invention can well maintain the geometric shape of the image, and can learn the noise distribution and the brightness effect of the real ultrasound; the defect that the GAN network cannot well maintain the geometric shape is overcome, and texture information and other sense of reality information of the generated image can be maintained; the method can be closer to the sense of reality of real ultrasound, and can better keep the geometrical shape of human tissues corresponding to the generated simulation ultrasound.

title: Library screening for cancer probability
abstract: A method, system, and computer program product are provided for generating a predictive model. A processor(s) obtains a raw data set (peptide libraries) of patients designated as diagnosed/pre-diagnosed with a condition or not diagnosed with the condition. The processor(s) segments the raw data set into a pre-defined number of groups and separates out a holdout group. The processor(s) performs a principal component analysis on the remaining groups to identify, based on a frequency of features in the remaining groups, common features (principal components) in the remaining groups and weighs the common features based on frequency of occurrence. The processor(s) determines a smallest number of the principal components that yields a pre-defined level of validation accuracy. The processor(s) generates a predictive model, by utilizing the smallest number for a best fit in a logistic regression model. The predictive model provides binary outcomes.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and program
abstract: Provided are an information processing apparatus, an information processing method, and a program capable of accumulating appropriate relearning data. An information processing apparatus includes an input unit that inputs input data to a learned model acquired in advance through machine learning using learning data, an acquisition unit that acquires output data output from the learned model through the input using the input unit, a reception unit that receives correction performed by a user for the output data acquired by the acquisition unit, and a storage controller that performs control for storing, as relearning data of the learned model, the input data and the output data that reflects the correction received by the reception unit in a storage unit in a case where a value indicating a correction amount acquired by performing the correction for the output data is equal to or greater than a threshold value.

title: Data coding method based on deep learning and cloud computing service and big data platform
assignee: 深圳天使无忧科技开发有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a data coding method and a big data platform based on deep learning and cloud computing services. Therefore, data coding control of different interactive service elements in the video interactive channel process can be performed on the online video service terminal in a more targeted manner, targeted control with the interactive service elements as data coding control objects is realized, and the real-time interactive effect is improved.
assignee_clean: 深圳天使无忧科技开发有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳天使无忧科技开发有限公司

title: Method and apparatus for processing block to be processed of urine sediment image
abstract: Concepts herein relate to processing urine sediment images. An example method comprises: approximating the color of a pixel in a block to be processed to one of the kc colors in a code book, wherein the code book is a set of the kc colors generated in a set of urine sample blocks; obtaining a distribution histogram of the number of pixels the color approximation results of which fall on each color of the kc colors; using an occurrence frequency correction factor to correct the number of pixels the color approximation results; standardizing the corrected number of pixels the color approximation results; and processing the block to be processed.

title: Delivery of an extended digital therapeutic (ExRx) based on an emotional/mental state (EMS) and/or home-bound state (HBS)
abstract: The current invention describes a method and system for delivering reconfigured digital content or reconfigured delivery of digital content designed to allay the effects of Q/D-related EMS. Disclosed is a system/method for delivering an extended digital therapeutic (ExRx) based on a selected emotional/mental state (EMS) and home-bound state (HBS).

title: Method and apparatus for reporting processing delay related information in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to method and apparatus for reporting processing delay related information in wireless communications. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by a wireless device in a wireless communication system comprises: receiving a configuration on measurements and reporting of reordering statistics; measuring a reordering delay (RD); calculating the reordering statistics; and sending a radio resource control (RRC) message including the reordering statistics based on a pre-defined condition.

title: Question analysis method for medical knowledge graph questions and answers
abstract: The invention relates to a question analysis method for medical knowledge graph questions and answers. The technical proposal is as follows: classifying the medical problems by using a classifier, and performing entity identification and attribute identification on the medical problems by using an identifier; then, the identified entities are matched with all the entities in the knowledge graph one by one, and the entity with the highest matching degree in the knowledge graph is a standard entity; matching the identified attributes with all the attributes in the knowledge graph one by one, wherein the attribute with the highest matching degree in the knowledge graph is a standard attribute; and then converting the standard entity, the standard attribute and the standard attribute value into query sentences, and obtaining the answer of the medical question after the query sentences are received by the query module in the knowledge graph. The invention has the characteristics of high recognition accuracy and low question analysis error rate, and can effectively relieve unbalance of medical resources and reduce medical cost.

title: Systems and methods for hybrid synchronization in virtual distributed ledger networks
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for hybrid synchronization in virtual distributed ledger networks. In one embodiment, a processor-implemented method is disclosed, comprising receiving, at the first virtual machine or container associated with a master ledger, a transaction request comprising transaction information; updating the master ledger with the transaction information; upon determining to perform a synchronous update of the slave ledgers, updating the slave ledgers based on the updated master ledger with the transaction information using a consensus protocol; and upon determining to perform an asynchronous update of the slave ledgers, communicating by the first virtual machine or container, with one or more additional virtual machines or containers associated with the slave ledgers, an update of the slave ledgers at one or more times determined based on a delay tolerance associated with each of the one or more additional virtual machines or containers.

title: Postoperative acute pain prediction system based on brain-computer interface and deep learning and application
assignee: 天津大学, 天津富瑞隆金属制品有限公司
abstract: A postoperative acute pain prediction system based on brain-computer interface and deep learning and application thereof comprise: acquiring resting state electroencephalogram signals of a patient before operation for 0-3 days by portable electroencephalogram acquisition equipment; performing data segmentation on the preoperative resting state electroencephalogram signal through a sliding window to obtain a series of resting state electroencephalogram signal segments; a series of resting state electroencephalogram signal segments are correspondingly converted into a series of two-dimensional images by utilizing a preprocessing method for subsequent analysis; constructing a data set, adding labels and dividing a training set and a testing set; and constructing a prediction model based on deep learning, determining a model structure and model parameters to be optimized, and obtaining the prediction model based on deep learning, which can predict postoperative acute pain, through training and testing. The portable electroencephalogram acquisition equipment can conveniently and efficiently acquire electroencephalogram signals; the postoperative pain category is predicted under the condition of no damage to the patient through the analysis of the brain electrical signals of the patient in the preoperative resting state.
assignee_clean: 天津大学; 天津富瑞隆金属制品有限公司

title: Methods and kits for providing preeclampsia assessment and prediction of preterm labor
assignee: 苏州爱尔迪思生物科技有限公司
abstract: A method for providing preeclampsia assessment and prediction of preterm labor in a subject is disclosed. The method is implemented by the following method: developing and training a random forest model to derive a scoring metric to distinguish normal subjects, preeclamptic subjects, and preterm subjects; evaluating a marker panel from the subject to determine the level of each of the marker panels; and providing the level of each of the marker panels to a random forest model to provide preeclampsia assessment and prediction of preterm birth. The marker panel comprises inhibin beta A (activin A) and at least one selected from the group consisting of ADAM metallopeptidase domain 12(Adam12), Body Mass Index (BMI), and white blood cell count (WBC).
assignee_clean: 苏州爱尔迪思生物科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 苏州爱尔迪思生物科技有限公司

title: Size measurement apparatus, image display unit, computer-readable size measurement program storage medium, and computer-readable image display program storage medium
abstract: A size measurement apparatus comprises a designation section that designates parts in images of two or more medical images acquired through image taking for a subject; a first measurement section that measures a size of an image on a part designated by the designation section, of the medical image, as to a measurement direction associated with a geometry of the image; and a second measurement section that measures a size of a common measurement direction common to two or more medical images, the common measurement direction being determined in accordance with the measurement direction in the first measurement section.

title: Long-duration arrhythmia detection
abstract: This document discusses, among other things, systems and methods to detect an initial arrhythmia event indication and, after a threshold amount of detection window intervals detecting the initial arrhythmia event indication, adjust a set of arrhythmia parameters or at least one of a respective set of parameter thresholds to increase sensitivity of an extended arrhythmia event indication detection.

title: Unified extraction platform for optimized data extraction and processing
assignee: Cognizant Technology Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.
abstract: The present invention provides for a system and a method for optimized data extraction of different document types. First digitised data is extracted from ingested documents based on extraction rules and is classified into first classified data based on pre-defined rules. Confidence score is assigned to first classified data based on comparison of first classified data with pre-defined data. A second digitised data is extracted from classified document types corresponding to first classified data via a tool selected from multiple integrated tools based on extraction rules. An extraction score is determined for second digitised data. Classified document types are validated based on pre-defined requirements. In the event the pre-determined requirements are met the confidence score and the extraction score are compared with pre-defined parameters. If the result is above a pre-determined threshold the second digitized data is transmitted as executable files to applications for execution.

title: Systems and methods for image processing
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method may include obtaining an image representing a region of interest (ROI) of an object. The ROI may include two or more sub-regions. The method may include determining an average value of quantitative indexes associated with elements in the image corresponding to a first region of the ROI. The method may include determining, for each of the two or more sub-regions of the ROI, a threshold based on the average value; identifying target elements in the image based on the thresholds of the two or more sub-regions. The method may include assigning a presentation value to each of at least some of the target elements based on the average value and the quantitative index of the each target element. The method may include generating a presentation of the image based on the presentation values.

title: Image reconstruction method and device of Willis ring, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 沈阳先进医疗设备技术孵化中心有限公司
abstract: The specification provides an image reconstruction method, an image reconstruction device, an electronic device and a storage medium of a Willis ring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a CTA image of the head and neck of a subject; identifying a bounding box of a Willis ring in a CTA image, and sampling a sub-image containing the bounding box from the CTA image; inputting the sub-image into a key point positioning model, wherein the key point positioning model is obtained by training a neural network by adopting a CTA image sample, and key point position information on a Willis ring is marked in the CTA image sample; according to the positions of a plurality of key points, which are output by the key point positioning model and are positioned on the Willis ring, a display area of the Willis ring is intercepted from the sub-image; and reconstructing an image of the display area, adjusting the display area to a target observation angle, and outputting the image. Automatic and accurate identification and display of the display area of the Willis ring are realized.
assignee_clean: 沈阳先进医疗设备技术孵化中心有限公司
primary_assignee: 沈阳先进医疗设备技术孵化中心有限公司

title: Pre-training model fine tuning method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a pretraining model fine tuning method and a pretraining model fine tuning system, wherein the pretraining model fine tuning method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a service end preprocesses a medical pre-training global model to obtain the medical pre-training global model with freezing parameters and adjustable LoRA parameters; the terminal side inputs the local medical task data into the medical pre-training global model for calculation to obtain an initial output result; adjusting the initial output result by using the noise data to obtain a final output result; updating the medical pre-training global model based on the final output result; uploading the updated medical pre-training global model; and the server performs federal aggregation treatment on the medical pre-training global models uploaded by all the terminals to obtain a final medical pre-training global model. The invention realizes the fine adjustment of the large model by combining the federal learning and gradient estimation methods, thereby obtaining better performance results and being beneficial to improving the applicability and efficiency of the model in various downstream tasks.

title: Mobility analysis
abstract: A method, a structure, and a computer system for assessing user mobility. The exemplary embodiments may include collecting mobility data corresponding to a user and extracting one or more low level features from the mobility data. The exemplary embodiments may further include extracting one or more clinical level features from the low level features and assessing one or more health conditions of the user based on applying one or more models to the one or more clinical level features.

title: Multi-tier conversational architecture with prioritized tier-driven production rules
abstract: A chatbot maintains a conversation with a user by providing a plurality of separate conversational tiers that allow the chatbot to interact with the user, each of the conversational tiers having a set of production rules that are independent of production rules for other ones of the tiers. The production rules indicate a flow of conversation between the user and the chatbot. The chatbot selects one of the conversational tiers based on previous conversational tiers used by the chatbot in connection with conversing with the user and based on content of conversations between the user and the chatbot. The chatbot responds to statements of the user according to a specific production rule that is chosen by the chatbot based on a particular one of the conversational tiers that has been selected and based on other factors. A scripting engine may match statements of the user with specific production rules.

title: Medical image analysis method, medical image analysis device, and medical image analysis system
abstract: A method of analyzing a medical image includes acquiring a correction parameter computed based on a correlation between a first morphological value that is acquired from a first medical image acquired under a first scan condition and is related to a target element, and a second morphological value that is acquired from a second medical image acquired under a second scan condition and is related to the target element. A target medical image is acquired under the second scan condition. A target region related to the target element is acquired by segmenting the target medical image into regions corresponding to elements including the target element. A target morphological value related to the target element is based on voxel data corresponding to the target region. A corrected morphological value is based on the target morphological value and the correction parameter. A morphological index is outputted based on the corrected morphological value.

title: Emergency treatment pushing method and system applied to disease control monitoring and early warning system
assignee: 常熟市疾病预防控制中心
abstract: According to the emergency treatment pushing method and system applied to the disease control monitoring and early warning system, the situation that space-time situation representation vectors of the disease control emergency events are difficult to comprehensively and abundantly represent global monitoring and early warning states of the disease control emergency events is considered, and the disease control emergency events are excavated by comprehensive and multiple-aspect details. And additionally introducing event element knowledge vectors of the disease control emergency events, detecting the involved disease control emergency events to consider the description vectors of the involved disease control emergency events, fully mining event detail knowledge of the disease control emergency events, and then screening an emergency treatment push processing network with better performance according to a depth residual error network to output an emergency treatment push label. The push decision analysis performance of the depth residual error network can integrate the detail of the disease control emergency events of a plurality of description layers in a high quality mode, so that implicit relations among different disease control emergency event vectors are extracted, and a first emergency handling push label of a target disease control emergency event is determined as accurately and reasonably as possible.
assignee_clean: 常熟市疾病预防控制中心
primary_assignee: 常熟市疾病预防控制中心

title: Method for detecting abnormality, non-transitory computer-readable recording medium storing program for detecting abnormality, abnormality detection apparatus, server apparatus, and method for processing information
abstract: A computer obtains a chest X-ray image, detects boundary lines in the chest X-ray image using a model constructed through machine learning, sets a third lung area including at least one of a first lung area or a second lung area, extracts a vascular index indicating at least one of thickness or density of at least one pulmonary blood vessel present in an area included in the third lung area, determines whether the area included in the third lung area is in an abnormal state on a basis of the vascular index and a reference index based on indices extracted in advance from an area in chest X-ray images in a normal state corresponding to the area included in the third lung area, and outputs, if determining that the area included in the third lung area is in an abnormal state, information indicating a result of the determination.

title: Ultrasound diagnosis apparatus, method of controlling ultrasound diagnosis apparatus, and storage medium having the method recorded thereon
abstract: An ultrasound diagnosis apparatus is provided, including a touch display which displays a graphical user interface (GUI) including a plurality of input buttons and receives an input of a user; and a controller which detects an input posture of the user and sets a display mode of the GUI based on the detected input posture. The GUI has a first display mode and a second display mode, and the first display mode and the second display mode are modes in which locations of at least one of the plurality of input buttons included in the GUI are differently displayed.

title: Antibody screening method and device based on machine learning
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses an antibody screening method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: obtaining topological structure information of antigens and antibodies and knowledge graph information of antigen-antibody interaction, and constructing a sample set based on the topological structure information and the knowledge graph information; training a network model in a directional transmission mode by utilizing a sample set containing topological structure information and knowledge graph information, and constructing an antibody prediction model with a perceivable molecular structure and knowledge graph characteristics; and responding to an instruction of screening the target antibody aiming at the target antigen, inputting the amino acid sequence and topological structure information of the target antigen to be predicted into an antibody prediction model, and obtaining the amino acid sequence information of the target antibody with neutralizing activity on the target antigen. The invention can learn and excavate the topological structure of antigen and antibody and the knowledge graph characteristic of antigen-antibody interaction, and can be used as the predictive discovery of neutralizing antibody, thereby improving the screening effect of antibody.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method and system for detecting orthopedic consumables based on rasterization image processing method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image and image processing, and relates to an orthopedic consumable detection method and system based on a rasterization image processing method. The method has no strict requirements on the quantity and quality of original data images, and the orthopedic consumable outer box and the orthopedic consumable are detected in stages by a stage detection method, so that the detection accuracy is greatly improved. The type of the orthopedic consumables outer box is detected only, the corresponding orthopedic consumables are detected according to the type of the outer box, and the accuracy is improved by 50% -60%. The method for detecting the target under the condition of only a small amount of data is provided, when the accurate marking data amount is insufficient, the method of detecting the orthopedic consumable outer box and then detecting the orthopedic consumable is adopted, and the method is superior to the single method of detecting the orthopedic consumable only. The invention can have higher accuracy under the condition of less data sets.

title: Methods of diagnosing and treating lung cancer
assignee: Savicell Diagnostic Ltd., Ramot At Tel-Aviv University Ltd.
abstract: A method of diagnosing lung cancer in a subject-in-need thereof is provided. The method comprises:(a) providing a biological sample of the subject which comprises peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs);(b) in vitro contacting the PBMCs with a stimulant selected from the group consisting of the stimulants listed in Tables 3 and 4; and(c) measuring metabolic activity of the PBMCs having been contacted according to (b), wherein a statistically significant change in the metabolic activity of the PBMCs as compared to a control sample is indicative of lung cancer.
assignee_clean: savicell diagnostic; ramot at tel-aviv university

title: Flash secure erase
abstract: A system with storage memory and a processing device has a logical deletion to physical erasure time bound. The system dereferences data, responsive to a direction to delete the data. The system monitors physical blocks in storage memory for live data and the dereferenced data. The system cooperates garbage collection with monitoring the physical blocks, so that at least a physical block having the dereferenced data is garbage collected and erased within a logical deletion to physical erasure time bound.

title: Modeling and extracting elements in semi-structured documents
abstract: The disclosed embodiments provide a system that describes a semi-structured document for the purpose of acquiring a set of data elements from the semi-structured document. During operation, the system obtains a physics model of a semi-structured document, wherein the physics model includes a set of relationships represented by physical objects that describe relative positions of a set of data elements in the semi-structured document. Next, the system applies the physics model to a representation of the semi-structured document to automatically extract a set of data from the representation. The system then provides the extracted set of data for use with one or more applications without requiring manual input of the data into the one or more applications.

title: Method, device and system for identifying junctional escape of electrocardiowave image and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海夏先机电科技发展有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for identifying interfacial escape of a electrocardiowave image and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of portable medical equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a cardiac electric wave image with a preset time length; identifying characteristic points and characteristic waves in the electrocardiowave image; and identifying the interfacial escape of the electrocardiowave image based on the characteristic points and the characteristic waves. The method, the device and the system for identifying the junctional escape of the electrocardiowave images, which are provided by the invention, provide a new identification algorithm, can realize the real-time identification of the electrocardiowave images only by collecting the electrocardiosignals for tens of seconds, have the advantages of quick identification and higher accuracy rate, and can be used for household portable medical diagnosis equipment.
assignee_clean: 上海夏先机电科技发展有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海夏先机电科技发展有限公司

title: Medical self-correlation time sequence data differential privacy release method
abstract: The invention provides a medical self-correlation time sequence data differential privacy release method. Firstly, constructing personal medical time sequence data; dividing the personal medical time sequence data into a plurality of mutually disjoint and equal-length personal medical time sequence data subsequences through a set sliding window; calculating according to the subsequence to obtain an autocorrelation function of the subsequence after normalization, and calculating according to the query function to obtain the periodic sensitivity of the subsequence; and generating a Laplace noise sequence corresponding to the subsequence, splicing all the noise sequences to obtain the Laplace noise sequence corresponding to the subsequence, and adding the Laplace noise sequence with the original time sequence data to obtain a final result to be released. The invention protects the privacy of the user from being revealed to a greater extent, and can process the medical time sequence data which is recently arrived. The invention can effectively improve the security of the privacy protection of the medical time sequence data and the time sequence data processing efficiency on the premise of ensuring that the correlation of the release data is the same as that of the original data.

title: Electronic medical record data processing method and system
assignee: 北京嘉和海森健康科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for processing electronic medical record data, which are used for preprocessing acquired electronic medical record data to be processed to obtain first data matched with the electronic medical record data; calling a pre-constructed information identification model, wherein sample data of the information identification model are matched with the first data; the data processing device inputs the first data into the information identification model, determines target information matched with the electronic medical record data to be processed, and outputs the target information, wherein the target information represents information with a specific association relationship with the electronic medical record data. The invention can automatically obtain the associated information of the electronic medical record data by utilizing the information model, and solves the problems of low efficiency and poor accuracy of obtaining the associated information by means of manual analysis in the prior art.
assignee_clean: 北京嘉和海森健康科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京嘉和海森健康科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for predicting pain level
assignee: The Florida International University Board Of Trustees
abstract: Devices and methods for learning and/or predicting the self-reported pain improvement levels of osteoarthritis (OA) patients are provided. A device or apparatus can include a processor and a machine-readable medium in operable communication with the processor and having stored thereon an algorithm and a unique set of features. The algorithm and set of features can enable building one or more models that learn the self-reported pain improvement levels of OA patients.
assignee_clean: the florida international university board of trustees
primary_assignee: the florida international university board of trustees

title: System and method for Z-PAT defect guidance statistical outlier detection for semiconductor reliability failure
