abstract: A system and method for Z-PAT defect guidance statistical outlier detection for semiconductor reliability failure comprising: receiving electrical test bin data and semiconductor die data for a plurality of wafers in a lot generated by a statistical outlier detection subsystem configured to perform a Z-direction part average test (Z-PAT) on test data generated by the electrical test subsystem after fabrication of the plurality of wafers in the lot; receiving characterization data for the plurality of wafers in the lot generated by a semiconductor factory characterization subsystem during the manufacturing of the plurality of wafers in the lot; determining a statistical correlation between the electrical test cartridge data and the characterization data at the same x, y locations on each of the plurality of wafers in the lot; and locating defect data signatures on the plurality of wafers in the batch based on the statistical correlation.

title: Method for estimating periodontal pocket inflammation area
abstract: The present invention provides a method for easily predicting the degree of inflammation of periodontal tissue such as inflammatory area (PISA value, CAPRS value) and a device (DNA chip, etc.) used in the method. The present invention provides a method for detecting bacterial amounts of 2 or more bacteria in saliva and estimating periodontal pocket inflammation areas using the detection results obtained as an index, the detected bacteria including: bacteria whose bacterial amount and periodontal pocket inflammation area show a positive correlation, and bacteria whose bacterial amount and periodontal pocket inflammation area show a negative correlation.

title: Defense agent method for improving Byzantine robustness of distributed learning system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a defense agent method for improving Byzantine robustness of a distributed learning system. The method comprises the steps of dynamically evaluating the credibility of each submitted gradient by using an adaptive credibility evaluation module based on a neural network structure, updating global classifier parameters maintained on a current main node, generating reward signals, and adjusting the parameters of the adaptive credibility evaluation module under a reinforcement learning frame according to the reward signals; and in the training process, the feasibility evaluation value of each working node is dynamically adjusted, so that the influence of the tampered gradient submitted by the malicious working node on the system training process is relieved, and the Byzantine robustness of the distributed learning system is improved. The method can be widely applied to various distributed deep learning systems, and the Byzantine robustness of the system is improved. The safety of the distributed training process of the artificial intelligence system is obviously improved, especially under the condition that the proportion of malicious working nodes is greater than or equal to 50%.

title: Confidence determination in a medical imaging video clip measurement based upon video clip image quality
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method, system and computer program product for video clip quality determination in medical device imaging and diagnosis. In an embodiment of the invention, a method for video clip quality determination in medical imaging includes first retrieving from a data store into memory of a host computer, video clip imagery of a target organ. Then, a quality value assigned to the video clip imagery may be identified in connection with the retrieved video clip imagery. A measurement of the target organ is computed based upon the retrieved video clip imagery. Finally, a confidence in respect to the computed measurement is determined based upon the identified quality value and the confidence determination displayed in a user interface provided by the host computer.

title: Medical insurance intelligent auditing system based on machine learning feedback rule enhancement
assignee: 浙江网新恩普软件有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical insurance intelligent auditing system based on machine learning feedback rule enhancement, which comprises a data structuring module, a recording word segmentation module, a text feature extraction module, a neural network module, an expert auditing module and a rule engine module. The invention combines the advantages of the association of the semantic AI and the symbolic AI, reduces the dependence on the explicit rules by introducing the neural network, reduces the requirement on the examination of experts by using a feedback type learning mode, reduces the manual cost, updates the rule engine by using feedback data after the examination of the experts, optimizes the neural network parameter learning by using the feedback data as a training sample, and further improves the intelligence, the accuracy and the reliability of the system.
assignee_clean: 浙江网新恩普软件有限公司
primary_assignee: 浙江网新恩普软件有限公司

title: Click-and-lock zoom camera user interface
abstract: A method includes receiving a selection of a selected zoom area on an input image frame displayed on a user interface; determining one or more candidate zoom previews proximate to the selected zoom area using a saliency detecting algorithm; and displaying the one or more candidate zoom previews on the user interface adjacent to the selected zoom area.

title: Human body part recognition method, computer device, and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a human body part identification method, computer equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image sequence to be identified, and extracting a preset number of image layers from the image sequence to be identified; inputting each image layer into a preset human body identification model to obtain a human body part label corresponding to each image layer; fitting the position labels corresponding to the image layers and the human body part labels corresponding to the image layers by using a preset fitting method to obtain a human body part identification relationship; the position labels corresponding to the image layers are the position information of the image layers in the image sequence to be identified; obtaining a human body part label corresponding to the target image sequence according to the human body part recognition relationship, or obtaining a human body position label corresponding to the target image sequence according to the human body part recognition relationship; the target image sequence is any sequence in the image sequence to be identified. The accuracy of obtaining the human body part label or the human body position label corresponding to the target image sequence is improved.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Device and host communications for input/output (I/O) operative touch sensor device (TSD)
abstract: A touch sensor device (TSD) includes TSD electrodes associated with a surface of the TSD. Also, an overlay that includes marker electrode(s) is also associated with at least a portion of the surface of the TSD. The TSD also includes drive-sense circuits (DSCs) operably coupled to the plurality of TSD electrodes. A DSC is configured to provide a TSD electrode signal to a TSD electrode and simultaneously to sense a change of the TSD electrode signal based on a change of impedance of the TSD electrode caused by capacitive coupling between the TSD electrode and the marker electrode(s) of the overlay. Processing module(s) is configured to process a digital signal generated by the DSC to determine characteristic(s) of the overlay that is associated with the at least a portion of the surface of the TSD.

title: System and method for color paint selection and acquisition
abstract: A system and method and computer program product for paint color recommendation. The system obtains measures of an environment to be painted and trains a learned model to input data received from customers including data representing each customer's initial color paint and pigment selection, and one or more of: a customer perceptual, a customer context, and environment measure (P/C/E data) to generate a sparse matrix. One or more paint vendors may then use the generated sparse matrix to determine a color pigment recommendation from a pigments color space for a customer. From a user selected color/pigment, and using the learned model, the system maps the selection, together with the user's P/C/E data back to the color/pigments space. User feedback representing a degree of satisfaction that the recommended color pigment applied to the user environment has matched the user's initial color paint and color pigment selection is elicited.

title: Artificial risk assessment method for lumbar vertebra small Liang Fuzai stress change and hidden fracture
assignee: 暨南大学附属第一医院（广州华侨医院）
abstract: The invention relates to a lumbar vertebra bone small Liang Fuzai stress change and hidden fracture artificial risk assessment method, which is characterized in that lumbar vertebra X-ray images of lumbar vertebra patients are collected, screening and image processing are carried out, and a lumbar vertebra body identification model is established; acquiring a bone small Liang Tuxiang from an image of a lumbar vertebral body recognition model, analyzing morphological parameters and change rules of the bone trabecula, and measuring and evaluating the structural health condition of the bone trabecula; based on the health condition of the bone trabecula structure, the images of healthy bone trabecula, hidden fracture and bone trabecula injury in the bone trabecula image are identified, the convolutional neural network is subjected to learning training through different types of bone trabecula Liang Tuxiang, and the category of the bone trabecula image is automatically identified through the convolutional neural network after training. The invention can judge the bone Liang Fuzai and the fracture more accurately, can judge and process the image data of richer types in batch, can greatly relieve the basic labor of doctors, improves the diagnosis efficiency and saves the medical cost.

title: Multi-scale semantic feature-based chronic venous disease image classification method
abstract: The invention discloses a chronic venous disease image classification method based on multi-scale semantic features, which comprises the following steps: performing multi-scale division on the chronic venous disease image to be detected, and classifying the image blocks by using a concept classifier corresponding to each scale on each scale to obtain the concept category of each image block in the chronic venous disease image to be detected; taking the frequency of each concept category on each scale as a global representation feature, and connecting the global representation features on each scale in series to obtain multi-scale semantic representation of the chronic venous disease image to be detected; and acquiring a feature subset with optimal classification result distinguishing performance from multi-scale semantic representation by a feature selection method based on high-order correlation, and inputting the feature subset into a scene classifier to obtain a classification result of the to-be-detected chronic venous disease image. The invention has high accuracy and reliability of classification result.

title: Information processing apparatus and information processing method
abstract: Provided is an information processing apparatus including a processing unit that detects a gaze of a gaze-detection subject on a basis of a polarization image in which an eye of the detection object is imaged.

title: Endoscope polyp real-time detection method, system and terminal
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system and a terminal for detecting polyp of an endoscope in real time, comprising the following steps: acquiring an output image of endoscope equipment; preprocessing an input image; calling an endoscope polyp detection model to detect the preprocessed image; inputting the image with polyps in the output result into a generator model to output a simulation diagram after artificial correction and labeling, inputting the polyp image and the simulation diagram into an attacker to obtain a disturbed polyp image and a disturbed simulation diagram, and storing the disturbed image and the simulation diagram which cannot be identified by the current detection model into a training database; a self-updating strategy for retraining the endoscope polyp detection model is periodically performed using a training database. The invention can acquire the video of the endoscope in real time, detect polyp and output the video before and after lesion detection, thereby facilitating the observation of doctors. The invention has simple operation and no technical threshold when in use. The self-expansion model timing updating function of the data is provided, so that the later maintenance is simple and the accuracy is high.

title: Prescription efficacy classification method based on characteristic deviation alignment
abstract: The invention discloses a prescription efficacy classification method based on characteristic deviation alignment, which comprises the following steps: s1, a data preprocessing module: dividing the prescription by minimum semantic units, replacing the homonymous and heteronymous traditional Chinese medicines, and pre-training the minimum semantic units by using a language model; s2, a data augmentation module: based on the characteristic of weak sequence of a prescription semantic unit, carrying out random disordered processing on an original sample to generate a secondary sample, wherein the original sample and the secondary sample jointly form a training sample; s3, a deep learning feature extraction network module: extracting features of the training samples by adopting a deep learning model to obtain a training sample feature map; s4, characteristic deviation alignment parameter-free network module: performing deviation calculation on the training sample feature map based on metric learning; s5, fusing the optimization functions of feature deviation alignment: and taking the deviation calculation of the training sample feature map as a regular term of the cross entropy loss function, and participating in the update calculation of network parameters together, so as to improve the learning capacity of the network sample features.

title: Wearable device tracking a biomarker in a team for early indication of infectious disease
abstract: A method for addressing tactical situations via tactical devices may include (i) identifying at least one wearable device that monitors at least one biomarker of a user wearing the at least one wearable device during a span of time while carrying out daily activities, (ii) receiving, by a server, information about activity of the at least one biomarker monitored by the at least one wearable device during the span of time, (iii) determining that the activity of the at least one biomarker during the span of time includes an early indication of an illness, and (iv) transmitting an alert about the early indication of the illness detected by the at least one wearable device. Various other systems, and methods are also disclosed.

title: Managing a fleet of workflow devices and standby devices in a device network
abstract: Methods of managing a fleet of devices are provided, as are methods for configuring a standby device for a job in a workflow environment, and methods for performing a job in a workflow environment. Device information is analyzed, such as information pertaining to verification systems. Device instructions are sent to various locations on a device network in response to a deviation from a parameter value having been detected. The deviation from the parameter value may correspond to printed media and/or indicia produced by one or more devices. A workflow device and a standby device are provided, and the workflow device sends configuration data to the standby device. The standby device installs configuration data and is introduced into the workflow environment.

title: Computing device and related product
assignee: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a computing device and a related product, the computing device is used for executing convolutional neural network training operation, and the computing device has the advantages of low cost and low power consumption.

title: Guided backpropagation-gradient updating for image processing task using redundant information from image
abstract: A method includes obtaining, using at least one processor, an input image frame. The method also includes identifying, using the at least one processor, one or more regions of the input image frame containing redundant information. In addition, the method includes performing, using the at least one processor, an image processing task using the input image frame. The image processing task is guided based on the one or more identified regions of the input image frame. The method may further include obtaining, using the at least one processor, a coarse depth map associated with the input image frame. Performing the image processing task may include refining the coarse depth map to produce a refined depth map, where the refining of the coarse depth map is guided based on the one or more identified regions of the input image frame.

title: Medical insurance fraud discovery method based on dynamic medical practice alignment
abstract: The invention discloses a medical insurance fraud discovery method based on dynamic medical practice alignment, which comprises the steps of (1) constructing a static graph network according to basic medical scene data, and then carrying out multiple graph rolling operations on an adjacent matrix of the static graph network by utilizing a multi-layer graph rolling network added with a residual error idea to obtain characteristic representation of each entity information in the static graph network; (2) Constructing a feature representation of the dynamic hospitalization behavior according to the feature representation containing entity information of the dynamic hospitalization behavior, and mapping the feature representation into a fixed length to serve as an input of an LSTM; (3) And extracting the time-related features of the feature representation of the dynamic hospitalization behavior by utilizing the LSTM determined by the parameters, encoding and decoding the related features, and obtaining a detection result by utilizing a softmax function. The medical insurance fraud discovery method improves the accuracy of medical insurance fraud detection.

title: Fusion graph generation method and device and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 安徽寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a fusion graph generation method, a fusion graph generation apparatus, and a computer-readable storage medium. The generating means may be comprised in the combined processing means as computing means, which may further comprise interface means and other processing means. The computing device interacts with other processing devices to jointly complete computing operations specified by a user. The combined processing device may further comprise a storage device connected to the computing device and the other processing device, respectively, for storing data of the computing device and the other processing device. Aspects of the disclosure may preprocess IR maps of a band control flow to suit operator fusion requirements of a machine learning processor, and then may generate a fused map of the machine learning processor based on the preprocessed IR maps.

title: Persona/individual based actions based on community specific trigger
abstract: Systems and methods herein spawn action sets for networked communities which are executed based on detected triggers. A method that spawns action sets can include selecting a community including member devices. The member devices are associated with a distributed job. The method can also include identifying a trigger related to the distributed job and spawning an automated action set related to the trigger. The automated action set includes at least one of automated action by the member devices or automated action by a remote device communicatively coupled to at least one of the member devices.

title: Method, device and storage medium for generating deactivated word list based on Chinese medicine dialogue
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a method for generating a deactivated vocabulary based on traditional Chinese medicine dialogue, which comprises the following steps: acquiring text data of a dialogue of a traditional Chinese medicine inquiry; taking the text data of the dialogue as corpus, and performing word segmentation processing by using a preset Chinese medicine word segmentation model to obtain a text to be processed and a primary screening stop word; screening the text to be processed by using a target stop word screening model obtained through pre-training to obtain word vectors with entropy and mutual information meeting preset values; and taking the text to be processed corresponding to the word vector obtained by screening as a target stop word, and combining the primary screening stop word and the target stop word to form a stop word list based on Chinese medicine dialogue. The invention can effectively recognize scenes aiming at Chinese medicine dialogue in the field of Chinese medicine, automatically complete intelligent generation of stop words, and achieve the technical effect of improving the accuracy of Chinese medicine intention recognition.

title: Non-invasive systems and methods to detect cortical spreading depression for the detection and assessment of brain injury and concussion
abstract: The present invention provides systems and methods for detection and diagnosis of concussion and/or acute neurologic injury comprising a portable headwear-based electrode array and computerized control system to automatically and accurately detect cortical spreading depression and acute neurological injury-based peri-infarct depolarization (CSD/PID). The portable headwear-based electrode system is applied to a patient or athlete, and is capable of performing an assessment automatically and with minimal user input. The user display indicates the presence of CSD/PID, gauges its severity and location, and stores the information for future use by medical professionals. The systems and methods of the invention use an instrumented DC-coupled electrode/amplifier array which performs real-time data analysis using unique algorithms to produce a voltage intensity-map revealing the temporally propagating wave depressed voltage across the scalp that originates from a CSD/PID on the brain surface.

title: Saposin D and FAM3C are biomarkers for alzheimer's disease
abstract: The present invention provides protein-based biomarkers and biomarker combinations that are useful in qualifying Alzheimer's disease status in a patient. In particular, the biomarkers of this invention are useful to classify a subject sample as Alzheimer's disease or non-Alzheimer's disease. The biomarkers can be detected by SELDI mass spectrometry.

title: Customer service call routing and/or scheduling system and method
abstract: A method of routing a communication of a customer to an appropriate service representative includes, in accordance with an embodiment of the present disclosure, identifying, within a database stored to a server, a customer account associated with the customer. The method also includes analyzing a data fingerprint saved to the customer account, where the data fingerprint comprises data indicative of a plurality of life events associated with the customer. The method also includes determining, via a switch, the appropriate service representative based on the analyzing of the data fingerprint.

title: Multi-mode medical data analysis system and method based on feature mining
abstract: The application discloses a multi-mode medical data analysis system and method based on feature mining, relates to the technical field of intelligent data analysis, integrates multi-mode medical data, namely endoscope images, rectal nuclear magnetic images, chest, abdomen and basin enhanced CT images and serum tumor marker level values, extracts semantic features of each mode data by combining an intelligent algorithm, realizes probability assessment of achieving pathological relief after treatment of a rectal cancer patient, and provides objective and consistent support for clinical decision and prognosis assessment.

title: MDT remote consultation system and method based on scene fusion and mr
assignee: 四川省医学科学院·四川省人民医院
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote consultation, and provides an MDT remote consultation system and method based on scene fusion and mr, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting data information of a patient, calculating error degree between three-dimensional data and medical history data information of the patient, judging whether the three-dimensional model is subjected to refined reconstruction, obtaining the three-dimensional data of the patient again, fusing with technologies such as virtual reality and the like, constructing a remote consultation environment based on scene fusion, transmitting the data information of the patient and the information such as diagnosis results of doctors to a remote consultation center, and transmitting the final consultation results to a system terminal of a hospital, wherein the hospital treats the patient according to the consultation results.

abstract: The present invention relates to methods of determining colorectal cancer status in a subject. The invention further relates to kits for determining colorectal cancer status in a subject. The invention further related to methods of identifying biomarker for determining colorectal cancer status in a subject.

title: Bone suppression for chest radiographs using deep learning
abstract: A system and method for generating a rib suppressed radiographic image using deep learning computation. The method includes using a convolutional neural network module trained with pairs of a chest x-ray image and its counterpart bone suppressed image. The bone suppressed image is obtained using a bone suppression algorithm applied to the chest x-ray image. The convolutional neural network module is then applied to a chest x-ray image or the bone suppressed image to generate an enhanced bone suppressed image.

title: Utilizing polarization characteristics to detect vibrations in optical fibers
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for utilizing polarization parameters obtained from an optical network to determine vibrations in optical fibers using coherent optics equipment and machine learning techniques. A method, according to one implementation, includes the step of obtaining a time-series dataset that includes measurements of polarization characteristics of light traversing an optical fiber of an optical network. The method also includes the step of detecting vibration characteristics of the optical fiber based on the time-series dataset. In some implementations, the time-series dataset may be a multi-variate dataset and the polarization characteristics may be related to transients in a State of Polarization (SOP). The SOP, for example, may be represented by an amplitude and a phase of an electric field vector and may be defined as having one of a linear polarization, elliptical polarization, and circular polarization.

title: Compression imaging method and system
assignee: 澳大利亚核科学和技术组织
abstract: A mask for compressive sensing of incident radiation, the mask comprising: a body formed of a material that modulates the intensity of incident radiation of interest. The body has a plurality of mask aperture regions, each mask aperture region including at least one mask aperture that allows higher transmission of radiation relative to other portions of the respective mask aperture region, the relative transmission being sufficient to allow reconstruction of a compressed sensing measurement; the mask has one or more rotational symmetry axes about the mask aperture region; the mask aperture has a shape that provides symmetry after rotation about one or more rotational symmetry axes; and the mutual dryness of the sensing matrices resulting from the rotation of the respective mask aperture areas is less than 1. An imaging system for compressive sensing of incident radiation including the mask is also provided.

title: Indices of microbial diversity relating to health
abstract: Provided herein are methods for altering a health state of a subject by administering a wellness intervention to subjects found to have quantitative measures of microbial genera in the subject's microbiome that are associated with undesirable health states. Undesirable health states can be inferred by executing models that predict health states based on the quantitative measures, such as relative amounts of selected microbial genera to all microbes. Models are created by statistical methods that analyze datasets that include, for each of a plurality of subjects, verified health states and quantitative measures of each of a plurality of microbes classified at designated taxonomic levels, e.g., genus level.

title: Delirium risk assessment method and system based on hospital information system
abstract: The present invention relates to a delirium risk assessment device based on a hospital information system, in particular for an object to be assessed, such as an ICU patient, and the object to be assessed is limited in at least one of language expression, body movement, facial expression, the assessment device comprising at least: and an evaluation processing module configured to combine the above-mentioned several evaluation values about the at least one delirium feature, determine whether the combination satisfies a predetermined evaluation condition, and when the combination between the several evaluation values about the at least one delirium feature obtained by the fast evaluation of delirium consciousness blur by the subject to be evaluated does not satisfy the predetermined evaluation condition, retrieve history information related to the subject to be evaluated in the hospital information system, perform a secondary evaluation in combination with medical information and/or evaluation information in the history information, and determine a delirium potential risk level of the subject to be evaluated based on the dynamic delirium risk evaluation policy.

title: Retinal vascular disease detection from retinal fundus images using machine learning
assignee: .B.M.S, Rani Ms, Bobbillapati, Suneetha Ms, H, Bhavani Naga Prasanna Ms, Mikkili, Divyasree Ms, Pittala, Chandra Shaker Dr, Vallabhuni, Rajeev Ratna Mr, Vallabhuni, Vijay Dr
abstract:
RETINAL VASCULAR DISEASE DETECTION FROM RETINAL FUNDUS IMAGES 
USING MACHINE LEARNING 
ABSTRACT 
One of the essential senses in the human body is the eyesight. A human existence is 
meaningful in the world only by the vision. So any malfunction in the vision of the human 
eye has to be handled with highest priority. So even in the world, there are number of scientific 
technologies implement lot of changes in biomedical field, the technology related to vision 
finds its significance. The researchers proven that the vision blurriness or the vision loss not 
only caused by the change in human eye power but also reflects malfunction of other parts of 
the body. As, the blood vessels that carry blood oxygen flow through the body and especially 
the blood vessels that is at the back of the eye connects to the heart. So even the heart related 
disorder also reflects in the eye. Not only heart, other functions like liver, kidney and 
inflammatory disease reflect in human eye. So detection of retinal vascular disease is very 
essential. For this function, the fundus images from the retina are observed by fundus camera 
and then only the luminous green is considered to undergo processing. CLAHE is deployed 
to categorize pixels of similar characteristics and noise is removed by filters. By deploying 
machine learning, mean-C threshold method with convolution, computation is performed and 
non-vessel images are removed. By making accurate predictions, the eye-care specialist can 
make proper diagnosis and give good consultation to the patients.

title: Training device and method
assignee: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a training device and method, the device comprising: the parameter compression unit determines parameters to be compressed of the neural network according to the received model data of the neural network, and compresses the parameters to be compressed to obtain semantic vectors corresponding to the neural network; the parameter storage unit stores semantic vectors corresponding to the neural network and sends the semantic vectors to the parameter decompression unit or the arithmetic unit when receiving a data reading instruction; when receiving the semantic vector, the parameter decompression unit decompresses the semantic vector to obtain a decompression parameter of the neural network and sends the decompression parameter to the operation unit; the arithmetic unit trains the neural network for the received semantic vector or the decompression parameter. The method and the device can compress the parameters to be compressed, thereby effectively reducing the size of the model of the neural network, reducing the requirement on the memory and effectively improving the data processing speed of the neural network.

title: Control of a surgical instrument having backlash, friction, and compliance under external load in a surgical robotic system
abstract: For control of a surgical instrument in a surgical robotic system, multiple actuators establish a static pretension by actuating in opposition to each other in torque control. The static pretension reduces or removes the compliance and elasticity, reducing the backlash width. To drive the tool, the actuators are then moved in cooperation with each other in position mode control so that the movement maintains the static pretension while providing precise control.

title: Medical image classification method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a medical image classification method, a medical image classification device, medical image classification equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a detected image of a detected chest, and respectively inputting the detected image into a trained pulmonary tuberculosis detection model and at least one pulmonary tuberculosis symptom detection model; inputting the pulmonary tuberculosis feature vectors output by the pulmonary tuberculosis detection model and the pulmonary tuberculosis feature vectors output by each pulmonary tuberculosis feature detection model into the trained pulmonary tuberculosis classification model; and outputting the classification result of the pulmonary tuberculosis classification model. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the diversity of the pulmonary tuberculosis signs is considered, the detected images are respectively detected based on the independent pulmonary tuberculosis detection model and the independent pulmonary tuberculosis sign detection model of at least one typical sign in pulmonary tuberculosis, the extraction precision of pulmonary tuberculosis features and each pulmonary tuberculosis sign feature is improved, further, the comprehensive analysis is carried out on each feature vector, and the classification precision of medical images is improved.

title: Almost unsupervised cycle and action detection
abstract: An event detection method can include encoding a plurality of training video snippets into low dimensional descriptors of the training video snippets in a code space. The low dimensional descriptors of the training video snippets can be decoded into corresponding reconstructed video snippets. One or more parameters of the encoding and decoding can be adjusted based on one or more a loss functions to reduce a reconstruction error between the one or more training video snippets and the corresponding one or more reconstructed video snippets, to reduce a class entropy of the plurality of event classes of the code space, to increase fit of the training video snippet, and/or to increase compactness of the code space. The method can further include encoding one or more labeled video snippets of a plurality of event classes into low dimensional descriptors of the labeled video snippets in the code space. The plurality of event classes can be mapped to class clusters corresponding to the low dimensional descriptors of the labeled video snippets. After training, query video snippets can be encoded into corresponding low dimensional descriptors in the code space. The low dimensional descriptors of the query video snippets can be classified based on their respective proximity to a nearest one of a plurality of class cluster of the code space. An event class of the query video snippet can be determined based on the class cluster classification.

title: Image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium based on CT image
assignee: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and discloses an image processing method, device and equipment based on CT images and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: performing smooth segmentation treatment on the initial cervical vertebra CT image to obtain a candidate cervical vertebra CT image; performing abnormal position identification on the candidate cervical vertebra CT images through an abnormal identification model to obtain at least one abnormal region image; performing anomaly type analysis on the anomaly area image to determine at least one anomaly type; dividing the candidate cervical vertebra CT images to obtain a plurality of cervical vertebra CT division images; inputting a plurality of cervical vertebra CT segmentation graphs into a convolutional neural network for feature extraction to obtain a semantic feature information set; performing feature information matching on at least one abnormal type to obtain at least one abnormal feature information; and filling at least one piece of abnormal characteristic information into an information filling area preset in each cervical vertebra CT segmentation map to obtain a target cervical vertebra CT image. The invention also relates to blockchain technology, and initial cervical vertebra CT images can be stored in the blockchain.

title: Medical clinical test auxiliary system and method based on virtual reality technology
assignee: 奥罗科技(天津)有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a medical clinical test auxiliary system and a method based on a virtual reality technology, wherein the system comprises a medical clinical test hardware system and medical clinical test software, the medical clinical test hardware system consists of an interactive integration unit and a data integration unit, and the clinical test software consists of an application program and a data analysis system; the method comprises the following steps: establishing a test scheme before a newly developed drug enters a clinical test link; establishing a prediction model for each clinical individual through a machine learning neural network according to the individual behaviors and the bioelectrical signals of the clinical individuals; grouping clinical individuals to implement medicaments, and obtaining clinical data through tests; the influence of non-drugs is eliminated from clinical data, and drug effect data which is only dominated by drug factors is obtained. The invention provides clinical test auxiliary function for the development of nerve drugs by adopting a virtual reality technology, obtains the key data of the effectiveness of clinical drugs and helps a medicine developer to reduce the technical risk in clinical tests.

title: Neural network training method, reasoning method and related products
assignee: 北京鹰瞳科技发展股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a training method, an inference method, a computing device and a computer-readable storage medium of a neural network implemented by a computer. The neural network is used for reasoning on the homomorphic encrypted ciphertext data. The training method comprises the following steps: acquiring training data; training a neural network by using training data, wherein an activation function of an activation layer in the neural network is a unary quadratic polynomial which at least comprises quadratic terms and first-order terms, and the activation function has the characteristics of monotonous increase and non-negative gradient in a selected input interval; and determining parameters associated with the activation layer for use in reasoning based on the training. The scheme of the application provides a homomorphic encryption friendly universal activation layer scheme of the neural network, and the homomorphic encryption operation characteristic can be adapted by providing an activation function in a polynomial form, so that any neural network can be conveniently migrated to operate under homomorphic encryption.

title: Streamlining dialog processing using integrated shared resources
abstract: Techniques for reducing memory resources and processing resources used by a dialog system by sharing resources between pipelined processes of the dialog system. An integrated shared lexicon is constructed for simultaneous use by an Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) subsystem and a Natural Language Understanding (NLU) subsystem of the dialog system. The integrated shared dictionary includes a plurality of entries, wherein each entry includes first information used by the ASR subsystem, second information used by the NLU subsystem, and information associating the first information with the second information. The ASR subsystem uses the integrated shared lexicon to identify lexicon entries containing a set of words corresponding to a speech input. The dictionary entry information is transmitted to the NLU subsystem, which uses the entry to generate a meaning representation of the speech input. Sharing the dictionary among these subsystems significantly saves memory resources used by the dialog system and speeds up processing.

title: Image processing method and device
assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an image processing method and apparatus, the method comprising: performing target detection processing on the image to be processed to obtain a first contour of a target in the image to be processed under a first coordinate system; when the first contour is incomplete, carrying out coordinate transformation processing on the first position information of the first contour to obtain a second contour under a second coordinate system; determining third position information of a complete third contour according to the second position information of the second contour; and carrying out coordinate transformation processing on the third position information to obtain a fourth contour of the target under the first coordinate system. According to the image processing method of the embodiment of the disclosure, under the condition that the detected outline of the target is incomplete, the outline can be supplemented completely according to the coordinate transformation processing and the second position information of the pixel points on the outline after the coordinate transformation, a complete target area can be obtained, the detection efficiency is improved, the detection precision is improved, and the visual effect of the detection result is optimized.
