title: Multilayer perceptron based network to identify baseline illness risk
abstract: A method for training a baseline risk model, including: pre-processing input data by normalizing continuous variable inputs and producing one-hot input features for categorical variables; providing definitions for clean input data and dirty input data based upon various input data related to a patient condition; segmenting the input data into clean input data and dirty input data, wherein the clean input data includes a first subset and a second subset, where the first subset and the second subset include all of the clean input data and are disjoint; training a machine learning model using the first subset of the clean data; and evaluating the performance of the trained machine learning model using the second subset of the clean input data and the dirty input data.

title: System for providing Home Rehabilitation by using Wearable Electrocardiogram Patch
abstract: Disclosed is a home cardiac rehabilitation system using a wearable ECG patch. The provided home cardiac rehabilitation system using a wearable ECG patch compares the amount of oxygen consumed by a body during maximum exercise intensity predicted based on sensor data obtained while the wearable ECG patch was attached to the patient with the amount of oxygen consumed by the body during maximum exercise intensity measured in the hospital so as to perform cardiac rehabilitation in an appropriate state, so that cardiac rehabilitation can be performed at home without visiting the hospital.

title: Data training method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京达佳互联信息技术有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to a data training method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: splitting the training data by taking the category as a unit to obtain N sub-data sets; the category is determined according to a first attribute of the training data; the number of categories in the subdata set does not exceed the preset number; performing M times of iterative training on the deep learning model based on the N sub-data sets to obtain a trained deep learning model; the process of each iterative training comprises the following steps: training the deep learning model based on the first subdata set until the loss function of the deep learning model reaches a first preset value; training the deep learning model based on the second to Nth sub-data sets. The GPU utilization rate and the training speed during deep learning model training are improved.
assignee_clean: 北京达佳互联信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京达佳互联信息技术有限公司

title: Methods, systems, and computer program products for normalization and cumulative analysis of cognitive post content
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer program products for assessing a student in in an online discussion event using at least one processor of a computer includes obtaining discussion data comprising a plurality of discussion posts in a data file, each comprising a post author and post content, grouping the plurality of discussion posts of the data file into a plurality of discussion threads, classifying individual discussion posts of the plurality of discussion posts based on a post type, and assigning relative value units (RVUs) to at least one of the plurality of discussion posts, where the RVUs are time-normalized scores based on a complexity of the discussion post.

title: Brain aneurysm three-dimensional detection segmentation method based on deep convolutional neural network
assignee: 清华大学, 贵州省人民医院
abstract: The application provides a brain aneurysm three-dimensional detection segmentation method based on a deep convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional medical image data to be segmented; initializing the prediction of the three-dimensional medical image data, and generating seed points as initial tested areas; expanding an area outwards from the tested area to obtain an expanded area; inputting the expansion area into a trained flow network model, predicting the expansion area, and merging the predicted expansion area into a tested area; performing iterative prediction on the three-dimensional medical image data until the tested area completely covers the three-dimensional medical image data, and completing the prediction to obtain a prediction result of the three-dimensional medical image data; and obtaining a segmentation result of the three-dimensional medical image data according to the prediction result of the three-dimensional medical image data. The application introduces the thought of iterative prediction in the flow network model, and reduces the parameter number of the model while maintaining the three-dimensional structure information of the sample, thereby ensuring that the model is more accurate and convenient.
assignee_clean: 清华大学; 贵州省人民医院

title: Method and apparatus for performing measurement in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to method and apparatus for performing a measurement wireless communications. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by a wireless device comprises: receiving measurement configurations from a network, each of the measurement configurations mapping to a corresponding signal quality range; measuring a first signal quality for a serving cell at a first time point and a second signal quality for the serving cell at a second time point after the first time point; identifying a signal quality range to which a difference between the first signal quality and the second signal quality belongs; and performing a measurement based on a measurement configuration mapped to the identified signal quality range.

title: The medical image cutting method of the semi-supervised quick spectral clustering of full expression and system
abstract: The invention discloses the complete medical image cutting method and the system that represent semi-supervised quick spectral clustering.Method step comprises: the medical image that acquisition etc. are pending; Drawn at this medical image centre circle by touch-screen; Pixel grey scale, locus and Gabor texture feature extraction are carried out to full width medical image, carries out feature normalization and Feature Dimension Reduction process; The All-In-One form of carrying out enclosing picture region reference information represents; Generate and represent that the graph theory of semi-supervised mechanism relaxes Clustering Model based on complete; Clustering Model quadratic term rearranges into new positive definite matrix; Be rewritten as that restricted type is minimum comprises spherical formula; Ball quick approximation Strategy estimation last solution is comprised based on core set is minimum; Graphic cluster instruction vector determines the concrete class number of cluster segmentation; Component is indicated to be divided into different subset cluster according to classification base in K mean algorithm.System comprises a FPGA module and external equipment.The inventive method and system, simple to operate, real-time is good, and accuracy is high.

title: Methods of enhancing homeostatic capacity in a subject by modulating homeostatic system synchrony, and devices for use in practicing the same
abstract: Methods of enhancing homeostatic capacity in a subject are provided. Aspects of the methods include modulating synchrony, e.g., via modulating communication and/or coordination, among two or more distinct homeostatic systems of the subject in a manner sufficient to enhance homeostatic capacity of the subject. Also provided are devices configured for use in practicing the methods. Aspects of the invention further include methods of treating a subject for a condition via enhancement of homeostatic capacity. The methods and devices described herein find use in a variety of applications.

title: Machine learning based decentralized business planning system
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to a machine learning based decentralized business planning system. A computing platform may identify an event likely to impact one or more business operations. Subsequently, the computing platform may receive, for the event, data from one or more sources of data. Then, the computing platform may generate a data structure including a plurality of nodes, where the plurality of nodes corresponds to the received data. Then, the computing platform may authenticate, by utilizing a distributed ledger-based verification system, the plurality of nodes. Subsequently, the computing platform may perform, based on business rules applicable to the one or more business operations, analytics on the plurality of authenticated nodes. Then, the computing platform may generate, based on the analytics, a contingency plan to mitigate the impact to the one or more business operations, and may provide, via an interactive graphical user interface, the contingency plan.

title: Internal organ feature coding method based on face image multi-stage relation learning
assignee: 广州华见智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an internal organ feature coding method based on face image multi-stage relation learning, which comprises the steps of collecting face images and obtaining labels marked for each face image, wherein the labels comprise internal organ labels and organ feature labels associated with each internal organ; after the face image is subjected to data amplification, normalization and standardization processing are respectively carried out on the RGB channels to obtain a training set; and simultaneously performing supervised learning of two subtask branches on the face image training set by using the visceral organ label and the organ feature label to embed prior guiding knowledge of the visceral features, and finally obtaining a visceral feature coding model embedded with the prior knowledge. The invention can fully consider the relevance between the human face image and the organ label and the organ feature label, carries out modeling and analysis on the multi-stage relation learning model, and provides visual and objective basic support for human health care and health preservation for the coding result of the human organ features.
assignee_clean: 广州华见智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 广州华见智能科技有限公司

title: System and method for multi-label image segmentation of digital photographs
abstract: A system and method for multi-label image segmentation is provided. The method comprises the steps of: receiving image data including a set of labeled image elements; mapping a change in image data to edge weights; determining potentials for each image element in the image data; and assigning a label, based upon the determined potentials, to each image element in the image data.

title: Data processing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract: The application discloses a data processing method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after obtaining the training image corresponding to a plurality of labeling data sets, since each labeling data set contains a labeling value corresponding to each pixel point of the training image to which the labeling data set belongs, and pixels of a background region pixel point and pixels of different target objects are respectively labeled with different labeling data sets, based on the labeling data sets, after inputting the training image into a pre-constructed object segmentation model, test data sets respectively corresponding to the background region pixel point and pixels of different target objects can be obtained, and each set contains a test value on each pixel point, thereby obtaining current loss data between the labeling data set and the test data sets and adjusting model parameters in the object segmentation model according to the loss data.
assignee_clean: 联想 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 联想 北京 有限公司

title: Fundus imaging classification system based on integrated deep learning
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a fundus imaging classification system based on integrated deep learning, which comprises the following components: a pre-diagnosis classification network, a segmentation network, and a final diagnosis module, wherein: the pre-diagnosis classification network obtains an initial diagnosis result based on global information of the target fundus illumination; the segmentation network performs image segmentation on the states of the optic disc, the optic cup and the optic nerve fiber layer of the target fundus based on the initial diagnosis result; the final diagnosis module extracts the vertical cup-disk ratio and ISNT score based on the result of the state segmentation of the optic disk, the optic cup and the optic nerve fiber layer, and acquires and displays the final category of the target fundus illumination based on the vertical cup-disk ratio, the ISNT score and the optic nerve fiber layer defect state. The embodiment of the invention firstly performs the pre-diagnosis of glaucoma on the target fundus, and selects a proper target segmentation network, thereby improving the segmentation precision; when glaucoma judgment is carried out, the accuracy of the classification result is further improved by combining quantitative indexes of various types of energy-responsive disc edge forms.

title: Multi-tenant storage
abstract: A system, apparatus and product comprising: a multi-tenant layer that comprises shared resources, wherein the shared resources are accessible to multiple tenants of the storage system, wherein the shared resources comprise shared logic resources and shared data resources; and multiple single-tenant layers, wherein each single-tenant layer is associated with a respective tenant of the multiple tenants, wherein each single-tenant layer comprises a database and business logic of the respective tenant, wherein a multi-tenant encryption scheme is configured to enable secure communications with the multiple tenants without divulging sensitive information to the multi-tenant layer.

title: Multi-sensor information fusion method for sterilization robot
assignee: 吉林省森祥科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-sensor information fusion method for a sterilization robot, which aims to solve the problems that the sterilization robot in the medical field has higher uncertainty, can not accurately determine the operation parameters of the sterilization robot in different scenes, has poorer autonomy and the like when the multi-sensor information of the sterilization robot is fused. The invention comprises the following steps: generating a target classification training data set, acquiring characteristic information through processing a mixed depth neural network fused with a multi-source signal, establishing a decision fusion model based on a voting evidence theory, and training to obtain a sterilization robot operation parameter model; according to the invention, a visual signal and a sensor signal of the sterilization robot are organically fused together by combining a deep neural network with an improved evidence theory method through the deep learning and the improved evidence theory method, so that possible redundancy and contradiction among multi-sensor information are eliminated, the redundancy and the contradiction are complemented, the uncertainty is reduced, and further the operation parameters of the sterilization robot are output more accurately.
assignee_clean: 吉林省森祥科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 吉林省森祥科技有限公司

title: Image processing method, image processing apparatus, device, and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment provides an image processing method, an image processing device, equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image to be processed; inputting an original image into a preset neural network model; wherein the neural network model comprises: encoder, residual module and decoder; the method comprises the steps of performing coding processing on an original image through an encoder to obtain an initial feature map; performing self-attention processing on the initial feature map based on a self-attention mechanism of the residual error module to obtain initial feature information; screening the initial characteristic information based on a gating mechanism of the residual error module to obtain target characteristic information; fusing the target feature information and the initial feature map to obtain a preliminary feature map; and decoding the preliminary feature map through a decoder to obtain a target image. The embodiment of the disclosure can strengthen information interaction between the encoder and the decoder so as to improve segmentation precision.

primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Sidelink communication based on multiple sidelink technologies
abstract: One disclosure of the present specification provides a method by which a UE performs sidelink communication. The method may comprise the steps of: performing sidelink communication on the basis of a first RAT; switching a RAT for the sidelink communication from the first RAT to a second RAT; performing the sidelink communication on the basis of the second RAT; and communicating with a base station on the basis of NR.

title: Methods and apparatus for fall prevention
abstract: A system for fall prevention includes a platform for supporting a patient, the platform including rails and rail sensors, an image capturing device for capturing images of the patient, a patient monitor for interactive communication with the patient, a health monitoring station for receiving rail sensor data and communicating with the patient monitor, and an edge network device co-located with the platform and communicating with the station and the image capturing device. The edge network device receives image data from the image capturing device when the rail sensors indicate that the rail is down and the patient is at risk to themselves, anonymizes the image data to generate a skeleton image, determines a posture associated with the skeleton image, triggers alerts at the station when the patient is predicted to be sitting, and triggers escalated alerts at the station when the patient is predicted to be standing.

title: Homomorphic encryption method based on k-Lin hypothesis
abstract: The invention discloses a homomorphic encryption method based on k-Lin hypothesis, which comprises the following steps: a key generation step, an encryption step and two decryption steps. The invention meets the IND-CPA security under a standard model, has the property of addition homomorphism and also has a double trapdoor decryption mechanism; there are two kinds of private keys, one is a private key bound with a specific public key, and the other is a private key with stronger universality, and ciphertext obtained by encrypting any public key under the encryption system can be decrypted. The invention can simultaneously give consideration to confidentiality and availability of data and lighten the key management cost and pressure of a supervision party.

title: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for standardizing medical text data
assignee: 医渡云（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, device and storage medium for standardizing medical text data. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical text data to be standardized; based on a pre-established attribute word stock, word segmentation is carried out on the medical text data; generating first structured data corresponding to the medical text data based on the word segmentation result of the medical text data; searching at least one structured annotation data matched with the first structured data in a pre-established structured annotation data index based on the attribute words in the first structured data; respectively determining grading information of at least one structured label data; and screening out the structured annotation data from the at least one structured annotation data based on the hierarchical information, wherein the structured annotation data is used as standardized data of the medical text data. The method can convert the medical text data into standardized data, and then map the standardized data into a corresponding medical standard table system.

title: Optimization of user interaction during segmentation
abstract: FIELD: system for segmenting an object on an image.SUBSTANCE: graphic segmentation interface may contain a set of segmentation means for enabling a user to obtain a first segmentation of an object on an image. First segmentation can be represented by segmentation data. Interaction data can be obtained, which give an idea of a set of user interactions with a graphic segmentation interface, through which the first segmentation of the object was obtained. System may comprise a processor configured to analyze segmentation data and interaction data to determine an optimized set of user interactions, which, when executed by the user, obtains a second segmentation similar to the first segmentation in a faster manner.EFFECT: technical result is enabling accurate segmentation of an object on an image.13 cl, 32 dwg

title: Method and apparatus for inter-RAT cell selection mechanism in NB-IOT
abstract: A method and apparatus for inter-RAT cell selection mechanism in NB-IOT in a wireless communication system is provided. A wireless device receives a configuration related to periodic uplink transmission. A wireless device performs the periodic uplink transmission on a suitable cell. A wireless device selects other suitable cell, based on a periodicity of the periodic uplink transmission. A wireless device performs the periodic uplink transmission on the selected suitable cell.

title: Feature access control in a digital transaction management platform
abstract: An online document system manages access to features within the online document system. The online document system may receive and fulfill a request from a first entity to sponsor a feature for a second entity. The online document system may determine an access policy to restrict access to the sponsored feature. For example, the access policy may include a requirement that the second entity only use the sponsored feature with the first entity. The first entity may provide a second access policy to the online document system to enforce. If the second entity satisfies requirements of the access policies, the online document system may then provide access to the second entity to use the sponsored feature.

title: Mental disorder magnetic resonance image preliminary screening model construction method
abstract: The invention provides a method for constructing a mental disorder magnetic resonance image preliminary screening model, which comprises the steps of carrying out clinical whole brain MRI scanning on a plurality of subjects, wherein image processing is carried out on a joint image workstation; examining the images of all subjects by a neurologist to exclude subjects with significant brain abnormalities or image artifacts; converting the DICOM file storage format data into an NIFTI format, and storing the NIFTI format data in a 3D model image; removing bone voxels with a skull dissection tool to eliminate non-tissue effects; obtaining a skull removing brain template representing hemispheric information of a brain through a brain segmentation packet, and taking T1WI-nii, T2WI-nii and corresponding brain templates as input of a convolutional neural network model; the convolutional neural network model removes the characteristic channel with low contribution to the confidence score of the image category and the corresponding filter, reduces the redundancy of the model, compresses the model and simultaneously maintains the performance of the model; the classification model is trained in a weakly supervised manner based on the questionnaire at the patient level, and the trained classification model is examined.

title: Method and apparatus for performing 3D imaging examinations of a structure under differing configurations and analyzing morphologic changes
assignee: David Byron Douglas, Robert Edwin Douglas, Kathleen Mary Douglas
abstract: Digital breast tomosynthesis represents an enhanced type of mammogram for detecting breast cancer. In this disclosure, data from digital breast tomosynthesis is reconstructed into a volumetric database with each voxel having a (x, y, z) coordinate and viewed in true 3D using geo-registered head display unit and geo-registered tools for overall enhanced diagnosis. The breast is imaged under various configurations and the internal architecture of an anatomic feature three-dimensionally analyzed. Additional dataset creation and three-dimensional imaging techniques are disclosed.
assignee_clean: david byron douglas; robert edwin douglas; kathleen mary douglas

title: CNN-based periocular organ segmentation method, CNN-based periocular organ segmentation equipment and CNN-based periocular organ segmentation storage medium
assignee: 北京连心医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical images and computers, and relates to a method, equipment and a storage medium for segmenting periocular organs based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the medical image to be segmented into a trained convolutional neural two-class network to obtain a cross section containing eyes in the medical image; positioning the approximate region of the eye in the eye cross section: finding the center of the skull in the cross section of the eye after the skull is divided; locating a general region of the eye through a center of the skull according to the anatomical dimensions of the human body; dividing the trained convolutional neural network for delineating the eyeballs into eye delineating eyeballs at the approximate positions of the positioned eyes; according to the position of eyes and the anatomical structure of a human body, the crystalline lens, the optic nerve and the pituitary are respectively positioned; and then the lens, optic nerve and pituitary are respectively sketched out through corresponding convolutional neural networks.
assignee_clean: 北京连心医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京连心医疗科技有限公司

title: Apparatus, method and computer program for providing medical advice based on self-describing symptoms of a user
abstract: An apparatus (100) comprises: a processor (104); a memory (102); the memory stores information of a plurality of medical conditions, the memory further storing associations between one or more of the medical conditions and information of one or more medical diseases; the apparatus (100) is configured to receive input from a user via a user interface of the apparatus, the input comprising an indication of one or more medical symptoms of the user; the processor is configured to process the received indication of one or more medical symptoms of the user to determine a medical condition associated with the indication of one or more medical symptoms; the processor (104) is further configured to generate an output to the user on a display (106) of the device, the output comprising a suggestion on how the user responded to the medical condition.

title: System and method for recommending health checkup items based on machine learning
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for recommending health examination items based on machine learning, wherein the present invention is configured to: create a checkup data set based on a preset checkup guide and clinical results; create an independent examination learning model for each examination item using the examination data set; determine whether or not examination is necessary for each examination item based on medical information of a requester when receiving the medical information of the requestor; and integrate the results of the determination of whether or not the examination is necessary, which is determined for each examination item to send a requester (customer or user) for medical examination.

title: Time period reasoning method for selecting samples of hospital infection data
assignee: 上海利连信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a time period inference method for selecting samples of hospital infection data, which is characterized in that in the process of data sampling, a recorded diagnosis date is taken as a reference, a real infection date or samples of the latest days of the real infection date are selected, wherein the samples are extracted in the time unit length of inference of a former time period before and a latter time period after the reference, and an average value is obtained for estimating. The beneficial effects are as follows: the method solves the problem of sample selection by adopting a time period reasoning method, effectively obtains the infection sample in the time period in the infection state, has generalizability, can try on time series data, and has basic conditions similar to basic experience when being used.
assignee_clean: 上海利连信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海利连信息科技有限公司

title: Body landmark detection based on depth images
abstract: A system and method includes acquisition of a plurality of sets of body surface data, first data indicating locations of a first one or more body landmarks for each of the plurality of sets of body surface data, and second data indicating locations of a second one or more body landmarks for each of the plurality of sets of body surface data, training, using the plurality of sets of body surface data and data indicating locations of the first one or more body landmarks for each of the plurality of sets of body surface data, of a first reinforcement learning network to identify the first one or more body landmarks based on body surface data, and training, using the plurality of sets of body surface data and data indicating locations of the second one or more body landmarks for each of the plurality of sets of body surface data, of a second reinforcement learning network to identify the second one or more body landmarks based on body surface data.

title: Image processing apparatus, magnetic resonance imaging apparatus, and storage medium
abstract: An image processing apparatus according to an embodiment includes a processing circuitry. The processing circuitry obtains an MR image acquired by a magnetic resonance imaging apparatus and related to a brain. The processing circuitry divides a region of the brain in the MR image, into plural regions. The processing circuitry sets a parameter value used in generation of a calculated image generated by synthetic MRI and related to the brain, such that a relation of contrast among regions included in the plural regions becomes a predetermined relation. The processing circuitry generates the calculated image by the synthetic MRI, by using the MR image and the parameter value.

title: Personalized health system, method and device having a recommendation function
abstract: A personal health system, method and device that maintains a health knowledge base, inputs user characteristics, generates health scores based on the user characteristics and provides recommendations based on the user characteristics, health scores and knowledge base, wherein the recommendations are indicated by the knowledge base to be likely to improve the user's health.

title: Intelligent real-time molding information analyzer
abstract: The present invention relates to an intelligent real time molding information analysis system and, particularly, to an intelligent real time molding information analysis system which extracts an efficient application range with each data characteristic, and is applied to a manufacturing process to offer a standard guideline for enhancing the manufacturing process by collecting raw data provided from a plurality of manufacturing apparatuses, categorizing the collected raw data by each data characteristic, applying a statistical scheme and an artificial intelligent scheme to the data characteristic according to a category to perform analysis, and analyzing a correlation between the category of each data and a manufactured product based on the analysis result. The system comprises: a sensor interface collecting the raw data from the manufacturing apparatuses based on an internet of things; a data input processing module transmitting the collected data to a data analysis server and simultaneously transmitting the collected data to a fuzzy decision tree (FDT) module for intelligent data categorization; the FDT module categorizing the data collected via the data input processing module based on a master data list and displaying the categorized data on a display unit; and a data analysis server analyzing the data inputted via the data input processing module to provide a category master data list.

title: Association-based predictions of pathogen characteristics
abstract: A system comprising a machine learning classifier trained on a plurality of associations between a host and a pathogen to predict a pathogen characteristic is described herein. The pathogen characteristic can relate to a disease state of the host. Computer-executable instructions for performing a method of forecasting a portion of a target molecule anticipated to influence an organism's condition also are described herein. The method comprises employing population data to automatically analyze one or more areas of the target molecule to determine the portion of the target molecule anticipated to influence the organism's condition. The population data can pertain to at least one relationship between at least one diverse organism trait and the target molecule. One or more epitopes forecast by employing the method also are contemplated.

title: Method and system for determining a volume of interest
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A system includes a storage device storing a set of instructions and a processor in communication with the storage device. When executing the set of instructions, the processor is configured to cause the system to obtain a 3D image including a plurality of 2D images, the 3D image relating to a lesion of an object and determine a preliminary VOI in the 3D image. The processor is also configured to cause the system to determine a preliminary shape based on an intersection of the preliminary VOI and a 2D target image of the plurality of 2D images and determine a transformation matrix corresponding to an operation to transform the preliminary shape to a target shape relating to the 3D ROI. The processor is further also configured to cause the system to determine a transformed VOI based on the preliminary VOI and the transformation matrix.

title: System and method for merging slowly changing data
abstract: The disclosure generally describes computer-implemented methods, software, and systems for accessing volumes of data records structured to include sets dimensions, each dimension labelled in a manner specific to respective entities; identifying candidates data records keyed by managed keys that span a subset of dimensions even though at least one dimension from the subset of dimensions is labelled differently between the different volumes; comparing the candidate data records from the different volumes to determine whether a particular managed key is valid based on contents of the candidate data records from the different volumes; in response to determining that the particular managed key is valid, combining the candidate data records keyed by the valid managed key to be merged and accessible as one continuous entry; and in response to determining that the particular managed key is invalid, combining the candidate data records from the different volumes as separate entries.

title: Presence data determination and utilization
abstract: Systems and methods for presence ground truth approximation and utilization are disclosed. For example, a system detects the presence of a predefined subject, such as a person associated with a given user profile, and/or determines that authentication criteria for performing an action in association with the user profile has been satisfied. A period of time to associate data is determined, and data of one or more data types is labeled as being associated with the speaker identification event. That data may be formatted and input into one or more models to train those models to more accurately detect presence and/or determine whether authentication of a user profile should succeed.

title: Automatic cell nucleus detection method for medical image
abstract: The invention discloses a method for automatically detecting a medical image cell nucleus based on a deep neural network, which designs a connecting branch for replacing jump connection on the basis of a network structure of an encoder-decoder; the multi-scale feature extractor in the connecting branch can effectively utilize the multi-scale spatial position information of cell nucleuses in different level feature maps, and the channel attention module and the spatial attention module in the connecting branch can automatically select information with discrimination in the feature maps, so that the detection performance is obviously improved.

title: Inferring confidence and need for natural language processing of input data
abstract: Improved data ingestion techniques are provided. A data set comprising records is received, where each record contains one or more fields. A group of fields is identified, where each of the fields has a common metadata attribute. Metrics are determined for the group based on metadata associated with each field, and weight values are assigned to each of the metrics. A natural language processing (NLP) measure and a discreteness measure are generated for the group of fields based on the metrics and the weight values. A processing workflow is selected to use when ingesting data from the group of fields into a corpus, based on comparing the NLP measure and the discreteness measure to one or more predefined thresholds, and each of the fields in the group of fields are processed using the processing workflow.

title: Abnormality detection within a defined area
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: Abnormality detection within a defined area includes obtaining a plurality of images of the defined area from image-capture devices. An extent of deviation of one or more types of products from an inference of each of the plurality of images is determined using a trained neural network. A localized dimensional representation is generated in a portion of an input image associated with a first location of the plurality of locations, based on gradients computed from the determined extent of deviation. The generated localized dimensional representation provides a visual indication of an abnormality located in the first location within the defined area. An action associated with the first location is executed based on the generated dimensional representation for proactive control or prevention of occurrence of undesired event in the defined area.

title: Providing automated personal privacy during virtual meetings
abstract: Systems and methods for providing automated personal privacy during virtual meetings are provided herein. The method may include establishing, by a video conference provider, a video conference having a plurality of participants. The method may also include receiving, from a first client device associated with one of the plurality of participants, a first audio stream and a first video stream, and recording responsive to an indication from one of the plurality of participants, one or more audio or video streams within a recording. The method may include receiving, from the first client device, a personal privacy request. In response to the personal privacy request, the method may include modifying, by the video conference provider, at least one of the first audio stream or the first video stream in the recording and storing the least one of the first audio stream or the first video stream as modified to the recording.

title: Methods and systems for providing reward based verified recommendations
abstract: Methods and systems for providing reward based verified recommendations. A method disclosed herein includes broadcasting a recommendation request to a plurality of registered users, on receiving the recommendation request from a customer. The method further includes receiving and verifying an input from at least user of the plurality of users in response to the broadcasted recommendation request using a blockchain. The received input relates to the recommendation request and the input includes at least one of at least one service provider and at least one service provided by the at least one service provider. The method also includes issuing reward points (RPs) to the at least one user who has provided the input and the service provider who is included in the input on verifying the input. The method further includes providing at least one recommendation to the requested customer using the verified input and maintained previous recommendations.

title: Tiered detection of treatable events
abstract: Techniques are disclosed for a multi-tier system for delivering therapy to a patient. In one example, a first device senses parametric data for a patient and determines, based on a first analysis of the parametric data, that the patient is experiencing a treatable event. In response, the first device establishes wireless communication with a second device and transmits the parametric data to the second device. The second device verifies, based on a second analysis of the parametric data, whether the patient is experiencing the treatable event. The second device selects, based on the second analysis of the parametric data, an instruction for responding to the treatable event and transmits the instruction for responding to the treatable event to the first device. In some examples, in response to receiving the instruction, the first device aborts delivery of therapy for the treatable event or proceeds with delivering therapy for the treatable event.

title: Auxiliary implementation method and device for on-line prediction by using machine learning model
assignee: 第四范式（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: An auxiliary implementation method and device for on-line prediction by using a machine learning model are disclosed. Setting an online data storage system and an offline data storage system, wherein the online data storage system is used for storing at least part of data used for performing feature calculation in an online environment, and the offline data storage system is used for storing at least part of data used for performing feature calculation in an offline environment; respectively storing the data into an online data storage system and an offline data storage system; in response to the online prediction request, at least a portion of the data needed for online feature computation is obtained from the online data storage system. Thus, by synchronizing data between the online data storage system and the offline data storage system, consistency of data sources and processing procedures during online feature calculation and offline feature calculation can be ensured.
assignee_clean: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 第四范式 北京 技术有限公司

title: Server for managing online service providing customized commercial platform and system thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a server for operating an online service for providing a customized advertisement platform and a system thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the server comprises: a communication module for receiving first information inputted via the advertisement platform by a user from a user terminal which executes the advertisement platform; and a control module for controlling the output of information representing a plurality of advertisement categories through the user terminal, acquiring first selection information of the user corresponding to a plurality of advertisement categories from the user terminal, and controlling the generation of information representing a plurality of recommended advertisement companies based on the first selection information and the first information to output the information through the user terminal. Also, the first information further includes personal information of the user including information representing a reward of the user generated by the server and the name, identifier (ID), address, telephone number, and email address of the user.

title: Apparatus and method for diagnosing the mental state of a picture diary user through picture diary analysis based on artificial intelligence model
abstract: The present invention relates to a mental state diagnosing method of a picture diary user through analysis of a picture diary based on an artificial intelligence model. This diagnosing method comprises the following steps of: obtaining picture diary data inputted by a user through a picture diary creation mode of an exclusive picture diary application; diagnosing a mental state of the picture diary user through an output value obtained by inputting the inputted picture diary data into an artificial intelligence model if the picture diary data is inputted; generating a solution corresponding to the mental state of the picture diary user based on a diagnosing result; and outputting the generated solution through an output unit of a mental state diagnosing device.

title: Anesthesia depth detection device based on multiple indexes and electronic equipment
assignee: 江西杰联医疗设备有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an anesthesia depth detection device and an electronic device based on multiple indexes, wherein the anesthesia depth detection device comprises: the device comprises an acquisition unit, a processing unit and a determining unit, wherein the acquisition unit is used for acquiring a first electroencephalogram signal of a target object; the processing unit is used for amplifying the first electroencephalogram signal to obtain a second electroencephalogram signal; performing interference elimination on the second electroencephalogram signal according to a target preprocessing algorithm to obtain a third electroencephalogram signal; the determining unit is used for determining P anesthesia depth index data according to the third electroencephalogram signals; the acquisition unit is also used for acquiring a target physiological state parameter of the target object; the determining unit is also used for determining Q anesthesia depth index identifications corresponding to the target physiological state parameters; acquiring Q anesthesia depth index data corresponding to the Q anesthesia depth index identifications; and determining a target anesthesia depth value according to the target anesthesia depth algorithm and the Q anesthesia depth index data. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the detection accuracy of the anesthesia depth is improved.
assignee_clean: 江西杰联医疗设备有限公司
primary_assignee: 江西杰联医疗设备有限公司

title: Privacy-preserving document sharing
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of sending, by a user node, a document request comprising a document identifier (ID) to a document processor node connected over a blockchain, receiving, by the user node, a one-time pass-code from the document processor node based on the document ID, linking to the document using the one-time pass-code, and retrieving the document from a document owner node.

title: Media obfuscation
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving a request to access a file from a user node, by a file processor node, generating, by the file processor node, a file storage plan based on a distribution of file chunks throughout a peer-to-peer network, authenticating, by the file processor node, the user node based on blockchain credentials, acquiring, by the file processor node, a permission to access the file from a file owner node, and sending the file storage plan to the user node.

title: Image segmentation method and system for enhancing edge information of encoding and decoding end and guiding attention
abstract: The invention discloses an image segmentation method and system for enhancing and directing attention to edge information of a coding and decoding end, wherein a real image set, a semantic segmentation truth value diagram and an edge segmentation truth value diagram form a data set, and the data set is divided into a training set, a verification set and a test set; constructing an image segmentation network N for enhancing and paying attention to guiding of the edge information of the encoding and decoding end, wherein a feature extractor and a decoder are arranged in the image segmentation network N; training the image segmentation network N by using the training set and the verification set to obtain a trained image segmentation model M, and inputting the image data of the test set into the trained image segmentation model M to obtain an image segmentation result. The invention effectively relieves the problem of blurring of edge recognition in the image segmentation method, thereby obtaining more accurate image segmentation result and finer edge characteristics.

title: Method for constructing disease ontology model of thyroid cancer
abstract: The invention discloses a method for constructing a disease ontology model of thyroid cancer, which comprises the following steps: s100, collecting information; s200, preprocessing information, unifying entities with different names in the information from different sources, and performing semantic extraction on the information to obtain thyroid cancer data; s300, classifying thyroid cancer data, including entity data and entity relation data; s400, screening and filtering the entity data to obtain basic entity data; s500, constructing a thyroid cancer disease ontology model according to the entity relation data obtained in S300 based on the basic entity data; s600, mapping the thyroid cancer disease ontology model to MeSH. The invention systematically arranges and analyzes the disease knowledge of thyroid cancer, determines the disease core concept and the attribute, semantic relation and domain knowledge axiom thereof, establishes a Chinese-English corresponding ontology concept framework system model in the thyroid cancer disease field and creates a precondition for constructing a thyroid cancer disease knowledge base system.

title: Entity relation extraction method, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The application discloses a method for extracting entity relationship, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: manually extracting a plurality of binary entity pairs meeting a preset entity relationship from an electronic medical record text database to serve as seed examples; searching sentences comprising seed examples in the electronic medical record text database for each seed example, and extracting feature vectors of the sentences; clustering the seed instances based on the feature vectors; generating an extraction template corresponding to the cluster according to the seed instance and the feature vector of the sentence corresponding to the seed instance; extracting candidate examples from the electronic medical record text database by using the extraction template; confidence levels of the candidate instances are calculated according to entity relations between the candidate instances and the extraction templates, and whether the candidate instance is to be used as a new seed instance for next iteration is confirmed according to the confidence levels. The application can greatly improve the accuracy of extracting the entity relationship of the electronic medical record.

title: Claims settlement decision method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a data processing technology and provides a method and a device for claim settlement decision-making, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring injury data of an injury person to be settled, and acquiring corresponding anatomical part information according to the injury data; acquiring a lesion corpus set associated with the information of the anatomical part from a pre-established semantic network, and sending a first option information set to a terminal according to the lesion corpus set; receiving a first selection result sent by the terminal, searching a corresponding damage severity corpus set from a semantic network according to the first selection result, and sending a second option information set to the terminal according to the damage severity corpus set; receiving a second selection result returned by the terminal, and acquiring target matching data according to the anatomical part information, the first selection result and the second selection result; and acquiring preset claim data corresponding to the target matching data, obtaining target decision data according to the preset claim data, and sending the target decision data to the terminal.
assignee_clean: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司

title: Medical image lesion region segmentation method based on machine learning energy functional model
abstract: The invention discloses a machine learning-based energy functional model medical image lesion area segmentation method, which comprises the steps of firstly processing medical images by using Gabor transformation and a generalized linear machine learning method, capturing distinguishing description of a lesion area and a normal tissue area, and obtaining a lesion area-based learning model; then, an energy functional model is constructed on the basis, and the lesion area of the medical image is segmented. The method solves the problems that the machine learning method is sensitive to the label data and the energy functional can fall into local minima, can segment medical images containing complex backgrounds well, effectively reserves the characteristic information of focus areas, and provides reliable guarantee for doctors to diagnose the focus areas.

title: Bid tool optimization
abstract: A method including determining a first bid for a healthcare plan and a second bid for the healthcare plan. A bid-pricing tool is configured to utilize one or more first components to determine the first bid and one or more second components to determine the second bid, respectively. A bid difference between the first bid and the second bid includes at least a monetary difference in premiums paid by members of the first bid for the healthcare plan and members of the second bid for the healthcare plan. One or more third components are determined based at least in part on the bid difference to determine a third bid for the healthcare plan. A second bid difference is determined between at least one of the first bid and the third bid or the second bid and the third bid.

title: Medical record processing method, computer readable storage medium and computer device
assignee: 阿里巴巴达摩院(杭州)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical record processing method, a computer readable storage medium and computer equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target medical record; extracting a target symptom word set from a target medical record; extracting a target symptom characteristic word set from a target medical record based on the target symptom word set; acquiring a first weight of a target symptom word included in the target symptom word set in a preset disease and a second weight of a target symptom feature word included in the target symptom feature word set in the preset disease; and determining the target disease corresponding to the target medical record based on the first weight of the target symptom words included in the target symptom word set in the predetermined disease and the second weight of the target symptom feature words included in the target symptom feature word set in the predetermined disease. The invention solves the technical problems of low efficiency and high error rate when corresponding diseases are determined according to patient medical records in the related technology.
assignee_clean: 阿里巴巴达摩院 杭州 科技有限公司

title: Personalized monitoring of injury rehabilitation through mobile device imaging
abstract: A method and system of diagnosing a medical condition of a target area of a patient using a mobile device are provided. One or more magnetic field images of a target area of a patient are received. One or more hyperspectral images of the target area of the patient are received. For each of the one or more magnetic field images and the one or more hyperspectral images, a three-dimensional (3D) position of the mobile device is tracked with respect to the target are of the patient. A 3D image of the target area is generated based on the received one or more magnetic field images, one or more hyperspectral images, and the corresponding tracked 3D position of the phone with respect to each image. A medical condition of the target area is diagnosed or monitored based on the generated 3D image.

title: Operation method related to UE transmits signal on unicast link in bandwidth part in wireless communication system
abstract: A method of operating a first user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system includes receiving information related to a sidelink bandwidth part (BWP) by the first UE, establishing a plurality of unicast links by the first UE, transmitting a sidelink signal in the sidelink BWP on a first unicast link among the plurality of unicast link, and releasing a second unicast link for which radio link failure (RLF) has been declared among the plurality of unicast links, based on the RLF and a PC5 link identifier (ID) by the first UE. The PC5 link ID is used to identify the second unicast link for which the RLF has been declared among the plurality of unicast links.

title: Predicting legal matter outcome using artificial intelligence
abstract: The present disclosure contemplates a variety of improved methods and systems for providing predicted outcomes which can include suggested strategies for pursuing legal matter resolution. Machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence can analyze information from a plurality of data sources to determine important factors and dynamically adjust the weights of the information received to provide accurate predictions.

title: Providing trust and safety functionality during virtual meetings
abstract: Techniques for providing trust and safety functionality during virtual meetings are provided. In an example, a method includes establishing a video conference between client devices. The method includes receiving, from a first client device of the client devices, a stream corresponding to the video conference and including one or more items of content. The method further involves applying, to the stream, a machine learning model that is trained to identify inappropriate or harmful content in the stream. The method further includes determining, via the machine learning model, that an item of content in the stream is inappropriate or harmful. The method further includes editing the stream to remove the item of content. The method further includes transmitting the edited stream to the client devices.

title: Health supervision law enforcement data retrieval system and method based on natural language processing
assignee: 北京梦天门科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a natural language processing-based health supervision law enforcement data retrieval system, which comprises an input module, a processing module, a retrieval module, an output module and a database, wherein the input module is used for receiving and processing data of a user; the retrieval module comprises a fuzzy retrieval module and an accurate retrieval module, wherein the accurate retrieval module comprises fuzzy fields and accurate fields. The application also comprises a retrieval method of the health supervision law enforcement data retrieval system based on natural language processing, which comprises the following steps: word segmentation is carried out on the legal and legal texts through a word segmentation device; obtaining a deep learning algorithm model based on law and regulation text of health supervision law enforcement; when a user selects a fuzzy retrieval mode, obtaining the similarity between the input text and each text of law and regulation of the law enforcement of the sanitation supervision in the database; when the accurate retrieval mode is selected, matching and counting are carried out according to the obtained paraphrasing and original words and law and regulation texts of health supervision law enforcement, and the text content with the highest similarity is found. The application improves the working efficiency.

title: Remote consultation system for foot diagnosis and treatment
assignee: 马文足医疗科技(北京)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a remote consultation system for foot diagnosis and treatment, which comprises: the system comprises a patient terminal and a network side server, wherein the patient terminal acquires foot characteristic information of a patient and transmits the foot characteristic information to the network side server; the network side server comprises a feature processing module, a diagnosis database and a diagnosis module, wherein the feature processing module is used for processing the foot feature information to obtain foot health state information; the diagnosis module is used for searching a foot diagnosis result and a rehabilitation suggestion matched with the foot health state information in the diagnosis database according to the foot health state information; and the network side server is used for transmitting the foot diagnosis result and the rehabilitation suggestion to the patient terminal. According to the remote consultation system, the patient can obtain the foot diagnosis result and the rehabilitation suggestion only at home, so that the expensive hospitalization cost is saved, the patient is prevented from running between the hospital and the home, the home rehabilitation is realized, and the psychological stress of the patient is relieved.

title: Method and apparatus for providing total curation service based on skin analysis
abstract: According to various embodiments, a skin total curation providing server which provides a skin total curation service for a user comprises: a DB management unit interlocked with the server and obtaining the user's face image from a skin measuring device including a camera; a skin characteristic determination unit determining skin characteristics and skin type of the user based on the obtained face image; a trouble diagnosis unit diagnosing the user's skin trouble based on the obtained face image; a cosmetics determination unit determining cosmetics including necessary ingredients and necessary effects required for the user based on the skin characteristics, the skin type, and the skin trouble; a personal color determining unit determining the personal color of the user and makeup and fashion corresponding to the personal color; and a service providing unit providing information on the skin analysis result and skin analysis history of the user through the user terminal of the user. According to various embodiments, the skin type and troubles that could be diagnosed through experts can be easily and quickly diagnosed and managed anytime, anywhere, and non-face-to-face counseling services can be provided.

title: Method for training artificial neural network for analysis of immunohistochemical staining image, and computing system performing the same
abstract: Disclosed are a method for training a machine learning model for analysis of an immunohistochemical staining image, which can train a machine learning model used to analyze the degree of expression of a biomarker in detail by analyzing an image of a biological tissue slide stained by an immunohistochemical staining method that stains a tissue in which a specific biomarker is expressed, and can make a determination on a pathological sample image, such as analyzing the degree of expression of a biomarker, by using the trained machine learning model, and a computing system for performing the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided are the method and a system, which generate training data corresponding to an immunohistochemical staining image by using a plurality of feature vectors calculated based on various staining intensity reference values, and train a machine learning model. The method comprising the steps in which: a system for training a machine learning model generates a training dataset including M pieces of individual training data (where M is a natural number of two or more); and the system for training a machine learning model trains the machine learning model, based on the training dataset.

title: Deep learning-based tumor target area cloud detection device, system, method and medium
assignee: 山东英信计算机技术有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a device, a system, a method and a medium for detecting the cloud of a tumor target area based on deep learning, which comprise a data acquisition module and a detection module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-modal medical images to be detected and radioactive source parameters; the detection module comprises a delineation submodule, and the delineation submodule is used for delineating a tumor target area in the multi-modal medical image to be detected by using the trained target area delineation model; the target region delineation model is obtained by training a model constructed based on a deep learning algorithm by using a training set, the training set comprises a multi-modal medical sample image and a corresponding sample label, and the sample label comprises tumor target region information and radioactive source parameters in the multi-modal medical sample image. This application sets up data acquisition module and including the detection module who sketches the submodule piece on tumour target area cloud detection device, realizes the automatic sketching to tumour target area through each module of the aforesaid, improves detection accuracy and efficiency to tumour target area.
assignee_clean: 山东英信计算机技术有限公司

title: X-ray image processing method and x-ray image processing apparatus
abstract: An X-ray image processing method, including obtaining a first X-ray image of an object including a plurality of materials including a first material and a second material; obtaining a first partial image generated by imaging the first material and a second partial image generated by imaging the first material overlapping the second material from the first X-ray image; obtaining first information related to a stereoscopic structure of the first material, based on the first partial image included in the first X-ray image; and obtaining second information about the second material based on the first information and the second partial image.

title: Chronic heart disease state of illness trend prediction system
abstract: The invention provides a chronic heart disease state of illness development trend prediction system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment. The method comprises a database construction and feature extraction module for acquiring relevant features of a patient; the screening module is used for screening the data in the cloud database and further screening the medical service institutions; the training module is used for obtaining a trained first prediction model based on federal learning; the prediction module is used for preliminarily predicting the disease development trend of the patient to be predicted by using the first prediction model, classifying the patient based on the pre-trained second classification model, and judging whether the chronic heart disease development trend of the patient to be predicted is stable or not. The method realizes the training of the personalized custom model of the chronic cardiac disease patient to be predicted, and the obtained model can be better matched with a certain type of patient, and has high prediction precision.

title: Multi-modal spectroscopic analysis
assignee: Case Western Reserve University, University Of Florida Research Foundation
abstract: An example includes performing near infra-red (NIR) spectrometry to provide NIR measurement data for a sample compound. The method also includes performing magnetic resonance (MR) spectrometry to provide MR measurement data for the sample compound. The method also includes analyzing, by a computing device, the MR measurement data in view of the NIR measurement data to characterize the sample compound.
assignee_clean: case western reserve university; university of florida research foundation

title: Learned invertible reconstruction
assignee: Stichting Het Nederlands Kanker Inst Antoni Van Leeuwenhoek Ziekenhuis
abstract: A system for image reconstruction comprises a memory for storing data and instructions and a processor system. The system obtains measured data y defined in a dual space, the measured data relating to a primal space. The system determines dual parameters defined in the dual space based on the measured data and primal parameters defined in the primal space based on backprojection of the dual parameters. The system updates the primal parameters and the dual parameters, by obtaining auxiliary dual parameters by forward-projecting the primal parameters, applying a dual-space learned invertible operatorto the dual parameters, based on the auxiliary dual parameters, obtaining auxiliary primal parameters by back-projecting the dual parameters, and applying a primal-space learned invertible operatorto the primal parameters, based on the auxiliary primal parameters. The system determines an image in the primal space based on the updated primal parameters.
assignee_clean: stichting het nederlands kanker inst antoni van leeuwenhoek ziekenhuis

title: Imaging method and device in endoscope image pickup system and computer equipment
assignee: 杭州海康慧影科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides an imaging method, an imaging device and computer equipment in an endoscope camera system, and belongs to the technical field of medical imaging. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image shot in a target scene, wherein the first image is used for presenting a part to be detected of a target living body in the target scene; identifying a scene category to which the target scene belongs according to at least one object in the first image for identifying the scene category; and processing key factors influencing the imaging quality of the part to be detected of the target living body according to a scene processing strategy corresponding to the scene category to obtain a second image. In the method, the scene category to which the target scene belongs is identified according to at least one object of the scene category identified in the first image, accuracy of identifying the scene category is improved, and then imaging quality key factors affecting a part to be detected of the target living body are processed according to a scene processing strategy corresponding to the scene category, so that a second image is obtained, and imaging quality can be improved.

title: Identification method and device for ischemic retinal vein occlusion
assignee: 中日友好医院(中日友好临床医学研究所)
abstract: The identification method and the device for the ischemic retinal vein occlusion can extract global information and contextual information, accurately grasp local information of the ischemic retinal vein occlusion, and accurately identify the ischemic retinal vein occlusion in an omnibearing manner. Comprising the following steps: (1) data reading: reading the marked FFA image, preprocessing and enhancing the data, and dividing the data into a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a proportion at random; (2) model training: extracting features through Vision Transformer and CNN networks respectively, splicing the two feature images, and fusing; sending the FFA image to a full connection layer to acquire an identification result of the FFA image, and carrying out back propagation through a loss function during the identification result so as to train a model; (3) model test: and loading parameters by using a parameter file of the trained model, reading FFA images to be identified, preprocessing the images to enable the images to be consistent with the format of training data, and sending the images into the model to obtain an identification result.

title: Sepsis prediction method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 天津中医药大学第二附属医院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical data mining, and discloses a sepsis prediction method and system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: obtaining a sepsis patient sample and preprocessing the sepsis patient sample to obtain a preprocessed sepsis patient sample set; s2: classifying the sepsis patient sample set into a first sample set and a second sample set according to an age threshold in the sepsis patient sample; s3: training the first deep learning model according to the first sample set to obtain a first sepsis prediction model, and training the second deep learning model according to the second sample set to obtain a second sepsis prediction model. According to the invention, sepsis prediction models respectively applied to two age groups are designed according to different ages of patients, and the two models are trained by using patient samples of specific age groups only during training, so that the accuracy of the models after training is ensured, and different model predictions can be selected according to the ages of patients to be predicted.
