title: Interpretation maps with guaranteed robustness
assignee: International Business Machines Corporation, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute
abstract: Interpretation maps of deep neural networks are provided that use Renyi differential privacy to guarantee the robustness of the interpretation. In one aspect, a method for generating interpretation maps with guaranteed robustness includes: perturbing an original digital image by adding Gaussian noise to the original digital image to obtain m noisy images; providing the m noisy images as input to a deep neural network; interpreting output from the deep neural network to obtain m noisy interpretations corresponding to the m noisy images; thresholding the m noisy interpretations to obtain a top-k of the m noisy interpretations; and averaging the top-k of the m noisy interpretations to produce an interpretation map with certifiable robustness.
assignee_clean: international business machines; rensselaer polytechnic institute

title: Multi-shot echo planar imaging through machine learning
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for improving MRI data acquisition efficiency while providing more detailed information with high resolution and isotropic resolution without gaps. Improved data acquisition efficiency may be achieved by implementing a machine learning algorithm with a hardware processor and a memory to estimate imperfections in fast imaging sequences, such as a multi-shot echo planar imaging (MS-EPI) sequence. These imperfections, such as patient motion, physiological noise, and phase variations, may be difficult to model or otherwise estimate using standard physics-based reconstructions.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine remote consultation system based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine remote consultation system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a inspection module, a pulse diagnosis module, a consultation module, an auditory diagnosis module, a diagnosis database and a remote diagnosis module, wherein remote transmission and diagnosis standardization of inspection inquiry and four diagnosis data are realized by using the artificial intelligence, and accurate remote diagnosis between doctors and patients can be facilitated.

title: Transmitting of information in wireless communication
abstract: A method comprising receiving a modulated radio signal transmitting coded information bits, performing demodulating on the modulated radio signal, wherein demodulating comprises performing orthogonal time frequency space demodulation, performing equalization on the demodulated radio signal to obtain equalized symbols, obtaining log-likelihood ratios for the coded information bits from the equalized symbols using a trained machine learning model, and reconstructing the coded information bits.

title: Method and apparatus for managing hospital assets of mental health medicine
abstract: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for managing hospital assets of mental health medicine. The artificial intelligence-based method and apparatus for managing hospital assets of mental health medicine according to an embodiment include: obtaining a photograph of a target asset, the asset including medicines, medical devices, disposable treatment tools, office supplies, and electronic devices, using the camera of the portable terminal; encoding a picture to generate a first input signal; inputting the first input signal to a pre-learned convolutional neural network of an embedded computer in the control device; inputting an output value of the convolutional neural network and a first output signal pre-stored in a database in the control device into a pre-trained neural network based on a result of the input of the convolutional neural network; obtaining a modified first output signal based on a result of the input of the neural network; displaying an asset status on the portable terminal based on the modified first output signal; generating a first order signal and transmitting it to a first network storage device, based on the order information in the modified first output signal; and storing the modified first output signal and the first order signal in a database and a blockchain network.

title: K-space trajectory infidelity correction in magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: For k-space trajectory infidelity correction, a model is machine trained to correct k-space measurements in k-space. K-space trajectory infidelity correction uses deep learning. Trajectory infidelity is corrected from a k-space point of view. Since the image artifacts arise from k-space acquisition distortion, a machine learning model is trained to correct in k-space, either changing values of k-space measurements or estimating the trajectory shifts in k-space.

title: Techniques for generating multi-modal discourse trees
abstract: Methods for generating and utilizing a multi-modal discourse tree (MMDT) are provided herein. An extended discourse tree (EDT) may be generated (e.g., from a discourse tree (DT) or a communicative DT (CDT)) from a corpus of text. Data records (e.g., records contained numerical data) may be linked to the extended discourse tree to generate a multi-modal discourse tree. The multi-modal discourse tree may link any suitable text/records from disparate sources. For example, entities identified from elementary discourse units of the EDT may be matched to an entity of a data record. Causal links may be identified between EDTs and/or data records. Rhetorical relationships can be identified for each entity/causal link match to incorporate the data records with the EDT to generate a MMDT. The MMDT may be used to classify subsequent input, to generate answers to subsequent questions, to navigate the corpus of text and/or data records, or the like.

title: Machine learning method
abstract: A machine learning method includes acquiring data including attendance records of employees and information indicating which employee has taken a leave of absence from work, in response to determining that a first employee of the employees has not taken a leave of absence in accordance with the data, generating a first tensor on a basis of an attendance record of the first employee and parameters associated with elements included in the attendance record, in response to determining that a second employee of the employees has taken a leave of absence in accordance with the data, modifying the parameters, and generating a second tensor on a basis of an attendance record of the second employee and the modified parameters, and generating a model by machine learning based on the first tensor and the second tensor.

title: Code conversion method, system and application for memory computing platform
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of memory computing, and discloses a code conversion method, a system and application for a memory computing platform. Establishing an algorithm library based on a hardware description language for a memory computing platform by facing neural network application; converting the neural network model into a calculation graph form, and acquiring node information from the calculation graph; inquiring whether the algorithm library contains the operation of the node; and constructing a top-level file according to the interconnection relation between the nodes, and realizing code conversion from a high-level language to a bottom-level hardware description language. The universal high-level language to bottom hardware description language conversion method facing the memory computing platform enables a user to directly adopt high-level language programming without knowing a hardware bottom framework in the development process and convert the high-level language programming into the hardware description language, reduces the development difficulty, accelerates the deployment speed of tasks and effectively improves the execution efficiency of the tasks. And finally, summarizing an experimental result through the feasibility of the experimental and simulation verification method.

title: Training method for image segmentation network, image segmentation method, and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a training method of an image segmentation network, an image segmentation method and a storage medium. The training method of the image segmentation network comprises the following steps: inputting the first resolution image into a first image segmentation network to be trained to obtain a first segmentation result; the first resolution image is obtained by performing image mapping on the second resolution image, and the resolution of the first resolution image is lower than that of the second resolution image; inputting the second resolution image and the first segmentation result into a second image segmentation network to be trained to obtain a second segmentation result; and according to the second segmentation result and the segmentation marking data corresponding to the second resolution image, adjusting network parameters of the first image segmentation network to be trained and the second image segmentation network to be trained so as to obtain a first image segmentation network with training convergence. The method can greatly improve the accuracy of the segmentation labeling result.

title: Medical named entity recognition model training method, recognition method and federal learning system
assignee: 北京智源人工智能研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a medical named entity recognition model training method, a medical named entity recognition method and a federal learning system. The medical named entity recognition model training method comprises the following steps: receiving a global model which is sent by a central server and used for identifying medical named entities; training a global model based on local medical text labeling data, and calculating to obtain corresponding gradient data; sending the gradient data to a central server so that the central server trains the global model based on each gradient data received by the federal learning system to obtain a new global model, and distributing the converged global model if the new global model is converged currently; receiving a converged global model; and carrying out localization fine tuning processing on the converged global model based on a local prompt template to form a localization medical named entity recognition model. The technical scheme of the invention realizes privacy protection of medical data and local personalization of the medical named entity recognition model.

title: Control method for a medical imaging system
abstract: In a control method for a screen display of a medical imaging system, an image data set of a patient is acquired and a comparison of the acquired image data set is made with a number of pre-stored image data sets, each of which is stored with layout parameters for the screen display associated therewith. Display of the acquired image data set take place with the layout parameters of the pre-stored image data set that has the greatest similarity with the acquired image data set.

title: Sepsis detection and monitoring
abstract: A sensor device includes a housing defining a cavity, an inlet to receive fluid pumped from an instrument device, an outlet to return the fluid to a fluid reservoir, and a fluid channel defined inside the cavity between the inlet and the outlet. A heat pump is mounted inside the cavity, and has a side surface thermally coupled to the fluid channel and an opposite side surface thermally coupled to a plate. The heat pump is configured to induce a temperature change. A sensor unit is aligned with an aperture in the plate and includes an optical component and a thermal component. The optical component configured to measure a vascular endothelial response from the induced temperature change.

title: Masking personal information in audio recordings
abstract: One example method includes transcribing a portion of the audio component to create a transcription file that includes text, searching the text of the transcription file and identifying information in the text that may include personal information, defining a textual window that includes the information, evaluating the text in the textual window to identify personal information, and masking the personal information in the audio component of the recording. The personal information may be masked with information of a non-personal nature.

title: Customized presentation of data
abstract: Provided herein are various systems and methods for monitoring how users interact with medical imaging exams to automatically determine the view order and importance of various series within medical imaging exams as a function of a particular user, exam type, clinical information, and/or other characteristic of medical data.

title: Registration method and equipment for nuclear magnetic resonance image sequence
assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a nuclear magnetic resonance image sequence registration method and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the operation of a user, and taking the nuclear magnetic resonance image sequence of the patient as an image sequence to be registered; performing image registration between the image sequence to be registered and a pre-generated reference image sequence using a convolutional neural network, wherein specific regions in a plurality of images in the reference image sequence are aligned with each other, and wherein the convolutional neural network contains discriminative features for image registration, and wherein the discriminative features are used to discriminate image translation, image scaling, image rotation and/or image miscut performed on images in the image sequence to be registered with respect to corresponding images in the reference image sequence; and outputting the registered nuclear magnetic resonance image sequence. The invention can complete image registration at one time by utilizing the discriminant characteristics for image registration in the convolutional neural network, thereby greatly shortening the image registration time.
assignee_clean: 北京安德医智科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京安德医智科技有限公司

title: Providing personalized chat communications within portable document format documents
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and methods for initiating electronic chats based on conversation workflows identified in response to detected user actions in connection with an embedded document container displaying a PDF file. In particular, in one or more embodiments, the disclosed systems detect user interactions with a PDF file displayed by a document container embedded in a webpage. The disclosed systems can determine whether the detected user interactions include or indicate a conversation workflow trigger associated with a conversation workflow. The disclosed systems can further generate electronic messages based on the conversation workflow and provide the generated electronic messages to the user in connection with the webpage where the document container is embedded.

title: Fundus image segmentation method and device
assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a fundus image segmentation method and device, wherein the method relates to a model training method, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining training data, wherein the training data comprises fundus images and a plurality of labeling data for the same interested target; dividing the fundus image by using a trained first division model to obtain a first division result of the object of interest; and training a second segmentation model by using the training data and the first segmentation result to output a second segmentation result of the object of interest.
assignee_clean: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司

title: Acquiring ultrasound image
abstract: A method and a system for acquiring a 3D ultrasound image. The method includes receiving a request to capture a plurality of ultrasound image for a medical test corresponding to a medical condition. The method further includes determining a body part corresponding to the medical test. Further, the method includes identifying an imaging site particular to the medical test. Furthermore, the method includes providing a navigational guidance to the user in real time for positioning a handheld ultrasound device. Subsequently, the user is assisted to capture the plurality of ultrasound image of the imaging site in real time using deep learning. Further, the plurality of ultrasound images of the imaging site is captured. Finally, the method includes converting the plurality of ultrasound image to a 3-Dimensional (3D) ultrasound image in real time.

title: Synonym distinguishing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for distinguishing synonyms of terms, and relates to the technical field of knowledge maps. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring characteristic information of entry pairs to be subjected to synonymous judgment; inputting the characteristic information of the entry pairs into a trained neural network model to obtain synonymous discrimination results of the entry pairs; according to the embodiment, the structure, the parameters and the characteristics of the pre-training layer are directly subjected to knowledge migration, the pre-training layer is adopted to learn the characteristic information of the entry pairs, the labeling amount in the training process is reduced, a large amount of resources and manpower are saved, the synonymous judging efficiency is further improved, and the accuracy of synonymous judging results is improved.

primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Techniques for data classification based on sensitive data
abstract: Techniques for data classification may be realized as a method including: selecting from a group of files a sample set representing fewer than all of the files; classifying each file in the sample set, wherein classifying each file includes identifying whether each file represents sensitive information; and providing an estimate for the group of files based on the classification of each file in the sample set, including an estimate of sensitive information within the group of files.

title: System and method for providing health-care diagnosis and access contol solutions through non-contact type biological recognition
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for providing a non-contact biometric health care diagnosis and an access management solution and a method therefor, that enable to easily verify an identity of a user accessing and enable an access record to be easily managed by recognizing the face of the user through an image photographed by a camera and matching the body temperature information and drinking information to verify the health condition of the user, verify the health condition of the user according to a high fever and an abnormal body temperature, and restrict access according to whether or not drinking, thereby preventing a spread of infectious diseases and an occurrence of an accident.

title: Automatically constructing lexicons from unlabeled datasets
abstract: A system, method, and computer-readable medium are disclosed for performing a lexicon construction operation. The lexicon construction operation includes: identifying a corpus, the corpus comprising a plurality of training events, each of the plurality of training events comprising a term; grouping terms from the plurality of training events into topic clusters; analyzing the plurality of topic clusters, the analyzing providing a plurality of classified clusters; and, deriving a plurality of learned lexicons from the plurality of classified clusters.

title: Image recognition method and system based on searching of multiple group alternative evolutionary neural structures
abstract: The invention discloses an image recognition method and system based on searching of multiple group alternative evolutionary nerve structures, comprising the following steps: acquiring image data, and determining a search network according to a target task; constructing a super-network, and pre-training the super-network according to preset parameters; dividing a network structure search space into L subspaces through an L-layer structure of the neural network, and randomly selecting N candidate subnetworks from the subspaces to form initialized L populations; sampling a plurality of populations from a plurality of search subspaces for alternate evolution, selecting leading-edge individuals from the combined populations by using multi-objective environment selection so as to generate a next parent population, and performing the alternate evolution of the multiple populations; and obtaining an optimal neural network model to identify the image. The method realizes module diversification with smaller search cost, obviously reduces complexity of search space, promotes automatic processing of future image analysis, improves search efficiency and obtains optimal solution.

title: Monitoring bone properties
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods and devices for monitoring bone characteristics of various conditions, such as osteoporosis and/or periodontitis. In various embodiments, a dental hygiene implement (100) may comprise: a handle (102) adapted to be held by a user; a tool (106) secured to the handle to perform a task related to dental hygiene; a transmitter (114A, 116, 360A) mounted on the dental hygiene implement to transmit wave(s) (252, 362) towards a mandible (250, 350) of a user; a sensor (114B, 116, 360B) mounted on the dental hygiene implement to detect wave(s) (254, 364) propagating away from the mandible, wherein the detected wave(s) originate from or are caused by the transmitted wave(s); and a controller (108) communicatively coupled with the emitter(s) and the sensor(s). The controller may: receiving signal(s) from sensor(s) indicative of the detected waves; and determining bone characteristic(s) of the user based on the signal(s).

title: Intelligent classification of regions of interest of an organism from multispectral video streams using perfusion models
abstract: Embodiments for implementing intelligent classification of region of interest in an organism in a computing environment by a processor. Time series data of a contrast agent in one or more regions of interest captured from multispectral image streams may be collected. The one or more regions of interest may be classified into one of a plurality of classes by applying one or more perfusion models, representing spatio-temporal behavior of the contrast agent reflected by the time series data, and by using a machine learning operation.

title: Robust rapid image segmentation method based on priori constraint level set frame
abstract: The invention provides a robust rapid image segmentation method based on a priori constraint level set frame, which comprises the following steps: s1: defining an energy functional; s2: minimizing the energy functional; s3: dividing the medical image by a parallel algorithm; s4: and (5) comparing the segmentation result to obtain a final contour line. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the medical image can be accurately and rapidly segmented, and the segmentation efficiency and the segmentation accuracy are obviously improved.

primary_assignee: 哈尔滨工业大学 深圳

title: Flexible pressure plate
assignee: 深圳市松果体机器人科技有限公司
abstract: A flexible pressure plate comprising: a double-layer flexible layer structure consisting of a bionic epidermal layer and a bionic dermis layer, a camera and a light source; wherein: the camera is used for capturing the deformation of the double-layer flexible layer structure; the flexible pressure plate is used for capturing light irradiated to the double-layer flexible layer structure by the light source, so that the deformation of the double-layer flexible layer structure is sensed. Therefore, the flexible pressure plate with an innovative structure and better performance is realized, and the flexible pressure plate can be used in the industries of sports, auxiliary medical treatment or shoemaking and the like, can measure the pressure distribution state when a person stands or moves, and can realize digital measurement of high resolution, six-dimensional force and high dynamic performance.

title: Systems and methods for providing crisis and emergency management and monitoring
abstract: A security platform for real-time alerting, monitoring and managing onging security incidents in a locality such as an educational, religious, industrial or commercial center. Video and audio data gathering are combined to graphically present a security incident, enabling community or management to respond faster and more effectively and to provide a valuable tool for first responders. The platform integrates three components: smart sensors, mobile application and an intuitive presentation dashborad. The system further may provide instant mobile alerts and a navigation aid away from danger.

title: Physiological signal monitoring and apparatus therefor
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure are directed to apparatuses and methods for monitoring vital signs from a human being. Various such aspects involve an apparatus or method involving the monitoring of vital signs in a manner that facilitates enhanced characterization of physiological conditions. In many embodiments, two or more such vital signs are monitored. A signal acquisition, digitization, and computing module removing noise, extracts information useful for diagnosing a health or fitness characteristic of the human being, and/or compresses information to reduce data volume. A wireless communications circuit transmits the vital signs to a receiver.

title: Channel coding and decoding method and communication device
abstract: The application provides a channel coding method and a communication device. The method comprises the following steps: the second communication device determines first code structure information for constructing a coding bit sequence according to an information bit sequence during channel coding according to the first parameter, and after the first code structure information is sent to the first communication device, communication data between the first communication device and the second communication device is subjected to channel coding and decoding by adopting the first code structure information. So as to improve the performance of channel coding and further improve the reliability of communication.

title: Text information processing and model training method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a text information processing and model training method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as knowledge graph and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: determining information to be extracted; determining information to be coded according to the information to be extracted and the original text; coding the information to be coded to obtain a coding result; and determining a corresponding fragment of the information to be extracted in the original text according to the coding result. The embodiment can accurately extract the text information and provide convenience for works such as text labeling.

title: Evaluation of query for data item having multiple representations in graph on a sub-query by sub-query basis until data item has been retrieved
abstract: Sub-queries for a query are ordered. The query is for retrieving a data item of a data graph. The data graph stores representations of the data item. Each representation stores information represented by the data item in a different manner or way. Each sub-query corresponds to a different representation in which the data graph stores the data item. The sub-queries are ordered in an ordered list according to likelihood that evaluation thereof will yield an appropriate or selected representation of the data item that is correct for the query and that correctly answers the query. The sub-queries within the ordered list are evaluated on a sub-query by sub-query basis, until the data item has been retrieved.

title: Glucose alert prediction horizon modification
abstract: Data describing glucose measurements is received from a continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system worn by a user and predicted glucose values during a future time period are generated for the user based on the data. A determination is made that at least one of the predicted glucose values satisfies a threshold value for an alert, which is associated with a prediction horizon that defines an amount of time prior to satisfaction of the threshold value for communicating the alert to the user. Output of the alert is caused responsive to determining that the at least one predicted glucose value satisfies the threshold value for the alert within the prediction horizon, relative to a current time. The prediction horizon is modified based on a user response to the alert. Output of a subsequent instance of the alert is caused based on the modified prediction horizon.

title: Model training method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 东软集团股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a model training method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image dataset; carrying out weighted summation processing on the images in the first image data set to obtain an incremental image; based on the delta image and the first image dataset, a first model is trained. The embodiment of the invention can ensure large-scale and effective incremental images under the condition of clear and unchanged image characteristics.

title: Medical image registration method, device, terminal and computer-readable storage medium
assignee: 武汉楚精灵医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a medical image registration method, a device, a terminal and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time perspective image and a first contour figure of a patient; determining a first magnetic resonance pancreaticobiliary duct imaging image meeting preset requirements and a second contour graph corresponding to a first preset marker in the first magnetic resonance pancreaticobiliary duct imaging image from the magnetic resonance pancreaticobiliary duct imaging image set based on the first preset marker and the second preset marker of the patient; determining a rotation angle parameter based on the first graph characteristic parameter and the second graph characteristic parameter; determining a scaling parameter based on the third graphic characteristic parameter and the fourth graphic characteristic parameter; adjusting the first magnetic resonance pancreaticobiliary tract imaging image based on the rotation angle parameter and the scaling parameter; and carrying out image registration on the adjusted magnetic resonance pancreaticobiliary tract imaging image and the real-time perspective image. According to the embodiment of the application, the accuracy of medical image registration is improved, and the success rate of the operation is improved.

title: Medical image acquisition method and medical image display method
assignee: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司, 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention mainly discloses a medical image acquisition method, which comprises the steps of dividing a three-dimensional medical image to obtain a first interested image and a second interested image; projecting the first image of interest along a first direction to obtain a first image, and projecting the second image of interest along the first direction to obtain a second image; and superposing the first image and the second image to obtain a first medical image, wherein the first direction is one direction of directions perpendicular to a coronal plane, a sagittal plane or a transverse plane. By adopting the scheme provided by the invention, the more comprehensive information of the part to be detected can be given in a more visual mode, so that the doctor can read the film conveniently and the diagnosis efficiency of the doctor is improved to a great extent.

title: Method for faciliating to read pathology image and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for assisting to read a pathology image and an apparatus using the same. According to the present invention, the method for assisting to read a pathology image comprises the following steps. A computing device obtains a pathology image which is a target for reading. An image which is similar to a part or all parts of the pathology image is searched in order to classify inputted images into a plurality of pathological classes based on a previously trained deep neural network. The search reflects predetermined biases for a biased search with respect to at least one specific class. The similar image is provided to an external entity.

title: Method and apparatus to facilitate administering therapeutic radiation to a patient
abstract: A control circuit accesses patient image content as well as field geometry information regarding a particular radiation treatment platform. The control circuit then generates a predicted three-dimensional dose map for the radiation treatment plan as a function of both the patient image content and the field geometry information.

title: Psoriasis nail image processing method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 苏州体素信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a psoriasis nail image processing method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: the nail cover ROI area is cut out from the nail image through the detection network, the nail cover area and the nail injury area are cut out from the nail cover ROI area through the rough segmentation model, the nail cover ROI area and the nail injury area are combined through the fine segmentation model, and the fine segmentation nail injury area of each symptom is finely segmented. Calculating the proportion of the total area of the nail injury area to the nail cover area, or combining the subdivided nail injury areas with a plurality of symptoms, increasing the weight of the superposition part of the subdivided nail injury areas with a plurality of symptoms, and calculating the proportion of the total area of the combined nail injury area to the nail cover area, or calculating the proportion of the total area of the subdivided nail injury area to the nail cover area. The application can detect and extract the nail region from the hand photo of the patient by the detection network, and performs image segmentation so as to identify the nail cover region and the image region of the nail injury.

title: Inspection information display device, method, and program
abstract: In inspection information display device, method, and program includes a display controller displays data related to a patient, for example, an analysis result obtained by analyzing a medical image and inspection information related to the data on a display, a decision unit decides at least one of a necessary inspection or a necessary treatment for confirming the analysis result, a resource information acquisition unit acquires resource availability information for executing at least one of the necessary inspection or the necessary treatment for confirming the analysis result, and a display controller 31 further displays the resource availability information on the display.

title: Method for processing vascular structure images
abstract: A method (100) of processing clinical 3D imaging of blood vessels in order to enable an analysis of the shape of blood vessels of a person, a statistical analysis of the shape and properties of blood vessels in a group of individuals, and the detection and quantification of blood vessel diseases.

title: Image processing method, image processing apparatus, computer device, storage medium, and program product
assignee: 杭州太美星程医药科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides an image processing method, an image processing device, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the steps of receiving an image sequence comprising a target body part, determining a reference image corresponding to the image sequence based on prior knowledge, and further cutting the image sequence according to position information and size information corresponding to a region range mark in the reference image to obtain a focus image sequence, so that not only is a focus image accurately cut from the image sequence by taking the reference image as a reference, but also noise influence in a background image is reduced, and the focus is completely cut from the image sequence.

abstract: The invention provides an unsupervised field self-adaptive image segmentation method. Converting the target domain image to ensure that semantic information is reserved, and reconstructing image shallow information by taking the source domain image as a characteristic; and then, carrying out image discrimination on the converted and reconstructed target domain image by utilizing a segmentation model established by the source domain image, thereby realizing migration among data sets in different fields of the model on the premise of no new data annotation.

title: Device for determining biological samples
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods of identifying physicochemical properties associated with protein corona formation at the protein and NP functionalization levels, as well as compositions comprising combinations of particles configured for low abundance protein collection and deep proteomic analysis. Further disclosed herein is a device for assaying a biological sample.

title: Actuated retractor with tension feedback
assignee: Smith & Nephew, Inc., Smith & Nephew Orthopaedics Ag, Smith & Nephew Asia Pacific Pte. Limited
abstract: Methods and apparatus for performing joint laxity measurement are disclosed. A retractor includes a plurality of spacers, such as plates, that are capable of being moved from a central portion of the retractor by a carriage mechanism. In some cases, the carriage mechanism may press against ramps connected to internal sides of the plates, thereby causing the plates to be displaced outwardly. In other cases, the carriage mechanism may include blades that rotate and press against the internal sides of the plates, thereby causing the plates to be displaced outwardly. The retractor is mounted on a surgical device configured to actuate the carriage mechanism. When the retractor is placed in a joint and the carriage mechanism is actuated, a measurement of the joint laxity may be determined based upon characteristics of the retractor and/or the surgical device.

assignee: University Of Pittsburgh-Of The Commonwealth System Of Higher Education

title: Reference image guided object detection in medical image processing
abstract: In some examples, a method includes receiving a test image from a user or client, the test image depicting an anatomical region or structure of a human body, obtaining a reference image corresponding to the anatomical region or structure depicted in the test image, and analyzing the test image and the reference image to obtain a set of differences between the two images. In some examples, the method further includes, based at least in part on the set of differences, detecting a possible abnormality in the test image and outputting a result to the user or client. In some examples, a fast R-CNN is used to detecting the possible abnormality in the test image.

title: Cervical learning data generation system
abstract: The present invention relates to a cervical learning system. Particularly, provided are a system for generating cervical learning data for cervical deep learning and a method for classifying cervical learning data in the system. The method comprises: an unclassified image reception step of receiving unclassified photographing image data of the cervix from an external device; an image data classification step of classifying the unclassified photographing image data of the cervix based on a neural network algorithm, and classifying the image in accordance with a plurality of multi-level classification criteria; and a learning data generation and progressing learning step of generating and storing learning image data of the cervix classified by the classification criteria as learning data for each classification criterion, or progressing learning.

title: Pattern recognition system for quantifying the likelihood of the contribution of multiple possible forms of chronic disease to patient reported dyspnea
abstract: Systems and methods for quantifying the likelihood of the contribution of multiple possible forms of chronic disease to patient reported dyspnea can include the testing protocol having a flow/volume loop, performed at rest, flowed by the measurement of cardiopulmonary exercise gas exchange variables during rest, exercise and recovery as unique data sets. The data sets are analyzed using feature extraction steps to produce a pictorial image consisting of disease silos displaying the likelihood of the contribution of various chronic diseases to patient reported dyspnea. In some embodiments, the silos are split into subclass silos. In some embodiments, multiple chronic disease indexes are used to differentiate between sub-types of a particular chronic disease (e.g., differentiating WHO 1 PH from WHO 2 or WHO 3 PH). Test results are plotted serially to asses to provide feedback to the physician on the efficacy of therapy provided to the patient.

title: Methods and systems for controlling cooperative surgical instruments
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods for controlling cooperative surgical instruments are provided. Various aspects of the present disclosure provide for coordinated operation of surgical instruments accessing a common body cavity of a patient from different approaches to achieve a common surgical purpose. For example, various methods, devices, and systems disclosed herein can enable the coordinated treatment of surgical tissue by disparate minimally invasive surgical systems that approach the tissue from varying anatomical spaces and operate in concert with one another to effect a desired surgical treatment.

abstract: The invention relates to the field of gene detection and bioinformatics, and discloses application of a method for constructing a complex disease state assessment model based on high-throughput sequencing data and clinical phenotypes in pancreatic duct cancer state assessment models. The marker with both accuracy and mechanism interpretation is constructed by the method, and can be used for prognosis evaluation of pancreatic duct cancer, treatment effect prediction, auxiliary decision making of treatment scheme and the like.

abstract: The invention discloses an AI-based tumor stem cell characteristic extraction and classification system, which comprises: the data acquisition unit is used for automatically identifying and synchronously acquiring the related data of the tumor stem cells from the medical database; the feature extraction unit is used for automatically adjusting the network structure and parameters of the feature extraction model according to the characteristics of the tumor stem cell data, and extracting corresponding features from the related data through the feature extraction model; and the classification unit is used for classifying the characteristics based on the self-adaptive classification model of deep learning and predicting the types of the tumor stem cells through classification. The method can more accurately conduct classification prediction on the tumor stem cells, and improves the accuracy of classification prediction.

title: Method, device and medium for segmenting partial quality abnormal region of mammary gland X-ray image
assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a segmentation method, a segmentation device and a segmentation medium for a local quality abnormal region of a mammary gland X-ray image, wherein the segmentation method comprises the following steps: carrying out standardization processing on the image to be segmented to obtain a standardized image; extracting the characteristics of the standardized image through an extrusion excitation residual network to obtain first characteristic information; carrying out feature extraction on the first feature information through space pyramid pooling to obtain second feature information; fusing the first characteristic information and the second characteristic information to obtain a first segmentation result; and optimizing the first segmentation result by using an edge refinement network to obtain a target segmentation result corresponding to the image to be segmented, and better combining global features and local features in the image by applying the method provided by the embodiment of the application, thereby improving the accuracy of the model on local abnormal segmentation of the quality of various breast X-ray images.

title: Electroencephalogram signal classification method based on addition network and supervised contrast learning
abstract: The invention discloses an electroencephalogram signal classification method based on addition network and supervised contrast learning, which comprises the following steps: 1, carrying out data selection and pretreatment of slicing on original electroencephalogram data; 2, establishing an addition network classification model; 3, designing a mixing loss function, and establishing a classification model optimization target; and 4, training the network by inputting data, and completing electroencephalogram signal classification by using the trained optimal model. According to the invention, the multiplication operation is replaced by addition, so that the calculation complexity and energy consumption are greatly reduced, the loss function of mixing the supervision contrast loss and the cross entropy loss is used, the signal classification can be automatically completed without manually extracting the characteristics or processing the signals of the original electroencephalogram, and the accuracy of the electroencephalogram classification can be remarkably improved, thereby increasing the application value of the electroencephalogram in the fields of medical treatment and the like.

title: Health care system for cow using detecting rumination
abstract: Provided is a cow health care system using measurement of rumination comprising: an action detecting sensor attached to a cow to detect the movements and actions of the cow; a DB server receiving and storing data detected by the action detecting sensor and building a database with previously stored cow-related raising information; and an analysis server analyzing data stored in the DB server to recognize an action pattern of the cow and manage health of the cow. The analysis server includes: an action analysis module configured to analyze movement data stored in the DB server, figure out a characteristic pattern of action types of the cow involving eating and rumination, and determine an action type of the cow; and a disease detecting module configured to analyze a volume of activity for each action through information on the action type of the cow so as to detect a disease of the cow. According to the present invention, it is possible to determine whether a cow is infected more accurately and easily so the health of cows can be improved and damage caused by undetected diseases may be reduced.

title: Intelligent medical record big data center management method and device
assignee: 贵州精准健康数据有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a system for managing a big data center of an intelligent medical record, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an intranet server obtains medical record data through an AI interface, the medical record data are stored through a large data warehouse, and the medical record data are sent to a fort cloud server, wherein the medical record data comprise structured data and unstructured data; the bastion cloud server receives and stores the medical record data sent by the intranet server, sends the push data generated according to the medical record data and the push instruction to a user terminal under the condition that the push instruction is detected, and prohibits sending data to the intranet server through a prohibition protocol.

title: Tubular structure identification method, tubular structure identification device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to a tubular structure identification method, apparatus, computer device and computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises: extracting the central line of each tubular structure in the scanned image; acquiring central line characteristic parameters according to the central line, wherein the central line characteristic parameters comprise coordinate values of each point on the central line and integral information of a central line tree; the central line tree consists of central lines corresponding to the tubular structures; preprocessing the characteristic parameters of the central line; inputting the preprocessed central line characteristic parameters into a well-trained deep learning model; obtaining the name of a tubular structure output by the deep learning model; and selecting a corresponding tubular structure in the scanned image according to the name of the tubular structure. Through the method and the device, the problems of complex tubular structure identification steps and inaccurate identification are solved, and the efficiency and accuracy of tubular structure identification are improved.

title: Bio-information measuring apparatus and bio-information measuring method
abstract: A bio-information measuring apparatus bio-information measuring method are provided. The bio-information measuring apparatus includes: a pulse wave obtainer configured to obtain a pulse wave signal, and a processor configured to correct a feature of the obtained pulse wave signal based on a variation in an amplitude of the obtained pulse wave signal, and to measure bio-information based on the corrected feature.

title: ICD 9-CM-3-based surgical knowledge graph construction method and device
assignee: 云知声智能科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a surgical knowledge graph construction method and device based on ICD9-CM-3, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, fusing ICD-9-CM-3 official and all nationwide expanded surgical concepts to obtain fusion information, and establishing guidance codes of the relation between the surgical concepts; step 2, constructing relations among surgical concepts based on the guidance codes, and if the codes corresponding to the surgical concepts have implication relations, constructing implication relations among the surgical concepts according to the implication relations of the codes; step 3, defining concept attributes of the operation; step 4: using a Bert+BiLSTM+CRF model to carry out named entity identification on the surgical concepts, and identifying defined concept attributes; step 5: extracting the identified concept attributes, and establishing attribute relations between the concept attributes and the corresponding surgical concepts; step 6: and filling the attribute relationship and the implication relationship into a graph database to form a surgical knowledge graph.
