primary_assignee: 云知声智能科技股份有限公司

title: Multi-stage attention answer selection method integrating semantic and question key information
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-stage attention answer selection method integrating semantic and question key information, which comprises two stages, wherein the first stage is as follows: acquiring semantic representations of the two-way output of the candidate answers LSTM, carrying out attention weighted update on the semantic representations of the candidate answers by utilizing the key information of the questions, carrying out correlation calculation on the weighted updated semantic representations of the candidate answers and the semantic representations of the questions, and screening out the candidate answers with highest correlation; the second stage is as follows: and obtaining the semantic representation of the selected candidate answer LSTM bidirectional output, carrying out attention weighted update on the semantic representation of the candidate answer by utilizing the semantic information of the question, carrying out relevance calculation on the weighted updated semantic representation of the candidate answer and the semantic representation of the question again, and selecting the best answer from the candidate answers. The invention can strengthen the capturing capability of the model on the key information of the candidate answers, thereby improving the accuracy of answer selection.

title: Method and system for determining an association of biological features with a medical condition
assignee: Macau University Of Science And Technology
abstract: A system and a method for determining an association of one or more biological features with a medical condition provides empirical results and simulations confirming that the involvement of both L1/2-regularized logistic regression and L2-regularized logistic regression in the regression model is highly competitive against usual approaches like Lasso, L1/2, SCAD-L2, and Elastic net in analyzing high dimensional and low sample sizes data.
assignee_clean: macau university of science and technology
primary_assignee: macau university of science and technology

title: Method for processing endoscopy image using deep learning
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for processing an endoscopic image using deep learning, which includes the steps of: removing noise from a noise model by applying denoising a convolutional neural network (DnCNN), which is a residual learner with respect to the endoscopic image; and co-classifying a lesion image using a convolutional neural network (CNN) on the denoised image obtained through the step of removing the noise. By using deep learning-type noise removal modeling and classification modeling, endoscopic images can be effectively processed and accurately classified.

title: Intelligent processing system and method for nasal bone fracture image
abstract: The utility model discloses a nasal bone fracture image intelligent processing system and method, which relates to the field of image processing, and is characterized in that nasal bone region images are acquired through an X-ray machine, and after the nasal bone region images are subjected to image preprocessing to improve the quality and definition of images, the preprocessed nasal bone region images are automatically analyzed by introducing an image processing and analyzing algorithm based on artificial intelligence at the rear end, so that whether the nasal bone is fractured or not is judged. Therefore, the efficiency and the intellectualization of fracture diagnosis can be improved, auxiliary diagnosis and decision support are provided for doctors, the workload of the doctors is reduced, and better medical services are provided for patients.

title: System and method for endoscopic imaging and analyses
abstract: An ear nose and throat (ENT) imaging and analysis system includes an endoscope usable to capture images of the nasal canal and other aspects of patient anatomy. Endoscopic images may be presented to a user via a touchscreen display, and the software may provide different imaging modes that aid in identifying particular anatomical structures or areas within the nasal canal. In one mode, the system uses an object recognition process to identify the nasal valve opening within the images at a relaxed state, and during forceful inhalation, and then calculates the difference between the two states, which may be suggestive of nasal valve collapse. In other modes, the system is configured to identify abnormalities of the inferior turbinate, septum, or other anatomy, as well as empty spaces within the nasal canal, as well as areas and volumes of empty space and user defined boundaries.

title: Electrocardiogram data processing server, method for displaying analysis data of electrocardiogram signal, and computer program
abstract: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, a method for displaying analysis data on an electrocardiogram signal, comprises the steps of: receiving, by an electrocardiogram data processing server, a load input for a first electrocardiogram signal from a user terminal; generating, by the electrocardiogram data processing server, analysis data obtained by analyzing the first electrocardiogram signal and a first expected analysis time for the first electrocardiogram signal, in response to the load input for the first electrocardiogram signal; and transmitting, by the electrocardiogram data processing server, the analysis data to the user terminal to display a first window for displaying the first electrocardiogram signal and a second window for displaying the first expected analysis time in the user terminal. Therefore, output data in which electrocardiogram signals are classified and displayed as first information can be generated.

title: Wearable underwater and in-air blast sensor
abstract: A wearable universal blast sensor includes an underwater pressure sensing transducer and at least one blast parameter sensing transducer to measure a blast parameter from the blast other than pressure, an analog-to-digital converter having an analog input and a digital output, the analog input coupled to the pressure sensing transducer and a digital output, a rolling memory buffer coupled to the digital output of the analog-to-digital converter, at least one controller coupled to the rolling memory buffer and configured to store a time sequence of digital pressure signals from the digital output of the analog-to-digital converter, write into a blast event memory data from the rolling memory buffer including data corresponding to the blast event if one of the digital pressure signals exceeds a set first threshold, generate a first blast magnitude indicator signal if any of the digital pressure signals exceeds a second set threshold.

title: Fast cell setup for dual connectivity
abstract: Provided are a method for fast cell setup. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, the method includes receiving a cell group configuration including a list of cells, performing measurement on the cells, identifying at least one invalid cell among the cells included in the cell group configuration based on a result of the measurement, reporting information on the identified invalid cell.

title: Auxiliary fluid delivery systems and methods
assignee: 爱德华兹生命科学公司
abstract: Techniques are disclosed herein that automatically identify the beginning and end of a bolus of fluid and calculate the volume of fluid administered during an impact. The flow measurement device is used to measure the flow of fluid in a catheter (e.g., IV tubing), while the algorithm is used to determine the start time and stop time of a bolus of fluid and calculate the volume of fluid administered during the bolus. Also disclosed herein are techniques for controlling fluid in Intravenous (IV) infusions, providing a high flow state to deliver a fluid bolus to a subject and providing a low flow state to provide an uninterrupted flow of fluid to the subject.
assignee_clean: 爱德华兹生命科学公司
primary_assignee: 爱德华兹生命科学公司

title: Method and device for generating coronary artery path map and readable storage medium
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京安贞医院
abstract: The invention provides a method, a device and a readable storage medium for generating a coronary artery path map, wherein the method for generating the coronary artery path map comprises the steps of acquiring a dynamic perspective image of a coronary artery; acquiring a sequence of angiographic images of a coronary artery over a preset time period during which the heart performs a periodic motion; matching an angiographic image corresponding to the phase of the fluoroscopy images in the sequence of angiographic images; the fluoroscopic image is fused with the phase-coincident angiographic image to generate a dynamic coronary roadmap, which provides real-time image guidance, improves accuracy and surgical efficiency, and reduces fluoroscopy time and contrast agent usage.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京安贞医院
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京安贞医院

title: Ophthalmic robot end effector guidance and positioning system
abstract: The invention discloses a computer program product and a system for guiding and positioning an ophthalmic robot end effector, wherein the computer program product is configured to output information of an accurate incision point and a surgical implementation point of an eye surgery in real time so as to guide and dynamically adjust the posture and the position of the ophthalmic robot end effector. The invention can provide accurate coordinates for space guidance and positioning adjustment of the ophthalmic robot end effector, does not need manual operation and identification in the operation, and is a functional basis for realizing the ophthalmic automatic operation; meanwhile, by real-time image segmentation and target tracking during operation execution, the given dynamic coordinate can support the automatic posture and position adjustment of the ophthalmic surgical robot; when the head and the eyes move in an overrun mode in the operation, the robot can be stopped reliably and safely, and safety is improved faster and better than that of manual operation.

title: Devices and systems for promoting continuous sleep of a subject and methods of using same
abstract: A method for promoting continuous sleep of a subject by eliminating and/or preventing sleep associations includes: (a) providing an apparatus including at least one sensor and at least one output device; (b) monitoring a state of the subject using the apparatus; (c) determining the subject is in an awake state using the at least one sensor; (d) in response to determining the subject is in the awake state, initiating and maintaining an output using the at least one output device; (e) determining the subject is in a sleep state using the at least one sensor; (f) halting the output in response to determining that the subject is in the sleep state such that the apparatus does not produce any output; (g) repeating at least step (b) during a sleep session. The method further includes modifying an intensity of the output over time until the intensity reaches zero.

title: Video action recognition method and device and machine equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司, 北京大学
abstract: The invention discloses a video motion recognition method, a video motion recognition device and machine equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring video data for motion recognition; in the process of extracting the characteristics of each network layer of video data in a neural network, enabling the spatial domain characteristics extracted from a video image to enter a bilinear layer through the network structure of the neural network; carrying out bilinear correlation operation on a bilinear layer between adjacent frame video images according to the spatial domain characteristics to obtain the time-spatial domain characteristics of each frame video image in the video data; and classifying the motion in the video through the time-space domain characteristics to obtain a motion recognition result of the video data. For feature extraction of each network layer in a neural network, parameters and calculation complexity in bilinear correlation operation on a bilinear layer are controlled, and then time-space domain features are extracted under the condition of controlling the complexity, so that explicit modeling on a time domain relation is realized, and the performance of action recognition is effectively improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司; 北京大学
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Traditional Chinese medicine individuation intelligent prescription medicine recommendation system based on similar patient matching
assignee: 中国中医科学院中医临床基础医学研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine individuation intelligent prescription medicine recommendation system based on similar patient matching. The traditional Chinese medicine individuation intelligent prescription recommendation system based on similar patient matching comprises a patient information importing module for acquiring patient matching information corresponding to a patient to be matched; the similar patient matching module performs similar patient matching in the case database according to the patient matching information of the patients to be matched to obtain a similar patient group; the prescription drug recommendation visualization module analyzes the similar patient group, constructs a similar patient drug knowledge graph, and performs visual display on the similar patient drug knowledge graph; the case database stores relevant data of historical patients, etc. According to the invention, similar patient medical cases are matched according to the diagnosis results and the individuation information of the patients, and the traditional Chinese medicine prescription association is analyzed to construct a similar patient medicine knowledge graph, so that the matching degree of the prescription medicine recommendation results and the patients is improved, and the problem of lower matching degree of the traditional Chinese medicine prescription medicine recommendation results and the patients is solved.
assignee_clean: 中国中医科学院中医临床基础医学研究所
primary_assignee: 中国中医科学院中医临床基础医学研究所

title: Ultrasonic image analysis method and related device
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an ultrasonic image analysis method and a related device, which are applied to the field of artificial intelligence. The method provided by the application can segment the focus area of the ultrasonic image to obtain focus positioning results, acquire personal information and medical history of a target object corresponding to the ultrasonic image as first clinical information, record and detect the current drug use of the target object as second clinical information, and input the focus positioning results, the first clinical information and the second clinical information into the multi-layer perceptron to analyze the disease diagnosis results. By the method, the focus positioning result is analyzed by combining the previous clinical information and the current clinical information of the target object, the influence of individual difference is avoided, and the accuracy of the diagnosis result is improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Facial shaping and repairing auxiliary system and method based on artificial intelligent reconstruction technology
abstract: The application discloses a facial shaping and repairing auxiliary system and a facial shaping and repairing auxiliary method based on an artificial intelligence reconstruction technology, which relate to the technical field of intelligent facial shaping and repairing, wherein facial images of a patient are captured from multiple angles through a camera, and the images are processed by a three-dimensional reconstruction module to generate a three-dimensional model of the face of the patient; on the basis, performing virtual plastic repair operation on the three-dimensional model of the face of the patient to obtain the three-dimensional model of the face of the patient after repair. Specifically, the facial image of the patient is processed through the three-dimensional reconstruction module, which comprises the steps of extracting facial features to generate a feature map, and carrying out spatial perception enhancement and context correlation feature analysis to obtain a plurality of patient facial feature maps with the visualized context spatial dimensions, and finally, generating a three-dimensional model of the face of the patient by utilizing the feature maps. In this way, the doctor can modify and adjust the three-dimensional model of the patient's face to predict and evaluate the effect of different repair schemes on the appearance and function of the face, providing references and guidance for the actual procedure.

title: Feature-space clustering for physiological cycle classification
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for performing operations comprising: receiving a plurality of training images representing different phases of a periodic motion of a target region in a patient; applying a model to the plurality of training images to generate a lower-dimensional feature space representation of the plurality of training images; clustering the lower-dimensional feature space representation of the plurality of training images into a plurality of groups corresponding to the different phases of the periodic motion; and classifying a motion phase associated with a new image of the target region in the patient based on the plurality of groups of the clustered lower-dimensional feature space representation of the plurality of training images.

title: Automatic real-time identification and presentation of analogies to clarify a concept
abstract: A method is disclosed including presenting a concept to a user via one or more presentation devices and monitoring the user's response to the presentation of the concept by a sensing device. The sensing device may generate sensor data based on the monitored user's response. The method further includes determining based on the sensor data generated by the sensor that the user requires clarification of the presented concept. In response to determining that the user requires clarification of the presented concept, the method further includes identifying an analogy that is configured to clarify the presented concept and presenting the identified analogy to the user via one or more of the presentation devices.

title: Video interaction method based on deep learning
assignee: 珠海九松科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image enhancement and video interaction, and particularly discloses a video interaction method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of groups of historical shooting images, calculating the head rotation angle and the inclination angle of the collected images, predicting the action gesture of a human face, carrying out adaptive image enhancement processing on the collected images based on illumination change data, and adaptively adjusting the shooting angle of a camera based on the predicted action gesture of the human face; when the head turns to close-range shooting, intelligent video interaction of head turning and shooting angle adaptive adjustment is automatically achieved, shooting light and a scene are subjected to image enhancement by combining a deep learning technology, detail enhancement is performed through a plurality of acquired shooting object head images with different angles, shooting quality is improved, and high-precision adaptive adjustment of shooting angles is achieved.
assignee_clean: 珠海九松科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 珠海九松科技有限公司

title: System and method for actionizing comments using voice data
abstract: A system and method for processing and actionizing structured and unstructured experience data is disclosed herein. In some embodiments, a system may include a natural language processing (NLP) engine configured to transform a data set into a plurality of concepts within a plurality of distinct contexts, and a data mining engine configured to process the relationships of the concepts and to identify associations and correlations in the data set. In some embodiments, the method may include the steps of receiving a data set, scanning the data set with an NLP engine to identify a plurality of concepts within a plurality of distinct contexts, and identifying patterns in the relationships between the plurality of concepts. In some embodiments, the data set may include voice data from a voice based assistant or a voice based survey.

title: Directed connections on a communication platform
abstract: A dynamic communication link provided. Briefly, a process aggregates content from content providers in the form of triggers (e.g., QR codes, newsfeeds, etc.). Here, the content is related to information of interest to users. In the example of newsfeeds, the process curates a newsfeed for a user by assembling articles, each article selected for the user based upon data in a user profile, data associated with the article, combinations thereof, etc. Upon initiation of the trigger, the communication platform initiates an ability to carry out a direct communication between the user and a specific representative of a content provider that is associated with the trigger, where the direct communication is independent of the trigger.

title: Personalized difference analysis method for retinopathy
assignee: 珠海全一科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a personalized difference analysis method for retinopathy, which comprises the following steps: extracting and grading characteristics of a lesion area according to eye image analysis, including density and surface characteristics, and formulating an evaluation standard of lesion severity by combining clinical indexes and expert knowledge; according to multi-time feature analysis of a lesion area, time sequence processing and trend identification are carried out, and the lesion development state is predicted by combining correlation analysis and change rate calculation; evaluating the matching relation between the lesion morphology and the visual dysfunction degree of a patient under the same time phase, judging the lesion severity degree, and establishing a quantitative mapping model of lesion images and visual function injuries; and setting individual lesion diagnosis and progress evaluation thresholds according to the age, gene level and physical condition factors of the patient, and integrating individual difference factors into the formulation of the judgment standard.
assignee_clean: 珠海全一科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 珠海全一科技有限公司

title: Nervous system disease monitoring and early warning system based on articles for daily use
assignee: 中国科学院软件研究所, 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
abstract: The invention discloses a nervous system disease monitoring and early warning system based on articles for daily use. The condition that the user uses the living goods in daily life is monitored by combining the universal sensor with the living goods. By collecting, segmenting and analyzing the data, the upper limb motor function of the person who possibly suffers from the nervous system disease is evaluated, and the early warning or auxiliary diagnosis of the disease condition of the nervous system disease is further carried out. Through the data of quantification, explain old person's motion function condition, avoid the uncertainty of artificial inspection to through implanting the system in daily life, solve the problem that can not real-time monitoring and early warning.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院软件研究所; 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院软件研究所

title: Systems and methods for detecting flow of biological fluids
abstract: A system and computer-implemented method for detecting flow of biological fluid, and facilitating the diagnosis of stenosis or other pathology of a hepatic artery or other non-carotid vasculature by using machine learning to analyze a spectral Doppler ultrasound waveform of blood flow or flow of other biological fluids. A region of interest is identified in a sonogram, a waveform envelope is generated for a waveform within the region of interest, an extracted waveform is generated based on the waveform envelope, a Fourier transform is performed on the extracted waveform, and a Fourier spectrum is generated. Machine learning is used to determine a likelihood of pathology based on waveform parameters, including the Fourier spectrum, and to determine a pathology prediction value. Additional patient information may be accessed and used in determining the likelihood of the pathology.

title: Method and system for generating worker protection digital person
assignee: 卓世科技(海南)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for generating a worker protecting digital person, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring professional knowledge of a worker and interest knowledge of the old, and constructing a knowledge base; constructing a response model, and training the response model by using a knowledge base; collecting output results of the trained response model, and carrying out emotion classification on the output results by combining a graphic neural network and a syntax tree to obtain a plurality of emotion types; recording a video sample, and extracting video frames and an audio stream from the video sample; receiving a voice request of a nursing object, extracting the voice request as a text request, inputting the text request into a response model, and obtaining a target output result through the response model; analyzing the target emotion type; constructing a dual-mode encoding and decoding network, and fusing corresponding video frames and audio streams to obtain a worker protecting digital person with audio characteristics and video characteristics; and broadcasting the target output result by the worker protecting digital person. The fidelity of the nursing staff digital person and the conversation experience of the nursing object are improved.
assignee_clean: 卓世科技 海南 有限公司
primary_assignee: 卓世科技 海南 有限公司

title: Endoscope system, terminal device, and control method
abstract: An endoscope system includes a processor that performs image processing on endoscope image data acquired by an endoscope, which is inserted in a subject and observes an inside of the subject. The processor communicate with a terminal device including a transceiver configured to transmit identification information identifying the terminal device, and a controller configured to: determine whether the processor is a connection destination configured to perform two-way communication, based on the received processor identification information, authenticate whether a user of the terminal device is a predetermined registered user by analyzing data obtained by the terminal device from the user, and allow two-way communication between the processor and the terminal device in response to the processor being determined as the connection designation to perform two-way communication and in response to authenticating the user of the terminal device.

title: Computation of supply-chain metrics
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a processing node, a plurality of documents reflecting at least one action performed on supply-chain assets at a location of an asset supply-chain node, translating, by the processing node, the plurality of the documents into a plurality of entry and exit events of the supply-chain assets, and generating incomplete or non-chronological supply chain assets-related data based on the plurality of the entry and the exit events.

title: Automatic creation of a virtual model and an orthodontic treatment plan
abstract: A system and a computer-implemented method are provided to create a virtual model representing at least the individual visible teeth parts and gingiva of at least part of a dentition of a patient in segmented form out of a 3d model representing that part of the dentition in unsegmented form. At least one treatment plan is created and a process is provided for obtaining at least one appliance based on the at least one treatment plan.

title: Medical data managing apparatus and medical data managing system
abstract: A medical data managing apparatus includes processing circuitry. The processing circuitry generates network access data based on patient information of a patient. The processing circuitry acquires the reference data from a data generating device via a communication network constructed based on the network access data, and checks the reference data against benchmark data included in the patient information. The processing circuitry acquires, when it is determined that the reference data and the benchmark data represent same patient as a result of the check, the multiple non-DICOM data from the data generating device via the constructed communication network. The processing circuitry classifies each of the multiple non-DICOM data into first non-DICOM data to be registered in a data archive apparatus or other second non-DICOM data, and displays the first non-DICOM data and the second non-DICOM data on a display in different display modes.

title: Corporate credit rating server based on deep learning and method for corporate credit rating using the same
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for corporate credit rating based on deep learning comprises: a corporate rating model forming step of generating a corporate credit determination model through deep learning based on at least one information among intrinsic loan information which is information related to an intrinsic index of a corporation and required for determining whether loan is to be granted to the corporation, and extrinsic loan information which is information related to an extrinsic index of a corporation and required for determining whether loan is to be granted to the corporation; and a corporation credit rating step of rating credit of the corporation by inputting, to the corporation credit determination model, at least one among intrinsic loan information which is information related to an intrinsic index of a corporation to be rated and required for determining whether loan is to be granted to the corporation to be rated, and extrinsic loan information which is information related to an extrinsic index of the corporation to be rated and required for determining whether loan is to be granted to the corporation to be rated.

title: Structure segmentation via MAR-cut
abstract: A method for segmenting image data includes creating a plurality of marching regions within the medical image data. Region-wise segmentation is performed on the plurality of marching regions. Region-wise segmentation may include a normalized cut performed on a graph wherein each marching region represents a node. Region-wise segmentation may also include or may alternatively include a min cut performed on a graph wherein each marching region represents a node. Voxel-wise segmentation is performed on a subset of the plurality of marching regions.

title: Computation of supply-chain metrics
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of receiving, by a first node, from a second node at least one document describing an action performed on assets of an asset supply-chain at a location of the second node, executing, by the first node, a smart contract to translate the at least one document into a standardized form of entry and exit events and to define containment relationship of the assets, and computing metrics on the asset supply-chain based on the standardized form and the containment relationship.

title: Systems and methods for bioimpedance body composition measurement
abstract: There is provided a system for monitoring a heart of a subject and monitoring impedance-related parameters, comprising: a feeding tube, an electrode disposed(s) on a distal end of the feeding tube, a controller that performs, while the feeding tube is in located in an esophagus and feeding is delivered to a subject via the feeding tube, in a plurality of iterations: continuously measuring voltage at the electrode(s) of the feeding tube, applying alternating current(s) between the electrode(s) of the feeding tube and at least one other electrode, computing impedance measurement(s) from the electrode(s) of the feeding tube according to the applied alternating current(s) and the measured voltage, computing impedance-related parameter(s) based on the impedance measurement(s), terminating the application of the alternating current(s), obtaining an electrocardiogram (ECG) measurement based on the voltage measured at the electrode(s) of the feeding tube, and providing the impedance-related parameter(s) and the ECG measurement.

title: Security as a service for machine learning
abstract: Embodiments are disclosed for a method. The method includes validating training data that is provided for training a machine learning model using ordinary differential equations. The method further includes generating pre-processed training data from the validated training data by generating encrypted training data from the validated training data using homomorphic encryption and generating random noise based on the validated training data. The method also includes training the machine learning model adversarially with the pre-processed training data.

title: Text multi-label classification method based on medical subject vocabulary enhancement characterization
assignee: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院
abstract: The invention discloses a text multi-label classification method based on enhanced representation of a medical subject vocabulary, which comprises the steps of enhancing representation of labels: s1, taking a medical subject vocabulary in a literature as a label, and establishing a positive sample set of the label; s2, extracting keyword information about labels from the positive sample set; s3, extracting semantic features from the keyword information to obtain vector representation of the keyword information, and marking the vector representation as a first vector; s4, converting the label into a vector, and marking the vector as a second vector; s5, connecting the first vector and the second vector to carry out enhancement characterization on the tag.
assignee_clean: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院
primary_assignee: 清华大学深圳国际研究生院

title: Identification of areas of interest in imaging applications
abstract: A solution is proposed for analyzing an object. A corresponding method comprises providing one or more images of the objects (each comprising a plurality of cells containing corresponding values) to a computing system. The computing system retrieves a selected value reference and a selected shape reference for a selected characteristic of interest. The computing system identifies one or more areas of interest of the images according to the corresponding values matching the selected value reference and according to the corresponding cells matching the selected shape reference. A computer program product for performing the method and a corresponding system are also provided; moreover, a diagnostic method and a therapeutic method based on the same method are proposed.

title: Apparatus and method for automatic detection and classification of industrial alarms
abstract: An occurrence of a predetermined event is detected within a stream of data and a classification for the event is determined. A message is sent to an application when the predetermined event is detected. The message is received at the application and the message is visualized to a user of the application. The stream of data from the industrial machine to the transceiver circuit, to the control circuit, and to the application occurs in real-time without substantial interruption allowing the user of the application to make decisions and determine insights concerning the industrial machine in real-time.

title: Method and apparatus for mobile stroke self-detection
abstract: Disclosed herein are implementations of a method and apparatus for stroke self-detection. The method and apparatus may include a mobile platform for stroke detection. The method may include receiving sensor data. The method may include comparing the sensor data with a baseline test result to determine a test score. The method may include determining a passing test result based on a threshold. The method may include transmitting the results or an alert to one or more of an emergency contact, emergency medical services, a physician, or a telemedicine provider.

title: System and method for determining health care procedures and reimbursement
abstract: A method and system is provided for recording a health care event, optimizing medical procedures and calculating reimbursement. The method includes: acquiring metadata comprising a patient identifier, a practitioner identifier, a health care site identifier, an entry time and a medical reason for the health care event; receiving a reimbursement request; generating a procedures list based on the medical reason; selecting a procedure; generating a list of required data types and a list of required quality data for the procedure; acquiring raw data comprising the procedure, a medical device identifier, an entry time and one or more quality data from the medical device for the procedure; and calculating a reimbursement for the health care event based on the procedure, the medical device identifier, the required quality data and the quality data from the medical device. The method implements iterative learning using the collected data to determine optimal health care procedures.

title: System for storinging shared seoul rental bike and operation method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for storing shared bicycles in Seoul and an operation method thereof and, more specifically, to a system for storing means of transportation for rental and an operation method thereof. Also, one embodiment of the present invention provides a device for storing means of transportation for rental, which includes: a floor frame in which racks are arranged to be spaced apart from each other in parallel so that at least two means of transportation are stored; a pair of vertical frames vertically installed on both ends of the floor frame and having display panels; and a horizontal frame integrally connecting the pair of vertical frames and having a solar panel installed on an upper surface.

title: Data matching method, device, equipment and medium for query conditions
assignee: 医渡云（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a data matching method, a device, equipment and a medium for query conditions, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a non-temporal query condition from a user; matching a corresponding medical data model according to the non-time query condition; determining a standard timestamp of query data binding in the medical data model; screening the standard timestamp bound to the query data to determine target data corresponding to the non-time query condition; the method realizes the transmission of the time information by using the time score, particularly realizes the effective transmission of the time information in each data level in the inquiry process, solves the problems that the non-time inquiry condition is difficult to efficiently transmit by using the inquiry statement and difficult to implement, and can meet the search appeal of the user on the target data without consuming extra storage and calculation resources.
assignee_clean: 医渡云 北京 技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 医渡云 北京 技术有限公司

title: Deep learning-based coronary angiography image segmentation optimization method
assignee: 北京红云智胜科技有限公司, 中国医学科学院阜外医院
abstract: The invention discloses an optimization method for coronary angiography image segmentation based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: using a Tensor object to store a coronary artery angiogram, and performing accelerated calculation in a neural network through a GPU to obtain a segmentation result; the segmentation result of the coronary artery angiogram is optimized through a network structure formed by combining a cascade module and a pixel recovery module added in a neural network. The invention can improve 0.083s by iterating one graph once during training, and can save more than 1 minute in the face of a data set with the number up to thousands of levels in real life. And the neural networks generally used for the image style are trained for at least more than 10 ten thousand times, and the training of the whole network can be saved by more than 100 minutes. Meanwhile, part of the structure of the network is modified, so that the method has the advantages of greatly shortening the time length while ensuring the picture segmentation accuracy, and improving the segmentation accuracy.

title: Systems and methods for image processing
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for image processing. The methods may include obtaining imaging data of a subject, generating a first image based on the imaging data, and generating at least two intermediate images based on the first image. At least one of the at least two intermediate images may be generated based on a machine learning model. And the at least two intermediate images may include a first intermediate image and a second intermediate image. The first intermediate image may include feature information of the first image, and the second intermediate image may have lower noise than the first image. The methods may further include generating, based on the first intermediate image and at least one of the first image or the second intermediate image, a target image of the subject.

title: Intensity-based image registration using Earth Mover's Distance
abstract: A method of aligning image having the steps of obtaining a first image, the first image having a corresponding first data set, obtaining a second image, the second having a corresponding second data set; learning a joint intensity distribution from a pair of prealigned images, and aligning the first image and the second image by computing Earth Mover's Distance between their observed joint intensity distribution and the learned joint intensity distribution.

title: Real-time health care inventory imaging and tracking intelligence system
abstract: An imaging and tracking device used for real-time health care inventory intelligence includes an image sensor and a processor. The image sensor captures images of inventory items stored within a furniture unit to which at least a portion of the imaging and tracking device is coupled. The processor processes the images captured using the image sensor to detect a physical retrieval of one of the inventory items from the furniture unit and to generate a signal including data associated with the retrieved inventory item. A software application running on a server device uses the signal to automatically update a database record associated with the retrieved inventory item within a database. Information associated with the updated database record is then transmitted to a client device in communication with the server device. The information may include instructions for rendering a graphical user interface of the software application at the client device.

title: Deep learning point cloud completion method for enhancing frame details
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning point cloud completion method based on frame detail enhancement, which can better perform point cloud completion by fully utilizing the interconnection between a shape frame and details. The network comprises a framework-detail Transformer module which comprises a cross attention layer and a self attention layer so as to fully explore the correlation from local details to global shapes and utilize the correlation to enhance the overall shape framework. The invention can not only enhance the detail of point cloud completion and the overall accuracy.

title: Implanted medical instrument's remote monitering system's patient terminal
assignee: 北京品驰医疗设备有限公司, 清华大学
abstract: The utility model relates to an implanted medical instrument's remote monitering system's patient terminal, it includes: patient's customer end, and the external controller of a patient, the external controller of patient with patient's customer end links to each other, wherein, further include an electric physiological signal sensor and a signal acquisition controller, electricity physiological signal sensor is used for gathering patient's electric physiological signal, just the signal acquisition controller will this electricity physiological signal send to patient's customer end. The utility model provides an implanted medical instrument's remote monitering system's patient terminal passes through patient's electric physiological signal is gathered to electricity physiological signal sensor for adopt the remote monitering system monitoring ways at this patient terminal diversified, can realize more comprehensively monitoring the patient.

title: A kind of long distance control system of implantable medical devices
assignee: 北京品驰医疗设备有限公司, 清华大学
abstract: The utility model relates to a kind of long distance control system of implantable medical devices, and it comprises: a doctor terminal; One remote monitoring server; One Audio Visual Communication server; One patient customer's end; One patient body outer controller; And an implantable medical devices; Wherein, an electricity physiological signal transducer, a signal acquisition controller and a data analytics server be connected with this remote monitoring server is comprised further; Described electricity physiological signal transducer is connected with described signal acquisition controller, and to be held with described patient customer respectively and described remote monitoring server is connected by this signal acquisition controller; Described data analytics server is used for carrying out online or off-line analysis to the electric physiological data of the patient that described electricity physiological signal transducer collects.The long distance control system of the implantable medical devices that the utility model provides is by the electricity physiological signal of described electricity physiological signal transducer collection patient, and monitoring means variation, can realize the monitoring more comprehensively to patient.

title: Navigating unstructured documents using structured documents including information extracted from unstructured documents
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure describe techniques for generating a machine learning model for extracting information from textual content. The method generally includes receiving an unstructured document and a structured document including information extracted from the unstructured document and position information associated with the extracted information. The unstructured document is rendered in a first pane, and a graphical rendering of the structured document is rendered in a second pane. The graphical rendering generally may be a structure in which content from the structured document is displayed in a hierarchical format. Each element in the structured document is linked to the rendered unstructured document based on position information included in the structured document.

title: Image data processing method, image data processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image data processing method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: performing first compression on the first image data to obtain a first characteristic diagram; and performing n times of second compression on the first feature map to obtain n second feature maps, acquiring first distribution information corresponding to the first feature map based on the n second feature maps, performing third compression on the first feature map based on the distribution parameter of each feature value in the first feature map to obtain a third feature map corresponding to the first image data, and determining the third feature map and decompression information associated with the first distribution information as compression information of the first image data. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the application, the first image data is compressed in a multi-time compression mode, and the redundant information contained in the third feature diagram obtained by compression is weakened according to the distribution situation of the feature values in the feature diagram corresponding to the first image data, so that the compression effect is ensured.

title: Lung nodule deep learning classification method based on floating cutting
abstract: The invention discloses a lung nodule deep learning classification method based on floating cutting, which comprises the steps of establishing a CT image lung nodule classification neural network model, and setting a lung nodule CT image sequence as a two-dimensional lung nodule image sequence at X, Y axis obtained by cutting a lung nodule along the Z axis direction; setting an image containing a three-dimensional center position of a lung nodule in a lung nodule CT image sequence as a center image; screening images of known nodule classifications as training, verification and test samples; determining a center image in the image sequence and a nodule center position and a nodule length on the center image; during training, floating cutting is carried out on the training sample sequence along the positive and negative directions of the Z axis by adopting the changed cutting interval, so as to obtain a plurality of groups of dynamic training sample sequences; training the model by adopting a dynamic training sample sequence; and during testing, sequentially inputting the upper and lower images at the nodule into the model to obtain a predicted value, and obtaining a comprehensive predicted value according to the weight of the predicted value. The invention can learn three-dimensional image information by two-dimensional input and improve the performance of the model.

title: Method for prediction of response to cardiovascular regeneration
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for prediction of response to cardiovascular regeneration comprising the use of biomarkers. Furthermore, the invention relates to a combination of biomarkers for use in a method for prediction of response to cardiovascular regeneration, a computer device for performing the method according to the invention and a device adapted to perform the method of the invention.

title: Implementation of architecture document via infrastructure as code
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of storing, in memory, a cloud architecture document of a cloud computing environment, transforming the cloud architecture document into infrastructure as code (IaC) based on predefined code and storing the IaC in a machine-readable file, deploying the cloud computing environment via a host platform, and executing the machine-readable file and automatically configuring cloud resources of the cloud computing environment based on the IaC included in the machine-readable file.

title: Medical object detection and identification via machine learning
abstract: An approach for improving object detection performance by using bilateral organ information disclosed. The approach comprises introducing a penalty term to an object localization model. The penalty term encourages the model to identify same physical regions (actual same physical location in the patient's body) in multiple images, which create an image of the same organ. The approach includes a sub-component of the model that can output an entity embedding, in additional to the conventional classification and localization prediction. During optimization process, similar entity embedding for the same logical entity are encouraged, and similar entity embedding for different logical entities are discouraged.

title: Computing system that facilitates digital rights management for healthcare records
abstract: Described herein are various technologies pertaining to facilitating digital rights management of patient healthcare records. A computing system executing an electronic health records application (EHR) receives an attribute of a healthcare worker and a patient identifier from a client computing device. The computing system retrieves a computer-readable file for the patient, the computer-readable file comprising a plurality of file records and a file access portion. A file record in the plurality of file records comprises a data portion and an access portion. The computing system transmits data in the data portion to the client computing device only when both the file access portion of the computer-readable file and the access portion of the file record include the attribute of the healthcare worker.

title: System and method for determining the position and orientation of a joint replacement surgical implant
assignee: 史密夫和内修有限公司
abstract: A system, apparatus and method for determining the position and orientation of an implant (100) for joint replacement surgery are described. For example, the system includes a sleeve (200) configured to be worn by a patient and collect (415) biomechanical information related to movement of the joint, and a surgical system (320). The surgical system is configured to receive (605) the collected biomechanical information, determine (605) clinical measurement information related to the joint, generate (610) a musculoskeletal simulation of the joint based on the collected biomechanical information and the determined clinical measurement information, determine (615) one or more surgical parameters of the patient based on the musculoskeletal simulation, and determine (620) at least one of a position and an orientation of an implant component to be inserted into the joint based on the one or more surgical parameters.
assignee_clean: 史密夫和内修有限公司
primary_assignee: 史密夫和内修有限公司

title: Medical image processing apparatus, medical image processing method, and medical image processing program
abstract: In a medical image processing apparatus, a medical image processing method, and a medical image processing program, in a case where there are a plurality of past brain images, it is possible to select a past brain image with which the atrophy rate of the brain can be accurately calculated. An image acquisition unit acquires a target brain image Bt as a diagnostic target and a plurality of past brain images Bpi, which have earlier imaging dates and times than the target brain image Bt, for the same subject. A similarity calculation unit calculates the similarity between each of the plurality of past brain images Bpi and a standard brain image Bs. A selection unit selects a reference brain image B0 serving as a reference for calculating the amount of change of the brain from the plurality of past brain images Bpi.

title: Tumor focus region semantic segmentation method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 北京知见生命科技有限公司, 重庆知见生命科技有限公司, 中国人民解放军陆军军医大学第一附属医院
abstract: The invention provides a tumor focus area semantic segmentation method and system based on deep learning, and provides an end-to-end network structure model, wherein the whole structure is divided into two parts of a coding layer and a decoding layer, a dense connection network structure block is introduced into the coding layer to solve the gradient dispersion problem caused by deep network, a characteristic attention mechanism and a channel attention mechanism are introduced into the decoding layer to accurately acquire segmentation target information, a multi-scale receptive field network structure is added at a jump joint to acquire different-scale semantic information, and the segmentation precision is improved. The model can accurately divide the accurate position of the tumor focus area on the premise of considering the speed and the precision, and has wide application prospect in the field of medical image processing.

title: Plaque erosion automatic detection system based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic plaque erosion detection system based on artificial intelligence, which mainly comprises a convolutional neural network Mask RCNN-CK detection model based on shape coding and a post-processing algorithm module based on domain knowledge, wherein the convolutional neural network Mask RCNN-CK detection model based on shape coding comprises three input branches: the method comprises the steps that an original image, convexity and curvature are subjected to feature extraction by using independent coding modules respectively, and then a preliminary detection result of plaque erosion is obtained through a classification regression module and a segmentation module; the post-processing algorithm module based on the domain knowledge comprises a classification module and a three-dimensional processing module based on clinical interpretable features, and further optimizes a preliminary detection result by extracting clinical features of plaque erosion to obtain a final detection result of the plaque erosion. The invention realizes the automatic detection of plaque erosion in the intravascular image and provides reliable basis for the clinical diagnosis of plaque erosion.

title: Insertion device positioning guidance system and method
abstract: There is provided herein a guidance system for positioning an insertion device comprising: an electromagnetic field generator configured to generate an electromagnetic field covering a treatment area, an insertion device comprising an electromagnetic sensor, the electromagnetic sensor configured to receive signals indicative of the electromagnetic field, and a processing circuitry configured to: load an X-ray, CT, ultrasound or MRI image of the subject's chest, mark a location of a first and a second anatomic landmarks on the subject's torso using a registration sensor and obtaining a subject coordinate system based thereon, identify the location of the first and the second anatomic landmarks on the loaded X-ray, CT, ultrasound or MRI image of the subject's chest; aligning the subject coordinate system with the loaded X-ray, CT, ultrasound or MRI image, and display, on the image, a path of the insertion device insertion with respect to the first and the second anatomic locations; wherein the path is generated according to changes in the strength of the electromagnetic field sensed by the tip sensor's during the insertion of the insertion device.

title: Method and system for data analysis service mediation based on blockchain and homomorphic encryption
abstract: The present invention relates to a data analysis service mediation system and method based on blockchain and homomorphic encryption. The system comprises: a user terminal for selecting one analysis service provider from among one or more analysis service providers and providing homomorphically encrypted data together with an analysis request; at least one analysis service provider terminal for registering a type of an analysis service that can be provided and providing an analysis result of the homomorphically encrypted data to the user terminal; and an analysis service mediation server for receiving and providing a type of at least one or more analysis service providers to the user terminal and mediating a smart contract between the user terminal and the selected analysis service provider based on the analysis request and the homomorphically encrypted data. The present invention provides an analysis service without leaking sensitive personal information to the outside and can mediate various analysis services and analysis service companies that a user needs.

title: Pre-diagnosis information acquisition method and device
assignee: 北京嘉和海森健康科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for acquiring pre-diagnosis information, comprising the following steps: patient basic information and symptom information are acquired. And acquiring a symptom attribute category corresponding to the symptom information from a pre-established medical knowledge graph, and generating a first question text aiming at the symptom attribute category. A first answer result of the first question text is obtained, wherein the first answer result comprises a target attribute value of the symptom attribute category. Inputting the basic information, symptom information and target attribute values of symptom attribute categories of the patient into a machine learning model to obtain a first target disease output by the machine learning model. And acquiring a checking examination item corresponding to the first target disease from the medical knowledge graph, and generating a second problem text aiming at the checking examination item. And acquiring a second answer result of the second question text, wherein the second answer result comprises whether to carry out a checking item or not. The method acquires the pre-diagnosis information of the patient through heuristic questions and answers, has strong expandability, improves the diagnosis efficiency and is convenient for the patient to visit.

title: Method for use in generating a computer-based visualization of 3D medical image data
abstract: A method for use in generating a computer-based visualization of 3D medical image data is described. The method includes receiving 3D medical image data and performing a selection process to select first image data forming a first portion of the 3D medical image data, the first image data representing a first anatomical object of a given type. An analysis process is performed on the first image data, a parameter of the analysis process being based on the given type of the first anatomical object. Based at least in part on a result of the analysis process, a visual parameter mapping for the first portion is determined, for use in a rendering process for generating a visualization of the 3D medical image data. Also described is a method of generating a computer-based visualization of 3D medical image data and an apparatus for performing the methods.

title: Method and system for secretion analysis embedded in a garment
abstract: An apparatus, and method, for a garment embedded secretion analysis. The system includes a liner that includes at least a sensor from a plurality of sensors. The system also includes a computing device embedded in the liner and communicatively connected to the at least a sensor, where the computing device includes a detection module configured to extract at least a biological sample from the user, authenticate the user as a function of the biological sample and a biological data of the user, detect a condition datum as a function of the biological sample and biological data of the user and determine an event datum as a function of the condition datum. Computing device also includes a safety module configured to receive the event datum and generate an alert datum as a function of the event datum.

title: Cooperative access hybrid procedures
abstract: A method of operating a surgical anchoring system can include inserting an outer sleeve of a surgical instrument at least partially into a first natural body lumen, the outer sleeve having a working channel. The method can include inserting a channel arm of the surgical instrument through the working channel of the outer sleeve and into a second natural body lumen. The channel arm has at least one first anchor member coupled thereto and a control actuator operatively coupled to the at least one first anchor member. The method can include expanding the at least one first anchor member from an unexpanded state to an expanded state to form an anchor point at a portion of the second natural body lumen. The method can include controlling, by the control actuator, a motion of the channel arm to selectively manipulate an organ associated with the first and second natural body lumens.

title: Training method, recognition method, device, medium and equipment of image recognition model
assignee: 北京字节跳动网络技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a training method, a recognition method, an apparatus, a medium, and a device of an image recognition model, the method including: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of training sample sets, wherein data distribution of each training sample set is not completely consistent, determining the gradient of each training image according to the training image and a training recognition result corresponding to the training image aiming at each training image, determining a first statistic and a second statistic of each training sample set according to the gradient of each training image, determining a statistic loss function according to the first statistic and the second statistic, and updating a preset model according to the statistic loss function to obtain an image recognition model. The preset model can be updated according to the statistic loss function determined by the first statistic and the second statistic, the image recognition model with high generalization performance is obtained, additional fine adjustment on the image recognition model is not needed, the over-fitting problem can be avoided, and the recognition accuracy of the image recognition model is improved.

title: Capsule endoscope system for real-time remote data center data processing
assignee: 浙江鸿禾医疗科技有限责任公司
abstract: The invention discloses a capsule endoscope system for real-time remote data center data processing, which comprises one or more capsule endoscopes, wherein the signal output end of each capsule endoscope is in wireless connection with a corresponding data record transmission terminal; the capsule endoscope system also comprises a remote data center, all the data record transmission terminals are connected with the remote data center in a wired or wireless way, the data record transmission terminals transmit data to the remote data center and receive control instructions of the remote data center. The invention adopts the capsule endoscope system architecture based on the remote data center, and the screening, detecting and diagnosing data of the capsule endoscope can be transmitted to the remote data center, and the capsule endoscope can receive the control instruction of the data center. The control instruction can be automatically or under the guidance of an expert sent to the capsule endoscope through the data record transmission terminal through the processing decision of the remote data center, so that diagnosis and treatment of the digestive tract of the capsule endoscope controlled by the remote data center are realized.

title: Image generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for generating an image. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first original image and a second original image, and respectively preprocessing the first original image and the second original image to obtain a first sample image and a second sample image; generating a mask image corresponding to a region to be supplemented in the second sample image according to the first sample image or the second original image; and inputting the mask image of the area to be supplemented, the first sample image and the second sample image into an image generation network, and outputting a target image. According to the embodiment of the invention, the original image is obtained and preprocessed to obtain the sample image, then the mask image corresponding to the region to be supplemented in the sample image is generated, the mask image of the region to be supplemented and the sample image are input into the image generation network, and the target image is output, so that the part outside the visual field aperture of the image is supplemented, a data result closer to the real large visual field aperture is obtained, and the influence of attenuation correction on the image is reduced.

title: Customer service guiding method based on customer service machine model
assignee: 厦门快商通信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a customer service guiding method based on a customer service machine model, which is characterized in that related sentences in a field are input into a training model to obtain corresponding robot replies; analyzing the chat linguistic data in the field, cleaning data according to the rule obtained by analysis, filtering invalid data, and deleting redundant items; labeling each question-answer pair by using the product classification name in the field as a label; performing word segmentation on all question sentences and corresponding answers in the corpus, and learning the semantic features of each word; and guiding the client to fill the associated slot positions according to the product classification required by the client and each requirement of the product classification, mapping according to the client requirement and the product classification, formulating a client problem reply rule, obtaining the product classification required by the client and each requirement of the product classification, and guiding the client to fill the associated slot positions. Due to the fact that product name classification and personal information state recording are added, the whole conversation is not deviated, and service quality is improved.

title: Deep learning model training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 中国移动通信有限公司研究院, 中国移动通信集团有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a deep learning model training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: labeling the first training data by using a first deep learning model to obtain a first labeling result; based on the first labeling result, obtaining first characteristic data of each piece of first training data; acquiring a second labeling result of the first characteristic data; and training a second deep learning model based on a first training set formed by the first characteristic data and the second labeling result.
