title: Apparatuses, systems, and methods for machine learning using on-memory pattern matching
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure are drawn to apparatuses, systems, methods for performing operations associated with machine learning. Machine learning operations may include processing a data set, training a machine learning algorithm, and applying a trained algorithm to a data set. Some of the machine learning operations, such as pattern matching operations, may be performed within a memory device.

title: Systems and methods for tracking with discrete texture traces
abstract: An active set of discrete texture traces to a target point is determined in a first video frame and is applied to a second video frame to detect the target location in a second video frame. An estimate is made of the target location in the second video frame. A score map is computed of an area of locations. A location with a highest score in the score map is the new target location. If a threshold value is not met the active set of texture traces is stored. A score map for each of stored active sets is computed to determine the target location. If no score meets the threshold the target location in a previous video frame is made the current target location and a new active set of discrete texture traces is determined. Systems that implement the steps of the methods are also provided.

title: FPGA accelerator and chip for federal learning and privacy computation
assignee: 深圳致星科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an FPGA accelerator and a chip for federal learning and privacy computation. The FPGA accelerator includes a plurality of basic operator units and each includes a plurality of stages of pipelined arithmetic units, each stage configured to select one of a plurality of basic operations and further configured to selectively obtain input data from a previous stage and send a calculation result to a next stage. The plurality of basic operator units form a plurality of operator engines, each of which comprises at least one basic operator unit connected in parallel and all the basic operator units of the operator engine perform parallelization calculation. The plurality of operator engines constitute at least one operator engine block, each of the at least one operator engine block comprising at least one operator engine combined in series-parallel. The FPGA accelerator executes one or more operation tasks through the at least one operator engine block, and the calculation flow can be expanded into a combination of the plurality of basic operations. This has improved computational efficiency and adaptability.
assignee_clean: 深圳致星科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳致星科技有限公司

title: Digital pathology using an artificial neural network
abstract: Various example embodiments pertain to processing images that depict tissue samples using a neural network algorithm. The neural network algorithm includes multiple encoder branches that are copies of each other that share the same parameters. The encoder branches can, accordingly, be referred to as Siamese copies of each other.

title: Systems and methods for displaying augmented anatomical features
abstract: A method, user device, and system for displaying augmented anatomical features is disclosed. The method includes detecting a target individual having a body. The method also includes tracking the target individual. The method further includes displaying, on a display, a visual representation of the body. The method further includes identifying a plurality of reference markers on the visual representation of the body. The method also includes determining, at a processor, an anatomical profile of the target individual based on the plurality of reference markers. The anatomical profile includes a plurality of anatomical features. The method further includes displaying, on the display, graphical representations of the anatomical features overlaid on the visual representation of the body. The graphical representations of the anatomical features are oriented on the visual representation of the body based on the anatomical profile.

title: Adaptive segmentation of lesions in medical images
abstract: A method comprising using at least one hardware processor for: receiving a digital medical image and a binary image mask, wherein the binary image mask depicts a segmentation of a lesion in the digital medical image; computing a plurality of layers of the lesion; for each of the plurality of layers of the lesion, extracting layer features; and sending the extracted layer features to a lesion classifier.

title: Classification tool
abstract: A classification system that includes a first input module, a marker module, unclassified Lagrange multiplier calculation module, and a classification module. The unclassified vector describes a physical condition. The marker module assigns a marker to the unclassified vector. The marker should place the unclassified vector into one of two classes. The unclassified Lagrange multiplier calculation module calculates a classifying Lagrange multiplier for the unclassified vector using the marker and a classification rule. The classification rule may be generated using a training system for classifying the physical condition. The classification module is configured to determine that the marker places the unclassified vector in the proper class if the classifying Lagrange multiplier is small.

title: Analytical optimization of translation and post editing
abstract: Improved translation operations are disclosed. A first segment of text in a first language is received, to be translated into a second language. The first segment is evaluated, by operation of one or more processors, of text using the pattern model to generate a first s-score. A second segment of text in the second language is generated based on processing the first segment of text using a machine translation model. Upon determining that the first s-score exceeds a predefined threshold, the first segment of text is flagged for auto-substitution with the second segment of text, such that the first segment of text is not reviewed by a human editor.

title: Appointment scheduler within sponsored content items
abstract: This specification describes methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer-readable storage device, for providing content items. The subject matter of this specification is embodied in methods that include providing, from a processing device, data that causes display of a sponsored content item on a client device. The display of the sponsored content item includes a control for scheduling the appointment, and the control causes display of a form within the content item in response to the input to receive user input related to scheduling the appointment. The method also includes receiving, at one or more processing devices, information indicative of user input related to scheduling the appointment, and providing the information indicative of the user input to a computing device associated with scheduling the appointment related to the sponsored content item. This information is used by the computing device to schedule the reservation.

title: Wearable pulse waveform measurement system and method
abstract: A pulse waveform measurement system including an LED light source that provides an incident light beam having a predetermined wavelength onto a radial or other artery samples, calculates, and displays a pulse waveform and various parameters associated therewith at a predetermined sampling rate. The wavelength and sampling rate are set to provide the desired data quality.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine facial diagnosis auxiliary diagnosis method and device based on face feature detection and storage medium
assignee: 北京鹰之眼智能健康科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine face diagnosis auxiliary diagnosis method based on face feature detection, which comprises the steps of collecting a face image, labeling face diagnosis key features of the face image for face feature detection model training, wherein the face diagnosis key features comprise at least one of spots, nevi, acne, blood streaks and transverse striations; acquiring a face region required by facial diagnosis by adopting a face key point detection algorithm, and carrying out traditional Chinese medicine facial diagnosis partitioning on the face image according to the face key point positioning; extracting the key features of the facial diagnosis from the face image through a convolutional neural network structure, wherein the convolutional neural network structure comprises at least one convolutional layer, one pooling layer, one feature fusion and one feature pyramid; and obtaining a traditional Chinese medicine facial diagnosis result according to medical logic judgment by combining the facial diagnosis key characteristics and the traditional Chinese medicine facial diagnosis subarea. The invention can automatically extract key features of the face such as spots, nevus, acne, striation and the like, and effectively support the improvement of the diagnosis accuracy of the traditional Chinese medicine facial diagnosis.
assignee_clean: 北京鹰之眼智能健康科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京鹰之眼智能健康科技有限公司

title: Systems and methods for eye imaging and position control
abstract: A method for altering an eye color of a patient with a color alteration procedure is disclosed that may include imaging the iris with an image sensor prior to the color alteration procedure to generate an image of the iris. A mapping of the iris may be generated from the image. The mapping may include a number of regions corresponding to varying absorption coefficients of a treatment wavelength in the stromal pigment of the iris. A laser system may be set, based on the mapping, to deliver laser light at a laser power sufficient to cause elimination of at least a portion of stromal pigment in the iris. The laser light may then be delivered with the laser system.

title: A system that creates communication NPC avatars for healthcare
abstract: As a system that generates a communication NPC avatar for healthcare, the present invention relates to the system that generates the communication NPC avatar for healthcare that receives the biometric information, the activity information, and the medical information of a user through a VR device, enables to generate an avatar inside a virtual reality based on thereof, and provides a cognitive ability training of the user and a guide for rehabilitation by generating an NPC avatar for which the user can interact with.

title: Imaging support apparatus, method, and program for detecting an abnormal site in a medical image
abstract: An abnormal site detection unit detects an abnormal site included in a medical image acquired based on radiation transmitted through a subject. A position specifying unit generates positional information for specifying a position of the abnormal site based on a feature point of the subject included in the medical image in a case where the abnormal site is detected in the medical image. An information generation unit generates additional imaging instruction information, including information that indicates a type of additional imaging based on the abnormal site and information that indicates the position of the abnormal site based on the positional information, for instructing at least one additional imaging.

title: Text-assisted semi-supervised 3D medical image segmentation method
abstract: The invention discloses a text-assisted semi-supervised 3D medical image segmentation method, and belongs to the technical field of medical image processing. According to the invention, when the 'almost unsupervised' 3D medical image segmentation based on the text auxiliary orthogonal annotation is performed, the work of maximally reducing manual annotation in the whole process is considered, the redundancy of adjacent slice annotation is reduced, and the advantage that parallaxes brought by different visual angles of the volume picture can be mutually compensated is fully utilized. Overcoming the two-branch cross supervision is a paradigm of 'not so that it', more penalty factors are introduced, so that the effect of cross pseudo supervision is better. The method has important significance for alleviating the complex annotation work required in training the 3D medical image segmentation, and provides a new direction for guiding the work of the 3D medical segmentation by using the text.

title: Monitoring system information on unlicensed band
abstract: A receiving system information method includes monitoring a first system information (SI) monitoring window based on a first frequency. Receiving frequency pattern information on the first frequency, when a signal is not detected in the first SI monitoring window. Monitoring a second SI monitoring window on a second frequency based on the frequency pattern information.

title: Quantification method and device for coronary artery stenosis
abstract: The application provides a quantification method and device for coronary artery stenosis, comprising the following steps: establishing a corresponding relation between multi-view image characteristics of the coronary artery multi-view medical image and morphological parameters of the coronary artery stenosis by utilizing the self-learning capability of the artificial neural network; acquiring current multi-view image characteristics of a current coronary artery multi-view medical image of a patient; determining morphological parameters of the current coronary artery stenosis corresponding to the current multi-view image features according to the corresponding relation; specifically, determining morphological parameters of the current coronary stenosis corresponding to the multi-view image features includes: and determining the morphological parameters of the coronary artery stenosis corresponding to the multi-view image features which are the same as the current multi-view image features in the corresponding relation as the morphological parameters of the current coronary artery stenosis. Based on morphological parameters of multi-view prediction coronary artery stenosis, the influence of the overlapping of the stenosis and other blood vessels on the quantification of the stenosis is relieved.

title: Multi-mode laser dry eye therapeutic instrument wavelength control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of dry eye treatment, and particularly discloses a wavelength control method of a multi-mode laser dry eye therapeutic apparatus, which comprises the following steps: s1: collecting data; s2: data input: processing a dry eye data prediction model; s3: and (3) data output: the dry eye data prediction model outputs relevant information of the intense pulse laser; s4: generating a wavelength of the intense pulsed laser and selecting an energy waveform combination of the intense pulsed laser, and selecting at least two waveforms; s5: therapeutic application: applying the combined information of at least two intense pulsed lasers to an intense pulsed laser dry eye treatment apparatus; s6: abnormal feedback: if the expected effect is not achieved, feeding back to the dry eye data prediction model; s7: and (3) readjusting: again, the parameters of the dry eye data prediction model are fine-tuned. According to the method, multiple strong pulse lasers are used for treatment at the same time, and the treatment effect is obviously better than that of treatment by using only one waveform of strong pulse laser, so that the treatment time is shortened, and the treatment efficiency is higher.

title: Method and system for predicting radiation pneumonitis by using dosimetry and deep learning characteristics
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting radiation pneumonitis by using dosimetry and deep learning characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of disease prediction. According to the method, feature extraction of different lung tissue areas is carried out through a deep learning network pre-trained through medical images, an MLP algorithm is used, in an internal verification result, a region of interest of normal lung tissue is optimized, and then a prediction model combining the dosimetry features and the deep learning features to carry out RP is established by combining the dosimetry features and the dosimetry features related to RP. In the external verification set, the AUC of the dosimetry model is 0.583, the AUC of the model based on the deep learning characteristic is 0.690, the AUC of the model after combining the two characteristics is 0.746, and the prediction accuracy is obviously improved by delong test p < 0.05.

title: Ultrasound diagnosis apparatus, medical image processing apparatus, and medical image processing method
abstract: In an ultrasound diagnosis apparatus according to an embodiment, processing circuitry obtains volume data corresponding to at least one cardiac cycle and being taken of a region including the right ventricle of a patient. The processing circuitry estimates motion information of a tissue in the region by using the volume data. The processing circuitry calculates information including at least one selected from between wall motion information and volume information related to the right ventricle, on the basis of the motion information of the tissue. The processing circuitry outputs the calculated information. The processing circuitry corrects first motion information of the right ventricular outflow tract, which is an outflow tract of the right ventricle, by using second motion information of a site that is positioned in the vicinity of the right ventricular outflow tract and exhibits motion similar to that of the right ventricular outflow tract.

title: Emergency stop of robot
abstract: A robot may perform emergency stopping. The robot includes: a driving device configured to perform movement of the robot; a stop switch configured to output a stop switch signal; a controller configured to output a stop signal; and a stop circuit configured to output a first control signal and a second control signal for stopping the driving device. The stop circuit may output the first control signal and the second control signal in response to the stop signal and the stop switch signal.

title: Systems and methods for detecting multi-molecule biomarkers
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods, systems, compositions, and kits for the high-throughput detection of multi-molecule biomarkers in a biological sample. The disclosed methods, systems, compositions, and kits utilize antibody-oligonucleotide tags to detect two or more molecules that are in close proximity.

title: Method and electronic device for tracking eye
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a light source module, a display module including at least one layer, a camera module, and a processor operatively connected to the light source module, the display module, and the camera module. The processor may emit light through the light source module along a waveguide formed in the at least one layer of the display module, may use the camera module to detect, based on at least one pattern structure formed in the waveguide, at least a part of the light, which has been reflected from a user's eyeball, and may track the movement of the user's eyeball, based on the detected light.

title: System for measuring heart rate
abstract: A method of computing a heart rate value compensates for noise derived from the subject, the sensor, the transmission, and/or other variables that can lead to false R-peak detection or missed R-peak detection. The method computes an updated heart rate based on a window of approximately ten seconds of digitized ECG readings broadcast from a sensor. A new value is calculated approximately every second such that the window of ECG readings overlaps considerably between consecutive calculations. The method compensates for noisy data by discarding heart rate samples that differ by more than a threshold amount from a previously calculated heart rate value. The threshold is adjusted based on a standard deviation of differences between heart rate samples. Prior to calculating a heart rate value, a forward-looking, pre-filter logic may be applied in situations where the raw data has an extremely low signal-to-noise ratio.

title: Cartilage damage classification method, cartilage damage classification device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a cartilage damage classification method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the medical image containing the cartilage into an image segmentation model to obtain a segmented image of the cartilage in the medical image; inputting the segmented image of the cartilage into an image classification model to obtain a cartilage classification result; the classification result is used for representing the injury grade of cartilage; and determining the damage category of the cartilage according to the classification result of the cartilage. In the method, the medical image is processed by using the training convergence image segmentation model and the image classification model to determine the cartilage classification result, so that the efficiency of obtaining the classification result can be greatly improved, the accuracy of the classification result is also greatly improved, and the efficiency and accuracy of the obtained cartilage damage class are further improved.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Methods and systems for predicting a health condition of a human subject
abstract: Disclosed are embodiments of methods and systems for predicting a health condition of a first human subject. The method comprises extracting a historical data including physiological parameters of second human subjects. Thereafter, a first distribution of a first physiological parameter is determined based on a marginal cumulative distribution of a rank transformed historical data. Further, a second distribution of a second physiological parameter is determined based on the first distribution and a first conditional cumulative distribution of the rank transformed historical data. Further, a latent variable is determined based on the first and the second distributions. Thereafter, one or more parameters of at least one bivariate distribution, corresponding to a D-vine copula, are estimated based on the latent variable. Further, a classifier is trained based on the D-vine copula. The classifier is utilizable to predict the health condition of the first human subject based on his/her physiological parameters.

title: Detection of point sources with variable emission intensity in sequences of images with different point spread functions
assignee: Yeda Research And Development Co. Ltd.
abstract: A System and a method for processing at least two M-dimensional data-measurements (DMs) of a physical-property for detecting one or more new-objects and/or a transition of one or more known-objects, in complex constant-background DMs, using at least one processor and at least one memory element, the method comprising: generating a filtered-new-DM by match-filtering a new-DM, respective to impulse response of a reference-DM; generating a filtered-reference-DM by match-filtering the reference-DM, respective to impulse response of the new-DM; generating an M-dimensional object-indicator (OI) by subtracting the filtered-reference-DM from the filtered-new-DM, or vice versa; and generating an M-dimensional data score (DS) from the M-dimensional OI, where each of the scores is a probe for existence of an object at a specific M-dimensional location.

title: Machine learning methods for monitoring a user's interaction with 3D medical images
abstract: There is provided a method for monitoring interaction with 3D medical images, comprising: dividing the 3D image into a sequence of a 2D images, arranging the sequence into slabs each including at least one 2D image, computing, for each respective slab, a minimal amount of viewing time a user is predicted to spend viewing the respective slab, monitoring, while the 3D medical image is presented on a display, an amount of time a user actually spent viewing portions of the 3D medical image corresponding to each of the of slabs, in response to the amount of time spent viewing a certain portion of the 3D medical image being less than the computed minimal amount of viewing time of a certain slab corresponding to the certain portion, generating instructions for implementation by a user interface indicative of the amount of time spent being less than the computed minimal amount of time.

title: Method for profiling based on foothold and terminal using the same
abstract: Disclosed are a foothold-based profiling method and a terminal using the same. A foothold-based profiling method includes collecting information about an event, collecting location information of a terminal when an event occurs, selecting a foothold based on location information, and collecting information about the foothold. According to the present disclosure, footholds may be determined based on connectivity related events of the terminal, and profiling information may be collected in regards to movement between the footholds.

title: The dividing method of symmetrical organ in medical image
abstract: The present invention relates to Medical Image Processing, technical field of computer vision.Considering the symmetric properties of organ for providing a kind of, the dividing method of symmetrical organ in speed and precision problem medical image can be solved, for achieving the above object, the technical scheme that the present invention takes is, does the dividing method of symmetrical organ in medical image, comprise the steps: step one: the restriction frame Bounding determining image? Box; Step 2: detect axis of symmetry, calculates symmetrical mapping matrix; Step 3: obtain symmetrical similar matrix; Step 4: introduce symmetry constraint model in the drawings; Step 5: solve energy equation by figure segmentation method, obtains final segmentation result.The present invention is mainly used in Medical Image Processing.

title: Anomaly detection and diagnostics based on multivariate analysis
abstract: Anomalies in a target object can be detected and diagnosed using improved Mahalanobis-Taguchi system (MTS) techniques. For example, an anomaly detection and diagnosis (ADD) system can receive a set of measurements associated with attributes of a target object. A Mahalanobis distance (MD) can be determined using a generalized inverse matrix. An abnormal condition can be detected when the MD is greater than a predetermined threshold value. The ADD system can determine an importance score for each measurement of a corresponding attribute. The attribute whose measurement has the highest importance score can be determined to be responsible for the abnormal condition.

title: Selecting a stressor based on thermal measurements of the face
abstract: Described herein are systems and methods for selecting a stressor based on thermal measurements. In one embodiment, a system includes an inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAM) and a computer. CAM takes thermal measurements of a region on a periorbital area (THROI1) of the user. The computer detects extents of stress based on THROI1, receives indications of potential stressors to which the user was exposed while THROI1 were taken, and selects the stressor, from among the potential stressors, based on the indications and the extents. Optionally, during most of the time the user was affected by the stressor, the effect of the stressor, as manifested via changes to THROI1, was higher than the effects of most of the potential stressors. Optionally, thermal measurements of other regions on the face may also be utilized to detect the extents of stress.

title: Selecting triggers of an allergic reaction based on nasal temperatures
abstract: Described herein are systems and methods for selecting a trigger of an allergic reaction. In one embodiment, a system includes an inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAM) and a computer. CAM takes thermal measurements of a region on the nose (THN) of the user. Optionally, CAM weighs below 10 g and is located less than 15 cm from the user's face. The computer detects extents of the allergic reaction based on THN, receives indications of potential triggers of the allergic reaction to which the user was exposed, and selects the trigger, from among the potential triggers, based on the extents and the indications. Optionally, during most of the time the user was affected by the trigger, an effect of the trigger, as manifested via changes to THN, was higher than effects of most of the potential triggers.

title: Visualization and exploration of probabilistic models
abstract: Embodiments facilitating data exploration in a computing environment by a processor. A multidimensional dataset may be received. The multidimensional dataset may be processed according to booting operation parameters. A visualization and exploration of an interactive representation of one or more probabilistic models using multidimensional dataset.

title: Data processing method based on machine learning and related equipment
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a data processing method and device based on machine learning, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of computers and communication. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current health data image of a target object from a client; performing optical character recognition and natural language processing on the current health data image to obtain structured physical examination data of the current health data image; carrying out quantization processing on the structured physical examination data to generate a current feature vector; normalizing the current feature vector; processing the normalized current feature vector through a strong classifier to obtain a current underwriting conclusion of the target object; and sending the current warranty to the client so as to display the current warranty on the client. According to the technical scheme, data processing based on machine learning can be automatically performed, and the efficiency and accuracy of the verification are improved.

title: An image-based artificial intelligence deep-learning based blood pressure estimation apparatus
abstract: The present invention relates to a blood pressure estimating device using artificial intelligence deep learning based on an image and, more specifically, to a blood pressure estimating device using artificial intelligence deep learning based on an image for obtaining an image photographed through a camera to measure a PPG signal using a color component value changed by frame of an image, dividing the measured PPG signal into a morphological feature and a spectrum feature to extract a morphological feature and a spectrum feature, and then estimating blood pressure using a learned blood pressure estimation algorithm with systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure as outputs by using the extracted features as input values.

title: Patient care safety informatization management system and method
abstract: The application discloses an informatization management system and method for patient nursing safety, and relates to the field of nursing safety. Therefore, whether the patient has the risk of pressure sores or not is judged in real time through intelligence, the development and further deterioration of the pressure sores are prevented, and the nursing safety of the patient is improved.

title: Disease charge calculation method and device and terminal equipment
assignee: 河北省科学院应用数学研究所
abstract: The invention provides a disease charge calculating method, a device and terminal equipment, wherein the method is applied to the technical field of data processing and comprises the following steps: acquiring medical record homepage data of medical institutions in medical insurance jurisdictions; carrying out data cleaning on the first page data of the medical record; carrying out data correction on the cleaned first page data of the medical record; and (5) calculating the disease seed expense of the corrected first page data of the medical record based on the DRGs group. The method, the device and the terminal equipment for calculating the disease seed expense can effectively improve the accuracy of calculating the disease seed expense.

title: SDWSN optimal path calculation method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to a SDWSN optimal path calculation method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of software-defined wireless sensor networks. The method comprises the following steps: s1: combining node position and time delay information, constructing a network node energy consumption estimation model, and estimating the energy consumption rates of all nodes according to the model; s2: according to the correlation between the energy consumption and the node density space, calculating the number k of the cluster head nodes to be selected in the event area by adopting a cluster head selection algorithm with a dynamic radius; simultaneously selecting k secondary cluster head nodes as intra-cluster data forwarding nodes of the cluster head nodes; s3: and calculating the optimal path of transmission by adopting an optimal path selection algorithm based on reinforcement learning. The invention can effectively improve the life cycle, balance the network energy consumption and improve the data packet transmission rate.

title: Medical image diagnosis method, system and device
assignee: 杭州涿溪脑与智能研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image diagnosis method, a system and a device, comprising S1, acquiring medical image data without focus; s2, establishing a convolution network for local reconstruction of the lesion-free medical image according to the lesion-free medical image data; s3, acquiring a medical image; s4, dividing the medical image acquired in S3 into a plurality of parts, and processing the parts into a plurality of medical images missing a certain part; s5, inputting the medical images missing a certain part into the convolution network for reconstruction to obtain a plurality of reconstructed images of a certain part; s6, splicing the reconstructed images of a plurality of parts into a complete lesion-free image; and S7, comparing the complete non-focus image with the medical image acquired in S3, and judging focus points. The invention can realize the lesion judgment, get rid of the data dependence on specific diseases in the current image analysis model training process, reduce the development difficulty of the model and increase the types of the analyzable diseases of the model.

title: Method for adapting an image impression
abstract: A method is provided for adapting an image impression of an image, in particular of an image acquired in the context of medical imaging. The method includes: providing an image or input data from which the image is acquired; specifying a respective ideal image impression class for the image and/or for at least one image segment of the image specified directly or by specifying at least one segment type, wherein a connection between the image data in the image and/or in the respective image segment and an assigned image impression class is specified by a classification algorithm; and modifying the image or the input data by a modification algorithm, in order to adapt the image impression class that has been assigned to the resulting modified image data pertaining to the image or pertaining to the respective image segment to match the respective ideal image impression class, wherein at least one modification parameter of the modification algorithm is or becomes specified as a function of the classification algorithm.

title: Brain medical image scoring method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳市铱硙医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a brain medical image scoring method, a brain medical image scoring device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a brain medical image to be processed; extracting a brain parenchyma mask of the brain medical image, and acquiring a median sagittal plane characteristic image corresponding to the brain medical image according to the brain parenchyma mask; mapping the median sagittal plane characteristic image to a standard brain image, determining regions of interest in the median sagittal plane characteristic image according to region division of the standard brain image, and extracting local characteristics of each region of interest and overall characteristics of all regions of interest; extracting high-dimensional image features of the median sagittal plane feature image; and according to the local features, the overall features and the high-dimensional image features, performing abnormal scoring on the brain medical image to obtain a scoring result corresponding to the brain medical image. By adopting the method, the efficiency and the accuracy of brain medical image scoring can be improved.

title: Device, system and non-transitory readable storage medium for predicting fractional flow reserve of a vessel tree
assignee: 深圳科亚医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to devices, systems, and non-transitory readable storage media for predicting fractional flow reserve of a vessel tree. The apparatus comprises: an interface that acquires a medical image of a vessel tree; a processor that extracts a centerline of the vessel tree based on the medical image and extracts first mask image blocks on a cross-section at a plurality of sampling locations along the centerline to obtain a set of first mask image blocks; and predicting the fractional flow reserve of the plurality of sampling positions by utilizing a trained tree structure learning network based on the obtained set of the first mask image blocks, wherein the tree structure learning network is constructed based on the spatial structure relation of the plurality of sampling positions. The accuracy of the prediction of fractional flow reserve can be improved.

title: Inpatient cost prediction method and device based on artificial intelligence and computer equipment
assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a hospital stay prediction method and device based on artificial intelligence and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and digital medical treatment. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, training to obtain a hospital hospitalization cost prediction model of an existing regional hospital according to hospital hospitalization medical data of the existing regional hospital; if the hospitalization medical data of the new regional target hospital does not accord with the data conditions which can be used for training to obtain the standard model, performing transfer learning processing based on the hospitalization cost prediction model of the existing regional hospital to obtain the hospitalization cost prediction model of the new regional target hospital, and further realizing the hospitalization cost required by the hospitalization treatment of the target user in the new regional target hospital. The application can improve the prediction accuracy of hospital hospitalization cost under the condition of limited hospital medical data. In addition, the application also relates to a blockchain technology, and hospitalized medical data can be stored in the blockchain to ensure data privacy and safety.

title: Device, process and computer program for detecting optical image data and for determining a position of a lateral limitation of a patient positioning device
abstract: Exemplary embodiments provide a device (10), a process and a computer program for detecting optical image data of a patient positioning device (100). The device (10) is configured to detect optical image data of a patient positioning device (100) and to determine a position of at least one lateral limitation (110) of the patient positioning device (100) based on the image data. The device (10) is configured to determine at first a position of art least one partial segment (120) of the patient positioning device (100) based on the image data, and to determine the position of the at least one lateral limitation (110) of the patient positioning device (100) based on the position of the at least one partial segment (120).

title: Full-mode medical image sequence grouping method based on deep learning physical sign structure
assignee: 复旦大学附属中山医院
abstract: The technology relates to the technical field of medical image information, in particular to a full-mode medical image sequence grouping method based on a deep learning sign structure, which comprises the following steps: acquiring medical image information; extracting information from the acquired medical image information; establishing a full-mode deep learning AI sequence matching system; performing sequence matching treatment; transmitting the processed medical image sequence group to a display unit; the display unit performs group display of the full-mode medical image sequence; according to the invention, the deep learning neural network is utilized, the human skeleton is accurately identified and segmented into relatively fixed local areas according to accurate anatomical information of the human CT and MR, the specific skeleton part is used for accurate human body position segmentation, and the accurate positioning is carried out according to the CT or MR images in the double modes of the molecular images, so that the accurate positioning is converted to the corresponding layers of the full-mode images, automatic accurate registration display is carried out, the diagnosis errors caused by the difference of technical levels are reduced, and meanwhile, the working efficiency of doctors is improved.

primary_assignee: 复旦大学附属中山医院

title: Method and device for generating medical knowledge representation
assignee: 北京富通东方科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method and an apparatus for generating a medical knowledge representation, wherein the method comprises: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a single-step path triple set and description text data of a head entity and a tail entity based on a medical knowledge map data set, obtaining initial description information of the entities based on the description text data of the entities and the single-step path triple set, storing the obtained initial description information of the entities in the single-step path triple set, obtaining a multi-hop path triple set corresponding to each single-step path triple, combining all the single-step path triples and the corresponding multi-hop path triples into a positive sample set, processing the positive sample set to obtain a negative sample set, inputting the positive sample set and the negative sample set into a neural network to train to obtain a medical knowledge representation learning model, and obtaining the medical knowledge representation learning model to input the entity to be processed and the tail entity to be processed to generate medical knowledge representation. Therefore, multi-step relation path information is added on the basis of the text information described by the fused entity, and semantic information expressed by knowledge is increased.

title: Wearable electronic device including heat dissipation structure
abstract: A wearable electronic device is provided. The wearable electronic device includes a housing including a first portion constituting a first outer surface of the wearable electronic device and a second portion constituting a second outer surface of the wearable electronic device, at least one electronic component positioned in an inner space of the housing and configured to emit heat, and multiple support structures which are at least partially positioned to correspond to the at least one electronic component between the first portion and the second portion, wherein a boundary part between the first portion and the second portion is at least partially positioned along a surface boundary between the first outer surface and the second outer surface and includes at least one opening, and an at least one distancing space between the multiple support structures is configured to communicate with an outer space of the housing through the at least one opening.

title: Intelligent decision-making method and system for blood donation
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of assistant decision making, and discloses an intelligent decision making method and system for blood donation, wherein the intelligent decision making method for blood donation comprises the following steps: acquiring transfusion related data of a patient needing transfusion as a historical user data set; obtaining original features from the historical user data set; training the original features by using a gradient lifting decision tree algorithm to obtain corresponding combined features or reconstructed new features; carrying out model training on the original features and the combined features or the new features; and determining the blood donation amount according to the current patient blood transfusion related information and the blood donation amount prediction model. The invention solves the problems that the uncompensated blood donation amount is unknown and the clinical blood use amount is difficult to predict during the relevant blood storage period, can accurately predict the blood transfusion amount of each patient so as to obtain the blood donation amount, can improve the success rate of patient treatment and reduce the death rate.

title: Machine learning techniques for optimized communication with users of a software application
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to methods and systems for optimized delivery of communications including content to users of a software application. The method also includes obtaining, by a customer engagement platform (CEP), a set of cohort selection criteria for identifying a user cohort to deliver the content; identifying, by a data analytics platform (DAP), the user cohort to communicate with in accordance with the set of cohort selection criteria; identifying, by the DAP, one or more communication configurations for communicating with one or more sub-groups within the user cohort; and to each user of the user cohort, transmitting one or more communications based on the content and a corresponding communication configuration for a sub-group that may include the corresponding user; and measuring engagement outcomes associated with usage of the corresponding one or more communication configurations in communication with each of the sub-groups.

title: Force-sensing joint tensioner
assignee: Smith & Nephew, Inc., Smith & Nephew Orthopaedics Ag, Smith & Nephew Asia Pacific Pte. Limited
abstract: A force-sensing joint tensioner assembly, surgical system, and method of use is provided. The joint tensioner assembly can include a housing that is configured to receive a fluid from a pump and a movable member that is configured to translate relative to the housing as the fluid is pumped into the housing. The tensioner and/or a surgical system including the tensioner can further include a pressure sensor configured to sense a pressure exerted by the movable member as the movable member translates and distracts the patient's joint. A surgical computer system can be configured to determine a distraction distance of the joint according to a volume of the fluid pumped into the joint tensioner assembly by the pump and/or determine a pressure exerted by the movable member according to the pressure sensor.
assignee_clean: smith nephew; smith nephew orthopaedics; smith nephew asia pacific pte

title: Methods and systems for securing an imaging system
abstract: Various methods and systems for securing imaging systems are provided. In one embodiment, a method for an imaging system comprises monitoring usage of the imaging system in real-time while a user is controlling the imaging system, detecting that the usage of the imaging system is an abnormal usage, and performing one or more corrective actions based on the abnormal usage. In this way, an imaging system may be secured from cyber-attacks that may attempt to maliciously execute in an abnormal context while appearing legitimate to typical security controls.

title: Cost balance decision method, insurance claim decision method, apparatus and equipment
assignee: 蚂蚁胜信(上海)信息技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification discloses a cost balance decision method, an insurance claim decision device and equipment, which are used for determining a target named entity and attributes of the target named entity contained in a voucher picture based on a plurality of deep learning models and the voucher picture carried in the request after a cost balance request aiming at a target cost balance product sent by a user is received; based on the target named entity and the attribute of the target named entity, constructing event information related to the service field corresponding to the target cost balance product; then constructing a plurality of decision factors based on the relevant business data of the user aiming at the target cost balance product and the event information; and finally, carrying out cost balance decision based on a target decision tree and the plurality of decision factors, wherein the target decision tree is constructed based on cost balance decision logic of the target cost balance product, and decision subtrees in the target decision tree carry out decision based on the decision factors.
assignee_clean: 蚂蚁胜信 上海 信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 蚂蚁胜信 上海 信息技术有限公司

title: Tissue drift correction method and device for three-dimensional model, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 华科精准（北京）医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a tissue drift correction method and device of a three-dimensional model, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional model based on the acquired medical image data, and extracting a plurality of mark points of a tissue structure in the skull in the three-dimensional model; acquiring spatial position information of a plurality of body surface feature points by using a tracking system, performing rigid registration with a three-dimensional model, and establishing a space-to-model conversion matrix; extracting a plurality of mark points of a tissue structure in the skull in the three-dimensional model, acquiring first space position information of the plurality of mark points, and matching second space position information of the plurality of mark points with the first space position information according to a conversion matrix; calculating the displacement relation between the intra-operation position and the pre-operation position of each mark point to obtain a non-rigid matching relation for drift correction of the three-dimensional model; and correcting the three-dimensional model by using the non-rigid matching relation. The technical scheme of the application can effectively solve the problem that tissue deformation causes three-dimensional digital model drift in operation.
assignee_clean: 华科精准 北京 医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 华科精准 北京 医疗科技有限公司

title: Method and device for classifying virtual activities of mobile users
abstract: A mobile computing device includes a processor, wherein the processor is to host a set of one or more applications. The processor is configured to receive a message from a first application of the hosted set of one or more applications, wherein the received message indicates a user action. The processor is configured to: determining whether the user action is present in a predetermined set of user actions; creating an intercepted message containing a copy of the received message when the user action exists in a predetermined set of user actions. The processor is configured to broadcast the interception message to one or more applications of the hosted set of applications, wherein the hosted set of applications is configured to receive the interception message.

title: Downstream tracking of content consumption
abstract: An example operation may include one or more of storing, within a blockchain, a request comprising an identifier of content and a value of a user who created the content, detecting consumption of a reusable instance of the content by a second user, designating fractional values of the content to the first and second users based on the detected consumption of the reusable instance, and storing, within the blockchain, a second request comprising an identifier of the reusable instance of the content, identifiers of the first and second users, and the designated fractional values of the content to the first and second users.

title: Systems and methods for illuminant-invariant model estimation
abstract: A method is described. The method includes determining normalized radiance of an image sequence based on a camera response function (CRF). The method also includes determining one or more reliability images of the image sequence based on a reliability function corresponding to the CRF. The method further includes extracting features based on the normalized radiance of the image sequence. The method additionally includes optimizing a model based on the extracted features and the reliability images.

title: Fundus image segmentation method based on deep information transfer network
abstract: The invention discloses a fundus image segmentation method based on a deep information transfer network, which is characterized in that a deep information extraction network is constructed, the deep information transfer network constructed by pre-processing fundus images is trained, a better network model is provided for fundus image segmentation, a video disc area of the fundus image is fitted, and the image segmentation precision is improved. According to the method, the pre-training network is used for initializing the coding layer, the network related to the image segmentation task requirement is obtained through training, and the decoding layer network module is adopted in the network, so that the segmentation precision is improved; the deep information transmission network module is combined with the feature map context extraction module to transmit the high-dimensional features of the feature map to the finally output prediction map, so that the decoding path information is less lost; the deep network of the coding layer adopts cavity convolution, the receptive field of the convolution kernel is enlarged under the condition of keeping parameters unchanged, and more comprehensive characteristic diagram information is extracted.

title: Hospital multi-stage medical index quality control method and system
assignee: 广州悦微信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a hospital multi-stage medical index quality control method and system. The system comprises a user authentication subsystem and a human-computer interaction interface. In response to a touch selection of a current user for a user service icon, activating the user service icon, the user service icon acquiring medical metric data from a plurality of application sources in communication therewith; the visual quality control analysis engine summarizes a plurality of groups of medical index data acquired by a plurality of different user service icons for quality control analysis. And displaying the multi-level association analysis result of the highlighted medical index data on the second device in a visualized mode in response to the visualization instruction. The number and range of the highlighted medical index data are less than the number and range of the plurality of sets of medical index data. The method comprises the step of carrying out visual quality control analysis on medical index data generated by a plurality of medical acquisition terminals within a preset monitoring range. The invention also provides electronic equipment for implementing the method. The invention can realize hierarchical active quality control and visual analysis of multi-level medical indexes.
assignee_clean: 广州悦微信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 广州悦微信息技术有限公司

title: Clustering data regarding health care providers
abstract: Techniques and architectures for clustering health care providers based on data regarding services that have previously been provided by health care providers are described herein. For example, the techniques and architectures may receive data from devices of health care providers regarding services that have been provided by the health care providers to patients. The techniques and architectures may perform various machine learning techniques, including clustering, to categorize health care providers into multiple clusters based on the services that were provided. Health care providers that lie within a cluster may be associated with a category of the cluster. While health care providers that lie outside a cluster, and have designated themselves as being associated with or are otherwise associated with a practice area that is associated with the cluster, may be flagged as potentially practicing outside an area that is designated by or otherwise associated with the health care providers.

title: Dynamic candidate expectation prediction
abstract: A computer system may receive a first set of bundled information. The computer system may have a processor and a memory storing one or more natural language processing modules. The computer system, using a natural language processing module, may ingest the first set of bundled information. The computer system may generate a first set and a second set of categories. The computer system may generate one or more models. The computer system may receive a set of input characteristics. The computer system may select a model based on the input characteristics. The computer system may rank one or more correlations using the selected model. The computer system may output a display of the one or more correlations on a graphical user interface.

title: Question bank generating method, server and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 深圳壹账通智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a question bank generating method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the description information of the recruitment position of the recruitment website; converting the job description information into a factual sentence with complete information; generating an industry problem by the fact sentence according to a problem generation template; and storing the industry problems according to industry classification to generate question banks of different industries. The invention also provides a server and a computer readable storage medium. The question bank generating method, the server and the computer readable storage medium provided by the invention automatically generate the industry problems according to the description information of the recruitment position, and store the industry problems according to the industry classification, thereby saving the labor.
assignee_clean: 深圳壹账通智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳壹账通智能科技有限公司

title: System and method for directives based mechanism to orchestrate secure communications in multi-cloud distributed systems
abstract: A directive based access system and method manage access permissions in systems. In one embodiment, the directive based access system and method may be used to orchestrate effective secure access control and communications in multi-cloud distributed systems. In one implementation, the directive based access system and method may include a lineage traceability enforcement engine that uses a lineage traceability. The directive based access system and method may also be implemented using other mechanisms such as blockchain based Hyperledger based system.

title: Hub for automated recovery after a critical event in shared mobility services
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for using a hub to automate recovery after a critical event during shared mobility services. One method may include, receiving, by a computing device and from a user device, a notification of a critical event during a shared mobility service; receiving natural language input associated with a first aspect of the critical event; parsing the natural language input and identifying a first value corresponding to the first aspect; determining, based on the first value, a second aspect (e.g., severity of damage) of the critical event; requesting the user device to send images of the second aspect; after receiving the images, determining a second value corresponding to the second aspect; generating, by the computing device and via a user interface of the user device, a representation of the critical event; receiving, from the user device, an approval of the representation; and generating a damage assessment.

title: Computer-assisted surgical planning
abstract: A method comprises obtaining, by a computing system, one or more surgeon preference parameters that specify values of one or more surgical parameters, wherein the surgical parameters include one or more positioning parameters for a glenoid implant to be attached to a glenoid fossa of a patient during a surgery; determining, by the computing system, based on one or more anatomic parameters of the patient and the surgeon preference parameters, one or more suggested surgical options, each of the surgical options corresponding to a. different combination of the positioning parameters for the glenoid implant and types of glenoid implant; and outputting, by the computing system, for display, the one or more suggested surgical options.

title: Methods and systems for target localization and DBS therapy
abstract: Methods and systems are described for detecting if a stimulation lead implanted in a patient's brain has moved. Lead movement occurring between a first time and a second time may be determined by comparing features extracted from evoked potentials recorded at the two times. The disclosed methods and systems are particularly useful for determining if a stimulation lead has moved between the time it was implanted in the patient's brain and the time that stimulation parameters are being optimized. Lead movement during implantation, during parameter optimization, and during or between other lead optimization processes may be determined as well.

title: Hospitalization cost prediction method and device based on knowledge graph and computer equipment
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a hospital stay prediction method, a hospital stay prediction device and computer equipment based on a knowledge graph, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and can solve the technical problems of large prediction workload and low accuracy existing in the existing hospital stay prediction mode. Comprising the following steps: acquiring a medical knowledge graph, and performing characterization learning on the medical knowledge graph by utilizing a graph embedding algorithm to obtain node characterization vectors of all knowledge graph nodes; generating a first feature vector of the sample inpatient about the historical medical data according to the node characterization vector, and training an inpatient prediction model by utilizing the first feature vector and the historical expense data in the historical medical data; obtaining target diagnosis data of a target patient in a first time period, generating a second feature vector of the target diagnosis data according to the node characterization vector, inputting the second feature vector into a trained hospitalization cost prediction model, and obtaining a hospitalization cost prediction result of the target patient in a second time period.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Reconstruction of magnetic-resonance datasets using machine learning
assignee: Siemens Healthcare Gmbh, The General Hospital Corporation
abstract: A method includes determining an initial magnetic resonance imaging, MRI, dataset (201) in image domain based on an initial reconstruction of MRI measurement data obtained using an undersampling scheme (400); and determining patches (231-233) of the initial MRI dataset (201) in accordance with a patching scheme, the patching scheme depending on the undersampling scheme (400); and, for each one of the patches (231-233): applying a machine-learned algorithm to obtain a respective patch (231-233) of a reconstructed MRI dataset, the machine-learned algorithm depending on the undersampling scheme (400); and combining the patches (231-233) of the reconstructed MRI dataset.

title: Real-time and adaptive data mining
abstract: A method of analyzing data is presented. The method includes generating a query based on a topic of interest, expanding search terms of the query, executing the query on one or more data sources, monitoring a specific data source selected from the one or more data sources. The monitoring is performed to monitor for matches to the query.

title: Adaptive analytical behavioral and health assistant system and related method of use
abstract: An adaptive analytical behavioral health assistant may obtain blood pressure measurements from a user, execute a model of a physiological system generic to any user to generate notifications for the user, generate a modified model specific to a physiological system of the user based on the received blood pressure measurements, execute the modified model to generate personalized notifications, generate an updated modified model, at least once, based on the modified model and additional blood pressure measurements, and output the notifications including adjusting a timing of obtaining the blood pressure measurements, the personalized notifications, and the updated personalized notifications to the user.

title: Digital twin model-based fixed correction and invisible correction hybrid treatment system
assignee: 上海交通大学医学院附属第九人民医院
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of oral cavity digitization, and particularly discloses a digital twin model-based fixed correction and invisible correction hybrid treatment system, which comprises a data acquisition module, a control module and a control module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring dental jaw face neck soft and hard tissue image data and the like of a patient; the data processing module is used for processing the acquired images and data; the digital twin module is used for integrating the data acquisition information, the processing information and the data scanning information uniformly, and constructing a digital twin model and carrying out operation processing; the machine learning module is used for collecting data processing and scheme design of mixed treatment of fixed correction and invisible correction; the scheme selection module is used for selecting fixed correction and/or invisible correction schemes; the correction effect prediction module is used for outputting the change condition of the soft and hard tissues after the teeth are corrected; and the scheme revising module revises the preferred treatment scheme according to the predicted correction effect. The system of the invention fully combines the advantages of different correction appliances and can greatly shorten the treatment time.
assignee_clean: 上海交通大学医学院附属第九人民医院
primary_assignee: 上海交通大学医学院附属第九人民医院

title: System and method for robotic patient synthesis
assignee: University Of Notre Dame Du Lac
abstract: Some embodiments of the invention include a robotic patient system including a computer system including a processor and a coupled sensor, and a control system configured to receive control data. The robotic patient system also includes a synthetic patient robot including a feature detector and action selector configured to actuate the robot based at least in part on the control data. Some further embodiments of the invention include a computer-implemented method of providing a robotic synthetic patient by providing a synthetic patient robot, configuring a control system to receive control data, extracting and converting a feature from the control data, and converting to an actuator command to move the robotic patient system. Some embodiments include a robot including a computer system including a processor, a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium, and a control system configured to be coupled to a source of control data to control the robot substantially autonomously.
assignee_clean: university of notre dame du lac
primary_assignee: university of notre dame du lac

title: Advanced cardiac waveform analytics
abstract: This disclosure describes systems and methods for electrocardiographic waveform analysis, data presentation and actionable advisory generation. Electrocardiographic waveform data can be received from a wearable device associated with a patient. A mathematical analysis can be performed on the electrocardiographic waveform data to provide cardiac analytics. A visualization of the cardiac analytics on a dashboard display can be generated. A value can be based on a comparison of the cardiac analytics to at least one baseline value for the patient; and a decision of whether or not to generate an actionable advisory for the electrocardiographic waveform data can be made based on the value. When the actionable advisory is generated, the actionable advisory is sent to one or more medical professionals, where it can be modified, and displayed with the visualization of the cardiac analytics.

title: Fault category detection method and system for medical instrument based on deep learning
abstract: The application belongs to the field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a fault class detection method and system of a medical instrument based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a vibration signal of the medical instrument, and preprocessing the vibration signal; performing interpolation operation on the preprocessed signals; adding random disturbance into the interpolation signal to obtain a first supplementary signal; randomly oversampling the vibration signal to generate a second supplemental signal; combining the second supplementary signal with the vibration signal to obtain an expanded signal; converting the expansion signal into a fault image, inputting the fault image into a multi-layer classification model for fault classification, and obtaining the fault category of the medical instrument; the method can simulate noise and variation in an actual vibration signal by adding random disturbance to the interpolation signal, and enhance the anti-interference capability of data. The first complementary signals are randomly oversampled, so that the number of signals of different types of medical instrument fault categories can be balanced, and the accuracy of fault classification of the medical instrument is improved.

title: Security surveillance and entry management system
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) entry management (EM) security system includes a camera, a microphone, a motion detector, a speaker, a software platform and a smart electronic device. The smart electronic device is operable to interface with the software platform device to provide verification, receive alerts, and receive images, video and/or audio. The smart electronic device include one or more of a smart wearable device including smart watches, smart glasses, virtual reality devices, and augmented reality devices.

title: Rapid identification method for piling and drilling behaviors in protected area
assignee: 上海同岩土木工程科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for quickly identifying piling and drilling behaviors in a protected area, which mainly solves the problems that piling and drilling behaviors in ground protected areas of underground projects such as tunnels, pipe galleries and the like are not timely and comprehensively monitored. The technical scheme of the invention comprises a video image and vibration data acquisition system in a monitoring area of a protection area, and further comprises the following steps: s1, semi-automatically defining the boundary of the protection area based on the video image and the fixed image characteristic area; s2, dynamically monitoring the moving object in the area through an image target detection algorithm based on the video image, and carrying out preliminary judgment on piling and drilling machine invasion; s3, rapidly identifying the piling and drilling operation behaviors in the protected area based on the vibration signals; s4, comprehensively judging and positioning piling and drilling operation behaviors based on the video images and the vibration signals; s5, remotely sending alarm information of piling and drilling behaviors and identifying self-adaptive learning evolution by a monitoring point; s6, repeating the step S1 (3), the step S2, the step S3, the step S4 and the step S5, and realizing continuous monitoring of pile driving and drilling behaviors in the protected area.
assignee_clean: 上海同岩土木工程科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海同岩土木工程科技股份有限公司

title: Method and device for determining result values on the basis of a skeletal medical imaging recording
abstract: A method is for determining result values based upon a skeletal medical imaging recording. In an embodiment, the method includes providing a skeletal medical imaging recording; automatically determining reference points in the image recording; and calculating an orthopedic result value based at least upon a spacing between two reference points and/or upon an angle defined by reference points. A corresponding device, a corresponding diagnostic station for the assessment of a skeletal medical imaging recording and a corresponding medical imaging system also are disclosed in embodiments.

title: Methods and systems for optimizing therapy using stimulation mimicking natural seizures
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices for automatic generation of a stimulation therapy that mimics electrographic activity in the brain at natural seizure termination define a stimulation therapy to be generated by an implanted component of a medical device system and delivered to a subject through identifying data characterizing a patient's seizures, especially at termination. A machine learning model identifies the seizures or seizure types from which to establish a canonical seizure or seizure type, and an algorithm translates the canonical seizure or seizure type into data that can be used to characterize a stimulation therapy. The systems, methods, and devices, include those configured to deliver the stimulation therapy that emulates the canonical seizure or seizure type when the seizure is detected, with the aim of terminating the seizure sooner than it would terminate without intervention.

title: Medical image super-resolution method based on generation countermeasure network improvement
abstract: A medical image super-resolution method based on generation countermeasure network improvement obtains a high-resolution medical image data set which is divided into a training data set and a testing data set; down-sampling the high-resolution medical image data set to obtain a low-resolution medical image data set; replacing common convolution with cavity convolution in a residual block of a generator module of the SRGAN to obtain a first network structure model; removing the batch normalization layer of the generator module of the first network structure model to obtain a second network structure model; improving the perception loss function of the SRGAN by using the average structure similarity perception loss function to obtain a structure perception loss function; taking the high-resolution training data set and the low-resolution training data set as the input of a second network structure model, and training the second network structure model by using a structure perception loss function; and verifying the trained second network structure model by using the high-resolution test data set and the low-resolution test data set to complete the medical image super-resolution.

title: Modes, control and applications of recommendations auto-consumption
abstract: A method includes acts for filtering auto consumption recommendations and auto consumption actions. The method includes receiving from a recommendation system, a recommendation of an asset for consumption. The asset for consumption is evaluated in the context of one or more filter rules regarding auto consumption. The filter rules are configured to filter recommended assets from being consumed when certain criteria are met or to permit recommended assets to be consumed when certain criteria are met. As a result, the method includes identifying one or more constraints on how recommended asset should be consumed. The method further includes filtering consumption of the recommended asset based on the one or more constraints.

title: Multi-channel sensing system with embedded processing
abstract: System and method for monitoring objects of interest including persons in an indoor or outdoor scene with high accuracy, strong privacy protection, high security, low volume data transmission and storage. The system includes: an embedded sensing device with multiple sensors and microprocessor(s) with built-in artificial intelligence as an end unit with parametric outputs, a controller that aggregate parametric outputs from multiple end units with local intelligence and configurable control outputs, and an optional gateway that aggregates multiple controllers output and connect with the network, cloud and/or human interface. The embedded sensing devices can capture data of the scene through multiple sensors with different functions and technologies; detect and track the objects of interest including persons; analyze features of the objects of interest; detect event and behavior associated with the detected objects or persons of interest based on the features and/or events; and only provide these parametric outputs to controller.

title: Camera module and electronic device including the same
abstract: An electronic device according to an embodiment of the disclosure includes: a housing and a camera module, at least part of which is disposed in the housing. The camera module includes a camera housing, a sensor assembly including an image sensor and is fixed to the camera housing, and a lens unit, at least part of which is accommodated in a space formed by the camera housing and the sensor assembly, the lens unit being configured such that all or part of the lens unit moves relative to the camera housing and the sensor assembly.
