title: Sepsis early warning device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application discloses early warning device, equipment and medium of sepsis blood disease includes: the training module is used for training a prediction model by using the sample index data provided with the sepsis label and the deviation label; the calculation module is used for calculating the correlation values of the various types of disease data and the sepsis blood, and calculating the time thresholds corresponding to the various types of disease data; the acquisition module is used for acquiring current index data and historical index data of a target user; the interpolation module is used for determining the type of disease data corresponding to the missing value in the current index data, selecting target disease data meeting the requirement of a time threshold from the historical index data as the missing value according to the principle of proximity, and obtaining updated current index data; the prediction module is used for inputting the updated current index data and the deviation labels respectively corresponding to the current disease data in the updated current index data into the prediction model to obtain a prediction result; and the display is used for displaying the prediction result.

title: Deformation field extraction method, registration method and registration device for medical image insensitive to artifacts
abstract: The invention discloses an image deformation field extraction method insensitive to artifact, which comprises the following steps: constructing an artifact image and an artifact-free image at each sampling moment, wherein the artifact images at any two moments form an artifact image pair, the artifact-free images form an artifact-free image pair, and 1 training sample is formed; constructing an extraction model comprising an artifact removal module and a deformation field extraction module based on a deep neural network; taking a deformation field extracted according to an artifact image pair and a deformation field extracted according to an artifact-free image pair as learning targets, simultaneously taking an image obtained by acting on an image at the previous moment by the extracted deformation field and an image at the later moment as learning targets, and optimizing model parameters by utilizing a training sample pair to extract a model; the extraction model with optimized parameters is used for extracting the deformation field of the image pair, and the method improves the extraction accuracy of the image deformation field. The registration method and the registration device for the medical images are also disclosed, the registration is carried out according to the extracted deformation field, and the registration accuracy is improved.

title: Method and device for positioning focus
assignee: 北京推想科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a method and a device for positioning a focus, which are used for detecting the position parameters of a vertebra from a medical image and determining the intersection point of an extension line of the vertebra and the edge of a trunk in the medical image. And determining the boundary of the trunk in the medical image in the front-back direction according to a target vertical line of the connecting line of the central point and the intersection point. And determining the region where the focus is located according to the boundary. Based on the physiological structure characteristics of the spine, the intersection point of the extension line of the spine and the edge of the trunk is determined, the connecting line of the central point of the region occupied by the spine and the intersection point and the perpendicular line of the connecting line are further determined, so that the boundary lines of different regions are determined, and the purpose of determining the region where the focus is located according to the boundary lines is achieved.

title: Question-answering model construction method and project question-answering method
assignee: 浙江阿里巴巴机器人有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a question-answering model construction method and an item question-answering method, comprising the following steps: receiving a model construction instruction aiming at a project question-answer model, wherein the model construction instruction carries project knowledge information; and constructing a project question-answer model corresponding to the project knowledge information according to the project knowledge information and the data processing model, wherein the data processing model is obtained by training sample data consisting of structured data, and the sample data comprises at least one of knowledge dialogue data, flow planning data and code data. The data processing model is obtained through training of various structured sample data, and then the project question-answer model is built through project knowledge information and the data processing model, so that accuracy of the project question-answer model in application of complex scenes is improved.

title: System and method for medical imaging
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure directs to a system and method for automated positioning of a subject. The method may include obtaining a scout image of a subject when the subject is positioned at a first position in an apparatus. The method may also include determining location information of a reference structure of the subject based on the scout image. The method may also include determining an offset between the first position of the subject relative to a characteristic point of the apparatus according to the location information of the reference structure. The method may further include moving the subject to a second position based on the offset. The method may still further include performing, using the apparatus, a procedure relating to a target structure of the subject located at the second position.

title: Detecting and bucketing sparse indicators for communication generation
abstract: Techniques, systems, and products for analyzing sparse indicators and generating communications based on bucketing of sparse indicators are disclosed.

title: Body joystick for interacting with virtual reality or mixed reality machines or software applications with brainwave entrainment
abstract: A system and method for integration of body movement computer gaming control and brainwave entrainment comprising an attachment device configured to be attached to a portion of a user's body, a sensor attached to or integrated into the attachment device for detecting movement, a stimulation transducer for providing brainwave entrainment therapy, and a tether and actuator for providing feedback to the user about interactions with the virtual or mixed-reality machines or software applications.

title: Methods of diagnosing and treating patients with cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods for predicting the risk of recurrence and/or metastasis, or both in primary cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC).

title: Oxygen mask respirometer
abstract: Devices, systems, and methods for monitoring respiration using surface temperature, humidity, air pressure, carbon dioxide gas sensors, pulse oximetry sensors and electromyography sensors, and/or acceleration sensors to obtain information related to respiration rate (RR), exhalation/inhalation strength, exhalation/inhalation volume, exhalation/inhalation acceleration, and/or exhalation/inhalation regularity.

title: Artificial intelligence system with unsupervised model training for entity-pair relationship analysis
abstract: Respective labels are generated automatically for a plurality of record pairs, with a label for a given pair indicating a relationship detected between the records of the pair. One or more machine learning models are trained using the labeled record pairs. The trained versions of the models are stored.

title: Method and arrangement for identifying similar pre-stored medical datasets
abstract: Similar pre-stored medical datasets are identified by comparison with a current case dataset. A current case dataset is provided and includes radiological data of a patient. A number of pre-stored medical datasets each including radiological data of other patients are provided. Each case dataset is evaluated according to a predefined AI-based method to obtain a number of definitive features for that case dataset. The definitive features of the current case dataset are compared with the definitive features of each pre-stored medical dataset to identify a number of pre-stored medical datasets most similar to the current case dataset. The identified number of most similar pre-stored medical datasets are output.

title: Lymph node metastasis prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and digital medical treatment, and discloses a lymph node metastasis prediction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an organ segmentation image by segmenting the acquired medical image; dividing the organ segmentation image according to a combined threshold value of the region growth calculated by the organ segmentation image and a preset region growth algorithm to obtain a target organ image, inputting FASTER RCNN a model, and determining a suspected lymph node image in the image based on the model and pixel points of the image; and constructing a lymph node detection model, preprocessing a suspected lymph node image, inputting the obtained target lymph node image into a lymph node metastasis prediction model, predicting metastasis of the lymph node, and providing visual data for evaluating whether the pancreatic ductal cancer lymph node metastasizes. The invention predicts whether the lymph nodes metastasize or not through the classification network, thereby providing visual data support for evaluating whether the symptoms of the patient metastasize or not according to the prediction result.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Model training method and device, image processing method and device, and medium
abstract: The present disclosure provides a model training method, comprising: acquiring a plurality of sample images, wherein any of the plurality of sample images comprises: three-dimensional PET images of a given tumor with known genotypes. Genotype information of either sample image is acquired. Then, a feature set of any sample image is determined. Training an initial model based on the genotype information and the feature set of each of the plurality of acquired sample images to obtain a target model, wherein the target model is used for determining: genotype information about three-dimensional PET images of a given tumor for which the genotype is unknown. The disclosure also provides a model training device, an image processing method and device, and a storage medium.

title: Biometric data capturing and analysis using a hybrid sensing systems
abstract: Apparatuses and methods detect a health condition of a user that may be assessed from a thermal sensor signal and/or radar sensor signal. One or more resultant biometric vectors may be generated from biometric vectors based on the thermal and radar signals, where the resultant biometric vectors contain resultant information about one or more biometric features for a user. Hazard information about the user is obtained from the one or more resultant biometric vectors, where the hazard information is indicative of a health event for the user. Consequently, an appropriate action on behalf of the user may be performed to ameliorate the health condition. The one or more resultant biometric vectors may include additional biometric features and/or a time sequence of the resultant biometric vectors to enhance hazard prediction. Moreover, the apparatuses and methods may support the user in different settings including a home, business, or vehicle.

title: Automatic evaluation system and method for lung CT image quality
assignee: 杭州健培科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an end-to-end automatic evaluation system and an end-to-end automatic evaluation method for lung CT image quality, which can acquire artifacts in CT images with high accuracy and high efficiency, evaluate the CT images objectively and fairly, facilitate the use and expansion of CT image quality control of hospitals and physical examination institutions, and creatively realize CT image body position discrimination and assist image quality inspection personnel in judging whether protection detection is in place or not.
assignee_clean: 杭州健培科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州健培科技有限公司

title: Scheduling in a repetitive RF environment
abstract: Many environmental or operating conditions create repetitive Radio Frequency (RF) interference conditions caused by repetitive mechanical or electrical activity. Such activity may create oscillations in the RF conditions between the MTC UE and the serving base station. Aspects of the present invention relate to optimizing communications based on a periodicity of repeated mechanical or electrical activity detected at a UE by monitoring oscillations of at least one RF condition between an MTC UE and a base station, and scheduling communications between the UE and a network during periods associated with favorable radio conditions, thereby improving data efficiency and battery life.

title: Electronic device for supporting artificial intelligence agent services to talk to users
abstract: An electronic device and method are provided. The method includes identifying a speech section of a user and a speech section of a neighbor in a received audio signal, identifying a user utterance in the speech section of the user and a neighbor answer to the user utterance in the speech section of the neighbor, obtaining preference information associated with the user utterance, giving a first reliability to the neighbor answer and a second reliability to an agent answer of an artificial intelligence agent generated in response to the user utterance, based on the preference information, not responding to the user utterance when the second reliability is lower than the first reliability, and outputting the agent answer when the second reliability is equal to or higher than the first reliability.

title: Medical question-answer generating system based on lightweight Actor-Critic generating type confrontation network
abstract: The invention discloses a medical question-answer generating system based on a lightweight Actor-Critic generating type confrontation network, which comprises a generator and a discriminator with a lightweight Actor-Critic structure, wherein after a medical problem proposed by a user is input into the system, the generator generates a medical diagnosis scheme in a coding-decoding mode; the known medical question-answer text is used as a data set and input into a generator, pre-training is carried out by adopting a maximum likelihood estimation method, then data distribution generated by the pre-trained generator is used as a false sample, and the known data is used as a true sample and input into a discriminator network for pre-training. After pre-training the generator and the discriminator, the multiplexing generator is an Actor network, a Critic network with a long-term and short-term memory network is constructed, the Actor-Critic algorithm is adopted to update the weight parameters of the generator network, the generator network and the discriminator are subjected to antagonistic training, and meanwhile, the network is subjected to light weight processing by adopting a multi-path multi-layer Actor and Critic network light weight method based on the group MCP regular term.

title: Systems and methods for computationally efficient non-invasive blood quality measurement
abstract: In some embodiments, a system comprises a wearable member configured to receive first energy, generate first signals, select a first subset of the time series data, determine a standard deviation indicating a quality at a low percentile of values associated with first windows of the time series data and a high percentile of values associated with the first windows of the time series data, the signal assessment threshold being including at least the values of the lower percentile, receive second energy, generate second signals containing second time series data from the second energy, select a second subset of the time series data to assess, compare all or part of the second signals to the signal assessment threshold, and if all or part of the second signals include the second time series data that is within the values of the lower percentile, then remove the second signals from further processing.

title: Optimized real peak detection in cyclic biological data signals
abstract: A method of real peak detection includes optimizing a scoring function using training signals with known peaks and known features. The method includes receiving an input signal measured from a mobile sensor and representative of a cyclic biological process. The method includes filtering the input signal to remove low and high frequency noise. The method includes identifying candidate peaks and troughs within a selected time range of the input signal. The method includes extracting a feature that describes properties of the two or more candidate peaks. The method includes scoring the candidate peaks using the scoring function, selecting a real peak as the candidate peak with the highest score, and generating a biologic interval data set with the real peak and another peak that is representative of health markers. The method includes assessing a condition of the patient based on the biologic interval data set.

title: Determining a complexity value of a stenosis or a section of a vessel
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for evaluating the complexity of a stenosis or a section of a vessel. At least one image of the stenosis or the section of the vessel is provided. A geometrical feature value of the stenosis and/or or the section of the vessel is identified from the at least one image. At least one intensity feature value is determined based on a grey level intensity of the stenosis or the section of the vessel from the at least one image. A complexity value relating to the geometrical complexity of the stenosis or the section of the vessel is calculated as a function of the at least one geometrical feature value and the at least one intensity feature value of the stenosis or the section of the vessel.

title: Secure medical alert and medical referral delivery using a cloud computing server in an online/offline mode
abstract: A method for providing secure medical alerts includes executing, using a mobile healthcare worker application executing on a mobile healthcare worker device, a Health Level 7 (HL7) compliant protocol to retrieve medical profiles from a cloud computing server. Using the mobile healthcare worker application, a medical profile of a person (e.g., child or child's mother) is identified from the medical profiles when the mobile healthcare worker device is disconnected from the cloud computing server. The identifying includes reading, using a quick response (QR) code scanner, a QR code of an immunization document of the person, or capturing, using a biometric sensor, biometric data of the person. Using the medical profile of the person, an alert is generated indicating a medical deadline for the person on a graphical user interface of the mobile healthcare worker device when the mobile healthcare worker device is disconnected from the cloud computing server.

title: System and method for multi-microphone automated clinical documentation
abstract: A method, computer program product, and computing system for receiving audio encounter information from a microphone array. Speech activity within one or more portions of the audio encounter information may be identified based upon, at least in part, a correlation among the audio encounter information received from the microphone array. Location information for the one or more portions of the audio encounter information may be determined based upon, at least in part, the correlation among the signals received by each microphone of the microphone array. The one or more portions of the audio encounter information may be labeled with the speech activity and the location information.

title: System and method for prostate treatment under local anesthesia
abstract: A system and method for prostate cancer treatment under local anesthesia includes creating a superficial skin and subcutaneous block in a perineal area of a patient by administering a first anesthetizing agent; creating a deep nerve block under ultrasound guidance by administering a second anesthetizing agent, the second anesthetizing agent infiltrating cavernosal nerve bundle tissue and periprostatic space; and ablating prostate tissue. The office-based method, statistical models and computer generated treatment plans identify and ablate prostate tissue containing cancer through or via the perineum while preserving prostate function, and critical anatomical structures. Multiple technologies are integrated and processed to deliver a safe treatment procedure, under local anesthesia by integrating the information of magnetic resonance imaging and planning the ablative treatment using algorithms that ensure maximal precision in both killing cancerous tissue and preserving healthy tissue along with its corresponding function.

title: Quantitative elastography with tracked 2D ultrasound transducers
abstract: A method is described for acquiring 3D quantitative ultrasound elastography volumes. A 2D ultrasound transducer scans a volume of tissue through which shear waves are created using an external vibration source, the synchronized measurement of tissue motion within the plane of the ultrasound transducer with the measurement of the transducer location in space, the reconstruction of tissue displacements and/or tissue velocities in time and space over a volume from this synchronized measurement, and the computation of one or several mechanical properties of tissue from this volumetric measurement of displacements. The tissue motion in the plane of the transducer may be measured at a high effective frame rate in the axial direction of the transducer, or in the axial and lateral directions of the transducer. The tissue displacements and/or tissue velocities over the measured volume may be interpolated over a regular grid in order to facilitate computation of mechanical properties.

title: Automated refinement of augmented reality virtual object annotations
abstract: Mechanisms are provided for generating an augmented reality representation of a real-world environment. An augmented reality (AR) system receives a captured digital image of the real-world environment and generates an initial estimate of a candidate point specifying an estimated location of an annotation point of a virtual object model within the captured digital image of the real-world environment. An accuracy of the initial estimate is calculated based on a function of characteristics of the annotation point and a function of characteristics of the candidate point and, in response to the evaluation of accuracy indicating that the initial estimate is not accurate, an annotation point location refinement operation is performed to generate a refined candidate point for aligning the annotation point with the captured digital image of the real-world environment. An AR representation of the real-world environment is generated based on the refined candidate point.

title: Method and apparatus for singles spectrum estimation and for dead-time correction in positron emission tomography (PET)
abstract: A method and apparatus is provided to perform dead-time correction in a positron emission tomography (PET) by estimating a full singles spectrum using a scatter model. The scatter model can use a Monte Carlo method, a radiation transfer equation method, an artificial neural network, or an analytical expression. The scatter model simulates scatter based on an emission image/map and an attenuation image/map to estimate Compton scattering. In the full singles spectrum, the singles counts with energies less than 511 keV are determined from the simulated scatter. The attenuation image can be generated based on X-ray computed tomography or based on applying a joint-estimation to PET data.

title: Rationally-designed synthetic peptide shuttle agents for delivering polypeptide cargos from an extracellular space to the cytosol and/or nucleus of a target eukaryotic cell, uses thereof, methods and kits relating to same
abstract: The present description relates to methods for delivering polypeptide cargos from an extracellular space to the cytosol and/or nucleus of a target eukaryotic cell. The methods involve contacting the cell with the polypeptide cargo in the presence of a peptide shuttle agent at a concentration sufficient to increase the polypeptide cargo's transduction efficiency. Also described here are parameters that may be used in the rational design of such synthetic peptide shuttle agents, peptide shuttle agents that satisfy one or more of these design parameters, as well as methods and compositions relating to the use of the synthetic peptide shuttle agents for delivery of a variety of polypeptide cargos (such as transcription factors, antibodies, CRISPR-associated nucleases and functional genome editing complexes) from an extracellular space to the cytosol and/or nucleus of target eukaryotic cells. Applications and targets for genome-editing NK cells for improved immunotherapy are also described.

title: Robot
abstract: Provided is a robot. The robot includes a main body in which an opening portion is defined in a top surface thereof, a seat configured to cover an upper side of the opening portion, a traveling wheel protruding downward from a bottom surface of the main body, a backrest connected to the seat, an opening defined in a front surface of the main body, a foot supporter protruding forward from the main body through the opening, and a pair of arm supporters connected to both sides of the seat, respectively.

title: Neuron learning type integrated circuit device using a plurality of synapses, a soma, transistors, a zener diode, and condensers
abstract: According to one embodiment, a neuron learning type integrated circuit device includes neuron cell units. Each of the neuron cell units includes synapse circuit units, and a soma circuit unit connected to the synapse circuit units. Each of the synapse circuit units includes a first transistor including a first terminal, a second terminal, and a first control terminal, a second transistor including a third terminal, a fourth terminal, and a second control terminal, a first condenser, one end of the first condenser being connected between the second and third terminals, and a control line connected to the first and second control terminals. The soma circuit unit includes a Zener diode including an input terminal and an output terminal, the input terminal being connected to the fourth terminal, and a second condenser, one end of the second condenser being connected between the fourth terminal and the input terminal.

title: Password semantic analysis pipeline
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods, systems, processes, and machine learning paradigms to implement a password semantic analysis pipeline. A password semantic analysis pipeline model is trained according to one or more machine learning techniques to at least (a) determine, based on given characteristics data of a given network environment, whether each of several tokens that are chunked portions of a data structure input as a password in an application is a known syntax type or a recognized entity, (b) generate, using the password semantic analysis pipeline model, a password strength score that is a combination of a confidence score determined for each of the plurality of tokens and a weight factor assigned to the known syntax type or the recognized entity, (c) apply the password strength score to the data structure input as the password in the application, and (d) provide an output to the application indicating whether the data structure input as the password is acceptable or unacceptable for continued access to the application.

title: Grammar dependent tactile pattern invocation
assignee: University Of Central Florida Research Foundation, Inc.
abstract: A system for translating text streams of alphanumeric characters into preconfigured, haptic output. Text strings are parsed against a grammar index to locate assigned haptic or vibratory output. This may include speech-to-text, chat messaging, or text arrays of any kind. When a match is located, a standardized haptic output pattern is invoked through a haptic device. A device affordance module adapts the haptic output pattern to the capabilities of the target haptic device.
assignee_clean: university of central florida research foundation
primary_assignee: university of central florida research foundation

title: Automatic lumbar vertebra positioning method based on CT sequence image
abstract: The invention discloses a lumbar vertebra automatic positioning method based on CT sequence images, which is a common research object for clinically measuring bone density and provides a lumbar vertebra automatic positioning method based on CT sequence images, wherein a transverse CT sequence image is loaded firstly, DICOM original data is preprocessed, a bone enhanced coronal map is reconstructed in three dimensions, then thoracic vertebra T12 is automatically matched based on a multi-scale template matching method, and a CT initial serial number n matched with the thoracic vertebra T12 is extracted 0 (ii) a Training a vertebra segmentation model based on the transverse position CT image based on a deep learning network; n is to be 0 As an initial serial number, performing lumbar vertebrae segmentation on the transverse position image by using a trained model and storing a segmentation result; and finally, separating the intervertebral disc and the vertebral body based on the pixel sum of the segmentation result of the lumbar vertebrae of the transverse position image, and extracting the CT serial number interval corresponding to each lumbar vertebrae.

title: Method and system for identifying lung lesions
assignee: 中国人民解放军陆军军医大学第一附属医院, 重庆知见生命科技有限公司, 北京知见生命科技有限公司, 任菲
abstract: The invention provides a lung lesion recognition method and a lung lesion recognition system. The ground glass region and the bronchi expansion region in the lung medical image are detected through a target detection and example segmentation algorithm, so that the method is used for identifying lung lesions. The method extracts basic visual features of the lung medical image by using a multi-scale multi-depth convolutional neural network structure, and fuses features with different scales and depths through a feature pyramid network. Features of regions that are likely to be targets are extracted by the lesion candidate region identification network while useless background information is filtered out. And then the extracted target region features are subjected to classification head network, detection head network and segmentation head network to obtain detection segmentation results, and finally final prediction results are obtained through non-maximum suppression post-processing. The whole network structure adopts an end-to-end multitasking model, so that the network can effectively learn the characteristic information of medical images, and the robustness and generalization capability of an algorithm are enhanced.

title: Radiotherapy dose prediction method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a radiotherapy dose prediction method, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing, namely establishing a patient phantom according to a medical image of a patient; calculating a dose distribution H of radioactive particles in a phantom of the patient using a first calculation of a radiotherapeutic dose; obtaining the dose distribution L of radioactive particles in a patient phantom by using a TG-43 method and a tissue heterogeneity correction method; model training, namely inputting the dose distribution L and the medical image of the patient for a plurality of times, outputting the dose distribution H for a plurality of times, and sending the dose distribution L and the medical image into a deep learning neural network for training to obtain a radiotherapy dose prediction network; dose prediction, namely, sending a medical image of any patient into an input end of a radiotherapy dose prediction network, and obtaining dose distribution L by using a TG-43 method and a tissue heterogeneity correction method; and obtaining the dose distribution H of any patient phantom predicted by the output end of the radiotherapy dose prediction network. The technical scheme of the invention realizes the technical effect of predicting the output result of the high-precision algorithm by using the low-precision algorithm.

title: Systems and methods of managing medical images
abstract: Computer-implemented methods and systems are provided for managing one or more images. An example method for indexing involves operating a processor to, divide an image portion of an image of the one or more images into a plurality of patches, for each patch of the image: detect one or more features of the patch; and assign the patch to at least one cluster of a plurality of clusters of the image, based on the one or more features of the patch. The processor is operable to, for each cluster of the image, select at least one patch from the cluster as at least one representative patch for the cluster; for each representative patch, generate an encoded representation based on one or more features of the representative patch; and generate an index identifier for the image based on the encoded representations of the representative patches of the image.

title: Medical image cross-contrast synthesis method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 长沙微妙医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a medical image cross-contrast synthesis method and a system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining two contrast images of the same part, preprocessing the two contrast images, and using the two contrast images as a training set; training the double-flow fusion generation network by using a training set; preprocessing an image to be synthesized, and inputting the preprocessed image into a trained double-flow fusion generation network; and acquiring a synthetic image according to the trained double-flow fusion generation network. The global branches focus on global image generation by using dual branches through a dual-stream fusion generation network, and the local branches are used for local region generation and refinement of contours and texture details. The global branch fuses the multi-scale context information to the local branch, so that the generation quality of local area details is improved. The method provided by the application can reduce the blurring degree of the synthesized image and has higher image quality.
assignee_clean: 长沙微妙医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 长沙微妙医疗科技有限公司

title: Image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an image processing method, an image processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on artificial intelligence; the method comprises the following steps: in response to a retrieval request for an image, determining an image to be retrieved; coding the image to be retrieved through a coding network to obtain semantic features corresponding to the image to be retrieved; acquiring an image to be detected in a database; matching the semantic features corresponding to the image to be retrieved and the semantic features of the image to be detected through a matching network to obtain the matching degree between the image to be retrieved and the image to be detected; and obtaining a detected image meeting the requirement of the matching degree according to the matching degree between the image to be retrieved and the image to be detected, and using the detected image as reference data of the image to be retrieved. By the method and the device, the endoscope image with reference value can be efficiently and accurately retrieved.

primary_assignee: 腾讯医疗健康 深圳 有限公司

title: Approximate mixed-mode square-accumulate for small area machine learning
abstract: Multipliers, Multiply-Accumulate (MAC), and Square-Accumulate (SAC) circuits are fundamental building blocks in signal processing, including in emerging applications such as machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) that predominantly utilize digital-mode multipliers, MACs, and SACs. Generally, digital multipliers, MACs, and SACs can operate at high speed with high resolution, and synchronously. As the resolution and speed of digital multipliers, MACs, and SACs increase, generally the dynamic power consumption and chip size of digital implementations increases substantially that makes them impractical for some ML and AI segments, including in portable, mobile, near edge, or near sensor applications. The multipliers, MACs, and SACs utilizing the disclosed current mode data-converters are manufacturable in main-stream digital CMOS process, and they can have medium to high resolutions, capable of low power consumptions, having low sensitivity to power supply and temperature variations, as well as operating asynchronously, which makes them suitable for high-volume, low cost, and low power ML and AI applications.

title: Improving surgical video consumption by identifying useful segments in surgical videos
abstract: One example method for identifying useful segments in surgical videos includes accessing a video of a surgical procedure and user activities of a plurality of users who have watched the video of the surgical procedure. The user activities include operations performed during playback of the video. The method further includes dividing the video into multiple segments and determining a popularity score for each of the multiple segments based on the operations. Useful segments are identified from the segments based on the popularity scores. The method further includes generating metadata for the video of the surgical procedure to include an indication of the identified useful segments and associating the metadata with the video of the surgical procedure.

title: Electrocardiogram data classification method and classification system
assignee: 京东方科技集团股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a classification method and a classification system for electrocardiogram data, relates to the technical field of medical information, and can improve the accuracy and generalization capability of processing the electrocardiogram data. A method for processing electrocardiogram data comprises the following steps: segmenting the electrocardiographic data into a plurality of heart beat data; performing convolution and pooling on a plurality of heartbeat data to obtain a first feature vector; acquiring a second feature vector, wherein the second feature vector comprises frequency domain feature data and time domain feature data of a plurality of heartbeat data; fusing the first feature vector and the second feature vector to generate a fused feature vector; and obtaining the classification information of the electrocardiogram data according to the fusion feature vector.
assignee_clean: 京东方科技集团股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 京东方科技集团股份有限公司

title: Methods and systems for delivering a document
abstract: A computer-implemented method for delivering a document to a user may include obtaining, via an automated teller machine (ATM), first identification data of the user, wherein the first identification data of the user includes a card number and a password associated with the card number; determining a notification status of the user based on the first identification data; obtaining, via the ATM, second identification data based on the notification status of the user; determining a delivery status of the user based on the first identification data and the second identification data; and delivering the document to the user based on the delivery status of the user via the ATM.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging apparatus and medical complex image processing apparatus
abstract: According to one embodiment, a magnetic resonance imaging apparatus includes processing circuitry. The processing circuitry is configured to apply a filter to each of a first real-part image and a first imaginary-part image of a first complex image generated based on acquired magnetic resonance data and thereby generate a second complex image that includes a second real-part image and a second imaginary-part image. The processing circuitry is configured to generate a phase image denoised by the filter, the denoised phase image generated based on the second real-part image and the second imaginary-part image. The processing circuitry is configured to generate an intensity image related to an absolute value of the first complex image based on pixel values of the denoised phase image, the first real-part image, and the first imaginary-part image.

title: Systems and methods for segmenting customer targets and predicting conversion
abstract: Methods, systems and apparatuses, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, are provided for generating prediction models related to targeting and acquiring customers. Thousands of variables of historical data, including data for prospects and external data, are used to train the prediction models. The variables are pre-processed, then sensitivity analysis is performed on the input variables with respect to the target. The variables with the most influence on the target are selected and added to the feature set used for training a prediction model.

title: Image classification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: An image classification method and device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and acquiring a target image, and identifying first key point information from the target image. And correcting the first key point information for a plurality of times according to a preset rule to obtain a key point information set, wherein the key point information set comprises target key point information corrected each time. And inputting the target key point information corrected each time into a first preset model to obtain a characteristic weight map corrected each time. And inputting the target image and the feature weight map corrected each time into a second preset model to perform feature extraction, so as to obtain target feature information. And classifying the target image according to the target characteristic information to obtain an image classification result. The method and the device can continuously correct the key point information, avoid continuous accumulation of errors caused by unbalanced data quantity distribution, guide the second preset model to learn more effective and interpretable target characteristic information from the target image through the characteristic weight map, and improve the reliability of image classification.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Intelligent venous blood sampling positioning device based on computer vision
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent venous blood sampling positioning device based on computer vision. The blood sampling positioning device comprises a medical disinfection spraying module A, a computer vision module B, core-x-y movement module C, a control module D, a supporting frame E, a computer and a bottom plate; wherein, one side of the bottom plate is fixed with a supporting frame E, and a computer vision module B is fixed above the supporting frame E; the other side of the bottom plate is respectively fixed with a medical disinfection spraying module A and a core-x-y movement module C from left to right; the control module D is arranged on a bottom plate below the core-x-y motion module C; the invention can ensure that the blood sampling positioning part can freely move in the plane to reach the blood sampling point appointed by the computer, and can efficiently and accurately complete the venous blood sampling positioning task.

title: Method for computing performance in multiple machine learning classifiers
abstract: Performance in a multi-classification system having multiple component classifiers can be based on a combination of the true positive rate (TPR) and false positive rate (FPR) of the component classifiers. Each component classifier can be configured with a decision threshold, and its TPR and FPR determined from a training set presented to the component classifier so configured. A system TPR and system FPR can be determined from the component TPRs and FPRs. A set of system TPRs and FPRs can be determined from additional sets of decision thresholds.

title: Eyeglasses having inward-facing and outward-facing thermal cameras
abstract: Described herein are systems and methods for detecting a physiological response based on thermal measurements while accounting for effects of the environment. In one embodiment, a system includes an inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAMin) that takes thermal measurements of a region of interest (THROI) on a user's face, and an outward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAMout) that takes thermal measurements of the environment (THENV). CAMin does not occlude the region of interest, and the system further includes a computer that detects the physiological response based on THROI and THENV. Optionally, the computer generates feature values based on sets of THROI and THENV, and utilizes a machine learning-based model to detect, based on the feature values, the physiological response.

title: Wearable human body communication method and device capable of self-adaptive optimization
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable human body communication method and device capable of self-adaptive optimization. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a correlation model between the dielectric characteristics of the human body and the transmission frequency; detecting the electromagnetic interference condition of the transmission environment around the communication sending end to obtain electromagnetic interference frequency spectrum information; inputting the human body dielectric characteristics of the communication sending end into the correlation model to obtain a plurality of candidate transmission frequencies; and selecting the working carrier frequency from the candidate transmission frequencies for communication by using the electromagnetic interference spectrum information and taking the channel capacity with the minimum interference as an optimization target. The invention avoids interference of peripheral electromagnetic waves according to different physiological characteristics, adaptively selects working carrier frequency, enables the transmission efficiency to be higher, and effectively increases bandwidth and anti-interference performance.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院

title: Fuzzy judgment method, system, equipment and medium for medical bill pictures
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a fuzzy judgment method, a system, equipment and a medium for medical bill pictures, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, obtaining slice text, coordinates and confidence coefficient of an identification result; step 2, obtaining a direction judgment result based on the obtained slice text, coordinates and recognition result confidence; if the direction judging result is a preset angle, the step 4 is executed in a jumping mode, otherwise, the step 3 is executed in a jumping mode; step 3, carrying out rotation correction on the medical bill picture based on the direction judging result to obtain a rotation corrected picture, and repeatedly executing the step 1 and the step 2; and 4, performing fuzzy calculation based on the confidence level of the recognition results of all the slice texts to obtain fuzzy judgment results. The method and the device can solve the technical problems that the judgment accuracy of the existing fuzzy algorithm for motion blur is low and the use experience of users is poor.

title: Camera with meta-lens and electronic device including same
abstract: An electronic device according to various embodiments disclosed herein may include a lens assembly having a structure in which at least one meta-lens and a spacer member are stacked, and an image sensor assembly attached to one side of the lens assembly to receive light passing through the lens assembly and convert the light into an optical signal. The spacer member may be fixed to one side of the lens assembly between the image sensor assembly and the lens assembly such that a cavity is defined by an inner side surface of the spacer member, a bottom surface of the lens assembly, and a top surface of the image sensor assembly.

title: Systems and methods for enhancing REM sleep with sensory stimulation
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system and method for automatically detecting Rapid Eye Movement (REM) sleep and delivering sensory stimuli to extend REM duration without interfering with sleep. The sensory stimulus may be auditory or other stimulus. The system and method ensure timely delivery of stimulation and automatically adjust the amount, intensity, and/or timing of stimulation as needed. REM sleep is detected based on brain activity, heart activity, and/or other information. REM sleep may be detected and/or predicted by a trained neural network. The amount, timing, and/or intensity of sensory stimulation may be determined and/or adjusted based on one or more values of one or more intermediate layers of the neural network and one or more brain activity and/or heart activity parameters to enhance REM sleep in the subject.

title: Urinary metabolomic biomarkers for detecting colorectal cancer and polyps
abstract: The invention relates to methods and compositions for detecting colorectal cancer and colorectal polyps by measurement of metabolites in bodily fluids such as urine, including diacetylspermine and kynurenine.

title: Perperative critical adverse event intervention decision method based on Bayesian network and utility system
assignee: 中国科学院重庆绿色智能技术研究院
abstract: The invention relates to a Bayesian network and utility system-based intervention decision method for perioperative critical adverse events, belonging to the field of artificial intelligence and medical application thereof, and comprising the following steps: s1: constructing a critical adverse event intervention measure set in the perioperative period; s2: assigning a utility value to each intervention measure to form an intervention measure utility system; s3: constructing an expert knowledge base aiming at intervention measures; s4: forming a plurality of combined intervention schemes; s5: constructing a Bayesian network model for intervention of perioperative critical adverse events based on clinical case data and source and expert knowledge of patients; s6: inputting perioperative data information for a single patient, taking the perioperative data information as a data evidence of a Bayesian network model, and executing Bayesian network inference to obtain a probability value of whether each intervention measure is adopted; s7: calculating an overall utility value of each combination scheme; s8: and selecting a combination scheme of the total utility value Top-3 as a recommendation result of the intervention decision scheme.

abstract: Assessing protection for storage resources, including: identifying a set of active data protection features for one or more storage resources; generating a data protection assessment based on the set of active data protection features; and reporting the data protection assessment.

assignee: 意法半导体公司, 意法半导体股份有限公司
abstract: In one embodiment, an apparatus may comprise: a first sensor configured to generate first sensor data during a first time period and a second time period; a second sensor configured to be disabled during a first time period, the second sensor further configured to generate second sensor data during a second time period; and a processor configured to determine a characteristic of the first sensor data during a first time period. The device may also include a classification circuit configured to determine whether the device has changed state based on a characteristic of the first sensor data during a first time period, the classification circuit further configured to cause the second sensor to be enabled in response to the change in the device state.

title: Patient screening marking method based on partial multi-marking learning
assignee: 芽米科技(广州)有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of partial multi-marker learning and data mining, and particularly relates to a patient screening marking method based on partial multi-marker learning; the method comprises the following steps: obtaining pathological sample data of a patient, inputting the pathological sample data into a trained medical text semantic information big data prediction model based on partial multi-mark learning, predicting the disease type and the disease probability of the patient, and marking the patient according to the disease type and the disease probability of the patient; the invention further processes the unbalanced problem of classification, can predict more accurate marking result, the patient can carry on health management according to this marking result, doctor can carry on the next diagnosis to patient according to this result too, have good social benefit and economic benefits.

title: Apparatus for integrated management of active injury information and method thereof
abstract: An active risk information integrated management device and a method thereof are disclosed. The present invention collects source risk information from a pre-selected collection channel, verifies whether the collected risk information is risk information, and further verifies whether the verified risk information is a management item. The present invention refines the additionally verified risk information to standardize according to a preset unified format, applies the standardized risk information to a preset logical model analysis scenario to analyze the type of risk, degree of risk, and grade of risk, and the like, and provides various statistical information provision functions, risk information proactive response functions, risk information reporting functions, blind spot information management functions, and accident investigation result management functions based on the analyzed type of risk, risk information, the grade of risk, and the like. Therefore, it is possible to create a foundation for active product safety management by realizing integrated risk information management, and to realize product safety management at the right time in the right place through analysis and utilization of collected risk information.

title: Neurofeedback eyeglasses
abstract: Thermal measurements of the forehead can be indicative of brain activity, and as such, may be useful for conducting brain-related treatments, such as neurofeedback. In one embodiment, a system for conducting a neurofeedback session includes an inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAM) and a user interface. CAM takes thermal measurements of a region on the forehead (THF) of a user, and is located below the middle of the region. The user interface provides, based on THF, the neurofeedback session for the user. Optionally, a computer controls the neurofeedback session by providing the user feedback via the user interface. The computer may generate the feedback based on the similarity between a current THF pattern and a previous THF pattern of the user taken while the user was in a target state.

title: Proximal gradient method for huberized support vector machine
abstract: The Support Vector Machine (SVM) has been used in a wide variety of classification problems. The original SVM uses the hinge loss function, which is nondifferentiable and makes the problem difficult to solve in particular for regularized SVMs, such as with l1-norm. The Huberized SVM (HSVM) is considered, which uses a differentiable approximation of the hinge loss function. The Proximal Gradient (PG) method is used to solving binary-class HSVM (BHSVM) and then generalized to multi-class HSVM (MHSVM). Under strong convexity assumptions, the algorithm converges linearly. A finite convergence result about the support of the solution is given, based on which the algorithm is further accelerated by a two-stage method.

title: Tubular structure segmentation graph fracture repairing method and system of three-dimensional image based on deep learning network
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a tubular structure segmentation graph fracture repairing method and system of a three-dimensional image based on a deep learning network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: collecting three-dimensional image data and preprocessing the three-dimensional image data; step S2: resampling the preprocessed three-dimensional image data to generate a plurality of candidate three-dimensional data of the interested region; step S3: inputting the three-dimensional data of all candidate sensing areas into a target segmentation depth learning network to obtain a target organ segmentation map in each interested area; step S4: and performing distance transformation on the target organ segmentation graph to obtain a distance transformation graph, inputting the target organ segmentation graph and the distance transformation graph into a fracture repair deep learning network together to obtain a fracture repair graph of each region of interest, and splicing and combining all the fracture repair graphs together to obtain a complete target organ segmentation result. The method and the system can realize automatic fracture repair, are simple and effective, and improve the segmentation effect.

title: Generating time-based predictions and controlling access to the same
abstract: There is a need to accurately and dynamically generate a time-based prediction and control access to the time-based prediction. This need can be addressed, for example, by allowing controlled access to user information pertaining to a user visiting a facility. In one example, a method includes storing a companion user identifier in association with a public user identifier; receiving a request for a user status of the user; determining whether the companion user is permitted to receive the user status of the user based at least in part on the public user identifier and the companion user identifier; responsive to determining that the companion user is permitted to receive the user status of the user, requesting an aggregated time-based prediction for the user; and causing, the aggregated time-based prediction to be decrypted and provided as a response to the request for the user status of the user.

title: Network entity ID AAA
abstract: A set of data packets transmitted by an IoT device is received at a system. At least one packet included in the set of data packets is analyzed. An Authentication, and Account (AAA) message, including contextual information associated with the IoT device, is transmitted on behalf of the IoT device.

title: Electronic device for measuring posture of user and method thereof
abstract: An electronic device according to an embodiment disclosed herein may include a sensor, a short-range communication module, and a processor. The processor is configured to generate first rotation angle information, establish a connection to the external electronic device, receive, from the external electronic device, second rotation angle information and check data uniquely assigned to the second rotation angle information, configure a first time stamp based on the check data and a time of receiving the second rotation angle information, configure a second time stamp based on the check data and a time of correcting the second rotation angle information, compare the first time stamp and the second time stamp to calculate a delay time, correct the second rotation angle information based on the delay time, and generate posture information based on the first rotation angle information and the corrected second rotation angle information.

title: Wireless probe, intelligent processing module and wireless fetal monitoring system for fetal monitoring
assignee: 深圳市理邦精密仪器股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a wireless probe, an intelligent processing module and a wireless fetal monitoring system for fetal monitoring. The wireless probe includes: the system comprises a sensor and a wireless circuit, wherein the sensor is used for acquiring fetal monitoring information; the wireless circuit is connected with the sensor and used for sending the fetal monitoring information to the intelligent processing module so that the intelligent processing module can calculate and analyze the fetal monitoring information from the wireless probe to obtain an analysis result; judging whether the analysis result is abnormal or not; and when the analysis result is judged to be abnormal, triggering a prompt corresponding to the abnormality. Through the mode, the triggering prompt which can be timely when abnormity occurs in the fetal monitoring process can be realized, so that medical care personnel can timely make a corresponding coping scheme for the prompt, and the life safety of a fetus and a mother is maintained.

title: System and method supporting delivery of network accessible services to connected devices of a local environment
abstract: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include, for example, monitoring a control plane of a service provider network including messages that facilitate network access by local equipment to subscribed services. A data plane managed by the network and separate from the control plane is also monitored. The data plane facilitates an exchange of user data between the connected devices, the network and the subscribed services. Local equipment are identified based on the monitoring of the control plane, and local network connectivity is established between the processing system and the local equipment. A common communication channel is established between the processing system and the network, wherein network access to the subscribed services is based on an exchange of the user data via the common communication channel. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title: Graph-based multitasking self-supervision emotion recognition method
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of information, and relates to a classification method of electroencephalogram signals, in particular to a graph-based multitasking self-supervision emotion recognition method, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: s1, acquiring electroencephalogram emotion data and preprocessing; s2, constructing a self-supervision auxiliary task; s3, constructing a graph convolutional neural network; s4, training a graph convolution neural network; s5, the test chart convolves the neural network. The invention considers the design of self-supervision tasks for electroencephalogram emotion recognition for the first time. The designed space jigsaw task learns the space mode related to the brain electricity emotion by learning the internal space relation among different brain areas; the designed frequency jigsaw task aims at digging a frequency band which is more critical to emotion recognition; the task of contrast learning of the design aims at further normalizing the feature space and learning the inherent characterization. The emotion recognition method has higher accuracy rate.

title: Healthcare protocols for use with a distributed ledger
abstract: Systems and methods may use healthcare protocols for use with distributed ledger technology. The healthcare protocols may be used to, among other things, classify event data items as distributed ledger data items such that record of such classified event data items may be stored in a distributed ledger. Further, the healthcare protocols may be modified over time, and record of such modifications may also be stored in a distributed ledger.

title: Electroencephalogram data processing method and device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an electroencephalogram data processing method and apparatus, the method comprising: acquiring electroencephalogram data of a target object; determining a first feature vector from the brain electrical data of the target object, the first feature vector comprising a plurality of brain network attributes determined from the brain electrical data of the target object; and inputting the first feature vector into a trained prediction model to obtain a prediction result, wherein the prediction result represents whether the target object is suitable for receiving specific medical treatment. According to the electroencephalogram data processing method disclosed by the embodiment of the disclosure, the prediction accuracy of the adaptability of the target object to specific medical treatment can be improved.

title: System and method for gait monitoring and improvement
abstract: A wearable device for gait monitoring and improvement, as well as systems for sensing relevant metrics and delivering real-time sensory feedback. One system receives a baseline active training program to target a mobility abnormality; downloads it onto a wearable device; determines the activity type based on sensor data obtained from a sensor array; generates cueing intensity feedback; receives field data from the wearable device; dynamically recommends new modification parameters based on the field data; and modifies the active training program based on the new modification parameters. The system may modify cueing intensity to correct the wearer's gait by selecting ranges of values for cueing response variables for a cueing window; receiving a sample dataset from a wearable device; determining whether a number of the cycles of frames spent in a no-correction frame is increasing; adjusting the outer bounds of the no-correction frame; and adjusting the cueing window.

title: System and method for generating an addiction nourishment program
abstract: A system and method for generating an addiction nourishment program includes a computing device, the computing device configured to obtain an addiction element, produce an addiction signature as a function of the addiction element, wherein producing further comprises identifying a predictive signal as a function of an addiction directory, and producing the addiction signature as a function of the predictive signal and addiction element using a predictive machine-learning model, identify a physiological impact as a function of the addiction signature, wherein identifying a physiological impact further comprises receiving a medical influence and identifying the physiological impact as a function of the medical influence and addiction signature using a physiological machine-learning model, determine an edible as a function of the physiological impact, and generate a nourishment program as a function of the edible.

title: Ultrasound imaging with deep learning-based beamforming and associated devices, systems, and methods
abstract: Ultrasound image devices, systems, and methods are provided. An ultrasound imaging system, comprising an array of acoustic elements configured to transmit ultrasound energy into an anatomy and to receive ultrasound echoes associated with the anatomy; and a processor circuit in communication with the array of acoustic elements and configured to receive, from the array, ultrasound channel data corresponding to the received ultrasound echoes; normalize the ultrasound channel data by applying a first scaling function to the ultrasound channel data; generate beamformed data by applying a predictive network to the normalized ultrasound channel data; de-normalize the beamformed data by applying a second scaling function to the beamformed data; generate an image of the anatomy from the beamformed data; and output, to a display in communication with the processor circuit, the image of the anatomy.

title: Wearable impedance cytometer
assignee: Rutgers, The State University Of New Jersey
abstract: This disclosure provides an impedance cytometer which includes a carrier that can be attached to a living being, with a biosensor mounted thereto. The bio sensor includes a microfluidic flow channel, formed in the carrier, and an impedance circuit. The microfluidic flow channel accommodates passage of a particle therethrough. The impedance circuit, connected to the microfluidic flow channel, includes a signal generator that produces a high-frequency drive signal applied to the flow channel to produce a biosensor output signal having high-frequency variation resulting from the drive signal and low-frequency variation resulting from impedance variation within the flow channel during the particle's passage. A lock-in amplifier is disposed to (i) amplify the bio sensor output signal, (ii) mix the amplified signal with the drive signal, and (iii) frequency-filter the mixed, amplified signal to output an impedance signal representing the low-frequency impedance variation resulting from the passage of the particle. Embodiments enable wearable, personalized cytometry.

title: Electromagnetic wave medical imaging system, device and methods
abstract: An electromagnetic wave medical imaging system, the system including: at least one antenna; transmission electronics; receiving electronics; and receiving computing electronics, where the transmission electronics are structured to transmit a first electromagnetic wave having an Orbital Angular Momentum wave-front thru the antenna towards a target, where the Orbital Angular Momentum wave-front includes a vortex region, where the transmission electronics are structured to transmit a second electromagnetic wave having a non Orbital Angular Momentum wave-front thru a first portion of the antenna towards the target, where the receiving electronics are structured to form a first signal from a first return wave of the first electromagnetic wave, where the receiving electronics are structured to form a second signal from a second return wave of the second electromagnetic wave, and where the receiving computing electronics includes a computing process to estimate the return wave associated with the vortex region.

title: Pregnancy data modeling method based on self-attention mechanism
assignee: 北京航空航天大学, 国家卫生健康委科学技术研究所, 北京市海淀区妇幼保健院
abstract: The invention discloses a pregnancy data modeling method based on a self-attention mechanism, which comprises the following specific steps: extracting three types of data, integrating various information by taking one pregnancy as a basic unit, sorting pregnancy samples, and performing data preprocessing; modeling discretized laboratory data by using a Transformer architecture fused with time information, and modeling pregnancy graph data with strong trend by using a GRU-ATN architecture; and the fusion characterization part firstly adds basic pregnant and lying-in information, splices the three parts of data, and further fuses the multi-aspect information by using linear transformation with an activation layer to obtain final characterization. The invention provides a pregnancy data modeling method based on a self-attention mechanism, which mainly utilizes the self-attention mechanism and other mechanisms to model data, converts original multivariate, high-dimensional and sparse information input data into single, low-dimensional and dense information output data, and outputs data characterization vectors for further analysis and use.

title: Medical image annotation recommendation method based on block-level active learning
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image labeling recommendation method based on block-level active learning. The invention solves the problem of repeated recommendation on the medical image by the existing annotation recommendation method by positioning the region with the annotation value. The method reduces the basic unit recommended by the image labeling to the image block level, avoids resource waste caused by repeated labeling of similar objects in the image, and further reduces the labeling cost. Compared with the best medical image annotation recommendation method at present, the method can reduce the annotation overhead by 15% at most under the condition of achieving the same semantic segmentation accuracy, or can improve the semantic segmentation accuracy by 2% under the condition of achieving the same annotation overhead.

Present invention relates to a device which can be used to measure the temperature of the 
person and analyze his/her cough which can be further used to check the person whether he/she 
has contracted the Corona Virus. The device can be used as a first level screening system to 
identify a person who has contracted the Corona Virus or COVID-19 virus. It can be used to find 
the contact of Corona Virus and COVID-19 within the people and help to contain the spread of 
Corona Virus and to break the chain of spread.  
A major problem in its treatment is its initial examination and diagnosis, which will 
determine its treatment. The virus's screening is extremely tough due of its rapid contactless 
dissemination. The medical community requires efficient methods for detecting the virus in the 
least amount of time. In this study, we invent a medical gadget that uses composable sensors to 
monitor the health condition of people who show the symptoms of the coronavirus or infected. In 
our invention, the medical device comprises wearable medical sensors which are merged with 
Raspberry PI hardware interfacing and a smartphone application. At the backend, an IoT 
framework is deployed, allowing multiple devices to connect in real time. Temperature, cough 
sound, heartbeat, breath sound, and oxygen concentration (SpO2) are examined using our 
ensemble machine learning algorithm to establish the patient's critical status of the impacts of the 
coronavirus or its symptoms.

title: Surgical tracking methods and fiber optic shape sensing devices thereof
assignee: Smith & Nephew, Inc., Smith & Nephew Orthopaedics Ag, Smith & Nephew Asia Pacific Pte. Limited
abstract: Methods, non-transitory computer readable media, surgical tracking devices, and systems that facilitate improved tracking in surgical environments are disclosed. With this technology, a fiber optic shape sensing (FOSS) device is rigidly attached to patient anatomy and/or surgical instrument(s) to facilitate location and/or flexibility tracking. The data provided by the FOSS device can be analyzed and registered to preoperative or intraoperative 3D anatomy model(s). The FOSS device can be attached to a surgical instrument to provide intraoperative guidance, used to locate a hollow needle for tracking bones in a minimally invasive manner, and/or used to detect bending in an instrument such as an arthroscope or tissue removing burr shaft, for example. The tracked location and/or flexibility data provided by the FOSS device can also be used to automatically control the location and/or operation of a surgical instrument during a surgical proceeding to facilitate improved surgical accuracy and patient outcomes.

title: Using classifications from text to determine instances of graphical element types to include in a template layout for digital media output
abstract: Provided are a computer program product, system, and method for using classifications from text to determine instances of graphical element types to include in a template layout for digital media output. Text is processed to determine classifications. The determined classifications of the text are inputted to a machine learning module to output instances for graphical element types. The outputted instances of the graphical element types are rendered in a user interface for a user to select. User selection is received of one of the instances rendered in the user interface for each of the graphical element types. The text with the user selected instances for the graphical element types are rendered in a template layout. The template layout including the text rendered with the user selected instances for the graphical element types is rendered in an output layout of digital media.

title: Platform for hygiene behavioral monitoring and modification
abstract: A hygienic behavior monitoring system is configured to use sensors to detect instances of hygienic behaviors. The hygienic behavior monitoring system includes a presentation unit that presents one or more media items and a processing unit that indexes behavioral instances. An analytic unit calculates instances of one or more hygienic events based at least in part on a fusion of sensor signals including instances of the actions of a sanitary device with instances of detected human presence.

title: Disease prediction method and device with few samples
assignee: 中国科学院自动化研究所
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a disease prediction method and device with few samples, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring electronic medical record information to be processed; predicting the electronic medical record information to be processed based on the disease prediction model to obtain a prediction result; the disease prediction model is obtained by training a backbone model by taking a sample obtained by amplifying and resampling sample electronic medical record information as a training sample and taking a latent layer representation extracted from the training sample through a shared weight encoder as a training feature. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target document and a target data pair set input by a user, and acquiring the target document and the target data pair set; generating a target knowledge graph based on the target document and the target data pair set; inputting the target knowledge graph into a predetermined learning model to obtain a candidate information set and an index; in response to the index characterizing a "0," the candidate information set is determined as the target information set.
