primary_assignee: 北京金山软件有限公司

title: Dynamic per-node pre-pulling in distributed computing
abstract: An apparatus includes a processor to: receive an indication of ability of a node device to provide a resource for executing application routines, at least one identifier of at least one image including an executable routine stored within a cache of the node device, and an indication of at least one revision level of the at least one image; analyze the ability to provide the resource; in response to being able to support execution of the application routine, identify a first image in a repository; compare identifiers to determine whether there is a second image including a matching executable routine; in response to a match, compare revision levels; and in response to the revision level of the most recent version of the first image being more recent, retrieve the most recent version of the first image from the repository, and store it within the node device.

title: Knowledge graph-based data code matching method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a data code matching method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical inventory data; inputting the project data into a target text classification model, and obtaining a text classification result corresponding to the project data; if the text classification result belongs to the medical insurance catalog classification result, searching a category node corresponding to the text classification result from the knowledge graph; preprocessing project data to obtain keywords; acquiring a plurality of first links corresponding to the category nodes from the knowledge graph, and determining target links matched with all keywords from all the first links; acquiring a target medical code corresponding to a target link; and taking the target medical code as a code matching result of the project data. The application can accurately realize the code matching processing of the item data in the medical list data. The application can also be applied to the field of block chains, and data such as the result of the upper pair codes and the like can be stored on the block chain.
assignee_clean: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司

title: Method, a system, and a computer readable storage medium for automated recommendations for an online shopping cart
abstract: An information processing system, a computer readable storage medium, and a method for providing a recommendation for a plaything as a recommended item can include analyzing information received from a person monitoring system to provide an analysis for providing the recommendation for the plaything, and based on the analysis, sending a representation of the recommended item in a signal to a shopping cart such as an online shopping cart. The system can include an analysis module that receives information from a person monitoring system, and at least one processor configured to analyze information received from the person monitoring system (for one or more persons) to provide an analysis. The analysis provides a recommendation for a plaything. The processor can further send a representation of the recommended item in a signal to a shopping cart to upload into the shopping cart based on the analysis. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title: Electronic device and operation method thereof
abstract: An electronic device may include a display, a communication circuit, at least one camera, a memory, and a processor operatively connected to the display, the communication circuit, the at least one camera, and the memory. The memory may store instructions that, when executed, cause the processor to provide an augmented reality (AR) environment or a virtual reality (VR) environment through the display, connect the electronic device and at least one external electronic device through the communication circuit, display the at least one external electronic device through the display, specify a first external electronic device among the displayed at least one external electronic device based on an input interface switching event, and control an operation of the electronic device in the augmented reality environment or the virtual reality environment using the specified first external electronic device.

title: Method, computing device and storage medium for generating structured text
assignee: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods, computing devices, and storage media for generating structured text. According to the method, a text structured template is obtained, wherein the text structured template comprises a plurality of information subject types; identifying a plurality of basic text information of the text to be structured based on a plurality of first information topic types; identifying a plurality of compound text messages of the text to be structured based on a plurality of second information topic types and the tree hierarchical relation; determining a final information subject type for each compound text information and each basic text information based on the tree hierarchical relationship; and generating a structured text of the text to be structured based on the plurality of basic text messages, the plurality of compound text messages and the final information subject type. Therefore, the structured texts can be automatically generated for various different medical clinical medical texts, so that the adaptability is strong, and the marginal development cost can be reduced.
assignee_clean: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京欧应信息技术有限公司

title: Systems and methods for ultrasound review and imaging
abstract: A system for reviewing results of ultrasound examinations provides enhanced control over reviewed images. A review and imaging system receives additional data comprising one or more of additional ultrasound images generated using parameter settings different from those selected by and sonographer and earlier stage ultrasound data. An ultrasound machine may be configured to acquire and make the additional data available to the review and imaging system. The review and imaging system may provide a wide range of control options for obtaining optimized display of images based on the additional data.

title: Pedestrian head injury prediction method and prediction system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a pedestrian head injury prediction method and a prediction system thereof, wherein the prediction method comprises the following steps: based on sensitive parameters of pedestrian head injury, establishing a large-scale numerical database; establishing a pedestrian head injury prediction model based on the numerical database; when the vehicle detects a pedestrian, the speed of the vehicle and the speed of the pedestrian at the time of collision are calculated, and the parameters are substituted into a pedestrian head injury prediction model, so that the risk of pedestrian head injury at the time of collision is predicted. The pedestrian head injury prediction algorithm in the prior art does not consider key parameters including factors such as pedestrian gait, pedestrian walking speed and the like which influence the pedestrian head injury when in collision, so that the model prediction accuracy is difficult to reach the expectation.

title: Image quality evaluation method
assignee: 杭州迪英加科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to an image quality evaluation method for evaluating the quality of pathological images, which comprises the following steps: judging whether the pathological image is a digital pathological image obtained by scanning or a real-time acquired image obtained by a camera, when the pathological image is the digital pathological image, judging the imaging quality of the image, if the imaging quality is poor, ending the image quality evaluation, and outputting a judgment result; otherwise, judging the content quality of the image and outputting a judgment result; and when the pathological image is a real-time collected image, judging the content quality of the image and outputting a judgment result. The method and the device for judging the quality of the digital pathological image simulation medical expert firstly judge the scanning quality, directly define the pathological image with unqualified obvious scanning quality as an unqualified image, and do not judge the content quality, thereby improving the working efficiency of a quality control link.
assignee_clean: 杭州迪英加科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州迪英加科技有限公司

title: Automatic detection method and device for annulus, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海博动医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment, in particular to an automatic detection method and device for an annulus, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical image data comprising a heart valve; inputting the medical image data into a multitasking deep learning model to obtain a key point detection result of an annulus of the heart valve; post-processing the key point detection result to obtain a detection key point set of the valve annulus of the heart valve; and correcting each detection key point in the detection key point set based on the reinforcement learning model to obtain a target key point set of the valve annulus of the heart valve. According to the automatic detection method for the valve annulus, disclosed by the invention, the automatic detection and positioning of the valve annulus can be realized by combining the multi-task deep learning model and the reinforcement learning model, and the efficiency and the accuracy of the valve annulus detection are improved.
assignee_clean: 上海博动医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海博动医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Cognitive learning lifecycle
abstract: A cognitive information processing system comprising a processor; a data bus coupled to the processor; and a non-transitory, computer-readable storage medium embodying computer program code, the non-transitory, computer-readable storage medium being coupled to the data bus, the computer program code interacting with a plurality of computer operations and comprising instructions executable by the processor and configured for: receiving data from a plurality of data sources; processing the data from the plurality of data sources to perform a cognitive learning operation, the processing being performed via a cognitive inference and learning system, the cognitive learning operation comprising a plurality of cognitive learning operation lifecycle phases, the cognitive learning operation applying a cognitive learning technique to generate a cognitive learning result; and, updating a destination based upon the cognitive learning result.

title: Anomaly detection using magnetic resonance fingerprinting
abstract: The invention provides for a medical imaging system comprising: a memory for storing machine executable instructions; a processor for controlling the medical instrument. Execution of the machine executable instructions causes the processor to: receive MRF magnetic resonance data acquired according to an MRF magnetic resonance imaging protocol of a region of interest; reconstruct an MRF vector for each voxel of a set of voxels descriptive of the region of interest using the MRF magnetic resonance data according to the MRF magnetic resonance imaging protocol; calculate a preprocessed MRF vector (126) for each of the set of voxels by applying a predetermined preprocessing routine to the MRF vector for each voxel, wherein the predetermined preprocessing routine comprises normalizing the preprocessed MRF vector for each voxel; calculate an outlier map for the set of voxels by assigning an outlier score to the preprocessed MRF vector using a machine learning algorithm.

title: System for color-coding medical instrumentation and methods of use
abstract: A system comprising a biopsy needle device comprising a cannula comprising a distal end configured to sever a tissue sample, and a trocar disposed within the cannula comprising a notch configured to retain a tissue sample, wherein at least one of the cannula and the trocar is divided into at least two segments including different echogenic coatings, an ultrasound probe, and a processor configured and arranged to collect images from the ultrasound probe and color code the at least two segments based on at least one characteristic relating to different echogenic coatings, surface textures, surface contours and dimensions of the biopsy device.

title: Method for monitoring interactions to perform a cognitive learning operation
abstract: A cognitive learning method comprising: monitoring a user interaction of a user; generating user interaction data based upon the user interaction; receiving data from a plurality of data sources; processing the user interaction data and the data from the plurality of data sources to perform a cognitive learning operation, the processing being performed via a cognitive inference and learning system, the cognitive learning operation comprising analyzing the user interaction data, the cognitive learning operation generating a cognitive learning result based upon the user interaction data; and, associating a cognitive profile with the user based the cognitive learning result.

title: Anomaly detection for medical samples in multiple settings
assignee: 香港应用科技研究院有限公司
abstract: The use of multiple imaging modalities in full-slice image screening can potentially be used to reduce false positives. To use multiple imaging modalities, a method for locating abnormalities on a medical sample from an image of the medical sample uses an abnormality detection process that includes individually classifying an object of interest suspected of being abnormal using a plurality of basis classifiers. Each base classifier separately extracts features of the object of interest and generates a score indicating a likelihood that the object of interest is abnormal from the extracted features. The anomaly detection process further includes merging scores generated by the base classifier using a set classifier to determine whether the object of interest is an anomaly. The set classifier determines a dependency metric for each base classifier based on set variables of a setting at which the sample and the image were obtained, and then selectively combines scores of the base classifiers based on the dependency metric.
assignee_clean: 香港应用科技研究院有限公司
primary_assignee: 香港应用科技研究院有限公司

title: System to detect dielectric changes in matter
abstract: Systems and methods for detecting dielectric changes in matter are provided. The system includes a data collection array to collect microwave scattering data and a machine learning device. The machine learning device is configured to receive the microwave scattering data, patient information, and imaging modality data corresponding to at least one of a presence of disease, absence of disease, or one or more disease features; analyze the microwave scattering data, patient information, and imaging modality data; output at least one of a predicted disease state and predicted features based on the analyzed microwave scattering data, patient information, and imaging modality data; compare the imaging modality data corresponding to the at least one of a presence of disease, absence of disease, or one or more disease features to the predicted disease state or predicted features; and use the comparison as an input into the machine learning device.

title: Method of assisting a driver if a passenger encounters a health issue
abstract: An embodiment relates to a system, comprising: a processor and a communication module; wherein the processor performs, under power, following functions, wherein the functions comprise: receiving, an indication that a passenger of a vehicle is experiencing a medical emergency; identifying, via the communication module, an emergency contact in a device of the passenger; establishing, via the communication module, a secondary communication channel with the emergency contact; sending, via a communication module, a message to the emergency contact comprising a detail of occurrence of an emergency event in the vehicle and a location of the vehicle; and wherein the system is configured to be a component of the vehicle.

title: Clinical trial progress statistics and analysis tool based on big data
assignee: 北京厚普医药科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of clinical data management, in particular to a clinical test progress statistics and analysis tool based on big data. In the invention, the self-adaptive threshold value and dynamic data segmentation module improves the flexibility and accuracy of data processing, adapts to data change, enhances the data analysis efficiency, and the intelligent data tracking module improves the data control and response speed through real-time monitoring and anomaly detection, reduces accidents, and the multidimensional statistics and AI prediction analysis provide deep insight and future trend prediction, enhance the decision-making prospective and scientificity, combine the data visualization with the decision-making support module, strengthen the data presentation, provide a practical decision-making scheme, and support the clinical trial optimization and the strategy formulation.
assignee_clean: 北京厚普医药科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京厚普医药科技有限公司

title: Animal management method and animal management system based on cloud platform
abstract: The invention discloses an animal management method and an animal management system based on a cloud platform, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting daily information of animals; analyzing the image information in the daily information into analysis data; transmitting the daily information and the analysis data to a workstation; the workstation sends the daily information and the analysis data to a cloud platform, and the cloud platform classifies and archives the daily information and the analysis data; in the cloud platform, a training set is established according to text information and analysis data of daily information; a machine learning-based method, utilizing a training set training model; and the workstation downloads the model from the cloud platform and analyzes the archived text information and the analysis data. Daily information of the exercise is collected, the daily information is preprocessed through a workstation, archive is established and uploaded to a cloud platform, the daily information is processed by utilizing mass data of the cloud platform, data is provided for health management, pathological interpretation and medical treatment of animals, and the animal feeding is helped and guided.

title: Concussion sensing system with cloud-based prediction model update
abstract: A system to monitor hit impact force and to predict the likelihood of a concussion which includes a wearable device with an impact sensor and an application processor for prediction, a smartphone mobile application, a cloud-based data storage system, and an algorithm improvement system. The wearable device is mounted to the player's helmet or other locations where the impact force to the head is measured and a prediction algorithm is used to predict the potential risk of concussion. The wearable device wirelessly communicates with a smartphone, where data is viewed and associated information is managed. The impact force data and all related information are also automatically uploaded from the smartphone to a cloud-based database for storage. An algorithm improvement system will periodically analyze the data in order to build a better prediction model between impact force measured and the concussion diagnosed. Once a better prediction algorithm for such model is identified, such algorithm will be sent to the smartphone and hence downloaded to each athlete's wearable device automatically for a better prediction of concussion risk.

title: Recommendation management for an electronic device
abstract: A method, system, apparatus, and/or device that may include: a first sensor operable to take a first physiological measurement; a second sensor operable to take a second physiological measurement; and a processing device operatively coupled to the first sensor and the second sensor. The processing device may be operable to: receive a first measurement data for the first physiological measurement; receive a second measurement data for the second physiological measurement; generate an event data set based on the first measurement data with the second measurement data; determine an event occurred based on the event data set; determine a type of the event; and in response to the event being a safety event: determine a type of the safety event; identify a risk level of the safety event; and in response to the risk level exceeding a threshold level, notify a second device of the safety event.

title: Probabilistic motion model for generating medical images or medical image sequences
assignee: Siemens Healthcare Gmbh, Institut National De Recherche En Informatique Et En Automatique
abstract: Systems and methods for performing a medical imaging analysis task using a machine learning based motion model are provided. One or more medical images of an anatomical structure are received. One or more feature vectors are determined. The one or more feature vectors are mapped to one or more motion vectors using the machine learning based motion model. One or more deformation fields representing motion of the anatomical structure are determined based on the one or more motion vectors and at least one of the one or more medical images. A medical imaging analysis task is performed using the one or more deformation fields.
assignee_clean: siemens healthcare; institut national de recherche en informatique et en automatique

title: Image segmentation using isoperimetric trees
abstract: In a method of image segmentation, a tree is derived from input data. A no-fill ordering of a matrix is produced, the matrix representing the tree. A system of linear equations is solved with respect to the matrix, obtaining a solution. The solution is used to define a family of segmentations. A segmentation is selected from the family of segmentations based on a metric of segment quality.

title: Facilitating quantum tomography
abstract: Methods and systems for facilitating quantum tomography are provided. The system comprises a circuit generation component (104) and a tomographic analysis component (106). The circuit generation component (104) generates tomographic experiment data (502) indicative of information for a set of tomographic experiments based on quantum circuit data (112) indicative of a machine-readable description of the quantum circuit. The tomographic analysis component (106) generates tomographic data (114) based on experimental result data (504) indicating information associated with the tomographic experimental data (502).

title: Fractal calculating device and method, integrated circuit and board card
abstract: A fractal computing device according to an embodiment of the present application may be included in an integrated circuit device. The integrated circuit device includes a universal interconnect interface and other processing devices. The calculating device interacts with other processing devices to jointly complete a user specified calculation operation. The integrated circuit device may also include a storage device. The storage device is respectively connected with the calculating device and other processing devices and is used for data storage of the computing device and other processing devices.

title: Item recommendation method and equipment for protecting user privacy and learning system
assignee: 阿里巴巴达摩院(杭州)科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a project recommendation method, a device and a learning system for protecting user privacy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: any data device obtains a locally collected scoring matrix, the scoring matrix is used for describing scoring conditions of multiple users on multiple projects, and scoring matrices collected by the multiple data devices respectively have the same user set and different project sets. And sending the first user expression matrix obtained by local training to the server so that the server carries out aggregation processing on the user expression matrices uploaded by the plurality of data devices respectively and sends the second user expression matrix obtained by aggregation to the plurality of data devices. If the training cutoff condition is met, predicting the preference degrees of the multiple users to the multiple items according to the item expression matrix obtained by local training and the second user expression matrix, and recommending the items for the multiple users according to the preference degrees.
assignee_clean: 阿里巴巴达摩院 杭州 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 阿里巴巴达摩院 杭州 科技有限公司

title: Method and computer system for generating a combined tissue-vessel representation
abstract: An embodiment relates to a computer-implemented method for generating a combined tissue-vessel representation. The method includes receiving imaging data of a tissue; receiving imaging data of a vessel; generating a tissue representation based on the imaging data of the tissue; generating a vessel representation based on the imaging data of the vessel; and generating a combined tissue-vessel representation based on the vessel representation and the tissue representation, the vessel representation being overlaid over the tissue representation.

title: Method and system of privacy enablement in a family networking computing platform
abstract: In one aspect, computerized method of a managing an online social network comprising: providing an online social network, wherein the online social network comprises a set of nodes, wherein each node represents a user and a set of relationships between each node; managing a private profile setting in the online social network by: in the settings of a user's dashboard of the online social networking-computing, providing the user an option to change to a private user from a public user; detecting that the user has selected to be a private user; and assigning a unique networking-computing platform identifier to the private user, wherein the unique networking-computing platform identifier is required to search for the private user in the online social network, wherein the private user cannot make any comment to another user's post, and wherein the private user is enabled to like the user's post.

title: Distinguishing minimally invasive carcinoma and adenocarcinoma in situ from invasive adenocarcinoma with intratumoral and peri-tumoral textural features
abstract: Embodiments include controlling a processor to access a radiological image of a region of lung tissue, where the radiological image includes a ground glass (GGO) nodule; define a tumoral region by segmenting the GGO nodule, where defining the tumoral region includes defining a tumoral boundary; define a peri-tumoral region based on the tumoral boundary; extract a set of radiomic features from the peri-tumoral region and the tumoral region; provide the set of radiomic features to a machine learning classifier trained to distinguish minimally invasive adenocarcinoma (MIA) and adenocarcinoma in situ (AIS) from invasive adenocarcinoma; receive, from the machine learning classifier, a probability that the GGO nodule is invasive adenocarcinoma, where the machine learning classifier computes the probability based on the set of radiomic features; generate a classification of the GGO nodule as MIA or AIS, or invasive adenocarcinoma, based, at least in part, on the probability; and display the classification.

title: On-line visual detection system for high-speed dispensing
assignee: 苏州矩度电子科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an online visual detection system for high-speed dispensing, which is used for acquiring real-time dispensing effect images acquired by a camera; extracting shallow layer characteristics and deep layer characteristics of the real-time dispensing effect image to obtain a dispensing effect shallow layer characteristic image and a dispensing effect deep layer characteristic image; performing feature interaction and reinforcement on the spot gluing effect shallow feature map and the spot gluing effect deep feature map to obtain a regional focusing reinforced spot gluing effect shallow feature map; and determining whether a dispensing defect exists or not based on the shallow characteristic map of the area focusing reinforced dispensing effect. Therefore, the real-time dispensing effect image can be processed and analyzed by combining the artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning, so that whether the dispensing defect exists or not can be intelligently judged, and the online detection of the dispensing process is realized.
assignee_clean: 苏州矩度电子科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 苏州矩度电子科技有限公司

title: Ownership determination in privacy firewalls
abstract: Systems, methods and non-transitory computer readable media for ownership determination in privacy firewalls are provided. A request of a user to perform an action for creating a new data collection using source data collections may be received. In response to the user not having permission to view at least part of at least one of the source data collections and the user not being an owner of the at least one of the source data collections, it may be determined that the user is not an owner of the new data collection, and in response to the user being at least an owner of the data collection or having permission to view the entire data collection for all source data collections, it may be determined that the user is an owner of the new data collection.

title: Identification server by artificial intelligence and image processing system based on pacs including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an image processing system, and more particularly, to an artificial intelligence reading server for determining whether a patient has a lesion based on a PACS that provides functions of storing and transmitting medical images and, through the same, providing useful medical information, a PACS-based image processing system including the same and a method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the artificial intelligence reading server determines whether a patient has a lesion with high accuracy from medical images acquired by various medical equipment for CT, MRI, etc. through an artificial intelligence technique, and distributes a determination result by generating an overlay plane and inserting the same to the medical images. Therefore, a doctor can perform medical treatment faster by using the same for diagnosis, and a patient without specialized knowledge can also easily check whether the patient has a lesion and the state of the lesion.

title: User terminal having a plurality of subscriber identity modules
abstract: A user equipment (UE) is provided. The UE includes a first subscriber identity module (SIM) configured to correspond to a first cellular network, a second SIM configured to correspond to a second cellular network, a wireless communication circuit, and a processor configured to determine a SIM to be used for Internet data communication among the first SIM and the second SIM as the first SIM, perform a connection process for Internet data communication and internet protocol (IP) multimedia subsystem (IMS) communication for a voice call with the first cellular network using first identification information about the first SIM, perform a connection process for the IMS communication with the second cellular network using second identification information about the second SIM, configure a parameter for the UE to support a narrow bandwidth for the second cellular network in UE capability information and transmit the UE capability information to the second cellular network.

title: Image classification method, device, equipment and storage medium based on self-supervision active learning
abstract: The invention relates to an image classification method based on self-supervision active learning, which is characterized in that an initial neural network model is trained by using a marked first image data set and an unmarked second image data set through self-supervision learning, and the initial classification network model is finely tuned by using the marked first image data set; obtaining a value image dataset from the unlabeled second image dataset by utilizing information entropy and self-supervision loss; and labeling the value image data set, updating the first image data set, and fine-tuning the optimized first classification network model again. According to the invention, the self-supervision loss of the mask self-encoder and the uncertainty of the image data sample are combined by utilizing the self-supervision active learning training neural network model, the most valuable image data is selected for labeling, and meanwhile, the optimized classification neural network model is finally obtained through screening and optimization, so that classification can be performed when a small amount of image data is labeled, and the classification accuracy of the image is improved.

title: Compositions and methods for monitoring the treatment of breast disorders
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems, media, and methods for processing and aligning breast images and uses thereof. The processes disclosed herein may be used to diagnose, predict, and monitor the status or outcome of breast density masking, and breast cancer in a subject, and methods of treating the same.

title: Synthetic mammogram with imprinted image impression
abstract: A method is for generating a synthetic mammogram. In an embodiment, the method incudes acquisition of a plurality of projection data sets at a plurality of projection angles; and generation of at least one synthetic mammogram with an image property essentially equivalent to a conventional full-field digital mammography acquisition based on several projection data sets.

title: Medicine data sales prediction method and system based on time series hybrid model
assignee: 北京药云数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a medicine data sales prediction method and a system based on a time sequence hybrid model, which relate to the technical field of medicine sales prediction, and the medicine data sales prediction method based on the time sequence hybrid model comprises the following steps: acquiring time series data of medicine sales, preprocessing the medicine sales data in the time series data set, and constructing a feature matrix; respectively constructing a short-term prediction model and a long-term prediction model based on the feature matrix; model training and test evaluation; and (3) predicting the sales of the medical data through an optimized short-term prediction model or long-term prediction model according to the predicted demand, visually displaying the predicted result, and explaining and deducing the predicted result by using an explanatory machine learning algorithm. The method can effectively improve the accuracy and the robustness of the prediction model; the method is beneficial to improving the application value of the prediction result, and can help enterprises to make reasoning and decision, so that market trend and competition environment can be better mastered.
assignee_clean: 北京药云数据科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京药云数据科技有限公司

title: Modification of neural network topology
abstract: A method may include obtaining data representative of an NNT of a graph-based model that includes multiple components. The multiple components may include multiple neural nodes and at least one connection. The at least one connection may associate two or more of the neural nodes. The method may include displaying the NNT including the multiple components in a GUI via a display screen. The method may include receiving user input effective to indicate that at least one of the components of the NNT is to be modified. The user input may be received via the GUI. The method may include modifying the at least one of the components of the NNT. The at least one of the components may be modified based on the user input. The method may include displaying the NNT that comprises the modification of the at least one of the components via the GUI.

title: Methods and devices for detection of eating behavior
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods are provided for detecting and correcting eating behavior. A device may receive audio data, determine that the audio data is indicative of consumption of a product by a user. The device may determine, based on the product, a measureable attribute associated with the user. The device may receive first data associated with the measureable attribute. The device may determine that the first data exceeds a threshold. The device may generate a message for presentation.

title: Knowledge base acquisition method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides a knowledge base acquisition method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: performing feature extraction on at least two modal data of the information resource to obtain at least two modal features; fusing the at least two modal characteristics to obtain at least one modal fusion characteristic; extracting information from the at least one modal fusion feature to obtain at least one piece of knowledge slice information; and acquiring a target knowledge base based on at least one piece of knowledge piece information of the information resource. According to the technical scheme, the knowledge source channel is enlarged by extracting the characteristics of at least two modal data of the information resources, the extracted modal characteristics are fused, information extraction is carried out on the fused modal fusion characteristics, and the content association among multimodal knowledge can be mined, so that the knowledge base can be more accurately acquired, and the knowledge base acquisition efficiency is improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Construction method of disease risk prediction model
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
abstract: The invention relates to a construction method of a disease risk prediction model. The invention provides a new method for constructing a disease risk prediction model, which is used for filling missing data values by machine learning and effectively optimizing parameters of the disease prediction model, so that the disease risk prediction model suitable for clinic is constructed and formed. Aiming at the problem that the prediction result of the artificial intelligence in the medical data processing is unreliable, the invention provides a new model construction method, which has important application value.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院

title: Controllable medical ultrasonic image denoising method, system and computer storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a controllable medical ultrasonic image denoising method, a system and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a simulated noise ultrasonic image data set, preprocessing a simulated noise ultrasonic image, establishing a denoising model, training the denoising model, establishing a joint loss function and the like, establishing a controllable medical ultrasonic image denoising model, then firstly downsampling a true medical ultrasonic image to be denoised, inputting a subgraph of the downsampled true medical ultrasonic image and 2 characteristic parameters with set values into the trained denoising model, adaptively denoising the true medical ultrasonic image by the denoising model, flexibly adjusting denoising intensity, and finally outputting medical ultrasonic images denoised by different denoising intensities. The invention can adapt to a wider denoising range, can adaptively denoise, can flexibly adjust the denoising intensity, can effectively remove the noise of the medical ultrasonic image, and simultaneously retains the detailed information of the medical ultrasonic image.

title: Collaborative imaging method and device, storage medium and collaborative imaging equipment
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The application is applicable to the technical field of image processing, and provides a collaborative imaging method, a device, a storage medium and a collaborative imaging device, which comprise: acquiring original data of a first image and original data of a second image corresponding to the same detection area, wherein the original data of the first image and the original data of the second image have a position corresponding relationship, and the first image and the second image are acquired by adopting different image acquisition modes respectively; and inputting the original data of the first image, the original data of the second image and the position corresponding relation into a collaborative imaging model for image reconstruction to obtain a first reconstructed image corresponding to the first image and a second reconstructed image corresponding to the second image. The method and the device can shorten the time of image reconstruction, and can further improve the imaging efficiency while improving the cooperative imaging effect.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院

title: Deformable registration of medical images
abstract: Systems and computer-implemented methods of performing image registration. One method includes receiving a first image and a second image acquired from a patient at different times and, in each of the first image and the second image, detecting an upper boundary of an imaged object in an image coordinate system and detecting a lower boundary of the imaged object in the image coordinate system. The method further includes, based on the upper boundary and the lower boundary of each of the first image and the second image, cropping and padding at least one of the first image and the second image to create an aligned first image and an aligned second image and executing a registration model on the aligned first image and the aligned second image to compute a deformation field between the aligned first image and the aligned second image.

title: QRS wave detection method based on deep learning
abstract: The QRS wave detection method based on deep learning is short in time consumption, simple in process and high in accuracy, can quickly and accurately detect the QRS wave, and can also be applied to medical mobile equipment for detecting heart diseases; the invention provides a hole convolution, which is characterized in that a hole convolution is added on the basis of a basic neural network algorithm, the view field of the convolution is increased while the convolution kernel is kept unchanged through the hole convolution, and the detection precision of QRS waves is greatly improved; the method does not need the operations of electrocardiosignal preprocessing, waveform feature extraction and the like, directly uses deep learning to replace, saves time, reduces workload, does not need manual identification, and improves working efficiency.

title: Anonymized generating and proving of processed data
abstract: A computer-implemented method is for providing processed data. In an embodiment, the method includes receiving, by a first encryption entity, first plaintext data including a matrix of numbers; determining, by the first encryption entity, an encryption key including an integer matrix; homomorphically encrypting, by the first encryption entity, the first plaintext data based on a matrix multiplication of the first plaintext data and the encryption key, to generate first encrypted data; sending, by the first encryption entity, the first encrypted data to a processing entity; receiving, by a decryption entity, encrypted processed data from the processing entity, the encrypted processed data being based on the first encrypted data; decrypting, by the decryption entity, the encrypted processed data based on a matrix multiplication of the processed data and an inverse of the encryption key, to generate processed data; and providing, by the decryption entity, the processed data.

title: Medical document creation support apparatus, method and program, learned model, and learning apparatus, method and program
abstract: A feature information acquisition unit acquires the first feature information on the first medical image and second feature information on the second medical image having an imaging time different from an imaging time of the first medical image. A sentence creation unit compares the first feature information and the second feature information generated by the feature information acquisition unit, and creates a sentence representing a change between the first medical image and the second medical image. A display control unit causes the display unit to display a sentence representing a change.

title: Combination of spla2 activity and oxpl/apob cardiovascular risk factors for the diagnosis/prognosis of a cardiovascular disease/event
assignee: 国立健康与医学研究所, 加利福尼亚大学董事会, 巴黎大学迪德罗特第七分校
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of identifying a subject having or at risk of having or developing a cardiovascular disease and/or a cardiovascular event, comprising: measuring, in a sample obtained from said subject, at least two cardiovascular risk factors: a) sPLA2 activity and b) oxidized phospholipids on apolipoprotein B-100 particles (Ox PL/apo B), combining said measurements, the combined value of s PLA2 activity and Ox PL/apo B being indicative of having or a risk of having or developing a cardiovascular disease and/or cardiovascular event.
assignee_clean: 国立健康与医学研究所; 加利福尼亚大学董事会; 巴黎大学迪德罗特第七分校
primary_assignee: 国立健康与医学研究所

title: Quality control method, device and system for monitoring treatment equipment and storage medium
assignee: 神州医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: Some embodiments of the present application provide a quality control method, apparatus, system and storage medium for monitoring a therapeutic device, the method comprising obtaining a three-dimensional point cloud image including an object of interest; inputting the three-dimensional point cloud image into a subarea detection model to obtain a subarea point cloud image of interest; acquiring information to be evaluated according to the regional point cloud image of interest; and generating a quality control strategy according to the information to be evaluated and the plan information, wherein the plan information is plan treatment information formulated according to the condition of the patient. The method provided by the embodiment of the application can automatically monitor the accelerator in real time in the treatment process, thereby improving the effectiveness and accuracy of treatment and providing a guarantee for the safety of the treatment process of patients.
assignee_clean: 神州医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 神州医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Artificial intelligence apparatus for performing self diagnosis and method for the same
abstract: Disclosed is an artificial intelligence apparatus that includes: a sensing unit that includes a gyroscope sensor and an acceleration sensor; an output unit that outputs information; and a processor that acquires a resultant value output from a deep learning model by inputting data acquired from the gyroscope sensor and the acceleration sensor into the deep learning model, performs self-diagnosis when the resultant value shows a shock requiring self-diagnosis, and controls the output unit to output a result of the self diagnosis, in which the deep learning model is a neural network having an adjusted weight by being trained using whether a shock is a shock requiring the self-diagnosis as a resultant value and sensing values of the gyroscope sensor and the acceleration sensor as input values.

title: Deep learning staging method based on diabetic foot wound ischemia or infection images
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning staging method based on images of ischemia or infection of diabetic foot wounds. The method comprises the steps of using a two-input single-output integrated fusion network structure, adopting pre-training model parameters of an image data set in a network training process as initial parameters of feature extraction during training, and using a training data set to train the whole network parameters. In addition, the learning rate also adopts a cosine decay with warmup cosine attenuation strategy with preheating, a smaller learning rate is used at first when training is started, and the model is relatively stable and then the preset learning rate is selected for training, so that the model convergence speed is faster, and the model effect is better. The invention effectively improves the classification accuracy, provides a new thought for the auxiliary diagnosis of diabetic foot ulcer wounds, and has a certain clinical application value. The invention is suitable for being applied to the field of medical image auxiliary diagnosis.

title: Multi-phase object contour refinement
abstract: A method and system perform single phase and multi-phase contour refinement of lesions. The method includes receiving a three dimensional input mask; receiving input slices from the medical images including a lesion; cropping the input slices with the input mask; performing lesion contour refinement for the cropped input slices and the input mask to obtain a predicted mask; and storing the predicted mask that includes 3D lesion contour refinement. A multiphase method includes deforming the 3D input mask from the reference phase to a target phase or warping the input slices from the target phase to the reference phase before contour refinement. The warped images generate an output mask in the reference phase coordinate system that is then deformed to the target phase coordinate system for display.

title: System and method for automatic emergency airway detection
abstract: A method and apparatus is provided for automatic emergency airway detection. The apparatus includes a frame with a carriage guide configured to be secured around a neck of a subject. A carriage including a sensor is configured to move along the carriage guide. The sensor is configured to measure a value of a parameter indicating a topography of the neck of the subject. A processor includes a memory with instructions to receive first data from the sensor of the value of the parameter as the carriage is moved along the carriage guide and to determine, with the first data, second data indicating a position along the carriage guide corresponding to the cricothyroid region of the neck. The processor subsequently transmits a first signal indicating the second data. A method of using the apparatus is also provided.

title: Mammary gland image processing method, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a mammary gland image processing method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a mammary gland image to be detected; performing mammary gland segmentation processing on the mammary gland image to be detected based on a mammary gland segmentation model to obtain an image segmentation result corresponding to the mammary gland image to be detected, and performing parameter analysis on the image segmentation result to obtain a parameter analysis index corresponding to the mammary gland image to be detected; and/or carrying out foreign matter detection processing on the breast image to be detected based on a foreign matter detection model to obtain a foreign matter detection result corresponding to the breast image to be detected; and when the parameter analysis index is unqualified and/or the foreign matter detection result is a detection result with the presence of foreign matter, determining the breast image to be detected as an unqualified breast image to be detected. The method and the device can improve the imaging quality of the mammary gland image and ensure high accuracy of mammary gland disease diagnosis.

title: Automated medication compliance assurance system
abstract: Provided is a system providing a solution for improving prescription drug compliance monitoring and compliance. Prescription drug compliance monitoring may be achieved by using patient's electronic device to initiate secure digital imaging. Medications may be dispensed in containers with pre-printed encoded unique identifiers and markings. The patient may use the digital camera in their smart phone to take a picture of the dispensed blister pack which may be processed and analyzed. Analysis may include assessment of the number of pills taken from and remaining in the uniquely identified blister pack. Package identification and consumption information may then be linked with other prescription information to determine if the observed rate of use is compliant with the legal prescription and to document that the imaged medication package is the same as the dispensed medication package. Data may also be linked with pharmacologic and clinical data to categorize risk and urgency of misuse.

title: Pregnancy outcome influence factor evaluation method based on relative risk decision tree model
assignee: 北京航空航天大学, 国家卫生健康委科学技术研究所

title: Biological information analysis method and device for high-throughput sequencing, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 广州达安临床检验中心有限公司, 成都高新达安医学检验有限公司, 上海达安医学检验所有限公司, 高新达安健康产业投资有限公司, 杨剑锋
abstract: A high-throughput sequencing biological information analysis method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, the method in one embodiment comprises the following steps: acquiring high-throughput sequencing data of a gene sequence to be detected; analyzing and processing the high-throughput sequencing data to obtain gene sequence parameters of the gene sequence to be detected; extracting and obtaining user information parameters corresponding to the gene sequence to be detected; and classifying the variable characteristics comprising the gene sequence parameters and the user information parameters through a classification model obtained by training to obtain a gene classification result of the gene sequence to be detected. The scheme of the embodiment reduces the detection cost, can correct the results of false positive and false negative, and improves the detection accuracy.

title: Relative feature scores for brain parcels
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for generating explainability data that explains a medical condition in a subject. In one aspect, a method comprises: obtaining data identifying a plurality of brain parcels that are predicted to be relevant to the medical condition; receiving fMRI data for a brain of a subject; processing the fMRI data for the brain of the subject to determine a respective activation score for each of the plurality of brain parcels that are predicted to be relevant to the medical condition; determining, for each of the plurality of brain parcels that are predicted to be relevant to the medical condition, a relative activation score for the brain parcel; and taking an action based on the relative activation scores.

title: Autism auxiliary evaluation system based on deep learning
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The utility model provides an autism assists evaluation system based on degree of depth learning. The system comprises a data acquisition and feature extraction unit, a first neural network, a second neural network, a third neural network and a result output unit, wherein the data acquisition and feature extraction unit and the result output unit are respectively connected with the first neural network, the second neural network and the third neural network, and the data acquisition and feature extraction unit is used for acquiring eye movement data of a subject watching a video to obtain a heat spot diagram, a focus diagram and a scanning path diagram; inputting a hot spot diagram by a first neural network to obtain a first classification result; the second neural network inputs a focus map to obtain a second classification result; inputting a scanning path diagram by a third neural network to obtain a third classification result; the result output unit collects the first classification result, the second classification result and the third classification result to obtain the autism detection result of the subject. The utility model provides high autism's prediction efficiency and prediction accuracy.

title: Auxiliary diagnosis system and method for palace laparoscope
abstract: The invention discloses a palace laparoscope auxiliary diagnosis system which comprises a video receiving module, a machine learning module, a result reporting module and a database module, wherein the machine learning module comprises a machine diagnosis unit, an artificial diagnosis unit and a deep learning unit; the video receiving module transmits the received images acquired by the palace laparoscope equipment to the machine learning module, the machine learning module learns and trains machine diagnosis results and artificial diagnosis results, the images are classified and stored in the database module, machine judgment results are repeatedly corrected according to the stored classified image sets, judgment result optimization is gradually achieved, and the result reporting module is used for recording and displaying the image diagnosis results. The invention can carry out feedback learning on the machine diagnosis and manual diagnosis results and provide more accurate and reliable basis for disease diagnosis.

title: Electronic device and method for generating a user-customized keypad based on usage characteristics
abstract: An electronic device and method thereof are provided, which allow an input device e.g., a keypad or a keyboard) thereof to be customized. The electronic device may include a display module, a processor operatively connected to the display module, and a memory operatively connected to the processor. The memory may store instructions that cause, when executed, the processor to display a UI based on execution of an application, to acquire keypad information and/or user input information from a user input related to a first keypad of the UI, to determine characteristic information for a second keypad based on the acquired information, to organize the second keypad based on the characteristic information, and to display the second keypad through the UI.

title: High-resolution cardiac motion pattern analysis device and method
assignee: 杭州海睿博研科技有限公司, 帝工(杭州)科技产业有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a high resolution heart machine motion mode analysis device, comprising: the super-resolution processing unit receives an original heart image, and carries out super-resolution processing on the image through a super-resolution neural network focusing an interested region ROI to obtain a super-resolution image; and a motion analysis unit that extracts local and global motion features in the super-resolution processed image through a deep learning framework.

title: Intelligent rehabilitation nursing device to thorax export syndrome
assignee: 深圳市前海蛇口自贸区医院
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent rehabilitation nursing device for thoracic outlet syndrome, which comprises a rehabilitation scheme generation module, wherein the module generates a personalized rehabilitation scheme according to the positions, the number and the affected degree of affected muscles of the thoracic outlet syndrome of a patient. In addition, the nursing execution module executes corresponding nursing operation according to the generated rehabilitation scheme. The dynamic monitoring module evaluates the rehabilitation progress and effect by monitoring myoelectricity information of the affected muscles in the process of the nursing operation. And the adjusting feedback module adjusts and optimizes the rehabilitation scheme in real time according to the evaluation result of the dynamic monitoring module. And finally, the patient interaction module is used for interacting with the patient, collecting patient feedback and transmitting information. The intelligent rehabilitation nursing device provides a comprehensive solution integrating evaluation, treatment, feedback and interaction for rehabilitation treatment of patients with the thoracic outlet syndrome, thereby improving the rehabilitation nursing effect on the thoracic outlet syndrome.

title: System and method of pre-processing discrete datasets for use in machine learning
assignee: Andre J. UNGER, Robert William ENOUY
abstract: There is provided a system and method of pre-processing discrete datasets for use in machine learning. The method includes: determining a median and a standard deviation of an input discrete dataset; determining a probability mass function including a probability of finding a particular data point in the input discrete dataset within a particular bin of a histogram representative of the input discrete dataset; transforming the probability mass function into a continuously differentiable probability density function using the standard deviation, the probability density function determined using a parametric control function, the parametric control function including a lognormal derivative of the probability density function, the parameters within the control function are estimated using optimization that minimizes a mean-squared error of an objective function; and outputting the probability density function for use an input to a machine learning model.
assignee_clean: andre j unger; robert william enouy

title: Implantable medical device control system and control method therefor
abstract: Provided are an implantable medical device control system and a control method therefor, the system comprising: an implantable medical device implanted into the body so as to stimulate a specific area in the body; a management terminal for controlling the driving of the implantable medical device by communicating with the implantable medical device through a wireless communication method; and a management server connected with the management terminal so as to be capable of communicating therewith, assigning priority to each parameter included in patient condition information and storing and managing same, and providing the stored information, and thus, since priority is assigned to each parameter included in patient condition information and stimulation applied to a specific part in the body is adjusted according to the assigned priority, the entire parameter can be controlled such that a patient condition is maintained in a stabilized state by satisfying a preset reference value.

title: Segment level heterogeneity
abstract: A method of operating a storage system having solid-state storage memory with segment level heterogeneity is provided. The method includes mapping data into data segments, and mapping the data segments into data stripes. The method includes writing a first data stripe from a first data segment across a first plurality of blades of the storage system comprising heterogeneous total amounts of the solid-state storage memory per blade, and writing a second data stripe from the first data segment across a second plurality of blades of the storage system.

title: Disease coding method and system based on regional medical big data
assignee: 中电通商数字技术(上海)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a disease coding method and system based on regional medical big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring electronic medical record data; s2, cleaning and denoising the acquired disease name data; s3, establishing a mapping relation dictionary to obtain an international disease classification mapping dictionary; s4, establishing a commonality mapping model; s5, mapping the disease name data and outputting a corresponding disease coding result; s6, carrying out targeted supervision on the successful mapping data set and the unsuccessful mapping data set. The beneficial effects are that: the invention can effectively improve the efficiency, accuracy and recall rate of automatic disease coding, and can further be more beneficial to standardized processing of electronic medical record data, associated medical image data, examination and inspection and other medical big data by carrying out standard and standard classification coding on complex and changeable disease names, and finally can be applied to the fields of quality control, scientific research and artificial intelligence.

title: Digital twin model mapping system for oral cavity, dental jaw face and neck and establishing method
assignee: 上海交通大学医学院附属第九人民医院, 无锡时代天使医疗器械科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of an oral digital model, and particularly discloses an oral dental maxillofacial neck digital twin model mapping system and an establishing method thereof, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a 3D printing module, a mechanical analysis module, a data scanning module, a digital twin module and an output module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires maxillofacial soft and hard tissue image data of a patient, facial images, respiration acquisition, pronunciation acquisition, saliva acquisition, blood acquisition and gene acquisition; collecting the image data of the soft and hard tissues of the jaw and the face of a patient comprises collecting the data of the jaw, the face and the neck of the patient by utilizing CT, and scanning the intraoral tooth data by an intraoral scanner and the soft tissue contour of the face by a face scanner. The twin model fully considers the differences of three-dimensional model data, biochemical data, language, respiration and facial expression changes of different individuals, screens the optimal treatment scheme and visualizes the effect of the treatment in distress.

title: Medical record coding method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 医渡云（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a medical record coding method, a medical record coding device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: extracting a plurality of target entities from a target medical record; determining the single-hot codes corresponding to the target entities based on the number of the entities in the preset knowledge graph; determining a plurality of first vectors corresponding to the plurality of target entities based on the first vectors of the entities in the preset knowledge graph; determining a vector of the target medical record based on a plurality of first vectors corresponding to the plurality of target entities and the unique hot codes corresponding to the plurality of target entities; and determining the codes corresponding to the vectors of the target medical record through a deep learning model. The method has the advantages that the vector of the target medical record is determined based on the knowledge graph, the accurate vector representation of the target medical record is realized, then the automatic coding based on the vector is realized by combining the deep learning model, and the medical record coding efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title: Wi-Fi signal-based human body key point detection method and system
abstract: The application discloses a human body key point detection method and system based on Wi-Fi signals, which record CSI data and CSI time stamps in signal coverage areas of a Wi-Fi signal transmitting end and a Wi-Fi signal receiving end; video data and UNIX timestamps; performing cross-mode indirect labeling on the CSI data by utilizing the acquired video data; inputting the marked CSI data as training data into a Wi-Fi transducer model for training, and storing the Wi-Fi transducer model after convergence; and inputting Wi-Fi data to be detected into a trained Wi-Fi transducer model, and outputting human body key point data. The Wi-Fi transducer model is adopted to detect key points of a human body, so that the method is simple, quick and accurate; the method can not expose sensitive privacy of faces and the like, and can be used in the fields of daily life and health care.

title: A classifier for attack detection in cloud environment and data computing for smart cities and smart healthcare system using internet of things
assignee: Deena Babu Mandru, Ranadheer Donthi, Ghantasala, G S Pradeep, D. NageswaraRao, Naik. B, Venkateswarulu, O. Obulesu, G. Somasekhar, S. Vijay Prasad, N. VinayaKumari, Raparthi Yaswanth
abstract:
A CLASSIFIER FOR ATTACK DETECTION IN CLOUD ENVIRONMENT AND DATA 
COMPUTING FOR SMART CITIES AND SMART HEALTHCARE SYSTEM USING 
INTERNET OF THINGS 
ABSTRACT 
Cloud computing shares the resource in information technology field. Intrusion detection 
systems are used by network administrator to examine the traffic being exchanged between 
different network segments. The designed technique failed to provide better results for 
identifying unknown attacks with higher accuracy and lesser time consumption. In order to 
address these problems, Radial Basis Kernel Regressive Feature Extracted Brown Boost 
Classification (RBKRFEBBC) method is introduced for performing the attack detection 
performance with higher accuracy and minimal time consumption in cloud computing.  
RBKRFEBBC method perform the feature extraction using dichotomous radial basis kernelized 
regressive function and classification using Generalized Recurrent Neural Brown Boosting 
Classifier (GRNBBC) algorithm. Dichotomous radial basis kernelized regressive function is used 
to extract the relevant features through determining the correlation between the output and one or 
more input variables. After extracting relevant features, GRNBBC algorithm is used to improve 
the secured data communication performance through classifying the patient data transaction as 
attack presence or attack absence. Experimental evaluation is carried out by NSL-KDD dataset 
using different metrics like attack detection accuracy, attack detection time and error rate. The 
evaluation result shows RBKRFEBBC method improves the accuracy and minimizes the time 
consumption, error rate than existing works.

title: Fundus lesion grading method based on small sample learning
assignee: 中国矿业大学, 徐州市第一人民医院
abstract: The invention discloses a fundus disease grading method based on small sample learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting and preprocessing retina fundus color photographs to obtain the existing fundus disease data set; respectively learning the intra-class characteristics and inter-class characteristics of each level of fundus lesions by the image data through a contrast network and a meta-network which are subjected to pre-training and meta-training; and finally, carrying out similarity scoring on the unlabeled image and each level fundus lesion prototype so as to carry out grading prediction of fundus lesions. According to the invention, fundus lesions can be classified better by self-learning fundus lesions and fundus illumination with a small number of samples through a dual-network structure comprising a comparison network and a meta-network after meta-training, and the fundus lesions can be classified on the basis of effectively reducing noise influence in both aspects of a feature space and a label space, so that the accuracy of fundus lesions prediction is improved.
assignee_clean: 中国矿业大学; 徐州市第一人民医院

title: System and method for processing and identifying content in form documents
abstract: The present disclosure generally provides a system and method for processing and identifying data in form. The system and method may distinguish between content data and background data in a form. In some aspects, the content data or background data may be removed, wherein the remaining data may be processed separately. Removal of the background data or the content data may allow for more effective or efficient character recognition of the data. In some embodiments, data may be processed on an element basis, wherein each element of the form may be labeled as background data, content data, noise, or combinations thereof. This system and method may significantly increase the ability to capture and extract relevant information from a form.

title: Chronic patient follow-up method, device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a chronic disease patient follow-up method, a device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring characteristic data of each chronic patient; analyzing the characteristic data of each chronic patient by using a first reinforcement learning model, determining the intervention form of each chronic patient, and taking a plurality of chronic patients with the intervention form manually intervention as patients to be visited to form a patient set to be visited; acquiring characteristic data and follow-up preference time periods of each patient to be followed, calculating intervention weight of each patient to be followed, and acquiring a plurality of idle time periods of medical staff; and analyzing the characteristic data, the follow-up preference time period and the intervention weight of each patient to be visited and a plurality of idle time periods of the medical staff by using the second reinforcement learning model, and generating the follow-up sequence of the medical staff to each patient to be visited. This application can provide convenient for medical and nursing follow-up work, promotes the follow-up effect, and applicable in wisdom medical field.

title: Image judgment device, image judgment method, and storage medium
abstract: Disclosed is an image judgment device including a hardware processor that functions as an image acquirer that acquires image data of a medical image that is obtained by radiographing of a part including a region to be diagnosed of a patient, a segmentation unit that extracts an anatomical structure from the medical image to generate an extracted image, an image converter that performs image conversion on the extracted image to generate a converted image; a feature value extractor that calculates a feature value from the extracted image and/or the converted image by using a result of machine learning; and a judgment unit that judges whether the medical image is taken with positioning appropriate for diagnosis based on the feature value by using a result of machine learning concerning feature values.

title: System and method for offering customers' appointments based on their predicted likelihood of accepting the appointment
abstract: A non-transitory storage medium having stored thereon instructions, the instructions being executable by one or more processors to perform operations comprising responsive to a trigger, generating a model based on extracted features from a first selection of data from a dataset, testing the predictive appointment model based on a second selection of data from the dataset. Applying the predictive appointment model to the dataset to generate customer preference probabilities. Aggregating a list of available appointments. Predicting and proactively contacting customers most likely to accept one or more available appointments based on the customer preference probabilities.

title: Image processing method and device, image processing equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of image processing, and provides an image processing method, an image processing device, image processing equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of dividing a tomography image to be processed into tomography image blocks, extracting image features of the tomography image blocks, processing the image features of the tomography image blocks according to a pre-trained sparse coding network, a high-resolution dictionary and a low-resolution dictionary to generate a high-resolution image block corresponding to each tomography image block, combining the high-resolution image blocks corresponding to all the tomography image blocks to obtain and output a high-resolution reconstructed image corresponding to the tomography image, and therefore artifact removal and detail compensation are performed on the low-resolution tomography image through combination of depth learning and sparse coding, the calculated amount and hardware cost of processing the tomography image are reduced, and meanwhile the processing efficiency and processing effect of the tomography image are effectively improved.

title: Scoring system of electronic medical record question-answering model
assignee: 生命奇点(北京)科技有限公司, 奇点数联(北京)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a scoring system of an electronic medical record question-answering model, which comprises a sample electronic medical record information set, a second preset text set, a processor and a memory storing a computer program, wherein when the computer program is executed by the processor, the following steps are realized: according to a sample electronic medical record information set, an initial electronic medical record question-answering model is obtained, a second preset text set is input into the initial electronic medical record question-answering model, a first initial text set is obtained, a first initial text vector set is obtained, a second initial text set and a second initial text vector set are obtained, a first similarity list is obtained, a second similarity list is obtained according to a first initial keyword set and a second initial keyword set, a to-be-selected priority corresponding to the initial electronic medical record question-answering model is obtained, the result output by the model is judged, the model is scored when the result meets a threshold value condition, and the model is scored based on different dimensions, so that the scoring accuracy of the obtained electronic medical record question-answering model is higher.
