title: Companion animal augmented reality implementation system using artificial intelligence
abstract: Embodiments provide a system for implementing companion animal augmented reality (AR) using artificial intelligence, which can generate an AR video of a companion animal in augmented reality very similar to a real companion animal even after the animal has died. The system for implementing companion animal AR using artificial intelligence according to an embodiment comprises: an object data collection unit that collects object data of a companion animal; an auxiliary data collection unit that collects location information including information about a place where the object data is collected and state information including information about the companion animal's health; a trigger generation unit that generates trigger information of the object data by collecting information about an event in which the object data is generated; a correlation information analysis unit that generates correlation information of the object data; and an AR implementation unit that outputs an AR video of the companion animal based on the object data. The correlation information analysis unit generates metadata of the object data based on the location information and the state information, determines trigger information corresponding to the object data among the multiple pieces of trigger information, calculates the weight of each of the determined trigger information, and generates the correlation information of the object data based on the weight and the determined trigger information. The AR implementation unit selects the object data referring to the metadata and the correlation information and can output the AR video of the companion animal based on the object data.

title: Technology to automatically identify the most relevant health failure risk factors
abstract: Systems, apparatuses and methods may provide technology that identifies minority class data and majority class data in patient-level data, wherein the minority class data corresponds to patients with a health failure and the majority class data corresponds to patients without the health failure, oversamples the minority class data to obtain synthetic class data and automatically reduces, via a machine learning classifier, a set of risk factor variables based on the majority class data, the minority class data and the synthetic class data.

title: Multi-type muscle fatigue detection method based on feature extraction and GRU deep learning model
assignee: 中国科学院合肥物质科学研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a muscle fatigue detection method based on feature extraction and GRU deep learning models, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of 1, collecting surface electromyographic signals of a long-term back muscle group of a subject through a surface electromyographic sensor, dividing sample data, screening abnormal values, filtering and denoising, and setting classification labels according to fatigue limit; 2, extracting the cleaned data sample sliding window into a characteristic sequence of the shape [ s, c ], guiding the characteristic sequence into a GRU neural network for training, and setting sample sampling weight measures in the training process to solve the problem of unbalanced sample labels; and 3, adjusting the learning rate optimization model by using the verification set, selecting an optimal model by taking the accuracy of the verification set as a standard, and running the final model on the test set, wherein the fatigue detection of each final muscle area can reach an accuracy rate of more than 98%. The invention can overcome the limitation of the traditional single muscle detection method, carry out comprehensive fatigue detection on main muscle groups of the human body, and improve the detection accuracy.

title: Analytics system onboarding of web content
abstract: Analytics system onboarding of web content is described. In one example, an analytics onboarding system is configured to process web content to generate recommendations, automatically and without user intervention. The recommendations are configured to assist in mapping of web content variables in web content to data elements supported by an analytics system to generate metrics that describe occurrence of events as part of user interaction with web content.

title: Ambulatory monitoring of physiologic response to Valsalva maneuver
abstract: Systems and methods for monitoring physiologic response to Valsalva maneuver (VM) are disclosed. An exemplary patient monitor may detect a natural incidence of a VM session occurred in an ambulatory setting using a heart sound (HS) signal sensed from the patient. The patient monitor may include a physiologic response analyzer to sense patient physiologic response during the detected VM session, and generate a cardiovascular or autonomic function indicator based on the sensed physiologic response to the VM. Using the physiologic response to the VM, the system may detect a target physiologic event using the sensed physiologic response to the VM.

title: Multi-channel speech compression system and method
abstract: A method, computer program product, and computing system for selecting a reference audio acquisition device from a plurality of audio acquisition devices of an audio recording system. Audio encounter information of the reference microphone may be encoded, thus defining encoded reference audio encounter information. A plurality of acoustic relative transfer functions between the reference microphone and the plurality of audio acquisition devices of the audio recording system may be generated. The encoded reference audio encounter information and a representation of the plurality of acoustic relative transfer functions may be transmitted.

title: Blood flow characteristic prediction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳睿心智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a blood flow characteristic prediction method, a blood flow characteristic prediction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the blood flow characteristic prediction method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image of a target object; dividing blood vessels of the target object and functional tissues of the target object from the medical image, and dividing the functional tissues into areas to determine functional tissue areas irrigated by the blood vessels; acquiring image features of a target blood vessel, and acquiring image features of a target functional tissue region, wherein the target functional tissue region is a functional tissue region irrigated by the target blood vessel; and predicting the blood flow characteristic of the target blood vessel based on the image characteristic of the target blood vessel and the image characteristic of the target functional tissue region. The embodiment of the application can improve the accuracy of blood flow characteristic prediction and reduce the requirement on hardware resources.

title: Manifold-anomaly detection with axis parallel
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for detecting and identifying anomalous data in an input data set are provided.

title: Training method and device for information prediction model, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a training method, a training device, computer equipment and a storage medium of an information prediction model, which mainly aims at improving the prediction precision of the information prediction model. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multiple times of diagnosis data and actual disease information of a sample patient; determining a first node related to the sample patient in a medical knowledge spectrogram and an associated node corresponding to the first node according to the multiple visit data; constructing a personalized knowledge graph corresponding to the sample patient according to the first node and the corresponding associated node, and determining a first feature vector corresponding to the sample patient according to the personalized knowledge graph; inputting the first feature vector into an initial disease information prediction model for prediction to obtain predicted disease information corresponding to the sample patient; and constructing a preset disease information prediction model based on the predicted disease information and the actual disease information. The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and digital medicine.

title: Blockchain-based central repository and analytical platform for communications in the internet of things
abstract: A method, computer system, and a computer program product for communicating and interpreting a plurality of Internet of Things (IoT) sensor data from one or more IoT devices is provided. The present invention may include collecting the plurality of IoT sensor data from the one or more IoT devices associated with a user to a central collection repository. The present invention may then include analyzing the collected plurality of IoT sensor data by utilizing an artificial intelligence (AI) enabled analytics platform. The present invention may also include creating one or more transactions associated with the analyzed plurality of IoT sensor data. The present invention may further include adding the one or more created transactions to a blockchain structure.

title: Electronic device including speaker module
abstract: According to various embodiments of the disclosure, an electronic device may include: a first housing, a second housing accommodating at least a portion of the first housing and configured to guide sliding movement of the first housing, a flexible display including a first display area disposed on the first housing and a second display area extending from the first display area, a speaker module including a speaker unit including at least one speaker disposed in the second housing and a speaker enclosure accommodating the speaker unit and including a vent hole, and a seal connected to the first housing and the speaker enclosure and configured to be variable based on the sliding movement of the first housing.

title: Using unstructured temporal medical data for disease prediction
abstract: A method for providing a lung disease risk measure in a Computer Aided Diagnosis system is described. The method comprising the steps of: receiving a plurality of inputs for a subject, each input comprising at least one image showing all or part of the lungs of a patient and a time stamp for the image, where the inputs are obtained at varying intervals; analysing the inputs to assess temporal changes in the images using at least one of an input data encoder and a time stamp encoder; inputting the output of at least one of the encoders to a score calculator to calculate a risk score; outputting the risk score indicating the lung disease risk for the subject. A Computer Aided diagnosis system for implementing the method is also described.

title: Method, apparatus, system and computer storage medium for obtaining fractional flow reserve
assignee: 杭州脉流科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a method, a device, a system and a computer storage medium for obtaining fractional flow reserve, comprising the following steps: acquiring image data and physiological parameters related to coronary arteries and hearts, and constructing a corresponding three-dimensional model through processing the image data; the image data includes an aortic image and a coronary image, the coronary image including a diastolic coronary image and a systolic coronary image; solving a hemodynamic control equation according to the three-dimensional model to obtain hemodynamic parameter distribution of a coronary artery in an area expressed by the three-dimensional model; the hemodynamic parameter distribution is used to calculate fractional flow reserve at the site of the vascular stenosis. The method for obtaining the fractional flow reserve provided by the application has the advantages that the three-dimensional model is more in accordance with a physiological structure by processing the diastolic image data and the systolic image data, and the reduction degree of the three-dimensional model is improved; by solving the hemodynamic parameter distribution, the fractional flow reserve of the narrow part of the blood vessel is calculated, and the accuracy is improved.

title: Target contour curve determination method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for determining a target contour curve, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image of a target object, and performing image segmentation on the medical image to obtain a part segmentation result of the target object; determining initial triangular patch data of the target object based on the part segmentation result, and smoothing the initial triangular patch data based on vertex coordinates and vertex pixel values of all vertexes in the initial triangular patch data to obtain target triangular patch data of the target object; and rendering the target triangular patch data to obtain a target contour curve of the target object. By the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the time for extracting the contour information is shortened, and the accuracy and the safety of extracting the contour information are improved.

title: Scanning dose modulation method, scanning device, scanning apparatus and storage medium
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly provides a scanning dose modulation method, a scanning device, scanning equipment and a storage medium. The scanning dose modulation method comprises the following steps: obtaining flat sheet data of a measured object; obtaining attenuation curve data of each slice position according to the flat slice data; inputting the attenuation curve data into a pre-trained attenuation curve data and scanning attenuation data relation network, and outputting corresponding scanning attenuation data; the scanning attenuation data are corresponding to each paying-off position of the measured object at the slicing position; and obtaining corresponding scanning dose according to the scanning attenuation data. According to the scanning dose modulation method provided by the invention, through the pre-training of the relation network of the attenuation curve data and the scanning attenuation data, the modulation of scanning doses at different positions is realized according to the scanning attenuation data at the corresponding output positions, the consistency of imaging noise is ensured to be better, and the imaging quality is improved.

title: Medical image stream identification method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a medical image stream identification method, a medical image stream identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium; after the medical image stream of the object to be identified is acquired, the local trained image classification engine can be directly called, a plurality of medical image frames in the medical image stream are classified through the trained image classification engine, then the inspection type of the object to be identified is determined according to the classification result of the medical image frames, and the determined inspection type and the medical image stream are sent to the server, so that the server calls the artificial intelligence engine corresponding to the inspection type to identify the medical image stream; the scheme not only can improve the processing efficiency, but also can simplify the implementation flow and conditions and improve the applicability of the method.

title: Methods and systems for medical imaging based analysis of ejection fraction and fetal heart functions
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for enhanced heart medical imaging operations, particularly as by incorporating use of artificial intelligence (AI) based fetal heart functional analysis and/or real-time and automatic ejection fraction (EF) measurement and analysis.

title: Generating interactive zones for interventional medical devices
abstract: A concept for facilitating a user interface for interacting with interventional medical devices depicted in an image. The positions of one or more features of at least one interventional medical device are identified. A size and shape of an interactive zone is determined for each feature, where an interactive zone (when provided on a display of a user interface) facilitates interaction with the corresponding feature and/or interventional medical device. The size of the interactive zone is chosen to be larger than the size of the feature. A position for the interactive zone is selected based on the position/position of the corresponding feature in the image. Zone information is then output to define the size, shape and position of the interactive zones with respect to the image.

title: System for providing artificial intelligence based smart health care service
abstract: Provided is a system for providing a smart health care service based on an artificial intelligence, which comprises: a user terminal for outputting one or more exercise programs, outputting the selected exercise program to be synchronized with time and position when any one of the exercise programs is selected, and detecting an exercise state of a user from a wearable band including one or more sensors; a monitoring terminal for collecting milestone data including a current position of the user terminal, and a position of one or more exercise tools arranged in a member store, and arranging the milestone data in a 2D drawing converted from 3D information obtained by scanning the member store; and a smart health care service providing server including a transmission unit for transmitting the exercise programs to the user terminal, a control unit for controlling the exercise program selected by the user terminal to be output from the user terminal so as to be synchronized with time and position, a storage unit for storing at least one sensor data received from the wearable band to be mapped with the user terminal, and a tracking unit for monitoring the position of the user terminal collected from the monitoring terminal to be synchronized with the time.

title: Systems and methods of clinical state prediction utilizing medical image data
assignee: Mcgill University, D. Louis Collins, Simon Duchesne
abstract: There is provided a method for predicting a clinical state of a subject based on image data obtained from a Volume Of Interest in the subject. The method comprise the establishment of a predictive model that relates image features and the future evolution of a clinical state.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for training model and acquiring additional characteristic data
assignee: 第四范式（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for training a model and acquiring additional characteristic data. Acquiring a feature prediction model, wherein the feature prediction model is trained based on a source data set, and the feature prediction model is used for predicting at least one part of unique features of source data based on at least one part of common features between the source data and target data; acquiring a target data set; inputting at least a part of common features in the target data into a feature prediction model for each item of target data in the target data set to obtain at least a part of unique features predicted by the feature prediction model for at least a part of the input common features; and taking at least one part of the predicted unique characteristics as additional characteristic data of the target data. According to the invention, the common characteristic is taken as the springboard, the unique characteristic of the source data is migrated to the target data in a model migration mode, and the source data and the target data are not contacted in the process, so that the leakage risk of the source data is greatly reduced.

title: Free-breathing MRI with motion compensation
assignee: Siemens Healthcare Gmbh, The Regents Of The University Of California
abstract: A method for acquiring magnetic resonance imaging data with respiratory motion compensation using one or more motion signals includes acquiring a plurality of gradient-delay-corrected radial readout views of a subject using a free-breathing multi-echo pulse sequence, and sampling a plurality of data points of the gradient-delay-corrected radial readout views to yield a self-gating signal. The self-gating signal is used to determine a plurality of respiratory motion states corresponding to the plurality of gradient-delay-corrected radial readout views. The respiratory motion states are used to correct respiratory motion bias in the gradient-delay-corrected radial readout views, thereby yielding gradient-delay-corrected and motion-compensated multi-echo data. One or more images are reconstructed using the gradient-delay-corrected and motion-compensated multi-echo data.

title: Exam prefetching based on subject anatomy
abstract: Inference of appropriate anatomical region from inconsistent descriptions in order to provide fast and accurate prefetching is provided. In various embodiments, a first plurality of user-configurable rules is read from a data store. Each rule maps to a user-configurable anatomical region. A plurality of studies is accessed from the image archive. Each of the plurality of studies has associated metadata. The plurality of rules is applied to the metadata associated with the plurality of studies to determine an anatomical region of each of the plurality of studies. Based on the anatomical regions of the plurality of studies and one or more additional rule, a subset of the plurality of studies is selected for display to a user on a display.

title: Focus positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on template image
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the fields of digital medical treatment and artificial intelligence, and discloses a focus positioning method, a focus positioning device, focus positioning equipment and a storage medium based on a template image. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first tissue abnormality training image and performing focus area enhancement treatment; extracting spatial image features of a plurality of sizes corresponding to each tissue abnormal image block and a first feature map thereof; updating the focus positioning training model until the focus positioning training model converges, and obtaining a focus positioning model; obtaining a tissue structure template image and a tissue abnormality image to be identified, and respectively extracting a second characteristic image of the tissue abnormality image to be identified and a third characteristic image of the tissue structure template image; and carrying out similarity matching on the second feature map and the third feature map based on the position information to obtain a similarity matching result, and determining positioning information of the similarity matching result in the template image. The invention realizes the positioning and identification of the specific position of the focus point.

title: Sensitive data processing method, system and storage medium based on forgetting model
assignee: 湖北省楚天云有限公司, 华中科技大学
abstract: The invention discloses a sensitive data processing method, a sensitive data processing system and a storage medium based on a forgetting model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining the KL divergence of noise by initializing a machine learning identification model and an original machine learning model according to the forgetting data error rate minimized noise matrix; updating an original machine learning identification model based on KL divergence to obtain a forgetting model to be processed; obtaining KL divergence of the sample through an original machine learning identification model and a forgetting model to be processed according to the error rate minimization sample; updating the forgetting model to be processed based on the sample KL divergence to obtain a forgetting model; and obtaining the data to be identified, inputting the data to be identified into a forgetting model for category prediction, and obtaining a false prediction result of sensitive data to be identified and a correct prediction result of safety data to be identified. The invention obtains the forgetting model after the private data is erased, and effectively protects the privacy safety of personal sensitive information on the premise of not sacrificing the performance of the model.

title: Method and device for transmitting sidelink signal in wireless communications system
abstract: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a method whereby a sidelink terminal transmits a signal in a wireless communications system, the signal transmission method comprising the steps of: mapping data to symbols in a slot; and transmitting a signal after mapping the data, wherein whether to map data to a predetermined symbol in the slot and the interval of mapping are determined on the basis of subcarrier spacing and a frequency range.

title: Methods and systems for automated selection and ordering of hair products
abstract: A system for the viewing and selection of hair products includes a processor configured to obtain customer identification information characterizing one or more characteristics of a customer and to obtain customer measurement information characterizing one or more physical measurements of the customer. The processor also obtains selected product information characterizing a selected hair product of the customer and sends finalized order information regarding the selected hair product.

title: Sensing and operation of devices in viscous flow using derived parameters to reduce data-handling requirements
abstract: Devices, including robotic devices, operating in viscous fluid flow can use passive sensor data collected to represent fluid parameters at an instant in time to derive information about the flow, the motion and position of the device, and parameters of the physical system constraining the flow. Using quasi-static analysis techniques, and appropriate feature selection for machine learning, very accurate determinations can be made, generally in real time, with very modest computational requirements. These determinations can then be used to map systems, navigate devices through a system, or otherwise control the actions of, e.g., robotic devices for clean-up, leak detection, or other functions.

title: Intestinal tract preparation quality judging system
assignee: 首都医科大学宣武医院
abstract: The invention relates to an intestinal tract preparation quality judging system, which comprises an acquisition module; and a cloud server for analyzing and processing the image information related to the execution of the intestinal canal preparation operation by the patient, wherein the image information related to the execution of the intestinal canal preparation operation by the patient comprises first image information related to the administration operation by the patient and second image information related to the excretion operation by the patient, and the cloud server is configured to: and when the second image information is not matched with the excrement standard image information stored in the cloud server, the first image information is called to analyze the normative of the taking time node and/or the taking dosage of the patient, and a taking suggestion after the excretion time node corresponding to the second image information is generated. The invention can solve the problem that the cause of the phenomenon cannot be determined when the intestinal preparation quality of a patient is judged to be unqualified or insufficient in the prior art, and accurate medication advice cannot be given.

title: Electronic device and method for audio sharing using the same
abstract: An electronic device is provided to detect a connection of a first wireless audio device and a second wireless audio device, identify whether a wearer of the first wireless audio device and a wearer of the second wireless audio device are different, based on a first sensor signal received from the first wireless audio device and a second sensor signal received from the second wireless audio device, execute an audio sharing mode, based on the wearer of the first wireless audio device and the wearer of the second wireless audio device being different, control configuration information about the first and the second wireless audio device that are related to a function of the audio sharing mode, and transmit audio data according to the audio sharing mode to the first wireless audio device and the second wireless audio device, based on the configuration information.

title: Method for sharing health information
abstract: Disclosed is a method performed by a computing apparatus, including at least one processor, to share health information. The method includes the following steps of: receiving food information including information about food intake of a user and exercise information including information about exercise of the user from a first user terminal to store the food information and the exercise information in a server; transmitting the food and exercise information received from the first user terminal, to a second user terminal in order to share the food and exercise information of the user of the first user terminal with a user of the second user terminal; and receiving an information modification request from the second user terminal to modify at least one piece of the food and exercise information stored in the server in order for the user of the second user terminal to provide improved information to the user of the first user terminal.

title: Cloud-based medicine service management system
assignee: 愛酷智能科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a cloud-based medicine service management system, which comprises: a member communication management module, a drugging management module, a medication reminding module, a data storing module, a medical information providing module, a health education resource acquisition module, a medical resource acquisition module and a machine learning module. The system uses the drugging management module to obtain medication information on the drug list and reminds the individual or group of drugging time and drugging amount through the medication reminding module. In addition, the system can also provide medical-related information through the medical information providing module, the health education resource acquisition module and the medical resource acquisition module.

title: Smart pellet for sample testing
abstract: A submersible sensor device configured as a small pellet for testing biological and other liquid samples is provided. In one aspect, a sensing device includes: a housing; and one or more sensors contained within the housing, wherein the housing hermetically seals the sensors such that the sensing device is fully submersible in a liquid analyte. A method and system for analysis of a liquid sample using the present sensing device are also provided.

title: Knee joint femur tibia segmentation method and device
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The application discloses a knee joint femur tibia segmentation method and device. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional medical image of a knee joint after segmenting obtained medical image data to be processed, obtaining a three-dimensional medical image of the knee joint after the three-dimensional medical image of the knee joint is corroded by corroding the three-dimensional medical image of the knee joint, wherein the knee joint is divided into a femur and a tibia, the knee joint is corroded, the three-dimensional medical image of the knee joint is restored, bone corroded in the corrosion process is filled in the corresponding femur or tibia, a complete femur and tibia segmentation result is obtained, the medical image data is processed by adopting a computer vision technology, the problems that a knee joint segmentation method in the prior art is unstable in segmentation effect and slow in segmentation speed are solved, and the technical effects that the segmentation effect is stable and the segmentation speed is fast are achieved.

title: Parameter adjustment method, focus prediction method, parameter adjustment device and electronic equipment
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a parameter adjustment method of a single-mode detection network, a focus prediction method in an eye image, a parameter adjustment device of the single-mode detection network and electronic equipment; relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: performing feature coding on the first image features to obtain a first distribution function, and performing feature coding on the second image features to obtain a second distribution function; determining a first loss function value from the first distribution function and the second distribution function; determining the image characteristics to be compared according to the fusion of the sampling result of the second distribution function and the first image; and determining a second loss function value according to the comparison of the image features to be compared and the tags to be compared, and adjusting network parameters of the single-mode detection network according to the first loss function value and the second loss function value until the loss function value is converged. The method can overcome the problem of poor parameter adjustment effect to a certain extent, and further improves the processing effect of the network model on the input image.

title: Medical image diagnosis support device and magnetic resonance imaging apparatus
abstract: Two or more learning images generated for a first subject or a second subject and one or more correct answer images generated for the second subject or a third subject are received. In a case where pixel values of corresponding pixels of the two or more learning images are synthesized by using a synthesis parameter value, the parameter value at which the synthesized pixel values are close to a pixel value of a corresponding pixel of the correct answer image is obtained. An image generated for the first subject and having the same type as the two or more learning images is received as an examination target image. A synthesized image desired by a user is generated by synthesizing pixel values of corresponding pixels of the two or more examination target images by using the synthesis parameter value.

title: Method and Apparatus for Matching Medicine Code
abstract: Disclosed is a method and apparatus for matching medicine codes. An embodiment of the present invention provides a method and apparatus for collecting drug codes used at home and abroad, building a matching model, and providing a globally connected drug matching code. According to an aspect of the present embodiment, the apparatus comprises: a data collection unit for collecting a plurality of drug codes; a drug analysis unit that analyzes the drug code to generate code analysis information; a drug code matching unit generating drug code matching information; and a drug identification unit for identifying unidentified drugs from among the drug-related big data pre-stored in a plurality of medical institutions based on the drug code matching information.

title: Novel auxiliary chemotherapy multi-mode ultrasonic diagnosis system for breast cancer based on CNN
assignee: 新疆医科大学第三附属医院
abstract: The CNN-based breast cancer new auxiliary chemotherapy multi-mode ultrasonic diagnosis system comprises the steps of collecting breast cancer multi-mode ultrasonic images; making a database; determining the position corresponding relation between the multi-mode ultrasonic images; determining benign and malignant breast lesions or determining lesion relief area images after new adjuvant chemotherapy according to the corresponding relation; setting up a deep learning model according to the benign and malignant images and the focus relieving area images after chemotherapy; determining a benign and malignant classified image and a classified image of focus alleviation degree after chemotherapy according to the deep learning model; superposing the benign and malignant classified image and the classified image of the focus relieving degree after chemotherapy to the multi-mode ultrasonic image to determine a benign and malignant identification image and a focus relieving identification image; and identifying the benign and malignant focus and the focus alleviation degree after chemotherapy according to the benign and malignant identification image and the focus alleviation identification image.

title: Retrieval system and method for medical examination information
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical information retrieval, in particular to a retrieval system and a retrieval method for medical examination information. The method comprises the following steps: performing information extraction processing on the medical data information source by using a natural language processing technology to obtain medical examination information; the medical examination information is subjected to noise reduction processing by utilizing an information noise reduction algorithm so as to obtain medical examination information noise reduction data; classifying the medical examination information noise reduction data by using an examination information classification model based on machine learning to obtain medical examination information type data; constructing a medical examination information database, performing data structure conversion processing on the medical examination information type data through a structural conversion algorithm to obtain medical examination information structural data, and storing the medical examination information structural data into the medical examination information database. According to the invention, the medical examination information keyword index table is constructed by using the keyword index algorithm, so that the retrieval rate of medical examination information data is rapidly and effectively improved.

title: Deformable medical image registration method based on deformation field fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a deformable medical image registration method based on deformation field fusion, which is characterized in that a preprocessed image to be registered and a preprocessed reference image are input into a double-flow registration network, the double-flow registration network is provided with two branch networks with the same architecture and different loss functions, two different deformation fields are obtained, the two deformation fields are fused through a deformation field fusion module, the deformation field fusion module respectively carries out maximum pooling and average pooling on the two deformation fields, and the obtained characteristics are subjected to characteristic extraction through a convolution layer, and then the final deformation field is obtained through dimension reduction of the convolution layer; and finally registering the images to be registered according to the deformation field to obtain registered images. According to the invention, different deformation fields are effectively combined through the deformation field fusion module, the advantages of the different deformation fields are fully utilized to describe different types of deformation, the similarity loss function of the double-flow registration network can describe the interdependent context change between the reference image and the image to be registered, and the registration precision is improved.

title: Methods of treating cancers with CT45 targeted therapies
assignee: The University Of Chicago, Max-Planck-Gesellschaft Zur Forderung Der Wissenschaften E.V.
abstract: The current disclosure relates to methods for treating ovarian cancer based on specific antigen expression of the cancer. Furthermore, the expressed antigen may be used in immunotherapeutic methods for treatment of the ovarian cancer. Aspects of the disclosure relate to immunotherapies targeting CT45 polypeptides, methods for treating ovarian cancer based on CT45 expression, and kits for detecting CT45 polypeptides and nucleotides.

title: Interactive data processing method and device and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an interactive data processing method, an interactive data processing device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first interactive data of a target user, and determining interactive data characteristics of the first interactive data; acquiring a test task according to the first interactive data, and acquiring a test result of a target user aiming at the test task; determining a business object corresponding to the target user and a confidence coefficient corresponding to the business object according to the interactive data characteristics and the test result; generating third interaction data for responding to the first interaction data when the confidence reaches a confidence threshold; the third interaction data comprises the business object. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the man-machine interaction types are enriched, and meanwhile, the accuracy of solving the user problems through man-machine interaction is improved.

title: Neural network operation device and operation method
assignee: 北京中科寒武纪科技有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to a neural network arithmetic device and an arithmetic method, which can select different processing to be performed on the arithmetic result of a vector subunit in the same processing circuit. The method can enable the operation result obtained by the vector subunit in the operation process of the neural network to have more element subsequent processing modes, further well utilize the data sparsity in the training stage of the neural network, greatly reduce the operation amount of the neural network and improve the operation speed.

title: Data management techniques using distributed policy agent
abstract: Techniques described herein relate to a method for distributed data management. The method may include making a first determination that data is written to a data structure of storage of a data host; obtaining, based on the first determination, data information associated with the data; making a second determination of intent corresponding to the data; generating a global name and metadata corresponding to the data, wherein the metadata comprises the intent; and publishing the global name and the metadata to a global name repository.

title: Utilizing source context and classification in a copy operation
abstract: Aspects of the present invention disclose a method, computer program product, and system for augmenting a copy operation with contextual information from a source. The method includes one or more processors determining that a user provides input selecting content, within a document, and input adding the selected content to a clipboard. The method further includes one or more processors determining a classification of the selected content based on analyzing the selected content and the document utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP). The method further includes one or more processors extracting information associated with the selected content from the document based on the determined classification. The method further includes one or more processors updating the clipboard with the selected content and the extracted information.

title: Systems and methods for managing caregiver responsibility
abstract: Methods and systems for managing patient attributions are provided. Interaction events between clinicians and the patient are identified, and using times associated with each interaction, a time series of the interactions for each clinician may be constructed. Care responsibility curves measuring a clinician's care responsibility level over time may be generated using the time series, an initial care responsibility level assigned to each interaction and a rate of decay for each interaction, which may be based on the type of action and type of clinician who interacted with the patient. A care responsibility score for each clinician may be determined from the clinician's care responsibility curve, and a patient-attribution assignment record may be created to attribute the patient to one of the clinicians based on a ranking of the clinicians' care responsibility scores.

title: Ultrasonic imaging apparatus, image processing apparatus, and method thereof
abstract: Information on an anatomical feature of a subject is automatically displayed in real time on an intra-operative ultrasound image, and an operation is accurately guided. The ultrasonic imaging device is provided with: an image generation unit that generates an ultrasound 2D image from a reception signal of an ultrasound probe that transmits and receives ultrasound to and from a subject, and generates an ultrasound 3D image by a plurality of ultrasound transmissions and receptions; an image processing device that processes an ultrasonic 2D image and an ultrasonic 3D image, the image processing device including: a characteristic part position estimation/recognition unit (22) for an ultrasonic 3D image, which estimates/recognizes a characteristic part of the subject from the ultrasonic 3D image acquired by the ultrasonic 3D image acquisition unit (21); an ultrasonic 2D-3D image position alignment unit (25) that performs position alignment of the ultrasonic 2D image and the ultrasonic 3D image; an image display unit (26) displays the position and name of the characteristic part and information on the distance relationship with the ultrasonic 2D image on the real-time ultrasonic 2D image by using the acquired position information and the position alignment result of the characteristic part.

title: Electronic device and method for providing or obtaining data for training thereof
abstract: Methods for providing and obtaining data for training and electronic devices thereof are provided. The method for providing data for training includes obtaining first voice data for a voice uttered by a user at a specific time through a microphone of the electronic device and transmitting the voice recognition result to a second electronic device which obtained second voice data for the voice uttered by the user at the specific time, for use as data for training a voice recognition model. In this case, the voice recognition model may be trained using the data for training and an artificial intelligence algorithm such as deep learning.

title: Treatment image generation method and system in chemotherapy preparation stage
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The invention discloses a treatment portrait generation method and a treatment portrait generation system in a chemotherapy preparation stage, which belong to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an electronic medical record of a patient, extracting basic information, illness state information and checking results from the electronic medical record, and predicting whether a NAC mode of the new auxiliary chemotherapy has curative effect on the patient; in a history case library of a recommended chemotherapy mode, calculating the matching degree of the electronic medical record of the current patient and each history case; selecting a preset number of historical cases with highest matching degree, and generating an alternative chemotherapy scheme; predicting the chemotherapy effect; generating a treatment portrait of the patient in a chemotherapy preparation stage when the patient adopts the alternative chemotherapy scheme according to the basic information, the illness state information, the examination and examination result, the recommended chemotherapy mode, the alternative chemotherapy scheme and the estimated chemotherapy effect of the patient; the patient's treatment profile during the preliminary phase of chemotherapy is displayed.

title: Electronic device
abstract: To adjust the size or brightness of augmented reality information provided through an electronic device, the present disclosure provides an electronic device comprising an optical driving assembly including an image source panel for emitting image light, an optical element wherein the emitted image light is incident and totally reflected, a plurality of pin mirrors distributed in a region of the optical element and for deepening a depth of the image light reached, and a variable lens member provided at one point of an optical path before reaching the plurality of pin mirrors to vary a region where the image light reaches among the region where the plurality of pin mirrors are provided.

title: Dynamic threshold filtering for watched questions
abstract: Embodiments are directed to a watched questions threshold filtering system that functions to determine and deliver to a user relevant and significant data changes with respect to a user's goals, as defined by a notification threshold value provided by the user. The user is provided with an option to flag one or more queries for automatic re-querying. Confidence scores are processed on new data (i.e., data ingested after the original question was asked) by utilizing a confidence threshold for indicating if the new data warrants alerting a user.

title: System and method for automated gross examination of tissues
abstract: The various embodiments herein provide a system and method for automatic gross-examination of tissue samples. The apparatus is of cubicle shape comprising a bed where the specimen is placed, an ultrasound equipment mounted on top of cubicle box, a robotic arm mounted with a plurality of surgical blades, and a camera. The ultrasound technology is used to accurately understand the specimen, size and dimensions of a tumor that is studied. The robotic arm assisted surgical blades receive ultrasound output or camera output and accurately slice the specimen for further analysis. The information pertaining to gross-examination is stored in an external server connected to the apparatus and analyzed using artificial intelligence algorithms.

title: Method, apparatus, electronic device and medium for generating physical examination model
assignee: 北京大数医达科技有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a method, apparatus, electronic device and medium for generating a physical examination model. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample set; selecting a sample from the sample set and performing the training steps of: inputting basic information of a sample patient and symptom information of the sample patient in sample case information of the selected sample into an initial model to obtain physical examination information of the sample patient; analyzing the physical examination information of the patient of the sample and the physical examination information of the sample patient in the corresponding sample case information to determine a loss value; comparing the loss value with a target value; determining whether the initial model is trained according to the comparison result; in response to determining that the initial model training is complete, the initial model is determined to be a physical examination model. This embodiment enables the generation of physical examination information.

title: Image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image processing method, an image processing device, image processing equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an orientation map group; acquiring an orientation regression line corresponding to the orientation graph group; training a first model based on the orientation graph group and an orientation regression line corresponding to the orientation graph group; the first model is used for obtaining a second model to be trained through parameter migration, and the second model is used for executing an image processing task on a target image containing the object of the specified type after being trained through a training sample set. According to the technical scheme, the scanned image can be transmitted to the cloud server, the image processing based on the computer vision technology is carried out on the second model obtained by transferring and retraining the first model parameters trained on the basis of the orientation graph group and the orientation regression line corresponding to the orientation graph group in the cloud server, and the accuracy of the image processing is improved under the condition that the training sample set is small.

title: Systems and methods for premises monitoring
abstract: Monitoring a premises may comprise receiving signals from a plurality of devices. One or more spatially static devices of the plurality of devices may be determined based on strengths of the received signals. A user activity pattern may be determined based on changes in strengths of signals received from the spatially static devices. Abnormal user activity may be determined based on the user activity pattern and a strength of at least one signal received from at least one of the spatially static devices.

title: Pneumonia detection in cardiovascular patients
abstract: Systems and methods to detect pneumonia in cardiovascular patients are disclosed, including receiving physiologic information of a patient from an ambulatory medical device (AMD), the physiologic information comprising respiration information of the patient, and determining a pneumonia score of the patient using the received respiration information.

title: Electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic device. In the electronic device of the present invention, the center axis of the view angle with respect to the eyes of the user coincides with the center axis of the view angle with respect to the optical axis of the lens of the imaging section. The electronic device of the present invention may be associated with an artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence) module, a robot, an augmented reality (Augmented Reality, AR) device, a Virtual Reality (VR) device, a 5G service related device, or the like.

title: Systems for controllable summarization of content
abstract: A method of generating summaries of content items using one or more large language models (LLMs) is disclosed. A first content item is identified. The first content item includes a set of sub-content items. A level of abstraction is determined for the content item. A prompt is automatically engineered for providing to the one or more LLMs. The prompt includes a reference to the first content item and the level of the abstraction for the first content item. A response to the prompt is received from the LLM. The response includes a second content item. The second content item includes a representation of the first content item that is generated by the LLM. The representation omits or simplifies one or more of the set of sub-content items based on the level of abstraction. The representation is used to control an output that is communicated to a target device.

title: Intelligent chip device based on dynamic monitoring and analysis of cardiac function and application method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent chip device based on dynamic monitoring and analysis of cardiac function and an application method thereof. The portable intelligent wearable device is used as a core component of a heart function dynamic monitoring and analyzing device, so that the portable intelligent wearable device becomes smaller and more ingenious, the external monitoring on the mechanical vibration of the heart can be carried out in real time, the vibration information of the heart can be continuously and non-invasively obtained, and the pattern recognition and intelligent diagnosis are carried out by combining digital signal processing, machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies, so that the abnormity of the physical structure and the beating rhythm of the heart can be discovered at an early stage. Meanwhile, the early warning and timely medical care aims of early warning of heart diseases are achieved by combining with an early warning report system.

title: Information pushing method and device based on click behavior prediction
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an information pushing method and device based on click behavior prediction, relates to the field of artificial intelligence and digital medical treatment, and aims to solve the problems that the prior medical project is directly matched for pushing according to the patient treatment result, and the patient behavior information is not considered, so that the pushing requirement of the patient medical information cannot be met, and the effectiveness of receiving pushing information is reduced. Comprising the following steps: acquiring user characteristic information and product characteristic information; predicting the user characteristic information and the product characteristic information based on the completed click behavior prediction model to obtain a predicted click behavior result; if the result is the expected click behavior, extracting target keywords in target product information matched with the product characteristic information, and determining the similarity between each product keyword and the target keywords in the product database; and acquiring associated product information corresponding to the product keywords with the similarity larger than a preset similarity threshold, and outputting the associated product information and the target product information in a linkage mode.

title: Remote fault processing method and system for medical instrument
assignee: 江苏优创生物医学科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a remote fault processing method and a remote fault processing system for medical equipment, which relate to the technical field of fault processing, wherein the fault processing method comprises the following steps: dividing fault grades, and taking a part with high fault occurrence frequency as a fault point which is easy to occur; simulating the running state of the medical instrument under the limit condition by utilizing a digital twin technology, and identifying potential fault points; establishing emergency control measures based on fault prediction results of the easy fault points and the potential fault points; uploading and sharing fault data and operation data in real time; determining a fault source and providing remote fault diagnosis and maintenance guidance in combination with emergency control measures; and implementing limit control and safe shutdown according to the diagnosis result and maintenance guidance. The invention can effectively trigger the performance of partial performance faults by simulating the running state of the medical instrument under the limit condition, helps to identify potential fault points and provides references for remote fault handling personnel.

title: Healthcare interoperability environment system
abstract: The invention concerns an Interoperability Environment comprising: a core software engine comprising means to collect and transfer electronic data from any number of sources including medical devices, clinical information systems, hospital information systems, a means to apply rules to improve compliance with hospital approved protocols, standards and guidances, a means to update all subsystems using any given parameter when the parameter is updated in the official recognized source of truth for that parameter, a means to populate the CIS with all required patient information, while at the same time maintaining all quality and process control data in a format supporting advanced analytics separate from the CIS data, a means to communicate notifications to any number of remote electronic devices without limitation of platform and comprising a hardware eco system comprising means to collect, translate, store and send electronic data to the core software engine for any electronic source via communication methods including but not limited to LAN, Serial, Wi Fi, Wireless, etc.

title: Methods of measuring force using a tracking system
assignee: Smith & Nephew, Inc., Smith & Nephew Orthopaedics Ag, Smith & Nephew Asia Pacific Pte. Limited
abstract: Methods of measuring a force using a tracking system are disclosed. A first vector is determined between a first tracking array and a second tracking array on a tool. The tool has a flexible portion that has a known modulus of elasticity and moment of inertia. A force is applied to the tool, and a second vector is determined between the first tracking array and the second tracking array. An amount of deflection is determined for the tool, and the magnitude and direction of the applied force are determined based on at least the amount of deflection, the modulus of elasticity and the moment of inertia. Information pertaining to the magnitude and direction of the applied force is provided to a user.

title: Medical image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium

abstract: The application discloses a medical image processing method, a medical image processing device, medical image processing equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. According to the method and the device, the overall characteristic of the abnormal object is obtained by obtaining the position and the image characteristic of the abnormal object in the medical image, the sub-image containing the abnormal object is obtained based on the position of the abnormal object, the visual characteristic of the abnormal object is obtained based on the sub-image, the visual characteristic has definite physical significance, the physical characteristic of the abnormal object is obtained, the abnormal object is further classified based on the image characteristic and the splicing characteristic of the visual characteristic, the overall characteristic and the physical characteristic of the abnormal object are comprehensively considered in the classification process, the accuracy rate of identifying the abnormal object is improved, meanwhile, the visual characteristic has definite physical significance, the interpretability is strong, the accuracy rate of identifying the abnormal object can be further improved, and therefore, a doctor is effectively assisted in disease diagnosis.

title: Patient-specific guides for latarjet procedure
assignee: Smith & Nephew, Inc., Smith & Nephew Asia Pacific Pte. Limited, Smith & Nephew Orthopaedics Ag
abstract: Patient-specific guides for the Latarjet procedure, as well as surgical systems and methods of performing the Latarjet procedure to treat glenohumeral instability using such patient-specific guides are disclosed. A patient-specific coracoid guide and a patient-specific glenoid guide may be configured based on preoperatively generated three-dimensional models of the patient's shoulder anatomy. Guides may be configured for coracoid graft preparation and glenoid decortication. The coracoid graft may be placed in the desired position based on three-dimensional (3D) preoperative planning.

title: Display apparatus and method for operating display apparatus
abstract: Disclosed are a display apparatus and a method for operating the display apparatus, the display apparatus being operated by executing an artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm in a 5G environment connected for Internet of Things. The method for operating the display apparatus includes the acts of receiving utterance information of a user who is watching the display apparatus, selecting an utterance intention corresponding to the user's utterance information according to a predefined rule, switching operation of the display apparatus on the basis of the selected utterance intention, collecting reaction information of the user corresponding to the switched operation of the display apparatus, and reconstructing the predefined rule by using the user's utterance information, the selected utterance intention, and the user's reaction information. Since the user's utterance intention corresponding to the user's utterance information is accurately reflected when the operation of the display apparatus is switched, user satisfaction in using the display apparatus can be improved.

title: Electronic apparatus and control method thereof for reducing image blur
abstract: An electronic apparatus obtains a panoramic image by overlapping partial areas of image frames and identifies an object from the panoramic image or an area of a predetermined shape of maximum size within the panoramic image.

title: Method and system for assessing fibrosis in a tissue sample
assignee: Agency For Science, Technology And Research
abstract: There is provided a method of assessing fibrosis in a tissue sample. The method includes: obtaining a stained image of a stained tissue sample, the stained tissue sample being stained in relation to collagen therein; producing a plurality of different types of collagen images based on the stained image, the plurality of different types of collagen images corresponding to a plurality of different types of collagen, respectively; determining a plurality of different types of collagen parameters based on the plurality of different types of collagen images using a deep neural network; and determining a degree of fibrosis in the stained tissue sample based on the plurality of different types of collagen parameters. The plurality of different types of collagen comprises portal collagen, fibrillary collagen and septal collagen. The different types of collagen images are produced by determining if the collagen satisfies a predetermined size condition or a predetermined distance condition with respect to a boundary of the portal tracts and central veins.

title: Data processing method, data processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a data processing method, apparatus, computer device, and storage medium. Its disclosed integrated circuit board includes: the device comprises a storage device, an interface device, a control device and a neural network operation device based on label data; the neural network operation device based on the label data is respectively connected with the storage device, the control device and the interface device; a memory device for storing data; the interface device is used for realizing data transmission between the neural network operation device based on the label data and the external equipment; and the control device is used for monitoring the state of the neural network operation device based on the label data. According to the data processing method, the data processing device, the computer equipment and the storage medium, the data in the neural network are marked through the label information, the processes of storing, transferring, calculating and the like of the data are simplified, the occupation of hardware resources is reduced, and the calculation speed of the neural network is improved.

title: Speech recognition method and apparatus therefor
abstract: A speech recognition apparatus and an operating method thereof which execute a mounted artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or machine learning algorithm to perform speech recognition and communicate with different electronic apparatuses and external servers in a 5G communication environment are disclosed. A speech recognition method according to an exemplary embodiment of the present disclosure includes determining a temporary pause for reception of a first utterance sentence in the middle of the reception of the first utterance sentence, outputting a speech recognition processing result of a second utterance sentence which is received after the temporary pause, separately from the first utterance sentence, determining a third utterance sentence which is received after outputting the speech recognition processing result of the second utterance sentence as an extension of the first utterance sentence, and outputting a speech recognition processing result of a fourth utterance sentence obtained by combining the first utterance sentence and the third utterance sentence. According to the present disclosure, a delay occurring in the middle of reception of uttering speech is recognized as an uncompleted utterance to be temporarily stored and a speech recognition processing result for an additional uttering speech received after the delay is provided and then uttering speech which is input again and the uttering speech before the delay are recognized as completed utterance and a speech recognition processing result is provided to improve the speech recognition processing performance.

title: Text information processing method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a text information processing method, a text information processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical fields of natural language processing, intelligent medical treatment and knowledge graph. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: generating a corresponding medical record export graph according to text information in medical records to be processed, clustering disease nodes in the medical record export graph, dividing the medical record export graph into a plurality of medical record subgraphs according to clustering results, respectively encoding the plurality of medical record subgraphs, and generating a disease diagnosis result according to entity characteristics obtained by encoding. According to the clustering result of the disease nodes in the medical record derived graph, the medical record derived graph is divided into a plurality of medical record subgraphs, and the plurality of case subgraphs are respectively encoded to obtain entity characteristics, so that the information of different subgraphs can be effectively encoded, the structural encoding capacity of the medical record is effectively improved, the text information processing effect is enhanced, and the accurate recall rate of disease diagnosis prediction is improved.

title: Generating simulated photographic anatomical slices
abstract: Methods and systems for generating a simulated anatomical photograph based on a medical image generated by an imaging modality. One method includes receiving, with an electronic processor, the medical image, anatomically segmenting the medical image, with the electronic processor, to determine a plurality of anatomical structures represented in the medical image, and determining, with the electronic processor, how each of the plurality of anatomical structures is photographically depicted by accessing at least one knowledge base. The method also includes generating, with the electronic processor, the simulated anatomical photograph based on the plurality of anatomical structures and how each of the plurality of anatomical structures is photographically depicted, wherein the pixels of the simulated anatomical photograph represent a simulated cross-sectional anatomical photograph of the plurality of anatomical structures, and displaying, with the electronic processor via a display device, the simulated anatomical photograph within a user interface.

title: Medical image processing apparatus, medical image processing method, medium, and medical image processing system
abstract: A medical image processing apparatus includes a memory; and at least one processor configured to execute detecting one or more vertebral bodies and one or more intervertebral disks in a medical image; labeling each part satisfying a predetermined condition among the one or more vertebral bodies and the one or more intervertebral disks detected by the detecting; interpolating a vertebral body or an intervertebral disk in a case where the one or more vertebral bodies and the one or more intervertebral disks detected by the detecting do not include the vertebral body or the intervertebral disk that satisfies the predetermined condition; and executing the labeling also for the vertebral body or the intervertebral disk interpolated by the interpolating.

title: A kind of self adaptation oxygen absorption machine intelligence control system and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of self adaptation oxygen absorption machine intelligence control system, comprise, oxygen absorption machine (3), is connected with oxygen therapic patient (1) respiratory system by oxygen uptake flexible pipe; Physical signs monitor (2); be connected with oxygen therapic patient (1); be used for monitoring oxygen therapic patient (1) physical signs, described physical signs monitor (2) is also connected and is used for regulating and controlling described oxygen absorption machine (3) with described oxygen absorption machine (3); Intelligent terminal (4), be electrically connected respectively with described oxygen absorption machine (3) and described physical signs monitor (2), described intelligent terminal (4) receives described physical signs monitor (2) signal, controls described oxygen absorption machine (3) operation simultaneously. In addition, this case also discloses a kind of self adaptation oxygen absorption machine intelligent control method. Self adaptation oxygen absorption machine intelligence control system provided by the invention can long-rangely be monitored constantly oxygen therapic patient physiological situation and make response, applied widely, and saves human resources, has greatly promoted the security of oxygen uptake process.

title: Inpatient bed information intelligent management system
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院第三医学中心
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent management system for hospital bed information, which relates to the technical field of bed information management, and is characterized in that if the value of a weather variation index exceeds a weather variation threshold value, a model established by a Bp neural network is trained to generate a hospital bed demand prediction model so as to predict the hospital bed demand in a hospital and obtain a prediction result; using the trained cleaning evaluation model to evaluate whether the corresponding sickbed needs cleaning or not, and if so, sending a cleaning instruction; matching corresponding bed allocation rules according to the illness state information of the patient to be inpatified, allocating corresponding sickbeds for the patient from a plurality of idle sickbeds by using the trained bed allocation model, and sending out allocated sickbed position information; and generating feedback coefficients of bed allocation by the feedback data set, and sending out revision instructions when the feedback coefficients exceed a feedback threshold value, so as to rapidly allocate corresponding beds for patients, realize high efficiency and low error rate and reduce human intervention.

title: Bone age assessment method for bone image
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a computer program stored in a computer readable storage medium is disclosed. The computer program includes instructions for causing one or more processors to estimate bone age from a bone image, and the instructions include: estimating a RUS score for each of one or more partial bone images using a partial bone RUS score estimation model comprising one or more layers, and wherein the one or more partial bone images are generated from a whole bone image; and estimating bone age corresponding to the whole bone image using one or more RUS scores estimated for each of the one or more partial bone images, in which the partial bone RUS score estimation model is trained by using a labeled partial bone image as training data, and is trained by adjusting feature values calculated from the one or more layers.

title: Urban construction environment traffic accident spatial distribution influence factor analysis method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for analyzing space distribution influence factors of traffic accidents in urban construction environment, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining traffic accident information data and converting texts by utilizing a geocoding technology; step 2, utilizing data provided by a Goldmap open platform and combining a quadtree index method to extract 8 types of POI data in batches; step 3, analyzing the influence degree of various interest points around the traffic accident point on the accident occurrence by using a nuclear density method, and constructing an interest point set index to quantify the influence degree; step 4, carrying out correlation analysis on the POI average index and traffic accidents; step 5, performing dimension reduction and combination on the independent variables by using a principal component analysis method; step 6, constructing an accident point association network based on cosine similarity; and 7, performing optimized network clustering based on DBSCAN and performing clustering result analysis. The method quantitatively analyzes the interaction between the urban built environment and the traffic accident distribution, and has important significance for formulating a targeted traffic safety prevention scheme.

assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
