title: Yield inspection monitoring method and device and related equipment
assignee: 深圳平安智慧医健科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to artificial intelligence technology and digital medical technology, and provides a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for monitoring yield test, which comprise the following steps: determining a pregnancy test schedule according to the basic information; acquiring a target pregnancy time node closest to the gestational period of a target pregnant woman, and determining a target pregnancy project set corresponding to the target pregnancy time node; monitoring whether the target pregnant woman starts to execute the target pregnancy test item set; when the monitoring result is yes, acquiring the execution sequence and queuing number of each target pregnancy test item, and inputting the execution sequence and queuing number into a priority calculation model to obtain the priority sequence of each target pregnancy test item; acquiring a pregnancy test result of each target pregnancy test item, and calling an anomaly monitoring model to process the pregnancy test result to obtain an anomaly index; judging whether the abnormal index meets the prenatal diagnosis requirement; and when the judgment result is yes, reserving a department corresponding to prenatal diagnosis, and outputting a prompt target pregnant woman for diagnosis. The application can improve the efficiency of the labor examination monitoring and promote the rapid development of intelligent medical treatment.

title: Virtual even image generation method and device and electronic equipment
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a virtual even image generation method, a virtual even image generation device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as computer vision and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: when the virtual even image is acquired, the characteristic information of a target object can be acquired first, the characteristic information of the target object is used as the generation basis of the virtual even image, a target virtual face matched with the characteristic information is determined from a preset face material library in a targeted manner, and a target action video matched with the characteristic information is determined from a preset action video library; and fusing the virtual face with the face image in the action video, so that a virtual even image in the target object representation scene can be generated in a targeted manner, and the target object can be represented by the virtual even image in the follow-up process.

title: Image attenuation correction method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image attenuation correction method, an image attenuation correction device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of frames of original images and original correction images; establishing an original training matrix according to a plurality of frames of the original images and the original correction images; inputting the original training matrix into a deep learning model to obtain a deformation field of each frame of original image and an original correction image; and performing attenuation correction on the corresponding original image according to the deformation field of each frame of original image and original correction image and the original correction image. By adopting the method, the breathing artifact in the original image can be eliminated, and the imaging effect of the medical imaging equipment is improved.

title: Medical named entity recognition modeling method based on fusion attention
abstract: The medical named entity recognition modeling method based on the fusion attention comprises the following steps: performing Chinese word segmentation and indexing on the medical text sentence; obtaining a Bi-LSTM model by splicing forward LSTM and reverse LSTM; updating the output feature vector through an attention mechanism; and decoding the output characteristic vector by a conditional random field CRF to obtain the label of the medical entity type of the input medical text sentence. The invention adds the matched words in the dictionary on the basis of the character sequence, provides more guidance for the model through the dynamic control of the gate structure, and selects the most relevant characters and words from the medical corpus. Compared to character-based methods, multi-granular information is explicitly exploited by the model to obtain better recognition performance. And moreover, an attention mechanism is introduced, so that the model focuses on effective information, and the condition that the traditional Bi-LSTM-CRF model considers context information but ignores different characters and words with different importance in sentences is overcome.

title: Information output method and related product
assignee: Oppo广东移动通信有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of mobile terminals, and discloses an information output method and a related product. In the embodiment of the invention, the mobile terminal sends request information to the server through the processor to acquire the prescription information of a user, and then transmits the prescription information returned by the server to the AI module; the AI module generates a medicine purchase request according to the prescription information and outputs the medicine purchase request through the touch display screen so that a user can determine whether to complete medicine purchase according to the medicine purchase request. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can generate the medicine purchase request according to the prescription information, and if the user confirms the medicine purchase request, the payment interface is called to complete the payment, so that the medicine purchase flow is simplified.

title: Homologous genomic regions for characterization associated with biological targets
abstract: Embodiments of a method and/or system can include generating a co-amplified mixture based on co-amplifying a set of nucleic acid molecules (e.g., cell-free nucleic acids, etc.) from the biological sample, wherein the set of nucleic acid molecules includes a genomic region of interest associated with the medical condition; and a homologous native genomic region with partial sequence similarity to the genomic region of interest; sequencing the co-amplified mixture; determining an abundance metric for the genomic region of interest and an abundance metric for the homologous native genomic region; and/or facilitating the characterization of the medical condition based on the abundance metric for the genomic region of interest and the abundance metric for the homologous native genomic region.

title: Medical image segmentation method and system based on MEDU-Net+network
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image segmentation method based on an MEDU-Net+network, which comprises the following steps: adopting an acceptance module in the GoogLeNet to replace a 3X 3 convolution layer used for extracting image characteristic information in the original U-Net network, wherein the 3X 3 convolution layer comprises a plurality of branches to form a multi-scale encoder; correspondingly optimizing a decoder of the U-Net network, and recovering acquired semantic information of different scales by adopting a multi-scale decoding mode; wherein, each branch of the encoder and the decoder is uniform and corresponds to each other, a layer of one-pass jump connection is introduced to directly transfer the information extracted by the encoding end to the decoding end, and each part of the intermediate connection is the transposition convolution of the next adjacent layer; combining the generalized Dice loss function and the Focal loss function, introducing weights according to the characteristics of the medical image to generate the loss function in a combined form. The invention can learn the image characteristics as much as possible through a small amount of data, and obtain better segmentation results.

title: Secure messaging system with constrained user actions, including override, for ensured compliant transmission of sensitive information
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for secure messaging with constrained user actions. An example method includes causing presentation of an interactive user interface, the interactive user interface enabling messaging with end users, each end user being associated with a respective phone number. Selection of a particular end user is received via the interaction user interface and the interactive user interface is updated to include a selectable option which triggers transmission of a standardized consent message to a particular phone number associated with the particular end user. User input is received which indicates receipt of externally provided affirmative consent. The interactive user interface is updated, with the updated interactive user interface including an input portion configured to receive arbitrary information for transmission to the particular phone number.

title: Decentralized privacy-preserving clinical data evaluation
abstract: A system for decentralized privacy-preserving clinical data evaluation includes a plurality of sites of a decentralized private network, a memory device for storing program code, and at least one processor device operatively coupled to the memory device and configured to execute program code stored on the memory device to, for each of the local datasets, evaluate the local dataset using each of the local models to obtain one or more features related to a degree of outlierness, determine at least one outlier dataset based on the one or more features, and implement one or more actions based on the determination.

title: Medical image processing method and system
assignee: 阿里巴巴（中国）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image processing method and a medical image processing system. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring original medical images respectively scanned by image scanning equipment in different phases, wherein the original medical images in different phases at least show an object to be detected, and the positions of the object to be detected in the original medical images in different phases are not identical; converting the original medical image into a target medical image, wherein the positions of the objects to be detected in the target medical images of different phases are the same; and dividing the target medical image to obtain labeling information of the target medical image, wherein the labeling information is used for labeling focuses of the object to be detected in a corresponding period phase, and is used as a training sample for training to obtain an image prediction model, and the image prediction model is used for predicting the labeling information of the image to be analyzed containing the object to be detected. The invention solves the technical problem of low efficiency of image marking on medical images.

title: Method, system and device for oral cavity CBCT ultra-low dose imaging
assignee: 中日友好医院(中日友好临床医学研究所), 锐视智慧(北京)医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system and a device for oral cavity CBCT ultra-low dose imaging, and relates to the technical field of medical imaging, wherein the method comprises the steps of high-dose oral cavity CBCT image data collection, data splitting treatment, data three-dimensional reconstruction treatment, model training, image data input, image enhancement and image data output; the method comprises the specific flow of carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction processing on oral cavity CBCT two-dimensional projection data of a patient in an ultra-low dose mode to obtain ultra-low dose oral cavity CBCT three-dimensional reconstruction image data, inputting the ultra-low dose oral cavity CBCT three-dimensional reconstruction image data into an oral cavity CBCT ultra-low dose imaging image enhancement network model, and outputting to obtain high-quality oral cavity CBCT image data for subsequent clinical diagnosis and treatment flow. The invention can obviously reduce the imaging radiation dose, quicken the imaging speed and improve the oral cavity CBCT imaging safety on the premise of ensuring the imaging quality, and has wide clinical application prospect.

title: Early negative acknowledgment indication for a data message
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. Some systems may support the transmission of a predicted negative acknowledgment (NACK) indication for a downlink data message. In some cases, a base station may transmit a downlink data message to a user equipment (UE). The UE may perform a decoding process for the message. The UE may determine whether the decoding process is likely to fail during a first portion of the decoding process prior to completion of the decoding process. The UE may transmit a predicted NACK message to the base station prior to a feedback opportunity configured for the UE to transmit feedback based on a result of the completed decoding process. The base station may determine whether to retransmit the downlink data message based on the predicted NACK message, such that the predicted NACK message may reduce the latency associated with retransmission of downlink data messages.

title: Robot nursing system based on vision and idea signal cooperative control
abstract: The invention provides a robot nursing system based on vision and idea signal cooperative control, which comprises: the device comprises an image processing module, a human face mouse control module, a idea signal processing module and a mechanical arm control module. The image processing module realizes three-dimensional coordinate positioning of the mouth and the nose by identifying key points of the face and the face; the human face mouse control module selects a required object by detecting a mouse on a movement control screen of the nose tip; the idea signal processing module acquires brain wave signals of a nursing object in real time, extracts concentration degree and judges concentration state; the mechanical arm control module is used for grabbing objects and sending the objects to the mouth of a patient. According to the invention, the taking, delivering and feeding of the edible articles can be automatically completed according to the independent consciousness and the requirement of the cared personnel, the working intensity of the cared personnel can be reduced to a certain extent, the cared personnel can be liberated, and the problem of tension of the cared personnel can be solved.

title: Bill abnormity detection method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a bill abnormity detection method, device and equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a document to be processed of a target user, wherein the document to be processed is a document which is not subjected to resource restoration; acquiring a historical document of a target user, wherein the historical document is a document subjected to resource restoration; and determining an abnormal detection result corresponding to the document to be processed based on the document to be processed and the historical document. According to the method, an abnormity detection rule does not need to be established manually, so that the abnormity detection process of the document to be processed is more reasonable, and the abnormity detection result of the document to be processed is higher in accuracy.

title: Feature selection-based Chinese medicine main symptom selection method
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicine chief complaint selection method based on feature selection, which comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing medical record data; s2, carrying out preliminary filtering on the original feature set to obtain a candidate feature subset; s3, performing secondary feature screening on the candidate feature subset: and S4, performing final feature selection based on a cost principle to obtain a finally selected main symptom. In the feature selection process, the invention not only considers the weight of the features, but also considers the correlation between the features and the categories and the interactivity between the features, and selects the final features based on the minimum cost principle, thereby being beneficial to finding important features and obtaining the optimal feature subset.

title: Dynamic provisioning of data exchanges based on detected relationships within processed image data
abstract: The disclosed exemplary embodiments include computer-implemented systems, apparatuses, devices, and processes that, among other things, dynamically provision exchanges of data based on detected relationships within processed image data. For example, a network-connected apparatus may receive, from a device, image data that identifies a plurality of individuals associated with an exchange of data. Based on an analysis of the image data, the apparatus may determine a value of a first characteristic associated with each of the individuals and generate relationship data characterizing a relationship between the individuals. The apparatus may also determine candidate values of parameters that characterize the data exchange based on portions of the first characteristic values and the relationship data, transmit the candidate parameter values to the device. An application program executed by the device may cause the device to present at least a portion of the candidate parameter values within a digital interface.

title: Method and a device for monitoring the capacity of a crew member of an aircraft
abstract: A monitoring device comprising at least one measurement module for measuring at least one physiological parameter of the crew member, at least one consolidation module for consolidating the measured physiological parameter or parameters, a fusion module for fusing the consolidated physiological parameter or parameters in order to detect at least one physiological status of the crew member, a filtering module for filtering the physiological status or statuses, a determination module for determining a level of incapacity of the crew member, a transmission module for transmitting a signal indicative of the level of incapacity of the crew member to a user device.

title: Method for isolating and classifying blood cell types using deep convolution neural networks
assignee: Общество с ограниченной ответственностью "ПЛАТФОРМА ТРЕТЬЕ МНЕНИЕ"
abstract: FIELD: medicine; computer engineering.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to computer engineering and medicine. Image containing blood cells is obtained; method includes detecting, on the obtained image, blood cells; distinguished are normal and peripheral blood cells; isolating normal blood cells and cutting them from the image, and blood boundary cells are excluded from further analysis; followed by classification of blood cells by types, wherein: obtaining for each image of cut blood cells using augmentation method, which consists in obtaining from a single image a set of images, by turns, images and cuts of part of image; method includes analysing a set of images obtained for each cell and classifying each blood cell by type according to the given set.EFFECT: technical result consists in automatic detection and classification of blood cell types using deep convolutional neural networks.5 cl, 1 tbl, 7 dwg

title: Medical insurance intelligent management method, system, device and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a medical insurance intelligent management method, a system, a device and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the information of a patient in a hospital and the participation information; determining medical insurance problems of the patient based on the hospital information and the participation information; pushing at least one answer item to the patient based on the medical insurance problem, wherein the at least one answer item at least comprises the medical insurance problem and a medical insurance policy corresponding to the medical insurance problem; based on the at least one solution item, at least one read solution item for the patient is determined and a medication regimen for the patient is recommended to the physician. The medical insurance intelligent management system comprises an acquisition module, a determination module, a pushing module and a recommendation module. The method can be realized by a medical insurance intelligent management device. The method may also be run after being read by computer instructions stored on a computer readable storage medium.

title: Machine learning health analysis with mobile device
abstract: Devices, systems, methods, and platforms for continuously monitoring a user's health (e.g., heart health) are disclosed. Systems, methods, devices, software and platforms are described for continuously monitoring health indicator data (such as, but not limited to, PPG signals, heart rate or blood pressure, etc.) of a user from a user device in conjunction with (temporally) corresponding data related to factors ("other factors") that may affect the health indicator to determine whether the user has normal health by, for example, but not limited to, determining or comparing, for example, but not limited to: i) A group of individuals affected by similar other factors; or ii) the user himself affected by similar other factors.

title: COPD patient personalized management and optimization device and equipment based on deep learning
abstract: A COPD patient personalized management and tuning device and equipment based on deep learning include: obtaining current symptom indicators of COPD patients; recommending an intervention strategy via a COPD intervention strategy model based on the current symptom indicator; generating an input vector according to the current symptom index and the recommended intervention strategy; inputting the input vector into a trained COPD virtual intervention environment model to obtain an output vector; and calculating to obtain a current improvement value according to the current symptom index and the symptom index of the dry prognosis, and updating to obtain the evaluation standard of the current intervention strategy combination according to the current improvement value and the improvement value obtained by historical calculation. The invention is based on deep reinforcement learning technology, constructs an unsupervised dynamic self-adaptive self-management cooperative mechanism on the basis of artificial intelligence auxiliary decision, and adopts optimized nursing intervention measures according to the pathophysiological and psychological states of patients to realize the whole-course and individualized precise management of COPD patients.

title: Temporal-mandibular joint disc shift MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) examination and diagnosis system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a temporal mandibular joint disc shift MRI examination and diagnosis system based on deep learning, which relates to the field of MRI examination and diagnosis and comprises the following components: an acquisition unit for acquiring MRI images of the human head; the labeling unit is used for obtaining a temporomandibular joint area image based on the human head MRI image, labeling the temporomandibular joint area image to obtain a training set, and classifying the temporomandibular joint area image comprises: an image of the joint disc at a normal and abnormal position in the open-close state; the diagnosis unit is used for constructing a first temporomandibular joint disc displacement diagnosis model, training the first temporomandibular joint disc displacement classification model based on the training set to obtain a second temporomandibular joint disc displacement diagnosis model, wherein the second temporomandibular joint disc displacement diagnosis model is used for classifying and identifying the temporomandibular joint region image to be diagnosed, outputting a temporomandibular joint disc displacement inspection diagnosis result and realizing the displacement MRI inspection diagnosis of the temporomandibular joint disc in an open-close state.

title: Domain self-adaptive enhancement method applicable to various visual tasks
assignee: 中山大学中山眼科中心
abstract: The invention discloses a field self-adaptive enhancement method applicable to various visual tasks, which comprises the following steps of S01: aiming at a medical image analysis task based on a deep learning algorithm, analyzing and extracting a business model of the task from the task; s02: according to the business model, a domain self-adaptive framework based on cooperative learning of a CycleGAN model and auxiliary tasks is constructed, wherein the domain self-adaptive framework comprises a CycleGAN module and an auxiliary task module, the CycleGAN module is used for converting image styles of different domains, and the auxiliary task module comprises a main auxiliary task and a secondary auxiliary task; s03: training the domain adaptive framework based on the CycleGAN model and auxiliary task collaborative learning by using an unpaired target domain image dataset and a source domain image dataset; s04: and converting the target domain image into a source domain image style by using the trained CycleGAN model, and inputting the source domain image style into a business model to obtain a final result. The invention improves generalization of the service model trained by the source domain data to the target domain image, and can improve service performance on the target domain image without service labels.

title: Image classification method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 联仁健康医疗大数据科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image classification method, an image classification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial image to be classified; classifying the initial image, and determining the image classification probability of the initial image corresponding to each image category; extracting text information in the initial image based on a text extraction technology, processing the text information based on a pre-established natural language processing model, and determining text classification probability of the text information corresponding to each image category; and determining a target image category of the initial image based on the image classification probability and the text classification probability. By the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the technical effects of comprehensively considering the image information and the text information and improving the medical image classification accuracy are realized.

title: Electronic device including flexible display
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a first structure, a second structure coupled to the first structure so as to be slidable, a display including at least one portion disposed on the first structure and another portion accommodated in the second structure, the display being configured such that a size of an exposed region that forms a front side of the electronic device varies in response to a sliding motion of the second structure, a display support member disposed on a rear surface of a partial region of the display to support the partial region of the display, a first driving member that connects one side of the first structure and one side of the second structure and provides a first driving force to the second structure to move the second structure relative to the first structure, and a second driving member that is disposed on at least one of the first structure or the display support member and that provides a second driving force to the display support member to move a portion of the display support member relative to the first structure.

title: Boundary condition processing method and device for coronary artery three-dimensional model
assignee: 上海杏脉信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention aims to provide a method and a device for processing boundary conditions of a coronary artery three-dimensional model. The simulation equipment initializes a coronary artery three-dimensional model of a current patient and a flow resistance model serving as a boundary condition of the coronary artery three-dimensional model; taking the initialization result of the flow resistance model as a boundary condition, and performing simulation calculation on the coronary artery three-dimensional model; and repeating the steps in a circulating way until the result of the simulation calculation meets the convergence condition. Compared with the existing complex flow resistance model, the method for processing the boundary condition based on the steady-state simulation and capable of effectively considering the influence of the flow resistance greatly shortens the calculation time, for example, the calculation time can be shortened from hours to about 10 minutes, and solves the problem that the existing flow model has obvious unreasonable results.

title: Vagina pathology image classification method based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and machine learning, and discloses a vaginal pathology image classification method based on a convolutional neural network. The invention comprises the following steps: obtaining a vaginal pathology image dataset with balanced categories by using the sampling method; amplifying the vaginal pathology image dataset using a data enhancement method; training an image classification convolution neural network by using the amplified vaginal pathology image data set; updating network parameters of the image classification convolution neural network by using a cross entropy loss function and combining a BP algorithm; and classifying the input images through the trained optimal image classification convolutional neural network. The invention avoids the limitations of the traditional feature extraction method, such as: the method highly depends on experience knowledge of medical staff, consumes a large amount of time and energy to complete the process, is difficult to extract high-quality characteristics with distinctiveness and low in accuracy rate, and realizes high-precision classification of the vaginal pathological images by means of the convolutional neural network.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device is disclosed. An electronic device according to the present invention includes a display, first to third optical elements which are disposed to be dispersed on the display to emit red (R) light, green (G) light, and blue (B) light, an optical system which is installed in the display to combine light emitted from the first to third optical elements into the display, and a pinhole mirror which is installed on an illumination path of light combined by the optical system to reflect the combined light to eyeballs of a user. An electronic device according to the present invention may be associated with an artificial intelligence module, robot, augmented reality (AR) device, virtual reality (VR) device, and device related to 5G services.

title: Data processor, method, chip and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a data processor, a method, a chip and electronic equipment, wherein the data processor comprises a Booth coding circuit, a first partial product acquisition circuit, a second partial product acquisition circuit, a first compression circuit and a second compression circuit, the output end of the Booth coding circuit is connected with the first input end of the first partial product acquisition circuit and the first input end of the second partial product acquisition circuit, the output end of the first partial product acquisition circuit is connected with the first input end of the first compression circuit, and the output end of the second partial product acquisition circuit is connected with the first input end of the second compression circuit; in addition, the data processor does not need to perform multiply-accumulate operation on the multiplication result again to realize multiply-accumulate operation, and can directly realize multiply operation or multiply-accumulate operation only through one operation process, thereby reducing the power consumption of the data processor.

title: Dynamic model training method, system and equipment based on annular knowledge distillation and meta federal learning
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application relates to the field of intelligent medical treatment, in particular toAnd a dynamic model training method, system and equipment based on annular knowledge distillation and meta federal learning. The meta federation learning comprises M meta federations, one meta federation is composed of a central server and N clients, and a trained global model is used as a teacher model M 1 The next element federation in the M element federations is used as a student model M 1 The student model m 1 Learning the teacher model m by knowledge distillation 1 Updating parameters of (a) to obtain a teacher model m 2 The teacher model m 2 Transferring parameters to the next student model m by knowledge distillation n Repeating the steps until the teacher model m 1 And converting the model into a learning model to form a ring-shaped framework. The method and the device can effectively analyze data and train the model while guaranteeing the data privacy, and have good clinical value.

title: Apparatus and method for monitoring network
abstract: A network monitoring apparatus includes a memory configured to store a performance management data sample of a network; and at least one processor configured to input the performance management data sample and an abnormality probability value to an auto-encoder of an abnormality detection model that is trained based on performance management data of the network, wherein the abnormality probability value is a default value, obtain, from the auto-encoder of the abnormality detection model, a reconstructed performance management data sample and an abnormality score value, and detect an abnormal sample based on the abnormality score value, wherein the auto-encoder is configured to receive the performance management data sample and the abnormality probability value, and output the reconstructed performance management data sample and the abnormality score value.

title: Construction method of non-diagnosis-purpose virtual bronchoscope
assignee: 天津国科医工科技发展有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for constructing a non-diagnosis and treatment purpose virtual bronchoscope, and introduces a method for providing a segmented image required by constructing the virtual bronchoscope by using a deep learning method, wherein the method provided by the invention specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, segmenting an obtained lung CT sequence image into a bronchial tree by using a trained deep learning segmentation model; extracting a complete centerline image from the segmented bronchial tree image by using a three-dimensional topology thinning algorithm and acquiring a coordinate point set of the centerline image; planning a required branch path in a plurality of complicated branch paths of the central line of the bronchial tree by using a three-dimensional medical image path planning algorithm based on Euclidean distance; and smoothing the roaming path by using a path interpolation smoothing method based on a Bezier curve, and finally realizing the purpose of automatic roaming by circularly changing the positions of the virtual camera and the focus thereof.
assignee_clean: 天津国科医工科技发展有限公司
primary_assignee: 天津国科医工科技发展有限公司

title: Computer-implemented methods and evaluation systems for evaluating at least one image data set of an imaging region of a patient, computer programs and electronically readable storage mediums
abstract: At least one example embodiment provides a computer-implemented method for evaluating at least one image data set of an imaging region of a patient, wherein at least one evaluation information describing at least one medical condition in an anatomical structure of the imaging region is determined.

title: Systems and methods for data frame representation
abstract: Various embodiments provide a copy-on-write data frame (CoW-DF) that permits lightweight copies of a data frame, where the copies comprise memory allocation for only changed portions of a data frame. A CoW-DF may have semantics of a data frame, and a CoW-DF may appear and behave like a traditional data frame copy, while on the backend of a CoW-DF, only data differences created by modifications to a data frame may be maintained, rather than whole copies of a modified data frame. For various embodiments, the CoW concept is applied to other types of data structures, such as a column, a row, or a data frame value.

title: Agile image encryption method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning-based agile image encryption method, which uses an improved ResNet as a backbone network by an encryption network and a decryption network, removes all pooling layers in the ResNet, introduces hole convolution in residual connection of a residual module, and adopts a multi-scale fusion structure. Meanwhile, in order to improve the safety of the image encryption method, the encrypted images based on the deep learning convolutional neural network are further confused, so that the key space of the encryption method is greatly expanded, the avalanche effect of the image encryption method is enhanced, and the difficulties of group lifting search attack and differential attack are improved. The image encryption method is easy to integrate with an artificial intelligence system based on deep learning, so that the privacy protection capability of the artificial intelligence system is improved. The method has good time performance, the encryption and decryption network does not need to be retrained when the key is modified, the model structure and the parameters can be disclosed, the Ke Kehuo principle is met, and the method is convenient and quick to use.

title: System, method, and apparatus for temperature asymmetry measurement of body parts
abstract: System, apparatus, and method for automatic detection of arthritis according to temperature asymmetry estimation in contralateral joints is presented. Simultaneously recorded thermogram and the optical image of an inspected joint and its contralateral joint are sent to the processing unit, where they are stored, processed, and analyzed. The system, apparatus, and method automatically detects outlines of joints in thermograms and optical images. Grid of points of interest is distributed inside the inspected and the contralateral joint's outline. Temperature maps are calculated according to both grids points and the temperature disparity map is estimated. The set of inflammation regions is obtained by analyzing the temperature disparity map and collecting adjacent points containing temperature differences surpassing the threshold. The system, apparatus, and method are non-invasive and non-contact, and suitable for real world environments with natural home or health care institutions background.

title: Methods and systems for behavior signal generation and processing
abstract: Instances of claim data are received by an apparatus. Each instance of claim data corresponds to an entity. A claim vector is generated for each instance of claim data. The claim vector is added to a group of claim vectors that all correspond to a same entity. Each group of claim vectors is aggregated to generate an entity vector corresponding to the entity. Based at least in part on the entity vector and (a) an entity profile corresponding to the corresponding entity or (b) an entity cluster with which the entity is associated, at least one behavior signal value is determined for the entity. A behavior signal is amended to include the behavior signal value. The behavior signal comprises at least two behavior signal values. Each of the behavior signal values are associated with a different time period. The behavior signal is provided for display and/or further processing.

title: Configurable smart object system with clip-based connectors
abstract: Configurable smart object systems with grid or frame-based connectors are provided. Example systems implement machine learning based on neural networks that draw low power for use in smart phones, watches, drones, automobiles, and medical devices, for example. Example assemblies can be configured from pluggable, interchangeable modules that have compatible ports with magnetic electrical contacts for interconnecting and integrating functionally dissimilar sensor systems. An example system has a clip attachable to a substrate for securing a smart object module to the substrate, and a housing of the clip with a geometry for aligning electrical contacts of the smart object module with electrical contacts of the substrate. The clip may have a compliant layer to provide spring, resilience, or pressure to securing the smart object module to the substrate. The clip may also integrate features of a secure digital (SD) port and a universal serial bus (USB) port. The clip may be either permanently affixed to the substrate, or removable, to make an expandable smart object system.

title: User interface for X-ray tube detector calibration
abstract: Systems (SYS) and related methods for supporting X-ray imaging. The system (SYS) comprises a Machine Learning Module (MLM), a Logic (LG) configured to calculate output correction information for adjusting an imaging geometry of the X-ray imaging device to achieve a target imaging geometry. The modulator (MOD, L-MOD, H-MOD, S-MOD) is a system configured to provide user instructions for imaging geometry adjustment. The user instruction is modulated based on the output correction information. The machine learning module was previously trained on training data that includes responses of particular users to previous instructions.

title: Predictive data analysis using value-based predictive inputs
abstract: There is a need for solutions that perform predictive data analysis using a value-based predictive input. This need can be addressed by, for example, determining, based at least in part on the value-based predictive input, a plurality of predictive component values; for each predictive component value of the plurality of predictive component values: obtaining a quantile regression distribution for the predictive component value; determining, based at least in part on the quantile regression distribution, a non-outlier portion of the quantile regression distribution; generating, for each quantile regression value of the one or more quantile regression values that is associated with the non-outlier portion, a scaled quantile regression value; and determining, based at least in part on each scaled quantile regression value for a quantile regression value associated with a predictive component value of the plurality of predictive component values, an entity opportunity prediction of the one or more entity predictions for the prediction entity.

title: Systems and methods for high-resolution spectral computed tomography imaging
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for high-resolution computed tomography imaging. In one embodiment, a method comprises detecting, with a detector array comprising a plurality of individual detectors each configured with a first number of energy bins, photons generated by an x-ray source and attenuated by a subject to be imaged, generating a first dataset, for a virtual detector array comprising a combination of individual detectors and macro-detectors, by selectively aggregating a subset of the individual detectors into the macro-detectors with a second number of energy bins, generating a second dataset, for an augmented detector array comprising the plurality of individual detectors each configured with the second number of energy bins, by up-sampling the first dataset, and reconstructing an image of the subject from the second dataset. In this way, high-resolution detector arrays can acquire minimal data while maintaining a high image resolution and spectral resolution.

title: Antenna and electronic device including the same
abstract: According to various embodiments, an electronic device includes: a first housing including a first area, a second housing coupled to be slidable in a first direction from the first housing and including a second area overlapping the first area in a slide-in state, an antenna structure disposed in the first housing to overlap the first area when the first housing is viewed from the top, a conductive part disposed in the second area and electromagnetically connected to the antenna structure in the slide-in state, and wireless communication circuitry electrically connected to the antenna structure. The wireless communication circuitry may be configured to transmit and/or receive radio signals in at least one designated frequency band through the antenna structure and the conductive part in the slide-in state.

title: Systems and methods for diagnosing computer vision model performance issues
abstract: Systems and methods for clustering data are disclosed. For example, a system may include one or more memory units storing instructions and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions to perform operations. The operations may include receiving, from a first client device, a classification data associated with a classification model and receiving feature data corresponding to the classification model output. The operations may include training a meta-model to predict the classification data based on the feature data and/or additional data associated with the classification data such as location data or environmental data. The operations may include generating a meta-model output based on the classification data, the feature data, and/or the additional data. The operations may include updating the classification model based on the meta-model output and transmitting the updated classification model to at least one of the first client device or a second client device.

title: Sensor certificate lifecycle manager for access authentication for network management systems
abstract: Systems and methods provided for a sensor certificate lifecycle manager for a network management system of an enterprise network for the automated generation of unique certificates for sensors used to act like a client device in the enterprise network for the purposes of troubleshooting. Furthermore, the network management and command center in association with the sensor certificate lifecycle manager manages a pool of signed unique certificates and have control over the lifecycle of such certificates, such as for revoking, transferring, and reassigning certificates for the sensors.

title: Selectively blocking content on electronic displays
abstract: A method for selectively blocking content on a transparent electronic display is provided. Unstructured information is analyzed using natural language processing techniques. A portion of the unstructured information is classified as protected content. An emissive layer displays the protected content over a substantially opaque portion of the selectively transparent layer. A user is provided with a prompt that identifies the protected content. The substantially opaque portion of the selectively transparent layer become substantially transparent in response to receiving an interaction with the prompt from the user.

title: Method and apparatus for determining a feature characterizing intentional breath-holding by a patient in a medical imaging device
abstract: In a method and medical imaging apparatus for determining a feature characterizing intentional breath-holding by an examination object for acquiring medical raw data with breath-holding algorithm, an algorithm, the algorithm being designed to allocate at least one feature characterizing intentional breath-holding to at least one physiological property. The algorithm includes or accesses trained artificial neural network. A physiological property of the examination object is detected during free breathing of the examination object. The feature characterizing intentional breath-holding by the examination object is determined by the computer, by executing the algorithm with the detected physiological property of the examination object, as an input to the algorithm.

title: Backend bundled healthcare services payment systems and methods
abstract: An apparatus for providing a bundled set of individually redeemable healthcare services in a purchase data record, determining a Good Faith Estimate (GFE) for the at least one healthcare service of the bundled set, associating the purchase data record with user debt for purchase of the healthcare services, providing a digital health asset token representing the purchase data record identified by and with a unique confirmation number, said purchase data record comprising the associated user debt of the at least one bundled set of healthcare services, and providing marketplace access to the token to finance the debt. The marketplace may use the token for buying, selling or trading the bundled set of healthcare services to finance the debt. The token and a Good Faith Estimate (GFE) may be provided to an Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process for resolving a dispute under the No Surprises Act.

title: Method and equipment for training multi-disease referral model
assignee: 北京鹰瞳科技发展股份有限公司, 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and equipment for training a multi-disease transfer model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a training set comprising a decision contour and a referral label of each of a plurality of samples and a decision template of each of a plurality of referral classifications; acquiring a machine learning model, wherein the machine learning model is configured to determine a referral result according to a decision contour, a decision template and a plurality of decision weights, a plurality of distance components are obtained according to the decision contour and the decision template, decision distances are calculated according to the plurality of decision weights, and the referral result of a corresponding sample is output according to the decision distances; and training the machine learning model by using the training set, and adjusting a plurality of decision weights based on the referral result and the referral label to obtain the multi-disease referral model. According to the invention, the triage classification performance of the model can be improved according to the contribution difference of different elements in the decision contour to the triage result.

title: Ultrasonic imaging method, apparatus and storage medium
assignee: 深圳迈瑞生物医疗电子股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an ultrasonic imaging method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting a first ultrasonic wave to a target area of a measured object, obtaining a first ultrasonic echo signal based on an echo of the first ultrasonic wave, and processing the first ultrasonic echo signal to obtain a two-dimensional ultrasonic image; automatically detecting the position of a preset key anatomical structure of a target region in a two-dimensional ultrasonic image, and automatically setting an imaging reference line based on the position; transmitting a second ultrasonic wave to the target area for volume scanning, obtaining a second ultrasonic echo signal based on an echo of the second ultrasonic wave, and processing the second ultrasonic echo signal to obtain volume data including the target area; imaging of one or more of the sections is effected based on the volumetric data and the automatically set imaging reference line. According to the ultrasonic imaging method and the ultrasonic imaging equipment, the imaging process of any section of a key anatomical structure is simplified, and the efficiency of ultrasonic examination can be effectively improved.

title: Methods and systems for characterizing mouth-related conditions
abstract: Embodiments of the systems and methods for characterizing mouth-related conditions for a user may include one or more of the following: a processing network operable to collect containers containing substances from a collection of users, the processing network comprising a sequencing system operable to determine a sequence of a microorganism by sequencing the substances; a microbiome characterization system operable to determine a microbiome composition dataset and a microbiome functional diversity dataset based on a microbiome sequence, collect a complementary dataset associated with mouth-related disorders of the set of users; and converting the supplemental data and the features extracted from the microbiome composition data and the microbiome functional diversity data into a characterization model of the mouth-related disorder; and/or a therapy system that characterizes a user for a mouth-related condition based on using a characterization model, the therapy system operable to facilitate therapy of the user.

title: Method and system for microbiome-derived diagnostics and therapeutics for endocrine system conditions
abstract: A method for at least one of characterizing, diagnosing, and treating an endocrine system condition in at least a subject, the method comprising: receiving an aggregate set of biological samples from a population of subjects; generating at least one of a microbiome composition dataset and a microbiome functional diversity dataset for the population of subjects; generating a characterization of the endocrine system condition based upon features extracted from at least one of the microbiome composition dataset and the microbiome functional diversity dataset; based upon the characterization, generating a therapy model configured to correct the endocrine system condition; and at an output device associated with the subject, promoting a therapy to the subject based upon the characterization and the therapy model.

title: Systems, sensors, and methods for determining analyte concentration
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems, sensors, and methods for determining the concentration of an analyte in a fluid. The system comprises: a sensor configured to produce a differential response to a constant concentration of the analyte; and a collection device configured to determine a concentration of the analyte from the differential response. The method comprises the following steps: exposing the fluid to a sensor configured to produce a differential response to a constant concentration of the analyte; and measuring a differential response of the sensor to the analyte.

title: Localization system and method
abstract: A system comprises a plurality of first computing devices, wherein each first computing device is wearable by a user or is affixed to an asset within an environment and configured to generate and transmit a message; and a plurality of second computing devices installed within the environment, wherein a portion of the plurality of second computing devices are configured to detect at least one of the plurality of first computing devices, receive messages transmitted by a detected first computing device, and timestamp the messages before transmitting the messages to a computing server system. The computing server system is configured to determine at least a location of the detected first computing device based at least upon the messages received from the portion of the plurality of second computing devices.

title: B-COSFIRE-based retinal vessel segmentation method for fundus image
abstract: The invention discloses a retinal vessel segmentation method for fundus images based on B-COSFIRE, which comprises the steps of firstly, highlighting vessel characteristics and reducing noise by operations such as taking a green channel and CLAHE, then, carrying out response filtering by using a B-COSFIRE filter, and finally, improving segmentation effect by morphological top-hat transformation and post-processing operation based on a connected domain; the B-COSFIRE filter has accurate response to the fundus image through special configuration of the B-COSFIRE filter; the method has important significance for establishing a high-efficiency and reliable computer-aided medical system, and provides a more efficient blood vessel segmentation basis for improving the precision and the efficiency of the computer-aided medical system, and even for clinical diagnosis, curative effect evaluation, early disease screening and the like.

title: Method to read lesion
abstract: Provided is a lesion reading method, which includes the steps of: inputting medical data including a chest image to first and second neural network models to detect an object region for lesion reading from the medical data, and detecting at least one finding region related to a specific lesion; calculating the volume and location of at least one finding region included in the object region; and generating result information for the medical data based on the volume and location of the observation region.

title: Systems and methods for data cleansing such as for optimizing clinical scheduling
abstract: A scheduling system and method for data cleansing may be used to optimize clinical scheduling. The present disclosure describes receiving clinical record data, in an agnostic manner, from a system including a source scheduling database containing the clinical record data; mapping the clinical record data to a desired format; conforming the clinical record data to standardized scheduling elements of the scheduling system; cleansing, in a manner configurable by a user, the clinical record data to purge portions of the clinical record data; providing the clinical record data to an optimization engine for optimization of the clinical record data; optimizing the clinical record data by applying configurable logic to the clinical record data; and uploading one or more newly defined optimized scheduling templates via an outbound connection back to the scheduling system.

title: Bandwidth-dependent media stream compression
abstract: In general, this disclosure describes media stream transmission techniques for a computing device. The computing device captures a first media item and identifies a primary portion of the first media item and a secondary portion of the first media item different than the primary portion. The computing device applies a first compression algorithm to the primary portion of the first media item to generate a compressed primary portion. The computing device applies a second compression algorithm to the secondary portion of the first media item to generate a compressed secondary portion, where a data compression ratio of the second compression algorithm is greater than a data compression ratio of the first compression algorithm. The computing device transmits, to a central computing device, the compressed primary portion of the first media item and the compressed secondary portion of the first media item.

title: Three-dimensional selective bone matching
abstract: Method, system, and program products are disclosed herein for creating a 3D model based on a plurality of received 2D medical images. Once the 2D images are received, a determination is made regarding any potential processing steps required to put the images into a standard view. Once the images are processed, a plurality of points are identified that are associated with a portion of an anatomical landmark. Various historical 2D images are then identified based on a comparison between the plurality of points. Using the historical information, a 3D image is generated of an anatomical feature of a patient.

title: Large-capacity data storage device and data destruction method thereof
assignee: 北京中超伟业信息安全技术股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data storage, in particular to a high-capacity data storage device and a data destruction method thereof, comprising a plurality of storage modules, a centralized data dispatcher, a data verification and correction module, a safety monitoring and response unit and a self-adaptive data management unit, wherein the centralized data dispatcher performs preprocessing on data and issues data instructions to the functions of the storage modules; the data verification and correction module uses a check code technology to detect data errors and automatically trigger an error correction flow; the safety monitoring and responding unit ensures the safety and the integrity of data; and the self-adaptive data management unit predicts faults or performance degradation and automatically adjusts data distribution and backup strategies. According to the invention, the data storage, retrieval and backup are automatically optimized by continuously learning the use mode and environmental factors of each storage module, so that the overall efficiency and reliability of the system are improved.

title: System and method for automatic delineation of scanned images
abstract: A method and system for generating synthetic images for use in a database is described. The database is used for delineation of features in real images, the method comprising the steps of: providing a delineated image acquired using a first scanner, defining a model related to the generation of synthetic images using a second scanner, processing the delineated image using the model to generate a synthetic image, mapping contours to the synthetic image to form a synthetic image-contour pair; repeating providing, defining and processing steps to generate a plurality of synthetic images and contour pairs for the database; using said database of synthetic images and contour pairs to optimise a contouring algorithm, where the optimised algorithm generates contours for the real images of the same type as the synthetic images; processing one or more further real images to contour and delineate features on the further real image using the algorithm.

title: Auditable asset tracking model
abstract: A system can provide efficiency in monitoring prescription medication can include a client computer system configured to service a user interface (UI) for facilitating a pill counting procedure. The client receives a notification from a server computer system to initiate a pill count. The instructions can also cause the system to display a UI on the client computer system to facilitate the pill counting procedure. The displayed layout includes: (i) a timestamp field; (ii) a pill count field; (iii) an image field displaying an image of the pills the user has; (iv) a certification field; and (v) a submit field. On submission, the system can generate an encrypted data file comprising a secret key that de-identifies the user, the image of the pills, and metadata describing conditions associated with the pill count. The system can then transmit the encrypted data file to the server computer system.

title: Utilize the perforation of the magnetic resonant imaging examination external membrane of heart
assignee: 韦伯斯特生物官能(以色列)有限公司
abstract: The entitled perforation using the magnetic resonant imaging examination external membrane of heart of the present invention.Cardiac ablation is monitored by the following terms to detect hemopericardium: repeatedly magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data of acquisition including the pericardium, the variation for organizing the measurement pericardium, the construction decision making and report the pericardium in response to the judgement different to the measurement of the pericardium in the group of continuous N RI data via the analysis MRI data.

title: Mobile phone auxiliary detection system for cranial nerve system diseases
assignee: 中国科学院软件研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a mobile phone auxiliary detection system for cranial nerve system diseases, which mainly comprises two parts: one is a data acquisition part, which takes the smart phone as a carrier and acquires behavior data of a user operating the mobile phone; the other part is a data analysis part which is used for processing and analyzing the collected user behavior data through the trained classifier models of different cranial nerve system disease data, and further giving the risk of testing the cranial nerve system disease possibly existing in the user based on the classification result. The system provides a natural and convenient disease examination mode, and the cranial nerve system diseases can be examined only by using the sensor and the API provided by the mobile phone. Compared with the examination of expensive professional medical equipment, the method has the advantages that the cost is greatly reduced, the detection can be carried out at any time and any place, and method support is provided for integrating disease examination into daily mobile phone operation.

title: Blood vessel segmentation method and device based on feature enhancement
assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a blood vessel segmentation method and device based on feature enhancement, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. Firstly, acquiring a characteristic diagram of a blood vessel to be detected corresponding to a CT image of the blood vessel to be detected; the characteristic graph of the blood vessel to be detected carries a blood vessel structure point used for indicating the category of the blood vessel; obtaining a blood vessel adjacency matrix according to the geodesic distance between any two blood vessel structure points; then, splicing the position information of all the blood vessel structure points and the characteristic graph of the blood vessel to be detected to obtain a blood vessel node matrix; and finally, based on the blood vessel node matrix and the blood vessel adjacent matrix, performing blood vessel characteristic enhancement processing by using the graph neural model to obtain a blood vessel segmentation result. Therefore, in the embodiment, by utilizing the blood vessel adjacency matrix and the blood vessel node matrix, the correlation between the top point and the side can be established by the point cloud data formed by the blood vessel structure points, so that the blood vessel characteristics can be extracted from different angles by the graph neural model, the data characteristics are enriched, and the accuracy of blood vessel segmentation is improved.

title: Alert System
abstract: A system is provided which, in at least some embodiments, can read the vital signs of the body of a user utilising a sensing device such as a smartwatch or smart phone (for example utilising the iOS, Android or Pebble operating systems) and apply algorithms to interpret the vital signs and then send a notification with an escalation process to nominated carers if the patient is interpreted as having a fall or fit or seizure. In at least some embodiments doctors or other parties can log in to a secured dashboard and check a patient data in real time. Also in at least some preferred forms doctors or other parties can analyse the history of the patient. In at least some embodiments users/patients can also use data to keep track of fall or fit or seizure episodes and monitor their progress. Embodiments of the invention can be applied for example in situations where the patient/user suffers from a medical condition such as epilepsy and which may predispose the patient/user to falls and related events. title: Systems and methods for detecting BRAF-V600E mutations
abstract: The present application relates to a system and method for detecting a BRAF-V600E mutation, the system comprising: an ultrasound map acquisition module that generates an ultrasound image of the living tissue through examination of the patient; the positioning and segmentation module is in communication connection with the ultrasonic image acquisition module, receives the ultrasonic image of the active tissue generated by the ultrasonic image acquisition module, and performs positioning and segmentation on the nodule on the ultrasonic image of the active tissue through a TransU-Net model loaded on the ultrasonic image after preprocessing the ultrasonic image so as to form one or more nodule area images to be checked; the BRAF-V600E module is used for carrying out BRAF-V600E gene mutation prediction on each of one or more to-be-examined nodule region images formed on the positioning and segmentation module through a DenseNet network loaded on the BRAF-V600E module; and the output module outputs the result of BRAF-V600E gene mutation prediction formed by the BRAF-V600E module. The system and the method for detecting BRAF-V600E mutation can be used for auxiliary diagnosis of melanoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, colorectal cancer, thyroid cancer and non-small cell lung cancer.

title: Robot
abstract: A robot includes a robot arm formed with an ingredient channel including an ingredient inlet and an ingredient outlet; an ingredient feeder having an ingredient port configured to discharge ingredients; and a carrier configured to move the robot arm to a connection position where the ingredient inlet is connected to the ingredient port, and move the robot arm to an area where the ingredient inlet is separated from the ingredient port.

title: Electronic device for supporting sliding operation
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a first housing, a second housing coupled to the first housing and that performs a sliding operation, a display, of which a size of a visual exposure area is changed in correspondence to the sliding operation of the second housing, a first variable magnetism member disposed at a first location of the first housing, and of which a magnetic force varies depending on a current or a voltage that is supplied thereto, a second variable magnetism member disposed at a second location of the first housing, and of which a magnetic force varies depending on a current or a voltage that is supplied thereto, a magnet member fixed to an inner surface of the second housing, and that moves between the first variable magnetism member and the second variable magnetism member during the sliding operation, and a processor operatively connected.

title: Method and system for automatic calibration of an operator monitor
abstract: Systems and methods for automatic calibration of a monitor of a driver include receiving an indication that the driver is driving a car and determining a typical orientation of the driver in a first set of images, the first set captured after receiving the indication. An orientation of the driver in a second set of images, which is captured after the first set, is compared to the typical orientation and a command is generated based on the comparison.

title: Medical image classification method, image classification network processing method, device and equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to artificial intelligence technology, and in particular, to a medical image classification method, apparatus, computer device, and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: slicing the medical image to obtain an image slice sequence; extracting image features of an object in each image slice in the image slice sequence; sequentially determining the continuous probability of the target object in each image slice according to the image features respectively extracted from each image slice; determining the communication rate of the target object in the image slice sequence based on the accumulated sum of difference values between continuous probabilities corresponding to each adjacent image slice in the image slice sequence and the total slice amount of the image slices in the image slice sequence; and judging the classification category of the medical image according to the communication rate. By adopting the method, the influence on the accuracy of medical image classification caused by smaller target objects can be avoided.

title: Electronic device including flexible display
abstract: According to various embodiments of the disclosure, an electronic device may comprise: a first housing, a flexible display including a first area disposed on the first housing and a second area extending from the first area and deformable into a curved shape, and a multi-bar structure comprising a plurality of bars and having an end coupled to the first housing and deformably supporting the second area. The multi-bar structure may include a support having a surface disposed to support the second area, and at least one rail disposed on another surface of the support when viewed from outside of the flexible display, wherein the rail is at least partially disposed in an area overlapping the second area.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging apparatus
abstract: According to one embodiment, a magnetic resonance imaging apparatus includes processing circuitry. The processing circuitry collects magnetic resonance data in accordance with a pulse sequence. The processing circuitry determines image quality based on the magnetic resonance data. The processing circuitry selects a re-collection pulse sequence when it is determined that the image quality does not satisfy criteria, the re-collection pulse sequence having at least one of a type of sequence or an imaging condition differing from that of the pulse sequence.

title: Parameter adjustment method, fundus image processing device, fundus image processing medium and fundus image processing apparatus
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a parameter adjustment method of an image processing model, a fundus image processing method, a parameter adjustment apparatus of an image processing model, a computer-readable storage medium, and an electronic apparatus; relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and relates to the machine learning technology. The parameter adjustment method of the image processing model comprises the following steps: extracting features of an input image, and determining a prediction label and prediction image information corresponding to the image according to the extracted features of the image; determining a first loss function value according to the prediction label and the original label of the image, and determining a second loss function value according to the prediction image information and the original image information of the image; and adjusting parameters of the image processing model according to the first loss function value and the second loss function value. The parameter adjustment method of the image processing model can overcome the problem that the application range of the image processing model is not wide enough to a certain extent, and further the application range of the image processing model is enlarged.
