title: Coronary heart disease multi-mode data characteristic extraction method based on knowledge graph
abstract: The invention discloses a coronary heart disease multi-mode data characteristic extraction method based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: a: acquiring signal entities of an electrocardiogram, a photoelectric volume pulse wave and a phonocardiogram; b: acquiring an image entity of a heart color Doppler ultrasound image; c: acquiring text entities and text entity attributes of medical record texts, and extracting text entity relations; d: linking the coronary heart disease patient knowledge graph body structure to form a knowledge graph, and establishing a case relation graph network; e: adopting a random walk algorithm and a Skip-Gram model to characterize node dimension reduction in a case relation graph network as a unified node expression vector; f: and E, adopting a principal component analysis algorithm, reducing the dimension of the node representation vector obtained in the step E again, and finally obtaining the dimension reduction characteristic of the node. The invention can provide more accurate data base for auxiliary verification of coronary heart disease diagnosis results.

title: Process for infill well development in a subsurface reservoir
abstract: A method for determining a location and trajectory for a new wellbore relative to an adjacent wellbore includes: receiving controllable variable data and uncontrollable variable data related to fracturing a formation by a stimulation operation in a first wellbore penetrating the formation; receiving pressure communication event or pressure non-communication event identification data related to identification of a pressure communication event or pressure non-communication event in a second wellbore penetrating the formation in response to the fracturing; extracting features from the controllable and uncontrollable variable data to provide extracted features; detecting a pressure communication event using the extracted features and the pressure communication event or pressure non-communication event identification data using an analytic technique; identifying one or more quantified causes of the detected pressure communication event using an artificial intelligence technique; and determining the location and trajectory of the new wellbore using the one or more quantified causes.

title: Task processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a task processing method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to the fields of artificial intelligence, intelligent search, information flow and the like. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring characteristic information of a plurality of tasks and acquiring characteristic information of each task receiver; for a task receiver, determining a target task from a plurality of tasks based on the characteristic information of the plurality of tasks and the characteristic information of each task receiver. The method can determine a more proper target task for the task receiver, and can be understood as improving the accuracy of task processing.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Three-dimensional brain tumor segmentation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application relates to a three-dimensional brain tumor segmentation method, a three-dimensional brain tumor segmentation device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining MRI three-dimensional images of brain tumors; the dual-path sequence attention mechanism and the structural remodeling attention mechanism are fused into a general convolutional neural network 3D-Unet or a UNETR facing three-dimensional MRI image brain tumor segmentation to obtain an improved 3D-Unet network or an improved UNETR, and the brain tumor MRI three-dimensional image is input into an improved 3D-Unet network or an improved UNETR to obtain brain tumor segmentation results; the dual path sequence attention mechanism is used to extract key features contained in different brain MRI sequences; the structural remodeling attention mechanism is used to guide the model to more efficiently find out areas that need to be focused on. By adopting the method, the feature information fusion under different sequences can be realized, the extraction of local features between the continuous slices is realized, and the identification accuracy of the three-dimensional medical image is improved.

title: Disease prognosis prediction system based on time sequence evolution process explanation
abstract: The invention discloses a disease prognosis prediction system based on time sequence evolution process interpretation, which comprises: the data acquisition module is used for extracting relevant health medical data of the patient from the electronic medical record database; the data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing relevant health medical data; the prognosis prediction and attribution module is used for predicting prognosis of different time nodes and explaining the importance degree of risk factors; and a visualization module for interpreting the prediction result and performing data visualization based on the result obtained in the prognosis prediction and attribution module. The invention combines structured laboratory examination data and long-term data of unstructured disease course records, makes accurate prediction for prognosis of patients in different time periods, makes full explanation for the model, provides a visual method to increase the transparency and credibility of the model, and is beneficial to providing high-quality and sustainable service for the patients by responsible relatives.

title: X-ray apparatus and method for acquiring medical image thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a method for acquiring medical images of an X-ray device, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original radiation image of a target object and capturing condition information of the object; acquiring a scattered radiation image related to the original radiation image by inputting the original radiation image and the capturing condition information to a learning network model configured to estimate scattered radiation; and acquiring a scattered radiation processed medical image from the original radiation image based on the original radiation image and the scattered radiation image, wherein the learning network model configured to estimate the scattered radiation is a learning network model taught using the plurality of scattered radiation images and the plurality of pieces of capturing condition information associated with each of the plurality of scattered radiation images.

title: Female pelvic cavity MRI automatic sketching system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a female pelvic cavity MRI automatic sketching system based on deep learning, which comprises: the original file preprocessing module is used for loading and preprocessing the female pelvic cavity MRI desensitization file and generating an image file with stronger readability and a corresponding image mask file; the sketching model training module is used for preprocessing an image, automatically encoding the characteristic and learning the potential characteristic by utilizing a deep learning network model constructed by a convolutional neural network, and obtaining an optimally sketched prediction model through multiple iterations; the automatic sketching and predicting module is used for carrying out full-automatic organ sketching and predicting on the image without the corresponding mask; and the prediction result writing module is used for writing the sketching result obtained by the automatic sketching prediction module into the original MRI file. The invention builds an end-to-end medical image segmentation model, provides a spanning type feature extraction method and enhanced feature representation, extracts and integrates image features, greatly improves segmentation accuracy, and improves the efficiency of delineating organs at risk in the radiotherapy diagnosis process.

title: Image display apparatus and computer-readable image display program storage medium
abstract: An image display apparatus and an image display program includes image acquiring section which acquires cross-section image groups which include cross-section images on cut positions arranged in a predetermined direction of a subject, a place setting section which sets places on the cross-section images in the cross-section image groups, an image group extracting section which extracts a series of image groups which continue along the cross-section images and include the image on the places from the cross-section image groups, a cut position calculating section which calculates cut positions whose positional feature in the respective image groups is common among the image groups, on the image groups, and an image display section which arranges to display cross-section images in the cross-section image groups.

title: Medical breathing machine regulation and control system for sleep apnea syndrome
assignee: 首都医科大学宣武医院
abstract: The invention relates to a medical ventilator control system for sleep apnea syndrome. A medical ventilator regulation and control system for sleep apnea syndrome contains detection module, control module and breathing machine body. The detection module collects snoring sounds of the patient that can characterize the patient's respiratory rhythm, and the control module is configured to: the time node of the pumping gas which is generated according to the collected snoring sound and has the same frequency with the breathing rhythm of the patient is adjusted based on the time migration quantity related to the air flow delivery time so that the air flow direction of the pumping gas of the breathing machine body is matched with the physiological action of the inhalation of the patient in the snoring state. The ventilators involved in the prior art are mostly regulated based on regular behaviour of the patient, and neglecting the respiratory choking phase with the deepest influence on the patient. The present application enables adjustment of ventilation pressure by adjusting the tone of the snoring sound of the patient and the blood oxygen content of the patient so that the adjusted ventilation pressure can open the airway of the patient.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学宣武医院
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学宣武医院

title: Method for operating a medical imaging apparatus, medical imaging apparatus, computer program and electronically readable storage medium
abstract: A method for operating a medical imaging apparatus includes acquiring a first image data set of a region of interest of the patient; automatically evaluating the first image data set using at least one evaluation algorithm yielding evaluation information, regarding at least one type of findings, describing a presence of at least one finding of the type requiring the acquisition of a second image data set and at least one imaging parameter for the second image data set; automatically notifying a user, upon the evaluation information indicating the presence of a required second image data set, of the required acquisition of the second image data set; and acquiring the second image data set acquiring the second image data set after confirmation of acquisition of the second image data set by the user, in a same examination process, using the at least one imaging parameter of the evaluation information.

title: Medical image identification enhancement method for subclass diseases
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image identification enhancing method for subclass diseases, which comprises the following steps: extracting the embedded features of the input medical image by using a pre-trained embedded feature extraction unit; respectively extracting a common activation feature, a background noise feature and a core feature from the embedded features by using the trained three channel feature extraction units; and inputting the common activation feature, the background noise feature and the core feature into a pre-trained classifier as a whole to form a redistribution feature, and outputting a classification result for identifying a normal image or an abnormal image through the prediction calculation of the classifier. The method can realize the enhancement and identification of the medical image and identify whether the medical image is a normal image or an abnormal image.

title: Presenting health data to a responding emergency medical system
abstract: A method for presenting health data to a responding emergency medical system (EMS) device includes: (a) registering an EMS profile and a member profile, the member profile to include an option for sharing member information, and the EMS profile to include one or more authorizations for receiving the member information; (b) receiving trigger information including a request for the member information; (c) receiving the member information from one or more sources; (d) packaging the member information in a member care file based on the request for the member information being valid; and (e) providing the member care file to the EMS device.

title: AI(Artificial Intelligence) BASED BRAIN INFORMATION PROVIDING DEVICES USING MEDICAL IMAGING INFORMATION
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an artificial intelligence-based brain information providing device using medical image information comprises: a brain signal measurement unit for collecting signals related to the brain of a user; and a diagnosis unit for determining the brain conditions of the user based on the collected signals. The brain signal measurement unit includes: a brain signal acquisition unit for emitting near-infrared rays at the brain of the user and detecting light that has passed through the cerebral cortex of the brain; a brain signal processing unit for determining the degree of oxygenation of hemoglobin in the cerebral blood flow of the user based on the detected light; and a brain signal analysis unit for extracting at least one activated brain activation region from among a plurality of regions of the brain of the user based on the determined degree of oxygenation of hemoglobin, wherein the signal collection operation of the brain signal measurement unit is performed while the user is moving. The diagnosis unit determines the brain conditions of the user based on the at least one activated brain activation region continuously extracted for a predetermined period. The device further includes: a user data collection unit for collecting body information related to the user; and an image collection unit for collecting medical images related to the user. The diagnosis unit can determine the brain conditions of the user by using the at least one activated brain activation region, the body information related to the user, and the medical images related to the user.

title: Data aggregation, integration and analysis system and related devices and methods
abstract: A system for recording, storing and processing diagnostic information, including: a computer implementing a computer-readable media including digital data and ground truth; a registry constructed and arranged to store and associate transactions or accesses on the data; and a machine learning system that considers each learning step modification a microtransaction for the data used in that step and which is recorded in the transaction registry. Other embodiments of this aspect include corresponding computer systems, apparatus, and computer programs recorded on one or more computer storage devices, each configured to perform the actions of the methods.

title: Wheelchair pressure ulcer risk management coaching system and methodology
assignee: University of Pittsburgh—of the Commonwealth System of Higher Education, The United States Government as represented by the Department of Veterans Aftairs
abstract: A wheelchair system includes a wheelchair including a plurality of force sensors including at least three force sensors. A rigid seat pan is placed in contact with each the plurality of force sensors at a different position on the rigid seat pan so that the rigid seat pan does not contact the frame and forces on the rigid seat pan are transferred to the plurality of force sensors. Each of the plurality of force sensors is in communicative connection with a processor system. A memory system is in communicative connection and an interface system is in connection with the processor system and a user interface system in communicative connection with the processor system. Instructions stored on the memory system are executable by the processor system to determine a value of a variable related to a distribution of force on the rigid seat pan over time.
assignee_clean: university of pittsburgh of the commonwealth system of higher education; the united states government as represented by the department of veterans aftairs
primary_assignee: university of pittsburgh of the commonwealth system of higher education

title: System and method for memory augmented domain adaptation
abstract: A system is presented. The system includes an acquisition subsystem configured to obtain images corresponding to a target domain. Moreover, the system includes a processing subsystem in operative association with the acquisition subsystem and including a memory augmented domain adaptation platform configured to compute one or more features of an input image corresponding to a target domain, identify a set of support images based on the features of the input image, where the set of support images corresponds to the target domain, augment an input to a machine-learnt model with a set of features, a set of masks, or both corresponding to the set of support images to adapt the machine-learnt model to the target domain, and generate an output based at least on the set of features, the set of masks, or both. Additionally, the system includes an interface unit configured to present the output for analysis.

title: Diagnosis and treatment data processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure discloses a treatment data processing method, a treatment data processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as big data processing, natural language processing and knowledge graph. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: firstly, acquiring diagnosis and treatment data to be processed, and then analyzing the diagnosis and treatment data to acquire key information contained in the diagnosis and treatment data, wherein the key information comprises: the diagnosis and treatment system comprises a diagnosis and treatment object, a first diagnosis and treatment operation and first diagnosis and treatment time, and then obtains a diagnosis and treatment event map associated with the diagnosis and treatment object, wherein the diagnosis and treatment event map comprises second diagnosis and treatment operation and corresponding second diagnosis and treatment time, and finally, the first diagnosis and treatment time and the first diagnosis and treatment operation are utilized to update the diagnosis and treatment event map according to the first diagnosis and treatment time and the second diagnosis and treatment time, so that the relationship and progress of each diagnosis and treatment event of the diagnosis and treatment object in the diagnosis and treatment process can be intuitively and comprehensively reflected by updating the diagnosis and treatment event map in real time according to key information.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Vein thromboembolism (VTE) risk assessment system
abstract: A vein thromboembolism (VTE) risk assessment system that includes a casing having a shape adapted to secure a plurality of components with the casing. The casing includes a microphonic sensor, a Photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor, an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensor, a diaphragm, and a microcontroller. The microphonic sensor captures VTE audio signals indicative of the VTE risk of the user. The PPG sensor measures blood volume changes in a skin area in response to venous hemodynamic changes in a lower limb. The IMU sensor captures seismic signals indicative of the VTE risk of the user. The diaphragm enhances auscultation signals. The microcontroller transmits data to a computing device.

title: Tumor diagnosis system and construction method thereof, terminal device and storage medium
assignee: Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy Of Medical Sciences
abstract: A tumor diagnosis system and a construction method thereof, a terminal device and a storage medium are provided, wherein a radiomics signature is obtained by a radiomics signature-generation module in the tumor diagnosis system according to target radiomics information and clinical data information, based on a pre-trained radiomics signature model; a first classification comprehensive diagnosis result is obtained by a benign and malignant comprehensive classification module according to a ambient situation of a lesion outside an intestinal wall, the clinical data information and a first radiomics signature, based on a pre-trained first classification comprehensive diagnosis model; a second classification comprehensive diagnosis result is generated through a malignant focus sub-classification module based on a pre-trained second classification comprehensive diagnosis model, if the first classification comprehensive diagnosis result includes high-risk malignant information; and a final diagnosis result is obtained and displayed in a result displaying module.
assignee_clean: cancer hospital; chinese academy of medical sciences

title: Machine learning services with pre-trained models
abstract: Features related to systems and methods for automated generation of a machine learning model based in part on a pretrained model are described. The pretrained model is used as a starting point to augment and retrain according to client specifications. The identification of an appropriate pretrained model is based on the client specifications such as model inputs, model outputs, and similarities between the data used to train the models.

title: Smart healthcare system
assignee: The Research Foundation For The State University Of New York
abstract: A system is provided for advanced health monitoring and diagnosis based on wearable nano-biosensing networks. Nanophotonic and wireless communication technologies are synergistically leveraged to bridge the gap between nano-biosensing technologies and commercial wearable devices. Embodiments of the presently-disclosed system may include: (1) a nanoplasmonic biochip, implanted subcutaneously and built on a flexible substrate; (2) a nanophotonic smart band or wearable device that is able to collect in-vivo signals on-demand and relay them wirelessly to the user's smartphone by means of a secure data transfer; and (3) advanced signal processing techniques implemented on a remote processor to extract relevant data from the received signals and provide a diagnosis in real-time.
assignee_clean: the research foundation for the state university of new york
primary_assignee: the research foundation for the state university of new york

title: Prediction device for thoracic outlet syndrome
assignee: 深圳市前海蛇口自贸区医院
abstract: The invention provides a prediction device for thoracic outlet syndrome. The device extracts muscle activity information comprising activation intensity, activation synchronism, activation duration and activation frequency by collecting electromyographic signal data when a tested individual executes a preset action; then obtaining anatomical structure information of the thoracic outlet region of the tested individual, wherein the information comprises anatomical structure changes and the positions, shapes and sizes of specific structures such as muscles, nerves and blood vessels of the anatomical structure changes; further, myoelectricity-anatomy structure association feature data is extracted through myoelectricity signal data and anatomy structure information, and pathological change feature parameters are extracted according to the myoelectricity-anatomy structure association feature data and the anatomy structure change. And finally, determining the prediction result of the chest outlet syndrome of the tested individual through all the information. The device provides a systematic and multidirectional evaluation means, and can improve the prediction accuracy of the thoracic outlet syndrome.
assignee_clean: 深圳市前海蛇口自贸区医院
primary_assignee: 深圳市前海蛇口自贸区医院

title: Method for, device for, and system for analazing brain image
abstract: A method for analyzing a brain image according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: obtaining a brain image including voxel data; segmenting the brain image into a plurality of areas including a cranial area and a reference area to obtain a first boundary defining a first inner area inside the cranial area and the reference area; correcting at least part of the first boundary related to the first inner area based on the reference area to obtain a second inner area having a second boundary, part of the second inner area being included in the first inner area and including a target component; obtaining a first volumetric value related to the target component based on voxel data corresponding to the target component; obtaining a second volumetric value related to the second inner area based on voxel data included in the second boundary; and calculating the volumetric index of the target component based on the first volumetric value and the second volumetric value. Therefore, provided are a method for analyzing a brain image, a device for analyzing a brain image and a system for analyzing a brain image.

title: VTE risk automatic evaluation system based on deep learning
assignee: 山东众阳健康科技集团有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a VTE risk automatic assessment system based on deep learning, including: the first analysis module is used for obtaining the probability of selecting all unstructured risk indexes of the patient based on the information related to all risk items of the patient according to a preset VTE (virtual traffic environment) knowledge graph; the second analysis module is used for obtaining the probability of selecting a certain unstructured risk index of the patient based on the information related to the patient and the certain unstructured risk index; the first judgment module is used for judging whether the unstructured risk indexes are selected or not based on the results of the first analysis module and the second analysis module; the second judgment module is used for judging whether the structured risk indexes are selected or not; the risk item evaluation module is used for judging that the risk item is risky when any one risk index is selected based on the judgment results of the first judgment module and the second judgment module; the method greatly reduces the workload of nursing staff and improves the accuracy of VTE risk assessment.
assignee_clean: 山东众阳健康科技集团有限公司
primary_assignee: 山东众阳健康科技集团有限公司

title: Method for, device for, and system for analazing brain image
abstract: A brain image analysis method in accordance with an embodiment of the present application comprises: obtaining a first correction parameter for correcting a first morphological value associated with a first brain element; obtaining a second correction parameter for correcting a second morphological value associated with a second brain element different from the first brain element; acquiring a target brain image; segmenting the target brain image into multiple brain regions including a first region corresponding to the first brain element, a second region corresponding to the second brain element, and a cranial region to obtain a third region associated with the first region, the second region, and an internal region of the cranial region; obtaining a first brain morphological index associated with the first brain element based on voxel data corresponding to the first region, voxel data corresponding to the third region, and the first correction parameter; and obtaining a second brain morphological index associated with the second brain element based on voxel data corresponding to the second region, the voxel data corresponding to the third region, and the second correction parameter. In accordance with the embodiment of the present application, the morphological indexes based on the medical image of an object can be more accurately calculated by appropriately applying the correction parameters in consideration of scan conditions in which the medical image is acquired or a position of the target element.

title: Method for detecting sensitivity of different types of tumors to radiotherapy rays based on machine learning technology
assignee: 山东省肿瘤防治研究院（山东省肿瘤医院）, 山东大学, 济南比山网络科技有限公司
abstract: A method for detecting the sensitivity of different types of tumors to radiotherapy rays based on a machine learning technology comprises the following steps: the medical case data processing system comprises a medical case database module, a case data preprocessing module, a decision tree C4.5 algorithm generating module, a decision tree pruning module, a decision tree model verifying module, a patient information input module and a decision tree model calculation result output module. The invention can establish judgment models of different tumors with different ray sensitivities according to the existing case database and train the models, and after the relevant information of the tumors of the patient is input, the detection model can automatically judge and output the sensitivity results of the tumors with different rays so as to assist doctors to make corresponding radiotherapy plans.
assignee_clean: 山东省肿瘤防治研究院 山东省肿瘤医院; 山东大学; 济南比山网络科技有限公司
