title: Systems and methods for magnetic resonance imaging
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: A method for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is provided. The method may include obtaining scan data of a subject. The scan data may be acquired by an MR scanner at a time according to a pulse sequence. The method may include obtaining motion data of the subject. The motion data of the subject may be acquired by one or more sensors at the time. The motion data may reflect a motion state of the subject at the time. The method may also include determining, based on the motion data of the subject, a processing strategy indicating whether using the scan data to fill one or more k-space lines corresponding to the pulse sequence in a k-space. The method may further include obtaining k-space data based on the processing strategy.

title: System, method, and apparatus for temperature asymmetry measurement of body parts
abstract: Method for automatic detection of inflammation or functional disorder according to temperature asymmetry estimation in contralateral body parts is presented. Simultaneously recorded thermogram and the optical image of the inspected and contralateral body parts are sent to the processing unit, where they are stored, processed, and analyzed. Method automatically detects outlines of body parts in thermograms and optical images. Grid of points of interest is distributed inside the inspected and the contralateral body part's outline. Temperature maps are calculated according to both grids points and the temperature disparity map is estimated. The set of inflammation regions is obtained by analyzing the temperature disparity map and collecting adjacent points containing temperature differences surpassing the threshold. This is non-invasive and non-contact inspection method, suitable for real world environments with natural home or health care institutions background.

title: Contrast region detection imaging method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a contrast region detection imaging method based on deep learning. S1, randomly selecting a plurality of original ultrasonic RF images, and segmenting signals on each scanning line of the original ultrasonic RF images to obtain a plurality of one-dimensional RF signal segments with equal length; s2, training and testing the convolutional neural network by using the RF signal segment; s3, dividing the RF signal of each scanning line of the actual measurement object into one-dimensional actual measurement RF signal segments with equal length, and inputting the signal segments into the trained convolutional neural network; s4, setting P imaging points in the middle of a one-dimensional measured RF signal section with a tissue signal as a label as 0; s5, recombining the one-dimensional actually measured RF signal section to obtain pre-imaging; s6, improving the brightness of the microbubble image in the pre-imaging by adopting mother microbubble wavelet transformation; and S7, improving the image contrast by adopting a feature space minimum variance algorithm. The invention applies the concept of deep learning to the classification of the ultrasonic RF signals, can more effectively filter out tissue interference, and further improves the accuracy of medical clinical diagnosis.

title: Wearable device assisted chronic patient clinical monitoring platform and method
assignee: 郑州大学第二附属医院
abstract: The invention provides a wearable device assisted chronic patient clinical monitoring platform and a wearable device assisted chronic patient clinical monitoring method. The platform comprises a data receiving end, a data coding end, a data predicting end, a data output end and a data feedback end; the data receiving end receives clinical monitoring data of a plurality of chronic patients; the data encoding end comprises an encoding process pipeline; a clinical data trend analysis model is arranged in the data prediction end; the clinical data trend analysis model takes clinical monitoring coded data as input and outputs a corresponding clinical trend prediction result; after acquiring a clinical trend prediction result, the data output end screens the clinical trend prediction result and sends the clinical trend prediction result to the data feedback end; and the data feedback end sends the screened clinical trend prediction result as a feedback signal to the data prediction end for updating the clinical data trend analysis model. The invention also discloses a clinical monitoring method realized based on the platform. The technical scheme of the invention can effectively realize the whole clinical process closed-loop dynamic monitoring of the chronic disease patient.
assignee_clean: 郑州大学第二附属医院
primary_assignee: 郑州大学第二附属医院

title: Diagnostic result prediction method, diagnostic result prediction device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京惠每云科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a diagnosis result prediction method, a diagnosis result prediction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the diagnosis result prediction method comprises the following steps: and acquiring first information, wherein the first information is patient medical record information after desensitization treatment. And carrying out field analysis on the first information to obtain first data and second data serving as input data and output data of the model. And cleaning the first data and the second data to remove invalid data in the first data and the second data. And acquiring instruction data, and constructing a training data set based on the cleaned first data and the cleaned second data so as to finely adjust the ChatGLM-6B model. And obtaining a model prediction result and an actual diagnosis result, and evaluating the model prediction result and the actual diagnosis result by taking BLEU and ROUGE as evaluation indexes so as to optimize the ChatGLM-6B model.
assignee_clean: 北京惠每云科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京惠每云科技有限公司

title: System and method of user mobility monitoring
assignee: Curamicus Ltd., Robin Frost, Susan Frost
abstract: A user mobility monitoring system has a user-wearable device and a remote analysis system. The user-wearable device monitors the physical mobility of a user, having a plurality of sensors, including at least motion sensors, the device being wirelessly connectable to the Internet and adapted in use to transmit wirelessly to the Internet real-time sensor data from the sensors for the duration of a monitoring period. The remote analysis system is connectable to the Internet and adapted in use to receive the sensor data transmitted via the Internet from the user-wearable device and, during the monitoring period, to analyse the data so as to detect a physical instability event of the user and generate corresponding alert data. An analogous method of monitoring the mobility of a user is also provided. The operation of the user-wearable device is controlled at least partly by the remote analysis system.

title: Deep learning-based pancreatic cystic disease clinical decision method and system
assignee: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司, 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a pancreatic cystic disease clinical decision method and a pancreatic cystic disease clinical decision system based on deep learning, comprising: acquiring multi-phase pancreas images with the same layer number, registering the multi-phase pancreas images, and acquiring registered multi-phase pancreas images; obtaining a multi-phase local pancreatic image and a multi-phase global pancreatic image; extracting the multi-phase local pancreatic image and multi-phase global pancreatic image characteristics to generate a multi-phase local characteristic set and a multi-phase global characteristic set; guiding the multi-phase local feature set through the multi-phase global feature set, and completing gradual fusion of the multi-phase local feature set and the multi-phase global feature set to obtain multi-phase fusion features; and performing multi-task learning according to the multi-phase fusion characteristics, and generating clinical decision results by contrast with clinical guidelines. The method can obtain richer and clearer pancreatic contour image details, so that pancreatic cyst identification is more accurate, and corresponding clinical decisions can be formed according to the actual situation of the pancreatic cyst.
assignee_clean: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司; 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司

title: Small target semantic segmentation method and system based on low-rank mixed attention mechanism
abstract: The invention provides a small target semantic segmentation method and a system based on a low-rank mixed attention mechanism, which comprise the following steps of: constructing a segmentation model, specifically: constructing a segmentation data set and performing data preprocessing; and (3) performing feature extraction on the preprocessed segmented data set: expanding the receptive field based on the dilated convolution; as an alternative to pooling layers, aggregating feature information and extracting higher-order semantic features by adding low-rank mixed attention mechanisms in the network; calculating weighted cross entropy loss and Dice loss according to the extracted features, and training the network by using a mixed loss function to obtain a network model; and outputting a small target segmentation result by utilizing the segmentation model aiming at the object to be segmented. The method effectively solves the problems that the small target size in the image data set easily causes serious class imbalance and information is lost in the characteristic learning process, so that the accurate reconstruction of the image in a decoder is difficult to realize.

title: Cognitive assistant for aiding expert decision
abstract: Intelligent cognitive assistants for decision-making are provided. A first plurality of decisions made by a first healthcare provider during treatment of a first patient is monitored. For each respective decision of the first plurality of decisions, one or more corresponding medical attributes of the first patient that were present at a time when the respective decision was made are determined. A cognitive assistant is trained, using an imitation learning model, based on each of the first plurality of decisions and the corresponding one or more medical attributes of the first patient. Subsequently, one or more medical attributes of a second patient are received, and a first medical decision is generated by processing the one or more medical attributes of the second patient using the cognitive assistant.

title: Systems and methods for generating pluggable domain-specific data types
abstract: Systems and methods for generating pluggable domain-specific data types are provided herein. According to some embodiments, methods for generating pluggable domain-specific data types may include determining a schema for the domain-specific data type, the schema including a data protocol that defines how data units are to be encoded into a domain-specific data unit, the domain-specific data unit including two or more data units received from one or more data sources, generating the domain-specific data type utilizing the determined schema, the domain-specific data type having a pluggable format such that the domain-specific data type may be utilized by a third-party application, and storing the domain-specific data type in a domain-specific data type library.

title: Smart location alert system
abstract: In an approach to sending an alert based on a user's location, one or more computer processors identify a position of a target device as a first location based, at least in part, on data provided by one or more geolocation systems; identify a location category for the first location; determine that the identified location category is among a predetermined set of location categories; identify a time threshold for the identified location category; identify an alert that is associated with the identified location category within the database; determine an amount of time that the target device is present at the first location; and determine that the amount of time the target device is present at the first location exceeds the time threshold, and in response, sending the alert to the one or more recipient devices for the purpose of notifying users of the first location of the target device.

title: Method, apparatus, and computer program product for adaptive tail digital content object bid value generation
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide methods, systems, apparatuses, and computer program products for adaptively generating an electronic bid value for a tail digital content object.

title: Optimization method and optimization device for scanned image and medical scanning system
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The present application relates to a scan image optimization method, a scan image optimization apparatus, a medical scan system, and a computer-readable storage medium. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: updating network parameters of the first artificial neural network by taking the first image as an input image and taking the second image as a target image; and respectively taking the output image and the input image of the first artificial neural network as training samples of the second artificial neural network, taking the output image and the input image of the second artificial neural network as training samples of the first artificial neural network, and alternately and iteratively training the first artificial neural network and the second artificial neural network until the preset iteration times are reached or the current output image of the first artificial neural network meets the set conditions, and outputting the current output image of the first artificial neural network. The application solves the problem of long imaging time required by repeated scanning of the same part in the related technology and shortens the medical imaging time.
assignee_clean: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司

title: Customized deep learning classifier for detecting organization sensitive data in images on premises
abstract: Disclosed is a method of building a customized deep learning (DL) stack classifier to detect organization sensitive data in images, referred to as image-borne organization sensitive documents, and protecting against loss of the image-borne organization sensitive documents, including distributing a trained feature map extractor stack with stored parameters to an organization, under the organization's control, configured to allow the organization to extract from image-borne organization sensitive documents, feature maps that are used to generate updated DL stacks, without the organization forwarding images of organization-sensitive training examples, and to save non invertible feature maps derived from the images, and ground truth labels for the image. Also included is receiving organization-specific examples including the non-invertible feature maps extracted from the organization-sensitive documents and the ground truth labels and using the received organization-specific examples to generate a customer-specific DL stack classifier. Further included is sending the customer-specific DL stack classifier to the organization.

title: Predicting recurrence and overall survival using radiomic features correlated with PD-L1 expression in early stage non-small cell lung cancer (ES-NSCLC)
assignee: Case Western Reserve University, The Cleveland Clinic Foundation
abstract: Embodiments include controlling a processor to perform operations, the operations comprising accessing a digitized image of a region of tissue (ROT) demonstrating cancerous pathology; extracting a set of radiomic features from the digitized image, where the set of radiomic features are positively correlated with programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression; providing the set of radiomic features to a machine learning classifier; receiving, from the machine learning classifier, a probability that the region of tissue will experience cancer recurrence, where the machine learning classifier computes the probability based, at least in part, on the set of radiomic features; generating a classification of the region of tissue as likely to experience recurrence or non-recurrence based, at least in part, on the probability; and displaying the classification and at least one of the probability, the set of radiomic features, or the digitized image.
assignee_clean: case western reserve university; the cleveland clinic foundation

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for determining facility layout position
assignee: 北京大也智慧数据科技服务有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining a facility layout position, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information of a target object in a designated community; clustering the position information of the target object to obtain an aggregation area of at least one target object; acquiring medical emergency facility demand corresponding to each aggregation area based on the association relation between the target object and the medical emergency facilities in each aggregation area; and clustering the position information of the target object in each aggregation area based on the medical emergency facility demand corresponding to each aggregation area so as to determine the layout position information of the medical emergency facility. The scheme disclosed by the application realizes the improvement of the rationality of the arrangement positions of the medical emergency facilities and the emergency services.
assignee_clean: 北京大也智慧数据科技服务有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京大也智慧数据科技服务有限公司

title: Medical knowledge graph construction method, device, equipment and computer readable medium
abstract: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a computer readable medium for constructing a medical knowledge graph. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing sensitive information elimination operation on original case data acquired from a case database or the Internet to obtain case source data from which sensitive information is eliminated; screening the human body structure data, the human body function data and the clinical presentation data of the cases from the case source data from which the sensitive information is eliminated according to the basic medical knowledge base; screening human body structure inspection technical data and human body function inspection technical data of cases from case source data from which sensitive information is eliminated according to a clinical medical knowledge base: the human body structure data and the human body structure checking technical data are corresponding, the human body function data and the human body function checking technical data are corresponding, and the corresponding result of the human body structure, the corresponding result of the human body function and the clinical manifestation data are organized according to a causal logic chain to construct a medical knowledge graph.

title: Managing computer resources for clinical applications
abstract: Techniques regarding the management of computational resources based on clinical priority associated with one or more computing tasks are provided. For example, one or more embodiments described herein can regard a system comprising a memory that can store computer-executable components. The system can also comprise a processor, operably coupled to the memory, that executes the computer-executable components stored in the memory. The computer-executable components can include a prioritization component that can prioritize computer applications based on a clinical priority of tasks performed by the computer applications. The clinical priority can characterize a time sensitivity of the tasks. The computer-executable components can also include a resource pool component that can divide computational resources across a plurality of resource pools and can assign the computer applications to the plurality of resource pools based on the clinical priority.

title: Updating method and device of medical insurance auditing system, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 武汉金豆医疗数据科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure discloses an updating method and device of a medical insurance auditing system, an electronic device and a storage medium, and the main technical scheme comprises the following steps: the preset medical insurance knowledge base and the preset engine configuration table are intensively deployed in the open service platform in a cluster mode, when the preset medical insurance knowledge base and/or the preset engine configuration table need to be updated, only the preset medical insurance knowledge base and the preset engine configuration table in the open service platform need to be updated, the medical insurance auditing system which accords with the current medical insurance reimbursement policy can be used when medical insurance data are audited, the problem that auditing is inaccurate or errors exist in auditing results due to untimely updating of the system is effectively solved, and auditing accuracy of the medical insurance data is improved.
assignee_clean: 武汉金豆医疗数据科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 武汉金豆医疗数据科技有限公司

title: Method for providing insurance clause rule based medical information service associate with similar question and answer database connecting to bigdata for health insurance claim
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for providing a medical information service associated with similar queries and answers based on a rule applied with an insurance clause for examining a medical expense payment, which comprises the steps of: receiving medical record data of a patient, which is transmitted for requesting and examining a medical expense payment, from a payment request terminal; extracting an association element which is cross-referred with a parameter included in the medical record data of the patient from a medical consultation database constructed in a medical consultation service providing server interworking with a medical information service providing server; filtering the association element including at least one metadata included in a query among the extracted association elements, when the query received from the payment request terminal is received; and generating the filtered association element in an answer form to interwork with a pre-stored insurance clause to transmit the same to the payment request terminal.

title: Hospital control system and the control method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a hospital control system, comprising: a communication unit for transmitting and receiving data; a memory storing one or more instructions; and at least one processor executing the one or more instructions stored in the memory, wherein the at least one processor is configured to: control the communication unit to receive patient's biometric information in real time; determine a change amount of a patient's condition based on and the biometric information and an examination result including at least one of CT, X-ray, MRI, body temperature, pulse, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, electrocardiogram, and blood sugar information of the patient; control the communication unit to transmit at least one of upper body information and the change amount of the disease to a hospital electronic medical record system and a medical staff device; and receive prescription information from a medical team and performs a prescription corresponding to the prescription information for the patient. The present invention determines a change in a disease based on a patient's test result and biometric information, so that treatment and prescription can be made in a non-face-to-face method or in a remote place.

title: Abdominal multi-organ dynamic enhancement segmentation method and system based on federal learning
abstract: The application discloses an abdomen multi-organ dynamic enhancement segmentation method and system based on federal learning, comprising the following steps: labeling a dynamic enhancement network model on the abdomen multi-organ part constructed at the server side; the abdomen multi-organ part labeling dynamic enhancement segmentation network model training module is constructed at the client and used for training based on the local part labeling data; and the federal learning framework construction module is used for carrying out cooperative interaction between the client and the server. Compared with the prior art, the multi-organ segmentation network training method introduces a federal learning mechanism into the multi-organ segmentation network, can train the multi-organ segmentation network by effectively utilizing multi-organ segmentation image information of different part labeling types distributed in different medical centers, breaks the limit of completely labeling data for multi-organ segmentation, can realize collaborative modeling of a plurality of medical centers on the basis of not sharing privacy data, further improves the robustness and generalization of the model, and relieves the privacy protection difficulty of the medical industry.

title: Method and apparatus for real time respiratory gating signal generation and detection of body deformation using embedded fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: A method and system of compensating for body deformation during image acquisition or external beam treatment includes acquiring image data of a body and peak wavelength data from a plurality of fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs) disposed on the body aligned along a predetermined coordinate system on the body, such as a cartesian coordinate system. The method further comprises detecting effective shifts of the Bragg wavelengths of the FBGs caused by body deformation during image acquisition, and controlling the movement of the body through a cavity in a scanning device and controlling the acquisition of the image data or external beam treatment during body deformation based on the effective shifts of the Bragg wavelengths of the FBGs.

title: Privacy preserving location tracking
abstract: A method, an apparatus and a computer program for tracking location of users without disclosing Personally Identifiable Information (PII). The method comprises analyzing sequences of location events of a user over time to determine a Point Of Interest (POI) of the user. In response to determining that the POI is PII-revealing POI; obfuscating the POI, by generating a pseudolocation identifier of the POI indicative of a semantic meaning thereof to the user without revealing a geographic location of the POI. The method further comprises generating an anonymized sequence of location events of the user based on the sequence of location events, that comprises the pseudolocation identifier to represent location events associated with the POI, and absent of the geographic location thereof. The anonymized sequence of location events may be provided a third party to analyze behavior of the user without divulging identity of the user.

title: Medication recommendation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on sorting algorithm
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a medication recommendation method, a medication recommendation device, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on a sorting algorithm. According to the method, the patient characteristic information data of a patient are obtained, the patient characteristic information data comprise disease characteristic information data of the patient, a candidate medicine set corresponding to the disease characteristic information data is screened out from a preset medicine database based on an inverted index algorithm according to the disease characteristic information data, the preset medicine characteristic information data corresponding to medicines contained in the candidate medicine set are obtained according to the candidate medicine set, medicines contained in the candidate medicine set are ordered according to the patient characteristic information data and the medicine characteristic information data based on a preset ordering algorithm, a medicine ordering queue is obtained, a target recommended medicine is determined according to the medicine ordering queue, and the target recommended medicine is recommended, so that a doctor can select medicines from recommended medicines, and the accuracy of medicine recommendation can be improved.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma image segmentation method and system based on deep learning
assignee: 天津医科大学第二医院
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of image segmentation, in particular to a nasopharyngeal carcinoma image segmentation method and system based on deep learning; according to the application, the nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus is divided into two types of bone tissues and muscle adipose tissues by the characteristic of being relatively complex to the area of the nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus, and the focus is respectively identified by adopting two deep learning models, so that the accuracy of model identification is improved, and the accuracy of model segmentation is further improved; in addition, according to the problem that the identification accuracy is not high when the nasopharyngeal carcinoma focus occurs on the muscle adipose tissue, the HU value larger than a certain threshold value is randomly deleted, so that the influence of bones in the training process is weakened, the model is enabled to pay more attention to the messages such as muscle, fat and the like, the identification capability of the model on the focus of the muscle and fat region is improved, the identification accuracy of the model is improved, and the segmentation accuracy of the model is further improved.
assignee_clean: 天津医科大学第二医院
primary_assignee: 天津医科大学第二医院

title: Weighted bone age assessment method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a weighted bone age assessment method and a system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing an X-ray image of the bones of the hand of the tester; then, rough segmentation is carried out to respectively obtain a carpal bone and radial ulna interested region set and interested region sets corresponding to different metacarpal bones; inputting the coarse segmented region of interest set into a hand bone fine segmentation model to obtain a plurality of fine segmented hand bone regions of interest; respectively inputting the classification and grading models of the hand bones to obtain the classification and development grades corresponding to each hand bone; according to the metacarpophalangeal bone and radial ulna development maturity evaluation chart, obtaining the bone age estimated by the RUS-CHN method according to the corresponding classification and development grades of each hand bone; according to the wrist bone development maturity evaluation chart, obtaining the bone age estimated by the TW3-C Carpal method according to the corresponding classification and development grade of each Carpal bone; and carrying out weighted summation on the bone ages estimated by the two methods to obtain a final bone age estimation result of the tester.

title: Medical apparatus
abstract: A medical apparatus of embodiments includes processing circuitry. The processing circuitry is configured to input third projection data to a first trained model to generate fourth projection data, the first trained model being generated through learning using first projection data collected by a first X-ray detector included in a first scanner and relatively greatly affected by scattered rays as learning data of an input side and using second projection data relatively less affected by scattered rays as learning data of an output side, the first trained model being configured to generate, on the basis of the third projection data collected by a second X-ray detector included in a second scanner, the fourth projection data in which the influence of scattered rays in the third projection data has been reduced. The first projection data is collected by the first X-ray detector in a case where a collimator provided in a first X-ray source included in the first scanner has a first opening width. The second projection data is collected by the first X-ray detector in a case where the collimator has an opening width smaller than the first opening width.

title: Contextual integrity preservation
abstract: An example operation includes one or more of receiving, by a data processing node, inference data object from a multi-channel data server over a blockchain, sorting, by the data processing node, longitudinal records contained in the inference data object, linking, by the data processing node, transaction outcomes and inferences data from the inference data object to the sorted longitudinal records, and recording linked data onto a blockchain ledger. The data processing node serves as a validator of data from a robo-advisory using natural language (NL) processing to reduce bias and measure effectiveness of inference from the robo-advisory.

title: Three-dimensional image processing method, image processing model training method and medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a three-dimensional image processing method, an image processing model training method and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the image processing models of different stages, determining at least one batch of image subsets from the three-dimensional image set to be processed, constructing a training set for training the image processing model based on the at least one batch of image subsets and corresponding image processing results, and processing the images in the three-dimensional image set by using the trained image processing model to obtain the corresponding image processing results. Therefore, the model training efficiency can be improved, the three-dimensional image processing efficiency and the three-dimensional image processing accuracy are improved, and the workload of personnel is reduced.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Infrared and visible light fusion imaging method based on deep learning
abstract: The application discloses infrared and visible light fusion imaging method based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: simultaneously acquiring infrared images and visible light images with the same size aiming at a target to form a target object image pair, carrying out sub-image pair segmentation, preprocessing and noise image addition on sub-images in the target object image pair, and inputting the sub-image pair added with the noise image as an input image pair into a trained image fusion model to obtain a fused image; the image fusion model comprises a shallow layer feature extraction unit, an encoder, a fusion module and a decoder. The method considers the common fact that the source image contains noise, takes the source image as the premise of practical imaging application, and performs image denoising in the process of fusing the images, so that noise in the source image pair is effectively prevented from being introduced into the fused image; the application is very favorable for the application research of infrared and visible light fusion and deep learning technology, and is expected to be widely applied in the fields of medical imaging, night monitoring and the like.

title: Image tag semi-automatic labeling method, system, terminal and medium
assignee: 中科海微(北京)科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a semi-automatic labeling method and a semi-automatic labeling system for image labels, comprising the following steps: acquiring a plurality of image samples, performing attribute labeling on part of the image samples to obtain image contents and labels thereof in one-to-one correspondence, and generating a learning sample; based on the learning sample, selecting a network for training to obtain a learning model; based on a learning model, taking a learning sample and a pre-calibrated test sample as inputs of the learning model, and outputting to obtain a corresponding learning result; and feeding back the learning result to the learning model, and optimizing the learning model. Meanwhile, a corresponding terminal and medium are provided. According to the invention, for a given image sample, a final calibration result can be obtained, and a manual intervention process is added. The whole process does not need to consume too much manpower, and a large network is not used, so that shorter running time is ensured. The method can meet the labeling work of most data sets at the present stage, and comprises the steps of classifying the data sets, detecting the data sets, identifying the data sets and the like.
assignee_clean: 中科海微 北京 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 中科海微 北京 科技有限公司

title: Method, device, and computer program product for deep lesion tracker for monitoring lesions in four-dimensional longitudinal imaging
abstract: The present disclosure provides a computer-implemented method, a device, and a computer program product for deep lesion tracker. The method includes inputting a search image into a first three-dimensional DenseFPN (feature pyramid network) of an image encoder and inputting a template image into a second three-dimensional DenseFPN of the image encoder to extract image features; encoding anatomy signals of the search image and the template image as Gaussian heatmaps, and inputting the Gaussian heatmap of the template image into a first anatomy signal encoders (ASE) and inputting the Gaussian heatmap of the search image into a second ASE to extract anatomy features; inputting the image features and the anatomy features into a fast cross-correlation layer to generate correspondence maps, and computing a probability map according to the correspondence maps; and performing supervised learning or self-supervised learning to predict a lesion center in the search image.

title: System and method for prioritization and presentation of heterogeneous medical data
abstract: A system and method prioritizes and presents heterogenous medical data. The method includes retrieving medical data of a patient, the medical data including data from multiple data sources. The method includes phenotyping the medical data to generate a reasoning trail and reasoning outcome including one or more codes, the reasoning trail including a basis for which the reasoning outcome is determined. The method includes assigning a relevance score to each of the one or more codes. The method includes ranking the codes based on the relevance score of each of the one or more codes. The method includes displaying the codes in rank order.

title: Clinical grade consumer physical assessment system
abstract: A clinical grade consumer physical assessment system generates clinical grade physical assessment information for a patient based on a plurality of consumer grade measurements taken from different body portions of the patient using a consumer device. The system operates to correlate the plurality of consumer grade measurements, which have low resolution and accuracy, to a clinical grade result that is adequate for clinical purposes.

title: Electronic device and method for controlling external electronic device
abstract: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present invention may include an antenna module configured to sense an electromagnetic (EM) signal generated from an external electronic device, a communication module, a processor operatively connected to the antenna module and the communication module, and a memory storing instructions which, are configured to, when executed, cause the processor to identify the external electronic device based on at least part of the EM signal sensed from the external electronic device via the antenna module, identify whether the identified external electronic device is registered in a designated control application, and provide information related to the external electronic device based on whether the external electronic device is registered. In addition, other various embodiments of the present invention may be possible.

title: Codebook embedding generation and processing
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to wireless communication systems, and in particular, to techniques for generation and processing of an embedding representing a beam for communication. Certain aspects provide a method for wireless communication by a wireless node. The method generally includes receiving an embedding representing a characterization associated with a beam; providing the embedding to a machine learning (ML) model; generating one or more communication parameters for communication using the beam via the ML model based on the embedding; and communicating using the one or more communication parameters.

title: Method and apparatus for categorizing documents containing sensitive information
abstract: A method and apparatus for determining whether a document is to be protected is described. In one embodiment, a computer system identifies a document to be categorized. The computer system then determines one or more probabilities that the document belongs to one or more of a plurality of predefined categories, the probabilities based on profiles of the predefined categories. The computer system then determines whether the probabilities indicate that the document is to be protected, and, if the document is to be protected, causes the document to be used in data loss detection.

title: Image synthesis for personalized facial expression classification
abstract: A method may include obtaining a facial image of a subject and identifying a number of new images to be synthesized with target AU combinations and categories of intensity. The method may also include synthesizing the number of new images using the facial image of the subject as the base image with the number of target AU combinations and categories of intensity with a number of new images that have different AU combinations than the facial image of the subject. The method may additionally include adding the number of new images to a dataset and training a machine learning system using the dataset to identify a facial expression of the subject.

title: Image processing method and device and computer equipment
assignee: 杭州海康慧影科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image processing method, an image processing device and computer equipment, and belongs to the technical field of computers. In the embodiment of the application, the operation stage is automatically identified based on the intra-operation image, and the image processing is automatically performed according to the image processing modes corresponding to the identified operation stage, wherein at least two image processing modes corresponding to different operation stages exist. In addition, the scheme automatically identifies the operation stage, automatically matches the corresponding image processing mode for image processing, reduces the influence of manual adjustment on the operation, does not cut off the continuity of the operation, does not cause the field of view to be lost due to manual operation, and greatly improves the operation efficiency.
assignee_clean: 杭州海康慧影科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州海康慧影科技有限公司

title: Lifelong learning with a changing action set
abstract: Systems and methods are described for a decision-making process that includes an increasing set of actions, compute a policy function for a Markov decision process (MDP) for the decision-making process, wherein the policy function is computed based on a state conditional function mapping states into an embedding space, an inverse dynamics function mapping state transitions into the embedding space, and an action selection function mapping the elements of the embedding space to actions, identify an additional set of actions in the increasing set of actions, update the inverse dynamics function based at least in part on the additional set of actions, update the policy function based on the updated inverse dynamics function and parameters learned during the computing the policy function, and select an action based on the updated policy function.

title: Comprehensive evaluation method for quality of traditional Chinese medicinal materials
assignee: 中国食品药品检定研究院
abstract: The invention provides a comprehensive evaluation method for quality of traditional Chinese medicinal materials, which comprises the following steps: the process of establishing the quality index of the traditional Chinese medicine comprises the process of establishing a plurality of quality indexes based on the traditional quality view of the traditional Chinese medicine and the modern quality view of the production standardization of the whole process and the modern pharmacological efficacy evaluation, wherein the process of establishing the quality index of the traditional Chinese medicine comprises the steps of determining the pharmacological activity index and determining the quality attribute related index to evaluate the quality of the traditional Chinese medicine. The method also comprises the step of integrating a plurality of quality indexes by adopting a machine learning model based on the established quality indexes to construct a traditional Chinese medicine quality comprehensive evaluation model so as to calculate a traditional Chinese medicine quality comprehensive evaluation index (TCM QCEI). The traditional Chinese medicine quality comprehensive evaluation index (TCM QCEI) integrates traditional character evaluation and mainstream chemical evaluation, and simultaneously associates pharmacological activity, thereby providing technical support and demonstration for scientifically and objectively evaluating the quality of the traditional Chinese medicine.
assignee_clean: 中国食品药品检定研究院
primary_assignee: 中国食品药品检定研究院

title: Brain disease judgment system based on machine learning and intracranial multi-modal information fusion
assignee: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院
abstract: The invention provides a machine learning-based encephalic multi-modal information fusion brain disease judgment system, which comprises an input layer and an output layer, wherein encephalic information is input into the input layer, multi-level processing of data is carried out, various encephalic injury types are automatically judged and output, and an intervention treatment combination is designated according to the type combination of the output layer, wherein the encephalic information comprises encephalic pressure, encephalic oxygen partial pressure, intracranial temperature, intracranial neuroelectric signals, intracranial sodium ion concentration and intracranial potassium ion concentration.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院

title: Biomarkers of rapid progression in advanced non-small cell lung cancer
abstract: Methods and kits for identifying rapidly progressing lung cancer in a subject are provided. The method includes obtaining a biological sample from the subject and assaying a level of a biomarker in a biomarker panel in the biological sample where the panel includes at least one biomarker selected from Table I or Table II. The method further includes determining with the subject is treatment naive or has received at least one treatment; and comparing the level of the biomarker in the subject's sample to a cutoff value listed in Table I for treatment naive subjects or Table II for previously treated subjects. The method further includes determining whether the subject's level is above or below the cutoff value to determine whether the subject has rapidly progressing lung cancer.

title: Method for constructing infection diagnosis model around artificial joint prosthesis
assignee: 中山大学附属第一医院, 中山大学
abstract: The invention discloses a diagnostic model of infection around an artificial joint prosthesis, which comprises 1 element learner and 6 bottom layer learners; the meta learner integrates 6 bottom layer learners; the infection diagnosis model around the artificial joint prosthesis utilizes an integrated machine learning algorithm to integrate the advantages of a plurality of sub-models so as to improve the performance of the model and further improve the accuracy of PJI diagnosis. The infection diagnosis model around the artificial joint prosthesis can remarkably improve the early diagnosis efficiency of the PJI, improve the clinical diagnosis and treatment status, and provide a new scheme for the accurate diagnosis and prognosis prediction of the PJI; the method can be widely developed and used in hospitals at all levels, and the diagnosis indexes in the model are all conventional indexes which are easy to obtain, so that the method has an extremely important effect on reducing the misdiagnosis rate of PJI in hospitals at all levels, especially in primary hospitals.
assignee_clean: 中山大学附属第一医院; 中山大学
primary_assignee: 中山大学附属第一医院

title: Apparatus and methods for supporting reading of fundus image
abstract: Provided are apparatuses, a non-transitory computer-readable medium or media, and methods for supporting reading of a fundus image of a subject. In certain aspects, disclosed a method including the steps of: extracting a first feature information from a first fundus image of the subject based on a machine learning model; generating a second fundus image having a second feature information by mapping an adversarial factor to the first fundus image so that the first feature information is changed; and displaying the first fundus image having the first feature information and the second fundus image having the second feature information on a display device.

title: Method and system for microbiome-derived diagnostics and therapeutics for autoimmune system conditions
abstract: A method for at least one of characterizing, diagnosing, and treating an autoimmune disorder in at least a subject, the method comprising: receiving an aggregate set of biological samples from a population of subjects; generating at least one of a microbiome composition dataset and a microbiome functional diversity dataset for the population of subjects; generating a characterization of the autoimmune condition based upon features extracted from at least one of the microbiome composition dataset and the microbiome functional diversity dataset; based upon the characterization, generating a therapy model configured to correct the autoimmune condition; and at an output device associated with the subject, promoting a therapy to the subject based upon the characterization and the therapy model.

title: Medical image data set manufacturing method based on federal learning and antagonism network generation
abstract: The invention relates to a medical image data set making method based on federal learning and a generated countermeasure network, which comprises the following steps: issuing the discriminators in the generated countermeasure network model as global models to all clients; the client randomly extracts training samples and sends the training samples to the server; the server inputs the training samples into a center generator to generate simulation samples and sends the simulation samples to the client; the client judges the samples in the simulation sample and the training sample by using the global model to obtain a judging result, and updates parameters of the global model according to the judging result to generate a local model; uploading the local model and the discrimination result to a server; the server calculates the aggregation weight of the client according to the number of the local samples of all the clients; updating parameters of the center generator according to the discrimination result of the sample; and the server aggregates the local model according to the aggregation weights of all the clients to obtain a new global model, and the steps are repeated to generate a simulated medical image dataset by using the converged center generator.

title: Breast tumor image processing system, method and device
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image processing, mainly relates to a computer vision technology in artificial intelligence, in particular to a breast tumor image processing system, method and device, which are used for acquiring DCE magnetic resonance images corresponding to a plurality of time points of the same breast organ; respectively determining the average pixel gray value of the image of the same breast tumor region in the DCE magnetic resonance image at each time point, further determining the peak reaching time, and respectively generating a first-phase time-signal intensity image before the peak reaching time and a second-phase time-signal intensity image after the peak reaching time according to the DCE magnetic resonance image and the peak reaching time at each time point; wherein, the first-stage time-signal intensity image and the second-stage time-signal intensity image are 3D breast tumor images, and the gray values of the pixels of the breast tumor regions with different severity degrees are different. Based on the DCE magnetic resonance image, two 3D images are generated, which can provide more comprehensive information to express the change of the whole breast tumor region.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Low-rank generation type countermeasure network construction method for medical image generation
abstract: A low-rank generation type confrontation network construction method for medical image generation belongs to the field of deep learning and comprises the following construction steps: 1) utilizing a principal component mode to approximate full-rank convolution operation in the GAN model, and constructing low-rank convolution operation based on a calculation rule of tensor CP decomposition; 2) constructing a low-rank dimension convolutional layer and a low-rank channel convolutional layer to replace a full-rank convolutional layer by using the low-rank convolution operation of the step 1, adding a ReLU activation function and a batch regularization term between the low-rank convolutional layers, adjusting the data distribution of the low-rank convolutional layers, and designing a low-rank generation model; 3) and fusing the low-rank generation model and the full-rank discrimination model to construct a complete medical image low-rank generation type countermeasure network. The method provided by the invention has the following effects: the low-rank generation countermeasure method effectively reduces computational resources such as FLOPs, memory, video memory and space occupation in a medical image generation task, and has a good generation effect.

title: Personalized device routines
abstract: Systems and methods for personalized device routines include determining devices associated with user account data and generating device usage data indicating aspects of smart device usage over a period of time. The usage data may then be utilized to identify candidate smart devices, time indicators, and trigger event types to associate with candidate routines. One or more of the candidate routines may be recommended to a user based at least in part on the usage data and the trigger event types at issue to personalize the device routine recommendations.

title: Methods and systems for microbiome-derived diagnosis and treatment of endocrine system conditions
abstract: A method for at least one of characterizing, diagnosing, and treating an endocrine system condition in at least a subject, the method comprising: receiving an aggregate set of biological samples from a population of subjects; generating at least one of a microbiome composition dataset and a microbiome functional diversity dataset for a population of subjects; generating a characterization of an endocrine system condition based on features extracted from at least one of a microbiome composition dataset and a microbiome functional diversity dataset; generating a therapy model configured to correct the endocrine system condition based on the characterization; and at an output device associated with the subject, administering a therapy to the subject based on the characterization and the therapy model.

title: Lung medical image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a lung medical image processing method, apparatus, device and storage medium, the method comprising: acquiring a three-dimensional target lung CT image; inputting the target lung CT image into a pre-trained medical image segmentation model to obtain each lung lesion area image in the target lung CT image. The method is adopted, wherein the medical image segmentation model is obtained by training a neural network to be trained based on a three-dimensional sample lung CT image, each lesion area image in a pre-marked sample lung CT image and a preset example loss function, the example loss function reflects the influence of each pre-marked lesion area image on the neural network to be trained to segment the lesion area image in the sample lung CT image, and the medical image segmentation model obtained by training effectively reduces the missed segmentation of multiple lesion area images of the lung by using the example loss function, so that the lung CT image segmentation effect is improved.
assignee_clean: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司

title: Cardiac resuscitation machine control system and method
assignee: 烟台万利医用品有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of automatic control of medical equipment, in particular to a control system and a method of a cardiac resuscitation machine, comprising the steps of firstly acquiring physiological index data information and basic body data information of a patient, establishing a human body model as a three-dimensional digital model according to the acquired data information, and simultaneously acquiring a two-dimensional image; preprocessing the obtained data information, constructing a heart-lung state analysis neural network model, analyzing the preprocessed data to obtain the heart-lung state of a patient in the process of heart-lung resuscitation, and then forming feedback information; based on the feedback information, adapting chest compression frequency and respiratory frequency of the patient according to the cardiopulmonary health status level of the patient for further efficient first aid; in the process of carrying out cardiopulmonary resuscitation, a chest protection model is constructed according to the obtained feedback information and the data information, and the extrusion force of the cardiopulmonary resuscitation machine on the chest of a patient is controlled. The invention can lighten the burden of medical staff and improve the resuscitation effect and accuracy.

title: Data processing method and device based on deep neural network
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a data processing method and device based on a deep neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining at least 2 training samples, sequentially inputting the at least 2 training samples into a constructed deep neural network DNN model for training, reducing the loss function of the DNN model to a preset fluctuation range after training, enabling the loss function of the DNN model to be a four-element loss function, inputting the feature vector of medical record data to be predicted into the trained DNN model for processing, obtaining a target embedded vector corresponding to the medical record data to be predicted, and determining the quality of the medical record data to be predicted according to the distance between the target embedded vector and a quality embedded vector and a preset quality abnormal distance. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the quality of the medical record data can be screened from multiple aspects/angles, and the accuracy of quality screening is improved. In addition, the application can be applied to the field of intelligent medical treatment, thereby promoting the construction of intelligent cities.

title: Apparatus and method for labeling medical image based on flexible superpixel
abstract: According to the present invention, provided are a method for labeling a medical image based on a flexible superpixel and an apparatus thereof which use minimum resources and increase user convenience comprising: a step of receiving a medical image; a step of generating a first superpixel based on a whole size of the medical image; a step of changing the size of the image with zoom-in or zoom-out by a user; a step of generating a second superpixel based on the changed image; and a step of performing region definition through labeling by the user.

title: 2.5D pneumonia medical CT image classification device and equipment
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）, 北京邮电大学
abstract: The application provides a 2.5D pneumonia medical CT image classification device and equipment, the device includes: the target image slice module is used for acquiring a plurality of continuous slices corresponding to the target 3D lung medical CT image data so as to form target 2.5D lung medical CT image data corresponding to the target 3D lung medical CT image data; the target image classification module is used for inputting target 2.5D lung medical CT image data into ConvNeXt optimization models adopting 2D convolution layers, so that the ConvNeXt optimization models correspondingly output a pneumonia focus type identification result corresponding to the target 2.5D lung medical CT image data. The application can realize automatic classification of the medical CT images of the pneumonia, can effectively improve the execution efficiency and convenience of the classification process of the CT images of the pneumonia and can improve the reliability and accuracy of the classification result of the CT images of the pneumonia on the basis of reducing the complexity and time consumption of model training.

title: Evaluating a mammogram using a plurality of prior mammograms and deep learning algorithms
abstract: An approach for training, on a computer, one or more deep learning algorithms with a plurality of mammograms with known outcomes based, at least in part, on using a set of mammograms of each patient in the plurality of mammograms. The approach includes receiving a first set of mammograms of a first patient. The first set of mammograms includes an unevaluated mammogram of the first patient and a set of prior mammograms of the first patient. The approach includes the trained convolutional neural network extracting the set of features from each mammogram of the set of mammograms of the first patient. Furthermore, the approach includes using a second deep learning algorithm of the one or more deep learning algorithms to perform an evaluation of the unevaluated mammogram of the first patient based, at least in part, on the set of prior mammograms of the first patient.

title: Commercial claim processing platform using machine learning to generate shared economy insights
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to using machine learning methods to produce commercial and shared economy insights. A computing platform may receive historical claim processing information. The computing platform may train a machine learning model using the historical claim processing information, which may configure the machine learning model to output new claim processing information based on claim information. The computer platform may receive a new claim, including claim information, and may process the new claim using the machine learning model, which may result in the new claim processing information. The computing platform may send, to a user computing device, the new claim processing information and one or more commands directing the user computing device to display the new claim processing information, which may cause the user computing device to display the new claim processing information.

title: Method and system for quickly visualizing earthquake emergency information
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for quickly visualizing earthquake emergency information. The method comprises the following steps: dynamically acquiring web text data by using a dynamic web crawler technology, and rapidly cleaning the data by using an optimized fastText model to generate a basic database of earthquake emergency events; based on the earthquake emergency basic database, carrying out Chinese word segmentation and part-of-speech tagging by using an artificial neural network, formulating a data classification rule and extracting metadata of earthquake emergency text information; and establishing a visual dynamic model of the earthquake emergency data by using the optimized BP artificial neural network based on the earthquake emergency text metadata, and completing the visual platform of the earthquake emergency information by using an SOA service architecture. The method and the system for quickly visualizing the earthquake emergency information combine data thinking with earthquake emergency services, and find out the potential value and the data correlation of the earthquake emergency data according to the characteristics and the influence of the earthquake emergency data among data in different time periods.

title: Model training method, fundus image generation method, model evaluation method and device
assignee: 北京鹰瞳科技发展股份有限公司, 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a model training method, a fundus image generation method, a model evaluation method and a model evaluation device, wherein the model training method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first training set, wherein the first training set comprises a plurality of sample fundus images; generating a blood vessel segmentation map of each sample fundus image, wherein the blood vessel segmentation map is a binary map; for each sample fundus image, combining the pixel values of each pixel point RGB three channels in the sample fundus image with the pixel values of the pixel points at the corresponding positions in the blood vessel segmentation map to obtain a four-channel image; inputting the four-channel images into a pre-built initial network model for model training to obtain a target network model, wherein network super parameters of the initial network model at least comprise guide intensity, the guide intensity is used for inspiring the network model to generate blood vessels in a new fundus image based on blood vessel information in the four-channel images, and the target network model is used for generating the new fundus image.

title: Methods and systems for an adaptive four-zone perfusion scan
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for adaptive scan control. In one embodiment, a method includes, upon an injection of a contrast agent, processing acquired projection data of an anatomical region of interest (ROI) of a subject to measure a contrast signal of the contrast agent, determining when each of a plurality of zones of a contrast scan are estimated to occur based on the contrast signal, updating a scan prescription for the contrast scan based on when each of the plurality of zones of the scan protocol are estimated to occur, and performing the contrast scan according to the updated scan prescription.

title: System for providing a platform for integrating and processing big data of complex biological signals based on artificial intelligence and method for processing big data of complex biological signals using thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for providing a complex biosignal big data integrated processing platform based on an artificial intelligence and a method for complex biosignal big data integrated processing using thereof, that acquires a complex biosignal data of a user, enables a bio-state, diagnosis, and prediction of a result of the user through a result learned through machine learning or deep learning technology, and dramatically reduces a time and cost required to develop a big data-based artificial intelligence analysis model in a healthcare field and enables the development of a high-accuracy model. The system comprises: a complex biosignal data acquisition part; a database; a data pre-processing part; and an artificial intelligence learning part.

title: Systems and methods of a tracking analytics platform
abstract: In one embodiment, an analytics tracking system is disclosed that comprises an interface in electronic communication with one or more consumer devices configured to enable a corresponding consumer to access the interface via a mobile application. The system further comprises a consumer data store comprising data regarding at least one consumer, a movement data store comprising data regarding locations and/or movement of the at least one consumer, and an online behavior data (OBD) data store comprising data associated with browsing and/or application data histories of the at least one consumer. The system further comprises a dynamic analysis system configured to analyze data from the consumer data store, the movement data store, and the OBD data store to generate at least one of custom information for the at least one consumer or identify a location for presentation of information to the at least one consumer.

title: Analysis of dose rate robustness against uncertainties in radiation treatment planning
assignee: Varian Medical Systems Particle Therapy GmbH & Co, KG, Siemens Healthineers International Ag
abstract: Presented systems and methods enable efficient and effective robust radiation treatment planning and treatment, including analysis of dose rate robustness. In one embodiment, a method comprising accessing treatment plan information, accessing information corresponding to an uncertainty associated with implementation of the radiation treatment plan, and generating a histogram, wherein the histogram conveys a characteristic of the treatment plan including an impact of the uncertainty on the characteristic. The histogram can be a dose rate volume histogram and can be utilized to test a degree of robustness of a treatment plan (e.g., including allowance for uncertainty scenarios, etc.). The uncertainty can be associated with potential variation associated with tolerances (e.g., radiation system/machine performance tolerance, patient characteristic tolerances, etc.) and set up issues (e.g., variation in initial system/machine set up, variation patient setup/position, etc.).

title: Chinese medical synonym clustering method based on deep pre-training neural network
assignee: 杭州祺鲸科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medical synonym clustering method based on a deep pre-training neural network. 1) Classifying synonyms in the disclosed Chinese medical data set and then constructing a synonym cluster set C; 2) generating a model training data set based on the synonym cluster set C constructed in the step 1): 3) constructing a set-instance neural network model; 4) training a set-instance neural network model; 5) and clustering the candidate word set by using the trained neural network model to generate a candidate synonym cluster set. 6) And merging the candidate synonym clusters by using the trained neural network model to generate a final synonym cluster. The invention introduces the prior knowledge into a set-instance neural network model in the form of a pre-training model, thereby solving the problem that the vocabulary lacks context; in addition, the invention can utilize the trained neural network model to perform clustering operation on the candidate words.

title: Smart toilet system
abstract: Improved toilet apparatus and accessories are provided. The smart toilet system comprises components to enhance the functionality and use of existing toilets or new toilets. The smart toilet system comprises components designed to be fit in, on, above, or under a toilet seat, or to replace a toilet seat, bidet components, health monitoring components, ventilation or hygiene components, and communications and/or control components.

title: Parameter configuration method and system of blood supply driving device and related device
assignee: 萱闱(北京)生物科技有限公司, 上海萱闱医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a parameter configuration method, a parameter configuration system and a related device of a blood supply driving device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring user individual data corresponding to a target device; the target device is a blood supply driving device used by a user; acquiring target equipment parameters matched with the physical state of the user based on the individual data of the user; the physical state of the user is associated with the blood supply requirement of the blood supply driving system of the user; the physical state of the user at least comprises a behavior state and/or a muscle strength degree; the target equipment parameters comprise driving component operation parameters matched with the blood supply driving system in the physical state; the target apparatus is configured based on the target device parameters. According to the blood supply driving device and the blood supply driving method, the blood supply driving device can be more matched with the individual situation of the user under the automatic configuration of the target equipment parameters, and the customization cost of the blood supply driving device is reduced.
