title: Method and device for selecting conversion treatment scheme, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device and equipment for selecting a conversion treatment scheme, which are used for solving the problems that the safety of the selected conversion treatment scheme is lower and the like because the proper conversion treatment mode cannot be accurately selected in the related technology. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first target information of a patient to be predicted, wherein the first target information comprises baseline data, molecular pathology data, imaging characteristic information and clinical information of the patient to be predicted; inputting the first target information into a pre-trained curative effect prediction model to obtain curative effect prediction results of patients to be predicted under different conversion treatment schemes; wherein, the curative effect prediction result comprises: surgical excision probability of tumor, R0 excision rate and objective reflection rate; and selecting a transformation treatment scheme from different transformation treatment schemes according to the curative effect prediction results of the patient to be predicted under different transformation treatment schemes, and taking the transformation treatment scheme as a target transformation scheme matched with the patient to be predicted.

title: Intelligent screening method and device for dental caries of children
assignee: 深圳格瑞健康科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent screening method for dental caries of children, which comprises the following steps of S1: acquiring an original image by using an image acquisition device; the original image includes, but is not limited to, image information of the target tooth; s2: acquiring a pre-training image, wherein the pre-training image comprises the acquired image information of the target teeth; data cleaning is carried out on the pre-training image, and the positions of target teeth in the cleaned image information are marked; further determining N scale feature images of the pre-training image, wherein different scale feature images correspond to different scales; s3: further determining weights corresponding to different positions in each scale feature map, and determining features corresponding to the scale feature map based on the weights corresponding to each scale feature map and each scale feature map, wherein in the practical application process, shooting and classifying treatment can be better performed on target teeth, so that subsequent management and targeted treatment are facilitated.
assignee_clean: 深圳格瑞健康科技有限公司

title: Text processing method, text processing device and text processing equipment
assignee: 腾讯云计算（北京）有限责任公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a text processing method, a text processing device and text processing equipment, wherein the text processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring reference text data and a text to be classified; the reference text data comprises a plurality of reference texts under a plurality of text types and reference text features corresponding to the plurality of reference texts, wherein one reference text corresponds to one reference text feature; preprocessing the text to be classified to obtain target text characteristics of the text to be classified; performing text clustering processing on the multiple reference texts and the texts to be classified according to the target text features and the reference text features corresponding to the multiple reference texts, and determining a target text set where the texts to be classified are located; and determining the text type of the text to be classified based on the text type of the reference text included in the target text set. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the text classification efficiency and the text classification accuracy can be effectively improved.

title: Method and device for generating dose prediction model, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 福建自贸试验区厦门片区Manteia数据科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and device for generating a dose prediction model, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a small sample data set, wherein the small sample data set at least comprises medical images and actual dose distribution diagrams corresponding to M first reference objects; determining an actual isodose line region map and an actual dose change gradient map corresponding to the first reference object based on the actual dose distribution map corresponding to the first reference object; performing iterative training on the first encoder and the first decoder according to the small sample data set, the actual isodose line region diagram and the actual dose change gradient diagram corresponding to the first reference object to obtain a target encoder and a target decoder; the target encoder and the target decoder are used as a dose prediction model. The method solves the technical problem that the dose prediction model has poor training effect in most scenes due to the fact that the existing training method of the dose prediction model has high data volume requirements on a data set.

title: Intelligent electronic medical record diagnosis method based on SEV-SDG-CNN
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent electronic medical record diagnosis method based on SEV-SDG-CNN, which comprises the following steps: mining medical field vocabularies to construct a shallow semantic vocabulary dictionary; generating a shallow semantic vector expression SEV (semantic vector) of each word in the text corpus based on the shallow semantic vocabulary; calculating a shallow semantic pre-judging mode SDG of each corpus by using a shallow semantic vocabulary dictionary; the SEV and the SDG are fused into the traditional CNN classification model construction, namely the SEV and the word embedding vector are spliced in the feature expression layer, and the SDG and the CNN discrimination mode are fused in the mode output layer, so that the improved SEV-SDG-CNN classification model is realized. The method is applied to the disease diagnosis of the electronic medical record, can fully extract a large amount of rich semantic information contained in the electronic medical record with extremely strong specialty and extremely high knowledge density, and has higher performance due to the advantage that the CNN can automatically mine the characteristics from big data.

title: Real-time and adaptive data mining
abstract: A method of analyzing data is presented. The method includes generating a query based on a topic of interest, expanding search terms of the query, executing the query on one or more data sources, monitoring a specific data source selected from the one or more data sources. The monitoring is performed to monitor for matches to the query.

title: Apparatus and method of recommending user-customized health food
abstract: The present invention relates to technology of recommending user-customized health food. In addition, one embodiment of the present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for recommending user-customized health food based on artificial intelligence (AI). An electronic device according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises a memory and a processor linked to the memory, wherein the processor can receive basic personal constitution information including a user's height, weight, eating habits, family history, drinking status, and smoking status from a user terminal, derive a correlation between a disease and the height, weight, eating habits, family history, drinking status, and smoking status, based on a medical database through an AI module, derive the user's expected disease, based on the correlation and the basic personal constitution information, derive first analysis information including a disease, positive nutrients that have a positive effect on the disease, and negative nutrients that have a negative effect on the disease, based on the medical-related DB through the AI module, generate second analysis information on each of the health foods, which includes positive effect diseases corresponding to diseases where the health food has a positive effect and negative effect diseases corresponding to diseases where the health food has a negative effect for each health food, based on the medical-related DB and the health food DB containing multiple health foods and the nutrients contained in the health foods through the AI module, calculate a matching score between the user and multiple health foods based on the expected disease, the first analysis information, and the second analysis information, derive recommended health foods, based on the matching score, and transmit the same to the user terminal.

title: Method and system for projection profile enabled computer-aided detection
assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and system for projection profile-enabled Computer Aided Detection (CAD). The present invention provides systems and methods for projection profile-enabled Computer Aided Detection (CAD). A volumetric ultrasound data set may be generated based on the echo ultrasound signals, and a three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound volume may be generated based on the volumetric ultrasound data set. Selective structure detection may be applied to three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound volumes. Selective structure detection may include: generating a two-dimensional (2D) image based on a projection of a three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound volume in a particular spatial direction; applying two-dimensional (2D) structure detection to the two-dimensional (2D) image to identify structure candidates associated with a particular type of structure; selecting a corresponding local volume within a three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound volume for each identified structure candidate; applying a three-dimensional (3D) structure detection to each selected local volume; and identifying one or more structure candidates that match the particular type of structure based on applying three-dimensional (3D) structure detection.

title: Device management apparatus, device management system, and device management method
assignee: 佳能医疗系统株式会社
abstract: The possibility of detecting a failure sign of the device is improved. The device management apparatus according to the embodiment includes: an acquisition unit that acquires information indicating the occurrence of a failure warning of the first device; and an adjustment unit that adjusts a detection sensitivity of a failure warning of at least one second device associated with information indicating the occurrence of the failure warning, based on a correlation between the first device and the one or more second devices different from the first device.
assignee_clean: 佳能医疗系统株式会社
primary_assignee: 佳能医疗系统株式会社

title: Medical imaging equipment fast scan positioner based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical images, and discloses a medical imaging equipment rapid scanning positioning device based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a support piece rotatably provided with a rotary seat, wherein a connecting rod is arranged on the rotary seat, a sealing cavity is arranged in the connecting rod, a telescopic rod is connected in the sealing cavity in a sliding manner through a sealing piston, the telescopic rod is connected with an X-ray machine through an angle adjusting mechanism, and the medical imaging equipment rapid scanning positioning device also comprises a locking mechanism used for locking the rotary seat; the air outlet of the sealing cavity is formed in the end portion of the connecting rod, the locking mechanism comprises a sealing plug, and the locking stroke of the locking mechanism drives the sealing plug to seal the air outlet. The X-ray machine locking device can lock the X-ray machine after the position of the X-ray machine is adjusted while the position of the X-ray machine is adjusted, can not cause the X-ray machine to shake or change the position even if the X-ray machine is interfered by external acting force, and ensures the shooting effect.

title: Noise to noise ensemble learning for pet and CT image and data denoising
abstract: A system and method for training a neural network to denoise images. One noise realization is paired to an ensemble of training-ready noise realizations, and fed into a neural network for training. Training datasets can also be retrospectively generated based on existing patient studies to increase the number of training datasets.

title: Dual connectivity support for V2X communication
abstract: A method and apparatus for dual connectivity support for vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication is provided. When a master node (MN) belonging to a first radio access technology takes role of signaling to a wireless device in multi-RAT dual connectivity (MR-DC) option 3/7, the MN receives authorization information on a second RAT for the wireless device from a core network node, and transmits a request for a radio resource of the second RAT to a secondary node (SN) belonging to the second RAT. The request includes the authorization information on the second RAT for the wireless device. Upon receiving information on the radio resource from the SN, the MN transmits a message to the wireless device based on the information on the radio resource.

title: Method and system for automatically determining inspection results in an image sequence
abstract: The invention relates to a method for automatically determining the examination result in an image sequence consisting of a plurality of temporally successive frames, comprising the following steps: -for a preset diagnosis, finding in each frame a diagnosis candidate in the form of an associated image region, for a plurality of diagnosis candidates: -for a diagnostic candidate in one frame, deciding which candidate image areas in the other frame correspond to the diagnostic candidate; -determining whether the candidate image area of the diagnostic candidate in the further frame overlaps with the further diagnostic candidate; -generating a graph having the resolved diagnostic candidates of the frame as nodes and the resolved overlap as edges; -generating communities from nodes connected by means of edges, wherein the nodes are combined into communities. The invention further relates to a corresponding system and a medical technical system.

title: System and method for projecting product movement
abstract: A method includes receiving data encoding search results from at least one search engine, each of the at least one search engine applying an ontology in a corresponding social-media channel, the ontology refined to account for at least one healthcare product and at least one event; retrieving a database that includes relationships between identified event and healthcare indication, the database being developed from historical sales activities of healthcare products and healthcare indications for the healthcare products; and analyzing the search results by: determining at least one event identified by the search results; comparing the at least one event with the retrieved database to determine a corresponding healthcare indication; identifying a healthcare product with the determined corresponding healthcare indication; and correlating the search results about the identified healthcare product with historical sales activities of the identified healthcare product to determine a sales trend for the identified healthcare product during a projected period.

title: Method and system for displaying a resource layer and a need layer over a selected geographical area
abstract: A method includes displaying, on a GUI, a graphical representation of a geographical area sectioned into a plurality of subareas defined by boundaries; displaying, over the graphical representation, a resource need layer that visually depicts a first parameter associated with a need of a resource within a subarea, the depiction of the first parameter varying within the subarea; and displaying, over the graphical representation, a resource availability layer that visually depicts a second parameter indicating the availability of the resource within the subarea, the depiction of the second parameter varying within the subarea; wherein the layers are displayed simultaneously over the graphical representation to provide a visual comparison of the need of the resource and the availability of the resource within the subarea. In some embodiments, the need is based on data including one or more of demographic data from a census, other data from the census, and crime data.
assignee_clean: cook children s health care system
primary_assignee: cook children s health care system

title: Spinal surgery robot system for nail placement operation
assignee: 上海极睿医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a spinal surgery robot system for nail placing operation, which comprises: the path planning module is used for generating a planning operation path of the nail placing operation, and the planning operation path is distributed along the direction in which the tissue density gradient in the operation bone of the operation object is reduced most quickly; the execution module is used for executing the nail placing operation; and the control module is used for controlling the execution module to execute the nail placing operation according to the planned operation path. The spinal surgery robot system provided by the invention has the advantages that the planned operation paths generated by the path planning module are distributed along the direction in which the tissue density gradient in the operation bone of the operation object is reduced most quickly, so that the execution module is arranged from the cancellous bone with lower density when the nail placing operation is executed, the resistance is small, and the safety of the nail placing operation is ensured.

title: Training method of text coding model, information retrieval method and equipment
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a training method, an information retrieval method and equipment for a text coding model, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning. The method comprises the following steps: inputting sample texts in the text relation network into a text coding model to obtain sample feature vectors corresponding to the sample texts; determining a model loss based on the sample feature vector and the objective function; and performing iterative training on the text coding model based on the model loss. Acquiring search information based on a text search operation in response to the text search operation; inputting the search information into a text coding model to obtain a search information feature vector corresponding to the search information; determining a target text from a text library based on the retrieval information feature vector; and displaying the target text through a search result display interface. The modeling is performed based on the network relation of the sample text, and meanwhile, under the conditions of sparse network edges and more noise of the text relation network, the model can obtain more accurate vector representation by capturing semantic information of the text.

title: Ocular monitoring headset
assignee: Emory University, Georgia Tech Research Corporation
abstract: A system for monitoring ocular movement can comprise a housing, a plurality of light sources, at least one imager, and a controller. The housing can define a cavity configured to allow each eye of a patient to view an interior region of the housing. The plurality of light sources can be oriented within the interior region of the housing. The at least one imager can be oriented to capture an image of an eye of a patient during an evaluation. The at least one controller can comprise at least one processor and a non-transitory computer readable medium storing instructions. The instructions can be executed by the processor and cause the controller to receive image data from the at least one imager and illuminate the plurality of light sources in a predetermined and reconfigurable sequence.

title: Systems and methods for monitoring physiologic changes using cardiac electrogram signals
abstract: Various embodiment disclosed herein include a method for monitoring serum potassium in a patient. The method can include gathering cardiac electrogram data from the patient using two or more electrodes, separating the cardiac electrogram data into discrete subunits including a T-wave, aligning T-waves to create aligned discrete subunits, averaging the aligned discrete subunits to generate an average T-wave for the cardiac electrogram data, and determining a serum potassium value using the average T-wave for the cardiac electrogram data and a predetermined model relating T-wave values with serum potassium magnitudes.

title: Machine logic for recommending specialized first aid services
abstract: Technology for locating medical supplies, medical practitioners and/or non-medical-practitioner individuals who are in proximity to a first user who is experiencing a medical emergency. Appropriate notifications of and/or to the proximate medical supplies, medical practitioners and/or non-medical-practitioner individuals are made over a communication network.

title: Stethoscope audio data processing method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a stethoscope audio data processing method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: firstly, collecting audio data, segmenting the audio data, and framing the audio data by segmentation; secondly, classifying the voice data by adopting a deep learning method, and then recombining classification results according to the sequence of segmentation processing; and finally, mapping the blood pressure value, and converting the classification result into the blood pressure value. The method provided by the patent simplifies the measurement of the blood pressure value into a classification problem, and classifies the collected stethoscope audio data by adopting a deep learning method with the most extensive application, namely, judges whether the signal in the stethoscope data is a korotkoff sound signal or not. The stethoscope audio data processing method provided by the invention is scientific, and the measurement result is accurate and reliable.

title: Angiography image processing and calibrating method based on deep learning
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）
abstract: The application provides a processing and calibrating method of angiography images based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing a current contrast image according to an image analysis model, and performing first calibration; the method comprises the steps of carrying out gray level preliminary judgment on a current contrast image, roughly locking a possible abnormal region, carrying out region segmentation on the current contrast image according to the position of a target body of the current contrast image, carrying out n1 times of clear amplification processing on the segmented region of the possible abnormal region, and carrying out n2 times of clear amplification processing on the rest segmented region; analyzing the inner width and the outer width of each position point in each blood vessel branch in each partition area, drawing a branch contour of each blood vessel branch, and carrying out second calibration on abnormal position points in the branch contour; and performing coincidence analysis on the first calibration result and the second calibration result to perform third calibration on the final abnormal point. The accuracy of determining the abnormality in the blood vessel is effectively improved, and effective assistance is provided for subsequent medical treatment.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院
primary_assignee: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院

title: Physiological characteristic discriminating method and system based on multisource health perception data fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a physiological characteristic discriminating method based on multisource health perception data fusion, which comprises the following steps: acquiring health perception data and preprocessing; constructing a medical sensing data matrix; based on a gating circulation unit network, fusing hidden features of a learning medical sensing data matrix and a personal physique record data vector; based on physiological characteristic status data, calculating the influence coefficient of any type of physiological characteristic on the other type of physiological characteristic by adopting a conditional probability method, and constructing a physiological characteristic association matrix; and converting the hidden features into discrimination probabilities of multi-category physiological features through a fully connected network, and multiplying the discrimination probabilities by a physiological feature correlation matrix to obtain a final physiological feature discrimination result. The method can fuse and learn multi-source heterogeneous health perception data and fully utilize potential correlation among physiological characteristics. In the calculation based on the mass health perception data, the method has a better detection effect.

title: Three-dimensional medical image super-resolution reconstruction method based on cascade cavity convolution
abstract: The invention relates to a three-dimensional medical image super-resolution reconstruction method based on cascade cavity convolution, which comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a data set and preprocessing data; secondly, constructing a three-dimensional medical image super-resolution reconstruction network based on cascade cavity convolution through a deep learning framework TensorFlow, wherein the three-dimensional medical image super-resolution reconstruction network based on cascade cavity convolution comprises three parts, a shallow feature extraction module, a nonlinear mapping module and a reconstruction module; thirdly, training a model; and fourthly, inputting the three-dimensional medical low-resolution small block, loading the model trained in the third step, and outputting the reconstructed super-resolution small block.

title: Drug information normalization method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 北京懿医云科技有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method, apparatus, computer-readable medium, and electronic device for drug information normalization. The method comprises the following steps: extracting a plurality of field information of medicine information from medical record data, and determining a combined field formed by the plurality of field information; identifying standard fields corresponding to the combined fields according to a first dictionary and the combined fields, and determining a plurality of independent fields corresponding to the combined fields when the standard fields corresponding to the combined fields are not found in the first dictionary; identifying standard fields corresponding to each independent field according to the second dictionary and the plurality of independent fields; and normalizing the combined field according to the standard field corresponding to each independent field. Before normalization processing, standard field identification of combined fields and independent fields is performed on medical record data, so that the efficiency and accuracy of normalization processing are improved.
assignee_clean: 北京懿医云科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京懿医云科技有限公司

title: System and method for the validation and quality assurance of computerized contours of human anatomy
abstract: A system and method for validating the accuracy of delineated contours in computerized imaging using statistical data for generating assessment criterion that define acceptable tolerances for delineated contours, with the statistical data being conditionally updated and/or refined between individual processes for validating delineated contours to thereby adjust the tolerances defined by the assessment criterion in the stored statistical data, such that the stored statistical data is more closely representative of a target population. The present invention may be used to facilitate, as one example, on-line adaptive radiation therapy.

title: Device, system and method for role based data collection and public-safety incident response
abstract: A device, system and method for role based data collection and public-safety incident response is provided. A computing device receives a call to report a public-safety incident. The computing device determines a role of a caller on the call, the role of the caller being relative to the public-safety incident. The computing device retrieves, from one or more memories, data dependent on the role of the caller. The computing device controls a notification device to provide the data dependent on the role of the caller.

title: Method and system for managing image quality utilizing a generative model
abstract: Systems, methods and computer program products are provided to collect ultrasound (US) data. A processor is configured to acquire the US data along one or more acquisition scan planes. The US data defines a plurality of image frames that have a first image quality. The processor is further configured to apply a generative model to at least one of the US data or plurality of image frames to generate a synthetic scan plane image along a synthetic scan plane. The generative model is defined based on one or more training ultrasound data sets. The synthetic scan plane image has an image quality that is common with the first image quality of the plurality of image frames. The system further comprises a display configured to display the synthetic scan plane image.

title: Methods and systems for autonomous task composition of vision pipelines using an algorithm selection framework
abstract:
This disclosure relates generally to systems and methods for autonomous task 
composition of vision pipelines using an algorithm selection framework. The 
framework leverages transformer architecture along with deep reinforcement 
learning techniques to search an algorithmic space for unseen solution templates. In 
an embodiment, the present disclosure describes a two stage process of identifying 
the vision pipeline for a particular task. At first stage, a high-level sequence of the 
vision pipeline is provided by a symbolic planner to create the vision workflow. At 
second stage, suitable algorithms for each high-level task are selected. This is 
achieved by performing a graph search using a transformer architecture over an 
algorithmic space on each component of generated workflow. In order to make the 
system more robust, weights of embedding, key and query networks of a visual 
transformer are updated with a Deep Reinforcement Learning framework that uses 
Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) as underlying algorithm.  
[To be published with FIG. 4]

Receiving, (i) a plurality of input data pertaining to one or more domains of one or more 
enterprises and (ii) a descriptive query from a user as input, wherein the plurality of input data 202

solutions, and wherein the descriptive query describes a goal task to be executed on the 
plurality of input data 
Identifying, a vision pipeline for execution of the goal task by inputting the descriptive query 
and one or more state attribute levels corresponding to the plurality of input data to a symbolic 204

Identifying, a set of algorithms from a plurality of algorithms that are suitable to be executed 
at one or more stages of the vision pipeline for execution of the goal task using a transformers 
and Reinforcement Learning (RL) based autonomous pipeline composition framework, 
wherein the transformers and Reinforcement Learning based autonomous pipeline 
composition framework comprises a set of RL policies that are interlinked and resemble every 
step in the vision pipeline, and wherein each RL policy comprises: (i) a task specific module 
comprising the plurality of algorithms that performs a specific sub task from the one or more 206 
subtasks associated with the goal task; (ii) an embedding module comprising one or more 
neural networks corresponding to each algorithm in the plurality of algorithms comprised in 
the task specific module, wherein each fully connected neural network of the embedded 
module is configured to map output of each algorithm in the subset of algorithms to a specific 
embedding output dimensionality; and (iii) a transformer module comprising a key network 
and a query network, wherein the key network converts an embedding output of each of the set 
of algorithms into a key vector and the query network receives an aggregation output of the 
embedding output of each of the subset of algorithms to generate a global query vector

title: Method, system, device and storage medium for medical data integration
assignee: 北京懿医云科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for integrating medical data, which comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of original data table fields of an original data table; providing an interactive interface and providing a selection of matching relations between a plurality of original data table fields and a plurality of target data table fields of a target data table on the interactive interface; receiving a matching relation between an original data table field and a target data table field selected by a user, and generating an SQL statement according to the matching relation; and executing SQL sentences in Spark SQL, transferring data of the original data tables by HIVE to generate target data tables, unifying different original data tables into the target data tables, and converting and integrating clinical data of the original data tables acquired from different systems into a unified data arrangement form.
assignee_clean: 北京懿医云科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京懿医云科技有限公司

title: Error sample identification method, device and terminal
assignee: 中国移动通信有限公司研究院, 中国移动通信集团有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an error sample identification method, an error sample identification device and a terminal, wherein the error sample identification method comprises the following steps: acquiring a data set to be identified; training a deep learning network by using the data set to be identified to obtain a loss value sequence of each sample in the data set to be identified; and identifying and obtaining error labeling samples in the data set to be identified according to the loss value sequence of each sample. According to the embodiment of the invention, the automatic identification of the error labeling sample can be realized by utilizing the characteristic information of the sample, namely, different performances of the error labeling sample and the correct labeling sample on the loss value sequence in the model training process, so that the efficiency and the accuracy of identifying the error labeling sample are improved.
assignee_clean: 中国移动通信有限公司研究院; 中国移动通信集团有限公司

title: Device, system and method for modifying workflows based on call profile inconsistencies
abstract: A device, system and method for modifying workflows based on call profile inconsistencies is provided. A device monitors a call, received from a caller reporting an incident. The device performs one or more sentiment analysis and semantic analysis on one or more of: video of the caller on call; audio of the caller on call; and transcribed text of the audio of the call. The device determines a profile for the call, from a plurality of predetermined profiles stored at a memory accessible to the device, the plurality of predetermined profiles previously generated from historical data. In response to determining an inconsistency between the profile for the call and one or more of the sentiment analysis and the semantic analysis, the device determines a modified workflow for handling the call. The device provides, at a notification device, the modified workflow for handling the call reporting the incident.

title: Methods for evaluating therapeutic benefit of combination therapies
abstract: The invention provides methods for evaluating the therapeutic benefit of a combination therapy useful for treating a medical disorder, such as cancer.

title: Method and device for extracting entity relationship of unstructured text
assignee: 新华三大数据技术有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to a method and a device for extracting entity relationship of unstructured text, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out named entity recognition on a target statement in an unstructured text to determine a named entity in the target statement, and acquiring a relationship type between every two named entities contained in the target statement; establishing a complete binary tree of the target statement; synthesizing the n-dimensional feature vectors corresponding to all leaf nodes of the complete binary tree into one n-dimensional feature vector; training a model according to the relation type and the synthesized n-dimensional feature vector; the trained model is used for extracting the relation type of the target unstructured text, so that the trained model is more suitable without depending on the experience of a user, the extracted relation type is more accurate, in addition, the calculation and the conversion of the feature vectors corresponding to the participles in the network are easier to understand, the effect of the model is enhanced, and the understanding by the user is facilitated.
assignee_clean: 新华三大数据技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 新华三大数据技术有限公司

title: Devices, systems, and methods for labeling objects of interest during a medical procedure
abstract: A device includes a memory including instructions, and a processor that executes the instructions to determine, based on eye tracking data, that a clinician gazes at a sub-section of a display for more than a threshold amount of time during a first time period of a medical procedure, where the display displays video of the medical procedure according to a video signal. The processor executes the instructions to identify a block of the video signal that corresponds the first time period, segment a selected frame in the block of the video signal into a plurality of sub-regions, perform further processing on the plurality of sub-regions, and automatically identify an object of interest within the selected frame based on the further processing.

title: Epidemic situation prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳云天励飞技术股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an epidemic situation prediction method, an epidemic situation prediction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring regional personnel holographic data, regional medical data and regional epidemic situation structured physical data of a target region; training a preset prediction model according to regional personnel holographic data, regional medical data and regional epidemic structured physical data to obtain a target epidemic prediction model; predicting epidemic trend of the target area based on the target epidemic situation prediction model, and outputting a prediction result of the target area. The target epidemic situation prediction model is obtained through multi-dimensional data training such as regional personnel holographic data, regional medical data and regional epidemic situation structural physical data, and the epidemic situation trend and the spreading range of the target region are predicted based on the target epidemic situation prediction model, so that the future epidemic situation trend can be accurately and dynamically predicted.
assignee_clean: 深圳云天励飞技术股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳云天励飞技术股份有限公司

title: Normalizing OCT image data
abstract: In an aspect for generating device-specific OCT image, one or more processors may be configured for receiving, at a unified domain generator, first image data corresponding to OCT image scans captured by one or more OCT devices; processing, by the unified domain generator, the first image data to generate second image data corresponding to a unified representation of the OCT image scans; determining by a unified discriminator, third image data corresponding to a quality subset of the unified representation of the OCT image scans having a base resolution satisfying a first condition and a base noise type satisfying a second condition; and processing, using a conditional generator, the third image data to generate fourth image data corresponding to device-specific OCT image scans having a device-specific resolution satisfying a third condition and a device-specific noise type satisfying a fourth condition.

title: Medical literature relation extraction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for extracting the relationship of medical literature, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The relation extraction method of the medical literature comprises the following steps: acquiring a data set, and pre-training a Bert model based on the data set, wherein the data set comprises medical documents in an external medical document database, the medical documents are marked with entities in advance, and the Bert model is used for entity supervision; constructing a relation extraction model, wherein the relation extraction model comprises a head entity extraction module, an association module and a tail entity/relation extraction module, and encoders of the head entity extraction module and the association module are finely adjusted based on a Bert model supervised by entities; and obtaining a progressive weight loss function to perform relationship extraction on the medical literature by using a relationship extraction model. According to the embodiment of the application, the relation extraction effect of medical literature can be improved, and the specialty of obtaining the clinical knowledge map subsequently is improved.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军总医院
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院

title: Literature knowledge context generation method, device and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to artificial intelligence, and discloses a literature knowledge context generation method, which comprises the following steps: classifying labels of documents to be detected, and acquiring a class label set corresponding to the documents to be detected; acquiring query information, and acquiring a target document range corresponding to the query information in the document to be detected based on the query information; meanwhile, extracting the entity of the target document in the target document range to obtain all standard entity names in the target document; based on the standard entity index and the class label set, acquiring a class label and the standard entity index set corresponding to the target document; and forming a literature knowledge context corresponding to the query information based on the category label and the standard entity designation set. The invention can complete the knowledge context combing of the related documents, and further can recommend corresponding contents for the user according to the knowledge context combing and the user expectation for guiding.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Self-learning migration method based on feature sharing
abstract: The invention discloses a self-learning migration method based on feature sharing, which comprises the following steps: step one: a convolutional neural network is adopted as a convolutional self-encoder, a nonlocal module is added behind the coding characteristics of the convolutional self-encoder, the nonlocal module comprises four convolutional layers and a softmax layer, and the softmax is adopted as a classifier; step two: selecting a data set A formed by non-tag data and a data set B formed by tag data, and dividing the data set B into a training set and a testing set; step three: training the self-encoder by using the data set A, extracting the encoded part in the self-encoder after training, and connecting the self-encoder to a classifier C as a feature extractor 1 In training a new classifier C using the training set divided in dataset B 2 The combination of the feature extractor trained by the final data set A and the classifier trained by the data set B is the classification model of the method; step four: and (5) testing. The invention can effectively expand the application range of the existing medical image classification method.

title: Automatic positioning method for cardiac mitral valve vertex based on CT image
abstract: An automatic positioning method for cardiac mitral valve vertex based on CT image belongs to medical image analysis field. Firstly, carrying out image preprocessing on a CT image based on a deep neural network to realize extraction and expression of key features of the CT image; and then, positioning a CT image mark point based on the intelligent agent by using a deep reinforcement learning model, and automatically detecting the position of the vertex of the cardiac mitral valve. The invention provides a searching strategy of an optimal path, which can conveniently realize the automatic positioning of the position of the heart mitral valve vertex in a CT image by a computer for a doctor to diagnose diseases, and has a certain expansibility along with the change of the manually appointed positioning position, thereby being beneficial to establishing machine image understanding in the medical image analysis context.

title: Target detection method, device and medium based on deep learning
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a target detection method, equipment and medium based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be detected; processing an image to be detected through a first detection network to obtain a target first detection frame; extracting a feature map of an image to be detected; cutting a feature map of the image to be detected to obtain a target cutting image containing a target first detection frame; inputting the target clipping image into a second detection network to obtain the centrality of each pixel point in the target clipping image and the offset between each target pixel point and each boundary of the target second detection frame, wherein the centrality is the probability that the corresponding pixel point is the central point of the second detection frame, and the target pixel point is the pixel point with the centrality larger than the preset centrality threshold value; and determining each target second detection frame according to the offset between each target pixel point and each boundary of the corresponding target second detection frame. The application can solve the problem that adjacent objects in the image are difficult to accurately distinguish.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Integrated progressive lens simulator
abstract: A Progressive Lens Simulator comprises an Eye Tracker, for tracking an eye axis direction to determine a gaze distance, an Off-Axis Progressive Lens Simulator, for generating an Off-Axis progressive lens simulation; and an Axial Power-Distance Simulator, for simulating a progressive lens power in the eye axis direction. The Progressive Lens Simulator can alternatively include an Integrated Progressive Lens Simulator, for creating a Comprehensive Progressive Lens Simulation. The Progressive Lens Simulator can be Head-mounted. A Guided Lens Design Exploration System for the Progressive Lens Simulator can include a Progressive Lens Simulator, a Feedback-Control Interface, and a Progressive Lens Design processor, to generate a modified progressive lens simulation for the patient after a guided modification of the progressive lens design. A Deep Learning Method for an Artificial Intelligence Engine can be used for a Progressive Lens Design Processor. Embodiments include a multi-station system of Progressive Lens Simulators and a Central Supervision Station.

title: Measurement device
abstract: A measurement device and associated systems and methods are described. The device includes a body and an attachment mechanism fixed to and extending from the body. The attachment mechanism is configured for attachment to a part of a human or animal subject. The or a part of the body is configured for gripping by a user. The device incudes a processor in communication with a force sensor module and a position sensor module. The force sensor module is configured to measure a force applied to the attachment mechanism, in use, and output force measurement data relating to the measured force. The position sensor module is configured to measure the position of the part of the human or animal relative to other parts thereof, in use, and output position measurement data. The processor is configured to store the force measurement data and position measurement data in a memory component associated therewith.

title: Data set generation for performance evaluation
abstract: A computing system receives a request to generate computer-generated data for an experiment. The computer-generated data comprises generated inputs defining setting(s) for a plurality of factors for a design of the experiment. The generated inputs are generated to be representative of a respective design space of different design spaces for the design of the experiment. The system receives first characteristic(s) for specifying generation of the computer-generated data associated with a first design space. The system receives second characteristic(s) for specifying generation of the computer-generated data associated with a second design space. The system, responsive to the request, generates a design suite that comprises the computer-generated data that represents, in a first set of design cases of the design suite, settings constrained by the first design space, and represents, in a second set of design cases of the design suite, settings constrained by the second design space.

title: Method of operating a progressive lens simulator with an axial power-distance simulator
abstract: A Progressive Lens Simulator comprises an Eye Tracker, for tracking an eye axis direction to determine a gaze distance, an Off-Axis Progressive Lens Simulator, for generating an Off-Axis progressive lens simulation and an Axial Power-Distance Simulator, for simulating a progressive lens power in the eye axis direction. The Progressive Lens Simulator can alternatively include an integrated Progressive Lens Simulator, for creating a Comprehensive Progressive Lens Simulation. The Progressive Lens Simulator can be Head-mounted, A Guided Lens Design Exploration System for the Progressive Lens Simulator can include a Progressive Lens Simulator, a Feedback-Control Interface, and a Progressive Lens Design processor, to generate a modified progressive lens simulation for the patient after a guided modification of the progressive lens design. A Deep Learning Method for an Artificial Intelligence Engine can be used for a Progressive Lens Design Processor, Embodiments include a multi-station system of Progressive Lens Simulators and a Central Supervision Station.

title: Cross-domain problem processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 汉王科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for processing cross-domain problems, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of natural language processing. The method comprises the following steps: performing problem classification processing on input problems based on a preset field word stock of each field and a pre-trained text classification model to obtain a field classification result of the input problems; and then, taking the domain classification result and the input questions as input of a preset language processing model, and acquiring answers corresponding to the input questions through the preset language processing model. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of question and answer of the preset language processing model.
assignee_clean: 汉王科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 汉王科技股份有限公司

title: Medical image processing device, endoscope system, and method for operating medical image processing device
abstract: The invention provides a medical image processing apparatus and an endoscope system capable of identifying the accurate position of a region of interest and preventing flickering of a display screen, and an operating method of the medical image processing apparatus. The processor device (16) is provided with an image signal acquisition unit (50), an image processing unit (56), and a display control unit (58). An image signal acquisition unit (50) acquires a digital image signal corresponding to an observation mode from an endoscope (12). The image processing unit (56) is provided with a region-of-interest detection mode image processing unit (64). A display control unit (58) sets an emphasized region having a larger area than the region of interest and including the region of interest, and highlights the emphasized region, and determines whether to change the setting of the emphasized region based on the amount of change in the region of interest.

title: Method for wearable ECG signal analysis
abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable electrocardiogram signal analysis technology. According to an embodiment, a wearable electrocardiogram signal analysis method comprises the following steps of: collecting electrocardiogram data from a server; executing a deep learning model; classifying and loading a plurality of modules based on the executed deep learning model; calculating deep learning results processed in the plurality of classified modules; comparing the calculated deep learning results; branching to a process of executing the deep learning model to update the deep learning model for error data according to a comparison result; and displaying the comparison result.

title: Image registration method for medical image, image processing method and medium
assignee: 中国科学院苏州生物医学工程技术研究所
abstract: The invention provides an image registration method for medical images, which comprises the steps of traversing floating images and fixed images, extracting image blocks with fixed sizes, and then carrying out two classifications on the traversed image blocks through a depth convolution network; then dividing the depth convolution network into centers of positive image blocks to be regarded as candidate feature points, screening the feature points by adopting a RANSAC algorithm, and carrying out affine registration on the floating images by utilizing the screened feature points; secondly, calculating a candidate feature point set after affine transformation in the floating image, and searching a corresponding feature point set in the fixed image; and then registering by utilizing the characteristic point set obtained before. The invention also relates to an image processing method and medium. The invention provides a medical image registration algorithm with high applicability and high performance by combining deep learning and a traditional method, and can perform high-efficiency and high-precision registration on the images to be registered.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院苏州生物医学工程技术研究所
primary_assignee: 中国科学院苏州生物医学工程技术研究所

title: Intelligent access to a storage device
abstract: A method of failure detection in a storage system is performed by the storage system. The method includes detecting a failure in a nonvolatile random access memory device that is in or coupled to a storage device having storage memory. The storage system has multiple NVRAM devices and multiple storage devices that have storage memory. The method includes taking a portion or all of the NVRAM device offline. Taking a portion or all of the NVRAM device offline is responsive to detecting the failure. Taking a portion or all of the NVRAM device off-line is while keeping online the storage memory of the storage device, sufficient ones of the NVRAM devices, and sufficient ones of the storage devices to provide reliable access to data and metadata in the storage system.

title: Voice and chatbot conversation builder
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for a voice/chatbot building system. The voice/chatbot builder may involve receiving an identified intent, receiving a task related to the identified intent, and receiving a response related to both the identified intent and the task. The identified intent, task, and response may form a first conversation. The first conversation may be linked to other conversations to establish contextual relationships among conversations and determine conversation priority. Voice/chatbot building may also train natural language processing machine learning algorithms.

title: Systems and methods for imaging
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for imaging. The method may include obtaining a real-time representation of a subject. The method may also include determining at least one scanning parameter associated with the subject by automatically processing the representation according to a parameter obtaining model. The method may further include performing a scan on the subject based at least in part on the at least one scanning parameter.

title: Intelligent medical condition monitoring method and system based on big data
assignee: 深圳市即达健康医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical information, and provides a smart medical condition monitoring method and system based on big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current illness information of a patient; determining the type and the degree of the disease of the patient according to the current disease information of the patient; calculating a disease degree score according to the disease degree, analyzing the disease degree score, and if the disease degree score exceeds a score threshold, acquiring first historical disease information of a first historical patient according to the type, wherein the first historical patient and the disease of the patient belong to the same type; and screening first historical illness information related to the current illness information of the patient from the first historical illness information according to the current illness information of the patient, and sending the first historical illness information to a doctor corresponding to the patient. The method can pay attention to the current illness state of the patient in real time, and once serious, the method can also immediately acquire the history illness information, so that the patient can be helped to acquire a proper treatment scheme, and the treatment is convenient.
assignee_clean: 深圳市即达健康医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市即达健康医疗科技有限公司

title: Methods and systems for an adaptive perfusion scan
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for adaptive scan control. In one embodiment, a method includes, upon an injection of a contrast agent, initiating a contrast scan of a subject according to a fallback scan prescription, processing acquired projection data of an anatomical region of interest (ROI) of the subject to measure a contrast signal of the contrast agent, identifying a peak in the contrast signal within a predetermined time frame, if the peak in the contrast signal is not identified within the predetermined time frame, updating the fallback scan prescription to generate an adapted scan prescription for the contrast scan based on the contrast signal, and performing a remainder of the contrast scan according to the adapted scan prescription, and if the peak in the contrast signal is not identified within the predetermined time frame, continuing the remainder of the contrast scan according to the fallback scan prescription.

title: Data stream processing for dynamic resource scheduling
abstract: In some examples, a data stream processing system is provided for processing data streams so as to extract and transmit pertinent information from the data streams to devices or systems. More specifically, the data stream processing system can facilitate a selective, reliable and efficient processing of data elements within the data streams.

title: Method, apparatus, and computer program product for balancing network resource demand
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention provide methods, systems, apparatuses, and computer program products for predicting network asset requests for a future network time interval.

title: Ai based assistance diagnosis system for diagnosing cerebrovascular disease
abstract: The present invention relates to an AI-based auxiliary diagnostic system for diagnosis of cerebrovascular diseases. According to the present invention, the AI-based auxiliary diagnostic system comprises: a learning database in which a plurality of MRA images labeled with cerebrovascular diseases are stored; a coordinate system registration module which registers a spatial coordinate system in each of the MRA images stored in the learning database; and an AI module which learns, through a preregistered deep learning-based learning model, each of the MRA images in which the spatial coordinate system is registered by the coordinate system registration module. When cerebrovascular diseases are read through a deep learning-based learning model, the same coordinate system is registered in learning images to be learned by the learning model so as to increase accuracy of learning and reading.

title: Monitoring and early warning method and system based on reinforcement learning
assignee: 中国科学院重庆绿色智能技术研究院
abstract: The invention provides a monitoring and early warning method and a system based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: predicting the incidence relation between the time sequence monitoring data and the adverse event label according to the time sequence monitoring data input in real time, and creating a decision environment; modeling the agent decision-making action; the intelligent agent selects a decision action according to the time sequence monitoring data input at the current moment; the decision environment outputs response information according to the decision action, wherein the response information comprises environment states and reward and punishment values of the decision action; inputting the environment state into a pre-constructed deep reinforcement learning framework, and acquiring the action with the highest expected value in all selectable decision actions of the intelligent agent as the output of the next action decision of the intelligent agent; interacting the intelligent agent and the decision-making environment according to the steps until the end condition is met, and outputting a prediction result; the invention monitors the condition of the target object in real time through reinforcement learning and improves the timeliness of problem processing.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院重庆绿色智能技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院重庆绿色智能技术研究院

title: Real-world evidence of diagnostic testing and treatment patterns in U.S. breast cancer patients with implications for treatment biomarkers from RNA-sequencing data
abstract: Techniques are provided for replacing image assays using real world data and real word evidence RNA-seq analysis for assessing biologic pathways for identifying molecular subtypes. Systems of a methods diagnose HER2 status for a patient, by identifying discordant HER2 status result between the HER2 status from immunohistochemistry (IHC) and the HER2 status from fluorescence in-situ hybridization (FISH) and diagnosing HER2 status based gene expression data.

title: Cognitive system for automatic risk assessment, solution identification, and action enablement
abstract: A method includes monitoring with at least one monitoring tool one or more activities associated with an enterprise. The method further includes analyzing data input from the at least one monitoring tool of the one or more activities, and determining, based on analytics performed on the data input and an implemented policy, when the one or more activities qualifies as an incident. A remedial response responsive to the incident is initiated. The monitoring, analyzing, determining and initiating steps are performed by at least one processing device including a processor operatively coupled to a memory.

title: Methods and systems for auto-filling fields of electronic documents
abstract: Embodiments for managing an electronic document by one or more processors are described. An entry for a first of a plurality of fillable fields of an electronic document is received. A recommended entry for at least a second of the plurality of fillable fields is determined based on at least one data source associated with a user. A signal representative of the determined recommended entry for the at least a second of the plurality of fillable fields is generated.

title: Operation method, device and related product
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an operation method, an operation device, and a related product, wherein the product includes a control module, and the control module includes: the system comprises an instruction cache unit, an instruction processing unit and a storage queue unit; the instruction cache unit is used for storing calculation instructions related to the artificial neural network operation; the instruction processing unit is used for analyzing the calculation instructions to obtain a plurality of operation instructions; the store queue unit is configured to store an instruction queue, where the instruction queue includes: a plurality of arithmetic instructions or calculation instructions to be executed in the order of the queue. By the method, the operation efficiency of the related products in the operation of the neural network model can be improved.
assignee_clean: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司

title: Medical image display control device, method, and program for displaying medical images with selectable tabs
abstract: A medical image display control device includes a reception unit that receives an input instruction, a creation unit that creates a display image having a tab and a viewer region in which at least a medical image is displayed, the creation unit creating a new display image having a tab and a viewer region different from a viewer region of a display image displayed on a display unit based on the input instruction received by the reception unit, a display controller that performs control such that the tab of the new display image created by the creation unit and the already displayed tab are displayed so as to be selectable on the display unit, and a switching display controller that performs control such that in a case where any tab of the tabs displayed on the display unit is selected, the viewer region corresponding to the selected tab is switched with the already displayed viewer region and is displayed on the display unit.

title: View synthesis for dynamic scenes
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques are presented to perform monocular view synthesis of a dynamic scene. Single and multi-view depth information can be determined for a collection of images of a dynamic scene, and a blender network can be used to combine image features for foreground, background, and missing image regions using fused depth maps inferred form the single and multi-view depth information.

title: Oscillometric blood pressure estimation method based on machine learning
abstract: Provided by the present invention is an oscillometric blood pressure estimating method capable of providing accurate blood pressure estimating values and improved confidence interval (CIs). The oscillometric blood pressure estimating method based on machine learning according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: (a) a step of obtaining the envelope of an oscillometric waveform about a measurement value based on a sample blood pressure measurement value; (b) a step of obtaining a physician maximum amplitude (PMA) based on the maximum amplitude (MA) of the envelope of the oscillometric waveform about the measurement value by using a non-paramilitary boot strap; (c) a step of obtaining a physician envelope (PE) based on the envelope of the oscillometric waveform about the measurement value by using the non-paramilitary boot strap; (d) a step of connecting the PMA with the PE; (e) a step of estimating a systolic blood pressure characteristic ratio (SBPR) and a diastolic blood pressure characteristic ratio (DBPR) about individual subject by using machine learning; and (f) a step of estimating the systolic blood pressure (SBP) and the diastolic blood pressure (DBP) with a confidence interval (CI) based on the estimated SBPR and the estimated DBPR.

title: Attention-based diagnosis and prediction method for bidirectional recurrent neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a diagnosis and prediction method of a bidirectional recurrent neural network based on attention, and relates to the technical field of prediction and diagnosis. The method first embeds high-dimensional medical codes (i.e. clinical variables) into a low-code layer space, and then inputs the coded representation into an attention-based bidirectional recurrent neural network to generate a hidden state representation. The hidden representation is entered via the softmax layer to predict future access to the medical code. Experimental data show that by adopting the method provided by the embodiment, when future access information is predicted, different weights can be distributed to previous accesses by an attention mechanism, so that not only can a diagnosis and prediction task be effectively completed, but also a prediction result can be reasonably explained.

title: Human body data monitoring method and device for big data
assignee: 深圳市维康致远科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a human body data monitoring method and device for big data, and relates to the technical field of image processing. Comprising the following steps: acquiring diagnosis information and physiological information in real time; acquiring a multi-frame first image of a target epileptic patient based on a camera device; processing the multi-frame first image to obtain a multi-frame second image; processing the physiological information to determine corresponding physiological characteristics of the target epileptic patient; based on the epileptic identification model generated by pre-training, the physiological characteristics, the second image and the diagnosis information, whether the target epileptic patient is in a disease state or not is judged, and the wearable device is controlled to perform early warning. Therefore, the method can accurately monitor the morbidity of the patient according to the emotion and the action of the patient, realize early warning, combine different pathological features of different patients, detect the action and the emotion in a targeted manner, be more accurate and reliable, improve the monitoring force of the patient and be more personalized.
assignee_clean: 深圳市维康致远科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市维康致远科技有限公司

title: Method, device, electronic equipment and readable medium for determining focus sampling area
assignee: 浙江太美医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable medium for determining a focus sampling area, wherein the method for determining the focus sampling area comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image containing a focus, and dividing the medical image to obtain a focus area; calculating multi-fractal dimension of each pixel point in the focus area; and determining a sampling area of the focus based on the multi-fractal dimension of each pixel point in the focus area. The method for determining the focus sampling area provided by the application comprises the steps of obtaining a focus area by dividing a medical image, calculating the multi-fractal dimension of each pixel point in the focus area, and determining the focus sampling area based on the multi-fractal dimension of each pixel point in the focus area; the heteroplasmy parameters of the focus are represented by the multi-fractal dimension, so that a reference can be provided for evaluating the internal structural difference of the focus, and the accurate positioning of a biopsy sampling area can be guided, so that the detection accuracy of the subsequent pathological typing and molecular typing is improved.

title: IoT device application workload capture
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) device application workload capture is disclosed. A target IoT device is selected. A flow associated with the target device is determined and tagged. Packets from the tagged flow are admitted into a ring buffer. An indication is received that an extraction should be performed on a portion of the packets included in the ring buffer.

title: System and method for image registration
abstract: Certain embodiments of the present invention provide for a system and method for performing medical image registration. Pixel and voxel correspondences are formulated as energy minimization problems and are optimized with graph cuts. The method includes processing a first set of data and a second set of data using a graph cuts algorithm to determine a minimum value of an energy function. The energy function has a data term and a smoothness term. The method also includes performing registration for the first set of data and the second set of data based on the data term and the smoothness term of the energy function. The system includes a computer system for performing medical image registration. The computer system comprises a processor and a memory in communication with the processor. The memory includes program code executable by the processor for executing a medical image registration algorithm.

title: Retina blood vessel segmentation method and terminal based on residual network feature extraction
abstract: The invention provides a retinal vessel segmentation method based on residual network feature extraction, which is applied to a neural network model and comprises the following steps: and obtaining a plurality of images through the pretrained VGG coding layer by the original retinal vascular image, wherein the plurality of images are five images, and the images and the original retinal vascular image have a preset proportional relation. The accuracy of network segmentation is obviously improved, and the fitting capacity and generalization capacity of the model are better optimized. Compared with the Unet, the network has better performance in other data sets.

title: Photobiomodulation therapy garment, methods and uses
abstract: The present specification discloses a photobiomodulation therapy garment having a garment structure configured to be worn by a user atop a skin surface with one or more near-infrared light sources integrated with the garment structure. The near-infrared light source is configured to emit near-infrared light directed to one or more regions of interest of the skin at a wavelength between 600 nm to 1600 nm and at a predetermined dosimetry and duration. A controller with a processor and memory is in communication with the near-infrared light source to control the operational parameters of the near-infrared light source.

title: Method for automatically identifying primary tumor of nasopharyngeal carcinoma based on deep semantic segmentation network
assignee: 广州柏视医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for automatically identifying primary tumors of nasopharyngeal carcinoma based on a deep semantic segmentation network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a magnetic resonance three-dimensional image of a patient; correcting the gray level deviation field of the three-dimensional image; processing the three-dimensional image after the preprocessing step by utilizing an improved histogram matching algorithm; intercepting an ROI area of the three-dimensional image after the preprocessing step, and dividing the three-dimensional image into 2-by-2 overlapped patches serving as the input of a model; inputting the plurality of patches into the trained deep semantic segmentation network to identify the primary tumor of the nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and finally combining the output identification results of the plurality of patches to obtain a final primary tumor identification result. The invention can effectively improve the quality of input data, learn the global information and the detail information of the high-resolution image, and effectively improve the accuracy of prediction and the generalization capability of the model by combining a post-processing method, thereby effectively improving the working efficiency of medical workers.

title: Image processing method and device and computer readable medium
assignee: 数坤(北京)网络科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device and a computer readable medium for image processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out tissue anatomical structure processing on an original medical image sequence to generate target organ quasi-diagnosis information; then based on the target organ quasi-diagnosis information, performing focus diagnosis processing on the original medical image sequence to generate focus quasi-diagnosis information; and finally, splicing the target organ quasi-diagnosis information and the focus quasi-diagnosis information to generate an interpretation report corresponding to the focus. Therefore, the conventional medical image diagnosis process and the artificial intelligence auxiliary diagnosis are combined, the artificial intelligence auxiliary diagnosis process which accords with the medical image diagnosis process is realized, the efficiency of the artificial intelligence auxiliary diagnosis is improved, and the problems that the screening process is complex and the screening efficiency is low due to disorder of the output information of the artificial intelligence auxiliary diagnosis in the prior art are solved.
