title: Knowledge graph construction method based on network security
assignee: 浙江辰龙检测技术有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of digital processing, and particularly discloses a knowledge graph construction method based on network security, which is characterized in that ternary knowledge is extracted based on rules, entity relation is extracted based on a BERT language model, a mask language model is used for randomly training corpus mask for unlabeled texts, a next sentence prediction training mode is introduced for training the BERT model, a special mark is inserted before each entity containing sentences of two entities, a hidden state vector of the entity is obtained, and self-attention weighted score analysis is used for self-attention and situation analysis; according to the invention, efficient storage and acquisition of data are realized through a crawler technology and a graph database, the accuracy of a query result is improved based on a knowledge graph retrieval technology, the importance and the credibility of entity relationships are evaluated by introducing situation analysis, and network security maintenance is performed by combining a situation analysis method.

title: Cerebral vessel segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium suitable for multiple modes
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院
abstract: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for segmenting cerebral vessels, which are applicable to multiple modes. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a three-dimensional image block and a two-dimensional image block of a three-dimensional medical image; inputting the three-dimensional image block into a three-dimensional image processing model to obtain first three-dimensional characteristic information; acquiring three-dimensional gradient information of a three-dimensional image block; inputting the two-dimensional image block into a two-dimensional image processing model to obtain first two-dimensional characteristic information; acquiring two-dimensional gradient information of a two-dimensional image block; determining a target area of the three-dimensional image block according to the first three-dimensional characteristic information, the three-dimensional gradient information, the first two-dimensional characteristic information and the two-dimensional gradient information; and obtaining a cerebral vessel segmentation result of the brain three-dimensional medical image according to each target area. According to the invention, the boundary can be enhanced through gradient information, the accuracy of cerebral vessel segmentation is improved, information of multiple modes can be fused, and the information utilization rate of the three-dimensional medical image of the brain and the accuracy of cerebral vessel segmentation are improved.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院

title: Systems and methods for constructing motion models based on sensor data
abstract: This disclosure relates to systems, media, and methods for updating motion models using sensor data. In an embodiment, the system may perform operations including receiving sensor data from at least one motion sensor; generating training data based on at least one annotation associated with the sensor data and at least one data manipulation; receiving at least one experiment parameter; performing a first experiment using the training data and the at least one experiment parameter to generate experiment results; and performing at least one of: update or validate a first motion model based on the experiment results.

title: Write granularity for storage system
abstract: A storage array controller may receive a write request comprising data to be stored at one or more solid-state storage devices. A write granularity associated with the write request may be generated that is less than a logical block size associated with the storage array controller. The data associated with the write request may be segmented based on the generated write granularity. The write request may be executed to store the segmented data at the one or more solid-state storage devices.

title: Method and device for obtaining deep learning training set through magnetic resonance imaging
assignee: 上海东软医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for obtaining a deep learning training set through magnetic resonance imaging, a computer readable storage medium and a processor. Parallel imaging is carried out, and K space data of a detected part are acquired by a first preset acceleration multiple; reconstructing an image of the K space data in a parallel imaging mode, and performing denoising processing on the reconstructed image to obtain a labeled image set of a deep learning training set; acquiring noise data of a measured part in a K-full space; extracting partial noise data from the full K space noise data by a second preset acceleration multiple, and then performing parallel imaging reconstruction to obtain a noise image set; and adding the marked image set and the noise image set to obtain an input image set of the deep learning training set. According to the invention, the input image set and the marked image set can be obtained by single acquisition without acquiring the K space data of the detected part for multiple times. The DNN model obtained by the deep learning training set obtained by the method can realize high-quality magnetic resonance imaging under the condition of limited acquisition time and/or limited acquisition times.

title: Providing an optimum subtraction data set
abstract: A method for providing an optimum subtraction data set includes: receiving first image data sets acquired by a medical imaging device and which map an object under examination within a first time phase; receiving at least one second image data set acquired by the same or another medical imaging device and which maps a change in the object under examination within a second time phase; dividing the at least one second image data set into a plurality of image regions; generating subtraction image regions for the plurality of image regions; determining an image quality parameter for each subtraction image region; determining an optimum subtraction image region for each image region of the plurality of image regions of the at least one second image data set by comparing the image quality parameters; generating the optimum subtraction data set from the optimum subtraction image regions; and providing the optimum subtraction data set.

title: Master-slave control method based on deep learning and application
abstract: According to the problems of the prior art, the invention provides a master-slave control method and application based on deep learning, wherein after a motion coordinate system of an execution unit is established, a master-slave mapping relation is established, the master-slave mapping relation is utilized to describe the motion forward and backward operations of master hands and slave hands corresponding to the execution unit, and a master-slave heterogeneous model is constructed; and carrying out real-time tracking on the target under the master-slave relationship to obtain tracking result data, and finally carrying out deep learning through a convolutional neural network to complete the control process of the execution unit. The invention can facilitate the operator to improve the control precision of the flexible robot according to the assistance of the target tracking algorithm in the master-slave control mode, and facilitate the operation in a complex and narrow operation space, thereby reducing the operation risk and relieving the pressure of doctors.

title: Electronic medical record medication structured processing system based on multiple models
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-model-based electronic medical record medication structured processing system, which comprises: the medical record input equipment is used for inputting the electronic medical record information of the corresponding medical group/doctor, and each piece of electronic medical record information comprises a course paragraph; and the cloud service network element set is used for selecting a corresponding deep neural network model according to the source medical group/doctor of each piece of received electronic medical record information so as to execute deep neural network identification processing on the course paragraph, and obtaining the patient medication structured file with the medication name as the main index word. The electronic medical record medication structured processing system based on multiple models is intelligent in operation and timely in response. On the basis that a computer reads in electronic medical record data mainly based on a text by adopting a deep neural network model, medical record writing habits of different medical groups/different doctors in the same medical institution are identified, and effective structured medical basic data are provided for a scientific research data platform of the medical institution.

title: Dysmenorrhea traditional Chinese medicine syndrome differentiation system based on DAELA-LSTM neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of informatization of traditional Chinese medicine syndrome differentiation, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine syndrome differentiation system for dysmenorrhea based on a DAELA-LSTM neural network. The system comprises a traditional Chinese medicine dysmenorrhea symptom acquisition module, a data processing module and a man-machine interaction device, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine dysmenorrhea symptom acquisition module is used for acquiring traditional Chinese medicine dysmenorrhea symptoms and inputting the traditional Chinese medicine dysmenorrhea symptoms into the data processing module; the data processing module calculates corresponding traditional Chinese medicine dysmenorrhea syndrome results according to the traditional Chinese medicine dysmenorrhea symptoms, and a traditional Chinese medicine dysmenorrhea differentiation model based on a DAELA-LSTM neural network is adopted in the calculation process of the data processing module. The model can effectively mine the internal relation of the information of the four diagnostic methods, better perform the traditional Chinese medicine dialectical treatment of dysmenorrhea and has high accuracy.

title: De-identification device for healthcare image
abstract: The present invention relates to a de-identification device for a healthcare video, and more particularly, to a de-identification device for a healthcare video that prevents personal information leakage by de-identifying personal identification information existing on a healthcare video image or a clinical video image. The de-identification device includes a video image acquisition part, a personal identification information detection part, a disease area detection part, a de-identification processing part, and a de-identification information storage processing part.

abstract:

title: Availability evaluation method of medical text structuring algorithm
abstract: The invention provides a new usability evaluation method of a medical text structuring algorithm. For any medical text structuring algorithm, the availability is used to evaluate the medical text structuring algorithm, and the numerical value indicates how well the algorithm is applicable to the actual application scenario, and the three dimensions are included: generalization capability on different hospitals, different department corpora; the anti-interference capability of the algorithm; and the tolerance of algorithm errors. The invention constructs a specific and available evaluation method based on the definition of availability and combining the similarity relation between medical texts, the type of algorithm errors, the type of data interference and the like. The index and the method examine whether the machine learning algorithm theory research oriented to the medical text is suitable for the actual application scene or not, and can be used in other fields.

title: Medical image recognition training method
assignee: 上海全景医学影像诊断中心有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a medical image recognition training method, which designs a plurality of training strategies based on a reinforcement learning concept in the field of medical image processing and establishes a medical image automatic recognition mechanism. The optimization framework provided by the invention breaks through the simplification of the previous deep learning method, and can jointly optimize and jointly improve the model performance from two aspects of structure and parameters. The sub-networks available for the task of few sample identification are dynamically generated by the controller, saving time and effort spent on human design. The generation strategy of the network architecture is directly determined by the task distribution in the data set, so that the sub-network is familiar with the complex and changeable task environment and is more suitable for the classification scene of a small amount of labeled data.
assignee_clean: 上海全景医学影像诊断中心有限公司

title: Devices, systems, and methods for real time surveillance of audio streams and uses therefore
abstract: Various examples are provided for surveillance of an audio stream. In one example, a method includes identifying presence or absence of a sound type of interest at a location during a time period; selecting the sound type from a library of sound type information to provide a collection of sound type information; incorporating the collection on a device proximate to the location; acquiring an audio stream from the location by the device to provide a locational audio stream; analyzing the locational audio stream to determine whether a sound type in the collection is present in the audio stream; and generating a notification to a user or computer if a sound type in the collection is present. The device can acquire and process the audio stream. In another example, a bulk sound type information library can be generated by identifying sound types of interest including them based upon a confidence level.

title: Systems and methods for medical treatment using a series of pulsed lasers
abstract: Embodiments of systems and methods for medical treatment using a series of pulsed lasers are disclosed. In an example, a system for medical treatment includes a laser source, an optical module, and a controller coupled to the optical module. The laser source is configured to generate a series of pulsed lasers. The optical module is configured to provide a series of focused laser spots on a patient based on the series of pulsed lasers. The controller is configured to control the at least one of the optical module and a stage for holding the patient to move the series of focused laser spots on the patient to form a scan pattern.

title: Vitals monitoring system
abstract: A remote care system may include a platform that includes one or more memory devices and one or more processors communicatively coupled to the one or more memory devices. The platform may connect and communicate bi-directionally with a plurality of devices via a gateway device. At least some of the plurality of devices may include sensors capable of gathering vitals data from a patient. The vitals data may include different types of vitals data. The platform may connect and communicate bi-directionally with another plurality of devices. The other plurality of devices may be remote to the gateway device and the at least some of the plurality of devices. The platform may support continuous and live streaming of the vitals data from the sensors. The platform may perform a set of actions on a per patient basis based on analyzing the vitals data.

title: Object detection method, object detection device, endoscope system, electronic device, and storage medium
assignee: 杭州海康威视数字技术股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an object detection method, an object detection device, an endoscope system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and video data to be detected are obtained; respectively carrying out target detection on each video frame in the video data based on a pre-trained deep learning target detection network to obtain attribute information of an object in each video frame; tracking each object according to the attribute information of each object to obtain a tracking result of each object; according to the tracking result of each object, the video frame with the new object appearing compared with the previous frame is determined as a first type video frame, and the video frame with the object appearing compared with the next frame and about to disappear is determined as a second type video frame. Besides detecting the position of the object, the first-type video frame and the second-type video frame can clearly know the appearance time of a new object and the disappearance time of an existing object, so that the condition that the object such as gauze is left in the body cavity of a patient can be reduced.
assignee_clean: 杭州海康威视数字技术股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州海康威视数字技术股份有限公司

title: Systems and methods for using geometry sensitivity information for guiding workflow
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for using geometry sensitivity information for guiding workflows in order to produce reliable models and quantities of interest. One method includes determining a geometric model associated with a target object; determining one or more quantities of interest; determining sensitivity information associated with one or more subdivisions of the geometric model and the one or more quantities of interest; and generating, using a processor, a workflow based on the sensitivity information.

title: Garbage collection tuning for low drive wear
abstract: A storage system determines a present amount of reclaimable space in storage memory. The storage system determines a garbage collection directive based on the present amount of reclaimable space in comparison to a target amount of reclaimable space. The storage system selects blocks of storage memory for a group of blocks for garbage collection. Each block selected has greater than or equal to a threshold amount of reclaimable space in accordance with the garbage collection directive. The storage system performs garbage collection, using blocks from the group.

title: Medical single view three-dimensional reconstruction device based on priori knowledge guidance
abstract: The invention discloses a medical single-view three-dimensional reconstruction device based on priori knowledge guidance, which comprises: the descriptor extraction module is used for acquiring the characteristics of the 2D image and the characteristics of the 3D shape and aligning the characteristics; the cross-domain feature alignment network module is used for extracting three-dimensional features from the retrieved multiple three-dimensional models by using a three-dimensional model encoder as cross-modal prior knowledge; the three-dimensional model reconstruction module is used for extracting original view features by utilizing the view encoder, and processing the three-dimensional prior knowledge into a feature set by utilizing the three-dimensional model encoder; the feature fusion module is used for constructing a multi-mode feature fusion network based on a multi-layer transducer network, and fusing the extracted cross-mode priori knowledge with the input medical single view features by adopting a cross-attention mechanism; and the training network framework module is used for capturing multi-scale significance characteristics of the single view by adopting jump connection, and predicting the spatial structure of the three-dimensional model through the three-dimensional model decoder based on the fusion characteristics of the view and the retrieved 3D priori knowledge.

title: Method and system for adapting content on HMD based on behavioral parameters of user
abstract: Embodiments herein provide a method for automatically adapting content on a HMD device. The method includes receiving the vital parameters of the user while viewing an immersive view of the content on the HMD device. Further, the method includes determining that the vital parameters of the user meet a threshold criteria. Further, the method includes generating a modified immersive view including at least one visual element of the content modified based on the behavioral parameters of the user. Further, the method includes causing to display modified immersive view on the HMD device.

title: Automatic detection method for performance of medical ultrasonic equipment based on gray scale image
abstract: The invention discloses a method for automatically detecting the performance of medical ultrasonic equipment based on gray scale images, which comprises the steps of image preprocessing, longitudinal geometric position calibration, transverse geometric position calibration and blind area geometric position calibration, then calculus/cyst detection is carried out according to the acquired longitudinal geometric position, transverse geometric position and blind area geometric position, and finally index calculation is processed; by combining the threshold segmentation with the Hough circle detection and other methods, the method can quickly and effectively calibrate the detection key points and analyze errors of the ultrasonic images under different shooting conditions, thereby realizing the automatic detection of the performance of the ultrasonic detector and avoiding the complicated steps of manual screening.

title: Display apparatus and operation method of the same
abstract: Provided is an artificial intelligence (AI) system for providing functions similar to the human brain, such as recognition, determination, etc., using a machine learning algorithm, e.g., deep learning, and an application thereof. A method includes establishing communication with a first device located in an available zone, the available zone being a range in which content is viewable; receiving a communication signal from a second device; receiving, from the first device, connection information of the first device and the second device connected to the first device; and identifying whether the second device is located in the available zone based on the communication signal received from the second device and the connection information of the first device and the second device.

title: Slide image information acquisition method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for acquiring information of a slide image, and relates to the field of medical image analysis. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target slide image, wherein the target slide image is an image obtained by scanning a target slide loaded with cells to be observed; identifying a foreground region in the target slide image to obtain a foreground region image, wherein the foreground region is used for indicating a region loaded with cells to be observed in the target slide image; carrying out feature extraction on the foreground region image to obtain target features; and performing background type prediction on the target slide image based on the target characteristics to obtain pathological background type information corresponding to the target slide, wherein the pathological background type information is used for indicating background characteristics of cells to be observed in the foreground region. By extracting the foreground region of the target slide image and analyzing the foreground region, the background characteristic of the cells to be observed is determined, and the screening and reading efficiency of the pathological slide is improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯医疗健康 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯医疗健康 深圳 有限公司

title: Method and apparatus for analyzing body composition using medical image
abstract: Disclosed are a method for analyzing a human body composition using a medical image and a device thereof. By using the learning data that labels the human body tissue area of a muscle or a fat in the medical image for learning, the device for analyzing the human body composition distinguishes the human body tissue from the medical image to be examined using a first artificial intelligence model after allowing the first artificial intelligence model to be learned, and outputs the human body composition information identified based on an area, a volume, or a weight of the human body tissue of the medical image to be examined. The present invention is a technology developed through the Seoul Industry Promotion Agency 2020 artificial intelligence technology commercialization support project (CY20053) "CT image-based metabolic syndrome, osteoporosis, and sarcopenia opportunity screening artificial intelligence verification and commercialization". Therefore, the present invention is capable of allowing changes in the human body composition over a period of time to be identified.

title: Monitoring method, device, equipment and medium for ward environment
assignee: 浙江远图技术股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of ward monitoring, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for monitoring ward environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and carrying out ward personnel analysis based on ward information and the number of the exploring personnel, determining a personnel number influence result, carrying out stimulation behavior detection based on the activity behaviors of each exploring personnel, determining a behavior influence result corresponding to each exploring personnel, and further, integrating the personnel number influence result, the number of the exploring personnel, the behavior influence result of each exploring personnel and the activity behaviors of each exploring personnel, and determining an environment analysis result. And then, when the environment state is abnormal, carrying out environment regulation analysis based on the abnormal information, determining environment regulation information and warning information, sending the environment regulation information to regulation equipment, and sending the warning information to the warning equipment. The ward environment is analyzed through the number of exploring staff and activity behaviors, and the ward environment can be responded and processed rapidly when abnormality occurs, so that the accuracy of ward link monitoring is improved.
assignee_clean: 浙江远图技术股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 浙江远图技术股份有限公司

title: Medical examination assistance apparatus
abstract: According to one embodiment, a medical examination assistance apparatus includes processing circuitry. The processing circuitry outputs presence/absence of pre-detection for an adverse event at respective time points when a pre-detection model for an adverse event is applied to time-series medical examination data multiple times. The processing circuitry classifies a detection event of the pre-detection model, into a plurality of patterns each defined by a combination of presence/absence of the pre-detection of an adverse event and presence/absence of a medical event related to the adverse event. The processing circuitry calculates a performance indicator for evaluating the pre-detection model based on the number of instances of each pattern.

title: Integration of speech processing functionality with organization systems
abstract: Systems and methods for integration of speech processing functionality with organization systems are disclosed. For example, a voice interface application may be created to enable a voice interface functionality for devices associated with an organization. Space identifiers of spaces of the organization may be created and associated with the voice interface application. Devices associated with the space identifiers may be enabled for utilizing the voice interface application and may be set up utilizing wireless network identifiers associated with the spaces and/or the organization.

title: Load balancing in streams parallel regions
abstract: In response to receiving a flow of data, one or more operators in a parallel region included in a distributed data processing system for stream processing the flow of data are initialized. In response to identifying a change to the flow of data or a change to the distributed data processing system, at least one of the flow of data and a size of the parallel region included in the distributed data processing system are dynamically adjusted. The flow of data is processed via the dynamically adjusted one of the flow of data and the parallel region included in the distributed data processing system.

title: Method and system for image compression
abstract: The disclosure relates to method and system for compressing an image. The method involves receiving an image of the one or more images. Further, at least one segmentation algorithm is applied on the image and dividing the image into a plurality segments. The method further includes comparing the plurality of segments of the image with a seed image, where seed images include a seed image identifier. Further, a seed image is associated with the segments of the image in case there is a match between the seed image and the plurality of segments. The method also includes storing the image as a residual image and a seed image along with one or more seed image identifiers. Further, the image may be reconstructed based on the residual image and one or more seed images associated with the image. Thereafter, the image may be displayed on a display unit.

title: Artificial intelligence system and method based on child radiological image quality control
assignee: 辽宁万象联合医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides an artificial intelligence system and method based on child radiological image quality control. In the system and the method, the MEDM model can effectively solve the problems of low working efficiency of manual quality control, large quantity gaps of related doctors, difficult multiplexing of doctor technologies and the like, realize automatic quality control of the pediatric medical images, enable the pediatric medical images to accord with quality control standards, simultaneously help to reduce invalid exposure areas, reduce pediatric radiation dose, avoid the occurrence of radiation safety problems, and make more detailed quality control detection on diagnostic reports. The artificial intelligence system and the method provided by the application are reliable, accurate, efficient, reusable and stable.
assignee_clean: 辽宁万象联合医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 辽宁万象联合医疗科技有限公司

title: Enhanced section detection using a combination of object detection with heuristics
abstract: Aspects of the invention include converting text from a first image file into a first machine-encodable text, wherein the image file includes a first section of text that is offset from a second section of text. Analyzing the first image file to detect a position of the first section of text. Embedding a first section of the first machine encodable-text with metadata describing the position of the first section of text. Reformatting the first section of the first machine encodable-text to conform to the position of the first section of text.

title: Thickness measuring method for transparent layer of fetal cervical item
assignee: 四川大学华西第二医院, 成都市汪汪科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for measuring the thickness of a transparent layer of a fetal cervical item, which sequentially comprises the following steps: inputting an original fetus ultrasound median sagittal section ultrasound scanning image; removing sensitive information of an input image; inputting the data to the trained DeepLabv3+ to obtain a multi-angle image segmentation result; and finishing measurement after extracting the segmentation boundary. The invention realizes the accurate measurement of the thickness of the ultrasonic cervical transparent layer of the fetus, effectively divides and identifies the area of the median sagittal tangent plane of the fetus by using a DeepLabv3+ convolution neural network model, accurately finds out the subcutaneous long strip-shaped non-echogenic zone of the back of the neck in the ultrasonic image, further realizes the measurement of the thickness of the cervical transparent layer of the fetus, has higher accuracy, is suitable for prenatal ultrasonic examination, is beneficial to the skilled grasp of doctors, ensures that the diagnosis result has objectivity, reduces the misdiagnosis rate, can also improve the effective utilization of medical resources, has higher use value, and is expected to be popularized and used to primary hospitals.
assignee_clean: 四川大学华西第二医院; 成都市汪汪科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 四川大学华西第二医院

title: Automated explanation of machine learning predictions using classification score targeting
abstract: Automated explanation of machine learning predictions, by: Obtaining an input, a machine learning model, and a classification score produced by application of the machine learning model to the input. Optimizing iterative application of the machine learning model to perturbations of the input, wherein a target of said optimizing is at least a predefined non-zero classification score. Generating, based on one of the perturbations which achieved the predefined non-zero classification score, an explanation to the classification score produced by the application of the machine learning model to the input.

title: Machine learning analytics in real time for health services
abstract: Methods and systems detect a random state change in a subject in real time. Eye state changes may be identified in encephalogram brain signals, or honeybee dance patterns may be classified. Multivariate signals including state change information are received via a plurality of channels. The signals are sampled and may be filtered to remove DC components. Statistical characteristics of the signals are monitored. When the statistical characteristics exceed a threshold during a critical time interval, a potential change of state is detected. The critical time segment of the signals may be filtered to generate respective state change artifact signals. The state change artifact signals are decomposed by MEMD, and intrinsic mode functions are generated. Features are extracted from the intrinsic mode functions. These steps may be repeated while the extracted features are provided to a logistic regression classifier that is used to predict a state of the subject.

title: Echocardiogram classification with machine learning
abstract: A method for analysing a structure within a patient's heart includes receiving a patient study including a plurality of images of the patient's heart obtained by an ultrasound device, extracting respective sets of pixel data from the images, and using trained machine learning algorithms to analyse the sets of pixel data to a) identify first images captured using a colour Doppler modality and assign the first images to said structure, b) identify second images captured using spectral Doppler modality and assign the second images to said structure, c) determine a flow convergence zone radius from an analysis of the first images; and d) determine a maximum gradient of structure, from an analysis of the second images. The flow convergence zone radius, the maximum gradient of structure, and a Nyquist value identified for the colour Doppler modality, are combined to determine an Effective Regurgitant Orifice Area for the structure.

title: Human-intelligent interactive computer-aided diagnosis system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a computer-aided diagnosis system and a computer-aided diagnosis method for human-intelligent interaction, wherein a data set is selected according to the type of a neural network; calling a data set to train the deep learning network model; completing the quantization of the deep learning network model; compiling the quantized deep learning network model; the compiled deep learning network model is transmitted to the edge computer auxiliary diagnosis equipment; the edge computer auxiliary diagnosis equipment receives the image to be diagnosed and carries out pretreatment by combining with a suspicious focus marked on the image to be diagnosed by a user; inputting the preprocessed image to be diagnosed into the compiled deep learning network model for processing to obtain an image processing result; according to the invention, a feedback mechanism is introduced in a computer-aided system in a manual labeling manner, so that the diagnosis accuracy is improved; the long axis and the short axis of the suspicious lesion area can be determined, and then the minimum rectangle containing the lesion area is determined to be the region of interest, so that the data processing amount is reduced.

title: Brain image redirection method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for redirecting brain images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a segmentation result of at least one anatomical tissue in a target brain image by using a machine learning model; determining a reorientation rotation parameter according to the segmentation result of the anatomical tissue; and redirecting the target brain image according to the redirection rotation parameter. The reorientation rotation parameters obtained by the invention can realize reorientation of the brain image with high precision, thereby improving the precision of post-processing of the brain image.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Automatic retrospective review of electronic medical records
abstract: Retrospective review of electronic medical records is provided. In some embodiments, a retrospective review of a plurality of electronic medical records is performed. The retrospective review includes searching for electronic medical records relevant to a medical condition. Based on the retrospective review, a plurality of studies most relevant to a present study is determined. Each of the plurality of studies are flagged for supplemental review in a worklist.

title: RFID-enabled medical device system, kit, ultrasound system and optically-enabled medical device kit
assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
abstract: RFID-enabled medical device systems, kits, ultrasound systems, and optically-enabled medical device kits are disclosed herein that include an RFID transmitter configured to provide an interrogation signal that impinges on an RFID tag associated with a medical device to trigger a response signal. The response signal may indicate the presence or absence of a medical device in proximity to the RFID transmitter. A console communicatively coupled to the RFID transmitter may determine, record, and analyze procedure or usage information about the medical device. Further information about the medical device may be encoded within the response signal and provided to the console. The console settings may be automatically updated based on information in the response signal. Additional modes are also contemplated, including optical image recognition of the medical device kit. In addition, the AR viewer may provide image overlays to guide the user through the correct procedure. Program compliance may be automatically recorded and monitored.
assignee_clean: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 巴德阿克塞斯系统股份有限公司

title: Medical interventional imaging device
abstract: According to some implementations, a n medical interventional imaging device for monitoring an interventional procedure is described. The medical interventional imaging device includes a temporary data buffer configured to temporarily store medical interventional fluoroscopic image data, a signal processor configured to detect if an abnormal state occurs during an intervention and to record an instant at which the abnormal state has occurred, and a permanent data storage configured to permanently store at least a part of the medical interventional fluoroscopic image data stored temporarily before and/or at the recorded instant if the abnormal state is detected.

title: Determining application security and correctness using machine learning based clustering and similarity
abstract: A computing system includes persistent storage configured to store representations of software applications installed on computing devices, and a software application configured to perform operations, including retrieving, from the persistent storage, a first plurality of representations of a first plurality of software applications installed on a particular computing device and a second plurality of representations of a second plurality of software applications installed on a reference computing device. The operations also include determining a device fingerprint of the particular computing device based on the first plurality of representations and a reference device fingerprint of the reference computing device based on the second plurality of representations, and comparing the device fingerprint to the reference device fingerprint. The operations further include, based on the comparing, determining a disparity between software applications installed on the particular computing device and the reference computing device, and storing, in the persistent storage, a representation of the disparity.

title: System and method for generating a stained image
abstract: A system and method for generating a stained image including the steps of obtaining a first image of a key sample section; and processing the first image with a stain learning engine arranged to generate at least one stained image, wherein the at least one stained image represents the key sample section stained with at least one stain.

title: Systems and methods for imputing missing values in data sets
abstract: A computer readable medium includes a data set with data stored in rows and N columns. Each of the rows is associated with one individual patient. Each of the N columns is associated with one type of data for patients. One or more processors is configured to: initialize missing values in M ones of the N columns with M values for the M ones of the N columns, respectively; generate M mathematical models for the M ones of the N columns having one or more missing values; for each of the rows having one or more missing values, update ones of the M values for the M ones of the N columns; and fill missing values in the M ones of the N columns with the M values, respectively.

title: Centralized privacy management system for automatic monitoring and handling of personal data across data system platforms
abstract: A method of operating a privacy management system for managing personal data includes receiving a first input indicative of a first user activity in accessing personal data stored within a memory element. The method also includes creating an activity model based on the first input. The activity model is indicative of typical activity in accessing personal data stored in the memory element. The method further includes receiving a second input indicative of a second user activity in accessing personal data stored within the memory element. Also, the method includes recognizing, according to the activity model, the second user activity as being anomalous to the typical activity in accessing personal data stored in the memory element. Moreover, the method includes generating, as a result of recognizing the second user activity as being anomalous, a command that causes at least one of the client devices to perform an anomaly corrective action.

title: Device, body, method and system for health-care
abstract: A health-care device includes a health-care body for positioning a body part of a user and maintaining a first specific positional relationship with the body part having an acupuncture point; a needle device for carrying out on the acupuncture point a health-care work; and a needle fixture having a first end connected to the health-care body, and a second end for fixing the needle device, so that while the health-care body and the body part have therebetween at the first specific positional relationship, the health-care work is carried out under a condition that the needle fixture and the acupuncture point have therebetween a second specific positional relationship. A health-care body, method and system are also provided.

title: Methods and systems for translating magnetic resonance images to pseudo computed tomography images
abstract: Various methods and systems are provided for translating magnetic resonance (MR) images to pseudo computed tomography (CT) images. In one embodiment, a method comprises acquiring an MR image, generating, with a multi-task neural network, a pseudo CT image corresponding to the MR image, and outputting the MR image and the pseudo CT image. In this way, the benefits of CT imaging with respect to accurate density information, especially in sparse regions of bone which exhibit with high dynamic range, may be obtained in an MR-only workflow, thereby achieving the benefits of enhanced soft-tissue contrast in MR images while eliminating CT dose exposure for a patient.

title: Dynamic data asset security using cognitive data analysis
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein identify a first data asset that is associated with a non-optimized security configuration, based at least in part on metadata associated with the first data asset. Additionally, an optimized security configuration is generated for the first data asset by processing the metadata associated with the first data asset using one or more machine learning models. Furthermore, the optimized security configuration is applied to the first data asset.

title: Segmented vertebra CT image segmentation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a segmented vertebra CT image segmentation method based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of image segmentation; the segmentation method comprises the following steps: step one, preprocessing a vertebra CT image; step two, detecting the center of the vertebra; step three, vertebrae CT image segmentation; the method automatically detects all visible vertebra centers in the current image by using a deep learning mode, and performs high-resolution segmentation on the visible vertebra centers through a segmentation network; helps doctors to effectively find vertebral malformation and injury in early stage, thereby preventing and treating diseases in time.

title: Medical image segmentation method based on single pixel characteristics
assignee: 中国人民解放军第四军医大学
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image segmentation method based on single pixel characteristics, which relates to the technical field of image processing.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军第四军医大学
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军第四军医大学

title: Graph enabled location optimization
abstract: A method and a related system for allocating target locations to optimize trajectories between several objects and the target locations may be provided. The method comprises capturing location data of the target locations as well as location and movement data of the objects, building a graph using the target locations as well as the location and movement data and integrating constraints into the graph. Furthermore, the method comprises determining for each of the several objects a desired target location using a first optimization system, thereby determining endpoints of a trajectory between each of the objects and its respective desired target location and selecting for each of the several objects an optimal path as the trajectory between the object and the desired target location, using a second optimization system, and taking into account movements of other objects along their trajectories.

title: Medical data relation mining method and device
assignee: 天津新开心生活科技有限公司, 天津开心生活科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a medical data relation mining method and device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first medical data and second medical data in a target text; performing feature extraction on the first medical data and the second medical data to obtain feature vectors of the first medical data and the second medical data; inputting the feature vectors into a trained classification model, and determining a target relationship between the first medical data and the second medical data. The method and the system can efficiently identify the relationship between the medical data in the clinical case text, improve the efficiency of relation mining of the medical data, and are favorable for further data statistical analysis.
assignee_clean: 天津新开心生活科技有限公司; 天津开心生活科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 天津新开心生活科技有限公司

title: 5G admission by verifying slice SLA guarantees
abstract: In a 5G network, a slice controller is arranged to dynamically configure a radio access network (RAN) by allocating physical radio resources into RAN slices by making predictions of channel state information (CSI) for user equipment (UE) executing applications that make connectivity requests for admission to particular identified slices. The slice controller grants or denies admission requests based on the predicted CSI to ensure that applicable service level agreement (SLA) guarantees are satisfied for traffic across all the RAN slices. Each time new admission requests are received from applications, the slice controller determines whether a suitable RAN configuration exists that will enable SLA guarantees for the slices to continue to be satisfied for the current traffic while also meeting the SLA guarantees applicable to the new admission request.

title: Health risk key event detection method and system based on time window cutting
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting health risk key events based on time window cutting, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s100, inputting the electronic medical record of the patient into a trained deep learning model, and acquiring an important index and a death risk index of the physiological index of the patient in each visit; s200, dividing targets of the patient health risk key event detection into four types according to a time window, respectively detecting the four types based on the acquired important index and death risk index of each physiological index, and screening out the physiological index of the health risk key event to be provided; and S300, displaying the detection process and the detection result of the key event of the health risk of the patient based on a visual interface. The invention can excavate more valuable information with reference meaning from the patient electronic medical record data of the hospital to help the doctor to diagnose.

title: Gastric mucosa bleeding risk early warning method and device and medical image processing equipment
abstract: The application provides a gastric mucosa bleeding risk early warning method, a device and medical image processing equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a gastroscope medical image; carrying out object classification on the gastroscope medical image through a trained image classification model to obtain stomach type information and stomach confidence level, bleeding type information and bleeding confidence level; respectively screening a target stomach weight and a target bleeding weight from a plurality of prestored stomach type weights and bleeding type weights according to the stomach type information and the bleeding type information; and calculating the gastric mucosa bleeding risk level of the gastroscope medical image according to the target stomach weight, the target bleeding weight, the stomach confidence coefficient and the bleeding confidence coefficient, and performing risk early warning according to the gastric mucosa bleeding risk level. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the gastric mucosa bleeding risk early warning can be effectively improved.

title: Medical three-dimensional animation embedding system based on picture recognition
assignee: 北京泽桥医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of distribution routes, and particularly discloses a medical three-dimensional animation embedding system based on picture identification. Performing time-frequency analysis by utilizing Fourier transformation to form a characteristic matrix of the frequency spectrum animation, and constructing a picture recognition neural network model; and acquiring medical three-dimensional animation data, constructing an animation embedding forest for animation analysis, determining the layer position of a picture to be embedded according to the layer relation of each frame of image, embedding a target picture into the medical three-dimensional animation, and rendering and fusing. The problems that the relation of different layers in the animation of a medical complex picture is not accurate enough, the transformation of the layers is not smooth enough, the medical three-dimensional animation is not vivid and concise enough, and a user lacks immersive feeling in the prior art are solved.
assignee_clean: 北京泽桥医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京泽桥医疗科技股份有限公司

title: External device-enabled imaging support
abstract: Systems and methods for imaging. An external device may be used to acquire optical image data of a subject. One or more physical parameters of the subject may be determined based on the optical image data. The one or more physical parameters may be translated to one or more properties of the subject. The one or more properties may then be used to generate medical image data of the subject.

title: Smart refrigerator for smart consumption of food
abstract: The exemplary embodiments disclose a method, a computer program product, and a computer system for managing a consumption of food. The exemplary embodiments may include collecting data of a user and of one or more food items, extracting one or more features from the collected data, and determining a food consumption recommendation based on the extracted one or more features and one or more models.

title: Automatic fusion method of traditional feature and depth feature
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic fusion method of traditional characteristics and depth characteristics, which comprises the following steps: 1. traditional features are extracted: extracting features suitable for describing the analyzed data by combining a target task and utilizing a conventional feature engineering method; 2. the traditional features are converted into leaf index features of the GBDT model. Inputting the features extracted in the step one into a trained gradient lifting tree model to extract leaf node index features of the sample; the leaf node index features are regarded as category features, and n tree types can have n category features; 3. automatic extraction of depth features is achieved by enhanced DNN, converting sparse class characteristics and automatically fusing the characteristics; the method specifically comprises a depth feature extraction step, a sparse class feature conversion step and a feature fusion step. The method effectively integrates the traditional characteristic engineering and deep learning to automatically extract the characteristics, thereby improving the accuracy of classification or regression tasks.

title: Travel industry optimized cognitive information processing system environment
abstract: A cognitive information processing system environment comprising: a plurality of data sources, at least some of the plurality of data sources comprising travel relevant data sources; a cognitive inference and learning system coupled to receive a data from the plurality of data sources, the cognitive inference and learning system processing the data from the plurality of data sources to provide cognitively processed travel relevant insights, the cognitive inference and learning system further comprising performing a learning operation to iteratively improve the cognitively processed travel relevant insights over time; and, a destination, the destination receiving the cognitively processed travel relevant insights.

title: Chinese medicine primary and secondary symptom recognition system, device, electronic equipment and storage medium thereof
assignee: 联仁健康医疗大数据科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese medicine primary and secondary symptom identification system, electronic equipment and a storage medium thereof. The system includes a processor configured to perform the steps of: acquiring source data of a target object, and forming a symptom relation graph of the target object based on the source data; the symptom relation graph comprises symptom nodes of the target object, and the symptom nodes with association relations are connected with each other; determining a recommendation index of each symptom node based on the relation among the symptom nodes in the symptom relation graph; and identifying and obtaining the recommended primary and secondary symptoms of the target object based on the recommendation index of the symptom node. The primary and secondary symptom identification system of the traditional Chinese medicine can reflect the essence of the symptoms more quickly and comprehensively, help clinicians to intelligently identify primary and secondary symptoms, quickly determine the symptoms and select prescriptions, and improve the traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment service capability of basic medical institutions.
assignee_clean: 联仁健康医疗大数据科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 联仁健康医疗大数据科技股份有限公司

title: Generating relaxed synthetic data using adaptive projection
abstract: An algorithm releases answers to very large numbers of statistical queries, e.g., k-way marginals, subject to differential privacy. The algorithm answers queries on a private dataset using simple perturbation, and then attempts to find a synthetic dataset that most closely matches the noisy answers. The algorithm uses a continuous relaxation of the synthetic dataset domain which makes the projection loss differentiable, and allows the use of efficient machine learning optimization techniques and tooling. Rather than answering all queries up front, the algorithm makes judicious use of a privacy budget by iteratively and adaptively finding queries for which relaxed synthetic data has high error, and then repeating the projection. The algorithm is effective across a range of parameters and datasets, especially when a privacy budget is small or a query class is large.

title: Hybrid data architecture having a cognitive data management module for use within a cognitive environment
abstract: A data architecture for use within a cognitive information processing system environment comprising: a plurality of data sources, the plurality of data sources comprising a public data source and a private data source; and, a cognitive data management module, the cognitive data management module accessing information from the plurality of data sources and providing the information to an inference and learning system.

title: Tumor infiltration depth monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring tumor infiltration depth, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing. Wherein the monitoring method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a magnetic resonance image; s2, recognizing a uterus contour and a tumor contour in the magnetic resonance image through a segmentation model, and extracting a target image containing the uterus contour and the tumor contour from the magnetic resonance image; s3, matching a proper infiltration depth recognition model through a classification model according to the target image; s4, analyzing the target image through the matched infiltration depth identification model to obtain the tumor infiltration depth corresponding to the magnetic resonance image. The uterus contour and the tumor contour are identified through the segmentation model, then the appropriate infiltration depth identification model is matched, and the infiltration depth is accurately identified through the matched infiltration depth identification model, so that the efficiency is high, and the accuracy is high.

title: Method for using hybrid data within a travel industry optimized cognitive environment
abstract: A method for using hybrid data within a cognitive information processing system environment comprising: receiving data from a plurality of data sources, the plurality of data sources comprising a public data source and a private data source, the public data source comprising publicly available travel information, the private data source comprising privately managed, company specific travel information; accessing information from the plurality of data sources via a cognitive data management module; and, providing the information to an inference and learning system.

title: Statistic quantizer, storage device, processing device and board card for quantized data
assignee: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a statistic quantizer, a storage device, a processing device and a board card for quantizing a plurality of original data, wherein the statistic quantizer, the storage device and the processing device are included in an integrated circuit device which comprises a universal interconnection interface and other processing devices. The computing device interacts with other processing devices to jointly complete computing operations specified by the user. The integrated circuit device may further include a storage device, which is connected to the computing device and the other processing device, respectively, for data storage of the computing device and the other processing device.

assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for image segmentation, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method for image segmentation comprises the following steps: acquiring a first feature layer based on the image; obtaining a second characteristic layer through a neural network based on a residual error structure according to the first characteristic layer; and acquiring a segmentation result of the image according to the second characteristic layer. According to the technical scheme, even under the condition of being influenced by image quality, the accuracy of the image segmentation result can be improved.

title: Method and device for predicting radiation dose, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 深圳市信润富联数字科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium for predicting radiation dose, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an influence factor parameter currently corresponding to the kernel medical diagnosis equipment in a target scene; normalizing the influence factor parameters to generate an influence factor data set; processing the influence factor data set by using a pre-trained ray radiation equivalent prediction model to obtain a ray air absorption rate predicted value corresponding to the influence factor data set, wherein the ray radiation equivalent prediction model is an artificial neural network obtained by training according to the sample influence factor data set and a ray air absorption rate measured value corresponding to the sample influence factor data set; and determining the radiation dose equivalent currently corresponding to the target scene based on the predicted value of the ray air absorptivity. Through this application, solved and adopted radiation dose equivalent rate monitor monitoring ray air absorption rate to have the problem that there is radiation danger and unable real-time supervision.

title: Systems, methods, and computer program products for authorizing a transaction
abstract: Disclosed are methods for authorizing a transaction, including receiving a policy message, the policy message including a policy ruleset for determining whether a transaction is authorized and biometric parameters for a machine learning algorithm for authenticating an identity of a user involved in a transaction, receiving biometric measurement data associated with a biometric measurement of a user involved in the transaction, calculating an authentication score based on the biometric measurement data using the machine learning algorithm, wherein the authentication score includes an indication of whether an identity of the user is authenticated based on the biometric measurement data, determining whether the transaction satisfies the policy ruleset for determining authorization of the transaction, and transmitting a decision message, wherein the decision message includes an indication of whether the transaction satisfies the policy ruleset. Systems and computer program products are also disclosed.

title: Medical image registration method and system based on full convolution neural network and mutual information
assignee: 广州市大智网络科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image registration method and a medical image registration system based on a full convolution neural network and mutual information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out image transformation on the first two-dimensional image and the second two-dimensional image by adopting a full convolution neural network model to obtain three-dimensional transformation parameters; updating the second three-dimensional image according to the three-dimensional transformation parameters; calculating mutual information values of the first three-dimensional image and the second three-dimensional image; and carrying out iterative optimization on the mutual information value to obtain the optimal three-dimensional transformation parameter. According to the method, the initial value of mutual information registration is obtained through the full convolution neural network, so that the search value is close to the global optimal solution, the search times are reduced, and the registration speed is improved; mutual information registration search is carried out by adopting the mutual information value, and the precision of image registration is improved. The invention can be widely applied to the field of image processing.

title: Method, device and equipment for training model
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for training a model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving parameter matrixes transmitted by other nodes except the current node in the distributed cluster in the process that the current node performs the current training based on the current parameter matrix; after the current node finishes the training of the round, if the number of the received parameter matrixes is greater than or equal to a preset threshold value, determining a next round of parameter matrixes based on the received parameter matrixes and the parameter matrixes obtained after the current node finishes the training of the round; and controlling the current node to perform the next round of training based on the next round of parameter matrix. The invention can greatly reduce the dependence of the scheme on the parameter server, and can avoid the too single parameter matrix used for training and promote the effect of the subsequent model training because the parameter matrix of the next training of the current node is determined based on the received parameter matrix sent by other nodes.

title: B ultrasonic image selection method and system
assignee: 上海深至信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a B ultrasonic image selection method and a B ultrasonic image selection system, which belong to the technical field of medical image processing and comprise the following steps: s1, decomposing a video to be processed into multi-frame images; step S2, extracting the corresponding feature set from the features; step S3, evaluating to obtain a corresponding quality evaluation value; s4, forming a first image sequence according to the quality evaluation value sequence, and recording frame numbers; s5, comparing frame numbers in pairs according to the sequence; step S6, matching the image similarity in pairs according to the sequence, and when the similarity is greater than a similarity threshold, reserving a next image in the two images to obtain a third image sequence; and S7, extracting a frame number corresponding to each frame of image of the third image sequence as a preview node, and fusing the frame number into a progress bar of the video to be processed. The invention has the beneficial effects that: based on a deep learning method, images containing focuses and video subsections where the images are located in an ultrasonic video sequence are extracted and provided for a doctor to preview, so that time is reduced, and diagnosis efficiency is improved.

title: Habilitation and/or rehabilitation methods and systems
abstract: A method, including capturing an individual's voice with a machine, and logging data corresponding to events and/or actions of the individual's real world auditory environment, wherein the individual is speaking while using a hearing assistance device, and the hearing assistance device at least one of corresponds to the machine or is a device used to execute the action of logging data.

title: System and method for generating a pulmonary dysfunction nourishment program
abstract: A system and method for generating a pulmonary dysfunction nourishment program, comprises a computing device configured to receive at least a respiratory volume collection relating to a user, generate at least a respiratory parameter of a plurality of respiratory parameter as a function of the respiratory volume collection, determine a pulmonary bundle element as a function of the at least respiratory parameter, identify at least an edible as a function of the pulmonary bundle element, wherein identifying comprises, obtaining a nourishment composition from an edible directory, determining a nourishment deficiency as a function of the pulmonary bundle element, and identifying the at least edible as a function of the nourishment composition, the nourishment deficiency, and an edible machine-learning model, and output a nourishment program as a function of the at least edible.

title: Identification method for confusable sports injury entity words
assignee: 北京富通东方科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a recognition method for easily confused sports injury entity words, which is based on large-scale text corpus in the field of sports injury, trains word2vec semantic models, cuts the text corpus to generate character vector texts and vocabulary vector texts, and marks the character vector texts and the vocabulary vector texts of a training set, a verification set and a test set by adopting an automatic marking tool; creating codes for the character vector text and the vocabulary vector text and calculating the relative position codes of the character vector text and the vocabulary vector text. And then, carrying out first discrimination on the character vector text and the vocabulary vector text to obtain the predictive labels of the character vector text and the vocabulary vector text. And classifying the entity words with the predictive labels of symptoms, signs, inspection results and test results into groups to be determined, and carrying out secondary identification. By the method, the category of the entity word in the sports injury field can be effectively identified.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, computer equipment and medium
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application discloses an image processing method, an image processing device, computer equipment and a medium, wherein the image processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target medical image to be evaluated, and decomposing the target medical image into continuous single-frame images; processing each single-frame image according to a conversion rule to obtain at least one conversion image corresponding to the single-frame image; inputting the single frame image and at least one corresponding transformation image into a trained segmentation model to obtain a first probability estimation value corresponding to the single frame image and a second probability estimation value corresponding to each transformation image; calculating a quality score of the single frame image based on the first probability estimate and the second probability estimate. The image processing method provided by the application realizes the image quality evaluation process in an unsupervised mode, and the image quality evaluation process is more accurate and reliable.

title: Method for adjusting color of image and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for adjusting the color of an image and an apparatus using the same. Specifically, according to the method of the present invention, a computing apparatus obtains an image, classifies a class for each of the image elements, which are individual elements constituting the image and obtains a result image by adjusting the color of each of the image elements by referring to the class. Therefore, the accuracy and efficiency of image classification can be increased.

title: System and method for data driven risk relationship review tool
abstract: A system to provide an automated data driven risk relationship review tool via a back-end application computer server of an enterprise. A resource allocation data store may contain electronic records representing requested resource allocations between the enterprise and a plurality of entities. The server may receive an indication of a selected requested resource allocation and retrieve, from the resource allocation data store, the electronic record associated with the selected requested resource allocation. The server may automatically calculate a first and second review date for the selected requested resource allocation and automatically establish a communication link based on the first review date for the selected requested resource allocation. The system may then support a graphical interactive user interface display via a distributed communication network, the interactive user interface display providing resource allocation data in connection with the second review date.

title: Prediction system and method based on federal learning
assignee: 湖南三湘银行股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a forecasting system and method based on federal learning, which comprises the following steps: the collecting unit is used for collecting the user prediction request to determine the number of key words and the actual data length of the user prediction request; the alignment unit is used for carrying out data alignment on the prediction requests collected by the collection unit; the federal learning unit is used for predicting the aligned data to obtain a prediction result; the feedback unit is used for feeding back the prediction result to the user sending the prediction request; the control unit is respectively connected with the collection unit and the alignment unit and is used for controlling the alignment process of the data corresponding to the prediction request of the user; therefore, the data length can be determined according to the number of the keywords, the data capacity is determined according to the data length, the data capacity is accurately determined through the data capacity difference value so as to accurately judge whether the data are aligned, a more accurate prediction result can be obtained under the condition that the data are aligned, and the accuracy of the prediction result is effectively improved.

title: PET detector signal sampling method, device, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a PET detector signal sampling method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the PET detector signal sampling method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target electrical signal of a PET detector; sampling the target electric signal based on a first time period to obtain a first waveform signal; inputting the first waveform signal into a trained deep learning model to obtain a second waveform signal; and acquiring photon information corresponding to the target electric signal based on the second waveform signal. According to the PET detector signal sampling method, the PET detector signal sampling device, the electronic device and the storage medium, the low-frequency waveform signals are converted into the high-frequency waveform signals through the deep learning model, and the energy resolution is high and the cost is low when photon information is acquired.

title: Medical image processing method and device and computer equipment
assignee: 浙江太美医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a medical image processing method and device and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a position frame of at least one of character information and mark information in the medical image by detecting the medical image in the medical image sequence, and analyzing pixel data in the position frame to obtain pixel distribution characteristics in the position frame. And under the condition that no overlap exists between the position frame and the target area part and the target object does not meet the blind film reading condition, filling the inner area of the position frame by using the pixel average value on the position frame to obtain the target image sequence meeting the blind film reading condition. At the moment, the blind film reading condition is not met at the beginning of the medical image sequence, the examinee does not need to be checked and shot again, the occurrence probability of the medical examination of the examinee is reduced, unnecessary use of medical imaging equipment is reduced, and the execution of clinical test items is facilitated.
