title: Machine-learned entity function management
abstract: A system and a method are disclosed herein for machine-learned detection of outliers within entity functions. An entity management system uses machine learning to cluster data characterizing functions performed by entities, and determines one or more data clusters that are outliers. The system receives entity function data indicating a metric and a type, and provides the received data into a supervised machine learning model. The model is trained to apply a label to the entity function data, where the label indicates a classification of the data into a cluster (e.g., an outlier cluster). This outlier detection may inform the system's generation of a function monitor to guide rectifying action that addresses the detected outliers. The system may receive user input affirming or rejection the classification of the data into a particular cluster. The system may leverage the user input to retrain the supervised machine learning model.

title: Method and device for extracting entity concepts in medical record document and readable storage medium
assignee: 北京惠每云科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a method, a device and a readable storage medium for extracting entity concepts in a medical record document, wherein at least one candidate concept tuple is constructed and obtained on the basis of at least one entity concept word extracted from the medical record document and the attribute type of each entity concept word; determining a prediction judgment type of each candidate concept tuple based on a word vector of each word in each entity concept participle included in each candidate concept tuple, a type vector of an attribute type of each entity concept participle, a relation vector between every two entity concept participles and a completeness vector of the candidate concept tuple; determining at least one target concept tuple from at least one candidate concept tuple according to the prediction judgment type; and standardizing each target concept tuple to obtain at least one entity concept tuple for describing the medical record document. Therefore, the information in the medical record text can be simplified while the disease description information in the medical record text is unified.

title: Whole blood lumen guide plate design method based on 3D printing technology
abstract: A whole blood lumen guide plate design method based on a 3D printing technology. Belongs to the field of medical auxiliary instrument design. The existing aortic guide plate has the problem that the accurate positioning of branch openings and fenestration cannot be realized in the manufacturing process. A whole blood lumen guide plate design method based on a 3D printing technology comprises the following steps: obtaining three-dimensional data of a target by using CT original data with blood vessels through a three-dimensional reconstruction method; obtaining a CAD model of the nonparametric curved surface sheet by using three-dimensional data at a target through an AI intelligent algorithm; simulating the stress deformation of the blood vessel after the guide plate is implanted; designing windowing position parameters by a simulation result in a data processing center through a reverse engineering technology, and correcting the designed windowing position parameters according to a clinical windowing case to obtain an industrial STL model of the windowing guide plate; and printing the obtained industrial STL model by a 3D printer to obtain the resin windowing guide plate. The branch and windowing positions designed by the method are accurate.

title: Mobile sickle cell diagnostic tool
assignee: Rachel Olema Aitaru, Bonita Beatrice Nanziri
abstract: Implementing a mobile device configured to detect sickle cell traits in a blood sample. The device comprises a mobile device with a camera operatively coupled to a microscope lens. An image converter configured to receive an image form the camera and to perform a noise reduction procedure. The noise reduction procedure manipulates the image to a monochrome image and applies a Gaussian filter. A contour detector detects the contours of the image. An image analysis tool is configured to analyze the contours to identify discrete blood cells and clustered blood cells. The user is then notified if sickle cell traits are present based at least on the shape of the discrete blood cells.

title: Image screening method and device
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image screening method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a bone image from a chest X-ray; performing fusion processing on the chest X-ray film and the bone image to obtain a fusion image; inputting the fused image into an image screening model for testing to obtain an image screening result; the image screening model comprises a model determined by deep learning training based on a sample fusion image and an abnormal bone label of the sample fusion image. The invention can generate the skeleton image generated by the similar dual-energy subtraction technology on the conventional X-ray chest radiography, thereby greatly reducing the shielding of soft tissues on the skeleton, providing more clear and detailed focus information, realizing the full-automatic screening of the abnormal skeleton image and obtaining the image screening result with higher accuracy.

title: Medical image processing method based on dictionary studying upsampling
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image processing method based on dictionary studying upsampling, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The medical image processing method is realized by the following steps of: inputting an original medical image; cutting and reinforcing the original medical image; extracting the characteristics of the cut and reinforced medical image to obtain a training sample set and a testing sample set according the extracted characteristics; finding out boundary points of weakness samples from the training sample set to obtain the number of new samples to be generated according to the situation of the neighborhoods of the boundary points; generating required new samples by utilizing a sparse ligature and point getting method; adding the new samples into the training sample set to form a new training sample set; carrying out classifying diagnosis to the new training sample set to get a classifier; and diagnosing the testing sample set by adopting the classifier to get a final diagnosis result. The medical image processing method has the advantages of high recognition rate and strong generalization capability on medical image diagnosis, and can be used for medical workers to evaluate disease prognosis and therapeutic effect.

title: End-to-end autonomous navigation method for indoor mobile robot in unstructured environment
abstract: The invention discloses an end-to-end autonomous navigation method for an indoor mobile robot in a non-structural environment, which comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring a plane layout diagram in the unfamiliar building; 2) carrying out topology on the layout diagram and creating an undirected graph; 3) generating a shortest node path by using an undirected graph and combining a target room; 4) inputting the first visual angle image of the robot into a collision avoidance navigation module, and generating collision avoidance waypoints; 5) generating a collision-prevention path by utilizing a cubic spline, and tracking by model prediction control; 6) judging whether the target point is reached, if so, ending navigation, otherwise, returning to the step 3; by adopting the autonomous navigation method of the robot, the autonomous navigation can be realized by only using a single monocular RGB camera as visual input in a complex medical environment. The method has the advantages of simplicity, flexibility, economy, practicability, high accuracy and strong robustness.

title: Cuff type noninvasive hemodynamic artificial intelligence cloud monitoring system and method
assignee: 山东宝利好医疗器械有限公司, 北京立恒医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a cuff type noninvasive hemodynamic artificial intelligence cloud monitoring system and method, which comprises the following steps: sleeve area formula electrode, data acquisition box, information monitor terminal, artificial intelligence high in the clouds remote server, sleeve area formula electrode includes: cuff type blood pressure measurement, cuff concealed ECG and ICG electrodes built in the blood pressure cuff; the data acquisition box carries out synchronous data primary processing on the blood pressure data, the ECG and the ICG signals to generate human ECG and ICG noninvasive heart hemodynamic state original data, and the original data are sent to the artificial intelligent cloud remote server for storage filtering operation; and presenting the data of the information monitoring terminal to a user. The cuff type ICG built-in electrode enables a tested person to finish ICG detection without the help of other people. The data acquisition box is only responsible for completing data acquisition and transmission, and complex operations such as data processing, artificial intelligence and the like are completed by the separated artificial intelligence cloud server, so that the hardware requirement of the local data acquisition box is greatly reduced, and the volume and the cost are reduced.

title: Meta-learning cell nucleus segmentation system and method based on label correction
abstract: The invention discloses a cell nucleus segmentation system and a cell nucleus segmentation method based on label correction, wherein the system comprises a cell nucleus extraction module, a segmentation correction module and a post-processing module; the method comprises the following steps: extracting all connected domains for an original pathological picture and corresponding part noise labeling, and carrying out pixel-level mask correction; the noise label and the corresponding original image of each extracted connected domain are marked, the correction of the noise label is completed through the label correction network, and the training of the segmentation network is supervised; after the correction mask of each connected domain noise label is obtained, the mark of the overlapped cell nucleus is segmented by using a watershed algorithm with an identifier for all correction masks, and finally, the segmentation boundary can be obtained for each cell nucleus. The network model trained by the invention can accurately identify the boundary outline of each cell nucleus, assist the clinical diagnosis of pathology, improve the working efficiency of pathologists, and support the tasks of downstream tumor microenvironment research and the like.

title: Medical image processing method, apparatus, device and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a medical image processing method, a medical image processing device, medical image processing equipment and a storage medium. The terminal extracts a calculus central region from the calculus rough selection region by acquiring a CT scanning image and acquiring a calculus rough selection region obtained after labeling the CT scanning image, inputs the calculus central region into a preset neural network model, and outputs a calculus type result. In the method and the device, the terminal obtains the calculus central region by obtaining the calculus rough selection region obtained after the CT scanning image is labeled, the calculus central region is input into the preset neural network model, and the calculus type result is output, so that in the process of obtaining the calculus type result, the calculus central region is obtained by deep learning, the introduction of a non-calculus region in the process of obtaining the calculus type result is avoided, and the obtained calculus type result is more accurate.

title: System and method for joint abnormality detection and physiological condition estimation
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure provide methods and systems for joint abnormality detection and physiological condition estimation from a medical image. The exemplary method may include receiving, by at least one processor, the medical image acquired by an image acquisition device. The medical image includes an anatomical structure. The method may further include applying, by the at least one processor, a joint learning model to determine an abnormality condition and a physiological parameter of the anatomical structure jointly based on the medical image. The joint learning model satisfies a predetermined constraint relationship between the abnormality condition and the physiological parameter.

title: Method and system for intelligently identifying osteoarthritis based on deep learning
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for intelligently identifying osteoarthritis based on deep learning, which are applied to the field of image processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be processed; determining a first contour region of a first bone and a second contour region of a second bone in the image to be processed; projecting a plurality of discrete points on a first contour region at the far end of the first skeleton to a second contour region at the near end of the second skeleton to obtain a plurality of projection points corresponding to the discrete points one by one; determining a gap between the first bone and the second bone according to a distance between the plurality of discrete points and projected points corresponding to each of the plurality of discrete points. The method and the system for intelligently identifying the osteoarthritis based on the deep learning can improve the accuracy of the determined bone clearance.

title: Predictive analytical system and method
assignee: Board Of Supervisors Of Louisiana State University And Agricultural And Mechanical College
abstract: A system and method for generating a predictive model include accessing data from a dynamic dataset and a static dataset, generating a unique individual profile for each of a plurality of subjects within a population, assigning a class attribute to each subject, and based on the unique individual profile and the class attribute for each subject, developing a classification model based on the unique individual profile and the class attribute for each of the plurality of subject, and generating an individual score for each of the plurality of subjects using the classification model. The unique individual profile is generated from the data in the dynamic and the static datasets.

title: Systems and methods for an artificial intelligence system
abstract: A method is disclosed, which may include generating, in a natural language processing (NLP) system, a plurality of entity data objects. The method may include generating, in the NLP system, a plurality of activity data objects. The method may include generating, on at least one server, an evaluation data object. The evaluation data object may include a problem data object, an observation data object, or an action data object. The method may include configuring each problem data object, observation data object, or action data object of the evaluation data object with a scoring rubric. Other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.

title: Therapeutic bacterial composition
abstract: The invention relates to bacterial compositions useful in the treatment of cancer. In particular, the compositions can be used as a co-therapy with an immune checkpoint therapy. The invention also relates to methods for identifying a subject that will respond to therapy with an immune checkpoint inhibitor comprising determining the abundance of bacteria in a biological sample from said subject.

title: Automatic cervical cancer diagnosis system
abstract: The present invention relates to an automatic cervical cancer diagnosis system for performing machine learning by classifying cervical data required for automatic diagnosis of cervical cancer according to accurate criteria and automatically diagnosing cervical cancer based on the machine learning, the automatic cervical cancer diagnosis system including: a learning data generator configured to classify unclassified photographed image data for a cervix transmitted from an external device or a storage according a combination of multi-level classification criteria to generate learning data for each new classification criterion in a learning mode; a photographed image pre-processer configured to pre-process photographed cervix images; a cervical cancer diagnoser including a machine learning model for cervical cancer that learns a characteristic of the learning data generated for each classification criterion in the learning mode, wherein the machine learning model generates diagnosis information about whether cervical cancer has occurred with respect to the pre-processed photographed cervix image; a screen display controller configured to display and output a user interface screen configured to display the diagnosis information and inputting evaluation information according to a reading specialist; a retraining data generator configured to extract information required for retraining from the evaluation information input through the user interface screen and request retraining the machine learning model; and a diagnosis and evaluation information storage configured to store the diagnosis information about whether cervical cancer has occurred and the evaluation information input through the user interface screen.

title: How to increase the chances of clinical trial success probability by selecting gruops of patients with stroke
abstract: According to the present invention, a method for selecting a stroke patient group and increasing the probability of success in a clinical trial comprises: a first step in which an image acquisition unit acquires non-contrast CT images obtained by capturing the brains of a plurality of patients, who are a candidate group for a clinical trial for demonstrating the efficacy of drugs; a second step in which a pre-processing unit pre-processes the non-contrast CT images and determines whether the plurality of patients are in a non-hemorrhage state or a hemorrhage state based on the pre-processed image; a third step in which an image processing unit normalizes the pre-processed images and segments and extracts a region of interest (ROI) by using a preset standard mask template; a fourth step in which a determination unit determines whether the cerebral large vessel of the at least one patient is abnormal by using the segmented and extracted ROI; a fifth step in which when the cerebral large vessel has an abnormality, the determination unit estimates the ASPECTS of the at least one patient by using the segmented and extracted ROI; a sixth step in which only when the at least one patient of the plurality of patients has the estimated ASPECTS having a predesignated value or higher, the determination unit determines that the at least one patient is a first patient to which mechanical thrombectomy can be applied; and a seventh step in which a central management unit selects a patient group based on the acquired information and demonstrates the efficacy of drugs based on a clinical trial for the selected patient group. Therefore, provides are an ASPECTS estimation system and method for estimating ASPECTS, which are factors that discriminates stroke diseases from non-contrast CT images of brains.

title: Method, system and storable medium for predicting fetal congenital heart disease risk based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京妇产医院
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system and a storable medium for predicting fetal congenital heart disease risk based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the field of intelligent medical treatment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an ultrasonic image of a fetus; extracting features from the fetal ultrasonic image to obtain image features, wherein the image features comprise cardiovascular micro abnormal features and relative position data of the features in the ultrasonic image; inputting the image features into a classifier to obtain three classification results, wherein the three classification results are CHD risk-free, mild CHD risk-free and severe CHD risk-free; the classifier is a logistic regression model, and a secondary gradient method is introduced into the logistic regression model training to optimize updating of logistic regression model parameters. The method provided by the invention can accurately evaluate the risk of fetal suffering from congenital heart disease by utilizing artificial intelligence, ultrasonic image analysis and other technologies, can provide risk evaluation of fetal chromosomal abnormality, and has higher application value and clinical significance.

Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image containing a target object; and carrying out image segmentation on the first image by utilizing a U-shaped full convolution neural network model to obtain the boundary of the target object, wherein the U-shaped full convolution neural network model adopts a level set loss function. The invention solves the technical problems of low identification accuracy and poor repeatability of the target object in the prior art.

title: Bone marrow cell classification and identification method, device and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a bone marrow cell classification and identification method, device and system based on deep learning, and belongs to the field of medical image processing. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring a low-power mirror full-slice image of the bone marrow smear by utilizing a low-power mirror; (2) Cutting the low-power mirror full-slice image of the bone marrow smear into a plurality of low-power mirror small images with the size of the imaging visual field of the high-power mirror; (3) Classifying the low-power mirror small images obtained in the step (2) by using a trained image classification model to obtain low-power mirror small images with good visual fields; (4) Scanning and imaging a low-power mirror small image with a good visual field by using a high-power mirror to obtain a corresponding high-power mirror image; (5) Classifying and counting bone marrow cells in the high-power mirror image obtained in the step (4) by using a trained target detection model; (6) And carrying out blood disease prediction according to the classification and counting results of the bone marrow cells. The bone marrow cell identification and classification can be reliably and automatically realized, and the accuracy of blood disease prediction can be improved.

title: Terminal Device for use in Lonely-Death Management
abstract: A terminal device for use in lonely-death management includes a terminal worn by a subject and a cradle put in the place of the subject. The terminal includes a sensor part for collecting state information including information on the health or activity state of the subject and illuminance around the terminal, and a first communication part for transmitting the information collected by the sensor part to the management server for use in lonely-death management. The cradles comprise an illuminance sensor for collecting the illumination of the place and a second communication part for transmitting the collected illuminance to the terminal. The terminal transmits illumination information to the management server. The management server determines whether the lonely death of the subject occurs or there is the risk of lonely death based on the illuminance.

title: Electronic medical record data processing method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic medical record data processing method, which comprises the following steps: collecting electronic health data and serology detection index data, and performing vascular calcification grade evaluation on the electronic health data and the serology detection index data to obtain a sample label data set; carrying out data screening and feature selection preprocessing on the sample label data set to obtain feature representation of the calcification state; constructing an embedding layer by adopting the characteristic representation of the calcification state to obtain a multi-dimensional vector embedding model; inputting the multi-dimensional vector embedding model to construct a historical calcification state set, selecting the historical calcification states in the multi-historical calcification state set by adopting an agent to obtain the state environment of the agent, and carrying out self-adaptive learning on the state environment through an LSTM network to obtain a vascular calcification assessment model according to the historical calcification states and the calcification states at the last moment. The evaluation accuracy of the model is improved by adopting a dynamic spanning long-short term reinforced memory network to fuse the calcification state data of the electronic medical record in different periods.

title: False alarm reduction systems and related methods
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents Acting For And On Behalf Of Northern Arizona University, The Regents Of The University Of Michigan
abstract: Implementations of a system for determining the relevancy of a plurality of alarms may include: a plurality of sensors configured to be coupled to a patient, wherein the plurality of sensors is configured to gather physiological data, a medical monitoring device coupled to the plurality of sensors through a telecommunication channel, and wherein the medical monitoring device is configured to determine a physiological state of the patient using the physiological data. The medical monitoring device may be further configured to issue a plurality of alarm states, and a processing unit coupled to the medical monitoring device through a telecommunication channel, is then configured to evaluate the plurality of alarm states, determine the relevancy of each alarm state of the plurality of alarm states, and issue one or more alarms corresponding with each relevant alarm state to a computing device associated with a user.

abstract: The disclosure discloses a method for predicting traffic flow, relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to the field of big data and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: generating a functional relation diagram and a flow relation diagram of a plurality of traffic areas; generating flow characteristics of a target traffic area according to historical flow information of the target traffic area in the traffic areas; generating flow function relation features aiming at a target traffic area based on the function relation graph and the flow relation graph; and predicting the flow of the target traffic area according to the flow characteristics and the flow functional relation characteristics. The disclosure also discloses a device for predicting traffic flow, electronic equipment and a storage medium.

abstract: The invention provides a temporal-mandibular joint gap area automatic measurement method based on deep learning, which realizes the segmentation of temporal-mandibular joints and the automatic measurement of gap areas thereof, and relates to the field of medical image analysis. According to the invention, the VNet neural network is utilized for image segmentation, sagittal plane screening and positioning of the region to be detected are carried out on the basis of the segmentation map, the front and rear areas of the temporomandibular joint gap of the selected section are measured, the corresponding measurement regions are marked in the CBCT image and the segmentation map, the problems of automatic measurement and marking of the temporomandibular joint gap area are solved, and the problems of working efficiency of stomatologists and manual error segmentation and measurement caused by clinical experience are solved to a certain extent by realizing image segmentation and automatic measurement.

title: State-based atrial event detection
abstract: An implantable medical device includes a memory storing criteria for transitioning between states of a cardiac cycle model, the states including a P-wave state. The device also includes sensing circuitry that senses a cardiac signal that varies as a function of a cardiac cycle of a patient, and also includes processing circuitry coupled to the sensing circuitry. The processing circuitry is configured to detect an R-wave in the sensed cardiac signal, to determine an elapsed time since the detection of the R-wave, to determine one or more morphological values of a post-R-wave segment of the cardiac signal to compare the elapsed time and the one or more morphological values to the stored criteria for transitioning between the plurality of states of the cardiac cycle model, and to detect a P-wave in the sensed cardiac signal in response to a transition to the P-wave state of the cardiac cycle model.

title: System and method for diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment of obstructive sleep apnea
assignee: University Of Maryland, Baltimore, Sonosa Medical, Inc.
abstract: A method and system detects a hypoxic condition during an obstruction of an airway of a subject to detect and treat obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) in the subject. The method and system includes an organ stimulating transducer configured for placement in a vicinity of an organ of the subject to stimulate the organ and remove the obstruction when OSA is detected.

abstract: The invention provides a generation method and a platform of a personalized demand scheme of pregnant women, wherein the method comprises a preparation process of a medical database, a pregnant woman data collection process and a matching process of data; the preparation process of the medical database comprises the steps of establishing a medical database and a pregnancy nutrition education knowledge base, and automatically analyzing each education material to obtain an education knowledge portrait label; the pregnant woman data collection process comprises the steps of obtaining a pregnant woman nutrition portrait label through on-line release portrait questionnaires, and determining the pregnant woman diagnosis portrait label through collecting diagnosis and treatment scheme information of the pregnant woman in a plurality of systems; the matching process of the data specifically comprises the following steps: and comparing and matching the pregnant woman nutrition portrait label and the diagnosis portrait label with the medical nutrition portrait label or the medical diagnosis portrait label of each medical material and the education knowledge portrait label of each education material, thereby making a personalized requirement scheme which is most suitable for the pregnant woman and pushing the personalized requirement scheme to the pregnant woman.

title: Method for deformation correction
abstract: A method for deformation correction includes receiving a preoperative 3D image data set from an examination region of an examination object, generating a segmented 3D image data set by segmenting an anatomical structure in the preoperative 3D image data set, and acquiring image data from the examination region. A medical object is arranged in the examination region. The medical object is identified in the image data, and the segmented 3D image data set is registered with the image data. An overlay data set is generated and displayed based on the segmented 3D image data set and the image data. A position of a deviation between the image data and the segmented 3D image data set is defined, and a deformation rule is determined for the reduction of the deviation between the image data and the segmented 3D image data set. The corrected overlay data set is generated and provided.

title: CT image denoising processing method, device, computer equipment and medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a data processing technology, and provides a CT image denoising processing method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: the first CT real image set is processed by adding noise to obtain a first CT noise image set; classifying the first CT noise image set to obtain a first CT noise image subset, and configuring a task set according to the first CT noise image subset; performing meta-migration learning based on the task set to obtain target meta-model parameters; updating the initial CT image denoising model to obtain a target CT image denoising model; acquiring a second CT noise image to be denoised, denoising the second CT noise image to obtain a second CT denoised image; calculating loss values of the second CT real image and the second CT denoising image, and detecting whether the loss values are smaller than a preset loss threshold value; and when the detection result is yes, denoising the second CT real image to obtain a target CT image. The CT image processing method and device can improve accuracy of CT image noise removal processing and promote intelligent medical treatment and intelligent city construction.

abstract: The invention discloses a chronic kidney disease supervision method, device, equipment and storage medium based on big data. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring physical condition data of each object to be screened in the crowd to be screened; according to a pre-stored big data analysis model, analyzing the physical condition data of each object to be screened, and screening out the object suffering from chronic kidney disease; determining the chronic kidney disease stage corresponding to the object according to a pre-stored chronic kidney disease stage standard and physical condition data of the object; according to the physical condition data of the object and the chronic kidney disease stage corresponding to the object, a chronic kidney disease management scheme aiming at the object is formulated; and issuing the chronic kidney disease management scheme to the terminal equipment of the object, and/or issuing the chronic kidney disease management scheme to the terminal equipment of the medical staff. By the mode, the technical problem that monitoring and management cannot be carried out on each period of chronic kidney disease in the prior art is solved.

abstract: The invention relates to a knocking signal-based early warning system which comprises a mattress body, a sensing unit, a processing unit, an early warning unit, a decision unit and a monitoring unit, wherein the sensing unit responds to external excitation received by the mattress body and acquires power information of the mattress body; the decision unit responds to the successful matching of the characteristic value and the corresponding trigger condition, determines a monitoring scheme based on the characteristic value and the matching relation of the characteristic value and the corresponding trigger condition, and starts the monitoring unit based on the monitoring scheme, and the processing unit generates early warning information and transmits the early warning information to the early warning unit based on the physiological data information and/or the environmental data information acquired by the monitoring unit under the condition that the physiological data information and/or the environmental data information are abnormal.

title: System and method for extracting a periodic signal from video
abstract: What is disclosed is a system and method for processing a video to extract a periodic signal which was captured by the video imaging device. One embodiment involves the following. First, a video of a subject in a scene is received. The video is acquired by a video imaging device. There is an underlying motion signal in the scene corresponding to cardiac or respiratory function. A time-series signal is generated for each pixel or for each group of pixels in a temporal direction across a plurality of image frames. Time-series signals of interest are selected. The selected time-series signals of interest are then processed to obtain a periodic signal corresponding to cardiac or respiratory function. The present method has a low computational complexity, is robust in the presence of noise, and finds its uses in applications requiring real-time motion quantification of a signal in a video.

title: Signal noise removing method based on reconstruction signal substituting frequency spectrum data
abstract: The method comprises: extracting the singular point and singular value from the observed signal g(x); using the singular point and singular value to construct the relevant singular function; using the frequency spectrum zero-setting threshold preset by the system to construct the noise-removing function and permutation function; according to said result, using the reconstructed signal substitution method to get the noise-removed signals.

title: Depression detection method and system based on voice pre-training model
abstract: The invention relates to a depression detection method and a depression detection system based on a voice pre-training model, comprising the steps of establishing a voice database; relevant data for voice feature effectiveness analysis and classifier training optimization; performing voice pretreatment; including pre-emphasis, windowing, and fast fourier variations; extracting voice characteristics based on a pre-training model; extracting voice characteristics representing depression degree; classifying based on machine learning; the obtained model tests the voice signal and outputs the corresponding depression state as the depression detection basis for judging the tested person. According to the depression detection method and system based on the voice pre-training model, based on the machine learning technologies such as voice feature extraction of the voice pre-training model, a time delay neural network and a door control circulation unit algorithm, whether a tested person suffers from depression is objectively estimated in a voice reading mode by searching the relation between voice features and depression; the accuracy and precision of depression identification are improved.

title: Fast synthetic Haralick texture generation for histology images
abstract: Embodiments discussed herein facilitate training deep learning models to generate synthetic versions of histological texture features and employing such deep learning models. One example embodiment is an apparatus configured to convert a stained histological image to grayscale; extract patches from the grayscale image; for each patch of the plurality of patches: provide that patch to a deep learning model trained to generate a synthetic version of a texture feature; and obtain an associated patch from the deep learning model that indicates an associated value of the synthetic version of the histology texture feature for each pixel of that patch; and merge the associated patches for each patch of the plurality of patches to generate an associated feature map for the stained histological image, wherein the associated feature map indicates the associated value of the synthetic version of the histology texture feature for each pixel of the plurality of pixels.

title: Apparatus and method for predicting suicide criticality
abstract: Disclosed is an apparatus for predicting the suicide criticality. The apparatus comprises: an input unit for receiving demographic information, visit information, a plurality of digitized questionnaire records and correlation information between the questionnaire information with respect to at least one subject; a deep learning model for storing information with respect to the subject input through the input unit on a flat matrix and generating input data for each subject; and a processor for controlling the deep learning model to learn the suicide criticality by performing a deep learning operation on the input data generated for each subject. Accordingly, the criticality of the suicide attempt result can be predicted accurately.

title: Medical image analyzing system and method thereof
abstract: A medical image analyzing system and a medical image analyzing method are provided and include inputting at least one patient image into a first model of a first neural network module to obtain a result having determined positions and ranges of an organ and a tumor of the patient image; inputting the result into a plurality of second models of a second neural network module, respectively, to obtain a plurality of prediction values corresponding to each of the plurality of second models and a model number predicting having cancer in the plurality of prediction values; and outputting a determined result based on the model number predicting having cancer and a number threshold value. Further, processes between the first model and the second models can be automated, thereby improving identification rate of pancreatic cancer.

title: Cerebral hematoma volume analysis
abstract: A system performs cerebral hematoma analysis. The system includes a computing device receiving computerized tomography (CT) images from CT imaging devices. The CT images are associated with patients exhibiting cerebral hematomas. CT images may be converted into feature vectors and passed as input to a convolution neural network model for identification and diagnosis of hematoma volume changes. Detected changes may be thresholded to determine if the change represents an increase or shrinkage in the volumetry of the hematoma.

title: Intelligent health monitoring and early warning method and system based on machine learning
assignee: 宁波伟吉电力科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent health monitoring and early warning method and system based on machine learning. Then calculating threshold parameters corresponding to the biological sign based on the historical biological sign data of the user, and correspondingly representing the historical biological sign data as original probability distribution of corresponding categories based on an original probability density function of the threshold parameters; the categories of the original probability distribution are undirected graphs or directed graphs or hidden Markov chains. And finally, simulating by adopting a conditional random field, and updating an original probability density function. Deriving a group of thresholds from the updated density function, calculating the threshold probability in the group by adopting a probability classification-based method, and selecting the threshold with the maximum probability as an alarm threshold corresponding to the organism sign. The intelligent health detection system can provide services for the health of the elderly in an omnibearing and multi-angle manner, and realizes personalized intelligent health detection and emergency services.

abstract: An example operation includes one or more of receiving a request associated with a software library, identifying metadata of the software library, determining, via chaincode, whether data of the software library has been previously stored on a blockchain, and in response to a determination that the software library has not been previously stored, storing the identified metadata of the software library and a notarization value generated by the chaincode within the blockchain.

title: Three-dimensional reconstruction method of binocular near-infrared limb vein image based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to a binocular near-infrared limb vein image three-dimensional reconstruction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: 1: dividing the vein part from the original image; 2: generating a high-precision global dense disparity map set of limbs; 3: dividing the vein part pixel disparity values in the high-precision global dense disparity map obtained in the step 2 to generate a vein dense disparity map data set; 4: training a deep neural network model by utilizing the corresponding limb vein segmentation data set and the vein dense disparity map data set; 5: inputting the binocular near-infrared limb images into a depth neural network model to generate a vein dense disparity map corresponding to the group of binocular images; 6: a three-dimensional model of the limb vein is generated. Compared with the prior art, the vein density disparity map generation method can generate the vein density disparity map in real time from the binocular near-infrared image, so that the three-dimensional model and the pose information of the limb vein can be acquired in real time, and the vein puncture robot can adjust and plan the motion trail in real time.

title: Medical data processing method, and prediction model training method and device
assignee: 颐保医疗科技(上海)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical data processing method, a prediction model training method and a prediction model training device. The medical data processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first medical data parameter of a first object and a second medical data parameter of a second object; respectively performing parameter expansion on the first medical data parameter and the second medical data parameter based on a first expansion rule, and performing associated parameter expansion on the first medical data parameter and the second medical data parameter based on a second expansion rule to obtain expanded medical data parameters; determining the distribution state of each expanded medical data parameter based on the prior distribution of each expanded medical data parameter, and performing iterative sampling on each expanded medical data parameter based on the distribution state; and screening the expanded medical data parameters according to the sampling result to determine effective medical data parameters. Invalid medical data parameters are removed, the number of samples required in the process of training the prediction model is reduced, and small sample training of the prediction model is achieved.

title: Machine learning sample weight adjustment method and device, and storage medium

abstract: The disclosure relates to a machine learning sample weight adjustment method and device and a storage medium. The machine learning sample weight adjustment method comprises the following steps: for scenes with unbalanced sample numbers of different types, after each round of model training in a multi-round iterative training process of the machine learning model, determining errors of sample predicted values and sample label values of each sample; and dynamically adjusting the current sample weight of each sample after model training according to the error between the sample predicted value and the sample label value, and taking the current sample weight as the sample weight of the next model training. The method and the device can realize dynamic and fine adjustment of the weight of the learning sample through heuristic iterative ideas.

title: Techniques for improved automatic drug delivery performance using delivery tendencies from past delivery history and use patterns
abstract: Disclosed are a device, system, methods and computer-readable medium products that provide techniques to implement functionality to receive blood glucose measurements over a period of time. An average of missing blood glucose measurement values may be maintained over a predetermined time period. A count of a number of missing blood glucose measurement values over a period of time may be established. A controller may calculate a divergence of the number of missing blood glucose measurement values over the period of time from the average of missing blood glucose measurements over the predetermined time period. Based on a value of the divergence, a determination that a safety constraint for delivery of insulin is to be reduced. The safety constraint may be reduced by a predetermined percentage. An instruction to deliver an insulin dosage may be generated according to the reduced safety constraint may be forwarded to a wearable drug delivery device.

title: Dermatological identification method, dermatological identification device, dermatological identification equipment and dermatological identification storage medium based on image processing
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the field of artificial intelligence and digital medical treatment, and provides a dermatological disease identification method, device, equipment and storage medium based on image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a skin image to be identified; performing image preprocessing on the skin image to obtain a target image; performing recognition processing on the target image through a pre-trained image recognition model to obtain the probability of the skin disease category corresponding to each skin disease category; performing recognition processing on the target image through the image recognition model to obtain the probability of the skin disease part corresponding to each skin part; according to the probability of the skin disease part, screening the skin part to obtain a target skin disease part; sorting the skin disease categories according to the skin disease category probability to generate a candidate skin disease category sequence; and filtering the skin disease categories of the candidate skin disease category sequence according to the target skin disease position to obtain the target skin disease category. The method can improve the accuracy of skin disease identification.
