title: Full-automatic intelligent fundus disease diagnosis system
abstract: The utility model provides a full-automatic intelligent eye ground disease diagnostic system. Specifically, the utility model provides a diagnostic system includes: (a) a fully automatic fundus camera (2) comprising: a photographing control unit, a base (25), and a camera body (21) having an optical head (24) provided on the base, a mandibular rest (23), and a forehead rail support; (b) a starting unit and (c) an analytical diagnostic unit. The utility model provides a full-automatic intelligent eye ground disease diagnostic system has functions such as eye ground image acquisition, disease diagnosis, report out and medical treatment or further referral suggestion. The utility model discloses a diagnostic system can practice thrift medical resource greatly, is applicable to each rank medical institution including basic unit's medical institution.

title: Identifying adversarial attacks with advanced subset scanning
abstract: An illustrative embodiment includes a method for detecting whether a given item within input data is anomalous. The method includes: extracting activations at respective nodes of an autoencoder trained on the data, the activations comprising activations at the respective nodes for the given item within the data and for one or more other items within the data; calculating p-values corresponding to the respective nodes, wherein the p-value for a given node represents a proportion of the activations at the given node for the other items which are greater than the activations at the given node for the given item; determining at least one score at least in part by scanning for a subset of the respective nodes which maximizes a statistical scoring function applied to the corresponding p-values; and providing a visualization of at least the given item within the input data to a human user.

title: Medical data processing method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京友谊医院
abstract: The specification discloses a medical data processing method, a medical data processing device, a storage medium and an electronic device, which can at least partially solve the technical problem that the effect of model data processing caused by insufficient training samples in the related art is negatively influenced. The medical data processing method in this specification evaluates a plurality of amplification strategies and determines a target strategy that is more suitable for amplification from among them. And then, amplifying the target sample set by adopting a target strategy to obtain a training sample set. Because the target strategy is determined based on the evaluation result in the multiple amplification strategies, on one hand, the number of samples contained in the training sample set obtained by amplification of the target strategy is not too insufficient; on the other hand, the amplified samples contained in the method have low risk of causing negative influence on the training of the medical prediction model. Therefore, the medical prediction model trained based on the training sample set can obtain better model performance.

title: Sample processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a sample processing method, a sample processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical fields of artificial intelligence and deep learning in the technical field of data processing and the medical field. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a feature vector of a verification sample; according to the feature vector of the verification sample, grouping the verification sample into similar samples to obtain a plurality of similar sample groups; determining a target similar sample group meeting target screening requirements according to the plurality of similar sample groups; the target screening requirement is used for indicating screening of systematic error labeling samples or random error labeling samples; and screening error labeling samples from the training samples according to the target similar sample group.

title: Imaging body parts using sound
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to imaging a body part using sound. In an embodiment, a system includes a motion sensor and a processing device communicatively coupled to the motion sensor. The motion sensor is configured to sense an acceleration wave generated by sound emitted by a source and generate an acceleration measurement in response to sensing the acceleration wave, wherein the source is associated with a body part of the subject. The processing device is configured to receive the acceleration measurements and determine a location of the source using the location of the motion sensor and the acceleration measurements. Further, the processing device is configured to image the body part of the subject using the determined position of the source and the acceleration measurements.

title: Method and device for extracting multi-mode disease features
assignee: 武汉大学人民医院（湖北省人民医院）
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for extracting multi-mode disease features, which are characterized in that disease data of a historical patient of a target disease are collected, a medical record text is split, a disease description word and a disease description word of the disease description word and the disease description word are marked, the marked disease description word and the disease description word are associated to obtain the disease text features of the target disease, a medical examination image is subjected to feature extraction, multi-mode supplementary data is subjected to feature extraction to obtain the multi-mode supplementary features of the target disease, the disease text features, the auxiliary image features and the multi-mode supplementary features are combined to obtain the disease features of the target disease, so that the disease features of the target disease are more comprehensive and rich, and the disease text features are obtained by extracting the medical record text after carrying out word and sentence splitting, marking and association of different disease description dimensions, so that the disease text features are more accurate, and the disease feature of the target disease is greatly improved.

title: Medical image processing device, operation method therefor, and medical image processing program
abstract: There are provided a feature point extraction unit that extracts an anatomical feature point included in a medical image based on the medical image and a standardization conditions acquisition unit that acquires standardization conditions of pixel values of the medical image based on some pixel values around the anatomical feature point among the pixel values of the medical image.

title: Mouse embryo organ identification and scoring method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a mouse embryo organ identification and scoring method and a mouse embryo organ identification and scoring system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting original images of mouse embryos at different periods and carrying out artificial annotation; inputting the original image and the annotation file of the mouse embryo into a Mask-RCNN network for training to obtain an organ recognition model; intercepting organs in the marked image from an original image, taking the organs and corresponding scores as training set data, and respectively training different convolutional neural networks to obtain image score models capable of respectively scoring the development of each organ; inputting an original image of a mouse embryo to be identified into an organ identification model, and outputting all organs in the image; intercepting all organs from an original image, and respectively inputting the organs into an image scoring model to obtain development scores of all the organs; a total score is obtained. The invention can quickly and accurately identify the organs in the mouse embryo and judge the current development stage of each organ.

title: Medical image report information extraction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 浙江太美医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a medical image report information extraction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: recognizing text information from the target medical image report based on an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model; assembling the text information into paragraph text to filter out target type text information; extracting entity information from the target type text information based on a first neural network model and a Trie tree respectively; merging the extracted entity information based on the word frequency probability to determine target entity information; and extracting relationship information from the target entity information based on a second neural network model. Therefore, the user can conveniently look up the key information of the medical image report, and the reliability of the information extraction result is high.

title: Sentiment-based navigation
abstract: Sentiment-based navigation is provided herein. A method can include extracting features of sensor data captured by a sensor associated with a vehicle, wherein the sensor data is representative of a subject selected from a group of subjects comprising an occupant of the vehicle and an environment in which the vehicle is located, resulting in extracted features. The method can further include determining sentiment data representative of an emotional condition of the occupant of the vehicle based on an analysis of the extracted features, and generating a navigation route for the vehicle from an origin point to a destination point based on the sentiment data.

title: Ultrasound image two-stage deep learning breast tumor classification method and device
assignee: 浙江机电职业技术学院
abstract: The invention discloses a breast tumor classification method and a breast tumor classification device for ultrasound image two-stage deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a BI-RADS tag image set D1 from a breast tumor ultrasonic image, and obtaining a biopsy tag image set D2 from the BI-RADS tag image set D1; training the deep neural network M1 and the deep neural network M2 through the BI-RADS tag image set D1 and the biopsy tag image set D2; initializing the parameters of a deep neural network M2 with the same structure as that of the deep neural network M1 by adopting the trained parameters of the deep neural network M1; classifying the BI-RADS labels of the breast tumor ultrasound images to be classified; and when the BI-RADS label is 3 grades or above, classifying the biopsy label of the breast tumor ultrasonic image to be classified, and determining the benign and malignant of the breast tumor ultrasonic image to be classified. The method can effectively improve the accuracy and the intelligent level of the classification diagnosis of the breast tumor ultrasonic image, and can be used for assisting the sonographer in the fields of medical diagnosis and the like.

title: System and method for improving exercise performance using a mobile device
abstract: A computing device for implementing a sensor-less method to improve exercise performance is described. An engine of the computing device receives, from a camera of the computing device, video exercise data associated with a user performing an active exercise and then converts the video via a deep learning algorithm to one or more movements of a user's skeleton in real-time performing the active exercise. A first movement of the one or more movements is compared to a predictive model associated with an ideal performance of the first movement. A confidence score is assigned to the comparison. Feedback data is transmitted to a graphical user interface of the computing device for display to the user, where the feedback data includes the confidence score and instructions on how the user can improve the first movement to raise the confidence score.

title: Glioma classification method and device based on twin neural network and image histology
abstract: The invention discloses a glioma classification method and device based on a twin neural network and image histology, and the glioma classification method and device comprises the following steps: collecting T1 reinforced brain magnetic resonance image data of a glioma patient and corresponding glioma grading label data, preprocessing the magnetic resonance image data, and dividing the collected magnetic resonance image data into a training set and a testing set; normalizing the size of the preprocessed magnetic resonance image data, and constructing a twin neural network training sample set; and the like. After massive depth feature data and image group learning feature data are obtained, a new feature selection scheme is provided, namely, screening results of a group of existing front edge feature selection algorithms are integrated through a majority voting rule, so that a feature selection process is more complete and reasonable, and the scheme can realize further optimization of feature selection by selecting feature selection algorithms based on different principles as much as possible to complement advantages.

title: Etiology diagnosis method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 中国医学科学院阜外医院
abstract: The invention provides a etiology diagnosis method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining electrocardiographic information of the patient when the etiology diagnosis of the patient is required; judging whether the patient accords with the continuous monomorphic ventricular tachycardia diagnosis condition according to the electrocardiogram information, if so, acquiring case data of the patient, inputting the case data into a etiology diagnosis information model, and obtaining etiology diagnosis information after model processing; determining at least one target etiology diagnosis model in the first etiology diagnosis model and the second etiology diagnosis model; inputting the etiology diagnosis information into a target etiology diagnosis model, and obtaining diagnosis information output by the model after model processing; and determining the etiology diagnosis result of the patient according to the diagnosis information output by each target etiology diagnosis model. By applying the method of the invention, the etiology diagnosis model can assist doctors in carrying out the etiology diagnosis work of the continuous monomorphic ventricular tachycardia, thereby improving the diagnosis accuracy.
assignee_clean: 中国医学科学院阜外医院
primary_assignee: 中国医学科学院阜外医院

title: Automated conversational response generation
abstract: Systems, computer-implemented methods, and/or computer program products facilitating a process to identify and respond to a primary electronic message are provided. According to an embodiment, a system can comprise a memory that stores computer executable components and a processor that executes the computer executable components stored in the memory. The computer executable components can include a determination component can determine that a primary electronic message has not received a response electronic message. An analysis component can generate a generated electronic message addressing the informational or emotional content of the primary electronic message. In one or more embodiments, an updating component can update the analytical model based on one or more feedbacks to the generated electronic message, where the analytical model can remain active while being updated. The one or more feedbacks can comprise a feedback from an entity-in-the-loop monitoring outputs of the analytical model including the generated electronic message.

title: Method for selecting uplink carrier and device supporting the same
abstract: Provided are a method of selecting uplink carrier and a device supporting the method. According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, the method includes: configuring multiple uplink (UL) carriers for a cell; acquiring information on congestion of at least one of the multiple UL carriers; selecting one UL carrier among the multiple UL carriers based on the acquired information on congestion.

title: Method for deriving cell quality and device supporting the same
abstract: Provided are a method for deriving cell quality and a device supporting the method. According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, the method includes: measuring a first reference signal (RS) group transmitted in a first measurement window; deriving a first cell quality of a cell for the first measurement window, based on M best RSs of the first RS group; measuring a second RS group transmitted in a second measurement window; and deriving a second cell quality of the cell for the second measurement window, when the second RS group includes N RSs among the M best RSs of the first RS group.

title: Probabilistic atlases of post-treatment multi-parametric MRI scans reveal distinct hemispheric distribution of glioblastoma progression versus pseudo-progression
abstract: Embodiments discussed herein facilitate generating a quantitative population atlas of tumor progression (TP) versus pseudo-progression (PsP) in Glioblastoma (GBM). A first set of embodiments discussed herein relates to generating a quantitative population atlas of TP versus PsP based on a plurality of multi-parametric (mpMRI) studies of a population of patients demonstrating GBM. A second set of embodiments discussed herein relates to computing a probability that a patient will experience PsP or TP based on a DICE analysis of a mapping of a diagnostic mpMRI study associated with the patient into the quantitative population atlas space.

title: System and methods for post-cardiac MRI images
abstract: Systems and methods for post processing cardiac magnetic resonance images are described that utilize a machine-learning algorithm. Embodiments of the systems and methods maximize physician and technologist efficiency by minimizing the necessary manual labor that is required to post-process medical images through smart-automation, thereby improving consistency and reproducibility of post-processing results by minimizing operator bias.

title: Methods and systems for nutritional recommendation using artificial intelligence analysis of immune impacts
abstract: A system for nutritional recommendation using artificial intelligence analysis of immune impacts includes a computing device designed and configured to receive a test result detecting an effect of at least an aliment on at least a biomarker, determine an immune system impact of the at least an aliment as a function of the at least a biomarker using a machine-learning process, the machine-learning process trained using a first training set relating biomarker levels to immune system function, generate a nutritional recommendation using the determined immune system impact, and provide the nutritional recommendation to the user.

title: Assessing unreliability of clinical risk prediction
abstract: Aspects of the invention include includes identifying a respective estimated clinical risk score for each of a first group of patients and a second group of patients. An alternative probability estimate is generated using a same set of inputs used to determine each respective estimated clinical risk score. An unreliability of a patient's clinical risk score is determined based at least in part on a feature of the patient and on a difference between the alternative probability estimate and the determined respective estimated clinical risk score.

title: Processing delay predictions based on queue assessments
abstract: Systems and methods of processing delay predictions based on queue assessments are described herein. In some examples, the queues may correspond to queues for usage and/or access of resources. A central server can manage one or more queues for the resources. Queue elements can correspond to requests for performing a task, which can include a task for using and/or accessing a resource. The queue elements can remain in the queue until processing of the task is initiated.

title: Multi-mode diffusion optical tomography reconstruction method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode diffusion optical tomography reconstruction method based on deep learning, which belongs to the field of medical image processing, and aims to solve the technical problems of realizing end-to-end optical characteristic parameter direct reconstruction by fusing an optical signal and nuclear magnetic resonance imaging.

title: Using host connectivity states to avoid queuing I/O requests
abstract: Using host connectivity states to avoid queuing I/O requests: identifying a fault in data communications between a first storage system and a second storage system among a plurality of storage systems across which a dataset is synchronously replicated; updating, upon identifying the fault, an access state of a data communications path between first storage system and a host from an active state to a transitional state with respect to the dataset; and indicating, to the host, a first access state change.

title: Video target detection method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: A video object detection method, apparatus, device and medium based on artificial intelligence are disclosed. The video target detection method comprises the following steps: acquiring target detection information of a current image frame in a video and a target detection result of at least one historical image frame in the video; determining a target detection threshold for a current image frame based on target detection results for at least one historical image frame; and determining a target detection result of the current image frame based on the target detection information of the current image frame and the target detection threshold value of the current image frame. The target detection threshold of the current image frame is determined based on the target detection result of the historical image frame, so that the stability of the detection result of the continuous image frame and the recall rate of the continuous image frame are improved; when the video image shakes or shakes, the non-target area is prevented from being judged as the target, and the target detection accuracy is improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯医疗健康 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯医疗健康 深圳 有限公司

title: Pen and voice-based cooperative task nervous system disease auxiliary diagnosis system
assignee: 中国科学院软件研究所
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of digital medical treatment, and relates to a multi-channel multitask nervous system disease auxiliary diagnosis system based on a pen and voice. The system comprises a data acquisition unit, a data preprocessing unit, a multi-channel interactive feature acquisition unit and a model construction and feedback unit. The system carries out synchronous task acquisition on handwriting signals and sound signals of a user, extracts multi-channel characteristics by utilizing the influence of brain nerve state change on aspects of motor cognition, pronunciation, multi-task cooperative processing and the like, considers the physiological characteristics of nervous system diseases in a pen interaction channel and a voice interaction channel single channel, simultaneously considers the physiological characteristics of different physiological channel characteristics such as correlation, mutual exclusion and the like when the pen channel and the voice channel cooperate in multi-task, and finally trains a decision model to analyze and judge whether the user has the nervous system diseases. The invention does not need any invasive treatment and can carry out the auxiliary diagnosis of the disease in real time, robustly and accurately.

title: Medical image cutting method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a medical image cutting method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the medical image to be cut into an image cutting model, and outputting a sub-medical image cut into small blocks; the image cutting model comprises an image offset module, a feature extraction module, a conditional random field module and a cutting module, wherein the image offset module is used for acquiring a plurality of second small sub-image sets in different areas according to a preset offset set and a first small sub-image in a first area, the feature extraction module is used for extracting features of each second small sub-image, the conditional random field module is used for acquiring probability that each second small sub-image is identical to the first small sub-image in label, loss values corresponding to the probabilities are calculated through a loss function, and the cutting module is used for cutting medical sample images. The embodiment of the invention can realize self-adaptive cutting of medical images, improves the training efficiency of the neural network and reduces the training cost of the neural network.

title: Method and system for real-time tracking of health condition of parturient
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for real-time tracking of the health condition of a parturient in labor, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a first nursing grade according to a first prenatal physical condition evaluation result of a first parturient, and then determining a first nursing requirement for the first parturient; acquiring image information of the predelivery environment of a first parturient to obtain the movement tracks of the first parturient and nursing staff; inputting the movement tracks of the lying-in woman and the nursing staff and a first nursing requirement into a first evaluation model to obtain a first nursing qualification degree; obtaining first vital sign data of a first maternal host; respectively obtaining the nursing qualification degree and the influence degree of the puerpera emotion change value on the first vital sign data; and adjusting the first care level according to the influence degree. The technical problem of unstable health condition of the old lying-in woman due to the fact that various factors influencing the health condition of the old lying-in woman before delivery can not be acquired in time and intelligently adjusted in the prior art is solved.

title: Pancreas CT image registration method integrating multipath characteristics and organ morphology guidance
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pancreatic CT image registration, and discloses a pancreatic CT image registration method combining multipath characteristics and organ morphology guidance, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring a reference image and an image to be registered, wherein the reference image and the image to be registered are pancreatic CT images; s2: preprocessing the acquired reference image and the image to be registered; s3: registering the preprocessed image to be registered through an organ morphology guiding registration network to obtain a pancreas morphology guiding deformation field; s4: extracting and fusing multipath features of the preprocessed image to be registered through a multipath feature registration network to obtain a multipath feature deformation field; s5: compounding the pancreas morphology guide deformation field and the multipath characteristic deformation field; s6: and (3) applying the composite deformation field obtained in the step (S5) to the preprocessed image to be registered to obtain a deformed image, and realizing the registration of the pancreatic CT image. The obtained registration image has higher accuracy, and better robustness and smoothness.

title: Microinjection system
assignee: 首都医科大学宣武医院
abstract: The present invention relates to a microinjection system, which may include an injection device arranged in a plurality of independently drivable injection channels, the injection device comprising a reservoir unit for storing a drug to be injected; the liquid delivery unit comprises a liquid outlet chamber and an infusion head, wherein the liquid outlet chamber is configured to suck medicine from the liquid storage unit or discharge medicine to the infusion head through volume change; a controller driving the liquid outlet chamber to suck or discharge the medicine to be injected based on the determined injection amount of the medicine to be injected; wherein, be provided with the detection room that is used for providing the optics testing result that is related to waiting to inject the medicine between liquid room and the infusion head to allow the controller to confirm the matching nature of injection channel and waiting to inject the medicine based on optics testing result.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学宣武医院
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学宣武医院

title: Secure communications
abstract: A system for providing secure communications may include a management system to receive first information, the first information being received via a first secure connection, analyze the received information to form analyzed information, and provide the analyzed information, a processor device to receive the analyzed information, the analyzed information being received via a second secure connection between the processor device and the management system, and perform an action based on the analyzed information, and a clearinghouse device to receive second information, the second information being received via a third secure connection between the clearinghouse device and each provider device of a plurality of provider devices, process the second information to form the first information, and provide the first information to the management system via the first secure connection.

title: Method for automating custom-fitting joint brace
abstract: An automated method for applying specific geometric constraints to a starter file and considering external specifications outside of fit to achieve an optimized, restorative joint brace or orthotic device. External specifications may include indications of the patient, biometric data, data from prescribing doctors, X-ray data, MRI data, joint geometry to restore optimized function, and envelope of motion. After the fitting process, the starter file undergoes a process of exact commands in order to finish and/or add additional features. With a vertical integration from scanning an object to producing the custom fitted device, the product can be manufactured at scale more rapidly and at lower cost, improving access to superior devices at a reasonable price to the consumer.

title: Computer-implemented method, computing device and non-transitory computer readable storage medium related to distributed computing for dynamic generation of optimal and interpretable prescriptive policies with interdependent constraints
assignee: 美商萬國商業機器公司
abstract:
A computer-implemented method of generating an Artificial Intelligence (AI) driven prescriptive policy and executing a function includes obtaining interdependent operational information about the function. A model is trained with the interdependent operational information about the function to dynamically generate a plurality of candidate decision paths from a group of all feasible decision paths for a 
plurality of interrule logical conditions and one or more dynamic constraints of the operational information. A prescriptive policy is generated from the plurality of candidate decision paths to execute the function that satisfies to a threshold degree of confidence the interrule logical conditions and the one or more dynamic constraints of the operational information. The function is executed based on the generated prescriptive policy.
assignee_clean: 美商萬國商業機器公司
primary_assignee: 美商萬國商業機器公司

title: Thyroid papillary carcinoma (PTC) risk auxiliary layering system
abstract: The invention discloses a thyroid papillary carcinoma (PTC) risk auxiliary layering system, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a model building, training and verifying module, a layering module and a database platform. According to the invention, the characteristic proteins and the characteristic clinical variables are screened through machine learning, a system prediction risk degree model is constructed to realize the value of proteomics on PTC dangerous layering, and a decision basis is provided for making a personalized treatment scheme for PTC patients.

title: Image classification method, device and readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an image classification method, an image classification device and a readable storage medium, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image; converting the target image to obtain at least two channel images, wherein the at least two channel images correspond to different channel expression modes; classifying and identifying at least two channel images through corresponding image classification models to obtain at least two channel identification results; and fusing at least two channel recognition results through a fusion model to obtain a classification result corresponding to the target image. The target image is converted into at least two channel images, and classification and identification are carried out through the image classification models corresponding to the target image, so that the images are classified from different dimensions, namely, the details of the target image are extracted from different angles for classification and identification, and the accuracy of image classification is improved.

title: Target area and organ-at-risk delineating contour accuracy checking method based on image histology
assignee: 福建自贸试验区厦门片区Manteia数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a target area and organ at risk delineating accuracy inspection method based on image histology. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sketching outline of a target object in an image; scaling the sketched outline by different scaling sizes, and determining the difference value characteristics of the preset scaling sizes according to scaling outlines of different scaling sizes adjacent to the preset scaling sizes; establishing a first neural network model aiming at a preset size according to the difference characteristic; and testing whether the outline drawing is accurate according to the first neural network model. The invention solves the technical problems that the image segmentation algorithm in the related technology has poor sketching effect on the image, low accuracy and stability and is difficult to evaluate sketching quality rapidly, so that the result of graph sketching needs to be identified manually.

title: Evidence-based medical document screening method and device
assignee: 北京大学第三医院, 北京诺道认知医学科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a evidence-based medical document screening method and device, which can improve screening efficiency under the condition of ensuring the accuracy of document screening. The method comprises the following steps: s1, removing repeated documents in the evidence-based medical document data source; s2, automatically extracting document screening rules by using a pre-constructed intelligent document screening model, judging whether each document accords with the document screening rules one by one, and reserving documents which accord with the document screening rules.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院; 北京诺道认知医学科技有限公司

title: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative farmland spraying method based on deep learning algorithm
abstract: The invention provides a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative farmland spraying method based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: firstly, dividing a farmland into N small areas with the same size uniformly, and acquiring crop images in each small area by using a camera on an exploration machine; secondly, inputting the crop image into a neural network model in an intelligent controller on the exploration machine, and outputting the category of the crop in each small area; then, the exploration machine divides the small areas corresponding to the same category into a group, and an optimal path is drawn out by utilizing a genetic algorithm according to the coordinates of each group of small areas and is sent to a target machine; and finally, implementing the target machines according to the operation corresponding to the category and the optimal path, simultaneously, mutually cooperating the target machines and returning the coordinate information to the exploration machine in real time through a communication protocol. The invention utilizes the unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative control method to spray the pesticide, thereby improving the orderliness and efficiency and saving the resources.

title: Medical information processing method and device and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 杭州依图医疗技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a medical information processing method, apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium, the processing method mainly including: determining a value source in medical information based on time reasoning and medical reasoning for the medical information to be analyzed; extracting target structural information corresponding to the time point from a value source by combining the time point; and obtaining a target value of the medical information to be analyzed according to the target structural information. The processing device mainly comprises: an information source selection module; a structured information extraction module; and a processing module. The computer readable storage medium implements a method of processing medical information. In the process of processing the medical text information, the method and the device reserve various information on the time attribute dimension required by the subsequent information integration, analysis and application, and take the information as the background information of the structured information, so that the calculation based on the structured data is more suitable for the real diagnosis and treatment scene, and the method and the device have sufficient flexibility.

title: Medical resource allocation method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to a medical resource allocation method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target attribute information, a target insurance portrait and a target health portrait of a target user according to user identification information included in the medical consultation request; inputting a preset doctor practice portrait, target attribute information, target insurance portrait and target health portrait into a first medical resource allocation model to obtain a first medical resource allocation result; inputting the target disease information, the target attribute information, the target insurance portrait, the target health portrait and the preset doctor practice portrait into a second medical resource allocation model to obtain a second medical resource allocation result; and matching the corresponding target medical resources for the target user according to the first medical resource allocation result and the second medical resource allocation result. The medical resource allocation method and device improve accuracy of medical resource allocation results.

title: Ophthalmic disease prediction method based on structured electronic medical record and storage device
assignee: 福州数据技术研究院有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an ophthalmic disease prediction method based on a structured electronic medical record and a storage device. The ophthalmic disease prediction method based on the structured electronic medical record comprises the following steps: establishing an ophthalmic disease database; acquiring a text vector and a numerical vector, taking the text vector and the numerical vector as an integral characteristic vector of the electronic medical record to be diagnosed, and performing weighted splicing on the integral characteristic vector; obtaining a trained model; and obtaining the model probability of each disease. Carrying out similarity calculation to obtain a similarity probability; and carrying out weighted summation on the model probability and the similar probability to obtain a final disease probability vector. In the above steps, the use of the weighted concatenation preset model for the whole feature vector enables the model portion to have higher interpretability than the existing deep learning model, and the weight of each portion, such as the chief complaint or a certain feature of the chief complaint, can correspond to the contribution of the portion to the final model output result.

title: Scheduled federated learning for enhanced search
abstract: An indication of availability over time and resource usage is maintained for each computing device of a plurality of computing devices. An optimal combination of a subset of the plurality of computing devices is determined for each round of one or more rounds of training based on the availability over time and the resource usage for each computing device. A global model is generated utilizing the one or more optimal combinations of the plurality of computing devices and a query is performed utilizing the global model.

title: Medical record quality assessment method and computing equipment
assignee: 北京颐圣智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical record quality assessment method, which is executed in computing equipment and comprises the following steps: obtaining a medical record text to be subjected to quality evaluation, wherein the medical record text comprises a patient identifier; matching the critical value report record corresponding to the patient identifier with the critical value processing record in the medical record text to determine the corresponding relation between the critical value report record and the critical value processing record; judging whether the information content of each critical value processing record meets preset conditions or not; when each critical value report record has a corresponding critical value processing record and the information content of each critical value processing record meets the preset condition, judging that the quality of the critical value processing record of the medical record text is qualified; otherwise, judging that the critical value processing record of the medical record text has quality defects. The invention also discloses corresponding computing equipment.

title: Medical record quality assessment method and computing equipment
assignee: 北京颐圣智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical record quality assessment method, which is executed in computing equipment and comprises the following steps: obtaining a medical record text to be subjected to quality evaluation, and extracting at least one transfusion medical advice and at least one transfusion record from the medical record text; matching the at least one transfusion order with the at least one transfusion record to determine a correspondence between the transfusion order and the transfusion record; judging whether the information content of each blood transfusion record meets preset conditions or not; when each transfusion doctor's advice has a corresponding transfusion record and the information content of each transfusion record meets the preset condition, judging that the transfusion record quality of the medical record text is qualified; otherwise, judging that the blood transfusion record of the medical record text has quality defects. The invention also discloses corresponding computing equipment.

title: Method and apparatus for managing a call connection between a customer terminal and an agent terminal based on usage information related to a chatbot service using a neural network
abstract: Disclosed in embodiments are a method and an apparatus in which a server manages call connections between a customer terminal and an agent terminal based on usage information related to a chatbot service using a neural network through a call server. According to one embodiment, the method comprises the steps of: receiving a first connection request message requesting a connection to an agent for a call from a chatbot server which provides a chatbot service to a first customer terminal, wherein the chatbot service is provided based on an authentication procedure between the first customer terminal and the chatbot server, and the connection request message includes usage information related to the chatbot service for the first customer terminal; based on the usage information related to the chatbot service for the first customer terminal and information related to a call connection status of a plurality of agent terminals, determining a priority for the first customer terminal and the plurality of agent terminals through a decision model using a plurality of neural networks; based on the determined priority for the first customer terminal and the plurality of agent terminals, selecting a first agent terminal among the plurality of agent terminals; transmitting the usage information related to the chatbot service for the first customer terminal to the first agent terminal; and establishing a call connection between the first customer terminal and the first agent terminal. Based on the fact that the last time of the first customer terminal using the chatbot service is within a range from the establishment point of the call connection to a pre-set time, transmission of interactive voice response matching the call connection may be omitted for the first customer terminal. The method and the apparatus can enhance the convenience of the customer terminal using the chatbot service.

title: Method and device for segmenting region of interest in medical image
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The specification provides a segmentation method and device for a region of interest in a medical image, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a grid model aiming at a region of interest of the medical image, wherein the grid model takes space coordinates in the region of interest as grid vertices; under the condition that the grid vertexes are not positioned on the edge of the region of interest, calculating the similarity between the pixel characteristics of the grid vertexes and the pixel characteristics of the space coordinates which are the preset moving vectors from the grid vertexes, and moving the grid vertexes according to the actual moving vectors, wherein the distance of the actual moving vectors is positively correlated with the similarity, and the direction of the actual moving vectors is the same as the direction of the preset moving vectors; in the case where the mesh vertices are located on the edges of the region of interest, the region of interest in the medical image is segmented according to the mesh model after the mesh vertices are moved. Therefore, on the basis of ensuring accuracy, the calculation amount is greatly reduced, and the efficiency is improved.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Method, device and control system for controlling mobile robot
assignee: 百度在线网络技术（北京）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device and a control system for controlling a mobile robot. One embodiment of the method comprises: receiving a motion mode change request sent by a target mobile robot, wherein the motion mode change request comprises motion mode information, and the motion mode information is information of a motion mode requested to be changed by the target mobile robot; determining whether the target mobile robot has the authority to move according to a movement mode; and in response to determining that the target mobile robot has the authority, sending motion confirmation information for the motion mode change request to the target mobile robot to control the target mobile robot to move in a motion mode. This embodiment improves the safety of the mobile robot movement.

title: Systems, devices and methods for disinfecting objects or surfaces in a scene
abstract: There are provided methods, devices and systems for disinfecting one or more objects or surfaces in a scene comprising: a sensing subsystem, comprising at least one sensor configured and enabled to identify at least one user approaching the one or more objects or surfaces or the scene; at least one device for measuring a distance of said at least one user or said one or more objects and at least one timer for measuring the time said at least user or said one or more objects are in the scene; a treatment subsystem, comprising: one or more containers comprising cleaning or disinfecting agents or materials; at least one pump and one or more spraying devices and a processing subsystem comprising at least one processor, configured to activate the one or more spraying devices before or after the identified one or more users touch the one or more objects or surfaces or approach or leave the scene.

title: Panoramic sheet decayed tooth depth identification method based on deep learning and attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a panoramic film decayed tooth depth recognition method based on deep learning and attention mechanisms, which realizes grading of different lesion periods of decayed tooth in a full-view film of an oral cavity by using a deep learning model comprising the attention mechanisms. The entire caries grading system consists of three modules: a segmentation network module, an attention extraction module, and a classification module. The automatic identification of the caries region in the whole oral cavity film and the result derivation of different caries lesion periods are realized, so that the auxiliary accurate classification is facilitated, the basis is provided for preventing occurrence and development of caries, and the method has important clinical and social significance for maintenance of oral health.

title: Cross-industry universal intelligent machine vision perception method
assignee: 成都中轨轨道设备有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a cross-industry universal intelligent machine vision perception method. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an industry to-be-processed image by using a general image acquisition device, and carrying out standardized processing on the industry to-be-processed image; step 2: inputting the expanded image as an original image into a 3D image reconstruction model; step 3: extracting the characteristics of the obtained three-dimensional structure; step 4: analyzing the feature map by using a target tracking algorithm of reinforcement learning to obtain a target network; step 5: the new feature map is processed using the target network to output the visual perception result. Through technologies such as 3D image reconstruction, self-attention mechanism, reinforcement learning and the like, fine image processing, self-adaptive decision and intelligent target tracking are realized, so that the accuracy, robustness and adaptability of the system are improved.

title: Wide key hash table for a graphics processing unit
abstract: A wide hash key, that exceeds the word size of a GPU memory, is used to perform a key-value mapping by using paired hash tables configured in a multi-level tree configuration. The wide hash key is partitioned into segments, where each segment is used as a key into a respective paired hash table. The paired hash table has one hash table that stores an upper portion of an address and another hash table that stores the lower portion of the address. The upper and lower portions are combined to generate either an address to a paired hash table at the next level in the multi-level tree configuration or the address to the location of the value associated with the wide hash key.

title: Medical image processing method and compression and restoration system thereof
assignee: 成都知识视觉科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image processing method which is used for compressing an image file with high space occupation amount to a file with low space occupation amount for storage or transmission, and restoring the file with low space occupation amount to an original image for display; decomposing the original color image into one or more decomposition files which are sparsely represented and contain a plurality of parameters for completely representing the image file through an online dictionary learning method, and storing or transmitting the decomposition files; and the decomposed file is subjected to multiple times of generation type countermeasure network to obtain a restored image for displaying. The system for compressing and restoring by adopting the method comprises a dictionary learning compression module, a storage module and a generating type confrontation network module. The invention adopts a generating type confrontation network technology, can maximally restore the picture and supplement the details of the pathological image.
assignee_clean: 成都知识视觉科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 成都知识视觉科技有限公司

title: System and method for generating a cognitive disorder nourishment program
abstract: A system for generating a cognitive disorder nourishment program comprises a computing device configured to obtain a cognitive indicator element, produce a cognitive appraisal as a function of the cognitive indicator element, wherein producing further comprises identifying a cognitive function as a function of an experience label, and producing the cognitive appraisal as a function of the cognitive function and cognitive indicator element using a cognitive machine-learning model, determine an edible as a function of the cognitive appraisal, and generate a nourishment program as a function of the edible.

title: Method for selecting forwarding path based on learning medium access control layer collisions in internet of things networks, recording medium and device for performing the method
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of selecting a forwarding path based on MAC layer collision learning in an IoT network environment, comprising the steps of: learning a collision probability of a medium access control (MAC) layer through a Q-learning algorithm in each of a root node and heterogeneous sensor nodes transmitting a packet to the root node; measuring, by each node, a size of a current contention window (CW) using a backoff exponent (BE) in a backoff stage; calculating the collision probability (P_coll ) using contention window size information and the number of adjacent nodes; storing and transmitting priority information determined based on a parental priority of the node and the collision probability (P_coll) in a DIO control packet; and selecting a packet forwarding path through one of a network exploration based on a rank of a node or a network exploitation based on a reward value obtained through the Q-learning algorithm, when receiving the DIO control packet. Accordingly, it is possible to efficiently achieve a higher packet reception rate in the IoT network environment, significantly lower control overhead, and consume less energy.

title: Medical support system and ophthalmologic examination apparatus
abstract: An object of the utility model is to provide a can be when ensureing to diagnose the accuracy, alleviate the burden of patient etc. and improve the medical support system and the ophthalmology inspection device who diagnoses efficiency. The medical support system 1 includes: a user terminal 200 having an identifier creating unit 201 for creating an identifier for a specific user; an ophthalmologic examination apparatus 300 for performing ophthalmologic examination on a user, the ophthalmologic examination apparatus having an identifier reading section 301, the identifier reading section 301 reading the identifier and specifying the user from the read identifier; an examination data receiving unit 40 that receives examination data of an ophthalmic examination performed by the ophthalmic examination apparatus 300; and a storage unit 20 for storing the inspection data received by the inspection data receiving unit 40.

title: Medical image diagnosis support system, medical image processing apparatus, and medical image processing method
assignee: 富士胶片医疗健康株式会社
abstract: The invention provides a medical image diagnosis support system, a medical image processing apparatus and a medical image processing method, which can shorten the time required for diagnosis and determination of lesion candidates. A medical image diagnosis support system including a medical image capturing device for capturing a medical image of a subject and a medical image processing device for processing the medical image, the medical image diagnosis support system comprising: a projection data acquisition unit that acquires projection data of the subject; a reconstruction unit that reconstructs the medical image based on the projection data; an acquisition unit that acquires lesion candidate data, which is data of a lesion candidate detected from the medical image; a reconstruction condition determination unit that determines a reconstruction condition of an enlarged reconstructed image that includes the lesion candidate and is enlarged as compared with the medical image, based on the lesion candidate data; an enlarged reconstruction unit that reconstructs the enlarged reconstructed image using the reconstruction conditions; and a display unit for displaying the enlarged reconstructed image.

title: Image processing method and device
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an image processing method and device. In the embodiment of the invention, the image to be optimized is determined to be one frame of continuous multi-frame images of the same imaging target, at least one frame of image in a preset range is selected as a first image in the multi-frame images, a trained machine learning model is utilized for each first image to acquire a displacement field between the first image and the image to be optimized, the first image is subjected to space transformation according to the displacement field to obtain second images with each pixel point aligned with the corresponding pixel point of the image to be optimized, and the second images corresponding to all the first images are fused with the image to be optimized to obtain the target image, so that noise in the image can be weakened, the signal to noise ratio of the image scanned at low dose can be improved, image blurring or distortion caused by motion can be effectively restrained, and the image quality can be improved.

title: System and method for programming a monitoring device
abstract: A system for programming a monitoring device includes a computing device configured to obtain a user datum of a plurality of user datums from a monitoring device, calculate a signal profile as a function of the user datum, identify a scan frequency correlated to the signal profile, wherein identifying further comprises receiving a frequency training set relating at least a first element of a vigor element to at least a first frequency requirement and using a frequency machine learning process, wherein the frequency machine learning process is configured using the signal training set, generate a device scheme as a function of the scan frequency, and program the monitoring device as a function of the device scheme.

title: Angiography machine control method and device, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 北京东软医疗设备有限公司, 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The specification provides a control method and device of an angiography machine, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image, wherein the medical image scans a target object by the X-ray device at an initial projection angle and is generated according to an X-ray signal acquired by a detector; determining location information of hemangiomas in the medical image; determining a target projection angle of the X-ray device according to the position information; and controlling the frame assembly to move so as to enable the X-ray device to switch from the initial projection angle to the target projection angle and scan the target object. Therefore, the automatic calculation of the optimal projection angle is realized, the workload of medical staff is reduced, the human error is reduced, and the efficiency and the accuracy are improved.

title: Interactive patent visualization systems and methods
abstract: An interactive, dynamic GUI for visualization of patent documents including content-dense graphics illustrating the number, content size, type of a multiplicity of patent documents (issued or granted patent versus published pending application), distributed over time, with comparison to similar patent documents, market events, and expert insights based upon content of specification or detailed description and claims, all within a predetermined technology sector having at least one sub-sector or category within the technology sector.

title: Coronary heart disease patient hand diagnosis data processing method and system based on deep learning model
assignee: 中国中医科学院中医临床基础医学研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a coronary heart disease patient hand diagnosis data processing method and a system thereof based on a deep learning model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a hand image of a sample to be detected, wherein the hand image comprises a left hand front image, a right hand front image, a radial side image and an ulnar side image; dividing the hand image to obtain an ROI area image corresponding to each image; the ROI area image includes: a large thenar region, a small thenar region, a palmar region, a thumb root region, and a tiger mouth region; and inputting the ROI region image into a constructed coronary heart disease deep learning model to obtain a classification result.

title: Method for disease risk assessment
assignee: 百醫醫材科技股份有限公司
abstract: A method for disease risk assessment includes a capturing step, a preprocessing step, and a determining step. In the capturing step, a medical record of a subject, a static physiological information of the subject measured, and a dynamic physiological information corresponding to different actions of the subject are obtained. In the preprocessing step, a terminal device is applied to integrate the aforementioned data for generating a current statistic. In the determining step, the current statistic is inputted into a prediction model for calculation, so as to generate a disease risk assessment result corresponding to the subject. The assessment result includes a disease category, an onset probability corresponding to the disease category, and an estimated time of the onset of the disease. Thus, the present invention accurately assesses the disease probability of the subject in the future for health improvement and disease prevention and postponement.

title: Remote fault diagnosis and operation and maintenance method and system for hyperbaric oxygen chamber based on Internet of things
assignee: 烟台宏远氧业股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a remote fault diagnosis and operation and maintenance method and system for a hyperbaric oxygen chamber based on the Internet of things, wherein a cloud source signal of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber is obtained; carrying out corrosion operation and then expansion operation on the cloud source signal by morphological filtering, and filtering out positive pulse noise of the cloud source signal; carrying out expansion operation and corrosion operation on the cloud source signal by morphological filtering, and filtering negative pulse noise of the cloud source signal; acquiring a cloud source signal mean value after filtering positive impulse noise and negative impulse noise; random noise of the cloud source signal is filtered by singular value decomposition, and characteristic singular values of the cloud source signal are reserved by ensemble empirical mode decomposition; the fault tree is utilized to carry out fault location on the hyperbaric oxygen chamber, the convolution self-encoder is utilized to train a hyperbaric oxygen chamber fault classifier, and the hyperbaric oxygen chamber fault classifier is utilized to diagnose, operate and maintain faults of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber. The invention can find the fault problem in the using process of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber in time, improve the maintenance efficiency of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber and ensure the safety of patients and medical care personnel.

title: Microfluidic testing system for mobile veterinary applications
abstract: A method for generating a treatment plan in response to medical test results is provided. The method comprises requesting point-of-care (POC) services from a mobile POC unit, receiving at a server confirmation of delivery of POC services to a patient, receiving at the server one or more test results as a result of operation of a medical testing device used in the POC services, wherein the one or more test results includes a determination of the efficacy and dosage level of a medication, generating at the server an updated digital patient record reflecting the one or more test results, and transmitting by the server to a medical entity a treatment plan based on the efficacy and dosage level determined for the medication, wherein the treatment plan is a dosage regimen for the medication.

title: Web-based system and method for healthcare cost management
abstract: A web-based system of the present invention includes databases, processors and computer-readable memory media storing a computer program product is executable by the processor to perform functions of the invention. A claim is obtained regarding medical care services associated with a user and healthcare service data associated with the services. The healthcare service data for the obtained claim is compared to data for comparable claims in the system. Healthcare service options for the user are identified based on the compared data. A notification or alert regarding identified options is delivered to the user, and a second message upon request by the user provides details for obtaining or implementing the healthcare service options. A financial return report is subsequently generated based on input from the user corresponding to an actual difference in price between the services received and/or from comparison of subsequent claims.

title: Method and device for determining downlink transmission timing for relay node in next generation communication system
abstract: The present application discloses a method for transmitting a downlink signal by a child node in a next generation wireless communication system. Specifically, the method comprises the steps of: receiving information on a timing advanced value from a parent node; determining a reception timing of a first downlink signal transmitted from the parent node; calculating a transmission timing of a second downlink signal preceding the reception timing of the first downlink signal by a timing correction value based on a preconfigured offset value and the timing advanced value; and according to the transmission timing of the second downlink signal, transmitting the second downlink signal to another child node.

title: Computing device and board card
assignee: 中科寒武纪科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a computing device and integrated circuit board, computing device is used for carrying out GRU operation, the integrated circuit board includes: the device comprises a storage device, an interface device, a control device and a neural network chip, wherein the neural network chip comprises a computing device, and the storage device is used for storing data; the interface device is used for realizing data transmission between the chip and external equipment; and the control device is used for monitoring the state of the chip. The computing device has the advantages of low cost and low power consumption.

title: X-ray exposure index range generation method and X-ray system
assignee: 深圳康桥软件技术有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method for generating an X-ray exposure index range, which comprises the following steps: and receiving at least a first set of training data and a second set of training data which are marked and inputting a machine learning model to train so as to obtain at least a first classifier and a second classifier which correspond to each other. Receiving a plurality of images acquired under different exposure conditions and inputting the images into at least a first classifier and a second classifier so as to judge at least part of the images in the plurality of images to be first classified images corresponding to the first classifier or second classified images corresponding to the second classifier; calculating an exposure index value of each of the first classified image and the second classified image; and selecting the maximum value of the exposure index value of the first classified image as the lower limit value of the exposure index range, and selecting the minimum value of the exposure index value of the second classified image as the upper limit value of the exposure index range. The invention also provides an X-ray system and a computer readable storage medium for executing the method.

title: Detection method and device for specific cells and pathological section detection system
assignee: 博奥生物集团有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a detection method and device of specific cells and a pathological section detection system, which are particularly used for controlling photographic equipment of the pathological section system to photograph pathological sections at a first multiplying power to obtain panoramic color images of the first multiplying power; processing the panoramic color image by utilizing a pre-trained region segmentation model to obtain at least one ROI region and region parameters of the ROI region; for each ROI, acquiring a regional color image of the ROI according to regional parameters, wherein the multiplying power of the regional color image is a second multiplying power; processing the regional color image according to a pre-trained cell segmentation model to obtain a regional segmentation binary image of a specific cell and other cells; the specific cells were fractionated and the number of specific cells and other cells under each fractionation was counted. The process does not need the participation of doctors according to professional knowledge, so that the influence of the professional level and subjective factors of the doctors is eliminated, and the accuracy of specific cell technology is further improved.

title: Diagnosis support apparatus, control method for diagnosis support apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: A diagnosis support apparatus comprising: first inference means for performing inference concerning diagnosis using data collected under a first condition; second inference means for performing inference concerning the diagnosis using the data collected under the first condition and data collected under a second condition different from the first condition; third inference means for performing inference concerning the diagnosis using the data collected under the second condition; and integration means for integrating inference results of the first inference means, the second inference means, and the third inference means using a first weight, a second weight, and a third weight respectively corresponding to the first inference means, the second inference means, and the third inference means.

title: Detecting an allergic reaction from nasal temperatures
abstract: Described herein are systems and methods for personalized detection of an allergic reaction of a user. In one embodiment, a system includes an inward-facing head-mounted thermal camera (CAM) and a computer. CAM takes thermal measurements of a region on the nose (THN) of a user. The computer generates feature values based on THN and utilizes a model to detect an allergic reaction of the user based on the feature values. The model is trained based on previous THN of the user taken during different days. Some embodiments may utilize additional thermal cameras that take thermal measurements of other regions on the face, which may be utilized by the computer to generate additional feature values that are used to detect the allergic reaction. In some cases, detection of the allergic reaction may occur following a rise in nasal temperature, even before the user becomes aware of the allergic reaction.

title: Device and a system for simulated ultrasound-guided needling
abstract: This invention relates to a computer-implemented simulation system comprising a needle device having a retractable needle shaft comprising a resistance mechanism which can be activated to vary the resistance of the needle shaft. A processing module is configured to: receive ultrasound image data representative of a subject being scanned, receive position and orientation data representative of an ultrasound probe and a needle device, calculate a projected path for the needle device and generate a simulation needle from the projected path. When the simulation needle is determined to intersect with an identified tissue type, it modulates a signal and sends the modulated signal to the resistance mechanism, thereby to cause a change in the resistive force acting on the retractable needle shaft. The invention also relates to a computer-implemented method for simulating ultrasound guided needling using this system.

title: Breast cancer data labeling method through collaborative active learning model
abstract: The invention discloses a breast cancer data labeling method through a collaborative active learning model, relates to the field of medical image data labeling, and adopts the combination of a deep learning network, an active learning system and a collaborative learning system to label breast cancer data. The method provided by the invention combines the deep learning, the active learning and the collaborative learning together through three machine learning branches which are completely incoherent originally, and uses the machine learning branches for medical image classification tasks: breast image computer aided diagnosis. On the premise of not increasing extra labeling cost, all samples can be fully utilized, so that the method is particularly suitable for being used for medical image classification tasks with high acquisition cost, and better model prediction effect than that of an active learning method can be obtained.

title: Public medical health named entity identification and entity linking method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 中国科学院新疆理化技术研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for identifying and linking a public medical and health named entity, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a plurality of Chinese named entity recognition data sets, and training to obtain a group model; obtaining a fine-grained named entity recognition model by implementing a specific transfer learning method; extracting entities in public health and medical knowledge graphs, and constructing a dictionary tree entity matching model by utilizing entity character sequences; inputting the multi-source character sequence representation of the input text into the plurality of models to obtain an identified named entity set, and linking the entities in the set to a certain entity item in the knowledge graph; and linking the named entities of the input text to the corresponding knowledge maps. According to the technology, the model can be guaranteed to have higher recognition rate, new entity types can be quickly learned under the condition of smaller samples, and the adaptability of the model is improved.
