title: Medical image segmentation network based on double interleaving
abstract: The invention provides a network based on double interleaving, which comprises: processing the picture data set; by using a double-interleaving network structure, a first DCNN basic block acquires the feature of a medical picture and fuses with the feature of an original image to be used as the picture input of a second DCNN basic block; in the up-down sampling process of each basic block, a non-horizontal symmetrical structure is adopted, a dense connecting block is adopted in the down-sampling process, the down-sampling feature loss is reduced, a criss-cross mode is used in each basic block as hidden features of different levels, the multi-level semantic feature fusion in the network is enhanced, and the capability of extracting and retaining feature information by the network is improved. Higher accuracy is achieved in the medical image segmentation task. The problems that small objects are lost and positioning boundary information is blurred due to the use of Bottom-up are solved.

title: Self-contained, portable, sanitization device and telemedicine station
abstract: A sanitization device and telemedicine station (SDTS) may automatically detect and disinfect users as the users pass through the device. Sanitizing solution may be distributed throughout a disinfecting area within the SDTS such that people, pets, items, and/or other objects are disinfected. The SDTS may collect biometric data such as body temperature. Collected data may be analyzed to identify conditions and/or generate recommendations by matching collected data to various condition profiles. The SDTS may allow telemedicine sessions, where a user may communicate with a practitioner or virtual practitioner.

title: Determination of clinical characteristic variables using a combination of different recording modalities
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: The invention relates to the determination of clinical characteristic quantities using a combination of different recording modalities. The invention relates to a method for determining clinical parameters of a body vessel segment, comprising a) providing (1) a first three-dimensional reconstruction of a body vessel having the body vessel segment to a computing device, b) providing (2) a second segmented angiographic recording of the body vessel segment to the computing device, c) extracting (4) at least one global feature of the body vessel from the three-dimensional reconstruction by the computing device, d) extracting (5) at least one local feature of the body vessel segment from the angiographic recording by the computing device, and e) determining (8) the clinical parameters of the body vessel segment as precisely as possible from the extracted local and global features in order to calculate the clinical parameters of the body vessel segment with the least possible radiation load on the patient.

title: Method for generating hepatonuclear magnetic image sequence guided by description of focal lesion symptom
abstract: The invention discloses a method for generating a hepatonuclear magnetic image sequence guided by description of focal lesion symptoms. The method not only accords with the corresponding symptom description, but also can ensure the integrity and the authenticity of the liver structure by generating the liver image generated by the countermeasure network. According to the method, long-distance dependency relations among different liver structures can be constructed when the self-attention module generates partial liver structures, so that the liver structures in the generated images are complete and have no abnormality, and the overall authenticity of the liver images is improved. According to the method, when a certain region of the liver is generated, the multi-head attention module can take the overall symptom description into consideration from the global angle and the fine granularity description of the focus from the local angle, so that the semantic consistency of the generated liver image and the corresponding symptom description is improved. By the method for generating the data, data support can be provided for other deep learning models related to liver images.

title: Method and system for selecting a region of interest in an image
abstract: A system and computer-implemented method for analysing or monitoring a subject, the method comprising: identifying one or more objects of interest that have been segmented from a first image comprising any of a baseline scan, a follow-up scan or a reference image of the subject; identifying predefined landmarks of the objects; determining reference morphometries pertaining to the objects by performing morphometrics on the objects by reference to the landmarks; selecting one or more regions of interest (ROIs) from the objects according to the reference morphometries, comprising identifying respective locations of the ROIs relative to the reference morphometries; performing a first analysis of the one or more ROIs; performing at least one corresponding second analysis of the one or more ROIs in respectively at least one second image comprising any other of a baseline scan, a follow-up scan or a reference image; and generating a comparison of one or more results of the first analysis and one or more corresponding results of the second analysis.

title: Double-channel craniopharyngioma invasiveness classification and focus region segmentation system thereof
assignee: 中国科学院自动化研究所
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and particularly relates to a dual-channel craniopharyngioma invasiveness classification and focus region segmentation system, aiming at solving the problems that manual work cannot accurately classify the invasiveness of craniopharyngioma in a noninvasive mode and accurately segment a focus region. The invention comprises the following steps: an image acquisition module configured to acquire a craniopharyngioma MR image; the threshold segmentation module is configured to remove the background of the image, adjust the image to a set size and take the image with the adjusted size as a first image; the focus segmentation module is configured to obtain a predicted value of whether pixel points in each slice of the first image belong to a focus region and a focus region segmentation result, and extract 2D features of each slice; and the classification module is configured to extract the 3D features of the first image and acquire a classification result corresponding to the MR image of the craniopharyngioma. The invention realizes accurate segmentation and invasive classification of focus regions of craniopharyngiomas in a noninvasive mode.

title: Reduce discrepancy of human annotators in medical imaging by automatic visual comparison to similar cases
abstract: A method comprising using at least one hardware processor for automatically receiving, using a user interface associated with the hardware processor(s), an annotation for a medical image of a patient, the medical image associated with a suspected disease of the patient and metadata of the patient. The hardware processor(s) are configured for performing a search query in real time on a database for the annotation. The hardware processor(s) are configured for receiving at least one result of the search query. The hardware processor(s) are configured for retrieving at least one other medical image comprising at least one other annotation, wherein the at least one other medical image is associated with the at least one result. The hardware processor(s) are configured for displaying, on the user interface, the at least one other medical image and the at least one other annotation.

title: Crowd sourced database system
abstract: Systems and methods are provided to improve data sets and/or data set collection. An entity submits a request for a data set crowd sourced database system. Contributor(s) work to complete the data set, such as by submitting components of the data set. Multiple separate users contributing to a data set improves the diversity of a data set. The crowd sourced database system ranks contributing users using a ranking algorithm based on the previous submissions of a user. The crowd sourced database system ranks contributions based on the quality of the data submitted. The crowd sourced database system anonymizes data contributions where data privacy considerations are required or are important.

title: System for providing pet information sharing service using harness camera
abstract: Provided is a system for providing companion animal information sharing service using a harness camera. The system comprises: a harness camera that is installed or provided opposite the face of a companion animal to photograph the face of the companion animal, is fixed and supported on a harness worn on part or the entire body of the companion animal, and outputs image data of the face of the companion animal; a user terminal that uploads the image data received from the harness camera in real time through wireless or wired communications, and outputs result data based on an analysis result of the image data; and a sharing service providing server that includes a registration unit that maps and registers the user terminal and the harness camera from the user terminal, an extraction unit that pre-processes and then extracts a facial region or body region, which is an object included in the image data received from the harness camera via the user terminal, a storage unit that labels and maps a tag to the facial region or the body region and stores the tag, a reception unit that transmits the labeled tag to the user terminal to receive feedback, and a sharing unit that shares the image data and the tag corresponding to the facial region or the body region if the feedback is positive.

title: Electronic device and method for providing memory service by electronic device
abstract: According to an embodiment, an electronic device comprises a communication module, a memory, and a processor configured to, upon obtaining a first utterance related to a memory service, prepare to store first information for the memory service for the first utterance and store the first information including essential information, sensitivity information for the first information, and an authentication method for the first information, detected from the first utterance, in the memory, and obtain a second utterance for looking up information related to the memory service, upon identifying that the obtained second utterance is one for looking up the first information, complete authentication based on the authentication method, and provide the essential information by a providing method determined based on the sensitivity information. Various other embodiments may be provided.

title: Medication storage and closure container, medication delivery station for delivery of medication from a replaceable pre-filled medication storage and closure container, automated and adaptable remote medication management system including a medication delivery station, and methods of operating and/or utilizing the same
abstract: A portable remote medication management system for automated and adaptive precision dosing is disclosed. The system includes a medication delivery station comprising a receptacle that stores a pre-filled replaceable medication storage and closure container. The pre-filled medication container can store oral solid medication in storage silos above a rotary release mechanism and contains a storage and communication chip that communicates with the delivery station. The medication delivery station includes a delivery housing, a drive and control mechanism, communication interfaces with the container closure and remote devices, and a removable medication receptacle within the delivery station. The medication delivery station and medication closure container connect mechanically through a drive interface under the control of the station. Dosing parameter adjustments can be controlled by an administration portal and uploaded to the medication delivery station, as commanded by the administrator. Also disclosed are method operating the system and devices.

title: Emulation pipeline selection and emulation pipeline parameter prediction
abstract: Incompatible graphics frameworks present a barrier to emulating applications of one operating system (guest OS) upon a computer system employing a different operating system (host OS) such as occurs with virtual machines. Accordingly, in order to address limitations of emulating guest OS graphic pipelines upon the host OS the inventors have established methodologies for cross-platform graphics pipeline emulation, thus enabling efficient implementations of cross-platform virtualization solutions, through the establishment of emulation keys to support generic and specific graphics pipelines together with caching sets of graphical pipelines for subsequent retrieval and execution.

title: Preparation method of multi-modal sensor for acquiring intracranial physiological and biochemical information
assignee: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a multi-modal sensor for acquiring intracranial physiological and biochemical information, which comprises the following steps: preparing a flexible substrate; preparing a metal or polymer lead wire on the flexible substrate; preparing or placing a flexible sensor at a node of the lead wire; the flexible sensor comprises a flexible pressure sensor, a flexible shearing force sensor, a flexible temperature sensor, a flexible oxygen partial pressure sensor, a flexible potassium-sodium ion sensor and a flexible electrode; and covering a layer of flexible polymer above the lead wire and the flexible sensor, so as to finish the preparation of the implanted flexible multi-physiological sensor.

title: Device and method for anomaly detection
abstract: A computer-implemented method for classifying whether an input signal, which comprises image and/or audio data, is anomalous or not with respect to a second data distribution using an anomaly classifier. The method includes: providing the input signal to the anomaly classifier; in the anomaly classifier, providing the input signal to a reference detector and a second detector; obtaining a reference value from the reference detector based on the input signal, the reference value characterizing the likelihood of the input signal to belong to a reference data distribution; obtaining a second value from the second detector based on the input signal, the second value characterizing the likelihood of the input signal to belong to the second data distribution; and providing an output signal, which characterizes a classification of the input signal as anomalous or not based on a comparison of the reference value and the second value.

title: Computing device and related product
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a computing device and a related product, the computing device is used for executing machine learning calculation, the device comprises a controller module, an operation module, a data format conversion module and a data format selection module, wherein the controller module is used for controlling the data format conversion module to perform data format conversion on data to be operated according to a data conversion format determined by the data format selection module; and the operation module is used for performing operation according to the data to be operated after format conversion under the control of the controller module. The format conversion module in the embodiment of the disclosure can change the bit width of the data to be operated on the premise of maintaining the data precision, thereby adapting to different operation requirements.

title: Title generation method, computer and readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a title generation method, a computer and a readable storage medium, which can use a machine learning technology in the field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: performing word segmentation processing on the target text data to obtain at least two target text word segmentation phrases forming the target text data; acquiring target text keywords in target text data according to the importance degree of target word groups of at least two target text word groups, and acquiring target word group characteristics of the target text keywords; inputting the target phrase characteristics into a title generation model, carrying out characteristic prediction on the target phrase characteristics based on the title generation model to obtain a prediction statement set, and taking a prediction statement with the maximum first prediction probability value in the prediction statement set as a target text title of target text data; pushing the target text data carrying the target text title. By adopting the method and the device, the generation efficiency of the text title can be improved.

title: Accurate estimation of battery charge remaining in a mobile cart
abstract: Systems and methods for monitoring and management of an electronic device are discussed here. An authentication request is received from a user for access to an electronically secured compartment of an electronic device. Authentication data is obtained from the user. An authentication request that includes a device identifier for the electronically secured compartment and the authentication data is transmitted to a cloud-based authentication service. Access to the electronically secured compartment is provided upon receipt of an indication of an association between the user and the electronically secured compartment from the cloud-based service provider.

title: Construction method and system of cognitive disorder assessment model and cognitive disorder assessment method
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京安贞医院
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a cognitive disorder assessment model and a cognitive disorder assessment method. The construction method comprises the following steps: performing a cognitive assessment on a plurality of cardiovascular disease patients to classify into normal patients and cognition disorder patients according to the cognition assessment data; acquiring ultrasonic cardiac data of a cognitive disorder patient, and inputting a multi-task learning model by combining the cognitive evaluation data; and performing multi-task learning in the first stage by using the multi-task learning model to acquire the mapping relation between the echocardiographic data and the cognitive dysfunction, so as to construct a cognitive dysfunction assessment model for cardiovascular disease patients. In the invention, the index for predicting the risk of cognitive impairment is mainly based on the echocardiographic data, which is a check conventionally needed by patients with cardiovascular diseases, so the popularization value is high. Furthermore, for medical scenes with insufficient evaluation level, cognitive impairment evaluation can still be performed on patients with cardiovascular diseases.

title: Online perspective search for 3D components
abstract: Techniques for formulating queries and retrieving relevant results for 3D components in a virtual or augmented reality system. In an aspect, a user works with a 3D component using a workflow, and views the 3D component from one or more selected perspective views. Data associated with the workflow and the selected perspective views are transmitted to an online engine. The online engine may include a query formulation module for automatically forming a query based on the received workflow data and selected perspective views. The formulated query may be supplied to a search engine to retrieve online results based on relevance to the formulated queries. One or more most relevant online results may be seamlessly served to the user as part of the workflow.

title: Systems and methods for continuous threat-informed exposure management
abstract: Aspects of the subject technology relate to determining a defense surface change command to be applied to a defense surface. An organizational threat profile is stored and a baseline exposure score for threats is generated. The baseline exposure score is weighted based on at least the organizational threat profile to generate a prioritized exposure score. A defense surface change command is generated based on at least the prioritized exposure score, which is transmitted to hardware or software components, and an updated prioritized exposure score for the one or more hardware or software components is generated.

title: Securely manipulating and utilizing user credentials
abstract: A method, system, and apparatus comprising: automatically identifying a login session to a first software system in a Graphical User Interface (GUI) of a user device; automatically extracting user credentials from the login session; automatically manipulating at least a portion of the user credentials to obtain manipulated credentials; automatically verifying that the login session is authentic by: encrypting the user credentials, providing the encrypted credentials to a separate environment, and reconstructing the login session at the separate environment; and automatically adding the manipulated credentials to an account of the user in a second software system that is independent from the separate environment.

title: Identity management
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for identifying management, are disclosed. In one aspect, a method includes the actions of receiving, at a given time, a request to verify an identity of a user and a location of the user. The actions further include, in response to the request to verify the identity of the user, identifying a computing device associated with the user. The actions further include determining a previous time and a previous location that computing device verified the identity of the user. The actions further include, based on the given time, the location of the user, the previous time, and the previous location, determining whether to output data verifying the identity of the user at the location.

title: Intelligent design method of hospital ward ventilation system based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 中南建筑设计院股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent design method of a hospital ward ventilation system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: establishing ward three-dimensional geometric models of different ventilation schemes by using a Rhino software parameterized modeling technology; performing indoor airflow organization simulation through open source CFD software OPENFOAM to obtain the spatial distribution of indoor air age of different ventilation schemes, and further calculating to obtain ventilation efficiency; establishing a deep neural network model describing the relationship between ventilation scheme parameters and ventilation efficiency, and training the deep neural network model by taking the parameters of different ventilation schemes as model input quantities and the corresponding ventilation efficiency as model output quantities; and designing a plurality of ventilation schemes, obtaining the ventilation efficiency of each ventilation scheme by utilizing the trained deep neural network model, and determining the optimal ventilation scheme. The method aims to convert the AI algorithm into design productivity and find the optimal design scheme of the ventilation system of the hospital ward.

title: Method and apparatus for managing measurement result in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to managing measurement results in wireless communications. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by wireless device in a wireless communication system, the method comprises: receiving, from a first cell, a first frequency list for a measurement comprising a specific frequency; performing a measurement on the specific frequency to obtain a measurement result for the specific frequency; receiving, from a second cell to which a cell reselection is performed, a second frequency list for a measurement; and upon identifying that the specific frequency is different from all frequencies included in the second frequency list, releasing the measurement result for the specific frequency.

title: Automated fixups based on partial goal satisfaction
abstract: A compliance of a system is managed. Internal parameters of the system are received. One or more compliance control documents that relate to the system are identified. Each compliance control document is decomposed into one or more auditable units. Auditable units that are relevant to the system, are identified. Relevant auditable units are mapped to a corresponding available executable code. Each mapped executable code is executed. A risk associated with each relevant auditable unit that is deemed to be not compliant is identified. For each compliance control document, a compliance risk is calculated based on the identified risk. A report of compliance risk for each document is created to be displayed on a user interface of a computing device.

title: Operation method, device and related product
assignee: 北京中科寒武纪科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an arithmetic method, apparatus and related product, the product comprising a control module, the control module comprising: the device comprises an instruction cache unit, an instruction processing unit and a storage queue unit; the instruction cache unit is used for storing the calculation instruction associated with the artificial neural network operation; the instruction processing unit is used for analyzing the calculation instruction to obtain a plurality of operation instructions; the storage queue unit is configured to store an instruction queue, where the instruction queue includes: and a plurality of operation instructions or calculation instructions to be executed according to the front and back sequence of the queue. Through the method, the operation efficiency of the related product in the operation of the neural network model can be improved.

title: Hospital electric equipment management system and method based on RFID
assignee: 重庆医科大学附属第一医院
abstract: The invention relates to the field of electric equipment monitoring, and provides a hospital electric equipment management system and a method thereof based on RFID, wherein the system comprises the following components: the electric equipment and the matched plug are embedded with RFID electronic tags; the intelligent socket is internally provided with an RFID electronic tag identifier, and the plug is connected with the intelligent socket to identify the RFID electronic tag to acquire the electricity utilization information of each electric equipment; the intelligent distribution box is used for collecting and monitoring electricity consumption of electric equipment corresponding to the intelligent sockets on each line, and generating early warning and realizing intelligent circuit breaking protection when abnormal conditions of the electric equipment are monitored; and the server classifies the received electricity information of the electric equipment uploaded by each intelligent distribution box, trains the convolutional neural network model by adopting different types of electricity information according to classification results, obtains a three-level early-warning model of the electricity information, updates the three-level early-warning model to monitor and early-warn, realizes the safety management of the electric equipment, and improves the safety performance of the electric equipment in hospitals.

title: Method and apparatus for mobility in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to method and apparatus for mobility wireless communications. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by a wireless device in a wireless communication system comprises: performing measurements to derive a cell quality; determining a set of candidate cells for a mobility based on the cell quality; selecting a mobility target cell from the set of candidate cells for the mobility based on a number of good beams and a number of detected beams; and performing the mobility to the mobility target cell.

title: Method and apparatus for initial access in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to initial access in wireless communications. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by a wireless device in a wireless communication system comprises: measuring a signal quality for a first cell and a signal quality for a second cell; and based on a determination that the signal quality for the first cell and the signal quality for the second cell are within an offset, performing an initial access to both of the first cell and the second cell.

title: Muscle contraction state triggering of quantitative medical diagnostic ultrasound
abstract: For quantitative ultrasound imaging with a medical diagnostic ultrasound scanner, muscle tissue is scanned in order to determine the state of contraction. Once the desired state is identified, then QUS imaging is triggered to quantify or measure a tissue property while the muscle is in the desired state. The values of the tissue property at a known state of contraction may be more diagnostically useful or informative. Comparisons of the tissue property across time and/or location may more accurately reflect diagnostic information due to the triggering.

title: Pre-training method for medical text
assignee: 江苏天瑞精准医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical text-oriented pre-training method, which comprises the following specific steps: acquiring medical dictionaries for diseases, examination and examination, symptoms, medicines, body parts, operations and the like; collecting medical text content in encyclopedia and electronic medical records; loading a medical dictionary, and performing word segmentation processing on the medical text by using jieba to serve as a training corpus; acquiring pictures of Chinese characters from a classical, constructing corresponding pictures without characters; extracting character features by using VGG-16 convolution network; reducing the dimension of the extracted character features as a word vector using PCA; superposing the word vector and the position vector of the word as a new word vector; loading an open-source Chinese word vector corpus as an initial word vector; training the medical text content by using ELMo model to obtain a final ELMo pre-training model; ELMo vectors for specific words in sentences are generated using ELMo pre-training models. The pre-training method can solve the problem that the general corpus is not suitable for medical natural language processing tasks.

title: Gaze-initiated communications
abstract: A method comprises displaying an image of an environment on a graphical user interface, the environment including personnel elements visible in the image, detecting a gaze of a user directed at an image of a first personnel element corresponding to a first information conveyor of a plurality of information conveyors, changing a state of the first information conveyor corresponding to the first personnel element from a passive state to a listening state in response to detecting that the gaze is directed at the image of the first personnel element, wherein the first information conveyor includes a first audio output device, receiving audio information through an audio input device, and when the state of the first information conveyor is changed to the listening state, controlling an output operation, wherein the output operation includes directing the received audio information as an audio output through the first audio output device.

title: Forecasting uterine activity
abstract: A decision support tool is provided for predicting uterine contractions. The predicted contractions are determined from measurements of uterine activity (UA). The contraction forecast may be made using a plurality of trained predictive models. The forecasts are formed with linear regressive models based, at least in part, on UA data from a reference population. The predicted contractions may be predictions of contraction duration, contraction peak, and time between contractions. In this way, these predicted contractions may be used for decision support for care plans during labor, such as increased monitoring and/or modifying the care plan.

title: Automatically generating rules for laboratory instruments
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods and systems for automatically generating processing rules for automatic decision making when operating an instrument to analyze and process a biological sample (e.g., for the presence, absence, or concentration of an analyte). For example, some automatically generated processing rules may suggest conditions and criteria in which some test results obtained from biological samples may be automatically validated and sent out, while other test results are flagged for additional review. The processing rules may be generated based on patterns observed through actions taken with respect to historical test results associated with similar biological samples.

title: Super resolution for satellite images
abstract: Systems and methods for generating predicted high-resolution images from low-resolution images. To generate the predicted high-resolution images, the present technology may utilize machine learning models and super resolution models in a series of processes. For instance, the low-resolution images may undergo a sensor transformation based on processing by a machine learning model. The low-resolution images may also be combined with land structure features and/or prior high-resolution images to form an augmented input that is processed by a super resolution model to generate an initial predicted high-resolution image. The predicted initial high-resolution image may be combined or stacked with other predicted high-resolution images to form a stacked image. That stacked image may then be processed by another super resolution model to generate a final predicted high-resolution image.

title: Cataloging database metadata using a signature matching process
abstract: A system and computer implemented method for cataloging database metadata using a signature matching process are provided. The method includes receiving an input name to be matched to a key in a seed table; generating a first fingerprint by decomposing the received input name into a first set n-grams; generating, based on the received input name, a second fingerprint using a predetermined pronunciation schema, wherein the second fingerprint is a phonetic fingerprint; generating a third fingerprint by decomposing the second fingerprint into a second set of n-grams; identifying a matching key by matching any combination of the first fingerprint, the second fingerprint, and the third fingerprint against keys in the seed table; and cataloging the metadata with the matching key as a tag.

title: System and method for assessing ventilated patient condition
assignee: 维亚埃尔医疗股份有限公司
abstract: The disclosed system receives various physiological and physical information and operational data about a patient from a ventilation device and a drug delivery device and provides the physiological and physical information and operational data together to a neural network configured to analyze the information and data. A system receives a patient assessment classification from the neural network corresponding to at least one of a pain assessment, a sepsis assessment, and a delirium assessment of a patient based on providing the determined patient physiological state, the determined patient physical state, the determined ventilator operation mode, drug delivery information, and the received patient diagnostic information to the neural network; and based on the assessment classification, adjusting ventilation parameters affecting a ventilator operating mode that provides ventilation to the patient.
assignee_clean: 维亚埃尔医疗股份有限公司

title: Method and system for facilitating displaying search result
abstract: A computer system that facilitates presentation of data to a user. A search engine component receives and executes queries on behalf of a user. Results of the query are received and analyzed by an analysis component that filters and organizes the results as a function of relevancy of the data to the user and associated context of the query. A user interface component presents the data to the user in a manner that facilitates easy consumption/processing of data by respective users. The user interface component can dynamically modify display settings as a function of content and type of information displayed, user state, user preferences, explicit or implicit learning, user intent, etc.

title: Unbalanced data set processing method and device based on machine learning
assignee: 国家电网有限公司, 国网电子商务有限公司, 国网雄安金融科技集团有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a processing method and a processing device of an unbalanced data set based on machine learning, relates to the technical field of data processing, and can solve the problem of distribution marginalization caused in the process of synthesizing an artificial sample by an SMOTE algorithm. The processing method comprises the following steps: a method of processing a machine learning based unbalanced data set, comprising: generating a central sample according to a first sample set containing a plurality of majority type image samples and an initial second sample set containing a plurality of minority type image samples, wherein the majority type image samples and the minority type image samples both contain N-dimensional attributes, the central sample is composed of an average value of the attributes of each dimension of the plurality of majority type image samples and the plurality of minority type image samples, and N is larger than or equal to 1; and performing random linear interpolation between the central sample and at least one minority image sample to generate a new minority sample, and obtaining a second sample set updated by using the new minority sample.

title: Microspur imaging system, method and device
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a macro imaging system, a macro imaging method and a macro imaging device. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of macro shot images obtained by a target terminal in different lighting modes through macro shooting of a target sample, preprocessing the plurality of macro shot images to obtain a plurality of preprocessed images, inputting the preprocessed images into a target neural network model, and obtaining an image recognition result output by the target neural network model. The invention solves the technical problem that the target area required by the sample is difficult to completely and comprehensively obtain when the sample is difficult to shoot when the target area of the target sample is obtained in the related technology.

title: System and method for physically detecting, identifying, and diagnosing medical electronic devices connectable to a network
abstract: A method for detecting, in a real-time manner, a presence or an absence of a an anomaly in or a cyber attack onto a medical apparatus comprises the steps of capturing, with an antenna, one or more emissions of electromagnetic energy from the processing devices within medical apparatus; converting, with a receiver coupled to the antenna, the one or more emissions from an analog to a digital form; generating, with a controller, a digital signal in a time domain; converting, the digital signal from the time domain to a frequency domain, the digital signal containing a signature of cross modulation products from the non-linear attachments; processing, in the frequency domain, the signature of cross modulation products to determine mixing characteristics of the cross modulation products; and detecting, based on the mixing characteristics, the absence or the presence of the anomaly or the cyber attack.

title: Digital intelligent oxygen generation system oriented to medical environment
assignee: 湖南一特医疗股份有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing, and particularly relates to a digital intelligent oxygen generation system for medical environments. The oxygen generating system provided by the invention can carry out integrated management and control on the oxygen generating system in the medical environment, and can comprehensively integrate oxygen storage equipment of the oxygen generating system and resources of the oxygen generating equipment. In addition, the shallow classifier is designed to classify the oxygen supply states under various data, so that deviation or error caused by manual judgment can be overcome, and the intelligent identification of different oxygen supply states in the oxygen production system can be realized on the premise that the real-time performance of judging the oxygen supply states in the medical environment is met. In addition, the invention provides the method based on the reinforcement learning algorithm, so that the intelligent agent automatically learns the optimal execution instruction of the oxygen generating system in different oxygen supply states in the process of interacting with the oxygen generating system, and the oxygen supplying state of the oxygen generating system is automatically and accurately controlled by the intelligent agent in different oxygen supplying states.

title: COPD respiratory monitoring device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of COPD medical equipment, and particularly discloses a COPD respiratory monitoring device which comprises a prediction system for COPD acute exacerbation and respiratory failure, a respiratory monitoring mechanism and a head-mounted respiratory training mechanism, wherein the prediction system comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring clinical case data of a sample, a data processing module for receiving and processing the clinical case data and acquiring variable parameters, a risk factor acquisition module for receiving the variable parameters and screening to obtain independent risk factors, and a prediction module for bringing the independent risk factors into a machine learning prediction model and predicting. By adopting the technical scheme, the sample information is collected and screened by matching the modules, and whether the T2RF occurs to the patient is predicted according to the collected information.

title: Big data artificial intelligence computer system used for medical care connected to millions of sensor-equipped smartphones connected to their users' configurable footwear soles with sensors and to body sensors
abstract: A big data artificial intelligence computer system is used for medical care connecting to sensor-equipped smartphones of users of footwear. The footwear has smartphone-connected soles with sensors and configurable structures. The smartphone is also connected to sensors located on the users' body, including proximate to its center of gravity and/or on the head. The web and/or cloud-based computer system is configured to use the big data techniques of machine learning in a database compiled from millions of smartphones to perform operations on billions of data sets from the smartphones of the footwear users. The correlations found from the big data operations provide solutions to medical problems of the footwear users involving their body structure and/or function. The solutions are implemented by configuring the users' footwear soles, including active configuration, including during running and/or walking to optimize corrections to the structure and/or function of their bodies.

title: Method for pinned and guide data user interface for fast movement between medical labeling data and apparatus using the same
abstract: According to the present invention, provided is a method for providing a user interface for fast movement between medical labeling data to improve the speed of moving between data. The method for providing a user interface comprises the steps of: receiving input for selecting fixed data for fast movement among a plurality of image data; and registering a small thumbnail corresponding to the fixed data and displaying the small thumbnail to be exposed on a work screen. The input for selecting the fixed data includes input of a fixed icon displayed on an area of the work screen by a user.

title: Method and apparatus for analyzing biomolecules using oligonucleotide
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for analyzing biomolecules using oligonucleotides, and more particularly, to a method and apparatus for confirming the biological significance of biomolecules in a biological sample by preparing oligonucleotides which completely and complementarily bind to a specific region of a target nucleic acid from the nucleic acid of the target nucleic acid including nucleic acid and receptor-analyte ligand complex, etc., analyzing the target nucleic acid, and analyzing the biomolecules contained in the biological sample by one-time examination.

title: Method for merging an analysis data record with an image data record, positioning device, computer program and electronically readable data storage medium
abstract: A method for merging a three-dimensional analysis data record of a tissue sample of a patient with a three-dimensional image data record of the patient indicating, prior to removal, the removal area of the tissue sample. The method includes registering a three-dimensional intermediate data record of the three-dimensional analysis data record. The registering includes transforming analysis data of the three-dimensional analysis data record into intermediate data, corresponding to image data recorded with a modality with which the three-dimensional image data record has been recorded and including a resolution reduced, to determine the three-dimensional intermediate data record corresponding, in terms of resolution, to the image data record; and registering the three-dimensional intermediate data record with the three-dimensional image data record. Finally, the method includes merging the three-dimensional analysis data record and the three-dimensional image data record using a registration rule obtained during the registering of the three-dimensional intermediate data record.

title: Fractal analysis of left atrium to predict atrial fibrillation recurrence
assignee: Case Western Reserve University, The Cleveland Clinic Foundation
abstract: Embodiments discussed herein facilitate determination of risk of recurrence of atrial fibrillation (AF) after ablation based on fractal features. One example embodiment is configured to generate a binary mask of at least a portion of a CT scan of a heart of a patient with AF; compute one or more radiomic fractal-based features from at least one of the binary mask or the portion of the CT scan; provide the one or more radiomic fractal-based features to a trained machine learning (ML) classifier; and receive a prediction from the trained ML classifier of whether or not the AF will recur after AF ablation, wherein the prediction is based at least in part on the one or more radiomic fractal-based features.
assignee_clean: case western reserve university; the cleveland clinic foundation

title: Pathological critical value early warning method based on pathological knowledge graph and related equipment
assignee: 广州金域医学检验中心有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a pathology critical value early warning method based on a pathology knowledge graph, which comprises the steps of acquiring pathology text information from a pathology report; extracting a target entity from the pathological text information; carrying out matching analysis on a target entity by using a preset pathology knowledge graph, and determining whether a pathology critical value exists in a pathology report; if a pathology critical value exists, early warning and reminding are carried out, and timely early warning of the pathology critical value is achieved, so that a pathologist and a clinician are timely reminded of paying priority and early attention, next clinical treatment is given, further clinical treatment is carried out on a patient to the greatest extent timely, and accordingly timely treatment rate of the patient is greatly improved, and early warning efficiency and medical quality of the pathology critical value are improved. In addition, a pathology critical value early warning system, computer equipment and storage medium based on a pathology knowledge graph are also provided.

title: Pervasive 3D graphical user interface configured for machine learning
abstract: A three-dimensional graphical user interface (3D GUI) configured to be used by a computer, a display system, an electronic system, or an electro-mechanical system. The 3D GUI provides an enhanced user-engaging experience while enabling a user to manipulate the motion of an object of arbitrary size and a multiplicity of independent degrees of freedom, using sufficient degrees of freedom to represent the motion. The 3D GUI includes the functionality of machine learning (ML), which uses support vector machine (SVM) and/or convolutional neural network (CNN) to provide intelligent control of robot kinematics and computer graphics as well as the ability of the user to more quickly learn the more subtle applications of 3D computer graphics.

title: Data processing method and system for medical clinical study based on middle stage technology
assignee: 广东珠江智联信息科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing consoles, in particular to a data processing method and a system for medical clinical research based on a console technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: medical clinical data in hospitals or big data are collected, standardized processing is carried out on the medical clinical data, the screened medical clinical data are stored into a database, the medical clinical data in the database are extracted, further data processing is carried out on the medical clinical data, a convolutional neural network model is input for training, the trained convolutional neural network model is used for carrying out data processing on the medical clinical data, the medical clinical data are stored in a distributed mode, the medical clinical data corresponding to keywords are stored in a distributed mode through weights, the medical clinical data can be guaranteed to be acquired rapidly and accurately, the data are cleaned to remove redundant data, and the data size is greatly reduced.

primary_assignee: 广东珠江智联信息科技股份有限公司

title: Methods for the diagnosis and prognosis of melanoma from topical skin swabs
abstract: A method for predicting the presence of melanoma comprises performing molecular profiling of at least one of genomic and transcriptomic material extracted from a skin swab sample collected from a lesion of a patient, extracting one or more biological features from the molecular profiling, comparing the one or more extracted biological features to one or more biological features corresponding to one or more reference skin swab samples collected from a plurality of reference patients, and predicting, based on the comparing, whether the lesion of the patient is cancerous.

title: Artificial intelligence (AI) electrocardiogram (ECG)
abstract: Electrical impulses are received from a beating heart. The electrical impulses are converted to an ECG waveform. The ECG waveform is converted to a frequency domain waveform, which, in turn, is separated into two or more different frequency domain waveforms, which, in turn, are converted into a plurality of time domain cardiac electrophysiological subwaveforms and discontinuity points between these subwaveforms. The plurality of subwaveforms and discontinuity points are compared to a database of subwaveforms and discontinuity points for normal and abnormal patients. An ST-T interval is identified from the plurality of subwaveforms and discontinuity points based on the comparison, the ST-T interval is divided into N number of equally spaced sections, and an average data value of detection is calculated for each section. A table is displayed that includes an average data value of detection for each section of the ST-T interval.

title: Dynamic neuropsychological assessment tool
abstract: A dynamic neuropsychological assessment tool according to an embodiment utilizes speech recognition, speech synthesis and machine learning to assess whether a patient is at risk for a neurological disorder, such as Alzheimer's disease. The dynamic neuropsychological assessment tool enables self-administration by a patient. The tool performs pre-test validation operations on the test environment, test equipment, and the patient's capability for performing the test at that time. The tool also enables dynamic modification of a questionnaire presented to the patient while the patient completes the questionnaire. Also provides the dynamic modification of which tests to present the patient with. The modification can be rule based or modified by a provider. The dynamic neuropsychological assessment tool enables providers and administrators to modify and improve tests and validate them using machine learning based on previously completed assessments and results.

title: Based on the intellectual medical diagnostic classification method for thering is supervision isometric to map
abstract: The present invention relates to based on the intellectual medical diagnostic classification method for having supervision isometric to map.Medical data is compiled into training dataset and test data set by the present invention, the isometry mapping dimensionality reduction for having supervision of training data, including calculating geodesic curve distance, supervision message is incorporated to geodesic curve distance, the manifold low-dimensional of training data is embedded in, construct categorised decision face, the unsupervised low-dimensional insertion of test data.The present invention overcomes the defects for the loss for leading to manifold overall structure information existing for the past.The present invention has label data to carry out feature extraction higher-dimension, then classification boundaries face is constructed using data of the linear SVM algorithm building categorised decision after dimensionality reduction according to data characteristics, explicit low-dimensional mapping is constructed plus linear categorised decision face, be conducive to improve comprehensibility, reduce the redundancy of data, the precision for calculating analysis is improved, the calculating cost to medical data is also reduced.

title: Diagnosis device and computer system for detecting non-alcoholic fatty liver disease state of subject
assignee: 深圳市绘云生物科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a diagnostic device for detecting the non-alcoholic fatty liver disease state of a test object, which takes the age and body mass index of the test object, the fasting blood sugar of a biological sample of the test object, gamma-glutamyl transferase, high-density lipoprotein, cholesterol, total bilirubin, albumin, aspartate aminotransferase and platelet count as diagnostic indexes and can be combined with the biomarker level of the biological sample of the test object to evaluate the non-alcoholic fatty liver disease state of the test object. The diagnosis device can quickly, accurately and comprehensively evaluate and diagnose the non-alcoholic fatty liver disease state of a tested body.
assignee_clean: 深圳市绘云生物科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市绘云生物科技有限公司

title: Hearing performance and rehabilitation and/or rehabilitation enhancement using normals
abstract: A system comprising: a first microphone of a non-body-carried device; and a processor configured to receive input based on sound captured by the first microphone and analyze the received input to: a determination is made as to whether the sound captured by the first microphone indicates attempted communication between persons in a structure in which the microphones are located, and success of the communication is assessed in response to determining that the sound indicates attempted communication between the persons.

title: Medical data management query method
assignee: 成都安哲斯生物医药科技有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of data management, and discloses a medical data management query method, which comprises a database construction flow and a search query flow; the database construction flow comprises the following steps: collecting medical data and classifying; the non-text information is written into a database after standardized processing; extracting keywords from the natural text information, performing standardized processing, and writing the standardized processing into a database; the search query flow includes: classifying the input query field; searching in a database through standardized text input; extracting keywords from natural text input, performing standardization processing, and judging fields to be searched by using a knowledge graph to obtain the fields and conditions to be searched; the search is performed in the database by the fields and conditions being searched. The medical data management query method can process natural text search, and reduces the use threshold of a database.

primary_assignee: 成都安哲斯生物医药科技有限公司

title: Medical image style migration method combining Markov field and Graham matrix characteristics
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image style migration method combining Markov fields and Graham matrix characteristics, which comprises the following steps of 1) carrying out pre-operation on a target image and a reference image; 2) an affine loss function is constructed by calculating a Laplace matrix of a target image, and local affine is restrained to restrain image transformation; 3) extracting depth features of each level of the target image and the reference image by using a depth neural network, and iteratively aggregating the depth features; 4) constructing a content retention loss and style loss function; 5) and continuously updating the initial image by using a gradient descent method until the style information of the reference image and the texture structure of the target image are provided through the constructed total loss function. The invention can complete the style transfer function in the medical scene and can generate real and beautiful medical images.

title: Coronary reconstruction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a coronary reconstruction method, a coronary reconstruction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial coronary image to be segmented, carrying out gray scale normalization on the initial coronary image to obtain a target coronary image, and dividing the target coronary image into at least one image block to be segmented; the method comprises the steps of respectively determining initial key points, radiuses and actual extending directions of coronary arteries to be segmented in each image block to be segmented, and determining new key points of the coronary arteries based on the initial key points, the radiuses and the actual extending directions of the coronary arteries; dividing coronary blocks in the image blocks to be divided based on the initial key points of the coronary, the newly added key points of the coronary, the radius of the coronary to be divided and the actual extending direction; a target coronary image of the initial coronary image is determined based on the segmented coronary blocks of each image block to be segmented. According to the technical scheme, accurate segmentation of the coronary artery can be realized, and the sufficiently fine branches can be segmented under the condition that motion artifact and coronary artery plaque exist, so that the robustness is high.
assignee_clean: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司

title: User device based Parkinson's disease detection
abstract: A method and user device for determining a unified Parkinson's disease rating scale (UPDRS) value associated with a user of the user device include obtaining video data associated with a movement of a body part of the user. The UPDRS value is determined using a model and the video data associated with the movement of the body part of the user. The UPDRS value is provided to permit an evaluation of the user based on the UPDRS value.

title: Automatic learning method and system of virtual assistant
assignee: 鼎捷软件股份有限公司
abstract: An automatic learning method and system for virtual assistant. The automatic learning method of the virtual assistant comprises the following steps: receiving audio input and identifying audio to form corpus data; analyzing the corpus data by using a natural language processing model to generate language characteristic information corresponding to the corpus data; performing function context analysis on the language characteristic information according to the function context information, and judging operation corresponding to one of the intentions; if the function situation analysis cannot judge the operation corresponding to one of the intentions, word segmentation is carried out on the corpus data; judging whether new vocabulary or new corpus data exists according to the word segmentation result; if new vocabulary exists, the natural language processing model is updated according to the meaning of the new vocabulary, and if new corpus data exists, the function context analysis is updated according to the intention of the new corpus data. Therefore, the ERP system can be used by a user more quickly and conveniently.
assignee_clean: 鼎捷软件股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 鼎捷软件股份有限公司

title: Deep learning-based multi-scene fusion endangered organ segmentation method
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning-based multi-scene-fused organ-at-risk segmentation method, which comprises the steps of respectively constructing a segmentation model for each data set by considering the common characteristics of data in a scene, and acquiring a first optimal sub-model and a second optimal sub-model which are obtained by training each organ in each data set; an integrated model is built for all data sets, the integrated model is trained through all the data sets, and meanwhile, in the training process, all the obtained first optimal submodels and the obtained second optimal submodels are introduced into the integrated model as feature extractors and are used for guiding the integrated model to train data under different scenes, so that the integrated model focuses on personalized features of the segmented organs and the differences between the organs and the background, the detection rate of the to-be-segmented organs can be improved, and the appearance of false positives can be reduced.

title: Structure display method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a structure display method, a structure display device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image, the medical image comprising a target structure; preprocessing the medical image to obtain a center line tree of a target structure; performing surface fitting processing on the center line tree of the target structure to obtain a surface where the center line tree of the target structure is located; and performing projection processing on the curved surface where the center line tree of the target structure is located by using a preset conical projection method to obtain a planar target structure image, and displaying the planar target structure image. The target structure displayed by the method is complete and accurate, and a doctor can observe the target structure conveniently, so that the obtained observation result is more accurate.

title: Automatic positioning of an X-ray source by way of segmentation
abstract: At least one example embodiment provides a method for automatic positioning of an X-ray source of a medical X-ray system with a mobile X-ray detector. The method includes determining an examination region of the examination object, acquiring a position and a location of the examination object and the examination region by way of an optical position determining system, localizing the examination region, ascertaining a field point of the central ray of the X-ray source and a collimator size of the X-ray source based on the localized examination region, and automatic positioning of the X-ray source based on the field point and the collimator size.

title: System, methods, and devices for visual construction of operations for data querying
abstract: A platform, device and process is provided for visual construction of operations for data querying. In particular, embodiments described herein provides a platform, device and process for visual construction of nested operations for data querying. The visual construction is a display of one or more projected data spaces enabling a selection of data indicators on the display. The selection is conducted graphically on the visual construction and the system is configured to translate the selection to generate and conduct a query operating visually on the visualized (e.g., projected) data space. The visual data space includes distinct views of the plurality of multi-dimensionality data points mapped to reduced-dimensionality data points with a transformation function associated with each view. The selections are used to augment the multi-dimensionality data points with one or more additional dimensions to track the selections and to perform operations and visualizations.

title: Determination of further processing positions in magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: The invention provides a method of training a neural network (322), the method being configured to provide a further processing location (326). The method comprises providing (200) a marked medical image (100), wherein the marked medical image comprises a plurality of markers, each marker indicating a true treatment location (102, 104, 106), the method further comprising inputting (202) the marked medical image into the neural network to obtain one trial treatment location. The one trial process location includes a most likely trial process location (108). The method further includes determining (204) a closest true process location (106) for the most likely trial process location. The method further comprises calculating (206) an error vector (110) using the closest true process position and the most likely trial process position. The method further includes training (208) the neural network using the error vector.

title: Medical image sample generation method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The specification discloses a medical image sample generation method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. In the medical image sample generation method provided in the present specification, when a user analyzes a medical image, the medical image is collected as a sample image, and sight line data of the user is collected; according to the sight line data, generating an interested region related to medical information in the sample image as a labeling image corresponding to the sample image; fusing any two sample images to obtain a synthesized sample image, and obtaining a synthesized annotation image according to two annotation images corresponding to the two sample images, wherein the synthesized annotation image corresponds to the synthesized sample image; and determining each sample image and each synthesized sample image as a training sample of the model, determining each labeling image and each synthesized labeling image as a labeling of the model, and performing medical image sight area prediction based on a deep learning frame, namely generating the synthesized labeling image sample.

title: Sleep comprehensive monitoring system
assignee: 广州赛哲生物科技股份有限公司, 华南理工大学
abstract: The utility model discloses a monitor system is synthesized in sleep, including brain electricity monitoring devices, intelligent terminal, network service platform, backend server and the little electric current of transcranial stimulation appearance, brain electricity monitoring devices's output and intelligent terminal's input wireless connection, intelligent terminal still is connected with network service platform and the little electric current of transcranial stimulation appearance respectively, network service platform still with backend server wireless connection. The utility model discloses set up intelligent terminal, network service platform and backend server, can not only come in time to assess the sleep quality through intelligent terminal, can cooperate the backend server to carry out the sleep quality assessment through network service platform moreover, can also acquire the advisory suggestion that long-range expert fed back through the backend server, it is more convenient, the function is abundanter; the transcranial micro-current stimulation instrument is additionally arranged, so that the sleep quality can be assisted to be improved according to the sleep quality evaluation result, and the method is more convenient and comprehensive. The utility model discloses but wide application in medical equipment field.

title: Methods and systems using fractional rank precision and mean average precision as test-retest reliability measures
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods and systems of evaluating test-retest precision using fractional rank precision or mean-average precision, comprising: a) collecting a test and a retest result of each subject, wherein the results are described in feature space(s) and collected from a vision test machine; b) selecting, a first test result of a first subject; c) calculating distances from the first test result to the retest result of each subject; d) assessing, a similarity between the first test result and the retest result of each subject by ranking the distances in a non-descending order; e) assessing a rank precision for the first subject based on a rank of a distance from the first test result to the retest result of the first subject; f) repeating b), c), d), and e) for each subject; and evaluating, the test-retest precision based on the rank precision for each of the plurality of subjects.

title: Case management model processing
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus and system for processing a case management model (CMM). According to an embodiment, there is provided a method for processing a CMM, the method includes: obtaining an existing CMM having a plurality of elements; obtaining a new CMM having at least one element; aligning an element of the new CMM to an element of the existing CMM according to match costs between the element of the new CMM and the plurality of elements of the existing CMM; and fusing the new CMM into the existing CMM based on the match cost between the aligned elements.

title: Semi-supervised cyclic self-learning method and model for few-sample lumbar medical image
assignee: 杭州健培科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a semi-supervised loop self-learning method and a semi-supervised loop self-learning model for a few-sample lumbar medical image, which aim at solving the problem of high labeling cost of the medical image.

title: Big data visualization processing method and system for medical diagnosis based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 武汉蓝嵊科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a big data visualization processing method and a big data visualization processing system for medical diagnosis based on artificial intelligence.A data processing module preprocesses information detected by biological characteristic detection equipment so as to acquire life information, behavior and action information, body scanning information and voice information processed by the data processing module to acquire pathological images; the diagnostic analysis module performs diagnostic analysis according to the acquired pathological image extraction features to obtain analysis data; the visualization module draws a reference picture and a comparison picture according to the obtained analysis data to compare the analysis result, and the data format conversion and the table structure conversion are carried out on the analysis result and are stored in the storage module; the correlation module establishes a correlation relation between field query icons of the basic and pathological information data tables and the image information data table, the gene information data table and the CT image path data table respectively through the correlation module and generates a view, so that data interaction and chart conversion are realized; and the image display device performs display by executing the instruction of the cloud server.

title: Natural language processing method, device and storage medium for epidemiological survey report
assignee: 医渡云（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a natural language processing method, a natural language processing device and a computer readable storage medium for a epidemic disease investigation report, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing sense group division on the natural language information to obtain a plurality of sense group phrases; then, identifying medical event information from the sense group phrase, reserving other information as non-medical event information, and extracting main information of a conventional event from the non-medical event information by using a general natural language processing system; then, the medical event information and the main information of the conventional event are combined, and joint information processing is carried out to obtain data required by decision making. Therefore, through the mode of extracting the medical event information and the main information of the conventional event in a layered manner, not only can the typical medical event information be extracted in a targeted manner, but also other important information in the conventional event can be acquired, so that information omission is avoided, and the efficiency, the accuracy and the integrity of information extraction are greatly improved.
