title: Sensing for heart failure management
abstract: In some examples, determining a heart failure status of a patient using a medical device comprising a plurality of electrodes includes determining an estimated arterial pressure waveform of the patient based on an arterial impedance signal received from at least two of the plurality of electrodes. The estimated arterial pressure waveform may comprise a plurality of arterial pressure cycles. Each of the plurality of arterial pressure cycles may correspond to a different cardiac cycle of a plurality of cardiac cycles of the patient. At least one value of an intrinsic frequency of the corresponding arterial pressure cycle may be determined for at least some of the plurality of cardiac cycles and the heart failure status of the patient may be determined based on the at least one value of the intrinsic frequency.

title: System and method for many langaguses support using chatbot
abstract: The present invention relates to a technology for a multilingual service that provides various information necessary for domestic life by using a chatbot. The present invention categorizes each domestic institution and provides the multilingual service for guiding foreigners who are not familiar with a native language through an administrative procedure and the like by using the chatbot.

title: System and method for audio signal placement and projection
abstract: System and method for projecting audio signals to an operator of a teleoperational surgical system to convey spatial orientation associated with the audio signals to the operator. Characteristics of the audio signals such as direction and volume may be selected to give the impression that the remote operator is positioned locally next to the patient. Characteristics of the audio signals may also be modified to provide spatial translations between actual locations of audio sources within a physical audio environment and simulations locations of the audio sources with a virtual audio environment.

title: Method and system for provisioning cloud service on vehicle
abstract: Embodiments of this disclosure disclose provisioning a cloud service on a vehicle. The method may include, in response to receiving a registration request for cloud services for a vehicle and determining a geographical location of the vehicle based on the registration request. The method may further include identifying cloud services available to the geographical location and extracting capability information of the vehicle from real time series data of the vehicle. The method may further include determining cloud services applicable to the vehicle from the cloud services available to the geographical location based on the extracted capability information of the vehicle and in response to receiving a service subscription request from the vehicle, provisioning on the vehicle a cloud service applicable to the vehicle corresponding to the service subscription request.

title: Deep neural network visualisation
abstract: Aspects and embodiments relate to a method of providing a representation of a feature identified by a deep neural network as being relevant to an outcome, a computer program product and apparatus configured to perform that method. The method comprises: providing the deep neural network with a training library comprising: a plurality of samples associated with the outcome; using the deep neural network to recognise a feature in the plurality of samples associated with the outcome; creating a feature recognition library from an input library by identifying one or more elements in each of a plurality of samples in the input library which trigger recognition of the feature by the deep neural network; using the feature recognition library to synthesise a plurality of one or more elements of a sample which have characteristics which trigger recognition of the feature by the deep neural network; and using the synthesised plurality of one or more elements to provide a representation of the feature identified by the deep neural network in the plurality of samples associated with the outcome. Accordingly, rather than visualising a single instance of one or more elements in a sample which trigger a feature associated with an outcome, it is possible to visualise a range of samples including elements which would trigger a feature associated with an outcome, thus enabling a more comprehensive view of operation of a deep neural network in relation to a particular feature.

title: Vital sign data processing method, system, device and computer readable medium
assignee: 四川华迪信息技术有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to a data processing technology. The invention discloses a vital sign data processing method, a vital sign data processing system, a vital sign data processing device and a computer readable medium. The vital sign data processing method of the invention comprises the following steps: a. preprocessing vital sign data; b. learning random latent variables in the vital sign data and constraining the variables to be Gaussian distribution; c. learning the feature representation of vital sign data in each subset through two fully-connected network layers of a neural network according to a specific task, and performing fusion learning on the learned feature of each subtask and the random latent variable feature; d. training the model, verifying the model by using a verification set every 30 iterations, and reserving the optimal model; e. and testing the stored optimal model by using the test set to finally obtain the evaluation result of each task. The method can be used for accurately evaluating the capability and risk of the vital sign data of the healthy body, and the evaluation accuracy is greatly improved.

title: Intelligent management system and method for adverse events of heart failure patients
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent management system and method for adverse events of a heart failure patient, belonging to the field of medical data management. The system comprises a communication server, a computing cloud server and one or more clients connected with the computing cloud server; the communication server comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring heart failure patient data; the computing cloud server comprises an algorithm module for modeling the patient data by using a DCC algorithm, and an analysis result of an adverse event model is obtained through calculation of the algorithm module; the result display module of the client is used for result output or data input and comprises a result display module used for analysis result output or grading input. The defect that the existing system and method cannot solve the intelligent management of adverse events of the heart failure patients is effectively overcome, and the intelligent management system and method are beneficial to standardizing and improving the flow and level of the intelligent management of the heart failure patients.

title: Miniaturization of Fiber Bragg Grating interrogation for integration into implantable devices
abstract: A miniaturized fiber Bragg grating (FBG) interrogation system may comprise a light source, a FBG sensor, and a photodetector. The FBG sensor may be configured to receive an optical signal from the light source, interact with a transmitted spectrum of the light source over a discriminating spectral domain, and generate a reflected optical signal representative of a change in a physical signal sensed by the FBG sensor. Additionally, the system may include a power management unit configured to reduce power consumption in order to prolong the lifespan of the system.

title: Man-machine interaction method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a man-machine interaction method, a man-machine interaction device, man-machine interaction equipment and a man-machine interaction medium. The method comprises the following steps: and according to the detected interactive instruction, acquiring interactive content corresponding to the interactive instruction based on knowledge point information in a pre-established knowledge point library, and outputting the interactive content to finish the interaction with the interactive object. The knowledge point information in the knowledge point base is obtained by analyzing a disease diagnosis model through a pre-trained analysis model. The man-machine interaction method provided by the embodiment of the invention carries out man-machine interaction by using the analyzed knowledge point information on the basis of using the disease diagnosis model to carry out disease diagnosis, so that an interactive object can convert the knowledge accumulated by artificial intelligence into self knowledge and experience by learning the knowledge points analyzed and obtained from the disease diagnosis model under the condition of not participating in simple disease diagnosis, and the accumulation of primary knowledge and experience to advanced knowledge and experience is completed.

title: Method and apparatus for improved presentation of information
assignee: Robert Edwin Douglas, David Byron Douglas, Kathleen Mary Douglas
abstract: A method and apparatus comprising generating a dynamic content blocker. An image, which may be comprised of words, symbols and pictures, is segmented into items. Each item is analyzed by an artificial intelligence algorithm. Items can be determined by the AI algorithm to be of non-interest. The dynamic content blocker consists of a blocking image, which is dynamically placed over the items of non-interest, as determined by the AI. If the AI determines that the items are of interest, then these items will remain visible to the user. This will therefore generate a more eye-appealing image for the user and improve the presentation of imagery to a user.

title: Warehouse Management Control System for Oriental Medical Products
abstract: The present invention relates to a warehouse management control system for oriental medical products, which comprises an administrator terminal group (100g), a network (200), an oriental medical product warehouse management server (300), a warehouse terminal (500), an IoT sensor module group (600g), and a CCTV group (700g). The efficiency of storing oriental medical products can be improved by collecting environmental information parameters based on an environmental sensor for oriental medical products stored for online sales, and designating and storing the oriental medical products in a region matching storage characteristics of the oriental medical products based on the collected parameters.

title: Multi-view multi-scale lymph node false positive inhibition modeling method
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-view multi-scale lymph node false positive inhibition modeling method. The invention discloses a radiotherapy automatic plan design system and a construction method thereof, relating to the field of radiotherapy plan systems and comprising a plan design auxiliary contour generation module, a prescription setting module, an addition radiation field module, a deep neural network dose prediction module and an optimization objective function generation and plan design module; the deep neural network dose prediction module is used for providing a reasonable dose design target for a reverse optimization process according to data obtained from the same disease species; after the deep neural network model is trained, the dose distribution condition of the radiotherapy patient can be predicted quickly within a few minutes, and the radiotherapy plan design is automatically carried out, so that the working efficiency of a radiotherapy doctor is effectively improved, and the formulation of a radiotherapy scheme of the patient is accelerated.

title: Machine learning-based chronic lymphocytic leukemia tumor cell identification method
assignee: 江苏省人民医院（南京医科大学第一附属医院）
abstract: The invention discloses a chronic lymphocytic leukemia tumor cell identification method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: (1) detecting antigens related to chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and calculating a confidence interval of fluorescence intensity of the antigens; (2) constructing a neural network model, wherein the input of the model is a confidence interval boundary, and the output of the model is the expected output of whether the model belongs to chronic lymphocytic leukemia or not; (3) training a neural network model by using the collected cell fluorescence intensity data of the chronic lymphocytic leukemia patient and the non-chronic lymphocytic leukemia patient; (4) for a new patient needing diagnosis, collecting the fluorescence intensity data of the cells of the patient, and giving a reference identification result by using a neural network model. By means of machine learning and a large amount of historical data, the method can assist clinicians in accurately identifying whether the tumor cells belong to chronic lymphocytic leukemia, so that the efficiency and quality of clinical diagnosis are improved.

title: Medical information extraction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京惠每云科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a medical information extraction method, a medical information extraction device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the medical information extraction method comprises the following steps: and acquiring first text data, wherein the first text data is a medical record text. And invoking the BERT model to perform fixed point number operation on the first text data to obtain a first matrix and a second matrix which respectively correspond to the first embedded layer and the second embedded layer, wherein the first matrix and the second matrix are integer matrices and are respectively used for extracting medical entities and entity relations in medical record texts. And identifying the first matrix through the multi-layer perceptron to extract a first sequence corresponding to the medical entity, wherein the first sequence is used as an input sequence of the conditional random field to acquire a second sequence output by the conditional random field. And calling a concat function to longitudinally combine the integrated second sequence and the second matrix to obtain a third matrix, wherein the third matrix is used for obtaining the multi-group phrase corresponding to the first text data. The situation that the relation between the named entity and the entity is extracted in series is reduced.

title: Image filter
abstract: A computer implemented method is provided that includes generating a spatial filter spectrum that includes a plurality of filters, receiving an input via an interaction device, and performing an operation on the spatial filter spectrum based on the received input, to apply a new filter in the plurality of filters of the spatial filter spectrum.

title: Method and system of repairing oral defect model
abstract:
A method of repairing an oral defect model is proposed and includes a three-dimensional oral defect model obtaining step, a defect cutting line detecting step, a defect point selecting step and a smoothing step. The three-dimensional 
oral defect model obtaining step is for driving a scanner to scan an oral cavity to obtain a three-dimensional oral defect model message. The defect cutting line detecting step is for driving a processor to detect a defect cutting line of the three-dimensional oral defect model message, and driving a displayer to display the defect cutting line. The defect cutting line includes at least one defect feature point. The defect point selecting step is for selecting the at least one defect feature point of the defect cutting line via the displayer. The smoothing step is for driving the processor to perform a smoothing process at the at least one defect feature point, and then converting the three-dimensional oral defect model message into a three-dimensional oral repaired model message, thereby smoothing the defect cutting line. Therefore, the method of repairing the oral defect model of the present disclosure utilizes the smoothing process to repair a defective region so as to obtain a better model.

title: Integrated system and method for personalized stratification and prediction of neurodegenerative disease
assignee: B. G. Negev Technologies And Applications Ltd., At Ben-Gurion University
abstract: An integrated system and method for personalized stratification and prediction of neurodegenerative disease state and progression rate. Homogenous patient clusters are identified among heterogeneous patient data. Each patient cluster is characterized by specific disease factors that are used to predict disease progression state and rate for patients assigned to a particular patient cluster in accordance with his disease profile.

title: Electronic computer tomography front-end equipment, system, method and storage medium
abstract: The invention is suitable for the medical technical field, has provided a electron computer tomography front-end apparatus, system, method and storage medium, the emission source of the front-end apparatus includes: the emitting units are arranged in a preset arrangement mode and are sequentially controlled to execute corresponding scanning actions, and the emergent direction of the emitting units passes through the scanning center. Therefore, the multiple emission units can be controlled to sequentially and rapidly execute scanning actions without acquiring projection images at different projection angles by adopting step-by-step movement of a single emission unit, so that the moving time of the emission units is saved, the scanning actions can be rapidly carried out while the requirement on the spatial resolution of the reconstructed image is met, the problem of image motion artifacts caused by rapid acceleration and deceleration in step-by-step movement is avoided, and the quality of the reconstructed image is ensured while rapid scanning is carried out.

title: Method, apparatus, storage medium, and program product for image processing
assignee: 北京字节跳动网络技术有限公司
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method, an apparatus, a storage medium, and a program product for image processing are provided. The method described herein comprises: acquiring a training image set, wherein the training image set comprises a group of strongly labeled images and a group of weakly labeled images; determining first gradient information and second gradient information of an image segmentation model to be trained; determining a target training weight associated with the target weakly labeled image based on the similarity between the first gradient information and the second gradient information; and training the image segmentation model using a set of strongly labeled images and a set of weakly labeled images, wherein an impact of the target weakly labeled image on the training is determined based on the target training weights. By determining training weights for a single weakly labeled sample, embodiments of the present disclosure can improve the performance of an image segmentation model.

title: Exercise function assessment method and system based on multi-modal coupling analysis
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-modal data processing, and particularly discloses a motor function assessment method and a motor function assessment system based on multi-modal brain muscle coupling analysis.

title: Comprehensive detection device and method for cancerous region
abstract: The present invention provides a comprehensive detection device and method for a cancerous region, and belongs to the technical field of deep learning. In the present invention, a cancerous region detection network is trained for preprocessed and annotated CT image data to predict bounding box coordinates of a cancerous region and a corresponding cancer confidence score; a clinical analysis network is trained for preprocessed clinical data with a cancer risk level to predict a cancer probability value of a corresponding patient; and a predicted cancer probability value is weighted to a predicted cancer confidence score to realize a comprehensive determination of the cancerous region. The present invention can detect a cancerous region with high accuracy and high performance.

title: Interface for displaying patient data
abstract: An exemplary mobile device may include: an engine programmed to receive one or more sources of patient data providing patient identification information, vital sign information, alarm information, and task information; and a display of the mobile device, the display providing a screen having: a first window having a list of patients assigned to a caregiver; and a second window having a plurality of vital signs and early warning scores associated with a patient of the caregiver.

title: Service recommendation method based on embedded user portrait model in healthy endowment environment
abstract: The invention relates to a service recommendation method based on an embedded user portrait model in a healthy endowment environment, which comprises the following steps: collecting various information related to the service object; transmitting the collected information related to the service object into a user portrait label which is designed in advance, and selecting four modules of population attribute, social attribute, consumption attribute and health attribute of the old user for the label design label of the old; embedding the user portrait label into a neural network space, and learning a high-dimensional vector capable of summarizing portrait characteristics for each user; and obtaining a high-dimensional vector of the data of the old people after embedding, calculating the similarity between users according to the Euclidean distance, and calculating the prediction score of each user for the target service.

title: Based on pregnant and lying-in women's health monitoring system of mobile Internet
assignee: 华南理工大学, 广州双悠生物科技有限责任公司
abstract: The utility model discloses a kind of pregnant and lying-in women's health monitoring system based on mobile Internet, comprise intelligent terminal, Cloud Server, ECG detection device and blood oxygen saturation checkout gear; Described ECG detection device and blood oxygen saturation checkout gear, be respectively used to the electrocardiosignal and the oxygen saturation signal that gather pregnant and lying-in women, and electrocardiosignal and oxygen saturation signal be sent to intelligent terminal; Described intelligent terminal, for uploading to Cloud Server by electrocardiosignal, oxygen saturation signal, scale screening results and clinical information; Described Cloud Server, for receiving the information that biochemical analysis information and intelligent terminal upload, thus the Health Situation analysis automatically completed pregnant and lying-in women, and generate corresponding nursing and health care guidance, then Health Situation analysis result, nursing and health care are instructed and feed back to intelligent terminal.This utility model make use of development of Mobile Internet technology, is conducive to the Real-Time Monitoring of pregnant and lying-in women's stress situation and physical condition to prevent antenatal, postpartum depression.

title: Classification and device of tumor cell images
assignee: 广州领拓医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to classification and an apparatus of tumor cell images. The classification method of the tumor cell image comprises the steps of training m classifiers for multiple times, determining L optimal projection matrixes according to a target function of a multi-classifier system comprising the m classifiers, obtaining image data to be detected of cells to be detected, projecting characteristic data of the image data to be detected to a new characteristic space through the L optimal projection matrixes to obtain L sets of characteristic data to be detected, inputting the L sets of characteristic data to be detected into the m classifiers, and determining the category of the cells to be detected according to output results of the m classifiers to realize accurate classification of the cells to be detected, so that the classification efficiency is high.

title: Liver disease cognition system based on electronic medical record
assignee: 吾征智能技术(北京)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a liver disease cognition system based on electronic medical records. Comprising the following steps: the preprocessing module is used for acquiring history medical record data, extracting liver disease data information, preprocessing the liver disease data information and acquiring preprocessed liver disease data information as data to be divided; the characteristic dividing module is used for dividing liver disease description characteristic information from data to be divided through the ICTCLAS word segmentation tool and generating a corresponding liver disease description characteristic information data set; the screening module is used for carrying out feature screening on the liver disease description feature information data set through an IV value analysis method, generating a corresponding feature table, and taking the feature table as a diagnosis system model; and the prediction cognition module is used for acquiring the liver disease description characteristic information to be diagnosed and carrying out diagnosis cognition on the liver disease description characteristic information to be diagnosed by using a diagnosis system model. According to the invention, redundant features in the liver disease description feature information dataset are removed by an IV value analysis method, so that the accuracy of feature analysis is improved, and the stability of the whole cognitive system is improved.

title: Medical institution recommendation method based on linear regression factor non-negative matrix factorization model
assignee: 深圳北航新兴产业技术研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a medical institution recommendation method based on a linear regression factor nonnegative matrix factorization model, which is used for processing a medical institution-residential area attendance matrix according to a linear regression tensor factor to obtain a medical institution recommendation target model; then, activating data mining is carried out on the multivariate heterogeneous recommendation original data by adopting a recessive feature model to obtain a recessive feature matrix; and finally, calculating whether the medical institution-residential area treatment amount matrix is converged or not through iteration, and if so, calculating the corrected medical institution-residential area treatment amount matrix by adopting a recommended standard error model, thereby providing a recommended result for the user. The method is applied to the recommendation system, and the recommendation accuracy of the medical institution is effectively improved, so that the utilization value of the internet data of the medical institution to the construction of the smart city is improved, and the influence of incomplete data on the intelligent construction of most smart cities is solved.

title: System and method for computing drug controlled release performance using images
abstract: A method for computing the release rate of a controlled release drug and medical device using a combination of imaging data and computational physics is described. The method employs a three-dimensional digital representation of a drug sample, derived from two-dimensional or three-dimensional imaging, which captures the drug active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), excipients, and porosity with distinctive contrasts. Direct numerical simulations are conducted on the three-dimensional digital representation to derive effective transport properties of the API going through a porous matrix or membrane. Drug release rate can be predicted more efficiently than laboratory-based methods. When there is strong heterogeneity presented in the drug, a further method is described that engages imaging and release simulations at multiple scales. Computerized systems and programs for performing the methods are also described.

title: Endometrial cancer risk screening method and system based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
abstract: The invention provides an endometrial cancer risk screening method and system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises a training process and a verification process. The system comprises a data processing module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data processing module is used for performing data processing, extracting characteristic information of data, and performing labeling processing to form structured data; the Xgboost loss model module is used for training or predicting the structured data to obtain trained or predicted data; the Lasso model simplification module is used for feature simplification to obtain a feature data matrix; and the BR ridge model module is used for obtaining an endometrial cancer risk screening prediction model according to the trained data and obtaining an endometrial cancer risk prediction value according to the predicted data. The invention can be widely used for cross-section risk screening of clinic or physical examination conventional patients, avoids missing high-risk patients, and simultaneously facilitates the work of doctors in automatic risk screening and improves the efficiency; the risk prediction model can be moved forward to the patient end for preliminary screening, so that the self-monitoring and management of the patient are facilitated.

title: MRI image reconstruction method based on structural similarity
abstract: The invention discloses an MRI image reconstruction method based on structural similarity, and belongs to the technical field of medical image optimization. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out analog undersampling pretreatment on the fully sampled MRI image; establishing a single contrast ratio reconstruction model of the contrast ratio of T1 and T2; constructing a similarity constraint loss function; performing fusion training on a multi-contrast fusion reconstruction model; and inputting the undersampled MRI images with a plurality of contrasts at the same part into a multi-contrast fusion reconstruction model. The method utilizes a deep learning technology with strong fitting capability to establish single-contrast reconstruction models for the MRI images with different contrasts, and uses structural similarity constraint to perform fusion training on the single-contrast reconstruction models with different contrasts, so that a higher-quality reconstruction effect is achieved compared with a single-contrast reconstruction neural network model.

title: Food waste detection method and system
abstract: A system (1) for detecting food related products (2) before thrown away, the system comprising: one or more cameras (11), a display unit (12), a computing device (13) that is communicatively connected to the cameras and the display; and a scale (3) that is communicatively connected to the computing device, the scale holding a trash bin (31), wherein the cameras obtain an image or a Video of the products when the products are within a field of View of the cameras and before the products are in the trash bin, the scale configured to weigh the products in the trash bin, and wherein the computing device obtains information about the products from the obtained image or Video by applying an image recognition algorithm, receives the weight from the scale and generates and outputs data on the display unit, the data being based on the information about products and the weight.

title: Predicting atrial fibrillation recurrence after pulmonary vein isolation using simulations of patient-specific magnetic resonance imaging models and machine learning
abstract: A device may receive images of a patient, and may perform segmentation of surfaces on the images to create a 3D model. The device may identify normal tissue regions and atrial fibrosis (AF) regions in the 3D model, and may divide the 3D model into the normal tissue regions and the AF regions. The device may assign first cell and tissue properties to the normal tissue regions, and may assign second cell and tissue properties to the AF regions. The device may perform simulations on the normal tissue regions and the AD regions, based on the first and second cell and tissue properties, to generate simulation results, and may extract first features from the simulation results. The device may extract second features from the images, and may process the first and second features, with a model, to select a feature that is predictive of atrial fibrillation recurrence.

title: Systems and methods for utilizing federated machine-learning to protect against potentially malicious data
abstract: The disclosed computer-implemented method for utilizing federated machine-learning to protect against potentially malicious data may include (i) arranging a set of client devices into groups for applying a federated machine-learning model, (ii) determining model updates for each of the groups over a predetermined period, (iii) training one or more recurrent neural networks to derive a low-dimensional representation of the model updates, (iv) calculating a data quality score for each of the client devices based on the model updates, (v) applying the federated machine-learning model to classify data instances on each of the client devices as including clean data or potentially corrupt data, and (vi) performing a security action that protects against the potentially malicious data by tagging the data instances classified as the potentially corrupt data. Various other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.

title: Detecting apparatus, medical apparatus and method for detecting a position of a predetermined part of a subject
abstract: A detecting apparatus configured to detect a position of a predetermined part of a subject, based on image data of a region including the predetermined part is provided. The detecting apparatus includes a first detecting unit configured to detect a reference position used when the position of the predetermined part is detected, the reference position detected from within the image data, a determining unit configured to rotate a window for detecting the position of the predetermined part about the reference position, and configured to determine a rotational angle of the window when the predetermined part is included in the window, and a second detecting unit configured to set an actual rotational angle of the window to the determined rotational angle and configured to detect the position of the predetermined part from within the window.

title: Intelligent accident detection system
abstract: An accident detection system for providing movement data for processing using a ML model executed on a mobile device, the movement data being generated by the mobile device, receiving, from the ML model, a first prediction representative of an occurrence of a first accident, in response to receiving the first prediction, providing a first local alert on the mobile device, and selecting one of a first network and a second network for broadcasting a first remote alert to one or more end-points, if the first network is selected, the first remote alert is broadcast over the first network by the mobile device, and, if the second network is selected, the first remote alert is broadcast over the second network by an alerting module that is in communication with the mobile device.

title: Online medical method and system, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
assignee: 杭州好育信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an online medical method and system, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the method and the system receive data sent by a community medical terminal and push the data to a doctor terminal; receiving data sent by a doctor terminal, generating a control instruction, pushing the control instruction to the community medical terminal, wherein the control instruction is used for controlling the community medical terminal to execute operations corresponding to the control instruction. The utility model discloses a can utilize community medical terminal to carry out patient data's collection to carry out remote control to community medical terminal, make its execution and control instruction corresponding medical operation come the rescue patient, when patient's illness or injury, need not go to the hospital, can carry out remote therapy in community medical terminal department.

title: Medical picture optimization method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a picture processing technology, and discloses a medical picture optimization method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a medical sample picture set, generating a transformation disturbance script set according to the medical sample picture set, performing transformation disturbance on the medical sample picture set by using the transformation disturbance script set to obtain a plurality of medical duplicate picture sets, and respectively identifying the medical sample picture set and the plurality of medical duplicate picture sets by using a pre-constructed target detection model to obtain a sample detection frame set and a duplicate detection frame set medical sample picture set medical duplicate picture set; and optimizing according to the sample detection frame set and the copy detection frame set to obtain an optimized picture set. In addition, the invention also relates to a blockchain technology, and the model file can be stored in a blockchain node. The invention further provides a medical picture optimization device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The invention can solve the problems of medical picture feature waste and lower optimization accuracy.

title: Pathological labeling method and device applied to FOV picture of mobile terminal
assignee: 广州金域医学检验中心有限公司
abstract: The pathology labeling method applied to the FOV picture of the mobile terminal disclosed by the embodiment of the invention calls any FOV picture and displays the FOV picture on a display interface of the mobile terminal by responding to a pathology labeling instruction input by a user at the mobile terminal; the FOV picture is obtained by segmenting an original scanning image of a pathological section, and the storage space occupied by the FOV picture is smaller than a preset threshold value; the method has the advantages that the response is carried out on the user right, the labeling instruction of the FOV picture is saved, the user right is carried out on the labeling result of the FOV picture, the labeling worker does not need to face the whole integral labeling, only needs to label the divided small picture, the workload of the labeling worker is reduced, the fatigue of the labeling worker is reduced, the labeling accuracy is improved, the operation is carried out on the mobile terminal, the labeling can be carried out anytime and anywhere, the limitation of places is avoided, and the efficiency of labeling work is improved.

title: System and method for preliminary registration
abstract: Methods and systems for performing a preliminary registration is provided. Image data corresponding to an image depicting a tracking device and an anatomical element may be received. Robot positional data corresponding to a position of a robot may also be received. The robot and the anatomical element may be located in a common three-dimensional coordinate system based on the image data and the positional data to yield a preliminary registration. A suggested robot position may be determined based on the preliminary registration and a dimensional reach of a robot arm of the robot.

title: Method and system for generating inspection report
assignee: 宜宝科技（北京）有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a detection report generation method and device. The check report generation method comprises the following steps: receiving first user information acquired by terminal equipment; analyzing the first user information according to a preset processing rule, and determining a first lesion characteristic of the first user; generating a first examination report according to the first lesion feature; and sending the first physical examination report to a related terminal. The information processing apparatus includes: the device comprises a first information receiving unit, a first information analyzing unit and a first information sending unit. The system and the method solve the technical problems that the information processing capability is weak and the utilization rate of doctor resources is low because the characteristic that pathological changes possibly occur is determined by the intelligent analysis of the information obtained by detecting the physical examination vehicle.

title: Method and apparatus for generating multi-stage classification model
abstract: Disclosed are a method for generating a multistage classification model and an apparatus thereof. The apparatus sequentially connects and arranges a plurality of classification models outputting predictive values indicating which group an inputted sample is closer to, inputs the N^th learning data into the N^th classification model, wherein N is a natural number of 1 or more, extracts a certain amount of samples based on the predictive values for each sample of the N^th learning data outputted from the N^th classification model to generate the (N+1)^th learning data, and repeats a process of inputting the (N+1)^th learning data into the (N+1)^th classification model until a size of a loss function of the N^th classification model is less than or equal to a certain level.

title: Method and device for determining heart coronary artery dominance
assignee: 深圳睿心智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the present application provide a method, apparatus, computer-readable medium, and electronic device for determining a dominant type of heart coronary artery. The method for determining the dominant type of heart coronary artery comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out pixel segmentation on a heart coronary image, determining ventricular pixel segmentation and arterial pixel segmentation, taking an intersection curved surface of a left ventricle and a right ventricle in the ventricular pixel segmentation as a ventricular interface, then respectively calculating weighted relative distances of pixel points on the arterial pixel segmentation relative to the ventricular interface based on the ventricular interface, determining dominant types of heart coronary based on the weighted relative distances respectively corresponding to a right coronary artery and a left cyclotron artery in the arterial pixel segmentation, and determining the weighted relative distances of the right coronary artery and the left cyclotron artery in the arterial pixel segmentation based on the interface by taking the interface between the left ventricle and the right ventricle as a reference.

title: Method and system for real-time evaluation of gastrointestinal function and motion rhythm based on ultrasound
assignee: 四川大学华西医院, 成都中创五联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating gastrointestinal functions and movement rhythms in real time based on ultrasound, and relates to the technical field of medical treatment. According to the invention, by fixing the ultrasonic probe on the body of the person to be tested, the arterial blood flow change condition on the antrum and mesenteric of the person to be tested is collected in real time, and the collected ultrasonic image is compared with the standard image in real time so as to correct the position and angle of the ultrasonic probe, thus obtaining the standard gastric Dou Duanzhou section. If the body position of the tested person changes, prompting medical staff to correspondingly adjust the fixed position of the ultrasonic probe, ensuring the qualification rate of ultrasonic images obtained by subsequent monitoring and the accuracy of arterial blood flow changes on the antrum and the mesenteric, dynamically displaying trend charts of antrum movement, antrum area, antrum wall thickness and blood flow, evaluating the gastrointestinal function of the tested person according to the changes of the antrum movement indexes in combination with the different antrum movement expression forms, and assisting doctors to accurately judge the gastrointestinal function state of the tested person, thereby guiding clinical treatment.

title: Telemedicine system data sharing method based on federal learning and federation chain
abstract: The application discloses a data sharing method of a telemedicine system based on federation learning and a federation chain. And secondly, the reputation value of the data provider and the soft label output by the model are stored in the alliance chain by utilizing the alliance chain, so that the communication overhead is reduced, the traceability and the non-falsification of the data are ensured, a safe and efficient data sharing method is provided for task publishers of federal learning, and the risk of data leakage in a remote medical system is reduced.

title: Computerized-system and method for generating a reduced size superior labeled training dataset for a high-accuracy machine learning classification model for extreme class imbalance of instances
abstract: A computerized-system and method for generating a reduced-size superior labeled training-dataset for a high-accuracy machine-learning-classification model for extreme class imbalance by: (a) retrieving minority and majority class instances to mark them as related to an initial dataset; (b) retrieving a sample of majority instances; (c) selecting an instance to operate a clustering classification model on it and the instances marked as related to the initial dataset to yield clusters; (d) operating a learner model to: (i) measure each instance in the yielded clusters according to a differentiability and an indicativeness estimators; (ii) mark measured instances as related to an intermediate training dataset according to the differentiability and the indicativeness estimators; (e) repeating until a preconfigured condition is met; (f) applying a variation estimator on all marked instances as related to an intermediate training dataset to select most distant instances; and (g) marking the instances as related to a superior training-dataset.

title: Method for automatically segmenting multiple organs in head and neck CT image
abstract: The invention relates to a method for automatically segmenting multiple organs in a head and neck CT image, belonging to the technical field of medical image segmentation. The invention first performs intensity conversion on the original CT image by using a piecewise linear function. And inputting the converted image into a network through a spatial separable convolutional neural network established on the basis of the convolution in the slice and the convolution between the slices, and training the network by using a weighting loss function until convergence. The final weighted combination of the multiple submodels gives the final segmentation result as well as the uncertainty estimate. The invention can overcome the defects of processing large-space images by using simple linear intensity conversion and standard three-dimensional convolution and the like, and more effectively process organs with different sizes and different difficulty degrees. While the segmentation of the organ is more robust, corresponding uncertainty estimates at the pixel level and organ level can be given.

title: Information classification method, device and equipment based on medical probability map
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a medical probability map-based information classification method, a device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring symptom description information, wherein the symptom description information comprises at least one description element; determining the probability of different symptom types corresponding to the description elements according to a medical probability chart; the medical probability map is determined according to probability results obtained by processing the same medical corpus according to at least two probability models; determining the symptom type corresponding to the symptom description information according to the probability of different symptom types corresponding to the description elements; the medical probability map in the embodiment is obtained by processing the same medical corpus according to a plurality of probability models, so that on one hand, the accuracy of the transition probability among all nodes in the medical probability map is ensured, and the accuracy of information classification is improved; on the other hand, the medical staff do not need to label manually, and the time cost and the labor cost for constructing the medical probability map are reduced.
