title: System for providing stock managing service and method for operation thereof
abstract: Various embodiments of the present invention relate to a system that provides an inventory management service using an artificial intelligence model and an operating method therefor. The system that provides the inventory management service comprises: a plurality of user devices; a product providing server; and a management server.

title: Cervical lesion region segmentation method and device based on multi-mode segmentation network
abstract: The invention discloses a cervical lesion area segmentation method and device based on a multi-modal segmentation network, belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and fuses the characteristics of an acetic acid image and an iodine image in a cross connection mode in the characteristic extraction process of the two images. In order to fuse the characteristics of the two images, the acetic acid image characteristic of the previous volume block and the iodine image of the next volume block are spliced at a channel level, and then the iodine image is branched and then subsequent characteristic learning is carried out; similarly, the iodine image feature of the previous volume block and the acetic acid image feature of the next volume block are spliced, and then the acetic acid image is branched for subsequent feature learning. Such cross-connection continues until the fifth convolution block, and the characteristics of the acetic acid image and the iodine image output from the fifth convolution block substantially maintain the characteristics of both images. Then, the features learned from the acetic acid image branch and the iodine image branch are respectively entered into the FCN model segment to perform segment prediction.

title: Detecting implantable medical device orientation change
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to detecting implantable medical device orientation changes. In an exemplary embodiment, a medical device having a processor, comprises an acceleration sensor and memory. The acceleration sensor is configured to generate acceleration data that comprises a plurality of acceleration measurements. The memory comprises instructions that when executed by the processor, cause the processor to: obtain the acceleration data from the acceleration sensor; and determine, based on the acceleration data, that the medical device has flipped.

title: Method for controlling video call and electronic device thereof
abstract: An electronic device includes at least one display, a communication circuit, at least one processor, and a memory. The processor is configured to obtain information on a first display aspect ratio associated with a current state of the at least one display if an input indicating initiation of a video call is received. The processor is configured to determine at least one first image ratio associated with the video call based on the information on the first display aspect ratio. The processor is configured to transmit, to an external electronic device, a first signal including information on the at least one first image ratio. The processor is configured to receive, from the external electronic device, a second signal including information on a second image ratio associated with the video call. The processor is configured to perform the video call based on the second image ratio.

title: Method of providing data integrity
abstract: Provided herein is a system involving the utilization of a low-power device that is programmed to capture data from a source, whether from a sensor or other type of data generating component, with the data capture and/or further data transfer set within a specific time period and further data storage platform having programmed storage compartments uniformly set to meet the exact date and time for which the data capture and/or transfer was initially undertaken. Having a known value of storage capacity for each timed data packet in this manner, the ability to ensure veracity of the transferred data is provided since any result that does not meet the time frame and thus the storage capacity set from the programmed platform itself will result in a quarantine of any problematic data packet, thus allowing for filtering and review of any unexpected data captured and transferred in such a manner.

title: Deformable registration of magnetic resonance and ultrasound images using biomechanical models
abstract: A computer-implemented method for performing deformable registration between Magnetic Resonance (MR) and Ultrasound (US) images include receiving an MR volume depicting an organ and segmenting the organ from the MR volume to yield a first 3D point representation of the organ in MR coordinates. Additionally, a US volume depicting an organ is received and the organ is segmented from the US volume to yield a second 3D point representation of the organ in US coordinates. Next, a plurality of point correspondences between the first 3D point representation and the second 3D point representation are determined. Then, a biomechanical model is applied to register the MR volume to the US volume. The plurality of point correspondences are used as displacement boundary conditions for the biomechanical model.

title: Method and device for analyzing acquired magnetic resonance images
abstract: In a method for analyzing acquired magnetic resonance images, an image series is provided that includes acquired magnetic resonance images of a slice of an object, picture elements of the acquired magnetic resonance images of the image series are fitted to generate a parameter map and an error map, the acquired magnetic resonance images are automatically segmented to generate image segments, histograms of the parameter map and the error map are generated based on the image segments, and the histograms are analyzed to generate an output of analysis results and/or generate a visualization including the parameter map, the error map, and the image segments. The acquired magnetic resonance images can have a variation of a contrast-determining acquisition parameter.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine incompatibility prediction method based on supervised learning framework
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine compatibility data mining, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine compatibility taboo prediction method based on a supervised learning framework, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting compatibility taboo and medicine attribute data, constructing a basic model for compatibility taboo learning, verifying the implicit relationship between the medicine attribute and the traditional Chinese medicine compatibility taboo, and extracting the medicine attribute from classical ancient books as the supervision information of the model; then, a Chinese medicine incompatibility learning model is constructed by combining the basic model and the constraint terms, and model parameters are optimized; and finally, predicting the incompatibility relation by using the model. The method can model the incompatibility relation among the medicines, and constructs a Chinese medicine incompatibility learning model by introducing the medicine efficacy, the nature and taste attributes and the relation among the attributes. The invention discloses the relationship of the incompatibility of the traditional Chinese medicines from a new angle, greatly reduces the medical experiment space and improves the efficiency of the identification of the incompatibility.

title: Methods and apparatus for neural network based image reconstruction
assignee: Siemens Medical Solutions Usa, Inc., University Of Tennessee Research Foundation
abstract: Systems and methods for reconstructing medical images are disclosed. Measurement data, such as sinogram data, is received from an image scanning system. A plurality of masks are applied to corresponding portions of the measurement data to generate a plurality of masked measurement data portions. In some examples, the measurement data is encoded before the plurality of masks are applied. A neural network including a plurality of fully connected layers is applied to the plurality of masked measurement data portions to generate a plurality of image patches. The plurality of image patches are then combined to generate an initial image. In some examples, refinement and scaling operations are applied to the initial image and corresponding attenuation maps to generate a final image. In some examples, the final image is stored in a database. In some examples, the final image is displayed for diagnosis.
assignee_clean: siemens medical solutions usa; university of tennessee research foundation

title: Defending against adversarial queries in a data governance system
abstract: An apparatus and related method defend against adversarial queries. A policy enforcement hypergraph is constructed to express a set of security policies. Then, the hypergraph is repeatedly traversed to determine whether a user behavior is changing over time. The user behavior is measured by reference to a vertex or an edge in the hypergraph. If it is determined that the user behavior has changed over time an enforcement action is taken based on a security policy.

title: Establishing quality of service for internet of things devices
abstract: Techniques for establishing network quality of service for an internet of things device are described. A manufacturer usage description identifier relating to the internet of things device is received. The internet of things device is coupled to a communication network. Quality of service parameters relating to the internet of things device and the communication network are determined based on the manufacturer usage description identifier. The quality of service parameters are provided to a network policy controller. The network policy controller is configured to establish a quality of service for the internet of things device on the communication network based on the one or more quality of service parameters.

title: Automatic identification and setting of magnetic resonance protocols from read-in image data
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: The invention relates to a method, a device and a computer program product for determining measurement protocol parameters of an MR image, the method comprising: reading in a first MR image having a first contrast characteristic; determining at least one first contrast relationship from the first contrast characteristic; determining measurement protocol parameters for generating a second MR image having a second contrast characteristic taking into account the at least one first contrast relationship, such that the second contrast characteristic is as close as possible to the first contrast characteristic; and outputting the measurement protocol parameters.
assignee_clean: 西门子保健有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司

title: Method for providing secondary parameters, decision support system, medium, computer program
assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司
abstract: The invention implies a method for providing secondary parameters (3) in a decision support system (100) providing primary parameters, in particular in a clinical decision support system, comprising the steps of: providing an input data set; approximating the secondary parameters (3) based on the input dataset by using a subsystem (10) trained by a machine learning mechanism, in particular by a deep learning mechanism; and providing an approximate secondary parameter; wherein the input dataset is a shape dataset (2).
assignee_clean: 西门子保健有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 西门子保健有限责任公司

title: Electronic device, server and method for filtering, blocking and replacing web objects
abstract: A method for controlling displaying, an electronic device therefor, and a server and method therefor are provided. The method includes transmitting information including at least one input keyword to a server, receiving, from the server, a recognition model for filtering out an object included in a received webpage, installing the recognition model, determining whether a first object corresponding to the at least one input keyword exists in the webpage, when the first object corresponding to the input keyword exists in the webpage, processing the first object to become a second object, and displaying the webpage including the processed object.

title: Method and system for determining precursors of health abnormalities from processing medical records
abstract: Medical reports are converted to document vectors in computing apparatus and sampled by applying a maximum variation sampling function including a fitness function to the document vectors to reduce a number of medical records being processed and to increase the diversity of the medical records being processed. Linguistic phrases are extracted from the medical records and converted to s-grams. A Haar wavelet function is applied to the s-grams over the preselected time interval; and the coefficient results of the Haar wavelet function are examined for patterns representing the likelihood of health abnormalities. This confirms certain s-grams as precursors of the health abnormality and a parameter can be calculated in relation to the occurrence of such a health abnormality.

title: Medical data processing method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to a medical data processing method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of electronic medical record text analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: processing the medical data to be processed by using a preset rule to obtain a plurality of candidate medical words; inputting each candidate medical word into a classification model to obtain a plurality of output results; the classification model is obtained by training a conjoined neural network through a plurality of word vectors; and judging whether each candidate medical word belongs to the target medical word according to the confidence coefficient of the output result. The embodiment of the invention reduces the recognition cost of the target medical words.

title: Training method of image optimization network, image processing method and device
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a training method, an image processing device, a storage medium and electronic equipment of an image optimization network, which are used for realizing the same accurate and robust image quality optimization of source domain low-quality images and target domain low-quality images. The training method comprises the following steps: acquiring a source domain data set and a target domain data set; training a pre-constructed image optimization network comprising a feature extractor and an optimizer based on the source domain dataset to obtain a first network parameter of the feature extractor; training a pre-constructed discrimination network connected with the feature extractor based on the source domain data set and the target domain data set and the feature extractor with the first network parameters to obtain second network parameters of the discrimination network; and based on the source domain data set, performing joint training on the trained image optimization network and the discrimination network with the second network parameters to obtain the image optimization network.
assignee_clean: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司

title: Distributed, self-adjusting and optimizing core network with machine learning
abstract: A system and method for dynamically creating distributed, self-adjusting and optimizing core network with machine learning is disclosed. The method includes receiving a request to access one or more services and establishing a secure real time communication session with one or more client devices and a set of service layers based on the received request. The method further includes determining one or more service parameters based on the received request and sending one or more handshake messages to each of the set of service layers. Further, the method includes determining one or more environmental parameters and determining best possible service layer capable of processing the received request by using a trained service based ML model. The method includes processing the request at the determined best possible service layer and terminating or transferring the secure real time communication session after the request is processed.

title: Esophageal tumor segmentation shape perception contrast depth supervision method based on CT scanning
assignee: 西北工业大学太仓长三角研究院
abstract: The application discloses a shape perception contrast depth supervision method based on CT scanning esophageal tumor segmentation, which comprises the following specific steps: 1) Creating a data set; 2): constructing a shape perception contrast depth supervision model; 3): constructing a final loss function; 4): training a shape perception contrast depth supervision network; 5): and evaluating the segmentation score of the medical image. The shape sensing contrast depth supervision method for esophageal tumor segmentation based on CT scanning can successfully predict the whole structure by adopting the shape sensing contrast depth supervision network, obtain the segmentation result close to the real segmentation boundary, and effectively improve the esophageal tumor segmentation performance by adopting the simple and feasible shape contrast depth supervision method for esophageal tumor segmentation, thereby being beneficial to improving the segmentation performance of esophageal tumor in CT images.
assignee_clean: 西北工业大学太仓长三角研究院
primary_assignee: 西北工业大学太仓长三角研究院

title: Device and method based on intelligent clinical infusion tree
abstract: A device and a method based on intelligent clinical infusion tree comprise a base, a connecting rod unit, an intelligent interaction and detection unit, an intelligent continuous infusion unit and a hospital medical management system. After medical workers respectively place the sterile infusion boxes of several groups of liquid in the corresponding infusion boxes according to the sequence of infusion requirements at one time, placing each infusion tube in a semi-closed groove at the bottom of a miniature electric actuating mechanism, manually closing a pressure plate of the electric actuating mechanism, setting a switch to be in a remote state, continuously collecting detection signals returned by a gravity sensor at the bottom of the infusion box by a hospital medical intelligent management software system, automatically opening a valve for the other electric actuating mechanism at the lower part of the infusion box according to a setting instruction of an application program when the collected gravity signals reach a threshold limit value, and then closing the electric actuating mechanism at the lower part of the infusion box which has completed infusion, thereby operating sequentially and gradually to realize continuous intelligent infusion; meanwhile, the hospital medical management system realizes the medical purposes of intelligent continuous transfusion, remote video secondary acquisition, real-time body temperature detection, exclusive two-dimensional code pushing and the like through the intelligent visual camera of the machine in the device, infrared scanning body temperature detection, and remote control of a terminal display screen.

title: Hierarchical natural language understanding systems
abstract: Methods and systems for hierarchical natural language understanding are described. A representation of an utterance is inputted to a first machine learning model to obtain information on the first utterance. According to the information on the utterance a determination that the representation of the utterance is to be inputted to a second machine learning model that performs a dedicated natural language task is performed. In response to determining that the representation of the utterance is to be inputted to a second machine learning model, the utterance is inputted to the second machine learning model to obtain an output of the dedicated natural language task.

title: Artificial intelligence device and method thereof
abstract: Disclosed herein is an artificial intelligence device for providing connection between a plurality of home devices, including a communication interface configured to receive a visitor image from a door locking device including a door camera for photographing a visitor, and a processor configured to obtain visitor information output from a visitor recognition model by inputting the visitor image to the visitor recognition model and select a home device to receive the visitor image and the visitor information from among the plurality of home devices, wherein the communication interface transmits the visitor image and the visitor information to the selected home device.

title: System, method, and computer program product for determining a dominant account profile of an account
abstract: Provided is a computer-implemented method for determining a dominant account profile of an account. The method may include receiving transaction data associated with a plurality of payment transactions conducted within a predetermined time interval of activation of an account involved in the plurality of payment transactions, generating a dominant account profile classification model, determining a plurality of prediction scores for the account based on the dominant account profile classification model and the transaction data, where determining the plurality of prediction scores includes determining, for the user, a prediction score for each dominant account profile, where a prediction score includes a prediction of whether the user will conduct a threshold value of payment transactions using the account in one or more payment transaction categories of a plurality of payment transaction categories, and communicating data associated with the plurality of prediction scores.

title: Digital reflex quantization and signature analysis
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents On Behalf Of The University Of Arizona
abstract: Systems and methods for digital reflex quantization and signature analysis. Movement of a stimulating device invoking a reflex response in an organism is captured as stimuli data. Electromyographic (EMG) of the reflex response is captured as EMG data. Movement resulting from the reflex response of a limb/appendage of the organism is captured as motion data. One or more of the stimuli data, the EMG data, and the motion data are analyzed to determine one or both of a motion signature and an EMG signature defining quantitative evaluation of the reflex response.
assignee_clean: arizona board of regents on behalf of the university of arizona
primary_assignee: arizona board of regents on behalf of the university of arizona

title: System and methods for computer aided analysis of images
abstract: Certain embodiments of the present technology provide systems, methods and computer instructions for computer aided analysis of images. In certain embodiments, for example, such a method includes: isolating a motion area in an image; segmenting the image; utilizing a support vector machine to identify a region of interest in the image; utilizing a graph-cut algorithm to refine the region of interest; and verifying the region of interest. In certain embodiments, for example, such a method further includes: aligning a set of images and/or outputting a set of aligned images sequentially. In certain embodiments, the systems, methods and computer instructions disclosed herein can be used to aid analysis of cardiac images, for example. In certain embodiments, the systems, methods and computer instructions disclosed herein can be used to aid analysis of four dimensional images, for example.

title: Internet hospital data security management method and device
assignee: 浙江蕙康科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for safely managing data of an Internet hospital, relates to the technical field of blockchain, and can realize safe storage of medical data. The method of the embodiment of the invention comprises the following steps: receiving an on-line inquiry history; aggregating the on-line inquiry history records of each doctor node; counting the number of the on-line consultation transactions of the received on-line consultation transactions of each doctor node, and dividing the number by the total number of the received on-line consultation transactions to obtain a real consultation rate; counting the number of the good scores of each doctor node, dividing the number of the good scores by the number of the evaluation levels to obtain a real good score; determining the average value of the evaluation scores of each doctor node as a real overall evaluation value, and determining the average value of the drug adoption rates of each doctor node as a real overall adoption rate; and synchronizing the real consultation rate, the real qualification rate, the real overall evaluation value and the real overall adoption rate of each doctor node to the blockchain.
assignee_clean: 浙江蕙康科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 浙江蕙康科技有限公司

title: System and method for inter-arm registration
abstract: Systems and methods for inter-arm registration include a computer-assisted system having a control unit coupled to a repositionable arm of a computer-assisted device. The control unit is configured to: receive, from an imaging device, successive images of an instrument mounted to the repositionable arm; determine an observed velocity of a feature of the instrument; determine an expected velocity of the feature of the instrument based on kinematics of the repositionable arm; transform the observed velocity and/or the expected velocity to a common coordinate system using a registration transform; determine an error between directions of the observed and expected velocities in the common coordinate system; and update the registration transform based on the determined error. In some embodiments, the instrument is a medical instrument and the imaging device is an endoscope. In some embodiments, the control unit is further configured to control the instrument using the registration transform.

title: Model training method, device, system, apparatus, medium, and program product
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a model training method, a device, a system, equipment, a medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of computers, in particular to the technical field of artificial intelligence, natural language processing and deep learning. In some embodiments of the application, at least one first cluster trains a sample data set to obtain training data; the second cluster is used for training the training model according to the training data; the method comprises the steps that a model for generating training data and a pre-training model are respectively deployed on different clusters, cross-cluster training is conducted on the model, only the training data need to be transmitted between a first cluster and a second cluster, model parameters do not need to be transmitted, cross-cluster training of the method can be met through low-bandwidth communication between the clusters, training data generating tasks and pre-training model training tasks are respectively placed in different processors based on training tasks in different stages, hardware processing speed is improved, and training efficiency of the model is improved.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Computer-aided tumor ablation navigation system with accurate positioning function
assignee: 吉林省安瑞健康科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computer-aided surgery, in particular to a computer-aided tumor ablation navigation system with a precise positioning function, which comprises the following components: the tumor detection device comprises a CT image processing module, a visualization module, a machine learning module and a tumor ablation navigation module, wherein the CT image processing module acquires strong-attribute tumor points and weak-attribute tumor points of a tumor CT image, acquires segmentation similarity of the weak-attribute tumor points and label ambiguity of the strong-attribute tumor points, acquires a tumor region detection result, and acquires tumor properties according to the tumor region detection result to obtain a specific detection result. According to the invention, by means of the combined detection method of electromagnetic detection and radiological image, the tumor position can be accurately detected, and the segmentation results of multiple scales are fused, so that the limitation of single segmentation scale on tumor detection with non-fixed position and size can be eliminated.
assignee_clean: 吉林省安瑞健康科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 吉林省安瑞健康科技有限公司

title: Image reconstruction storage method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to an image reconstruction storage method, an image reconstruction storage device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring scanning data of an object to be detected and two different reconstruction parameters; respectively carrying out data reconstruction on the scanning data by adopting the two different reconstruction parameters to obtain a first sequence image and a second sequence image; the resolution of the first sequence of images is higher than the resolution of the second sequence of images, both the first sequence of images and the second sequence of images comprising a region of interest; fusing part of slice images in the first sequence image and part of slice images in the second sequence image to obtain a third sequence image, and storing the third sequence image; the third sequence of images includes the region of interest. The method can solve the problems of image reconstruction precision and data storage space.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Vessel segmentation method of double decoder network fused with geodesic model
assignee: 山东省人工智能研究院, 齐鲁工业大学(山东省科学院)
abstract: A blood vessel segmentation method of a double decoder network integrated with a geodesic model relates to the technical field of computer vision and medical image processing, and firstly, a network encoder is utilized to extract characteristics of medical images. Secondly, contrast enhancement is carried out on the medical image, geodesic densities are calculated on three channels of the medical image respectively, then the geodesic densities of the three channels of the medical image are integrated and are integrated into the features extracted by the decoder, and finally the segmentation of the blood vessels of the medical image is finished through decoding by the decoder. Wherein the network part consists of a shared encoder and two decoders with similar architecture. The first decoder is used for dividing tasks and extracting vascular structures. The second decoder is used for auxiliary tasks for extraction of vessel centerlines to assist the completion of the first decoder vessel segmentation task. The geodesic voting algorithm and the double-decoder neural network are used for realizing advantage complementation technically, and the segmentation efficiency and quality are improved.
assignee_clean: 山东省人工智能研究院; 齐鲁工业大学 山东省科学院

title: Method for detecting nodule and apparatus using the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nodule detection method performed by a computing device. According to the nodule detection method, the computing device provides nodule detection results by acquiring a second image group, corresponding to a thickness greater than or equal to a first slice thickness, of a first image group generated according to the continuous volumes of a subject, or performing support so that other devices linked with the computing device acquire the second image group, by generating a third image group corresponding to a second slice thickness predetermined as a thickness smaller than the first slice thickness through the second image group, or performing support so that other devices linked with the computing device acquire the third image group, and by detecting nodule regions with respect to the first and third image groups, or performing support so that other devices linked with the computing device detect the nodule regions. Therefore, the nodule detection method can increase the accuracy of nodule detection.

title: Medical action fine-grained recognition device and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a medical behavior fine-grained identification device, which comprises a camera, a processor, a memory and the following algorithm: acquiring a real-time medical behavior video through a camera; preprocessing video data; acquiring a sampling receptive field of a convolution kernel at the previous moment; calculating local coherence constraints of the image at the last moment and the image at the current moment; calculating the receptive field displacement at the current moment; adding corresponding displacement to each sampling point to obtain a deformed convolution kernel; performing convolution operation at the current moment to obtain appearance characteristic information; calculating the difference value of the receptive fields along with time and extracting motion characteristic information; combining the motion characteristics and the appearance characteristics to obtain space-time characteristics; inputting the space-time characteristics into a three-dimensional convolutional neural network, and obtaining action segmentation and prediction results through a full connection layer; and performing feature segmentation and action classification prediction on the output result of the three-dimensional convolution neural network. The invention can improve the speed and efficiency of the system and the identification precision.

title: Content evaluation based on machine learning and engagement metrics
abstract: Techniques for machine learning analysis are provided. A machine learning (ML) model is trained to identify appropriate documents based on lexical knowledge of target groups. A lexical knowledge of a set of users is determined. Additionally, a first document of a plurality of documents is selected by processing the determined level of lexical knowledge using the ML model. The first document is presented to the set of users. A level of engagement of the set of users is then determined. Upon determining that the level of engagement is below a predefined threshold, a second document of the plurality of documents is selected using the ML model.

title: Image analysis system and construction method thereof
assignee: 四川大学华西第二医院
abstract: The invention provides an image analysis system and a construction method thereof. The system comprises an image database construction unit, a convolutional neural network unit and an analysis unit; the image database construction unit comprises an image data acquisition unit, an image data labeling unit and an image database construction unit; the convolutional neural network unit comprises a convolutional neural network model construction unit and a convolutional neural network model training unit; and the analysis unit is used for analyzing the specific image structure in the image to be analyzed by using the trained image anomaly detection model. The image analysis system has a simple structure, can rapidly identify the image and output an analysis result, and improves the judgment accuracy, the working efficiency and the work duration state.
assignee_clean: 四川大学华西第二医院
primary_assignee: 四川大学华西第二医院

title: Recommendation method and device for recommendation
assignee: 北京搜狗科技发展有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a recommendation method and device and a device for recommending, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: receiving current input content of a user; if the intention corresponding to the current input content is not the first intention, determining recommendation information corresponding to the current input content; and outputting the recommendation information. The embodiment of the invention can reduce the occurrence of wrong recommendation.
assignee_clean: 北京搜狗科技发展有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京搜狗科技发展有限公司

title: Picture region segmentation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to artificial intelligence, and discloses a picture region segmentation method, which comprises the following steps: training by utilizing a first training picture set obtained by adding noise to the first initial picture set to obtain a picture noise reduction model; training by using a second training picture set obtained by reducing the resolution of the first initial picture set to obtain a high-resolution model; training by utilizing a second initial picture set to obtain a picture segmentation model; and carrying out segmentation processing on the picture to be segmented according to the picture noise reduction model, the high-resolution model and the picture segmentation model to obtain a segmentation result. The invention also relates to a blockchain, and the picture to be segmented can be stored in a blockchain node. The invention also provides a picture region segmentation device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The invention can be applied to the segmentation of the pleural effusion region in the chest CT picture. The invention can improve the accuracy of picture segmentation.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Class-narrowing for type-restricted answer lookups
abstract: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system configured with a natural language processing pipeline executing on at least one processor of the data processing system, for class narrowing for answer lookups. The natural language processing pipeline annotates an input question with a verb in the input question and a syntactic relation between the verb and a focus of the question. A class narrowing component of the natural language processing pipeline finds an entry in a verb/type lookup resource corresponding to the verb and the syntactic relation. The entry comprises the verb, the syntactic relation, and a set of classes. Each given class in the set of classes has a corresponding frequency value representing a frequency the given class occurs with the syntactic relation to the verb. The class narrowing component performs class-narrowed type-restricted answer lookup from a topology based on the entry in the verb/type lookup resource to generate a set of candidate answers.

title: Medical term feature extraction model training and standardization method and device
assignee: 北京亚信数据有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a medical term feature extraction model training and standardization method and device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of client medical terms and a plurality of standard medical terms; according to the mapping relation between nouns, combining the client medical nouns and the standard medical nouns as training samples to generate a sample set; inputting the sample set into a twin network model for feature extraction, carrying out model parameter optimization adjustment according to the difference between the feature vectors extracted in each training sample, and taking the adjusted model as a medical term feature extraction model. The invention greatly improves the efficiency and accuracy of the standardized process of medical science and technology.
assignee_clean: 北京亚信数据有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京亚信数据有限公司

title: Infant sucking remote assessment and breast feeding guidance method
abstract: The invention provides a method for remote evaluation of infant sucking and guiding breast feeding, which comprises the following steps: s10, data acquisition is carried out to obtain multi-source data; s20, preprocessing data to obtain multisource information fusion characteristics to be evaluated; s30, forming a multi-modal fusion deep learning model, and training the convolutional neural network model by using infant sucking-swallowing standard data to obtain the multi-modal fusion deep learning model; and S40, evaluating the multisource information fusion characteristics to be evaluated by utilizing the multi-mode fusion deep learning model to obtain an automatic infant sucking evaluation result. According to the remote assessment and breast feeding guiding method for the baby sucking, disclosed by the invention, the breast feeding process is assessed remotely and automatically through machine learning, the guidance of a professional medical staff in going up is not needed, the assessment result is fed back to a puerpera in real time, the requirements on the cooperation of home equipment and the baby are less, and the feasibility and the accuracy are higher.

title: Mental Healing Device
abstract: Disclosed is a mental healing device. The mental healing device can comprise: a display; a content management part managing content; and a controller providing diagnostic content intuitively recognized through the display, receiving feedback on the diagnostic content, and providing therapeutic content corresponding to the feedback. Therefore, user convenience can be improved.

title: Pulmonary tissue pathology image processing model, construction method and image processing method
assignee: 吉林大学, 沈阳医学院附属中心医院
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and particularly relates to a lung tissue pathology image processing model, a construction method and an image processing method, wherein a data set of a lung tissue pathology image is obtained, and the data set is preprocessed and then is divided into a training data set and a testing data set according to a proportion; establishing an upstream task, generating a new sample after proportional fusion and addition of each image in a training data set, and training the new sample to obtain a trained mask self-encoder upstream model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a downstream task, utilizing a mask self-encoder upstream model trained by the upstream task, evaluating the performance of the mask self-encoder upstream model by adopting a test data set, solving the problems of complex diagnosis system and the like caused by complex convolution operation and sub-attention mechanisms in the current mainstream algorithm, and having the effects of high efficiency and simplifying the diagnosis system due to long training time of the algorithm.
assignee_clean: 吉林大学; 沈阳医学院附属中心医院

title: Data processing device and related product
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to a data processing apparatus. The data processing apparatus for performing processing of machine learning data includes: the machine learning device comprises a plurality of machine learning units, each machine learning unit comprises at least one arithmetic unit, the plurality of machine learning units are connected with the transmission circuit through a first transmission interface, and the transmission circuit is connected with the shared memory. The data processing device arbitrates the data operation signals sent by the machine learning units through the arbitration circuit and acquires data from the shared memory according to the arbitration result, so that when the data processing device performs data operation, the machine learning units can perform data operation on the shared memory through one transmission circuit and arbitrate the data operation signals through the arbitration circuit, and the hardware cost is reduced and the signal blocking is avoided.
assignee_clean: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司

title: Physical examination item recommendation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 善诊(上海)信息技术有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical treatment, and particularly relates to a physical examination item recommendation method, device and equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a first examination result of the user through a first examination item, wherein the first examination result comprises a target risk disease and a risk degree; obtaining a recommendation result aiming at the target risk disease according to the physical examination data of the user except the first examination item and a preset examination item recommendation model; determining a queue to be added of a second inspection item according to the first inspection result and the recommended result; and determining a reforming queue of the second examination item according to the real-time queue congestion state of the second examination item and the queue to be added, so that the accuracy of health examination can be improved, and user experience is improved.
assignee_clean: 善诊 上海 信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 善诊 上海 信息技术有限公司

title: Method for digitally labelling websites
abstract: A host website, method and system for digitally labelling websites or subscribers with digital labels which represent characteristics or qualities of the website is disclosed. Digital labels are stored on host websites, each of which is directed to a specific subject or activity. The host website can also provide digital labels for storage in other host websites. The host website is provided with artificial intelligence capabilities. Methods and systems for asymmetric access in a host website database are disclosed.

title: Pattern recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium based on gas detection
abstract: The invention discloses a pattern recognition method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on gas detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring gas to be detected; determining gas response sequence data of the gas to be detected based on gas sensing of the gas to be detected by a gas sensor; and carrying out pattern recognition on the gas response sequence data by using a preset pattern recognition network based on an attention mechanism to obtain a pattern recognition result output by the preset pattern recognition network. Compared with the traditional machine algorithm mode identification method adopted in the traditional mode identification method based on gas detection, the method improves the feature extraction capacity and generalization capacity of the network model, and is beneficial to improving the accuracy and the identification effect of the mode identification.

title: Data auditing method and device
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）, 北京京东世纪贸易有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a data auditing method and device, and relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring prescription data to be audited, extracting medicine information and diagnosis information from the prescription data, and determining sample diagnosis information similar to the diagnosis information in a sample diagnosis information base; querying a medicine vector corresponding to the medicine information, and querying a diagnosis vector corresponding to the sample diagnosis information; and calculating the similarity of the medicine vector and the diagnosis vector, and determining that the prescription data passes the audit in response to the similarity being greater than or equal to a preset similarity threshold. According to the embodiment, the relations among the medicine information, the diagnosis information and the diagnosis information are mined based on the knowledge graph, and the problem of diversified diagnosis description in prescription data can be solved.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院; 北京京东世纪贸易有限公司

title: Method and system for quickly detecting an abnormal concentration of potassium ions in blood from an electrocardiogram
abstract: A method and system are devised for quickly detecting an abnormal concentration of potassium ions in blood from an electrocardiogram. The system includes at least one vector-converting device that includes a processor, a transmitter, at least one memory and at least one storage unit. The at least one storage includes a model data module and a predicting and converting module. The model data module includes data of a model of the concentration of potassium in the blood. The model of the concentration of potassium in the blood includes at least one reference electrocardiogram and corresponding reference data of the concentration of potassium in the blood. The predicting and converting module converts an electrocardiogram into a corresponding predicted concentration of potassium in the blood according to the reference concentration of potassium in blood. The vector conversions device is connected to at least one electrocardiogram generator and at least one monitor. Thus, the electrocardiogram obtained by the electrocardiogram generator is converted to the corresponding predicted concentration of potassium in the blood. The corresponding predicted concentration of potassium in the blood is shown on a monitor to facilitate the medical personnel to take proper actions to reduce the risks of sudden cardiac death.

title: CT three-dimensional positioning image acquisition method and device and computer equipment
assignee: 广州海兆印丰信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a CT three-dimensional positioning image acquisition method, a CT three-dimensional positioning image acquisition device, computer equipment and a storage medium. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a micro-radiation dose CT three-dimensional positioning image during CT imaging; denoising the micro-radiation dose CT three-dimensional positioning image and performing multi-scale artifact inhibition treatment to obtain a reference CT three-dimensional positioning image; acquiring viscera types and regions in an imaged region in the reference CT three-dimensional positioning image; determining imaging parameters in a CT scanning protocol according to the viscera types and the regions; configuring an imaging function in a CT imaging device according to the imaging parameters; and acquiring a target CT three-dimensional positioning image by using the configured CT imaging equipment, wherein the configured CT imaging equipment acquires the target CT three-dimensional positioning image by adopting the CT scanning protocol. The method improves the image quality of the CT three-dimensional positioning image under the micro radiation dose.
assignee_clean: 广州海兆印丰信息科技有限公司

title: ESD preoperative discussion system based on mobile terminal
assignee: 山东大学齐鲁医院, 青岛美迪康数字工程有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an ESD preoperative discussion system based on a mobile terminal, belonging to the technical field of ESD preoperative analysis, wherein an evaluation classification module traverses patient records of a plan for developing an ESD operation, and obtains an indication evaluation classification result according to an ESD indication evaluation classification standard; the preoperative discussion application module selects medical record information of a patient needing preoperative discussion according to the indication evaluation classification result and initiates a preoperative discussion request; the preoperative discussion participation module receives a participation request of a doctor user, and allows the doctor user to join a preoperative discussion if the participation request meets the operation qualification of corresponding medical record information, so that an ESD preoperative pathology discussion result is obtained. The invention forms a mobile discussion system which is convenient to operate and operate, extracts the relevant information of the corresponding endoscope information system database, accurately evaluates the classification of ESD operation indications, screens the patients which accord with the ESD indications, avoids the over-treatment of the patients which are not suitable for the endoscope operation, reduces the occurrence probability of the operation complications and provides guarantee for the medical safety.

title: Method and electronic device of improving speech recognition model
assignee: 中華電信股份有限公司
abstract: A method and an electronic device of improving a speech recognition model are provided. The method includes: obtaining knowledge graph and generating at least one graph vector according to the knowledge graph; obtaining a voice signal and generating a text sequence corresponding to the voice signal according to the speech recognition model, wherein the text sequence includes at least one word; generating first labeled data corresponding to the at least one word according to the at least one graph vector in response to the at least one word matching with the at least one graph vector; training a first neural network according to the first labeled data; obtaining a current voice signal and generating a recognition result corresponding to the current voice signal according to the speech recognition model and the first neural network; and outputting the recognition result.

title: Compositions and methods relating to monitoring alcohol consumption and alcohol abuse
abstract: Methods and compositions according to embodiments of the present invention are provided that specifically and sensitively detect alcohol consumption and whether alcohol consumption is moderate or high in a subject. Aspects of the present invention relate to assays of panels of proteins for detecting non-consumption, moderate consumption and high consumption of ethanol by a subject.

title: Data information processing method and device for orthopedics spine
assignee: 山东颐养健康集团淄博医院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical care information processing, in particular to a data information processing method and device for an orthopedics backbone. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring physiological sign data and pathological image data of a target living body; performing data preprocessing on the physiological sign data so as to obtain preprocessed physiological data; performing age characteristic extraction according to the preprocessed physiological data to obtain age characteristic data and performing skeleton morphological characteristic extraction according to the pathological image data to obtain skeleton morphological characteristic data; identifying the age characteristic data through an age skeleton basic deformation identification model to generate age skeleton basic deformation data, and identifying the skeleton morphological characteristic data through a skeleton morphological identification model to generate skeleton morphological data; and generating an age form association information set according to the age skeleton basic deformation data and the skeleton form data. The invention provides accurate life body detailed information through data deep analysis processing.
assignee_clean: 山东颐养健康集团淄博医院

title: Image synthesis method, device, electronic equipment and medium for fusing ROI (region of interest)
abstract: The invention relates to an image synthesis method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium for fusing an ROI (region of interest) region, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a disease-associated and disease-free initial image with corresponding category information; acquiring a region of interest with a pathogen initial image by using a weak supervision positioning network to obtain a mask image with a disease; obtaining a similar disease-free image corresponding to the disease-free initial image through similarity calculation, and obtaining a disease-free mask image; shielding the diseased and pathogenic initial images by using the diseased and pathogenic mask images respectively to obtain the images shielded by the mask; the design generates an antagonistic network model based on conditions and trains the network model using the diseased and non-diseased mask images, the images blocked by the mask and the corresponding category information, thereby obtaining a composite medical image. According to the invention, the medical image of a specified type can be efficiently synthesized by acquiring the region of interest in the medical image and using the condition-based antagonism network model, so that the image quality is improved.

title: Virtual reality device for diagnosis of nerve disorder, system and method for thereof
assignee: Samsung Life Public of Welfare Foundation, Korea Institute Of Science And Technology
abstract: Disclosed is a VR (Virtual Reality) device for diagnosis of nerve disorder, system and method thereof, wherein the device comprises: a display part providing a user with a VR environment in response to an image; and a user response receiver receiving a user response relative to the image, and wherein the image includes an introduction video included with two or more characters, and a question video image provided subsequent to the introduction video to include an inquiry related to the characters, whereby a user's linguistic competence, visual ability and associative ability can be comprehensively evaluated, and more accurately grasp a degree of user's nerve disorder can be accurately grasped without being influenced by a user's academic background and age.

title: Medical image segmentation method based on DR-Unet104,104
assignee: 山西三友和智慧信息技术股份有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image segmentation, and particularly relates to a medical image segmentation method based on DR-Unet104,104, which comprises the following steps: and (3) data acquisition: constructing an original data set by collecting related medical images; data expansion: carrying out data enhancement on the original data set to realize data set expansion; and (3) data processing: the method comprises the steps of dividing, standardizing and unifying the data size of a data set; model construction: model training was performed by using the DR-Unet model. The model generalization capability is improved through pretreatment methods such as standardization and data expansion, the model combines the advantages of a basic Unet model and a residual error connection module, the model segmentation performance is improved, the overall performance of the model is improved through the dropout, and a great auxiliary effect is provided for medical diagnosis of doctors. The invention is used for segmentation of medical images.

title: Disease collaborative progressive prediction method based on big data deep learning and robot
abstract: Disease collaborative progressive prediction method and robot based on big data deep learning, comprising: a target user determining step; a disease prediction model acquisition step; a disease prediction model information acquisition step; calculating the disease prediction model preference; a disease prediction model using step; a first setting step of presetting a function; a disease prediction first model step of target disease detection; disease prediction for target disease detection more model steps. According to the method, the system and the robot, data acquired by various means such as hope and smell questions, western medicine and the like are fully utilized to train and predict the disease prediction model based on deep learning, various data sources can be combined differently, the optimization degree of each disease prediction model is determined by calculating the cost, the data acquisition difficulty and the prediction accuracy of the multiple disease prediction models with preset functions, the optimal combination mode is found, and the disease prediction model with the lowest cost, the easiest implementation and the optimal effect is obtained.

title: Techniques for aperiodic beam failure detection reference signals for wireless communications systems
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A user equipment (UE) may receive control signaling including a set of parameters. The set of parameters may include one or more thresholds associated with initiating aperiodic beam failure detection (BFD) reference signals (RSs). The UE may receive a set of periodic BFD-RSs. In some examples, the UE or the base station may determine that a triggering threshold is satisfied. In some cases, the UE may determine that the set of periodic BFD-RSs satisfies a consecutive beam failure indication (BFI) threshold, a cumulative BFI threshold, or the like. In some cases, a base station may determine that the set of periodic BFD-RSs satisfies a channel quality threshold. The UE may receive a set of one or more aperiodic BFD-RSs based on whether the triggering threshold is satisfied.

title: System and method for imaging of moving subjects
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method for imaging of moving subjects. The method may include determining a motion range of a region of interest (ROI) of a subject in an axial direction. The method may also include causing a radiation source to emit, at each of a plurality of axial positions relative to the subject, radiation beams to the ROI to generate an image frame of the ROI. The radiation beams corresponding to the plurality of axial positions may jointly cover the motion range of the ROI in the axial direction. The method may further include determining a position of the ROI in the axial direction based on the image frames of the ROI, and determining, based on the positions of the ROI in the axial directions, at least one time bin in which therapeutic beams are to be emitted to the ROI.

title: Display method and system of bedside card data and hospital bed equipment
assignee: 山东亚华电子股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and a system for displaying data of a bedside card and sickbed equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the hospital bed equipment is in a first display state, wherein the first display state is a state that a display screen of the hospital bed equipment displays a user operation interface; based on triggering or after preset time, the hospital bed equipment loads a bedside card display template and acquires bedside card data corresponding to the bedside card display template; the display screen of the sickbed equipment enters a second display state, the second display state is that the display screen of the sickbed equipment displays the state of the bedside card data of the sickbed equipment corresponding to the patient, the bedside card data comprises the nursing information of the sickbed equipment corresponding to the patient, and the nursing information comprises the name of the sickbed equipment corresponding to the patient. This application shows the bedside card with the mode of simulation screen saver, both can play the effect of protection display screen, can make things convenient for medical personnel to look over the purpose of bedside card again, still can not influence patient user's user experience's technological effect.

title: Transport dangerous driving reporting
abstract: An example operation includes one or more of identifying a dangerous driving situation, capturing first media by a vehicle involved in the dangerous driving situation, establishing a geofence based on a distance associated with the dangerous driving situation, and capturing second media by one or more other vehicles within the geofence.

title: Dynamic vehicle tags
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc., Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha
abstract: An example operation includes one or more of receiving an opt-in request to display information on a display of a vehicle configured to be viewed from outside of the vehicle, authenticating the request to allow displaying information on the display, determining information associated with the vehicle to be displayed on the display, determining misuse of the information displayed on the display based on a notification from another vehicle, and flagging the misuse.

title: Rib fracture CT image classification method based on grouping aggregation deep learning model
abstract: The invention discloses a rib fracture CT image classification method based on a grouping aggregation deep learning model, which comprises the steps of obtaining a clean data set, continuously taking 80 slices from each desensitized rib fracture CT image in the clean data set, and forming training sample data by the rib fracture CT images respectively containing 80 slices and corresponding labels; constructing a grouping aggregation deep learning network, wherein the grouping aggregation deep learning network comprises a slice grouping stage, a feature extraction stage and an aggregation decision stage; training sample data is input into a packet aggregation deep learning network for training, and a packet aggregation deep learning network classification model is obtained by calculating a loss function value; inputting a test image containing 80 slices into a grouping aggregation deep learning network classification model to obtain classification scores; the method has the advantages that the information is extracted more fully on the high-resolution axial plane, the information extraction process is simple, and the information is prevented from being extracted excessively on the low-resolution axial plane, so that the classification is accurate.

title: Method and system for detecting pregnancy-induced hypertension, electronic device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for detecting pregnancy-induced hypertension, wherein the detection method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical fundus images of a plurality of patients with pregnancy-induced hypertension; taking each historical fundus image as input, taking a training characteristic point marked in advance in the historical fundus image as output, and establishing a characteristic point acquisition model; acquiring a target fundus image of a target patient; inputting the target eye fundus image into the characteristic point acquisition model, determining that the target patient has pregnancy-induced hypertension eye fundus lesions when the target characteristic point output by the characteristic point acquisition model is acquired, and determining whether the target patient has pregnancy-induced hypertension or not and carrying out disease prognosis prediction by combining with other index establishment algorithms. The diagnosis and treatment mode of pregnancy-induced hypertension is effectively improved, the detection early property, timeliness and convenience are realized, and the detection accuracy and efficiency are improved; the risk of the disease progress is accurately predicted, so that the active intervention and timely treatment of the disease of the patient are realized, and the risk and damage of the pregnancy-induced hypertension are reduced.

title: Determining a competency relationship, setting dose-related recording parameter using competency relationship
abstract: A method for determining at least one competency relationship to be used as a basis for selection of a dose-related recording parameter for an examination process, in particular the recording of a timed series of x-ray images as an x-ray image dataset, of a patient at an x-ray device, between at least one competency value describing a user-specific or user-group specific user competency in respect of the evaluation of recorded x-ray images and at least the at least one recording parameter. The method includes displaying a plurality of x-ray image datasets corresponding to different recording parameters and/or having different image contents described by image content parameters; recording, for each x-ray image dataset, at least one measured value describing the competency value based on an interaction of a user with an operating device assigned to a display device; and determining, based on the measured values, the competency relationship describing the recording parameter-dependent competency value.

title: Device for comprehensive health monitoring
abstract: Implementations described herein disclose a method for direct screening and monitoring of health parameters of multiple individual subjects in a remote location with easy access and periodic visits by such multiple individual subjects, where such remote location is not a healthcare facility. Furthermore, an apparatus disclosed herein enables remote health monitoring of individual subjects including children outside the confines of a healthcare facility.

title: Domain-specific generative machine learning models
abstract: A plurality of resolved incident tickets may each include a worklog providing a history of actions taken during attempts to resolve a corresponding resolved incident and a resolution having at least one resolution statement. An iterative processing of the plurality of resolved incident tickets may include processing each resolution statement of the resolution with at least one domain-specific statement classifier specific to the incident domain to either discard or retain a classified resolution statement; processing each retained classified resolution statement in conjunction with the worklog to determine whether to discard or retain the resolved incident; providing an updated resolution for the resolved incident when the resolved incident is retained, and adding the resolved incident with the updated resolution to the processed incident tickets. Then, at least one machine learning model may be trained to process a new incident ticket, using the processed incident tickets.

title: Feature selection method and device based on clinical data
abstract: The invention discloses a feature selection method and device based on clinical data, and belongs to the technical field of digital medical treatment. The invention improves the fitness function of a genetic algorithm by using a filtering method and an mRMR factor, and provides a clinical data feature selection method based on an mRMR-GA algorithm. Meanwhile, in order to ensure that the mRMR factor is calculated more efficiently, mutual information is calculated using kernel density function estimation, which has the advantage of a smoother probability density function than density histogram estimation, and finally, feature selection processing using a genetic algorithm is a way of searching a feature space set based on a feature relationship, and a better feature set selection result can be obtained. In the prediction model for the specified prediction task, the optimal characteristic subset of the prediction target is determined based on the method, and then the prediction model is trained, tested and identified, so that the data dimension can be effectively reduced, and the accuracy of the prediction model can be effectively improved.

title: Transcription of audio
abstract: A method may include obtaining first features of first audio data that includes speech and obtaining second features of second audio data that is a revoicing of the first audio data. The method may further include providing the first features and the second features to an automatic speech recognition system and obtaining a single transcription generated by the automatic speech recognition system using the first features and the second features.

title: Orthopedics consumable detection method and system based on cascade deep learning method
abstract: The invention relates to an orthopedic consumable detection method and system based on a cascade deep learning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring orthopedic consumable image data for training, and manually marking the position of an orthopedic consumable object to be detected in the orthopedic consumable image for training; detecting the training images after the manual marking by using at least two detectors, wherein the detection process is divided into two processes, namely detecting the orthopedic consumable outer box by using the detectors, and detecting the orthopedic consumable by using the detectors; inputting the data set into an orthopedics consumable outer box deep learning model, and training the deep learning model to obtain a trained deep learning model; based on the trained orthopedics consumptive material outer box deep learning model and the orthopedics consumptive material deep learning model, the new orthopedics consumptive material image is detected, and a new detection result of the orthopedics consumptive material image to be detected is obtained.

title: System for determining the presence of features in a dataset
abstract: A system for determining whether a dataset including a plurality of cross-sectional images includes a predetermined feature is provided. A first AI receives a dataset including a plurality of cross-sectional images, and analyses the dataset to identify a subset of cross-sectional images of the dataset capable of including the predetermined feature A second AI model receives a first cross-sectional image from the subset, analyses the first cross-sectional image to determine whether the first cross-sectional image includes the predetermined feature, and outputs an indication of whether the first cross-sectional image includes the predetermined feature. A processor is configured to obtain the output from the second AI model, and based on the output from the second AI model indicating that the first cross-sectional image includes the pre-determined feature, determine that the dataset includes the predetermined feature.

title: Cross-domain medical care equipment recommendation method and system with privacy protection function
abstract: The disclosure provides a cross-domain medical care equipment recommendation method and system with a privacy protection function, which are used for acquiring ID data of a target domain about users and items of medical care equipment; respectively carrying out one-hot coding representation on the user ID data and the project ID data of the target domain; expanding the one-hot coded representation of the target domain by utilizing the auxiliary domain user domain dependent characteristic and the auxiliary domain user domain independent characteristic to obtain an expanded characteristic; predicting the grade of the target domain user to the project by using the expanded characteristics and the trained factorization machine model, and recommending the medical care equipment according to the grade result; the method and the device can ensure that other platforms can not reversely deduce original scoring information according to the disclosed user potential factor vector, and can effectively solve the problem that the original data privacy of the user is revealed in the auxiliary domain data migration process.

title: Symbiotic modeling system and method
abstract: A modeling server is in communication with multiple databases and/or knowledge systems. The modeling server may utilize predetermined rules for suggesting design elements such as plants, lighting, fencing, irrigation, and more. The modeling server may acquire legal information pertaining to the project, based on jurisdictions that contain the location of the project. The modeling server may further generate one or more teams to implement the project, including, but not limited to, design teams, construction teams, and/or management teams. The modeling server may further produce a rendering and/or simulation of a landscaping or landscape architecture project to facilitate improved customer engagement, which may result in increased customer satisfaction as well as improved project performance in terms of scheduling, budget, and longevity of the project.

title: Method and system for detecting medical insurance fraud behavior based on clustering
assignee: 浙江大学山东工业技术研究院
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical insurance data processing, and particularly relates to a cluster-based medical insurance fraud detection method and system. A method for detecting medical insurance fraud based on clustering comprises the following steps: s1, data extraction; s2, normalization processing; s3, clustering data; and S4, obtaining a result, and repeating the step S3 until the clustering is converged to obtain mechanism information of the suspicious abnormal behavior. The invention provides a cluster-based medical insurance fraud detection method and system for medical institutions, which solve the problem of massage item abnormity in actual scenes and detect suspected medical insurance fraud abnormal behaviors.
assignee_clean: 浙江大学山东工业技术研究院
primary_assignee: 浙江大学山东工业技术研究院

title: System for identification of treatment and resource deployment based on treatment interaction
abstract: A system for extracting treatment information from a resource image, predicting a likely future event based on the extracted treatment information, and developing an action step to address the likely future event is provided. The system uses image capture technology and a data analytics engine to predict a likely future event and thereby allows users to allocate resources accordingly. In this way, the system provides a more efficient way to manage resources to address a likely future event.

title: User classification method, device, server and storage medium based on big data
assignee: 中国平安人寿保险股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a user classification method, a device, a server and a storage medium based on big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring insurance purchase information of a current user, wherein the insurance purchase information comprises dangerous seed type information and dangerous seed limit information; extracting security information in the dangerous seed type information, and determining the user category of the current user according to the security information and the dangerous seed limit information; and determining recommended target dangerous seeds according to the user categories, and pushing the target dangerous seeds. According to the invention, the purchased dangerous seed type and the dangerous seed amount information of the user are obtained from the insurance purchase information of the user, the dangerous seed type is further refined into the corresponding guarantee information of the dangerous seed, the category of the user is further refined and learned from the guarantee information, and the user is further refined and distinguished according to the category, so that the recommended dangerous seed is recommended according to the category, the recommended dangerous seed is more in accordance with the requirement of the user, and the user experience is improved.

primary_assignee: 中国平安人寿保险股份有限公司

abstract: The application provides a computing device and a related product, the computing device is used for executing the full-connection neural network training operation, and the computing device has the advantages of low cost and low power consumption.
