title: Text processing method based on orthopedic symptom feature selection
abstract: The invention relates to a text processing method based on orthopedic symptom characteristic selection, and belongs to the field of computer natural language processing. Firstly, selecting an initial candidate tag set, jointly inputting symptom information, patient tag information and depth characteristics of an original question obtained through a neural network into a Softmax layer, and selecting a Top K corresponding tag with the highest probability as the initial candidate tag set; and then performing a second-order tag correlation calculation: examining the interaction relation between every two labels according to the conditional probability of each pair of labels in the initial candidate label set obtained in the last step, and simultaneously setting a threshold value to decide the choice of the subsequent candidate labels; and (3) post-treatment: on the basis of obtaining an initial candidate tag set, repeatedly selecting or rejecting by using the correlation of the 'second-order' tag and a threshold value to serve as a final result; the method is superior to the traditional ML-KNN, rank-SVM and AdaBoost. M2 algorithms in all evaluation indexes.

title: Anatomy-aware motion estimation
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: Described herein are neural network-based systems, methods and instrumentalities associated with estimating the motion of an anatomical structure. The motion estimation may be performed utilizing pre-learned knowledge of the anatomy of the anatomical structure. The anatomical knowledge may be learned via a variational autoencoder, which may then be used to optimize the parameters of a motion estimation neural network system such that, when performing motion estimation for the anatomical structure, the motion estimation neural network system may produce results that conform with the underlying anatomy of anatomical structure.

title: Dynamic weighted attribute reduction method for large-scale cognitive impairment disease detection
abstract: The invention provides a dynamic weighting attribute reduction method for large-scale cognitive disorder disease detection, belongs to the technical field of medical information intelligent processing, and aims to solve the technical problem that uncertainty is caused in the characteristic selection of complex cognitive disorder diseases due to long processing time of large-scale data processing by a traditional method. The technical proposal is as follows: the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring and preprocessing large-scale cognitive disorder disease data; s2, calculating knowledge granularity of the original data and the incremental data of the cognitive disorder disease; s3, constructing a dynamic characteristic interaction weighted attribute tree; s4, branching the constructed dynamic characteristic interaction weighted attribute tree, and adding the low-weight attribute into the interaction set F to perform incremental characteristic interaction when each round of branching is finished; and S5, outputting the calculation node reduction set to a main node after all the attribute trees are branched, and obtaining the large-scale cognitive disorder disease data reduction. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the speed of feature selection and accuracy can be effectively improved.

title: Informed patient consent through video tracking
abstract: A system, method, and computer-readable media for obtaining the informed consent of a patient for a medical procedure. Specifically, a video describing a medical procedure may be provided to the patient through a client device having two display portions. As the video is playing in a first portion, the client device may capture the patient watching the video and display the captured image on the second portion. The entire display of the client device may be recorded, providing a record that the patient has watched the video describing the medical procedure and consents to the medical procedure.

title: Rapid illness screening of a population using computer vision and multispectral data
abstract: An embodiment provides a method including obtaining, using a camera system, imagery of one or more individuals in an environment; analyzing, using a processor, the individual data using a trained model to identify individuals and recognize gestures that are indicative of sickness behavior; presenting, using a display device, information about individuals that have displayed sickness behavior above a calculated threshold.

title: Wireless communication method and device, and electronic device
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to classifying a target object. An electronic device may transmit a detection signal and receive a reflection signal reflected from the target object. The electronic device then determines, based on one or more features of the reflection signal, a category of the target object and adjusts at least one transmission parameter based on the category. The electronic device then transmits an adjust signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title: Method, device and equipment for selecting fusion model weight parameters
assignee: 东软集团股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device and equipment for selecting fusion model weight parameters, wherein an initial fusion model is firstly constructed, the initial fusion model comprises N neural network models, and each neural network model corresponds to model weight. And selecting a first model weight combination from the constructed fusion models to construct fusion models to be verified, and acquiring verification results of each fusion model to be verified, wherein the first model weight combination comprises 1 st to N-1 st model weights. And obtaining m groups of second model weight combinations meeting preset conditions according to the verification results of the fusion models to be verified, wherein the second model weight combinations comprise 1 st to N th model weights. And after determining the second model weight combination, obtaining m groups of second model weight combinations meeting preset conditions according to the verification results of the fusion models to be verified so as to determine a group of target model weights, and generating a corresponding target fusion model by using the target model weights, thereby improving the model fusion efficiency.

title: Sensor and method for detecting target molecules
abstract: An apparatus and method for detecting one or more target molecules includes a hydrophobic substrate, and a sensor. The sensor includes two or more electrodes disposed on the hydrophobic substrate and separated from one another by a gap, a plurality of nanostructures formed on or within an upper surface of each electrode, a plurality of binding molecules attached to the plurality of nanostructures, wherein the plurality of binding molecules are configured to bind with the one or more target molecules, and wherein the upper surface of each electrode and the plurality of nanostructures are hydrophilic, and may further detect two or more analytes with two or more sensors that detect two or more different modalities, such as, electrical, optical fluorescence, optical resonance, magnetic detection, or acoustic waves.

title: On-line self-adaptive system and method for neural network
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: Neural network-based systems, methods, and apparatuses associated with image data processing are described herein. The neural network may be pre-trained to learn parameters or models for processing image data, and upon deployment, the neural network may automatically perform further optimization of the learned parameters or models based on a small set of online data samples. On-line optimization may be facilitated via offline meta-learning, such that optimization may be accomplished quickly in several optimization steps.

title: Cognitive responses with electronic messaging
abstract: Providing cognitive responses with an electronic message system includes predicting an urgency level corresponding to an electronic message received by the system based on detecting pre-defined features within the message and assigning a classification to the message based on the detected features. The message and corresponding urgency level can be mapped to a response action based on the classification assigned to the message. A notification of the response action and corresponding urgency level can be generated.

title: Recruiting and recording system
abstract: The present application relates to a recruiting and recording system. Operations include summarizing, analyzing, and displaying information about potential personals of the educational institution. The system may aggregate potential persona information by traversing, for example, a lower educational database, a social networking website, or a test organization database. The system may evaluate potential options as potential applicants to generate recommendations for the sponsor to contact. Alternatively or additionally, the system may evaluate potential options that have been applied to enter the institution to generate recommendations for acceptance by the record officer. The system may recommend potential personas based on their potential to be successful in the institution. Success may correspond to metrics such as the likelihood of obtaining employment from an educational institution graduation or from after an institution graduation. Potential personals sharing attributes with previously successful students may be selected for recommendation. Potential personals that do not share attributes with previously successful students may not be selected for recommendation.

title: Oral data collection device
abstract: The present disclosure provides an oral data collection device comprising a mouthguard and at least two sensors, a medical analytics system comprising the device, and methods of using the device and system to provide a personalized treatment protocol, stage a health condition, measure a response to therapy, phenotype for selection to participate in drug trials, measure stability of an anatomical structure, or predict a rate of change of a health condition in a subject in need thereof.

title: Spine image segmentation method and device based on artificial intelligence and attention mechanism
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The invention provides a spine image segmentation method and device based on artificial intelligence and an attention mechanism, wherein the method comprises the following steps: encoding the spine image to obtain encoded image matrixes D1 to Dn; determining image matrices D1 'to Dn' corresponding to D1 to Dn based on upsampling and/or downsampling with the size of the image matrix Di as a reference; adding D1 'to Dn' to obtain an image matrix Mi; carrying out attention mechanism fusion on Mi and a target image matrix to obtain an image matrix Ui1; up-sampling the target image matrix to obtain an image matrix Ui2; and performing connection operation on the Ui1 and the Ui2 to obtain a decoded image matrix Ui. According to the method provided by the invention, the Mi is determined by adding the D1 'to the Dn', so that the features in the spine image can be reserved as much as possible compared with the mode of determining the Mi based on a single image matrix, the loss of feature elements is reduced, and the accuracy of obtaining the spine image by segmentation is improved.

title: Visual detection method, system, electronic equipment and medium
assignee: 望知科技(深圳)有限公司
abstract: One or more embodiments of the present specification disclose a visual inspection method, system, electronic device, and medium. The visual detection method is suitable for a visual detection system to carry out visual detection, wherein a sampling image is a video, and a scene of a target detection object exists in the video, and comprises the following steps: selecting n+1 frames of pictures in the video; respectively extracting semantic information of the n+1 frames of pictures; performing differential operation on the semantic information; and sending the semantic information subjected to the difference operation into a forward neural network for processing to obtain the related information of the target detection object, so that the accuracy and the robustness of the visual detection system can be improved.

title: Method and device for determining puncture point, electronic device and storage medium
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for determining puncture points, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining whether an intersection exists between a candidate puncture path in a medical image and a puncture obstacle in the medical image, wherein the candidate puncture path is a path between a focal point in the medical image and each of a plurality of candidate needle insertion points on a epidermis in the medical image; determining at least one feasible needle entering point according to a candidate needle entering point corresponding to the candidate puncture path without intersection in the plurality of candidate needle entering points; and determining the puncture point according to the score of the at least one needle-inserting-possible point, so that the puncture point of the percutaneous puncture ablation operation can be obtained, the success rate of the percutaneous puncture ablation operation is improved, and the time required by the percutaneous puncture ablation operation is shortened.

title: System, method, and recording medium for restaurant management
abstract: A restaurant management method, system, and non-transitory computer readable medium, include receiving a state of a user from user data, determining a confidence value that a restaurant change results in an improvement of the state of the user, and deploying the restaurant change when the confidence value is greater than a predetermined threshold value.

title: Method, apparatus and storage medium for object analysis of medical images
assignee: 深圳科亚医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method, apparatus and storage medium for object analysis of medical images, which may include the following steps. A 3D medical image containing the object may be acquired. Corresponding window width window levels can be set for various types of objects, and each sub-image sequence is respectively windowed based on the window width window levels to obtain the sub-image sequences of each channel. And analyzing by using the sub-object analysis models corresponding to all parts based on the sub-image sequences of all channels to obtain sub-object analysis results. The method and the device set various window width window levels according to the types of the pathological changes of the object, the sub-image sequence adjusts the window according to the set window width window levels to obtain a multi-channel image, and the multi-channel image replaces a single-channel image to be used as the input of a sub-object analysis model.

title: Endoscope processor, information processing device, program, information processing method, and learning model generation method
abstract: The present invention provides a processor for endoscope with high capability of detecting lesions. The endoscope processor is provided with: an image acquisition unit for acquiring a captured image captured by an endoscope; a1 st image processing section for generating a1 st processed image (571) from the captured image acquired by the image acquisition section; a2 nd image processing unit for generating a2 nd processed image (572) from the captured image; and an output unit that outputs the acquired disease state using a learning model (61) that outputs the disease state when the 1 st processed image (571) generated by the 1 st image processing unit and the 2 nd processed image (572) generated by the 2 nd image processing unit are input.

title: System maintenance using unified cognitive root cause analysis for multiple domains
abstract: A computer-implemented method, system, and non-transitory computer program product for maintaining a system. A domain of the system is identified. Problem information identifying a problem in the system is captured. Key performance indicators are obtained from a historical model database for the identified domain. An unsupervised model is applied to the key performance indicators to identify historical solutions to historical problems that are similar to the problem in the system. A linear complexity model is used to identify potential solutions for the problem as an historical solution for each historical problem that has the lowest combination of time-cost complexity, resource-cost complexity, and recurrence frequency for the historical problem. A real-time objective function is used to select a solution to the problem from the potential solutions. A maintenance operation to be performed on the system to implement the solution and fix the problem is identified.

title: Methods and systems for patient parameter fusion and feedback
abstract: An example method is performed by a computing device executing instructions stored in data storage, and includes receiving physiologic monitoring data from a plurality of sensors coupled to a patient, receiving information indicating a measurement of patient motion during the patient care event, determining whether the measurement of patient motion is above a threshold, based on determining whether the measurement of patient motion is above the threshold, generating, for the physiologic monitoring data, a respective quality indicator, analyzing, by the computing device, (i) a combination of the physiologic monitoring data from the plurality of sensors and (ii) the respective quality indicator for the physiologic monitoring data to generate a response dependent upon the combination of the physiologic monitoring data as weighted by the respective quality indicator, and based on analyzing, outputting caregiver feedback by the computing device according to the response.

title: Maxwell parallel imaging
abstract: During operation, a computer system may acquire magnetic resonance (MR) signals associated with a sample from a measurement device or memory. Then, the computer system may access a predetermined set of coil magnetic field basis vectors associated with a surface surrounding the sample, where coil sensitivities of coils in the measurement device are represented by weighted superpositions of the predetermined set of coil magnetic field basis vectors using coefficients, and where the predetermined coil magnetic field basis vectors are solutions to Maxwell's equations. Next, the computer system may solve, on a voxel-by-voxel basis for voxels associated with the sample, a nonlinear optimization problem for MR information associated with the sample and the coefficients using: a forward model that uses the MR information as inputs and simulates response physics of the sample, the MR signals and the predetermined set of coil magnetic field basis vectors.

title: Multi-modal medical image fusion method based on optimal transmission theory
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-modal medical image fusion method based on an optimal transmission theory, which belongs to the technical field of computer graphics and medical image processing and comprises the following steps: s1: inputting two medical images to be fused in different modes; s2: negating the source image, and normalizing the negated source image; s3: calculating an optimal transmission centroid between the source images after the normalization operation; s4: and performing image negation according to the optimal transmission centroid, and reconstructing a result fusion image. The method can eliminate more noise under the condition of reserving more source image information, and simultaneously reduces the calculation complexity, thereby carrying out faster and more effective fusion of the multi-mode medical image. Meanwhile, the method has the advantages of high running speed, high efficiency and strong robustness, can quickly give out a fusion result after the image is input, is suitable for medical images, and can effectively fuse non-medical images.

title: Interest point information processing method based on robot process automation and related device
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a point of interest information processing method based on robot flow automation and a related device, and relates to the technical fields of robot flow automation, task flow generation and the like. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an operation instruction of a functional component, which is transmitted by a user under a visual configuration interface; determining each target function component related to the interest point task according to the operation instruction; assembling each target function component according to the operation time sequence of each operation instruction by the robot flow automation technology to obtain a component structure chart; and generating a target interest point task according to the component structure diagram. According to the method, the robot flow automation technology is applied to the field of automatic processing of the point of interest information, various point of interest information processing tasks can be rapidly and automatically completed in a code-free mode, a more convenient solution is provided for users without the code compiling capability, and therefore the labor cost of the point of interest information processing tasks is reduced.

abstract: The application relates to a tumor prognosis evaluation method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring preoperative image data of a target object; the preoperative image data comprises a plurality of image sequences; preprocessing each image sequence to obtain a four-dimensional image data set; respectively acquiring a tumor target area mask corresponding to each four-dimensional image data in the four-dimensional image data set; forming a plurality of tumor target area image data sets corresponding to the four-dimensional image data sets according to the communication areas meeting preset conditions in each tumor target area mask; and determining a tumor prognosis evaluation result of the target object based on each tumor target area image data set. The method not only increases the evaluation dimension of the tumor prognosis evaluation result, but also effectively improves the accuracy of the tumor prognosis evaluation result.

title: Method for generating 7T magnetic resonance image based on 3T magnetic resonance image of deep learning
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院第一医学中心
abstract: The invention discloses a method for generating 7T magnetic resonance images based on 3T magnetic resonance images of deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a training set of paired 3T images and 7T images, constructing a 3T image to generate a 7T image deep learning model, defining a loss function of the 7T image deep learning model generated by the 3T image, training the deep learning model to obtain optimal model parameters, and synthesizing the 3T image into the 7T image by using the deep learning model obtained by training. The invention uses the space alignment network to estimate and compensate the space mismatch between the 3T image and the 7T image, thereby realizing better 7T image synthesis effect.

title: Multimodal self-supervised learning for image analysis
abstract: A machine learning model may be trained on a first task of puzzle solving before being tuned on a second task of image analysis. The training of the machine learning model may be self-supervised whereas the tuning of the machine learning model may be supervised. The training data may include a puzzle generated to include multiple imaging modalities. The puzzle may be generated by shuffling a position of the pieces forming an original image. The machine learning model may be trained to perform the first task by reassembling the pieces in the puzzle to generate a reconstruction of the original image. Upon being trained to perform the first task and tuned to perform the second task, the machine learning model may be deployed to perform the second task. The second task may be an image segmentation task such as tumor segmentation and a regression task such as survival prediction.

title: Imaging method and device for four-dimensional ultrasonic guided puncture
assignee: 深圳蓝影医学科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides an imaging method and device for four-dimensional ultrasonic guided puncture, and the method is applied to the generation of a real-time three-dimensional ultrasonic image by acquiring real-time ultrasonic volume data to assist medical staff in clinical guided puncture; the ultrasonic volume data is a set of a plurality of time-continuous two-dimensional ultrasonic image data; the method comprises the following steps: determining integral space information in the ultrasonic volume data, and generating three-dimensional rendering space information according to the integral space information; determining puncture needle information in the ultrasonic volume data, and generating three-dimensional rendering puncture needle information according to the puncture needle information; determining target tissue area information in the ultrasonic volume data, and generating three-dimensional rendering target tissue area information according to the target tissue area information; and generating a three-dimensional ultrasonic image according to the three-dimensional rendering space information, the three-dimensional rendering puncture needle information and the three-dimensional rendering target tissue area information. The three-dimensional ultrasonic image can clearly and intuitively display the spatial position of the puncture needle and the spatial anatomical structure of the target and surrounding tissues.

title: Estimating the temperature of a housing of a device
abstract: Techniques for estimating the temperature of an external portion of a medical device are described. In an example, processing circuitry may determine a temperature sensed by at least one temperature sensor of an internal portion of the device, and determine, based on an algorithm that incorporates the temperature of the internal portion of the device, an estimated temperature of a second portion of the device, wherein the algorithm is representative of an estimated temperature difference between the first portion of the device and the second portion of the device based at least in part on a dynamic transfer function that operates in a time-domain.

title: Determining image values in marked pixels of at least one projection image
abstract: A method for determining image values in marked pixels of at least one projection image is provided. The at least one projection image is part of a projection image set provided for reconstruction of a three-dimensional image dataset and acquired in each case using a projection geometry in an acquisition procedure. The image values are determined through evaluation of at least one epipolar consistency condition that is to be at least approximately fulfilled, that results from the projection geometries of the different projection images of the projection image set, and that requires the agreement of two transformation values in transformation images determined from different projection images by Radon transform and subsequent derivation as a condition transformation.

title: Tumor treatment prognosis prediction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京市肿瘤防治研究所, 北京大学
abstract: The invention provides a tumor treatment prognosis prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of medical detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring tumor anti-HER 2 treatment information of a patient to be tested, wherein the tumor anti-HER 2 treatment information comprises a slice image of tumor tissues, clinical report information and patient information; inputting the tumor anti-HER 2 treatment information of the patient to be tested into a bimodal prognosis model to obtain a tumor anti-HER 2 treatment prognosis prediction result of the patient to be tested, which is output by the bimodal prognosis model; the bimodal prognosis model is used for carrying out multimode feature fusion on slice images of tumor tissues, clinical report information and patient information in tumor anti-HER 2 treatment information, and determining a prognosis prediction result of tumor anti-HER 2 treatment of a patient to be detected based on the fused features. The invention can effectively improve the prognosis prediction precision of the tumor anti-HER 2 treatment and is beneficial to the effective evaluation of the prognosis of the tumor anti-HER 2 treatment of patients.

title: Methods and apparatus for specimen characterization using hyperspectral imaging
abstract: An apparatus for characterizing a specimen and/or specimen container. The characterization apparatus includes an imaging location configured to receive a specimen container containing a specimen, a light source configured to provide lighting of the imaging location, and a hyperspectral image capture device. The hyperspectral image capture device is configured to generate and capture a spectrally-resolved image of a small portion of the specimen container and specimen at a spectral image capture device. The spectrally-resolved image data received at the spectral image capture device is processed by a computer to determine at least one of: segmentation of at least one of the specimen and/or specimen container, and determination of a presence or absence of an interferent, such as hemolysis, icterus, or lipemia. Methods of imaging a specimen and/or specimen container, and specimen testing apparatus including a characterization apparatus are described, as are other aspects.

title: Block chain-based pension certification data analysis method, device, equipment and medium

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a block chain-based pension authentication data analysis method, an analysis device, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein the analysis method firstly acquires pension authentication data of a target user in a block chain; then, acquiring an electronic medical record corresponding to the target user from a trusted institution; judging whether the performed state record in the endowment authentication data is abnormal or not according to the electronic medical record, and obtaining a first judgment result; and if the first judgment result indicates that the performed state record is abnormal, sending first early warning information to an early warning node connected with the blockchain.

title: Method to augment routing delivery systems with intuitive human knowledge, expertise, and iterative artificial intelligence and machine learning in contact center environments
abstract: Dynamically routing and re-evaluating a work item based on actions taken on the work item (e.g., adding context information). The augmented routing system categories a work item into one or more dynamic work categories and identifies active knowledge workers and/or knowledge articles based on the work categories. The work item is displayed in a dynamic knowledge worker view, which allows the knowledge worker to take action on the work item. The actions a knowledge worker may take are based on permissions of the knowledge worker, one of the actions that a knowledge worker may take on a work item is to add context information to the work item. After an action is taken on a work item, the system re-evaluates the work item, which may result in the work item being added/removed from one or more work categories; and added/removed from one or more dynamic customized knowledge worker views.

title: Disease diagnosis device and equipment based on medical knowledge map knowledge reasoning
abstract: The invention discloses a disease diagnosis method, a device and equipment based on medical knowledge map knowledge inference, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a userInteracting content with medical question-answering system and acquiring user based on the interacting contentThe user symptom set of (1); calculating the user according to the user symptom setPresence eventsFirst probability ofAccording to the first probabilityComputing users S and diSecond probability of co-occurrence of diseaseAccording to the first probabilityAnd the second probabilityComputing usersPatient diThird probability of diseaseOutputting a user based on a dynamic threshold and the third probabilityThe final disease diagnosis result. The invention can be used as an auxiliary tool for doctor diagnosis, improves the working efficiency of doctors, can be used for preliminary self-examination of patients, and can serve high-level artificial intelligence medical applications, such as medical question-answering systems, medical auxiliary diagnosis, private artificial intelligence health assistants and the like.

title: Security analysis method for private data and financial private data of trusted processing unit
assignee: 杭州锘崴信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a security analysis method for private data and financial private data of a trusted processing unit, and relates to a data processing technology. According to the security analysis method of the TEE-based private data and the financial private data, the security module can be distributed into a physical memory area shared by an available processing unit and a kernel to be requested in a Dynamic Random Access Memory (DRAM) according to a TEE application request. In this way, when the core to be requested uses the available processing unit to perform data processing, the private data to be processed is transmitted through the physical memory area that is only allowed to be accessed by the available processing unit and the core to be requested, and the private data to be processed in the physical memory area cannot be accessed by other cores of the CPU. Therefore, the TEE is realized in the available processing unit, the flow is simple, the cost is low, the safety of privacy data is high, and a technical basis is formed for the privacy protection calculation federal learning.

title: Training method of pulsation artifact correction model and pulsation artifact correction method
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a training method, a device, equipment and a computer-readable storage medium of a beating artifact correction model, and a beating artifact correction method. The training method of the beating artifact correction model comprises the following steps: acquiring a first magnetic resonance image; simulating arterial pulsation on the first magnetic resonance image, and generating a plurality of second magnetic resonance images with time sequence; transforming the plurality of second magnetic resonance images into a frequency domain space to obtain a plurality of first K spaces with time sequence; filling acquisition lines corresponding to the time sequence of the acquisition lines in the plurality of first K spaces into a second K space; reconstructing according to the second K space to obtain a third magnetic resonance image; and training the machine learning model according to the first magnetic resonance image and the third magnetic resonance image to obtain a beating artifact correction model. The invention solves the problem that the motion artifact simulation method in the related technology can not obtain the training data which can be used for training the pulsation artifact correction model.

abstract: A topical neurostimulator patch and system are provided, including a dermal patch; an electrical signal generator associated with the patch; a signal receiver for activating the electrical signal generator; a power source for an electrical signal generator associated with the patch; an electrical signal activating device; and a nerve feedback sensor.

title: Plasma wound treatment system, method, device and storage medium
assignee: 江苏容正医药科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a plasma wound treatment system, a plasma wound treatment method, a plasma wound treatment device and a storage medium, and the plasma wound treatment system comprises a power supply device, a plasma generation device, a plasma array device and a controller; the power supply device is used for supplying power to the wound treatment system; the plasma generating device is used for generating plasma; the plasma array device is used for transmitting plasma; the controller is used for determining plasma generation parameters of the plasma generated by the plasma generation device based on the wound surface characteristics of the patient; the wound surface characteristics comprise at least one of wound time, wound surface peripheral temperature and wound surface type; the plasma generation parameter includes at least one of an intensity of the plasma, a temperature of the plasma.

title: Exercise control system based on edge calculation and cloud feedback
abstract: The invention discloses an exercise control system based on edge calculation and cloud feedback, which comprises a healthy cloud 1, a mobile portable terminal 2, an exercise equipment edge calculation node 3, a wearable device 4, a voice reminding unit 5, a big data storage center 8 and a medical care management terminal 10; the calculation and planning module 7 automatically reads weather data, the latest exercise condition of the individual exerciser, historical exercise condition and physical fitness and the exercise mode of the individual exerciser, calculates big data, and generates an exercise plan book which accords with exercise. Therefore, the application provides a more intelligent exercise guiding device and a control system, which can provide a proper exercise strategy according to various complex factors such as physiological states, exercise conditions, exercise progress and the like of an exerciser, help exercise to select proper exercise places, set reliable exercise strength guiding devices and intelligently customize a more reliable exercise mode according to users.

title: Imaging systems and methods
abstract: X-ray and fluoroscopic image capture and, in particular, to a versatile X-ray emitter operative to capture images of a target configured to track and position the X-ray emission relative to an image sensor that generates the X-ray image using the X-ray emission. The system is configured to prompt the user or operator of the X-ray system with various informational data to improve the outcome of the X-ray and decrease the frequency of X-ray emissions required to obtain a desirable X-ray image.

title: Health state evaluation method, device, storage medium and computer system
assignee: 医渡云（北京）技术有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of data processing technologies, and in particular, to a method and an apparatus for health status assessment, a storage medium, and a computer system. The health state evaluation method comprises the following steps: constructing a risk analysis model according to the user data of the target object; wherein the user data comprises a plurality of characteristics relating to the health status of the target subject; determining a risk parameter corresponding to the characteristic value of the characteristic based on the risk analysis model; acquiring preset characteristics of an object to be evaluated; and determining a state evaluation result of the object to be evaluated by combining the preset features of the object to be evaluated and the risk parameters corresponding to the feature values of the preset features. By calculating the risk parameters of the characteristic values and calculating the user data evaluation result based on the risk parameters, the characteristics which mainly affect the user data evaluation result can be clearly obtained, and the backtracking analysis of the data is convenient to carry out.
