title: System for providing concierge service using self-driving robot
abstract: Provided is a guide service providing system using an autonomous driving robot. The guide service providing system includes: an autonomous driving robot recognizing a voice uttering a name to output a reception event, reproducing and outputting guide content while driving along a preset route, and driving by recognizing a person or an object as an obstacle through an obstacle avoidance function; a manager terminal outputting the name in the reception event outputted from the autonomous driving robot, and connected with the autonomous driving robot through bidirectional video communication when a problem occurrence event is outputted from the autonomous driving robot; and a guide service providing server including a registration part registering the autonomous driving robot and the manager terminal, a route management part setting and storing a route for the autonomous driving robot to travel, a transmission part converting the name recognized by the autonomous driving robot into a text to transmit the same to the manager terminal, a content management part registering the guide content to be outputted by the autonomous driving robot, and a generation part generating a channel for calling and connecting the manager terminal through bidirectional video communication when the problem occurrence event is outputted. Therefore, the present invention is capable of minimizing the risk of personal information spillage.

title: Systems, apparatus, and methods for data driven location detection
abstract: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture are disclosed for data driven location detection. An example method includes executing a machine-learning model to generate an output based on at least one of multi-spectral or multi-modal data input to the machine-learning model, the at least one of the multi-spectral or the multi-modal data associated with a target device or a target object, the output to be representative of a location of the at least one of the target device or the target object. The example method also includes publishing the location of the at least one of the target device or the target object to a datastore for application access. Further, the example method includes causing an action based on the location of the at least one of the target device or the target object to be performed by the at least one of the target device or the target device.

title: Method and device for reader to transmit signal in wireless communication system
abstract: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a method for a reader to transmit and receive a signal to and from a tag, the method comprising: a step in which a first reader transmits a first signal to a tag; and a step in which the first reader receives the first signal reflected on the tag. The timing for the first reader to transmit the first signal is determined by using an offset value based on an ID related to the first reader.

title: Activity image reconstruction using anatomy data
assignee: Siemens Medical Solutions Usa, Inc., Jicun Hu, Vladimir Y. Panin, Vijay Shah
abstract: A method for reconstructing medical images comprises: identifying a plurality of organs in a body of a subject based on an anatomic image; assigning a plurality of voxels in the body to respective ones of the plurality of organs based on the anatomic image; and reconstructing activity images of the body using respectively different processing for the voxels assigned to each respective one of the plurality of organs.
assignee_clean: siemens medical solutions usa; jicun hu; vladimir y panin; vijay shah

title: Methods and systems for authorizing program activities
abstract: Methods and systems are disclosed for processing information. An example method can comprise receiving a request to authorize an operation. The request can comprise a product identifier and an account identifier. The method can further comprise determining authorization plan data associated with the account identifier. The authorization plan data comprises a collection of product identifiers indicating products authorized by a sponsor. The method can comprise determining whether the transaction is authorized based on a comparison of the product identifier to at least a portion of the collection of product identifiers and providing an authorization message in response to the determining whether the transaction is authorized.

title: Few-view CT image reconstruction system
abstract: A system for few-view computed tomography (CT) image reconstruction is described. The system includes a preprocessing module, a first generator network, and a discriminator network. The preprocessing module is configured to apply a ramp filter to an input sinogram to yield a filtered sinogram. The first generator network is configured to receive the filtered sinogram, to learn a filtered back-projection operation and to provide a first reconstructed image as output. The first reconstructed image corresponds to the input sinogram. The discriminator network is configured to determine whether a received image corresponds to the first reconstructed image or a corresponding ground truth image. The generator network and the discriminator network correspond to a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (WGAN). The WGAN is optimized using an objective function based, at least in part, on a Wasserstein distance and based, at least in part, on a gradient penalty.

title: Booked-blocked classifier
abstract: Provided are a system and method for determining whether an apparent booking is a genuine booking or is a blocked period of unavailability that is not the result of a genuine booking. Bookings occur in all sorts of industries, such as travel, medical, entertainment, weddings, catering, and the like. In some examples, the method may include receiving content from a website that includes a listing for an object, identifying a period of unavailability of the object based on the content received from the website, predicting, via a machine learning model, whether the period of unavailability of the object is a blocked period that is not a result of a reservation of the object, the predicting being performed based on additional content visible on the website being input into the machine learning model, and storing an identifier of the period of unavailability and information about the prediction within a storage device.

title: Magnetic resonance image segmentation system and segmentation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a magnetic resonance image segmentation system and a segmentation method thereof. The method realizes the improvement of the effectiveness and robustness of the segmentation algorithm by introducing a multi-map registration mechanism and an attention mechanism; aiming at the difficulties existing in the segmentation of the brain region of the sTBI image and the problems existing in other segmentation methods, a deep learning segmentation framework based on a hard attention mechanism and a soft attention mechanism is provided; in order to solve the problem that a deformed brain region is difficult to locate and identify, a hard attention module is provided, and a prior information map is generated by using a multi-map segmentation algorithm based on deep learning to prompt a region concerned by a segmentation model; furthermore, a soft attention module is provided for expanding the receptive field of the deep learning model to a full map, so that the robustness of the model for the feature extraction of the deformation region can be effectively improved.

title: Computer implemented methods for training or using a software infrastructure based on machine learning techniques
abstract: Computer implemented method for training a software infrastructure based on machine learning techniques and intended for analysis of data obtained from a three-dimensional tomographic inspection of objects of a predetermined type, such as logs, with the aim of determining information about internal characteristics of interest of the self-same objects, wherein, once a training set comprising a plurality of objects of the same predetermined type has been selected, for each object the software infrastructure is supplied with training input data and corresponding training output data, which are processed by the software infrastructure for setting internal processing parameters of the software infrastructure which correlate the training input data with the training output data; where the training input data comprise data obtained from a three-dimensional tomographic inspection of the object, and the training output data comprise information about internal characteristics of interest assessed at internal points of the object, and where the information about the internal characteristics of interest is at least partly assessed at real internal points of the object, previously made accessible by cutting or breaking the object.

title: End to end differentiable machine vision systems, methods, and media
abstract: End to end differentiable machine vision systems, training methods, and processor-readable media are disclosed. A differentiable image signal processor (ISP) is disclosed that can be trained, using machine learning techniques, to adapt raw images received from a new sensor into an adapted images of the same type (i.e. in the same visual domain) as the images previously used to train a perception module, without fine-tuning the perception module itself. The differentiable ISP may include functional blocks for performing specific image enhancement operations using a relatively small number of learned parameters corresponding to meaningful characteristics of the image enhancement operations.

title: Optimization method of text recognition system, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to artificial intelligence, and discloses an optimization method of a text recognition system, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a training sample of an OCR model, wherein the training sample comprises a text picture; inputting the training sample into the OCR model for training; uploading the model parameters obtained through training to a server, wherein the server optimizes the model parameters uploaded by a plurality of text recognition systems and feeds the optimized model parameters back to each text recognition system; and updating and iterating the OCR model according to the model parameters fed back by the server. The application also discloses a computer device and a computer readable storage medium. According to the text recognition method and the text recognition system, the text recognition system can be optimized by sharing the OCR model parameters corresponding to the text data only to the server, so that the text recognition system can be optimized by utilizing the big data processing capacity of the server, and the user privacy information can be prevented from being revealed.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: System generating data for interpretating dental image
abstract: A data generating system for reading a dental image according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a storage unit which stores a dental image in which an anatomical structure of an oral cavity is photographed, diagnostic information including an anatomical identification number and a plurality of diagnosis names of the anatomical structure, and resultant data for the dental image; an input unit for receiving a first input including the selection of a region corresponding to the anatomical structure of the dental image and a second input including the selection of the diagnosis name corresponding to the selected region; a processing unit for generating the resultant data for the dental image based on the first input and the second input; and a display unit for displaying the dental image and the resultant data. Accordingly, the present invention can generate a reading result which has high quality and is simply used.

title: Detecting and processing sections spanning processed document partitions
abstract: Aspects of the invention include detecting and processing sections spanning processed document partitions by caching a document partition. The document partition includes metadata indicating that the document partition is a portion of a whole document. Aspects also include pairing a candidate paragraph from the document partition with a cached paragraph segment and determining, using a coherence model, a probability that the candidate paragraph and the cached paragraph segment constitute a semantically coherent paragraph. Aspects further include discarding the cached paragraph segment and processing the candidate paragraph and the cached paragraph segment separately based on a determination that the probability is less than a threshold level and processing the candidate paragraph and the cached paragraph segment together as a cross-partition paragraph based on a determination that the probability is greater than the threshold level.

title: System, method, and computer program product for analyzing a relational database using embedding learning
abstract: Provided are systems for analyzing a relational database using embedding learning that may include at least one processor programmed or configured to generate one or more entity-relation matrices from a relational database and perform, for each entity-relation matrix of the one or more entity-relation matrices, an embedding learning process on an embedding associated with an entity. When performing the embedding learning process on the embedding associated with the entity, the at least one processor is programmed or configured to generate an updated embedding associated with the entity. Computer implemented methods and computer-program products are also provided.

title: System and method for carbon particle therapy for treatment of cardiac arrhythmias and other diseases
assignee: Mayo Foundation For Medical Education And Research
abstract: Particle or hadron therapy is used on abnormal tissue using carbon atoms, protons, or helium atoms run through a linear accelerator and then directed at the target in the body. This can be used to treat, for example, atrial fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia, hypertension, seizures, gastrointestinal maladies, etc. Contouring and gating may be used to account for cardiac and respiratory motion, helping reduce collateral damage.
assignee_clean: mayo foundation for medical education and research
primary_assignee: mayo foundation for medical education and research

title: Deep venous thrombosis thrombolytic curative effect prediction method and system, storage medium and terminal
abstract: The invention discloses a deep venous thrombosis thrombolytic curative effect prediction method and system, a storage medium and a terminal. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an MRI image of a patient with deep venous thrombosis of the lower limb; training the MRI image based on a semantic segmentation network to obtain a deep learning semantic segmentation model; extracting high-dimensional semantic features of the deep venous thrombosis of the lower limbs by adopting the deep learning semantic segmentation model, and performing feature screening on the high-dimensional semantic features by adopting a clustering algorithm; and (4) predicting the lower limb deep venous thrombus thrombolysis curative effect by adopting a thrombus thrombolysis curative effect prediction algorithm according to the screened semantic features to obtain a lower limb deep venous thrombus thrombolysis curative effect prediction result, and outputting the result. The invention establishes a relation model between semantic features and thrombolytic therapy effect of thrombus based on deep learning semantic segmentation network and magnetic resonance image to effectively predict thrombolytic therapy effect of patient thrombus, thereby reducing doctor burden and improving diagnosis efficiency.

title: Dynamic spatiotemporal beamforming
abstract: A method for imaging a room by a controller includes requesting a signal, indicative of a measurement of a parameter, from a sensor associated with a position and direction of a mobile platform in the room, wherein the measurement from the sensor includes background noise, distortions, and a foreground signal of interest, in response to the mobile platform reaching a new position, requesting a second measurement of the parameter from the sensor associated with the new position of the mobile platform, spatially aggregating the signal from the sensor and associated position and direction to create an energy map via spatio-dynamic beamforming, wherein the background noise and distortions are reduced, by spatially averaging beamformed information acquired across multiple locations to synthesize signals indicative of the foreground signal of interest, analyzing the energy map to identify a state of an apparatus in the room, and outputting a foreground beamformed image.

title: Smart mask for COVID-19 screening, tracking and monitoring
abstract: A smart face mask comprising a mask body; a temperature sensor; a respiration sensor; and a transmitter for transmitting information from the temperature sensor, the respiration sensor and a geotracker to a smart phone or smart watch.

title: Time-to-intensity profile analysis using matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometer
abstract: An apparatus, method or computer program is disclosed. Spectrometer test data for a sample may be received for processing. The spectrometer test data may include time-of-flight data in units of time and intensity of ionized particles passing through the flight tube. Spectrometer test data can be matched against a reference library to determine characteristic information of the sample. The reference library may include spectrometer sample data in units of time and intensity at which the spectrometer detects ionized particles of a pre-stored reference sample detected in the past. The spectrometer reference data has known characteristics that match the correlation with the received spectrometer test data.

title: Method and electronic device for predicting blood pressure dip
assignee: 纬创资通股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and an electronic device for predicting blood pressure dip, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving first physiological information of a corresponding first user; receiving a first current blood pressure of a first user; acquiring a probability value of a depressurization event according to the blood pressure characteristic model, the first physiological information and the first current blood pressure; judging whether the probability value of the depressurization event is not smaller than a triggering threshold value; and judging that the blood pressure suddenly dropping event occurs when the probability value of the dropping event is not smaller than the triggering threshold value.
assignee_clean: 纬创资通股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 纬创资通股份有限公司

title: A kind of multichannel chromatogram fusion method, system and Medical Devices
assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
abstract: The present invention is applicable to multichannel chromatogram emerging system, and provide a kind of multichannel chromatogram fusion method, system and Medical Devices, described method comprises: carry out registration to many group atlas image and target image; By many groups of registration atlas image and target image corresponding be divided into sub-block region; Calculate the local correlation degree in the sub-block region corresponding with every width collection of illustrative plates gray level image, each sub-block region of target gray image; In the local correlation degree result that each sub-block region is corresponding, choose the collection of illustrative plates gray level image that relevance degree is positioned at front X position, wherein, described X is positive integer; The collection of illustrative plates identification image corresponding according to the described collection of illustrative plates gray level image being positioned at front X position, merges each sub-block region of target gray image; The fusion results in each sub-block region is integrated, obtains the fused images of target image.The present invention, owing to having taken into full account the collection of illustrative plates local message that registration is effective, can reach more accurate, segmentation effect fast.
assignee_clean: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院
primary_assignee: 中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院

title: Training method of text desensitization model, text desensitization method and application
assignee: 杭州太美星程医药科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a training method of a text desensitization model, the text desensitization method and application, wherein the training method of the text desensitization model comprises the following steps: training to obtain an initial model based on a sample set containing label information; determining label probability distribution of each word in the text to be desensitized based on the initial model; determining whether the text to be desensitized is a low confidence sample or not based on the label probability distribution of each word in the text to be desensitized; if yes, obtaining labels of all words in the text to be desensitized, and performing incremental training on the initial model as a training sample. The training method of the text desensitization model provided by the invention can be used for rapidly intervening in error desensitization data on one hand and rapidly deploying with individuation under different scenes on the other hand; meanwhile, as usage scenes are increased and the models are updated iteratively, the time for deploying the models is continuously shortened.
assignee_clean: 杭州太美星程医药科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州太美星程医药科技有限公司

title: Internal nasal disease real-time auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system based on Att-Res2-CE-Net
abstract: The invention discloses an Att-Res 2-CE-Net-based intranasal disease real-time auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system, which is based on Att-Res2-CE-Net, uses Res2Net50 characteristics to extract a main network, and embeds a dense cavity rolling block DAC module and a residual multi-core pooling RMP module into an Attention U-Net network, wherein the system comprises a video acquisition and processing end, a cloud platform and a server end, the video acquisition and processing end comprises a plurality of intranasal endoscope video acquisition devices and is wirelessly connected with the cloud platform, and the cloud platform is wirelessly connected with the server.

title: Access control rights assignment capabilities utilizing a new context-based hierarchy of data based on new forms of metadata
abstract: One example method includes extracting content metadata from data, storing the content metadata in a data catalogue, receiving at the data catalogue, from a user, a request to access the data, transmitting, by the data catalogue to a security service provider, an access request that includes the extracted content metadata and metadata relating to the access request, accessing, by the security service provider, identity metadata concerning an identity of the user, and a data access policy, and transmitting, by the security service provider to the data catalogue, a decision as to whether or not access can be granted to the data, and the decision is based on the data access policy, the identity metadata, and the metadata in the access request.

title: Method, device and equipment for predicting intracranial aneurysm occlusion
assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院, 强联智创（北京）科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification discloses a method, a device and equipment for predicting intracranial aneurysm occlusion, and belongs to the technical field of medical images and computers. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be processed; inputting the data to be processed into an intracranial aneurysm prediction model to obtain a predicted value corresponding to the data to be processed, wherein the intracranial aneurysm prediction model comprises a first model, the first model is obtained by deep learning and pre-training, and the predicted value corresponding to the data to be processed comprises the first predicted value; and obtaining a prediction result of aneurysm occlusion of the data to be processed based on the corresponding prediction value of the data to be processed. By adopting the method provided by the specification, the difference caused by human factors can be eliminated or reduced, the time required by human observation and thinking is shortened, the aneurysm occlusion can be rapidly predicted, and the accuracy of occlusion prediction is improved.
assignee_clean: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院; 强联智创 北京 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院

title: Automated implant movement analysis systems and related methods
abstract: Methods, systems, workstations, and computer program products that provide automated implant analysis using first and second sets of patient image stacks of a patient having at least one metallic implant coupled to bone. Relevant image stack pairs are selected from the first and second patient image stacks, the image stack pairs having at least one common target object or part of a target object for analysis therein. Bone and the at least one metallic implant are segmented in the first and second image stacks to define segmented objects and/or segmented parts of objects. Selected relevant image stack pairs from the first and second patient image stacks can be registered using the selected segmented objects and/or the segmented parts of objects. Measurements of movement of the implant and/or coupled bone after the registration can be calculated using the selected segmented objects and/or the segmented parts of objects.

title: Method for manufacturing human body simulation image data with lesion for nuclear medicine
assignee: 佛山读图科技有限公司, 京心禾(北京)医疗科技有限公司
abstract: A method for producing simulated image data of a human body with a disease focus for nuclear medicine comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring human body type statistical data, and manufacturing diversified human body digital model data according to the human body type statistical data; s2, adding focus data into the diversified human body digital model data to obtain simulated human body data with a focus and focus position information added by the simulated human body data; and S3, modeling by using simulated foci-carrying human body data according to the nuclear medicine scene to obtain foci-carrying human body simulated image data in the nuclear medicine scene. According to the invention, the actual human body data and the simulated focus data are combined, so that the obtained simulated image data is more similar to anatomical structure diversity of the real data and focus feature diversity of the real data, and meanwhile, corresponding data can be flexibly manufactured according to imaging characteristics of different medical image scenes through the customization of parameters, thereby realizing convenient and rapid acquisition of medical focus simulated data.
assignee_clean: 佛山读图科技有限公司; 京心禾 北京 医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 佛山读图科技有限公司

title: Federal learning workflow construction method based on pre-training and related equipment
abstract: The application provides a federal learning workflow construction method based on pre-training and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a local data set; determining a target training set according to the local data set, and determining a target calculation task and a pre-training model according to the target training set; initiating participation requests of other participants; responding to the rejection request, and determining a first federal learning model according to the target training set, the target calculation task and the pre-training model; and responding to the receiving request, acquiring an auxiliary training set of the alliance member, and determining a second federation learning model according to the target training set, the auxiliary training set, the target calculation task and the pre-training model. According to the method, the target training set and the pre-training model are applied to federal learning to create the federal learning model, the method is not limited by computing resources, is low in image input limit, is used for accelerating fitting of complex functions, reduces model training time, and achieves aggregation of global models with minimum communication expenditure, so that model performance is improved.

title: Bladder capacity determination and three-dimensional shape assessment method and system special for radiotherapy
assignee: 北京大学第三医院（北京大学第三临床医学院）
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for measuring bladder capacity and evaluating three-dimensional morphology special for radiotherapy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, an ultrasonic diagnosis probe is adopted to send ultrasonic waves to the abdomen of a human body under the action of high-frequency electric pulses; receiving echo signals transmitted by the wall of a human organ, analyzing image information by the processing terminal according to the echo signals, and acquiring a current bladder volume value by combining a bladder apparatus of a neural network harmonic technology according to the image information; secondly, collecting ultrasound image information during simulated positioning and ultrasound image information before treatment each time to perform reinforcement learning registration training to obtain a model for guiding ultrasound image rapid registration of a subsequent new patient; thirdly, calculating the Daiss similarity coefficient DSC of the bladder image A in positioning and the bladder image B before each treatment after registration; and fourthly, collecting the bladder capacity value and corresponding DSC data, establishing a one-to-one corresponding data set, and carrying out comparative analysis to obtain an optimal bladder capacity value to guide subsequent treatment.
assignee_clean: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院
primary_assignee: 北京大学第三医院 北京大学第三临床医学院

title: Intelligent automated method and system for setting radiation therapy plan
abstract: An embodiment of the present invention provides an intelligent automatic radiation treatment plan establishing method which includes: a step of receiving first information including the personal information, diagnosis and examination information, disease state information, and medical image information of existing patients who had radiation treatment, second information including radiation dosage information and radiation emission information performed in the radiation treatment for the patient, and third information of a result drawn out after proceeding with radiation treatment by the second information, and storing the received information in a database; a step of generating a treatment plan prediction model by performing an artificial intelligence-based correlation and regression analysis on the first to third information; a step of determining, by using the treatment plan prediction model, the radiation treatment plan of a new patient having fourth information including the personal information, the diagnosis and examination information, the disease state information, and the medical image information prior to treatment; and a step of storing, in the database, the fourth information and sixth information of the result drawn out after performing radiation treatment according to the radiation treatment plan of the new patient.

title: Encoding / decoding system and method
abstract: A computer-implemented method, computer program product and computing system for: processing an unencoded data file to identify a plurality of file segments, wherein the unencoded data file is a dataset for use with a blockchain process; mapping each of the plurality of file segments to a portion of a dictionary file to generate a plurality of mappings that each include a starting location and a length, thus generating a related encoded data file based, at least in part, upon the plurality of mappings; receiving a request to manipulate the unencoded data file from the blockchain process; and processing the related encoded data file based, at least in part, upon the plurality of mappings and the dictionary file to generate a modified encoded data file that represents the requested manipulations of the unencoded data file.

title: Method, server and computer program for providing surgical simulations
abstract: According to various embodiments of the present invention for realizing a described task, disclosed is a method for providing surgical simulation. The method, in a method performed by one or more processors of a computing device, comprises the steps of: generating three-dimensional (3D) modeling data based on a medical image; creating a user interface including the 3D modeling data and providing the same to a user terminal; and generating surgical simulation result data by performing a surgical simulation based on the response of the user terminal to the user interface.

title: Detecting false statement using multiple modalities
abstract: Methods for preventing the transmission of sensitive information to locations outside of a secure network by a person who has legitimate access to the sensitive information are described. In some embodiments, in order for an end user of a computing device to establish a secure connection with a secure network and access data stored on the secure network, a client application running on the computing device may be required by the secure network. The client application may monitor visual cues (e.g., facial expressions and gestures) associated with the end user, detect suspicious activity performed by the end user based on the visual cues, and in response to detecting suspicious activity may perform mitigating actions to prevent the transmission of sensitive information such as alerting human resources personnel or requiring authorization prior to sending information to locations outside of the secure network.

title: Image data acquisition method, device and storage medium
assignee: 青岛海信医疗设备股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses an image data acquisition method and device, and belongs to the technical field of computers. In the application, one or more image data identifiers can be extracted from a plurality of data packets transmitted between a first client and a server, and the extracted image data identifiers are sent to a second client, so that the second client can obtain corresponding image data according to the received image data identifiers. Because the image data identification is extracted from the data packet transmitted between the first client and the server, the accuracy is relatively high, the condition that the identification cannot be realized does not exist, the success rate of acquiring the image data by the second client is ensured, and the diagnosis efficiency is improved.
assignee_clean: 青岛海信医疗设备股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 青岛海信医疗设备股份有限公司

title: Adjustable implant, system and methods
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to an adjustable implant configured to be implanted into a patient that includes an adjustable portion moveable relative to a housing. The adjustable implant may include various smart components for enhancing operation of the implant. Smart components may include a controller for managing operations and a transducer for communicating ultrasound data with an external interface device. Additional smart components may include a load cell within the housing for measuring an imparted load; a sensor for measuring angular position of the adjustable portion; a dual sensor arrangement for measuring imparted forces; a reed switch; a half piezo transducer; and an energy harvester.

title: Automatic detect detection device of six age tooth decayed teeth
abstract: The invention discloses a detection device for automatically detecting caries of six-age teeth, which comprises: the shooting device and the network cloud server are configured to execute the following steps: inputting the children oral cavity region image into a depth residual error network for feature extraction to obtain a feature image of the image, and performing feature enhancement processing on the feature image based on a feature pyramid network; selecting corresponding anchor point frames according to different scales of the enhanced feature map to generate six-age tooth candidate frames; inputting the six-age tooth candidate frame into a regional regression sub-network to obtain the coordinate offset of the six-age tooth candidate frame to a real target and obtain the coordinate data of the six-age tooth region according to the coordinate offset; inputting the six-age tooth candidate frame into a region classification sub-network to obtain the predicted category of the six-age tooth; and finally, combining and outputting the coordinate data of the six-age tooth area and the prediction category to provide a diagnostic image. The detection device can effectively carry out intelligent detection and classification on the caries of six-age teeth of children, and improves the diagnosis precision and efficiency of the caries of the fossa of the children.
assignee_clean: 哈尔滨工业大学 深圳
primary_assignee: 哈尔滨工业大学 深圳

title: Automatic detection of vertebral dislocations
abstract: In an approach to automatic detection of vertebral dislocations, training data is received, where the training data includes an ordered sequence of radiographic image patches of vertebrae and intervertebral spaces, and location data for each vertebra and each intervertebral space. Location deep learning models are trained to detect a location of each vertebra and each intervertebral space from the training data. Classification deep learning models are trained to classify an ordered sequence of image patches to identify vertebral anomalies of the vertebrae and the intervertebral spaces from the training data. Responsive to receiving radiographic image files, the location deep learning models and the classification deep learning models are applied to the radiographic image files to create a condition assessment.

title: Device and system for monitoring oral health based on artificial neural network
abstract: In a device for monitoring an oral cavity condition according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, the device comprises: a detection part that detects an oral cavity condition; a storage par that stores the data related to the oral cavity condition detected by the detection part; a communication part that transmits the stored data to a user terminal; a control part that controls a power supply part, the detection part, the storage part, the communication part, and an operation of the power supply part for supplying power to a device; and an attachment part configured in a shape corresponding to a shape of a tooth so that the device can be fixed to the tooth. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing the device for monitoring the oral cavity condition with an improved wearing comfort.

title: Customized function block sharing in wireless communications systems
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A base station may explicitly or implicitly identify one or more parameters associated with a user equipment (UE), and may classify the UE into a cluster of UEs based on identifying the one or more parameters. The base station may determine a customized function block based on classifying the UE into the cluster of UEs. For example, the base station may determine the customized function block based on determining whether the cluster of UEs is associated with a pre-trained customized function block. The base station may then transmit the customized function block to the UE. The UE may receive the customized function block and may process one or more signals at the UE based on the received customized function block.

title: Transfer result evaluation method, computer device, and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a transfer result evaluation method, computer equipment and a storage medium, which can greatly improve the precision of an evaluation result by acquiring medical images of a plurality of modes of a target structure, extracting a comprehensive characteristic value of the target structure from the medical images of each mode, and evaluating whether the target structure is transferred or not based on the comprehensive characteristic value, thus simultaneously considering the change conditions of the plurality of modes and the comprehensive characteristic value of the target structure and evaluating the transfer result according to a plurality of factors of the target structure.
assignee_clean: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司

title: Method and related device for detecting metastasis state of axillary lymph nodes of breast cancer
abstract: The application discloses a method and a related device for detecting the metastasis state of axillary lymph nodes of breast cancer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a B-type ultrasonic image and a shear wave elasticity ultrasonic image of an axillary lymph node part of a patient; and inputting the B-type ultrasonic image and the shear wave elastic ultrasonic image into a deep learning model for feature extraction, feature fusion and classification prediction to obtain a detection result of the metastasis state of the axillary lymph nodes of the breast cancer of the patient. The method and the device solve the technical problem that in the prior art, the metastasis state of the axillary lymph nodes of the breast cancer is detected by a machine learning method, and the prediction performance of a machine learning model is poor due to the fact that a few data samples are available.

title: Hotel guard personnel wearing detection method and system based on edge artificial intelligence
assignee: 浙江钛比科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a detection method and a detection system for wearing of hotel health personnel based on edge artificial intelligence, which are used for acquiring image data of an area to be detected in real time, preprocessing the image data and then sending the image data to an identification model preset at an edge equipment end; the recognition model is used for recognizing whether the wearing of the guard supplies of the staff is correct or not in the image data, and a preset early warning is made based on a detection result output by the recognition model, wherein the detection result comprises whether a mask is worn, an apron is worn, a working protective suit is worn, a glove is worn and a hat is worn or not. The invention can improve the wearing detection speed of the hotel health personnel and reduce the occupation of hardware resources.
assignee_clean: 浙江钛比科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 浙江钛比科技有限公司

title: Artificial intelligence's pendulum position device and accelerator treatment device
assignee: 苏州雷泰医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial intelligent positioning device and an accelerator treatment device, wherein a large amount of actual MV imaging data and DRR image data (generated by CT imaging data) are paired, correlation factors between the actual MV imaging data and the DRR imaging data are analyzed and searched, an accurate mathematical model (correlation function) is established, or an increasingly accurate correlation function is obtained by a deep learning method, and finally, converted DRR image data obtained by directly converting the correlation function can meet the actual application requirements, so that huge and convenient technical means are provided for the application efficiency, the treatment precision, the implementation control degree and the convenience of doctors of accelerator treatment equipment, and the social value and the economic value are very high.
assignee_clean: 苏州雷泰医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 苏州雷泰医疗科技有限公司

title: Device and method for displaying medical image and program
abstract: Both shape information and functional information of a subject can be efficiently understood. A shape image (SI) and a functional image (FI) are obtained, after which a reference line (CL) is set in the shape image (SI) and the functional image (FI) is divided on the basis of the reference line (CL). The shape image (SI) and the divided images (FI1, FI2) are then overlapped with each other and displayed on a display device (2). When displayed on the display device (2), according to the input from an input means (3), the functional image (FI) is divided and displayed using the center line (CL) as a reference. Alternatively, the cross-sectional position displayed by the shape image (SI) is rotated without changing the display of the functional image (FI).

title: Accelerated processing of genomic data and streamlined visualization of genomic insights
abstract: The technology disclosed relates to efficient tertiary analysis of genomic data. The technology disclosed includes splitting a genomic data file into a plurality of segments, and storing segments in the plurality of segments across nodes of a distributed storage system, pushing the segments from the nodes of the distributed storage system to nodes of a distributed, in-memory computing engine, distributing directives of tertiary analysis job contexts for the genomic data file across the nodes of the distributed, in-memory computing engine, directly executing the distributed directives on the segments stored on the nodes of the distributed, in-memory computing engine to cause parallel processing of the segments, and aggregating results of the parallel processing across the nodes of the distributed, in-memory computing engine to produce an output.

title: Electronic apparatus and method of controlling the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electronic apparatus, which helps to easily find a location of a wireless device (remote controller). The electronic apparatus includes: a signal input/output configured to communicate with a wireless device; an output; and a processor configured to: collect a movement history of the wireless device within a communication area through the signal input/output, and output information about a location, in which the wireless device is expected to be present within the communication area based on the movement history of the wireless device, to the output as an event for finding the wireless device occurs.

title: Methods for treating post-traumatic stress disorder in patients via renal neuromodulation
abstract:
OF THE DISCLOSURE 
Methods for treating post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and/or for reducing a 
risk associated with developing PTSD in patients via therapeutic renal neuromodulation and 
associated systems are disclosed herein. Sympathetic nerve activity can contribute to several 
cellular and physiological conditions associated with PTSD as well as an increased risk of 
developing PTSD following a traumatic event. One aspect of the present technology is 
directed to methods for improving a patient's calculated risk score corresponding to a PTSD 
status in the patient. Other aspects are directed to reducing a likelihood of developing PTSD in 
patients presenting one or more PTSD risk factors. Renal sympathetic nerve activity can be 
attenuated to improve a patient's PTSD status or risk of developing PTSD. The attenuation 
can be achieved, for example, using an intravascularly positioned catheter carrying a 
therapeutic assembly configured to use, e.g., electrically-induced, thermally-induced, and/or 
chemically-induced approaches to modulate the renal sympathetic nerve.

title: Medical application model training method and device based on BERT model
assignee: 北京诺道认知医学科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a medical application model training method and device based on a BERT model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a evidence-based medical training sample; performing entity vocabulary shielding on the evidence-based medical training sample to obtain an MLM training sample; performing MLM training on the BERT model by using the MLM training sample to obtain a PICO-BERT model; wherein the entity vocabulary corresponds to an entity having practical significance in evidence-based medicine; MLM training is performed by using an MLM training sample obtained by shielding entity words, and a PICO-BERT model is obtained, so that the overall semantic representation capability of the model is enhanced, the semantic understanding capability of the trained PICO-BERT model is higher, the natural language problem processing capability of complex scenes in a specific field is higher, the method and the device are better applicable to the medical field, and the understanding capability of natural language in specific research scenes in the medical field is improved.

title: System for communication of users without using muscular movements and speech
abstract: FIELD: information technology.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to a system for communication of users without using speech and movement. Said result is achieved by a system for communication of users without using speech and movements, comprising a user electroencephalogram registration means, a network interface, a server for forming a social network, a data processing unit configured to generate on the display screen varying light stimuli having different time variation parameters, wherein each of the stimuli is matched with a predetermined action, the data processing unit is configured to determine, in real time, stimuli directly selected by the user, and performing actions corresponding to user-selected stimuli by tracking selection of objects from a plurality of objects, device screen is configured to display results of performing actions based on results of stimuli presentation to multiple users on multiple screens, transmission of information on actions on results of presentation of stimuli between data processing units of various users is carried out by means of a remote server.EFFECT: technical result is creating a universal means for communication without using speech and movements.17 cl, 7 dwg

title: Imaging method and device under action of contrast agent
abstract: The object of the present application is to provide a method and apparatus for imaging under the influence of a contrast agent. The present application predicts subsequent images of one or more first contrast images based on a prediction model comprising a generator and a determiner to generate corresponding one or more predicted contrast images. Compared with the prior art, the imaging method and the imaging device truly restore the imaging image in the later period of the imaging, can greatly shorten the imaging time without influencing the diagnosis result, shorten the examination time and improve the experience of patients due to the reduction of the shooting period, solve the problems of overlong imaging time of medical institutions, overhigh management fund cost and the like, and have great significance for the patients and hospitals. In addition, the prediction model can be trained by adopting various training modes, so that the contrast and the signal to noise ratio of the image are improved, the texture details of the image are clear, the missing display rate of the focus is reduced, and the robustness is provided for the condition of incomplete registration to a certain extent.

title: Smart automatic shower booth apparatus, smart automatic shower booth system, and control method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to an automatic smart shower booth apparatus, a shower booth system, and a control method thereof. According to the present invention, the automatic smart shower booth apparatus comprises: a sensing information collection module (171); a pattern determination module (172); and a shower booth control module (173), wherein the sensing information collection module (171) obtains weight information from a weight sensor (111) and blood sugar information from a blood sugar measurement sensor (113). According to the present invention, health management can be performed simultaneously while taking a shower.

title: Techniques for dynamic beamforming mitigation of millimeter wave blockages
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A user equipment (UE) may communicate with other network devices as part of a wireless communications system. The UE may identify a blockage corresponding to one or more antenna arrays of a set of antenna arrays based on using a first set of beam weights, which may correspond to a static beamforming codebook of the one or more antenna arrays. The UE may switch from a static beamforming codebook-based beam weight determination to a dynamic beamforming codebook-based beam weight determination. The UE may then determine a second set of beam weights to use for the one or more antenna arrays based on the dynamic beamforming codebook-based beam weight determination. The UE may then communicate using the one or more antenna arrays according to the second set of beam weights.

title: Method and data processing system for providing decision-supporting data
abstract: A method is for providing decision-supporting data. In an embodiment, the method includes receiving photon-counting computed tomography data relating to an examination region; determining a location of a thrombus in the examination region, based on the photon-counting computed tomography data received; generating the decision-supporting data, relating to at least one of the thrombus and a vascular wall in a region of the thrombus, based on the photon-counting computed tomography data received and the location of the thrombus determined; and providing the decision-supporting data generated.

title: Training method and device of image segmentation model, segmentation method and device, and equipment
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a training method and device of an image segmentation model, a segmentation method and device, and equipment. The training method comprises the following steps: obtaining a new label of a target object by performing morphological operation on an original label of the target object on a medical sample image, wherein the new label of the target object only comprises a correctly labeled label; training the image segmentation model based on the new label of the target object. The image segmentation model is used for segmenting the target object on the medical sample image, so that the segmentation accuracy of the target object can be improved.

title: Reconfigurable transmitter array for electromagnetic tracking systems
assignee: Ascension Technology Corporation, Mark Robert SCHNEIDER, Northern Digital, Inc.
abstract: A magnetic tracking system is configured to determine an object pose of a tracked object in an environment of the magnetic tracking system. The tracking system includes a transmitter assembly that includes a transmitting coil configured to generate a magnetic signal indicative of an object pose of a tracked object with respect to the transmitter assembly and a marker that visually identifies a pose of the transmitter assembly with respect to a camera device. The camera device captures at least one image of the transmitter assembly. A computing device determines, based on the image, a pose for the transmitter assemblies in the image. Based on the magnetic signal and the pose associated with the transmitter assembly, the computing device determines the object pose of the tracked object in the environment.

title: Multi-modal eye imaging with shared optical path
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure provide improved techniques for imaging a subject's retina fundus. Some aspects relate to an imaging apparatus that may be substantially binocular shaped and/or may house multiple imaging devices configured to provide multiple corresponding modes of imaging the subject's retina fundus. Some aspects relate to techniques for imaging a subject's eye using white light, fluorescence, infrared (IR), optical coherence tomography (OCT), and/or other imaging modalities that may be employed by a single imaging apparatus. Some aspects relate to improvements in white light, fluorescence, IR, OCT, and/or other imaging technologies that may be employed alone or in combination with other techniques. Some aspects relate to multi-modal imaging techniques that enable determination of a subject's health status. Imaging apparatuses and techniques described herein provide medical grade retina fundus images and may be produced or conducted at low cost, thus increasing access to medical grade imaging.

title: Unsupervised medical image registration method based on band-limited deformation Fourier network
abstract: The invention provides an unsupervised medical image registration method based on a band-limited deformation Fourier network, belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and aims to solve the problems that the registration speed is not fast enough and higher precision cannot be achieved due to redundant modules in a registration model based on a self-encoder structure at present. The invention relates to an unsupervised network model based on a band-limited deformation Fourier network, which comprises an encoder module, a decoder module and a Warping module; the floating image and the fixed image may be encoded as low-dimensional feature maps of deformation fields in the band-limited fourier domain; reconstructing the deformation field from the band-limited Fourier domain to the full-resolution spatial domain to generate a deformation field; finally, inputting the floating image and the deformation field into a space transformation network to obtain a registration image; the network model is trained by calculating the similarity loss between the registered image and the fixed image and the regularized smoothing loss of the deformation field. The method has faster training and registering speeds, and achieves more accurate registering results.

title: Method and system for providing result of prospect of cancer treatment using artificial intelligence
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and system for providing a result of prospect of cancer treatment using an artificial intelligent network for a user to understand the most appropriate cancer treatment, by providing prospect of cancer treatment that meets the conditions required by the user among various types of cancer and methods of treatment by data mining technique. The method for providing a result of prospect of cancer treatment using an artificial intelligent network comprises the steps of: constructing a semantic database dictionary by collecting and data-mining cancer treatment literature information; when at least one of a treatment area, a treatment method, a side effect type, and patient condition information is input as input information, building a treatment prediction model based on the input information and the constructed semantic database dictionary; and providing result information corresponding to the input information based on the treatment prediction model.

title: Method for carrying out personalized intelligent application on electronic map identification
abstract: The invention discloses a method for carrying out personalized intelligent application on an electronic map identifier, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the intelligent application is based on an internet electronic map, the electronic map is provided with an intelligent application module for establishing and associating a person imitation, the person imitation intelligent application module is provided with a system default or user-defined added secondary pictographic mark with a person imitation function, and each secondary pictographic mark corresponds to one person imitation intelligent application module. The invention establishes the association and application of the electronic map identifier and the intelligent application software on the basis of the electronic map through the intelligent application of the symbol- 'identifier' on the electronic map, so that the electronic map provides artificial intelligent life service for people through the intelligence of the identifier.

title: Small sample CT image segmentation method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a small sample CT image segmentation method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method is based on a noise reduction probability diffusion model and uses unlabeled data to realize a generated self-supervision learning task. In addition, in order to effectively transfer the pre-trained noise reduction probability diffusion model to the image segmentation task, the method performs fine adjustment on part of parameters in the training process of the downstream task, so that the pre-training model can be suitable for the image segmentation task, and the accuracy of an image segmentation result is improved. The method effectively solves the problem that the deep learning method is difficult to use in the actual application due to insufficient data volume and poor robustness of the method based on supervised learning in the prior art.

title: Method and system for expanding sample data of long-time physiological signal time sequence
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method and a system for expanding sample data of a long-term physiological signal time sequence, which are mainly directed to solving the problem of insufficient medical labeling data in clinical application by a machine learning method, and include: selecting long-time physiological signal indexes of patients and healthy people which are not obviously related to time scales but have certain differences; and using indexes of different time scales as indexes of different samples to expand the sample size. The new samples expanded by the method are all characteristic data of the patient, so that compared with the traditional method, the synthesized samples can better represent the symptoms of the samples. The method is not limited to electrocardiosignals, and can be extended to other signals observed for a long time, and belongs to the protection scope of the patent. The method is not limited to the time scale, as long as the method is insensitive (but different) to the time scale.

title: Intelligent multifunctional care management system
assignee: 安徽力威精工机械有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent multifunctional care management system; the system comprises a home-end monitoring unit, a remote big data platform server, a care execution unit and a remote control terminal; the home-end monitoring unit comprises a monitoring router, a video monitoring module, a temperature sensing module, an audio acquisition module and a contact type sensing module; the care execution unit comprises a care bed, and the care bed comprises a bed frame, a bed board mechanism, a turnover mechanism, a back lifting mechanism, an anti-slip mechanism, a thigh supporting mechanism, a sewage discharge mechanism, a moving mechanism, a care router and a control module; the remote control terminal comprises a medical mobile phone terminal and a household mobile phone terminal. The nursing bed has the functions of turning over, lifting the back, preventing slipping, supporting the thighs, assisting defecation, moving and transferring and the like, and the comfort of the patient lying in bed is improved. The remote big data platform server automatically judges whether the prone position of the patient has potential safety hazards or not, and if the potential safety hazards exist, warning signals can be sent subsequently.

title: Health data processing method and server based on big data
assignee: 海军军医大学第三附属医院东方肝胆外科医院
abstract: According to the health data processing method and the server based on big data, global matching of the target comparison health description information and the quasi-marking electronic medical record is ensured through the text semantic representation carrier of the quasi-marking electronic medical record and the historical electronic medical record, matching of the health description information in the target comparison health description information and the health description information in the quasi-marking electronic medical record is ensured based on the health description commonality coefficient between the quasi-marking electronic medical record and the historical electronic medical record, and therefore the number of the health description information, the spatial distribution of the health description items, the health description item types and the like in the target comparison health description information and the quasi-marking electronic medical record are matched. Therefore, global matching and detailed matching of the target comparison health description information and the electronic medical record to be marked can be ensured, correlation between the target comparison health description information and the electronic medical record to be marked is improved, and accurate marking is carried out.

title: Image correction method, device, medical image equipment and storage medium
assignee: 上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image correction method, an image correction device, medical image equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining images to be processed, and dividing each image to be processed to obtain a target tissue image; performing principal component analysis on each position coordinate corresponding to the target tissue image to obtain a characteristic value and a characteristic vector corresponding to each principal component, and selecting at least one characteristic vector corresponding to the target characteristic value as a target rotating shaft; and determining image deflection angles corresponding to the images of different scanning sections according to the vector value of the target rotation shaft, and carrying out rotation correction on the images to be processed corresponding to each scanning section according to the image deflection angles. By adopting the technical scheme, the problem that the directions of the generated images are inconsistent due to different operators, different set scanning parameters, different scanning object postures and the like is solved, the image correction time and the calculation complexity are reduced, and meanwhile, the robustness and the correction precision of the image correction method are improved.

title: Code function checkpoint and restore
abstract: Technology is described for a checkpoint service for code function checkpoints associated with instances of code functions executed by a computing hub in a local area network. Subsequent to the execution of a code function being suspended by the computing hub, the computing hub may generate a code function checkpoint describing the execution of the code function. The computing hub may persist the code function checkpoint to storage using a checkpoint service. The computing hub may create the code function checkpoint in response to monitoring metrics associated with the computing hub, such as processor overutilization. The computing hub may resume the execution of the code function at a later time using the code function checkpoint retrieved from the checkpoint service.

title: Systems and methods for adaptive blending in computed tomography imaging
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for computed tomography (CT) imaging. In one embodiment, a method comprises adaptively blending at least two input image volumes with different spatially-variant noise characteristics to generate an output image volume with uniform noise throughout the output image volume. In this way, images may be reconstructed from projection data with data redundancy without introducing image artifacts from stitching images or variance in image noise due to the data redundancy.

title: Wearable device with overlapping ends coupled by magnets of a selected width, length and depth
abstract: A wearable device is provided with a wearable device structure. The wearable device has a first end and a second end, each with a plurality of magnets. The first and second ends are coupled by overlapping at least a portion of the first end magnets to at least a portion of the second end magnets. A size of the magnets is: (i) length, 0.5 mm to 30 mm; (ii), width, 0.5 mm to 30 mm; and (iii) thickness or depth, 0.5 mm to 10 mm. ID circuitry is provided at a surface or an interior of the wearable device.

title: Micro service cluster scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳市兴海物联科技有限公司
abstract: The application relates to cloud computing, in particular to load allocation, and provides a scheduling method of a micro-service cluster, which comprises the following steps: acquiring performance indexes of micro service applications of the micro service clusters; distributing system resources with corresponding scales for the micro-service application according to the performance index, wherein the system resources comprise storage spaces in task storage areas of the micro-service clusters; determining a task called by a micro-service consumer according to a service request of the micro-service consumer; storing the task called by the micro-service consumer into the task storage area; and distributing the task to the micro-service application corresponding to the storage space for execution according to the storage space in which the task is located. The application also relates to blockchain technology, and the data obtained by performing tasks by the micro-service application can be stored in the blockchain. Also relates to artificial intelligence, the micro-service clusters can be used to provide cloud computing for artificial intelligence platforms. The micro-service clusters may be used to implement medical clouds.

title: Drug infusion pump control system based on visual detection
assignee: 宁波大学医学院附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a drug infusion pump control system based on visual detection, which comprises a visual detection module, a deep reinforcement learning control module, a drug supply module and an alarm module, wherein the visual detection is used for identifying facial expressions of people, and the facial expressions of people can be accurately identified through the visual detection no matter the facial expressions are micro expressions of pain degree or micro expressions of dyspnea or unclear consciousness when the side effect of the drug occurs, and the deep reinforcement learning control drug supply is used on the basis of the visual detection, so that the automatic detection of a total analgesia anesthesia process can be realized, and the alarm module can be matched to timely send out reminding when abnormal conditions are possible.

title: Image segmentation
abstract: A method for segmenting an image includes receiving one or more object seeds associated with one or more first object portions represented by a first image and receiving one or more background seeds associated with one or more first background portions represented by the first image. A second image representing one or more second object portions and one or more second background portions is received, wherein the first image comprises a plurality of subportions and the second image is a subportion of the plurality of subportions of the first image. The second image is processed based on the one or more object seeds and the one or more background seeds to determine the one or more second object portions and the one or more second background portions.

title: Medical image frame interpolation method and terminal for iterative interlayer information fusion
abstract: The invention provides a medical image frame interpolation method and a terminal for iterative interlayer information fusion, which extract the characteristics of a medical image through a three-layer convolution network, input the medical image into a backbone network and predict the interlayer of the image; constructing an interlayer information fusion module, fusing effective characteristic information of a real interlayer image into a backbone network, and outputting an intermediate result; and optimizing a backbone network by using a weight-sharing fusion loss function in the interlayer information fusion module. By constructing an interlayer information fusion module, namely extracting effective interlayer information from real data and fusing the effective interlayer information into an intermediate prediction image, and measuring a prediction frame by using a weight-division fusion loss function, the aim of accurately predicting an interlayer image is fulfilled. The network adopts the convolution layer to extract the characteristics of an input image sequence, and simultaneously utilizes the self-defined backbone network to carry out identity transformation, thereby reducing the sensitivity degree of the model to the network depth, enlarging the space extent of the network on a two-dimensional plane by deepening the network on the basis, and finally outputting a frame of intermediate prediction image.

title: System and methods for flash suppression in ultrasound imaging
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for color flow ultrasound imaging. In one embodiment, a method comprises acquiring color flow data, detecting, with a neural network, a flash artifact in the color flow data, adjusting an adaptive filter cutoff of a clutter filter based on a classification result of the neural network, filtering, with the clutter filter, the flash artifact from the color flow data, and displaying a color flow image generated from the filtered color flow data. In this way, strong flash artifacts caused by strong tissue movement or probe movement may be dynamically suppressed during color flow ultrasound imaging.

title: Medical image segmentation apparatus, method and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: A medical image segmentation apparatus, method and computer-readable storage medium, the apparatus comprising: the salient feature acquisition unit is used for extracting salient features of the image to be segmented; a salient feature encoding unit that encodes salient features; a mask acquisition unit for extracting edge information of a main body to be segmented; the encoder performs feature extraction on the received image to be segmented; the salient feature fusion module of the first coding unit fuses the image to be segmented and the salient features of the image to be segmented; the decoder restores the image details and finally outputs the image segmentation result; the first coding unit further comprises a mask fusion module, which receives the output feature map of the salient feature fusion module and the mask output by the mask acquisition unit and fuses the output feature map and the mask output by the mask acquisition unit. The segmentation accuracy of the main body to be segmented is improved by combining the salient feature fusion module and the mask fusion module and the deep semantic network.

title: Electronic device and feedback information acquisition method therefor
abstract: Various embodiments of the present disclosure relate to an electronic device and a feedback information acquisition method therefor. The feedback information acquisition method of the electronic device includes: acquiring input feedback information of a user and first response information of the user, which are related to a specific function; training a feedback estimation model by using the input feedback information and the first response information; acquiring second response information of the user related to the specific function; and acquiring feedback information related to the specific function by applying the second response information to the trained feedback estimation model.

title: Image semantic segmentation method, device and storage medium
assignee: 江苏中科重德智能科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides an image semantic segmentation method, an image semantic segmentation device and a storage medium, which are used for solving the problem that the accuracy of semantic segmentation of an image is not high. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be processed; extracting texture features of the image to be processed by using texture branches in the semantic segmentation network model, and extracting shape features of the image to be processed by using shape branches in the semantic segmentation network model; performing semantic fusion on the texture features and the shape features by using a self-adaptive feature fusion module in the semantic segmentation network model to obtain fusion features; and performing semantic segmentation on the fusion features by using a segmentation convolution network in the semantic segmentation network model to obtain a semantically segmented image.
