title: Hemodialysis chamber instrument management method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a hemodialysis chamber instrument management method and a hemodialysis chamber instrument management device, wherein basic information of a first instrument of a first hemodialysis chamber is obtained; obtaining first correction information of a first instrument, judging whether a first correction result meets a first preset correction standard, and obtaining first service time of the first instrument when the first correction result meets the first preset correction standard; obtaining a first sterilization parameter of the first instrument after a first use time; obtaining first use patient information of a first instrument at a first use time through a first camera device; inputting a first disinfection parameter and first usage patient information into a first training model, and obtaining a first output result of the first training model, wherein the first output result comprises a second disinfection parameter with a first instrument infection risk level as one grade; the second sterilization parameter is used to sterilize the first instrument after use by the first use patient. The technical problem that in the prior art, medical staff manage equipment and potential safety hazards are caused due to inaccurate and unreasonable instrument management is solved.

title: Automatic preprocessing for black box translation
abstract: Various embodiments set forth systems and techniques for training a sentence preprocessing model. The techniques include determining, using a machine translation system, a back translation associated with a ground truth translation of a source sentence in a source language to a target language, wherein the back translation comprises a translation of the ground truth translation from one or more target languages to the source language; determining, using the sentence preprocessing model, a simplified sentence associated with the source sentence; and updating one or more parameters of the sentence preprocessing model based on the simplified sentence and the back translation.

title: Systems and methods for imaging disease biomarkers
abstract: A method includes generating spectral image data reproducible as one or more spectral images of a plurality of regions of interest in a sample. The method also includes analyzing the spectral image data to identify a plurality of scattering components in the spectral image data, each of the plurality of scattering components being associated with one or more biological properties of the sample. The method also includes identifying a feature of interest in the sample based at least in part on one or more the identified plurality of scattering components.

title: Remote consultation method, system, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention discloses a remote consultation method, a remote consultation system, a storage medium and an electronic device. The remote consultation method comprises the following steps: generating an inspection interaction component on a display interface of a user side of an inspection room in response to the consultation request instruction; generating a consultation interaction component on a display interface of a consultation user side in response to a consultation request instruction; the method comprises the steps that an examination interaction component obtains examination room data, wherein the examination room data at least comprises examination data of a patient; the consultation interaction component receives and displays the examination room data; and the consultation doctor carries out remote consultation on the patient in the examination room according to the examination room data displayed by the consultation interaction component. Therefore, the consultation doctor can see the examination data of the patient in real time without simply checking the ultrasonic examination report, thereby being beneficial to comprehensively judging the illness state of the patient; the consultation doctors, especially the consultation doctors in different hospitals, can communicate on line, and the diagnosis period and the manpower and material resource are obviously saved.

title: System, method, and computer program product for detecting merchant data shifts
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer program products for detecting merchant data shifts may identify a shift in transaction volume of a merchant system across Merchant Category Codes (MCCs) using a combination of time series analysis and machine learning.

title: Atypical data set balancing method, atypical data set balancing device and atypical data set balancing medium
assignee: 四川大学, 海宏智像医疗科技(天津)有限责任公司
abstract: The invention relates to an atypical data set balancing method, a device and a medium, which concretely comprise the steps of preprocessing a data set; performing amplification of the traditional method aiming at unbalanced data sets of different categories to obtain balanced data sets; sending the balance data set into a set network model for training to obtain an atypical class data set; amplifying the atypical class data set to obtain an atypical class balanced data set; and finally, inputting the typical class data set and the atypical class equalization data set into a network model for training to obtain a trained network model and a trained classification result. By the method for amplifying the atypical data set, a new thought is provided for the field of unbalanced data classification tasks, and the specificity and accuracy of the classification model are greatly improved. Meanwhile, the weight trained on the natural image is introduced to carry out transfer learning training, so that the problems of gradient disappearance and explosion can be solved, and meanwhile, the rapid convergence of a network can be helped to improve the performance of the model.
assignee_clean: 四川大学; 海宏智像医疗科技 天津 有限责任公司

title: Cervical OCT image feature visualization method for computer-aided diagnosis
abstract: The invention discloses a visualization method for extracting cervical tissue OCT image features based on parameter edge features of a convolutional neural network classification model, which can describe the edges of cervical tissue features learned by the model and improve the model interpretability from the angle, thereby better assisting a doctor in carrying out lesion diagnosis. The method comprises the following steps: 1) collecting a cervical OCT image to train a CNN classification model 2) performing data enhancement on trained parameters of the cervical tissue classification model 3) performing bidirectional gradient convolution on activated model neurons based on different cervical tissue classification results, and extracting edge features 4) creating a visual heat map according to the edge feature extraction result.

title: Method and system for generating optimized response to user input
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method and a system for generating optimized response to user input. The system may receive a user input indicative of a data required by the user. The system identifies one or more keywords based on the user input. The system determines user expertise level based on search graphs generated using the one or more keywords. The system retrieves a plurality of responses relevant to the data based on the one or more keywords. The system assigns a value to each of the plurality of responses based on the user expertise level. The system identifies a base response in one or more responses having the value greater than a threshold value. Finally, the system collates content of the one or more responses excluding the base response with content of the base response, in a pre-defined sequential order, for generating the optimized response to user input.

title: Method and system for production optimization
abstract: The disclosure provides a method and system for optimizing production of a natural gas liquefaction process, the method comprising the steps of: selecting at least one manipulated variable (MV) for controlling the liquefaction process; selecting at least one control variable (CV), the at least one control variable at least comprising liquefied natural gas (LNG) throughput; providing at least one model, each model providing a dependency of the at least one control variable (CV) on the at least one manipulated variable (MV); using the at least one model to estimate LNG throughput for at least one of the manipulated variables (MV);obtaining process data from the liquefaction process, the process data at least including observed values of LNG throughput; for combinations of the at least one manipulated variable and the at least one control variable, testing the interdependency thereof; creating a gain matrix based on said interdependencies; and using the gain matrix to optimize a process control system of the liquefaction process.

title: Recommendation method, device and storage medium of multimedia content
assignee: 腾讯数码（天津）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a recommendation method, a recommendation device and a storage medium of multimedia content, wherein the embodiment of the invention determines corresponding real weight according to user behavior data by detecting the user behavior data and multimedia content attribute information of the multimedia content in the playing process and determining corresponding real weight according to the user behavior data when the playing of the multimedia content is finished; generating a prediction model corresponding to the multimedia content; when the number of the played multimedia contents reaches a preset threshold value, inputting the real weight corresponding to the recorded multimedia contents into a prediction model so as to adjust the prediction weight; and determining the corresponding multimedia content to be learned according to the adjusted prediction weight and the recorded multimedia content attribute information. The corresponding prediction weight is determined by combining the actual learning condition of the user, and the proper multimedia content to be learned is determined according to the prediction weight and the recorded multimedia content attribute information, so that the recommendation flexibility and recommendation efficiency of the multimedia content are improved.
assignee_clean: 腾讯数码 天津 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯数码 天津 有限公司

title: Method for constructing knowledge graph of breast cancer ultrasonic image high confidence entity relationship
abstract: The invention provides a method for constructing a knowledge graph of a breast cancer ultrasonic image high confidence entity relationship. Firstly, extracting an entity of a breast cancer ultrasonic image by using a depth residual error network; then, mining the sample-entity matrix by using a dual clustering algorithm to obtain a plurality of highly correlated sub-matrices; then, an optimization function containing the confusion factor interference dependent variable relation is constructed and solved to obtain a high confidence relation set among the entities; and finally, constructing the knowledge graph of the breast cancer ultrasonic image by taking the entities as nodes and taking the high confidence relation between the entities as adjacent edges. The invention can provide a basis for interpretable diagnosis reasoning by excavating the high-confidence entity from the breast cancer ultrasonic image and constructing the high-confidence entity as the knowledge graph, can better solve the problem of low confidence of the prediction result caused by less medical data samples, and is more suitable for excavating the small-sample high-confidence entity relationship of the medical ultrasonic data.

title: Tooth full-scene caries identification method based on depth boundary supervision
abstract: After the tooth full-view film is obtained, the tooth full-view film is subjected to feature coding through a coding module to obtain a deep disturbance feature map, a jump connection feature map and a target boundary segmentation map; inputting the deep disturbance characteristic map into a classification module to identify whether shallow caries, medium caries and deep caries exist or not; and finally, inputting the deep disturbance characteristic map and the jump connection characteristic map into a decoding module for characteristic decoding to obtain a caries segmentation result and a target boundary segmentation map. The invention greatly enhances the classification recognition capability of the network on the decayed tooth and the segmentation capability of the network on the decayed tooth boundary, and leads the trained model to still obtain more reasonable classification and segmentation results by utilizing part of common characteristics in special cases when the decayed tooth image is more fuzzy.

title: Automatic bio-specimen inspection system and inspection method thereof
abstract: An automatic bio-specimen inspection system includes an inspection device, an image processing module, a spatial learning module, a path generation module and a motion device. The inspection device is used to approach an inspection site for performing a bio-specimens collection and/or inspection. The image processing module is used to capture and process a plurality of 2D images of the inspection site. The spatial learning module is used to generate a 3D spatial information of the inspection site according to the 2D images. The path generation module is used to generate an inspection path information based on the 3D spatial information. The motion device is used to move the inspection device to the inspection site according to the inspection path information for performing the inspection operation.

title: Method of computing a boundary
abstract: The disclosure relates to a method for determining a boundary about an area of interest in an image set. The includes obtaining the image set from an imaging modality and processing the image set in a convolutional neural network. The convolutional neural network is trained to perform the acts of predicting an inverse distance map for the actual boundary in the image set; and deriving the boundary from the inverse distance map. The disclosure also relates to a method of training a convolutional neural network for use in such a method, and a medical imaging arrangement.

title: Transmission of a data set and provision of data transmission information
abstract: An embodiment relates to the transmission of a data set to a central data store. A data set is received via a data source. Furthermore, country information is optionally received via the data source. Furthermore, a data classification is determined based on the data set via the data source. Furthermore, the data classification and optionally the country information are sent to a server via the data source. Furthermore, data transmission information from the server is received via the data source. In this context, the data transmission information is based on the data classification and optionally on the country information and the data transmission information relates to the permissibility of the transmission of the data set. Furthermore, the data set is transmitted to the central data store in dependence on the data transmission information.

title: Drug Sensitivity related Gene Expression and Copy Number Variation based Functional Haplotyping Methods and System
abstract: The present invention relates to genetic biomarker labeling scan (GBLscan) which is a drug indication and responsiveness prediction system and method thereof as a new learning model, capable of reliably predicting responsiveness of a drug by a coupling analysis of a molecular profile of the drug after transforming specific genetic variation fingerprints related to diseases including a cancer into a haplotype having functional information, wherein the present invention comprises: a learning module for learning a responsiveness correlation of constituent information constituting the drug with respect to genetic information included in a genome from collected learning information by means of linear regression and deep learning machine learning; a prediction module for receiving analysis information and calculating a responsiveness prediction result of the drug for the genome contained in the analysis information; and a storage module for storing a responsiveness prediction algorithm learned by the learning module, wherein the learning information is information on the responsiveness of the drug with respect to ex vivo cell lines and in vivo clinical studies. According to the present invention, there is an effect of predicting a degree of responsiveness of the genome whose pharmacological effect is not known and the drug from the results of the responsiveness of the drug for the genome collected from the clinical studies.

title: Fundus data prediction method and device
assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a fundus data prediction method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a fundus image; predicting a predicted macular center position, a disc center position, and a disc size in the fundus image using a machine learning model that generates a thermodynamic diagram in a prediction process, the macular center position and the disc center position being determined from pixel values of the thermodynamic diagram.
assignee_clean: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海鹰瞳医疗科技有限公司

title: Artificial intelligence based problem descriptions
abstract: Techniques regarding providing artificial intelligence problem descriptions are provided. For example, one or more embodiments described herein can comprise a system, which can comprise a memory that can store computer executable components. The system can also comprise a processor, operably coupled to the memory, and that can execute the computer executable components stored in the memory. The computer executable components can include, at least: a query component that generates key performance indicators from a query, determines a subset of key performance indicators that individually have a performance below a threshold, and maps the subset of key performance indicators to operational metrics; a learning component that generates, using artificial intelligence, problem descriptions from one or more of the subset of key performance indicators or the operational metrics and transmits the problem descriptions to a database.

title: Catheter stability indicator
assignee: 韦伯斯特生物官能(以色列)有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a catheter stability indicator. A probe having a temperature sensor on a distal portion thereof is introduced into a fluid-filled body cavity of a subject and delivers irrigation fluid through the probe. The temperature of the irrigation fluid exiting the probe is different from the temperature of the body cavity. A temperature reading of the irrigation fluid exiting the probe is recorded. A determination is made from the temperature reading that a predetermined contact criterion between the probe and the inner wall of the body cavity is met.
assignee_clean: 韦伯斯特生物官能 以色列 有限公司
primary_assignee: 韦伯斯特生物官能 以色列 有限公司

title: Method and equipment for predicting immune treatment effect of advanced cancer patient based on weighted multi-focus image histology characteristics
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
abstract: The invention relates to a method, a system, equipment and a computer readable storage medium for predicting the immune treatment effect of a patient with advanced cancer based on weighted multi-focus image histology characteristics. Comprising the following steps: acquiring an enhanced CT image of a cancer patient to be detected; the method is characterized in that the image histology characteristics are extracted based on a weighted multi-range method, the weighted image histology characteristics are obtained, and the image histology characteristics are extracted by the weighted multi-range method: extracting image histology characteristics of a plurality of focuses in the enhanced CT image of a patient, and carrying out self-adaptive weighted summation on the image histology characteristics of the plurality of focuses; and inputting the weighted image histology characteristics into a trained machine learning model to obtain a classification result of whether the cancer patient is suitable for anti-PD-1/PD-L1 monoclonal antibody treatment. The application has good application value in the clinical decision of cancer patient immunotherapy.
assignee_clean: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
primary_assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院

title: Method and electronic device for setting alarm
abstract: An electronic device includes a housing, one or more input/output (I/O) interfaces included in or on the housing, a processor, and a memory, wherein the memory stores a plurality of templates associated with a plurality of tasks, wherein each of the templates includes a plurality of parameters for at least partially completing a respective one of the tasks, and wherein the memory further stores instructions that, when executed, cause the processor to: receive a user input to set up an alarm associated with a task to be performed at a selected time, wherein the input includes a first time parameter associated with the selected time; select one of the plurality of templates; determine a second time parameter of the plurality of parameters of the selected template; determine a time for the alarm; and provide the alarm at the determined time.

title: Systems and methods for automated tagging of digital histology slides
abstract: Provided herein are methods and systems for performing an automated tagging of features in digital micrographs representing slides with tissue samples. Automated tagging of features may include automated entry of metadata associated with whole slide images or regions of the whole slide images.

title: Reconstruction of MR image data
abstract: The subject matter discussed herein relates to a fast magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) method to suppress fine-line artifact in Fast-Spin-Echo (FSE) images reconstructed with a deep-learning network. The network is trained using fully sampled NEX=2 (Number of Excitations equals to 2) data. In each case, the two excitations are combined to generate fully sampled ground-truth images with no fine-line artifact, which are used for comparison with the network generated image in the loss function. However, only one of the excitations is retrospectively undersampled and inputted into the network during training. In this way, the network learns to remove both undersampling and fine-line artifacts. At inferencing, only NEX=1 undersampled data are acquired and reconstructed.

title: Mobile virtual reality system for surgical robotic systems
abstract: Mobile virtual reality system for simulation, training or demonstration of a surgical robotic system can include a virtual reality processor. The processor can generate a virtual surgical robot and render the virtual surgical robot on a display. The virtual surgical robot can include a virtual surgical tool. A handheld user input device (UID) can sense a hand input from a hand. A foot input device can sense a foot input from a foot. The virtual reality processor can be configured to control a movement or action of the virtual surgical robot based on the hand input, and change which of the virtual surgical instruments is controlled by the one or more handheld UIDs based on the foot input. Other embodiments and aspects are disclosed and claimed.

title: X-ray imaging device and modeling method and device for X-ray image
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The present invention relates to a modeling method of an X-ray imaging apparatus, a modeling method of an X-ray image, and a modeling device of an X-ray imaging apparatus. A modeling method of an X-ray imaging apparatus including an X-ray source for emitting X-rays and a detector for converting the X-rays penetrating a scanning object into an X-ray image; the modeling method comprises the following steps: acquiring an optimal energy spectrum of X-rays emitted by the X-ray source; acquiring an optimal conversion function of the detector; and modeling the X-ray source according to the optimal energy spectrum, and modeling the detector according to the optimal conversion function to obtain a model of the X-ray imaging device. The modeling method reduces the part simulated by Meng Ka software, so that the modeling efficiency is improved.

title: Contrast-enhanced reproduction of spectral CT image data
abstract: A method is for setting a contrast of a multi-energy CT image representation. In an embodiment of the method, a plurality of multispectral image datasets of an examination region of a patient are received. Furthermore, an automated identification of a structure to be examined is achieved based upon the multispectral image datasets and an automated combining of the differently weighted multispectral image datasets is accomplished such that the contrast between the structure to be examined and its environment is improved compared to a uniform weighting. Further, a multi-energy CT imaging method is described. An image setting device is also described. In addition, a computed tomography system is described.

title: Deep learning model scheduling deployment method and system under condition of limited hardware resources
assignee: 上海体素信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a deep learning model scheduling deployment method and a system under the condition of limiting hardware resources, which comprise the following steps: step M1: acquiring a plurality of stage tasks with dependency relationship in a deep learning inference task; step M2: respectively evaluating the task resource consumption of a plurality of stages; step M3: evaluating currently available deployed hardware resources; step M4: selecting a currently executable stage task from a plurality of stage tasks with dependency relationship; and scheduling the currently executable stage tasks according to the currently available deployment hardware resources, updating the available deployment hardware resource assessment, and repeatedly executing the step M4 until all stage tasks in the deep learning inference task are completed. The invention realizes the efficient adaptation of computing resources in different deployment environments and the flexible adaptation of subsequent inference model changes.
assignee_clean: 上海体素信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海体素信息科技有限公司

title: Optical imaging module and wearing device
assignee: 宁波圻亿科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses optical imaging module and wearing device. The optical imaging module comprises an imaging optical machine module, a goggles module and a controller, the controller is connected with the imaging optical machine module and the goggles module, the controller is used for triggering a preset optical adjustment control program to perform color change adjustment operation of the color-variable protective film according to optical parameter data transmitted by the imaging optical machine module and/or the goggles module, the preset optical adjustment control program comprises a preset optical adjustment prediction model and/or a preset optical stacking dynamic adjustment algorithm, the optical imaging module and the wearing device provided by the embodiment of the application realize intelligent control adjustment of the optical imaging module, realize flexible adjustment functions of the optical imaging module and the wearing device by a user, meet the high-standard viewing requirements of the current user, and relieve fatigue which often appears when the user views and wears the optical imaging module, the user experience is greatly improved.

title: Computerized systems and methods for continuous and real-time fatigue detection based on computer vision analysis
abstract: According to some embodiments, disclosed are systems and methods for a novel framework that performs management of a location and the individuals operating therein based on determined fatigue data of such individuals. The framework may track a person (e.g., a user) at or around a location. Such tracking may be performed based on captured digital imagery of the user via a set of strategically positioned cameras at the location. In some embodiments, as soon as a user begins working, or upon detection by a camera(s), the framework may cause the camera(s) to begin capturing footage of the user, which may be fed, uploaded and/or streamed to a fatigue detection system that determines fatigue data related to the user. Such fatigue data may be leveraged to control which jobs certain users are performing, while reassigning other users based on safety decisions formed from their respective fatigue data.

title: Mask RCNN-based gastric cancer early-stage identification method, system and device
assignee: 合肥中纳医学仪器有限公司
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of image processing, and particularly relates to a Mask RCNN-based stomach cancer early-stage identification method, system and device. The identification method comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a gastric cancer recognition network, which comprises the following steps: s11: a Mask RCNN network model is obtained. S12: the architecture of the CSP Net network is introduced into Mask RCNN network model. S13: adopting CIoU Loss functions to replace IoU Loss functions as regression loss functions of the network model; s14: and constructing a gastric cancer identification network comprising two CSP-ResNet networks and a discrimination module. S2: multiple real gastroscopic images are acquired and pre-labeled as a training dataset. S3: the network model is trained using the training dataset. S4: and inputting the gastroscopic image into a gastric cancer recognition network to obtain an image segmentation result of the corresponding focus area. The invention solves the problems that the existing image analysis tool used in the gastroscopy process has poor efficiency and low accuracy and can not effectively distinguish the characteristics of canceration and inflammation.
assignee_clean: 合肥中纳医学仪器有限公司
primary_assignee: 合肥中纳医学仪器有限公司

title: Three-dimensional medical image segmentation method based on neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional medical image segmentation method based on a neural network, which comprises the specific steps of acquiring a three-dimensional medical image and performing image preprocessing; inputting the two-dimensional image slice sequence obtained by preprocessing into a first neural network for semantic segmentation, and extracting intra-slice information; inputting the semantic segmentation graph obtained after semantic segmentation into a second neural network, and extracting inter-slice information; according to the intra-chip information and the inter-chip information, obtaining the relevance of the same class of objects in different two-dimensional image slices and performing optimized semantic segmentation; and coaxially splicing the semantically segmented two-dimensional slice images to form a three-dimensional segmented image. According to the invention, the three-dimensional medical image is initially segmented into the two-dimensional image slice sequence, then the U-Net network and the LSTM network are combined to obtain the intra-slice information and the inter-slice information, and the three-dimensional segmented image which is more optimized is obtained after the relevance is re-segmented, so that the two-dimensional image slice is accurately segmented, and the better three-dimensional image segmentation is realized.

title: Hospital number calling management system and method thereof
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院第一医学中心
abstract: A hospital number calling management system and a method thereof acquire appointment information of a plurality of objects to be treated arranged in front of a target object to be treated; and mining the correlation characteristic distribution information among the semantic understanding characteristics of the appointment information of each object to be diagnosed by adopting an artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning, accurately estimating the waiting time of the appointment number based on the correlation characteristic distribution information, reasonably planning the own journey based on the estimated waiting time, and improving the experience degree and satisfaction of patients.
assignee_clean: 中国人民解放军总医院第一医学中心
primary_assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院第一医学中心

title: Data domain recommendation method and method for constructing integrated data repository management system using recommended domain
abstract: Provided is a method for collecting and pre-processing data on a predetermined type of industry, determining domains related to pre-processed data by applying a deep learning model trained for recommending domains related to the data, and providing the determined domains as recommended domains.

title: Automatic segmentation method and device based on dynamic contrast enhancement magnetic resonance image
assignee: 中日友好医院(中日友好临床医学研究所)
abstract: The automatic segmentation method and the device based on the dynamic contrast enhanced magnetic resonance image can be suitable for automatic segmentation of micro organs and tumors, and good segmentation results can be obtained. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Delineating gold standards for pituitary microadenoma segmentation based on DCE-MRI images; (2) processing the DCE-MRI image of the input model; (3) Selecting Resunate and SwinUnetr as basic frames for segmentation to perform model training; (4) The Dice similarity coefficient is used as an evaluation index for the quantization division performance.
assignee_clean: 中日友好医院 中日友好临床医学研究所

title: Early gastric cancer endoscope real-time auxiliary detection system based on target detection algorithm
assignee: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院
abstract: The invention relates to an early gastric cancer endoscope real-time auxiliary detection system based on a target detection algorithm, which relates to the technical field of medical detection control and comprises the following components: the endoscope control module is used for controlling the endoscope to carry out endoscopic examination on the stomach of the patient based on preset working parameters; the image acquisition module is used for acquiring stomach endoscopic images of a patient through an endoscope; a lesion recognition module for determining suspicious regions of the patient's stomach endoscopic image based on the SSD destination detection algorithm; the parameter adjustment module is used for adjusting the working parameters of the endoscope operation module based on the suspicious region of the stomach endoscope image of the patient; the endoscope control module is also used for adjusting the posture of the endoscope to the target posture based on the working parameters adjusted by the parameter adjustment module; the image acquisition module is also used for acquiring stomach endoscope images of the patient acquired by the endoscope in the target posture; the focus recognition module is also used for determining a focus detection result of the patient based on the SSD target detection algorithm, and has the advantage of reducing focus missing detection rate.
assignee_clean: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院
primary_assignee: 西安交通大学医学院第二附属医院

title: Image processing method, device and storage medium
abstract: The application discloses an image processing method, an image processing device and a storage medium, and specifically comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an image sample to be trained and a label segmentation image corresponding to the image sample to be trained, inputting the image sample to be trained into an image segmentation model to be trained, outputting a corresponding segmentation image sample when the image sample to be trained is extracted through the image segmentation model, calculating a model loss function based on the label segmentation image and the segmentation image sample, optimizing model parameters, generating an optimized image segmentation model, inputting the obtained image to be processed into the optimized image segmentation model, and generating a segmentation image corresponding to the image to be processed. According to the embodiment of the application, the quality of the hidden layer features is further improved by introducing the multilayer decoding output features, the segmentation precision is increased, the segmentation error is effectively reduced, and the identification efficiency and the identification accuracy of the model are improved.

title: Method and system for detecting chest x-ray thoracic diseases utilizing multi-view multi-scale learning
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure provide systems and methods for biomedical image analysis. A method may include receiving a plurality of unannotated biomedical images, including a first image and a second image. The method may also include determining that the first image is in a first view and the second image is in a second view. The method may further include assigning the first image to a first processing path for the first orientation. The method may additionally include assigning the second image to a second processing path for the second view. The method may also include processing the first image in the first processing path in parallel with processing the second image in the second processing path. The first path may share processing parameters with the second path. The method may further include providing a diagnostic output based on the processing of the first image and the second image.

title: Shooting method, shooting system and storage medium of target scene
assignee: 深圳市拓普智造科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a shooting method, a shooting system and a storage medium of a target scene, and relates to the technical field of intelligent medical equipment, wherein the shooting method of the target scene comprises the following steps: acquiring first rotation angle data of the mechanical arm, and calculating to obtain first three-dimensional coordinate data according to the first rotation angle data; acquiring a first target scene image through first camera equipment, and acquiring shooting object data according to the first target scene image; according to the shooting object data and the first three-dimensional coordinate data, calculating to obtain third three-dimensional coordinate data; adjusting a second image pickup device according to the third three-dimensional coordinate data and the shooting object data to obtain a second target scene image; and playing in real time according to the second target scene image. The shooting method of the target scene can shoot and intelligently adjust the target object in the target scene in real time, and improves shooting quality.
assignee_clean: 深圳市拓普智造科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 深圳市拓普智造科技有限公司

title: Model building method, device, equipment and storage medium based on transfer learning
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and provides a model building method, device, equipment and storage medium based on transfer learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: combining the first study data and the second study data into target multicenter study data; analyzing the target multi-center study data to obtain a first data set and a second data set; analyzing the target multi-center research data through a preset thresholding bilateral ridge ratio criterion TDRR algorithm to obtain feature space dimension; performing dimension reduction transfer learning based on the maximum mean difference on the first data set and the second data set according to the feature space dimension to obtain dimension reduction data; and training an initial model through a preset classification algorithm and the dimensionality reduction data to obtain a target model. By adopting the scheme, the data reliability after model processing can be improved.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Methods and systems for shear wave elastography
abstract: Various methods and systems are provided for ultrasound imaging. In one embodiment, a method comprises acquiring, with an ultrasound transducer of a scanning apparatus during an ultrasound scan of a patient, an ultrasound image, detecting, with an artificial intelligence model, a region of interest within the ultrasound image including a possible tumor, acquiring, with the ultrasound transducer, an elastic image of tissue within the region of interest, and displaying, with a display device, the elastic image. In this way, shear wave elastography may be automatically targeted to a region of interest, thereby reducing the processing load for the analysis and enabling a higher elasticity imaging frame rate for three-dimensional ultrasound imaging.

title: Method for predicting drug target binding based on combined cross-domain attention model
abstract: The invention discloses a method for predicting drug target binding based on a combined cross-domain attention model, which comprises the steps of extracting biological molecular chemical structure information and text semantic information of drug-target action from a drug and protein database as raw data to construct a data set; constructing an initial deep learning model for predicting the combined cross-domain attention of drug target binding based on the coupled neural network of the end-to-end combined architecture; dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set, and training the initial deep learning model through the training set to obtain a target deep learning model; and predicting the drug target binding property based on the target deep learning model to obtain a prediction result. The method has the advantages of less time, low cost, high prediction precision, low cost and simplicity, can save a great deal of manpower, material resources and financial resources, and provides corresponding basic tools and shortcut for the prediction precision of the drug targets.

title: Integrating compliance and analytic environments through data lake cross currents
abstract: An apparatus comprises a processing platform configured for integration of compliance and analytic environments. The compliance and analytic environments are implemented at least in part by the processing platform. The processing platform comprises at least a portion of a data lake at least partially shared between the compliance and analytic environments. The processing platform further comprises one or more integration mechanisms supporting interaction between the compliance and analytic environments via the data lake. Such integration mechanisms may include one or more of providing direct access from the analytic environment to the compliance environment, unified indexing across the compliance and analytics environments, tracking data set interrelationships across the compliance and analytic environments, associating event data of the compliance environment with enterprise activity data, movement of indexing artifacts, movement of contextual data, independent scaling of the compliance and analytic environments, and rehosting of data ingestion from the compliance environment to the analytic environment.

title: Systems, methods, and devices for generating a corrected image
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices for generating a corrected image are provided. A first robotic arm may be configured to orient a source at a first pose and a second robotic arm may be configured to orient a detector at a plurality of second poses. An image dataset may be received from the detector at each of the plurality of second poses to yield a plurality of image datasets. The plurality of datasets may comprise an initial image having a scatter effect. The plurality of image datasets may be saved. A scatter correction may be determined and configured to correct the scatter effect. The correction may be applied to the initial image to correct the scatter effect.

title: Method, system and device for processing data information of patient in traditional Chinese medicine internal medicine
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing of internal medicine of traditional Chinese medicine, and discloses a method, a system and a device for processing patient data information of internal medicine of traditional Chinese medicine.A data acquisition unit acquires patient information and data of a treatment card, stores the patient information and the data into a database based on a distributed file system, and performs format check before the patient information and the data are stored into the database according to the principle that an acquisition object corresponds to the data so as to prevent bad data from being stored; the patient information and the data object are represented as the matching relation between the object identification ID and the corresponding operation ID and the corresponding result data, the efficiency of storing the patient information and the data is improved, the expansibility is good, and the change of the user requirements can be quickly responded. The preprocessed patient information and data are subjected to statistical analysis and machine learning methods to find out rules in the data, the secret key is input, semantic matching is carried out on the preprocessed patient information and data according to the Name attribute of the patient data, the matching success rate of the data is improved, and the method is greatly helpful for improving the working efficiency of doctors.

title: Dynamic threshold filtering for watched questions
abstract: Embodiments are directed to a watched questions threshold filtering system that functions to determine and deliver to a user relevant and significant data changes with respect to a user's goals, as defined by a notification threshold value provided by the user. The user is provided with an option to flag one or more queries for automatic re-querying. Confidence scores are processed on new data (i.e., data ingested after the original question was asked) by utilizing a confidence threshold for indicating if the new data warrants alerting a user.

title: Method and system for assisted ultrasound scan plane identification based on M-mode analysis
assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
abstract: A system (100) and method (400) for assisting in identifying a standard ultrasound scan plane (210, 310) based on M-mode analysis is provided. The method (400) includes receiving and displaying (402) an ultrasound scan plane (210, 310) of an anatomical structure. The method (400) includes locating (404) one or more M-mode lines (212,312,314) in an ultrasound scan plane (210, 310). The method (400) includes providing an M-mode trace (220,320,330) for each of one or more M-mode lines (212,312,314). The method (400) includes providing (408) feedback based on the M-mode trace (220,320,330) for each of the one or more M-mode lines (212,312,314) with reference to one or more feature trace patterns of the standard view. The method (400) includes receiving and displaying (412) an updated ultrasound scan plane (210, 310) of an anatomical structure being manipulated in response to feedback.
assignee_clean: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司

title: Systems, devices, and methods for monitoring and modulation of therapeutic procedures
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents On Behalf Of The University Of Arizona
abstract: Wearable sensors that measure one or more parameters such as pressure, force, acceleration, or skin temperature, are used to measure, record, display and monitor the efficacy of therapeutic maneuvers applied to a subject by an operator. Systems and methods for assessing the physiological efficacy of therapeutic maneuvers performed by an operator on a subject in need thereof, and provide a way to guide subsequent therapeutic maneuvers toward optimal outcome. In some embodiments, the systems and methods measure, record, and display physiological parameters of an operator and/or subject during application of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR).
assignee_clean: arizona board of regents on behalf of the university of arizona
primary_assignee: arizona board of regents on behalf of the university of arizona

title: Detecting false positive variant calls in next-generation sequencing
abstract: A method for detecting false positive variant calls in a next generation sequencing analysis pipeline involves obtaining a plurality of read pileup windows associated with a first sample genome. The method also involves obtaining, for each reference nucleotide position represented in the plurality of read pileup windows, a label indicating that the reference nucleotide position is either (i) a known variant or (ii) a non-variant. The method further involves training a neural network based on data indicative of the plurality of read pileup windows and the labels. Additionally, the method involves receiving a read pileup window associated with a second sample genome. Further, the method involves determining, using the trained neural network, a likelihood that the read pileup window associated with the second sample genome represents a variant.

title: System of generating training data by questions and answers and method thereof
assignee: 台達電子工業股份有限公司
abstract: A system of generating training data by questions and answers and a method thereof are provided by the disclosure. A platform-end provides the browse of a target image, receives the operation to adjust a display view of the target image, shows a question used to analyze the display view, gets a response answer, and associates the display view with the question and the response answer to generating the training data used to automatically analyze the target image. The disclosure can automatically prompt the region of interest, and significantly reduce the burden to collect the training data to the user.
assignee_clean: 台達電子工業股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 台達電子工業股份有限公司

title: Routing of sensitive-information utterances through secure channels in interactive voice sessions
abstract: An example method includes obtaining first audio data representing one or more initial utterances during an interactive voice session with an interactive voice system (IVS); generating, based on the first audio data, a prediction regarding whether a subsequent utterance of the user in the interactive voice session will contain sensitive information; obtaining second audio data representing the subsequent utterance; determining, based on the prediction, whether to transmit the second audio data to the IVS via a first communication channel; based on a determination not to transmit the second audio data to the IVS via the first communication channel: transmitting third audio data to the IVS via the first communication channel in place of the second audio data; and transmitting the second audio data to a server via a second communication channel that bypasses the IVS.

title: Deep learning method for a progressive lens simulator with an artificial intelligence engine
abstract: A Progressive Lens Simulator comprises an Eye Tracker, for tracking an eye axis direction to determine a gaze distance, an Off-Axis Progressive Lens Simulator, for generating an Off-Axis progressive lens simulation; and an Axial Power-Distance Simulator, for simulating a progressive lens power in the eye axis direction. The Progressive Lens Simulator can alternatively include an Integrated Progressive Lens Simulator, for creating a Comprehensive Progressive Lens Simulation. The Progressive Lens Simulator can be Head-mounted. A Guided Lens Design Exploration System for the Progressive Lens Simulator can include a Progressive Lens Simulator, a Feedback-Control Interface, and a Progressive Lens Design processor, to generate a modified progressive lens simulation for the patient after a guided modification of the progressive lens design. A Deep Learning Method for an Artificial Intelligence Engine can be used for a Progressive Lens Design Processor. Embodiments include a multi-station system of Progressive Lens Simulators and a Central Supervision Station.

title: Data analytics collection using VPN gateway
abstract: Analytics are collected to monitor and report data usage of enterprise applications running on a mobile device. A second line service agent and an analytics agent assure that the mobile device is configured for analytics collection. Once configured, cellular data usage of applications that are monitored by the analytics engine are detected and a VPN connection is established for routing the communications between the monitored app an a public website. If the mobile device switches to WiFi usage, the analytics agent disconnects the VPN connection and routes data directly to the public website. Thus, data usage of the monitored applications can be reported by the VPN gateway.

title: Method and apparatus for communication
abstract: According to one aspect, an apparatus for performing the following is provided. The apparatus separately implements a reinforcement learning model for at least one downlink beam, wherein a state defines which of a plurality of uplink beams belong to a priority beam set of uplink reception corresponding to the downlink beam, an action is defined as addition of a new uplink beam to the priority beam set, removal of the uplink beam from the priority beam set, or nothing, and a reward is calculated based on a change in uplink signal-to-noise ratio, the change being caused by an action that adjusts with a cost for taking the action. The apparatus iteratively calculates at least one optimal state using at least one reinforcement learning model based on uplink signal-to-noise ratio statistics and a plurality of optimal downlink beams for transmission to the plurality of terminal devices.

title: Digital three-generation simulation method and device for heart motion
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a digital three-birth simulation method and device for heart motion. The method comprises the following steps: extracting motion information of the heart according to a current frame cardiovascular image of the heart; and acquiring a three-dimensional digital model corresponding to the next cardiovascular image according to the motion information and the three-dimensional digital model corresponding to the current cardiovascular image, and controlling the motion of the three-dimensional solid model of the heart according to the motion information. The digital three-generation simulation method and the device for the heart motion provided by the embodiment of the invention can realize the synchronous simulation of the three-dimensional digital model and the three-dimensional solid model to the real heart motion by mapping the real heart motion to the three-dimensional digital model and the three-dimensional solid model of the heart.

title: Vertebral artery interlayer risk assessment method, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯美国有限责任公司
abstract: Methods and apparatus for vertebral artery dissection risk analysis using four-dimensional magnetic resonance blood flow imaging based on hemodynamic variables, including: obtaining four-dimensional phase-contrast magnetic resonance imaging data, preprocessing the four-dimensional phase-contrast magnetic resonance imaging data, obtaining at least one hemodynamic index from the four-dimensional phase-contrast magnetic resonance imaging data, categorizing the at least one hemodynamic index into a hemodynamic predictor of the vertebral artery inter-layer, and using the hemodynamic predictor to create a comprehensive risk assessment of the vertebral artery inter-layer.
assignee_clean: 腾讯美国有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯美国有限责任公司

title: Apparatus and method for obtaining image
abstract: Provided is a method for obtaining an image includes: obtaining first image data by photographing a first color by means of the image sensor while an IR illumination is turned on; obtaining second image data by photographing the first color by means of the image sensor while an IR illumination is turned off; extracting, from the first image data, first row data obtained from a first pixel of the image sensor; extracting, from the first image data, IR row data corresponding to an IR component of the first pixel; and generating correction data of the first pixel based on a difference between the first row data and the IR row data. According to an embodiment, the artificial intelligence (AI) module may be related to unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), robots, augmented reality (AR) devices, virtual reality (VR) devices, and 5G service-related devices.

title: Terrain classification device and method based on surface electromyogram signals and plantar force
abstract: The invention discloses a terrain classification device based on surface electromyogram signals and plantar force, and further discloses a terrain classification method based on the surface electromyogram signals and the plantar force, which is realized by adopting the device. In the classification method, a subject pastes a myoelectric electrode patch group on the surface of selected muscle, pastes a pressure resistance patch on a selected position of a sole of a foot, and then finishes walking tasks of different terrains according to certain guidance; then carrying out data preprocessing and feature extraction; and taking the features extracted under different terrains as the input of a machine learning model, training the classification model, testing the accuracy of the classification model, adjusting parameters and optimizing the model. According to the wearable auxiliary device, the influence of different terrains on human body myoelectric signals is considered, quantification is carried out through experiments, classification is carried out through a simple machine learning model, and the intelligence and the safety of the wearable auxiliary device are improved. The invention is applicable to the technical field of medical equipment.

title: User-guided domain adaptation for rapid annotation from user interactions for pathological organ segmentation
abstract: The present disclosure provides a computer-implemented method, a device, and a computer program product using a user-guided domain adaptation (UGDA) architecture. The method includes training a combined model using a source image dataset by minimizing a supervised loss of the combined model to obtain first sharing weights for a first FCN and second sharing weights for a second FCN; training a discriminator by inputting extreme-point/mask prediction pairs for each of the source image dataset and a target image dataset and by minimizing a discriminator loss to obtain discriminator weights; and finetuning the combined model by predicting extreme-point/mask prediction pairs for the target image dataset to fool the discriminator by matching a distribution of the extreme-point/mask prediction pairs for the target image dataset with a distribution of the extreme-point/mask prediction pairs for the source image dataset.

title: Brain tissue hemorrhage localization and classification and hemorrhage quantification method, device, medium and program
assignee: 南昌大学第二附属医院
abstract: The invention discloses a brain tissue bleeding positioning classification and bleeding quantification method, equipment, medium and program, wherein the method is applied to a brain tissue bleeding positioning classification and bleeding quantification system, the brain tissue bleeding positioning classification and bleeding quantification system is provided with a brain tissue bleeding positioning classification and bleeding quantification model, and the brain tissue bleeding positioning classification and bleeding quantification model is a Hybrid 2D/3D U-Net deep learning network model, and the method comprises the following steps: extracting a three-dimensional brain tissue region in head CT image data based on a brain tissue extraction algorithm of region growth, and increasing brainstem recognition as a constraint boundary of region growth based on the brain tissue extraction algorithm of region growth; and carrying out hematoma detection, classification and segmentation on the three-dimensional brain tissue region by using the brain tissue bleeding positioning classification and bleeding quantification model, counting bleeding volume, and outputting a prediction result. The invention can more accurately classify the cerebral tissue bleeding parts and quantify the cerebral tissue bleeding volume.
assignee_clean: 南昌大学第二附属医院
primary_assignee: 南昌大学第二附属医院

title: Livestock product life information providing system by group
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for providing lifetime information of livestock products by group. More specifically, the system comprises: an information providing server; and a consumer device. The consumer device includes a recognition module, an information request module, and output module. According to the present invention, the system may provide various information related to lifetime of livestock products to easily understand a consumer and improve consumer reliability on the livestock products.

title: Data structure that facilitates digital rights management
abstract: Described herein are various technologies pertaining to creating and modifying a computer-readable file for a patient in response to receiving data about the patient. The computer-readable file is modified by appending a child file record to the computer-readable file, identifying a parent file record for the child file record in the computer-readable file, and storing a pointer in the parent file record to the child file record. The child file record comprises the data about the patient, an initially empty pointer portion, and an attribute of a user that has permission to access the data about the patient. The pointer portion may be later modified to include pointers to subsequently added file records in the computer-readable file.

title: Method and device for determining lung region, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京深睿博联科技有限责任公司, 杭州深睿博联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining lung area, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: lung regions are segmented in the 2D medical image. Rib contours in 2D medical images are acquired. And acquiring a preset contour, wherein the rib contour is contained in the preset contour, and the distance between the pixel point on the preset contour and the corresponding pixel point on the rib contour is more than 7 pixel points and less than 15 pixel points. The segmented lung region is taken as the lung region in the 2D medical image when the contour of the segmented lung region is located between the rib contour and the predetermined contour or on the rib contour or the predetermined contour. The scheme of the invention is beneficial to the reading and diagnosis of doctors, and improves the diagnosis efficiency and the diagnosis accuracy of the doctors. And the accuracy of the subsequent correlation detection based on the lung area is also improved. And the above scheme is adopted to judge the segmented lung regions, so that the method is simple and efficient.
