title: Artificial intelligence based suppression of chemical species in magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: A computer-implemented method for using machine learning to suppress fat in acquired MR images includes receiving multi-echo images from an anatomical area of interest acquired using an MRI system. A first subset of the multi-echo images is acquired prior to application of contrast to the anatomical area of interest and a second subset of the multi-echo images is acquired after application of contrast to the anatomical area of interest. Next, data is generated including water images, fat images, and effective R*2 maps from the multi-echo images. The water images, the fat images, and the effective R*2 maps are used to create synthetic fat suppressed images. A neural network is trained to use the multi-echo images as input and the synthetic fat suppressed images as ground truth. A plurality of components of the neural network are saved to allow later deployment of the neural network on a computing system.

title: Automatic segmentation of intra-cochlear anatomy in post-implantation CT of unilateral cochlear implant recipients
abstract: A method for automatic segmentation of intra-cochlear anatomy of a patient. The patient has an implanted ear and a normal contralateral ear. At least one computed tomography (CT) image is obtained to generate a first image corresponding to the normal contralateral ear and a second image corresponding to the implanted ear. Intra-cochlear surfaces of at least one first structure of interest (SOI) of the normal contralateral ear in the first image are segmented using at least one active shape model (ASM). Next, the segmented intra-cochlear surfaces in the first image is projected to the second image using a transformation function, thereby obtaining projected segmented intra-cochlear surfaces for the implanted ear in the second image.

title: Mobile computing unloading method, system and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a mobile computing unloading method, a mobile computing unloading system and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of data processing and specifically comprise the following steps: when a target time slice starts, collecting real-time information of an edge server and each piece of health-care Internet of things equipment; constructing a local calculation model, an edge calculation model, an energy collection model and a privacy entropy model according to the real-time information of the edge server and the real-time information of each Internet of things device; constructing an objective function according to the local calculation model, the edge calculation model, the energy collection model and the privacy entropy model; and maximizing an objective function and solving a task unloading strategy in the objective time slice. According to the scheme, real-time information of the Internet of things equipment and the edge server is collected, a calculation model, an energy collection model and a privacy entropy model are built, a target optimization function is obtained, finally an unloading decision vector can be obtained through solving, and adaptability of wireless energy supply and protection strength of privacy are improved.

title: Efficient data compression by grouping similar data within a data segment
abstract: A plurality of data blocks stored at a plurality of solid-state storage devices are identified. A portion of data is read from each data block of the plurality of data blocks. A corresponding property is determined for each data block of the plurality of data blocks based on reading the portion of the data. A set of data blocks from the plurality of data blocks is identified, wherein each data block of the set of data blocks is associated with a first corresponding property. The set of data blocks is stored at a data segment.

title: Electronic device for processing user utterance and controlling method thereof
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a microphone, and at least one processor operatively connected to the microphone, wherein the at least one processor may include a buffer memory configured to store a first feature vector for a first voice signal obtained from the microphone as an inverse value, and an operation circuit configured to perform a norm operation for a first feature vector and a second feature vector, based on the second feature vector, based on a second voice signal streamed from the microphone and an inverse value of the first feature vector stored in the buffer memory, or calculate a similarity between the first feature vector and the second feature vector. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title: Financial products for incentivizing health improvement
abstract: A financial instrument, and associated systems and methods, provide direct financial incentives to individual investors to maintain and improve their health. The financial product has a base rate of return which is based on the investor's well-being category or other characteristics. The base rate of return is retrospectively adjusted at the end of the time period based on changes in the investor's well-being category, with improvements in well-being category typically resulting in an increased rate of return. A number of integrated analytic and predictive models are used to determine investor morbidity risk, the well-being categories, investor migration between categories, the investor payouts, and the portfolio allocation for investments underlying the financial instrument.

title: System and method for tagging database properties
abstract: A method and system for tagging database columns are presented. The method includes receiving an input column name of at least one column in a database; performing signature matching of the input column name to contents of a seed table; determining a first confidence score for the signature matching; and tagging a matching value in the seed table as a tag for the input column name, when a first confidence score exceeds a first threshold value.

title: Selective throttling of operations potentially related to a security threat to a storage system
abstract: An illustrative method includes a data protection system detecting a request to perform an operation with respect to a storage system, identifying one or more attributes of the request, determining, based on the one or more attributes, that the request is possibly related to a security threat against the storage system, and throttling, based on the determining that the request is possibly related to the security threat against the storage system, a performance of the operation.

title: Detection system for group B streptococcus
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a detection system of group B streptococcus, which relates to the field of clinical microbiology inspection, and comprises the following components: a microbial colony culture dish in which a plurality of microbial colonies to be screened are grown; the shooting device is used for shooting the microbial colony culture dish to obtain microbial colony culture dish images containing a plurality of microbial colony images to be screened; the communication equipment is used for sending the microbial colony culture dish image containing the plurality of microbial colony images to be screened to the cloud analysis device; and the cloud analysis device is used for analyzing the plurality of microbial colony images to be screened in the microbial colony culture dish image shot by the shooting equipment and determining whether the group B streptococcus colonies exist in the plurality of microbial colonies to be screened. The embodiment of the invention is based on image recognition of the group B streptococcus, and greatly reduces the labor cost and the equipment cost on the basis of ensuring the screening accuracy.

title: Method and device for classifying stomach pathological images based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and provides a gastric pathological image classification method, device, computer equipment and storage medium based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image block of a stomach pathology image; identifying a non-glandular region image in the original image block, and adjusting pixel values of pixel points in the non-glandular region image to be maximum values to obtain a target image block of the stomach pathological image; extracting image features of a target image block; inputting the image characteristics of the target image block into a pre-trained random forest model to obtain the lesion category of the stomach pathological image; a pre-trained random forest model is used to obtain lesion categories for the stomach pathology image. In addition, the application also relates to a blockchain technology, and the lesion category of the stomach pathology image can be stored in the blockchain. By adopting the method, the interference of the non-glandular region image is avoided, so that the classification accuracy of the stomach pathological image is improved.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Device and method of performing automatic audio focusing on multiple objects
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a device and method of providing automatic audio focusing, the method includes: registering objects of interest; capturing a video; displaying the video on a display; recognizing at least one object included in the video; inferring at least one object of interest included in the video from the recognized at least one object; identifying distribution of the at least one object of interest in the video; and performing audio focusing on the at least one object of interest by adjusting activity of each of multiple microphones included in a microphone array on the basis of the distribution of the at least one object of interest in the video, whereby it is possible to emphasize voice of the object of interest during the video capturing of the electronic device, thereby improving the satisfaction with the video capturing result.

title: Role-based access control for a storage system
abstract: Systems and methods for role-based access control for a storage system are described. An illustrative method includes an access control system identifying, based on a role of a user requesting access to the storage system, a permission of the role to access a resource type; determining, based on the resource type and on a mapping of resources of different secured endpoints of the storage system to resource types, a set of resources of the storage system that the role has permission to access; identifying a subset of the set of resources of the storage system that the user is authorized to access; and granting the user role-based access to the subset of the set of resources of the storage system.

title: Resonating probe with optional sensor, emitter, and/or injection capability
abstract: A microsurgical probe employs an optional probe support structure; an optical fiber for providing a feed path for an emission wavelength; a chemical feed path for delivering a chemical; a resonator motor; and a probe accessory tool. A microsurgical system additionally employs a sensor and an artificial intelligence (AI) system to assess conditions based on data provided by the sensor. The system can be employed to remove tumor tissue that is interwoven with healthy tissue. This system can also be employed to fertilize old, inflexible ova.

title: Precision sleep tracking using a contactless sleep tracking device
abstract: Various devices, systems and methods for performing targeted sleep tracking are presented herein. Multiple digital radar data streams from multiple antennas may be received. A direction optimization process may be performed to determine a first weighting and a second weighting. The first weighting may be applied to a first digital radar data stream. The second weighting may be applied to a second digital radar data stream. The weighted first digital radar data stream and the weighted second digital radar data stream may be combined to create a first directionally-targeted radar data stream. A sleep analysis can be performed based on the first directionally-targeted radar data stream. Sleep data may be output for a user based on the performed sleep analysis.

title: Analysis method, equipment, medium and electrocardiograph for QRST waveform of electrocardiogram
assignee: 上海交通大学医学院附属瑞金医院
abstract: The application relates to the field of medical artificial intelligence and discloses an analysis method, equipment, a medium and an electrocardiograph for a QRST waveform of an electrocardiogram. The analysis method for the QRST waveform of the electrocardiogram comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of leads of electrocardiogram signals; dividing the electrocardiogram signal of each lead into a plurality of wave groups by using a wave group division model, and labeling to obtain a second electrocardiogram signal; extracting an ST segment in a second electrocardiogram signal, the T wave; and (4) dividing the extracted ST segment and T wave into specific classes by using a classification model, and respectively obtaining classification results of the ST segment and the T wave. According to the method and the device, accurate analysis of leads and even specific wave groups is achieved through processing of electrocardiogram signals, common ST segment abnormity and T wave abnormity can be identified, the fineness of STT abnormity analysis is improved, and the method and the device have higher clinical value.
assignee_clean: 上海交通大学医学院附属瑞金医院
primary_assignee: 上海交通大学医学院附属瑞金医院

title: Estimating body composition on a mobile device
abstract: A method, electronic device and non-transitory computer readable medium for estimating a body composition are provided. The method includes receiving a forced breathing data set from an electronic device. The method also includes deriving a flow rate based on the forced breathing data set. The method further includes determining a body composition based on the derived flow rates of the forced breathing data set.

title: Identifying retinal layer boundaries
abstract: Methods for automatically identifying retinal boundaries from a reflectance image are disclosed. An example of the method includes identifying a reflectance image of the retina of a subject; generating a gradient map of the reflectance image, the gradient map representing dark-to-light or light-to-dark reflectance differentials between adjacent pixel pairs in the reflectance image; generating a guidance point array corresponding to a retinal layer boundary depicted in the reflectance image using the gradient map; generating multiple candidate paths estimating the retinal layer boundary in the reflectance image by performing a guided bidirectional graph search on the reflectance image using the guidance point array; and identifying the retinal layer boundary by merging two or more of the multiple candidate paths.

title: Method, apparatus and system for monitering resident
abstract: The present invention relates to a method, an apparatus, and a system for monitoring residents. The method comprises the steps of: attempting to capture movement of a resident by using data received from a camera or a motion detector; outputting an alarm signal when the movement is not captured during a predetermined time; attempting to capture the movement of the resident after outputting the alarm signal; and transmitting an alarm message to a management server through a broadband communication network when the movement is not captured within the predetermined time. Therefore, the resident can be monitored according to a monitoring result by remotely monitoring various states of the resident.

title: Providing persistent storage to transient cloud computing services
abstract: Providing persistent storage to transient cloud computing services, including: creating a cloud computing instance, wherein the cloud computing instance is created on on-premises cloud infrastructure; and storing, in non-volatile storage in a storage system that is communicatively coupled to the on-premises cloud infrastructure, data associated with the cloud computing instance.

title: Scheduling data replication operations
abstract: Scheduling data replication operations, including: identifying, for each of a plurality of target storage systems, an amount of data to be transferred from one or more source storage systems in order to fully replicate a dataset to the target storage system; scheduling, based on the amount of data to be transferred from one or more source storage systems in order to fully replicate the dataset to each of the target storage systems, replication operations between the storage systems; and replicating the dataset from the one or more source storage systems to each of the target storage systems in accordance with the scheduling of replication operations between the storage systems.

title: Multivariate data backup retention policies
abstract: Use of multivariate data backup retention policies, including: generating a snapshot of a dataset; identifying respective subsets of the dataset that correspond to respective retention policies of a plurality of retention policies; and generating tracking information indicating the respective subsets of the dataset corresponding to the respective retention policies of the plurality of retention policies.

title: Using nonce to control erasure of data blocks of a multi-controller storage system
abstract: A block of a storage device of a plurality of storage devices is allocated for storage of data, wherein the allocation comprises identifying a nonce associated with the block of the storage device. An erase command for the block is transmitted to the storage device, the erase command comprising the nonce, wherein the storage device is to erase the block upon determining that the nonce matches a corresponding nonce stored locally at the storage device.

title: Protection of objects in an object-based storage system
abstract: An illustrative method includes an object retention management system establishing a retention policy for a bucket of an object-based storage system, detecting an operation that causes an object to be stored within the bucket, and applying, based on the detecting of the operation, the retention policy to the object, wherein the retention policy prevents the object from being deleted or overwritten for a predefined time duration and the retention policy cannot be modified or disabled for the bucket by a user.

title: Blood vessel segmentation method combining global and neighborhood information
abstract: A blood vessel segmentation method combining global information and neighborhood information is characterized in that a Gnet segmentation network is provided on the basis of a Unet network, a brand-new down-sampling mode is used in the network, and a long-time memory network is combined at a jump connection position, so that the extraction of characteristic information is optimized, and the loss of image information is reduced. Secondly, the invention provides a network Rnet for parallel calculation of neighborhood information by taking the network provided in the previous step as a basic segmentation framework, and trains a segmentation network Gnet by taking a loss function of the network as a penalty term of the basic segmentation network. The invention obviously improves the accuracy of segmenting cerebral vessels in the MRA image processing and can effectively solve the problem of segmentation and fracture of small vessels.

title: Sleep staging using an in-ear photoplethysmography (PPG)
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure provide methods and apparatuses for determining a subject's sleep stage based on a PPG signal measured using an in-ear earpiece. In aspects, one or more physiological signals are estimated based on the PPG. Based, at least in part, on the determined sleep stage, one or more outputs are provided. In an example, the outputs are provided to the subject, the subject's physician, the subject's clinician, the cloud, and/or a device external to the apparatus. The methods and apparatus of determining the subject's sleep state described herein are continuous and non-invasive and eliminate the need for a clinical setting.

title: System to identify and explore relevant predictive analytics tasks of clinical value and calibrate predictive model outputs to a prescribed minimum level of predictive accuracy
abstract: A method of implementing a task complexity learning system, including: learning a model for predicting the value of a continuous task variable y based upon an input variable x; learning an encoder that encodes a continuous task variable y into an encoded task value; calculating a loss function based upon the predicted value of y output by the model and the encoded task value output by the encoder; calculating a distortion function based upon the input continuous task variable y and the encoded task value, wherein learning the model and learning the encoder includes minimizing an objective function based upon the loss function and the distortion function for a set of input training data including x, y pairs.

title: Progressive lens simulator with an axial power-distance simulator
abstract: A Progressive Lens Simulator comprises an Eye Tracker, for tracking an eye axis direction to determine a gaze distance, an Off-Axis Progressive Lens Simulator, for generating an Off-Axis progressive lens simulation; and an Axial Power-Distance Simulator, for simulating a progressive lens power in the eye axis direction. The Progressive Lens Simulator can alternatively include an Integrated Progressive Lens Simulator, for creating a Comprehensive Progressive Lens Simulation. The Progressive Lens Simulator can be Head-mounted. A Guided Lens Design Exploration System for the Progressive Lens Simulator can include a Progressive Lens Simulator, a Feedback-Control Interface, and a Progressive Lens Design processor, to generate a modified progressive lens simulation for the patient after a guided modification of the progressive lens design. A Deep Learning Method for an Artificial Intelligence Engine can be used for a Progressive Lens Design Processor. Embodiments include a multi-station system of Progressive Lens Simulators and a Central Supervision Station.

title: Electroencephalogram emotion recognition method based on progressive graph convolution neural network
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of information, and particularly provides an electroencephalogram emotion recognition method based on a progressive graph convolution neural network. The method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring emotion electroencephalogram data and preprocessing the emotion electroencephalogram data; s2, constructing a progressive graph convolution neural network; s3, training a convolutional neural network of the graph; and S4, testing the trained neural network. According to the invention, the hierarchical characteristics of emotion are considered for the first time, a double-particle-size branch neural network model is constructed, the hierarchical characteristics of emotion are fully utilized, and the electroencephalogram emotion recognition effect is improved. The invention constructs a dynamic graph based on brain region functional connectivity and a static graph based on brain region spatial proximity, fully utilizes the complementarity of the brain dynamic functional connectivity information and the spatial proximity information, and improves the effect of electroencephalogram emotion recognition.

title: Storage system that drives an orchestrator based on events in the storage system
abstract: An illustrative method includes a storage management system detecting an event within a storage system, determining an operation based on the event, and providing a notification of the operation to an orchestration system configured to manage an execution of the operation by a computing system associated with the storage system.

title: Immune system feedback simulation system and method for immune teaching
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of immune system feedback simulation, and discloses an immune system feedback simulation system and method for immune teaching, wherein the immune system feedback simulation system for immune teaching comprises: the cell image acquisition module, the operation module, the central control module, the cell image segmentation module, the cell model construction module, the immune animation production module, the immune type selection module, the storage module and the display module. According to the invention, the characteristics of clear image segmentation, high self-adaptive threshold segmentation precision and less workload are adopted by the cell image segmentation module, so that advantages of the cell image segmentation module and the self-adaptive threshold segmentation precision are complementary, and the quality of an output image is improved; meanwhile, the problem of low efficiency of the existing animation production is solved by the immune animation production module, and the animation production efficiency is improved; the animation production process is simplified, and the animation production barriers are reduced; and based on reinforcement learning, the accuracy of animation production is ensured.

title: Container recovery layer prioritization
abstract: An illustrative method of container recovery using layer prioritization includes identifying a set of immutable layers of container images included in a dataset used by a container system to run containerized applications on a first cluster; copying the set of immutable layers of container images to a second cluster in preparation for a recovery event; receiving, after the set of immutable layers of container images are copied to the second cluster, a recovery request to recover the containerized applications; and copying, in response to the recovery request, a set of mutable layers included in the dataset to the second cluster, the second cluster configured to use the copied set of immutable layers and the copied set of mutable layers to recover the containerized applications on the second cluster.

title: Polyp segmentation model training method, polyp segmentation method and related device
abstract: The disclosure relates to a training method of a polyp segmentation model, a polyp segmentation method and a related device, so as to improve the polyp segmentation performance of a target domain model. The training method comprises the following steps: determining a first positive sample from a polyp positive sample set, a first negative sample from a polyp negative sample set, for predicting a polyp region, a second positive sample from a non-polyp positive sample set, and a second negative sample from a non-polyp negative sample set for predicting a non-polyp region; determining a first loss value based on the first positive sample, the first negative sample, and the characteristics of the predicted polyp region, and determining a second loss value based on the second positive sample, the second negative sample, and the characteristics of the predicted non-polyp region; determining a pseudo tag corresponding to the target sample image according to the predicted polyp segmentation result and the historical polyp segmentation result, and determining a third loss value according to the pseudo tag and the predicted polyp segmentation result; and adjusting the model parameters according to the first loss value, the second loss value and the third loss value.

title: Data decision method and system for classifying disease degree
abstract: The invention provides a data decision method and a system for classifying disease degrees, wherein the data decision method comprises the following steps: clustering analysis is carried out on the characteristic indexes of the diseases, and the characteristic indexes are divided into characteristic I with high association degree high Features I with low degree of association low The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Feature I with high degree of association high The CT image is input into an encoder for training to obtain a trained self-encoder; combining the trained self-encoder with the softmax classifier to obtain a decision classifier, classifying the CT image by the decision classifier, and taking the classification result as the output of the stage decision. The invention can combine the CT image and the auxiliary information to carry out the input information of disease stage decision, and can be fast. And accurately obtaining a disease stage decision result.

title: Training method and device for image segmentation model, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a training method of an image segmentation model, the method comprising: determining a first marking prediction image corresponding to a first marking sample image in the first training subset based on the first coding sub-network and the decoding sub-network; determining spatial feature vectors corresponding to all sample images in the first training subset based on the first coding sub-network, the second coding sub-network and the transformation sub-network; determining a first sub-loss value of the image segmentation model based on a first annotation image and a first annotation prediction image corresponding to the first annotation sample image; determining a second sub-loss value of the image segmentation model based on the space characteristic vectors corresponding to all the sample images in the first training subset; training the image segmentation model based on the first sub-loss value and the second sub-loss value of the image segmentation model; the first training subset comprises at least one group of sample image pairs, and each group of sample image pairs comprises an annotated sample image and a non-standard sample image which are acquired from the same video.
assignee_clean: 北京医准智能科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京医准智能科技有限公司

title: Pattern recognition and prediction using a knowledge engine
abstract: Various systems and methods for processing activity data with a knowledge engine to generate actionable insights for a human subject are described. These actionable insights may include identifying a most likely action given a particular state of the human subject, identifying a most likely state in which the human subject performs a particular activity, or identifying anomalies in human activity patterns. In an example, an electronic processing system operates the knowledge engine with operations that: identify patterns of activity using clustering of events, identify meaningful patterns of activity from the patterns of activity based on co-occurrence of characteristics for respective events, rank the identified meaningful patterns of activity based on confidence and support of respective patterns to occur for a human subject, and generate a personalization action (such as an action for a software application) based on the ranked, identified meaningful patterns of activity.

title: Health measuring device
abstract: A biometric information measuring device according to an embodiment of the present invention is disclosed. The biometric information measuring device comprises: a handle unit including two or more electrodes for making contact with a body part of the user to measure a multi-impedance including a multi-frequency impedance for one or more paths formed by the body part of the user; an upper plate unit including two or more electrodes for making contact with a body part of the user to measure a multi-impedance including a multi-frequency impedance for one or more paths formed by the body part of the user; and a control unit which generates learning data which includes learning biometric data including multi-impedance information of a user as an independent variable and includes actually measured bone density data of the user as a dependent variable, generates a learning dataset including learning data of users, learns a health measurement model to reduce an error between bone density data output by performing operations on the learning biometric data of the users through a health measurement model and the actually measured bone density data included in the learning dataset, receives at least a portion of the biometric data of the user from an input device and/or a user terminal, and generates the bone density data of the user by performing operations through the learned health measurement model by using the at least a portion of the biometric data of the user as an input independent variable.

title: Pulse generator, stimulator, and storage medium
assignee: 苏州景昱医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The present application provides a pulse generator, a stimulator, a storage medium, and a program product, at least one processor of the pulse generator being configured to implement the following steps when executing a computer program: respectively obtaining power spectral density amplitudes corresponding to the contact point when the electric stimulus is delivered to the internal tissue of the patient and when the electric stimulus is not delivered, and recording the power spectral density amplitudes as a first density amplitude and a second density amplitude; determining one of the contacts from the plurality of contacts as a target contact according to the first density amplitude and the second density amplitude corresponding to each contact; acquiring a plurality of alternative contact pairs near the target contact; collecting the power spectral density amplitude value corresponding to each alternative contact pair and recording the power spectral density amplitude value as a third density amplitude value; a target acquisition contact pair is determined. According to the pulse generator provided by the application, the power spectral density amplitude of the bioelectric signal is analyzed for each contact point to accurately position the target contact point, then the target acquisition contact point pair of the target contact point is determined, and the treatment pertinence of the pulse generator is improved.
assignee_clean: 苏州景昱医疗器械有限公司
primary_assignee: 苏州景昱医疗器械有限公司

title: Brain age prediction method for bimodal images
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, and further relates to image processing and medical image processing, in particular to a brain age prediction method of bimodal images, which mainly provides a bimodal feature fusion method, wherein the bimodal images are two medical images of MRI and PET; the feature fusion is obtained based on a 3D convolutional neural network method, and comprises the following steps: s01, using two 3D convolutional neural networks as backbone networks to extract the characteristics of PET and MRI images; s02, splicing the features of the MRI and PET images extracted by the two backbone networks in the channel dimension, and inputting the features into a compression excitation module (Squeeze-and-experientationnetworks); s03, multiplying the output result of the excitation part by the original feature map to obtain the feature of the attention information of the fusion channel, and obtaining a fusion feature map of the bimodal feature. According to the invention, brain age prediction is performed based on the fusion MRI and PET bimodal brain images, so that the spatial information of the images is effectively reserved, and compared with the traditional single-modality image brain age prediction method, the brain age prediction method can more comprehensively reflect the changes in the brain aging process, thereby remarkably improving the brain age prediction precision.

title: Control system for corneal local cross-linking
assignee: 超目科技(北京)有限公司
abstract: The utility model discloses a control system for cornea local cross-linking, include: the light source driving device receives state parameters input from the outside, converts the state parameters into pulse width modulation control signals and sends the pulse width modulation control signals to the light source device; the light source device comprises a plurality of light sources, is connected with the light source driving device and generates corresponding light signal output according to the pulse width modulation control signal. The utility model discloses a light source drive arrangement will receive external input's state parameter and convert pulse width modulation control signal into, and then control light source device and generate corresponding light signal output, realize that the single divides regional different light intensity (radiant flux power) to shine, and then can avoid can only shining an area at every turn according to the different regional light source transmission different light signals of topographic map control of different ophthalmic diseases, reduce the exposure time to the irradiation range covers comprehensively.
assignee_clean: 超目科技 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 超目科技 北京 有限公司

title: System for minimizing reevaluation of a ground truth corpus in response to concept drift
abstract: A method, system and computer-usable medium are disclosed for minimizing reevaluation of a ground truth corpus in response to concept drift. Certain embodiments are directed to a computer implemented comprising: generating a knowledge graph using a ground truth corpus, where the knowledge graph includes concept nodes, context definition nodes, and document nodes, where each concept node has one or more edges to a context definition node and to a document node; updating a context definition node in the knowledge graph based on context drift; identifying edges between the updated context definition node and concept nodes affected by the updated context definition; and identifying edges between the affected concept nodes and corresponding document nodes to identify document nodes affected by the context drift; and reevaluating documents in the ground truth corpus corresponding to the affected document nodes pursuant to updating the ground truth corpus to compensate for the context drift.

title: Picture processing method, device and system based on deep learning
assignee: 重庆金山医疗技术研究院有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a picture processing method, equipment and system based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a picture to be processed, inputting the picture to be processed into a deep learning model to obtain a classification label, and attributing the picture to be processed to corresponding classification according to the classification label; the establishing process of the deep learning model comprises the following steps: acquiring a training set and a verification set; constructing a picture processing convolution network, wherein the first-stage sub-network comprises a convolution layer and a residual neural network layer; the second level sub-network comprises a pooling layer and two residual neural network layers; the third-level sub-network, the fourth-level sub-network and the fifth-level sub-network respectively comprise a pooling layer and three residual neutral network layers; the sixth-level subnetwork comprises a pooling layer, four full-connection layers and an activation layer; and processing the convolutional network by training the pictures in batches by using the training set. And (5) completing the establishment of the deep learning model. The method realizes rapid picture screening without manual participation.
assignee_clean: 重庆金山医疗技术研究院有限公司
primary_assignee: 重庆金山医疗技术研究院有限公司

title: Methods and systems of risk identification, quantification, benchmarking and mitigation engine delivery
abstract: A computerized process useful for automating Risk Identification, Quantification, Benchmarking and Mitigation in an enterprise computer system, includes the step of integrating an enterprise security, privacy and compliance system in an enterprise computer system. The enterprise security, privacy and compliance system monitors a set of risk sources. The method includes the step of implementing an identification and a weighted scoring of a set of risks associated with each risk source. The method includes the step of, with a specified machine learning technique, matching a set of similar risk inputs with an associated weight. The set of similar risk inputs are similar to the risk sources in the RPPBM practice. The method includes the step of monitoring the relevant enterprise systems for changes in risk levels of each risk source. The method includes the step of generating a risk-score number for each risk source. The risk-score number is used to avoid a subjective assessment of the risk source.

title: Memory controller and memory system including the same
abstract: A memory controller includes a fault predictor which predicts a fault which causes an error occurring in a memory device, an error correction code (ECC) manager which classifies a type of the fault based on the predicted fault, and a plurality of ECC engines which perform ECC in parallel depending on the classified type of the faults. The fault predictor includes a memory error profiler which receives raw data related to the error and processes the raw data into an error profile that is data available for machine learning, and a memory fault prediction network which receives the error profile as an input, performs the machine learning using the error profile, and predicts the fault which causes the error.

title: Deep learning-based medicine spectrum data analysis method and device
assignee: 武汉大学人民医院（湖北省人民医院）
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing medicine spectrum data based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of medicine analysis and comprise the following steps: acquiring first information and second information; performing feature fusion processing on the historical spectrum data and the structural information to obtain third information; clustering the third information to obtain fourth information; training a preset deep learning mathematical model according to fourth information, and constructing to obtain a medicine interaction prediction model; and analyzing according to the drug interaction prediction model and the second information to obtain an interaction evaluation result of the new drug. According to the invention, by fusing historical spectrum data, medicine structure data and medicine interaction information, a medicine spectrum data analysis method based on deep learning is constructed, and the method can effectively predict the interaction between unknown medicines and provides powerful support for medicine research and development and clinical practice.
assignee_clean: 武汉大学人民医院 湖北省人民医院
primary_assignee: 武汉大学人民医院 湖北省人民医院

title: Data analysis method of multi-modal big data aiming at type 2 diabetes complications
assignee: 广州中医药大学第一附属医院
abstract: The invention relates to a data analysis method of multi-mode big data aiming at type 2 diabetes complications, which acquires historical big data corresponding to the diabetes complications according to the determined diabetes complications; designing a multi-density quantizer according to the corresponding change rate of the historical big data in each mode to obtain a sensing and acquiring method of real-time data; adopting a multi-mode data mining method for the historical big data and combining a convolutional neural network method to extract characteristic information corresponding to the type of the diabetes complication; deducing a dynamic evolution rule of an individual infected with the diabetes complication type in the historical big data according to the characteristic information; and combining the dynamic evolution rule of the individual to obtain the performance evaluation index of the real-time data. The invention can predict the incidence trend of the diabetes complications, provides decision basis and technical support for early diagnosis and treatment of the diabetes complications, and improves diagnosis efficiency and diagnosis quality.

title: Method for generating dose prediction model of nasopharyngeal carcinoma, dose prediction method and device
assignee: 福建医科大学附属第一医院, 国网信通亿力科技有限责任公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method for generating a dose prediction model of nasopharyngeal carcinoma, a dose prediction method and a device. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a three-dimensional medical image of a plurality of nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients into a plurality of two-dimensional slices, and dividing the plurality of two-dimensional slices into a training set and a testing set; the number of the radiation fields in the three-dimensional planned target area image of each nasopharyngeal carcinoma patient is within a preset range, and the preset range is [7, 12]; constructing a dose prediction model of nasopharyngeal carcinoma comprising a generator and a discriminator; and training the dose prediction model by utilizing the two-dimensional slices in the training set to obtain the dose prediction model with the judgment result meeting the preset condition. According to the invention, a dose prediction model suitable for various nasopharyngeal carcinoma types can be generated on the premise of ensuring the accuracy of dose prediction, so that the manpower, material resources and time consumption in the radiotherapy process are reduced.

title: System for supporting user's behavior
abstract: Provided is a system 10 which supports a user's behavior by generating a behavioral decision function indicating behavior to be adopted to a certain target. The system 10 includes: a data acquiring section 110 which acquires a cost caused as a result of adopting each of a plurality of behaviors to a target as training data for generating the behavioral decision function, the plurality of behaviors having already been adopted to the target; and a function generator 120 which generates, based on the training data, the behavioral decision function to minimize the expected shortfall of a cost to be obtained as a result of adopting the behavior to the target.

title: Self-adaptive physiological monitoring and intelligent scheduling positioning system and method
abstract: The invention relates to a self-adaptive physiological monitoring and intelligent scheduling positioning system and a self-adaptive physiological monitoring and intelligent scheduling positioning method, wherein the system comprises a physiological data monitoring module and a rescue module; the physiological data monitoring module collects physiological data of a human body by utilizing a somatosensory network, divides the priority level of the data by an RM-MAC (remote management-media access control) improvement protocol and performs self-adaptive transmission by an RS (Reed-Solomon) algorithm; the rescue module is used for assisting medical staff in efficiently positioning the patient by utilizing a multi-source heterogeneous indoor sensing positioning and sensing node advanced scheduling technology when the physiological data of the user is abnormal, so that the patient is timely rescued, and the energy consumption of the indoor heterogeneous sensing positioning network is saved. The invention applies the deep learning target track prediction technology to the indoor rescue module, carries out high-performance scheduling on the position tracking nodes in advance through track prediction, ensures the perception tracking precision, reduces the network energy consumption, and can carry out effective and rapid position rescue to avoid risks when the system monitors abnormal physiological data which possibly endanger the life of a patient.

title: Composition measurement system
abstract: A method for measuring one or more quantities characterizing a composition of a medium includes causing a first non-uniform spatially varying optical signal to impinge on a portion of the medium, processing a second optical signal emitted from the medium in response to the first optical signal including determining characteristics of a spatial variation of the second optical signal, and determining the one or more quantities characterizing the composition of the medium based on the characteristics of the spatial variation of the second optical signal.

title: Intelligent spine slippage recognition method and device based on weak supervised learning
assignee: 北京长木谷医疗科技股份有限公司, 张逸凌
abstract: The application provides a method and a device for intelligent identification of spondylolisthesis based on weak supervised learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting an image to be identified into a plurality of feature extraction units which are sequentially connected to obtain a thermodynamic diagram of the image to be identified; determining a preset number of thermal anchor frames according to the numerical value field in the thermodynamic diagram; inputting the thermal anchor frame into a classification unit to obtain a classification result of the thermal anchor frame; determining a spine slipping position in the image to be identified based on the classification result; the first sample image has a marked weak supervisory signal. In the application, through setting up feature extraction unit and two classification units, the position identification of taking off the backbone changes into two classification judgement to only need two categorised supervisory signals to accomplish the training, need not to mark the position of taking off the backbone this kind of strong supervisory signals, avoided the result that the high can't mark in batches to train of strong supervisory signals mark cost too high.

title: Artificial intelligence anesthesia management system
assignee: 长沙市妇幼保健院(长沙市妇幼保健计划生育服务中心), 湖南星迪医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial intelligence anesthesia management system, wherein a model training method includes: acquiring basic information of a sample patient, intraoperative time sequence data and gunpowder injection time sequence data, wherein the intraoperative time sequence data comprises physiological parameter data of the sample patient at different moments, and the gunpowder injection time sequence data comprises the gunpowder injection of the sample patient at different moments; training the first model based on the basic information of the sample patient, the intraoperative time sequence data and the gunpowder injection time sequence data to output the predicted blood concentration of the sample patient at the future preset time; training the second model based on the basic information of the sample patient, intraoperative time sequence data and the blood concentration of the sample patient at a preset time in the future to output a predicted gunpowder injection quantity reasoning value at a specified time; and updating the model parameters of the first model and the model parameters of the second model based on the target loss function, and ending training until the loss value of the target loss function meets the preset condition.

abstract: The invention provides a mass spectrum data analysis method which comprises a sample data acquisition step, a sample data preprocessing step, a data model construction and cross validation step, a data model optimization step and a sample group judgment step.

title: Method and device for predicting heparin dosage
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院, 神州数码医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting heparin dosage, wherein the method for predicting heparin dosage comprises the following steps: acquiring clinical observation data of a patient to be injected, and extracting parameter values corresponding to heparin dosage influence parameters contained in the clinical observation data according to preset heparin dosage influence parameters; combining the parameter values with each normalized heparin dosage value in a preset normalized heparin dosage set respectively to obtain combined parameter values matched with the input of a preset treatment classification model; inputting the combination parameter values into a preset treatment classification model to obtain probability values of the combination parameter values belonging to normal treatment in treatment classification, and obtaining target combination parameter values corresponding to the maximum probability values; predicting the heparin dosage of the patient to be injected according to the heparin dosage range corresponding to the normal treatment and the normalized heparin dosage value in the target combination parameter value. The accuracy of heparin dosage prediction can be improved.

title: Electrocardiosignal heart beat detection and identification method based on deep learning target detection
assignee: 推演医疗科技(北京)有限责任公司
abstract: The invention discloses an electrocardiosignal heart beat detection and identification method based on deep learning target detection, which is characterized in that a priori heart beat segments with different widths are arranged at each sampling point of an electrocardiosignal, a model can predict and output the type of the anchors and the conversion amount of the corresponding position through training and learning, the position of the anchors can be converted into the position of a predicted heart beat through translation and zooming, and the corresponding type of the anchors is converted into the type of the predicted heart beat. The method realizes detection and identification of the heart beat position and the type end to end, and compared with the existing method, the method carries out two tasks in stages, simplifies the process, improves the efficiency, and above all, the model can well learn heart beat characteristics through mass data training, the anti-interference capability of the model is obviously enhanced, and the accuracy rate of heart beat detection and identification is greatly improved.

title: Depth detection network for quantifying esophageal mucosa IPCLs blood vessel morphological distribution
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and particularly relates to a depth detection network for quantifying vascular morphology distribution of esophageal mucosa IPCLs. The method comprises a characteristic extraction network, a characteristic pyramid, a region candidate network, a cancer focus classification network with interest region pooling and clustering distribution prior self-embedding, and a system for visualization on a narrow-band imaging endoscope image. Extracting a feature map of an input image by a feature extraction network; the characteristic pyramid fuses the characteristics of different scales; the regional candidate network provides possible lesion regions; pooling the region of interest to pool features into suspicious lesion areas; the cluster distribution priori classifies the cancer foci from an embedded cancer focus classification network; and finally, visualizing the images on the narrow-band imaging endoscope, and using different colors to frame and mark the cancer focus. The invention can detect and diagnose the cancer focus of early esophageal squamous carcinoma in the image, can effectively improve the diagnosis efficiency and assist doctors to obtain higher diagnosis precision.

title: Method and device for providing information
abstract: Disclosed are an information providing device and an information providing method, which provide information enabling a conversation with a user by executing an artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm in a 5G environment connected for Internet-of-Things. An information providing method according to one embodiment of the present disclosure includes gathering first situational information from a home monitoring device, gathering, from the first electronic device, second situational information corresponding to the first situational information, gathering, from the home monitoring device, third situational information containing a behavioral change of the user after gathering the first situational information, generating a spoken sentence to provide to the user on the basis of the first situational information to the third situational information, and converting the spoken sentence to spoken utterance information to be output to the user.

title: X-ray diagnostic apparatus and medical-information processing apparatus
abstract: An X-ray diagnostic apparatus of an embodiment includes processing circuitry. The processing circuitry determines a concentration of a contrast agent in contrast-enhanced image collection based on first reference information in which a recommended contrast in a contrast-enhanced image is associated with each region of interest to be subject to collection of the contrast-enhanced image, and on second reference information that indicates a relation among a generation condition of an X-ray, a concentration of a contrast agent, and a contrast. The processing circuitry calculates setting information of an injector to inject a contrast agent to the subject based on the determined concentration of a contrast agent.

title: Diagnosing and treating neurological impairments
abstract: A method administers a therapeutic treatment for a neurological impairment of a patient. One or more processor(s) display query content on a display, and then receive responses to the query content from a patient. The processor(s) identify a physiological locus of a neurological impairment of the patient based on the responses to the query content from the patient, and administer a therapeutic treatment to the patient based on the identified physiological locus of the neurological impairment of the patient.

title: Method and system of providing an emergency response notification
abstract: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method of providing an automated emergency response alert for a patient, the method comprising: (a) sensing, via a sensor, patient information related to one more of activity, health, environment and location of the patient; (b) analyzing, with reference to predetermined emergency criteria, the patient information received from the sensor via a system in communication with the sensor; (c) selecting an emergency response alert based on the analysis of the patient information received from the sensor; and (d) issuing the selected emergency response alert via a communications network.

title: Identification method based on gustation induced electroencephalogram signals in telemedicine system
abstract: An identification method based on taste induced electroencephalogram signals in a telemedicine system comprises the following steps of firstly carrying out a user registration stage: preprocessing an initial electroencephalogram data set; selecting an optimal electrode channel, an effective time period and optimal characteristics on each channel corresponding to a user by utilizing a point-by-point double-row correlation coefficient method and a relation coefficient, extracting an electroencephalogram characteristic value for encoding, generating a 64-bit DES (data encryption standard) encryption algorithm key by utilizing an electrocardiosignal of the user, and encrypting and storing an electroencephalogram characteristic value sequence; and (3) performing a user authentication stage: the medical institution decrypts the EEG signal characteristic sequence when the user is registered before, compares the EEG signal characteristic sequence when the user is authenticated, and if the difference value of the EEG signal characteristic sequence and the EEG signal characteristic sequence is within a specified threshold value, the authentication is passed. The method overcomes the defects that the authentication credentials are easy to forget and forge; in addition, the method is particularly suitable for people with visual and auditory disorders, and the brain electrical signal characteristics are encoded, encrypted and stored, so that the damage of an intruder is prevented, and the identity recognition is more reliable.

title: Ultrasonic key frame autonomous identification method based on anomaly detection and semi-supervision
abstract: The invention provides an ultrasonic key frame autonomous identification method based on anomaly detection and semi-supervision, which is used for identifying standard section key frames in medical ultrasonic scanning video frames. Firstly, constructing an ultrasonic video frame data set of a common ultrasonic scanning part; then, extracting encoding vectors meeting normal distribution from the ultrasonic video frames by adopting a variation self-encoder; then, carrying out ultrasonic keyframe pre-screening in an unsupervised outlier detection mode; and finally, performing video frame low-rank decomposition and key frame autonomous identification of video frame coding vector low-rank pseudo-inverse by a labeling constraint similarity graph semi-supervised learning method. The method can solve the problem that the existing key frame identification method has excessive dependence on marking data of medical ultrasound, and realize autonomous identification of the ultrasound key frames with only a small number of marking video frames.

title: Medicine-taking rule generation method based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 杭州逸曜信息技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method for generating a medication rule based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: importing a sample training set into a medication rule model; training the medication rule model according to judgment category information, logic judgment conditions, warning information and label information of the judgment category information and the logic judgment conditions in the edited medication rule information to obtain a trained medication rule model; inputting the medication information to be edited into the trained medication rule model; marking the medication information to be edited by the trained medication rule model to obtain judgment category marking information and logic judgment condition marking information; generating corresponding judgment category information, logic judgment conditions and warning information according to the judgment to-be-edited medication information, the category marking information and the logic judgment condition marking information; and synthesizing the information according to the generated judgment category information, the logic judgment condition and the warning information to obtain the medication rule information of the medication information to be edited.
assignee_clean: 杭州逸曜信息技术有限公司
primary_assignee: 杭州逸曜信息技术有限公司

title: Interactive tablet and integrated facial treatment device
abstract: An interactive health, beauty, wellness, and lifestyle tablet device and steamer having a housing and a water basin coupled to the housing. The device can further include a fluid atomizer coupled to the housing, configured to atomize fluid from the water basin, and an interactive display coupled to the housing. Here, the interactive display is configured to receive input from a user. In addition, the housing can also include a lighting unit disposed around the interactive display, and also a heating or cooling element disposed therein. The housing of the device may also include a receptacle for receiving a capsule or container and a tube for releasing and dispensing the contents of the capsule or container, among other features.

title: Providing data quality feedback while end users enter data in electronic forms
abstract: An automated feedback may be provided while data is entered in an electronic form. Input entered into an input field of a form fillable window provided on a user interface display screen may be detected. A quality measure associated with the input as entered into the form fillable window may be determined. The quality measure is determined based on a quality needed for an analytics process of an application for which the input is being entered. A graphical indication representing the quality measure on the user interface display screen may be presented.

title: Aortic dissection screening system based on random subspace ensemble learning
assignee: 中南大学湘雅医院, 湖南自兴智慧医疗科技有限公司, 湖南省自兴人工智能研究院
abstract: The invention discloses an aortic dissection screening model based on random subspace ensemble learning and an establishing method, a system and a model thereof. Aiming at the defects of low efficiency, high misdiagnosis rate, low missed diagnosis rate, high cost and complex process of aortic dissection diagnosis of the traditional diagnosis method, the invention provides an aortic dissection screening method based on random subspace ensemble learning. According to the method, the RS model is established by using the RS-Ensemble algorithm of machine learning, and the screening and diagnosis of the aortic dissection are carried out by using the RS model, so that the diagnosis accuracy is greatly improved, the misdiagnosis rate and the missed diagnosis rate are greatly reduced, and the diagnosis with high efficiency and low cost is realized.
assignee_clean: 中南大学湘雅医院; 湖南自兴智慧医疗科技有限公司; 湖南省自兴人工智能研究院

title: Systems, methods and media for estimating compensatory reserve and predicting hemodynamic decompensation using physiological data
assignee: Mayo Foundation For Medical Education And Research, The Government Of The United States, As Represented By The Secretary Of The Army
abstract: In accordance with some embodiments, systems, methods, and media for estimating compensatory reserve and predicting hemodynamic decompensation using physiological data are provided. In some embodiments, a system for estimating compensatory reserve is provided, the system comprising: a processor programmed to: receive a blood pressure waveform of a subject; generate a first sample of the blood pressure waveform with a first duration; provide the sample as input to a trained CNN that was trained using samples of the first duration from blood pressure waveforms recorded from subjects while decreasing the subject's central blood volume, each sample being associated with a compensatory reserve metric; receive, from the trained CNN, a first compensatory reserve metric based on the first sample; and cause information indicative of remaining compensatory reserve to be presented.

title: Using high-level attributes to guide image processing
abstract: Using high-level attributes to guide image processing is described. In an embodiment high-level attributes of images of people such as height, torso orientation, body shape, gender are used to guide processing of the images for various tasks including but not limited to joint position detection, body part classification, medical image analysis and others. In various embodiments one or more random decision forests are trained using images where global variable values such as player height are known in addition to ground-truth data appropriate for the image processing task concerned. In some examples sequences of images are used where global variables are static or vary smoothly over the sequence. In some examples one or more trained random decision forests are used to find global variable values as well as output values for the task concerned such as joint positions or body part classes.

title: System and method for continuous calibration of eye tracking systems used in VR/AR HMD units
abstract: A virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR) wearable assembly is described herein. The VR/AR wearable assembly includes a wearable frame adapted to be worn over a patient's eyes, a pair of photosensor oculography (PSOG) assemblies mounted to the wearable frame with each PSOG assembly including a display and an eye tracking assembly, and a processor coupled to each PSOG assembly. The processor is configured to execute an algorithm to continuously calibrate the eye tracking assembly including the steps of rendering a sequence of images on a corresponding display and calibrating a corresponding eye tracking assembly by establishing a display coordinate system associated with the corresponding display, determining predicted fixation locations and estimated gaze position locations within the display coordinate system, and determining an offset gaze position value by mapping the estimated gaze position location to the predicted fixation location within the display coordinate system.

title: Human body acupoint recognition system based on reality and virtualization
assignee: 齐齐哈尔市祥和中医器械有限责任公司
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly provides a human body acupoint recognition method and system based on reality and virtualization, wherein the method comprises the steps of wearing VR glasses or AR glasses with a human body acupoint recognition function, collecting human body images of a patient, and preprocessing; extracting image features of the preprocessed human body image, inputting the image features into a preset acupoint recognition neural network model for training to obtain acupoint and meridian diagrams of a patient; and determining the positions of the acupoints which need to be treated according to a preset acupoint treatment scheme. The system comprises VR glasses or AR glasses, wherein the VR glasses or AR glasses comprise a main control module, a feature extraction module, an acupoint positioning module and a digital camera, and the main control module is respectively connected with the feature extraction module, the acupoint positioning module and the digital camera and is used for realizing the human acupoint recognition method. The invention reduces the grasping degree of the human body acupoint identification by the operator, simplifies the personnel training and can shorten the training time of medical personnel.

title: Cardiogenic shock prognosis prediction early warning system, equipment and storable medium
assignee: 中国人民解放军总医院
abstract: The application provides a cardiogenic shock prognosis prediction and early warning system, equipment and a storable medium, and relates to the field of intelligent medical treatment. The system comprises: the device comprises an acquisition unit, a characteristic extraction unit, a diagnosis unit, a second acquisition unit and a decision unit, wherein the acquisition unit is used for acquiring genetic information of a patient peripheral blood mononuclear cell sample and a classification label of whether ECMO treatment is given or not; the characteristic extraction unit performs characteristic extraction on the genetic information to obtain genetic characteristics; a diagnostic unit that determines whether the patient is to be administered ECMO therapy based on the genetic signature; the second acquisition unit is used for acquiring the patient cardiogenic shock stage diagnosis result; a decision unit selects a treatment regimen based on the staged diagnostic result. The system developed by the application predicts the effect of the patient after receiving ECMO treatment based on the gene information of the patient, provides molecular diagnosis evidence for whether the patient can receive ECMO treatment, better utilizes and distributes medical resources, and has important clinical value.

title: Medical image registration system and method based on magnetic navigation
assignee: 上海寻是科技有限公司, 青岛大学附属医院
abstract: A medical image registration system and method based on magnetic navigation, the registration system includes a structured light camera module, a magnetic navigation locator and a computing center; the structured light camera module comprises a structured light camera and a magnetic navigation positioning coil tool which are fixedly connected; the magnetic navigation positioner is arranged corresponding to the structured light camera module, and the magnetic navigation positioning coil tool is positioned in the capturing range of the magnetic navigation positioner; the computing center is in communication connection with the structured light camera and the magnetic navigation locator. The registration method comprises the following steps: 1. extracting three-dimensional image feature points of the head of a patient through the preoperative medical image; 2. acquiring point cloud data comprising a head outline of a patient through a structured light camera; 3. extracting three-dimensional characteristic points of the point cloud based on the obtained point cloud data; 4. and matching the three-dimensional image characteristic points with the three-dimensional point cloud characteristic points to realize the registration of the image space of the patient before operation and the real space position of the patient in operation. The invention has fast and accurate registration, and saves the cost of the mechanical arm and the occupied space.

title: Image detection method, device and system based on artificial intelligence and storage medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an image detection method, a device, a system and a storage medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target microscopic image under a microscope and a target observation multiplying power corresponding to the target microscopic image; calling an image detection model corresponding to the target observation magnification from a model library to serve as a target image detection model; the model library comprises image detection models corresponding to various observation magnifications, and the image detection models are used for analyzing microscopic images based on an artificial intelligence algorithm; and detecting the target microscopic image through the target image detection model, and determining a detection result corresponding to the target microscopic image. The method can automatically detect the microscopic image and ensure the accuracy of detection.
