title: Distributed classification system
abstract: A computing system classifies distributed data. A first computation request is sent to worker computing devices. A first response is received from each worker computing device. Each first response includes a first matrix computed as a second order derivative of a logarithm of a predefined likelihood function on a subset of training data distributed to each respective worker computing device. A global first matrix is defined by concatenating the first matrix from each worker computing device. A kernel matrix is computed using the training data and a predefined kernel function. A second computation request is sent to the worker computing devices. The second computation request indicates that each worker computing device compute a classification probability for each observation vector distributed to a respective worker computing device using the defined global first matrix and the computed kernel matrix. The determined classification probability is output for each observation vector.

title: Method and system for harvesting lesion annotations
abstract: A method of harvesting lesion annotations includes conditioning a lesion proposal generator (LPG) based on a first two-dimensional (2D) image set to obtain a conditioned LPG, including adding lesion annotations to the first 2D image set to obtain a revised first 2D image set, forming a three-dimensional (3D) composite image according to the revised first 2D image set, reducing false-positive lesion annotations from the revised first 2D image set according to the 3D composite image to obtain a second-revised first 2D image set, and feeding the second-revised first 2D image set to the LPG to obtain the conditioned LPG, and applying the conditioned LPG to a second 2D image set different than the first 2D image set to harvest lesion annotations.

title: Biomarkers for multiple sclerosis
abstract: The present invention relates to biomarkers associated with multiple sclerosis (MS), particular GLX molecules, and teven more particular GLX-related glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) and GLX-related proteoglycans (PGs).

title: Method and apparatus for communication environment analysis and network design considering movable object
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a communication technology and system thereof for combining a 5G communication system with IoT technology to support higher data transmission rates than a 4G system. The present disclosure may be applied to smart services (e.g., smart home, smart building, smart city, smart car or networking car, healthcare, digital education, retail business, security and security related services, etc.) based on 5G communications and IoT related technologies. A method for identifying transmission characteristics of a wireless signal in a wireless communication system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes the steps of: identifying a signal transmission position; identifying a signal receiving location; identifying an area in which a movable object between a signal transmission position and the signal reception position is located; identifying characteristics of the movable object in the region; and identifying a transmission characteristic of a wireless signal transmitted from the signal transmitting location to the signal receiving location based on the characteristic of the movable object.

title: Image classification method and device, computer readable storage medium and equipment
assignee: 明品云(北京)数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses an image classification method, an image classification device, a computer readable storage medium and computer readable storage equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be processed; zooming the image to be processed to obtain input images with different sizes; inputting the input image into a pre-trained image classification model to classify the input image to obtain the classification probability of the input image so as to obtain the image category to which the image belongs; the image classification model is composed of a plurality of classifiers with different scales, the classifier of each scale corresponds to an input image with one size, and different classifiers correspond to input images with different sizes. The invention carries out class processing on the image through the multi-scale neural network, ensures the classification robustness of the multi-scale input image and has remarkable advantages in the aspect of image classification.
assignee_clean: 明品云 北京 数据科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 明品云 北京 数据科技有限公司

title: Information processing method and apparatus therefor
abstract: Disclosed are an information processing method and apparatus capable of controlling an electronic device in a 5G communication environment by processing information based on execution of a mounted artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm or machine learning algorithm. An information processing method according to the present disclosure may include: obtaining verbal information and non-verbal information related to a controlling subject and a controlled object; generating a first sentence including a coreference and a control command, by converting the verbal information into text; assigning identification information to the controlled object based on analysis of the non-verbal information; generating, from the first sentence, a second sentence supplemented with the coreference by using the identification information on the controlled object; and calling the controlled object by using the identification information on the controlled object included in the second sentence, and distributing the control command to the called controlled object.

title: Method, system and storage medium for analyzing abnormal motion pattern of heart muscle of echocardiography
assignee: 东软教育科技集团有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method, a system and a storage medium for analyzing abnormal motion modes of cardiac muscles of an ultrasonic heart chart, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an echocardiographic sequence under a standard four-cavity cardiac facet, wherein the length at least comprises one cardiac cycle; analyzing the motion state of the left ventricular myocardial wall of an echocardiogram in a cardiac cycle, and extracting the multi-dimensional motion mode characteristics; and taking the echocardiography sequences and the motion pattern characteristics as input of a myocardial abnormal motion pattern recognition model, and outputting the confidence coefficient of the predicted myocardial abnormal motion pattern by using the myocardial abnormal motion pattern recognition model. According to the invention, by extracting the motion pattern characteristics in the echocardiogram sequence in one cardiac cycle, the time sequence information and the local motion information in the echocardiogram are fully mined, so that the accurate analysis of the abnormal motion pattern of the cardiac muscle can be automatically carried out according to the characteristics, and the prediction result is returned.

primary_assignee: 东软教育科技集团有限公司

title: Method and system for anonymizing facial images
abstract: A computer-implemented method for anonymizing a facial image includes detecting one or more sets of facial keypoints in the facial image. The method further includes standardizing the facial image. The method further includes preparing a masked facial image by separating one or more areas comprising skin-pixels and one or more areas comprising pixels related to non-skin information. The method further includes generating a synthetic image comprising photo-realistic skin patterns. The method further includes obtaining an anonymized facial image by concatenating the masked facial image with the generated photo-realistic skin patterns.

title: Text analysis method and system
assignee: 重庆思达普规划设计咨询服务有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a text analysis method, which constructs a multidimensional label pool according to a plurality of first standard files; according to the multi-dimensional tag pool, a plurality of second standard files and a plurality of third files are respectively matched with multi-dimensional tags, a priority level of the multi-dimensional tags is obtained through matching according to the acquired analysis conditions, full-text logic extraction is respectively carried out on the plurality of second standard files and the plurality of third files according to the priority level sequence, and corresponding first logic information sets and second logic information sets are respectively obtained; and then calculating the matching degree of the second logic information set and the first logic information set, and automatically generating a first analysis report according to the second logic information set with the matching degree larger than a preset threshold value.

title: Training method and focus segmentation method of convolutional neural network
assignee: 中移（杭州）信息技术有限公司, 中国移动通信集团有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a training method of a convolutional neural network, which comprises an input layer, a middle layer and an output layer; the network training method comprises the following steps: initializing network parameters of the middle layer; based on the training sample picture received by the input layer, forward propagation calculates expected output of the convolutional neural network; calculating an error between a desired output and a label corresponding to the training sample picture received by the output layer; counter-propagating the error and updating network parameters of the intermediate layer; performing loss evaluation on errors by using a Dice-CE function combined by the cross entropy function and the Dice function; when the error is estimated to be the least loss, the network parameters of the corresponding middle layer are taken as the final parameters of the convolutional neural network. The combination of the cross entropy loss function and the Dice function is used for calculating the loss function, so that the multi-detection rate and the omission ratio can be reduced, and the effect of accurate segmentation is finally achieved.

title: Classifying types of sensitive events for data loss prevention
abstract: Identification of an electronic communication containing specific information is provided. Content of the electronic communication may be evaluated by a machine-learning model, and based on an evaluation of the content, it may be determined that the electronic communication contains the specific information. The electronic communication may be tagged with tag information indicating that the electronic communication contains the specific information, and transmission of the electronic communication may be blocked based on the tag information.

title: Systems and methods for processing electronic images of slides for a digital pathology workflow
abstract: A computer-implemented method of using a machine learning model to categorize a sample in digital pathology may include receiving one or more cases, each associated with digital images of a pathology specimen; identifying, using the machine learning model, a case as ready to view; receiving a selection of the case, the case comprising a plurality of parts; determining, using the machine learning model, whether the plurality of parts are suspicious or non-suspicious; receiving a selection of a part of the plurality of parts; determining whether a plurality of slides associated with the part are suspicious or non-suspicious; determining, using the machine learning model, a collection of suspicious slides, of the plurality of slides, the machine learning model having been trained by processing a plurality of training images; and annotating the collection of suspicious slides and/or generating a report based on the collection of suspicious slides.

title: Using reinforcement learning in radiation treatment planning optimization to locate dose-volume objectives
abstract: A reinforcement learning agent facilitates optimization of a radiation-delivery treatment plan. The reinforcement learning agent is configured to generate a radiation-delivery treatment plan that can exceed the quality of a plan or plans employed to train the reinforcement learning agent. The reinforcement learning agent is trained to evaluate a radiation-delivery treatment plan that is output by an optimization software application, modify one or more dose-volume objective parameters of the evaluated radiation-delivery treatment plan, and then input the modified radiation-delivery treatment plan to the optimization software application for further optimization. The reinforcement learning agent adaptively adjusts the one or more dose-volume objective parameters based on an action policy learned during a reinforcement learning training process.

title: Generating reports from scanned images
abstract: A computer implemented method comprising: receiving a report on a condition of a human or animal subject, composed by a user based on a scan of the subject; inputting the current report and the scan into a trained machine learning model; and based on the report and the scan, the machine learning model generating one or more suggestions for updating the text of the report. The method further comprises causing a user interface to display to the user one or more suggestions for updating the text of the report, with each respective suggestion visually linked in the user interface to a corresponding subregion within at least one image of the scan based upon which the respective suggestion was generated.

title: Methods and systems for timing impact of nourishment consumption
abstract: A system for timing impact of nourishment consumption, the system including a computing device configured to receive a nutrient profile of a subject, wherein the nutrient profile maps physiological data of the subject to current nutrient levels of the subject, determine, using the nutrient profile, a nourishment consumption program, wherein the nourishment consumption program includes at least an alimentary element, and a time of day for consuming the alimentary element wherein the time of day is determined as a function of the nutrient profile and the current nutrient level of the subject, and provide, to the subject, the nourishment consumption program.

title: Image enhancement method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 推想医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention provides an image enhancement method and device, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which solve the problem that the quality of an image acquired by image acquisition equipment in the prior art cannot meet the requirement. The image enhancement method comprises the following steps: acquiring a group of sub-image sequences obtained by down-sampling an acquired original image, wherein the sub-image sequences are sequentially ordered according to the sequence of sequentially reduced resolution; taking the sub-image with the lowest resolution as a reference image to calculate a difference image of the last sub-image; carrying out multi-scale detail enhancement processing on the difference image to obtain a detail enhancement image; calculating a reconstructed image corresponding to a previous sub-image based on the detail-enhanced image and the previous sub-image; and updating the reference image by using the reconstructed image corresponding to the previous sub-image, and repeating the process to calculate the reconstructed image corresponding to the previous sub-image until the reconstructed image corresponding to the original image is obtained.

title: Double-screen different display machine intelligent settlement terminal
assignee: 旭辉卓越健康信息科技有限公司
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electronic payment, in particular to a double-screen different display machine intelligent settlement terminal, which comprises a display component and a supporting component arranged below the display component, wherein the display component is fixedly connected with the supporting component through a connecting piece, the display component is provided with a first mounting frame and a second mounting frame which are arranged on two mutual backs, and the inner sides of the first mounting frame and the second mounting frame are all clamped and fixed with a display screen; possess the face identification function, the preceding high definition digtal camera of equipment, through the facial feature of the different patients of face identification technology direct identification, let the user directly log in the health account number of oneself under the condition that need not to input the password, read the relevant health information data of oneself, register and payment, during the use, the machine is placed at hospital settlement window or nurse's platform, after confirming the deduction amount of money through liquid crystal touch-sensitive screen patient, the patient passes through the cell-phone two-dimensional code, the transaction of this time is accomplished to the convenient and fast of punching the card.

title: Systems and methods for generating a topic tree for digital information
abstract: The disclosed computer-implemented method for generating a topic tree for digital information may include parsing the digital information and extracting a set of keywords. This method may also include comparing the set of keywords to an ontology and extracting hierarchies from the ontology that match the set of keywords. The extracted ontology entries may then be pruned and sorted. Various other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.

title: Method and apparatus to measure tissue displacement and strain
assignee: Ahmed M Ehab Mahmoud, Mohamed Tarek Mohamed Ali
abstract: A method for reconstructing displacement and strain maps of human tissue of a subject in vivo or other objects includes applying a mechanical deformation for a target area, imaging tissues while deformation is applied on the target area, measuring the axial and lateral displacements and axial, lateral, and shear strains of tissue in the target area, differentiating between tissues of different stiffness and strain responses, and labeling tissues of different stiffness and strain responses. In some embodiments, displacement and strain imaging are performed using a high-resolution, high-speed, highly-accuracy hierarchy recursive displacement tracking from conventional ultrasound brightness mode images. Particularly, this invention relates to the reconstruction of displacement and strain images from conventional ultrasound B-mode images acquired using any ultrasound machine of different manufacturers without the need to use carrier signals.
assignee_clean: ahmed m ehab mahmoud; mohamed tarek mohamed ali

title: Classification of utility usage data
abstract: According to an example aspect of the present invention, there is provided an apparatus comprising a memory configured to store classifier parameters, and at least one processing core configured to use a classifier and the classifier parameters to determine a category of least one data composition, the at least one data composition comprising utility usage information concerning a utility unit, the category comprising a life condition present in the at least one utility unit.

title: Tissue classification method, device, storage medium and magnetic resonance imaging system
assignee: 上海联影医疗科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a tissue classification method and device of a magnetic resonance image, a storage medium and a magnetic resonance imaging system. The tissue classification method of the magnetic resonance image comprises the following steps: applying presaturation pulses with different preset frequency values for multiple times in an imaging visual field, acquiring magnetic resonance data under the condition that the presaturation pulses with the preset frequency values are applied every time, and reconstructing according to the magnetic resonance data to obtain a plurality of magnetic resonance amplitude images; determining a change curve of the amplitude value of the image unit at the same position in the plurality of magnetic resonance amplitude images and a preset frequency value according to the plurality of reconstructed magnetic resonance amplitude images; and classifying the tissue types corresponding to the image units according to the change curves. By the method and the device, the problem that the requirement of the tissue classification method on the main magnetic field uniformity in the related technology is high is solved, and the requirement of the tissue classification method on the main magnetic field uniformity is reduced.

assignee: 广州腾讯科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining the credit of a target object, a storage medium and an electronic device. Wherein the device includes: acquiring first characteristic information of a first account and second characteristic information of a second account; determining first credit information of the first account according to the first characteristic information, and determining second credit information of the second account according to the second characteristic information; and determining the target credit of the first account according to the first credit information and the second credit information. The invention solves the technical problem of lower accuracy in determining the credit of the target account in the prior art.

title: Method and system for establishing radiation pneumonitis prediction model
assignee: 广州医科大学附属肿瘤医院
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of medical intelligence, and relates to a method for establishing a radiation pneumonitis prediction model, which comprises the following steps: identifying lung tissue LUNG and clinical target CTV in the CT image, and segmenting LUNG and CTV to obtain lung tissue LUNG-CTV with the clinical target CTV removed; acquiring a three-dimensional physical dose of a lung tissue LUNG-CTV region in a lung cancer patient radiotherapy plan, and converting the three-dimensional physical dose into a 2Gy fractionated radiation equivalent biological dose; extracting image histology characteristics of a lung tissue LUNG-CTV region and dose histology characteristics of 2Gy fractionated radiation equivalent biological dose; and performing feature screening on the image histology features and the dose histology features by using a random forest algorithm. The application also provides a system, equipment and a storage medium for establishing the radiation pneumonitis prediction model. In addition, the application also relates to a blockchain technology, and the radiation pneumonitis diagnosis result can be stored in the blockchain.

title: Textural analysis of diffused disease in the lung
abstract: A method of creating a diagnostic evaluation for usual interstitial pneumonia is provided, including obtaining a first plurality of series of HRCT lung slices indicating the presence of UIP, obtaining an identification of UIP and non-UIP voxels, extracting textural and localization features from the UIP and non-UIP voxels, selecting features that are more accurate in differentiating UIP voxels from non-UIP voxels than other features are, eliminating features highly correlated with a more accurate feature, and constructing a predictive model by performing a second classifier to provide a probability that a voxel signifies the presence of UIP. Also provided is a method of identifying UIP in a subject's lung by applying a diagnostic evaluation for UIP that was created with the foregoing method.

title: Target area obtaining method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 数坤(上海)医疗科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a target area acquisition method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial image; inputting the initial image into a region identification model to obtain a first region set; determining importance indexes of the first subareas according to the first area set, wherein the importance indexes are used for representing the importance degree of each first subarea relative to other first subareas; marking the first subarea according to the first area set and the importance index to obtain a marked first subarea; and screening a target area from the marked first subarea, wherein the target area is used for representing an area corresponding to a relatively serious true positive focus in all focuses of the human body to be detected. According to the embodiment of the application, all focuses of the human body to be detected can be taken as a sample set, and true positive focuses which are serious relative to other samples can be rapidly and accurately found out from the sample set.

title: Sidelink communication
abstract: One disclosure of the present specification provides a UE performing sidelink communication. The UE may comprise: at least one transceiver; at least one processor; and at least one memory that stores instructions and is operably electrically connectable with the at least one processor. An operation performed on the basis of an instruction executed by the at least one processor may comprise the steps of: receiving, via a PSSCH or a PSCCH, a DMRS from another UE; and measuring an RSRP of the DMRS on the basis of RSRP measurement requirements.

title: Scalable hierarchical clustering
abstract: A hierarchical representation of an input data set comprising similarity scores for respective entity pairs is generated iteratively. In a particular iteration, clusters are obtained from a subset of the iteration's input entity pairs which satisfy a similarity criterion, and then spanning trees are generated for at least some of the clusters. An indication of at least a representative pair of one or more of the clusters is added to the hierarchical representation in the iteration. The hierarchical representation is used to respond to clustering requests.

title: Fundus image optic disk and optic cup segmentation method and device and electronic equipment
assignee: 杭州聚秀科技有限公司, 浙大城市学院
abstract: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to the field of medical image processing, and provides a fundus image optic disc cup segmentation method, a fundus image optic disc cup segmentation device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a fundus image to be segmented; inputting the fundus image into a pre-trained optic cup and optic disc segmentation network model, and segmenting a optic cup area and a optic disc area in the fundus image to obtain segmentation results; the visual cup and visual disc segmentation network model is obtained by training according to the following steps: acquiring a plurality of sample fundus images carrying labels, and dividing the plurality of sample fundus images into an image training set and an image testing set; respectively training a preset U-Net network and a preset segvomer network by using an image training set to obtain a fundus image optic disc optic cup segmentation neural network model based on UNet-segvomer; and testing the fundus image optic disc and optic cup segmentation neural network model by using the image test set to obtain a trained optic cup and optic disc segmentation neural network model. The embodiment of the disclosure can improve the segmentation precision of the optic cup of the video disc.

title: Image processing apparatus, image processing program, and image processing method
abstract: An image processing device (31) is provided with: a lesion detection unit (P1) that detects a lesion candidate (L) from a medical image acquired by imaging a subject; a feature detection unit (P2) that detects a feature of the lesion candidate (L); a marker determination unit (P3) that determines the display state of a marker to be displayed on the basis of the characteristics of the lesion candidate (L), and generates marker display information (Y) including information on the display state; and a display image generation unit (35) that generates a display image (Z) by applying a marker to the medical image on the basis of the marker display information (Y).

title: Brain image data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a brain image data processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring brain image data to be processed and contrast group brain image data; respectively extracting features of the brain image data to be processed and the brain image data of the contrast group to obtain a first feature to be detected and a first feature to be trained; respectively selecting the first feature to be detected and the first feature to be trained to obtain a second feature to be detected and a second feature to be trained; constructing a support vector machine classification model according to the second feature to be trained; and obtaining a processing result according to the second feature to be detected and the classification model of the support vector machine. The brain image data processing method provided by the invention can accurately analyze the abnormal sample in the brain image data, improves the analysis precision and accuracy, is simple, is easy to obtain data, and improves the inspection efficiency.

title: Spine CT-MR conversion method and system based on generation antagonism network
assignee: 济南大学, 山东大学齐鲁医院
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing, and aims to solve the problem of spine CT image edge information loss in the existing spine CT image-MR conversion process, and provides a spine CT-MR conversion method and system based on a generated antagonism network, wherein a constructed encoder of the antagonism network comprises a first branch and a second branch, the first branch is used for extracting multi-scale global features of the spine CT image, the second branch is used for utilizing high-frequency multi-scale edge features of the spine CT image, the sensitivity to the edge structure of the spine CT image is improved, and the tiny structure of the edge of the spine CT is ensured not to be lost; the attention module of the decoder is utilized to guide the fusion of global features and edge features of corresponding scales, so that the spine CT structure is not lost as much as possible, and the conversion quality from spine CT to MR is improved while the bone tissue edge information of the spine CT image is protected.
assignee_clean: 济南大学; 山东大学齐鲁医院

title: Classification system based on ultrasound contrast image uniformity degree
assignee: 成都思多科医疗科技有限公司, 四川大学华西医院
abstract: The invention discloses a classification system based on the uniformity degree of an ultrasonic contrast image, which comprises an image preprocessing module, a classification labeling module, a feature extraction module, a feature screening module, a principal component analysis module, a model training module and a classification prediction module; during off-line classification, a plurality of corresponding two-classification QDA models are obtained through the image preprocessing module, the classification labeling module, the feature extraction module, the feature screening module, the principal component analysis module and the model training module, then the classification prediction module carries out classification prediction on the ultrasonic contrast images with unknown classification results by using the obtained models, and during on-line classification, the classification prediction module directly uses the existing two-classification QDA models to complete the classification prediction on the ultrasonic contrast images with unknown classification results. Therefore, the method and the device can reduce the workload of doctors, effectively assist the doctors to make accurate diagnosis results, reduce the learning difficulty of the classification model and improve the training efficiency of the classification model.

title: Diagnostic mask and method
abstract: A diagnostic mask and method of diagnosing are disclosed. The method includes collecting data from a plurality of sensors in a mask placed on a patient's face such that the mask covers the patient's eyes, the data representing a plurality of health signs of the patient, wherein at least one of the health signs relates to the patient's eyes; and transmitting a signal from the mask, the signal representing the data representing the plurality of health signs.

title: Support vector classification with bounded uncertainties in input data
abstract: A computer-implemented method for determining a boundary for binary classification includes providing a data set, initializing a value for noise in the data set, and determining a hyperplane dividing the data set and a slack variable given a current value for noise. The method further includes updating the value for noise and the slack variable given the hyperplane, and determining the hyperplane to be the boundary for binary classification of the data set upon determining a termination criterion to be met, wherein elements of the data set are classified according to the boundary.

title: Deep learning method for predicting size of coronary artery in-situ lesion interventional operation stent
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning method for predicting the size of a coronary artery in-situ lesion interventional operation stent, which belongs to the technical field of medicine and comprises the steps of obtaining coronary angiography image data required by an experiment, training a multi-task classification and regression prediction model by using the deep learning method, verifying the performance of the multi-task classification and regression prediction model after the training is finished, testing the multi-task classification and regression prediction model, and applying the tested multi-task classification and regression prediction model to the selection of the coronary artery interventional operation stent; the multi-task classification and regression prediction model comprises a classification branch supervised and trained by a cross entropy loss function and a regression loop supervised and trained by a mean square error loss function. The invention can help doctors to quickly and accurately determine the optimal size of the needed coronary artery in-situ lesion interventional operation bracket, and can effectively improve the operation efficiency and the operation success rate.

title: System, method, and computer program product for detecting neurodegeneration using differential tractography
assignee: University of Pittsburgh—of the Commonwealth System of Higher Education
abstract: Described are a system, method, and computer program product for detecting neurodegeneration using differential tractography and treating neurological disorders accordingly. The method includes obtaining a first diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan of the brain of the patient and obtaining a plurality of diffusion MRI scans of a group of other brains. The method also includes generating a control diffusion MRI scan based on the plurality of diffusion MRI scans of the group of other brains. The method further includes determining a first anisotropy of first neural tracks of the first diffusion MRI scan and a second anisotropy of second neural tracks of the control diffusion MRI scan. The method further includes determining a differential by comparing the first anisotropy to the second anisotropy and identifying at least one neurological disorder based on the differential and a location of the first neural tracks in the brain of the patient.

title: Knee joint positioning method based on multitask two-stage convolution neural network
assignee: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学
abstract: The invention discloses a knee joint positioning method based on a multitask two-stage convolution neural network, and aims to improve the knee joint detection accuracy. The knee joint area positioning network based on the multitask two-stage convolutional neural network is constructed by two stages of networks, wherein the first stage of network is composed of a first feature extraction module and a preliminary target detection module, and the second stage of network is composed of a second feature extraction module and a final target detection module; training the knee joint area positioning network to obtain a trained knee joint area positioning network model; preprocessing a double-knee X-ray film to be detected, and dividing a double-knee image into single-knee images; and performing knee joint positioning on the single knee image based on the trained knee joint area positioning network to obtain a final boundary frame of the single knee image and a final key point of the knee joint area. The invention can improve the detection accuracy of knee joint positioning.

title: Cell detection method, cell detection device, intelligent microscope system and readable storage medium
assignee: 腾讯医疗健康(深圳)有限公司
abstract: The present disclosure provides a cell detection method, device, intelligent microscope system and readable storage medium based on a cell stain image. The cell detection method, apparatus, smart microscope system, and readable storage medium according to the present disclosure may be applied to the field of artificial intelligence such as smart medicine. The cell detection method based on the cell staining image comprises the following steps: decomposing the cell stain image into a first channel image and a second channel image; for the first channel image, determining a first detection result by extracting local maxima; for the second channel image, determining a second detection result by extracting a local minimum value; determining a cell detection result based on the first detection result and the second detection result.

title: Method for automatically evaluating adenoid hypertrophy by MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) image based on deep learning
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of medical image processing, and provides a method for automatically evaluating adenoid hypertrophy by MRI images based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: converting the acquired MRI image in DICOM format into PNG format, selecting one frame with nasal septum and several frames around the frame as data set from sagittal image sequence, and preprocessing the image; image enhancement, expanding a data set; making a label; extracting features of the image; four landmarks are automatically located in the image and the ratio of the adenoid thickness to the nasopharyngeal cavity gap (AN ratio) is calculated to evaluate whether the image corresponds to a patient with adenoid hypertrophy. According to the invention, by automatically positioning four landmarks and further calculating the AN ratio, the automatic evaluation of whether the patient has adenoid hypertrophy or not is realized, the repeated and time-consuming measurement work of doctors is reduced, and the doctors are assisted to evaluate and diagnose the adenoid hypertrophy.

title: Methods, systems, and computer readable media for automated attention assessment
abstract: The subject matter described herein includes methods, systems, and computer readable media for automated attention assessment. According to one method, a method for automated attention assessment includes obtaining head and iris positions of a user using a camera while the user watches a display screen displaying a video containing dynamic region-based stimuli designed for identifying a neurodevelopmental and/or psychiatric (neurodevelopmental/psychiatric) disorder; analyzing the head and iris positions of the user to detect attention assessment information associated with the user, wherein the attention assessment information indicates how often and/or how long the user attended to one or more regions of the display screen while watching the video; determining that the attention assessment information is indicative of the neurodevelopmental/psychiatric disorder; and providing, via a communications interface, the attention assessment information, a diagnosis, or related data.

title: Methods, systems and devices for identifying an abnormal sleep condition
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for identifying abnormal sleep conditions are disclosed. During each of a plurality of non-zero time periods, a wearable device configured to be worn on a body of a user may capture (i) a physiological parameter measurement and (ii) a non-physiological parameter measurement, thereby providing a plurality of physiological parameter measurements and a plurality of non-physiological parameter measurements, respectively. Based at least in part on the plurality of physiological parameter measurements and the plurality of non-physiological parameter measurements, the wearable device may identify an abnormal sleep condition. Responsive to identifying the abnormal sleep condition, the wearable device may cause an output device to provide a notification, with the output device being a part of or connected to the wearable device.

title: Training method of image classification model, image classification method and device
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides a training method of an image classification model, an image classification method and an image classification device, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to the technical fields of image processing, deep learning and the like. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: determining a first feature image of the sample image by using a first feature extraction network in the first image classification model, inputting a mask image of the sample image to a second feature extraction network in the second image classification model to obtain a second feature image with the same size as the first feature image, and training the second feature extraction network of the second image classification model according to the first feature image and the second feature image. Therefore, by means of the self-supervision training of the second image classification model by means of the first image classification model, the training cost of the second image classification model is reduced, and meanwhile, the trained second image classification model can achieve good classification effect.

title: Image description generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an image description generation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The image description generation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image; performing image coding processing on the target image to obtain a target image feature vector; performing target detection on the target image feature vector through a preset target detection model to obtain a target image feature matrix; carrying out semantic analysis on the target image feature matrix through a preset text generation model to obtain a candidate text sequence; screening the candidate text sequences according to the preset sentence length and the image description class labels to obtain target text sequences; and performing stitching processing on the target text sequence to obtain target image description information, wherein the target image description information comprises image local features corresponding to the image description category labels. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of the generated image description information.

title: Privacy protection-based two-party model prediction method, device and system
assignee: 支付宝(杭州)信息技术有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a two-party data joint processing method, device and system based on privacy protection. The two member devices are respectively provided with local privacy data, and the local privacy data of the two member devices form two-party combined processing data. In response to a joint processing request for determining a result of function sigmoid calculation of two-party joint processing data, each member device locally performs a first function calculation using local privacy data to obtain a local processing result, the first function including a trigonometric function performed at each member device, which is obtained by decomposing each fitting item when trigonometric function fitting is performed on the function sigmoid. Each member device uses the respective local processing result to execute and share the security calculation to obtain the two-party data joint processing result, and each member device is provided with the two-party data joint processing result fragment of the two-party data joint processing result.

title: Chatbot system providing learning data generated based on big data and method thereof
abstract: Provided are a chatbot system for providing learning data generated based on big data and a method thereof. The method, which is a chatbot method for providing learning data generated based on big data performed by a chatbot management server, includes: generating, by the chatbot management server, the learning data by repeatedly learning based on the big data; and generating, by the chatbot management server, answer data by analyzing user information and query data received from a user terminal, wherein the generating of the learning data may include collecting the big data; generating pre-processed data by pre-processing the big data and converting the pre-processed data into classifiable data; generating classified data by classifying the pre-processed data as machine-generated data, semi-generated data, human-generated data, enterprise-specialized data, enterprise-normalized data, and enterprise-specialized vocabulary data based on each task, individual, and enterprise; and generating the learning data by repeatedly learning the classified data.

title: Reservation request processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京声智科技有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for processing an appointment request, and belongs to the field of medical treatment. In the embodiment of the application, on one hand, in a manner that the plurality of first servers process the reservation requests in parallel, the plurality of first servers can distribute the reservation requests of the user account to be processed instead of being processed by one server, so that the load of the server can be reduced, and the processing efficiency of the reservation requests can be improved. On the other hand, after receiving the reservation request, the server firstly sends a reservation success notification to the user account when determining that the server has an available reservation identifier, and then processes the reservation request, so that the server can quickly feed back required information to the user, avoid long-time waiting of the user, optimize the processing flow of the reservation request, and improve the feedback effect of the reservation request.

title: Dynamic recommendations of sensors for patient monitoring
abstract: A recommendation method, system, and computer program product include monitoring a patient using a plurality of sensors, receiving patient information including a comfort level corresponding to a sensor of the plurality of sensors, determining a relevance of each sensor of the plurality of sensors to at least one health conditions of the patient, and determining at least one sensor of the plurality of sensors to disconnect based on the comfort level and the relevance of each sensor.

title: A System for Caring Rhinitis Using Portable Device for Curing Rhinitis
abstract: The present invention relates to a rhinitis care system. More specifically, a portable rhinitis treatment device is inserted into the nose of a user to treat rhinitis, and appropriate operation information of the rhinitis treatment device according to the rhinitis condition of the user to the user terminal so that the rhinitis treatment device is operated accordingly. Therefore, in the rhinitis care system using a portable rhinitis treatment device, optimized rhinitis treatment can be done for users in daily life.

title: Searching data structures maintained by distributed data sources
abstract: A method includes receiving a query that identifies an entity, obtaining a first set of entity records responsive to the query, wherein each record of the first set of entity records comprises one or more visual objects responsive to the query, obtaining a second set of entity records responsive to the query, wherein each record in the second set of entity records includes an entity score describing the entity that is associated with a period of time when the one or more visual objects were generated, executing computer program code correlating the first set of entity records with the second set of entity records, executing computer program code that uses the second set of entity records with which the first set of entity records is correlated to enhance the first set of entity records, and generating visual snapshot rendering data based on the enhanced first set of entity records.

title: Storage device including nonvolatile memory device, operating method of storage device, and operating method of electronic device including nonvolatile memory device
assignee: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., Korea University Research And Business Foundation
abstract: A storage device includes a nonvolatile memory device and a memory controller. An operating method of the storage device includes sending, at the memory controller, a first read command and first offset information to the nonvolatile memory device, performing, at the nonvolatile memory device, first read operations based on the first read command and the first offset information, sending, at the nonvolatile memory device, a result of the first read operations as first data to the memory controller, sending, at the memory controller, a second read command, read voltage levels, and second offset information to the nonvolatile memory device, performing, at the nonvolatile memory device, second read operations based on the second read command, the read level information, and the second offset information, and sending, at the nonvolatile memory device, results of the second read operations as second data to the memory controller.

assignee: Ecole Polytechnique Federale De Lausanne (Epfl), Onward Medical N.V.

title: Information reporting method and communication device
abstract: The application discloses an information reporting method and a communication device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a first wireless device sends a first frame to a second wireless device, wherein the first frame comprises first indication information and/or second indication information, the first indication information indicates configuration of feedback parameters in information feedback conditions, the second indication information indicates feedback parameters in the information feedback conditions, and the feedback parameters in the information feedback conditions are used for the second wireless device to determine whether the information feedback conditions are met or not; the first wireless device sends a measurement message to the second wireless device; the first wireless device receives first information sent by the second wireless device when the second wireless device determines that an information feedback condition is met. Based on the method provided by the application, the second wireless device can feed back the first information to the first wireless device when the feedback condition is met, so that the information interaction between the second wireless device and the first wireless device is reduced, and the channel resource is saved.

title: Method and system for facilitating compression
abstract: During operation, embodiments of the subject matter can perform compression of an n-dimensional m-channel patch based on unsupervised learning (clustering). Embodiments of the subject matter can perform multiple such compressions of patches tessellated (tiled) across a space. Embodiments of the subject matter can also perform hierarchical compression through recursive application of embodiments of the subject matter. Embodiments of the subject matter can compress but are not limited to compressing the following: a database, a sequence, an image, a video, and a volumetric video.

title: Optimizing analysis of a 3D printed object through integration of geo-registered virtual objects
abstract: In this patent, a method and apparatus for improving analysis of a 3D printed object is provided. A first portion of a 3D dataset is selected for 3D printing. The 3D dataset is geo-registered to the 3D printed object. A second portion of the 3D dataset is displayed on a head display unit (HDU). Additional advanced features are discussed herein. An example would be performing 3D printing of a heart from a CT scan and displaying the aorta and inferior vena cave on the HDU geo-registered to the 3D printed heart.

title: Sample balancing method and target organ segmentation model construction method
assignee: 安徽紫薇帝星数字科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a sample balancing method and a target organ segmentation model construction method. In the training process, the number of negative samples is gradually reduced, the related characteristic information of the negative samples can be well utilized in the early stage of training, the problem of sample unbalance caused by too many negative samples can be well avoided, the problem of data unbalance in the medical image segmentation process is effectively solved, and the segmentation precision is improved.
