title: Intelligent clustering systems and methods useful for domain protection
abstract: An intelligent clustering system has a dual-mode clustering engine for mass-processing and stream-processing. A tree data model is utilized to describe heterogenous data elements in an accurate and uniform way and to calculate a tree distance between each data element and a cluster representative. The clustering engine performs element clustering, through sequential or parallel stages, to cluster the data elements based at least in part on calculated tree distances and parameter values reflecting user-provided domain knowledge on a given objective. The initial clusters thus generated are fine-tuned by undergoing an iterative self-tuning process, which continues when new data is streamed from data source(s). The clustering engine incorporates stage-specific domain knowledge through stage-specific configurations. This hybrid approach combines strengths of user domain knowledge and machine learning power. Optimized clusters can be used by a prediction engine to increase prediction performance and/or by a network security specialist to identify hidden patterns.

title: Automated redistribution of queries to underutilized channels
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to automated redistribution of queries to underutilized channels. A computing platform may monitor user traffic for one or more customer service communication channels. Subsequently, the computing platform may identify estimated wait times for a plurality of users to be served via the one or more channels. Then, the computing platform may initiate, via an intelligent virtual assistant, a communication with a given user of the plurality of users. Then, the computing platform may receive, via the intelligent virtual assistant, one or more attributes of a query of the given user. Then, the computing platform may select a channel of the one or more channels. Then, the computing platform may provide, to an enterprise agent associated with the selected channel, the one or more attributes of the query. Subsequently, the computing platform may direct the given user to the selected channel.

title: Apparatus and method for constructing unified lesion learning model and apparatus and method for diagnosing lesion using the unified lesion learning model
abstract: According to the present invention, an integrated lesion learning device to determine a lesion may be provided. The integrated lesion learning device may comprise: an image-based learning unit learning at least one image-based learning model receiving a medical image and outputting a lesion prediction result based on an image; at least one clinic data-based learning unit learning a clinic data-based learning model receiving clinic data and outputting a lesion prediction result based on the clinic data; and an integrated learning unit performing ensemble learning on an integrated learning model receiving a lesion prediction result based on the image and the lesion prediction result based on the clinic data and outputting a final lesion prediction result.

title: Intelligent classification processing method for middle ear diseases
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent classification processing method for middle ear diseases, which comprises the following steps: s1, automatically extracting a middle ear characteristic image set through an algorithm; s2, obtaining a final characteristic 3D data block through a comparison network: the comparison network builds a convolutional neural network with two shared parameters and weights based on the twin network, and compares the similarity between the input image and the standard image to obtain a final characteristic 3D data block; s3, constructing a network which is subjected to downsampling alternately by 3D convolution operation and Leakyrelu based on the 3D convolution neural network, and connecting a self-constructed full-connection analysis to the network to give a final prediction result. The invention can adapt to the continuous data mode of the high-resolution CT image, can better reflect the condition of the diseases, weaken the data characteristics and control the data scale in the analysis process, finally realize the effect of assisting the high-precision automatic diagnosis of middle ear diseases, and the whole diagnosis process does not need to rely on manual intervention.

title: Training method of tongue fur image classification model based on progressive learning
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a training method of a tongue fur image classification model based on progressive learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original training data set at least comprising a plurality of tongue fur images; determining a target resolution set according to a preset progressive learning resolution amplification mode; determining a regularized intensity value set according to a preset regularized intensity amplification mode of progressive learning; performing a preset resolution resetting operation on each tongue fur image in the original training data set to obtain a target training data set; and training the preset tongue fur image classification model for multiple times based on the target training data set and the regularized intensity value set. Therefore, the invention can train the tongue coating images with different resolutions by using different regularization intensities, thereby accelerating the training speed of the tongue coating image classification model and improving the classification accuracy of the tongue coating image classification model after training. The invention can be applied to digital medical systems.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Combined steering engine and landmarking engine for elbow auto align
abstract: A method to automatically align magnetic resonance (MR) scans for diagnostic scan planning includes acquiring a three-dimensional (3D) localizer image of an anatomical object. One or more initial landmarks are identified in the 3D localizer image using a landmarking engine. One or more main axes associated with the anatomical object are identified based on the one or more initial landmarks. The 3D localizer image is registered to a canonical space based on the main axes associated to yield a registered 3D localizer image. The landmarking engine is applied to the registered 3D localizer image to yield one or more updated landmarks. A plurality of reference points for performing a MR scan are computed based on the one or more updated landmarks.

title: Medical internet of things device discovery
abstract: Devices and methods for internet of things (IOT) discovery/auto discovery are described. A discovery packet is received from a device. The discovery packet includes a first stream identifier and a request to establish a second stream. A stream acceptance packet is sent to the device. The stream acceptance packet includes the first stream identifier and an input for generating a second stream identifier. A first association is added to the registration based on the request to establish the second stream. The first association is between the second stream identifier and a determined destination. A first data packet is received from the device, where the first data packet includes/utilizes the second stream identifier. The first data packet is sent to the destination based on the first association in the registration.

title: Systems and methods for soft tissue navigation
abstract: There are provided systems and methods for soft tissue navigation. A sensor unit provides tracking information to determine positional data for a patient's structural anatomy and gravity direction measurements to determine a direction of gravity relative to the anatomy. A computing unit, during a procedure, computes the direction of gravity and determines spatial information for soft tissues of the patient, responsive to the direction of gravity. Expected soft tissue movement may be provided by a computer model modelling the mechanics of the soft tissues responsive to the direction of gravity, or by other means such as look up table. Surgical navigation data is presented via a display unit. Medical images may be registered and navigation provided relative to the images. Tool positions may be tracked via the sensor unit. Spatial differences in soft tissues between orientations of the patient (relative to gravity) may be determined and presented.

title: Apparatus and method for estimating bio-information
abstract: An apparatus for estimating bio-information, includes a pulse wave sensor configured to measure a pulse wave signal from a user, and a processor configured to obtain two or more parameters among a maximum point, an average point, and an onset point, from a waveform of the measured pulse wave signal, and combine the obtained two or more parameters to generate a pulse wave analysis result.

title: Remote operation appointment method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京天智航医疗技术服务有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a remote operation appointment method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target appointment mode and target appointment information selected by a current appointment user; determining a target diagnosis-accepting specialist and target operation appointment time based on the target diagnosis-accepting mode and the target diagnosis-accepting information, and generating a target diagnosis-accepting request; sending the target diagnosis request to a target diagnosis client; if the response information of agreeing to see is received, which is sent by the target client side to see, a target operation creating request is generated based on the target operation appointment time and the current appointment user information; sending a target operation creating request to a remote control end so that the remote control end creates a remote appointment operation corresponding to a current appointment user and feeds back operation creating success information; if the operation creation success information is received, the operation appointment success information is displayed, so that online quick appointment of the remote operation is realized, the remote operation appointment efficiency is improved, and the on-time execution of the remote operation is effectively ensured.
assignee_clean: 北京天智航医疗技术服务有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京天智航医疗技术服务有限公司

title: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for portraying organization
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a portrait method, a portrait device, portrait equipment and portrait storage media of an organization. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first data and second data of an organization to be portrayed, wherein the first data comprises operation data of the organization to be portrayed, and the second data comprises industry data of an industry to which the organization to be portrayed belongs; inputting the first data and the second data into a preset portrait model to obtain and display the portrait of the organization to be portrait; the portraits of the organization to be portrayed are used for providing reference bases for decision information of the organization to be portrayed, and the decision information comprises resource allocation information and/or operation suggestion information; the preset portrait model is obtained by training a random forest based on first sample data and training a decision tree based on second sample data, and fusing two training results, wherein the first sample data comprises historical operation data of a plurality of organizations, and the second sample data comprises historical industry data of industries to which the organizations belong.
assignee_clean: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司

title: Power aware switching using analytics
abstract: A method is described and, in one embodiment, includes: for each of a plurality of outgoing ports of the first network element: collecting data comprising a number of packets arriving at the outgoing port within a first time interval and an amount of power consumed by the outgoing port; calculating a packet per watt ("P/W") metric for the port over a first time interval, wherein the P/W metric comprises a number of packets entering the port during the first time interval divided by an amount of power consumed by the port; repeating the collecting and calculating for a number of consecutive time intervals; calculating an average P/W metric over a time period including a first time interval and consecutive time intervals; and calculating a variance over a time period comprising the first time interval and the successive time intervals; and redirecting traffic received at the network element to the outgoing port having the lowest variance.

title: Intelligent auxiliary interpretation method for thyroid capsule invasion
assignee: 福州大学, 福建医科大学附属协和医院
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent auxiliary interpretation method for thyroid capsule invasion. The method mainly adopts a biomedical image segmentation method which is self-developed by the research and provides high-efficiency local-global fusion and a parallel network of a transducer and a CNN. The model provided by the research is convenient to use, a thyroid ultrasonic picture is input, a positioning and segmentation picture with suspected thyroid nodule can be output, a thyroid nodule preliminary interpretation result is automatically obtained, the film reading time and diagnosis difficulty of doctors can be greatly reduced, the working efficiency of the doctors is improved, positive effects are mentioned for judging prognosis of thyroid nodule patients and improving treatment means, and the model has very important significance and broad prospects.
assignee_clean: 福州大学; 福建医科大学附属协和医院

title: Information processing method and device
assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
abstract: The disclosure provides an information processing method and device, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as deep learning and knowledge maps. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring terms to be classified; retrieving the terms in a corpus to obtain at least one paragraph text; respectively scoring the at least one paragraph text; selecting a preset number of paragraph texts as contexts according to the order of the scores from high to low; the terms and the context are input into a first pre-trained language model, and a first classification result of the terms is output. The method can effectively reduce the construction cost of the term system and improve the map construction efficiency.
assignee_clean: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

title: Method and system for establishing entity recognition model, electronic equipment and medium
assignee: 明品云(北京)数据科技有限公司
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of data processing, and provides a method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium for establishing an entity recognition model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining text data in a target field to obtain an entity data set, and dividing the entity data set into a data set to be marked and a data set to be processed; carrying out synonym replacement on the data set to be processed to obtain a processed data set; determining a new word data set in the processing data set according to the word meaning similarity of the data set to be labeled and the processing data set, and labeling the data set to be labeled and the new word data set to obtain a labeled data set; pre-training a data set to be processed by adopting an information extraction method based on the labeled data set to obtain a pre-training data set; the initial entity recognition model is trained by adopting the pre-training data set, and the target entity recognition model is output, so that the problems of small scale and the like of high-quality labeled corpus in the prior art are solved.
assignee_clean: 明品云 北京 数据科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 明品云 北京 数据科技有限公司

title: Text error correction method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses a text error correction method, a text error correction device, text error correction equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the field of digital medical treatment and comprise the following steps: acquiring text characteristics of initial text information, and determining a text to be retrieved according to the text characteristics; determining target domain knowledge from a domain intelligence library based on the text to be retrieved; and generating a text sequence to be corrected according to the text to be retrieved and the target domain knowledge, and correcting the text to be retrieved based on the text sequence to be corrected so as to realize the correction of the initial text information. By adopting the method and the device, the text can be corrected by associating the domain knowledge, and the text correction accuracy is improved.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method, device and equipment for segmenting cardiac medical image and storage medium
assignee: 广东省人民医院(广东省医学科学院), 广东省心血管病研究所
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for segmenting a cardiac medical image, which are characterized in that a 3D cardiac medical image to be segmented is firstly obtained, and a compartment and a cardiac muscle are segmented through a 3D U-net neural network to obtain a preliminary cardiac segmentation image; performing blood pool segmentation through a 2D U-net neural network to obtain a blood pool segmentation image; removing images belonging to the atrioventricular part in the blood pool segmentation image to obtain a blood vessel image, and optimizing the primary heart segmentation image according to the blood vessel image to obtain a heart segmentation image of the 3D heart medical image to be segmented; and extracting a blood vessel skeleton line in the blood vessel image, obtaining a blood vessel skeleton line graph to be matched, matching the blood vessel skeleton line graph with a prestored blood vessel skeleton line graph, segmenting the pulmonary artery and the aorta in the blood vessel image according to a matching result, and obtaining a blood vessel segmentation image of the 3D heart medical image to be segmented. By implementing the invention, the heart medical image with the missing heart structure can be segmented, and more boundary shape change information of blood vessels can be reserved.
assignee_clean: 广东省人民医院 广东省医学科学院; 广东省心血管病研究所
primary_assignee: 广东省人民医院 广东省医学科学院

title: Multi-functional personalized patch with therapeutic properties
abstract: Carefully coordinated patches having camouflaging and/or benefit properties can be formed for application to a desired region of human skin. The patches include a flexible film having a first, adhesive, outwardly facing major surface and a second outwardly facing surface which is textured to correspond to skin covered by the patch during use; wherein the flexible film further comprises at least one pigmented region and at least one region adapted to modify one or more optical properties selected from the group consisting of light transmission, light reflection, and light absorption. Methods of custom use of such patches may include 3D printing processes.

title: Disease prediction method based on dynamic graph and medical knowledge map and related equipment
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment, and discloses a disease prediction method based on a dynamic graph and a medical knowledge graph and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a graph structure corresponding to a medical knowledge graph of historical diagnosis and treatment data in sample medical data, and determining an initial knowledge characterization vector and an initial state characterization vector of each node in the graph structure; updating to obtain a knowledge characterization vector and a state characterization vector of each node according to historical diagnosis and treatment data; inputting the knowledge characterization vector and the state characterization vector of each node into a multilayer perceptron model to obtain outcome data of each user, and training the multilayer perceptron model according to the outcome data to obtain a disease prediction model; target medical data of the user to be tested are input into the disease prediction model, predicted outcome data of the next visit of the user to be tested are obtained, and accuracy of a disease prediction result is improved by means of a dynamic graph technology. The invention relates to a block chain technology, and the predicted ending data can be stored in the block chain.
assignee_clean: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Instrumented handheld tool for measuring upper extremity freezing
abstract: An apparatus, system and process for measuring, tracking, and analyzing unintentional muscle movements associated with upper body freezing of a user while using a handheld tool are described. The method may include receiving signals from a motion sensor of a handheld tool, the signals indicating motions of the handheld tool when used by a user during an activity. The method may also include analyzing the motions of the handheld tool. The method may also include detecting motions of the handheld tool having one or more predetermined characteristics. Furthermore, the method can include determining that the user experienced an upper extremity freezing while using the handheld tool during the activity based on the detected one or more predetermined characteristics.

title: Angiography image determination method and angiography image determination device
assignee: 仁寶電腦工業股份有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure provide an angiography image determination method and an angiography image determination device. The method includes: obtaining a plurality of first images of a body part injected with a contrast media; obtaining a plurality of corresponding second images by performing a first image preprocessing operation on each first image; obtaining a pixel statistical characteristic of each second image; finding a candidate image based on the pixel statistical characteristic of each second image; and finding a reference image corresponding to the candidate image among the plurality of first images.
assignee_clean: 仁寶電腦工業股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 仁寶電腦工業股份有限公司

title: Disaster response management system
abstract: A disaster response management system may include a device processor; and a non-transitory computer readable medium including instructions executable by the device processor to perform the following steps: receiving location data from a personal electronic device of a user; sending instructions for selectively displaying, based on the received location data, a list of one or more disaster response items which the user may commit to provide; and receiving a selection of the user committing to provide one of the selectively displayed disaster response items.

title: Control device and control method for robot system
abstract: The present disclosure provides a control device and a control method that can improve controllability and storage efficiency of operation objects having different attributes. The control device is a control device for a robot system including an operation robot for operating an operation target by depositing and/or removing the operation target on and/or from a pallet, and includes: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including information on an operation target and information on a pallet before the operation target is stacked on and/or removed from the pallet; a data storage unit that stores first data; and a robot control unit that creates a control sequence for depositing and/or removing the operation target on and/or from the pallet based on the first data before depositing and/or removing the operation target from and/or from the pallet, and instructs the robot to perform a task for depositing and/or removing the operation target from and/or to the pallet based on the control sequence.

title: Speech recognition system
abstract: A speech recognition system is provided. A speech recognition system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes: a voice recognition agent for receiving voice data from a user and transmitting the voice data to an artificial intelligence server; and an artificial intelligence server for inputting voice data into the voice recognition model, transmitting a recognition result for the voice data to the voice recognition agent, and learning the voice data, wherein the voice recognition agent requests additional data for learning the voice of the user to the user when the voice recognition rate of the voice data is lower than a preset reference.

title: Heart blood flow vector imaging method based on ultrasonic image and deep learning
assignee: 西南石油大学, 四川省人民医院
abstract: The invention provides a cardiac blood flow vector imaging method based on ultrasonic image and depth learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a two-dimensional color Doppler ultrasonic cardiogram image of ultrasonic equipment after color coding; extracting a left ventricle area; performing color blood flow information compensation on the left ventricle area; and extracting a radial velocity component using the velocity scale; identifying a left ventricular intimal contour of the left ventricular region using the trained U-Net model; reconstructing an echocardiographic sequence for the two-dimensional color Doppler echocardiographic image; performing motion tracking on the left ventricular intima by using a PWC-Net model retrained by the ultrasonic simulation image, and determining the tangential velocity of the left ventricular intima; and synthesizing a flow field of the left ventricular blood by using the radial velocity component and the tangential velocity component, and visualizing the flow field, wherein the visualization method comprises drawing a velocity vector diagram and a plane flow diagram.
assignee_clean: 西南石油大学; 四川省人民医院

title: Dynamic magnetic resonance imaging method, device, reconstruction computer and magnetic resonance system
assignee: 上海东软医疗科技有限公司, 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a dynamic magnetic resonance imaging method, a dynamic magnetic resonance imaging device, a reconstruction computer and a magnetic resonance system. According to the embodiment of the invention, the K space data of a plurality of time frames obtained by performing dynamic magnetic resonance down-sampling on the examinee according to the preset sampling track is obtained, the sampling density of the middle area of the K space in the preset sampling track is greater than that of the peripheral area of the K space, the K space data of the time frames are reconstructed by adopting a preset reconstruction algorithm for each time frame in the plurality of time frames to obtain the primary reconstruction image corresponding to the time frame, the primary image sequence formed by all the primary reconstruction images corresponding to the plurality of time frames is input into the pre-trained deep learning network model to obtain the target image sequence output after the deep learning network model is optimized, and the reconstruction speed of dynamic magnetic resonance imaging can be improved under the conditions of high multiple acceleration and imaging quality guarantee.
assignee_clean: 上海东软医疗科技有限公司; 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海东软医疗科技有限公司

title: In-situ additive manufactured motion-sparing implants
abstract: An additive-manufacturing system for printing spinal implants in-situ, within a patient, is disclosed. The system may include a robotic subsystem having scanning and imaging equipment and an armature including at least one dispensing nozzle and a controller apparatus having a processor and a non-transitory computer-readable medium. The controller may control the scanning and imaging equipment to determine a target alignment of a patients spine, develop an in-situ-printing plan including an in-situ material selection plan based on the target alignment of the patients spine, an interbody access space, and a disc space between adjacent vertebra of the patients spine, and execute the in-situ-printing plan. The controller may further control the armature to dispense at least one material chosen from a rigid material and a pliable material to form at least one motion-sparing implant.

title: Using cohorts to infer attributes for an input case in a question answering system
abstract: A cohort analysis mechanism analyzes cohorts to infer one or more additional attributes for an input case to provide a refined input case to answer a question in a question answering system. The refined input case is then used to answer a question in the question answering system. The refined input case can be used in a traditional question answering flow or in a flow that again uses cohort analysis to extract relevant data to answer the question. The cohort analysis mechanism analyzes cohorts to find common attributes in the cohorts and then determines whether to infer the common attributes into the refined input case. The cohort analysis mechanism may determine to dialog with a user to confirm an inferred attribute.

title: Risk rating method and system
abstract: A risk rating method and system that predicts the risk likelihood, the risk impact, and the risk rating of certain threats and vulnerabilities from exploiting different component groups. In some embodiments, the system's predictions (also referred to herein as inferences) are generated based on data elements provided by a user about its organization's information systems. In further embodiments, the method and system utilizes data mining, historical records, and an AI Engine to provide the predictions for the risk likelihood, the risk impact, and the risk rating posed by the various threat occurrences.

title: Imaging support device and storage medium storing imaging support program
assignee: 佳能医疗系统株式会社
abstract: The imaging support device according to the embodiment is for supporting imaging of a medical image diagnostic apparatus that performs a series of examinations including a plurality of scan protocols, and includes a processing circuit. The processing circuit acquires data collected by a captured one of the plurality of scanning protocols. The processing circuit controls a scanning protocol after the photographed scanning protocol or generates reference information related to control of the scanning protocol after the photographed scanning protocol when a portion in which a disease or a suspected disease exists is extracted from the data.
assignee_clean: 佳能医疗系统株式会社
primary_assignee: 佳能医疗系统株式会社

title: Lung lesion segmentation method for realizing practicality based on bilateral learning branch
abstract: The invention discloses a method for realizing practical lung lesion segmentation based on bilateral learning branches, which belongs to the technical field of medical images and comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring a lung data set; s2: preprocessing each image in the lung data set to obtain a preprocessed lung data set; s3: and segmenting the preprocessed lung data set by utilizing a focus image segmentation network to obtain a focus area. The method can solve the problems that the existing convolutional neural network has large calculation cost in the field of medical images due to the imbalance of global semantics and local details when modeling global information, and the Transformer and the multilayer perceptron (MLP), and can improve the reasoning speed and reduce the calculation cost on the basis of accurately segmenting inflammatory lesion areas in lung CT images according to the characteristic that interstitial pneumonia lesion areas have irregular size and form change.

title: Monitoring conditions associated with remote individuals over a data communication network and automatically notifying responsive to detecting customized emergency conditions
assignee: Trungram Gyaltrul R. Sherpa, David H. C. Chen
abstract: Individuals are remotely monitored over a data communication network to automatically detect and responds to anomalous conditions. A user account of a plurality of user accounts is configured for remote monitoring for emergency conditions of monitored individuals. A monitoring device can be wearable and in physical contact with a first individual. A notifying device can also be wearable for a second individual for notification of emergency conditions. An anomalous condition is detected. The monitoring device includes sensors that measure conditions within and around the first individual, and send readings to the anomalous condition server for analysis. An alert is sent responsive to the anomaly determination, from the network communication interface, to the notifying device, according to personalized settings of the second individual.
assignee_clean: trungram gyaltrul r sherpa; david h c chen

title: Pruning process execution logs
abstract: Methods and systems for pruning process execution logs include learning a predictive model from a set of execution traces that characterize a process, where the predictive model determines a likelihood of a given instance reaching a specified outcome; identifying attributes in the predictive model that fall below a threshold measure of relevance to the specified outcome using a processor; and removing the identified attributes from the set of execution traces.

title: Method and apparatus for processing data units by an IAB node in a wireless communication system
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for transmitting by an Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB) node configured with a first BAP address associated with a first home IAB node and a second BAP address associated with a second home IAB node in a wireless communication system. Specifically, the method comprises the following steps: receiving a packet including a destination BAP address and a path Identifier (ID); determining whether the destination BAP address and path ID of the packet match at least one entry in the configured overwrite table based on the packet being received over the second link and the destination BAP address not matching the second BAP address; and based on the destination BAP address and the path ID of the packet matching at least one entry, rewriting a header of the packet by setting the destination BAP address and the path ID of the packet according to the at least one entry, and transmitting the packet to the next hop node.

title: Standardized system for screening operation modes
assignee: 曜立科技(北京)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a standardized method and a standardized system for screening surgical modes, wherein first disease information of a first user is obtained under the consent or authorization of the first user; obtaining the disease type and disease level of the first disease information; using the disease type and the disease grade as a first screening condition of a surgical mode; obtaining a second screening condition of the operation mode according to the subjective intention information, the expense amount information, the visit area information and the doctor selection information of the first user; inputting the first screening condition and the second screening condition into a surgical screening model to obtain a first surgical mode; sending the first operation mode to a user side of the first user to obtain a first implementation instruction; performing a procedure on the first user according to the first surgical approach in accordance with the first implementation instructions. The technical problem that the operation in the prior art can not be intelligently selected according to the actual condition and the related will of an operator is solved.
assignee_clean: 曜立科技 北京 有限公司
primary_assignee: 曜立科技 北京 有限公司

title: Construction management method and system of intelligent city regional child management mechanism based on Internet of things
assignee: 成都秦川物联网科技股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides a construction management method and a system of a smart city regional child management mechanism based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring population related data of a historical target time period through an object platform based on a sensing network platform; predicting a population number of children for a future target time period based on population-related data; determining a construction plan of a child management mechanism based on the population number of the children; the construction plan includes the number of institutions; and feeding the construction plan back to the user through the user platform based on the service platform.
assignee_clean: 成都秦川物联网科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 成都秦川物联网科技股份有限公司

title: Method for designing and verifying the shape and position of a cannula for a patient by simulating the insertion of a trachea
assignee: 巴黎公共救济院, 凡尔赛大学
abstract: The invention relates to a method of designing a cannula for a patient, wherein a processing unit is configured to implement the steps of: a) generating a 2D or 3D numerical representation of at least one location of the trachea of the patient, b) identifying a set of anatomical landmarks, c) considering the 2D or 3D numerical representation of the cannula based at least on said landmarks, D) numerically modeling the insertion of the cannula in whole or in part into the trachea, e) estimating at least one mutual conflict measure between the cannula and the trachea during the insertion, f) changing the cannula when the estimated conflict measure does not meet a predetermined conflict criterion, and iterating at least one of the preceding steps until a cannula is found for which the estimated conflict measure meets the predetermined conflict criterion.
assignee_clean: 巴黎公共救济院; 凡尔赛大学

title: Method, device and storage medium for nipple positioning
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a nipple positioning method, a nipple positioning device and a nipple positioning storage medium, and belongs to the field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a gray level image of a target image; acquiring a target area image according to the gray level image; determining a first image area positioned outside the curve in the target area image; determining a nipple type by detecting whether a connected region having an area greater than a preset area exists in the first image region, and determining a nipple position according to the nipple type. According to the embodiment of the invention, the nipple types are divided into the convex nipple and the concave nipple, and the nipple positioning is carried out according to the nipple types by combining the morphological characteristics of the breast tissue area without searching, so that the calculation complexity caused by determining the searching direction and traversing a large number of irrelevant pixels in the searching process is reduced, the calculation efficiency is improved, and the positioning accuracy is improved by considering the morphological characteristics of the breast tissue area.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Method, device, and medium for data processing
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method, a device and a computer-readable storage medium for data processing. The method for data processing comprises: obtaining a set of observation samples regarding a plurality of factors, one of the set of observation samples comprising respective observed values of the plurality of factors. The method further comprises: estimating, for each of the plurality of factors and based on the set of observation samples, a distribution that differences between observed values of the factor and estimated values of the factor follow. The method further comprises determining, based at least on the estimated distribution, a causal structure representing a causal relationship among the plurality of factors. Embodiments of the present disclosure further provide a device and a computer-readable storage medium for implementing the above method. The embodiments of the present disclosure can accurately and robustly discover the causal relationship among a plurality of factors without making any assumptions about the relationship between the data distribution and the factors, and affect the observed value of the target factor based on the causal relationship.

title: A kind of multi-functional joint recovering telecontrol equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a kind of multi-functional joint recovering telecontrol equipments, can be used in passive and active the exercise rehabilitation training process of wrist joint, elbow joint, hip joint, knee joint, ankle-joint.The athletic rehabilitation telecontrol equipment is made of X-direction movement mould group, Y-direction movement mould group, control button module, Wireless Display controller, support column, the fixed part such as bracket and restraint strap, movement miscellaneous function can be provided for rehabilitations such as wrist joint, elbow joint, hip joint, knee joint, ankle-joints according to the rehabilitation demands flexible assembling application in different joints.The utility model realizes the unification of the process control of a variety of joint recovering movements, has the function of self study, memory, storage and reproduction etc., improves medical care efficiency, promote the scientific rationality of joint recovering movement, has important application and popularization value.

title: Selection of identifiers
abstract: An apparatus comprising an input to receive identifier parameters for one or more identifiers, where the identifiers are displayable at a display device mounted or mountable in a vehicle. The apparatus may comprise a storage device to store identifier parameters for at least one of the one or more identifiers. The apparatus may also comprise a locating module to determine a location parameter relating to the display device. Also the apparatus may comprise a processor to select an identifier for display at the display device based, at least in part, on the stored identifier parameters for one of the one or more identifiers matching the location parameter relating to the display device.

title: Model based adaptive multi-elliptical approach: a one click 3D segmentation approach
abstract: A seed point is selected inside a structure that is to be segmented in image data. An adaptive model is defined around the seed point, and a preprocessing filter is applied only within the bounding region. A presegmentation of the preprocessed result is performed, and the bounding region is expanded if necessary to accommodate the presegmentation result. An adaptive model for post-processing may be used. The model is translated, rotated and scaled to find a best fit with the pre-segmented data. Additional models can be grown based on testing performed on points on a perimeter of previous models to improve the segmentation of an object.

title: Intelligent wheelchair control mode switching method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent wheelchair control mode switching method, which is characterized in that an environment image is acquired in real time when a wheelchair moves in an automatic control mode, when the image identifies that the wheelchair is about to enter a narrow boundary space, the distance between the wheelchair and the narrow boundary space is smaller than a first distance, a prompt message is output to prompt a user that the wheelchair is about to be switched, and when the distance is smaller than a second smaller distance, the wheelchair is controlled to be switched into a man-machine interaction control mode; if the image identifies that the intelligent wheelchair leaves the narrow boundary space, the control wheelchair is switched into an automatic control mode, so that the intelligent wheelchair can be switched into a man-machine interaction control mode when entering the narrow boundary space, and is switched back into the automatic control mode after leaving the narrow boundary space, so that the self-adaptive switching of the automatic control mode and the man-machine interaction control mode is realized, and the control accuracy and the safety are improved.

title: Method, apparatus, and system for dynamic beacons address allocation
abstract: An approach is provided for dynamic beacons address allocation. The approach involves reporting, by each child node of a beacon tree structure, to a parent node, a load collection packet including a load count of each child node. Each child node is either a leaf node or a parent node. The parent node is either a root node or a child node reporting to another node. The parent node is located on a shortest path from a leaf node to the root node. The load count is a total number of the other nodes reporting to the parent node plus one. The approach also involves receiving, by each child node from the parent node, an address distribution packet that includes a contiguous logical address range and a weighted distance to the root node (WDR). The WDR and/or the tree structure are provided as an input for a drone navigation task.

title: Safety monitoring device for radiotherapy room
abstract: The utility model discloses a safety monitoring device used in a radiotherapy room, which comprises a safety detection module before radiotherapy, a respiration monitor, a camera group, a safety detection module of the radiotherapy room and a radiotherapy instrument; the safety detection module before radiotherapy is provided with identity recognition equipment, a patient information database and metal detection equipment; the respiration monitor is used for monitoring a respiration signal of a patient; the camera group is used for acquiring video image information and patient posture information in a radiotherapy room; the camera group collects the posture information of the patient and combines the patient posture formed by the respiratory monitor with the respiratory signal to judge the treatment abnormity; the radiotherapy room safety detection module is used for analyzing and processing the video image information collected by the camera group; the device and the method monitor the safety in the radiotherapy room, and simultaneously monitor the patient before and during radiotherapy in real time, thereby effectively ensuring the safety problem of the radiotherapy room and reducing the incidence rate of medical accidents.

title: Symptom identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 数坤(北京)网络科技股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a symptom identification method, a symptom identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an analysis image sequence to be detected; extracting a to-be-detected focus region corresponding to the analysis image sequence and first symptom information corresponding to the to-be-detected focus region; performing sign recognition on the lesion area to be detected and the first sign information to obtain second sign information; determining a target lesion area corresponding to the lesion area to be detected according to the first sign information and the second sign information; according to the embodiment of the application, the first symptom information which is input by a user and a worker based on the image sequence and corresponds to the to-be-detected focus region and the to-be-detected focus region is extracted, the first symptom information which corresponds to the to-be-detected focus region and the to-be-detected focus region is subjected to secondary symptom identification, the symptom information which is missed or lacked in the to-be-detected focus region is searched, and the problem of missing detection in AI analysis is solved.
assignee_clean: 数坤 北京 网络科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 数坤 北京 网络科技股份有限公司

title: Lung cancer automatic identification system based on self-learning artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention provides a lung cancer automatic identification system based on self-learning artificial intelligence, which comprises an image acquisition subsystem: acquiring a lung cancer puncture sample, and then acquiring an image to obtain a color microscopic image; a color processing subsystem: performing color recognition analysis on the color microscopic image, and obtaining a plurality of potential lung cancer area image blocks through the color recognition analysis; a shape processing subsystem: performing image block shape analysis, and obtaining a plurality of suspicious lung cancer area image blocks through the image block shape analysis; a combined processing subsystem: taking the plurality of potential lung cancer area image blocks and the plurality of suspicious lung cancer area image blocks as the input of an artificial intelligent identification model, and outputting an identification result; the result display subsystem: the display device is used for displaying a plurality of areas contained in the recognition result in a hierarchical mode. According to the technical scheme, the array and stack combination is executed respectively aiming at the image and the shape characteristics and is used as AI identification input through a double preprocessing technology, and the accuracy of automatic lung cancer identification is improved.

title: Soft bag detection device
assignee: 成都布兰特科技有限公司
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection devices, in particular to a soft bag detection device, which comprises an inclined conveying line for conveying soft bags, wherein the inclined conveying line comprises an upper inclined conveying mechanism and a lower inclined conveying mechanism, at least one lamp detection station and/or leakage detection module is arranged on the upper inclined conveying mechanism, and at least one lamp detection station and/or leakage detection module is arranged on the lower inclined conveying mechanism. The soft bag detection device is simple in structure, can realize lamp detection operation, can also realize leakage condition detection, can also finish lamp detection and leakage detection of the soft bag simultaneously, and the soft bag can cover the whole bag body area through the transportation of the upper inclined conveying mechanism and the lower inclined conveying mechanism in the detection process, so that the comprehensiveness of the detection area is ensured, the conveying is more stable, the structure is simple, the false detection probability is reduced, the detection accuracy is improved, and the equipment cost and the operation cost are reduced simultaneously.
assignee_clean: 成都布兰特科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 成都布兰特科技有限公司

title: Federal learning method, equipment and system based on optimal federal party selection
assignee: 济南中科泛在智能计算研究院
abstract: The invention discloses a federal learning method and a federal learning system based on optimal federal party selection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data set meta-information of all federation computing equipment and storing the data set meta-information in a federation state database; receiving a data set selection instruction submitted by a data user; wherein the selected data set is used for executing the federal training task; according to the data set selected by the data user and the information in the federation side state database, adopting an optimal federation side computing equipment selection algorithm to select a plurality of federation side computing equipment to perform the federation learning task; judging the working state of each selected federal computing device, if the working state is normal, generating a configuration file, sending the configuration file to the federal computing device, performing federal training by the federal computing device according to the configuration file, outputting a federal trained model, and feeding back the federal trained model to a data user; if the working state is abnormal, returning to the previous step.

title: Image reconstruction method, device and storage medium
assignee: 京东科技控股股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image reconstruction method, an image reconstruction device and a storage medium; the image reconstruction method comprises the following steps: acquiring projection sequence data; the projection sequence data represents an image sequence obtained by scanning an object by using scanning rays; generating an initial reconstructed image using the projection sequence data; generating a feature map of the initial reconstructed image by adopting a preset feature extraction model to obtain at least one feature map corresponding to the initial reconstructed image; and generating a reconstructed image by utilizing at least one characteristic map, and completing image reconstruction aiming at the projection sequence data.

title: Application system based on AIE engine platform
assignee: 江苏园上园智能科技有限公司
abstract: The utility model relates to an application system based on AIE engine platform, it includes: the user equipment layer is suitable for sending corresponding interactive information; the user data acquisition layer is suitable for acquiring user data; the user data acquisition layer is suitable for receiving the interactive information, generating feedback information according to the interactive information and the user data, and sending the feedback information to the user equipment layer; the user equipment layer is suitable for displaying feedback information; the user data acquisition layer is suitable for sending user data to the logic data processing layer; the logic data processing layer is suitable for processing and summarizing user data to form a data set of a corresponding user and sending the data set to the data center; the data center is suitable for continuously storing the data set of the user, the problem of stickiness of the client is fundamentally solved, the client re-trip rate is greatly enhanced, the operation experience content adjustment cost is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the innovation and the upgrade of real-time interactive experience are formed by combining personalized experience data.

title: Neural network model fusion method and electronic device using the same
assignee: 財團法人工業技術研究院
abstract:
A neural network model fusion method and an electronic device using the same are provided. The neural network model fusion method includes the following steps. An image is received. The images are analyzed through several neural network models. The neural network models include at least two of a degree classification model, a multi-class identification model and an object detection model. Several analysis results are obtained according to the neural network models. These analysis results are converted into a number 
of conversion factors. The conversion factors are inputted into a fusion model to obtain a fusion result.

title: Auditing system for machine learning decision system
abstract: Computer systems and associated methods are disclosed to implement a decision model auditing system that allows clients of a machine learning decision system to audit the decision-making process the decision system. In embodiments, the decision system is instrumented with reporting code to collect internal decision data of the decision system and send the data to a decision auditing service. In embodiments, the auditing service provides the client with an obfuscated token, which may be used to anonymize the client requests to the decision system. As client requests are handled by the decision system, the reporting code generates audit messages to the auditing service. The auditing service stores the audit information, which may later be provided to the client or used generate an audit report. In embodiments, the audit report may indicate whether the decision system contains any undesired bias.

title: Information recommendation method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: 平安银行股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application discloses an information recommendation method, an information recommendation device, information recommendation equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method may include: classifying first information of the first user in the target system by using the behavior topic model to obtain a classification result of the behavior topic of the first user; carrying out attenuation processing on first information of a first user under each action topic in a plurality of action topics by adopting a preset attenuation factor to obtain second information of the first user under each action topic; performing similarity analysis on the second information of the first user and the behavior information of the second user based on a similarity analysis model under a plurality of behavior topics respectively to obtain the behavior similarity of the first user and the second user under each behavior topic so as to determine the user similarity of the first user and the second user; and recommending information to the first user according to the user similarity. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the reliability of information recommendation is improved.
assignee_clean: 平安银行股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 平安银行股份有限公司

title: Abdominal lymph node partitioning method based on attention mechanism neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of abdominal lymph node partition, in particular to an abdominal lymph node partition method based on an attention mechanism neural network, which is used for solving the problems that in the prior art, doctors have large difference in film reading results of the same abdominal CT medical image and inaccurate prediction of abdominal lymph node partition is carried out. The invention comprises the following steps: step 1: preparing data; step 2: generating a mask, and preprocessing data; and step 3: constructing an attention mechanism residual error network model; and 4, step 4: repeating the step 3, and constructing and training a lymph node relative position partition model; and 5: and (4) classifying the abdominal lymph nodes automatically detected by the detection task by using the model trained in the steps 3 and 4. According to the method, the original CT image and the mask are superposed to be used as input, and an attention mechanism is introduced to the depth residual error neural network, so that abdominal lymph nodes in the CT image can be accurately partitioned.

title: Improved spatial spectrum fusion hyperspectral calculation reconstruction method based on ADMM framework
abstract: The invention discloses an improved spatial spectrum fusion hyperspectral calculation reconstruction method based on an ADMM frame, wherein a medical hyperspectral image is subjected to coded aperture snapshot type spectral imaging to obtain a medical hyperspectral measured value, and the medical hyperspectral measured value is vectorized; carrying out optimization solution on the medical hyperspectral measured value after vectorization by adopting a Lagrangian multiplier method with constraint terms to obtain an optimization solution expression; and solving and iterating the prior term in the optimization solving expression by using an improved spatial spectrum fusion denoising method, and obtaining a reconstruction value of the medical hyperspectral image when the iteration times reach the preset times. And carrying out reconstruction solution on the inverse problem of the computed imaging based on the ADMM optimization framework, and adding a dual constraint term based on hyperspectral image prior to limit the direction of image reconstruction. The hyperspectral image is denoised through the improved spatial spectrum fusion network, and the optimization direction of the ADMM can be corrected by the prior constraint after denoising, so that the calculation reconstruction achieves a satisfactory effect.

title: Fracture detection method and device
assignee: 青岛海信医疗设备股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a fracture detection method and device, which are used for improving the automatic fracture detection accuracy and the working efficiency. The application provides a fracture detection method, which comprises the following steps: determining a rib detection frame of a chest image of a fracture patient; determining the probability value of fracture of the rib in each rib detection frame; and outputting a fracture detection result based on the probability value of fracture of the rib in each rib detection frame, wherein the fracture detection result comprises rib detection frame information used for representing whether the rib is fractured or not.
assignee_clean: 青岛海信医疗设备股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 青岛海信医疗设备股份有限公司

title: Automated management of data transformation flows based on semantics
abstract: Various embodiments are provided for intelligent management of data flows in a computing environment by a processor. One or more data transformation in time-series data applications templates may be created and managed according to concepts, one or more instances of the concepts, relationships between the concepts, and a mapping of the concepts to one or more data sources.

title: System, method, and computer program product for segmenting users in a region based on predicted activity
abstract: A method of segmenting a plurality of users in a first region based on predicted activity external to the first region. A system and computer program product are also provided.

title: Balance compensation
assignee: Cochlear Limited, University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
abstract: Disclosed technology includes technology for compensating for a balance dysfunction. A system can combine sensory substitution with balance dysfunction suppression. Dysfunctional balance information coming from a recipient's vestibular system is inhibited using stimulation. Balance information (e.g. how the recipient is positioned with respect to gravity, such as rotation along pitch and roll axes) is then passed to another sensory channel (e.g., visual, audible, or tactile sensory channels). Such a system can be implemented with a cochlear implant or another sensory prostheses having balance signals injected into the stimulation signal processing path.
assignee_clean: cochlear; university of las palmas de gran canaria

title: Method, device and medium for generating question-answer data set based on chest radiography report
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for generating a question and answer data set based on a chest radiography report, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1, acquiring an original chest radiograph report; step S2, simplifying the original chest film report based on part-of-speech coding to obtain a simplified chest film report and a corresponding part-of-speech coding file; and step S3, generating a question and answer data set of the chest film report according to the simplified chest film report and the corresponding part-of-speech code file. The invention can greatly simplify the complex original chest radiography report, not only retains the key information of the chest radiography report, but also improves the structurality of the chest radiography report. Furthermore, the method based on part-of-speech coding has general applicability, and can be applied to analysis of various video reports as long as corresponding words in the video reports are collected. The question-answer data set generated by the invention can be used as an open data set for researching the chest radiography.

title: Method and system for providing anatomical orientation indicators
assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
abstract: The present invention provides a system and method for providing anatomical orientation indicators having a patient-specific model of an anatomical structure of interest extracted from a three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound volume. The method includes extracting the anatomical structure of interest from the 3D volume and generating a patient-specific model of the anatomical structure of interest. The method includes generating an anatomical orientation indicator that includes at least one model of a simulated patient anatomy of an anatomy adjacent to the anatomy of interest at a position and orientation relative to the patient-specific model. The method includes displaying the anatomical orientation indicator with the patient-specific model at the same first viewpoint. The method includes receiving an instruction to change a viewpoint of the patient-specific model to a second viewpoint, and updating a display of the anatomical orientation indicator with the patient-specific model to the second viewpoint.
assignee_clean: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司
primary_assignee: 通用电气精准医疗有限责任公司

title: Device, system and method for generating geofences based on public-safety factors
abstract: A device, system and method for generating geofences based on public-safety factors is provided. Responsive to receiving, via an input device, an input requesting formation of a public-safety geofence at a given location of a map rendered at the display screen, the device: retrieves public-safety factors from at least one public-safety information database; renders, at a display screen, at the given location of the map, a first public-safety geofence shaped and sized according to the factors; renders, at the display screen, respective indications of the factors. Responsive to receiving, via the input device, disabling input to disable a given factor represented by the respective indications of the factors, the device: disables the given factor; and replaces, at the display screen, at the given location of the map, the first geofence with a second public-safety geofence shaped and sized according to enabled factors which exclude the given factor as disabled.

title: Systems and methods for privacy preserving training and inference of decentralized recommendation systems from decentralized data
abstract: A system and method are disclosed for training a recommendation system. The method includes initiating, at a server device, an item-vector matrix V, wherein the item-vector matrix V includes a value m related to a total number of items across one or more client devices and a value d representing a hidden dimension, transmitting the item-vector matrix V to each client device, wherein each client device trains a local matrix factorization model using a respective user vector U and the item-vector matrix V to generate a respective set of gradients on each respective client device, receiving, via a secure multi-party compute protocol, and from each client device, the respective set of gradients, updating the item-vector matrix V using the respective set of gradients from each client device to generate an updated item-vector matrix V and downloading the updated item-vector matrix V to at least one client device.

title: Methods, apparatus, and articles of manufacture for interactive image segmentation
abstract: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture are disclosed for interactive image segmentation. An example apparatus includes an inception controller to execute an inception sublayer of a convolutional neural network (CNN) including two or more inception-atrous-collation (IAC) layers, the inception sublayer including two or more convolutions including respective kernels of varying sizes to generate multi-scale inception features, the inception sublayer to receive one or more context features indicative of user input; an atrous controller to execute an atrous sublayer of the CNN, the atrous sublayer including two or more atrous convolutions including respective kernels of varying sizes to generate multi-scale atrous features; and a collation controller to execute a collation sublayer of the CNN to collate the multi-scale inception features, the multi-scale atrous features, and eidetic memory features.

title: Training method of arrhythmia diagnosis model based on artificial neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a training method of an arrhythmia diagnosis model based on an artificial neural network, and relates to the technical field of medical signal processing. Training N epochs on a preset deep learning model by using a training data set, and determining the optimal epochs with the minimum loss function; the loss function of each epoch is an average loss function obtained by carrying out k-fold cross training verification for M times for a training data set; and training the preset deep learning model by using the optimal epoch training data set to obtain a target heart rhythm diagnosis neural network model. According to the method, the average loss function obtained through M times of k-fold cross training verification is used for further obtaining the target heart rhythm diagnosis neural network model, accuracy and efficiency of training the target heart rhythm diagnosis neural network model can be improved, the target heart rhythm diagnosis neural network model is verified once, information leakage into the model due to multiple verification processes is prevented, and reliability and generalization performance of the model are reduced.

title: Additional module, server device, positioning method, program, and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an add-on module (2) for a device (1), in particular a mobile device, a server device (3), a positioning method (33), and a corresponding computer program (33), and a corresponding computer-readable storage medium (5, 11, 18). According to the invention, the local electromagnetic field distribution caused by the respective infrastructure (27) is measured by the measuring device (12) by means of the respective sensor device by means of the device (1) or the add-on module (2) to be positioned. The respective current position of the add-on module (2) or of the device (1) equipped with the add-on module is determined by comparing the measured field distribution with a preset map. In order to enable tracking of the add-on module (2) or the device (1), the measured field distribution and/or the determined position are transmitted to a server device (3) via a wireless data connection.

title: Electronic device and method for predicting and compensating for burn-in of display
abstract: An electronic device with a rollable display may include the operations of: obtaining global burn-in information and local burn-in information according to a designated sampling period; on the basis of the result of analyzing the global burn-in information, predicting whether burn-in will at least partially occur in the entire area of a display area; when burn-in is predicted to at least partially occur in a boundary area, generating a first compensation map including pieces of local compensation data calculated to correspond to m block areas of the boundary area, respectively; when burn-in is predicted to at least partially occur in an area remaining after excluding the boundary area from the entire area, generating a second compensation map including pieces of global compensation data calculated to correspond to n block areas of the entire area, respectively; and controlling the rollable display to display image data compensated on the basis of the first compensation map or the second compensation map.

title: Deep neural network-based automatic generation method for prostatic hyperplasia target area
assignee: 华中科技大学同济医学院附属同济医院
abstract: The invention discloses a deep neural network-based automatic generation method of a prostatic hyperplasia target region, which comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring a nuclear magnetic resonance image of a benign prostatic hyperplasia patient before an operation, and carrying out slicing and data preprocessing; 2) acquiring physiological contour partial images of the middle zone and the peripheral zone of the slice in the horizontal plane; 3) completing three-dimensional segmentation of the physiological contour of the prostate and simultaneously generating a three-dimensional point cloud model of the physiological structure of the prostate; 4) establishing a virtual artificial potential field based on the central zone section of the prostate, and performing reinforced protection on the key direction to obtain the distribution of the safety coefficient on the section, thereby obtaining a reasonable target area; 5) and (4) carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the prostate slice containing the target region outline to finally obtain a three-dimensional benign prostatic hyperplasia surgical target model. The method can realize the three-dimensional reconstruction of the prostate and the BPH target area, and has a promoting effect on improving the safety and efficiency of the BPH operation.

primary_assignee: 华中科技大学同济医学院附属同济医院

title: EcoG-based epileptic neural signal decoding method and cloud decoding system
assignee: 天津职业技术师范大学(中国职业培训指导教师进修中心)
abstract: The invention discloses a decoding method and a cloud decoding system based on an EcoG epileptic neural signal, wherein the decoding method comprises the following steps: step 1, extracting an original temporal lobe EcoG time sequence signal, performing low-pass filtering on the signal, detecting and calculating a discharge peak value, and then extracting a discharge signal waveform near the discharge peak value; step 2, extracting a wavelet coefficient of the discharge signal waveform in the step 1 as a characteristic based on a Haar wavelet analysis method; and 3, training a learning model for the acquired wavelet coefficient characteristics based on the SVM model, predicting by using the learning model, and returning a model prediction result in step 4. According to the intelligent medical device, after the intelligent medical device collects the EcoG signals of the patient, the epilepsy EcoG recognition model deployed at the cloud can be accessed through the network api, the quasi-real-time EcoG information of the patient is uploaded, and the returned classification result is obtained.
assignee_clean: 天津职业技术师范大学 中国职业培训指导教师进修中心
