title: Systems and methods for processing images to determine image-based computational biomarkers from liquid specimens
abstract: A method of using a machine learning model to output a task-specific prediction may include receiving a digitized cytology image of a cytology sample and applying a machine learning model to isolate cells of the digitized cytology image. The machine learning model may include identifying a plurality of sub-portions of the digitized cytology image, identifying, for each sub-portion of the plurality of sub-portions, either background or cell, and determining cell sub-images of the digitized cytology image. Each cell sub-image may comprise a cell of the digitized cytology image, based on the identifying either background or cell. The method may further comprise determining a plurality of features based on the cell sub-images, each of the cell sub-images being associated with at least one of the plurality of features, determining an aggregated feature based on the plurality of features, and training a machine learning model to predict a target task based on the aggregated feature.

title: Communication routing between agents and contacts
abstract: Technology is described for routing communications between contacts and agents. Associations may be generated between agents and contacts who intend to communicate with the agents. Weightings for the associations between the agents and the contacts may be determined using a machine learning model to produce weighted associations. The weightings may represent a predicted interaction metric between the agents and the contacts. Selected pairs of agents and contacts may be determined by applying matching rules to the weightings. Communications may be routed between the contacts and the agents in accordance with the selected pairs of agents and contacts.

title: Aerial view generation for vehicle control
abstract: This application is directed to aerial view generation for vehicle control. A vehicle obtains a forward-facing view of a road captured by a front-facing camera of a vehicle and applies a machine learning model to process the forward-facing view to predict determine a trajectory of the vehicle and a road layout based on a Frenet-Serret coordinate system of the road for the vehicle. The trajectory of the vehicle is combined with the road layout to predict an aerial view of the road, and the aerial view of the road is used to at least partially autonomously drive the vehicle. In some embodiments, the machine learning model is applied to process the forward-facing view to determine a first location of each of an obstacle vehicle in the Frenet-Serret coordinate system. The first location of the obstacle vehicle is converted to a vehicle location on the aerial view of the road.

title: Data processing device and related product
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to a data processing device and a related product. The method comprises the following steps: the slave processing unit group comprises a shared slave processing unit and at least one parallel slave processing unit; the main processing unit is used for sending shared data to the shared slave processing units and respectively sending parallel computing data to each parallel slave processing unit; the sharing slave processing unit transmits the sharing data to each parallel slave processing unit; the parallel slave processing units respectively receive the parallel computing data in two clock cycles and transmit the parallel computing data to other parallel slave processing units step by step. According to the data processing device and the related product, the machine learning data are divided into the shared data and the parallel computing data, data interaction between the master processing unit and the slave processing unit is achieved through two clock cycles, the data bandwidth occupied by the data interaction between the master processing unit and the slave processing unit is reduced, and further the hardware overhead of the machine learning chip for transmission is reduced.

title: Evaluating functional fault criticality of structural faults for circuit testing
abstract: A system for evaluating fault criticality using machine learning includes a first machine learning module that is trained on a subset of a circuit and used for evaluating whether a node in a netlist of the entire circuit is a critical node, and a second machine learning module specialized to minimize classification errors in nodes predicted as benign. A generative adversarial network can be used to generate synthetic test escape data to supplement data used to train the second machine learning module.

title: Tear meniscus detection and evaluation system
abstract: A spectacles-mounted ophthalmic monitoring system may include a spectacles frame comprising a left rim and a right rim, an image sensor coupled with the spectacles frame to capture images of a field of view of an eye, and a processor. The processor may be configured to activate the image sensor to capture an image of the field of view, and identify a height of a tear film meniscus within the field of view of one or more images within the series of images.

title: Techniques for selecting content to include in user communications
abstract: Disclosed are techniques for determining the impact of including a token-set (e.g., text in the form of unigrams, bigrams, or trigrams) in a communication on a target outcome. More particularly, the present disclosure relates to techniques for determining the impact of the token-set based on, for example, the token-sets included in previous communications transmitted to user devices and the corresponding user responses to those previous communications.

title: Neural network model prediction confidence calibration method, system and storage medium
assignee: 东软教育科技集团有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a neural network model prediction confidence calibration method, a system and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: collecting sample data containing category labels and carrying out data cleaning and normalization treatment on the sample data; training a neural network model and storing the neural network model; dividing sample data into collected data and data to be tested, respectively inputting the collected data and the data to be tested into a neural network model which is trained, and obtaining corresponding feature embedded vectors from an implicit layer of the neural network model; calculating a density self-adaptive factor of each projection cluster and a local distance of each projection cluster of a test sample, correcting the local distance by adopting the density self-adaptive factor, normalizing the local distance to a preset interval to obtain a distribution consistency score of the test sample and each class, and obtaining a model prediction confidence of the neural network after calibration based on the distribution consistency score and an original prediction probability of the neural network model.
assignee_clean: 东软教育科技集团有限公司
primary_assignee: 东软教育科技集团有限公司

title: Ultrasonic ablation catheter
assignee: 苏州心岭迈德医疗科技有限公司
abstract: Embodiments of the present description provide an ultrasound ablation catheter. An ultrasonic ablation catheter comprising: the outer tube, the front end transducer and the rear end transducer; the front end transducer and the rear end transducer are arranged in the outer tube in a front-back mode along the length direction of the outer tube; the front end transducer can emit a first ultrasonic wave, the rear end transducer can emit a second ultrasonic wave, the first ultrasonic wave and the second ultrasonic wave have an overlapping part, and a plurality of test images corresponding to the plurality of test ultrasonic waves are generated according to reflection signals of the plurality of test ultrasonic waves; identifying a lesion in the plurality of test images and determining a resonance condition of the lesion in the plurality of test images; determining the type of the lesion according to the resonance condition of the lesion in the plurality of test images.

title: Method and device for analyzing multiple types of data by utilizing artificial intelligence AI model group
assignee: 华为云计算技术有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method and a device for analyzing multiple types of data by utilizing an artificial intelligence AI model group, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multiple types of data, wherein each type of data in the multiple types of data represents one aspect factor affecting the result of the target event; inputting each type of data in the multiple types of data to a corresponding first AI model, and obtaining the target hidden layer characteristics of the corresponding type of data according to the target hidden layer of each first AI model; then, generating fusion features according to the multiple target hidden layer features; and inputting the fusion characteristic to a second AI model to analyze the fusion characteristic according to the second AI model, and outputting a predicted value, wherein the predicted value indicates a result of predicting the target event according to the multi-class data. The method and the device improve the accuracy of predicting the target event according to the multi-class data.

title: Method for constructing classification model related to psoriasis
assignee: 安徽医科大学第一附属医院, 深圳华大基因研究院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical detection, in particular to a method for constructing a classification model related to psoriasis, which comprises the following steps: (1) selecting psoriasis susceptible sites; (2) converting the susceptible loci into input data according to different types of susceptible loci; (3) and classifying the data by using an Adaboost-SVM model. At present, relevant technologies are lacked to classify and predict psoriasis data, and only the existence of judgment sites is remained to infer the diseased situation. The invention utilizes the effective machine learning classifier SVM to classify, integrates the SVM by the adaboost frame, and improves the accuracy of the classifier. The model can integrate SNP, amino acid and type data for classification, comprehensively considers the information of each dimension, and improves the accuracy of the classification result.

title: Regional fluorine bone disease grading diagnosis system based on multi-type image fusion neural network
abstract: Based on regional fluorine osteopathia hierarchical diagnostic system of multiclass image fusion neural network relates to image processing technical field, to the problem of diagnosing inefficiency to fluorine osteopathia among the prior art, include: the invention fully utilizes the information of the lesion area based on a multi-classification model fused by a rough segmentation characteristic graph and an original image, and strengthens the cognitive ability of a neural network on a sensitive area on the basis of ensuring the integrity of the information. The cost function designed by the invention emphasizes the position with high probability of the pathological changes of the characteristic diagram and weakens the influence of irrelevant backgrounds, thereby solving the problem that the pathological change area accounts for a smaller area proportion of the total image and the image, and improving the training and classification efficiency of the model. The method provides an auxiliary means for detecting the fluorosis disease, fills the blank of intelligent diagnosis of the fluorosis disease, and improves the diagnosis efficiency aiming at the fluorosis disease.

title: Simultaneous estimation of fundamental frequency, voicing state, and glottal closure instant
abstract: A method and system is disclosed for simultaneously determining glottal closure instants (GCIs), fundamental frequency (F0s), and voicing state of a speech signal. A speech signal may be processed to determine a sequence of candidate GCIs. For each candidate GCI, a set of candidate F0s may be determined. A lattice of hypotheses may be constructed, where each lattice point is a hypothesis of a concurrence of a candidate GCI, a candidate F0, and voicing state. Each given hypothesis may also include a score of the candidate GCI, F0, and voicing state for evaluating a cost of the given hypothesis and a cost of connections between the given hypothesis and other hypotheses of the lattice. Dynamic programming may be used to determine a least-cost path through the lattice, and backtracking across the path may be used to determine an optimal set of GCIs, F0s and voicing states of the speech signal.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for guiding market supervision based on multi-dimensional data
assignee: 北京梦天门科技股份有限公司
abstract: An exemplary embodiment of the present invention provides a method for guiding market supervision based on multidimensional data, including: acquiring geographical position information of a supervisor, acquiring an alternative supervised object within a preset geographical position information range, and determining multi-dimensional data of the alternative supervised object, wherein the multi-dimensional data at least comprises supervision and supervision information, industry supervision information, public supervision information and self supervision information; depicting a user portrait of the alternative supervised object according to the multi-dimensional data, and determining a target supervised object according to the user portrait; determining a directional supervisor; and sending law enforcement information to a directed supervisor, so that the directed supervisor executes corresponding law enforcement activities on the target supervised object according to the law enforcement information. The invention can obtain risk units of different grades based on multi-dimensional data to realize directional supervision, and supervises with higher accuracy and more effect from actual market data.
assignee_clean: 北京梦天门科技股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京梦天门科技股份有限公司

title: Integrated terminal device based on artificial intelligence voice interaction system
assignee: 佛山威尔佳智能科技有限公司
abstract: The utility model provides an integrated terminal equipment based on artificial intelligence voice interaction system, including android decoding deck, intelligent house control circuit board display screen, touch-sensitive screen and face identification live body detection camera, people's face infrared sensor, aluminum alloy ex-trusions frame and panel beating support module. The utility model provides an integrated terminal device based on an artificial intelligence voice interaction system, which integrates face recognition and intelligent home furnishing; the complexity of intelligent household equipment management is effectively simplified, remote control is realized, and the reliability of management is improved; meanwhile, the method can be used for intelligent security, intelligent medical treatment and intelligent cosmetic skin detection, and has practicability.

title: Method, system, and computer program product for maintaining a cache
abstract: A method, system, and computer program product for maintaining a cache obtain request data associated with a plurality of previously processed requests for aggregated data; predict, based on the request data, (i) a subset of the aggregated data associated with a subsequent request and (ii) a first time period associated with the subsequent request; determine, based on the first time period and a second time period associated with a performance of a data aggregation operation that generates the aggregated data, a third time period associated with instructing a memory controller managing a cache to evict cached data stored in the cache and load the subset of the aggregated data into the cache; and provide an invalidation request to the memory controller managing the cache to evict the cached data stored in the cache and load the subset of the aggregated data into the cache during the third time period.

title: Estimating delay spread and doppler spread
abstract: To obtain delay spread estimations and/or Doppler spread estimations, data representing received data is input to at least one trained model, the trained model outputting spread estimations.

title: Training method and device for image recognition model
assignee: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The application provides a training method of an image recognition model, an image recognition method, an image recognition device, a server and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of image processing. According to the training method of the image recognition model, the server can synthesize the first reference image by adopting the content of the first sample image and the style of the second sample image, recognize the first reference image to obtain the position of the first sample object in the first reference image, and train the image recognition model according to the difference information between the position of the first sample object in the first reference image and the first target position. The first synthesized reference image is used for training in the training process, so that the recognition capability of the image recognition model for images in different image domains is improved, and in the subsequent image recognition process by using the image recognition model, no matter whether the image is a high-information-content image or a low-information-content image, the recognition effect can be improved, and the problem of domain drop is alleviated.
assignee_clean: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司
primary_assignee: 腾讯科技 深圳 有限公司

title: Fundus image regionalization deep learning method, device and equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京至真互联网技术有限公司
abstract: The application relates to a fundus image regionalization deep learning method, a fundus image regionalization deep learning device, fundus image regionalization deep learning equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a fundus image, and constructing a corresponding image template based on the acquired fundus image; wherein the different image modes represent different regions in the fundus image; selecting a corresponding current required template from the image templates, and processing the fundus image based on the selected current required template to obtain a processed fundus image; and inputting the processed fundus images into a pre-constructed neural network model, and training the neural network model. By constructing the image template, the fundus image used in the training of the neural network model is not the whole fundus image, but the fundus image is processed based on the selected current required template. Therefore, unnecessary interference factors are effectively eliminated, and the robustness and the generalization of the trained neural network model are finally improved.

title: Method and device for detecting osteoporosis by utilizing CT (computed tomography) image
assignee: 珠海仁康医疗器械有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting osteoporosis by utilizing CT images, wherein the method for detecting osteoporosis comprises the steps of performing super-resolution reconstruction on a lumbar vertebra sample CT image, classifying the lumbar vertebra reconstructed image by utilizing ResNet18 and the like, a super-resolution reconstruction network comprises a shallow feature extraction unit, a deep feature extraction unit and an image reconstruction unit, wherein a symmetrical MSRB module and an AEMSRB module are arranged in the deep feature extraction unit, the AEMSRB module is connected to the downstream of the MSRB module, and a feature map output by the MSRB module is also input into the corresponding AEMSRB module through short jump connection; the super-resolution reconstruction network has the advantages of high feature fusion efficiency, small parameter amount and calculation amount, good reconstruction effect and the like, improves the quality of images input into ResNet18, is beneficial to improving the accuracy of ResNet18 on image classification results, further improves the accuracy of the detection of osteoporosis of a patient body, meets the requirement of actual diagnosis and treatment, and relieves the situation of medical resource shortage.
assignee_clean: 珠海仁康医疗器械有限公司
primary_assignee: 珠海仁康医疗器械有限公司

title: Method of controlling display module and electronic device performing the method
abstract: A method of controlling a display module and an electronic device for performing the method are disclosed. The electronic device may include: a processor, a display module comprising a display panel, a memory electrically connected to the processor and configured to store instructions and an application executable by the processor, wherein the processor is configured to, when the instructions are executed: identify video data on a size, a state, and a position of a video object executed by the application, and based on an input not being received in a specified input waiting time, control a screen output on the display module, based on the video data.

title: Key points detection using multiple image modalities
assignee: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.
abstract: Image-based key points detection using a convolutional neural network (CNN) may be impacted if the key points are occluded in the image. Images obtained from additional imaging modalities such as depth and/or thermal images may be used in conjunction with RGB images to reduce or minimize the impact of the occlusion. The additional images may be used to determine adjustment values that are then applied to the weights of the CNN so that the convolution operations may be performed in a modality aware manner to increase the robustness, accuracy, and efficiency of key point detection.

title: Tracking in a moving platform
abstract: A method of tracking 3D position and orientation of an entity in a moving platform is described. The method comprises receiving data sensed by an inertial measurement unit mounted on the entity. Visual tracking data is also received, computed from images depicting the moving platform or the entity in the moving platform. The method computes the 3D position and orientation of the entity by estimating a plurality of states using the visual tracking data and the data sensed by the inertial measurement unit, where the states comprise both states of the moving platform and states of the entity.

title: Multiplier, data processing method, device and chip
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a multiplier, a data processing method, a device and a chip, wherein the multiplier comprises: a correction booth encoding circuit, an intermediate data register, a compression circuit, and an output data register; the compression circuit comprises a 4-2 compressor, and the 4-2 compressor comprises a full adder and a selection circuit; the output end of the correction Booth coding circuit is connected with the input end of the intermediate data register, the output end of the intermediate data register is connected with the input end of the compression circuit, the output end of the compression circuit is connected with the input end of the output data register, and the multiplication operation can be carried out on various data with different bit widths on the premise that the accuracy of the operation result of the multiplier is ensured in the process, so that the area of the AI chip occupied by the multiplier is effectively reduced.
assignee_clean: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司

title: Micro-calcification cluster detection method combining deep learning and feature multi-scale fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a micro-calcification cluster detection method combining deep learning and multi-scale feature fusion, which comprises the following steps: 1) Generating a candidate suggestion box; 2, obtaining an FCE-Net + MFF network model; 3) Inputting each candidate suggestion frame of an input picture into an FCE-Net + MFF network model to obtain a feature map, searching the feature frame corresponding to each candidate suggestion frame of the input picture in the feature map, pooling the searched feature frame to a preset size in a RoI pooling layer, processing the feature vector of the feature frame through a full connection layer, processing the feature vector of the obtained feature frame through the full connection layer to obtain a two-classification score output vector of softmax and a correction offset output vector of a calibration frame window, eliminating a micro-calcification cluster detection window with a classification score lower than a threshold value, inhibiting non-maximum values of the rest micro-calcification cluster detection windows, eliminating overlapped candidate suggestion frames, and obtaining a regression-corrected micro-calcification cluster detection window.

title: Managing consumables using artificial intelligence
abstract: A method includes receiving, at an artificial intelligence (AI) accelerator of a computing system, at least one of: manufacturer data, third-party data, sensor data, or primary usage data of a consumable in a primary device and performing an AI operation on at least one of: the manufacturer data, the third-party data, the sensor data, or the primary usage data at the AI accelerator of the computing system using an AI model. The method further includes determining a primary life expectancy of the consumable in the primary device at the AI accelerator in response to performing the AI operation.

title: Real-time mobility policy engine
abstract: A method of determining real-time tax and/or subsidy information includes obtaining, from an operator, trip-related information regarding a trip and determining a target objective associated with trip routing at a time of receipt of the trip-related information. The method includes obtaining additional information from one or more additional data sources based on the target objective and the trip-related information, determining, based on the trip-related information and the additional information, a tax or subsidy associated with the trip, and providing information indicative of the tax or subsidy to the operator.

title: Method for providing customized commercial information based on matching point and system thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for providing customized advertisement information based on a matching point and a system thereof. The system of the present invention may comprise: a first network node that at least one of a website and a mobile application for providing an advertisement platform is executed; and a second network node operating the website and the mobile application and performing communication with the first network node.

title: Systems and methods for motion estimation in PET imaging using AI image reconstructions
abstract: An image reconstruction system generates a motion estimation using images that have been reconstructed using AI processing. The system receives listmode data collected by an imaging system and produces two or more histo-images based on the listmode data. The system provides the two or more histo-images to an AI system and receives two or more AI reconstructed images back from the AI system based on the two or more histo-images. The system generates a motion estimation based on the two or more AI reconstructed images.

title: Multi-mode osteoporosis layering early warning method and system
abstract: The invention provides a multi-mode osteoporosis layering early warning method and system. The multi-mode osteoporosis layering early warning method comprises the following steps: receiving three layers of input features, wherein the three layers of input features are respectively individual information, laboratory examination indexes and lumbar CT image features; carrying out data cleaning, significance and correlation detection and data standardization pretreatment on three-layer input features; screening out optimal input features of all layers from the preprocessed three-layer input features, forming an input feature set, and outputting osteoporosis early warning results through a multi-mode osteoporosis layering early warning model; wherein, the multi-modal osteoporosis layering early warning model is an SVM classifier, and the optimization process of the SVM classifier is as follows: and simultaneously carrying out super-parameter optimization and optimal input feature selection of each layer by using a genetic algorithm.

title: Panorama piece periodontitis intelligent grading system based on two-stage deep learning model
abstract: The invention discloses a panoramic film periodontitis intelligent classification system based on a two-stage deep learning model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a tooth full-scene sheet to be detected; carrying out tooth segmentation on the full view of the teeth by utilizing the tooth segmentation model to obtain a single tooth image; performing key point positioning on the single tooth graph by using a key point detection model to obtain the key point position of each tooth; calculating periodontal bone loss rate based on the key points of each tooth; periodontitis grade is determined based on periodontal bone loss rate. The system can realize intelligent, rapid and accurate grading of periodontitis.

title: Single-frame image super-resolution reconstruction method based on Euclidean subspace group double-remapping
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing, and discloses a single-frame image super-resolution reconstruction method based on Euclidean subspace group double-remapping; firstly, generating an initial sample training set by using a natural image, and simplifying and classifying the initial sample training set to obtain a screening sample training set; then, extracting features from the screened sample training set to generate a feature training set, and clustering the feature training set to form an Euclidean subspace group; sequentially calculating a first remapping coefficient from a low-resolution image block to a high-resolution image block in each local subspace of the Euclidean subspace group by using a linear regression model; applying a first remapping coefficient to each low-resolution image block in the Euclidean subspace group to reconstruct a high-resolution image block to be selected, and calculating a second remapping coefficient from the high-resolution image block to the real high-resolution image block; and finally, generating a test sample set by the test image, and outputting a high-resolution reconstructed image by applying the two remapping coefficients. The cost of algorithm software and hardware is low; stand-alone and mobile image processing platforms are equally suitable.

title: Interactive liver segmentation method based on geodesic distance and V-net
abstract: An interactive liver segmentation method based on geodesic distance and V-net, based on V-net, combines with the interactive segmentation algorithm of geodesic distance, has proposed an interactive liver segmentation algorithm based on geodesic distance and V-net, at first, utilize and adjust the window algorithm to strengthen the contrast of the liver picture, and inhibit the noise interference through Gaussian filtering; secondly, by utilizing a three-dimensional segmentation network V-net, the characteristics of spatial context information can be effectively considered, and a preliminary segmentation result of the liver image is obtained; thirdly, artificial hard constraints are formed to correct the V-net segmentation result by utilizing the characteristics of simple and easy realization and good response to the liver boundary of the interactive segmentation method based on the geodesic distance, and a superpixel block formed by the watershed algorithm is further used as a sample point to carry out operation, so that the algorithm efficiency is improved; the experimental result shows that the algorithm can accurately segment the complete liver region, realizes the interactive liver image segmentation framework which is convenient for doctors to use clinically and has less user intervention and shorter time, and has good clinical use effect and wide application prospect.

title: Using priority scores for iterative precision reduction in structured lookups for questions
abstract: An approach is provided in which a knowledge manager matches a question to multiple natural language contexts that each correspond to relations associated with entities in a structured resource. The knowledge manager identifies database queries corresponding to the multiple natural language contexts and assigns priority scores to the database queries based upon their relative specificity. In turn, the knowledge manager invokes one of the database queries based upon the assigned priority scores.

title: Clear image acquisition method for sheath flow microscopic full-thickness flow channel cells
assignee: 桂林优利特医疗电子有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a clear image acquisition method for cells in a sheath flow microscopic full-thickness flow channel, which comprises the steps of acquiring and checking an initial position of an objective lens displacement platform and states of a camera and a flash lamp after power-on reset, emptying cached image data, entering an idle waiting state, driving the objective lens displacement platform to move after receiving an acquisition starting instruction, starting camera acquisition according to a backlight synchronous control signal, storing an image acquired based on a constraint relation into a data cache region, performing parallel preprocessing, performing automatic tracking, segmentation extraction and automatic collection on the same cell by using a convolutional neural network deep learning model, screening cell images with optimal definition in each collection through a definition algorithm, packaging and uploading, clearing all image data cached after preprocessing until receiving an image acquisition stopping instruction, exiting an image acquisition state, and greatly improving the accuracy and image definition of cell acquisition by using a system full-thickness real-time acquisition and real-time processing method.
assignee_clean: 桂林优利特医疗电子有限公司
primary_assignee: 桂林优利特医疗电子有限公司

title: Electronic apparatus performing self-test using self-test application and control method thereof
abstract: In an electronic apparatus, a processor executes a program stored in memory to perform essential functions. In the event of an error related to these functions, a self-test application is triggered. The processor may identify a relevant test routine from a set of routines, conduct tests on the function using the identified routine, and communicate the test results to a display. Accordingly, when an error occurs while the electronic apparatus is operating, the electronic apparatus can inform a user and a manufacturer of a cause of the error.

title: Image processing and KELM based qualitative detection method for concentration of medical reagent
abstract: The invention relates to a medical reagent concentration qualitative detection method based on image processing and KELM, which comprises the steps of arranging and placing medical reagent bottles with unknown concentration and a plurality of medical reagent bottles with known concentration, simultaneously obtaining images of all the medical reagent bottles, and respectively extracting reagent target areas in all the medical reagent bottles; secondly, performing median filtering denoising on target areas of the medical reagent images with unknown concentrations and the medical reagent images with known concentrations respectively, and acquiring RGB and HSV characteristic parameters of the denoised target area images; inputting the characteristic parameters and the real concentration of the medical reagent with the known concentration into a KeLM (kernel extreme learning machine) for training to obtain optimal parameters and a KELM model; and finally substituting the characteristic parameters of the medical reagent with unknown concentration into the KELM model to obtain the predicted concentration of the medical reagent with unknown concentration, thereby realizing the qualitative detection of the concentration of the medical reagent. The method has the advantages of high detection precision, easy use, simple operation and high detection efficiency.

title: Facial expression recognition method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a facial expression recognition method, a facial expression recognition device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The facial expression recognition method comprises the following steps: detecting a face contour point of a face image; determining a polygon representing the outline of the face based on the outline points of the face, determining an expression recognition area from the face image according to the positions of all pixel points in the face image relative to the polygon, and generating an image to be recognized containing the expression recognition area; and inputting the image to be identified into a trained machine learning model, and determining the facial expression of the facial image according to the output result of the machine learning model. The facial expression recognition method and device can improve accuracy of facial expression recognition.
assignee_clean: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司
primary_assignee: 泰康保险集团股份有限公司

title: Deep learning-based kidney segmentation method in CT image
assignee: 北京小白世纪网络科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method for segmenting kidney in a CT image based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: inputting a CT image group; normalizing each image in the image group; generating a position coding image of the kidney, and overlapping the position coding image with each image; convolving each image, determining an interested position area, and performing pixel Hadamard product on each processed image to obtain a segmented image; an output end binarizes the image; and performing Hadamard products on the obtained images and the images after the normalization processing, and determining to output the images of the kidney part. According to the method, the position code is added when the neural network training image is used, so that the problem that the spleen and the kidney are difficult to distinguish can be well distinguished and solved; in addition, an attention mechanism is used, so that the convergence rate of network fitting is higher, the network can pay attention to the kidney position region, and therefore the interference of the spleen is eliminated.
assignee_clean: 北京小白世纪网络科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京小白世纪网络科技有限公司

title: Automatic blood vessel puncture method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic blood vessel puncturing method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining a blood vessel picture of a part to be punctured, carrying out gray processing, loading the blood vessel picture into a convolutional neural network model, obtaining a background, a punctured area in a blood vessel and a non-punctured area in the blood vessel picture, and puncturing the blood vessel according to the punctured area in the blood vessel; the convolutional neural network model comprises a contraction path, an expansion path and an activation function which are connected in sequence, wherein the contraction path carries out down-sampling; the expansion path performs up-sampling and is spliced with the picture with the corresponding size in the contraction path, and the expansion path outputs the picture with the depth of 3; and the activation function carries out three-classification on the third dimensionality of the image output by the extension path, and selects the maximum value in three-classification results as final output. Compared with the prior art, the method realizes the identification of the puncture area in the blood vessel through image three-classification, is favorable for realizing automatic blood vessel puncture, and further avoids the contact between nurses and patients during the puncture.

title: Requirement runtime monitor using temporal logic or a regular expression
abstract: A hardware monitor may receive information that identifies a requirement for a system. The requirement may be associated with operation of the system during a runtime operation of the system in an intended operating environment. The hardware monitor may program the one or more hardware components to analyze the system based on the requirement. The hardware monitor may receive a signal from the system during the runtime operation of the system in the intended operating environment. The hardware monitor may analyze the signal during the runtime operation of the system based on the requirement. The hardware monitor may determine, during the runtime operation of the system, that the requirement was violated during the runtime operation of the system based on analyzing the signal. The hardware monitor may output information indicating that the requirement was violated.

title: Spectographic metabolite-signature for identifying a subject's susceptibility to drugs
abstract: A method of predicting the responsiveness of a patient to a pharmaceutical drug by measuring metabolites in a biological sample from the patient is disclosed. Specific drug metabolites in blood from breast cancer patients are analyzed using NMR spectroscopy whereby responsiveness of the human cancer patients before, during and after treatment with a cancer drug is assessed by measuring the change in clinical outcomes. Data obtained is used to identify particular NMR resonances that are strongly correlated with whether the patient is responsive or resistant to each drug. As such, models for predicting the responsiveness of a patient to each drug based on metabolites from the patient are provided.

title: Image recognition model construction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京瑞莱智慧科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application relates to the field of deep learning, and provides an image recognition model construction method, an image recognition model construction device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first data set, the first data set comprising a plurality of images; and performing data fitting on the first data set based on a deep Bayesian neural network to obtain an image recognition model, wherein each layer of the deep Bayesian neural network comprises a deterministic weight matrix and two low-dimensional Bayesian variables. The method can enable the constructed image recognition model to have good expansibility and good accuracy for image recognition.
assignee_clean: 北京瑞莱智慧科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 北京瑞莱智慧科技有限公司

title: Digital image screening and/or diagnosis using artificial intelligence
abstract: An example device is configured to capture an image of a patient. The devices includes a camera configured to capture the image of the patient. The device further: captures contextual data associated with the image; allows a caregiver to select the image to be stored; forwards the image and the contextual data to a remote server for processing using artificial intelligence; and receives a proposed diagnosis from the remote server based upon the image and the contextual data.

title: Data augmentation for driver monitoring
abstract: This application is directed to augmenting training images used for generating a model for monitoring vehicle drivers. A computer system obtains a first image of a first driver in an interior of a first vehicle and separates, from the first image, a first driver image from a first background image of the interior of the first vehicle. The computer system obtains a second background image and generates a second image by overlaying the first driver image on the second background image. The second image is added to a corpus of training images to be used by a machine learning system to generate a model for monitoring vehicle drivers. In some embodiments, at least one of the first driver image and the second background image is adjusted to match lighting conditions, average intensities, and sizes of the first driver image and the second background image.

title: Data selector, data processing method, chip and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a data selector, a data processing method, a chip and an electronic device, wherein the data selector comprises: the system comprises a data reading circuit, a cycle comparison circuit, an ending judgment circuit and an extreme value register circuit; the first output end of the data reading circuit is connected with the first input end of the cycle comparison circuit, the second output end of the data reading circuit is connected with the input end of the ending judgment circuit, the output end of the cycle comparison circuit is connected with the first input end of the extreme value registering circuit, the output end of the ending judgment circuit is connected with the second input end of the extreme value registering circuit, the first output end of the extreme value registering circuit is connected with the second input end of the cycle comparison circuit, and the data selector can perform cycle comparison on a plurality of data to obtain the maximum value and the minimum value, so that the operation time is saved; in addition, the data selector can process various data comparison operations with different bit widths according to different function selection mode signals received by the circular comparison circuit, and the area of the AI chip occupied by the data selector is effectively reduced.

title: Multiplier, data processing method, chip and electronic equipment
assignee: 上海寒武纪信息科技有限公司
abstract: The application provides a multiplier, a data processing method, a chip and an electronic device, wherein the multiplier comprises: the improved encoding circuit, the improved Wallace tree group circuit and the accumulation circuit are characterized in that the output end of the improved encoding circuit is connected with the input end of the improved Wallace tree group circuit, the output end of the improved Wallace tree group circuit is connected with the input end of the accumulation circuit, the multiplier can carry out multiplication operation on data with various bit widths, and the area of an AI chip occupied by the multiplier is effectively reduced; in addition, the multiplier can effectively reduce the power consumption of the multiplier by improving the Wallace tree group circuit to carry out accumulation operation on the partial product of the target code.

title: Automated language identification during virtual conferences
abstract: In some aspects, a computing device may access audio information comprising an audio stream from a client device. The computing device may provide an audio segment from the audio stream to a language identification process of the computing device comprising a machine learning model that is trained to identify a language of a plurality of languages within recorded speech. The computing device may identify an identified-language of the plurality of languages for the speech based at least in part on the audio segment. The computing device may provide the identified-language to the client device. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Single-period scanning image quality control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 四川大学华西医院, 北京绪水互联科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a single-period scanning image quality control method, a single-period scanning image quality control device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the single-period scanning image quality control method comprises the following steps: performing first analysis processing on a currently latest acquired real-time scanning image to acquire a first analysis result; when the first analysis result accords with a first preset condition, acquiring a second analysis result corresponding to each historical scanning image of the image inspection corresponding to the real-time scanning image; when the first analysis result and the second analysis result meet the second preset condition, generating a first feedback result according to the first analysis result, the real-time scanning image, the second analysis result and each historical scanning image of the image inspection corresponding to the real-time scanning image, and outputting the first feedback result, wherein the first feedback result is a qualified scanning image. The invention can effectively reduce repeated scanning of patients, reduce the influence of image examination on the patients and save image examination resources and time.
assignee_clean: 四川大学华西医院; 北京绪水互联科技有限公司

title: CT image super-resolution method and device based on mixed attention model
abstract: The invention discloses a CT image super-resolution method and device based on a mixed attention model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring an existing medical CT image public data set and an original high-resolution CT image of a plant; performing multi-mode combined practical degradation operation on the original high-resolution CT image of the plant, and then constructing a high-low resolution image data pair; training a mixed attention model by using the existing medical CT image public data set, and continuously using high-low resolution image data pairs to perform model training adjustment after the training is completed to obtain a final adjusted mixed attention model; and step four, inputting a low-resolution original CT image of the plant by utilizing the finally adjusted mixed attention model, and outputting a target resolution image. The invention is suitable for CT images in agriculture, and aims at the characteristic of rich plant tissues to realize nondestructive high-precision detection and super-resolution reconstruction of the plant tissues.

title: Monitoring apparatus and method
abstract: Monitoring apparatus for monitoring the pulse transit time and/or estimating one or more blood pressure parameters of a subject and the method of use of the monitoring apparatus. The apparatus comprises an upper arm unit for attaching to a subject's upper arm in use and comprising at least one motion sensor, a photoplethysmograph comprising at least one light source and at least one light detector and at least one display.

title: Method for transmitting and receiving sidelink signal in wireless communication system
abstract: According to one embodiment, a method for performing an operation for a first terminal in a wireless communication system comprises the steps of: transmitting, to a second terminal, a physical sidelink control channel (PSCCH) including sidelink control information (SCI); and transmitting a physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH) on the basis of the SCI, wherein the SCI is transmitted from a sub-channel mapped to the second terminal.

title: Method for transmitting/receiving signal in wireless communication system
abstract: In one embodiment, a method for performing an operation for a first terminal in a wireless communication system comprises the steps of: determining that a physical layer problem has occurred during communication with a base station; starting a recovery timer for the physical layer problem; and transmitting, to a second terminal, sidelink data by using a sidelink resource, wherein the first terminal determines whether to perform switching from resource allocation mode 1 to resource allocation mode 2 in consideration of the latency budget of the sidelink data and the expiration time of the recovery timer.

title: Operation method of UE related to system information and sidelink relay in wireless communication system
abstract: An embodiment relates to an operation method of a relay user equipment (UE) related to a sidelink relay in a wireless communication system, the method comprising: receiving, by a relay UE, a system information-related request from a remote UE; and transmitting, by the relay UE, system information to the remote UE, wherein the system information is obtained by the relay UE from a base station on the basis of the system information-related request.

title: Conversion rate prediction method, conversion rate prediction device, conversion rate prediction equipment and storage medium
assignee: 深圳平安医疗健康科技服务有限公司
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a conversion rate prediction method, a conversion rate prediction device, conversion rate prediction equipment and a storage medium, wherein the conversion rate prediction method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical project mining data set, performing data preprocessing and category classification on the historical project mining data set to obtain sample data, and training the sample data according to the data category to obtain a conversion rate prediction model corresponding to the data category; acquiring a data set to be predicted, and inputting the data set to a corresponding conversion rate prediction model according to the data type to obtain a corresponding conversion rate; calculating the average value of the conversion rate of all the data to be predicted, and taking the average value as a conversion rate prediction result of the data set to be predicted; and determining the maximum conversion rate in all conversion rates, and generating a prediction report according to the data to be predicted corresponding to the maximum conversion rate and the conversion rate prediction result. The method predicts the conversion rate based on the conversion rate prediction model obtained by training the decision tree model, has accurate prediction effect, and comprehensively considers the influence of different types of data on the conversion rate at the same time.

title: Image segmentation method, model training method, device, equipment and medium
assignee: 首都医科大学宣武医院
abstract: The application relates to an image segmentation method, a model training method, a device, equipment and a medium, belongs to the technical field of computer image processing, and solves the problem that the calculation time is longer along with the increase of the scale of a problem in the existing optimization model. The technical scheme of the application mainly comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be segmented, and carrying out feature extraction on the image to be segmented to acquire a first feature map; inputting the first feature map into a first segmentation network to generate a first segmentation result and a second feature map; generating a query vector through the second feature map; inputting the first feature map into a transducer module for high-dimensional feature coding to generate a third feature map, and simultaneously, acquiring the query vector by the transducer module to guide the high-dimensional feature coding; the third feature map is input into a second segmentation network to generate a second segmentation result.

title: Massager control method
assignee: 深圳市倍轻松科技股份有限公司
abstract: The application provides a massager control method, which is applied to a massager control process and comprises the following steps: obtaining a target three-dimensional file corresponding to a target massager, and rendering the target three-dimensional file by adopting a real-time renderer based on physical rendering to obtain and display the target three-dimensional model; and acquiring a control instruction, and controlling the target massager to execute massage operation according to the control instruction. According to the scheme, the control method of the massager enables a user to issue the control instruction through the 3D model corresponding to the massager, the user can intuitively know the structure of the controlled massager through the 3D model and issue the control instruction correspondingly, meanwhile, the loading efficiency of the 3D model is improved by adopting the three-dimensional file in the graphic language exchange format and the rendering mode of the real-time renderer based on physical rendering, the learning cost of the user to the massager control process is reduced, and the use experience of the massager of the user is improved.

title: Thyroid nodule segmentation method integrating global reasoning and MLP architecture
abstract: The invention relates to the field of computer-aided medical treatment and medical image processing, in particular to a thyroid nodule segmentation method integrating global reasoning and an MLP architecture, which comprises the following specific procedures: preprocessing a thyroid ultrasonic image by using a threshold method, adjusting the thyroid ultrasonic image to 256 multiplied by 256 pixels, and dividing the preprocessed data into a training set and a testing set based on a five-fold cross validation method; then constructing a thyroid nodule segmentation model: the MLP is taken as a basic framework, and a global reasoning module and a pyramid feature layer based on graph convolution are fused; training the thyroid nodule segmentation model by using a training set, and predicting thyroid nodules on a test set to obtain segmentation results; and finally, calculating index values of the model segmentation effect and efficiency.

title: Data processing method based on data center and related equipment thereof
assignee: 平安医疗健康管理股份有限公司
abstract: The application belongs to the technical fields of big data and artificial intelligence, and relates to a data processing method based on a data center, wherein the data center comprises: the Kafka system and the Hadoop system, the method mainly comprises the following steps: processing the real-time data through a Kafka system to obtain a real-time data calculation result; warehousing the real-time data calculation result into a data lake to realize the lasting off-line of the real-time data calculation result; storing the offline data into a data lake through a Hadoop system; and processing the offline data in the data lake through the Hadoop system to obtain an offline data calculation result, wherein the real-time data calculation result and the offline data calculation result are applied to the access module. The application also provides related devices. In addition, the present application relates to blockchain techniques in which real-time data computation results and offline data computation results may be stored in a blockchain. The Kafka system and the Hadoop system can be integrated, and the defects of the Kafka system and the Hadoop system can be made up by other systems while respective advantages are exerted.

title: Fundus image optic disc macula lutea detection method and device based on deep neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a fundus image optic disc macula lutea detection method and a device based on a deep neural network, which comprises the following steps: giving a data set containing a plurality of fundus color photographs, giving corresponding optic disc center position labels or whole optic disc region labels and macular center position labels, and dividing the data set into a training set and a verification set; preprocessing an original fundus color photograph to obtain an enhanced domain image, labeling a macular position of a video disc, and establishing a pseudo label image; establishing a model for positioning the macula lutea of the optic disc and segmenting the optic disc, and performing model training and verification on a training set and a verification set by utilizing an enhanced domain diagram and a pseudo label diagram; and positioning the optic disc and the macula lutea on the verification set by adopting the model constructed in the S13, extracting the region of interest, and segmenting by using the model to obtain the final macula lutea, optic disc positioning and optic disc segmentation results. The invention simultaneously covers two tasks of optic disc and yellow spot detection, is reliable and is easy to realize.

title: Multi-mode-based thyroid nodule automatic identification model construction method
assignee: 北京小白世纪网络科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for constructing an automatic thyroid nodule recognition model based on multiple modes, and provides a data alignment mode for aligning three thyroid ultrasonic image gray scale, color Doppler ultrasound and image areas under different modes; the invention proposes to extract three modal characteristics by ResNet, and to extract a replacement input layer for adaptation aiming at a plurality of incompatible pre-training models of the elastic image; the invention provides a method for fusing three mode information by using a bottleneck (bottleneck) structure after modification, thereby reducing the quantity of parameters; according to the invention, three models with different data enhancement and training modes are integrated by using a voting mode, so that the model effect is improved; according to the invention, the image to be identified is input into the constructed model to obtain the thyroid nodule identification result, so that the thyroid benign and malignant automatic identification effect is improved, the automatic screening work of thyroid cancer is performed, the detection rate is improved, and the false detection rate is reduced.

title: Method and system for analyzing test image
abstract: A method executed by one or more processors for analyzing at least one test image. The method includes collecting a plurality of reference images from at least one image source, extracting image features from the plurality of reference images, assigning weights to the image features extracted, determining image scores for the plurality of reference images, iteratively performing the assigning of the weights and the determining of the image scores, extracting image features from the at least one test image, assigning weights to the image features of the at least one test image, determining an image score for the at least one test image, based upon the weights assigned to the image features of the at least one test image, and providing an improvement proposal for the at least one test image, based upon the image score determined for the at least one test image.

title: Method, device and equipment for constructing survival analysis model and predicting survival rate
assignee: 东软集团股份有限公司
abstract: The application discloses a method, a device and equipment for constructing a survival analysis model and predicting survival rate, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring patient sample data; determining a manner of grouping patient sample data and a manner of grouping patient attributes; grouping patient sample data to obtain M personal group groups; grouping patient attributes to obtain N attribute groups; setting prior probability distribution for the coefficients of each patient attribute in each crowd group and the coefficients of each attribute belonging to each attribute group respectively; based on a Bayes formula, calculating posterior probability; and determining the value of the coefficient of each patient attribute in each crowd group with the maximum value of the posterior probability, and constructing a survival analysis model. According to the method, the problem that different people take different distributions and different patient attribute clothes take different distributions is considered, a survival analysis model is built for different people, the relevance of different people does not need to be cut, and the accuracy of the model is improved.

title: Voxel internal incoherent motion MRI three-dimensional quantitative detection of tissue anomalies using improved data processing techniques
abstract: Liver fibrosis can be detected using intra-voxel incoherent motion (IVIM) MRI techniques. For example, a diffusion weighted MRI imaging sequence may be used to scan the liver of a patient. The signal intensity data obtained in an MRI scan can be fitted to a bi-exponential model signal decay that represents a combination of "fast" portions associated with perfusion and "slow" portions associated with diffusion in tissue. This allows extracting parameters representing slow and fast diffusion rates, and fractional contributions of the fast and slow parts. Analysis of combinations of these parameters in a multidimensional space (e.g., three-dimensional space) yields metrics that can distinguish healthy liver from fibrotic liver.

title: System for managing fitness center
abstract: The present invention is to provide a customer management system which is efficient to attract new members by utilizing regional events through regional distribution charts of members registered with an operating facility through statistical map information by allowing to generate statistical maps based on location information of members registered with the operating facility in attendance and management of gym members. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the customer management system comprises an automatic member subscription unit which automatically registers a user who joins a fitness center to a homepage.

title: Method and system for material decomposition in dual-or multiple-energy x-ray based imaging
abstract: A method and system for generating material decomposition images from plural-energy x-ray based imaging, the method comprising: modelling spatial relationships and spectral relationships among the plurality of images by learning features from the plurality of images in combination and one or more of the plurality of images individually with a deep learning neural network; generating one or more basis material images employing the spatial relationships and the spectral relationships; and generating one or more material specific or material decomposition images from the basis material images. The neural network has an encoder-decoder structure and includes a plurality of encoder branches; each of one or more of the plurality of encoder branches encodes two or more images of the plurality of images in combination; and each of one or more of the plurality of encoder branches encodes a respective individual image of the plurality of images.

title: Multi-scale sequential training method of deep neural network for rapid MRI
abstract: A multi-scale sequential training method of deep neural network facing quick MRI, the training method constructs multi-scale MR training image to train the deep neural network, first learn the mapping relation from low-power undersampled MR image to full-sampled MR image, get the initial parameter of the deep neural network model; and then gradually increasing undersampling multiple of the input MR image, under each undersampling scale, training the deep neural network in sequence to learn the mapping relation from the undersampled MR image to the fully sampled MR image, wherein the training of the deep neural network model under the lower scale is based on the network model obtained by training under the previous scale every time, thereby accumulating abundant prior knowledge for the final reconstructed high-power undersampled MR image and effectively improving the reconstruction accuracy of the MR image. The method provided by the invention can effectively reconstruct the high-power undersampled magnetic resonance image, and has strong practicability.

title: Method for detecting jugular vein ball socket bone wall missing in temporal bone CT image
abstract: The application provides a method for detecting jugular vein ball socket bone wall deletion abnormality in temporal bone image, which is used for computer-aided pulsatility tinnitus diagnosis. The application fully utilizes a small amount of rare abnormal data, introduces the abnormal priori information into the network model, highlights the abnormal characteristics, increases the gap between the abnormal characteristics and the abnormal characteristics, and improves the overall detection accuracy. Through the targeted data enhancement mode and the innovative data use means, the reasonably designed proxy task enables the network model to fully exert the advantage of being good at prediction, and the detection accuracy is improved. Compared with the existing method, the anomaly detection method provided by the application does not depend on a great amount of marked data any more, and has the advantages of easier implementation and popularization.

title: Method and system for constructing contour lines in skull lateral position slice
assignee: 正雅齿科科技(上海)有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a contour line in a skull lateral position slice, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the construction method comprises the following steps: mapping a preset contour line template in a skull coordinate system of a current skull side position slice, and respectively extracting the position information of a preset mark point in the current skull side position slice, the position information of a template mark point on the preset contour line template and the position information of a contour adjusting point; comparing the position information of the template mark point with the position information of the preset mark point, and constructing a mark point position transformation relation between the position information of the preset mark point and the position information of the template mark point by utilizing an affine transformation matrix algorithm according to the comparison result; inputting the position information of the contour adjusting point into a mark point position transformation relation to obtain the position information of the dynamic adjustable mark point of the current skull side position piece; and constructing a contour line meeting diagnosis and treatment parameters on the current skull side position slice according to the position information of the preset mark points and the position information of the dynamic adjustable mark points.

title: Method and device for generating diffusion weighted image reconstruction model
assignee: 东软医疗系统股份有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for generating a diffusion weighted image reconstruction model. According to the embodiment of the invention, the deep learning network model is built, the initial parameter value of the deep learning network model is set, sample data is obtained, the training data is utilized to train the deep learning network model, the trained deep learning network model is obtained, the trained deep learning network model is used as a diffusion weighted image reconstruction model, a foundation is laid for image reconstruction in the process of repeatedly exciting diffusion weighted imaging by using the diffusion weighted image reconstruction model, the reconstruction time of repeatedly exciting DWI images is reduced by using the network model reconstruction, and the reconstruction speed of the DWI images is improved.

title: Comprehensive health care treatment management system for whole life of individual
abstract: The invention relates to a personal lifetime comprehensive health care treatment management system which is established on a health care treatment cloud platform and takes a real-time comprehensive health care treatment operation module, a comprehensive health care treatment scheme making module, a comprehensive health care treatment scheme execution guarantee module, a personal health care treatment information storage database and a network security module as basic core architectures. Compared with the prior art, the comprehensive health care treatment management system takes comprehensive health care treatment schemes formulated by psychology, nutrition, traditional Chinese medicine, western medicine, health care, biotechnology and the like as basic contents, takes the contemporary internet, the internet of things, artificial intelligence, wireless sensing, a big database, cloud computing, data analysis, intelligent equipment and the like as main implementation technologies, and provides comprehensive and systematic life-long comprehensive health care treatment management services for individuals.

title: Abnormal node identification method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
assignee: 北京奇艺世纪科技有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an abnormal node identification method, an abnormal node identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of inputting feature data of a test image into a deep learning model to be identified, wherein the deep learning model to be identified comprises a plurality of nodes, monitoring processing time of designated nodes in the plurality of nodes in the process of processing the feature data by the deep learning model to be identified, wherein the processing time of the designated nodes is time of the designated nodes for processing received data, and determining the designated nodes as abnormal nodes when the processing time of the designated nodes is longer than a preset time threshold. By adopting the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the abnormal nodes are identified from the plurality of nodes contained in the deep learning model, and after the abnormal nodes are identified, the abnormal nodes can be further processed, so that the deep learning model reasoning acceleration performance method can be studied deeply, and the running speed of the deep learning model can be accelerated.

title: Data poisoning method and data poisoning apparatus
abstract: A data poisoning method and a data poisoning apparatus are provided. In the method, a training set and a validation set are retrieved. A perturbation is randomly initiated and added to data in the training set to generate poisoned training data. Values of multiple kernel functions of the poisoned training data and the validation set are computed by using kernel functions in a Gaussian process, and used to compute a mean of the Gaussian process under the validation set. A loss between the mean and the data in the validation set is computed using a loss function of the Gaussian process, and used to generate a target function that maximizes the loss. The target function is solved to compute the perturbation that can maximize the loss.

title: System and method for evaluating content quality based on biometric changing information according to watching virtual reality(vr) content
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for evaluating content quality based on biometric information changes according to viewing of virtual reality (VR) content. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for evaluating the quality of VR content by receiving eye and biometric information of a viewer, who views VR content in a monitoring device, from the monitoring device comprises the steps of: acquiring eye and biometric information of a viewer, who views VR content; outputting a content evaluation screen based on the acquired eye and biometric information; acquiring content quality information of the VR content by inputting the eye and biometric information into a deep learning neural network; and displaying the acquired content quality information.

title: Model training, tubular object extraction and data recognition method and equipment
assignee: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a method and equipment for model training, tubular object extraction and data identification. The method comprises the following steps: predicting probabilities that the first sample data respectively belong to at least one possible category by using a calculation model; wherein the first sample data is a first sample region determined from a first sample image including a first sample tubular object image; evaluating uncertainty of the calculation model prediction according to probabilities that the first sample data respectively belong to at least one possible category; performing parameter optimization on the calculation model by combining the uncertainty; the calculation model is used for extracting a tubular object to be extracted from an image to be processed. By adopting the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the computational model can be trained by utilizing the training set doped with the samples marked by the noise categories, so that the marking cost of the training set can be greatly reduced, and the training effect of the computational model can be ensured.
