title: Table sequence identification method and system based on context attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a table sequence identification method and a system based on a contextual attention mechanism, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a form image to be identified; the method comprises the steps of processing a form image to be identified by adopting a trained form sequence identification network model to obtain an identified form structure and the content of each cell; the table sequence identification network model is realized by adopting an interconnected encoder and decoder, and the encoder is used for extracting the characteristics and generating a characteristic sequence; the decoder is used to implement the identification of the sequence. And converting the table structure into a structured label for identification in a sequence-to-sequence identification mode, and finally realizing the identification of the table structure and the aggregation of cell contents.

title: Methods and systems for generating a virtual assistant in a messaging user interface
abstract: A system for generating a virtual assistant in a messaging user interface the system including a computing device configured to initiate a virtual message user interface between a user client device and the computing device; receive a user message entered by a user into the virtual message user interface; retrieve data relating to a user agenda list including a plurality of agenda actions; analyze the user message to identify an agenda action related to the user message; and generate a response to the user message as a function of analyzing the user message, wherein generating the response further comprises generating a user-action learner, wherein the user-action learner utilizes a previous message and the user message as an input and output a response; identifying a response as a function of generating the user-action learner; and displaying the response within the virtual message user interface.

title: Endoscope system, control device, and control method of control device
abstract: An endoscope system includes a light source that emits illumination light, an image sensor that captures an image of an object toward which the illumination light is emitted, and a processor. The processor is configured to determine whether a fluid is present in the object. If the fluid is not present in the object, the processor switches to a first observation mode in which to illuminate the object by first illumination light. If the fluid is present in the object, the processor switches to a second observation mode in which to illuminate the object by second illumination light. The second illumination light includes is larger than the first illumination light in a relative ratio of long wavelength components.

title: Memory management device and method for intelligent processor and electronic equipment
assignee: 中国科学院计算技术研究所
abstract: The present disclosure provides a memory management device and method for an intelligent processor, the device comprising: the circulating memory section comprises a first memory area, a second memory area and a third memory area, and is respectively used for fractal operation, protocol operation, data loading and write-back time calling in the operation process of the intelligent processor; the static memory section comprises a fourth memory area and a fifth memory area and is used for storing fractal instructions input when the intelligent processor performs operation. Based on the difference of instruction execution life cycle, the intelligent processor control system memory is classified and managed, so that the execution efficiency of the intelligent processor can be improved, and the tensor replacement unit is added in the memory management device, so that the execution efficiency of the intelligent processor can be further improved obviously, and meanwhile, the data consistency is maintained.

title: Mining method for sample grouping
assignee: 財團法人工業技術研究院
abstract: A mining method for sample grouping is provided. The method includes the following steps. A field dataset including a plurality of samples is obtained, and each sample has a corresponding actual labeled result. The samples are respectively input to the existing model to obtain multiple estimation results. An outlier sample set in the field dataset is eliminated, and remaining samples in the field dataset form a remaining sample set based on difference distribution between the estimation results and the actual labeled results. The remaining sample set is grouped into a hard sample set and an easy sample set based on the estimation results of the remaining sample set.

title: Image processing-based old person gait recognition method and system
assignee: 天津医科大学第二医院
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a method and a system for identifying the gait of an old person based on image processing, which are used for converting an acquired walking image of the old person into a video frame, then comparing the similarity between the video frame image and a previous frame of video frame image, further removing a background area, and only inputting a target area image into a deep learning model, thereby improving the operation efficiency of the model; in addition, the invention carries out rough verification on the identification result through the actual distance and the identified key point distance, when the rough verification prompts have problems, a second deep learning model is set for further verification, on one hand, the identification result verification is set, so that the identification accuracy can be remarkably improved, meanwhile, the rough verification process is simpler, most of the identification result can pass verification, and only when the verification result does not pass, time-consuming secondary verification is carried out, so that the identification result verification efficiency can be effectively improved.

title: Method, apparatus and system for providing nutritional information based on fecal image analysis
abstract: The present invention relates to a method, an apparatus, and a system for providing required nutritional information based on fecal image analysis. By the method according to an embodiment, fecal images corresponding to an identifier are acquired, lump objects of incomplete digestion are extracted from the fecal images, the lump objects are classified into incomplete digestion food information using a pre-trained first neural network and based on first training lump objects and first labels (information on foods corresponding to training lump objects), and required nutrient information corresponding to the identifier is generated based on the incomplete digestion food information corresponding to the lump objects.

title: Radio resource parameter configuration
abstract: This document discloses a solution for configuring a radio resource control connection. According to an aspect, a method comprises: storing, in a database, an identifier of a terminal device and a first set of parameters of a first radio resource control connection of a terminal device; retrieving, from the database by using the identifier after the first radio resource control connection has been terminated, the parameters of the first radio resource control connection; and configuring, on the basis of the retrieved parameters of the first radio resource control connection, at least one operational parameter of a second radio resource control connection of the terminal device identified by the identifier.

title: Monitoring dynamics of patient brain state during neurosurgical procedures
abstract: A computer-implemented method of monitoring dynamics of patient brain state during neurosurgical procedures includes receiving a plurality of brain response images acquired using a functional MRI scan of a patient over a plurality of time points and selecting a plurality of image features from the brain response images. One or more recurrent neural network (RNN) model are used to directly estimate one or more brain state measurements at each time point based on the image features. Once estimated, the brain state measurements are presented on a display.

title: Cancer diagnostic tool using cancer genomic signatures to determine cancer type
abstract: Cancer types (e.g., organ/tissue of origin and/or cancer subtype for an organ/tissue) can be distinguished by applying statistical methods to data samples consisting of counts of somatic single nucleotide variations (SNVs) across a tumor genome of a patient. For example, a factor loading matrix for each cancer type to be distinguished can be computed using a set of training data samples for which the cancer type is known. To determine the cancer type for a testing (or diagnostic) data sample, a regression analysis over the set of factor loading matrices yields statistical parameters that can be used to identify the cancer type.

title: Wound characterization of a patient
abstract: A digital image is captured. The captured digital image includes a calibration pattern. The calibration pattern includes displayed information about the calibration pattern. The displayed information is read to obtain calibration information about the captured digital image.

title: Sample set labeling method, pathological image classification method, classification model construction method and device
assignee: 上海壁仞智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a method and a device for labeling a sample set, classifying pathological images and constructing a classification model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and determining the comprehensive uncertainty of each sample pathological image based on the labeling uncertainty of each sample pathological image, the prior uncertainty of each sample pathological image and the spatial correlation of each sample pathological image, and selecting the sample pathological images meeting the preset labeling conditions based on the comprehensive uncertainty of each sample pathological image for labeling until the preset convergence conditions are met. According to the invention, the comprehensive uncertainty is obtained based on the labeling uncertainty, the prior uncertainty and the spatial correlation, and then a part of sample pathological images are selected according to the comprehensive uncertainty for labeling, so that the sample can be accurately labeled with high quality, the labeling amount of the sample is greatly reduced, the training cost of the model is reduced, and the training efficiency and precision of the model are improved.

title: Robot nucleic acid sampling guiding method based on vision
assignee: 珞石（北京）科技有限公司
abstract: The invention provides a robot nucleic acid sampling guiding method based on vision, which comprises the following steps: performing face recognition by using a deep learning model, obtaining a recognition pharynx through model training, and calibrating the relation between camera internal parameters and a robot; a person to be sampled stands at a preset position, and the mechanical arm holds a sampler and is positioned at a waiting position; preprocessing an RGB image, performing compensation and alignment on a depth map, and applying a face recognition model to the processed image to obtain all key points of a face; when the face is judged to be in the designated area and is not blocked, the acquisition can be started, and voice is sent to prompt the person to be detected to have a long mouth; when the system identifies that the mouth of a person to be sampled is enlarged to a specified scale, the pharyngeal position and the facial pose at the moment are recorded, the target pose of the mechanical arm is obtained through calculation, and the robot is guided to start moving to the person to be sampled; and detecting the facial pose of the person to be sampled in real time through a camera, and adjusting the track of the mechanical arm until the sampling is completed.
assignee_clean: 珞石 北京 科技有限公司
primary_assignee: 珞石 北京 科技有限公司

title: Panoramic stitching method, apparatus, and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a panoramic stitching method, an apparatus, and a storage medium. A transformation matrix obtaining method includes: obtaining motion data detected by sensors, wherein the sensors are disposed on a probe used to collect images, and the motion data is used to represent a moving trend of the probe during image collection; inputting the motion data into a pre-trained neural network, to calculate matrix parameters by using the neural network; calculating a transformation matrix by using the matrix parameters, wherein the transformation matrix is used to stitch images collected by the probe, to obtain a panoramic image. In the present disclosure, the transformation matrix can be calculated and the images can be stitched without using characteristics of the images, and factors such as brightness and the characteristics of the images do not impose an impact, thereby improving transformation matrix calculation accuracy, and improving an image stitching effect.

title: Automated document summaries using highlighting
abstract: A computer-implemented method is provided that includes receiving, from a first client device associated with a managed network, a request for a record from a plurality of records that relate to the managed network. A depiction of a first graphical user interface that visually represents part of the record is sent to the first device and a representation of a selected portion of the record, that includes text from the part of the record that was visually represented, is received from the first device. A request for the summary of the record is then received from a second client device associated with the managed network and a depiction of a second graphical user interface that visually represents the summary of the record is transmitted to the second device. The depiction of the second graphical user interface is representative of at least the selected portion.

title: Authentication and access management for heterogeneous sources of anomaly detection data
abstract: The disclosed technology teaches aggregating 3rd-party risk measures during an authentication journey, including providing a risk measure aggregation node, a JSON transform, and a configuration for 3rd-party risk measures to request. Responsive to invocation of the risk measure aggregation node during the authentication journey, the method includes setting a timer for receipt of a configured 3rd-party risk measure, wherein expiration of the timer causes the risk measure aggregation node to stop waiting for a timed-out 3rd party risk measure provider and requesting the configured 3rd-party risk measures. Upon receiving at least some of the requested 3rd-party risk measures, included is applying the JSON transform to aggregate the returned 3rd-party risk measures into an aggregate score, and the risk measure aggregation node providing to another node in the authentication journey an aggregated score taking into account the configured 3rd-party risk measures received prior to expiration of the timer.

title: Automatic security check for missing passenger on ride services
abstract: An apparatus includes a processor and a memory that stores code executable by the processor to transmit a passenger status message in response to a trigger event indicative of a passenger failing to be picked up at a pickup location by a ride service vehicle. The passenger status message is transmitted to a passenger mobile communication device and a driver. The code is executable to transmit a help message to members of a passenger trusted list in response to receiving a reply to the passenger status message from the passenger indicative of a request for help by the passenger. The code is executable to transmit to a police agency a police request to assist the passenger in response to a trusted list timeout, which is indicative of not receiving a message from a member of the passenger trusted list that indicates the passenger is okay before the trusted list timeout.

title: Model matching and learning rate selection for fine tuning
abstract: A method, computer system, and computer program product for model selection for training a new dataset is provided. The present invention may include choosing a model from a set of models to be evaluated for training the new dataset, selecting a sample input from a subset of the new dataset, calculating a model activation score for each of the sample inputs in the chosen model, calculating an accumulated model activation score for the chosen model, depending on the model activation score of each of the sample inputs in the chosen model, calculating an accumulated model activation score for each model from the set of models to be evaluated for training the new dataset, and selecting the model for training the new dataset with the highest accumulated model activation score.

title: Cerebrovascular event automatic identification method and system based on MobileNet
abstract: The invention belongs to the crossing field of computer technology and medical images, and discloses a method and a system for automatically identifying cerebrovascular events based on MobileNet, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring two-dimensional carotid artery initial ultrasonic image data; (2) segmenting the carotid adventitia to obtain ROI image data; (3) constructing a deep learning network based on the MobileNet, and training; (4) and inputting the ROI image data into a trained deep learning network for testing to obtain a prediction result of whether the cerebrovascular event corresponding to the two-dimensional carotid artery initial ultrasonic image data occurs or not, thereby automatically identifying the cerebrovascular event. The invention adopts a deep learning network based on MobileNet, automatically extracts the ultrasonic carotid artery image characteristics by using a deep learning method, automatically identifies the cerebrovascular events, and can effectively solve the problems of strong subjectivity and redundancy of characteristics of manually defined characteristics.

title: Switch terminal with wiring components secured to circuitry wiring without external live points of contact
abstract: A system is provided for controlling a first switch terminal of a building occupied by one or more building occupant. The system includes a plurality of switch terminals at the building. A first computer system is coupled to the first switch terminal or equivalent of the building at a first location of the building. The first computer system runs on at least one platform. A first plurality of sensors is coupled to the first switch terminal and the first computer system. At least a portion of the sensors provide signal data to the first computer system. The first computer system produces a command or data output that relates to at least one of: a command output for a local control system, a command output for a different system, a data output for a different system, a command output for a non-local device or a data output that is a non-local device, each of an output including learned data from that is based on machine intelligence from previous data collected about patterns of a building occupant. A locking mechanism secures wiring components to circuitry wiring without live points of contact.

title: Methods and devices for correlating a biomarker in a non-blood bodily fluid with the biomarker in blood
abstract: Disclosed is a method for correlating a biomarker in a non-blood bodily fluid with the same biomarker in the blood of an individual, including: measuring, in a first period in time, the biomarker in non-blood bodily fluid and measuring the same biomarker in the blood of the same individual to establish an R ratio of [NBBF1]/[BB1], where [NBBF1] is the biomarker concentration in non-blood bodily fluid in the first period in time, and [BB1] is the biomarker concentration in the blood in the first period in time; storing the ratio in a memory; measuring, in a second period in time, the biomarker in non-blood bodily fluid to determine [NBBF2], where [NBBF2] is the biomarker concentration in the non-blood bodily fluid in the second period in time; and correlating the measured [NBBF2] with the R ratio to generate a correlated [BB2] biomarker concentration in the blood of the individual in the second period in time. Also disclosed is a device, apparatus, and method for correlating the glucose concentration in a non-blood bodily fluid such as saliva with the glucose in the blood of an individual.

title: Patient disease prediction control system and method based on Gaussian mixture model
assignee: 武汉科瓴智能科技有限公司
abstract: The invention discloses a patient disease prediction control system and method based on a Gaussian mixture model, wherein the system comprises a data processing module, a cluster analysis module, a classification prediction module, a patient management module and a database; the method comprises the following steps that a data acquisition module pulls customer data from a database and transmits the customer data to a data preprocessing module, and the data preprocessing module cleans, converts and integrates the customer data to extract features from the customer data; the clustering analysis module performs clustering analysis on the customer data by adopting a Gaussian mixture model to obtain the probability of a certain type of diseases of the customer, and performs disease classification and classification according to the probability to obtain a characteristic data set; the classification prediction module acquires a characteristic data set and uses the characteristic data set as a sample training classification model to conduct disease prediction on personal data of unknown customers so as to obtain disease prediction data; the patient management module acquires and manages personal data and disease prediction data of a customer, and sends a prediction result to the client according to the disease prediction data.

title: Product recommendation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on genetic algorithm
assignee: 平安科技（深圳）有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and discloses a product recommendation method, device and equipment based on a genetic algorithm and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data stream information, wherein the data stream information comprises product information and customer information; inputting the data stream information into a pre-trained cash stream prediction model to obtain a prediction result of cash stream data in the data stream information; acquiring a first sample training data set, inputting the first sample training data set into a preset genetic algorithm model for training, and obtaining an investment combination recommendation model; the data flow information and the prediction result are input into the investment portfolio recommendation model, the target recommended product is determined, and the target recommended product is sent to the client terminal, so that the flow direction condition of the cash flow data of the client is accurately predicted, intelligent investment product recommendation for the client is realized, and the accuracy and efficiency of product recommendation are improved. The present invention relates to blockchain techniques, such as writing data streams into blockchains for use in data forensics and other scenarios.

title: Three-dimensional volume data retrieval method based on tree structure topological graph
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional volume data retrieval method based on a tree-structure topological graph, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring a volume data sub-interface, constructing an oriented skeleton tree, performing characteristic representation on a skeleton and a ridge valley of volume data, constructing a tree structure topological graph and performing vector representation on the tree structure topological graph, and realizing the representation of three-dimensional space characteristics of an internal structure of the volume data; step 2, respectively calculating similarity of two volume data of a feature vector based on the directed skeleton tree, a feature vector of the skeleton and a ridge-valley feature vector, and then calculating the similarity of the feature vector based on the tree-structure topological graph; and 3, calculating the similarity among the tree-structure topological graph vectors of different volume data, and finishing the retrieval of the three-dimensional volume data based on the obtained similarity. The invention solves the problem that the three-dimensional space information, the shape information and the topological relation of the volume data are lost by the traditional volume data retrieval method, and can effectively realize the retrieval of the three-dimensional volume data model.

title: Switch terminal system with third party access
abstract: A system is provided for controlling a first switch terminal of a building occupied by one or more building occupant. The system includes a plurality of switch terminals at the building. A first computer system is coupled to the first switch terminal or equivalent of the building at a first location of the building. The first computer system runs on at least one platform. A first plurality of sensors is coupled to the first switch terminal and the first computer system. At least a portion of the sensors provide signal data to the first computer system. The first computer system produces a command or data output that relates to at least one of: a command output for a local control system, a command output for a different system, a data output for a different system, a command output for a non-local device or a data output that is a non-local device. A second switch terminal includes a second plurality of sensors coupled to a second computer system. The system is configured to be coupled with an imaging module at the dwelling. In response to authorization by at least one building occupant the sensing module is configured to provide third party access to at least a portion of the building.

title: On-device network simulation with user data loopback for device testing
abstract: A user equipment (UE) may simulate transmissions received from a BS to perform on-device testing of the UE. For example, the UE may be configured to loopback uplink data from the UL data path and input the uplink data as simulated downlink data for processing in the DL data path. The uplink data may include data related to a video call or network diagnostics. The user application data generated by the application and proceeding through the UL data path may be used to validate the DL data path. Downlink control information (DCI) may be determined by the UE and provided to the DL data path to accompany the uplink data. The DCI may include simulated uplink grants and/or simulated downlink scheduling assignments. The simulated downlink scheduling assignments may be determined based on availability of the uplink data in the UE's memory.

title: Application of metabolic marker group in preparation of kit for predicting epileptic seizure
abstract: The invention relates to the field of epilepsy, in particular to application of a metabolic marker group in preparation of a kit for predicting epileptic seizures. The present invention provides the use of a metabolic marker set comprising L-threonine, homovanillic acid and glycine for the manufacture of a kit for assessing the risk of seizures in a subject who has been diagnosed with seizures and has a predisposition for seizures, said kit comprising a detection reagent for detecting the content of said metabolic marker set in a urine sample of said subject. The invention also provides the metabolic marker group.

title: Apparatus and method for cannulation of vascular access vessel
abstract: An apparatus is provided for rotatable selection of sites for cannulation with a needle along a subcutaneous vascular access vessel. The cannulation site selection apparatus comprises a template having an inner surface and an outer surface, and a plurality of visible markings on the outer surface of the template. The template is adapted to be disposed adjacent the subcutaneous vascular access vessel such that the markings align with the cannulation sites along the vascular access vessel for selecting a site for cannulation with a needle into the vascular access vessel.

title: Medical auxiliary inquiry and rehabilitation guidance follow-up visit device based on artificial intelligence
assignee: 中国医学科学院北京协和医院
abstract: The utility model discloses a medical treatment is assisted to be consulted and recovered guides follow-up visit device based on artificial intelligence, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, inner cavity of the base's right side fixedly connected with motor, the left side fixedly connected with drive bevel gear of motor output end, inner cavity of the base's bottom swing joint has the rotary rod, the fixed cover in bottom on rotary rod surface is equipped with the driven bevel gear who uses with the cooperation of drive bevel gear, the top fixedly connected with standpipe of base. The utility model discloses a set up the base, driven bevel gear, drive bevel gear, the universal wheel, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, the standpipe, the movable sleeve, the machine of diagnosing, the loading board, the reinforcing plate, the opening, the rotary rod, the thread bush, the connecting plate, the mounting panel, the cooperation of threaded rod and system ware is used, the problem that current medical treatment based on artificial intelligence is assisted to diagnose and recovered guide follow-up visit device and be not convenient for the user use has been solved, this medical treatment based on artificial intelligence is assisted to diagnose and recovered guides follow-up visit device, possess the advantage that convenient to use person used.

title: Methods and systems of processing complex data sets using artificial intelligence and deconvolution
abstract: Disclosed herein, are systems and methods for analyzing complex data signals using artificial intelligence and/or deconvolution algorithms to determine output pertaining to the state or status of one or more parameters. Data sets may include signals from various sources that can confound or distort the signals of interest. Accordingly, disclosed herein are deconvolution algorithms that enable the determination of the status of sources that correspond to the signals of interest.

title: Non-rigid registration method of differential homomorphism based on fluid divergence loss
abstract: The invention provides a non-rigid body registration method of differential homomorphism based on fluid divergence loss, which comprises the following steps: superposing the template image f and the image m to be registered along a new dimension; sending the superposed pictures into a u-net neural network layer to generate a mean value mu and a variance sigma of velocity Gaussian distribution which are met by each grid; sampling the speed of the corresponding grid according to the Gaussian distribution of each grid, and integrally forming an Euler speed field; integrating the velocity field to obtain a displacement field phi v (ii) a Will shift the field phi v Inputting the image m to be registered into a space transformation network to obtain a registered image; based on a fluid compression loss function, optimizing by a gradient descent method, and training neural network parameters; after the network parameters are trained, a new image pair to be registered is given, and the step 1-5 is executed to obtain a registered image. The experimental result shows that the invention can obviously inhibit the generation of the local large-divergence velocity field, so that the registered displacement field meets the characteristic of differential homoembryo.

title: Accelerated pharmaceutical repurposing by finding anticorrelations and by text mining
abstract: Utilizing a computing device to assist in repurposing of a pharmaceutical. An identification of a pharmaceutical for repurposing study is received by a computing device. A pharmaceutical expression signature is retrieved based upon the identification of the pharmaceutical, the pharmaceutical expression signature indicating differential expressions of a plurality of biomolecules regulated by the pharmaceutical. A plurality of disease expression signatures are retrieved from a disease omics database, each disease expression signature indicating differential expressions of a plurality of biomolecules affected by a disease. A pharmaceutical vector is generated based upon the pharmaceutical expression signature for the pharmaceutical. A plurality of disease vectors are generated based upon the plurality of disease expression signatures for each disease. N hypotheses correlating the pharmaceutical vector and one or more of the plurality of disease vectors are generated, each hypothesis indicating a potential repurposing for the pharmaceutical to treat the disease.

title: Urinary sediment visible component detection method and system based on lensless microscopic imaging
abstract: The invention discloses a urinary sediment visible component detection method and system based on lensless microscopic imaging, the method adopts lensless microscopic imaging to replace a traditional optical microscope, and simplifies lighting and imaging light paths, so that the size of microscopic equipment is miniaturized, the weight is light, the cost is low, the operation is simple, and the medical cost is further saved; the method adopts an artificial intelligence algorithm to carry out phase recovery and super-resolution reconstruction on the holographic intensity image acquired by the lens-free microscopic imaging, realizes the microscopic imaging with wide field of view and ultrahigh resolution, greatly shortens the time of the microscopic imaging, improves the imaging speed of the microscope, improves the imaging quality of the microscope, and can be applied to clinical medical examination. In addition, the invention adopts a deep neural network to concentrate the detection, the segmentation and the identification of the urinary sediment tangible components in one model for multi-task learning, and realizes the full-automatic end-to-end detection, the segmentation and the identification of the urinary sediment tangible components.

title: Intelligent control device, method, system and medium for zirconia powder production
assignee: 金业新材料科技(昆山)有限公司
abstract: The embodiment of the specification provides an intelligent control device, method, system and medium for zirconia powder production. The device comprises: a reactor configured to process a production raw material for producing zirconia powder to obtain a reaction slurry; the filter-pressing scrubber is configured to filter-press and wash the reaction slurry to obtain a slurry cake and filtrate; a chloride ion detector configured to detect chloride ions from the filtrate to obtain chloride ion concentration; the calciner is configured to calcine the target slurry cake to obtain precursor powder; a pulverizer configured to pulverize the precursor powder to obtain zirconia powder; and the processor is configured to control the filter-press washer to repeatedly filter and wash the pulp cake under the condition that the chloride ion concentration is greater than or equal to a preset threshold value until the chloride ion concentration of the filtrate is less than the preset threshold value, and determine the pulp cake as a target pulp cake.

title: Neck rotation recognition method and system
assignee: 广西壮族自治区人民医院
abstract: The invention discloses a neck rotation identification method and system, and belongs to the three-dimensional identification technology. The invention designs a UV location map, which is a 2D image of the 3D coordinates of a complete facial point cloud, while preserving semantics at each UV location. A simple encoder-decoder network with weighting penalties is then trained, which puts more effort on the more discriminative feature areas to return the UV location map from the single 2D face image.

title: Image labeling method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment
assignee: 沈阳东软智能医疗科技研究院有限公司
abstract: The disclosure relates to an image labeling method, an image labeling device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be marked, executing a feature detection step on a first image and a second image to select a first number of first feature points from the first image, selecting a second number of second feature points from the second image, respectively matching the first number of first feature points and the second number of second feature points with the image to be marked to obtain a third feature point in the image to be marked, determining marking feature points according to the third feature point and the image to be marked, determining a region to be marked in the image to be marked according to the marking feature points, and marking the region to be marked. According to the method and the device, the region to be marked is automatically marked in the image to be marked through the marked first image and second image, each layer of section of the three-dimensional scanning image is not required to be marked manually layer by layer, marking efficiency is improved, and marking cost is reduced.
